kikuyu: Bilowgii Ilaah samada iyo dhulkuu abuuray.
english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

kikuyu: Dhulkuna qaab ma lahayn, wuuna madhnaa; gudcurna moolkuu dul joogay; oo Ruuxa Ilaahna wuxuu ka dul dhaqdhaqaaqayay biyaha.
english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu yidhi, Iftiin ha ahaado: iftiin baana ahaaday.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu arkay iftiinkii inuu wanaagsan yahay: Ilaahna iftiinkii ayuu ka soocay gudcurkii.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

kikuyu: Ilaahna iftiinkii wuxuu u bixiyey Maalin, gudcurkiina wuxuu u bixiyey Habeen. Waxaana jiray fiid iyo subax, isla maalin ah.
english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu yidhi, Meel bannaani ha noqoto biyaha dhexdooda, oo iyadu biyaha ha ka soocdo biyaha.
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Ilaah sameeyey meeshii bannaanka ahayd, oo wuxuu biyihii bannaanka ka hooseeyey ka soocay kuwii bannaanka ka sarreeyey; sidaasayna ahaatay.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

kikuyu: Ilaahna bannaankii wuxuu u bixiyey Samo. Waxaana jiray fiid iyo subax, maalintii labaad.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu yidhi, Biyaha samada ka hooseeya meel ha isugu soo urureen, oo ciidda engegani ha muuqato; sidaasayna ahaatay.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Ilaah ciiddii engegnayd u bixiyey Dhul; ururkii biyahana wuxuu u bixiyey Bado: oo Ilaah wuxuu arkay in taasu wanaagsan tahay.
english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu yidhi, Dhulku ha soo bixiyo doog, iyo geedo yaryar oo iniino dhala, iyo geedo waaweyn oo midho caynkooda ah dhala, oo iniinahoodu ku dhex jiraan, oo dhulka ku kor yaal; sidaasayna ahaatay.
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Dhulkiina wuxuu soo bixiyey doog, iyo geedo yaryar oo leh iniino caynkooda ah, iyo geedo waaweyn oo midho dhala, oo iniinahoodu ku dhex jiraan, iyagoo caynkooda ah, Ilaahna wuxuu arkay in taasu wanaagsan tahay.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Waxaana jiray fiid iyo subax, maalintii saddexaad.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu yidhi, Iftiimmo ha ahaadeen meesha bannaan oo samada dhex ah si ay u kala soocaan maalinta iyo habeenka; oo ha u ahaadeen calaamooyin, iyo xilliyo, iyo maalmo iyo sannado;
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

kikuyu: oo iftiimmo ha u noqdeen meeshii bannaanayd oo samada dhex ahayd si ay u iftiimiyaan dhulka dushiisa; sidaasayna ahaatay.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu sameeyey labada iftiin ee waaweyn; si uu iftiinka weynu u xukumo maalinta, iftiinka yaruna u xukumo habeenka; oo xiddigahana wuu sameeyey.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu iyaga dhigay meeshii bannaanayd oo samada dhex ahayd si ay dhulka u iftiimiyaan,
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

kikuyu: oo ay u xukumaan maalinta iyo habeenka, oo ay iftiinka uga soocaan gudcurka, Ilaahna wuxuu arkay in taasu wanaagsan tahay.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Oo waxaana jiray fiid iyo subax, maalintii afraad.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu yidhi, Biyuhu aad ha u soo bixiyeen uun dhaqdhaqaaqa oo badan, oo naf nool leh, haadduna ha duusho dhulka dushiisa xagga meeshii bannaanayd oo samada dhex ahayd.
english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu abuuray nibiriyada badda oo waaweyn, iyo uun kasta oo nool oo dhaqdhaqaaqa, ee biyuhu aad u soo bixiyeen iyagoo badan, oo caynkooda oo kale dhala, iyo haad kasta oo caynkiisa dhala; Ilaahna wuxuu arkay in taasu wanaagsan tahay.
english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah baa barakeeyey iyaga, isagoo leh, Wax badan dhala, oo tarma, oo biyaha badaha ka buuxsama, haadduna ha ku tarmeen dhulka.
english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo waxaana jiray fiid iyo subax, maalintii shanaad.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu yidhi, Dhulku ha soo bixiyo uun nool oo caynkiisa dhala, kuwaasoo ah xoolo, iyo waxa gurguurta, iyo dugaagga dhulka oo caynkooda dhala; sidaasayna ahaatay.
english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu sameeyey dugaagga dhulka oo caynkiisa dhala, iyo xoolo caynkooda dhala, iyo wax kasta oo dhulka gurguurta oo caynkiisa dhala; Ilaahna wuxuu arkay in taasu wanaagsan tahay.
english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu yidhi, Aan nin inoo eg ka samayno araggeenna, oo iyagu ha xukumeen kalluunka badda, iyo haadda hawada, iyo xoolaha, iyo dhulka oo dhan, iyo waxa dhulka gurguurta oo dhan.
english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah nin buu ka abuuray araggiisa, Ilaah araggiisa ayuu ka abuuray isaga; lab iyo dhaddig ayuu abuuray.
english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah waa barakeeyey iyaga; oo Ilaah wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Wax badan dhala oo tarma, oo dhulka ka buuxsama, oo ka sara mara dhulka, oo xukuma kalluunka badda, iyo haadda hawada, iyo wax kasta oo nool oo dhulka kor dhaqdhaqaaqa.
english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu yidhi, Bal eeg, waxaan idin siiyey geed kasta oo yar oo iniino dhala, oo ku yaal dhulka dushiisa oo dhan, iyo geed kasta oo weyn, kaasoo midho leh, iniinona dhala; oo waxay idiin noqon doonaan cunto;
english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

kikuyu: oo dugaag kasta oo dhulka jooga, iyo haad kasta oo hawada duula, iyo wax kasta oo dhulka gurguurta, oo naf nool leh ayaan geed kasta oo cagaar ah cunto u siiyey; sidaasayna ahaatay.
english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu arkay wax kasta oo uu sameeyey, oo bal eeg, aad bay u wanaagsanaayeen. Waxaana jiray fiid iyo subax, maalintii lixaad.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

kikuyu: Samada iyo dhulkuna way dhammaadeen, iyo waxa badan ee ku jira oo dhammuba.
english: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

kikuyu: Maalintii toddobaadna Ilaah wuu dhammeeyey shuqulkiisii uu sameeyey; oo maalintii toddobaad ayuu ka nastay shuqulkiisii uu sameeyey oo dhanba.
english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuu barakeeyey maalintii toddobaad, quduusna wuu ka dhigay; maxaa yeelay, maalintaas ayaa Ilaah ka nastay shuqulkiisii uu sameeyey ee ahaa abuuridda oo dhan.
english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa bilowgii samada iyo dhulka kolkii la abuuray iyaga, maalintii Rabbiga Ilaah ahu sameeyey dhulka iyo samada.
english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

kikuyu: Dhirta duurkuna weli kuma ay oollin dhulka, geedaha yaryar oo duurkuna weli sooma ay bixin: waayo, Rabbiga Ilaah ahu dhulka roob kuma soo dayn, nin dhulka beeraana ma jirin;
english: No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

kikuyu: laakiin ceeryaamo baa dhulka kor uga soo bixi jirtay, oo waraabin jirtay dhulka dushiisa oo dhan.
english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaah ahuna nin buu ka sameeyey ciidda dhulka, dulalka sankiisana wuxuu kaga afuufay neeftii nolosha; ninkiina wuxuu noqday naf nool.
english: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaah ahu beer buu ka beeray xagga bari ee Ceeden; oo halkaasuuna geeyey ninkii uu sameeyey.
english: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaah ahuna wuxuu dhulka ka soo bixiyey geed kasta oo indhaha u roon, oo cunto ku wanaagsan; beerta dhexdeedana wuxuu ka soo bixiyey geedkii nolosha iyo geedkii aqoonta wanaagga iyo xumaanta.
english: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

kikuyu: Ceedenna webi baa ka baxay inuu beerta waraabiyo; halkaasuuna ku kala qaybsamay, wuxuuna noqday afar madax.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

kikuyu: Kan kowaad magiciisu wuxuu ahaa Fiishoon: kaasu waa kan ku wareegsan dhulka Xawiilaah oo dhan, meeshaas oo dahab leh;
english: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

kikuyu: oo dahabka dhulkaasu waa wanaagsan yahay: oo meeshaasuna waxay leedahay beduliyum iyo dhagaxyo onika la yidhaahdo.
english: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

kikuyu: Webiga labaad magiciisuna waa Giixoon: kaasuna waa kan ku wareegsan dhulka Kuush oo dhan.
english: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

kikuyu: Webiga saddexaad magiciisuna waa Xiddeqel: kaasu waa kan Ashuur dhankeeda bari mara. Webiga afraadna waa Yufraad.
english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaah ahuna ninkii wuu kaxeeyey oo wuxuu geeyey beer Ceeden inuu falo oo dhawro.
english: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaah ahuna wuxuu ninkii ku amray isagoo leh, Geed kasta oo beerta ku yaal wax baad ka cuni kartaa:
english: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

kikuyu: laakiin geedka aqoonta wanaagga iyo xumaanta waa inaanad waxba ka cunin: waayo, maalintii aad wax ka cuntid hubaal waad dhiman doontaa.
english: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaah ahu wuxuu yidhi, Ma wanaagsana in ninku keligiis ahaado; waxaan u samayn doonaa mid caawisa oo ku habboon.
english: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaah ahuna wuxuu ciidda ka sameeyey dugaag kasta oo duurka jooga, iyo haad kasta oo hawada duula; oo iyagii wuxuu u keenay ninkii, inuu arko wuxuu u bixiyo; oo wax kastoo ninkii u bixiyey uun kasta oo nool ayaa magiciisii noqday.
english: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

kikuyu: Oo ninkii baa magacyo u bixiyey xoolaha oo dhan, iyo haadda hawada, iyo dugaag kasta oo duurka jooga, laakiin ninkii looma helin mid caawisa oo ku habboon.
english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaah ahu hurdo weyn buu ku riday ninkii, kolkaasuu gam'ay; kolkaasuu wuxuu ka bixiyey feedhihiisii middood, meesheediina hilib buu ku awday.
english: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

kikuyu: Oo feedhii Rabbiga Ilaah ahu ka bixiyey ninka ayuu naag ka sameeyey, oo wuxuu iyadii u keenay ninkii.
english: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

kikuyu: Ninkiina wuxuu yidhi, Tanu hadda waa laf ka mid ah lafahayga, iyo hilib ka mid ah hilibkayga: waxaa iyada loogu yeedhi doonaa Naag, maxaa yeelay, iyada waxaa laga soo saaray Nin.
english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed nin wuxuu ka tegayaa aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis, wuxuuna la joogayaa naagtiisa: oo waxay noqonayaan isku jidh.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

kikuyu: Oo labadooduba way qaawanaayeen, ninka iyo naagtiisuba, mana ay xishoonaynin.
english: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

kikuyu: Haddaba abeesadu way ugu khiyaano badnayd bahal kasta ee duurka jooga oo Rabbiga Ilaah ahu sameeyey. Oo waxay naagtii ku tidhi, Ilaah miyuu idinku yidhi, Waa inaydnaan waxba ka cunin geed kasta oo beerta ku yaal?
english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

kikuyu: Naagtiina waxay abeesadii ku tidhi, Midhaha geedaha beerta waannu cuni karnaa;
english: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

kikuyu: laakiinse midhaha geedka beerta dhexdeeda ku yaal, Ilaah wuxuu nagu yidhi, Waa inaydnaan waxba ka cunin, ama aydnaan taaban, yeydnan dhimanine.
english: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

kikuyu: Abeesadiina waxay naagtii ku tidhi, Ma dhiman doontaan;
english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

kikuyu: waayo, Ilaah wuxuu og yahay in maalinta aad cuntaan ay indhihiinnu furmi doonaan, oo aad noqon doontaan sida Ilaah oo kale, idinkoo kala garanaya wanaagga iyo xumaanta.
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

kikuyu: Oo markii naagtii aragtay in geedkii cunto ku wanaagsan yahay, oo indhaha u roon yahay, oo uu yahay geed caqli lagu yeesho, ayay midho ka qaadatay, oo cuntay; ninkeedii la joogayna wax bay ka siisay, oo isagiina wuu cunay.
english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

kikuyu: Oo labadoodiiba indhahoodii way furmeen, oo waxay garteen inay qaawan yihiin; waxayna isku tosheen caleemo berde, oo ay gunti ka samaysteen.
english: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

kikuyu: Oo waxay maqleen codkii Rabbiga Ilaaha ah, isagoo beerta dhex socda kolkii maalintu qaboobayd: oo ninkii iyo naagtiisii way iska qariyeen Ilaah, oo waxay ku dhuunteen geedihii beerta dhexdooda.
english: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaah ahu wuu u yeedhay ninkii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Xaggee baad joogtaa?
english: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

kikuyu: Isagiina wuxuu yidhi, Codkaagaan beerta ka dhex maqlay, waanan cabsaday, maxaa yeelay, waan qaawanaa; oo waan isqariyey.
english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ku yidhi, Yaa kuu sheegay inaad qaawan tahay? Miyaad wax ka cuntay geedkii aan kugu amray inaadan wax ka cunin?
english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

kikuyu: Ninkiina wuxuu yidhi, Naagtii aad i siisay inay ila joogto ayaa geedkii wax iga siisay, oo anna waan cunay.
english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaah ahu wuxuu naagtii ku yidhi, Waa maxay waxan aad samaysay? Naagtiina waxay tidhi, Abeesadaa i khiyaanaysay oo anna waan cunay.
english: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaah ahu wuxuu abeesadii ku yidhi, Waxan aad samaysay aawadiis waad ka habaaran tahay xoolaha oo dhan, iyo dugaag kasta oo duurka jooga; waxaanad ku socon doontaa boggaaga, ciid baanad cuni doontaa maalmaha cimrigaaga oo dhan:
english: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

kikuyu: oo colaad baan idin dhex dhigi doonaa adiga iyo naagta, iyo farcankaaga iyo farcankeeda; oo madaxaaguu burburin doonaa, adiguna cedhibtiisaad burburin doontaa.
english: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

kikuyu: Naagtiina wuxuu ku yidhi, Dhibtaada iyo wallacaaga aad baan u badin doonaa; oo dhib baad carruur ku dhali doontaa; oo waxay doonistaadu ahaan doontaa ninkaaga, wuuna kuu talin doonaa.
english: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

kikuyu: Aadanna wuxuu ku yidhi, Codkii naagtaadaad maqashay oo waxaad wax ka cuntay geedkii aan kugu amray, anigoo leh, Waa inaadan waxba ka cunin, sidaas daraaddeed dhulku waa habaaran yahay adiga aawadaa; maalmaha cimrigaaga oo dhanna dhibaataad wax kaga cuni doontaa.
english: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Qodxan iyo yamaarugna waa kaaga soo bixi doonaan, waxaanad cuni doontaa geedaha yaryar oo duurka.
english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

kikuyu: Wejigaagoo dhididsan baad wax cuni doontaa, ilaa aad dhulka ku noqotid; maxaa yeelay, dhulkaa lagaa qaaday; waayo, ciid baad tahay, ciid baadna ku noqon doontaa.
english: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”

kikuyu: Ninkiina wuxuu naagtiisii u bixiyey Xaawa, maxaa yeelay, waxay ahayd hooyadii waxa nool oo dhan.
english: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaah ahuna wuxuu Aadan iyo naagtiisii u sameeyey dhar harag ah, wuuna u xidhay iyagii.
english: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaah ahuna wuxuu yidhi, Ninku wuxuu noqday sidii mid innaga mid ah, isagoo garanaya wanaagga iyo xumaanta; oo haatan, waaba intaasoo uu gacantiisa soo fidiyaa, oo uu wax ka qaataa geedka nolosha, oo uu cunaa oo uu weligiis noolaadaa:
english: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

kikuyu: sidaas daraaddeed Ilaah isaga wuu ka saaray Beer Ceeden, si uu u beerto dhulkii isaga laga soo qaaday.
english: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ninkii eryay; Beer Ceeden barigeedana wuxuu taagay Keruubiim, iyo seef ololaysa, oo dhan walba u jeesanaysa, si ay u dhawrto jidka geedka nolosha.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

kikuyu: Ninkiina naagtiisii Xaawa ahayd buu u tegey; wayna uuraysatay, oo Qaabiil bay dhashay, oo waxay tidhi, Wiil baan ku helay Rabbiga caawimaaddiisa.
english: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”

kikuyu: Dabadeedna waxay dhashay walaalkiis Haabiil. Haabiilna wuxuu ahaa adhijir, laakiin Qaabiil wuxuu ahaa beerfale.
english: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

kikuyu: Maalmo dabadeed waxay noqotay in Qaabiil qurbaan ahaan Rabbiga ugu keenay midhihii dhulka.
english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.

kikuyu: Haabiilna wuxuu wax uga keenay curadyadii adhigiisa iyo baruurtoodiiba. Rabbiguna wuu eegay Haabiil iyo qurbaankiisii;
english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,

kikuyu: laakiinse Qaabiil iyo qurbaankiisii Rabbigu ma uu eegin. Qaabiilna aad buu u cadhooday, wejigiisiina wuu madoobaaday.
english: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu ku yidhi Qaabiil, Maxaad u cadhoonaysaa? Maxaase wejigaagu u madoobaaday?
english: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

kikuyu: Haddaad wax wanaagsan samaysid, sow laguma aqbaleen? Haddaadan wax wanaagsan samaynse, dembi illinkuu kuugu gabbanayaa; doonistiisuna aday noqon doontaa, adiguna waa inaad xukuntid isaga.
english: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

kikuyu: Qaabiilna wuxuu ku yidhi walaalkiis Haabiil, Ina keen, aynu duurka tagnee. Waxaana dhacday, markii ay duurka joogeen, in Qaabiil walaalkiis Haabiil ku kacay oo dilay isagii.
english: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu Qaabiil ku yidhi, Walaalkaa Haabiil meeh? Kolkaasuu yidhi, Ma aqaan: ma anigaa ah walaalkay ilaaliyihiisa?
english: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ilaah ku yidhi, Maxaad samaysay? Codkii dhiiggii walaalkaa ayaa dhulka iiga dhawaaqayaye.
english: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

kikuyu: Oo haatan waad ka habaaran tahay dhulkii afkiisa u kala qaaday si uu dhiiggii walaalkaa gacantaada uga helo.
english: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

kikuyu: Kolkii aad dhulka beeratid, wax badan kuuma dhali doono. Waxaad dhulka ku noqon doontaa mid carcarara oo warwareega.
english: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

kikuyu: Qaabiilna wuxuu Rabbiga ku yidhi, Taqsiirtaydu waa ka sii badan tahay wax aan qaadi karo.
english: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, maanta dhulkaad iga eriday, wejigaagana waan ka qarsoonaan doonaa, waxaanan dhulka ku noqon doonaa mid carcarara oo warwareega; waxaana dhici doonta in kii i arkaaba i dili doono.
english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu ku yidhi isagii, Sidaas daraaddeed ku alla kii dila Qaabiil, waxaa looga aargudan doonaa toddoba labanlaab. Rabbiguna calaamad buu u sameeyey Qaabiil, si aanu ku alla kii arkaaba u dilin.
english: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

kikuyu: Qaabiilna Rabbiga hortiisuu ka tegey, oo wuxuu degay dalkii la odhan jiray Nood, oo xagga bari oo Ceeden ku yiil.
english: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

kikuyu: Qaabiilna naagtiisuu u tegey; wayna uuraysatay, oo waxay dhashay Enoog. Wuxuuna dhisay magaalo, oo magaaladiina wuxuu ku magacaabay magicii wiilkiisii Enoog.
english: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

kikuyu: Enoogna waxaa u dhashay Ciiraad, Ciiraadna wuxuu dhalay Mexuuya'el, Mexuuya'elna wuxuu dhalay Metuusha'el, Metuusha'elna wuxuu dhalay Lameg.
english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

kikuyu: Lamegna wuxuu guursaday laba naagood; mid magaceedu wuxuu ahaa Caadah, tan kalena magaceedu wuxuu ahaa Sillah.
english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

kikuyu: Caadahna waxay dhashay Yaabaal: isna wuxuu ahaa aabbihii kuwa teendhooyinka deggan oo xoolaha leh.
english: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

kikuyu: Magaca walaalkiisna wuxuu ahaa Yuubaal; isna wuxuu ahaa aabbihii kuwa kataaradda iyo biibiilaha garaaca.
english: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

kikuyu: Sillahna waxay dhashay Tuubalqayin oo ahaa mid tumi jiray alaabtii naxaasta iyo birta ahayd oo dhan; Tuubalqayin walaashiisna waxay ahayd Nacmah.
english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

kikuyu: Lamegna wuxuu naagihiisii ku yidhi: Caadah iyo Sillahay, codkayga maqla; Lameg naagihiisow, hadalkayga dhegaysta; Nin baan u dilay dhaawicid uu i dhaawacay aawadeed, Iyo nin dhallinyar dhufashadii uu wax igu dhuftay aawadeed.
english: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

kikuyu: Haddii Qaabiil toddoba labanlaab looga aargudan lahaa, Runtii Lameg waa in toddoba iyo toddobaatan labanlaab looga aar gutaa.
english: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

kikuyu: Aadanna naagtiisii mar kale ayuu u tegey; waxayna dhashay wiil, magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Seed, iyadoo leh, Ilaah abuur kaluu ii soo dhigay Haabiil meeshiisii; waayo, Qaabiil baa dilay isagii.
english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

kikuyu: Seedna waxaa u dhashay wiil, magiciisiina wuxuu u bixiyey Enoos; markaasaa dadkii waxay bilaabeen inay Rabbiga ku baryaan magiciisa.
english: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Kanu waa buuggii farcankii Aadan. Maalintii Ilaah ninkii abuuray, ekaanta Ilaah buu ka sameeyey isagii;
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

kikuyu: wuxuu abuuray iyagoo lab iyo dhaddig ah; wuuna barakeeyey iyagii, magacoodiina wuxuu u bixiyey Aadan maalintii iyagii la abuuray.
english: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

kikuyu: Aadanna wuxuu jiray boqol iyo soddon sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay wiil isagii u eg oo araggiisii leh; magiciisiina wuxuu u bixiyey Seed.
english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

kikuyu: Aadanna markuu Seed dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa siddeed boqol oo sannadood; wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Aadan noolaa oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa sagaal boqol iyo soddon sannadood; dabadeedna wuu dhintay.
english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

kikuyu: Seedna wuxuu jiray boqol iyo shan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Enoos.
english: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

kikuyu: Seedna markuu Enoos dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa siddeed boqol iyo toddoba sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Seed noolaa oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa sagaal boqol iyo laba iyo toban sannadood; dabadeedna wuu dhintay.
english: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

kikuyu: Enoosna wuxuu jiray sagaashan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Qaynaan.
english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

kikuyu: Enoosna markuu Qaynaan dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa siddeed boqol iyo shan iyo toban sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Enoos noolaa oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa sagaal boqol iyo shan sannadood; dabadeedna wuu dhintay.
english: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

kikuyu: Qaynaanna wuxuu jiray toddobaatan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Mahalale'el.
english: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

kikuyu: Qaynaanna markuu Mahalale'el dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa siddeed boqol iyo afartan sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Qaynaan noolaa oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa sagaal boqol iyo toban sannadood, dabadeedna wuu dhintay.
english: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

kikuyu: Mahalale'elna wuxuu jiray shan iyo lixdan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Yaared.
english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

kikuyu: Mahalale'elna markuu Yaared dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa siddeed boqol iyo soddon sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Mahalale'el noolaa oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa siddeed boqol iyo shan iyo sagaashan sannadood, dabadeedna wuu dhintay.
english: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

kikuyu: Yaaredna wuxuu jiray boqol iyo laba iyo lixdan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Enoog.
english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

kikuyu: Yaaredna markuu Enoog dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa siddeed boqol oo sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Yaared noolaa oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa sagaal boqol iyo laba iyo lixdan sannadood; wuuna dhintay.
english: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

kikuyu: Enoogna wuxuu jiray shan iyo lixdan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Metushelax.
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

kikuyu: Enoogna wuxuu la socday Ilaah saddex boqol oo sannadood markuu Metushelax dhalay ka dib, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Enoog jiray oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa saddex boqol iyo shan iyo lixdan sannadood.
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

kikuyu: Enoogna Ilaah buu la socday; waana la waayay; maxaa yeelay, Ilaah baa qaatay isagii.
english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

kikuyu: Metushelaxna wuxuu jiray boqol iyo toddoba iyo siddeetan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Lameg.
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

kikuyu: Metushelaxna wuxuu noolaa markuu Lameg dhalay ka dib toddoba boqol iyo laba iyo siddeetan sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Metushelax noolaa oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa sagaal boqol iyo sagaal iyo lixdan sannadood; dabadeedna wuu dhintay.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

kikuyu: Lamegna wuxuu jiray boqol iyo laba iyo siddeetan sannadood; wuxuuna dhalay wiil:
english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

kikuyu: magiciisiina wuxuu u bixiyey Nuux, isagoo leh, Kanu waa inooga raaxayn doonaa shuqulkeenna iyo hawsha gacmaheenna, xagga dhulka Ilaah habaaray.
english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

kikuyu: Lamegna markuu Nuux dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa shan boqol iyo shan iyo sagaashan sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Lameg noolaa oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa toddoba boqol iyo toddoba iyo toddobaatan sannadood; dabadeedna wuu dhintay.
english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

kikuyu: Nuuxna wuxuu jiray shan boqol oo sannadood; wuxuuna dhalay Sheem, iyo Xaam, iyo Yaafed.
english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Waxayna noqotay, markii ay bilaabatay in dadku ku bataan dhulka oo ay gabdho u dhashaan,
english: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

kikuyu: in wiilashii Ilaah arkeen gabdhihii dadku inay wanaagsan yihiin, oo ay guursadeen in alla intay doorteen oo dhan.
english: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu yidhi, Ruuxaygu lama sii dagaallami doono dadka weligiis, maxaa yeelay, isagu waa jidh, laakiinse cimrigiisu wuxuu noqon doonaa boqol iyo labaatan sannadood.
english: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

kikuyu: Waagaas waxaa dhulka joogay dad waaweyn oo xoog badan, taas ka dibna kolkii wiilashii Ilaah u yimaadeen gabdhihii dadka, oo ay carruur u dhaleen, isla kuwaas waxay ahaayeen nimankii xoogga badnaa oo waagii hore ahaa raggii caanka ahaa.
english: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu arkay in dadka sharkiisu ku badan yahay dhulka, iyo in male kasta oo fikirrada qalbigiisu ay shar keliya yihiin had iyo goorba.
english: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu ka qoomamooday abuuriddii uu dadka ku abuuray dhulka, wuuna caloolxumaaday.
english: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan dhulka ka baabbi'in doonaa dadkii aan abuuray; dadka, iyo weliba dugaagga, iyo waxa gurguurta, iyo haadda hawada; maxaa yeelay, waan ka qoomamooday samayntii aan sameeyey iyaga.
english: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Rabbigu Nuux raalli buu ka ahaa.
english: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa farcankii Nuux. Nuux wuxuu ahaa nin xaq ah, oo ku eed la' farcankiisii; Nuuxna Ilaah buu la socon jiray.
english: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

kikuyu: Oo Nuux wuxuu dhalay saddex wiil oo ahaa Sheem, iyo Xaam iyo Yaafed.
english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Dhulkuna wuu kharribnaa Ilaah hortiisa, dhulkana dulmi baa ka buuxsamay.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu arkay dhulka, oo bal eeg, wuu kharribnaa; waayo, intii jidh lahayd oo dhammu jidkooday ku kharribeen dhulka.
english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu Nuux ku yidhi, Intii jidh leh oo dhan dhammaadkoodii aan dhammayn lahaa ayaa gaadhay; waayo, dhulkii waxaa ka buuxsamay dulmi iyaga ka yimid, oo bal eeg, iyagaan dhulka la baabbi'in doonaa.
english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

kikuyu: Doonni ka samayso qoryo gofer ah; qowladana ka dhex samee doonnida, daamurna ka mari dusha iyo hoostaba.
english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

kikuyu: Waa inaad sidatan u samaysid iyada: doonnida dhererkeeda waxaad ka dhigtaa saddex boqol oo dhudhun, ballaadhkeedana waxaad ka dhigtaa konton dhudhun, sarajooggeedana waxaad ka dhigtaa soddon dhudhun.
english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

kikuyu: Waa inaad dariishadna u samaysid doonnida, oo waxaad ku dhammaysaa in dhudhun ah ilaa xaggeeda sare, albaabka doonnidana dhinaca ka samee, dabaqad hoose, iyo tu labaad, iyo tu saddexaadna u samee iyada.
english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, anigu daad biyo ah baan ku soo dayn dhulka, inaan baabbi'iyo inta jidhka leh oo dhan oo neefta noloshu ku jirto, inta samada ka hoosaysa; wax kasta oo dhulka joogaaba way dhiman doonaan.
english: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is on the earth will die.

kikuyu: Laakiin axdigayga adigaan kula dhigan doonaa; oo doonnidaad soo geli doontaan, adiga, iyo wiilashaada, iyo naagtaada, iyo naagaha wiilashaada ee kula jiraba.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

kikuyu: Oo wax kasta oo nool oo jidh leh waa inaad cayn walba laba ka soo gelisaa doonnida, si ay kuula sii noolaadaan; waana inay ahaadaan lab iyo dhaddig.
english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

kikuyu: Haadda caynkooda, iyo xoolaha caynkooda, iyo wax kasta oo dhulka gurguurta caynkooda, cayn walba laba ka mid ihi ha kuu soo galeen, si ay u sii noolaadaan.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

kikuyu: Cuntada la cuno oo dhanna qaado, oo kulligeed ururso oo waxay idiin noqon doontaa cunto, adiga iyo iyagaba.
english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

kikuyu: Sidaasuu Nuux sameeyey; wax kasta sidii Ilaah ugu amray buu u sameeyey.
english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu Nuux ku yidhi, Adiga iyo dadka gurigaaguba soo gala doonnida; waayo, waxaan arkay adigoo qarnigan xaq ku ah hortayda.
english: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

kikuyu: Xoolaha daahirka ah toddoba iyo toddoba ka qaad, ku lab iyo dhaddiggiis; xoolaha aan daahirka ahaynna laba ka qaad, ku lab iyo dhaddiggiis;
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

kikuyu: haadda hawadana toddoba iyo toddoba ka qaad, lab iyo dhaddig: si farcan ugu sii noolaado dhulka dushiisa oo dhan.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa weli hadhay toddoba maalmood, dabadeedna afartan maalmood iyo afartan habeen ayaan roob ku soo dayn dhulka; oo wax kasta oo nool oo aan sameeyey waan ka baabbi'in doonaa dhulka dushiisa.
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

kikuyu: Nuuxna wax kasta sidii Rabbigu ugu amray ayuu u sameeyey.
english: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.

kikuyu: Nuuxna wuxuu jiray lix boqol oo sannadood markii daadka biyuhu dhulka dul joogay.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

kikuyu: Nuuxna doonniduu galay, isagii iyo wiilashiisii iyo naagtiisii, iyo naagihii wiilashiisii ee la jiray oo dhan, waxayna ka soo galeen biyihii daadka.
english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

kikuyu: Xoolihii daahirka ahaa, iyo xoolihii aan daahirka ahayn, iyo haaddii iyo wax kasta oo dhulka gurguurtaba
english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

kikuyu: Nuux bay laba laba ugu galeen doonnidii, lab iyo dhaddig, sidii Ilaah ugu amray Nuux.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

kikuyu: Waxaana dhacday, in toddobadii maalmood dabadeed, ay biyihii daadka ahaa dhulka dul joogeen.
english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

kikuyu: Sannaddii uu Nuux lix boqol oo sannadood jiray, bisheedii labaad, maalintii toddoba iyo tobnaad oo bisha, isla maalintaas ayaa ilihii moolka weyn biyo ka buqdeen, dariishadihii samadana la furay.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

kikuyu: Roobkuna wuxuu dhulka ku da'ayay afartan maalmood iyo afartan habeen.
english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Isla maalintaas Nuux wuxuu galay doonnidii, isagii iyo Sheem, iyo Xaam, iyo Yaafed, oo ahaa wiilashii Nuux, iyo naagtii Nuux, iyo saddexdii naagood oo wiilashiisa ee la jiray;
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

kikuyu: iyagii, iyo dugaag kasta caynkiisa, iyo xoolo kasta caynkooda, iyo wax kasta oo dhulka gurguurta caynkooda, iyo haad kasta caynkiisa, iyo shimbir kasta oo cayn kasta ah.
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

kikuyu: Wax kasta oo jidh leh oo neefta noloshu ku jirtaba Nuux bay laba laba ugu galeen doonnidii.
english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii galay waxay ahaayeen lab iyo dhaddig oo wax kasta oo jidh leh, sidii Ilaah ku amray isagii: oo Ilaahna waa ku xidhay isagii.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.

kikuyu: Daadkiina afartan maalmood buu dhulka dul joogay; biyihiina way sii kordheen, oo doonnidii bay kor u qaadeen, oo waxaa iyadii kor looga qaaday dhulka.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

kikuyu: Biyihiina way xoogaysteen, oo dhulkay aad ugu kordheen; doonnidiina waxay dul socotay biyihii.
english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

kikuyu: Biyihiina aad bay ugu xoogaysteen dhulka; oo dhammaan buurihii dhaadheeraa oo samada oo dhan ka hooseeyey way qarsoomeen.
english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

kikuyu: Shan iyo toban dhudhun baa biyihii xagga sare xoog ugu kaceen; buurihiina way qarsoomeen.
english: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

kikuyu: Oo wax kasta oo jidh leh oo dhulka ku dul dhaqaaqaaba way dhinteen, haaddii, iyo xoolihii, iyo dugaaggii, iyo wax kasta oo dhulka gurguurta, iyo dadkii oo dhanba.
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

kikuyu: Wax walba oo dhulka engegan joogay oo dulalka sankiisa ay neefta ruuxa nolosha ku jirtay, way wada dhinteen.
english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

kikuyu: Waxaa la wada baabbi'iyey wixii dhulka dushiisa ku noolaa oo dhan, xataa dadkii, iyo xoolihii, iyo wixii gurguuran jiray, iyo haaddii cirka; kulli waa laga wada baabbi'iyey dhulka; oo waxaa hadhay Nuux oo keliya, iyo kuwii doonnidii kula jiray isagii.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

kikuyu: Biyihiina boqol iyo konton maalmood ayay dhulka xoog ku lahaayeen.
english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu xusuustay Nuux, iyo wixii noolaa, iyo xoolihii doonnidii kula jiray isagii oo dhan; oo Ilaah dabayl buu dhulka dul mariyey, biyihiina way dhinmeen;
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

kikuyu: ilihii moolka iyo dariishadihii samaduna way awdmeen; roobkii samadana waa la joojiyey;
english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

kikuyu: biyihiina had iyo goorba dhulkay ka noqonayeen, oo boqol iyo konton maalmood dabadood ayaa biyihii dhinmeen.
english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

kikuyu: Oo bishii toddobaad, maalinteedii toddoba iyo tobnaad, ayay doonnidii ku fadhiisatay buuraha Araarad.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

kikuyu: Biyihiina way sii dhinmayeen ilaa bishii tobnaad. Bishii tobnaad, maalinteedii kowaad, ayaa buuraha dushoodii la arkay.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

kikuyu: Waxaana dhacday in afartan maalmood dabadood Nuux furay dariishaddii doonnidii uu sameeyey;
english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu dibadda u diray tuke, hor iyo dib buuna u duulayay, ilaa intay biyihii ka engegeen dhulka dushiisa.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna wuxuu diray qoolley si uu u ogaado bal in biyihii dhulka dushiisa ka yaraadeen iyo in kale;
english: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

kikuyu: laakiin qoolleydii meel ay cagta dhigto ayay weyday, kolkaasay Nuux xaggiisii ku soo noqotay iyo xaggii doonnidii, maxaa yeelay, biyihii baa dhulka oo dhan dul joogay; kolkaasuu gacanta dibadda u bixiyey, oo soo qabtay iyadii, oo soo geliyey doonnidii.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu toddoba maalmood oo kale sugay; markaasuu mar kale qoolleydii doonnidii ka diray;
english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

kikuyu: qoolleydiina waxay isagii ku soo noqotay fiidkii; oo afkana waxay ku wadatay caleen saytuun oo qoyan; kolkaasuu Nuux ogaaday in biyihii dhulka ka yaraadeen.
english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu toddoba maalmood oo kale sugay; dabadeedna qoolleydii buu diray; iyadiina mar dambe kuma ay soo noqon.
english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

kikuyu: Oo waxaana dhacday sannaddii lix boqol iyo kowaad, bishii kowaad, maalinteedii kowaad, inay biyihii dhulka ka engegeen: Nuuxna daboolkii buu doonnidii ka qaaday, wuuna fiiriyey, oo bal eeg, dhulka dushiisu way engegnayd.
english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

kikuyu: Oo bishii labaad, maalinteedii toddoba iyo labaatanaad, ayaa dhulka engegay.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

kikuyu: Ilaahna Nuux buu la hadlay, isagoo leh,
english: God spoke to Noah, saying,

kikuyu: Doonnida ka baxa adiga, iyo naagtaada, iyo wiilashaada, iyo naagaha wiilashaada ee kula jiraba.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

kikuyu: Soo bixi wax kasta oo nool oo kula jooga, inta jidhka leh oo dhan, kuwaas oo ah haadda, iyo xoolaha, iyo waxa dhulka gurguurta oo dhan; si ay dhulka ugu bataan, oo ay wax badan u dhalaan, oo ay dhulka ugu tarmaan.
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

kikuyu: Nuuxna wuu baxay, isagii iyo wiilashiisii, iyo naagtiisii, iyo naagihii wiilashiisa ee la jirayba.
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

kikuyu: Dugaag kasta, iyo wax kasta oo gurguurta, iyo haad kasta, iyo wax alla wixii dhulka ku dhaqaaqaaba, jinsigoodii ayay doonnidii kala soo baxeen.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

kikuyu: Nuuxna meel allabari buu Rabbiga u dhisay; xayawaankii daahirka ahaa iyo haaddii daahirka ahaydba, intuu wax ka qaatay, ayuu allabaryo la gubo ku bixiyey meeshii allabariga dusheeda.
english: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu uriyey caraftii udgoonayd, kolkaasuu Rabbigu iska yidhi qalbigiisa, Mar dambe dadka aawadiis dhulka uma habaari doono, maxaa yeelay, malaha qalbiga dadku waa shar tan iyo yaraantiisa; mar dambena ma aan dili doono wax kasta oo nool sidii aan yeelay.
english: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

kikuyu: Intuu dhulku jiro, beer abuurid, iyo beer goosasho, iyo qabow iyo kulayl, iyo gu iyo jiilaal, iyo habeen iyo maalin midnaba ma joogsan doono.
english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah waa barakeeyey Nuux iyo wiilashiisii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Wax badan dhala, oo tarma, oo dhulka ka buuxsama.
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

kikuyu: Cabsidiinna iyo baqdintiinnu way la jiri doonaan dugaag kasta, iyo haad kasta oo hawada, iyo waxa dhulka gurguurta oo dhan, iyo kalluunka badda oo dhan, gacmihiinna baa laydiin geliyey iyaga.
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

kikuyu: Wax kasta oo dhaqdhaqaaqa oo noolu cuntay idiin noqon doonaan; sidii aan geedaha cagaarka ah idiin siiyey ayaan kulli idiin siiyey.
english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa inaydnaan cunin hilibka noloshiisu la jirto, taasoo ah dhiiggiisa.
english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

kikuyu: Oo hubaal dhiigga naftiinna waan weyddiin, oo waxaan weyddiin dugaag kasta iyo dadkaba, xataa nafta nin kasta walaalkiis waan weyddiin.
english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

kikuyu: Ku kasta oo nin dhiiggiis daadiya, nin baa isna dhiiggiisa daadin doona: waayo, Ilaah araggiisuu ka sameeyey ninka.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

kikuyu: Idinku wax badan dhala, oo tarma; aad iyo aadna ugu farcama dhulka, kuna tarma dhexdiisa.
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah Nuux buu la hadlay, iyo wiilashiisii la joogay, isagoo ku leh,
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

kikuyu: Bal eega, anigu axdigayga baan idinku adkaynayaa, idinka iyo farcankiinna idinka dambeeya;
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

kikuyu: iyo uun kasta oo nool oo idinla jooga, haadda iyo xoolaha, iyo dugaag kasta oo dhulka idinla jooga; oo ah in alla intii ka soo baxda doonnida, xataa dugaag kasta oo dhulka.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan idinku adkayn doonaa axdigayga; inta jidh leh oo dhan mar dambe biyo daad ah laguma baabbi'in doono; daad dambe oo dhulka baabbi'iyaana mar dambe ma jiri doono.
english: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu yidhi, Waa tan calaamadii axdiga aan idinla dhiganayo idinka iyo uun kasta oo nool oo idinla jooga, tan iyo qarni kasta.
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

kikuyu: Waxaan qaansadayda ku dhex dhigay daruurta, waxayna noqon doontaa calaamadii axdiga dhex yaal aniga iyo dhulka.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

kikuyu: Waxaana dhici doonta, markii aan dhulka daruur dul keeno, in qaansada lagu arki doono daruurta dhexdeeda,
english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

kikuyu: oo waxaan xusuusan doonaa axdigayga ina dhex yaal aniga iyo idinka iyo uun kasta oo nool oo jidh kasta leh; biyuhuna dib dambe ma noqon doonaan daad baabbi'iya inta jidh leh oo dhan.
english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

kikuyu: Qaansaduna waxay ku dhex jiri doontaa daruurta; anna waan fiirin doonaa iyada, inaan xusuusto axdiga weligiis dhex yaal Ilaah iyo uun kasta oo nool oo jidh kasta leh oo dhulka jooga.
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu Nuux ku yidhi, Tanu waa calaamadii axdigii aan ku adkeeyey inta jidhka leh oo dhulka joogta.
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Nuux oo doonnidii ka soo baxay, waxay ahaayeen Sheem, iyo Xaam, iyo Yaafed: Xaamna waa Kancaan aabbihiis.
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

kikuyu: Saddexdanu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Nuux; oo iyagii farcankoodii baa dhulka oo dhan ku fiday.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

kikuyu: Nuuxna wuxuu bilaabay inuu beerrey noqdo, oo wuxuu beertay canab.
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wax ka cabbay khamrigeedii, wuuna sakhraamay; oo teendhadiisii dhexdeeda ayuu ku qaawanaa.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

kikuyu: Oo Xaam, oo ahaa Kancaan aabbihiis, ayaa arkay qaawanaantii aabbihiis, kolkaasuu u sheegay labadii walaalihiis ahayd oo dibadda joogta.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Sheem iyo Yaafed dhar qaadeen, oo labadoodu garbahay saareen, oo dib dib u socdeen, kolkaasay qaawanaantii aabbahood ku dedeen, oo wejiyadooduna way sii jeedeen, mana ay arkin qaawanaantii aabbahood.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

kikuyu: Nuuxna khamrigiisii wuu ka soo miyirsaday, wuuna ogaaday wixii wiilkiisa yaru ku sameeyey.
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu yidhi, Inkaaru ha ku dhacdo Kancaan; Addoonkii addoommaduu u noqon doonaa walaalihiis.
english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Ammaanu ha u ahaato Rabbiga ah Ilaaha Sheem, Kancaanna addoon ha u noqdo.
english: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

kikuyu: Ilaah ha fidiyo Yaafed, Hana dego teendhooyinka Sheem; Kancaanna addoon ha u noqdo isaga.
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

kikuyu: Nuuxna daadka ka dib wuxuu sii noolaa saddex boqol iyo konton sannadood.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Nuux noolaa oo dhammuna waxay ahaayeen sagaal boqol iyo konton sannadood; dabadeedna wuu dhintay.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa farcankii wiilashii Nuux, kuwaas oo ahaa Sheem, Xaam iyo Yaafed: oo wiilal baa u dhashay iyaga daadkii dabadiis.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yaafed waxay ahaayeen Gomer, iyo Maajuuj, iyo Maaday, iyo Yaawaan, iyo Tubal, iyo Mesheg, iyo Tiiraas.
english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Gomerna waxay ahaayeen Ashkenas, iyo Riifad, iyo Togarmaah.
english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yaawaanna waxay ahaayeen Eliishah, iyo Tarshiish, iyo Kitiim iyo Dodaaniim.
english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

kikuyu: Kuwaasay jasiiradihii quruumuhu ugu kala qaybsameen waddammadoodii, dad kasta sidii afkoodii, iyo qabiilooyinkoodii, iyo quruumahoodii ay ahaayeen.
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Xaamna waxay ahaayeen Kuush, iyo Misrayim, iyo Fuud, iyo Kancaan.
english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Kuushna waxay ahaayeen Sebaa, iyo Xawiilaah, iyo Sabtaah, iyo Racmaah, iyo Sabteka: wiilashii Racmaahna waxay ahaayeen Shebaa, iyo Dedaan.
english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: Kuushna wuxuu dhalay Nimrod: wuxuuna bilaabay inuu noqdo mid dhulka xoog weyn ku leh.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ahaa ugaadhsade ku xoog weyn Rabbiga hortiisa: taas daraaddeed waxaa la yidhaahdaa, Sidii Nimrod ugaadhsade xoog weyn Rabbiga hortiisa.
english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

kikuyu: Bilowgii boqortooyadiisu waxay ahayd Baabel, iyo Ereg, iyo Akad, iyo Kalneh, waxayna ku yiilleen waddankii Shincaar.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

kikuyu: Dhulkaas wuu ka tegey oo wuxuu galay Ashuur, wuxuuna dhisay Nineweh, iyo Rexobod, iyo Kaalah,
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

kikuyu: iyo Resen oo u dhexeeyey Nineweh iyo Kaalah, (taasuna waxay tahay magaalada weyn).
english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

kikuyu: Misrayimna wuxuu dhalay Luudiim, iyo Canaamiim, iyo Lehaabiim iyo Naftuxiim,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

kikuyu: iyo Fatrusiim iyo Kasluxiim (oo ay reer Falastiin ka yimaadeen), iyo Kaftoriim.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

kikuyu: Kancaanna wuxuu dhalay Siidoon oo ahaa curadkiisii, iyo Xeed;
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

kikuyu: iyo reer Yebuus, iyo reer Amor, iyo reer Girgaash;
english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

kikuyu: iyo reer Xiwi, iyo reer Carqi, iyo reer Siini;
english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

kikuyu: iyo reer Arwaad, iyo reer Semaar, iyo reer Xamaad: dabadeedna qabiilooyinkii Kancaan way kala firdheen.
english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintii reer Kancaan waxay ka bilaabmaysay Siidoon, markii loo kaco xagga Geraar, ilaa Gaasa, oo markii loo kaco xagga Sodom iyo Gomora iyo Admah iyo Seboyim, ilaa Laashac.
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Xaam, sidii qabiilooyinkoodii, iyo afafkoodii, iyo waddammadoodii, iyo quruumahoodii ay ahaayeen.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

kikuyu: Sheem oo aabbe u ahaa carruurtii Ceeber oo dhan, oo ahaa Yaafed walaalkiisii weynaa, isagana carruur baa u dhalatay.
english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Sheemna waxay ahaayeen Ceelaam, iyo Ashuur, iyo Arfaksad, iyo Luud, iyo Araam.
english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Araamna waxay ahaayeen Cuus, iyo Xuul, iyo Geter, iyo Mash.
english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

kikuyu: Arfaksadna wuxuu dhalay Salah; Salahna wuxuu dhalay Ceeber.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: Ceeberna waxaa u dhashay laba wiil: mid magiciisu wuxuu ahaa Feleg; waayo, waagiisii ayaa dhulku qaybsamay; magaca walaalkiisna wuxuu ahaa Yoqtaan.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

kikuyu: Yoqtaanna wuxuu dhalay Almoodaad, iyo Shelef, iyo Xasarmaawed, iyo Yerah;
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

kikuyu: iyo Hadooraam, iyo Uusaal, iyo Diqlah;
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

kikuyu: iyo Coobaal, iyo Abiimaa'el, iyo Shebaa;
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

kikuyu: iyo Oofir, iyo Xawiilaah, iyo Yoobaab: kuwaasu kulli waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Yoqtaan.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

kikuyu: Meeshay degganaayeenna waxay ka bilaabmaysay Meesha, markii loo kaco xagga Sefaar, buurta bari.
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Sheem; sidii qabiilooyinkoodii, iyo afafkoodii, iyo waddammadoodii, iyo quruumahoodii ay ahaayeen.
english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa qabiilooyinkii wiilashii Nuux; sidii farcankoodii iyo quruumahoodii ay ahaayeen; oo kuwanaa quruumuhu ka kala qaybsameen daadkii dabadiis.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.

kikuyu: Dhulka oo dhammuna wuxuu ahaa isku af iyo isku hadal keliya.
english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

kikuyu: Waxaana dhacday markay xagga bari u sii socdaaleen inay waddankii Shincaar meel bannaan ka heleen; oo halkaas ayay degeen.
english: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

kikuyu: Oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Ina keena, aynu leben samaysannee, oo aynu aad u dubnee. Oo waxay dhagaxa meeshiisa u haysteen leben, nuuradda meesheedana dhoobo.
english: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

kikuyu: Oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Ina keena, aynu magaalo dhisannee, iyo munaarad dhaladeedu samada gaadho, oo aynu magac yeelannee, waaba intaasoo aynu dhulka dushiisa oo dhan ku kala firidhnaaye.
english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu u soo degay inuu arko magaaladii iyo munaaraddii ay binu-aadmigu dhisayeen.
english: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi, Bal eega, iyagu waa isku dad keliya, oo dhammaan isku af keliya bay leeyihiin, oo waxanuna waa waxa ay bilaabayaan inay sameeyaan, oo haatan wax ka hor joogsan doona waxay damcaan inay sameeyaan ma jiraane.
english: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

kikuyu: Ina keena, aynu degnee, oo halkaas aynu afkooda iskaga qasnee, yaan midna midka kale hadalkiisa garanine.
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu halkaas ka kaxeeyey oo ku kala firdhiyey dhulka dushiisa oo dhan, oo dhisiddii magaaladii way joojiyeen.
english: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed magaceedii waxaa loo bixiyey Baabel, maxaa yeelay, halkaasaa Rabbigu afkii dhulka oo dhan iskaga qasay; oo halkaasuu Rabbigu ka kaxeeyey iyagii oo ku kala firdhiyey dhulka dushiisa oo dhan.
english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa farcankii Sheem. Sheem wuxuu jiray boqol sannadood, oo laba sannadood oo daadkii ka dambaysay wuxuu dhalay Arfaksad.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

kikuyu: Sheemna markuu Arfaksad dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa shan boqol oo sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Arfaksadna wuxuu jiray shan iyo soddon sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Salah:
english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

kikuyu: Arfaksadna markuu Salah dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa afar boqol iyo saddex sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Salahna wuxuu jiray soddon sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Ceeber.
english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: Salahna markuu Ceeber dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa afar boqol iyo saddex sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Ceeberna wuxuu jiray afar iyo soddon sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Feleg:
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

kikuyu: Ceeberna markuu Feleg dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa afar boqol iyo soddon sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Felegna wuxuu jiray soddon sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Recu:
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

kikuyu: Felegna markuu Recu dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa laba boqol iyo sagaal sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Recuna wuxuu jiray laba iyo soddon sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Seruug.
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

kikuyu: Recuna markuu Seruug dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa laba boqol iyo toddoba sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Seruugna wuxuu jiray soddon sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Naaxoor:
english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

kikuyu: Seruugna markuu Naaxoor dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa laba boqol oo sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Naaxoorna wuxuu jiray sagaal iyo labaatan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Terax;
english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

kikuyu: Naaxoorna markuu Terax dhalay ka dib wuxuu noolaa boqol iyo sagaal iyo toban sannadood, wiilal iyo gabdhona wuu dhalay.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Teraxna wuxuu jiray toddobaatan sannadood, wuxuuna dhalay Aabraam, iyo Naaxoor, iyo Haaraan.
english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa farcankii Terax. Terax wuxuu dhalay Aabraam, iyo Naaxoor, iyo Haaraan; Haaraanna wuxuu dhalay Luud.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

kikuyu: Haaraanna wuxuu dhintay aabbihiis Terax oo jooga, wuxuuna ku dhintay dhulkii uu ku dhashay, oo la odhan jiray Uur tii reer Kaldayiin.
english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

kikuyu: Aabraam iyo Naaxoorna way guursadeen: Aabraam naagtiisii waxaa la odhan jiray Saaray; naagtii Naaxoorna waxaa la odhan jiray Milkah, waxayna ahayd gabadhii Haaraan, aabbihii Milkah iyo Iskah.
english: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

kikuyu: Saarayna waxay ahayd madhalays; ilmona ma ay lahayn.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

kikuyu: Teraxna wuxuu kaxaystay wiilkiisii Aabraam, iyo Luud oo ahaa ina Haaraan, wiilkii wiilkiisii, iyo Saaray oo uu soddog u ahaa, oo ahayd naagtii wiilkiisii Aabraam; wayna kala baxeen Uur tii reer Kaldayiin, si ay u tagaan dalkii Kancaan; waxayna yimaadeen Haaraan, oo halkaasay degeen.
english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Terax noolaa wuxuu ahaa laba boqol iyo shan sannadood, Teraxna wuxuu ku dhintay Haaraan.
english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu Aabraam ku yidhi, Ka tag waddankaaga, iyo xigaalkaaga, iyo reerka aabbahaaba, oo dalka aan ku tusi doono u kac.
english: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

kikuyu: Oo quruun weyn baan kaa dhigi doonaa, oo waan ku barakayn doonaa, magacaagana waan weynayn doonaa; oo waxaad noqon doontaa barako;
english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

kikuyu: oo waan barakayn doonaa kuwa kuu duceeya, kan ku habaarana waan habaari doonaa: oo qabiilooyinka dhulka oo dhammu adigay kugu barakoobi doonaan.
english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Aabraam tegey, sidii Rabbigu ku yidhi; Luudna wuu raacay. Aabraam shan iyo toddobaatan sannadood buu jiray markuu Haaraan ka tegey.
english: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

kikuyu: Aabraamna wuxuu kaxaystay naagtiisii Saaray, iyo Luud oo ahaa wiilkii walaalkiis, iyo xoolahoodii ay urursadeen oo dhan, iyo dadkii ay Haaraan ka heleen oo dhan; kolkaasay u kaceen dalkii Kancaan, oo waxay yimaadeen dalkii Kancaan.
english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Aabraamna dalkii buu dhex maray ilaa meeshii la odhan jiray Shekem iyo tan iyo geedkii Moreh. Wakhtigaasna reer Kancaan dalkay joogeen.
english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah baa Aabraam u muuqday, oo ku yidhi, Dalkan farcankaagaan siin doonaa. Kolkaasuu meeshaas meel allabari uga dhisay Rabbigii u muuqday.
english: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu meeshaas ka guuray, oo wuxuu tegey buurtii xagga bari ka ahayd Beytel, oo teendhadiisii buu ka dhistay meel Beytel galbeed ka ahayd, Aaciina bari ka ahayd; markaasuu meeshaas meel allabari Rabbiga uga dhisay, oo magaca Rabbiga ku baryootamay.
english: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Aabraam socdaalay, isagoo weli xagga koonfureed u sii socda.
english: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa dhulkii abaari ka dhacday: markaasuu Aabraam Masar tegey; inuu halkaas qariib ku ahaado, waayo, abaartii aad bay dhulkii ugu xumayd.
english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in markii uu ku soo dhowaaday inuu Masar galo, uu ku yidhi naagtiisii Saaray, Bal eeg, waan ogahay inaad tahay naag arag quruxsan,
english: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

kikuyu: oo waxaa dhici doona in markii ay Masriyiintu ku arkaan, ay odhan doonaan, Waa naagtiisii tanu. Oo way i dili doonaan, laakiin adiga way ku dayn doonaan.
