english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

kikuyu: Waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Walaashiis baan ahay; si ay iigu roonaadaan adiga aawadaa, oo ay naftaydu daraaddaa u noolaato.
english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in markii Aabraam Masar soo galay, ay Masriyiintii arkeen in naagtu aad u quruxsan tahay.
english: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

kikuyu: Oo amiirradii Fircoon baa arkay, oo Fircoon bay u ammaaneen iyadii, oo naagtii waxaa loo kaxeeyey gurigii Fircoon.
english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

kikuyu: Isaguna Aabraam si wanaagsan buu u qabtay iyada aawadeed: wuxuuna lahaa ido, iyo dibiyo, iyo dameerro lab, iyo niman addoommo ah, iyo naago addoommo ah, iyo dameerro dhaddig iyo geel.
english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu belaayooyin waaweyn buu ku riday Fircoon iyo reerkiisiiba, Saaray oo naagtii Aabraam ahayd aawadeed.
english: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

kikuyu: Fircoonna Aabraam buu u yeedhay, oo ku yidhi, Waa maxay waxan aad igu samaysay? Maxaad iigu sheegi weyday inay tahay naagtaadii?
english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

kikuyu: Maxaad u tidhi, Waa walaashay si aan u guursado iyada? Haddaba waa tan naagtaadii, kaxayso oo iska tag.
english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

kikuyu: Fircoonna niman buu u soo amray isaga: wayna soo ambabbixiyeen isagii iyo naagtiisii, iyo wuxuu haystay oo dhan.
english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

kikuyu: Aabraamna Masar wuu ka baxay, isaga, iyo naagtiisii, iyo wuxuu haystay oo dhan, Luudna wuu raacay, oo wuxuu tegey xagga koonfureed.
english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

kikuyu: Oo Aabraam hodan buu ka ahaa xagga xoolaha iyo lacagta iyo dahabka.
english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

kikuyu: Xagga koonfureed ayuu ka tegey oo wuxuu u socdaalay ilaa Beytel, meeshii bilowgii ay teendhadiisu ahayd, ee u dhexaysay Beytel iyo Aacii;
english: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

kikuyu: ilaa meeshii allabariga oo uu horraantii halkaas ka sameeyey; oo meeshaasuu Aabraam magaca Rabbiga kaga baryootamay.
english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Oo Luud, oo isna Aabraam la socday, wuxuu lahaa adhi, iyo lo', iyo teendhooyin.
english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

kikuyu: Dhulkuna ma uu qaadi karin iyagii, hadday wada degganaan lahaayeen: waayo, xoolahoodu way badnaayeen, oo sidaas daraaddeed ma ay wada degganaan karin.
english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

kikuyu: Dirir baana ku dhex jirtay xoolojirradii Aabraam iyo xoolojirradii Luud. Markaasna reer Kancaan iyo reer Feris dhulkaasay degganaayeen.
english: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

kikuyu: Oo Aabraam wuxuu Luud ku yidhi, Waxaan kaa baryayaa inaan diriru inaga dhex dhicin aniga iyo adiga, iyo xoolojirradayda iyo xoolojirradaada; maxaa yeelay, waxaynu nahay walaalo.
english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

kikuyu: Dhulka oo dhammu sow kaa ma horreeyo? Waxaan kaa baryayaa inaad iga guurtid. Haddaad bidixda tagto, midigtaan tegayaa; haddaad midigta tagtona, bidixdaan tegayaa.
english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu Luud indhihiisii kor u taagay, oo wuxuu arkay Bannaankii Webi Urdun oo dhan, iyo inay meel waluba aad u waraabsan tahay, intaan Rabbigu baabbi'in Sodom iyo Gomora; wuxuu u ekaa beertii Ilaah, iyo sida dalka Masar markaad tagto xagga Socar.
english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Luud wuxuu doortay Bannaankii Urdun oo dhan; oo Luud xagga bari buu u socdaalay; oo way kala guureen.
english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

kikuyu: Aabraam wuxuu degay dalkii Kancaan, Luudna wuxuu degay magaalooyinkii Bannaanka ku yiil, oo teendhadiisii wuxuu u wareejiyey xagga Sodom.
english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

kikuyu: Haddaba dadkii Sodom shar miidhan bay ahaayeen, Ilaahna aad iyo aad bay ugu dembaabeen.
english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu Aabraam ku yidhi, intii Luud ka guuray ka dib, Indhahaaga kor u taag, oo meeshaad joogto ka fiiri, xagga woqooyi iyo xagga koonfureed, iyo xagga bari iyo xagga galbeedba;
english: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

kikuyu: waayo, dhulka aad aragto oo dhan waxaan siin doonaa adiga iyo farcankaaga weligiin.
english: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

kikuyu: Farcankaagana waxaan ka dhigi doonaa sida ciidda dhulka; haddii nin ciidda dhulka tirin karo, farcankaagana waa la tirin doonaa.
english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

kikuyu: Bal kac oo ku dhex soco dhulka dhererkiisa iyo ballaadhkiisa; waayo, adigaan ku siin doonaa.
english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

kikuyu: Oo Aabraam teendhadiisii wuu wareejiyey, oo wuxuu yimid oo degay dhirtii Mamre, ee ku tiil Xebroon, oo halkaasuu Rabbiga meel allabari uga dhisay.
english: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacday waagii Amraafel boqorka u ahaa Shincaar, Aryoogna boqorka u ahaa Ellaasaar, Kedorlaacomerna boqorka u ahaa Ceelaam, Tidcaalna boqorka u ahaa Goyiim,
english: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

kikuyu: inay la dirireen Berac oo boqor u ahaa Sodom, iyo Birshac oo boqor u ahaa Gomora, iyo Shinaab oo boqor u ahaa Admah, iyo Shemeeber oo boqor u ahaa Seboyim, iyo boqorkii Belac (oo iyana ahayd Socar).
english: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

kikuyu: Kuwanu waxay kulligood isugu yimaadeen Dooxo Siddiim (oo iyana ahayd Baddii Cusbada).
english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

kikuyu: Laba iyo toban sannadood bay Kedorlaacomer u adeegeen, markaasay sannaddii saddex iyo tobnaad ku caasiyoobeen.
english: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

kikuyu: Sannaddii afar iyo tobnaadna waxaa yimid Kedorlaacomer, iyo boqorradii la jiray, oo waxay reer Refaa'iim ku dileen Cashterod Qarnayim, oo reer Suusiimna waxay ku dileen Haam, oo reer Eymiimna waxay ku dileen Shaweh Qiryaatayim,
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

kikuyu: reer Xorna waxay ku dileen buurtoodii Seciir, iyo ilaa Aylfaaraan oo u dhowayd cidlada.
english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

kikuyu: Oo way soo noqdeen, oo waxay yimaadeen Ceyn Mishfaad (oo iyana ahayd Qaadeesh), oo waxay dileen dadkii dalkii reer Camaaleq oo dhan, waxaa kale oo ay dileen reer Amor oo degganaa Hasason Tamar.
english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa soo baxay boqorkii Sodom, iyo boqorkii Gomora, iyo boqorkii Admah, iyo boqorkii Seboyim, iyo boqorkii Belac (oo iyana ahayd Socar); oo waxay Dooxo Siddiim ugu diyaargaroobeen inay la dagaallamaan
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

kikuyu: Kedorlaacomer oo ahaa boqorkii Ceelaam, iyo Tidcaal oo ahaa boqorkii Goyiim, iyo Amraafel oo ahaa boqorkii Shincaar, iyo Aryoog oo ahaa boqorkii Ellaasaar. Waxay ahaayeen afar boqor oo shantii boqor ka gees ah.
english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

kikuyu: Haddaba Dooxo Siddiim waxaa ka buuxay boholo waaweyn oo dhoobo ah; oo boqorradii Gomora iyo Sodom way carareen, oo halkaasay ku dhaceen, intii kalena waxay u carareen xagga buurta.
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

kikuyu: Oo waxay qaateen alaabtii Sodom iyo Gomora oo dhan, iyo cuntadoodii oo dhan, wayna iska tageen.
english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa kaloo ay la tageen Luud, oo ahaa wiilkii Aabraam walaalkiis, oo Sodom degganaa, iyo alaabtiisii oo dhan, wayna iska tageen.
english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa yimid mid soo baxsaday, oo wuxuu u warramay Aabraam kii ahaa Cibraaniga isagoo ag deggan dhirtii Mamre kii ahaa reer Amor, oo Eshkol iyo Caaneer walaalkood ahaa. Kuwaasu Aabraam bay gaashaanbuur la ahaayeen.
english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

kikuyu: Oo Aabraam markuu maqlay in walaalkiis maxbuus ahaan loola tegey ayuu soo kaxaystay raggiisii la tababbaray oo gurigiisa ku dhashay, iyagoo ah saddex boqol iyo siddeed iyo toban nin, oo wuxuu raacdo ku jiray ilaa Daan.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

kikuyu: Oo habeennimo ayuu raggiisii u kala qaybiyey, isaga iyo addoommadiisiiba, oo waxay laayeen colkii, oo ay raacdaysteen ilaa Xoobah, oo Dimishaq xagga bidixda ka ah.
english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

kikuyu: Oo alaabtii oo dhan buu soo celiyey, oo waxaa kale oo uu soo celiyey walaalkiis Luud, iyo alaabtiisii, iyo naagihii, iyo dadkiiba.
english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

kikuyu: Markuu ka soo noqday layntii Kedorlaacomer iyo boqorradii la jiray ka dib ayaa boqorkii Sodom Aabraam kaga hor tegey Dooxo Shaweh oo ahayd Dooxadii Boqorka.
english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

kikuyu: Oo Malkisadaq oo ahaa boqorkii Saalem baa keenay cunto iyo khamri: wuxuuna ahaa wadaadkii Ilaaha ugu sarreeya.
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

kikuyu: Oo Aabraam buu u duceeyay, oo yidhi, Ilaaha ugu sarreeya, ee leh samada iyo dhulkaba ha barakeeyo Aabraam.
english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Ammaan waxaa leh Ilaaha ugu sarreeya, oo cadaawayaashaadii gacantaada geliyey. Markaasaa Aabraam wuxuu isagii wax kasta ka siiyey toban meelood oo meel.
english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

kikuyu: Boqorkii Sodom wuxuu Aabraam ku yidhi, Dadka uun i sii, alaabtana adigu iska qaado.
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Aabraam wuxuu boqorkii Sodom ku yidhi, Gacantaydaan kor u taagay oo waxaan ku dhaartay Rabbiga, kan ah Ilaaha ugu sarreeya, ee leh samada iyo dhulka,
english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

kikuyu: inaanan qaadanin miiq ama kab yeelmeheed ama wax adigu aad leedahay, waayo, waaba intaasoo aad tidhaahdaa, Anaa Aabraam hodan ka dhigaye.
english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

kikuyu: Waxba qaadan maayo wixii ay ragga dhallinyarada ahu cuneen mooyaane, iyo qaybtii raggii i raacay. Caaneer iyo Eshkol, iyo Mamre ha qaateen qaybtooda.
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas ka dib ereygii Ilaah baa Aabraam ugu yimid muuqasho ahaan, isagoo leh, Aabraamow, ha baqin: anigu waxaan ahay gaashaankaaga, abaalgudkaaguna aad buu u weynaan doonaa.
english: After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

kikuyu: Oo Aabraam wuxuu yidhi, Sayidow Rabbiyow, maxaad i siin doontaa? Waayo, anigu carruurla'aan baan sii socdaa, reerkaygana waxaa dhaxli doona Eliiceser oo ah reer Dimishaq.
english: Abram said, “Lord GOD, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

kikuyu: Oo Aabraam wuxuu yidhi, Bal eeg, aniga ima aad siin farcan: oo mid gurigayga ku dhashay baa i dhaxlaya.
english: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, ereygii Rabbigaa u yimid, isagoo leh, Ninkanu kuma dhaxli doono: laakiinse waxaa ku dhaxli doona wiil aad dhali doontid.
english: Behold, the LORD’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

kikuyu: Oo dibadduu u soo bixiyey, oo ku yidhi, Bal samada fiiri, oo xiddigaha tiri, haddaad tirin kartid: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Sidaas oo kalaa farcankaagu ahaan doonaa.
english: The LORD brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga wuu rumaystay; Ilaahna taas wuxuu ugu tiriyey xaqnimo.
english: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi isaga, Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga kaaga soo kaxeeyey Uur tii reer Kaldayiin, inaan ku siiyo dalkan si aad u dhaxashid.
english: He said to Abram, “I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

kikuyu: Oo Aabraam wuxuu yidhi, Sayidow Rabbiyow, maxaan ku ogaadaa inaan dhaxli doono?
english: He said, “Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ii kaxee qaalin lo' ah oo saddex jir ah, iyo ceesaan saddex jir ah, iyo wan saddex jir ah, iyo qoolley, iyo xamaam yar.
english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

kikuyu: Oo wuu u kaxeeyey kuwaas oo dhan, oo badhtankuu ka kala wada gooyay, oo badh kastaba kan kaluu hor dhigay: laakiinse shimbirrihii ma uu kala gooyn.
english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

kikuyu: Haad baana hilibkii ku soo degtay, laakiinse Aabraam baa ka eryay.
english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

kikuyu: Oo kolkii qorraxdu sii dhacaysay, ayaa hurdo aad u weynu Aabraam ku soo dhacday; oo bal eeg, cabsi gudcur weyn leh baa ku soo degtay.
english: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi Aabraam, Ogow in hubaal farcankaagu ay dad qalaad ku ahaan doonaan dal aan kooda ahayn, oo ay u adeegi doonaan, oo afar boqol oo sannadood waa la dhibi doonaa;
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

kikuyu: oo weliba quruuntaas ay u adeegi doonaan, xukun baan ku ridi doonaa; oo dabadeedna way ka soo bixi doonaan iyagoo xoolo badan wata.
english: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu nabad baad ugu tegi doontaa awowayaashaa, oo waxaa lagu xabaali doonaa adigoo cimri dheer gaadhay.
english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu qarniga afraad halkan bay ku soo noqon doonaan: waayo, dembigii reer Amor weli ma dhamma.
english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay, markii qorraxdii dhacday oo ay ahayd gudcur, in girgire qiiqaya iyo dab ololaya ay dhex mareen cadadkii.
english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

kikuyu: Maalintaas Rabbigu Aabraam buu axdi la dhigtay, isagoo leh, Farcankaagaan siiyey dhulkan, oo laga bilaabo webiga Masar ilaa webiga weyn, oo ah webi Yufraad:
english: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

kikuyu: reer Qeyn, iyo reer Qenas, iyo reer Qadmon,
english: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

kikuyu: iyo reer Xeed, iyo reer Feris, iyo reer Refaa'iim,
english: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

kikuyu: iyo reer Amor, iyo reer Kancaan, iyo reer Girgaash, iyo reer Yebuus.
english: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

kikuyu: Saaray oo ahayd Aabraam naagtiisii carruur uma ay dhalin isagii: waxayna lahayd gabadh midiidin ah, oo Masriyad ah, magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Haagaar.
english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

kikuyu: Oo Saaray waxay Aabraam ku tidhi, Bal eeg imminka, Rabbigu waa ii diiday inaan dhalo; haddaba waxaan kaa baryayaa inaad midiidintayda u tagto, mindhaa iyadaan carruur ka heli doonaaye, Aabraamna codkii Saaray buu maqlay.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

kikuyu: Saaray oo ahayd naagtii Aabraam waxay kaxaysay Haagaar tii Masriyadda ahayd, oo midiidinteeda ahayd, markii Aabraam toban sannadood joogay dalkii Kancaan ka dib, oo waxay iyadii siisay ninkeedii Aabraam inay naagtiisii u noqoto.
english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

kikuyu: Oo Haagaar buu u tegey, wayna uuraysatay; oo markay aragtay inay uuraysatay ayay murwadeedii aad u quudhsatay.
english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

kikuyu: Oo Saaray waxay Aabraam ku tidhi, Dulmigii laygu sameeyey dushaada ha ahaado: midiidintaydii waxaan geliyey laabtaada; oo markay aragtay inay uuraysatay ayay i quudhsatay; Rabbigu aniga iyo adiga ha ina kala xukumo.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May the LORD judge between me and you.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse Aabraam wuxuu ku yidhi Saaray, Bal eeg, midiidintaadii gacantaaday ku jirtaaye; waxaad doonto ku samee. Saarayna si adag bay ula macaamilootay, kolkaasay midiidintii ka carartay horteeda.
english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

kikuyu: Oo malaa'igtii Rabbigaa heshay iyadoo ag joogta il biyo ah oo cidlada ku taal, oo ishuna waxay ku tiil jidka Shuur.
english: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

kikuyu: Oo malaa'igtii waxay ku tidhi, Haagaar, midiidintii Saaray, xaggee baad ka timid? Xaggee baadse ku socotaa? Oo waxay ku tidhi, Murwadayda Saaray baan ka cararayaa.
english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”

kikuyu: Oo malaa'igtii Rabbigu waxay ku tidhi iyadii, Ku noqo murwadaadii, oo gacmaheeda is-hoos dhig.
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

kikuyu: Oo malaa'igtii Rabbigu waxay ku tidhi iyadii, Farcankaaga aad baan u tarmin doonaa si aan loo tirin karin farabadnaantiisa aawadeed.
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

kikuyu: Oo malaa'igtii Rabbigu waxay ku tidhi iyadii, Bal eeg, uur baad leedahaye, oo wiil baad dhali doontaa; magiciisana waxaad u bixin doontaa Ismaaciil, maxaa yeelay, Rabbigu waa maqlay dhibaatadaadii.
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction.

kikuyu: Oo dadka dhexdiisa wuxuu ku noqon doonaa sida dameer banjoog ah; gacantiisu nin walba gees bay ka noqon doontaa, oo nin walba gacantiisuna gees bay ka noqon doontaa isaga; wuxuuna degganaan doonaa walaalihiis oo dhan hortooda.
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay magicii Rabbigii la hadlay iyada u bixisay, Waxaad tahay Ilaaha wax arka, waayo, waxay tidhi, Weliba miyaan halkan ka arkay kan i arka?
english: She called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ceelkii waxaa loo bixiyeyBi'ir Lahayroy; bal eeg, wuxuu u dhexeeyaa Qaadeesh iyo Bered.
english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

kikuyu: Oo Haagaar waxay Aabraam u dhashay wiil; oo Aabraamna wuxuu wiilkiisii Haagaar dhashay u bixiyey Ismaaciil.
english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

kikuyu: Aabraamna wuxuu jiray lix iyo siddeetan sannadood, markii ay Haagaar Ismaaciil u dhashay Aabraam.
english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

kikuyu: Oo markuu Aabraam jiray sagaal iyo sagaashan sannadood ayaa Rabbigu u muuqday, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaan ahay Ilaaha Qaadirka ah; hortayda ku soco, oo mid eed la' ahow.
english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.

kikuyu: Oo axdigaygaan kula dhigan doonaa, oo anigu aad baan kuu tarmin doonaa.
english: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Aabraam wejiga u dhacay; oo Ilaah baa la hadlay isagoo ku leh,
english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

kikuyu: Bal eeg, axdigaygii waa kula jiraaye, oo adigu quruumo badan baad aabbe u noqon doontaa.
english: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

kikuyu: Magacaagana mar dambe lama odhan doono Aabraam, laakiinse magacaagu wuxuu noqon doonaa Ibraahim; waayo, waxaan kaa dhigay quruumo badan aabbahood.
english: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

kikuyu: Aad baanan kuu badin doonaa, oo quruumo baan kaa samayn doonaa, boqorrona way kaa soo bixi doonaan.
english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

kikuyu: Oo axdigayga waxaan ku adkayn doonaa dhexdeenna iyo farcankaaga kaa dambeeyaba, tan iyo qarniyadooda oo dhan, waana axdi weligiis waara, kaas oo ah inaan adiga Ilaah kuu noqdo iyo farcankaaga kaa dambeeya.
english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan ku siin doonaa, adiga iyo farcankaaga kaa dambeeyaba, dhulkii aad sodcaalka ku ahayd, kaas oo ah dalka Kancaan oo dhan inuu idiin ahaado hanti aad weligiin lahaataan; aniguna waxaan ahaan doonaa Ilaahood.
english: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu Ibraahim ku yidhi, Adiguna waa inaad axdigayga xajisaa, adiga iyo farcankaaga kaa dambeeyaba, tan iyo qarniyadooda oo dhan.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.

kikuyu: Kanu waa axdigayga aad xajin doontaan, oo inoo dhexeeya aniga iyo adiga iyo farcankaaga kaa dambeeyaba; mid kasta oo lab oo idinku jira waa in la gudaa.
english: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad iska gudi doontaan buuryadiinna; waxayna calaamo u noqon doontaa axdiga ina dhex yaal aniga iyo idinka.
english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

kikuyu: Kii siddeed maalmood jira oo idinku dhex jira waa in la gudaa, mid kasta oo lab tan iyo qarniyadiinna oo dhan, ha ahaado kii gurigaaga ku dhasha ama kii lacag lagaga soo iibsado shisheeyaha oo aan farcankaaga ahayn.
english: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.

kikuyu: Kii gurigaaga ku dhasha, iyo kii lacagtaada lagu iibsadoba, waa in la gudaa: axdigayguna wuxuu jidhkiinna ku noqon doonaa axdi weligiis waara.
english: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

kikuyu: Oo buuryoqabka lab oo aan buuryadiisa laga gooynin, midkaasu waa ka go'i doonaa dadkiisa; waayo, axdigaygii buu jebiyey.
english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu Ibraahim ku yidhi, Naagtaada Saarayna magaceeda waa inaadan ugu yeedhin Saaray, laakiinse magaceedu wuxuu ahaan doonaa Saarah.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.

kikuyu: Oo iyadaan barakayn doonaa, oo weliba wiil baan kaa siin doonaa; iyadaan barakayn doonaa, oo waxay noqon doontaa quruumo hooyadood; boqorrada dadyowguna iyaday ka iman doonaan.
english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Ibraahim wejiga u dhacay, oo qoslay, oo qalbigiisa wuxuu iska yidhi, Ma ilmaa u dhalan doona nin boqol jir ah? Oo Saarah oo sagaashan jir ihi miyey dhali doontaa?
english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahim wuxuu Ilaah ku yidhi, Waxaan jeclaan lahaa in Ismaaciil hortaada ku noolaado!
english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu yidhi, Maya, laakiin naagtaada Saarah wiil bay kuu dhali doontaa, magiciisana waxaad u bixin doontaa Isxaaq; oo waxaan isaga ku adkayn doonaa axdigayga, kaas oo farcankiisa ka dambeeya u ahaan doona axdi weligiis waara.
english: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

kikuyu: Xagga Ismaaciilna waan ku maqlay; oo bal eeg, isaga waan barakeeyey, waanan badin doonaa, oo aad baan u tarmin doonaa isaga; laba iyo toban amiir buu dhali doonaa, oo quruun weyn baan ka dhigi doonaa.
english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

kikuyu: Laakiin axdigayga waxaan ku adkayn doonaa Isxaaq kan Saarah kuu dhali doonto sannadda soo socota xilligan oo kale.
english: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

kikuyu: Oo kolkuu hadalkii u dhammeeyey, Ilaah waa ka tegey Ibraahim.
english: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ibraahim wuxuu kaxaystay wiilkiisii Ismaaciil, iyo intii gurigiisa ku dhalatay oo dhan, iyo kuwii lacagtiisa lagu iibsaday oo dhan, kulli intii labayd oo ka midka ahayd dadkii guriga Ibraahim joogay, oo isla maalintaas ayuu ka guday buuryadoodii sidii Ilaah ku yidhi isaga.
english: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahim wuxuu jiray sagaal iyo sagaashan sannadood markii laga guday buuryadiisii.
english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

kikuyu: Wiilkiisii Ismaaciilna wuxuu jiray saddex iyo toban sannadood markii buuryadiisii laga guday.
english: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

kikuyu: Oo isla maalintaas baa la guday Ibraahim iyo wiilkiisii Ismaaciil.
english: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

kikuyu: Oo raggii gurigiisa joogay oo dhan, kuwii gurigiisa ku dhashay, iyo kuwii lacagtiisii shisheeyaha lagaga iibsadayba waa lala guday isaga.
english: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigaa u muuqday isaga oo ag jooga dhirtii Mamre, isagoo iridda teendhada fadhiya markii maalinta ugu kululayd.
english: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

kikuyu: Oo indhihiisii buu kor u taagay oo eegay, oo wuxuu arkay saddex nin oo hortiisa taagan: oo kolkuu arkay, ayuu ka orday iriddii teendhada inuu ka hor tago iyagii, kolkaasuu dhulka ku sujuuday,
english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu yidhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, haddaad raalli iga tahay, ha i dhaafin anigoo addoonkaaga ah.
english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

kikuyu: Biyo yar ha laydiin keeno, oo cagamaydha, oo geedka hoostiisa ku nasta:
english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

kikuyu: oo waxaan idiin keeni doonaa wuxoogaa cunto ah, ee raaxaysta; waayo, waxaad u timaadeen addoonkiinna; markaas ka dib waad tegi doontaan. Oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Yeel sidaad tidhi.
english: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna dhaqsuu u galay teendhadii, oo Saarah u tegey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Saddex koombo oo bur ah degdeg u diyaari, oo cajiin, oo kibis ka samee.
english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahim xagga lo'dii buu ku orday, oo wuxuu soo kaxeeyey dibi yar oo dhaylo ah oo wanaagsan, oo wuxuu u dhiibay nin dhallinyaro ah, isaguna dhaqsuu u diyaariyey.
english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu u qaaday subag, iyo caano, iyo dibigii uu diyaariyey, oo hortooduu dhigay; isna dhinacooduu istaagay geedkii hoostiisii; iyana way cuneen.
english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Meeday bilcantaadii Saarah? Markaasuu yidhi, Waa taa; teendhaday ku jirtaa.
english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Hubaal waan kuu soo noqon doonaa markii xilligu soo wareego; oo bal ogow, naagtaada Saarah wiil bay dhali doontaaye. Saarahna way maqashay, iyadoo joogta iriddii teendhada oo ka dambaysay isaga.
english: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ibraahim iyo Saarah way da' weynaayeen; gabow bayna la dhaceen; caadadii naaguhuna Saarah way ka joogsatay.
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

kikuyu: Saarahna qalbigay ka qososhay, iyadoo leh, Ma anigoo gaboobay baan farxad heli doonaa, iyadoo sayidkayguna gaboobay?
english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu Ibraahim ku yidhi, Saarah maxay u qososhay, iyadoo leh, Runtii ma ilmaan dhali doonaa, anoo gaboobay?
english: The LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’

kikuyu: Ma wax Rabbiga ku adag baa jira? Wakhtigii la ballamay baan kugu soo noqon doonaa, markii xilligu soo wareego, oo Saarah wiil bay dhali doontaa.
english: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Saarah dafirtay oo tidhi, Ma aan qoslin; maxaa yeelay, way cabsatay. Oo isna wuxuu yidhi, Maya, laakiin waad qososhay.
english: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

kikuyu: Nimankiina halkaas way ka kaceen, oo waxay u jeesteen xagga Sodom: Ibraahimna wuu raacay inuu sagootiyo iyaga.
english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu yidhi, Miyaan Ibraahim ka qariyaa waxaan samaynayo,
english: The LORD said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, hubaal Ibraahim wuxuu noqon doonaa quruun weyn oo xoog leh, oo quruumaha dhulka oo dhammu isagay ku barakoobi doonaan?
english: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

kikuyu: Waayo, waan garanayaa isaga, inuu carruurtiisa iyo kuwa gurigiisa jooga ku amri doono, inay jidka Rabbiga xajiyaan inay sameeyaan xaqnimo iyo caaddilnimo; si uu Rabbigu Ibraahim ugu soo dejiyo wixii uu kaga hadlay.
english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu yidhi, Qaylada Sodom iyo Gomora way badatay, dembigooduna aad buu u weynaaday.
english: The LORD said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

kikuyu: Haddaba waan degi doonaa, oo waxaan arki doonaa inay wada sameeyeen sida qayladu ii soo gaadhay iyo in kale; haddaanay wada samaynna, waan ogaan doonaa.
english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

kikuyu: Oo nimankii halkaasay ka noqdeen oo waxay tageen xagga Sodom: laakiinse Ibraahim weli wuxuu hor taagnaa Rabbiga.
english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahim baa u dhowaaday, oo yidhi, Miyaad kuwa xaqa ah la baabbi'inaysaa kuwa sharka fala?
english: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

kikuyu: Mindhaa waxaa magaalada jooga konton xaq ah. De miyaad baabbi'inaysaa meesha oo aadan ugu tudhaynin kontonka xaqa ah ee jooga aawadood?
english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

kikuyu: Yaanay noqon inaad sidaas samayso, inaad kuwa xaqa ah la dishid kuwa sharka fala, oo sidaas kuwa xaqa ahu ay kula mid noqdaan kuwa sharka fala, taas yaanay noqon. Dunida oo dhan Xaakinkeedu miyuusan xaq samayn doonin?
english: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu yidhi, Haddaan Sodom ka helo konton qof oo xaq ah oo magaalada jooga, de markaas meeshaa oo dhan waxaan ugu tudhi doonaa iyaga daraaddood.
english: The LORD said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahimna wuu jawaabay oo yidhi, Bal eeg, waxaan isu diray inaan Sayidka la hadlo, anoo ciid iyo dambas ah.
english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.

kikuyu: Mindhaa kontonka xaqa ah shan baa ka dhiman; miyaad magaalada oo dhan u baabbi'in hadday shanu ka dhiman tahay? Markaasuu yidhi, Baabbi'in maayo haddaan meeshaas shan iyo afartan ka helo.
english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu mar kale la hadlay, oo yidhi, Mindhaa waxaa halkaas laga heli afartan. Markaasuu yidhi, Afartanka aawadood ayaanan u baabbi'inayn.
english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Sayidku yuusan cadhoon, waan la hadlayaaye. Mindhaa waxaa halkaas laga heli soddon. Markaasuu yidhi, Baabbi'in maayo haddaan soddon halkaas ka helo.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Bal eeg, waxaan isu diray inaan Sayidka la hadlo: mindhaa waxaa halkaas laga heli labaatan. Markaasuu yidhi, Labaatanka daraaddood ayaanan u baabbi'inayn.
english: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Sayidku yuusan cadhoon, oo weli waan la hadlayaaye, waase markan keliya. Mindhaa waxaa halkaas laga heli toban. Wuxuuna yidhi, Tobanka daraaddood ayaanan u baabbi'inayn.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuu iska tegey markuu Ibraahim la dhammeeyey hadalkii, Ibraahimna meeshiisii buu ku noqday.
english: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

kikuyu: Oo labadii malaa'igood baa Sodom fiidkii yimid; Luudna wuxuu fadhiyey iridda Sodom. Oo markuu Luud iyagii arkay ayuu u kacay inuu ka hor tago; wuuna sujuuday oo wejigiisuu dhulka saaray;
english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eega, sayidyadaydiiyow, soo leexda, waan idin baryayaaye, oo gala guriga addoonkiinna, oo caawa oo dhan jooga, oo cagamaydha. Aroortii baanad kici doontaan oo iska tegi doontaane. Oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Maya; laakiin jidkaannu joogaynaa caawa oo dhan.
english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

kikuyu: Aad buuna u baryay; xaggiisayna u soo leexdeen, oo gurigiisii bay galeen; diyaafad buuna u sameeyey, kibis aan khamiir lahaynna wuu u dubay, wayna cuneen.
english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

kikuyu: Laakiinse intaanay jiifsan ka hor, waxaa gurigii hareereeyey nimankii magaalada, oo ahaa nimankii Sodom, yar iyo weynba, dadkii oo dhan oo ka yimid meel kastaba;
english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

kikuyu: oo Luud bay u yeedheen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Meeye nimankii caawa kuu yimid? Dibadda noogu soo bixi iyaga, aannu fuulnee.
english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

kikuyu: Oo Luudna dibadduu ugu baxay iyagoo albaabka jooga, albaabkiina wuu xidhay.
english: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Waan idin baryayaaye, walaalahayow, ee wax sidaas u xun ha samaynina.
english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

kikuyu: Bal eega, waxaan leeyahay laba gabdhood oo aan weli nin u tegin; haddaba waan idin baryayaaye, aan idiin soo bixiyo iyaga, oo saad doontaan u gala, laakiin nimankan uun waxba ha ku samaynina, maxaa yeelay, waxay soo hoos galeen dugsiga saqafkayga.
english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

kikuyu: Waxayna yidhaahdeen, Dib u joogso. Oo waxay kaloo yidhaahdeen, Ninkanu socdaal buu ku yimid, oo wuxuu doonayaa inuu xaakin noqdo. Haatan wax daran baannu kugu samayn, intaannu iyaga ku samayn lahayn in ka sii daran. Markaasay si xun ninkii Luud ahaa u riixeen. Waxayna ugu soo dhowaadeen inay albaabka jebiyaan.
english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.

kikuyu: Laakiinse nimankii baa gacmahoodii soo bixiyey, oo Luud bay gurigii soo gashadeen, markaasay albaabkii xidheen.
english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

kikuyu: Wayna indho tireen nimankii guriga albaabkiisa joogay, yar iyo weynba: oo saas daraaddeed way ka daaleen inay albaabkii helaan.
english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

kikuyu: Oo nimankii waxay Luud ku yidhaahdeen, Intan mooyaane wax kale ma ku leedahay meeshan? Wiil aad soddog u tahay iyo wiilashaada iyo gabdhahaaga, iyo ku alla kaad magaalada ku leedahay kala soo bax meeshan;
english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

kikuyu: waayo, meeshan waannu baabbi'in doonnaa, maxaa yeelay, qayladoodii baa Rabbiga hortiisa aad ugu badatay: oo Rabbigu wuxuu noo soo diray inaannu baabbi'inno.
english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Luud dibadda u baxay, oo wuxuu la hadlay wiilashuu soddogga u ahaa, oo gabdhihiisa qabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Kaca, oo ka soo baxa meeshan; waayo, Rabbigu magaalada wuu baabbi'in doonaa. Laakiin wuxuu wiilashuu soddogga u ahaa ula ekaaday sidii mid ku cayaaraya.
english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

kikuyu: Oo markii waagii beryay ayaa malaa'igihii Luud deddejiyeen, iyagoo leh, Kac, oo la tag naagtaada iyo labadaada gabdhood oo halkan jooga; waaba intaasoo aad dembiga magaalada ku baabba'daane.
english: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

kikuyu: Laakiin markuu raagay ayay nimankii gacantiisa qabteen, iyo gacantii naagtiisa, iyo gacantii labadiisii gabdhood; Rabbiguna waa u naxariistay isaga, iyana way soo bixiyeen, oo waxay geeyeen magaaladii dibaddeeda.
english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

kikuyu: Oo markay dibadda u soo bixiyeen ayuu ku yidhi, Naftaada la baxso; gadaashaadana ha eegin. Bannaanka oo dhanna ha joogsan, ee buurta u baxso, waaba intaas oo aad baabba'daaye.
english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

kikuyu: Luudna wuxuu ku yidhi iyagii, Sayidkaygiiyow, saas yaanay noqon.
english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, anigoo addoonkaaga ah raalli baad iga ahayd, oo waad weynaysay naxariistaadii aad i tustay markii aad naftayda badbaadisay; aniguse buurta uma baxsan karo, waaba intaasoo shar i gaadhaa oo aan dhintaa.
english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, magaaladan baa dhow inaan u cararo, waana mid yar, de iyada aan u baxsado, (miyaanay mid yar ahayn?) naftayduna waa noolaan doontaa.
english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi isagii, Bal eeg, waxanna waan kaa aqbalay inaanan rogi doonin magaaladii aad ka hadashay.
english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

kikuyu: Dhaqso, oo halkaas u baxso; waayo, waxba ma aan samayn karo ilaa aad halkaas tagto. Sidaas daraaddeed magaalada magaceeda waxaa loo bixiyey Socar.
english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

kikuyu: Markii Luud Socar yimid ayaa qorraxdu dhulka u soo baxday.
english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Sodom iyo Gomora ku soo daayay baruud iyo dab ka yimid xagga Rabbiga oo samada ka soo daatay;
english: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky.

kikuyu: wuuna rogay magaalooyinkaas, iyo Bannaankii oo dhan, iyo dadkii degganaa magaalooyinkaas oo dhan, iyo wixii dhulka ka soo baxay oo dhan.
english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

kikuyu: Laakiinse naagtiisii oo daba socotay ayaa dib u eegtay, waxayna noqotay tiir cusbo ah.
english: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna aroortii hore ayuu u kacay meeshii uu Rabbiga hor istaagay:
english: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu eegay xagga Sodom iyo Gomora, iyo dhulkii Bannaanka oo dhan, wuuna fiiriyey, oo bal eeg, qiiqii dhulka ayaa kor u baxay sidii qiiqa foornada oo kale.
english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay, markii Ilaah baabbi'iyey magaalooyinkii Bannaanka, in Ilaah xusuustay Ibraahim, Luudna roggidda wuu ka bixiyey markuu rogay magaalooyinkii Luud dhex degganaa.
english: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

kikuyu: Luudna Socar wuu ka baxay, oo buurtuu degay, isaga iyo labadiisii gabdhood ee la joogayba; waayo, wuu ka cabsaday inuu Socar degganaado, wuxuuna degay bohol dhexdeed, isaga iyo labadiisii gabdhood.
english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

kikuyu: Oo tii curadda ahayd waxay tii yarayd ku tidhi, Aabbeheen waa duq, dhulkana ma jiro nin inoo iman kara sida caadada dunida oo dhan tahay.
english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man on the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

kikuyu: Kaalay, aynu aabbeheen khamri cabsiinnee, markaasaynu la jiifsanaynaa, si aynu aabbeheen farcan ugala hadhno.
english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

kikuyu: Oo habeenkaasay aabbahood khamri cabsiiyeen, oo tii curadda ahayd baa u tagtay oo la jiifsatay aabbeheed; mana uu ogayn markay la jiifsatay, iyo markay ka kacday toona.
english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in maalintii dambe ay tii curadda ahayd ku tidhi tii yarayd, Bal eeg, xalayto aabbahay baan la jiifsaday: caawana aynu khamri cabsiinno; oo adigu u tag oo la jiifso isaga, aynu aabbeheen farcan kala hadhnee.
english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana habeenkaasay aabbahood khamri cabsiiyeen: oo tii yarayd baa kacday oo aabbeheed la jiifsatay; mana uu ogayn markay la jiifsatay iyo markay ka kacday toona.
english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

kikuyu: Oo sidaasay Luud labadiisii gabdhoodba aabbahood uurka ugu lahaayeen.
english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

kikuyu: Oo tii curaddii ahayd waxay dhashay wiil, oo waxay magiciisii u bixisay Moo'aab, isna waa reer Moo'aabka maanta joogo aabbahood.
english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

kikuyu: Tii yarayd iyana waxay dhashay wiil, oo waxay magiciisii u bixisay Bencammi: isna waa reer Cammoonka maanta jooga aabbahood.
english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna meeshaas wuu ka sodcaalay oo wuxuu u kacay xagga dhulka Koonfureed, oo wuxuuna degay Qaadeesh iyo Shuur dhexdooda, qariib ahaan buuna Geraar u degay.
english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wuxuu naagtiisii Saarah ka yidhi, Waa walaashay. Oo Abimeleg oo ahaa boqorkii Geraar ayaa u soo cid dirtay, oo watay Saarah.
english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaah baa Abimeleg habeenkii riyo ugu yimid, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eeg, waxaad tahay meyd uun, waana naagtii aad qaadatay aawadeed, maxaa yeelay, iyadu waa nin naagtiis.
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

kikuyu: Abimelegna uma uusan dhowaan iyada, wuxuuna yidhi, Sayidow, miyaad quruun xaq ah baabbi'inaysaa?
english: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

kikuyu: Miyuusan isaga qudhiisu igu odhan, Waa walaashay? Oo iyana xataa waxay igu tidhi, Isagu waa walaalkay. Tan waxaan ku sameeyey daacadnimada qalbigayga iyo daahirsanaanta gacmahayga.
english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu ku yidhi isaga intuu riyoonayay, Haah, waan ogahay inaad waxan daacadnimada qalbigaaga ku samaysay, anna waan kaa celiyey inaad igu dembaabto: sidaas daraaddeed kuuma aan oggolaan inaad iyada taabato.
english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

kikuyu: Haddaba ninka naagtiisa u celi, waayo, isagu waa nebi, wuuna kuu ducayn doonaa, waanad noolaan doontaa. Haddaadan iyada celinna, ogow hubaal waad dhiman doontaa, adiga iyo waxaaga oo dhammuba.
english: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

kikuyu: Abimelegna aroor horuu kacay, oo wuxuu u yeedhay addoommadiisii oo dhan, oo waxyaalahan oo dhan buu u sheegay, nimankiina aad iyo aad bay u cabsadeen.
english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abimeleg wuxuu u yeedhay Ibraahim, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa maxay waxa aad nagu samaysay? Oo maxaan kuugu dembaabay, oo aad aniga iyo boqortooyadaydaba dembi weyn ugu soo jiidday? Waxaad igu samaysay waxyaalo aan waajib ahayn in la sameeyo.
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

kikuyu: Abimelegna wuxuu Ibraahim ku yidhi, Maxaad aragtay oo aad waxan u samaysay?
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan mooday inaan cabsida Ilaah meeshan jirin, oo ay naagtayda aawadeed ii dili doonaan.
english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

kikuyu: Oo weliba sida runta ah iyadu waa walaashay, waana gabadhii aabbahay, laakiin ma aha gabadhii hooyaday; waxayna noqotay naagtaydii.
english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

kikuyu: Waxaana dhacay, markii Ilaah iga wareejiyey gurigii aabbahay, inaan ku idhi iyada, Raxmaddaada aad i tusi doonto waxay tahay inaad meel kastoo aynu tagnaba iga tidhaahdo, Waa walaalkay.
english: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abimeleg wuxuu waday ido iyo dibiyo, iyo niman addoommo ah, iyo naago addoommo ah, oo wuxuu siiyey Ibraahim, naagtiisii Saarahna wuu u celiyey.
english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

kikuyu: Abimelegna wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eeg dhulkaygu waa ku hor yaallaaye. Meeshaad doonto deg.
english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

kikuyu: Saarahna wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eeg, walaalkaa waxaan siiyey kun xabbadood oo lacag ah, waana u indhadabool kuwa kula jooga oo dhan; oo xagga wax kasta waa lagaa xaq mariyey.
english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna Ilaah buu baryay, markaasaa Ilaah bogsiiyey Abimeleg, iyo naagtiisii, iyo gabdhihii midiidinyada u ahaa; waxayna dhaleen carruur.
english: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah wuxuu awday maxalladii kuwa reerka Abimeleg oo dhan, waana Saarah oo ahayd naagtii Ibraahim aawadeed.
english: For the LORD had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu Saarah wuu soo booqday siduu yidhi, oo Rabbigu wuxuu Saarah u yeelay siduu kula hadlay.
english: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.

kikuyu: Oo Saarah way uuraysatay, oo Ibraahim wiil bay u dhashay isagoo da' weyn, waxayna ahayd wakhtigii Ilaah kala hadlay isaga.
english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahim wuxuu wiilkiisii u dhashay, oo Saarah u dhashay isaga, u bixiyey Isxaaq.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahim baa guday wiilkiisii Isxaaq markuu siddeed maalmood jiray, sidii Ilaah ku amray isaga.
english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahimna wuxuu jiray boqol sannadood, markii wiilkiisii Isxaaq u dhashay isaga.
english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

kikuyu: Saarahna waxay tidhi, Ilaah waa iga qosliyey, qof kasta oo maqlaana waa ila qosli doonaa.
english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay tidhi, Yaa Ibraahim ku odhan lahaa, Saarah carruur bay nuujin doontaa? Waayo, wiil baan u dhalay isaga oo da' weyn.
english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

kikuyu: Wiilkiina wuu koray, naaskiina waa laga gudhiyey. Ibraahimna diyaafad weyn buu sameeyey maalintii Isxaaq naaska laga gudhiyey.
english: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

kikuyu: Saarahna waxay aragtay wiilkii ay Haagaar tii Masriyadda ahayd Ibraahim u dhashay oo ku cayaaraya.
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxay Ibraahim ku tidhi, Eri addoontan iyo wiilkeedaba: maxaa yeelay, wiilka addoontanu wax la dhaxli maayo wiilkayga Isxaaq ah.
english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

kikuyu: Waxaasuna Ibraahim aad buu ula xumaa xagga wiilkiisa.
english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu Ibraahim ku yidhi, Yaanay kula xumaan wiilka dartiis, iyo naagta addoonta ah toona. Wax alla wixii Saarah kugu tidhaahdo, hadalkeeda maqal; waayo, farcankaaga Isxaaq baa loogu yeedhi doonaa.
english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

kikuyu: Wiilka addoontana waxaan ka dhigi doonaa quruun, waayo, isna waa farcankaaga.
english: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna aroortii horuu kacay, wuxuuna qaaday cunto iyo sibraar biyo ah, oo Haagaar buu siiyey intuu garbaha u saaray, wiilkiina wuu siiyey, markaasuu eryay: wayna iska tagtay, oo ku wareegtay cidladii Bi'ir Shebac.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

kikuyu: Biyihii sibraarka ku jirayna way dhammaadeen, kolkaasay ilmihii ku xoortay geedihii midkood hoostiisa.
english: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

kikuyu: Wayna tagtay oo waxay fadhiisatay meel ku soo jeedda oo ka fog, oo qiyaastii ah intii fallaadh la ganay gaadho, waxayna tidhi, Yaanan eegin dhimashada wiilka. Iyadoo fadhida meel ku soo jeedda ayay codkeedii kor u qaadday oo ooyday.
english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

kikuyu: Ilaah baana maqlay codkii wiilka; malaa'igtii Ilaahna Haagaar bay samada uga yeedhay, oo waxay ku tidhi, Haagaaray, maxaa ku helay? Ha baqin; waayo, Ilaah waa maqlay codkii wiilka, meeshuu joogo isagu.
english: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

kikuyu: Kac oo wiilka toosi, oo gacantaada ku hay; maxaa yeelay, quruun weyn baan ka dhigi doonaa isaga.
english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ilaah indhaheedii furay, oo waxay aragtay ceel biyo ah; kolkaasay tagtay, oo sibraarkii biyo ka soo buuxisay, oo wiilkii waraabisay.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wiilkii buu la jiray; wuuna koray; oo cidladuu degay, wuxuuna noqday qaansoole.
english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna degay cidladii Faaraan: hooyadiis baana dhulka Masar naag uga qaadday.
english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Waxayna noqotay wakhtigaas in Abimeleg iyo Fiikol oo ahaa madaxda ciidankiisa ay la hadleen Ibraahim iyagoo leh, Ilaah waa kugula jiraa waxa aad samayso oo dhan.
english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

kikuyu: Haddaba halkan Ilaah iigu dhaaro inaadan i khiyaanaynin aniga ama wiilkayga, ama wiilkayga wiilkiisa, laakiinse sidii aan wanaagga kuugu sameeyey, inaad adna iigu samaynaysid, aniga iyo dhulka aad qariib ahaanta u degganaydba.
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wuxuu yidhi, Waan kuu dhaaran doonaa.
english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

kikuyu: Ibraahimse wuxuu Abimeleg u canaantay ceelkii ay addoommada Abimeleg ka xoogeen aawadiis.
english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

kikuyu: Abimelegna wuxuu yidhi, Anigu garan maayo ka waxaas sameeyey; adna iima aad sheegin, welina ma aan maqlin, maanta mooyaane.
english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ibraahim ido iyo dibiyo kaxeeyey, oo wuxuu siiyey Abimeleg; labadoodiina axdi bay dhigteen.
english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ibraahim idihii gooni ahaan uga bixiyey toddoba sabeenood.
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

kikuyu: Abimelegna wuxuu Ibraahim ku yidhi, Micnehoodu waa maxay toddobadan sabeenood oo aad gooni ahaantooda u bixisay?
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Toddobadan sabeenood waa inaad iga guddoontid inay markhaati ii noqoto inaan anigu ceelkan qoday.
english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed meeshaas wuxuu u bixiyey Bi'ir Shebac; maxaa yeelay, labadooduba meeshaas bay ku dhaarteen.
english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed axdi bay ku dhigteen Bi'ir Shebac; markaasaa Abimeleg kacay, isaga iyo Fiikol oo ahaa madaxda ciidankiisa, oo waxay ku noqdeen dhulkii reer Falastiin.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna geed buu Bi'ir Shebac ku beeray, oo halkaas buu ku ducaystay magaca Rabbiga Ilaaha daa'imka ah.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna maalmo badan ayuu dhulka reer Falastiin qariib ahaan ku degganaa.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacay waxyaalahaas ka dib, in Ilaah tijaabiyey Ibraahim, oo uu ku yidhi, Ibraahimow. Isna wuxuu yidhi, Waa i kan.
english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Hadda kaxee wiilkaaga keligiis ah, kan aad jeceshahay, oo ah Isxaaq, oo u kac dalka Moriyaah; oo halkaas isaga sida allabari la gubo ku dul bixi buuraha middood oo aan kuu sheegi doono.
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

kikuyu: Oo aroortii horaa Ibraahim kacay, oo wuxuu kooraystay dameerkiisii, oo wuxuu kaxaystay laba ka mid ah dhallinyaradiisii, iyo wiilkiisii Isxaaq; qoryihiina allabariga la gubo wuu u jeexjeexay, wuuna kacay, oo wuxuu tegey meeshii Ilaah u sheegay.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

kikuyu: Maalintii saddexaad ayuu Ibraahim indhihiisa kor u taagay, markaasuu meeshii oo ka fog arkay.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wuxuu raggiisii dhallinyarada ahaa ku yidhi, Idinku halkan dameerka la jooga, aniga iyo wiilkuna halkoo baannu tegaynaa oo Ilaah ku soo caabudaynaa, dabadeedna waannu idinku soo noqonaynaa.
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wuxuu qaaday qoryihii allabariga la gubo, oo wuxuu saaray wiilkiisii Isxaaq, isna wuxuu gacantiisa ku qaaday dabkii iyo mindidii; markaasay labadoodiiba israaceen.
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

kikuyu: Isxaaqna waa la hadlay aabbihiis Ibraahim, oo yidhi, Aabbow. Isna wuxuu yidhi, Waa i kan, wiilkaygiiyow. Markaasuu ku yidhi, Bal eeg, waa kuwan dabkii iyo qoryihii, laakiinse meeh wankii allabariga la gubo loo bixin lahaa?
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wuxuu yidhi, Ilaah qudhiisaa keeni doona wankii allabariga la gubo loo bixin lahaa, wiilkaygiiyow; saas daraaddeed labadoodiiba way israaceen.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

kikuyu: Oo waxay yimaadeen meeshii Ilaah isaga u sheegay; Ibraahimna meeshaasuu ka dhisay meeshii allabariga, qoryihiina wuu hagaajiyey, markaasuu xidhay wiilkiisii Isxaaq, oo meeshii allabariga saaray qoryihii dushooda.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna gacantiisii buu fidiyey, oo mindidii buu u qaaday inuu wiilkiisii dilo.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

kikuyu: Markaasay malaa'igtii Rabbigu samada uga yeedhay isaga, oo waxay ku tidhi, Ibraahimow, Ibraahimow. Kolkaasuu yidhi, Waa i kan.
english: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Markaasay ku tidhi, Gacantaada ha saarin wiilka, waxbana ha ku samaynin: waayo, hadda waan garanayaa inaad Ilaah ka cabsatid, maxaa yeelay, igama aadan lexejeclaysan wiilkaaga, kaas oo ahaa wiilkaaga keligiis ah.
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ibraahim indhihiisii kor u taagay, oo wax fiiriyey, oo wuxuu dabadiisa ku arkay wan geesaha kayn kula jira. Markaasaa Ibraahim tegey oo wankii soo kaxeeyey, oo wuxuu u bixiyey allabari guban meeshii wiilkiisa.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna meeshaas wuxuu u bixiyey Yehowah Yireh; xataa ilaa maanta waxaa la yidhaahdaa, Buurta Rabbiga ayaa lagu arki doonaa.
english: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa mar labaad malaa'igtii Rabbigu Ibraahim samada uga yeedhay,
english: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku tidhi, Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi, Waxan aad samaysay aawadood, iyo wiilkaaga aadan iga lexejeclaysan, kaas oo ah wiilkaaga keligiis ah aawadiis ayaan nafsaddayda ku dhaartay
english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

kikuyu: inaan barako ku barakayn doono, oo aan farcankaaga u tarmin doono sida xiddigaha cirka, iyo sida cammuudda taal badda xeebteeda; oo uu farcankaaguna hantiyi doono cadaawayaashiisa iriddooda;
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

kikuyu: oo ay quruumaha dunida oo dhammu ku barakoobi doonaan farcankaaga, maxaa yeelay, codkaygaad addeecday.
english: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

kikuyu: Haddaba Ibraahim wuxuu ku noqday raggiisii dhallinyarada ahaa, markaasay kaceen oo waxay wada tageen Bi'ir Shebac, Ibraahimna wuxuu iska degay Bi'ir Shebac.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacay waxyaalahaas dabadood, in Ibraahim loo sheegay, oo lagu yidhi, Bal eeg, Milkah carruur bay u dhashay walaalkaa Naaxoor.
english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

kikuyu: Waxay yihiin Cuus oo ah curadkiisa, iyo Buus oo ah walaalkiis, iyo Qemuu'el oo ah Araam aabbihiis;
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

kikuyu: iyo Kesed, iyo Haso, iyo Fildash, iyo Yidlaf iyo Betuu'el.
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

kikuyu: Betuu'elna wuxuu dhalay Rebeqah. Siddeeddan bay Milkah u dhashay Naaxoor, oo ahaa Ibraahim walaalkiis.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

kikuyu: Addoontiisii la odhan jiray Re'uumah waxay iyana u dhashay Tebah, iyo Gaham, iyo Tahash, iyo Macakah.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

kikuyu: Saarah waxay noolayd boqol iyo toddoba iyo labaatan sannadood; intaasu waa Saarah cimrigeedii.
english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

kikuyu: Oo Saarah waxay ku dhimatay Qiryad Arbac, taasoo ah Xebroon, tan ku taal dalka Kancaan: Ibraahimna wuxuu u yimid inuu u baroorto, oo uu u ooyo Saarah.
english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ibraahim meydkii naagtiisa ka kacay, oo wuxuu la hadlay reer Xeed, isagoo ku leh,
english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaan ahay shisheeye sodcaal ah oo idin dhex jooga: ee dhexdiinna iga siiya meel xabaaleed oo hanti ah, si aan meydka naagtayda hortayda uga aaso.
english: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

kikuyu: Oo reer Xeedna Ibraahim bay u jawaabeen, iyagoo ku leh,
english: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

kikuyu: Bal na maqal sayidkaygiiyow, adigu dhexdayada waxaad ku tahay amiir weyn. Midka ugu wanaagsan qabriyadayada meydka naagtaada ku aas.
english: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Midkayana kaama lexejeclaysan doono qabrigiisa inaad ku aastid meydka naagtaada. Markaasaa Ibraahim sare kacay, oo uu u sujuuday dadkii waddanka lahaa, oo ahaa reer Xeed.
english: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

kikuyu: Wuuna la hadlay oo ku yidhi, Haddaad oggoshihiin inaan meydka naagtayda hortayda ka aaso, i maqla oo ii barya Cefroon ina Sohar,
english: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

kikuyu: inuu i siiyo godka la yidhaahdo Makfelah oo uu haysto, oo ku yaal berrinkiisa geestiisa. Qiimo dhan ha iga siiyo, inay dhexdiinna ii noqoto meel xabaaleed oo hanti ah.
english: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Cefroon wuxuu fadhiyey reer Xeed dhexdooda; oo Cefroon oo ahaa reer Xeed ayaa Ibraahim u jawaabay, iyadoo ay maqlayaan reer Xeed intii iriddii magaaladiisa ka gashay oo dhammu, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

kikuyu: Maya, sayidkaygiiyow, i maqal, berrinka waan ku siinayaa, godka ku dhex yaalna waan ku siinayaa; waxaan kugu siinayaa ragga reerkayga hortooda, ee meydka ku aaso.
english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wuxuu ku hor sujuuday dadkii waddanka.
english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Cefroon la hadlay iyadoo ay dadkii waddanku maqlayaan, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, haddaad oggoshahay i maqal; waan ku siin qiimihii berrinka ee iga qaado, anna meydkaan meeshaas ku aasan.
english: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

kikuyu: Cefroonna Ibraahim buu u jawaabay, isagoo ku leh,
english: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

kikuyu: Sayidkaygiiyow, bal i maqal: meel dhul ah oo qiimihiisu yahay afar boqol oo sheqel oo lacag ah, waa maxay dhexdeenna? Haddaba meydka aaso.
english: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna Cefroon buu maqlay; markaasaa Ibraahim u miisaamay Cefroon lacagtii uu u sheegay, iyadoo ay reer Xeed maqlayaan, oo waxay ahayd, afar boqol oo sheqel oo lacag ah, oo lacagtii baayacmushtarka ku socotay ah.
english: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

kikuyu: Sidaasaa berrinkii Cefroon, oo Makfelah ku yiil, oo Mamre ku hor yiil, berrinkii iyo godkii ku dhex yiil, iyo geedihii ku yiil berrinkii, iyo xuduudkii ku wareegsanaa oo dhanba waxaa lagu xaqiijiyey
english: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

kikuyu: reer Xeed intii iriddii magaaladiisa ka gashay oo dhan hortooda, in Ibraahim hanti ahaan u lahaado.
english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

kikuyu: Markaas ka dib ayaa Ibraahim naagtiisii Saarah ku aasay godkii berrinkii Makfelah oo ku hor yiil Mamre, taas oo ah Xebroon oo dalka Kancaan ku tiil.
english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Oo berrinkii iyo godkii ku dhex yiilba reer Xeed ayaa Ibraahim u xaqiijiyey inay meel xabaaleed oo hanti ah u noqdaan.
english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.
