kikuyu: Ibraahimna waa da' weynaa, gabow buuna la dhacay. Rabbiguna Ibraahim buu ku barakeeyey wax walba.
english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahim, wuxuu ku yidhi addoonkiisii oo dadka gurigiisa ugu weynaa, oo u talin jiray wixii uu lahaa oo dhan, Waan ku baryayaaye gacantaada bowdadayda hoos dhig.
english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan kugu dhaarin doonaa Rabbiga ah Ilaaha samada iyo Ilaaha dhulka inaadan wiilkayga naag uga guurinayn gabdhaha reer Kancaanka aan dhex degganahay:
english: I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

kikuyu: laakiin waxaad u kacdaa dalkaygii iyo xigaalkaygii, oo waxaad naag uga keentaa wiilkayga Isxaaq.
english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

kikuyu: Addoonkiina wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaa laga yaabaa inaanay naagtu oggolaan inay ii soo raacdo dalkan; ma inaan wiilkaaga ku celiyo dalkii aad ka timid baa?
english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wuxuu ku yidhi isagii, Iska jir oo wiilkayga meeshaas ha ku celin.
english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaaha samada ah, oo iga soo kaxeeyey gurigii aabbahay iyo dalkaygii aan ku dhashay, oo ila hadlay, iiguna dhaartay, isagoo leh, Farcankaaga ayaan dalkan siinayaa, ayaa malaa'igtiisa kaa sii hor diri doona, wiilkaygana naag baad halkaas uga soo guurin doontaa.
english: The LORD, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

kikuyu: Haddii naagtu aanay oggolaan inay ku soo raacdo, markaas dhaartaydan waxba kaa ma saarna, laakiin wiilkayga halkaas ha ku celin.
english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

kikuyu: Addoonkii wuxuu gacantiisii hoos dhigay bowdadii sayidkiisii Ibraahim, wuxuuna ugu dhaartay wax arrintan ku saabsan.
english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

kikuyu: Addoonkiina wuxuu kaxeeyey toban awr, oo ka mid ah awrtii sayidkiisa, wuuna tegey, isagoo gacantiisa ku haya waxyaalihii sayidkiisa oo wanaagsanaa oo dhan, oo intuu kacay ayuu tegey Mesobotamiya, xagga magaalada Naaxoor.
english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

kikuyu: Awrtiina wuxuu tu'iyey meel magaalada dibaddeeda ah oo ceelka biyaha agtiisa ah kolkay galabtii ahayd, marka dumarku biyo dhaansiga u soo baxaan.
english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Rabbiyow, sayidkayga Ibraahim Ilaahiisow, waan ku baryayaaye, maanta i liibaani, sayidkayga Ibraahimna u roonow.
english: He said, “LORD, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxaan ag taaganahay isha biyaha ah, gabdhaha dadka magaaladuna waxay u soo baxayaan inay biyo dhaansadaan.
english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

kikuyu: Gabadhii aan ku odhan doono, Ashuunkaaga deji, waan ku baryayaaye, aan ka cabbee, oo igu odhan doonta, Cab, awrtaadana waan waraabin doonaa, taasu ha noqoto tii aad u dooratay addoonkaaga Isxaaq, oo taas baan ku ogaan doonaa inaad sayidkayga u roonaatay.
english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

kikuyu: Intuusan hadalkii dhammayn, waxaa soo baxday, iyadoo ashuunkeedii garabka ku sidata, Rebeqah oo u dhalatay Betuu'el wiilkii Milkah, oo ahayd naagtii Naaxoorkii ahaa Ibraahim walaalkiis.
english: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

kikuyu: Gabadhuna waa suurad quruxsanayd, waxayna ahayd bikrad aan ninna u tegin. Waxay tagtay ishii biyaha ahayd xaggeeda, oo intay ashuunkeedii soo buuxsatay, ayay soo baxday.
english: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

kikuyu: Markaasuu addoonkii ku orday inuu ka hor tago oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ashuunkaaga iga waraabi in yar oo biyo ah, waan ku baryayaaye.
english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

kikuyu: Markaasay tidhi, Cab, sayidkaygiiyow. Oo intay dhaqsatay ayay ashuunkeedii dejisay oo gacanta ku qabatay, wayna waraabisay.
english: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

kikuyu: Oo markii ay waraabisay ka dib ayay ku tidhi, Awrtaadana waan u dhaamin doonaa, ilaa ay wabxaan.
english: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

kikuyu: Oo intay dhaqsatay ayay biyihii ashuunkeedii ku shubtay berkeddii, oo mar kalay ceelkii ku orodday inay soo dhaamiso, wayna u dhaamisay awrtiisii oo dhan.
english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

kikuyu: Ninkiina aad buu u fiiriyey iyada, isagoo aamusan, inuu ogaado in Rabbigu ku liibaaniyey sodcaalkiisii iyo in kale.
english: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

kikuyu: Markii awrtii cabtay ka dib ayaa ninkii soo qaaday sangelis dahab ah oo miisaankiisu yahay nus sheqel, gacmaheedana wuxuu u soo qaaday laba dugaagadood oo dahab ah oo miisaankoodu yahay toban sheqel.
english: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ina ayaad tahay? Waan ku baryayaaye, ii sheeg. Guriga aabbahaa meel aannu ku hoyanno ma leeyahay?
english: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku tidhi isagii, Anigu waxaan ahay ina Betuu'el, wiilkii Milkah ay Naaxoor u dhashay.
english: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxa kale oo ay ku tidhi, Caws iyo cunto badanba waannu haysannaa, iyo meel lagu hoydo.
english: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa ninkii madaxa foororiyey oo Rabbiga caabuday.
english: The man bowed his head, and worshiped the LORD.

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Mahad waxaa leh Rabbiga ah sayidkayga Ibraahim Ilaahiisa, oo aan naxariistiisa iyo runtiisa ka joojin sayidkayga. Anigana Rabbigu jidkuu igu soo hoggaamiyey, oo wuxuu i keenay gurigii sayidkayga walaalihiis.
english: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

kikuyu: Gabadhiina intay orodday ayay waxyaalahan dadkii guriga hooyadeed uga warrantay.
english: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

kikuyu: Rebeqahna waxay lahayd walaal magiciisa la yidhaahdo Laabaan. Markaasaa Laabaan dibadda u baxay oo wuxuu ku orday ninkii isha joogay.
english: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

kikuyu: Markuu arkay sangeliskii, iyo dugaagadihii gacmihii walaashiis ku jiray, oo uu maqlay hadalkii walaashiis Rebeqah, iyadoo leh, Sidan buu ninkii iila hadlay, ayuu u yimid ninkii oo bal eeg, wuxuu ag istaagay awrtii isha joogtay.
english: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Kaaga Rabbigu barakeeyeyow, soo gal, maxaad dibadda u taagan tahay? Gurigii waan soo hagaajiyey, awrtana meel baan u diyaariyey.
english: He said, “Come in, you blessed of the LORD. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

kikuyu: Ninkiina gurigii buu soo galay, awrtiina wuu furay, wuxuuna isaga awrtii ugu dhiibay caws iyo cunto, biyona wuu siiyey inay ku cago maydhaan isaga iyo raggii la socdayba.
english: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

kikuyu: Cuntona waa la hor dhigay inuu cuno: laakiinse wuxuu yidhi, Cuni maayo ilaa aan sheego farriintayda. Kolkaasuu yidhi, Sheeg.
english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Waxaan ahay Ibraahim addoonkiisa.
english: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

kikuyu: Rabbigu aad iyo aad buu u barakeeyey sayidkayga, wuuna weynaaday: wuxuuna siiyey adhi iyo lo', iyo lacag iyo dahab, iyo rag addoommo ah, iyo naago addoommo ah, iyo geel iyo dameerro.
english: The LORD has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. The LORD has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

kikuyu: Saarah oo ahayd sayidkayga naagtiisii ayaa wiil u dhashay sayidkayga markay gabowday, oo wuxuu isaga siiyey wuxuu leeyahay oo dhan.
english: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

kikuyu: Sayidkayguna wuu i dhaariyey, isagoo leh, Wiilkayga waa inaanad naag uga guurin gabdhaha reer Kancaanka aan dalkooda degganahay.
english: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaad u kacdaa gurigii aabbahay, iyo xigaalkaygii, oo wiilkayga naag uga keen.
english: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

kikuyu: Markaasaan sayidkaygii ku idhi, Waxaa laga yaabaa inaanay naagtu i soo raaci doonin.
english: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Rabbiga aan hortiisa ku socdo wuxuu ku raacin doonaa malaa'igtiisa, jidkaagana wuu kugu liibaanin doonaa, wiilkaygana naag baad uga guurin doontaa xigaalkaygii iyo gurigii aabbahay,
english: He said to me, ‘The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

kikuyu: dabadeedna dhaartayda waxba kaama saarna, markaad u tagto xigaalkay; oo hadday iyada ku siin waayaan, markaas dhaartayda waxba kaama saarna.
english: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

kikuyu: Maantaan isha imid oo waxaan idhi, Rabbiyow, sayidkayga Ibraahim Ilaahiisow, haddaad haatan jidkayga aan ku socdo igu liibaanisid,
english: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘The LORD, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

kikuyu: bal eeg, waxaan ag taaganahay isha biyaha ah, gabadhii u soo baxda inay biyo dhaansato oo aan ku odhan doono, Waan ku baryayaaye, ashuunkaaga iga sii in yar oo biyo ah aan cabbee,
english: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

kikuyu: oo igu odhan doonta, Cab, awrtaadana waan u dhaamin doonaa, taasu ha noqoto tii Rabbigu u doortay wiilka sayidkayga.
english: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.’

kikuyu: Oo intaan hadalkii qalbigayga ka dhammaan ayaa Rebeqah soo baxday iyadoo ashuunkeedii garabka ku sidata, markaasay ishii ku dhaadhacday, oo soo dhaansatay: anna waxaan ku idhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, i waraabi.
english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

kikuyu: Iyana intay dhaqsatay oo ay ashuunkeedii garabkeeda ka soo dejisay ayay tidhi, Cab, awrtaadana waan waraabin doonaa: sidaas daraaddeed waan cabbay, awrtiina way waraabisay.
english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

kikuyu: Markaasaan weyddiiyey oo ku idhi, Ina ayaad tahay? Oo waxay tidhi, Ina Betuu'el wiilkii Naaxoor ay Milkah u dhashay isaga. Markaasaan sangeliskii sanka u sudhay; dugaagadihiina gacmaha u geliyey.
english: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaan madaxa foororiyey, oo Rabbiga caabuday, oo waxaan ammaanay Rabbiga ah sayidkayga Ibraahim Ilaahiisa, oo igu soo hoggaamiyey jidkii toosnaa, inaan gabadhii sayidkayga walaalkiis u kaxeeyo wiilkiisa.
english: I bowed my head, and worshiped the LORD, and blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaad sayidkayga ula macaamiloonaysaan si raxmad leh oo daacad ah, ii sheega: haddii kalese ii sheega, inaan u leexdo xagga midigta ama xagga bidixda.
english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

kikuyu: Markaasay Laabaan iyo Betuu'el jawaabeen oo yidhaahdeen, Waxanu wuxuu ka soo baxay xagga Rabbiga, annana kugulama hadli karno xumaan iyo samaan toona.
english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from the LORD. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, Rebeqah waa ku hor joogtaaye, kaxee oo la tag, oo ha noqoto sayidkaaga wiilkiisii naagtiisa, sidii Rabbigu ku hadlay.
english: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as the LORD has spoken.”

kikuyu: Markii uu Ibraahim addoonkiisii hadalkoodii maqlay ayuu Rabbiga u sujuuday.
english: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to the LORD.

kikuyu: Markaasuu addoonkii soo bixiyey jowharro lacag ah iyo jowharro dahab ah, iyo dhar, oo Rebeqah siiyey: walaalkeed iyo hooyadeedna wuxuu siiyey waxyaalo qaali ah.
english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

kikuyu: Markaasay wax cuneen oo wax cabbeen, isaga iyo raggii la jirayba, habeenkii oo dhanna halkaasay joogeen. Aroortii bay kaceen oo wuxuu yidhi, Xagga sayidkaygii ii dira.
english: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

kikuyu: Walaalkeed iyo hooyadeedna waxay yidhaahdeen, Gabadhu ha nala joogto dhawr maalmood, ugu yaraan toban beri; dabadeedna way tegi doontaa.
english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi iyagii, Rabbigu waa igu liibaaniyey jidkaygii, sidaas daraaddeed ha i raajinina, ee i dira inaan sayidkaygii u tago.
english: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

kikuyu: Markaasay yidhaahdeen, Gabadha waannu u yeedhi doonnaa oo weyddiin doonnaa.
english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

kikuyu: Markaasay Rebeqah u yeedheen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Ninkan ma raacaysaa? Oo waxay tidhi, Haah, waan raacayaa.
english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

kikuyu: Markaasay walaashood Rebeqah direen, iyada iyo midiidinteedii, iyo addoonkii Ibraahim, iyo raggiisiiba.
english: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

kikuyu: Oo Rebeqah bay u duceeyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Walaashayoy, kumanyaal kun hooyadood noqo, farcankaaguna kuwa iyaga neceb iriddooda ha hantiyeen.
english: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

kikuyu: Rebeqahna way kacday, iyada iyo gabdhaheediiba, oo waxay fuuleen awrtii, ninkiina way raaceen: addoonkiina wuu kaxeeyey Rebeqah, wuuna tegey.
english: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuxuu ka yimid xagga jidka Bi'ir Lahayroy, waayo, wuxuu degganaa dhulka Koonfureed.
english: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

kikuyu: Oo gabbaldhicii ayaa Isxaaq berrinka u soo baxay inuu fikiro: markaasuu indhihiisa kor u taagay, oo wax fiiriyey, oo wuxuu arkay awr soo socota.
english: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

kikuyu: Rebeqahna indhaheedii bay kor u taagtay, oo markay Isxaaq aragtay ayay ratigii ka degtay.
english: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

kikuyu: Oo waxay addoonkii ku tidhi, Waa ayo ninkaas berrinka dhex socda, oo inaga hor imanaya? Addoonkiina wuxuu yidhi, Waa sayidkaygii. Markaasay indhashareerteedii qaadatay oo hagoogatay.
english: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

kikuyu: Addoonkiina wuxuu Isxaaq u sheegay wixii uu sameeyey oo dhan.
english: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuxuu iyadii soo geliyey teendhadii hooyadiis Saarah, Rebeqahna wuu guursaday, oo naagtiisii bay noqotay. Wuuna jeclaaday iyada, oo Isxaaq waxaa laga qalbi qabowjiyey geeridii hooyadiis.
english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

kikuyu: Ibraahim wuxuu guursaday naag kale, magaceeduna wuxuu ahaa Qetuurah.
english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

kikuyu: Oo waxay u dhashay Simraan, iyo Yoqshaan, iyo Medaan, iyo Midyaan, iyo Yishbaaq, iyo Shuu'ah.
english: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

kikuyu: Yoqshaanna wuxuu dhalay Shebaa, iyo Dedaan. Wiilashii Dedaanna waxay ahaayeen Ashuurim, iyo Letushim, iyo Le'ummiim.
english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Midyaanna waxay ahaayeen Ceefah, iyo Ceefer, iyo Xanoog, iyo Abiidac iyo Eldacah. Kuwanu waxay wada ahaayeen carruurtii Qetuurah.
english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna wax alla wuxuu lahaa wuxuu siiyey Isxaaq.
english: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

kikuyu: Laakiinse naagihii addoommada ahaa oo Ibraahim haystay wuxuu wiilashoodii siiyey hadiyado, oo intuu isagu noolaa ayuu ka diray wiilkiisii Isxaaq, bari buuna u diray xagga dhulka bari.
english: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

kikuyu: Sannadihii Ibraahim noolaa oo cimrigiisu ahaa waa boqol iyo shan iyo toddobaatan sannadood.
english: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

kikuyu: Ibraahimna waa naf baxay, cimri wanaagsan buuna ku dhintay, isagoo duq ah, oo sannado badan jiray; oo wuxuu ku darmaday dadkiisii.
english: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

kikuyu: Markaasay wiilashiisii Isxaaq iyo Ismaaciil ku aaseen godkii Makfelah, oo ku dhex yiil berrinkii Cefroon ina Sohar oo ahaa reer Xeed oo ku hor yiil Mamre;
english: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

kikuyu: berrinkaas oo ahaa kii Ibraahim ka iibsaday reer Xeed. Halkaasaa lagu aasay Ibraahim iyo naagtiisii Saarahba.
english: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

kikuyu: Ibraahim geeridiisii ka dib ayaa Ilaah barakeeyey wiilkiisii Isxaaq; Isxaaqna wuxuu ag degganaa Bi'ir Lahayroy.
english: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa farcankii Ismaaciil ina Ibraahim, kii Haagaar tii Masriyadda ahayd oo Saarah midiidinteedii ahayd ay u dhashay Ibraahim.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa magacyadii wiilashii Ismaaciil, magacyadoodii sidii farcankoodii ahaa. Curadkii Ismaaciil wuxuu ahaa Nebayod; waxaana ku xigay Qedaar, iyo Adbe'el, iyo Mibsam,
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

kikuyu: iyo Mishmaac, iyo Duumah, iyo Masa;
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

kikuyu: Hadar, iyo Tema, iyo Yetuur, iyo Nafish, iyo Qedemah.
english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa wiilashii Ismaaciil, kuwanuna waa magacyadoodii sidii ay tuulooyinkoodii iyo xeryahoodii ahaayeen; waxayna lahaayeen laba iyo toban amiir sidii ay qolooyinkoodii ahaayeen.
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

kikuyu: Sannadihii Ismaaciil noolaa waa boqol iyo toddoba iyo soddon sannadood, wuuna naf baxay, oo dhintay; wuxuuna ku darmaday dadkiisii.
english: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

kikuyu: Waxayna degganaayeen tan iyo Xawiilaah iyo Shuur tan ku hor taal Masar, haddaad u kacdo xagga Ashuur. Walaalihiis oo dhan hortooda ayuu degay.
english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa farcankii Isxaaq ina Ibraahim. Ibraahim Isxaaq buu dhalay:
english: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

kikuyu: Isxaaqna afartan sannadood buu jiray markuu guursaday Rebeqah ina Betuu'el kii dalkiisu ahaa Suuriya ee reer Fadan Araam, iyadoo ahayd Laabaan kii dalkiisu Suuriya ahaa walaashiis.
english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

kikuyu: Isxaaqna naagtiisuu Rabbiga u baryay, maxaa yeelay, madhalays bay ahayd, Rabbiguna waa ka aqbalay, markaasay naagtiisii Rebeqah uuraysatay.
english: Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren. The LORD was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

kikuyu: Carruurtiina uurkeeday isku dhex riixriixeen; markaasay tidhi, Hadday saas tahay, maxaan sidan u ahay? Kolkaasay u tagtay inay Rabbiga wax weyddiiso.
english: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of the LORD.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu ku yidhi iyada, Laba quruumood baa maxalkaaga ku jirta, Oo laba dad oo kala duwan ayaa uurkaaga ka soo bixi doona; Oo labada dad midkood baa ka xoog badnaan doona dadka kale; Kan weynuna wuxuu u adeegi doonaa kan ka yar.
english: The LORD said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

kikuyu: Oo markii wakhtigii ay umuli lahayd dhammaaday, bal eeg, waxaa maxalkeedii ku jiray mataano.
english: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

kikuyu: Oo kii hore wuu soo baxay isagoo cas, korkiisa oo dhammuna wuxuu u ekaa dhar dhogor laga sameeyey, magiciisiina waxay u baxsheen Ceesaw.
english: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna waxaa soo baxay walaalkiis, gacantiisuna waxay ku dhegganayd cedhibta Ceesaw; magiciisiina waxaa loo bixiyey Yacquub; Isxaaqna lixdan sannadood buu jiray markay iyaga dhashay.
english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

kikuyu: Wiilashiina way koreen: oo Ceesaw wuxuu ahaa nin ugaadhsiga aad u yaqaan, wuxuuna ahaa nin duurgal ah; Yacquubna wuxuu ahaa nin aamusan oo teendhooyin degi jiray.
english: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuu jeclaa Ceesaw, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu cuni jiray hilibkiisii ugaadha; Rebeqahna waxay jeclayd Yacquub.
english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

kikuyu: Yacquub wuxuu karsaday fuud; markaasaa waxaa duurka ka yimid Ceesaw, wuuna daalanaa.
english: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ceesaw wuxuu Yacquub ku yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, i sii aan cunee fuudkaas cas, waayo, waan daalanahay. Sidaas daraaddeed magiciisii waxaa loo bixiyey Edom.
english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu yidhi, Maanta iga iibi curadnimadaada.
english: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ceesaw yidhi, Bal eeg, geeri baan ku dhowahay; haddaba curadnimadu maxay ii taraysaa?
english: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub ku yidhi, Maanta ii dhaaro. Kolkaasuu u dhaartay, curadnimadiisiina wuxuu ka iibiyey Yacquub.
english: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu Ceesaw siiyey kibis iyo fuud digir laga sameeyey, wuuna cunay oo cabbay, markaasuu intuu kacay, iska tegey. Sidaasuu Ceesaw u quudhsaday curadnimadiisii.
english: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhulkii ka dhacday abaar, oo aan ahayn tii hore oo waagii Ibraahim dhacday. Markaasaa Isxaaq u kacay xagga Abimeleg oo ahaa boqorkii reer Falastiin xagga Geraar.
english: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuu u muuqday isaga, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Xagga Masar ha u dhaadhicin, laakiinse deg dhulka aan kuu sheegi doono.
english: The LORD appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.

kikuyu: Dhulkan qariib ahaan u deg, oo anna waan kula jiri doonaa, oo waan ku barakayn doonaa; waayo, adiga iyo farcankaaga ayaan dalalkan oo dhan siin doonaa, oo waxaan adkayn doonaa dhaartii aan ugu dhaartay aabbahaa Ibraahim.
english: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

kikuyu: Farcankaagana waxaan u tarmin doonaa sida xiddigaha samada, oo waxaan farcankaaga siin doonaa dalalkan oo dhan, farcankaagayna quruumaha dunida oo dhammu ku barakoobi doonaan;
english: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, Ibraahim baa addeecay codkaygii, wuxuuna dhawray wixii la ii dhawri lahaa, iyo xukummadaydii, iyo amarradaydii, iyo qaynuunnadaydii.
english: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuxuu degganaa Geraar:
english: Isaac lived in Gerar.

kikuyu: oo dadkii meeshaas joogay baa naagtiisii ka warsaday, oo wuxuu yidhi, Iyadu waa walaashay: waayo, wuu ka cabsaday inuu yidhaahdo, Waa naagtaydii, oo wuxuu isyidhi, waaba intaasoo ay dadka meeshanu igu dilaan Rebeqah aawadeed, maxaa yeelay, way suurad quruxsanayd.
english: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”

kikuyu: Markuu halkaas wakhti dheer joogay ayaa Abimeleg oo ahaa boqorkii reer Falastiin daaqad ka fiiriyey, oo uu arkay Isxaaq oo naagtiisii Rebeqah la qooqaya.
english: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Abimeleg Isxaaq u yeedhay, oo yidhi, Hubaal iyadu waa naagtaadii. De sidee baad ku tidhi, Waa walaashay? Isxaaqna wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaa yeelay, waxaan is-idhi, Waaba intaasoo aad u dhimatid iyada aawadeed.
english: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”

kikuyu: Oo Abimelegna wuxuu ku yidhi, War waa maxay waxan aad nagu samaysay? Mid dadka ka mid ahu dhib yaraan buu ula jiifsan lahaa naagtaada, oo kolkaasaad eed noo soo jiidi lahayd.
english: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abimeleg wuxuu dadkii oo dhan ku amray, oo yidhi, Kii ninkan ama naagtiisa taabta hubaal naftaa laga qaadi doonaa.
english: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

kikuyu: Isxaaqna dhulkaasuu wax ku beertay, isla sannaddiina wuxuu helay boqol laab; Rabbiguna wuu barakeeyey isagii.
english: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. The LORD blessed him.

kikuyu: Ninkiina wuu weynaaday, oo hor u maray, ilaa uu noqday nin aad u weyn,
english: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

kikuyu: wuxuuna lahaa adhi iyo lo', iyo addoommo fara badan; markaasay reer Falastiin ka masayreen.
english: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

kikuyu: Ceelashii addoommada aabbihiis qodeen oo dhan waagii aabbihiis Ibraahim noolaa ayay reer Falastiin hore u awdeen oo ciid uga buuxiyeen.
english: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

kikuyu: Abimelegna wuxuu Isxaaq ku yidhi, Naga tag; waayo, aad baad nooga xoog badan tahay.
english: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Isxaaq halkaas ka tegey, oo dooxadii Geraar degay, halkaasuuna joogay.
english: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Isxaaq mar kale qoday ceelashii biyaha oo ay qodeen waagii aabbihiis Ibraahim noolaa, waayo, reer Falastiin baa awday markii Ibraahim dhintay ka dib, oo wuxuu magacyadoodii u bixiyey magacyadii aabbihiis Ibraahim u bixiyey.
english: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa addoommadii Isxaaq dooxadii qodeen, oo waxay ka heleen ceel durdur ah.
english: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

kikuyu: Markaasaa xoolojirradii reer Geraar la dirireen xoolojirradii Isxaaq, iyagoo leh, Biyaha annagaa leh. Ceelka magiciisiina wuxuu u bixiyey Ceseq, maxaa yeelay, way la dirireen isagii.
english: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

kikuyu: Ceel kalena way qodeen, oo kaasna way kula dirireen, markaasuu magiciisii u bixiyey Sitnah.
english: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu meeshaas ka guuray, oo wuxuu qoday ceel kale; kaasna kulama ay diririn; magiciisiina wuxuu u bixiyey Rexobod, oo wuxuu yidhi, Haatan Rabbigu meel buu noo banneeyey, oo dalka waannu ku badnaynaa.
english: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu halkaas ka tegey, oo wuxuu u kacay Bi'ir Shebac.
english: He went up from there to Beersheba.

kikuyu: Oo isla habeenkaas ayaa Rabbigu u muuqday isagii oo ku yidhi, Waxaan ahay aabbahaa Ibraahim Ilaahiisa. Ha cabsan, waayo, waan kula jiraa, oo waan ku barakayn doonaa, farcankaagana waan tarmin doonaa addoonkaygii Ibraahim aawadiis.
english: The LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu halkaas ka dhisay meel allabari, oo magaca Rabbiga ku baryootamay, halkaas buuna teendhadiisii ka dhisay, markaasaa addoommadii Isxaaq halkaas ceel ka qodeen.
english: He built an altar there, and called on the LORD’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna Abimeleg iyo saaxiibkiis Axusad, iyo Fiikol oo ahaa madaxda ciidankiisa ayaa Geraar ka tegey oo Isxaaq u kacay.
english: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Isxaaq ku yidhi, Maxaad iigu timaadeen, waabad i neceb tihiine, oo aad iska kay erideene?
english: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

kikuyu: Oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Caddaan baannu u aragnay in Rabbigu kula jiro; oo waxaannu nidhi, Annaga iyo adiga dhaaru ha inoo dhexayso oo aynu axdi dhiganno,
english: They said, “We saw plainly that the LORD was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,

kikuyu: inaadan wax na yeelayn, sidii annana aannan kuu taaban, oo aannan waxba kuugu samayn wanaag mooyaane, oo aannu nabad kuugu dirnay. Adigu hadda waxaad tahay kan Rabbigu barakeeyey.
english: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of the LORD.”

kikuyu: Diyaafad buuna u sameeyey, wayna cuneen oo cabbeen.
english: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay aroor hore kaceen, oo isu dhaardhaarteen: markaasaa Isxaaq iska diray, iyana nabad bay kaga ambabbaxeen.
english: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

kikuyu: Oo isla maalintaas ayay addoommadii Isxaaq yimaadeen, oo ay uga warrameen ceelkii ay qodeen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Biyaannu helnay.
english: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u bixiyey Shebcaah; sidaas daraaddeed magaaladaas magaceeda waxaa ilaa maantadan la yidhaahdaa Bi'ir Shebac.
english: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.

kikuyu: Ceesaw markuu afartan sannadood jiray ayuu guursaday Yuhuudiid ina Be'eerii kii reer Xeed, iyo Basmad ina Eeloon kii reer Xeed.
english: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

kikuyu: Kuwaasuna Isxaaq iyo Rebeqah ayay caloolxumo geliyeen.
english: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

kikuyu: Markii Isxaaq gaboobay, oo ay indhihiisii u arag darnaayeen si uusan waxba arki karin, ayuu u yeedhay wiilkiisii weynaa oo Ceesaw ahaa, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Wiilkaygiiyow. Isaguna wuxuu yidhi, Waa i kan.
english: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Bal i eeg, haatan waan gaboobay, garanna maayo maalinta dhimashadayda.
english: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waan ku baryayaaye, qaado hubkaaga, gabooyahaaga iyo qaansadaada, oo duurka u bax, oo hilib ugaadheed ii keen;
english: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

kikuyu: oo ii samee hilib macaan, oo ah kan aan jeclahay, oo ii keen, aan cunee, inay naftaydu kuu ducayso intaanan dhiman.
english: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

kikuyu: Rebeqahna way maqashay markii Isxaaq la hadlay wiilkiisii Ceesaw. Ceesawna duurkuu u kacay inuu ugaadh soo dilo oo uu keeno.
english: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

kikuyu: Markaasay Rebeqah la hadashay wiilkeedii Yacquub, oo tidhi, Waxaan maqlay aabbahaa oo la hadlaya walaalkaa Ceesaw, isagoo leh,
english: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

kikuyu: Hilib ugaadheed ii keen, oo ii samee hilib macaan, aan cunee, oo aan kuugu duceeyee Rabbiga hortiis intaanan dhimane.
english: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before the LORD before my death.’

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed, wiilkaygiiyow, codkayga u addeec sida aan kuugu amro.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

kikuyu: Bal adhiga u kac, oo iiga keen laba waxar oo wanwanaagsan, oo waxaan aabbahaa uga samayn hilib macaan, oo ah kan uu jecel yahay,
english: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

kikuyu: adna aabbahaa waad u geeyn doontaa inuu cuno, si uu kuugu duceeyo intuusan dhiman.
english: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu hooyadiis Rebeqah ku yidhi, Walaalkay Ceesaw waa nin xaad badan, anna waxaan ahay nin xaad yar.
english: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

kikuyu: Mindhaa aabbahay waa i taaban doonaa, oo markaasaan ula ekaan doonaa khaa'in, oo habaar baan isu soo jiidi doonaa, ducose ma heli doono.
english: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

kikuyu: Oo hooyadiis baa ku tidhi, Wiilkaygiiyow, habaarkaagu aniga ha igu dhaco: codkayga uun addeec, oo orod oo ii keen iyaga.
english: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu tegey, oo soo kaxeeyey, oo u keenay hooyadiis, hooyadiisna waxay samaysay hilib macaan, oo ah sidii kii aabbihiis jeclaa.
english: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rebeqah waxay soo qaadday dharkii wanaagsanaa oo wiilkeedii weynaa oo ahaa Ceesaw, oo ay guriga ku haysay, oo waxay u xidhay wiilkeedii yaraa oo ahaa Yacquub;
english: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

kikuyu: markaasay waxarihii hargahoodii ku xidhay gacmihiisii iyo intii aan xaadda lahayn oo luquntiisii.
english: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

kikuyu: Markaasay hilibkii macaanaa iyo kibistii ay diyaarisay u dhiibtay wiilkeedii Yacquub.
english: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu aabbihiis u yimid, oo yidhi, Aabbow. Isna wuxuu yidhi, Waa i kan. Kumaad tahay, wiilkaygiiyow?
english: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu aabbihiis ku yidhi, Waxaan ahay curadkaagii Ceesaw. Waan sameeyey sidii aad iigu amartay. Haddaba waan ku baryayaaye, kac oo fadhiiso oo cun hilibkaygan ugaadheed, si aad iigu ducayso.
english: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuxuu wiilkiisii ku yidhi, Wiilkaygiiyow, sidee baad dhaqso ugu soo heshay? Isna wuxuu yidhi, Maxaa yeelay, Rabbiga ah Ilaahaaga ayaa ii keenay.
english: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because the LORD your God gave me success.”

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuxuu Yacquub ku yidhi, Soo dhowow, waan ku baryayaaye, aan ku taabtee, wiilkaygiiyow, bal inaad tahay wiilkaygii Ceesaw iyo in kale.
english: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna waa u dhowaaday aabbihiis Isxaaq; markaasuu taabtay oo yidhi, Codku waa codkii Yacquub, gacmuhuse waa gacmihii Ceesaw.
english: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

kikuyu: Mana uu garanin, maxaa yeelay, gacmihiisu xaad miidhan bay ahaayeen sidii gacmihii walaalkiis Ceesaw; sidaas daraaddeed wuu u duceeyey.
english: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu yidhi, War ma tahay wiilkaygii Ceesaw qudhiisii? Isna wuxuu yidhi, Waan ahay.
english: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi. Bal ii soo dhowee, aan cunee wiilkayga hilibkiisa ugaadheed, si aan kuugu duceeyo. Kolkaasuu u soo dhoweeyey, oo isna wuu cunay: oo wuxuu kaloo u keenay khamri, wuuna cabbay.
english: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.

kikuyu: Markaasaa aabbihiis Isxaaq ku yidhi, Bal ii soo dhowow, oo i dhunko, wiilkaygiiyow.
english: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

kikuyu: Isna wuu u soo dhowaaday, oo wuu dhunkaday. Markaasuu ursaday dharkiisa, wuuna u duceeyey, oo yidhi, Bal eeg, urta wiilkaygu Waa sida urta duurka Rabbigu barakeeyey,
english: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.

kikuyu: Ilaahu ha ku siiyo sayaxa samada, Iyo barwaaqada dhulka, Iyo hadhuudh iyo khamri badan.
english: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.

kikuyu: Dadyowgu ha kuu adeegeen, Quruumuhuna ha kuu sujuudeen. Walaalahaa sayid u noqo, Wiilasha hooyadaana ha kuu sujuudeen. Ha inkaarnaado ku kasta oo ku inkaaraa, Ha ducaysnaado ku kasta oo kuu duceeyaa.
english: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”

kikuyu: Markii Isxaaq dhammeeyey ducadii uu Yacquub u ducaynayay, Yacquubna ka tegey aabbihiis, ayaa walaalkiis Ceesaw ka yimid ugaadhsigii.
english: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

kikuyu: Oo isna hilib macaan buu sameeyey, oo u keenay aabbihiis; oo wuxuu ku yidhi aabbihiis, Aabbow kac, oo cun hilibkaygan ugaadheed, si aad iigu ducayso.
english: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa aabbihiis Isxaaq ku yidhi, Kumaad tahay? Isna wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan ahay wiilkaaga ah curadkaaga Ceesaw.
english: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Isxaaq aad iyo aad u gariiray, oo yidhi, De yuu ahaa haddaba kii intuu hilib ugaadheed soo qaaday, ii keenay, oo aan kulli cunay intaadan iman ka hor, oo aan u duceeyey? Kaasu wuu ducaysnaan doonaa.
english: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

kikuyu: Ceesawna markuu maqlay hadalkii aabbihiis ayuu ku dhawaaqay dhawaaq aad iyo aad u weyn oo daran, oo wuxuu aabbihiis ku yidhi, Aabbahayow, anigana ii ducee.
english: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

kikuyu: Isna wuxuu yidhi, Walaalkaa baa khiyaano iila yimid oo ducadaadii qaatay.
english: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Miyaanay ku habboonayn in magiciisa loo bixiyo Yacquub? Waayo, labadan goor buu i khiyaaneeyey. Curadnimadaydii buu qaatay; haatanna wuxuu qaatay ducadaydii. Oo wuxuu yidhi, Miyaadan duco ii reebin?
english: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuu jawaabay oo wuxuu Ceesaw ku yidhi, Bal eeg, waxaan isaga ka dhigay sayidkaagii, walaalihiis oo dhanna waxaan u siiyey isaga inay addoommo u noqdaan, hadhuudh iyo khamrina waan u ballanqaaday, ee maxaan haddaba adiga kuu sameeyaa, wiilkaygiiyow?
english: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

kikuyu: Ceesawna wuxuu aabbihiis ku yidhi, Aabbahayow, ducadaadu ma mid keliya baa? Ii ducee anigana sidoo kale, Aabbow. Markaasuu Ceesaw aad u qayliyey oo ooyay.
english: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

kikuyu: Markaasaa aabbihiis Isxaaq u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Bal eeg, rugtaadu waxay ahaan doontaa meel ka baxsan dhulka barwaaqadiisa Iyo sayaxa samada sare ka yimaada.
english: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad ku noolaan doontaa seeftaada, walaalkaana waad u adeegi doontaa, Oo waxaa dhici doonta markaad xukunka qabsato Inaad harqoodkiisa surkaaga ka tuuri doonto.
english: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”

kikuyu: Ceesawna wuxuu Yacquub u nebcaaday ducadii aabbihiis ugu duceeyey aawadeed. Ceesawna wuxuu isku yidhi, Maalmihii aabbahay loo barooran lahaa waa dhow yihiin; dabadeedna waan dili doonaa walaalkay Yacquub.
english: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

kikuyu: Rebeqahna waxaa loo sheegay hadalkii wiilkeedii weynaa oo ahaa Ceesaw; markaasay intay u cid dirtay u yeedhay wiilkeedii yaraa oo ahaa Yacquub, oo waxay ku tidhi isagii, Bal eeg, walaalkaa Ceesaw wuxuu isku qalbi qabowjiyaa talajirka uu ku talo jiro inuu ku dilo.
english: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed wiilkaygiiyow, codkayga addeec. Kac oo u carar walaalkay Laabaan xagga Haaraan;
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

kikuyu: oo dhawr maalmood isaga la joog, ilaa walaalkaa ciilku ka ba'ayo, iyo ilaa walaalkaa cadhaduu kuu qabo ka ba'ayso,
english: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—

kikuyu: oo uu ka illoobayo wixii aad ku samaysay: dabadeedna waan kuu soo cid diri doonaa, oo halkaasaan kaa soo kaxayn doonaa. Maxaan labadiinnaba isku maalin idiin waayayaa?
english: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

kikuyu: Rebeqahna waxay Isxaaq ku tidhi, Naftaydu waa rafaadsan tahay gabdhaha reer Xeed dartood. Haddii Yacquub naag ka guursado gabdhaha reer Xeed oo kuwan oo kale ah, kuwaas oo ah gabdhaha waddanka, noloshaydu maxay igu taraysaa?
english: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuxuu u yeedhay Yacquub, wuuna u duceeyey, oo wuxuu ku amray, oo ku yidhi, Waa inaadan naag ka guursan gabdhaha reer Kancaan.
english: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

kikuyu: Kac oo xagga Fadan Araam tag, iyo xagga gurigii Betuu'el oo ah hooyadaa aabbeheed; oo halkaas naag ka guurso gabdhaha Laabaan oo ah hooyadaa walaalkeed.
english: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaaha Qaadirka ahu ha ku barakeeyo, oo ha ku badiyo, oo ha ku tarmiyo, inaad noqotid dad faro badan,
english: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

kikuyu: oo ha ku siiyo barakadii Ibraahim, adiga iyo farcankaaga kula joogaba, inaad dhaxashid dalka aad qariibka ku tahay, oo Ilaah Ibraahim siiyey.
english: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

kikuyu: Isxaaqna Yacquub wuu diray: oo wuxuu u kacay Fadan Araam xagga Laabaan, ina Betuu'el kii reer Suuriya, oo ahaa Rebeqah walaalkeed tii ahayd Yacquub iyo Ceesaw hooyadood.
english: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

kikuyu: Ceesawna wuxuu arkay in Isxaaq u duceeyey Yacquub oo u diray Fadan Araam, inuu halkaas naag ka guursado, iyo inuu markuu u duceeyey amray, oo ku yidhi, Waa inaadan naag ka guursan gabdhaha reer Kancaan;
english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

kikuyu: iyo in Yacquub addeecay aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis, oo uu u kacay xagga Fadan Araam.
english: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

kikuyu: Oo Ceesaw wuxuu arkay inaanay gabdhaha reer Kancaan ka farxin aabbihiis Isxaaq.
english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Ceesaw wuxuu u kacay xagga Ismaaciil, oo wuxuu naagihii uu qabay ku daray Mahalad gabadhii Ismaaciil ina Ibraahim, taas oo ahayd Nebayod walaashiis, si ay naagtiisii u noqoto.
english: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

kikuyu: Yacquubna waa ka tegey Bi'ir Shebac, oo wuxuu u kacay xagga Haaraan.
english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

kikuyu: Oo meel buu gaadhay oo halkaasuu habeenkii oo dhan joogay, maxaa yeelay, qorraxdu way dhacday, markaasuu qaaday mid ka mid ah dhagxantii meeshaas, oo barkaday, halkaasuuna jiifsaday si uu u seexdo.
english: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

kikuyu: Wuuna riyooday, oo riyadiisii wuxuu ku arkay sallaan dhulka qotoma oo caaraddiisiina samada gaadhay, wuxuuna arkay malaa'igihii Ilaah oo ku koraya, kuna soo degaya.
english: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, Rabbigaa isdul taagay, oo yidhi, Waxaan ahay Rabbiga ah Ilaaha awowgaa Ibraahim, iyo Ilaaha Isxaaq. Dhulka aad ku jiifto, waxaan siin doonaa adiga iyo farcankaaga.
english: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

kikuyu: Farcankaaguna wuxuu noqon doonaa sida ciidda dhulka, oo waxaad ku firdhi doontaan tan iyo galbeed, iyo bari, iyo tan iyo woqooyi, iyo koonfur: oo adiga iyo farcankaagay qabiilooyinka dhulka oo dhammu ku barakoobi doonaan.
english: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waan kula jiraa, meel alla meeshii aad tagtidna waan kugu dhawri doonaa, dalkanna mar kalaan kugu soo celin doonaa; waayo, anigu kaa tegi maayo ilaa aan sameeyo wixii aan kugula hadlay.
english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yacquub ka toosay hurdadiisii, oo wuxuu yidhi, Hubaal Rabbigaa halkan jooga, mana aan ogayn.
english: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

kikuyu: Wuuna cabsaday, oo wuxuu yidhi, Meeshanu cabsi badanaa! Tanu meel kale ma aha, gurigii Ilaah mooyaane, tanuna waa iriddii samada.
english: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna aroor horuu kacay, oo wuxuu qaaday dhagaxii uu barkaday, oo sidii tiir buu u qotomiyey, kolkaasuu saliid ku dul shubay.
english: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

kikuyu: Meeshaas magaceediina wuxuu u bixiyey Beytel: laakiinse markii hore magaalada magaceedu wuxuu ahaa Luus.
english: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

kikuyu: Yacquubna nidar buu nidray, oo wuxuu yidhi, Haddii Ilaah ila jiro, oo uu jidkan aan socdo igu dhawro, oo uu i siiyo wax aan cuno, iyo dhar aan xidho,
english: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

kikuyu: oo aan aniga oo nabad qaba ku soo noqdo gurigii aabbahay, markaas Rabbigu wuxuu ii noqon doonaa Ilaah,
english: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,

kikuyu: oo dhagaxan aan sidii tiir u qotomiyey, wuxuu noqon doonaa guriga Ilaah: oo wax alla wixii aad i siisidna hubaal meel tobnaadka adigaan ku siin doonaa.
english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna sodcaalkiisii buu iska sii watay, oo wuxuu yimid dalkii reer bari.
english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wax fiiriyey, oo wuxuu arkay ceel berrinka ku dhex yaal, oo waxaa joogay saddex qaybood oo ido ah oo agtiisa jiifjiifa, maxaa yeelay, ceelkaasay idaha ka waraabin jireen. Dhagaxa ceelka afkiisa saarnaana aad buu u weynaa.
english: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

kikuyu: Oo halkaasaa idaha oo dhan lagu soo ururin jiray: kolkaasay dhagaxa ceelka afkiisa ka rogi jireen, oo idaha ka waraabin jireen, markaasay mar labaad dhagaxa ceelka afkiisa saari jireen oo ku celin jireen meeshiisii.
english: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub ku yidhi, Walaalahayow, xaggaad ka timaadeen? Iyana waxay yidhaahdeen, Waxaannu ka nimid Haaraan.
english: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Ma taqaaniin Laabaan oo ah ina Naaxoor? Markaasay ku yidhaahdeen, Waannu naqaan.
english: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Ma nabad qabaa? Iyana waxay yidhaahdeen, Haah, wuu nabad qabaa. Waa taas gabadhiisii Raaxeel idaha soo kaxaynaysa.
english: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi iyagii, Bal eega, weli waa maalin weyn, mana aha goortii xoolaha la soo wada ururin lahaa. Idaha waraabiya, oo kaxeeya oo daajiya.
english: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

kikuyu: Iyana waxay yidhaahdeen, Ma yeeli karno taas, jeeray idoyowga oo dhammu isu yimaadaan, oo dhagaxa ceelka afkiisa laga rogo; markaasaannu idaha waraabinaynaa.
english: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

kikuyu: Oo intuu weli la hadlayay ayaa Raaxeel keentay idihii aabbeheed, waayo, iyadaa ilaalin jirtay.
english: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

kikuyu: Oo Yacquub markuu arkay Raaxeel oo ahayd gabadhii abtigiis Laabaan, iyo idihii abtigiis Laabaan, ayuu u dhowaaday, oo dhagaxii ka rogay ceelka afkiisa, oo uu waraabiyey idihii abtigiis Laabaan.
english: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yacquub Raaxeel dhunkaday, wuuna qayliyey oo ooyay.
english: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu Raaxeel u sheegay inuu yahay aabbeheed xigaalkiis, oo uu yahay wiilkii Rebeqah; kolkaasay orodday oo u sheegtay aabbeheed.
english: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

kikuyu: Oo Laabaan markuu maqlay warkii Yacquub oo ahaa wiilkii walaashiis ayuu ku orday inuu ka hor tago, markaasuu isku duubay, oo dhunkaday, oo uu gurigiisii keenay. Isna wuxuu Laabaan u sheegay waxyaalahan oo dhan.
english: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu ku yidhi isagii, Hubaal waxaad tahay laftayda iyo jidhkayga. Wuxuuna la joogay isagii intii bil ah.
english: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Laabaan Yacquub ku yidhi, Walaalkayga aad tahay aawadeed ma habboon tahay inaad mushahaarola'aan iigu shaqaysid? Bal ii sheeg, mushahaaradaadu maxay ahaan doontaa?
english: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu lahaa laba gabdhood: midda weyn magaceedu wuxuu ahaa Lee'ah, tan yar magaceeduna wuxuu ahaa Raaxeel.
english: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

kikuyu: Lee'ahna way indha darnayd, laakiinse Raaxeel way quruxsanayd, suurad wanaagsanna way lahayd.
english: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu jeclaa Raaxeel; markaasuu yidhi, Toddoba sannadood baan kuugu shaqayn gabadhaada yar oo Raaxeel ah.
english: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu yidhi, Waa wanaagsan tahay inaan adiga ku siiyo intii aan iyada nin kale siin lahaa, ee ila joog.
english: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna toddoba sannadood buu u shaqaynayay Raaxeel aawadeed; waxayna la ahaayeen maalmo yar, waana jacaylkii uu iyada u qabay aawadiis.
english: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu Laabaan ku yidhi, Maalmahaygii way dhammaystirmeen; ee naagtayda i sii, si aan ugu tago iyada.
english: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Laabaan soo ururiyey nimankii meeshaas joogay oo dhan, oo wuxuu sameeyey diyaafad.
english: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay inuu fiidkii kaxeeyey gabadhiisii Lee'ah, oo uu u geeyey isagii; isna wuu u tegey iyadii.
english: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu gabadhiisii Lee'ah siiyey Silfah oo isaga addoon u ahayd inay iyada addoon u noqoto.
english: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu aroortii arkay inay tahay Lee'ah, oo wuxuu Laabaan ku yidhi, Waa maxay waxan aad igu samaysay? Miyaanan Raaxeel kuugu shaqaynayn? De maxaad haddaba ii khiyaanaysay?
english: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu yidhi, Dhulkayaga sidaas laguma sameeyo in tan yar curadda la dhaafiyo.
english: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

kikuyu: Bal tan toddobaadkeeda dhammee, tan kalena waxaannu kugu siin doonnaa shuqulka aad toddoba sannadood oo kale ii shaqayn doontid.
english: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna sidii buu yeelay, toddobaadkeediina wuu dhammeeyey. Markaasuu Laabaan Yacquub siiyey gabadhiisii Raaxeel inay naag u noqoto.
english: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu gabadhiisii Raaxeel siiyey Bilhah oo isaga addoon u ahayd inay iyada addoon u noqoto.
english: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

kikuyu: Oo Raaxeelna wuu u tegey, oo isna Raaxeel aad buu uga jeclaa Lee'ah, toddoba sannadood oo kalena wuu u shaqeeyey isaga.
english: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu arkay in Lee'ah la nebcaaday, markaasuu maxalkeedii furay; laakiinse Raaxeel waxay ahayd madhalays.
english: The LORD saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

kikuyu: Lee'ahna way uuraysatay, oo waxay dhashay wiil, magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Ruubeen, oo waxay tidhi, Sababtu waxaa weeye inuu Rabbigu dhibaatadayda arkay, oo haatan ninkaygu wuu i jeclaan doonaa.
english: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because the LORD has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana way uuraysatay mar labaad, waxayna dhashay wiil, oo waxay tidhi, Rabbigu waa maqlay in lay nebcaaday, oo haddaba taas aawadeed ayuu ii siiyey wiilkanna; magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Simecoon.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

kikuyu: Oo haddana mar kalay uuraysatay, oo waxay dhashay wiil, waxayna tidhi, Haatan ninkayga ayaa ila jiri doona, maxaa yeelay, saddex wiil baan u dhalay isaga; sidaas daraaddeed magiciisii waxaa loo bixiyey Laawi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

kikuyu: Oo haddana way uuraysatay, oo waxay dhashay wiil; oo waxay tidhi, Haatan Rabbigaan ammaani, sidaas daraaddeed waxay magiciisii u bixisay Yahuudah; wayna dhalmo daysay.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.

kikuyu: Raaxeelna markay aragtay inaanay Yacquub carruur u dhalin, ayay walaasheed ka masayrtay; oo waxay Yacquub ku tidhi, Carruur i sii, haddii kalese waan dhiman.
english: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub aad ugu cadhooday Raaxeel; oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma anigaa ku jira meeshii Ilaaha midhihii maxalka kuu diiday?
english: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

kikuyu: Markaasay tidhi, Bal eeg addoontayda Bilhah, u tag iyada, inay jilbahayga ku dul dhasho, oo aan anna carruur ku helo iyada.
english: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

kikuyu: Markaasay isagii siisay addoonteedii Bilhah inuu naag ka dhigto; Yacquubna wuu u tegey iyadii.
english: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

kikuyu: Bilhahna way uuraysatay, oo Yacquub wiil bay u dhashay.
english: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

kikuyu: Raaxeelna waxay tidhi, Ilaah waa i xukumay, codkaygiina wuu maqlay, oo wiil buu i siiyey. Sidaas daraaddeed magiciisii waxay u bixisay Daan.
english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.

kikuyu: Bilhah oo ahayd addoontii Raaxeel mar kalay uuraysatay, oo waxay Yacquub u dhashay wiil labaad.
english: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

kikuyu: Oo Raaxeelna waxay tidhi, Legdan aad u weyn baan walaashay la legdamay, waanan ka adkaaday. Magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Naftaali.
english: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

kikuyu: Lee'ahna markay aragtay inay dhalmo daysay ayay kaxaysay addoonteedii Silfah, oo waxay siisay Yacquub inuu naag ka dhigto.
english: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

kikuyu: Lee'ah addoonteedii Silfah ahaydna Yacquub wiil bay u dhashay.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.

kikuyu: Oo Lee'ahna waxay tidhi, Ayaan weynaa! Magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Gaad.
english: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

kikuyu: Lee'ah addoonteedii Silfah ahaydna wiil labaad bay u dhashay Yacquub.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

kikuyu: Oo Lee'ahna waxay tidhi, Waan faraxsanahay! waayo, naaguhu waxay iigu yeedhi doonaan tan faraxsan. Magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Aasheer.
english: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

kikuyu: Maalmihii sarreenka la goosanayay ayaa Ruubeen tegey berrinka oo ka dhex helay ubax, oo wuxuu u keenay hooyadiis Lee'ah. Markaasay Raaxeel waxay Lee'ah ku tidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, wax iga sii ubaxa wiilkaaga.
english: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

kikuyu: Iyana waxay ku tidhi, Ma wax yar baa inaad ninkaygii iga qaadday? Weliba ubaxa wiilkaygana ma iga qaadan lahayd? Raaxeelna waxay tidhi, Haddaba wiilkaaga ubaxiisa aawadiis isagu caawa wuu kula seexan doonaa.
english: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna fiidkii buu beertii ka yimid, markaasay Lee'ah ka hor tagtay oo waxay tidhi, Waa inaad ii timaadaa, waayo, hubaal waxaan kugu kiraystay ubaxii wiilkayga. Habeenkaasna iyadii buu la seexday.
english: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuu maqlay Lee'ah, wayna uuraysatay, oo Yacquub bay u dhashay wiil shanaad.
english: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

kikuyu: Lee'ahna waxay tidhi, Ilaah waa i siiyey kiradaydii, maxaa yeelay, addoontaydii waxaan siiyey ninkayga. Wiilkii magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Isaakaar.
english: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

kikuyu: Lee'ahna mar kalay uuraysatay, oo waxay Yacquub u dhashay wiil lixaad.
english: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

kikuyu: Lee'ahna waxay tidhi, Ilaah dhiibaad wanaagsan buu igu dhiibaadiyey, haatan buu ninkaygu ila joogi doonaa, maxaa yeelay, waxaan u dhalay lix wiil. Wiilkii magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Sebulun.
english: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna waxay dhashay gabadh, magaceediina waxay u bixisay Diinah.
english: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuu xusuustay Raaxeel, oo Ilaah wuu maqlay iyada, maxalkeediina wuu u furay.
english: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

kikuyu: Oo way uuraysatay, oo wiil bay dhashay; oo waxay tidhi, Ilaah baa ceebtaydii iga qaaday.
english: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

kikuyu: Magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Yuusuf, iyadoo leh Rabbigu wiil kale ha iigu daro.
english: She named him Joseph, saying, “May the LORD add another son to me.”

kikuyu: Markii Raaxeel Yuusuf dhashay ka dib ayaa Yacquub Laabaan ku yidhi, Iska kay dir, si aan u tago meeshaydii, iyo dalkaygii.
english: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

kikuyu: I sii naagahayga iyo carruurtayda aan daraaddood kuugu adeegay, oo aan iska tago; waayo waad og tahay adeegiddii aan kuu adeegi jiray.
english: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu ku yidhi isagii, Haddaad raalli iga tahay, joog, waayo, waxaan faal ku gartay in Rabbigu daraaddaa ii barakeeyey.
english: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that the LORD has blessed me for your sake.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Mushahaaradaada ii sheeg, oo waan ku siin doonaa.
english: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu ku yidhi, Waad og tahay sidii aan kuugu adeegay, iyo sidii xoolahaagii aan daaqi jiray xaalkoodu ahaa.
english: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad haysan jirtay wax yar bay ahayd intaanan iman ka hor, waana ay korodhay oo waxay noqotay wax faro badan; Rabbiguna wuu kugu barakeeyey dhinacii aan u kacayba; de haddaba goormaan reerkaygana wax u dhaqan doonaa?
english: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. The LORD has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu yidhi, Maxaan ku siiyaa? Yacquubna wuxuu yidhi, Waa inaanad waxba i siin, laakiin haddaad waxan ii samaysid, adhigaaga haddana waan daajin oo waan ilaalin doonaa.
english: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

kikuyu: Maanta adhigaaga oo dhan waan dhex mari doonaa, oo waxaan ka sooci doonaa mid kasta oo dhibicyo iyo barbaro leh, iyo mid kasta oo madow oo idaha ku dhex jira, iyo inta barbaraha iyo dhibicyada leh oo riyaha ku jirta; oo waxaasu waxay noqon doonaan mushahaaradayda.
english: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

kikuyu: Oo sidaasay xaqnimadaydu iigu jawaabi doontaa hadda ka dib, goortaad timaadid oo ka hadlaysid mushahaaradayda ku hor taal. Mid kasta oo aan dhibicyo ama barbaro lahayn oo riyaha ku jira, iyo mid kasta oo aan madoobayn oo idaha ku jira, haddii layga helo, waxaa lagu tirin doonaa wax la soo xaday.
english: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu yidhi, Waa hagaag, sidaad tidhi ha noqoto.
english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

kikuyu: Oo maalintaasuu wada soocay orgidii xariijimaha iyo barbaraha lahayd, iyo riyihii dhibicyada iyo barbaraha lahaa oo dhan, mid kasta oo caddaani ku jirto, iyo kuwa madmadow oo idaha ku jira oo dhan, oo wuxuu gacanta u geliyey wiilashiisii;
english: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu Yacquub ka fogaaday intii saddex maalmood loo socdo, Yacquubna wuxuu daajin jiray Laabaan adhigiisii intii ka hadhay.
english: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu qaatay dhengedo qoyan oo ah geedihii la odhan jiray libneh iyo yicib iyo carmon, kolkaasuu diiray oo xariijimo cadcad ku sameeyey.
english: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

kikuyu: Markaasuu dhengedihii uu diiray adhigii hor dhigay oo ku riday dararkii berkedaha oo adhigu ka cabbi jiray; wayna rimeen markay soo arooreen.
english: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

kikuyu: Adhigiina dhengedihii hortooda ayuu ku rimay, wuxuuna dhalay maqal xariijimo iyo dhibicyo iyo barbaro leh.
english: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yacquub naylihii ka soocay oo wuxuu adhigii u jeediyey xagga kuwii xariijimaha lahaa iyo intii madmadoobayd oo dhan ee adhigii Laabaan; markaasuu gooni u soocay goosankiisii, kumana uu darin adhigii Laabaan.
english: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

kikuyu: Markii adhiga intiisii xoogga lahayd rintay ayaa Yacquub dhengedihii adhiga indhihiisa hor dhigay intuu dararkii ku riday, inay dhengedihii ku dhex rimaan;
english: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;

kikuyu: laakiinse adhiga qaarkii caatada ahaa, uma uu dhex gelin jirin; sidaas daraaddeed intii caatada ahayd waxaa lahaa Laabaan, intii xoogga lahaydna waxaa lahaa Yacquub.
english: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

kikuyu: Ninkiina aad buu u xoolo batay, wuxuuna lahaa adhi badan, iyo naago addoommo ah, iyo niman addoommo ah, iyo geel, iyo dameerro.
english: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

kikuyu: Wuxuu maqlay hadalkii Laabaan wiilashiisii, iyagoo leh, Yacquub baa wixii aabbeheen oo dhan wada qaatay, oo xoolahan oo dhan wuxuu ku helay wixii aabbeheen.
english: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu fiiriyey wejigii Laabaan, oo wuxuu arkay inuusan sidii hore u ahayn.
english: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu Yacquub ku yidhi, Ku noqo dalkii aabbahaa iyo xigaalkaaga, oo anna waan kula jiri doonaa.
english: The LORD said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu u cid diray oo u yeedhay Raaxeel iyo Lee'ah inay yimaadaan berrinkii adhigiisu joogay,
english: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Waxaan arkay wejigii aabbihiin inuusan sidii hore ii ahayn, laakiinse Ilaaha aabbahay baa ila jiray.
english: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

kikuyu: Idinkuna waad og tihiin inaan aabbihiin xooggayga oo dhan ugu adeegay.
english: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.

kikuyu: Laakiin aabbihiin wuu i khiyaaneeyey, oo toban goor buu mushahaaradaydii beddelay; Ilaahse uma oggolaan inuu wax i yeelo.
english: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
