kikuyu: Hadduu yidhi, Kuwa dhibicyada lahu waxay noqon doonaan mushahaaradaada, adhiga oo dhammu wax dhibicyo leh bay dhaleen; hadduu yidhina, Kuwa xariijimaha lahu waxay noqon doonaan mushahaaradaada, adhiga oo dhammu wax xariijimo leh bay dhaleen.
english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.

kikuyu: Sidaasaa Ilaah aabbihiin xoolihiisii uga qaaday, oo uu aniga ii siiyey.
english: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii adhigii rimay ayaan indhahayga kor u taagay, oo aan riyo ku arkay orgidii adhiga ku boodday inay wada lahaayeen xariijimo, iyo dhibicyo iyo barbaro.
english: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

kikuyu: Malaa'igtii Ilaahna waxay igu tidhi intaan riyoonayay, Yacquubow. Oo anna waxaan idhi, Waa i kan.
english: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’

kikuyu: Oo waxay tidhi, Haatan indhahaaga kor u taag, oo arag, orgida adhiga ku boodda oo dhammu waxay wada leeyihiin xariijimo iyo dhibicyo iyo barbaro, maxaa yeelay, waxaan wada arkay waxa Laabaan kugu sameeyo oo dhan.
english: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.

kikuyu: Waxaan ahay Ilaaha Beytel, meeshii aad tiirka ku subagtay, oo aad nidarka iigu nidartay. Haddaba kac, oo dalkan ka bax, oo ku noqo dalkii aad ku dhalatay.
english: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”

kikuyu: Markaasay Raaxeel iyo Lee'ah u jawaabeen isagii oo ku yidhaahdeen, Weli ma qayb baa guriga aabbahayo noogu hadhay amase dhaxal?
english: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

kikuyu: Miyaannan xaggiisa ka xisaabnayn shisheeye? Waayo, wuu na iibiyey, oo weliba lacagtayadiina wuu cunay.
english: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.

kikuyu: Waayo, kulli maalkii Ilaah ka qaaday aabbahayo waxaa leh annaga iyo carruurtayada; haddaba yeel wixii Ilaah kugu yidhi.
english: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yacquub kacay, carruurtiisii iyo naagihiisiina wuxuu fuushiiyey awrtii;
english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,

kikuyu: wuuna la tegey xoolihiisii oo dhan, iyo alaabadii uu urursaday, kuwaas oo ahaa xoolihii uu helay, oo uu ku ururiyey Fadan Araam, inuu tago xaggii aabbihiis Isxaaq iyo ilaa dalkii Kancaan.
english: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu ku maqnaa inuu idihiisa dhogorta ka soo xiirto; kolkaasay Raaxeel xadday sanamyadii aabbeheed lahaa.
english: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub si qarsoon uga tegey Laabaankii reer Suuriya oo aan ogayn, umana uu sheegin inuu cararayo.
english: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

kikuyu: Oo sidaasuu ula cararay wixii uu haystay oo dhan, oo intuu kacay, ayuu webigii ka gudbay, oo wejigiisii ku toosiyey buurtii Gilecaad.
english: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

kikuyu: Maalintii saddexaad baa Laabaan loo sheegay in Yacquub cararay.
english: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

kikuyu: Markaasuu walaalihiis kaxaystay, oo wuxuu raacdaynayay toddoba maalinsocod, wuxuuna ku gaadhay buurtii Gilecaad.
english: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ilaah riyo habeennimo ugu yimid Laabaankii reer Suuriya, oo ku yidhi, Iska jir oo Yacquub xumaan iyo wanaag toona ha kula hadlin.
english: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuu soo gaadhay Yacquub. Haddaba Yacquub teendhadiisii wuxuu ka dhistay buurta; Laabaanna walaalihiis buu kala dhistay buurtii Gilecaad.
english: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu Yacquub ku yidhi, Waa maxay waxan aad samaysay, oo maxaad si qarsoon iiga soo tagtay anoo aan ogayn, oo aad gabdhahayga ula soo carartay sidii iyagoo ah maxaabiis seef lagu soo dhacay?
english: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?

kikuyu: Maxaad qarsoodiga ugu soo carartay, oo aad si qarsoon iiga soo tagtay? Oo maxaad iigu sheegi weyday, si aan kuugu soo ambabbixiyo rayrayn iyo gabayo iyo daf iyo kataarad?
english: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;

kikuyu: Oo maxaad iigu oggolaan weyday inaan dhunkado wiilashayda iyo gabdhahayga? De taas nacasnimaad u yeeshay.
english: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.

kikuyu: De xoog aan wax kugu yeelo waan leeyahay, laakiinse Ilaaha aabbahaa baa xalay ila hadlay, oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Iska jir oo Yacquub ha kula hadlin xumaan iyo wanaag toona.
english: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’

kikuyu: Oo haatan waad tagtay, maxaa yeelay, aad baad ugu hilowday gurigii aabbahaa, laakiinse maxaad ilaahyadayda iiga soo xadday?
english: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

kikuyu: Yacquubna waa u jawaabay oo wuxuu Laabaan ku yidhi, Maxaa yeelay, waan cabsaday; waayo, waxaan is-idhi, Wuu kaa xoogi doonaa gabdhihiisa.
english: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’

kikuyu: Qofkii aad ilaahyadaadii ka hesho waa inuusan noolaan. Walaalahayo hortooda ku fiiri wixii aan kaa haysto, oo iska qaado. Waayo, Yacquub ma uu ogayn inay Raaxeel soo xadday.
english: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu galay teendhadii Yacquub, iyo teendhadii Lee'ah, iyo teendhadii labada addoommood, laakiinse ma uu helin. Oo intuu ka baxay teendhadii Lee'ah ayuu galay teendhadii Raaxeel.
english: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

kikuyu: Raaxeelna way qaadday sanamyadii, oo waxay gelisay heeryadii awrta, wayna ku fadhiisatay. Laabaanna wuu ka wada baadhay teendhadii oo dhan, mana uu helin.
english: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.

kikuyu: Oo waxay aabbeheed ku tidhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, ha u cadhoon inaanan istaagi karin, waayo, caadadii dumarku heli jiray baan qabaa. Isna wuu baadhay, laakiinse sanamyadii ma uu helin.
english: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuu cadhooday, oo Laabaan wuu la murmay; Yacquubna wuu u jawaabay oo wuxuu Laabaan ku yidhi, Waa maxay xadgudubkaygu? Waa maxay dembigayga aad aawadiis aad iigu soo raacdaysatay?
english: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

kikuyu: Waxaad baadhay alaabtayda oo dhan, ee maxaad ka heshay oo ah alaabtii gurigaaga? Halkan soo hor dhig walaalahayga iyo walaalahaaga, inay labadeenna inoo kala gar naqaan.
english: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.

kikuyu: Labaatan sannadood baan kula joogay; laxahaaga iyo riyahaaguna dhicis ma dhalin, wananka idahaagiina ma aan cunin.
english: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.

kikuyu: Kuwii dugaagu ka cunayna kuuma aan keenin; laakiinse anaa kuu magdhabay, anaad i weyddiisan jirtay, ha ahaadeen wixii maalin lagaa xado ama wixii habeen lagaa xado ee.
english: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

kikuyu: Maalintii kulayl baa i dili jiray, habeenkiina dhaxan; hurdadiina waa iga tagtay. Oo sidaasaan ahaan jiray.
english: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

kikuyu: Labaatan sannadood baan gurigaaga joogay; afar iyo toban sannadood waxaan kuugu shaqeeyey labadaada gabdhood aawadood, lix sannadoodna adhigaaga aawadiis. Mushahaaradaydiina waxaad beddeshay toban goor.
english: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

kikuyu: Ilaaha aabbahay, oo ah Ilaaha Ibraahim, iyo kan Isxaaq ka cabsado, haddii uusan ila jirin, hubaal haatan waxaad i diri lahayd anoo faro madhan. Ilaah wuxuu arkay dhibaatadaydii iyo hawshii gacmahayga, kolkaasuu xalay ku canaantay.
english: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuu u jawaabay oo wuxuu Yacquub ku yidhi, Gabdhuhu waa gabdhahayga, carruurtuna waa carruurtayda, adhiguna waa adhigayga, oo waxa aad aragto oo dhammuna waa waxayga, haddaba maxaan maanta ku samayn karaa gabdhahaygan, ama carruurtooda ay dhaleen?
english: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?

kikuyu: Haddaba kaalay, aan aniga iyo adigu axdi dhigannee, hana noqdo markhaati ina dhex yaal aniga iyo adiga.
english: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub dhagax soo qaaday, oo sidii tiir u qotomiyey.
english: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu walaalihiis ku yidhi, Dhagaxyo soo ururiya; kolkaasay dhagaxyo soo gureen, oo meel taalleeyeen; kolkaasay taallada agteedii wax ku cuneen.
english: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu meeshaas u bixiyey Yegar Sahaduta; Yacquubse wuxuu u bixiyey Galceed.
english: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu yidhi, Maanta taalladanu waa markhaati ina dhex yaal aniga iyo adiga. Sidaas daraaddeed waxaa magaceedii loo bixiyey Galceed, iyo Misfaah,
english: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed

kikuyu: waayo, wuxuu yidhi, Rabbigu ha dhawro aniga iyo adiga dhexdeenna markaynu kala maqan nahay.
english: and Mizpah, for he said, “The LORD watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

kikuyu: Haddaad gabdhahayga dhibtid, ama aad naago kale gabdhahayga la guursatid, ninna inalama joogo, balse ogow, Ilaah baa markhaati dhexdeenna ka ah aniga iyo adiga.
english: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”

kikuyu: Laabaanna wuxuu Yacquub ku yidhi, Bal eeg taalladan, oo bal fiiri tiirka aan ina dhex dhigay aniga iyo adiga.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.

kikuyu: Taalladanu markaati ha ka noqoto, tiirkuna markhaati ha ka noqdo, inaanan taalladan kuugu soo dhaafayn inaan wax ku yeelo, adna aadan taalladan iyo tiirkan iigu soo dhaafayn inaad wax i yeeshid.
english: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

kikuyu: Kan ah Ilaaha Ibraahim, iyo Ilaaha Naaxoor, iyo Ilaaha aabbahood, ha ina kala xukumo innaga. Yacquubna wuxuu ku dhaartay Kan aabbihiis Isxaaq ka cabsado.
english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.

kikuyu: Yacquubna allabari buu buurtii ku bixiyey, walaalihiisna wuxuu ugu yeedhay inay wax cunaan; cuntadiina way cuneen, habeenkii oo dhanna buurtay joogeen.
english: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.

kikuyu: Laabaanna aroor hore ayuu kacay, wiilashiisii iyo gabdhihiisiina wuu dhunkaday, wuuna u duceeyey; markaasuu Laabaan tegey, oo ku noqday meeshiisii.
english: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.

kikuyu: Yacquubna jidkiisii buu iska qaaday, malaa'igihii Ilaah baana ka hor yimid.
english: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

kikuyu: Yacquubna markuu iyagii arkay wuxuu yidhi, Kanu waa ciidankii Ilaah. Meeshaas magaceediina wuxuu u bixiyey Maxanayim.
english: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu iska hor mariyey kuwo farriin wada oo wuxuu u diray walaalkiis Ceesaw oo degganaa dalkii Seciir oo ahaa duurkii Edom.
english: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

kikuyu: Wuuna amray, oo wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Waxaad ku tidhaahdaan sayidkayga Ceesaw, Addoonkaagii Yacquub wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan qariib ahaan ula degay Laabaan, oo ilaa haatanna waan la joogay,
english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.

kikuyu: oo waxaan haystaa dibiyo, iyo dameerro, iyo adhi, iyo niman addoommo ah iyo naago addoommo ah; oo waxaan kuugu soo cid diray inaan kuu sheego, sayidkaygiiyow, inaad raalli iga noqotid.
english: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”

kikuyu: Kuwii farriinta wadayna Yacquub bay ku soo noqdeen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Waannu gaadhnay walaalkaa Ceesaw, oo weliba wuu soo socdaa inuu kaa hor yimaado isagoo wata afar boqol oo nin.
english: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub aad u cabsaday, cidhiidhi buuna galay; kolkaasuu kala qaybiyey dadkii la jiray, iyo adhigii, iyo lo'dii, iyo geelii, oo wuxuu ka dhigay laba kooxood,
english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu isyidhi, Ceesaw hadduu koox u yimaado oo uu laayo, dabadeed kooxda hadha ayaa baxsan doonta.
english: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu yidhi, Awowgay Ibraahim Ilaahiisiiyow, Aabbahay Isxaaq Ilaahiisiiyow, Ku noqo dalkaagii, iyo xigaalkaagii, oo anna wanaag baan kuu samayn doonaa, Rabbigii igu yidhiyow:
english: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’

kikuyu: Ma aan istaahilo waxa ugu wada yar ee ka mid ah naxariistaada iyo daacadnimadaada ee aad addoonkaaga tustay, waayo, ushaydaan kaga soo gudbay webigan Urdun, haatanna waxaan noqday laba kooxood.
english: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.

kikuyu: Waan ku baryayaaye, Iga samatabbixi gacanta walaalkay ee ah gacanta Ceesaw; waayo, isagaan ka baqayaa waaba intaasoo uu yimaadaa oo dilaa aniga iyo hooyooyinka iyo carruurta la socotaba.
english: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.

kikuyu: Waxaad igu tidhi, Hubaal wanaag baan kuu samayn doonaa, farcankaagana waxaan ka dhigi doonaa sida cammuudda badda, taas oo aan la tirin karin farabadnaan aawadeed.
english: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”

kikuyu: Habeenkaasna halkaas buu ku baryay, oo walaalkiis Ceesaw ayuu hadiyad uga qaaday wixii uu lahaa,
english: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:

kikuyu: taas oo ah laba tiro oo riyo ah, iyo labaatan orgi, iyo laba tiro oo sabeeno ah iyo labaatan wan,
english: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

kikuyu: iyo soddon halaad oo irmaan iyo nirgahoodii, iyo afartan sac iyo toban dibi, iyo labaatan dameerood iyo toban qayl.
english: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

kikuyu: Markaasuu xoolihii u dhiibay gacantii addoommadiisa, iyadoo goosan waluba goonidiisa yahay; oo wuxuu addoommadiisii ku yidhi, Iga sii hor gudba, xoolahana goosan waluba goosanka kale cabbaar ha ka dambeeyo.
english: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”

kikuyu: Oo kii ugu horreeyey ayuu amray oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Markii walaalkay Ceesaw kaa hor yimaado, oo ku weyddiiyo, isagoo ku leh, Yaa ku leh? Oo xaggee baad ku socotaa? Kuwan kaa horreeyana yaa leh?
english: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’

kikuyu: waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Waxaa leh addoonkaagii Yacquub; oo waa hadiyad loo soo diray sayidkayga Ceesaw; oo isagiina wuu naga dambeeyaa.
english: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”

kikuyu: Sidaasuu ku amray kii labaad, iyo kii saddexaad, iyo kuwii goosannada daba socday oo dhan, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Sidaas waa inaad ula hadashaan Ceesaw markaad aragtaan;
english: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.

kikuyu: oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Weliba addoonkaagii Yacquub waa naga dambeeyaa. Oo wuxuu yidhi, Hadiyadda iga horraysa ayaan ku cadho tirayaa isaga, dabadeedna wejigiisaan arki doonaa; oo mindhaa wuu i aqbali doonaa.
english: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed hadiyaddii waa ka sii hor gudubtay, isna habeenkaas geeddigii buu ku dhex baryay.
english: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu kacay habeenkaas, oo wuxuu kaxaystay labadiisii naagood, iyo labadiisii addoommood, iyo koob iyo tobankiisi carruurta ahayd, oo wuxuu ka gudbiyey tog Yabboq marinkiisii.
english: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

kikuyu: Wuuna kaxeeyey iyagii oo wuxuu u diray durdurka shishadiisa, wixii uu haystayna wuu gudbiyey.
english: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yacquub keligiis hadhay, nin baana la legdamayay isaga ilaa markii waagu beryayay.
english: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.

kikuyu: Oo markuu arkay inuusan ka adkaanayn ayuu taabtay godkii bowdadiisa, bowdadii Yacquubna way murkacatay, intuu la legdamayay isagii.
english: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, I sii daa, maxaa yeelay, waagii waa beryayaa. Isna wuxuu yidhi, Ku sii dayn maayo inaad i barakaysid mooyaane.
english: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”

kikuyu: Mar kaasuu ku yidhi isagii, Magacaa? Isna wuxuu yidhi, Yacquub.
english: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Magacaaga hadda ka dib lama odhan doono Yacquub, waase Israa'iil; waayo, Ilaah iyo dadba waad la dagaallantay, waanad ka adkaatay.
english: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuu weyddiiyey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, ii sheeg magacaaga. Oo wuxuu yidhi, Bal maxaad u haybsanaysaa magacayga? Halkaasuuna ku barakeeyey.
english: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.

kikuyu: Yacquubna meeshaas magaceedii wuxuu u bixiyey Fenii'eel; waayo, wuxuu yidhi, Ilaah fool ka fool baan u arkay, naftayduna way nabad gashay.
english: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”

kikuyu: Qorraxdiina waxay soo baxday markuu Fenuu'eel dhaaftay, isna bowdadiisii buu ka dhutinayay.
english: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ilaa maantadan reer binu Israa'iil ma cunaan seedda misigta oo ku dul taal godka bowdada; maxaa yeelay, wuxuu taabtay godkii bowdadii Yacquub xagga seedda misigta.
english: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub indhihiisii kor u taagay oo wax fiiriyey, wuxuuna arkay Ceesaw oo soo socda, oo afar boqol oo nin wata. Kolkaasuu carruurtii u qaybiyey Lee'ah, iyo Raaxeel, iyo labadii addoon.
english: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

kikuyu: Markaasuu addoommihii iyo carruurtoodii ugu hor mariyey, Lee'ah iyo carruurteediina wuu ku xigsiiyey, Raaxeel iyo Yuusufna wuu ugu dambaysiiyey.
english: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

kikuyu: Isna markaasuu ka hor gudbay, toddoba goor buuna sujuuday, intuusan walaalkiis u soo dhowaan.
english: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

kikuyu: Ceesawna wuu ku soo orday inuu ka hor tago isaga, wuuna isku duubay, oo qoortiisuu dhab yidhi, wuuna dhunkaday, wayna ooyeen.
english: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Ceesaw indhihiisii kor u taagay, oo wuxuu arkay dumarkii iyo carruurtii; oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa ayo kuwan kula socdaa? Isna wuxuu yidhi, Waa carruurtii Ilaah intuu ii roonaaday i siiyey anoo ah addoonkaaga.
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”

kikuyu: Dabadeedna addoommihii iyo carruurtoodii ayaa u soo dhowaaday, wayna wada sujuudeen.
english: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

kikuyu: Lee'ah iyo carruurteediina way u soo dhowaadeen, wayna wada sujuudeen; dabadeedna waxaa u soo dhowaaday Yuusuf iyo Raaxeel, wayna sujuudeen.
english: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Maxaad ula jeeddaa kooxahan iga hor yimid oo dhan? Isna wuxuu yidhi, Inaad raalli iga noqotid, sayidkaygiiyow.
english: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”

kikuyu: Ceesawna wuxuu yidhi, Walaalkayow, wax igu filan baan haystaa; ee iska hayso waxaaga.
english: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu yidhi, Maya, waan ku baryayaaye, haddii aad haatan raalli iga tahay, de hadiyaddayda gacantayda ka guddoon; waayo, wejigaaga waxaan u arkay sidii wejigii Ilaah loo arko, oo adna waad igu faraxday.
english: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

kikuyu: Waan ku baryayaaye, guddoon hadiyaddayda laguu keenay; maxaa yeelay, Ilaah baa ii roonaaday, oo haddana wax igu filan baan haystaa. Aad buuna u baryay, kolkaasuu guddoomay.
english: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Sodcaalkeenna aan iska sii soconno, oo ina keena, oo anna waan kaa hor marayaa.
english: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi isagii, Sayidkaygiiyow, waad og tahay in carruurtu ay tabar daranyihiin, adhiga iyo lo'dana waa la nuugaa; oo haddii maalin keliya aad loo sii kaxeeyo, de adhigu waa wada dhimanayaa.
english: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

kikuyu: Sayidkaygiiyow, waan ku baryayaaye, iga hor mar anigoo addoonkaaga ah, oo anna aayar baan soo kaxayn, anoo fiirinaya tallaabada xoolaha i hor jooga, iyo tallaabada carruurta, ilaa aan Seciir kuugu imaado, sayidkaygiiyow.
english: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ceesaw ku yidhi, Haddaba aan dadka ila jira qaar kaaga tago. Isna wuxuu yidhi, Maxaa looga baahan yahay? Raalli iga ahow, sayidkaygiiyow.
english: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

kikuyu: Oo maalintaasaa Ceesaw ku noqday jidkiisii ilaa Seciir.
english: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu u sodcaalay Sukod, wuxuuna ka dhistay guri, xoolihiisiina wuxuu u sameeyey xerooyin; sidaas daraaddeed meeshaas magaceeda waxaa la yidhaahdaa Sukod.
english: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

kikuyu: Yacquubna nabad buu ku yimid magaaladii Shekem, oo ku taal dalka Kancaan, markuu ka yimid Fadan Araam; oo wuxuu degay magaalada horteeda.
english: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

kikuyu: Jagadii uu teendhadiisii ka dhistayna wuxuu ka iibsaday reer Xamoor oo ahaa Shekem aabbihiis, oo wuxuu siistay boqol xabbadood oo lacag ah.
english: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

kikuyu: Halkaasna wuxuu ka taagay meel allabari, wuxuuna u bixiyey El-elohe-Israa'iil.
english: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

kikuyu: Oo Diinah oo ahayd gabadhii Lee'ah ay Yacquub u dhashay ayaa dibadda u baxday inay soo aragto gabdhihii dalka.
english: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Shekem ina Xamoor kii reer Xiwi oo ahaa amiirkii dalka arkay iyadii, oo uu kaxaystay oo la jiifsaday, wuuna ceebeeyey iyadii.
english: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

kikuyu: Naftiisiina way raacday gabadhii Yacquub oo Diinah ahayd, wuuna jeclaaday gabadhii, si raxmad lehna wuu ula hadlay gabadhii.
english: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Shekem la hadlay aabbihiis Xamoor, oo yidhi, Gabadhan ii doon aan guursadee.
english: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Yacquub waa maqlay in Shekem gabadhiisii Diinah nijaaseeyey; wiilashiisiina duurka ayay xoolihiisa la joogeen; Yacquubna wuu iska aamusay ilaa ay yimaadeen.
english: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Xamoor oo Shekem aabbihiis ahaa Yacquub ugu tegey inuu la hadlo isaga.
english: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Yacquub ayaa duurka ka yimid markay taas maqleen; nimankiina way caloolxumaayeen, aad bayna u cadhaysnaayeen, maxaa yeelay, nacasnimo buu ku sameeyey reer binu Israa'iil markuu la jiifsaday gabadhii Yacquub, taas oo aanay jid ahayn in la sameeyo.
english: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

kikuyu: Xamoorna wuu la hadlay iyagii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Wiilkaygii Shekem naftiisii aad bay u doonaysaa gabadhaada; haddaba waan ku baryayaaye, iyada sii ha guursadee.
english: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

kikuyu: Oo aan iska guursanno, gabdhihiinna na siiya annaga, idinkuna gabdhahayaga guursada.
english: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

kikuyu: Oo waad nala degganaan doontaan; dalkuna hortiinnuu oolli doonaa; degganaada oo ku baayacmushtara dhexdiisa, oo xoolo ku yeesha.
english: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

kikuyu: Shekemna wuxuu aabbeheed iyo walaalaheed ku yidhi, Raalli iga ahaada, oo anna wixii aad i weyddiisataan waan idin siin.
english: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

kikuyu: In alla intii aad meher iyo yarad doonaysaan i weyddiista, oo anna waan idin siin intii aad igu tidhaahdaan, laakiinse gabadha i siiya aan guursadee.
english: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yacquubna khiyaanay ugu jawaabeen Shekem iyo aabbihiis Xamoor, wayna la hadleen, maxaa yeelay, walaashood Diinah ayuu nijaaseeyey,
english: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Ma yeeli karno inaan walaashayo siinno nin buuryoqab ah; waayo, taasu ceeb bay nagu ahaan lahayd.
english: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

kikuyu: Si uun baannu idinku yeeli karnaa; taasuna waa haddii aad intiinna ragga ah oo dhan iswada guddaan, oo aad noqotaan sidayada oo kale;
english: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

kikuyu: markaasaannu gabdhahayaga idin siin doonnaa, oo annaguna waxaan guursan doonnaa gabdhihiinna, oo waannu idinla degganaan doonnaa, oo waxaynu noqon doonnaa isku dad.
english: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddaydnan na maqlin, inaad isguddaan, de markaas gabadhayada waannu wadan, oo waannu tegi.
english: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

kikuyu: Hadalkoodiina waa ka farxiyey Xamoor, iyo wiilkiisii Shekem.
english: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

kikuyu: Ninkii dhallinyarada ahaana dib uma uu dhigin inuu taas yeelo, maxaa yeelay, aad buu ugu faraxsanaa Yacquub gabadhiisii, Isna wuu ka wada maamuus badnaa intii guriga aabbihiis joogtay oo dhan.
english: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

kikuyu: Markaasay Xamoor iyo wiilkiisii Shekem magaaladoodii iriddeeda yimaadeen, oo ay raggii magaaladooda la hadleen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen,
english: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

kikuyu: Nimankanu waa inala nabad, sidaas daraaddeed dhulka ha degeen, oo ha ka baayacmushtareen dhexdiisa, maxaa yeelay, bal eega, dhulku waa weyn yahay oo waa ku wada filan yahay. Aynu gabdhahooda guursanno, oo innana aan gabdhaheenna siinno iyaga.
english: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.

kikuyu: Nimanku si uun bay inagu yeelayaan inay inala degganaadaan si aynu isku dad u noqonno, taasuna waa haddii inteenna lab oo dhan loo gudo sida ay iyagu u gudan yihiin.
english: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

kikuyu: Oo miyaan lo'dooda iyo alaabadooda iyo xayawaankooda oo dhammu noqon doonin kuweenna? Bal aynu yeelno uun, oo iyaguna way inala degganaan doonaan.
english: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa in alla intii ka baxday magaaladiisa iriddeeda waxay maqleen Xamoor iyo wiilkiisii Shekem; markaasaa la wada guday intii labka ahayd oo magaaladiisa ka baxday oo dhan.
english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

kikuyu: Oo maalintii saddexaad, markay dhaawaca wada ahaayeen, waxay noqotay in laba ka mid ahaa wiilashii Yacquub oo ahaa Simecoon iyo Laawi, Diinah walaalaheed, uu midkood kastaa seeftiisii qaatay, oo waxay yimaadeen magaaladii, iyagoo aan la ogayn, waxayna wada laayeen intii labka ahayd oo dhan.
english: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

kikuyu: Xamoor iyo wiilkiisii Shekemna waxay ku dileen seef afkeed, Diinahna way kala baxeen gurigii Shekem, wayna iska tageen.
english: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yacquubna waxay yimaadeen raqdii kuwii la laayay, oo magaaladiina way dhaceen, maxaa yeelay, walaashood bay ka nijaaseeyeen.
english: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

kikuyu: Waxayna la tageen adhigoodii iyo lo'doodii iyo dameerradoodii, iyo wax alla wixii magaalada u yiil, iyo wax alla wixii duurka u joogay,
english: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

kikuyu: iyo maalkoodii oo dhan, iyo dhallaankoodii oo dhan, iyo naagahoodiiba, way qabsadeen oo way dhaceen, xataa wixii guryaha yiil oo dhan.
english: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu Simecoon iyo Laawi ku yidhi, Dhib baad igu riddeen, maxaa yeelay, waxaad i nacsiiseen dadka dhulka deggan, oo ah reer Kancaan, iyo reer Feris. Haddaba anigoo dadkaygu yar yahay, ayay isu kay wada urursan doonaan oo ay i dili doonaan; markaasna aniga iyo reerkaygaba waa la baabbi'in doonaa.
english: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay ku yidhaahdeen, De miyey ku habboonayd inuu walaashayo sidii dhillo ula macaamiloodo?
english: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu Yacquub ku yidhi, Kac oo xagga Beytel tag, oo halkaas deg; oo meel allabari halkaas uga samee Ilaahii kuu muuqday markii aad walaalkaa Ceesaw ka cararaysay.
english: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub ku yidhi dadkii gurigiisa iyo intii isaga la jirtay oo dhan, Iska fogeeya ilaahyada qalaad oo idinku dhex jira, oo isdaahirsha, oo dharkiinnana beddesha,
english: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

kikuyu: oo ina kiciya, aynu Beytel tagnee, oo anna halkaas meel allabari baan uga samayn doonaa Ilaahii ii jawaabay maalintii aan dhibtoonayay oo ila jiray jidkii aan maray.
english: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

kikuyu: Markaasay Yacquub wada siiyeen ilaahyadii qalaad oo gacantooda ku jiray, iyo hilqadihii dhegahooda ku jiray, Yacquubna wuxuu ku qariyey geed Shekem ku ag yiil hoostiisa.
english: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

kikuyu: Wayna sodcaaleen, magaalooyinkii ku wareegsanaa oo dhanna cabsi weyn baa ku dhacday, mana ay ka daba tegin reer Yacquub.
english: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu yimid Luus oo ku taal dalka Kancaan (taasuna waa Beytel), isagii iyo dadkii la jiray oo dhanba.
english: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu halkaas ka dhisay meel allabari, wuxuuna meeshii u bixiyey Elbeytel, maxaa yeelay, Ilaah baa halkaas ugu muuqday isaga, markuu ka cararay walaalkiis.
english: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Debooraah oo Rebeqah midiidinteedii ahayd dhimatay, waxaana lagu aasay Beytel geedka hoostiisa; meeshaas magaceediina waxaa loo bixiyey Alloon Bakuud.
english: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ilaah mar kale Yacquub u muuqday, markii uu ka yimid Fadan Araam, wuuna barakeeyey.
english: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa Ilaah ku yidhi, Magacaagu waa Yacquub. Hadda ka dib magacaaga lama odhan doono Yacquub, laakiinse magacaagu wuxuu ahaan doonaa Israa'iil. Magiciisiina wuxuu u bixiyey Israa'iil.
english: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ilaah ku yidhi isaga, Waxaan ahay Ilaaha Qaadirka ah. Wax badan dhal oo taran; quruun iyo quruumo badan ayaa kaa iman doona, waxaa kaa soo bixi doona boqorro;
english: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

kikuyu: oo dhulkii aan siiyey Ibraahim iyo Isxaaq, adigaan ku siin doonaa, adiga dabadaana farcankaagaan siin doonaa dhulka.
english: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

kikuyu: Ilaahna kor buu uga tegey isagii iyo meeshii uu kula hadlayba.
english: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

kikuyu: Yacquubna meeshii uu kula hadlay isaga wuxuu ka taagay tiir, kaas oo ahaa tiir dhagax ah; wuxuuna ku dul shubay qurbaan cabniin ah, saliidna wuu ku dul shubay.
english: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

kikuyu: Yacquubna meeshii Ilaah kula hadlay isaga magaceedii wuxuu u bixiyey Beytel.
english: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

kikuyu: Wayna ka sodcaaleen Beytel; oo intaanay Efrad weli soo gaadhin ayaa Raaxeel foolatay, fooshiina way ku rafaadday.
english: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

kikuyu: Oo markay fooshii ku rafaadaysay umulisadii baa ku tidhi, Ha cabsan; waayo, haatan waxaad dhalaysaa wiil kale.
english: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in, markii ay naftu ka sii baxaysay, ay magiciisii u bixisay Benooni, waayo, way dhimatay, laakiinse aabbihiis wuxuu u bixiyey Benyaamiin.
english: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

kikuyu: Raaxeelna way dhimatay, waxaana lagu aasay jidka loo maro Efrad, taasuna waa Beytlaxam.
english: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

kikuyu: Yacquubna tiir buu ka taagay qabrigeedii; waana isla tiirka ka taagan qabrigii Raaxeel ilaa maanta.
english: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

kikuyu: Israa'iilna waa sodcaalay, oo wuxuu teendhadiisii ka dhistay munaaraddii Ceeder shishadeeda.
english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay, intuu Israa'iil dhulkaas degganaa, in Ruubeen u tegey oo la jiifsaday addoontii aabbihiis oo Bilhah ahayd; Israa'iilna taas wuu maqlay. Wiilashii Yacquubna laba iyo toban bay ahayeen.
english: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Lee'ah waxay ahaayeen Ruubeen oo ahaa curadkii Yacquub, iyo Simecoon, iyo Laawi, iyo Yahuudah, iyo Isaakaar, iyo Sebulun.
english: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Raaxeelna waxay ahaayeen Yuusuf iyo Benyaamiin.
english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

kikuyu: Addoontii Raaxeel oo Bilhah ahayd wiilasheediina waxay ahaayeen Daan iyo Naftaali.
english: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

kikuyu: Addoontii Lee'ah oo Silfah ahayd wiilasheediina waxay ahaayeen Gaad iyo Aasheer. Kuwanu waa wiilashii Yacquub oo isaga ugu dhashay Fadan Araam.
english: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub aabbihiis Isxaaq ugu yimid Mamre, iyo xagga Qiryad Arbac, taasuna waa Xebroon, oo ahayd meeshii Ibraahim iyo Isxaaq qariib ahaanta u degganaan jireen.
english: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

kikuyu: Isxaaq cimrigiisuna wuxuu ahaa boqol iyo siddeetan sannadood.
english: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

kikuyu: Isxaaqna wuu naf baxay, wuuna dhintay, oo wuxuu ku darmaday dadkiisii, isagoo duq ah oo cimri weyn; markaasay wiilashiisii Ceesaw iyo Yacquub isagii aaseen.
english: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanuna waa farcankii Ceesaw, isna waa Edom.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

kikuyu: Ceesaw wuxuu gabdhihii reer Kancaan ka guursaday Caadah ina Eeloon kii reer Xeed, iyo Aaholiibaamah ina Canah, oo ahayd ina Sibecoon kii reer Xiwi,
english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

kikuyu: iyo Basmad oo ahayd ina Ismaaciil, oo la dhalatay Nebayod.
english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

kikuyu: Caadahna waxay Ceesaw u dhashay Elifas, Basmadna waxay u dhashay Recuu'eel;
english: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

kikuyu: Aaholiibaamahna waxay u dhashay Yecuush, iyo Yaclaam, iyo Qorax; kuwanu waa wiilashii Ceesaw, oo isaga ugu dhashay dalkii Kancaan.
english: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ceesaw kaxaystay naagihiisii, iyo wiilashiisii iyo gabdhihiisii, iyo dadkii gurigiisa oo dhan, iyo lo'diisii, iyo xayawaankiisii oo dhan, iyo wixii uu lahaa oo dhan oo uu ku urursaday dalkii Kancaan; markaasuu tegey dal ka fog walaalkiis Yacquub.
english: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

kikuyu: Waayo, xoolahoodu aad bay u badnaayeen oo ma ay wada degi karin; dhulkii ay degganaan jireenna ma uu wada qaadi karin lo'dooda aawadeed.
english: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

kikuyu: Ceesawna wuxuu degay Buur Seciir; Ceesaw waa Edom.
english: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa farcankii Ceesaw oo ahaa reer Edom aabbahood oo degganaan jiray Buur Seciir.
english: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa wiilashii Ceesaw magacyadoodii, Elifas oo ahaa wiilkii Caadah oo naagtii Ceesaw ahayd, iyo Recuu'eel oo ahaa wiilkii Basmad oo naagtii Ceesaw ahayd.
english: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Elifasna waxay ahaayeen Teemaan, Oomaar, Sefoo, iyo Gactaam iyo Qenas.
english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

kikuyu: Timnac waxay ahayd addoontii uu Elifas ina Ceesaw qabay, oo waxay Elifas u dhashay Camaaleq; kuwanu waa wiilashii naagtii Ceesaw oo Caadah ahayd.
english: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa wiilashii Recuu'eel: Nahad, iyo Serax, iyo Shammah, iyo Misaah; kuwanuna waxay ahaayeen wiilashii naagtii Ceesaw oo Basmad ahayd.
english: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waxay ahaayeen wiilashii naagtii Ceesaw oo ahayd Aaholiibaamah, gabadhii Canah oo ahayd ina Sibecoon; oo iyana waxay Ceesaw u dhashay Yacuush, iyo Yaclaam, iyo Qorax.
english: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waxa weeye ugaasyadii wiilashii Ceesaw. Waa wiilashii Elifas kii ahaa curadkii Ceesaw kuwaas oo ah ugaas Teemaan, iyo ugaas Oomaar, iyo ugaas Sefoo, iyo ugaas Qenas,
english: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

kikuyu: ugaas Qorax, iyo ugaas Gactaam, iyo ugaas Camaaleq. Kuwanu waa ugaasyadii Elifas dhalay oo dalkii Edom joogay; kuwanu waa wiilashii Caadah.
english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa wiilashii Recuu'eel oo ahaa ina Ceesaw: ugaas Nahad, iyo ugaas Serax, iyo ugaas Shammah, iyo ugaas Misaah. Kuwanuna waa ugaasyadii uu Recuu'eel dhalay oo dalkii Edom joogay; kuwanu waa wiilashii naagtii Ceesaw oo Basmad ahayd.
english: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa wiilashii naagtii Ceesaw oo Aaholiibaamah ahayd: ugaas Yecuush, iyo ugaas Yaclaam, iyo ugaas Qorax. Kuwanuna waa ugaasyadii ay dhashay naagtii Ceesaw oo ahayd Aaholiibaamah, gabadhii Canah.
english: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa wiilashii Ceesaw oo ahaa Edom, oo kuwanu waa ugaasyadoodii.
english: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa wiilashii Seciir, kii reer Xor, oo ahaa kuwii dhulka degganaa, Lootaan, iyo Shoobaal, iyo Sibecoon, iyo Canah,
english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

kikuyu: iyo Dishon, iyo Eeser, iyo Diishaan. Kuwanu waa ugaasyadii reer Xor, oo ahaa ilma Seciir oo degganaa dhulkii Edom.
english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

kikuyu: Carruurtii Lootaanna waxay ahaayeen Xori iyo Heemaam, Lootaan walaashiisna waxay ahayd Timnac.
english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa carruurtii Shoobaal; Calwaan, iyo Maanahad, iyo Ceebaal, iyo Shefo, iyo Oonaam.
english: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa carruurtii Sibecoon; Ayah, iyo Canah. Kanu waa Canah kii cidlada ka helay ilaha biyaha oo kulul, markuu daajinayay dameerrada aabbihiis Sibecoon.
english: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa carruurtii Canah; Dishon, iyo Aaholiibaamah, gabadhii Canah.
english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa carruurtii Dishon; Xemdaan, iyo Eshbaan, iyo Yitraan, iyo Keraan.
english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa carruurtii Eeser; Bilhaan, iyo Sacwaan, iyo Caqaan.
english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa carruurtii Diishaan; Cuus iyo Araan.
english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa ugaasyadii reer Xor; ugaas Lootaan, iyo ugaas Shoobaal, iyo ugaas Sibecoon, iyo ugaas Canah,
english: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

kikuyu: ugaas Dishon, iyo ugaas Eeser, iyo ugaas Diishaan. Kuwanuna waa ugaasyadii reer Xor siday ahaayeen ugaasyadoodii dalka Seciir joogay.
english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa boqorradii xukumi jiray dalkii Edom intaan boqorna xukumin reer binu Israa'iil.
english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Belac ina Becoor wuxuu xukumi jiray Edom, magaaladiisii magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Dinhaabah.
english: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Belac dhintay, oo waxaa meeshiisii xukumi jiray Yoobaab ina Serax oo reer Bosraah ahaa.
english: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Yoobaabna waa dhintay, oo waxaa meeshiisii xukumi jiray Xushaam oo ka yimid dhulkii reer Teemaan.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Xushaamna waa dhintay, oo waxaa meeshiisii xukumi jiray Hadad ina Bedad, oo reer Midyaan ku laayay berrinkii Moo'aab, magaaladiisii magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Cawiid.
english: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Hadadna dhintay, oo waxaa meeshiisii xukumi jiray Samlah oo reer Masreqah ahaa.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Samlahna dhintay, oo waxaa meeshiisii xukumi jiray Sha'uul oo reer Rexobod ahaa oo webiga ag degganaa.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Sha'uulna dhintay, oo waxaa meeshiisii xukumi jiray Bacal Xaanaan ina Cakboor.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Bacal Xaanaan ina Cakboorna waa dhintay, oo waxaa meeshiisii xukumi jiray Hadar, magaaladiisii magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Faacuu; naagtiisa magaceeduna wuxuu ahaa Meheetabeel, oo ay Matreed gabadha Meesaahaab dhashay.
english: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa magacyadii ugaasyadii Ceesaw dhalay, siday ahaayeen qabiilooyinkoodii iyo magacyadii meelahoodii ay degganaan jireen, waana ugaas Timnac, iyo ugaas Calwah, iyo ugaas Yeteed,
english: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

kikuyu: iyo ugaas Aaholiibaamah, iyo ugaas Eelaah, iyo ugaas Fiinon;
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

kikuyu: iyo ugaas Qenas, iyo ugaas Teemaan, iyo ugaas Mibsaar;
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

kikuyu: iyo ugaas Magdii'eel, iyo ugaas Ciiraam. Kuwanu waa ugaasyadii reer Edom sidii ay u degganaayeen dhulkii ay lahaayeen. Kanu waa Ceesaw oo ahaa reer Edom aabbahood.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

kikuyu: Yacquubna wuxuu degay dhulkii aabbihiis qariibka ku ahaan jiray, oo ahaa dalkii Kancaan.
english: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa farcankii Yacquub. Yuusuf, isagoo jira toddoba iyo toban sannadood, ayuu idaha la daajinayay walaalihiis, wuxuuna ahaa wiil la jooga wiilashii Bilhah iyo Silfah oo ahaa naagihii aabbihiis. Markaasuu Yuusuf xaggooda war xun uga keenay aabbahood.
english: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

kikuyu: Israa'iilna Yuusuf wuu ka jeclaa carruurtiisa oo dhan, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu ahaa inankuu dhalay markuu gaboobay; oo wuxuuna u sameeyey shulug midabyo badan leh.
english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.

kikuyu: Markaasaa walaalihiis arkeen in aabbahood ka jecel yahay isaga walaalihiis oo dhan; kolkaasay nebcaadeen isagii, wayna kari waayeen inay isaga si nabad ah ula hadlaan.
english: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

kikuyu: Yuusufna wuu riyooday, markaasuu riyadiisii u sheegay walaalihiis, iyana aad bay u sii nebcaadeen.
english: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Waan idin baryayaaye, bal maqla riyadan aan ku riyooday.
english: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

kikuyu: Bal eega, waxaynu beerta ku xidhxidhaynay xidhmooyin, markaasaa xidhmadaydii kacday, oo istaagtay, xidhmooyinkiinniina hareeraheeday yimaadeen oo u sujuudeen xidhmadaydii.
english: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa walaalihiis ku yidhaahdeen, Ma annagaad na xukumi doontaa? Amase noo talin doontaa? Markaasay aad iyo aad ugu sii nebcaadeen riyooyinkiisii iyo hadalladiisii aawadood.
english: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

kikuyu: Markaasuu haddana riyo kale ku riyooday, oo walaalihiis u sheegay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eega, riyo kalaan ku riyoodaye. Waxaan ku riyooday qorraxdii iyo dayaxii, iyo koob iyo toban xiddigood oo ii sujuuday.
english: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu aabbihiis u sheegay, iyo walaalihiisba, aabbihiisna waa canaantay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa maxay riyadan aad ku riyootay? Ma aniga iyo hooyadaa iyo walaalahaa baa kuu iman doonna, oo intaan wejiga dhulka saarno kuu sujuudi doonna?
english: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”

kikuyu: Markaasay walaalihiis ka masayreen isagii; laakiinse aabbihiis maankuu ku haystay hadalkii.
english: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

kikuyu: Markaasaa walaalihiis tageen, inay adhigii aabbahood soo daajiyaan Shekem.
english: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

kikuyu: Israa'iilna wuxuu Yuusuf ku yidhi, Miyaanay walaalahaa adhigii daajinayn Shekem? Bal kaalay, xaggoodaan kuu dirayaaye. Markaasuu isna ku yidhi, Waa i kan.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi isagii, Bal tag oo soo arag in walaalahaa iyo adhigiiba nabad qabaan iyo in kale, oo haddana ii war keen. Sidaas daraaddeed isagii wuxuu ka diray dooxadii Xebroon, oo wuxuu tegey Shekem.
english: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

kikuyu: Markaasaa nin helay isagoo duurka wareegaya; ninkiina wax buu weyddiiyey oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad doondoonaysaa?
english: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

kikuyu: Isna wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan doondoonayaa walaalahay. Waan ku baryayaaye, ii sheeg meesha ay adhigii daajinayaan.
english: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa ninkii ku yidhi, Halkan way ka tageen, waayo, waxaan maqlay iyagoo isku leh, Ina keena aynu Dotaan tagnee. Markaasuu Yuusuf walaalihiis ka daba tegey, oo wuxuu iyagii ka helay Dotaan.
english: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

kikuyu: Markaasay meel fog ka arkeen isagii, oo intuusan u soo dhowaan iyagii, ayay ku tashadeen inay dilaan.
english: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

kikuyu: Oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Bal eega, kii riyada badnaa waa soo socdaaye.
english: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

kikuyu: Haddaba kaalaya aynu dilnee, oo aynu ku tuurno ceelasha midkood, oo waxaynu odhan doonnaa, Bahal xun baa cunay. Dabadeedna waxaynu arki doonnaa bal waxay riyooyinkiisii noqdaan.
english: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

kikuyu: Oo Ruubeen baa taas maqlay, isagiina wuu ka samatabbixiyey gacantoodii; oo wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Yeynan naftiisa ka qaadin.
english: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ruubeen ku yidhi iyagii, Dhiig ha daadinina, ee isaga ku tuura ceelkan cidlada ku yaal, laakiinse far ha saarina. Oo wuxuu taas u yeelay inuu isaga ka samatabbixiyo gacantooda oo uu u celiyo aabbihiis.
english: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in markii Yuusuf walaalihiis u yimid ay Yusuuf ka furteen shuluggiisii, kaasu wuxuu ahaa shuluggii midabyada badnaa oo uu qabay.
english: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

kikuyu: Kolkaasay qabteen oo ay ceelkii ku tuureen; ceelkuna waa madhnaa oo biyo kuma jirin.
english: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay u fadhiisteen inay wax cunaan; dabadeedna indhahay kor u taageen oo wax bay fiiriyeen, oo waxay arkeen safar reer Ismaaciil ah oo ka soo socda xagga Gilecaad, oo awrtooda ay ugu raran yihiin xawaash, iyo beeyo, iyo malmal, waxayna u socdeen xagga Masar.
english: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yahuudah ku yidhi walaalihiis, Maxaa faa'iido inoogu jirta, haddaynu walaalkeen dilno oo aynu dhiiggiisa qarinno?
english: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

kikuyu: Kaalaya, aynu reer Ismaaciil ka iibinnee, oo yeynan isaga far saarin, maxaa yeelay, isagu waa walaalkeen, waana jidhkeenna. Walaalihiisna way maqleen isagii.
english: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa ag maray niman reer Midyaan ah, oo baayacmushtariyaal ah. Markaasay Yuusuf soo jiideen oo ceelkii ka soo bixiyeen, oo waxay Yuusuf kuwii reer Ismaaciil kaga iibiyeen labaatan xabbadood oo lacag ah. Oo iyana Yuusuf waxay keeneen Masar.
english: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ruubeen ku noqday ceelkii; wuxuuna arkay inuusan Yuusuf ku jirin ceelka, kolkaasuu dharkiisii dildillaaciyey.
english: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

kikuyu: Markaasuu walaalihiis ku noqday, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Yarkii ma joogo, haddaba anigu xaggee baan tagaa?
english: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay shuluggii Yuusuf qaadeen oo intay orgi gowraceen ayay shuluggii dhiiggii geliyeen.
english: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

kikuyu: Markaasay shuluggii midabyada badnaa direen, oo ay aabbahood u keeneen; oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Kan waannu helnay, haddaba bal garo inuu shuluggii wiilkaagii yahay iyo in kale.
english: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”

kikuyu: Wuuna gartay, oo wuxuu yidhi, Waa shuluggii wiilkayga. Bahal xun baa cunay isagii. Shakila'aan Yuusuf cadcad baa loo kala jeexjeexay.
english: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub dharkiisii dildillaaciyey, oo joonyad buu dhexda ku xidhay, wiilkiisiina maalmo badan ayuu u barooranayay.
english: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa wiilashiisii oo dhan iyo gabdhihiisii oo dhammu u kaceen inay isaga qalbi qaboojiyaan, laakiinse wuu diiday inuu qalbi qaboobo, oo wuxuu yidhi, Anigoo barooranaya ayaan qabriga geli doonaa oo wiilkaygii u tegi doonaa. Aabbihiisna wuu u ooyay isagii.
english: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.

kikuyu: Markaasay kuwii reer Midyaan isagii Masar kaga iibiyeen nin la odhan jiray Footiifar, wuxuuna ahaa sirkaalkii Fircoon oo ahaa madaxa waardiyayaasha.
english: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

kikuyu: Oo waagaas waxay noqotay inuu Yahuudah ka tegey walaalihiis, oo wuxuu u leexday nin magiciisa la odhan jiray Xiirah oo reer Cadullaam ah.
english: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah wuxuu halkaas ku arkay nin reer Kancaan ah oo magiciisa la odhan jiray Shuuca gabadhiisii. Kolkaasuu kaxaystay iyadii oo uu u tegey.
english: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.

kikuyu: Wayna uuraysatay oo waxay dhashay wiil, magiciisiina wuxuu u bixiyey Ceer.
english: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

kikuyu: Oo haddana mar kalay uuraysatay oo waxay dhashay wiil; magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Oonaan.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

kikuyu: Oo weliba haddana wiil kalay dhashay, magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Sheelaah; oo isna wuxuu joogay Kesiib, markay dhashay isaga.
english: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah naag u guuriyey curadkiisii ahaa Ceer, magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Taamaar.
english: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

kikuyu: Yahuudah curadkiisii ahaa Ceer waa ku xumaa Rabbiga hortiisa; Rabbiguna waa dilay isagii.
english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah wuxuu ku yidhi Oonaan, Naagta walaalkaa u tag oo dumaal, oo ku samee wixii ninkeeda walaalkiis ku samayn lahaa, oo farcan u reeb walaalkaa.
english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

kikuyu: Oonaanna wuu ogaa inaan farcanku kiisii noqonayn, oo markuu u tegey naagtii walaalkiis ayuu shahwadiisii ku daadiyey dhulka, si uusan farcan u siin walaalkiis.
english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

kikuyu: Wixii uu sameeyeyna Rabbiga hortiisa aad buu ugu xumaa; oo markaasuu isagiina dilay.
english: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yahuudah ku yidhi gabadhii Taamaar oo uu soddogga u ahaa, Carmalnimo ku joog guriga aabbahaa, ilaa uu wiilkayga Sheelaah koro; waayo, wuxuu isyidhi, Waaba intaasoo uu isna dhintaa sidii walaalihiis. Kolkaasay Taamaar tagtay oo gurigii aabbeheed joogtay.
english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

kikuyu: Wakhti dheer ka dib waxaa dhimatay Shuuca gabadhiisii oo ahayd naagtii Yahuudah. Markaasaa Yahuudah loo tacsiyeeyey, oo wuxuu tegey xagga kuwii idihiisa dhogorta ka xiiri jiray oo joogay Timnaad, isaga iyo saaxiibkiis Xiirah kii reer Cadullaamba.
english: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Taamaar loo sheegay, oo waxaa lagu yidhi, Bal eeg, soddoggaa wuxuu tegayaa xagga Timnaad inuu idihiisii dhogorta ka soo xiirto.
english: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

kikuyu: Markaasay iska dhigtay dharkii carmalinimadeeda, oo waxay hagoogatay indhashareerteedii, oo intay isdedday ayay waxay fadhiisatay iriddii Cenayim, oo ku ag tiil jidka loo maro Timnaad, waayo, waxay aragtay inuu Sheelaah weynaaday, oo aan loo guurin iyada.
english: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

kikuyu: Markii Yahuudah arkay ayuu u maleeyey inay dhillo tahay; maxaa yeelay, wejigeeday qarisay.
english: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ku soo leexday iyadoo jidka ag fadhida, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, kaalay aan kuu tagee; waayo, ma uu ogayn inay tahay gabadhii uu soddogga u ahaa. Kolkaasay waxay ku tidhi, Maxaad i siinaysaa aad ii tagtide?
english: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaan adhiga kaaga soo diri doonaa waxar. Iyana waxay tidhi, Rahaamad ma i siinaysaa intaad ii soo diraysid?
english: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”

kikuyu: Isna wuxuu yidhi, Maxaan rahaamad kuu siiyaa? Kolkaasay tidhi, I sii kaatunkaaga iyo xadhiggaaga, iyo ushaada aad gacanta ku haysatid. Kolkaasuu siiyey, oo uu u tegey iyadii, oo iyana xaggiisay ka uuraysatay.
english: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay kacday oo tagtay, oo intay indhashareerteedii iska dhigtay, ayay xidhatay dharkii carmalinimadeedii.
english: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah waxar adhiga ka soo diray oo wuxuu ugu soo dhiibay gacanta saaxiibkiis kii reer Cadullaam, inuu rahaamaddii ka soo qaado gacantii naagta, laakiinse iyadii wuu waayay.
english: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

kikuyu: Markaasuu weyddiiyey dadkii degganaa meesheedii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Meeday dhilladii joogi jirtay Cenayim jidka dhinaciisa? Kolkaasay iyana ku yidhaahdeen, Halkan dhillo ma joogi jirin.
english: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku noqday Yahuudah, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Iyadii waan waayay, dadkii meeshaa degganaana waxay igu yidhaahdeen, Halkan dhillo ma joogi jirin.
english: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah yidhi, Ha iska qaadato, waaba intaasoo aynu ku ceebownaaye; waayo, bal eeg, anigu waxaan u diray waxarkan, waana aad soo weyday iyadii.
english: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in muddo saddex bilood ku dhow dabadeed Yahuudah war loo soo sheegay, oo lagu yidhi, Gabadhii Taamaar oo aad soddogga u ahayd waa dhillowday; oo dhillanimadeedii bay ku uuraysatay. Markaasaa Yahuudah yidhi, Soo bixiya oo ha la gubo.
english: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay markii la soo bixiyey farriin u dirtay soddoggeed, oo waxay tidhi, Ninka alaabtan leh ayaa i uureeyey; oo waxay kaloo tidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, bal hubso ninka leh kuwan ah kaatunka iyo xadhkaha, iyo usha.
english: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah qirtay iyagii, oo wuxuu yidhi, Iyadu way iga xaqsan tahay, waayo, waxaan iyada siin waayay wiilkayga Sheelaah ah. Mar dambena uma uu tegin iyadii.
english: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, markii ay foolatay mataano baa ku jiray maxalkeeda.
english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay, in markii ay foolatay uu midkood gacan soo bixiyey; markaasay umulisadii qaadatay dun guduudan oo ay gacantiisii ku xidhay, oo waxay tidhi, Kanaa soo hor baxay.
english: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay, markuu gacanta dib u ceshaday, inuu walaalkiis soo baxay; oo iyana waxay tidhi, De maxaad u soo dustay? Sidaas daraaddeed magiciisii waxaa loo bixiyey Feres.
english: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna waxaa soo baxay walaalkiis, kii ay dunta guduudanu gacanta ugu xidhnayd; magiciisiina waxaa loo bixiyey Serax.
english: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

kikuyu: Yuusufna waxaa la keenay Masar. Kuwii reer Ismaaciil oo isaga halkaas geeyeyna waxaa gacantoodii ka iibsaday nin Masri ahaa oo la odhan jiray Footiifar, oo Fircoon sirkaal u ahaa, oo madaxii waardiyayaasha ahaa.
english: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna waa la jiray Yuusuf, wuxuuna ahaa nin liibaansan, wuxuuna joogi jiray gurigii sayidkiisii Masriga ahaa.
english: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

kikuyu: Sayidkiisiina wuu arkay in Rabbigu liibaaniyey wixii uu sameeyey oo dhan.
english: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand.

kikuyu: Isaguna raalli buu Yuusuf ka ahaa, Yuusufna waa u adeegi jiray, oo wuxuu isagii ka dhigay kan gurigiisa u sarreeya, wixii uu haystay oo dhanna gacantiisuu wada geliyey.
english: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in wakhtigii uu ka dhigay kan u sarreeya gurigiisa iyo wixii uu haystay oo dhan, uu Rabbigu gurigii kii Masriga ahaa u barakeeyey Yuusuf aawadiis, wixii uu guriga iyo beertaba ku haystay oo dhanna barakada Rabbigaa saarnayd.
english: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. The LORD’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

kikuyu: Wixii uu lahaa oo dhanna Yuusuf gacantiisuu kaga tegey. Waxbana kama ogayn wixii uu hayay, wixii uu cuni jiray mooyaane. Yuusufna aad buu u quruxsanaa, wuuna suurad wanaagsanaa.
english: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay waxyaalahaas ka dib in naagtii sayidkiisu ay fiirisay Yuusuf, oo ay ku tidhi, Kaalay ila jiifso.
english: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse wuu diiday, oo wuxuu ku yidhi naagtii sayidkiisa, Bal eeg, sayidkaygu waxba kama oga waxa aan guriga ku hayo; wixiisii oo dhanna gacantayduu wada geliyey;
english: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

kikuyu: oo weliba gurigan mid aniga iga weynu ma joogo, oo isaguna waxba igalama hadhin adiga mooyaane, maxaa yeelay, adigu waxaad tahay naagtiisii, de haddaba sidee baan u samayn karaa xumaantan weyn, oo aan Ilaah ugu dembaabaa?
english: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay, in kastoo ay maalinba maalinta ka dambaysa la hadlaysay Yuusuf, inuu maqli waayay inuu la jiifsado ama uu la joogo iyadii.
english: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay haddaa oo kale, inuu gurigii galay inuu shuqulkiisii qabsado, nimankii gurigana midna gudaha ma joogin.
english: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay qabsatay dharkiisii, oo waxay ku tidhi, Ila jiifso. Isaguse dharkiisii gacanteeduu kaga tegey, wuuna cararay oo baxay.
english: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

kikuyu: Markay aragtay inuu dharkiisii gacanteeda kaga tegey, oo uu dibadda u cararay,
english: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

kikuyu: ayay u yeedhay raggii gurigeeda oo ay la hadashay, oo waxay ku tidhi, Bal eega, ninkaygu wuxuu inoo keenay nin Cibraani ah inuu inagu majaajiloodo. Wuxuu iigu soo galay inuu ila jiifsado aawadeed, markaasaan cod dheer ku qayliyey,
