english: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

kikuyu: oo markuu maqlay inaan codkaygii sare u qaaday oo aan qayliyey ayuu dharkiisii iiga tegey, wuuna cararay oo baxay.
english: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

kikuyu: Dharkiisiina way is-ag dhigtay ilaa uu sayidkiisii guriga yimid.
english: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay hadalkan kula hadashay isagii, oo waxay ku tidhi, Addoonkii Cibraaniga ahaa, oo aad inoo keentay, ayaa iigu soo galay inuu igu majaajiloodo,
english: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

kikuyu: oo markaan codkaygii sare u qaaday oo aan qayliyey ayuu dharkiisii iiga tegey, oo uu dibadda u cararay.
english: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

kikuyu: Markii sayidkiisii maqlay hadalkii naagtiisa, oo ay kula hadashay isaga, iyadoo leh, Addoonkaagii sidan buu igu sameeyey, ayuu cadhooday.
english: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf sayidkiisii qabtay isagii, oo wuxuu geliyey xabsigii ahaa meeshii maxaabiista boqorku ku xidhnaayeen; oo isna halkaasuu ku jiray xabsigii gudihiisa.
english: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Yuusuf waxaa la jiray Rabbiga, wuuna u roonaaday, kii xabsiga hayayna raalli buu uga dhigay.
english: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

kikuyu: Kii xabsiga hayayna wuxuu Yuusuf gacanta u geliyey maxaabiistii xabsiga ku jirtay oo dhan; oo wax kastoo ay halkaas ku sameeyeenna, wuxuu ahaa kii sameeyey.
english: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

kikuyu: Kii xabsiga hayayna ma uu eegi jirin waxa isaga gacantiisa ku jira, maxaa yeelay, Rabbigaa la jiray isaga, wixii uu sameeyeyna Rabbigu waa liibaaniyey.
english: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas ka dib, kii boqorkii Masar khamriga siin jiray iyo kii wax u dubi jiray waxay xumeeyeen sayidkoodii ahaa boqorkii Masar.
english: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

kikuyu: Fircoonna aad buu ugu cadhaysnaa labadiisii sirkaal oo ahaa kii madaxa u ahaa kuwii khamriga siin jiray, iyo kii madaxa u ahaa kuwii wax u dubi jiray.
english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyagii ku xabbisay gurigii madaxa waardiyayaasha, xagga xabsiga gudihiisa oo ahaa meeshii Yuusuf ku xidhnaa.
english: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

kikuyu: Madaxii waardiyayaashuna Yuusuf amar buu u siiyey iyagii, wuuna u adeegi jiray iyagii; intii wakhti ahna xabsigay ku jireen.
english: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

kikuyu: Kii khamriga siin jiray iyo kii wax u dubi jiray boqorkii Masar, iyagoo xabsiga ku xidhnaa, ayay labadoodiiba isku habeen riyoodeen, nin kastaana riyadiisuu ku riyooday oo nin kastaa wuxuu ku riyooday sidii riyadiisii fasirkeedu ahaa.
english: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

kikuyu: Subaxdii baa Yuusuf u soo galay oo fiiriyey iyagii, oo wuxuu arkay iyagoo calool xun.
english: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wax weyddiiyey saraakiishii Fircoon oo isaga lagula xabbisay guriga sayidkiisa, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad maanta ugu eg tihiin kuwo calool xun?
english: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay ku yidhaahdeen isagii, Riyaannu ku riyoonnay, mana jiro mid fasiri karaa. Markaasaa Yuusuf wuxuu ku yidhi iyagii, Miyaan Ilaah fasirro lahayn? Haddaba waan idin baryayaaye, bal ii sheega.
english: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa madaxii kuwii khamriga keeni jiray riyadiisii Yuusuf u sheegay, oo wuxuu yidhi, Riyadaydii waxaan ku arkay geed canab ah oo i hor yaal.
english: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

kikuyu: Geedkuna wuxuu lahaa saddex laamood. Waxayna u ekaayeen sidii iyagoo magoolaya, ubaxyadiina soo baxayaan; markaasaa rucubyadii waxay noqdeen canab bisil.
english: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

kikuyu: Koobkii Fircoonna gacantayduu ku jiray, markaasaan canabkii guray oo koobkii Fircoon ku tuujiyey, koobkiina waxaan u dhiibay gacantii Fircoon.
english: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf ku yidhi, Fasirkeedii waa kan: saddexda laamood waa saddex maalmood.
english: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

kikuyu: Oo weliba saddex maalmood dhexdooda ayaa Fircoon madaxaaga kor u qaadi doonaa, oo meeshaaduu kugu celin doonaa; Fircoon koobkiisiina gacantiisaad u dhiibi doontaa sidii waagii hore markaad ahaan jirtay kii khamriga siin jiray.
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waan ku baryayaaye, i soo xusuuso markay kuu hagaagto, oo ii roonow, oo Fircoon ii sheeg, oo gurigan iga bixi;
english: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

kikuyu: waayo, waxaa layga soo xaday dhulka Cibraaniyada, oo halkanna kuma aan samayn wax ay iigu ridaan godxabsiga.
english: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

kikuyu: Madaxii kuwii wax dubi jiray markuu arkay inuu fasirkaasu wanaagsanaa ayuu wuxuu Yuusuf ku yidhi, Aniguna waxaan riyadaydii ku arkay saddex dambiil oo kibis cadcadu ku jirto oo madaxayga saaran.
english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

kikuyu: Oo dambiishii ugu wada sarreeyey waxaa ku jiray cunto cayn kasta ah oo Fircoon loo dubay; markaasay haadkii cuntadii ka cuneen dambiishii madaxayga saarnaa.
english: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Fasirkeedii waa kan; saddexda dambiil waa saddex maalmood.
english: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

kikuyu: Oo weliba saddex maalmood dhexdooda ayaa Fircoon madaxaaga kor kaaga qaadi doonaa, geed buuna kaa soo deldeli doonaa, markaasaa haadku hilibkaaga cuni doonaa.
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

kikuyu: Maalintii saddexaad oo la xusuustay maalintii Fircoon dhashay ayuu addoommadiisii oo dhan diyaafad u sameeyey; markaasuu kor u qaaday madaxii kii madaxa u ahaan jiray kuwii khamriga isaga siin jiray iyo madaxii kii madaxa u ahaan jiray kuwii wax u dubi jiray oo addoommadiisa dhex joogay.
english: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

kikuyu: Markaasuu madaxii kuwii khamriga keeni jiray mar kale shaqadiisii ku celiyey; oo koobkii buu u dhiibay gacantii Fircoon;
english: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

kikuyu: laakiinse madaxii kuwii wax dubi jiray ayuu deldelay sidii Yuusuf ugu fasiray iyaga.
english: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

kikuyu: Laakiinse madaxii kuwii khamriga keeni jiray ma uu xusuusan Yuusuf, wuuse illoobay isagii.
english: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

kikuyu: Markii laba sannadood oo dhammu dhammaatay ayuu Fircoon riyooday, oo wuxuu is-arkay isagoo webiga ag taagan.
english: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa webigii ka soo baxay toddoba sac oo quruxsan oo cayillan, oo waxay daaqeen cawskii dareemada ahaa.
english: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa dabadood webigii ka soo baxay toddoba sac oo kale oo fool xun, oo weyd ahaa, oo waxay is-ag taageen sicihii kale oo webiga qarkiisa jooga.
english: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.

kikuyu: Markaasaa sicihii foosha xumaa oo weydda ahaa waxay cuneen toddobadii sac oo qurxoonayd oo cayillanayd. Kolkaasuu Fircoon toosay.
english: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.

kikuyu: Markaasuu haddana seexday oo mar labaad riyooday, oo wuxuu arkay toddoba sabuul oo buurbuuran oo wanaagsan oo ka soo baxay isku jirid.
english: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa haddana ka soo daba baxay toddoba sabuul oo xunxun, oo ay dabayshii bari qallajisay.
english: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa sabuulladii xunxumaa waxay liqeen toddobadii sabuul oo buurbuurnayd oo iltirnayd. Markaasuu Fircoon toosay, oo wuxuu arkay inay riyo tahay.
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.

kikuyu: Oo subaxdiina wuu dhibaataysnaa, kolkaasuu u cid diray oo uu u wada yeedhay saaxiriintii Masar oo dhan iyo nimankii xigmadda lahaa oo dhan; markaasaa Fircoon u sheegay riyadiisii; laakiin ma jirin mid Fircoon u fasiri karaa.
english: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa Fircoon la hadlay kii madaxa u ahaa kuwa khamriga siin jiray isaga, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Maantaan xusuustay dembiyadaydii.
english: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.

kikuyu: Fircoonow, adigoo u cadhaysnaa addoommadaada, waxaad igu xabbistay guriga madaxa waardiyayaasha, oo waxaannu ahayn aniga iyo kii madaxa u ahaa kuwii wax dubi jiray;
english: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.

kikuyu: oo markaasaannu isku habeen riyoonnay, aniga iyo isagiiba; waxaannu ku riyoonnay midkayo kastaba sidii riyadiisii fasirkeedu ahaa.
english: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.

kikuyu: Oo halkaasna waxaa nala joogay nin dhallinyaro ah oo Cibraani ah, oo madaxa waardiyayaasha addoon u ahaa, markaasaannu isagii u sheegnay, oo isna wuu noo fasiray riyooyinkayagii, nin kastana sidii riyadiisu ahayd buu ugu fasiray.
english: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

kikuyu: Oo sidii uu noogu fasiray ayay noqotay. Aniga waxaa laygu soo celiyey meeshaydii, isagiina waa la deldelay.
english: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”

kikuyu: Dabadeedna Fircoon baa u cid diray oo u yeedhay Yuusuf. Markaasay dhaqso uga soo bixiyeen godxabsigii; kolkaasuu xiirtay, oo dharkiisii beddeshay, oo uu u soo galay Fircoon.
english: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu Yuusuf ku yidhi, Riyaan ku riyooday, mana jiro mid fasiri karaa; oo waxaan maqlay in markii aad riyo maqashid aad fasiri kartid.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”

kikuyu: Yuusufna Fircoon buu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Taasu xaggayga ma aha, laakiinse Ilaah wuxuu Fircoon siin doonaa jawaab nabadeed.
english: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon Yuusuf la hadlay, oo yidhi, Waxaan riyadaydii ku arkay anigoo webiga qarkiisa taagan;
english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

kikuyu: oo bal eeg, waxaa webigii ka soo baxay toddoba sac oo buurbuuran oo quruxsan oo waxay daaqeen cawskii dareemada ahaa;
english: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;

kikuyu: oo waxaa haddana ka soo daba baxay toddoba sac oo kale, oo taagdaran oo fool xun oo weyd ah. Weligay dhulka Masar oo dhan kuma aan arag kuwa sidooda u xun.
english: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.

kikuyu: Markaasaa sicihii weydda ahaa oo foosha xumaa waxay cuneen toddobadii sac oo hore.
english: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;

kikuyu: Oo markay cuneen lagama garan karin inay cuneen, laakiinse waxay u fool xumaayeen sidii markii hore. Markaasaan toosay.
english: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan kaloo riyadaydii ku arkay toddoba sabuul oo iltiran oo wanaagsan, oo ka soo baxay isku jirid;
english: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;

kikuyu: dabadeedna waxaa ka soo daba baxay toddoba sabuul oo engegan oo xunxun oo dabayshii bari qallajisay.
english: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa sabuulladii xunxumaa waxay liqeen toddobadii sabuul oo wanaagsanayd; markaasaan u sheegay saaxiriinta, laakiinse ma uu jirin mid ii sheegi karay.
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”

kikuyu: Oo Yuusuf wuxuu ku yidhi Fircoon, Riyadaadu waa mid, oo waxa Ilaah samaynayo ayuu kuu sheegay, Fircoonow.
english: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Toddobada sac oo wanwanaagsanu waa toddoba sannadood, toddobada sabuul oo wanwanaagsanuna waa toddoba sannadood; riyadu waa mid.
english: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.

kikuyu: Toddobada sac oo weyd ah oo foosha xun, oo ka soo daba baxay waa toddoba sannadood, oo haddana toddobada sabuul oo madhan, oo dabayshii bari qallajisay waxay noqon doonaan toddoba sannadood oo abaar ah.
english: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

kikuyu: Taasu waa wixii aan kugula hadlay, Fircoonow. Waxa Ilaah samaynayo ayuu ku tusay.
english: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa dalka Masar oo dhan imanaya toddoba sannadood oo barwaaqo ah,
english: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.

kikuyu: oo dabadoodna waxaa dhici doona toddoba sannadood oo abaar ah; oo barwaaqadii oo dhanna waa laga illoobi doonaa dalka Masar, markaasay abaartu dhulka dhammayn doontaa,
english: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

kikuyu: barwaaqadana dhulka laguma ogaan doono abaartaas ka dambaysa aawadeed, waayo, waxay noqon doontaa mid aad u xun.
english: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

kikuyu: Oo taas aawadeed riyadii labanlaab bay kuu noqotay, Fircoonow, maxaa yeelay, waxaas waxaa amray Ilaah, oo weliba Ilaah dhowaan buu samayn doonaa.
english: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

kikuyu: Haddaba Fircoonow, waxaad doontaa nin caqli iyo xigmad leh, oo u sarraysii dalka Masar oo dhan.
english: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Tan yeel oo waxaad doorataa niman dalka u sarreeya, oo waxa toddobada sannadood oo barwaaqada ah dhulka ka baxa inta shanaad ha ururiyeen.
english: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.

kikuyu: Oo cuntada oo dhan sannadahan wanaagsan oo imanaya ha ururiyeen, hadhuudhkana ha kugu hoos kaydiyeen, Fircoonow, oo intay cunto ahaan magaalooyinka u dhigaan, ha ilaaliyeen.
english: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

kikuyu: Cuntaduna kayd bay dalka u noqon doontaa toddobada sannadood oo abaarta ah oo ka dhici doonta dalka Masar, si aan dalku abaarta ugu baabbi'in.
english: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”

kikuyu: Waxaasuna Fircoon way la wanaagsanaayeen, isaga iyo addoommadiisiiba.
english: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu addoommadiisii ku yidhi, Miyaynu heli karaynaa mid la mid ah kan, oo ah nin Ruuxa Ilaah ku jiro?
english: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Fircoon wuxuu Yuusuf ku yidhi, Mar haddii Ilaah ku tusay waxyaalahan oo dhan, ma jiro mid sidaadoo kale caqli iyo xigmad u leh.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.

kikuyu: Adigu waxaad ka sarrayn doontaa gurigayga, dadkayga oo dhanna waxaa lagu xukumi doonaa si waafaqsan hadalkaaga, oo anigu carshiga oo keliya ayaan kaaga weynaan doonaa.
english: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu Yuusuf ku yidhi, Bal eeg, dalka Masar oo dhan ayaan kaa sarraysiiyey.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Fircoon gacantiisa ka bixiyey kaatunkiisii, oo Yuusuf gacanta u geliyey, oo wuxuu u xidhay dhar aad u wanaagsan, silsilad dahab ahna qoortuu u sudhay;
english: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu fuushiiyey gaadhifaraskii labaad oo uu lahaa, oo waxay hortiisa kaga qayliyeen, Sujuuda; oo wuxuu ka sarraysiiyey dalka Masar oo dhan.
english: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu Yuusuf ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay Fircoon, oo adiga la'aantaa ninna gacantiisa ama cagtiisa kor uma qaadi doono dalka Masar oo dhan.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu Yuusuf magiciisii u bixiyey Saafnad Facneh, oo wuxuu u guuriyey Aasenad oo ahayd ina Footiiferac, wadaadkii Oon. Yuusufna markaasuu dalkii Masar oo dhan u baxay oo wada maray.
english: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Yuusufna soddon sannadood buu jiray markuu hor istaagay Fircoon oo ahaa boqorkii Masar. Markaasaa Yuusuf Fircoon hortiisii ka tegey, oo wuxuu wada maray dalkii Masar oo dhan.
english: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Markaasaa toddobadii sannadood oo barwaaqada ahayd waxaa dhulkii ka soo baxay wax aad u badan.
english: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ururiyey cuntadii toddobadii sannadood baxday oo dalka Masar oo dhan tiil, oo cuntadii wuxuu ku kaydiyey magaalooyinka. Cuntadii beerihii ku wareegsanaa magaalo kastana isku meel buu ku kaydiyey.
english: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf hadhuudh aad u badan wuxuu u kaydiyey sida cammuudda badda, ilaa uu tirintii daayay, maxaa yeelay, waxay ahayd wax aan tiro lahayn.
english: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

kikuyu: Oo Yuusuf waxaa u dhashay laba wiil intii aan sannaddii abaarta ahayd iman, oo waxaa u dhashay Aasenad oo ahayd ina Footiiferac, wadaadkii Oon.
english: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf wuxuu curadkii magiciisii u bixiyey Manaseh; waayo, wuxuu yidhi, Ilaah waa i illowsiiyey dhibaatadaydii oo dhan, iyo gurigii aabbahay oo dhan.
english: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”

kikuyu: Kii labaadna magiciisii wuxuu u bixiyey Efrayim. Waayo, wuxuu yidhi, Ilaah waa igu badiyey dalkii aan ku dhibtooday.
english: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa toddobadii sannadood oo barwaaqada ahayd ay dalkii Masar ka dhammaadeen.
english: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa bilaabatay toddobadii sannadood oo abaarta ahayd, sidii Yuusuf yidhi. Dalalkii oo dhanna abaar baa ka dhacday; laakiinse dalka Masar oo dhan cuntaa jirtay.
english: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

kikuyu: Oo markii dalkii Masar oo dhammu wada abaarsaday ayaa dadkii Fircoon cunto ugu qayliyeen. Markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu ku yidhi Masriyiintii oo dhan, Yuusuf u taga, oo wuxuu idin yidhaahdo yeela.
english: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”

kikuyu: Oo abaartuna waxay ka dhacday dhulka dushiisa oo dhan. Markaasaa Yuusuf wada furay maqsinnadii oo dhan, oo wuxuu hadhuudhkii ka iibiyey Masriyiintii, abaartuna aad bay ugu xumayd dalka Masar.
english: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dalalkii oo dhammu waxay u soo safreen Masar, oo Yuusuf bay ugu yimaadeen inay hadhuudh ka iibsadaan; maxaa yeelay, abaartu aad bay ugu xumayd dhulka oo dhan.
english: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.

kikuyu: Haddaba Yacquub wuxuu arkay in hadhuudh laga helo Masar, markaasuu Yacquub wiilashiisii ku yidhi, War maxaa midkiinba midka kale u fiirinayaa?
english: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Bal ogaada, waxaan maqlay in hadhuudh laga helo Masar. Bal xaggaas u dhaadhaca, oo halkaas wax inooga soo iibiya, inaynu noolaanno oo aynaan dhimanin.
english: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf tobankiisii walaal waxay u tageen Masar inay hadhuudh ka soo iibsadaan.
english: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Benyaamiin oo ahaa Yuusuf walaalkiis Yacquub ma uu raacinin walaalihiis; waayo, wuxuu isyidhi, Waaba intaasoo belaayo ku dhacdaa.
english: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wiilashii Israa'iil waxay u yimaadeen inay wax iibsadaan, iyagoo la socda kuwii yimid, waayo, abaartu dalkii Kancaanna way ka dhacday.
english: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Yuusufna wuxuu ahaa taliyihii dalka, isaguna wuxuu ahaa kii wax ka iibin jiray dadka dalka oo dhan. Markaasay Yuusuf walaalihiis u yimaadeen isagii, oo intay u wada sujuudeen ayay wejiga dhulka wada saareen.
english: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.

kikuyu: Yuusufna walaalihiis wuu arkay, wuuna gartay, laakiin wuxuu isaga dhigay sidii nin qalaad, oo intuu si qallafsan ula hadlay ayuu wuxuu ku yidhi iyagii, War xaggee baad ka timaadeen? Oo iyana waxay yidhaahdeen, Waxaannu ka nimid dalka Kancaan si aannu cunto u iibsanno.
english: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”

kikuyu: Yuusufna wuu gartay walaalihiis laakiinse iyagu ma ay garan isagii.
english: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf xusuustay riyooyinkii iyaga ku saabsanaa oo uu ku riyooday, oo wuxuu ku yidhi iyagii, Basaasyaad tihiin, oo waxaad u timaadeen inaad aragtaan dhulka abaarnimadiisa.
english: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”

kikuyu: Iyana waxay ku yidhaahdeen isagii, Maya, sayidkayagiiyow, laakiinse annagoo addoommadaada ah waxaannu u nimid inaannu cunto iibsanno.
english: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

kikuyu: Kulligayo isku nin wiilashiis baannu nahay, oo waxaannu nahay niman daacad ah, oo annagoo addoommadaada ah basaasyo ma nihin.
english: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu ku yidhi iyagii, Maya, laakiinse waxaad u timaadeen inaad aragtaan dhulka abaarnimadiisa.
english: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”

kikuyu: Iyana waxay yidhaahdeen, Annagoo ah addoommadaada waxaannu nahay laba iyo toban walaalo ah, oo waxaannu nahay nin jooga dalka Kancaan wiilashiisii; oo bal eeg, kii noogu yaraa wuxuu maanta la joogaa aabbahayo, midna maba joogo.
english: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yuusuf iyagii ku yidhi, Taasu waa tii aan idinkula hadlay, anigoo leh, Basaasyaad tihiin.
english: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’

kikuyu: Haddaba tan baa laydinku tijaabin doonaa; nolosha Fircoon baan ku dhaartay inaydaan halkan ka tegi doonin, in walaalkiinnii yaraa halkan yimaado mooyaane.
english: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.

kikuyu: Mid idinka mid ah dira, oo ha keeno walaalkiin, idinkuna waad xidhnaan doontaan, in la tijaabiyo hadalkiinna, bal inay runi idinku jirto iyo in kale, haddii kalese hubaal nolosha Fircoon baan ku dhaartay inaad basaasyo tihiin.
english: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu kulligood muddo saddex maalmood ah wada xabbisay.
english: He put them all together into custody for three days.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa maalintii saddexaad Yuusuf iyagii ku yidhi, Tan yeela, oo waad noolaan doontaan, waayo, anigu Ilaah baan ka cabsadaa.
english: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.

kikuyu: Haddaad niman daacad ah tihiin, walaalihiinna midkood ha ku xidhnaado guriga xabsigiinna; laakiinse idinku taga, oo hadhuudh u geeya reerihiinna abaaraysan.
english: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.

kikuyu: Walaalkiinna idiinku wada yar ii keena; sidaasuu hadalkiinnu ku rumoobi doonaa, mana aad dhiman doontaan. Iyana sidii bay yeeleen.
english: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Runtii walaalkeen eed baan ka galnay, maxaa yeelay, waxaynu aragnay naftiisii dhibaatada ku jirtay, markuu ina baryay, mana aynu maqlin, sidaas daraaddeed ayay dhibaatadanu inoogu dhacday.
english: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ruubeen u jawaabay iyagii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Miyaanan idinla hadlin oo idinku odhan, Wiilka ha ku dembaabina, oo sow ima aydin maqli waayin? Haddaba bal eega, dhiiggiisii baa laydin weyddiistaye.
english: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”

kikuyu: Oo iyana ma ay ogayn in Yuusuf gartay iyaga; waayo, turjumaan baa kala dhex joogay.
english: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ka sii jeestay iyagii, wuuna ooyay; oo haddana intuu ku soo noqday ayuu la hadlay, oo wuxuu kala dhex baxay Simecoon, wuuna xidhay isagii iyagoo arkaya.
english: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf wuxuu amray in joonyadahoodii hadhuudh looga buuxiyo, iyo in nin walba lacagtiisii loogu celiyo joonyaddiisii iyo in sahay jidka loo siiyo, oo sidii baana loo yeelay.
english: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.

kikuyu: Markaasay hadhuudhkoodii dameerradoodii ku rarteen, wayna ka tageen halkaas.
english: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.

kikuyu: Meeshay ku hoydeen markii uu midkood joonyaddiisii ugu furay inuu dameerkiisii cunto siiyo ayuu arkay lacagtiisii oo ku jirta joonyaddiisii afkeeda.
english: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

kikuyu: Markaasuu walaalihiis ku yidhi, Lacagtaydii waa lay soo celiyey; oo waxay ku jirtaa joonyaddayda, markaasay qalbiga ka nexeen, oo ay isku jeesteen iyagoo gariiraya, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Waa maxay waxakan Ilaah inagu sameeyey?
english: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”

kikuyu: Markaasay aabbahood Yacquub ugu yimaadeen dalkii Kancaan, oo waxay isagii u sheegeen wixii ku dhacay oo dhan, iyagoo leh,
english: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,

kikuyu: Ninka sayidka u ah dalka ayaa si qallafsan noola hadlay, oo wuxuu noo qaatay inaannu dalka basaasayno.
english: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.

kikuyu: Oo waxaannu isagii ku nidhi, Annagu waxaannu nahay niman daacad ah; oo basaasyo ma aannu nihin.
english: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.

kikuyu: Waxaannu nahay laba iyo toban walaalo ah, oo ah wiilashii aabbahayo. Mid ma joogo, kii noogu yaraana maanta dalkii Kancaan ayuu aabbahayo la joogaa.
english: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa ninkii sayidka u ahaa dalka wuxuu nagu yidhi, Inaad niman daacad ah tihiin tanaan idinku garan doonaaye; walaalihiin mid igaga taga, oo hadhuudh u qaada reerihiinna abaaraysan, oo iska taga,
english: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.

kikuyu: oo ii keena walaalkiinnii idiinku wada yaraa, markaasaan garan doonaa inaydaan basaasyo ahayn, laakiinse inaad tihiin niman daacad ah. Markaasaan walaalkiin idin siin doonaa, dalkana waad ka baayacmushtari doontaan.
english: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in markay joonyadahoodii hadhuudhkii ka shubeen, nin walba xidhmadiisii lacagta ahayd ay ugu jirtay joonyaddiisii, oo markii iyaga iyo aabbahood ay arkeen xidhmooyinkoodii lacagta ahaa ayay baqeen.
english: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

kikuyu: Markaasaa aabbahood Yacquub wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Gablan baad iga dhigteen, bal eeg, Yuusuf ma joogo, oo Simecoon ma joogo, oo haddana waxaad kaxayn doontaan Benyaamiin; waxyaalahan oo dhammu waa iga gees.
english: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ruubeen aabbihiis la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddii aan isaga kuu keeni waayo, dil labadayda wiil. Aniga ii dhiib isaga, oo anna waan kuu soo celin doonaa.
english: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Wiilkaygu idinla dhaadhici maayo; waayo, walaalkiis waa dhintay, oo keligiis baa hadhay. Haddii jidka aad sii maraysaan belaayo kaga dhacdo isaga, de markaas cirradayda caloolxumaad qabriga la gelin doontaan.
english: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”

kikuyu: Abaartuna dalka aad bay ugu xumayd.
english: The famine was severe in the land.

kikuyu: Oo markii ay wada cuneen hadhuudhkii ay Masar ka keeneen ayaa aabbahood ku yidhi, Bal taga haddana, oo cunto yar inoo soo iibiya.
english: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah la hadlay isagii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ninkii aad buu noogu digay, oo wuxuu nagu yidhi, Wejigayga ma aad arki doontaan in walaalkiin idinla jiro mooyaane.
english: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’

kikuyu: Haddaad walaalkayo na raacisid, waannu dhaadhacaynaa oo cuntaannu kuu soo iibinaynaa,
english: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;

kikuyu: laakiinse haddaadan isaga dirin, annagu dhaadhici mayno; waayo, ninkii wuxuu nagu yidhi, Wejigayga ma aad arki doontaan in walaalkiin idinla jiro mooyaane.
english: but if you don’t send him, we won’t go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Israa'iil wuxuu yidhi, Maxaad sida xun iigula macaamilooteen, oo aad ninka ugu sheegteen inaad walaal kale leedihiin?
english: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”

kikuyu: Markaasay yidhaahdeen, Ninku wuu na haybsaday annaga iyo xigaalkayaga, oo wuxuuna yidhi, Aabbihiin weli ma nool yahay? Walaal kale ma leedihiin? Oo annana waxaannu ugu jawaabnay wixii uu na weyddiiyey; waayo, miyaannu sinaba ku garan karnay inuu nagu odhan doono, Walaalkiin keena?
english: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah wuxuu ku yidhi aabbihiis Israa'iil, Wiilka i raaci, oo markaas waannu kici oo waannu tegi doonnaa, inaynu noolaanno, oo aynaan dhiman, annaga, iyo adiga, iyo dhallaankayaguba.
english: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.

kikuyu: Anigaa dammiin u noqon doona oo anaad i weyddiisan doontaa isaga. Haddii aan kuu keeni waayo isaga oo aan hortaada soo joojin waayo, aniga eeddu ha i saarnaato weligay,
english: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;

kikuyu: waayo, haddaannan raagin, hubaal hadda mar labaad waannu soo noqon lahayn.
english: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa aabbahood Israa'iil wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Hadday haatan saas tahay, bal tan yeela, haddaba midhaha ugu fiican oo dalka weelashiinna ku qaada, oo bal ninkii hadiyad ugu geeya, wuxoogaa beeyo ah, iyo wuxoogaa malab ah, iyo xawaash iyo malmal, iyo lows iyo yicib;
english: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;

kikuyu: gacantiinnana lacag labanlaab ah ku qaada, oo lacagtii joonyadihiinna afkooda lagu soo celiyeyna haddana gacantiinna ku qaada, waayo, mindhaa waa la soo qaldamay.
english: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.

kikuyu: Walaalkiinna kaxeeya, oo kaca, oo bal haddana ninkii u taga,
english: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.

kikuyu: oo Ilaaha Qaadirka ahu naxariis ha idinka siiyo ninka hortiisa, inuu idiin sii daayo walaalkiinnii kale iyo Benyaamiin. Oo haddaan carruurtayda ka gablamo, anaa gablamay.
english: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa nimankii waxay qaadeen hadiyaddii, lacag labanlaab ahna gacantooday ku qaadeen, Benyaamiinna way kaxeeyeen, wayna kaceen oo Masar tageen, oo waxay hor istaageen Yuusuf.
english: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

kikuyu: Oo markii Yuusuf arkay Benyaamiin oo iyaga la jira ayuu wakiilkii gurigiisa ku yidhi, Nimanka guriga soo geli, dabadeedna neef qal oo diyaari, waayo, duhurka nimanku anigay ila qadayn doonaan.
english: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa ninkii yeelay wixii Yuusuf ku amray; oo ninkii wuxuu nimankii soo geliyey gurigii Yuusuf.
english: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.

kikuyu: Nimankiina waa cabcabsadeen, maxaa yeelay, waxaa la soo geliyey gurigii Yuusuf; oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Lacagtii markii hore lagu soo celiyey joonyadaheenna weeye waxa laynoo soo xeraystay; wuxuu doonayaa inuu wax inoo qabsado, oo uu ina dhaco, oo uu ina addoonsado, dameerradeennana qaato.
english: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay u soo dhowaadeen wakiilkii guriga Yuusuf, oo waxay isagii kula hadleen albaabkii guriga,
english: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

kikuyu: waxayna ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidkayagiiyow, markii hore waxaannu u soo dhaadhacnay inaannu cunto iibsanno,
english: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

kikuyu: oo markii aannu meel aannu ku hoyanno gaadhnay ayaannu furnay joonyadahayagii, oo bal eeg, nin walba lacagtiisii waxay ugu jirtay joonyaddiisa afkeeda, waxay ahayd lacagtayadii oo miisaankeedii dhan yahay; oo haddana gacantayadaannu ku soo celinnay.
english: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.

kikuyu: Oo lacag kale oo aannu cunto ku iibsannona waan la soo dhaadhacnay. Annagu garan mayno kii lacagtayadii ku riday joonyadahayagii.
english: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”

kikuyu: Isna wuxuu yidhi, Nabad ha idiin ahaato, ee ha cabsanina. Ilaahiinna ah Ilaaha aabbihiin ayaa maal idiinku riday joonyadihiinnii. Anigu waan helay lacagtiinnii. Markaasuu Simecoon dibadda ugu soo bixiyey iyagii.
english: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.

kikuyu: Oo ninkii baa nimankii soo geliyey gurigii Yuusuf, oo biyo siiyey, kolkaasay cagamaydheen. Dameerradoodiina cuntuu siiyey.
english: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.

kikuyu: Markaasay diyaariyeen hadiyaddii intuusan Yuusuf duhurkii iman; waayo, waxay maqleen inay halkaas wax ka cuni doonaan.
english: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.

kikuyu: Oo markii Yuusuf gurigii yimid ayay gurigii ugu keeneen hadiyaddii gacantooda ku jirtay, markaasay u wada sujuudeen oo wejiga dhulka saareen.
english: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.

kikuyu: Isna markaasuu nabdaadiyey iyagii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ninkii duqa ahaa oo aad sheegteen oo aabbihiin ahaa ma ladan yahay? Weli miyuu nool yahay?
english: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”

kikuyu: Markaasay yidhaahdeen, Addoonkaagii aabbahayo ahaa waa ladan yahay, welina wuu nool yahay. Kolkaasay madaxa foororiyeen, oo ay u sujuudeen.
english: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.

kikuyu: Markaasuu intuu indhihiisii kor u taagay wuxuu arkay Benyaamiin oo ahaa walaalkiisii hooyo, oo wuxuu yidhi, Kanu ma walaalkiinnii idiinku yaraa oo aad ii sheegteen baa? Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Wiilkaygiiyow, Ilaah ha kuu roonaado.
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yuusuf dhaqsaday, oo goobtay meel uu ku ooyo, waayo, walaalkiis buu u beernuglaaday oo wuxuu galay qowladdiisii, oo halkaasuu ku ooyay.
english: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu intuu fooldhaqday soo baxay; oo intuu adkaystay ayuu wuxuu yidhi, Cunto noo soo dhiga.
english: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”

kikuyu: Markaasay isagii gooni ahaantiis ugu dhigeen, iyagiina gooni ahaantood, Masriyiintii isaga la cuntayna gooni ahaantood; maxaa yeelay, Masriyiintu lama ay cuni karin Cibraaniyada, waayo, taasu Masriyiinta karaahiyo bay u ahayd.
english: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Oo waxay hor fadhiisteen isagii, curadka sidii curadnimadiisii ahayd buu u fadhiistay, kii ugu yaraana yaraannimadiisii; markaasaa nimankii midba midka kale eegay oo ay wada yaabeen.
english: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.

kikuyu: Markaasaa hortiisa waxaa iyagii looga qaaday dhawr qaybood oo cunto ah, laakiinse intii Benyaamiin shan jeer bay ka weynayd kuwa kale intoodii. Kolkaasay wax cabbeen oo ay la farxeen isagii.
english: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu amray wakiilkii gurigiisa, oo ku yidhi, Nimanka joonyadahooda cunto uga buuxi, in alla intay qaadi karaan, nin walba lacagtiisana joonyaddiisa afkeeda ugu rid.
english: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

kikuyu: Kan ugu yar joonyaddiisa afkeedana waxaad ku riddaa koobkayga lacagta ah iyo lacagtiisii uu hadhuudhka ku doonayay. Markaasuu yeelay hadalkii Yuusuf kula hadlay.
english: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

kikuyu: Oo markii waagii beryay ayaa nimankii la diray, iyagii iyo dameerradoodiiba.
english: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

kikuyu: Oo markay magaaladii dibadda uga baxeen, oo ayan weli fogaan, ayaa Yuusuf ku yidhi wakiilkiisii, Kac oo ka daba tag nimankii, oo markaad gaadhid, waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Maxaad wanaag xumaan noogu abaalguddeen?
english: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

kikuyu: Miyuusan kanu ahayn koobka sayidkaygu wax ku cabbo, oo uu ku faaliyo? Wax xun baad samayseen markaad saas yeesheen.
english: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu gaadhay, oo uu hadalkan kula hadlay.
english: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay isagii ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidkaygiiyow, hadalka caynkan ah maxaad ugu hadlaysaa? Yaanay noqon in annagoo ah addoommadaada aannu wax caynkaas ah samayno.
english: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!

kikuyu: Bal eeg, lacagtii aannu ka dhex helnay joonyadahayaga afafkooda ayaannu kaaga soo celinnay dalkii Kancaan; de haddaba sidee baannu guriga sayidkaaga uga xadi karnaa lacag ama dahab?
english: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?

kikuyu: Ku alla kii addoommadaada ka mid ah oo laga helo, kaasu ha dhinto, annaguna addoommo baannu kuu noqon doonnaa, sayidkaygiiyow.
english: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Waa yahay, oo haatan sidaad tidhaahdeen ha noqoto. Kii laga helo addoon buu ii noqon doonaa, idinkuna waad eedla'aan doontaan.
english: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

kikuyu: Markaasay degdegeen, oo nin waluba joonyaddiisii buu dhulka dhigay, dabadeedna nin waluba joonyaddiisii buu furay.
english: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu baadhay, oo wuxuu ka bilaabay kii ugu weynaa, oo wuxuu ku dhammeeyey kii ugu yaraa; oo koobkiina waxaa laga helay joonyaddii Benyaamiin.
english: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay dharkoodii jeexjeexeen, oo nin waluba dameerkiisii buu rartay, oo magaaladii bay ku noqdeen.
english: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah iyo walaalihiis waxay yimaadeen gurigii Yuusuf; oo isna weli halkaasuu joogay. Kolkaasay hortiisa dhulka isku tuureen.
english: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

kikuyu: Oo Yuusufna wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Waxan aad samayseen waa maxay? Miyaydnaan ogayn ninkii anoo kale ahu inuu faalin karo?
english: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah ku yidhi, Maxaannu kuugu jawaabnaa, sayidkaygiiyow? Oo maxaannu ku hadalnaa? Ama sidee baannu ku eed baxnaa? Ilaah waa soo saaray dembigayagii annagoo ah addoommadaada; bal eeg, sayidkaygiiyow, waxaannu nahay addoommadaada, annaga iyo kii gacantiisa koobka laga helayba.
english: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Yaanay noqon inaan saas yeelo. Ninkii gacantiisa koobka laga helay ayaa addoon ii noqon doona; laakiinse idinku kaca oo nabdoonaan aabbihiin ugu taga.
english: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yahuudah u soo dhowaaday oo ku yidhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, anigoo addoonkaaga ah waxaan kaa baryayaa inaan hadal yar kugula hadlo, sayidkaygiiyow, oo ha ii cadhoon anigoo ah addoonkaaga; waayo, waxaad la mid tahay sida Fircoon oo kale.
english: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Sayidkaygiiyow, annagoo ah addoommadaada, ayaad wax na weyddiisay oo nagu tidhi, Aabbe ama walaal ma leedihiin?
english: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’

kikuyu: Oo annaguna waxaannu kugu nidhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, waxaannu leennahay aabbe duq ah, iyo wiil yar oo uu dhalay markuu gaboobay, oo walaalkiisna waa dhintay, oo keligiis baa ka hadhay bahdoodii, aabbihiisna waa jecel yahay isaga.
english: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

kikuyu: Oo adigu waxaad nagu tidhi, annagoo ah addoommadaada, Bal ii keena isaga, aan indhahayga saaree.
english: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’

kikuyu: Oo annaguna waxaannu kugu nidhi, sayidkaygiiyow, Yarku aabbihiis kama tegi karo; waayo, hadduu ka tago aabbihiis, de markaas aabbihiis waa dhiman lahaa.
english: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’

kikuyu: Oo adna waxaad nagu tidhi, annagoo ah addoommadaada, Haddii uusan walaalkiinnii idiinku yaraa idin soo raacin, wejigayga mar dambe ma aad arki doontaan.
english: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’

kikuyu: Oo markii aannu u tagnay aabbahay oo addoonkaaga ah, ayaannu isaga u sheegnay hadalladaadii, sayidkaygiiyow.
english: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

kikuyu: Oo aabbahayo wuxuu nagu yidhi, Orda haddana oo wuxoogaa yar oo cunto ah inoo soo iibiya.
english: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’

kikuyu: Oo waxaannu ku nidhi, Ma tegi karno. Haddiise walaalkayaga noogu yaru na raaco, markaasaannu dhaadhici doonnaa; waayo, ma aannu arki karno ninkii wejigiisa, haddii uusan walaalkayaga noogu yaru nala jirin.
english: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa addoonkaagii aabbahay ahaa wuxuu nagu yidhi, Waad og tihiin in naagtaydu ii dhashay laba wiil;
english: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

kikuyu: oo uu midkood iga baxay, oo waxaan idhi, Hubaal cadcad baa loo kala jeexjeexay, tan iyo waagaasna ma aanan arkin isagii.
english: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.

kikuyu: Oo haddaad kanna iga kaxaysataan, oo belaayo ku dhacdo isaga, de markaas cirradayda caloolxumaad qabriga la gelin doontaan.
english: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed markii aan u tago aabbahay oo addoonkaagii ah, haddii uusan wiilku nala jirin, de naftiisu waxay ku xidhan tahay nafta wiilka,
english: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

kikuyu: oo wuu dhiman doonaa markuu arko inuusan yarkii nala jirin; oo annagoo ah addoommadaada ayaannu aabbahayaga addoonkaaga ah cirradiisa caloolxumo qabriga la gelin doonnaa.
english: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigoo addoonkaaga ah ayaa aabbahay dammiin uga noqday wiilka, oo waxaan ku idhi, Haddaan kuu keeni waayo, xaggaaga eeddu ha iga saarnaato weligay, Aabbahayow.
english: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed, waan ku baryayaaye, aniga oo ah addoonkaagii, aan wiilka meeshiisii kuu joogo oo aan addoon kuu noqdo, sayidkaygiiyow; wiilkuna walaalihiis ha iska raaco.
english: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.

kikuyu: Waayo, sidee baan aabbahay ugu tegi doonaa iyadoo aan yarku ila jirin? Maba tegi karo waaba intaasoo aan arkaa hoogga aabbahay ku dhici doona.
english: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf ku hor adkaysan kari waayay kuwii isaga la taagnaa oo dhan; oo wuxuu ku qayliyey, Nin walba dibadda iiga bixiya. Oo ninnaba lama taagnayn isaga markii Yuusuf walaalihiis isu sheegay.
english: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

kikuyu: Markaasuu intuu codkiisii kor u qaaday ooyay; oo Masriyiintiina way maqleen, dadkii guriga Fircoonna way maqleen.
english: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yuusuf wuxuu walaalihiis ku yidhi, Yuusuf baan ahay, ee aabbahay weli ma nool yahay? Walaalihiisna way u jawaabi kari waayeen; waayo, aad bay ugu argaggexeen hortiisa.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf wuxuu walaalihiis ku yidhi, Bal ii soo dhowaada, waan idin baryayaaye. Kolkaasay u soo dhowaadeen. Markaasuu yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay walaalkiin Yuusuf, kii aad ka iibiseen kuwii Masar tegayay.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. He said, “I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

kikuyu: Oo haatan ha caloolxumaanina, naftiinnana ha u cadhoonina iibiskii aad halkan iga iibiseen aawadiis; waayo, Ilaah wuxuu hortiin ii soo diray in nafo la badbaadiyo.
english: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

kikuyu: Waayo, labadan sannadood baa dhulku abaar ahaa, oo weli waxaa hadhay shan sannadood, oo aan beer la fali doonin, waxna la goosan doonin.
english: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah wuxuu hortiin ii soo diray inuu dadkiinna qaar dhulka idiinku reebo, oo uu idiin badbaadiyo kuwo fara badan oo baxsada.
english: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant on the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed idinka ma ahayn kii halkan ii soo diray, laakiinse wuxuu ahaa Ilaah; oo isagu Fircoon buu aabbe iiga dhigay, iyo sayidkii dadka gurigiisa oo dhan, iyo taliyihii dalka Masar oo dhan.
english: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Dhaqsada, oo aabbahay u kaca, oo waxaad isaga ku tidhaahdaan, Wiilkaagii Yuusuf wuxuu kugu soo yidhi, Ilaah wuxuu iga dhigay sayidkii Masar oo dhan, ee soo dhaadhac oo ii kaalay, hana raagin;
english: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.

kikuyu: oo waxaad degi doontaa dhulka la yidhaahdo Goshen, oo waad ii soo dhowaan doontaa, adiga iyo carruurtaada, iyo carruurtaada carruurtooda, iyo adhigaaga iyo lo'daada, iyo waxa aad haysatid oo dhanba;
english: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

kikuyu: oo halkaasaan kugu quudin doonaa; waayo, weli waxaa hadhay shan sannadood oo abaar ah, waaba intaasoo aad gaajootaan, adiga iyo reerkaaga, iyo waxa aad haysatid oo dhammuba.
english: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’

kikuyu: Oo bal eega, indhihiinnu waa arkaan, iyo indhaha walaalkay Benyaamiinba, inuu afkaygii yahay kan idinla hadlaya.
english: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad aabbahay u sheegtaan ammaantayda aan Masar ku leeyahay oo dhan, iyo wixii aad aragteen oo dhan; oo dhaqsada oo aabbahay halkan keena.
english: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu walaalkiis Benyaamiin qoortiisa dhab yidhi, wuuna ku dul ooyay, Benyaamiinna qoortiisuu ku ooyay.
english: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wada dhunkaday walaalihiis oo dhan, wuuna ku dul ooyay; dabadeedna walaalihiis baa la hadlay isagii.
english: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa warkii laga maqlay gurigii Fircoon, oo waxaa la yidhi, Yuusuf walaalihiis baa yimid. Taasna aad bay uga farxisay Fircoon iyo addoommadiisiiba.
english: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu Yuusuf ku yidhi, Walaalahaa waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Idinku sidan yeela, gaadiidkiinna rarta, oo taga oo dalkii Kancaan u kaca;
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: oo waxaad soo kaxaysataan aabbihiin iyo reerihiinna oo dhan, oo aniga ii kaalaya; oo anna waxaan idin siin doonaa waxyaalaha wanwanaagsan ee dalka Masar, oo idinku waxaad cuni doontaan barwaaqada dalka.
english: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’

kikuyu: Haddaba waa lagu amray, Sidan yeela. Gaadhifardood dalka Masar uga kaxaysta dhallaankiinna, iyo dumarkiinna; oo aabbihiin keena, oo kaalaya.
english: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

kikuyu: Oo alaabtiinnana ha ka fikirina, waayo, waxyaalaha wanwanaagsan ee dalka Masar oo dhan idinkaa iska leh.
english: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wiilashii Israa'iil saas yeeleen, Yuusufna wuxuu iyagii siiyey gaadhifardood, sidii Fircoon amarkiisu ahaa, sahayna jidkuu u siiyey.
english: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

kikuyu: Dhammaantoodna wuxuu nin kasta siiyey dhar iskujoog ah; laakiinse Benyaamiin wuxuu siiyey saddex boqol oo xabbadood oo lacag ah, iyo shan iskujoog.
english: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

kikuyu: Oo aabbihiisna sidan buu wax ugu diray, toban dameer oo ay ku raran yihiin waxyaalihii wanwanaagsanaa ee Masar, iyo toban dameerood oo hadhuudh iyo cunto ku raran yihiin, iyo sahaydii aabbihiis jidka ku soo mari lahaa.
english: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

kikuyu: Markaasuu walaalihiis diray, oo iyana way tageen; oo wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Idinku jidka ha isugu cadhoonina.
english: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”

kikuyu: Markaasay Masar ka baxeen, oo ay yimaadeen dalkii Kancaan, oo waxay u yimaadeen aabbahood Yacquub.
english: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

kikuyu: Markaasay u sheegeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Yuusuf weli waa nool yahay, oo wuxuu u taliyaa dalka Masar oo dhan. Markaasuu taag darnaaday, waayo, wuu rumaysan waayay iyagii.
english: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: Markaasay u sheegeen hadalkii Yuusuf kula hadlay oo dhan, oo markuu arkay gaadhifardoodkii Yuusuf u soo diray in isaga lagu qaado ayaa aabbahood Yacquub ruuxiisii cusboonaaday.
english: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Israa'iil wuxuu yidhi, Igu filan mar haddii wiilkaygii Yuusuf weli nool yahay; haddaba waan tegi doonaa, oo waan arki doonaa isaga intaanan dhiman.
english: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Israa'iil la guuray wixii uu haystay oo dhan, oo wuxuu yimid Bi'ir Shebac, oo halkaasuu Ilaaha aabbihiis Isxaaq allabaryo ugu bixiyey.
english: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ilaah riyooyinka habeenka kula hadlay Israa'iil oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Yacquubow, Yacquubow. Isna wuxuu yidhi, Waa i kan.
english: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay Ilaaha ah Ilaaha aabbahaa. Ha ka baqin inaad Masar ku dhaadhacdo, waayo, anigu halkaas baan kaaga dhigi doonaa quruun weyn.
english: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

kikuyu: Anigu Masar baan kuu raaci doonaa, oo hubaal haddana waan kaa soo bixin doonaa; Yuusufna gacantiisuu saari doonaa indhahaaga.
english: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub ka tegey Bi'ir Shebac, wiilashii Israa'iilna waxay aabbahood Yacquub, iyo dhallaankoodii, iyo dumarkoodiiba ku qaadeen gaadhifardoodkii Fircoon u soo diray in isaga lagu soo qaado.
english: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

kikuyu: Oo waxay kaxaysteen xoolahoodii, iyo alaabtoodii ay ka heleen dalkii Kancaan, oo waxayna yimaadeen Masar, Yacquub iyo farcankiisii la socday oo dhammuba;
english: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

kikuyu: kuwaas oo ahaa wiilashiisii iyo wiilashiisii wiilashoodii isaga la socday, iyo gabdhihiisii iyo wiilashiisii gabdhahoodii. Farcankiisii oo dhanna wuxuu keenay Masar.
english: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa magacyadii reer binu Israa'iil oo Masar yimid, Yacquub iyo wiilashiisii: Ruubeen wuxuu ahaa curadkii Yacquub.
english: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Ruubeenna waxay ahaayeen Xanoog, iyo Falluu, iyo Xesroon, iyo Karmii.
english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Simecoonna waxay ahaayeen Yemuu'eel, iyo Yaamiin, iyo Ohad, iyo Yaakiin, iyo Sohar, iyo Shaa'uul oo ay naag reer Kancaan ihi dhashay.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Laawina waxay ahaayeen Gershoon, iyo Qohaad, iyo Meraarii.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yahuudahna waxay ahaayeen Ceer, iyo Oonaan, iyo Sheelaah, iyo Feres, iyo Serax; laakiinse Ceer iyo Oonaan waxay ku dhinteen dalkii Kancaan. Wiilashii Feresna waxay ahaayeen Xesroon iyo Xaamuul.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Isaakaarna waxay ahaayeen Toolac iyo Fuwaah, iyo Yoob, iyo Shimroon.
english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Sebulunna waxay ahaayeen Sered, iyo Eeloon, iyo Yaxle'eel.
english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa wiilashii Lee'ah oo ay Yacquub ugu dhashay Fadan Araam, iyo weliba gabadhiisii Diinah ahayd. Yacquub wiilashiisa iyo gabdhihiisa oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo soddon.
english: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Gaadna waxay ahaayeen Sifiyoon, iyo Xaggii, iyo Shuunii, iyo Esboon, iyo Ceerii, iyo Aroodii, iyo Areelii.
english: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Aasheerna waxay ahaayeen Yimnaah, iyo Yishwaah, iyo Yishwii, iyo Beriicaah, iyo walaashood Serax; wiilashii Beriicaahna waxay ahaayeen Xeber iyo Malkii'eel.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa wiilashii Silfah, tii uu Laabaan siiyey gabadhiisii Lee'ah, oo intaasay Yacquub u dhashay, waxayna ahaayeen lix iyo toban.
english: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

kikuyu: Naagtii Yacquub oo Raaxeel ahayd wiilasheedii waxay ahaayeen Yuusuf iyo Benyaamiin.
english: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

kikuyu: Yuusufna dalka Masar waxaa ugu dhashay Manaseh iyo Efrayim, oo waxaa u dhashay Aasenad ina Footiiferac, oo wadaadkii Oon ahaa.
english: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Benyaamiinna waxay ahaayeen Belac, iyo Beker, iyo Ashbeel, iyo Geeraa, iyo Nacamaan, iyo Eexii, iyo Rosh, iyo Mufiim, iyo Xufiim, iyo Ared.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa wiilashii Raaxeel u dhashay Yacquub, kulligoodna waxay ahaayeen afar iyo toban.
english: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Daanna waxay ahaayeen Xushiim.
english: The son of Dan: Hushim.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Naftaalina waxay ahaayeen Yaxse'eel, iyo Guunii, iyo Yeser, iyo Shilleem.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa wiilashii Bilhah, tii uu Laabaan siiyey gabadhiisii Raaxeel, oo intaasay Yacquub u dhashay; kulligoodna waxay ahaayeen toddoba.
english: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

kikuyu: Intii Yacquub Masar la timid, oo xanjaadkiisa ka soo baxday, haddaan lagu darin wiilashii Yacquub naagahooda, kulligood waxay ahaayeen lix iyo lixdan.
english: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yuusuf Masar ugu dhashayna waxay ahaayeen laba. Reerkii Yacquub dadkiisii Masar yimid oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen toddobaatan.
english: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu iska hor mariyey Yahuudah inuu Yuusuf u tago, si uu u tuso jidka loo maro Goshen; oo waxay yimaadeen dalkii Goshen.
english: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

kikuyu: Yuusufna wuxuu diyaarsaday gaadhifaraskiisii, oo aabbihiis Israa'iil ayuu kaga hor tegey Goshen; oo markuu isagii arkay ayuu qoortiisii dhab yidhi, qoortiisana wuxuu ku dul ooyay wakhti dheer.
english: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

kikuyu: Israa'iilna wuxuu Yuusuf ku yidhi, Haddaba aan iska dhinto, mar haddaan arkay wejigaaga, oo aad weli nooshahay.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

kikuyu: Yuusufna wuxuu walaalihiis iyo reerkii aabbihiis ku yidhi, Waan tegi, oo Fircoon baan u sheegi, oo waxaan ku odhan, Walaalahay iyo reerkii aabbahay oo joogi jiray dalka Kancaan ayaa ii yimid.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

kikuyu: Nimankaasuna waa adhijirro, waayo, waxay ahaan jireen lo'ley; waxayna la yimaadeen adhigoodii, iyo lo'doodii, iyo waxay haysteen oo dhan.
english: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

kikuyu: Markii Fircoon idiin yeedho, oo idinku yidhaahdo, Shuqulkiinnu waa maxay?
english: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

kikuyu: waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Annagoo addoommadaada ah waxaannu tan iyo yaraantayadii ahaan jirnay lo'ley, annaga iyo awowayaashayoba; si aad u degtaan dalka Goshen; waayo, adhijir waluba waa u karaahiyo Masriyiinta.
english: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf gudaha galay oo uu Fircoon u warramay, wuxuuna ku yidhi, Aabbahay iyo walaalahay, iyo adhigoodii, iyo lo'doodii, iyo waxay haystaan oo dhammu way ka yimaadeen dalkii Kancaan, oo bal eeg, haatan waxay joogaan dalka Goshen.
english: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”

kikuyu: Oo walaalihiisna wuxuu ka kaxeeyey shan nin, oo wuxuu hor taagay Fircoon.
english: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu Yuusuf walaalihiis ku yidhi, Shuqulkiinnu waa maxay? Markaasay waxay Fircoon ku yidhaahdeen, Annagoo addoommadaada ah waxaannu nahay adhijirro, annaga iyo awowayaashayoba.
english: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay Fircoon ku yidhaahdeen, Inaannu qariib ahaan dhulka u joogno ayaannu u nimid, waayo, adhiga addoommadaadu daaq ma haysto, maxaa yeelay, abaartu aad bay ugu xun tahay dalkii Kancaan; haddaba waxaannu kaa baryaynaa inaannu annagoo addoommadaada ah degno dalka Goshen.
english: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Fircoon la hadlay Yuusuf, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Aabbahaa iyo walaalahaa aday kuu yimaadeen.
english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.

kikuyu: Dalka Masarna wuu ku hor yaal; haddaba dalka meesha ugu wanaagsan aabbahaa iyo walaalahaa deji, oo dalka Goshen ha degeen. Oo haddaad ku garanaysid rag karti leh, de ka dhig kuwo xoolahayga u taliya.
english: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf aabbihiis Yacquub gudaha soo geliyey, oo wuxuu soo hor taagay Fircoon; Yacquubna Fircoon wuu u duceeyey.
english: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Fircoonna wuxuu Yacquub ku yidhi, Immisa jir baad tahay?
english: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub wuxuu Fircoon ku yidhi, Sannadihii aan qariibka ahaa waa boqol iyo soddon; cimrigaygu waa yaraa, wuuna xumaa, mana gaadhin cimrigii awowayaashay qariibka ahaayeen.
english: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”

kikuyu: Yacquubna Fircoon wuu u duceeyey, markaasuu Fircoon hortiisa ka tegey.
english: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yuusuf aabbihiis iyo walaalihiis dejiyey dalkii Masar oo uu ka siiyey meel hanti ah, taasoo ah meeshii dalka ugu wanaagsanayd oo ku tiil dalka la yidhaahdo Racmeses, sidii Fircoon ku amray.
english: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

kikuyu: Yuusufna aabbihiis iyo walaalihiis, iyo reerkii aabbihiis oo dhan, sidii ay carruurtoodii tiradoodii ahayd, ayuu u quudiyey.
english: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.

kikuyu: Dalkii oo dhanna cunto ma jirin; waayo, abaartu aad bay u xumayd, sidaas daraaddeed dalkii Masar iyo dalkii Kancaan abaartay la taag darnaadeen.
english: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

kikuyu: Yuusufna wuxuu ururiyey lacagtii dalka Masar tiil oo dhan, iyo tii dalka Kancaan tiil oo dhan, waayo, hadhuudh bay kaga iibsadeen; Yuusufna lacagtii wuxuu keenay gurigii Fircoon.
english: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

kikuyu: Oo markii lacagtii ka wada dhammaatay dalkii Masar iyo dalkii Kancaanba ayay Masriyiintii oo dhammu u yimaadeen Yuusuf, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Cunto na sii, waayo, maxaannu hortaada ugu dhimanaynaa? Maxaa yeelay, lacagtayadii way naga dhammaatay.
english: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddii lacagtii idinka dhammaatay, xoolihiinna keena, oo anna xoolihiinna ayaan cunto idinka siin doonaa.
english: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”

kikuyu: Markaasay xoolahoodii Yuusuf u keeneen, Yuusufna wuxuu iyagii cunto ugu beddelay fardihii, iyo adhigii, iyo lo'dii iyo dameerradii; oo sannaddaas ayuu quudiyey oo xoolahoodii oo dhan cunto ugu beddelay.
english: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.
