english: Then he cried to the LORD. The LORD showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaad aad u dhegaysatid Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah codkiisa, oo aad samaysid wixii ku hagaagsan indhihiisa hortooda, oo aad dhegta u dhigtid amarradiisa, oo aad dhawrtid qaynuunnadiisii oo dhan, de markaas anigu kugu ridi maayo cudurradii aan Masriyiinta ku riday midnaba; waayo, anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga ku bogsiiya.
english: He said, “If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am the LORD who heals you.”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay yimaadeen meel la yidhaahdo Eelim, oo meeshaas waxaa ku yiil laba iyo toban ilood oo biyo ah, iyo toddobaatan geed oo timir ah, oo halkaasay degeen biyaha agtooda.
english: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

kikuyu: Markaasay ka ambabbexeen Eelim, oo shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay yimaadeen cidlada Siin la yidhaahdo, taasoo u dhaxaysa Eelim iyo Siinay, waxayna ahayd bishii labaad, maalinteedii shan iyo tobnaad, taasoo ka dambaysay baxniintii ay Masar ka soo bexeen.
english: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Markaasaa shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu cidladii Muuse iyo Haaruun ugu gunuuseen.
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna waxay iyagii ku yidhaahdeen, Waxaa noo wanaagsanaan lahayd inaannu gacanta Rabbiga ku dhimanno, annagoo dalkii Masar joogna, intii aannu ag fadhinnay dheryaha hilibka ah, oo aannu kibis ka dhergaynay, waayo, waxaad cidladan noogu soo bixiseen inaad ururkan oo dhan gaajo ku dishaan.
english: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Bal eeg, waxaan samada idiinka soo dayn doonaa kibis, oo dadku waa inay dibadda u baxaan oo maalin walba soo urursadaan in maalin ku filan, si aan u tijaabiyo iyaga, bal inay sharcigayga ku socdaan iyo in kale.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta lixaad waa inay diyaarsadaan wixii ay soo gurteen, kolkaasay noqon doontaa intii ay maalin walba guran jireen in labanlaabkeed ah.
english: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse iyo Haaruun waxay reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan ku yidhaahdeen, Makhribka baad ogaan doontaan inuu Rabbigu idinka soo bixiyey dalkii Masar,
english: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: oo subaxdana waxaad arki doontaan ammaantii Rabbiga, waayo, wuu maqlayaa gunuuskiinna aad Rabbiga u gunuusaysaan. Oo annagu maxaannu nahay oo aad noogu gunuusaysaan?
english: In the morning, you shall see the LORD’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu yidhi; Rabbigu makhribka wuxuu idin siin doonaa hilib aad cuntaan, subaxdana wuxuu idin siin doonaa kibis aad ka dheregtaan; maxaa yeelay, Rabbigu wuxuu maqlayaa gunuuskiinna aad isaga u gunuusaysaan. Bal maxaannu annagu nahay? Annaga noo gunuusi maysaane, ee waxaad u gunuusaysaan Rabbiga.
english: Moses said, “Now the LORD will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu Haaruun ku yidhi, Shirka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Rabbiga hortiisa ku soo dhowaada; waayo, wuu maqlay gunuuskiinnii.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to the LORD, for he has heard your murmurings.’”

kikuyu: Intii Haaruun la hadlayay shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan waxay eegeen xaggii cidlada, oo bal eeg, ammaantii Rabbiga ayaa daruurtii ka dhex muuqatay.
english: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the LORD’s glory appeared in the cloud.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu isagii ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Anigu waan maqlay gunuuskii reer binu Israa'iil; haddaba la hadal, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Makhribka waxaad cuni doontaan hilib, subaxdana waxaad ka dhergi doontaan kibis; oo waad ogaan doontaan inaan anigu ahay Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacday in makhribkii digaagduur yimaadeen oo ay xeradii oo dhan qariyeen, oo subaxdiina waxaa degmadii hareeraheeda ku soo degay sayax.
english: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

kikuyu: Oo markii sayaxii soo degay baabba'ay ayaa waxaa dhulkii cidlada ku hadhay wax yaryar oo goobaaban oo laale'eg sayax barafoobay.
english: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

kikuyu: Oo markay reer binu Israa'iil arkeen ayaa midkoodba ka kale ku yidhi, Maxay tahay? Waayo, ma ay garanayn waxay tahay. Kolkaasaa Muuse wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Tanu waa kibistii Rabbigu idiin siiyey inaad cuntaan.
english: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.

kikuyu: Waxanu waa wixii Rabbigu idinku amray, Nin waluba ha ka gurto in cuntadiisa ugu filan, inta dadkiinna tiradiisu tahay, qofkiiba comer muggiis ha qaato, oo nin waluba inta teendhadiisa joogta ha u qayb qaado.
english: This is the thing which the LORD has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil sidaasay yeeleen, oo qaarna wax badan buu soo gurtay, qaarna wax yar.
english: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.

kikuyu: Oo markay comerkii ku qiyaaseen, kii wax badan soo gurtay waxba kama hadhin, kii wax yar soo gurtayna waxba kama dhinmin, oo nin waluba in cuntadiisa ugu filan buu soo gurtay.
english: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Ninna yuusan wax ka reebin ilaa subaxda.
english: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee Muuse ma ay dhegaysan, laakiinse qaarkood baa wax ka reebay ilaa subaxdii, kolkaasaa dirxi galay, oo ay urtay. Markaasaa Muusena iyagii u cadhooday.
english: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.

kikuyu: Oo subax kasta nin waluba wuxuu guran jiray in cuntadiisa ugu filan; oo markii qorraxdu soo kululaatana, way dhalaali jirtay.
english: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.

kikuyu: Oo maalintii lixaad waxay soo gurteen kibistii hore labanlaabkeed, qof waluba wuxuu soo gurtay laba comer, markaasaa taliyayaashii shirka oo dhammu intay u yimaadeen Muuse u sheegeen.
english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Waxanu waa wixii Rabbigu ku hadlay, Berri waa maalin weyn oo nasasho ah, oo waa sabti quduus u ah Rabbiga. Wixii aad duban lahaydeen dubta, oo wixii aad karin lahaydeen kariya, oo wax alla wixii idiin hadha meel dhigta oo ha idiin yaalleen ilaa subaxda.
english: He said to them, “This is that which the LORD has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay meel dhigteen ilaa subaxdii, sidii Muuse ku amray; oo mana ay urin, dirxina laguma arag.
english: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu yidhi, Intan maanta cuna; waayo, maanta waa maalin sabti u ah Rabbiga; oo maanta waxba duurka ka heli maysaan.
english: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.

kikuyu: Lix maalmood waa inaad soo gurataan, laakiinse maalinta toddobaad waa sabtida, oo maalintaas waxba ma jiri doonaan innaba.
english: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacday maalintii toddobaad inay dadkii qaarkood dibadda u bexeen inay wax soo gurtaan, laakiinse waxba ma ay helin.
english: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Ilaa goormaad diidaysaan inaad dhawrtaan amarradayda iyo qaynuunnadayda?
english: The LORD said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?

kikuyu: Bal eega, Rabbigu wuxuu idin siiyey sabtida, oo sidaas daraaddeed buu isagu maalintii lixaad idiin siiyey kibis laba maalmood idinku filan; haddaba nin kasta oo idinka mid ahu meeshiisa ha joogo, oo maalinta toddobaad ninna yuusan meeshiisa ka bixin.
english: Behold, because the LORD has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”

kikuyu: Oo sidaas daraaddeed baa dadkii maalintii toddobaad u nasteen.
english: So the people rested on the seventh day.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay magaceedii u bixiyeen Maanna; oo waxay u caddayd sida midhaha koryander la yidhaahdo, waxayna u dhadhan ekayd sidii buskud malab lagu sameeyey.
english: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu yidhi, Waxanu waa wixii Rabbigu idinku amray, oo wuxuu yidhi, Comer muggiis ha loo dhigo farcankiinna dambe, inay arkaan kibistii aan idinku masruufi jiray markaad cidlada joogteen oo aan dalkii Masar idinka soo bixiyey.
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu Haaruun ku yidhi, Weel qaado oo waxaad ku shubtaa comer muggiis oo Maanna ah, oo Rabbiga hor dhig in loo hayo farcankiinna dambe.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept throughout your generations.”

kikuyu: Sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray ayaa Haaruun Maragga hortiis u dhigay, in loo hayo aawadeed.
english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay maannadii cunayeen afartan sannadood, ilaa ay yimaadeen dhul la deggan yahay. Waxay cuni jireen maannadii ilaa ay yimaadeen dalkii reer Kancaan xadkiisii.
english: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Comer waa eefaah toban meelood loo dhigay meeshiis.
english: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaa shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay ka sodcaaleen cidlada Siin la yidhaahdo, oo waxay u socdeen sidii Rabbigu ku amray, kolkaasay waxay degeen meel la yidhaahdo Refiidiim; oo dadkuna ma ay haysan biyo ay cabbaan.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to the LORD’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed dadkii waxay la dirireen Muuse, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, War biyo aannu cabno na sii. Kolkaasaa Muuse wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Bal maxaad aniga iila diriraysaan? Oo maxaad Rabbiga u jirrabaysaan?
english: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the LORD?”

kikuyu: Markaasay dadkii meeshaas biyo ugu harraadeen; kolkaasaa dadkii intay Muuse u gunuuseen ayay waxay ku yidhaahdeen, War maxaad Masar nooga soo kaxaysay? Ma inaad annaga iyo carruurtayada, iyo xoolahayaga harraad noogu disha baa?
english: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Muuse Rabbiga u qayshaday oo ku yidhi, Bal maxaan dadkan ku sameeyaa? Waayo, waxay ku dhow yihiin inay i dhagxiyaan.
english: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Bal dadka ka hor mar, oo waxaad kaxaysataa waayeellada reer binu Israa'iil, ushaadii aad webiga ku dhufatayna gacanta ku qabso oo tag.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.

kikuyu: Oo bal ogow, halkaas ayaan hortaada isku dul taagi doonaa dhagaxa weyn oo Xoreeb yaal, kolkaas waa inaad dhagaxa ushaada ku dhufataa, oo waxaa halkaas ka iman doona biyo ay dadku cabbaan. Kolkaasaa Muuse sidaas ku sameeyey waayeelladii reer binu Israa'iil hortooda.
english: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasuu meeshaas magaceedii wuxuu u bixiyey Masaah iyo Meriibaah, dirirtii ay reer binu Israa'iil dirireen aawadeed, iyo jirrabaaddii ay Rabbiga jirrabeen aawadeed, oo ay yidhaahdeen, War, Rabbigu ma na dhex joogaa mise nama dhex joogo?
english: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us, or not?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa yimid reer Camaaleq, oo wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil kula diriray Refiidiim.
english: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu Yashuuca ku yidhi, Rag inoo dooro, oo la bax, oo reer Camaaleq la dirir. Berrito waxaan istaagi doonaa buurta dusheeda, anigoo gacanta ku haysta ushii Ilaah.
english: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Yashuuca yeelay sidii Muuse ku yidhi, oo wuxuu la diriray reer Camaaleq. Markaasaa Muuse iyo Haaruun iyo Xuur waxay koreen ilaa buurta dusheedii.
english: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

kikuyu: Oo markii Muuse gacanta kor u taagayba, waxaa adkaaday reer binu Israa'iil; markuu gacanta dejiyeyna, waxaa adkaaday reer Camaaleq.
english: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Muuse gacmihiisu way cuslaayeen; kolkaasay waxay soo qaadeen dhagax, oo Muuse u saldhigeen, isna kolkaasuu ku fadhiistay; Haaruun iyo Xuurna gacmihiisii bay sare u hayeen, intuu midba dhinac ka maray, oo gacmihiisiina way xoogeeyeen ilaa ay qorraxdii dhacday.
english: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

kikuyu: Oo Yashuucana seef afkeed buu ku jebiyey reer Camaaleq iyo dadkiisiiba.
english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Waxan buug ku qor si loo xusuusto, oo Yashuuca dhegihiisa maqashii, waayo, xusuusta reer Camaaleq lagu xusuusan jiray ayaan inta samada ka hoosaysa oo dhan ka baabbi'inayaa.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu dhisay meel allabari, oo magaceedii wuxuu u bixiyey Yehowah Nisii,
english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu yidhi, Rabbigu waa dhaartay, oo Rabbigu wuu la dagaallami doonaa reer Camaaleq ka ab ka ab.
english: He said, “The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”

kikuyu: Haddaba wadaadkii Midyaan oo Yetroo ahaa, Muusena soddog u ahaa, ayaa wuxuu maqlay kulli wixii Rabbigu u sameeyey Muuse iyo dadkiisa reer binu Israa'iil, iyo sidii Rabbigu reer binu Israa'iil uga soo bixiyey dalkii Masar.
english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yetroo oo Muuse soddog u ahaa ayaa wuxuu soo kexeeyey naagtii Muuse oo ahayd Siforaah, markuu iska diray dabadeed,
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

kikuyu: iyadii iyo labadeedii wiilba, oo midkood magiciisu wuxuu ahaa Gershoom, waayo, wuxuu yidhi, Qariib baan ku ahaa dal qalaad,
english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

kikuyu: midka kalena magiciisuna wuxuu ahaa Eliiceser; waayo, wuxuu yidhi, Ilaahii aabbahay baa i caawiyey, oo wuxuu iga samatabbixiyey seeftii Fircoon.
english: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yetroo oo Muuse soddog u ahaa ayaa Muuse ugu yimid cidladii ay degeen oo buurtii Ilaah agteeda ahayd isagoo wada wiilashiisii iyo naagtiisii.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Anigoo ah Yetroo soddoggaa waan kuu imid aniga iyo naagtaada iyadoo wadata labadeedii wiilba.
english: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse dibadda u baxay inuu ka hor tago soddoggiis, kolkaasuu u sujuuday oo dhunkaday, markaasaa intay iswaraysteen ayay teendhadii soo galeen.
english: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu soddoggiis u sheegay kulli wixii Rabbigu ku sameeyey Fircoon iyo Masriyiintii oo uu ugu sameeyey reer binu Israa'iil aawadood, iyo wixii dhib iyaga ku dhacay oo dhan intay soo socdeen, iyo sidii Rabbigu uga samatabbixiyey.
english: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yetroo ku farxay kulli wanaaggii Rabbigu reer binu Israa'iil u sameeyey oo dhan, iyo bixinta uu ka soo samatabbixiyey gacantii Masriyiinta.
english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yetroo wuxuu yidhi, Ammaan waxaa leh Rabbigii idinka soo samatabbixiyey gacantii Masriyiinta, iyo gacantii Fircoon; oo kaasu waa kii dadka ka soo samatabbixiyey gacantii Masriyiinta hoosteeda.
english: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Oo haatan anigu waan ogahay in Rabbigu ka wada weyn yahay ilaahyada oo dhan; waayo, waxyaalihii ay kula macaamiloodeen iyagoo kibirsan aawadeed, isagaa ka sarreeyey.
english: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yetroo oo Muuse soddog u ahaa ayaa wuxuu qaaday qurbaan la gubo iyo allabaryo. Markaasaa waxaa yimid Haaruun iyo waayeelladii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan inay Ilaah hortiisa kibis kula cunaan Muuse soddoggiis.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa maalintii dambe dhacday in Muuse u fadhiistay inuu dadkii u kala gar naqo; dadkiina waxay Muuse ag taagnaayeen subaxdii ilaa makhribkii.
english: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse soddoggiis markuu arkay wixii uu dadkii ku sameeyey oo dhan ayuu yidhi, Waa maxay waxan aad dadka ku samaynaysaa? Oo maxaad keligaa u fadhidaa, dadka oo dhammuna kuu ag taagan yahay subaxda ilaa makhribka?
english: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse soddoggiis ku yidhi, Maxaa yeelay, dadku waxay iigu yimaadaan inay Ilaah wax iga weyddiiyaan.
english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

kikuyu: Oo markay wax isu haystaanna anigay ii yimaadaan, oo markaasaan u kala gar naqaa nin iyo deriskiisa, oo waxaan iyaga ogeysiiyaa amarrada Ilaah iyo qaynuunnadiisa.
english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse soddoggiis wuxuu isaga ku yidhi, War waxaad samaysaa ma wanaagsana.
english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

kikuyu: Waayo, hubaal waad ku daali doontaan, adiga iyo dadka kula joogaaba, maxaa yeelay, waxanu waa kugu culus yihiin adiga; oo ma aad awooddid inaad keli ahaantaa samayso.
english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal i dhegayso oo waan kula talinayaaye, oo Ilaahna ha kula jiro. Adigu dadka daraaddiis Ilaah u dhowow, oo arrimahoodana Ilaah u keen.
english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad iyaga bartaa amarrada iyo qaynuunnada, oo waa inaad iyaga tustaa jidkii ay mari lahaayeen, iyo shuqulkii ay qaban lahaayeen.
english: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waa inaad dadka oo dhan kala soo baxdaa rag karti leh, oo Ilaah ka cabsada, oo daacad ah, oo neceb faa'iidada xaqdarrada ah, oo kuwo caynkaas ah madax uga dhig, inay ahaadaan kuwo kun kun u taliya, iyo kuwo boqol boqol u taliya, iyo kuwo konton konton u taliya, iyo kuwo toban toban u taliya,
english: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

kikuyu: oo kuwaasu dadka ha u gar naqeen had iyo goor, oo waxay noqon doontaa in wixii weyn oo dhan ay adiga kuu keenaan, laakiinse wixii yar oo dhan ay iyagu ka gar naqi doonaan; oo sidaasaa hawshu kaaga yaraan doontaa, oo iyana hawshay kula qaybsan doonaan.
english: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

kikuyu: Oo haddaad waxan samaysid, oo haddii Ilaah sidan kugu amro, de markaas waad adkaysan kari doontaa, oo dadkan oo dhammuna meeshooda ayay nabad ku tegi doonaan.
english: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Muuse wuu dhegaystay hadalkii soddoggiis, wuuna wada sameeyey wixii uu ku yidhi oo dhan.
english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan ka doortay rag karti leh, oo wuxuu ka dhigay madaxdii dadka, oo ah kuwo kun kun u taliya, iyo kuwo boqol boqol u taliya, iyo kuwo konton konton u taliya, iyo kuwo toban toban u taliya.
english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

kikuyu: Oo dadkay u gar naqi jireen had iyo goorba, oo arrimaha adadagna waxay u keeni jireen Muuse, laakiinse wixii yaryar oo dhan iyagaa ka gar naqi jiray.
english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse u oggolaaday soddoggiis inuu tago, isna dalkiisii ayuu tegey.
english: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.

kikuyu: Markii reer binu Israa'iil Masar ka soo bexeen dabadeed, bishii saddexaad, ayay isla maalintaas yimaadeen cidlada Siinay la yidhaahdo.
english: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Oo markay ka soo keceen Refiidiim oo ay yimaadeen cidladii Siinay ayay teendhooyinkoodii cidladii ka dhisteen, oo reer binu Israa'iil halkaasay degeen buurta horteeda.
english: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

kikuyu: Muusena kor buu ugu tegey Ilaah, markaasaa Rabbigu buurta uga yeedhay isagii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Yacquub reerkiisa waxaad ku tidhaahdaa sidan, reer binu Israa'iilna ku dheh,
english: Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

kikuyu: Idinku waad aragteen wixii aan ku sameeyey Masriyiintii, iyo sidii aan idiinku soo qaaday gorgorro baalashood, oo aan idiin soo kaxaystay.
english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed, haddaad daacad ahaan ii addeecaysaan, oo aad axdigayga dhawraysaan, de markaas waxaad ahaan doontaan dad hanti iiga ah dadyowga oo dhan, waayo, dhulka oo dhan anigaa iska leh;
english: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

kikuyu: oo waxaad ii ahaan doontaan boqortooyo wada wadaaddo ah, iyo quruun quduus ah. Kuwanu waa erayada aad reer binu Israa'iil kula hadli doonto.
english: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse yimid oo wuxuu u yeedhay waayeelladii dadka oo dhan, kolkaasuu erayadii Rabbigu isaga ku amray oo dhan hortooda wada dhigay.
english: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii oo dhammu waxay ku wada jawaabeen, oo yidhaahdeen, Kulli waxa Rabbigu ku hadlay oo dhan waannu wada yeeli doonnaa. Markaasaa Muuse Rabbiga uga warramay erayadii dadka.
english: All the people answered together, and said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Bal ogow, waxaan kuugu iman doonaa daruur qaro weyn dhexdeed, inay dadku maqlaan markii aan kula hadlayo, iyo weliba inay weligood adiga ku rumaystaan. Markaasaa Muuse Rabbiga u sheegay erayadii dadka.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Bal orod oo dadka u tag, oo maanta iyo berri quduus ka dhig iyaga, oo dharkooda ha dhaqeen,
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

kikuyu: oo maalinta saddexaad diyaar ha u noqdeen, waayo, maalinta saddexaad dadka oo dhan hortiisa ayaa Rabbigu ku soo degi doonaa Buur Siinay.
english: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad soohdin dadka kaga wareejisaa, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Iska jira, oo buurta ha fuulina, hana taabanina xuduudkeeda; waayo, ku alla kii buurta taabta hubaal waa la dili doonaa.
english: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

kikuyu: Gacanu yaanay taaban isaga, laakiinse hubaal isaga waa in la dhagxiyo ama waa in gantaal lagu dilo; dad iyo duunyo ha ahaado, kaasu sina yaanu u noolaan; oo markii buunka aad looga dhawaajiyo, buurta ha soo fuuleen.
english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse buurtii ka degay, oo wuxuu u tegey dadkii, kolkaasuu dadkii quduus ka dhigay, oo ay dharkoodii dhaqeen.
english: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dadkii ku yidhi, Maalinta saddexaad diyaar noqda oo naagna ha isugu dhowaanina.
english: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”

kikuyu: Oo maalintii saddexaad, markuu waagii beryay, waxaa dhacay onkod iyo hillaac, oo daruur qaro weyn baa buurtii soo dul joogsatay, oo waxaa yeedhay buun codkiisu aad iyo aad u weyn yahay, kolkaasay dadkii xerada ku jiray oo dhammu wada gariireen.
english: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse dadkii xeradii ka soo bixiyey inay Ilaah la kulmaan aawadeed; kolkaasay waxay istaageen buurta salkeedii.
english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

kikuyu: Oo Buur Siinay dhammaanteed way qiiqaysay, maxaa yeelay, Rabbi baa dusheeda ku soo degay, isagoo dab ku dhex jira, oo qiiqeediina kor buu u baxay sida qiiq foorno oo kale, oo buurtii oo dhammuna aad bay u gariirtay.
english: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the LORD descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

kikuyu: Oo markii buunkii codkiisii aad iyo aad u sii weynaaday ayaa Muuse hadlay, Ilaahna kolkaasuu cod ugu jawaabay.
english: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu ku soo kor degay Buur Siinay, oo wuxuu yimid buurta dusheedii. Kolkaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ugu yeedhay buurta dusheedii; oo Muusena kor buu u baxay.
english: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Hoos u deg, oo dadka u dig, waaba intaasoo ay Rabbiga xaggiisa u soo xadgudbaan inay fiirsadaan, oo ay qaarkood badanu halligmaane.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wadaaddada Rabbiga u soo dhowaanaya quduus ha iska dhigeen, waaba intaasoo Rabbigu uu halligaaye.
english: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Muuse wuxuu Rabbiga ku yidhi, Dadku Buur Siinay sooma fuuli karaan, waayo, waxaad nagu amartay, oo nagu tidhi, Buurta soohdin ku wareeji, oo quduus ka dhig.
english: Moses said to the LORD, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu isagii ku yidhi, Orod oo hoos u deg; oo dabadeedna soo fuul adigoo Haaruun wata; laakiinse wadaaddada iyo dadku yaanay kor u soo xadgudbin xagga Rabbiga, waaba intaasoo uu halligaaye.
english: The LORD said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break out against them.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Muuse hoos buu u degay oo dadkii u tegey, una sheegay.
english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu erayadan oo dhan ku hadlay, isagoo leh,
english: God spoke all these words, saying,

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah, oo kaa soo bixiyey dalkii Masar iyo gurigii addoonsiga.
english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: Aniga mooyaane ilaahyo kale waa inaanad lahaan.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad samaysan sanam xardhan, ama wax u eg waxa samada sare jira, ama waxa dhulka hoose jira, ama waxa biyaha dhulka ka hooseeya ku jira.
english: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

kikuyu: Waa inaanad iyaga u sujuudin, ama u adeegin, waayo, aniga oo ah Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah waxaan ahay Ilaah masayr ah, oo xumaantii awowayaasha waxaan soo gaadhsiinayaa carruurtooda tan iyo farcanka saddexaad iyo kan afraad oo kuwa i neceb,
english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

kikuyu: oo waxaan u naxariistaa kumanyaal ah kuwa i jecel oo amarradayda xajiya.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad magaca Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah si been ah ugu hadal qaadin, waayo, Rabbigu eedlaawe u haysan maayo kii magiciisa si been ah ugu hadal qaada.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

kikuyu: Xusuuso maalinta sabtida, inaad quduus ka dhigto.
english: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

kikuyu: Lix maalmood waa inaad hawshootaa, oo aad shuqulkaaga oo dhan qabsataa,
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

kikuyu: laakiinse maalinta toddobaad waa maalin sabti u ah Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah, oo waa inaanad shuqul qaban, adiga, ama wiilkaaga, ama gabadhaada, ama addoonkaaga, ama addoontaada, ama xoolahaaga, ama qariibka irdahaaga ku jira;
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

kikuyu: waayo, Rabbigu lix maalmood buu ku sameeyey samada, iyo dhulka, iyo badda, iyo waxa dhexdooda ku jira oo dhan, kolkaasuu nastay maalintii toddobaad, sidaas daraaddeed ayaa Rabbigu u barakeeyey maalintii sabtida ahayd oo quduus uga dhigay.
english: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

kikuyu: Aabbahaa iyo hooyadaa maamuus, in cimrigaagu ku dheeraado dhulka Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ahu ku siiyo.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad qudh gooyn.
english: “You shall not murder.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad sinaysan.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad waxba xadin.
english: “You shall not steal.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad deriskaaga marag been ah ku furin.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad damcin guriga deriskaaga, waa inaanad damcin naagta deriskaaga, ama addoonkiisa, ama addoontiisa, ama dibigiisa, ama dameerkiisa, ama waxa deriskaagu leeyahay oo dhan.
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

kikuyu: Oo dadkii oo dhammuna way wada arkeen onkodkii iyo hillaacii, iyo codkii buunka, iyo buurtii qiiqaysay; oo markii dadkii arkay ayay gariireen, oo meel fog istaageen.
english: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay waxay Muuse ku yidhaahdeen, Adigu nala hadal, oo annana waannu ku maqli doonnaa, laakiinse Ilaah yuusan nala hadlin, waaba intaasoo aannu dhimannaaye.
english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu dadkii ku yidhi, Ha cabsanina, waayo, Ilaah wuxuu u yimid inuu idin tijaabiyo, iyo in ka cabsashadiisu idinku jirto, si aydnaan u dembaabin.
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii waxay istaageen meel fog, Muusena wuxuu u soo dhowaaday gudcurkii qarada weynaa oo Ilaah joogay.
english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Waxaad reer binu Israa'iil ku tidhaahdaa, Idinka qudhiinnu waad aragteen inaan samada idinkala hadlay.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

kikuyu: Haddaba waa inaydnaan yeelan ilaahyo kale aniga mooyaane; oo ilaahyo lacag ah iyo ilaahyo dahab ah waa inaydnaan samaysan.
english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

kikuyu: Meel allabari waa inaad ciid iiga samaysaa, oo waa inaad dusheeda iigu bixisaa qurbaannadaada la gubo, iyo qurbaannadaada nabaadiinada, iyo idahaaga iyo dibiyadaada. Oo meel kasta oo aan magacayga dadka ku xusuusiyoba waan kuugu iman doonaa oo waan kugu barakayn doonaa.
english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

kikuyu: Oo haddaad meel allabari dhagax iiga samayso, waa inaadan dhagax qoran ka dhisin, waayo, haddaad alaabtaada taabsiisid waad nijaasaysay.
english: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

kikuyu: Ama waa inaanad meeshayda allabariga sallaan ku fuulin, si aan cawradaadu uga muuqan.
english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa amarradii aad hortooda dhigi lahayd.
english: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

kikuyu: Haddaad addoon Cibraani ah iibsatid, ha kuu adeego lix sannadood, oo tan toddobaadna ha iska tago isagoo xor ah oo aan waxba bixin.
english: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu keli ahaantiis ku soo galo, haddana keli ahaantiis ha ku baxo, hadduuse naag qabo, de markaas waa inay naagtiisu isaga la baxdaa.
english: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

kikuyu: Haddii sayidkiisu naag siiyona, oo ay wiilal iyo gabdho u dhasho, de markaas naagta iyo carruurteedaba waxaa iska lahaanaya sayidkeedii, oo waa inuu isagu keligiis iska baxaa.
english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii addoonku bayaan u yidhaahdo, Anigu waan jeclahay sayidkayga, iyo naagtayda, iyo carruurtayda, oo anigoo xor ah bixi maayo,
english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

kikuyu: de markaas waa in sayidkiisu xaakinnada u keenaa, oo waa inuu albaabka ag keenaa, ama tiirka albaabka; markaas sayidkiisu dhegta mudac ha kaga dalooliyo; oo weligiis ha u adeego.
english: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin gabadhiisa u iibiyo inay addoon noqoto, waa inaanay dibadda u bixin sida addoommada nimanka ahu ay u baxaan.
english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

kikuyu: Oo haddaanay raalli gelin sayidkeedii doonay iyada, de markaas waa inuu sii daayo iyada, ha la madax furto, laakiinse amar uma lahaan doono inuu iyada dad qalaad ka iibiyo, waayo, khiyaano ayuu kula macaamilooday iyada.
english: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu iyada wiilkiisa u guursho, de waa inuu iyada ula macaamiloodaa sida gabdhaha loola macaamiloodo.
english: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu naag kale la guursado, waa inuusan inna ka dhimin masruufkeeda, iyo dharkeeda, iyo xaqa naagnimadeeda.
english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

kikuyu: Oo hadduusan saddexdaas iyada u samayn, markaas lacagla'aan ha ku baxdo.
english: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

kikuyu: Kii nin wax ku dhufta si uu ninku u dhinto, isagana hubaal waa in la dilaa.
english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

kikuyu: Oo haddii aanu gaadin, laakiinse Ilaah u dhiibo gacantiisa, de markaas anaa kuu samayn doona meel uu ku cararo.
english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin kibir ula badheedho inuu deriskiisa khiyaano ku dilo, waa inaad isaga ka waddaa meeshayda allabariga, ha dhintee.
english: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

kikuyu: Oo kii aabbihiis ama hooyadiis wax ku dhufta, hubaal kaas waa in la dilaa.
english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

kikuyu: Oo kii intuu nin xada iibiya ama gacantiisaba laga helo, hubaal kaas waa in la dilaa.
english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo kii aabbihiis ama hooyadiis caaya, hubaal kaas waa in la dilaa.
english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo haddii niman diriraan, oo midkood kan kale dhagax ama feedh ku dhufto, oo uusan dhiman, laakiinse uu sariir ku jiif noqdo;
english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

kikuyu: kaasu hadduu mar kale sara kaco oo uu dibadda u baxo isagoo ushiisa ku tukubaya, markaas kii wax ku dhuftay eed ma leh, laakiinse waa inuu siiyaa wixii ka khasaaroobay intuu jiifay, waana inuu dhaqaaleeyo ilaa uu ka bogsado.
english: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

kikuyu: Haddii nin addoonkiisa ama addoontiisa uu ul ku dhufto, oo uu gacantiisa ku dhinto, kaas hubaal waa in la ciqaabaa.
english: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

kikuyu: Kan la dilayse hadduu maalin ama laba sii joogo, de markaas waa inaan la ciqaabin, waayo, isagu waa lacagtiisii.
english: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

kikuyu: Oo haddii niman diriraan oo ay wax yeelaan naag uur leh, oo uu ilmaheedu ka soo dhaco, laakiinse dhib kale aanu dhicin, kaas waa in lagu ganaaxaa intii ninkii naagta qabay uu kor saaro, oo waa inuu bixiyaa intii xaakinnadu ku xukumaan.
english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii dhib kale dhacdo, waa inaad naf naf u dishaa,
english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

kikuyu: oo waa inaad il il u riddaa, iligna ilig u riddaa, gacanna gacan u gooysaa, cagna cag u gooysaa,
english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

kikuyu: oo kii wax guba, gub, kii wax dhaawacana, dhaawac, kii wax karbaashana, karbaash.
english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin isha addoonkiisa ama isha addoontiisa wax ku dhufto, oo ka rido, de markaas waa inuu iska sii daayaa isagoo xor ah, ishiisa aawadeed.
english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu iligga addoonkiisa ama iligga addoontiisa wax ku dhufto oo ka rido, de markaas waa inuu iska sii daayaa isagoo xor ah iliggiisa aawadiis.
english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

kikuyu: Oo haddii dibi nin ama naag geeso ku mudo, oo ay dhintaan, markaas hubaal waa in dibiga la dhagxiyaa, oo hilibkiisana waa inaan la cunin; laakiinse qofkii dibiga lahaa waxba eed ma leh.
english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii markii hore dibigu dad geesaha ku mudi jiray, oo loo sheegay qofkii lahaa, isaguse aanu xidhin, laakiinse uu dibigu nin ama naag dilay, dibiga waa in la dhagxiyaa, oo weliba qofkii lahaana waa in isna la dilaa.
english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

kikuyu: Haddiise mag la saaro isaga, de markaas waa inuu bixiyaa wax alla wixii la kor saaray madaxfurashadiisa aawadeed.
english: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

kikuyu: Hadduu wiil geeso ku muday iyo hadduu gabadh geeso ku mudayba waa in xukunkan lagu qaadaa.
english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

kikuyu: Oo haddii dibigii geeso ku mudo nin addoon ah ama naag addoon ah, waa inuu ninkii dibiga lahaa sayidkoodii soddon sheqel oo lacag ah siiyaa, oo dibigana waa in la dhagxiyaa.
english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin god daboolka ka qaado, ama haddii nin god qodo oo uu dabooli waayo, oo uu ama dibi ama dameer ku dhaco,
english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

kikuyu: de markaas waa in ninkii godka lahaa xaq mariyaa. Waa inuu lacag siiyaa ninkii neefka lahaa, oo neefka dhintayna waa inuu isagu lahaado.
english: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin dibigiis nin kale dibigiis wax yeelo oo uu dhinto, de markaas waa inay dibiga nool iibiyaan, oo qiimihiisa waa inay qaybsadaan; oo weliba kan dhintayna waa inay qaybsadaan.
english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

kikuyu: Ama haddii dibiga lagu yiqiin inuu markii hore wax geeso ku mudi jiray, oo uusan qofkii lahaa xidhin, markaas hubaal waa inuu dibi dibi ku bixiyaa, oo neefka dhintayna waa inuu isagu lahaado.
english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

kikuyu: Haddii nin dibi ama lax xado, oo uu qasho ama iibiyo, waa inuu shan dibi dibigii ku magdhabo, laxdiina afar laxaad.
english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

kikuyu: Haddii tuug la helo isagoo guri u dhacaya, oo inta wax lagu dhufto uu dhinto, markaas kii dilay dhiig eed kuma laha.
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

kikuyu: Haddiise qorraxdu u soo baxdo, markaas dhiigga eed buu ku leeyahay. Waa inuu u soo celiyaa, hadduusanse waxba haysan, de markaas waa in isaga la iibiyaa tuugnimadiisii aawadeed.
english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

kikuyu: Haddiise wuxuu xaday iyagoo nool gacantiisa laga helo, ama dibi ha noqdo amase dameer, amase lax, waa inuu labanlaab u bixiyaa.
english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: Haddii nin beer canab ah ama beer kale xoolo daajiyo, oo uu neefkiisa ku sii daayo si uu nin kale beertiis u daaqo, de markaas waa inuu meesha beertiisa ugu wanaagsan iyo meesha beertiisa canabka ah ugu wanaagsan ugu magdhabaa.
english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

kikuyu: Haddii dab baxo, oo uu qodxanta qabsado, oo uu wada gubo xidhmooyinka sarreenka ah ama sarreenka weli baalka ku yaal, ama beerta oo dhan, markaas kii dabka shiday waa inuu magdhabaa.
english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: Haddii nin deriskiisa lacag ama alaab ammaano ugu dhiibto, oo ninka gurigiisii laga xado, oo markaas tuuggii la helo, waa inuu labanlaab u magdhabaa.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: Haddiise aan tuuggii la helin, markaas waa in ninkii guriga lahaa xaakinnada u soo dhowaadaa si loo caddeeyo inuu alaabtii deriskiisa fartiisa saaray iyo in kale.
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

kikuyu: Waayo, wax kasta oo xadgudub ah ama ha noqdo dibi aawadiis, ama dameer aawadiis, ama lax aawadeed, ama dhar aawadiis, ama wax kasta oo baadi ah, haddii la leeyahay, Waa kan, waa in labada qolo arrintooda xaakinnada la hor keenaa. Oo midkii xaakinnadu ku xukumaan waa inuu deriskiisa labanlaab ugu magdhabaa.
english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

kikuyu: Haddii nin deriskiisa ammaano ugu dhiibto dameer ama dibi, ama lax amase neef uun, markaas hadduu dhinto, ama wax gaadhaan, ama la kaxaysto iyadoo aan la arkayn,
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

kikuyu: markaas waa in dhaartii Rabbiga la dhex dhigaa labadooda, si loo caddeeyo inuu fartiisa saaray xoolihii deriskiisa iyo in kale, oo kii lahaana waa inuu aqbalaa, oo waxbana loo magdhabi maayo.
english: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii laga xado, waa inuu isagu qofkii lahaa u magdhabaa.
english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

kikuyu: Haddiise dugaag bakhtiisto, waa inuu marag ahaan u keenaa, oo wixii dugaaggu bakhtiistay waxba ka magdhabi maayo.
english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin deriskiisa neef ka ammaahdo, oo ay wax gaadhaan amaba uu dhinto, isagoo aan ninkii lahaa la joogin, kaasu hubaal waa inuu magdhabaa.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: Haddiise kii lahaa la joogay, waa inuusan waxba ka magdhabin, oo hadduu kiro ahaa, kiradiisii waa laga xisaabay.
english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin sasabto gabadh bikrad ah oo aan doonanayn, oo uu iyada la seexdo, de markaas waa inuu yarad ka bixiyo oo uu guursadaa iyada.
english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

kikuyu: Haddiise aabbeheed innaba u diido inuu isaga siiyo, de markaas waa inuu bixiyaa intii gabadh bikrad ah yaradkeedu yahay.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

kikuyu: Saaxirad inay sii noolaato waa inaadan u fasaxin.
english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii neef u galmooda, hubaal waa in la dilaa.
english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Kii wax u bixiya ilaah kale oo aan Rabbiga keligiis ah ahayn, kaas waa in dhammaantiis la baabbi'iyaa.
english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.

kikuyu: Oo qariib waa inaadan xumayn, ama waa inaadan dulmin, waayo, idinba qariib baad ku ahaydeen dalkii Masar.
english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Waa inaydnaan dhibin carmal, ama ilmo agoon ah.
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

kikuyu: Oo si kasta ha noqotee haddii aad iyaga dhibtid, oo ay ii qayshadaan hubaal qayladooda waan maqli doonaa,
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

kikuyu: oo aad baan u cadhoon doonaa, oo markaasaan seef idinku dili doonaa, kolkaasaa naagihiinnu waxay noqon doonaan carmallo, carruurtiinnuna agoon.
english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

kikuyu: Oo haddaad lacag ammaahisid dadkayga masaakiinta ah oo kula jooga, waa inaadan ku noqon sidii mid dayn ku leh ama waa inaadan waxba kor saarin.
english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

kikuyu: Haddaad deriskaaga dharkiisa rahmad uga qaadatid waa inaad u celisaa intaan qorraxdu dhicin,
english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

kikuyu: waayo, kaasu waa kan qudh ah oo uu isa saari jiray, oo waa dharkii uu huwan jiray, oo muxuu ku seexan doonaa? Oo waxaa dhici doonta in markuu ii qayshado, aan maqli doono, waayo, anigu waan raxmad badnahay.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan xaakinnada caayin, mid dadkaaga u taliyana ha habaarin.
english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan ka raagin inaad wax ka bixiso midhahaaga badan iyo dheecaanka macsaraddaada. Oo curadyada dadkaagana waa inaad aniga i siisaa.
english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

kikuyu: Oo sidaas oo kalena waa inaad ka yeeshaa dibiyadaada iyo idahaaga; toddoba maalmood waa inuu hooyadiis la joogaa, maalinta siddeedaadna waa inaad ii bixisaa.
english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad dad quduus ah ii ahaataan, oo sidaas daraaddeed waa inaydnaan cunin hilib neef oo dugaag berrinka ku bakhtiistay, laakiinse waa inaad eeyaha u tuurtaan.
english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan qaadqaadin war been ah; gacantaada heshiis ha ugu dhiibin kan sharka ah, yaadan markhaati xaqdaran noqone.
english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

kikuyu: Inaad xumaan fashid aawadeed dad badan ha u raacin, ama marag ha furin oo dad badan dhankooda ha u leexan inaad gar qalloocisaan,
english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

kikuyu: waana inaadan nin miskiin ah u gar eexan.
english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

kikuyu: Haddaad aragtid cadowgaaga dibigiisii ama dameerkiisii oo lumaya, waa inaad u celisaa.
english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

kikuyu: Haddaad aragtid kan ku neceb dameerkiisii oo rar la dhacay, oo aanad doonayn inaad caawiso, hubaal waa inaad caawisaa.
english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

kikuyu: Miskiinkaaga dacwaddiisa waa inaadan garta ka qalloocin.
english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

kikuyu: Wax been ah ka fogow; oo ha dilin mid aan eed lahayn iyo kan xaqa ah; waayo, anigu xaq ka dhigi maayo kan shar fala.
english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaadan laaluush qaadan innaba; waayo, laaluushku waa indho tiraa kuwa wax arka, wuuna qalloociyaa kan xaqa ah hadalkiisa.
english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

kikuyu: Oo qariib waa inaadan dulmin; waayo, qalbiga qariibka waad garanaysaan, maxaa yeelay, idinba qariib baad dalkii Masar ku ahaydeen.
english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Lix sannadood waa inaad dhulkaaga wax ku abuurtaa oo midhihiisa urursataa,
english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

kikuyu: laakiinse sannadda toddobaad waa inaad iska daysaa ha nasto, oo dhul aan beernayn ha noqdee, inay masaakiinta dadkaagu wax ka cunaan; oo waxay reebaanna dugaagga duurku ha daaqeen. Oo sidaas oo kalena waa inaad u gashaa beertaada canabka ah iyo beertaada saytuunka ah.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

kikuyu: Lix maalmood waa inaad shuqulkaaga qabsataa, oo maalinta toddobaadna waa inaad nasataa, si ay dibigaaga iyo dameerkaaguna u nastaan, oo ay wiilka addoontaada iyo kan qariibka ahuba nafis u helaan.
english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

kikuyu: Oo kulli wixii aan idinku idhi oo dhan waa inaad aad u dhawrtaan, oo ilaahyo kale magacood ha soo qaadina innaba, ama afkaagaba yaan laga maqlin.
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

kikuyu: Oo sannad walba saddex goor waa inaad ii iiddaa.
english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

kikuyu: Oo Iiddii Kibista-aan-khamiirka-lahayn waa inaad dhawrtaa. Toddoba maalmood waa inaad cuntaa kibis aan khamiir lahayn, sidii aan kugu amray wakhtigii la yidhi oo bisha Aabiib ah, maxaa yeelay, bishaas ayaad Masar ka soo baxday; oo midkiinna hortayda yuusan iman isagoo faro madhan.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad dhawrtaa Iiddii Beergoosadka oo ah midhihii ugu horreeyey hawshaada aad beerta ku abuurtay, iyo Iiddii Wax urursiga oo sannadda dhammaadkeeda ah, marka aad soo urursatid midhihii aad beerta ku hawshootay.
english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

kikuyu: Kuwaaga labka ah oo dhammu waa inay sannad walba saddex goor Rabbiga Ilaaha ah ka hor yimaadaan.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaadan dhiigga allabarigayga la bixin kibis khamiir leh; baruurta iiddayduna waa inaanay hadhin habeenka oo dhan ilaa subaxda.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

kikuyu: Oo dhulkaaga midhaha ugu horreeya waa inaad inta hore guriga Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah geeysaa. Waa inaadan waxar caanaha hooyadiis ku karin.
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxaan hortaada u soo dirayaa malaa'ig, inay jidka kugu dhawrto oo ay meeshii aan diyaarshay ku geeyso.
english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

kikuyu: Iyada iska jira, oo codkeeda dhegaysta, hana ka xanaajinina, waayo, iyadu xadgudubkiinna idinkama cafiyi doonto; maxaa yeelay, iyada magacaygii baa ku dhex jira.
english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

kikuyu: Laakiinse xaqiiqa haddaad codkeeda dhegaysatid, oo aad yeeshid kulli waxa aan ku hadlayo, de markaas waxaan noqon cadaawayaashaada cadowgooda, oo kuwa ku dhibana mid dhiba iyaga.
english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

kikuyu: Waayo, malaa'igtaydu way ku hor socon doontaa, oo waxay ku dhex geeyn doontaa reer Amor, iyo reer Xeed, iyo reer Feres, iyo reer Kancaan, iyo reer Xiwi, iyo reer Yebuus; oo kolkaasaan iyaga baabbi'in doonaa.
english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan u sujuudin ilaahyadooda, hana u adeegin, shuqulkooda oo kalena ha samayn; laakiinse waa inaad wada afgembidaa, oo aad sanamyadoodana jejebisaa.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah u adeegtaan, oo isaguna wuu idiin barakayn doonaa kibistiinna iyo biyihiinna; oo anna cudur waan ka fogayn doonaa dhexdiinna.
english: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

kikuyu: Oo dhulkaaga dhexdiisa miduna dhicis ma dhali doonto, ama madhalays ma noqon doonto, oo tirada maalmahaaga waan dhammaystiri doonaa.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

kikuyu: Oo cabsidaydaan ku hor marin doonaa, oo dadka aad u tegaysid oo dhan waan argaggixin doonaa, oo waxaan cadaawayaashaada oo dhan ka dhigi doonaa inay dhabarkooda kaa sii jeediyaan.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan hortaa diri doonaa xoon, kaas oo reer Xiwi, iyo reer Kancaan, iyo reer Xeed hortaada ka eryi doona.
english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga sannad uun hortaada ka eryi maayo, waayo, waaba intaasoo dhulku cidla noqdaa, oo dugaagga duurku kugu bataa.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

kikuyu: In yar in yar ayaan hortaada ka eryi doonaa, ilaa aad adigu badatid oo aad dalka dhaxashid.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan soohdintaada ka dhigi doonaa Badda Cas iyo tan iyo badda reer Falastiin, iyo cidlada ilaa tan iyo Webiga, waayo, dadka dhulka deggan waxaan gelin doonaa gacantaada, markaasaad hortaada ka eryi doontaa.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan axdi la dhigan iyaga iyo ilaahyadooda toona.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

kikuyu: Waa inayan iyagu dalkaaga degganaan, waaba intaasoo ay igu kaa dembaajiyaane, waayo, haddaad ilaahyadooda u adeegtid, hubaal waxay taasu kugu noqon doontaa dabin.
english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Soo fuula oo Rabbiga u kaalaya, adiga iyo Haaruun, iyo Naadaab, iyo Abiihuu, iyo toddobaatan oday oo reer binu Israa'iil ah, oo meel fog ka caabuda;
english: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

kikuyu: oo Muuse oo keliyahu waa inuu Rabbiga u soo dhowaada, laakiinse iyagu waa inayan soo dhowaan, dadkuna yuusan la soo fuulin.
english: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse dadkii u yimid, oo wuxuu u sheegay hadalladii Rabbiga oo dhan iyo amarradii oo dhan. Markaasaa dadkii oo dhammu isku cod ku jawaabeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Ereyadii Rabbigu ku hadlay oo dhan waannu wada yeeli doonnaa.
english: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu qoray ereyadii Rabbiga oo dhan, kolkaasuu aroor hore kacay, oo buurta hoosteedii wuxuu ka dhisay meel allabari iyo laba iyo toban tiir, sidii laba iyo tobankii qolo oo reer binu Israa'iil ay ahaayeen.
english: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu diray raggii dhallinyarada ahaa oo reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxay Rabbiga u bixiyeen allabaryo la gubo iyo qurbaanno nabaadiino oo dibiyo ah.
english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu qaaday dhiiggii badhkiis oo wuxuu ku shubay xeedhooyin; oo dhiiggii badhkiisna wuxuu ku rusheeyey meeshii allabariga.
english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu qaaday kitaabkii axdiga, oo wuuna akhriyey iyadoo ay dadkii maqlayaan, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Kulli wixii Rabbigu ku hadlay waannu yeeli doonnaa oo waannu addeeci doonnaa.
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu qaaday dhiiggii, oo dadkii ku rusheeyey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eega dhiiggii axdiga oo Rabbigu idinla dhigtay oo ku saabsan hadalladan oo dhan.
english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa waxaa kor u fuulay Muuse, iyo Haaruun, iyo Naadaab, iyo Abiihuu, iyo toddobaatan oday oo reer binu Israa'iil ah.
english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay arkeen Ilaahii reer binu Israa'iil; oo waxaa cagihiisa ka hooseeyey sallax dhagax safayr ah oo sida samada u daahirsan.
english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

kikuyu: Oo odayaashii reer binu Israa'iilna far ma uu saarin, oo Ilaah bay arkeen, waxna way cuneen oo cabbeen.
english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Bal kaalay oo buurta ii soo fuul, oo halkaas iska joog; oo waxaan ku siinayaa looxyada dhagaxa ah, iyo sharcigii iyo qaynuunnadii aan qoray, inaad iyaga bartid.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Muuse sara kacay, isaga iyo midiidinkiisii Yashuuca, oo Muuse wuxuu fuulay buurtii Ilaah.
english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu odayaashii ku yidhi, Idinku halkan noo jooga, ilaa aan mar kale idiin nimaadno, oo bal eega, waxaa idinla jooga Haaruun iyo Xuur; ku alla kii dacwo qaba, iyaga ha u yimaado.
english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu fuulay buurtii, oo buurtiina waxaa qarisay daruur.
english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

kikuyu: Oo ammaantii Rabbiguna waxay dul joogtay Buur Siinay, oo daruurtuna way qarinaysay intii lix maalmood ah, oo maalintii toddobaad ayaa Rabbigu Muuse uga dhex yeedhay daruurtii.
english: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

kikuyu: Oo muuqashada ammaantii Rabbigu waxay reer binu Israa'iil ula ekayd sidii dab wax gubaya buurta dusheeda.
english: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu galay daruurtii dhexdeeda, oo buurtuu fuulay; oo Muuse wuxuu buurtii fuushanaa afartan maalmood iyo afartan habeen.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu la hadlay Muuse, oo ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaad reer binu Israa'iil ku tidhaahdaa, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Qurbaan ii ururiya, oo nin kasta oo qalbigiisu raalli ka yahay waa inaad ka qaaddaa qurbaankayga.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

kikuyu: Oo qurbaanka aad ka qaadayso waxa weeyaan: dahab, iyo lacag, iyo naxaas,
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

kikuyu: iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan, iyo dhogor riyaad,
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

kikuyu: iyo wanan hargahood oo la caseeyey, iyo adhidibadeed hargahood, iyo qori qudhac ah,
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

kikuyu: iyo saliid laambadda lagu shubo, iyo udgoon lagu daro saliidda lagu subkado, iyo dhir udgoon oo lagu daro uunsiga;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

kikuyu: iyo dhagaxyo onika la yidhaahdo, iyo dhagaxyo loogu dhejiyo eefodka, iyo laabgashiga.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

kikuyu: Oo meel quduus ah ha ii sameeyeen aan iyaga dhex joogee.
english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku tusi doono oo dhan, oo ah hannaanka taambuugga iyo hannaanka alaabtiisa oo dhan, waa inaad sidaas oo kale u samaysaan.
english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

kikuyu: Oo waa inay sanduuq ka sameeyaan qori qudhac ah, oo dhererkiisuna waa inuu ahaadaa laba dhudhun iyo badh, ballaadhkiisuna waa inuu ahaadaa dhudhun iyo badh, sarajooggiisuna waa inuu ahaadaa dhudhun iyo badh.
english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad ku dahaadhaa dahab saafi ah, oo gudaha iyo dibaddaba waa inaad ka dahaadhaa, oo dushiisana waa inaad u samaysaa wax taaj oo kale ah oo dahab ah oo ku wareegsan.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad afar siddo oo dahab ah u yeeshaa, oo aad kaga dhejisaa afarta rukun, oo laba siddo waa inay isku dhinac ku yaalliin, laba siddona waa inay dhinaciisa kale ku yaalliin.
english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad ulo ka samaysaa qori qudhac ah, waana inaad dahab ku dahaadhaa.
english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

kikuyu: Oo ulahana waa inaad gelisaa siddooyinka sanduuqa dhinacyadiisa ku yaal, in sanduuqa lagu qaado.
english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

kikuyu: Oo uluhu waa inay ku jiraan sanduuqa siddooyinkiisa; oo waana inaan iyaga laga bixin marnaba.
english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

kikuyu: Oo sanduuqa gudihiisana waa inaad ku riddaa maragga aan ku siin doono.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

kikuyu: Oo daboolna waa inaad uga samaysaa dahab saafi ah; laba dhudhun iyo badh waa inuu dhererkiisu ahaadaa, ballaadhkiisuna waa inuu ahaadaa dhudhun iyo badh.
english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad laba keruub ka samaysaa dahab la tumay iyagoo daboolka labadiisa madax ka soo taagan.
english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Keruub waa inaad madax ka samaysaa, keruubka kalena waa inaad madaxa kale ka samaysaa; oo labada keruub oo labada madax ka kala taagan iyo daboolka waa inaad isku waslad ka wada samaysaan.
english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Oo keruubiimtu waa inay baalashooda meel sare ka soo kala bixiyaan, iyagoo baalashooda ku qarinaya daboolka, oo wejiyadoodu isku soo jeedaan, oo keruubiimta wejiyadooduna waa inay ku soo jeedaan daboolka.
english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Oo daboolkana waa inaad sanduuqa dushiisa saartaa; oo sanduuqa gudihiisana waa inaad ku riddaa maragga aan ku siin doono.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

kikuyu: Oo halkaasaan kugula kulmi doonaa, oo waxaan kaala hadli doonaa daboolka dushiisa, iyo labada keruub oo sanduuqa maragga dul saaran dhexdooda, oo waxaan kuu sheegi doonaa waxyaalaha aan ku siin doono oo dhan oo aan amar ahaan kuugu dhiibi doono reer binu Israa'iil.
english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad miis ka samaysaa qori qudhac ah, oo dhererkiisu ha ahaado laba dhudhun, ballaadhkiisuna ha ahaado dhudhun, sarajooggiisuna ha ahaado dhudhun iyo badh.
