english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad dahab saafi ah ku dahaadhaa, waana inaad u samaysaa wax taaj oo kale ah oo dahab ah oo ku wareegsan.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad qar le'eg calaacal ballaadhkeed oo ku wareegsan u samaysaa, oo waa inaad qarka u samaysaa wax taaj oo kale ah oo dahab ah oo ku wada wareegsan.
english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad afar siddo oo dahab ah u yeeshaa, oo siddooyinkana waa inaad ku dhejisaa afarta gees oo rukummada ah.
english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

kikuyu: Oo meel qarka ku dhow waa inay siddooyinku ku yaalliin, iyagoo ah meelaha laga geliyo ulaha miiska lagu qaado.
english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

kikuyu: Oo ulaha waa inaad qori qudhac ah ka samaysaa, oo aad dahab ku dahaadhaa, in miiska lagu qaado iyaga.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad u samaysaa suxuuntiisa, iyo malqacadihiisa, iyo kidhliyadiisa, iyo maddiibadihiisa wax lagaga shubo, oo waa inaad dahab saafi ah ka wada samaysaa.
english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

kikuyu: Oo miiska dushiisana waa inaad kibistii tusniinta saartaa, hana taallo hortayda had iyo goorba.
english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

kikuyu: Oo laambad waa inaad dahab saafi ah ka samaysaa, oo laambaddii waa in dahab laga tumaa, xataa salkeeda iyo usheeda dhexe, iyo koobabkeeda, iyo burooyinkeeda, iyo ubaxeeduba, waa inay isku waslad la ahaadaan.
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Dhinacyadana waa in lix laamood ka baxdaa; saddex laamood waa inay laambadda dhinac kaga yaalliin, saddexda kalena waa inay dhinaca kale kaga yaalliin.
english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

kikuyu: Saddex koob oo yicib ubaxeed u eg, iyo buro iyo ubax waa inay isku laan ku yaalliin, oo saddex koob oo yicib ubaxeed u eg iyo buro iyo ubaxna waa inay ku yaalliin laanta kale; oo lixda laamood oo laambadda ka baxdaa waa inay sidaas wada ahaadaan.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

kikuyu: Oo laambadduna waa inay lahaataa afar koob oo u eg yicib ubaxeed, iyo burooyinkoodii, iyo ubaxoodii;
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kikuyu: iyo buro oo laba laamood ka hoosaysa oo ay isku waslad la yihiin, iyo buro kale oo laba laamood ka hoosaysa oo ay isku waslad la yihiin, iyo buro kale oo laba laamood ka hoosaysa oo ay isku waslad la yihiin, oo waa inay lixda laamood oo laambadda ka baxday sidaas wada ahaadaan.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

kikuyu: Burooyinkooda iyo laamahooduba waa inay isku waslad la ahaadaan, oo kulligeedna waa inay ahaataa isku waslad dahab la tumay oo saafi ah.
english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad toddoba laambadood ka dhigtaa, oo laambadaheeda waa in la shidaa inay hortooda iftiimiyaan.
english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

kikuyu: Oo birqaabyadeeda iyo alaabteeda lagu safeeyoba waa inay dahab saafi ah ahaadaan.
english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

kikuyu: Oo iyada iyo alaabtan oo dhanba waa in talanti dahab saafi ah laga sameeyaa.
english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

kikuyu: Oo sida hannaankii lagugu tusay buurta waa inaad u samaysaa.
english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waa inaad samaysaa taambuugga toban daah leh, oo waxaad ka samaysaa maro wanaagsan, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, oo lagu daabacay keruubiim.
english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Oo daah walba dhererkiisu waa inuu ahaadaa siddeed iyo labaatan dhudhun, daah walba ballaadhkiisuna waa inuu ahaadaa afar dhudhun; oo daahyada oo dhammuna waa inay isku qiyaas ahaadaan.
english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: Shan daah waa inay isku xidhnaadaan, oo shanta daah oo kalena waa inay isku wada xidhnaadaan.
english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

kikuyu: Oo daahyada midkood waa inaad darafta uu ka laaban yahay u yeeshaa siddooyin buluug ah, oo sidaas oo kalena waa inaad ka yeeshaa daaha dibadda ugu xiga laabka labaad.
english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Isku daah waa inaad konton siddo u yeeshaa; oo daaha ku yaal laabka labaad waa inaad daraftiisa u yeeshaa konton siddo; oo siddooyinkuna waa in midkoodba kan kale ka hor jeedaa.
english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

kikuyu: Waa inaad konton qabsato oo dahab ah samaysaa, oo daahyadana waa inaad midba kan kale qabsatooyinka kula xidhaa, oo taambuuggana waa inuu mid dhan ahaadaa.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad daahyo ah dhogor riyaad samaysaa oo aad taambuugga ku deddaa; oo waa inaad iyaga ka dhigtaa koob iyo toban daah.
english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

kikuyu: Oo daah kasta dhererkiisu waa inuu soddon dhudhun ahaadaa, daah kasta ballaadhkiisuna waa inuu afar dhudhun ahaadaa; oo koob iyo tobanka daah waa inay isku qiyaas ahaadaan.
english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad shan daah gooni ahaantooda isugu xidhaa, lix daahna gooni ahaantooda isugu xidh, oo daaha lixaad waa inaad ku labanlaabtaa teendhada fooddeeda.
english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

kikuyu: Oo daaha dibadda u xiga laabka daraftiisa waa inaad konton siddo u yeeshaa, oo daaha laabka labaad ugu korreeya daraftiisana waa inaad konton siddo u yeeshaa.
english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad samaysaa konton qabsato oo naxaas ah, oo waa inaad qabsatooyinkana sudhaa siddooyinka, oo teendhadana isku xidh kulligeed si ay mid dhan u noqoto.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

kikuyu: Oo inta dusha ka lalmata oo ka hadhay daahyada teendhada, oo ah daaha badhkiisa, waa in laga lalmiyaa taambuugga dabadiisa.
english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Dhudhunka oo dhinaca ah iyo dhudhunka oo dhinaca kale oo ah waxa ka hadha daahyada teendhada dhererkooda waa in laga lalmiyaa dhinacyada taambuugga, oo ah dhankan iyo dhankaasba, inay dedaan.
english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

kikuyu: Oo teendhada waa inaad ded uga dhigtaa wanan hargahood oo la caseeyey, iyo ded ah adhidibadeed hargahood oo ka sarreeya.
english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kikuyu: Oo looxyada taambuuggu ku taagan yahay waa inaad qori qudhac ah ka samaysaa.
english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

kikuyu: Looxiiba dhererkiisu waa inuu toban dhudhun ahaadaa, oo loox kasta ballaadhkiisu waa inuu dhudhun iyo badh ahaadaa.
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

kikuyu: Oo loox kasta waa inuu lahaadaa laba caarad, oo looxyadu waa inay dhinacyada isku hayaan, oo waa inaad sidaas u yeeshaa looxyada taambuugga oo dhan.
english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo dhinaca koonfureed oo taambuugga looxyadiisa waa inaad labaatan loox ka dhigtaa.
english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad samaysaa afartan saldhig oo lacag ah oo ka hooseeya labaatanka loox; oo laba saldhigba waa inay ka hooseeyaan loox inay saldhig u ahaadaan labadiisa caarad, oo laba saldhigna waa inay ka hooseeyaan loox kale inay saldhig u ahaadaan labadiisa caarad.
english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

kikuyu: Oo taambuugga dhankiisa labaad oo woqooyi xiga waa inaad u yeeshaa labaatan loox,
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

kikuyu: iyo afartankoodii saldhig oo lacagta ahayd. Laba saldhigba waa inay loox ka hoosayso.
english: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: Oo meesha ugu dambaysa taambuugga oo ah dhankiisa galbeed waa inaad lix loox u yeeshaa.
english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

kikuyu: Oo laba loox waa inaad u yeeshaa labada geesood oo taambuugga xaggiisa dambe.
english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

kikuyu: Oo waa inay hoosta labanlaab ka noqdaan, oo sidaas oo kalena waa inay dhammaadaan ilaa siddada kowaad dusheeda, oo labaduba waa inay sidaas ahaadaan, oo labada gees baa iska leh.
english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

kikuyu: Oo waa inay ahaadaan siddeed loox, iyo saldhigyadoodii lacagta ahayd oo ah lix iyo toban saldhig, oo laba saldhigba waa inay loox ka hoosayso.
english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad ulo gudban ka samaysa qori qudhac ah; looxyada taambuugga dhinac kaga jira shan ulood u yeel,
english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

kikuyu: looxyada dhinaca kale kaga jirana shan ulood oo kale u yeel, oo shan ulood oo kale u yeel taambuugga looxyadiisa kaga jira dhanka galbeed xaggiisa dambe.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

kikuyu: Oo uldhexaadda oo looxyada ku gudban waa inay gaadhaa gees ilaa gees.
english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

kikuyu: Oo looxyada waa inaad dahab ku dahaadhaa, oo siddooyinkooda ah meelaha ulaha gudban ka gelayaan waxaad ka samaysaa dahab, oo ulahana waa inaad dahab ku dahaadhaa.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

kikuyu: Oo taambuugga waa inaad u taagtaa sidii hannaankii aan buurta kugu tusay.
english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad ilxidh ka samaysaa buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan; hana lagu daabaco keruubiim.
english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad ka soo lalmisaa afar tiir oo qudhac ah oo dahab lagu dahaadhay, iyagoo leh qabsatooyin dahab ah, oo ku taagan afar saldhig oo lacag ah.
english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad ilxidhka ka soo lalmisaa qabsatooyinka hoostooda, oo waxaad soo gelisaa sanduuqa maragga ilxidhka gudihiisa; oo ilxidhkuna wuxuu u dhexeeyaa meesha quduuska ah iyo meesha ugu quduusan idinka aawadiin.
english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

kikuyu: Oo daboolka waa inaad saartaa sanduuqa maragga oo ku jira meesha ugu quduusan.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

kikuyu: Oo miiskana waa inaad dhigtaa ilxidhka dibaddiisa, oo laambaddana waxaad dhigtaa miiska hortiisa oo ah dhanka koonfureed oo taambuugga, miiskana dhanka woqooyi dhig.
english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad iridda Teendhada u samaysaa daah buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan oo daabac leh.
english: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

kikuyu: Oo daaha waa inaad u samaysaa shan tiir oo qudhac ah, oo dahab ku dahaadh iyaga, qabsatooyinkooduna ha ahaadeen dahab; oo waa inaad shan saldhig oo naxaas ah u yeeshaa.
english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

kikuyu: Oo meesha allabariga waa inaad ka samaysaa qori qudhac ah, dhererkeedu shan dhudhun ha ahaado, ballaadhkeeduna shan dhudhun; oo meesha allabarigu afar geesood ha ahaado, oo sarajooggeeduna saddex dhudhun ha ahaado.
english: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

kikuyu: Oo afarteeda rukun waxaad u yeeshaa afar gees; oo geesaheedu waa inay isku waslad la ahaadaan; oo waa inaad naxaas ku dahaadhaa.
english: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad u samaysaa weelal dambaska lagaga guro, iyo majarafadaheeda, iyo maddiibadaheeda, iyo mudacyadeeda, iyo dabqaadayaasheeda, oo alaabteeda oo dhan waxaad ka samaysaa naxaas.
english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad shabag naxaas ah u yeeshaa; oo shabagga dushiisa waa inaad u yeeshaa afar siddo oo naxaas ah oo ku taal afarta gees.
english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad hoos dhigtaa qarka ku wareegsan meesha allabariga, inuu shabaggu gaadho meesha allabariga kalabadhkeeda.
english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

kikuyu: Oo meesha allabariga waa inaad u yeeshaa ulo qudhac ah oo lagu qaado, oo waxaad ku dahaadhaa naxaas.
english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

kikuyu: Oo ulaheeda waa in siddooyinka laga geliyaa, oo uluhu waa inay meesha allabariga labada dhinac kaga jiraan ha lagu qaadee.
english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad iyada ka samaysaa looxyo, sida sanduuq madhan oo kale, oo sidii buurta lagugu tusay ha u sameeyeen.
english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad samaysaa barxadda taambuugga; oo barxadda dhinaceeda koonfureed waxaad ka lalmisaa daah maro wanaagsan ah oo dhererkiisu yahay boqol dhudhun,
english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

kikuyu: oo tiirarkiisuna waa inay ahaadaan labaatan, iyo labaatan saldhig oo naxaas ah, oo tiirarka qabsatooyinkooda iyo waxyaalaha laysugu wada xidhaa waa inay lacag ahaadaan.
english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

kikuyu: Oo sidaas oo kale waa inaad dhinaca woqooyina ka lalmisaa daah ah boqol dhudhun, oo tiirarkiisuna ha ahaadeen labaatan, iyo labaatan saldhig oo naxaas ah, oo tiirarka qabsatooyinkooda iyo waxyaalaha laysugu wada xidhaana lacag ha ahaadeen.
english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Oo barxadda dhinaca galbeed ballaadhkeeda waxaad ka lalmisaa daah konton dhudhun ah, oo tiirarkiisu ha ahaadeen toban, saldhigyadooduna toban.
english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

kikuyu: Oo barxadda dhinaca bari ballaadhkeedu waa inuu konton dhudhun ahaado.
english: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

kikuyu: Oo iridda dhinaceeda waxaad ka lalmisaa daah shan iyo toban dhudhun ah; tiirarkiisuna waa inay ahaadaan saddex, saldhigyadooduna saddex.
english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Oo dhinaca kalena waxaad ka lalmisaa daah shan iyo toban dhudhun ah, tiirarkiisuna waa inay ahaadaan saddex, saldhigyadooduna saddex.
english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Oo barxadda iriddeeda waxaad u yeeshaa daah labaatan dhudhun ah, oo ah buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan oo daabac laga sameeyey, tiirarkiisu ha ahaadeen afar, saldhigyadooduna afar.
english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

kikuyu: Oo tiirarka barxadda ku wareegsan oo dhan waa in lacag laysugu wada xidhaa; oo qabsatooyinkooduna waa inay lacag ahaadaan, saldhigyadooduna waa inay naxaas ahaadaan.
english: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

kikuyu: Barxadda dhererkeedu waa inuu ahaado boqol dhudhun, oo ballaadhkeeduna waa inuu meel walba u ahaadaa konton dhudhun, sarajooggeeduna waa inuu ahaado shan dhudhun, kana samee maro wanaagsan oo saldhigyadooduna ha ahaadeen naxaas.
english: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

kikuyu: Oo alaabta taambuugga lagaga adeego oo dhan, iyo musmaarradiisa oo dhan, iyo barxadda musmaarradeeda oo dhammu waa inay naxaas wada ahaadaan.
english: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad reer binu Israa'iil ku amartaa inay kuu keenaan saliid saafi ah oo saytuun laga tumay oo laambadda lagu shido, si ay laambaddu had iyo goor u baxdo.
english: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

kikuyu: Taambuugga shirka gudihiisa oo ku yaal ilxidhka dibaddiisa, kuna hor yaalla maragga, fiidka ilaa subaxda waa inay Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu Rabbiga hortiisa ku diyaariyaan laambadda; oo wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil u noqon doonaa qaynuun weligiis u jira ka ab ka ab.
english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo soo kaxayso walaalkaa Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa, oo kala soo dhex bax reer binu Israa'iil, inuu iiga adeego hawsha wadaadnimada, kuwaasu waxa weeyaan Haaruun qudhiisa iyo Naadaab, iyo Abiihuu, iyo Elecaasaar, iyo Iitaamaar oo wada ah wiilashii Haaruun.
english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

kikuyu: Oo walaalkaa Haaruun waa inaad u samaysaa dhar quduus ah, ammaan iyo qurux aawadood.
english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad la hadashaa kulli inta qalbigooda xigmadu ku jirto, oo aan ruuxii xigmadda ka buuxiyey, inay Haaruun dharkiisa u sameeyaan oo ay isaga quduus ka dhigaan inuu iiga adeego hawsha wadaadnimada.
english: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Oo dharka ay u samaynayaanna waxa weeyaan laabgashi, iyo eefod, iyo khamiis, iyo jubbad, iyo duub, iyo dhex-xidh, oo waa inay dhar quduus ah u sameeyaan walaalkaa Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa, inuu iiga adeego hawsha wadaadnimada.
english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Oo ha qaateen dahab, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan.
english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

kikuyu: Oo eefodka ha ka sameeyeen dahab, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan, oo daabacna ha lagu sameeyo.
english: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

kikuyu: Waa inuu lahaadaa laba garab oo is-haysta oo ku xidhan labadiisa daraf, inuu iswada haysto kulligii.
english: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

kikuyu: Oo dhex-xidhka daabaca leh oo dusha kaga yaal in lagu xidho waa in isku si loo sameeyaa oo uu isku waslad la ahaadaa; oo ha ahaado dahab, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan.
english: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad qaadataa laba dhagax oo onika la yidhaahdo, oo waxaad dushooda ku xaradhaa magacyada reer binu Israa'iil;
english: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: magacyadooda lix waa inaad isku dhagax ku dhigtaa, oo lixda magac oo hadhayna waa inaad dhagaxa kale ku dhigtaa, siday u kala hor dhasheen.
english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

kikuyu: Sida shuqulka dhagax-xardhihii waa inaad labada dhagax u xaradhaa xaradh u eg xaradhka shaabadda, oo waana inaad ku dhigtaa magacyadii reer binu Israa'iil; oo waa inaad saldhigyo dahab ah ku dhejisaa.
english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

kikuyu: Oo labada dhagax waa inaad ku dhejisaa eefodka garbihiisa inay dhagaxyo xusuus ah u noqdaan reer binu Israa'iil, oo Haaruun waa inuu Rabbiga hortiisa magacyadooda ku qaadaa garbihiisa xusuus ahaan aawadeed.
english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad u samaysaa saldhigyo dahab ah,
english: You shall make settings of gold,

kikuyu: oo waa inaad u samaysaa laba silsiladood oo ah dahab saafi ah, oo waxaad u samaysaa sida wax xadhko u eg oo tidcan, oo silsiladaha isku tidcan waa inaad ku xidhaa saldhigyada.
english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad samaysaa laabgashi xukumaadeed, oo daabacna ha lagu sameeyo; oo waa inaad u samaysaa sida samaynta eefodka; waana inaad ka samaysaa dahab, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan.
english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

kikuyu: Waa inuu ahaadaa afargeesood oo isku laalaaban; dhererkiisuna ha ahaado taako, ballaadhkiisuna ha ahaado taako.
english: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad afar saf oo dhagaxyo ah ku dul dhejisaa; safka kowaad ha ahaado sardiyos, iyo tobasiyos, iyo mid birqaya;
english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

kikuyu: safka labaadna ha ahaado sumurud, iyo safayr, iyo dheemman;
english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

kikuyu: safka saddexaadna ha ahaado yakintos, iyo agate, iyo ametustos;
english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

kikuyu: safka afraadna ha ahaado berullos, iyo onika, iyo yasbid; oo waa in lagu dhejiyo saldhigyo dahab ah.
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

kikuyu: Oo dhagaxyadu waa inay tiro le'ekaadaan sida magacyada reer binu Israa'iil, ha ahaadeen laba iyo toban sida magacyadooda, oo laba iyo tobanka qabiil waa in mid kasta magiciisa lagu xardho sida xaradhka shaabadda.
english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

kikuyu: Oo laabgashiga waxaad ku samaysaa silsilado xadhko u eg oo laga tidcay dahab saafi ah.
english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Oo laabgashiga waxaad ku samaysaa laba siddo oo dahab ah, oo labada siddo waxaad sudhaa laabgashiga labadiisa darfood.
english: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Oo labada silsiladood oo tidcan oo dahabka ah waxaad ku xidhaa labada siddo oo ku yaal laabgashiga labadiisa darfood.
english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Oo labada silsiladood oo tidcan labadooda madax oo kale waxaad ku xidhaa labada saldhig, oo waxaad ku xidhaa eefodka garbihiisa xaggooda hore.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad samaysaa laba siddo oo dahab ah, oo waxaad soo sudhaa laabgashiga labadiisa darfood oo gudaha oo eefodka xiga.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad samaysaa laba siddo oo dahab ah, oo waxaad ku xidhaa eefodka labadiisa garab xaggooda hoose oo dhanka hore ku yaal, oo ku dhow meeshay isku xidhmaan, oo ka sarreeya eefodka dhex-xidhkiisa oo daabaca ah.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Oo laabgashiga waa inay siddooyinkiisa ku xidhaan siddooyinkii eefodka oo ha kula xidheen shalash buluug ah, inuu ku dul xidnaado dhex-xidhka daabaca ah oo eefodka, iyo inuusan laabgashigu ka furnaan eefodka.
english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

kikuyu: Oo magacyada reer binu Israa'iil waa in Haaruun ku qaadaa laabgashiga xukumaadda oo qalbigiisa saaran markuu galo meesha quduuska ah, inay xusuus noqdaan Rabbiga hortiisa had iyo goor.
english: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: Oo laabgashiga xukumaadda waa inaad gelisaa Uuriimka iyo Tummiimka, oo waa inay Haaruun qalbigiisa saarnaadaan markuu Rabbiga hortiisa tago; oo Haaruun waa inuu qalbigiisa ku qaadaa xukumaadda reer binu Israa'iil had iyo goorba.
english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: Oo khamiiska eefodka kulligiis waa inaad ka dhigtaa buluug.
english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

kikuyu: Oo waa inuu meel daloosha oo madaxu maro ku lahaadaa; oo waa inuu ahaado sida dhar leh tolmo wanaagsan oo daloolkiisa ku wareegsan inuusan dillaacin aawadeed.
english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

kikuyu: Oo khamiiska daraftiisa hoose waxaad u yeeshaa rummaanno oo ah buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, oo ku wada wareeji daraftiisa hareeraheeda oo dhan; oo dawanno dahab ahna dhexdooda geli oo ku wareeji.
english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

kikuyu: Dawan dahab ah iyo rummaan, haddana dawan dahab ah iyo rummaan, waa inaad ku wareejisaa khamiiska daraftiisa.
english: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun waa inuu gashado inuu ku adeego; oo sanqadhiisana waa la maqli doonaa markuu tago Rabbiga hortiisa oo uu galo meesha quduuska ah, iyo markii uu ka soo baxaba, inuusan dhiman aawadeed.
english: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he not die.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad samaysaa waslad khafiifa oo dahab saafiya ah, waxaad ku xaradhaa xaradhka u eg xaradhka shaabadda oo leh, WAA U QUDUUS RABBIGA.
english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO THE LORD.’

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad ku xidhaa shalash buluug ah, oo ku dhejisaa duubka, oo duubka intiisa hore ha ku taallo.
english: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.

kikuyu: Oo ha ku taallo Haaruun fooddiisa, Oo Haaruun baa qaadi doona dembiga alaabta quduuska ah, oo ay reer binu Israa'iil quduus kaga dhigi doonaan hadiyadahooda quduuska ah; oo mar kasta waxay ku oolli doontaa fooddiisa, in iyaga laga aqbalo Rabbiga hortiisa.
english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo jubbadda marada wanaagsan laga sameeyey waa inaad daabacdaa oo waa inaad duub ka samaysaa maro wanaagsan, oo dhex-xidh waa inaad ka samaysaa daabac.
english: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

kikuyu: Oo wiilasha Haaruunna waa inaad u samaysaa jubbado iyo dhex-xidho, iyo duubab, iyagu ha u ahaadeen ammaan iyo qurux.
english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad dharkaas u lebbistaa walaalkaa Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa la joogaba; oo waa inaad iyaga subagtaa, oo daahirisaa oo quduus ka dhigtaa, inay iiga adeegaan hawsha wadaadnimada.
english: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad iyaga u samaysaa sirwaallo maro wanaagsan ah oo gaadha dhexdooda ilaa bowdyahooda, oo ay ku qariyaan cawradooda;
english: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

kikuyu: Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu waa inay gashadaan markay galaan taambuugga shirka ama markay meesha allabariga u dhowaadaan inay ka dhex adeegaan meesha quduuska ah inaanay dembi qaadin oo dhiman. Waxay isaga iyo farcankiisa ka dambeeyaba ku noqon doontaa qaynuun weligiis ah.
english: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.

kikuyu: Oo waxyaalahan waa waxa aad ku samayso iyaga inaad quduus ka dhigtid inay iiga adeegaan hawsha wadaadnimada; waxaad wadataa dibi yar iyo laba wan oo aan iin lahayn,
english: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

kikuyu: iyo kibis aan khamiir lahayn, iyo moofo aan khamiir lahayn oo saliid lagu daray, iyo canjeero aan khamiir lahayn oo saliidu marsan tahay, oo waxaad ka samaysaa bur wanaagsan oo sarreen ah.
english: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad isku dambiil ku riddaa oo dambiisha ku keentaa, adigoo wada dibigii iyo labadii wan.
english: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa waa inaad ilaa iridda teendhada shirka keentaa, oo waa inaad biyo ugu maydhaa.
english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad qaadataa dharkii, oo waxaad Haaruun u gelisaa jubbadda, iyo khamiiska eefodka, iyo eefodka, iyo laabgashiga, oo dhexdana waxaad ugu xidhaa dhex-xidhka daabaca leh oo eefodka;
english: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: oo duubkana waa inaad madaxiisa saartaa, oo taajka quduuska ahna duubka saar.
english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

kikuyu: Oo markaas waxaad qaadataa saliidda lagu subkado, oo madaxiisa ku shub, oo ugu subag isaga.
english: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad soo kaxaysaa wiilashiisa oo iyagana jubbado u geli.
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

kikuyu: Oo dhex-xidho ugu xidh, duubabna u duub Haaruun iyo wiilashiisaba; oo qaynuun weligiis ah ayay hawsha wadaadnimada ku lahaan doonaan, oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisaba waa inaad quduus ka dhigtaa.
english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

kikuyu: Oo dibiga waxaad keentaa teendhada shirka horteeda, Haaruun iyo wiilashiisuna gacmaha ha dul saareen dibiga madaxiisa.
english: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

kikuyu: Oo dibiga waxaad ku qashaa Rabbiga hortiisa xagga iridda teendhada shirka.
english: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad qaaddaa dibiga dhiiggiisa, oo fartaada ku mari meesha allabariga geesaheeda; oo dhiigga oo dhan waxaad ku qubtaa meesha allabariga hoosteeda.
english: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad qaaddaa xaydha gudaha ku jirta oo dhan, iyo xuubka beerka ku dul yaal, iyo labada kelyood, iyo xaydha dushooda ku taal, oo meesha allabariga ku dul gub.
english: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

kikuyu: Laakiinse dibiga hilibkiisa iyo haraggiisa iyo uuskiisaba waxaad ku gubtaa xerada dibaddeeda; waayo, waa qurbaan dembi loo bixiyey.
english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaad qaaddaa wan; oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisuna gacmaha ha dul saareen wanka madaxiisa.
english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Oo markaas waa inaad wanka gowracdaa, oo dhiiggiisa intaad qaadatid waxaad ku dul rushaysaa meesha allabariga.
english: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

kikuyu: Oo markaas waa inaad wanka kala googooysaa, oo waxaad maydhaa uurkujirtiisa iyo lugihiisa, oo meel la dhig googo'iisa iyo madaxiisaba.
english: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

kikuyu: Oo wanka oo dhan waa inaad ku dul gubtaa meesha allabariga, waayo, waa qurbaan Rabbiga loo gubo; oo waa caraf udgoon oo waa qurbaan dab loogu sameeyo Rabbiga.
english: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaad qaaddaa wanka kale; oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisuna gacmaha ha dul saareen wanka madaxiisa.
english: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Oo markaas waa inaad wanka gowracdaa, oo dhiiggiisa intaad qaadatid waxaad marisaa dhegta midig oo Haaruun caaraddeeda, iyo dhegta midig oo wiilashiisa caaraddeeda, iyo suulka gacantooda midig, iyo suulka cagtooda midig, oo haddana waxaad dhiigga ku dul rushaysaa meesha allabariga.
english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad qaaddaa dhiigga meesha allabariga ku dul yaal, iyo saliidda lagu subkado, oo waxaad ku rushaysaa Haaruun, iyo dharkiisa, iyo wiilashiisa, iyo dharkii wiilashiisa isaga la jooga; oo waa in quduus laga dhigaa isaga, iyo dharkiisa, iyo wiilashiisa, iyo dharkii wiilashiisa isaga la jooga.
english: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad kaloo qaaddaa wanka baruurtiisa, iyo badhidiisa, iyo xaydhiisa gudaha ku duuban, iyo xuubka beerka ku dul yaal, iyo labadiisa kelyood iyo xaydhooda, iyo bowdada midigta ah; waayo, waa wanka quduuskadhigidda.
english: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

kikuyu: Oo dambiisha hor taal Rabbiga oo ay ku jirto kibista aan khamiirka lahaynu waxaad kala soo baxdaa xabbad kibis ah, iyo xabbad ah moofo saliid leh, iyo xabbad canjeero ah;
english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.

kikuyu: oo kulligood waxaad saartaa gacmaha Haaruun, iyo gacmaha wiilashiisa, oo Rabbiga hortiisa ku ruxrux inay ahaadaan qurbaanka la ruxruxo.
english: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo markaas waa inaad gacmahooda ka qaaddid, oo waxaad ku dul gubtaa qurbaanka la gubo oo meesha allabariga kor yaal, inay caraf udgoon ku ahaadaan Rabbiga hortiisa. Waa qurbaan dab loogu sameeyey Rabbiga.
english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad qaaddaa Haaruun wankiisa quduuskadhigidda sakaarkiisa, oo Rabbiga hortiisa ku ruxrux sidii qurbaanka la ruxruxo, oo wuxuuna noqon doonaa qaybtaada.
english: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be your portion.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad quduus ka dhigtaa sakaarka qurbaanka la ruxruxo, iyo bowdada qurbaanka sare loo qaado, oo la ruxruxo, oo sarena loo qaado, ee wanka quduuskadhigidda, xataa qaybta Haaruun iyo qaybta wiilashiisaba,
english: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

kikuyu: oo intaas waa inay Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu amar ahaan uga lahaadaan reer binu Israa'iil weligoodba, waayo, waa qurbaan sare loo qaado; waana inay ahaato qurbaan sare loo qaado, oo ay reer binu Israa'iil bixiyaan markay ku allabaryaan qurbaannadooda nabaadiinada. Waa qurbaankooda sare loogu qaado Rabbiga.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo dharka Haaruun oo quduuska ah waxaa qaadan doona wiilashiisa isaga dabadiis, si loogu subko oo quduus looga dhigo iyagoo gashan.
english: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

kikuyu: Oo wiilka isaga meeshiisa wadaad ka noqdaa toddoba maalmood waa inuu gashanaadaa markuu teendhada shirka galo inuu ka adeego meesha quduuska ah.
english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad qaaddaa wanka quduuskadhigidda, oo hilibkiisa waxaad ku karisaa meel quduus ah.
english: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu waa inay hilibka wanka iyo kibista ku jirta dambiisha cunaan xagga iridda taambuugga shirka.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo waa inay cunaan waxyaalahaas lagu kafaaro guday, inay daahir iyo quduus ku noqdaan; laakiinse qof qalaadu yaanu waxba ka cunin, waayo, iyagu waa quduus.
english: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

kikuyu: Oo haddii hilibka quduuskadhigidda iyo kibista wax ka hadhaan oo ay gaadhaan ilaa subaxda, de markaas waa inaad intii hadhay dab ku gubtaa, oo waa inaan la cunin, maxaa yeelay, waa quduus.
english: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa waxaad ku samaysaa sidii aan kugu amray oo dhan, oo toddoba maalmood waa inaad iyaga quduus ka dhigtaa.
english: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

kikuyu: Maalin walba waa inaad dibiga qurbaanka dembiga u bixisaa kafaaraggud aawadiis, oo meesha allabarigana waa inaad daahirisaa markaad u kafaaro gudaysid, oo waa inaad subagtaa inaad quduus ka dhigtid.
english: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

kikuyu: Oo toddoba maalmood waa inaad meesha allabariga u kafaaro guddaa oo quduus ka dhigtaa, oo meesha allabarigu waa inay ugu wada quduusnaataa, oo wax kasta oo meesha allabariga taabtaa quduus wuu noqon doonaa.
english: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxanu waa wixii aad meesha allabariga ku dul bixin lahayd; maalin walba had iyo goor waa inaad laba wan oo sannad jira ku bixisaa.
english: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

kikuyu: Wan waa inaad subaxda bixisaa, wanka kalena waa inaad makhribka bixisaa.
english: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

kikuyu: Oo bur wanaagsan oo hiin rubuceed oo saliid saafi ah lagu daray toban meelood oo meel waa inaad wanka la bixisaa, iyo weliba hiin rubuceed oo khamri ah oo ah qurbaankii cabniinka.
english: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo wanka kalena waa inaad makhribka bixisaa, oo waxaad u bixisaa sida qurbaanka hadhuudhka ah oo subaxda, iyo qurbaanka cabniinka oo subaxda, caraf udgoon ha lahaado hana ahaado qurbaan Rabbiga dab loogu sameeyo.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ka ab ka ab ahaan doonaa qurbaan joogto ah oo Rabbiga hortiisa lagu gubo xagga iridda taambuugga shirka, oo ah meesha aan kugula kulmi doono inaan kula hadlo aawadeed.
english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

kikuyu: Oo halkaas reer binu Israa'iil ayaan kula kulmi doonaa; oo taambuugguna wuxuu quduus ku noqon doonaa ammaantayda.
english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan quduus ka dhigi doonaa taambuugga shirka iyo meesha allabariga; oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisana quduus baan ka dhigi doonaa, inay hawsha wadaadnimada iiga adeegaan.
english: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Oo anigu waxaan dhex joogi doonaa reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxaan ahaan doonaa Ilaahood.
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu waxay ogaan doonaan inaan anigu ahay Rabbiga Ilaahood ah oo iyaga dalkii Masar ka soo bixiyey inaan iyaga dhex joogo. Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga ah Ilaahood.
english: They shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad samaysaa meel allabari oo foox lagu shido; waxaadna ka samaysaa qori qudhac ah.
english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

kikuyu: Oo dhererkeeduna ha ahaado dhudhun, ballaadhkeeduna ha ahaado dhudhun, afar geesoodna waa inay lahaataa, sarajooggeeduna ha ahaado laba dhudhun, oo geesaheeduna waa inay isku waslad la ahaadaan.
english: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad dahab saafi ah ku dahaadhaa dusheeda iyo dhinacyadeeda ku wareegsan iyo geesaheedaba; oo waxaad u samaysaa wax taaj oo kale ah oo dahab ah oo ku wareegsan.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Oo qarkeeda hoostiisa waa inaad laba siddo oo dahab ah ugu yeeshaa labada rukun; labada dhinac waa inaad sidaas u yeeshaa, oo waxay u noqon doonaan meelihii ulaha lagu qaado laga gelin lahaa.
english: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad ulaha ka samaysaa qori qudhac ah, waana inaad dahab ku dahaadhaa.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad hor dhigtaa ilxidhka u dhow sanduuqa maragga oo hor yaal daboolka ka sarreeya maragga, halkaas oo ah meesha aan kugula kulmi doono.
english: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun waa inuu ku shido foox udgoon; subax walba markuu laambadaha hagaajinayo waa inuu foox shido.
english: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

kikuyu: Oo makhribka Haaruun markuu laambadaha shidayo waa inuu foox shido, kaasoo ah foox joogto u ah Rabbiga hortiisa, ka ab ka ab.
english: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaydnaan dusheeda ku bixin foox qalaad, ama qurbaan la gubo, ama qurbaan hadhuudh ah, oo dusheedana ha ku daadinina qurbaan cabniin ah.
english: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.

kikuyu: Geesaheedana sannaddiiba mar Haaruun waa inuu ku dul kafaaro gudo; oo dhiigga allabariga dembiga oo kafaaraggud ah sannaddiiba mar waa inuu ku kafaaro gudo tan iyo ka ab ka ab. Waa kan ugu wada quduusan Rabbiga.
english: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to the LORD.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Markaad reer binu Israa'iil tirinaysid, intii ay tiradoodu noqoto oo dhan, nin waluba waa inuu Rabbiga siiyo madaxfurashadiisa, markaad tirisid; si aan belaayo ugu dhicin markaad iyaga tirisid.
english: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to the LORD when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.

kikuyu: Oo waxan waa inay bixiyaan, nin walba oo u gudba kuwa la tiriyey waa inuu bixiyaa nus sheqel le'eg sheqelkii meesha quduuska ah: (sheqelku waa labaatan geeraah:) nus sheqel waa in Rabbiga loo bixiyaa.
english: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo mid kasta oo u gudba kuwa la tiriyey oo ah inta jirta labaatan sannadood iyo wixii ka sii weyn, waa inuu bixiyaa Rabbiga wixiisa.
english: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Markay Rabbiga wixiisa u bixinayaan inay nafihiinna u kafaaro gudaan, kii taajir ahu waa inaanu bixin wax nus sheqel ka badan, kii miskiin ahuna waa inaanu bixin wax nus sheqel ka yar.
english: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad reer binu Israa'iil ka qaaddaa lacagta kafaaraggudka ah, oo aad wax kaga qabataa hawsha taambuugga shirka, inay reer binu Israa'iil u noqoto xusuus Rabbiga hortiisa, si aad nafihiinna ugu kafaaro guddaan.
english: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaad samaysaa berked weyso oo naxaas ah, salkeedana waxaad ka samaysaa naxaas, oo waxaad dhigtaa meel u dhexaysa taambuugga shirka iyo meesha allabariga; oo waa inaad biyo ku shubtaa, ha lagu maydho e.
english: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

kikuyu: Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu waa inay gacmaha iyo cagaha ku dhaqdaan:
english: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.

kikuyu: oo markay gelayaan taambuugga shirka waa inay biyo ku maydhaan, yaanay dhimanine, ama markay meesha allabariga ag yimaadaan inay ka adeegaan oo ay gubaan qurbaan Rabbiga dab loogu sameeyo,
english: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: waa inay gacmaha iyo cagahaba dhaqdaan, yaanay dhimanine; oo wuxuu iyaga u noqon doonaa qaynuun weligiis ah, xataa xagga isaga iyo farcankiisa ka dambeeyaba ka ab ka ab.
english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”

kikuyu: Oo markaasuu haddana Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo ku yidhi,
english: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaad qaadataa dhir udgoon oo wacan, oo ah shan boqol oo sheqel oo ah malmal asli ah, iyo badhkiis oo qorfe macaan ah, oo ah laba boqol iyo konton sheqel, iyo laba boqol iyo konton sheqel oo ah kalamus,
english: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

kikuyu: iyo shan boqol oo sheqel oo ah kasiya, oo le'eg sheqelka meesha quduuska ah, iyo hiin muggeed oo saliid saytuun ah.
english: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad ka samaysaa saliid lagu subkado oo quduus ah, taas oo ah cadar laysku daray sidii kan cadarsameeyaha oo kale; oo waxay noqon doontaa saliid lagu subkado oo quduus ah.
english: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad ku subagtaa taambuugga shirka iyo sanduuqa maragga,
english: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,

kikuyu: iyo miiska iyo alaabtiisa oo dhan, iyo laambadda iyo alaabteeda, iyo meesha allabariga ee fooxa,
english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

kikuyu: iyo meesha allabariga lagu gubo iyo alaabteeda oo dhan, iyo berkedda weysada iyo salkeedaba.
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad iyaga quduus ka dhigtaa, inay noqdaan kuwa ugu wada quduusan; oo wax kasta oo iyaga taabtaaba waxay noqon doonaan quduus.
english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisaba waa inaad u subagtaa oo quduus ka dhigtaa, inay iiga adeegaan hawsha wadaadnimada.
english: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad la hadashaa reer binu Israa'iil oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Tanu waxay ka ab ka ab ii noqon doontaa saliid lagu subkado oo quduus ah.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Haddaba waa inaan dad jidhkiisa lagu shubin, ama waa inaydnaan samayn mid la mid ah, oo sideeda oo kale loo sameeyey, waayo, iyadu waa quduus, oo waxay idiin noqon doontaa quduus.
english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii taas oo kale sameeya, ama ku alla kii qof qalaad mariya, dadkiisa waa laga gooyn doonaa.
english: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Waxaad qaadataa uunsi udgoon oo ah istakte iyo onika iyo galbanum, iyagoo ah uunsi ay ku jirto beeyo saafi ah, oo miisaankooduna ha iswada le'ekaado.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad ka samaysaa foox, kaas oo loo sameeyey sida cadarsameeyuhu uu u sameeyo oo kale, oo cusbo lagu daray, oo saafi ah, quduusna ah.
english: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

kikuyu: Oo qaarkiis waa inaad tuntaa oo yaryaraysaa, oo waxaad hor dhigtaa maragga ku jira taambuugga shirka, taasoo ah meesha aan kugula kulmi doono; oo waxay idiin noqon doontaa kan ugu wada quduusan.
english: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

kikuyu: Oo fooxa aad samayn doontaan sidiisa ha u samaysanina; waayo, wuxuu kuu noqon doonaa quduus Rabbiga aawadiis.
english: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii kaas oo kale sameeya, inuu ku udgoonsado, kaas dadkiisa waa laga gooyn doonaa.
english: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Bal eeg, magac baan ugu yeedhay Besaleel ina Uurii, oo ah ina Xuur, qabiilkiisuna yahay Yahuudah;
english: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

kikuyu: oo waxaan isaga ka buuxiyey Ruuxa Ilaah, xagga xigmadda, iyo waxgarashada, iyo aqoonta, iyo sancada cayn kasta ah,
english: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

kikuyu: inuu shuqullo yaab leh hindiso, oo uu ka shaqeeyo dahabka, iyo lacagta, iyo naxaasta,
english: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

kikuyu: iyo inuu qoro dhagaxyada saldhigyo lagu dhejiyo oo uu looxyada xardho, iyo inuu ka shaqeeyo sanco cayn kasta ah.
english: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaan isaga la doortay Aaholii'aab oo ah ina Axiisaamaag, oo qabiilkiisu yahay Daan; oo inta xigmadda leh oo dhan waxaan qalbigooda geliyey xigmad, inay sameeyaan wixii aan kugu amray oo dhan;
english: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

kikuyu: kuwaasoo ah taambuugga shirka, iyo sanduuqa maragga, iyo daboolka dul saaran, iyo alaabta Taambuugga oo dhan,
english: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

kikuyu: iyo miiska iyo alaabtiisa, iyo laambadaha saafiga ah, iyo alaabtooda oo dhan, iyo meesha allabariga oo fooxa,
english: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

kikuyu: iyo meesha allabariga lagu gubo, iyo alaabteeda oo dhan, iyo berkedda weysada iyo salkeeda,
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

kikuyu: iyo dharka adeegidda, iyo dharka quduuska ah oo wadaadka Haaruun ah, iyo dharka wiilashiisaba, inay ka adeegaan hawsha wadaadnimada,
english: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

kikuyu: iyo saliidda lagu subkado, iyo fooxa uunsiga udgoon ah oo meesha quduuska ah, oo wax walba sidii aan kugu amray waa inay u sameeyaan.
english: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaad la hadashaa reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Sida runta ah waa inaad dhawrtaan ayaamahayga sabtiyaasha ah: waayo, waa calaamo ina dhex taal aniga iyo idinka ka ab ka ab; si aad u ogaataan inaan anigu ahay Rabbiga quduus idinka dhigaya.
english: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

kikuyu: Haddaba waa inaad dhawrtaan sabtida, waayo, waa idiin quduus, oo mid kasta oo ka dhiga wax aan quduus ahayn hubaal waa in la dilaa, waayo, ku alla kii maalintaas shaqeeya, de qofkaas waa in laga gooyaa dadkiisa.
english: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

kikuyu: Lix maalmood waa in shuqul la qabtaa, laakiinse maalinta toddobaad waa sabti nasasho ah oo Rabbiga quduus u ah; oo ku alla kii maalinta sabtidaa shuqul qabta hubaal waa in la dilaa.
english: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed reer binu Israa'iil waa inay sabtida dhawraan, iyagoo ka ab ka ab sabtida u dhawra axdi weligiis ah aawadiis.
english: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

kikuyu: Waa calaamo weligeed ina dhex taal aniga iyo reer binu Israa'iil; waayo, Rabbigu lix maalmood buu ku sameeyey samada iyo dhulka, oo maalintii toddobaadna wuu nastay, wuuna qabowsaday.
english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

kikuyu: Oo markii uu dhammeeyey hadalkii uu kula hadlayay Buur Siinay dusheeda, ayuu Muuse siiyey labadii loox ee maragga iyagoo ah looxyo dhagaxyo ah, oo fartii Ilaah lagu qoray.
english: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.

kikuyu: Oo markii dadkii arkay in Muuse raagay oo uusan buurtii ka soo degin, ayaa dadkii iyagoo urursan Haaruun u yimaadeen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Kac, oo inoo samee ilaahyo ina hor socda; waayo, Muusahan oo ah ninkii inaga soo bixiyey dalkii Masar, garan mayno wax ku dhacay.
english: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Haaruun wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Soo bixiya hilqadaha dahabka ah oo dhegaha ugu jira naagihiinna, iyo wiilashiinna, iyo gabdhihiinna, oo ii keena.
english: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii oo dhammu waxay soo bixiyeen hilqadihii dahabka ahaa oo dhegaha ugu jiray oo waxay u keeneen Haaruun.
english: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu gacmahooda ka guddoomay, oo wuxuu ku xardhay alaabta wax lagu xardho, wuxuuna ka sameeyey weyl dahab la shubay ah; oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Reer binu Israa'iilow, kanu waa ilaahiinnii dalka Masar idinka soo waday.
english: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun markuu arkay ayuu meel allabari ka hor dhisay, markaasaa Haaruun ogeysiis ku dhawaaqay, oo wuxuu yidhi, Berri waa iiddii Rabbiga.
english: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”

kikuyu: Markaasay subaxdii dambe aroor hore keceen, oo waxay bixiyeen qurbaanno la gubo, oo waxay keeneen qurbaanno nabaadiino, markaasay dadkii u fadhiisteen inay wax cunaan oo wax cabbaan, oo ay u keceen inay cayaaraan.
english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Kac oo hoos u deg, waayo, dadkaagii aad dalkii Masar ka soo bixisay, way iskharribeen,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!

kikuyu: oo haddiiba way ka leexdeen jidkii aan ku amray, oo waxay samaysteen weyl dahab la shubay ah, wayna caabudeen, oo allabarina way u bixiyeen, oo waxayna yidhaahdeen, Reer binu Israa'iilow, kanu waa ilaahiinnii dalka Masar idinka soo waday.
english: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Anigu dadkan waan arkay oo waa dad madax adag,
english: The LORD said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

kikuyu: haddaba iska kay daa, aan aad ugu cadhoodee, oo aan kulligood baabbi'iyee, oo waxaan adiga kaa dhigi doonaa quruun weyn.
english: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse baryay Rabbiga Ilaahiis ah oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Rabbiyow, maxaad aad ugu cadhoonaysaa dadkaaga aad dalkii Masar kaga soo bixisay itaal weyn iyo gacan xoog leh?
english: Moses begged the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

kikuyu: Bal Masriyiintu maxay u odhan doonaan, Wuxuu iyaga u saaray xumaan inuu buuraha ku laayo iyo inuu dhulka iyaga ka baabbi'iyo? Rabbiyow, ka leexo cadhadaada kulul oo ka noqo xumaantan aad damacsan tahay inaad dadkaaga ku samaysid.
english: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

kikuyu: Bal xusuuso addoommadaadii ahaa Ibraahim, iyo Isxaaq, iyo Israa'iil, oo aad naftaada ugu dhaaratay, oo aad ku tidhi, Farcankiinna waxaan u badin doonaa sida xiddigaha cirka, oo dalkan aan ka hadlay oo dhan waxaan siin doonaa farcankiinna, wayna dhaxli doonaan weligood.
english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu ka noqday xumaantii uu damacsanaa inuu dadkiisa ku sameeyo.
english: So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Muuse jeestay, oo buurtii hoos uga degay, isagoo labadii loox oo maragga ahaa gacanta ku sita, looxyadana wax baa kaga qornaa labadooda dhinacba; oo dhankan iyo dhankaasba wax qoran baa kaga yiil.
english: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

kikuyu: Oo looxyadu waxay ahaayeen shuqulkii Ilaah, oo farta ku qoranuna waxay ahayd fartii Ilaah oo looxyada ku xardhan.
english: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

kikuyu: Oo markii Yashuuca maqlay qayladii ay dadku ku qaylinayeen ayuu Muuse ku yidhi, War xeradii qaylo colaadeed baa ka yeedhaysa.
english: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Kaasu ma aha codka kuwa guulaysta, mana aha codka kuwa laga adkaado, laakiinse waxaan maqlayaa kuwa gabyaya codkood.
english: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”

kikuyu: Oo markuu xeradii ku soo dhowaaday wuxuu arkay weyshii iyo cayaartii; markaasaa Muuse aad u cadhooday, looxyadiina gacmihiisa wuu ka tuuray, oo wuxuu ku jejebiyey buurta hoosteedii.
english: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

kikuyu: Markaasuu weyshii ay samaysteen qaaday, dab buuna ku gubay oo daqiijiyey, oo intuu biyaha ku dul daadiyey ayuu reer binu Israa'iil cabsiiyey.
english: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu Haaruun ku yidhi, War maxaa dadkanu kugu sameeyey oo aad dembi weyn ugu keentay?
english: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Haaruun wuxuu yidhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, bal ha ii cadhoon; waayo, adiguba waad og tahay inay dadkanu sharka jecel yihiin.
english: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay igu yidhaahdeen, Inoo samee ilaahyo ina hor socda, waayo, Muusahan oo ah ninkii inaga soo bixiyey dalkii Masar, garan mayno wax ku dhacay.
english: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

kikuyu: Markaasaan ku idhi, Ku alla kii dahab haystaa, ha siibo. Kolkaasay i siiyeen, anna dabkaan ku tuuray, oo waxaa ka soo baxday weyshan.
english: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

kikuyu: Oo markii Muuse arkay in dadkii layska sii daayay, waayo, Haaruun baa sii daayay oo ku kashifay cadaawayaashooda hortooda,
english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

kikuyu: ayuu Muuse istaagay xerada iriddeedii, oo wuxuu yidhi, Ku alla kii Rabbiga la gees ahow, ii kaalay. Markaasay reer Laawi oo dhammu agtiisa ku soo urureen.
english: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on the LORD’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil sidan buu leeyahay, Nin waluba seeftiisa dhinaca ha ku xidho, oo kulligiin irid ilaa irid xerada hore iyo dib u dhex qaada, oo nin waluba ha dilo walaalkiis, iyo saaxiibkiis, iyo deriskiisaba.
english: He said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”

kikuyu: Oo reer Laawi waxay yeeleen hadalkii Muuse, oo maalintaas dadkii waxaa ka dhintay qiyaastii saddex kun oo nin.
english: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu ku yidhi, Inuu maanta barako idinku soo dejiyo aawadeed, Rabbiga quduus isaga dhiga oo nin waluba ha ka gees noqdo wiilkiisa iyo walaalkiisba.
english: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacday, in Muuse maalintii dambe dadkii ku yidhi, Idinku dembi weyn baad samayseen, oo haatan waxaan kor ugu tegayaa Rabbiga; mindhaa dembigiinna aawadiis ayaan u kafaaro gudi doonaaye.
english: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu ku noqday Rabbiga xaggiisa, oo wuxuu yidhi, Bal dadkanu dembi weyn bay sameeyeen, oo waxay samaysteen ilaahyo dahab ah.
english: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadda haddaad dembigooda cafidid; haddii kalese waan ku baryayaaye, kitaabkaaga aad qortay iga tir.
english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Ku alla kii igu dembaabay weeye kan aan kitaabkayga ka tirayaa.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.

kikuyu: Ee haddaba tag, oo meeshii aan kaala hadlay dadka u hor kac, oo bal eeg, malaa'igtayda ayaa ku hor kici doontee; habase yeeshee maalinta aan soo booqdo ayaan dembigooda u ciqaabi doonaa.
english: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu dadkii belaayo ku riday, waayo, waxay sameeyeen weyshii taasoo tii Haaruun sameeyey ahayd.
english: The LORD struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Tag, oo halkan ka socda, adiga iyo dadkii aad dalkii Masar ka soo bixisayba, oo waxaad u kacdaan dalkii aan ugu dhaartay Ibraahim, iyo Isxaaq, iyo Yacquub, oo aan mid walba ku idhi, Farcankaagaan siin doonaa.
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

kikuyu: Oo waxaan hortiinna ku soo diri doonaa malaa'ig, oo waan eryi doonaa reer Kancaan, iyo reer Amor, iyo reer Xeed, iyo reer Feris, iyo reer Xiwi, iyo reer Yebuus.
english: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

kikuyu: U kaca dalkaas caanaha iyo malabka la barwaaqaysan. Anigu idin dhex socon maayo, waayo, waaba intaasoo aan jidka idinku baabbi'iyaa, maxaa yeelay, idinku waxaad tihiin dad madax adag.
english: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”

kikuyu: Oo markii dadkii warkaas xun maqlay, ayay wada calool xumaadeen, oo midkoodna ma xidhan wixii uu isku sharrixi jiray.
english: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Waxaad reer binu Israa'iil ku tidhaahdaa, Idinku waxaad tihiin dad madax adag, oo haddii aan daqiiqad qudh ah dhexdiinna imaado, waan idin baabbi'in; haddaba wixii aad isku sharrixi jirteen, iska fura, bal inaan ogaado waxaan idinku sameeyo.
english: The LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer binu Israa'iil waxay Buur Xoreeb ka bilaabeen inay iska furaan wixii ay isku sharrixi jireen.
english: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

kikuyu: Haddaba Muuse wuxuu qaadi jiray taambuugga oo uu ka dhisi jiray xerada dibaddeeda, meel xerada ka durugsan; oo wuxuu u bixiyey Taambuuggii shirka. Oo mid kasta oo Rabbiga doonay, wuxuu u baxay taambuuggii shirka oo xerada dibaddeeda ahaa.
english: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought the LORD went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.

kikuyu: Oo markii Muuse Taambuuggii u baxay, dadkii oo dhammu way wada keceen, oo nin waluba teendhadiisa iriddeeda ayuu istaagay, oo waxay eegayeen Muuse ilaa uu Taambuuggii galay.
english: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.

kikuyu: Oo markii Muuse Taambuuggii galay ayaa tiirkii daruurta ahaa soo degay oo Taambuugga iriddiisii qotonsaday, markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay.
