english: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the LORD spoke with Moses.

kikuyu: Oo dadkii oo dhammuna way wada arkeen tiirkii daruurta ahaa oo Taambuugga iriddiisii hor qotoma; kolkaasay dadkii oo dhammu wada kaceen oo Ilaah caabudeen, nin walba oo teendhadiisa iriddeeda ag jooga.
english: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ula hadlay sida nin saaxiibkiis ula hadlo, iyagoo iska soo hor jeeda. Kolkaasuu haddana xeradii ku soo noqday; laakiinse midiidinkiisii ahaa Yashuuca ina Nuun oo nin dhallinyar ahaa ayaan Taambuuggii ka bixin.
english: The LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.

kikuyu: Muusena wuxuu Rabbiga ku yidhi, Bal eeg, waxaad i leedahay, Dadkan kaxee, oo imana aad ogeysiin kan aad ila diraysid. Laakiin waxaad igu tidhi, Magacaaga waan kugu aqaan, oo raalli baan kaa ahay.
english: Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

kikuyu: Haddaba waan ku baryayaaye, haddaad raalli iga tahay, jidadkaaga i tus, inaan ku ogaado aawadeed, oo aad raalli iga ahaato, oo bal fiiri in quruuntanu tahay dadkaaga.
english: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Anigu waan kula socon doonaa, oo waan ku nasin doonaa.
english: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu isna ku yidhi, Haddaba haddaanad ila socon, halkan ha naga kaxayn.
english: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

kikuyu: Waayo, sidee baa lagu garanayaa inaad raalli naga tahay, aniga iyo dadkaagaba? Miyaanay ahayn inaad nala socoto si aannu aniga iyo dadkaaguba uga duwanaanno dadka dhulka jooga oo dhan?
english: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Weliba waxan aad ku hadashay waan kuu samayn doonaa; waayo, raalli baan kaa ahay, oo magacaagana waan kugu aqaan.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, ammaantaada i tus.
english: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”

kikuyu: Isna wuxuu ku yidhi, Wanaaggayga oo dhan ayaan hortaada soo marin, oo magaca Rabbiga ayaan hortaada ku naadin, oo waan u roonaan kii aan doonayo inaan u roonaado, waanan u naxariisan kii aan doonayo inaan u naxariisto.
english: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the LORD’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Adigu wejigayga arki kari maysid, waayo, dad i arkaa noolaan maayo.
english: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi, Bal eeg, meel baa agtayda ah, oo waxaad isku taagi doontaa dhagaxa weyn,
english: The LORD also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.

kikuyu: oo markii ay ammaantaydu ku ag marayso, waxaan ku gelin doonaa meel dhagaxa ka dillaacsan, oo gacantaydaan kugu dabooli doonaa ilaa aan ku dhaafo;
english: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

kikuyu: oo haddana waan kaa qaadi doonaa gacantayda, oo waxaad arki doontaa dhabarkayga, laakiinse wejigayga la arki maayo.
english: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Waxaad soo qortaa laba loox oo dhagax ah oo kuwii hore u eg, oo waxaan looxyada ku qori doonaa erayadii ku qornaa looxyadii hore, oo aad jebisay.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

kikuyu: Oo subaxda diyaar ahow, oo Buur Siinay subaxda soo fuul, oo halkaas buurta dusheeda ah iigu kaalay.
english: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

kikuyu: Oo ninna yuusan kula soo fuulin, oo buurta dhan yaan ninna lagu arkin, oo adhi iyo lo' toona yaanay buurta horteeda daaqin.
english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu qoray laba loox oo dhagax ah oo kuwii hore u eg; kolkaasuu Muuse aroor hore kacay, oo Buur Siinay fuulay sidii Rabbigu ku amray, oo gacantana wuxuu ku qaaday laba loox oo dhagax ah.
english: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu daruurtii ku soo degay, oo halkaas isla taagay, oo wuxuu naadiyey magicii Rabbiga.
english: The LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu hortiisa maray oo naadiyey isagoo leh, Waxaan ahay Rabbiga, Rabbiga, oo ah Ilaah raxmad iyo roonaan badan, oo cadho u gaabiya, oo naxariis iyo run badan,
english: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

kikuyu: oo kumankun u naxariista, oo xumaanta iyo xadgudubka iyo dembiga dhaafa, laakiin aan sinaba u caddayn in kan dembiga galay aanu eed lahayn; oo xumaantii awowayaasha soo gaadhsiiya carruurtooda iyo carruurta carruurtooda tan iyo farcanka saddexaad iyo kan afraadba.
english: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse intuu dhaqsaday u sujuuday oo caabuday.
english: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu yidhi, Haddaba, Rabbiyow, haddii aad raalli iga tahay, waan ku baryayaaye, Rabbiyow, bal na dhex soco oo naga cafi xumaantayada iyo dembigayaga, waayo dadkanu waa dad madax adag, ee annaga dhaxal ahaan noo qaado.
english: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Bal eeg, axdi baan dhigayaa; dadkaaga oo dhan hortiisa waxaan ku samayn doonaa cajaa'ibyo aan weligood lagu samayn dhulka oo dhan iyo quruunnaba; oo dadka aad dhex joogto oo dhammu waxay arki doonaan shuqulka Rabbiga, waayo, waxaan kugu samaynayaa waa wax cabsi badan.
english: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.

kikuyu: Waxaad dhawrtaa waxaan maanta kugu amrayo; oo bal ogow, hortaada waxaan ka eryayaa reer Amor, iyo reer Kancaan, iyo reer Xeed, iyo reer Feris, iyo reer Xiwi, iyo reer Yebuus.
english: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Haddaba iska jira, oo axdi ha la dhiganina dadka deggan dalka aad u socotaan, waaba intaasoo ay dabin ku noqoto dhexdiinna,
english: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

kikuyu: laakiinse waa inaad dumisaan meelahooda allabariga, oo burburisaan tiirarkooda, oo gooysaan geedahooda Asheeraah,
english: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

kikuyu: waayo, idinku waa inaydnaan caabudin ilaah kale, maxaa yeelay, Rabbiga magiciisu yahay Masayr waa Ilaah masayr ah;
english: for you shall worship no other god; for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

kikuyu: waaba intaasoo aad axdi la dhigataan dadka dalkaas deggan, oo ay ilaahyadooda raacaan sida naagi ninkeeda uga dhillowdo, oo ay allabari u bixiyaan ilaahyadooda, oo inta laydiin yeedho, aad allabarigiisa wax ka cuntaan,
english: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;

kikuyu: oo waaba intaasoo aad gabdhahooda u guurisaa wiilashaada, oo ay gabdhahooduna ilaahyadooda raacaan sida dhillooyin oo kale, oo ay wiilashaadana u jiitaan inay raacaan ilaahyadooda.
english: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad samaysaan ilaahyo shub ah.
english: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.

kikuyu: Waa inaad dhawrtaan Iiddii Kibista-aan-khamiirka-lahayn. Oo toddoba maalmood waa inaad cuntaan kibis aan khamiir lahayn, sidii aan kugu amray wakhtigii la yidhi ee bishii Aabiib ahayd, maxaa yeelay, bishii Aabiib ayaad Masar ka soo baxday.
english: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Kulli intii maxal furta anigaa iska leh, iyo kulli xoolahaaga intooda lab oo ah curadyada dibida iyo wananka oo dhan.
english: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

kikuyu: Oo dameerka curadka ah waa inaad wan yar ku furataa, oo haddaanad furanin, de waa inaad qoorta ka jebisaa. Oo dadkaaga curadyadiisa oo dhan waa inaad furataa. Oo hortayda midna yuusan iman isagoo faro madhan.
english: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

kikuyu: Lix maalmood waa inaad shaqaysaan, laakiinse maalinta toddobaad waa inaad nasataan; ha ahaatee xilliga beeraha la falo iyo xilliga beeraha la goostoba waa inaad maalinta toddobaad nasataan.
english: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad dhawrtaan Iidda Toddobaadyada, taasoo ah marka la goosto midhaha ugu horreeya ee sarreenka, iyo Iidda Waxurursiga ah marka sannadda ugu dambaysa.
english: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.

kikuyu: Sannaddiiba saddex goor waa inay labkiinna oo dhammu ka hor yimaadaan Rabbiga Ilaaha ah, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu quruumaan hortiinna ka eryi doonaa, oo soohdimihiinnana waan ballaadhin doonaa; oo ninnaba dalkiinna ma damci doono markii aad sannaddiiba saddex goor u baxdaan inaad Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah ka hor tagtaan.
english: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before the LORD, your God, three times in the year.

kikuyu: Waa inaydnaan dhiigga allabarigayga la bixin kibis khamiir leh, oo waa inaan allabariga Iidda Kormaridda ilaa subaxda la gaadhsiin.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.

kikuyu: Dhulkiinna midhaha ugu horreeya waa inaad inta hore guriga Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah geeysaan. Waa inaydnaan waxar caanaha hooyadiis ku karin.
english: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Erayadan qor, waayo, waxaan idinla dhigtay adiga iyo reer binu Israa'iilba axdi erayadan waafaqsan.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

kikuyu: Oo halkaasuu Rabbiga la joogay afartan habeen iyo afartan maalmood, waxbana ma uu cunin, biyona ma uu cabbin. Oo looxyadiina wuxuu ku qoray erayadii axdiga, kuwaas oo ah tobanka qaynuun.
english: He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

kikuyu: Oo markii Muuse Buur Siinay ka soo degay isagoo labadii loox oo maragga gacanta ku sita, intuu buurta ka soo degayay Muuse ma uu ogayn inuu dubka wejigiisu la dhalaalayay hadalkii uu kula hadlay aawadiis.
english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

kikuyu: Oo markay Haaruun iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu Muuse arkeen, bal eeg, dubka wejigiisu waa dhalaalayay, wayna ka cabsadeen inay u dhowaadaan.
english: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse iyagii u yeedhay; Haaruun iyo taliyayaashii shirka oo dhammuna way ku soo noqdeen; Muusena wuu la hadlay.
english: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waa u soo dhowaadeen. Markaasuu wuxuu iyagii ku amray kulli wixii Rabbigu isaga ugu sheegay Buur Siinay.
english: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Oo markuu Muuse dhammeeyey hadalkii uu kula hadlayay ayuu indho shareertay.
english: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

kikuyu: Laakiinse markii Muuse Rabbiga u galay oo uu is-hor taagay inuu la hadlo ayuu indhashareertii iska fayday ilaa uu soo baxay; kolkaasuu soo baxay, oo wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil u sheegay wixii lagu amray,
english: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

kikuyu: oo reer binu Israa'iilna way arkeen Muuse wejigiisii iyo inuu dubka wejigiisu dhalaalayay, markaasaa Muuse haddana indho shareertay ilaa uu gudaha u galay inuu la hadlo.
english: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse isu soo ururiyey shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Kuwanu waa erayadii Rabbigu idinku amray inaad yeeshaan.
english: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which the LORD has commanded, that you should do them.

kikuyu: Lix maalmood waa in la shaqeeyaa, laakiinse maalinta toddobaad waa inay maalin quduus ah idiin ahaataa oo waa sabti nasasho oo Rabbiga loo nasto, oo ku alla kii maalintaas shuqul qabta waa in nafta laga qaadaa.
english: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo maalin kasta oo sabti ah waa inaydnaan innaba dab ku shidin rugihiinna oo dhan.
english: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wuxuu la hadlay shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, isagoo leh, Waxanu waa wixii Rabbigu idinku amray, isagoo leh,
english: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

kikuyu: Idinku dhexdiinna waa inaad wax Rabbiga isaga ururisaan. Mid kasta oo qalbigiisu raalli ka yahay, ha keeno qurbaanka Rabbiga, kaasoo ah dahab, iyo lacag, iyo naxaas,
english: ‘Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,

kikuyu: iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan, iyo dhogor riyaad,
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

kikuyu: iyo wanan hargahood oo la caseeyey, iyo adhidibadeed hargahood, iyo qori qudhac ah,
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

kikuyu: iyo saliid laambadda lagu shubo, iyo udgoon lagu daro saliidda lagu subkado, iyo foox udgoon,
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

kikuyu: iyo dhagaxyo onika la yidhaahdo, iyo dhagaxyo lagu dhejiyo eefodka iyo laabgashiga.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

kikuyu: Oo nin kasta oo xigmad leh oo idinku dhex jiraaba ha yimaado oo ha sameeyo wixii Rabbigu idinku amray oo dhan;
english: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the LORD has commanded:

kikuyu: waxaas oo ah taambuugga iyo teendhadiisa, iyo dedkiisa, iyo qabsatooyinkiisa, iyo looxyadiisa, iyo ulihiisa gudban, iyo tiirarkiisa, iyo saldhigyadiisa,
english: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

kikuyu: iyo sanduuqa, iyo ulihiisa, iyo daboolka, iyo ilxidhka daaha ah,
english: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

kikuyu: iyo miiska, iyo ulihiisa, iyo alaabtiisa oo dhan, iyo kibista tusniinta,
english: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

kikuyu: iyo laambadda iftiinka aawadiis, iyo alaabteeda, iyo laambadaheeda, iyo saliidda iftiinka aawadiis,
english: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

kikuyu: iyo meesha allabariga ee fooxa, iyo ulaheeda, iyo saliidda lagu subkado, iyo fooxa udgoon, iyo daaha iridda laga soo galo taambuugga,
english: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

kikuyu: iyo meesha allabariga lagu gubo, iyo shabaggeeda naxaasta ah, iyo ulaheeda, iyo alaabteeda oo dhan, iyo berkedda weysada, iyo salkeeda,
english: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

kikuyu: iyo barxadda daahyadeeda, iyo tiirarkeeda, iyo saldhigyadooda, iyo daaha iridda barxadda,
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

kikuyu: iyo musmaarradii taambuugga, iyo musmaarradii barxadda, iyo xadhkahooda,
english: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

kikuyu: iyo dharka lagaga adeegi lahaa meesha quduuska ah, kuwaas oo ah dharka quduuska ah ee wadaadka Haaruun, iyo dharka wiilashiisa si ay ugaga adeegaan hawsha wadaadnimada.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay ka tageen Muuse hortiisii.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

kikuyu: Oo waxay yimaadeen iyagoo mid walba qalbigiisu kacay, oo mid walba ruuxiisu raalli ka dhigay, oo waxay keeneen waxay Rabbiga u bixiyeen, kuwaasoo ah wixii loo doonay shuqulkii teendhada shirka, iyo hawsheeda oo dhan, iyo dharkii quduuska ahaa.
english: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought the LORD’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

kikuyu: Oo in alla intii raalliga ahayd way yimaadeen, rag iyo dumarba, oo waxay keeneen dugaagado, iyo hilqado, iyo kaatunno, iyo murriyado, iyo wax kasta oo laysku sharxo oo dahab ah; oo nin kastaaba wuxuu Rabbiga u bixiyey wax dahab ah.
english: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo nin walba, oo laga helay buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan, iyo dhogor riyaad, iyo wanan hargahood oo la caseeyey, iyo adhidibadeed hargahoodba wuu keenay.
english: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

kikuyu: Oo mid kasta oo qurbaan lacag iyo naxaas ah bixiyey wuxuu u bixiyey Rabbiga; oo nin kasta oo laga helay qori qudhac ah wuxuu u keenay hawsha adeegidda aawadeed.
english: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

kikuyu: Oo dumarkii xigmadda lahaa oo dhammu waxay gacmahooda ku miiqeen dun, oo waxay keeneen wixii ay miiqeen oo ahaa buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan.
english: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

kikuyu: Oo dumarkii qalbigoodu xigmadda la kacay oo dhammu waxay miiqeen dhogor riyaad.
english: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

kikuyu: Oo taliyayaashiina waxay keeneen dhagaxyada onika la yidhaahdo, iyo dhagaxyada lagu dhejiyo eefodka iyo laabgashiga.
english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

kikuyu: Waxayna keeneen uunsiga, iyo saliidda iftiinka, iyo saliidda lagu subkado, iyo fooxa udgoon.
english: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay Rabbiga u bixiyeen qurbaan ay raalli ka yihiin; oo waxay ahaayeen dad rag iyo dumarba leh oo qalbigoodu raalli ka ahaa inay u keenaan shuqulka Rabbigu Muuse ku amray in la sameeyo oo dhan.
english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil ku yidhi, Bal eega, Rabbigu wuxuu magac ugu yeedhay Besaleel oo ah ina Uurii, oo ah ina Xuur, oo qabiilkiisu yahay Yahuudah;
english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu isaga ka buuxiyey ruuxii Ilaah, xagga xigmadda iyo waxgarashada, iyo aqoonta, iyo sancada caynka kasta ah,
english: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

kikuyu: iyo inuu shuqullo yaab leh hindiso, oo uu ka shaqeeyo dahabka, iyo lacagta, iyo naxaasta,
english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

kikuyu: iyo inuu qoro dhagaxyo saldhigyo lagu dhejinayo, oo uu looxyada xardho, iyo inuu ka shaqeeyo sanco cayn kasta ah.
english: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu qalbigiisii geliyey inuu wax baro, isaga iyo Aaholii'aab oo ah ina Axiisaamaag, oo qabiilkiisu yahay Daan.
english: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga wuxuu qalbigooda ka buuxiyey xigmad, inay ka shaqeeyaan shuqul cayn kasta ah oo ay qabtaan kuwa wax xardha iyo kuwa wax hindisa, iyo kuwa daabac ku tola buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan, iyo kuwa dharka sameeya, xataa ha ahaatee kuwa shuqul kasta qabta iyo kuwa shuqullo yaab leh hindisa.
english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

kikuyu: Oo Besaleel iyo Aaholii'aab iyo nin kasta oo xigmad leh, oo Rabbigu geliyey xigmad iyo waxgarasho ay ku gartaan si loo sameeyo shuqul kasta oo ah adeegidda laga qabanayo meesha quduuska ah, waa inay u qabtaan sidii Rabbigu ku amray oo dhan.
english: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu u yeedhay Besaleel iyo Aaholii'aab, iyo nin kasta oo xigmad leh, oo Rabbigu qalbigiisa xigmad geliyey, xataa mid kasta oo qalbigiisu kiciyey inuu yimaado oo shuqulka qabto.
english: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

kikuyu: Markaasay Muuse ka guddoomeen wixii la bixiyey oo dhan, oo ay reer binu Israa'iil u keeneen shuqulka adeegidda meesha quduuska ah, inay ka sameeyaan. Oo haddana waxay weliba subax walba u keeni jireen waxay raalli ka yihiin.
english: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

kikuyu: Oo raggii xigmadda lahaa oo dhan, oo ahaa kuwii shuqulka ka qabtay meesha quduuska ah, way wada yimaadeen, oo waxaa nin waluba ka soo kacay shuqulkii uu samaynayay.
english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

kikuyu: Oo intay Muuse la hadleen ayay ku yidhaahdeen, Dadku waxay keeneen in ka sii badan intii ku filnayd in lagu qabto shuqulkii Rabbigu amray in la sameeyo.
english: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse amar bixiyey, oo waxaa xeradii oo dhan laga naadiyey inaan nin iyo naag toona wax dambe u bixin shuqulka meesha quduuska ah. Sidaas daraaddeed baa dadkii looga joojiyey si aanay wax kale u keenin.
english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

kikuyu: Waayo, alaabtii ay haysteen waa ku filnayd in shuqulka oo dhan lagu sameeyo, wayna ka sii badnayd weliba.
english: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

kikuyu: Oo nin kasta oo xigmad leh oo iyaga ku dhex jiray oo shuqulkii qabtay wuxuu taambuuggii ka sameeyey toban daah, oo wuxuu ka sameeyey maro wanaagsan, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, oo keruubiim lagu daabacay.
english: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Oo daah kasta dhererkiisu wuxuu ahaa siddeed iyo labaatan dhudhun, oo daah kasta ballaadhkiisuna wuxuu ahaa afar dhudhun; oo daahyada oo dhammuna isku wada qiyaas bay ahaayeen.
english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

kikuyu: Oo shan daah ayuu mid kasta midka kale ku xidhay, oo shantii daah oo kalena ayuu mid kasta midka kale ku xidhay.
english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

kikuyu: Oo daahyada midkii darafta ugu xigay qarkiisa ayuu wuxuu u yeelay siddooyin buluug ah; oo sidaasoo kalena wuxuu u yeelay daahii dibadda ugu xigay intii labaad.
english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Konton siddo ayuu daahba u yeelay, oo konton siddo oo kalena wuxuu u yeelay qarkii daaha dibadda u xiga ee intii labaad; oo siddooyinkuna midba mid buu ku toosnaa.
english: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu sameeyey konton qabsato oo dahab ah, oo daahyadiina wuxuu midba midka kale kula lammaaneeyey qabsatooyinkii; sidaasuu taambuuggu mid u noqday.
english: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

kikuyu: Markaasuu daahyo ka sameeyey dhogor riyaad, inay ahaadaan teendho ka sarrayso taambuugga, oo wuxuu iyaga ka dhigay kow iyo toban daah.
english: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

kikuyu: Oo daah kasta dhererkiisu wuxuu ahaa soddon dhudhun, oo daah kasta ballaadhkiisuna wuxuu ahaa afar dhudhun; oo kow iyo tobanka daah isku wada qiyaas bay ahaayeen.
english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

kikuyu: Markaasuu shan daah gooni-ahaantooda isugu xidhay, lix daahna gooni-ahaan.
english: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

kikuyu: Markaasuu qarkii daahii dibadda u xigay intii kowaad u yeelay konton siddo, oo konton siddo oo kalena wuxuu u yeelay qarkii daahii dibadda u xigay intii labaad.
english: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Oo haddana wuxuu sameeyey konton qabsato oo naxaas ah inuu teendhada iskula dhejiyo oo ay mid noqoto.
english: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

kikuyu: Oo teendhadana wuxuu ded uga sameeyey wanan hargahood oo la caseeyey, iyo ded ah adhidibadeed hargahood oo ka sarreeya.
english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kikuyu: Oo taambuugga looxyadiisii taagtaagnaana wuxuu ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

kikuyu: Oo loox kasta dhererkiisu wuxuu ahaa toban dhudhun, ballaadhkiisuna wuxuu ahaa dhudhun iyo badh.
english: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

kikuyu: Oo loox kastaaba wuxuu lahaa laba caaro, oo looxyaduna dhinacyaday isku hayeen, oo looxyadii taambuugga oo dhan sidaasuu u sameeyey.
english: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

kikuyu: Oo looxyada ayuu Taambuugga u sameeyey, oo waxay ahaayeen labaatan loox dhinaca koonfureed.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu sameeyey afartan saldhig oo lacag ah oo ka hooseeya labaatan loox, oo laba saldhigba waxay ka hooseeyeen loox, oo waxay saldhig u ahaayeen labadiisii caaro, oo laba kale oo saldhigna waxay saldhig u ahaayeen loox kale labadiisii caaro.
english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

kikuyu: Oo taambuugga dhankiisa labaadna oo woqooyi xiga, wuxuu u sameeyey labaatan loox,
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

kikuyu: iyo afartankoodii saldhig oo lacagta ahayd. Laba saldhigba loox bay ka hooseeyeen, oo laba saldhig oo kalena waxay ka hooseeyeen loox kale.
english: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: Oo taambuugga xaggiisa dambe oo galbeed xigtana wuxuu u sameeyey lix loox.
english: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

kikuyu: Oo labada geesood oo taambuugga xaggiisa dambena wuxuu u sameeyey laba loox.
english: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

kikuyu: Oo hoosta bay labanlaab ka noqdeen, oo sidaas oo kalena way dhammaadeen ilaa siddada kowaad dusheeda, oo sidaasuu ka dhigay labadoodii ku jiray labada geesood.
english: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

kikuyu: Waxaana jiray siddeed loox, iyo saldhigyadoodii lacagta ahaa. Kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen lix iyo toban saldhig, oo lababa loox ka hoosayso.
english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ulo gudban ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah, oo shan buu u sameeyey looxyada taambuugga dhinac kaga jira,
english: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

kikuyu: oo shan ulood oo kalena wuxuu u sameeyey looxyada dhinaca kale kaga jira taambuugga, oo shan ulood oo kalena wuxuu u sameeyey looxyada taambuugga kaga jira xaggiisa dambe oo galbeed xigta.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

kikuyu: Oo uldhexaaddii ayuu looxyadii ku gudbay gees ilaa gees.
english: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

kikuyu: Oo looxyadii wuxuu ku dahaadhay dahab, oo siddooyinkoodana wuxuu ka sameeyey dahab inay ahaadaan meelihii ay ulaha gudban ka geli lahaayeen, oo ulihiina wuxuu ku dahaadhay dahab.
english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

kikuyu: Oo ilxidhkiina wuxuu ka sameeyey buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan, oo keruubiim buu ku daabacay.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu u sameeyey afar tiir oo qori qudhac ah, wuxuuna ku dahaadhay dahab; oo qabsatooyinkooduna waxay ahaayeen dahab; oo wuxuuna u yeelay afar saldhig oo lacag ah.
english: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

kikuyu: Oo iridda Teendhada wuxuu u sameeyey daah ah buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan oo daabac leh.
english: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

kikuyu: Wuxuuna sameeyey shantiisii tiir iyo qabsatooyinkoodiiba, oo dahab buu ku dahaadhay tiirarka madaxyadoodii iyo waxyaalihii laysugu wada xidhayba; oo shantoodii saldhigna waxay ahaayeen naxaas.
english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

kikuyu: Oo Besaleel wuxuu sanduuqii ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah, oo dhererkiisuna wuxuu ahaa laba dhudhun iyo badh, ballaadhkiisuna wuxuu ahaa dhudhun iyo badh, sarajooggiisuna wuxuu ahaa dhudhun iyo badh.
english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

kikuyu: Markaasuu gudaha iyo dibaddaba kaga dahaadhay dahab saafi ah, oo wuxuu u yeelay wax taaj oo kale ah oo dahab ah oo ku wareegsan.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu u yeelay afar siddo oo dahab ah oo afartiisa rukun ee hoose ku yaal; oo laba siddoba dhinac buu kaga dhejiyey, dhinaca kalena laba siddo buu kaga dhejiyey.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ulo ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah, dahab buuna ku dahaadhay.
english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ulihii wuxuu geliyey siddooyinkii sanduuqa dhinacyadiisa ku yiil, si sanduuqa loogu qaado.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu dahab saafi ah ka sameeyey dabool, oo dhererkiisuna wuxuu ahaa laba dhudhun iyo badh, ballaadhkiisuna wuxuu ahaa dhudhun iyo badh.
english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

kikuyu: Markaasuu laba keruub ka sameeyey dahab la tumay, oo daboolkii labadiisa madax ayuu ka taagay.
english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

kikuyu: Keruub wuxuu ka sameeyey madax, keruubkii kalena wuxuu ka sameeyey madaxa kale; oo labada keruub oo labada madax ka kala taagan iyo daboolkii wuxuu ka wada sameeyey isku waslad.
english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

kikuyu: Oo keruubiimtuna meel sare ayay baalashooda ka soo kala bixiyeen, oo daboolkay baalashooda ku qariyeen, wejiyadooduna way iska soo hor jeedeen; oo keruubiimta wejiyadoodu waxay ku soo jeedeen daboolka.
english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Miiskana qori qudhac ah ayuu ka sameeyey, oo dhererkiisu wuxuu ahaa laba dhudhun, ballaadhkiisuna dhudhun, sarajooggiisuna dhudhun iyo badh,
english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku dahaadhay dahab saafi ah, oo wuxuuna u yeelay wax taaj oo kale ah oo dahab ah oo ku wareegsan.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu u yeelay qar le'eg calaacal ballaadhkeed oo ku wareegsan, oo qarkiina wuxuu u yeelay wax taaj oo kale ah oo dahab ah oo ku wada wareegsan.
english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu u yeelay afar siddo oo dahab ah, oo wuxuu siddooyinkii ku dhejiyey afarta gees oo afarta rukun oo hoose kaga yiil.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

kikuyu: Oo siddooyinku waxay ku dhowaayeen qarka, iyagoo ah meelaha laga geliyo ulaha miiska lagu qaado.
english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ulihii ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah oo ku dahaadhay dahab, si miiska loogu qaado.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dahab saafi ah ka sameeyey alaabtii miiska saarnayd oo dhan oo ahayd suxuuntiisii, iyo malqacadihiisii, iyo maddiibadihiisii, iyo kidhliyadiisii wax laga shubo.
english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu laambadda ka sameeyey dahab saafi ah, oo laambaddii waxay ahayd mid tuman, xataa salkeeda iyo usheeda dhexe iyo koobabkeeda, iyo burooyinkeeda iyo ubaxeeduba isku waslad bay la wada ahaayeen.
english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Oo dhinacyadeeda waxaa ka baxayay lix laamood, oo saddex laamood dhinac bay kaga yiilleen, saddex laamoodna dhinaca kale ayay kaga yiilleen.
english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

kikuyu: Oo saddex koob oo yicib ubaxeed u eg, iyo buro, iyo ubax baa isku laan ku yiil, laanta kalena waxaa ku yiil saddex koob oo yicib ubaxeed u eg, iyo buro, iyo ubax, oo lixdii laamood oo ka baxday laambaddii sidaasay wada ahaayeen.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

kikuyu: Oo laambaddii waxaa ku yiil afar koob oo yicib ubaxeed u eg, iyo burooyinkoodii iyo ubaxoodii,
english: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kikuyu: oo buro waxay ku tiil laba laamood hoostood, isku waslad bayna la ahayd, buro kalena waxay ku tiil laba laamood hoostood, isku waslad bayna la ahayd, burona waxay ku tiil laba laamood hoostood, isku waslad bayna la ahayd, oo lixda laamoodba sidaasay wada ahaayeen.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

kikuyu: Oo burooyinkooda iyo laamahooduba isku waslad bay la ahaayeen: oo kulligeedna waxay ahayd isku waslad dahab la tumay oo saafi ah.
english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Oo dahab saafi ah wuxuu ka sameeyey toddobadeedii laambadood, iyo birqaabyadeedii iyo alaabteedii lagu safayn jirayba.
english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

kikuyu: Oo iyada iyo alaabteeda oo dhanba wuxuu ka sameeyey talanti dahab saafi ah.
english: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii allabariga ee fooxana wuxuu ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah, oo dhererkeeduna wuxuu ahaa dhudhun, ballaadhkeeduna wuxuu ahaa dhudhun, oo afar geesood bay ahayd, sarajooggeeduna wuxuu ahaa laba dhudhun, oo geesaheeduna isku waslad bay la ahaayeen.
english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dahab ku dahaadhay dusheedii iyo dhinacyadeedii ku wareegsanaa, iyo geesaheedii, oo wuxuu u sameeyey wax taaj oo kale ah oo dahab ah oo ku wareegsan.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Oo qarka hoostiisa laba siddo oo dahab ah ayuu ugu yeelay labadeeda rukun inay labadeeda dhinac ugu ahaadaan meelaha ulaha lagu qaado laga gelin lahaa.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

kikuyu: Oo ulihii wuxuu ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah, dahab buuna ku dahaadhay.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

kikuyu: Oo saliiddii quduuska ahayd oo lagu subkado iyo fooxii saafiga ahaa ee uunsiga udgoon wuxuu u sameeyey sidii shuqulka cadarsameeyaha oo kale.
english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii allabariga lagu gubi lahaana wuxuu ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah, oo dhererkeedu wuxuu ahaa shan dhudhun, ballaadhkeeduna wuxuu ahaa shan dhudhun, afargeesood bay ahayd, sarajooggeeduna wuxuu ahaa saddex dhudhun.
english: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

kikuyu: Oo geesaheediina wuxuu ugu sameeyey afarteeda rukun; oo geesaheeduna isku waslad bay la ahaayeen, naxaas buuna ku dahaadhay.
english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu kaloo sameeyey alaabtii meesha allabariga oo dhan, kuwaasoo ah dheryihii, iyo majarafadihii, iyo maddiibadihii, iyo mudacyadii, iyo dabqaadayaashii; oo alaabteeda oo dhan wuxuu ka sameeyey naxaas.
english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu meeshii allabariga u sameeyey shabag naxaas ah oo gaadha qarka hoostiisa ilaa kalabadhka.
english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

kikuyu: Afarta daraf oo shabaggii naxaasta ahaa ayuu u yeelay afar siddo si ay u ahaadaan meelihii ulaha laga gelin lahaa.
english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

kikuyu: Oo ulihiina wuxuu ka sameeyey qori qudhac ah, naxaas buuna ku dahaadhay.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

kikuyu: Oo ulihiina wuxuu ka geliyey siddooyinkii meesha allabariga si loogu qaado; oo wuxuu meeshii allabariga ka sameeyey looxyo sida sanduuq madhan oo kale.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

kikuyu: Oo berkeddii weysada iyo salkeedii wuxuu ka sameeyey naxaas, taasoo laga helay muraayadihii dumarka ka adeegi jiray teendhada shirka iriddeeda.
english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu sameeyey barxaddii; oo barxadda xaggeeda koonfureed waxaa ka lushay daahyo dhererkoodu yahay boqol dhudhun oo ah maro wanaagsan.
english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

kikuyu: Oo tiirarkoodu waxay ahaayeen labaatan, saldhigyadooduna labaatan, naxaas laga sameeyey; tiirarka qabsatooyinkooda iyo waxyaalihii laysugu xidhi jirayna waxaa laga sameeyey lacag.
english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

kikuyu: Oo xaggeeda woqooyina waxaa ka lushay daahyo boqol dhudhun ah, oo tiirarkoodu waxay ahaayeen labaatan, saldhigyadooduna labaatan, naxaas laga sameeyey; tiirarka qabsatooyinkooda iyo waxyaalihii laysugu xidhi jirayna waxaa laga sameeyey lacag.
english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Oo dhinaca galbeed daahyadiisu waxay ahaayeen konton dhudhun, tiirarkoodu waxay ahaayeen toban, saldhigyadooduna toban, oo tiirarka qabsatooyinkooda iyo waxyaalihii laysugu xidhi jirayna waxay ahaayeen lacag.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Oo xagga bari daahyadiisuna waxay ahaayeen konton dhudhun.
english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

kikuyu: Oo iridda daahyadeedu dhinac waxay ka ahaayeen shan iyo toban dhudhun, tiirarkooduna saddex bay ahaayeen, saldhigyadooduna saddex,
english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

kikuyu: oo dhinaca kalena sidaas oo kalay ahaayeen, oo barxadda iriddeeda xaggan iyo xaggaasba waxaa ka lushay daahyo dhererkoodu yahay shan iyo toban dhudhun, tiirarkooduna waxay ahaayeen saddex, saldhigyadooduna saddex.
english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Daahyadii barxadda ku wareegsanaa oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen maro wanaagsan.
english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Oo tiirarka saldhigyadoodu waxay ahaayeen naxaas; qabsatooyinkooda iyo waxyaalihii laysugu xidhi jirayna waxay ahaayeen lacag; tiirarka madaxyadooda waxaa lagu dahaadhay lacag, oo tiirarka barxadda oo dhanna waxaa laysugu wada xidhay lacag.
english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

kikuyu: Oo daaha barxadda iriddeeda wuxuu ahaa wax daabacan oo ah buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan, oo dhererkiisuna wuxuu ahaa labaatan dhudhun, sarajooggiisuna wuxuu ahaa shan dhudhun oo u dhigma barxadda daahyadeeda.
english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

kikuyu: Tiirarkooduna waxay ahaayeen afar, saldhigyadoodii naxaasta ahaana afar; qabsatooyinkooduna waxay ahaayeen lacag, oo tiirarka madaxyadoodii waxaa ku dahaadhnaa lacag, waxyaalihii laysugu xidhayna waxay wada ahaayeen lacag.
english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Oo musmaarrada taambuugga iyo barxadda ku wareegsanba kulligood waxay ahaayeen naxaas.
english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

kikuyu: Waa tan tiradii alaabtii taambuugga, kaas oo ah taambuuggii maragga, markii la tiriyey sidii Muuse ku amray adeegidda reer Laawi, oo uu tilmaamay Iitaamaar kii wadaadkii Haaruun ahaa dhalay.
english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Oo kulli wixii Rabbigu ku amray Muuse waxaa sameeyey Besaleel oo ahaa ina Uurii oo ahaa ina Xuur, oo qabiilkiisu ahaa Yahuudah.
english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa isaga la jiray Aaholii'aab oo ahaa ina Axiisaamaag, oo qabiilkiisu ahaa Daan, oo wuxuu ahaa mid wax xardha, oo aad iyo aad u farsamo badan, iyo mid yaqaan sida loo daabaco buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan.
english: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

kikuyu: Oo dahabkii la bixiyey oo loogu isticmaalay hawshii meesha quduuskaa oo dhammu wuxuu ahaa sagaal iyo labaatan talanti, iyo toddoba boqol iyo soddon sheqel, oo le'eg sheqelka meesha quduuska ah.
english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Oo shirka intiisii la tiriyey lacagtoodii waxay ahayd boqol talanti, iyo kun iyo toddoba boqol iyo shan iyo toddobaatan sheqel, oo le'eg sheqelka meesha quduuska ah.
english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

kikuyu: Waxaa nin kastaa bixiyey beqac, kaas oo ah nus sheqel, oo le'eg sheqelka meesha quduuska ah, oo kulli intii u gudubtay kuwii la tiriyey, intii jirtay labaatan sanadood iyo wixii ka sii weyn, waxay ahaayeen lix boqol iyo saddex kun, iyo shan boqol iyo konton nin.
english: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

kikuyu: Oo saldhigyada meesha quduuska ah iyo saldhigyada ilxidhku waxay ka samaysmeen boqolkii talanti oo lacagta ahaa, boqol saldhig baa laga sameeyey boqolkii talanti, saldhigba talanti baa laga sameeyey.
english: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

kikuyu: Kun iyo toddoba boqol iyo shan iyo toddobaatanka sheqel ayuu tiirarka qabsatooyinkoodii ka sameeyey, oo wuxuuna ku dahaadhay tiirarka madaxyadoodii, wuxuuna ka sameeyey waxyaalihii tiirarka laysugu wada xidhay.
english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

kikuyu: Naxaastii la bixiyey waxay ahayd toddobaatan talanti, iyo laba kun iyo afar boqol oo sheqel.
english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu naxaastii ka sameeyey iriddii teendhada shirka saldhigyadeedii, iyo meeshii naxaasta ahayd oo allabariga, iyo shabaggeedii naxaasta ahaa, iyo alaabtii meesha allabariga oo dhan,
english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

kikuyu: iyo saldhigyadii barxadda ku wareegsanaa, iyo saldhigyadii iridda barxadda, iyo musmaarradii taambuugga oo dhan, iyo musmaarradii barxadda ku wareegsanaa oo dhan.
english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

kikuyu: Oo waxay buluuggii, iyo guduudkii, iyo casaankii ka sameeyeen dhar aad u wanaagsan in meesha quduuskaa lagaga adeego, oo waxay kaloo sameeyeen dharkii quduuska ahaa oo Haaruun, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo eefodkiina wuxuu ka sameeyey dahab, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan.
english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Oo waxay dahabkii u tumeen sidii caleemo khafiif ah oo kale, markaasay googooyeen oo silig ka dhigeen, in looga shaqeeyo buluuggii, iyo guduudkii, iyo casaankii, iyo maradii wanaagsanayd, oo la daabacay.
english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

kikuyu: Oo waxay u sameeyeen garbo is-haystay, oo waxay iska haysteen labada daraf.
english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

kikuyu: Oo dhex-xidhkii daabaca lahaa oo dusha kaga yiil in lagu xidho, isku waslad buu la ahaa eefodka, isku sina waa loo sameeyey, waxaana laga sameeyey dahab, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo waxay diyaariyeen dhagaxyadii onika la odhan jiray, oo ku jira saldhigyo dahab ah, oo lagu xardhay xaradhkii shaabadda oo ah sida ay magacyadii reer binu Israa'iil ahaayeen.
english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku dhejiyey eefodka garbihiisa, inay dhagaxyo xusuus ah u noqdaan reer binu Israa'iil, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu sameeyey laabgashigii, oo la daabacay, oo u eg sida samaynta eefodka oo kale, oo ahayd dahab, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, iyo maro wanaagsan.
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ahaa afargeesood, oo laabgashiga waxay u sameeyeen labanlaab, oo dhererkiisu wuxuu ahaa taako, ballaadhkiisuna wuxuu ahaa taako isagoo labanlaaban.
english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku dul dhejiyeen afar saf oo dhagaxyo ah; oo safka kowaad wuxuu ahaa sardiyos, iyo tobasiyos, iyo mid birqaya.
english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

kikuyu: Safka labaadna wuxuu ahaa sumurud, iyo safayr, iyo dheemman.
english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

kikuyu: Safka saddexaadna wuxuu ahaa yakintos, iyo agate, iyo ametustos.
english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

kikuyu: Safka afraadna wuxuu ahaa berullos, iyo onika, iyo yasbid; oo waxaa lagu dhejiyey saldhigyo dahab ah oo meeshooda ku yaal.
english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

kikuyu: Oo dhagaxyaduna waxay tiro le'ekaayeen magacyadii reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxay ahaayeen laba iyo toban sidii magacyadoodii; oo laba iyo tobankii qabiil, mid kasta waxaa magiciisa loogu xardhay sidii xaradhkii shaabadda.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

kikuyu: Oo laabgashiga waxay ku sameeyeen silsilado xadhko u eg, oo laga tidcay dahab saafi ah.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Oo waxay sameeyeen laba saldhig oo dahab ah, iyo laba siddo oo dahab ah, oo waxay labadii siddo sudheen laabgashiga labadiisa daraf.
english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Oo labadii silsiladood oo dahabka ahayd oo tidcanaydna waxay ku xidheen labadii siddo oo ku yiil darfaha laabgashiga.
english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Oo labadii silsiladood oo tidcanayd labadoodii madax oo kalena waxay ku xidheen labadii saldhig, oo waxay ku xidheen eefodka garbihiisa xaggooda hore.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

kikuyu: Oo waxay sameeyeen laba siddo oo dahab ah, oo waxay soo sudheen laabgashiga labadiisa daraf oo gudaha ah oo eefodka xiga.
english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

kikuyu: Oo waxay kaloo sameeyeen laba siddo oo dahab ah, oo waxay soo sudheen eefodka garbihiisa xaggooda hoose, oo dhanka hore ku yaal, oo ku dhow meeshay iskaga xidhmaan, oo ka sarreeya suunka eefodka dhex-xidhkiisa daabaca ah.
english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Oo laabgashigii waxay siddooyinkiisii ku xidheen siddooyinkii eefodka, waxayna kula xidheen shalash buluug ah, inuu ku dul xidhnaado dhex-xidhka daabaca ah oo eefodka, iyo inuusan laabgashigu ka debcin eefodka, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo khamiiskii eefodkana wuxuu ahaa dhar samaysan, oo kulligiis buluug ah.
english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

kikuyu: Oo daloolkii khamiiska ku yiil wuxuu ahaa sida daloolka dhar afkiisa rigrig ku wareegsan yahay, si uusan u dillaacin.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

kikuyu: Oo khamiiska darafkiisa hoose waxay ku sameeyeen rummaanno buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan ah, iyo maro wanaagsan.
english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

kikuyu: Oo waxay sameeyeen dawanno dahab saafi ah, oo dawannadii waxay kala dhex geliyeen rummaannadii ku yiil khamiiska darafkiisa ku wareegsan, oo u dhexeeya rummaannadii;
english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

kikuyu: oo dawan iyo rummaan, haddana dawan iyo rummaan, ayuu ku wareejiyey khamiiska dharafkiisa, in lagu adeego aawadeed, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Waxay Haaruun iyo wiilashiisii u sameeyeen jubbadihii marada wanaagsan ahaa oo si fiican loo sameeyey,
english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

kikuyu: oo waxay kaloo sameeyeen duubkii Haaruun oo marada wanaagsan ahaa, iyo wiilashiisii duubabkoodii wacanaa oo marada wanaagsan ahaa, iyo sirwaalladii marada wanaagsan ahaa,
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

kikuyu: iyo dhex-xidhkii ahaa marada wanaagsan, iyo buluug, iyo guduud, iyo casaan, oo daabacnaa, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo waxay kaloo sameeyeen taajkii quduuska ahaa ee ahaa wasladdii khafiifka oo dahabka saafiga ahayd, oo waxay dushiisii ku qoreen far u eg xaradhkii shaabadda oo leh, WAA U QUDUUS RABBIGA.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku xidheen shalash buluug ah, in lagula dhejiyo duubka sare, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo sidaasay hawshii taambuugga teendhadii shirka oo dhammu ku dhammaatay; oo reer binu Israa'iil way wada sameeyeen wixii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray oo dhan, sidii bayna u sameeyeen.
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.

kikuyu: Oo waxay Muuse u keeneen taambuuggii, oo ahaa teendhadii iyo alaabteedii oo dhan, qabsatooyinkeedii iyo looxyadeedii iyo ulaheedii gudbanaa, iyo tiirarkeedii, iyo saldhigyadeedii,
english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

kikuyu: iyo dedkii ahaa wananka hargahooda oo la caseeyey, iyo dedkii ahaa hargaha adhidibadeedka, iyo ilxidhkii daaha ahaa,
english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

kikuyu: iyo sanduuqii maragga, iyo ulihiisii, iyo daboolkii,
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

kikuyu: iyo miiskii, iyo alaabtiisii oo dhan, iyo kibistii tusniinta,
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

kikuyu: iyo laambaddii saafiga ahayd, iyo laambadaheedii, kuwaasoo ah laambadihii la diyaarin lahaa, iyo alaabtoodii oo dhan, iyo saliiddii lagu shidi lahaa,
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

kikuyu: iyo meeshii allabariga oo dahabka ahayd, iyo saliiddii lagu subkan lahaa, iyo fooxii udgoonaa, iyo daahii iridda teendhada,
english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

kikuyu: iyo meeshii allabariga oo naxaasta ahayd, iyo shabaggeedii naxaasta ahaa, iyo ulaheedii, iyo alaabteedii oo dhan, iyo berkeddii weysada, iyo salkeedii,
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

kikuyu: iyo barxadda daahyadeedii, iyo tiirarkeedii, iyo saldhigyadeedii, iyo daahii iridda barxadda, iyo xadhkihiisii, iyo musmaarradiisii, iyo alaabtii lagu qaban lahaa hawsha taambuugga oo dhan, teendhada shirka aawadeed,
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: iyo dharkii loo sameeyey in lagaga adeego meesha quduuska ah, iyo dharkii quduuska ahaa oo wadaadka Haaruun ah, iyo dharkii wiilashiisa, ee loogu sameeyey inay kaga adeegaan hawsha wadaadnimada.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Oo kulli wixii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray oo dhan reer binu Israa'iil sidii bay hawshii u wada qabteen.
english: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu arkay shuqulkii oo dhan, oo bal eeg way wada sameeyeen; sidii Rabbigu ku amray ayay u sameeyeen; markaasaa Muuse iyagii u duceeyey.
english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Bisha kowaad maalinteeda kowaad waa inaad taambuugga teendhada shirka qotomisaa.
english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad sanduuqa maragga gudaheeda gelisaa, oo sanduuqa waa inaad ilxidhka ku qarisaa.
english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

kikuyu: Oo miiskana waa inaad gudaha soo gelisaa, oo aad alaabta saaran hagaajisaa, oo laambaddana waa inaad gudaha soo gelisaa, oo laambadaheeda waa inaad shiddaa.
english: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

kikuyu: Oo meesha allabariga oo dahabka ah oo fooxa waxaad dhigtaa sanduuqa maragga hortiisa, oo iridda taambuuggana daaheeda sudh.
english: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo meesha allabariga lagu gubona waxaad hor dhigtaa iridda taambuugga teendhada shirka.
english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo berkedda weysadana waxaad dhigtaa teendhada shirka iyo meesha allabariga dhexdooda, waana inaad biyo ku shubtaa.
english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad dayrka barxadda ku wareegsan qotomisaa, oo barxadda iriddeedana waxaad soo sudhaa daaha.
english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

kikuyu: Oo markaas waxaad qaadataa saliidda lagu subkado, oo waxaad ku subagtaa taambuugga, iyo waxa gudihiisa ku jira oo dhan, oo waa inaad quduus ka dhigtaa isaga iyo alaabtiisa oo dhanba; oo kolkaasuu quduus noqon doonaa.
english: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad kaloo subagtaa meesha allabariga lagu gubo, iyo alaabteeda oo dhan, oo meesha allabariga quduus ka dhig, oo markaasay meesha allabarigu waxay noqon doontaa tan ugu wada quduusan.
english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad kaloo subagtaa berkedda weysada iyo salkeeda, oo waa inaad quduus ka dhigtaa.
english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa waxaad keentaa iridda teendhada shirka, oo waa inaad biyo ugu maydhaa iyaga.
english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun waa inaad u gelisaa dharkii quduuska ahaa; oo waa inaad isaga u subagtaa oo quduus ka dhigtaa, inuu iiga adeego hawsha wadaadnimada.
english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashiisana waa inaad keentaa oo jubbado u gelisaa,
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

kikuyu: oo waa inaad iyana u subagtaa sidii aad aabbahood ugu subagtay oo kale, inay iiga adeegaan hawsha wadaadnimada, oo subkiddoodu waxay iyaga u noqon doontaa wadaadnimo iyaga u jiraysa weligood iyo tan iyo ka ab ka ab.
english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

kikuyu: Sidaasuu Muuse yeelay, oo sidii Rabbigu ku amray oo dhan wuu wada sameeyey.
english: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.

kikuyu: Oo sannaddii labaad, bisheedii kowaad, maalinteedii kowaad ayaa taambuuggii la qotomiyey.
english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wuxuu qotomiyey taambuuggii, saldhigyadiisiina wuu dhigay, oo wuxuu taagay looxyadiisii, ulahoodiina wuu ku gudbay, tiirarkiisiina wuu taagay.
english: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

kikuyu: Oo taambuuggii buu ku deday teendhada, oo teendhada dedkeediina wuu ka sii dul mariyey, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Markaasuu qaaday maraggii oo ku riday sanduuqii, oo ulihiina sanduuqii sudhay, daboolkiina wuxuu saaray sanduuqa dushiisii;
english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

kikuyu: markaasuu sanduuqiina taambuuggii soo geliyey, oo haddana sudhay ilxidhkii daaha, oo wuxuu ku qariyey sanduuqii maragga, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo miiskiina wuxuu geliyey teendhadii shirka, oo wuxuu dhigay ilxidhka dibaddiisa oo ah taambuugga dhankiisa woqooyi.
english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

kikuyu: Oo intuu Rabbiga hor dhigay ayuu kibistii hagaajiyey, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo laambaddiina wuxuu geliyey teendhadii shirka, oo wuxuu dhigay meel miiska ku toosan, oo ah taambuugga dhankiisa koonfureed.
english: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Markaasuu laambadihii Rabbiga hortiisa ku shiday, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii allabariga oo dahabka ahaydna wuu soo geliyey teendhadii shirka, oo wuxuu dhigay ilxidhka hortiisa,
english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

kikuyu: oo markaasuu ku shiday foox uunsi udgoon ah, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo taambuugga iriddiisiina wuxuu sudhay daahii.
english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii allabariga lagu gubi jirayna wuxuu ag dhigay iridda taambuugga ee teendhada shirka, oo wuxuu dusheeda ku bixiyey qurbaankii la gubayay iyo qurbaankii hadhuudhka ahaa, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo berkeddii weysadana wuxuu dhigay teendhadii shirka iyo meeshii allabariga dhexdooda, oo wuxuu ku shubay biyo in lagu maydho.
english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse iyo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisiiba gacmaha iyo cagaha ayay ku maydheen;
english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

kikuyu: oo markay teendhada shirka galeen iyo markay meesha allabariga u soo dhowaadeenba way ku maydheen, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Markaasuu qotomiyey dayrkii barxadda taambuuggii iyo meeshii allabariga ku wareegsanaa, oo barxadda iriddeediina wuxuu sudhay daahii. Sidaasuu Muuse shuqulkii u dhammeeyey.
english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

kikuyu: Markaasaa daruurtii teendhadii shirka qarisay, ammaantii Rabbiguna taambuuggay ka buuxsantay.
english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo Muusena inuu teendhadii shirka galo wuu kari waayay, maxaa yeelay, daruurtii baa dul joogtay, oo ammaantii Rabbiguna taambuuggay ka buuxday.
english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo markii daruurtii taambuuggii kor ahayd laga qaaday ayaa reer binu Israa'iil hore u sii wadeen sodcaalladoodii oo dhan,
english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

kikuyu: laakiinse haddii aan daruurtii kor loo qaadin, ma ay socon jirin ilaa maalinta kor loo qaado.
english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

kikuyu: Waayo, daruurtii Rabbigu maalintii taambuuggay dul joogi jirtay, habeenkiina waxaa daruurtii ku jiri jiray dab, reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammuna waxyaalahaas ayay arki jireen sodcaalladoodii oo dhan.
english: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse uga yeedhay teendhadii shirka oo intuu la hadlay ayuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil la hadal oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Markii nin idinka mid ahu uu Rabbiga qurbaan u bixinayo, qurbaankiinna waxaad ka bixisaan xoolaha, kuwaasoo ah lo'da iyo idaha.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

kikuyu: Oo haddii qurbaankiisu yahay qurbaan la gubo oo lo' ah, waa inuu bixiyaa neef lab oo aan iin lahayn, oo waa inuu ku bixiyaa teendhada shirka iriddeeda, si isaga Rabbiga hortiisa loogu aqbalo.
english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo waa inuu gacanta saaraa madaxa neefka qurbaanka la gubayo, oo waxaa loo aqbali doonaa inuu isaga u ahaado kafaaraggud.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

kikuyu: Oo dibiga waa inuu Rabbiga hortiisa ku gowraco, oo wiilasha Haaruun oo wadaaddada ahu waa inay dhiigga keenaan, oo ay dhiigga ku dul rusheeyaan hareeraha meesha allabariga ee teendhada shirka horteeda taal.
english: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo neefka qurbaanka la gubayo waa inuu haragga ka bixiyaa, oo haddana waa inuu xubin xubin u googooyaa.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

kikuyu: Oo wiilasha Haaruun oo wadaaddada ahu waa inay meesha allabariga dab ku shubaan oo haddana waa inay qoryo ku dul hagaajiyaan dabka,
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

kikuyu: oo markaas wiilasha Haaruun oo wadaaddada ahu xubnaha iyo madaxa iyo baruurta ha ku dul hagaajiyeen qoryaha dabka meesha allabariga saaran,
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

kikuyu: laakiinse neefka uurkujirtiisa iyo addimmadiisa biyo ha ku maydho, oo wadaadku meesha allabariga dusheeda dhammaantiis ha ugu gubo qurbaan la gubo oo ah qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo oo Rabbiga caraf udgoon u ah.
english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo haddii qurbaankiisu yahay neef adhi ah, ha ahaado wan ama orgi oo qurbaan la gubo loo keenay, ha bixiyo neef lab oo aan iin lahayn.
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

kikuyu: Oo neefka waa inuu Rabbiga ku hor gowraco meesha allabariga dhinaceeda woqooyi, oo wiilasha Haaruun oo wadaaddada ahu dhiiggiisa ha ku dul rusheeyeen hareeraha meesha allabariga.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Oo haddana isagu xubin xubin ha u kala googooyo, iyo madaxiisa iyo baruurtiisa, oo markaas wadaadku waa inuu ku dul hagaajiyo qoryaha dabka meesha allabariga saaran,
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

kikuyu: laakiinse neefka uurkujirtiisa iyo addimmadiisa biyo ha ku maydho, oo wadaadku dhammaantiis ha bixiyo, oo meesha allabariga dusheeda ha ku gubo, waayo, waa qurbaan la gubo oo ah qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo, oo Rabbiga caraf udgoon u ah.
english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo haddii qurbaankiisa uu Rabbiga u bixinayo uu yahay haad qurbaan la gubo ah, markaas qurbaankiisa ha u bixiyo qoolleyo ama xamaam yaryar.
english: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

kikuyu: Oo wadaadku ha keeno meesha allabariga agteeda, oo madaxa ha ka maroojiyo, oo meesha allabariga dusheeda ha ku gubo, oo dhiiggana ha lagaga miiro meesha allabariga agteeda.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;
