kikuyu: Waayo, jiidhka noloshiisii waxay ku dhex jirtaa dhiigga; oo anna waxaan meesha allabariga dusheeda idiinku siiyey in nafihiinna loogu kafaaro gudo, waayo, waa dhiigga waxa loogu kafaaro gudaa nolosha daraaddeed.
english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waxaan reer binu Israa'iil ku idhi, Qof idinka mid ahu waa inuusan dhiig cunin, oo shisheeyaha idin dhex degganuna waa inuusan dhiig cunin.
english: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

kikuyu: Oo nin alla ninkii ka mid ah reer binu Israa'iil ama shisheeyayaasha dhexdooda deggan hadduu ugaadhsasho ku helo neef amase haad ugaadh ah oo la cuno, waa inuu dhiiggiisa daadiyaa oo ciid ku daboolaa.
english: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

kikuyu: Waayo, jiidh kastaba naftiisa iyo dhiiggiisu waa isku mid qudha, oo sidaas daraaddeed ayaan reer binu Israa'iil ku idhi, Waa inaydaan jiidhnaba dhiiggiisa cunin cayn kastoo uu yahayba, waayo, jiidh kastaba noloshiisu waa dhiiggiisa, oo qof alla qofkii dhiig cunaba waa la gooyn doonaa.
english: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

kikuyu: Oo qof kasta oo cuna neef iska bakhtiyey amase neef dugaagu bakhtiistay, hadduu yahay waddani iyo hadduu shisheeye yahayba waa inuu dharkiisa maydhaa, oo isna biyo ku maydhaa, oo tan iyo fiidkana nijaas buu ahaanayaa, oo dabadeedna daahir buu ahaan doonaa.
english: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadduusan dharkiisa maydhin ama uusan jidhkiisa maydhin, markaasuu dembigiisa qaadan doonaa.
english: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD said to Moses,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil la hadal oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Falimaha dalka Masar ee aad degganaan jirteen waa inaydaan samayn, oo falimaha dalka Kancaan oo aan idiin geeynayana waa inaydaan samayn, oo qaynuunnadoodana waa inaydaan ku socon.
english: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

kikuyu: Waxaad samaysaan xukummadayda, oo waxaad dhawrtaan qaynuunnadayda si aad iyaga ugu dhex socotaan, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed idinku waa inaad dhawrtaan qaynuunnadayda iyo xukummadayda, oo ninkii sameeyaana iyaguu ku noolaan doonaa, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Waa inaan midkiinna u dhowaan qof ka mid ah xigaalkiisa u dhow inuu cawradiisa qaawiyo, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Cawrada aabbahaa taasoo ah cawrada hooyadaa waa inaadan qaawin, iyadu waa hooyadaa, ee waa inaadan cawradeeda qaawin.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaadan qaawin cawrada naagta aabbahaa, ee waa cawradii aabbahaa.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan qaawin cawrada walaashaa oo ah aabbahaa gabadhiisa ama hooyadaa gabadheeda, hadday guriga ku dhalatay iyo hadday meel kale ku dhalatayba.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan qaawin cawrada gabadha wiilkaaga, ama cawrada gabadha gabadhaada, waayo, toodu waa cawradaadii.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan qaawin cawrada naagta aabbahaa gabadheeda ay aabbahaa u dhashay, waayo, iyadu waa walaashaa, ee waa inaadan cawradeeda qaawin.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan qaawin cawrada eeddadaa, waayo, iyadu waa aabbahaa qaraabadiis u dhow.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan qaawin cawrada habaryartaa, waayo, iyadu waa hooyadaa qaraabadeed u dhow.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan adeerkaa cawradiisa qaawin. Waa inaadan naagtiisa u dhowaan, waayo, iyadu waa aayadaa.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan qaawin cawrada gabadha aad soddogga u tahay, waayo, iyadu waa naagtii wiilkaaga, ee waa inaadan cawradeeda qaawin.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan qaawin cawrada naagta walaalkaa, waayo, taasu waa cawradii walaalkaa.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan naag iyo gabadheedaba cawradooda wada qaawin, oo waa inaadan kaxaysan gabadha wiilkeeda ama gabadha gabadheeda si aad cawradeeda u qaawisid; waayo, iyagu waa naago qaraabo kuu dhow ah, oo taasu waa shar.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan naagtaada walaasheed la guursan oo aadan cawradeeda qaawin intay naagtaadu nooshahay.
english: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan naag u dhowaan si aad cawradeeda u qaawisid, in alla intay xaylka ku nijaasaysan tahay.
english: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan la jiifsan naagta deriskaaga, si aadan iyada ugu nijaasoobin.
english: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan carruurtaada Moleg siin oo aadan iyaga innaba dab u dhex marsiin, oo weliba waa inaadan magaca Ilaahaaga hadal nijaas ah ka sheegin, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan ragga ula seexan sida dumarka loola seexdo oo kale, waayo, taasu waa karaahiyo.
english: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan neef xayawaan ah kudin si aadan ugu nijaasoobin, oo naaguna waa inayan neef xayawaan ah is-hor taagin si ay isaga ugu jiifsato, waayo, taasu waa qasnaan.
english: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

kikuyu: Idinku waxyaalahaas midkoodna nafsaddiinna ha ku nijaasaynina, waayo, quruumihii aan hortiinna ka eryay oo dhammu waxyaalahaas bay ku nijaasoobeen,
english: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

kikuyu: oo dalkii wuu nijaasoobay, haddaba sidaas daraaddeed ayaan xumaantiisii soo gaadhsiinayaa, oo dalku waa mantagayaa dadka deggan.
english: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

kikuyu: Haddaba idinku waa inaad dhawrtaan qaynuunnadayda iyo xukummadayda, oo waa inaydaan waxyaalahaas karaahiyada ah innaba samayn, kiinnii waddani ah, iyo kii shisheeye ah oo idin dhex degganuba,
english: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

kikuyu: (waayo, dadkii dalka degganaan jiray oo idinka horreeyey waxyaalahaas karaahiyada ah oo dhan ayay wada samayn jireen, oo dalkuna wuu nijaasoobay;)
english: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),

kikuyu: si markaad nijaasaysaan dalku uusan idinkana idiin mantagin, siduu quruuntii idinka horraysay u mantagay oo kale.
english: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

kikuyu: Waayo, ku alla kii sameeya waxyaalahaas karaahiyada ah, xataa nafihii waxyaalahaas sameeya dadkooda waa laga gooyn doonaa.
english: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waa inaad amarkayga xajisaan si aydaan u samayn oo aydaan ugu nijaasoobin caadooyinkaas karaahiyada ah oo dadkii idinka horreeyey ay samayn jireen, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: La hadal ururka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Waa inaad quduus ahaataan, waayo, anigoo ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahuba quduus baan ahay.
english: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.

kikuyu: Oo idinka midkiin kastaaba waa inuu ka cabsadaa aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis, oo waa inaad dhawrtaan maalmahayga sabtida ah, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Sanamyo ha u jeesanina, oo hana samaysanina ilaahyo la tumay, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Oo markaad allabari qurbaanno nabaadiino ah Rabbiga u bixinaysaan waa inaad bixisaan si laydiin aqbalo.
english: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

kikuyu: Oo waa in dhammaantiis la wada cunaa maalinta aad bixisaan iyo maalinta ku xigta, oo haddii wax ka hadhaan oo ay gaadhaan maalinta saddexaad waa in dab lagu gubaa.
english: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Oo innaba haddii maalinta saddexaad la cuno waa karaahiyo, oo la aqbali maayo,
english: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

kikuyu: ku alla kii cunaase dembigiisuu qaadanayaa, maxaa yeelay, nijaas buu ka dhigay Rabbiga wixiisii quduuska ahaa, oo qofkaasna dadkiisa waa laga gooyn doonaa.
english: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Oo markaad goosataan waxa dhulkiinna ka soo baxa waa inaydaan midhaha ka wada goosan rukummada beertiinna, oo weliba waa inaydaan soo urursan xaaxaabka beergoosadkiinna.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

kikuyu: Oo beertiinna canabka ahna waa inaydaan xaaxaabin, oo midhaha beertiinna canabka ah oo dhacayna waa inaydaan soo urursan, laakiinse waa inaad u daysaan miskiinka iyo shisheeyaha, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan waxba xadin, oo aydaan daacadla'aan ku isticmaalin, waana inaan midkiinna midka kale been u sheegin.
english: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaydaan magacayga been ugu dhaaran, yeydnan hadal nijaas ah ka sheegin magaca Ilaahiinna, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan deriskaaga dulmin, waana inaadan waxba ka dhicin. Oo shaqaale aad soo kiraysatay mushahaaradiisu yaanay habeenkii kugu baryin oo kugu gaadhin tan iyo subaxda dambe.
english: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan caayin qofkii dhega la', oo kii indha la'na waa inaadan hortiisa dhigin wax lagu turunturoodo, laakiinse waa inaad Ilaahaaga ka cabsataa, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan garsooridda caddaaladdarro ku samayn, oo waa inaadan miskiinka u eexan, ama aadan cisayn qofka weyn, laakiinse deriskaaga waxaad ugu garsoortaa si caddaalad ah.
english: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan dadkaaga xan kula dhex wareegin, oo waa inaadan deriskaaga dhiiggiisa hor joogsan, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan walaalkaa qalbiga ka nebcaan, oo sida xaqiiqada ah waa inaad deriskaaga canaanataa, yaadan isaga daraaddiis dembi u qaadane.
english: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan ninna ka aarsan, waana inaadan dadkaaga u ciil qabin, laakiinse waa inaad deriskaaga u jeclaataa sidaad naftaada u jeceshahay oo kale, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Waa inaad qaynuunnadayda dhawrtaan. Waa inaadan xoolahaaga u dayn inay cayn kale ku beermaan, oo waa inaadan beertaada ku beeran midho laba cayn ah, oo waa inaadan xidhan dhar laga sameeyey laba cayn oo isku darsan.
english: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii la seexda naag addoon ah oo nin u doonan, oo aan la madax furin ama aan la xorayn, markaas waa in iyaga la ciqaabaa, laakiinse waa inaan iyaga la dilin, maxaa yeelay, iyadu xor ma ay ahayn.
english: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

kikuyu: Oo isagu waa inuu qurbaankiisii xadgudubka, kaasoo ah wan ah qurbaan xadgudub, Rabbiga ugu keenaa iridda teendhada shirka.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

kikuyu: Oo wadaadku waa inuu isaga kafaaraggud uga dhigaa wanka qurbaanka xadgudubka ah, oo waa inuu Rabbiga hortiisa ugu bixiyaa dembiguu dembaabay aawadiis, oo isagana waa laga cafiyi doonaa dembigii uu dembaabay.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

kikuyu: Oo markaad dalka gashaan, oo aad cunto u beerataan dhir cayn kasta ah, markaas waa inaad midhahooda ku tirisaan sidii wax buuryoqab ah, oo intii saddex sannadood ah waxay idiin ahaan doonaan sidii wax buuryoqab ah, oo waa inaan midhahaas la cunin.
english: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

kikuyu: Laakiinse sannadda afraad midhahooda oo dhammu quduus bay ahaan doonaan, si Rabbiga loo ammaano aawadeed.
english: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo midhahoodana waxaad cuni doontaan sannadda shanaad, si ay midhahoodu idiinku soo baxaan, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan wax dhiiggoodu ku jiro cunin, oo waa inaydaan u tegin falanfallowyo ama aydaan faalna ku noqnoqon.
english: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan timaha madaxa ka jaran dhinacyada, gadhkiinnana waa inaydaan jarin.
english: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan jidhkiinna u gooyn qof dhintay daraaddiis, ama waa inaydaan waxba ku daabicin, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan gabadhaada nijaasayn oo aadan dhillo ka dhigin, waaba intaasoo uu dalku noqdaa sino miidhan oo uu shar ka buuxsamaa.
english: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

kikuyu: Waa inaad maalmahayga sabtida ah dhawrtaan, oo aad meeshayda quduuska ah maamuustaan, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Ha u jeesanina xagga kuwa ruuxaanta leh, iyo saaxiriinta, oo iyaga ha doondoonina yeydnan nijaasoobine, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Waa inaad qofkii cirro leh u istaagtaa, oo waa inaad ninkii oday ah cisaysaa, waana inaad Ilaahaa ka cabsataa, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo haddii mid shisheeye ahu idinla deggan yahay dhulkiinna, waa inaydaan xumayn.
english: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

kikuyu: Shisheeyaha idinla degganu waa inuu idiinla mid ahaadaa sida waddaniga idin dhex jooga, oo waa inaad isaga u jeclaataan sidaad naftiinna u jeceshihiin oo kale, maxaa yeelay, idinkuba shisheeyayaal baad ku ahaan jirteen dalkii Masar, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan xaqdarro ka samayn garsooridda, iyo cabbiridda, iyo miisaamidda iyo beegiddaba.
english: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

kikuyu: Waa inaad haysataan kafado qumman iyo miisaan qumman, iyo eefaah qumman iyo hiin qumman, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah oo dalkii Masar idinka soo bixiyey.
english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad wada dhawrtaan oo yeeshaan qaynuunnadayda oo dhan iyo xukummadayda oo dhan, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Weliba waxaad ku tidhaahdaa reer binu Israa'iil, Ku alla kii reer binu Israa'iil ka mid ah, ama shisheeyayaasha idin dhex deggan ka mid ah, oo carruurtiisa Moleg siiya, sida xaqiiqada ah kaas waa in la dilaa, oo dadka dalka degganu waa inay dhagax la dhacaan.
english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

kikuyu: Oo anna qofkaas ayaan ka gees noqon doonaa, oo isagaan dadkiisa ka dhex gooyn doonaa, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu carruurtiisii siiyey Moleg, oo sidaasuu meeshayda quduuska ah ku nijaaseeyey oo uu magacayga quduuska ahna wax nijaas ah kaga sheegay.
english: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

kikuyu: Oo haddii dadka dalka degganu ay ninkaas indhahooda ka qarsadaan oo ayan isaga dilin markuu carruurtiisa Moleg siiyo,
english: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,

kikuyu: markaas aniga ayaa ninkaas iyo reerkiisaba ka gees noqon doonaa, oo isaga iyo in alla intii raacda inay Moleg u daba galaan sida naagu ninkeeda uga dhillowdo, waxaan ka dhex gooyn doonaa dadkooda.
english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

kikuyu: Oo qof alla qofkii u jeesta xagga kuwa ruuxaanta leh iyo saaxiriinta, oo iyaga u daba gala sida naagu ninkeeda uga dhillowdo, sida xaqiiqada ah anigu qofkaas ayaan ka gees noqon doonaa oo isagaan dadkiisa ka dhex gooyn doonaa.
english: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

kikuyu: Haddaba isdaahiriya oo quduus ahaada, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad qaynuunnadayda dhawrtaan oo yeeshaan, waayo, anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga quduus idinka dhiga.
english: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii caaya aabbihiis ama hooyadiis, sida xaqiiqada ah waa in la dilaa, waayo, wuxuu caayay aabbihiis ama hooyadiis, oo dhiiggiisuna isaguu dul saarnaan doonaa.
english: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.

kikuyu: Oo nin alla ninkii ka sinaysta nin kale naagtiis, kaasoo ah kii ka sinaysta naagta deriskiisa, sida xaqiiqada ah dhillayga iyo dhilladaba waa in la dilaa.
english: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo ninkii naagta aabbihiis la seexdaana wuxuu qaawiyey cawradii aabbihiis, oo sida xaqiiqada ah labadoodaba waa in la dilaa; oo dhiiggooduna iyaguu dul saarnaan doonaa.
english: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin la seexdo gabadh uu soddog u yahay, sida xaqiiqada ah labadoodaba waa in la dilaa; iyagu waxay sameeyeen wax qas ah, oo dhiiggooduna iyaguu dul saarnaan doonaa.
english: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin nin kaleeto ula seexdo sida dumarka loola seexdo oo kale, labadooduba waxay sameeyeen karaahiyo oo sida xaqiiqada ah waa in iyaga la dilaa, oo dhiiggooduna iyaguu dul saarnaan doonaa.
english: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin wada guursado naag iyo hooyadeed, taasu waa shar, oo isaga iyo labadoodaba waa in dhammaantood dab lagu gubaa, si aan sharu idiinku dhex jirin.
english: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin neef xayawaan ah kudo, sida xaqiiqada ah waa in ninkaas la dilaa, oo neefkana waa inaad gowracdaan.
english: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

kikuyu: Oo naaguna hadday u dhowaato neef xayawaan ah, oo ay u jiifsato, naagta iyo neefkaba waa inaad dishaan, sida xaqiiqada ah waa in labadoodaba la dilaa; oo dhiiggooduna iyaguu dul saarnaan doonaa.
english: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin kaxaysto walaashiis oo ah ina aabbihiis ama ina hooyadiis, oo uu cawradeeda arko, oo iyana ay cawradiisa aragto, taasu waa wax ceeb ah, oo iyaga waa in dadkooda hortiisa laga gooyaa, waayo, isagu wuxuu qaawiyey cawradii walaashiis, oo dembigiisana wuu qaadan doonaa.
english: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin la seexdo naag xayl qabta, oo uu cawradeeda qaawiyo, wuxuu qaawiyey ishii dhiiggeeda oo iyana waxay qaawisay ishii dhiiggeeda, oo markaas labadoodaba waa in laga gooyaa dadkooda.
english: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaadan qaawin habaryartaa, ama eeddadaa, waayo, kii saas yeelaa wuxuu qaawiyey xigaalkiisa u dhow, oo iyagu waxay qaadan doonaan dembigooda.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin la seexdo naagta adeerkiis, kaasu wuxuu qaawiyey cawradii adeerkiis; iyagu waxay qaadan doonaan dembigooda, oo waxay dhiman doonaan iyagoo gablan ah.
english: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin kaxaysto naagta walaalkiis, taasu waa nijaas, waayo, wuxuu qaawiyey cawradii walaalkiis, oo iyagu waxay ahaan doonaan gablan.
english: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.

kikuyu: Haddaba waa inaad wada xajisaan oo yeeshaan qaynuunnadayda oo dhan iyo xukummadayda oo dhan, si dalka aan idin geeynayo inaad degtaan uusan idiin mantagin.
english: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaydaan ku socon caadooyinkii quruuntii aan hortiinna ka eryayo, waayo, iyagu waxyaalahaas oo dhan ayay samayn jireen, oo sidaas daraaddeed ayaan u karhay.
english: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaan idinku idhi, Idinka ayaa dalkoodii dhaxli doona, oo hanti ahaan ayaan idiin siinayaa, kaasoo ah dal caano iyo malab la barwaaqaysan, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah oo idinka soocay dadyowga.
english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waa inaad kala soocdaan xayawaanka daahirka ah iyo kan nijaasta ah, iyo haadda daahirka ah iyo tan nijaasta ah, oo waa inaydaan nafihiinna wax karaahiyo ah kaga dhigin xayawaan ama haad ama waxa dhulka ku gurguurta oo aan idinka soocay oo aan idhi, Waa nijaas.
english: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

kikuyu: Waa inaad quduus ii ahaataan, waayo, anigoo Rabbiga ahuba quduus baan ahay, oo dadyowgii baan idinka soocay, si aad kuwaygii u ahaataan.
english: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

kikuyu: Oo weliba sida xaqiiqada ah waa in la dilaa ninkii ama naagtii ruuxaan leh, ama ku alla kii saaxir ah, oo iyaga waa in dhagax la dhacaa, oo dhiiggooduna iyaguu dul saarnaan doonaa.
english: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse ku yidhi, La hadal wadaaddada ah wiilashii Haaruun, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Ninkiinna yuusan isu nijaasayn mid dadkiisa ah oo dhintay,
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

kikuyu: xigaalkiisa u dhow mooyaane, kuwaasoo ah hooyadiis, ama aabbihiis, ama wiilkiisa, ama gabadhiisa, ama walaalkiis,
english: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

kikuyu: ama walaashiisa bikradda ah oo isaga u dhow, oo aan weli nin guursan; taas wuu isu nijaasayn karaa.
english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

kikuyu: Waa inuusan isnijaasayn isagoo dadkiisa madax u ah, yuusan nijaas iska dhigin.
english: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaan ninkoodna madaxa xiiran, oo waa inayan gadhkooda xiirin, ama ayan jidhkooda gooyn.
english: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

kikuyu: Iyagu waa inay Ilaahooda quduus u ahaadaan, oo ayan wax nijaas ah ka sheegin magaca Ilaahooda, waayo, iyagu waxay bixiyaan qurbaannadii Rabbiga ee dabka lagu sameeyo oo ah cuntada Ilaahooda, oo sidaas daraaddeed waa inay quduus ahaadaan.
english: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

kikuyu: Waa inayan guursan naag dhillo ah ama mid la nijaaseeyey, oo waa inayan guursan naag la furay, waayo, wadaadku quduus buu Ilaahiis u yahay.
english: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waa inaad isaga quduus ka dhigtaa, waayo, isagu wuxuu bixiyaa cuntada Ilaahaaga, oo isagu waa inuu quduus kuu ahaadaa, waayo, anba quduus baan ahay, anigoo ah Rabbiga quduus idinka dhiga.
english: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.

kikuyu: Oo wadaad kasta haddii ay gabadhiisu isnijaasayso oo ay dhillowdo, iyadu nijaas bay ka dhigaysaa aabbaheed, oo waa in dab lagu gubaa.
english: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Oo kii wadaadka sare walaalihiis ka dhex ah, oo madaxiisa lagu shubay saliiddii subkidda, oo ah kan loo daahiriyey inuu xidho dharka quduuska ah waa inaanay timaha madaxiisu arbushnaan ama uusan dharkiisa dildillaacin.
english: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waa inuusan meyd gudaha ugu gelin, oo xataa waa inuusan isu nijaasayn aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis toona.
english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

kikuyu: Oo waa inuusan dibadda uga bixin meesha quduuska ah, waana inuusan nijaasayn meesha quduuska ah ee Ilaahiisa, waayo, isaga waxaa kor saaran taajkii saliidda subkidda ee Ilaahiisa, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo isagu waa inuu guursadaa gabadh bikrad ah.
english: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

kikuyu: Waa inuusan marnaba guursan carmal, ama naag la furay, ama naag nijaasowday oo dhillo ah, laakiinse waa inuu guursadaa gabadh bikrad ah oo dadkiisa ka dhalatay.
english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

kikuyu: Oo waa inuusan dhashiisa ku dhex nijaasayn dadkiisa, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga isaga quduus ka dhiga.
english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Haaruun la hadal, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Tan iyo ab ka ab ku alla kii farcankaaga ahu, isagoo iin leh, yuusan u dhowaan inuu cuntada Ilaahiisa bixiyo.
english: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

kikuyu: Waayo, nin alla ninkuu yahayba, kii iin lahu waa inuusan u soo dhowaan, kaasoo ah ninkii indha la' ama curyaan ah, ama kii sankiisu faruuran yahay, ama jidhkiisu leeyahay wax dheeraad ah,
english: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

kikuyu: ama ninkii cag jaban, ama gacan jaban,
english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

kikuyu: ama kii tuur leh, ama kii cilin ah, ama kii ishiisu iin leedahay, ama kii cambaar qaba, ama kii cadho qaba, ama kii xiniinyihiisu burbureen.
english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

kikuyu: Wadaadka Haaruun ah nin alla ninkii farcankiisa ka mid ahu isagoo iin leh waa inuusan u soo dhowaan inuu bixiyo qurbaannada Rabbiga oo dabka lagu sameeyo, waayo, isagu iin buu leeyahay, oo waa inuusan u soo dhowaan inuu cuntada Ilaahiisa bixiyo.
english: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

kikuyu: Isagu waa inuu cunaa cuntada Ilaahiisa, tan quduuska ah iyo tan ugu wada quduusanba.
english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waa inuusan meesha daaha leh gelin, ama uusan meesha allabariga u dhowaan, si uusan u nijaasayn meelahayga quduuska ah, maxaa yeelay, isagu iin buu leeyahay, oo aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga iyaga quduus ka dhiga.
english: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

kikuyu: Muuse sidaasuu kula hadlay Haaruun iyo wiilashiisii, iyo dadkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhanba.
english: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: La hadal Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa, oo waxaad iyaga u sheegtaa inay iska soocaan waxyaalaha quduuska ah oo reer binu Israa'iil, oo ay ii daahiriyaan, iyo inayan wax nijaas ah ka sheegin magacayga quduuska ah, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad iyaga ku tidhaahdaa, Ku alla kii ka mid ah farcankiinna oo dhan tan iyo ab ka ab, hadduu isagoo nijaas qaba u soo dhowaado waxyaalaha quduuska ah oo reer binu Israa'iil ay Rabbiga u daahiriyeen, qofkaas hortayda waa in laga gooyaa, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii farcanka Haaruun ka mid ah oo baras qaba, ama dheecaan ka daadanayaa, waa inuusan wax ka cunin waxyaalaha quduuska ah jeeruu daahir noqdo. Oo ku alla kii taabta wax meyd ku nijaasoobay, ama uu taabta nin shahwaddiisu ka daadatay,
english: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,

kikuyu: ama ku alla kii taabta wax gurguurta oo uu isagu ku nijaasoobo, amase qof isaga nijaaso qabadsiin kara, wax kastoo ay nijaastiisu tahayba,
english: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—

kikuyu: qof alla qofkii waxyaalaha caynkaas ah taabtaa wuxuu nijaas ahaan doonaa tan iyo fiidkii, oo waa inuusan wax ka cunin waxyaalaha quduuska ah, inuu jidhkiisa biyo ku maydho mooyaane.
english: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.

kikuyu: Oo isna markii qorraxdu dhacdo ayuu daahir noqon doonaa, oo markaas dabadeedna isagu wax ha ka cuno waxyaalaha quduuska ah, maxaa yeelay, taasu waa cuntadiisii.
english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

kikuyu: Oo isagu si uusan ugu nijaasoobin waa inuusan innaba cunin wax iska bakhtiyey amase dugaagu bakhtiistay, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo sidaas daraaddeed iyagu waa inay amarkayga xajiyaan, waaba intaasoo ay dembi u qaataan taas aawadeed oo ay ku dhintaan haddii ay nijaaseeyaan, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga iyaga quduus ka dhiga.
english: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

kikuyu: Oo qof qalaadu waa inuusan waxba ka cunin waxa quduuska ah, oo qofkii wadaadka la deggan, amase shaqaalihii la soo kiraystay waa inuusan waxba ka cunin waxa quduuska ah.
english: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii wadaad qof soo iibsado, kii uu lacagtiisa ku soo iibsaday wax ha ka cuno, oo intii isaga gurigiisa ku dhalatayna cuntadiisa wax ha ka cuneen.
english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

kikuyu: Oo wadaad gabadhiis hadday nin qalaad guursato, iyadu waa inayan wax ka cunin qurbaanka sare loo qaado ee waxyaalaha quduuska ah.
english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

kikuyu: Laakiinse wadaad gabadhiis hadday carmal tahay, ama la soo furay, oo ayan carruur lahayn, oo ay ku soo noqoto gurigii aabbaheed, oo ay halkaas u joogto sidii waagii ay yarayd, markaas iyadu wax ha ka cunto cuntada aabbaheed, laakiinse qof qalaadu yuusan wax ka cunin.
english: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.

kikuyu: Oo waxa quduuska ah haddii nin kama' ku cuno, intii uu cunay oo shan meelood loo dhigay meesheed ha ku sii daro, oo waxa quduuska ah wadaadka ha u dhiibo.
english: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu waa inayan nijaasayn waxyaalaha quduuska ah ee reer binu Israa'iil oo ay Rabbiga u bixiyaan,
english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,

kikuyu: si ayan uga dhigin inay iyagu qaataan xumaanta eedda keenta, markay cunaan waxyaalahooda quduuska ah, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga iyaga quduus ka dhiga.
english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaad la hadashaa Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa iyo dadka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Ku alla kii reer binu Israa'iil ka mid ah, ama dadka shisheeyayaasha ah ee reer binu Israa'iil dhex deggan, markay keenaan qurbaankooda ay Rabbiga ugu bixinayaan qurbaan la gubo aawadiis, hadduu yahay nidarradooda midkood amase qurbaannadooda ikhtiyaarka ah,
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:

kikuyu: si laydiinka aqbalo aawadeed waa inaad bixisaan neef lab oo aan iin lahayn, kaasoo ka mid ah lo'da, ama idaha, ama orgida.
english: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waa inaydaan bixin wax alla wixii iin leh, waayo, waxaas laydinka aqbali maayo.
english: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii Rabbiga u bixiyo allabari qurbaanno nabaadiino ah, si uu ku oofiyo nidar amase qurbaan ikhtiyaar ah, si looga aqbalo aawadeed waa inuu ka bixiyaa lo'da ama idaha neef dhan oo aan innaba iin lahayn.
english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan Rabbiga u bixin ama aydaan ka dhigin qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo oo meesha allabariga loo saaro Rabbiga aawadiis neef indha la', ama mid jaban, ama mid naafo ah, ama mid qoon leh, ama mid cambaar qaba, ama mid cadho qaba.
english: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo dibi yar ama wan yar miduu yahayba neefkii jidhkiisu wax dheeraad ah leeyahay ama xubnihiisa wax ka dhiman yihiin, kaas qurbaan ikhtiyaar ah waad u bixin kartaa, laakiinse nidar daraaddiis loo aqbali maayo.
english: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan Rabbiga u bixin neef xiniinyihiisa la burburiyey, ama la tumay, ama la jejebiyey, ama laga gooyay, oo waa inaydaan dalkiinna sidaasoo kale ku dhex samayn.
english: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

kikuyu: Oo kuwaas waa inaydaan ka guddoomin qof shisheeye ah gacantiis oo aydaan ku bixin cuntada Ilaahiinna, maxaa yeelay, iyagu wax kharriban bay leeyihiin, oo iin baa ku taal. Sidaas daraaddeed iyaga innaba laydinka aqbali maayo.
english: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Markii uu dhasho dibi ama wan ama orgi intii toddoba maalmood ah waa inuu hooyadiis ku hoos jiraa, oo maalinta siddeedaad iyo intii ka dambaysana waa loo aqbali doonaa in Rabbiga loogu bixiyo qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo.
english: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo sac iyo lax toona waa inaydaan ilmaheeda iyo iyada isku maalin gowracin.
english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

kikuyu: Oo markaad Rabbiga u bixinaysaan allabari mahadnaqid ah, waa inaad kaas u bixisaan si laydiinka aqbalo.
english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

kikuyu: Oo isla maalintaas waa in la wada cunaa, oo waa inaydaan waxba ka reebin tan iyo subaxda dambe, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waa inaad xajisaan oo yeeshaan amarradayda, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan wax nijaas ah ka sheegin magacayga quduuska ah, laakiinse quduus baan ku dhex ahaan doonaa dadka reer binu Israa'iil, waayo, anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga quduus idinka dhiga,
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,

kikuyu: oo dalkii Masar idiinka soo bixiyey inuu Ilaah idiin ahaado aawadeed, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Dadka reer binu Israa'iil la hadal oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Kuwanu waa Rabbiga iidihiisa la amray, oo aad naadin doontaan inay ahaadaan shirar quduus ah. Xataa kuwanu waa iidahayga la amray.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

kikuyu: Lix maalmood waa in shuqul la qabtaa, laakiinse maalinta toddobaad waa sabti nasasho weyn leh oo ah shir quduus ah. Waa inaydaan innaba shuqul qaban cayn kastoo uu yahayba, waayo, waa sabti ay tahay in Rabbiga looga dhawro meel kastoo aad deggan tihiinba.
english: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa Rabbiga iidihiisa la amray, oo ah shirar quduus ah, oo ay tahay inaad naadisaan wakhtigooda la amray.
english: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

kikuyu: Bisha kowaad, maalinteeda afar iyo tobnaad, markay fiidkii tahay, waa Rabbiga iiddiisii Kormaridda.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.

kikuyu: Oo isla bishaas maalinteeda shan iyo tobnaadna waa Iidda Kibista-aan-khamiirka-lahayn oo Rabbiga loo qabto, oo intii toddoba maalmood ah waa inaad kibis aan khamiir lahayn cuntaan.
english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta kowaad waa inaad shir quduus ah yeelataan. Waa inaydaan innaba shuqul adag qaban.
english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Laakiinse intii toddoba maalmood ah waa inaad Rabbiga u bixisaan qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo, oo maalinta toddobaad waa shir quduus ah, oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul adag qaban.
english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi.
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Dadka reer binu Israa'iil la hadal, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Dalka aan idin siinaya markaad gashaan oo aad midhaha goosataan, markaas waxaad wadaadka u keentaan xidhmo ah beergooyska midhihiisa ugu horreeya.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

kikuyu: Oo isna xidhmada waa inuu ku ruxruxaa Rabbiga hortiisa si laydiin aqbalo, oo maalinta sabtida ka dambaysa wadaadku waa inuu ruxruxaa.
english: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta aad xidhmada ruxruxdaan, wan yar oo aan iin lahayn oo gu jira waa inaad Rabbiga ugu bixisaan qurbaan la gubo aawadiis.
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ahuna waa inuu ahaadaa eefaah toban meelood loo dhigay labadiis meelood oo bur wanaagsan ah oo saliid lagu daray, kaasoo ah qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo oo Rabbiga caraf udgoon u ah, oo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahuna waa inuu ahaadaa khamri, kaasoo ah hiin afar meelood loo dhigay meesheed.
english: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaydaan cunin kibis, ama hadhuudh duban, ama sabuullo cusub ilaa isla maalintaas, jeeraad keentaan qurbaankii Ilaahiinna. Kaasu weligiinba waa idiin qaynuun tan iyo ab ka ab meel kastoo aad deggan tihiinba.
english: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: Oo maalintii aad keenteen xidhmada qurbaanka la ruxruxo, oo ah maalinta ka dambaysa sabtida, waxaad ka tirsataan toddoba toddobaad oo kaamil ah.
english: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad tirsataan konton maalmood ilaa maalinta ka dambaysa sabtida toddobaad, oo dabadeedna waxaad Rabbiga u bixisaan qurbaan hadhuudh cusub ah.
english: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad rugihiinna ka keentaan laba kibsood oo ah qurbaan la ruxruxo, oo ah eefaah toban meelood loo dhigay labadiis meelood, oo waa inay bur ahaadaan, oo waa in khamiir lagu dubaa oo Rabbiga loogu keenaa qurbaan midhaha ugu horreeya.
english: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad kibista la keentaan toddoba wan oo yaryar oo aan iin lahayn oo wada gu jira, iyo dibi yar, iyo laba wan oo waaweyn, oo waa inay Rabbiga u ahaadaan qurbaan la gubo, oo waxaad iyaga la keentaan qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaannadooda cabniinka ahba, kuwaasoo wada ah qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo oo Rabbiga u ah caraf udgoon.
english: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad bixisaan orgi qurbaan dembi ah iyo laba wan oo yaryar oo gu jira oo ah allabari qurbaanno nabaadiino ah.
english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

kikuyu: Oo wadaadku waa inuu Rabbiga hortiisa qurbaan la ruxruxo iyaga ugula ruxruxaa kibista midhaha ugu horreeya oo raacda labada wan oo yaryar, oo iyagu quduus bay Rabbiga u ahaan doonaan wadaadka aawadiis.
english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

kikuyu: Oo isla maalintaas waa inaad naadisaan inuu shir quduus ah idiin jiri doono, oo waa inaydaan dharaartaas shuqul adag qaban, waayo, kaasu weligiinba waa idiin qaynuun tan iyo ab ka ab meel kastoo aad deggan tihiinba.
english: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Oo markaad beeraha dhulkiinna goosataan waa inaydaan dhammaan wada goosan midhaha ku yaal beertiinna geesaheeda, oo weliba waa inaydaan wada urursan xaaxaabka beergoosadkiinna; waa inaad u daysaan miskiinka iyo shisheeyaha, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Dadka reer binu Israa'iil la hadal, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Bisha toddobaad maalinteeda kowaad waxay idiin ahaan doontaa nasasho weyn oo ah buunafuufid xusuus ah, iyo shir quduus ah.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

kikuyu: Oo innaba waa inaydaan shuqul adag qaban, oo waa inaad Rabbiga u bixisaan qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo.
english: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Markaasa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee bishan toddobaad maalinteeda tobnaad waa maalinta kafaaraggudka. Oo waa inay idiin ahaataa shir quduus ah, oo waa inaad nafihiinna dhibtaan; oo waa inaad Rabbiga u bixisaan qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo.
english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo isla maalintaas waa inaydaan waxba shuqul qaban cayn kasta ha ahaadee, waayo, taasu waa maalintii kafaaraggudka in kafaaraggud laydiinku sameeyo Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah hortiisa.
english: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Oo qof kasta ha ahaadee kii aan maalintaas la dhibin, dadkiisa waa in laga gooyaa.
english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Oo qof kasta ha ahaadee kii maalintaas wax shuqul ah qabtaa cayn kastoo uu yahayba, qofkaas ayaan ka dhex baabbi'in doonaa dadkiisa.
english: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan innaba shuqul qaban cayn kastoo uu yahayba, oo kaasu weligiinba waa idiin qaynuun tan iyo ab ka ab meel kastoo aad deggan tihiinba.
english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: Oo dharaartaasu waxay idiin ahaan doontaa sabti nasasho weyn leh, oo waa inaad nafihiinna dhibtaan. Oo bisha maalinteeda sagaalaad waa inaad dhawrtaan sabtidiinna tan iyo fiid ilaa ka fiid.
english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: La hadal dadka reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Bishan toddobaad maalinteeda shan iyo tobnaad waa Iiddii Waababka oo waa in toddoba maalmood Rabbiga loo iidaa.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.

kikuyu: Maalinta kowaad waa inay shir quduus ah ahaataa, oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul adag qaban.
english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Oo intii toddoba maalmood ah waxaad Rabbiga u bixisaan qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo, oo maalinta siddeedaadna waa inay idiin ahaataa shir quduus ah, oo waa inaad Rabbiga u bixisaan qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo, oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul adag qaban, waayo, dharaartaasu waa shir quduus ah.
english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa Rabbiga iidihiisa la amray, oo ay tahay inaad naadisaan inay ahaadaan shirar quduus ah, oo waa inaad Rabbiga u bixisaan qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo, kaasoo ah qurbaan la gubo, iyo qurbaan hadhuudh ah, iyo allabari, iyo qurbaanno cabniin ah, oo mid kastana maalintiisa ha la bixiyo.
english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

kikuyu: Oo kuwaasu waa ka gooni sabtiyadii Rabbiga iyo hadiyadihiinna oo waa ka gooni nidarradiinna oo dhan, oo waa ka gooni qurbaannadiinna ikhtiyaarka ah oo dhan ee aad Rabbiga siisaan.
english: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee bisha toddobaad maalinteeda shan iyo tobnaad, markaad midhaha dhulka soo urursataan, waa inaad intii toddoba maalmood ah Rabbiga iiddiisa dhawrtaan. Maalinta kowaad waa inay ahaataa nasasho weyn, oo maalinta siddeedaadna waa inay ahaataa nasasho weyn.
english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta kowaad waxaad soo qaadataan midhaha dhirta wanaagsan, iyo laamo cawbaar ah, iyo dhir waaweyn laamaheed, iyo safsaafka durdurka, oo waa inaad Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah hortiisa ku rayraysaan intii toddoba maalmood ah.
english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

kikuyu: Oo sannaddiiba toddoba maalmood waa inaad Rabbiga iid u qabataan, oo kaasu waa qaynuun weligiisba idiin jira tan iyo ab ka ab; oo iiddaas waa inaad bisha toddobaad dhawrtaan.
english: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

kikuyu: Intii toddoba maalmood ah waa inaad waabab ku hoyataan, oo kulli reer binu Israa'iilka waddaniga ah oo dhammu waa inay waabab ku hoydaan,
english: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

kikuyu: si farcankiinna dambe u ogaado inaan reer binu Israa'iil waabab ku hoyiyey markaan iyaga ka soo bixiyey dalkii Masar, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Oo Muusena wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil u sheegay iidihii Rabbiga oo la amray.
english: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaad reer binu Israa'iil ku amartaa inay kuu keenaan saliid saafiya oo saytuun ah oo loo tumay laambadda, in laambad lagu shido had iyo goorba.
english: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

kikuyu: Oo daaha markhaatiga dibaddiisa oo teendhada shirka gudaheeda ah Haaruun waa inuu Rabbiga hortiisa had iyo goorba ku hagaajiyaa tan iyo fiidkii iyo ilaa subaxdii, oo kaasu waa inuu ahaadaa qaynuun weligiis idiin jiri doona tan iyo ab ka ab.
english: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Oo isagu waa inuu had iyo goorba laambadaha ku kor hagaajiyaa laambadda saafiga ah oo Rabbiga hortiisa taal.
english: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad bur soo qaadataa, oo aad ka dubtaa laba iyo toban xabbadood oo kibis ah, oo xabbaddiiba waa inuu eefaah toban meelood loo dhigo labadiis meelood ku jiraa.
english: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad laba saf u dhigtaa oo safkiiba waxaad ka dhigtaa lix xabbadood, oo waxaad saartaa miiska saafiga ah oo Rabbiga hortiisa yaal.
english: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo saf kastaba waxaad ku shubtaa foox saafi ah, si uu kibista ugu noqdo xusuus, kaasoo ah qurbaan Rabbiga dab loogu sameeyo.
english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo isagu had iyo goorba sabti kasta waa inuu Rabbiga hortiisa ku hagaajiyaa; waayo, kaasu wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil u yahay axdi weligiis ah.
english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo kibistaas waxaa iska yeelan doona Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa, oo waa inay meel daahir ah ku cunaan, waayo, taasu isaga waa ugu wada quduusan tahay qurbaannada Rabbiga ee dabka lagu sameeyo oo qaynuun weligiis ah loo amray.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

kikuyu: Oo naag reer binu Israa'iil ah wiilkeed, oo aabbihiis uu Masri ahaa ayaa reer binu Israa'iil dhex galay, oo wiilkii naagta reer binu Israa'iil iyo nin reer binu Israa'iil ah ayaa xerada dhexdeedii ku diriray.
english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

kikuyu: Markaasaa naagtii reer binu Israa'iil wiilkeedii magicii Rabbiga caayay oo habaaray, oo isagii waxaa loo keenay Muuse. Oo wiilkaas hooyadiis magaceedu wuxuu ahaa Shelomiid ina Dibrii, waxayna ahayd qabiilka Daan.
english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

kikuyu: Oo isagiina way xidheen ilaa xukunkiisu ka soo baxo afka Rabbiga.
english: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Kii caytamay xerada ka soo bixi, oo intii isaga maqashay oo dhammu gacmahooda madaxiisa ha kor saareen, oo dabadeedna ururka oo dhammu ha dhagxiyeen.
english: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad reer binu Israa'iil la hadashaa oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Ku alla kii Ilaahiisa caayaa waa inuu dembigiisa qaadaa.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

kikuyu: Kii magaca Rabbiga caaya sida xaqiiqada ah waa in la dilaa. Ururka oo dhammu hubaal waa inay isaga dhagxiyaan, oo hadduu shisheeye yahay iyo hadduu waddani yahayba, markuu magaca Rabbiga caayo waa in la dilaa.
english: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii qof kale dila, sida xaqiiqada ah waa in la dilaa.
english: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii neef xoolo ah dilaana waa inuu magaa, oo neef neef ku gudaa.
english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin deriskiisa wax yeelo, wax alla wixii uu yeelay oo kale waa in isagana la yeelaa.
english: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

kikuyu: Jabniin jabniin ha ku mago, ilna il ha ku mago, iligna ilig ha ku mago, oo isagu siduu qofka wax u yeelay, saasoo kale isagana ha loo yeelo.
english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

kikuyu: Oo kii neef xoolo ah dilaa waa inuu isagu magaa, kii qof dilase waa in isagana la dilaa.
english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad sharci qudha u haysataan shisheeyaha iyo waddanigaba, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse la hadlay reer binu Israa'iil, oo iyana waxay xerada ka soo bixiyeen kii caytamay, oo way dhagxiyeen. Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay sameeyeen sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Markaasa Rabbigu Muuse kula hadlay Buur Siinay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil la hadal, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Markaad gashaan dalka aan idin siinayo, waa in dalku sabti Rabbiga u dhawraa.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.

kikuyu: Lix sannadood waa inaad beertaada beerataa, oo lix sannadoodna waa inaad beertaada canabka ah baarka ka jartaa, oo midhaheedana waa inaad soo xeraysataa.
english: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

kikuyu: Laakiinse sannadda toddobaad waa inay dhulka u ahaataa sabti nasasho weyn ah, oo taasu waa sabti Rabbiga loo dhawro, oo waa inaadan beertaada beeran, ama aadan beertaada canabka ah baarka ka jarin.
english: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

kikuyu: Oo sannaddaas wixii beertaada ka baxa iyagoo aan la beerin waa inaadan guran, oo canabkaaga aan la hagaajin midhiihii ka baxana waa inaadan urursan, waayo, sannaddaasu waa inay dhulka u ahaataa nasasho weyn.
english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

kikuyu: Oo dhulka sabtidiisu cunto bay idiin ahaan doontaa. Adiga, iyo addoonkaaga, iyo addoontaada, iyo midiidinkaaga aad kiraysatay, iyo kan shisheeye kuu ah oo kula degganba,
english: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

kikuyu: iyo xoolahaaga, iyo xayawaanka dalkaaga jooga oo dhan waxaa cunto u ahaan doona midhaha dalka iska baxa oo idil.
english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad tirsataa toddoba sabtiyood oo sannado ah, taasu waxa weeyaan toddoba meelood oo toddoba sannadood ah; oo toddoba sabtiyood oo toddoba sannadood ah wakhtigoodu wuxuu kuu ahaan doonaa sagaal iyo afartan sannadood.
english: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

kikuyu: Oo dabadeedna waa inaad bisha toddobaad maalinteeda tobnaad buun dhawaajisaa, oo maalinta kafaaraggudka waa inaad dalkiinna oo dhan buun ka dhawaajisaan.
english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad sannadda kontonaad quduus ka dhigtaan, oo dhammaan dadka dalka deggan oo dhan waxaad u naadisaan xorriyad, oo sannaddaasu waxay idiin ahaan doontaa wakhti yubilii ah; oo midkiin kastaa waa inuu ku noqdaa hantidiisii, oo midkiin kastaa waa inuu ku noqdaa qoladiisii.
english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

kikuyu: Oo sannaddaas kontonaad wuxuu idiin ahaan doonaa wakhti yubilii ah, oo waa inaydaan waxba beeran, ama aydaan goosan wixii beertiinna iskood uga baxa, ama aydaan soo urursan canabka ka baxa geedcanabka oo aan la hagaajin.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

kikuyu: Waayo, sannaddaasu waa wakhti yubilii ah, oo waa inay idiin ahaataa mid quduus ah; oo waxaad cuni doontaan midhaha berrinka iskood uga baxa.
english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

kikuyu: Oo sannaddaas yubilii ah midkiin kastaa waa inuu ku noqdaa hantidiisii.
english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

kikuyu: Oo haddaad deriskaaga wax ka iibisid, ama haddaad gacanta deriskaaga wax ka iibsatid, waa inaan midkiinna midka kale dulmin.
english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

kikuyu: Oo sannadaha wakhtiga yubilii ah ka dambeeya siday tiradoodu tahay waa inaad deriskaaga wax uga iibsataa, oo isna wax ha kaaga iibiyo siday tahay sannadaha wax la goosto.
english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad qiimaha u kordhisaa sida sannaduhu u badan yihiin, oo waa inaad qiimaha u dhintaa sida sannaduhu u yar yihiin, waayo, isagu wuxuu wax kaaga iibin doonaa sida ay tahay tirada sannadaha wax la goosanayo.
english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

kikuyu: Waa inaan midkiinna midka kale dulmin; laakiinse waxaad ka cabsataan Ilaahiinna, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waa inaad qaynuunnadayda yeeshaan, oo aad xukummadaydana dhawrtaan oo yeeshaan, oo markaasaad dalka ammaan ku degganaan doontaan.
english: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

kikuyu: Oo dhulkuna wuxuu dhali doonaa midhihiisa, oo waxaad cuni doontaan wax aad ka dheregtaan, oo dalkana ammaan baad ku degganaan doontaan.
english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

kikuyu: Oo haddaad istidhaahdaan, Bal maxaynu sannadda toddobaad cuni doonnaa? Waayo, waxba ma aynu beeran doonno, oo soomana urursan doonno midhaheenna,
english: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”

kikuyu: markaas anigu sannadda lixaad ayaan barakadayda idiin amri doonaa, oo waxaa dhulka idiinka soo bixi doona midho saddex sannadood ku filan.
english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

kikuyu: Oo sannadda siddeedaadna wax baad beeran doontaan, oo waxaad cuni doontaan midhihii hore, oo tan iyo ilaa aad midhaha sannadda sagaalaad soo xeraysataan waxaad iska cuni doontaan midhihii hore.
english: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

kikuyu: Oo dalkana waa inaydaan hanti weligeed ah u iibin, waayo, dalka anigaa iska leh, oo idinna waxaad tihiin shisheeyayaal iyo socoto ila jooga.
english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

kikuyu: Oo dalka aad hantida u leedihiin oo dhan waxaad dhulka uga oggolaataan furasho.
english: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

kikuyu: Oo haddii walaalkaa miskiin noqdo oo uu hantidiisa qaar iibiyo, markaas xigaalkiisa ugu dhow ha yimaado, oo ha u furto wixii walaalkiis iibiyey.
english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

kikuyu: Oo nin hadduusan lahayn qof isaga u furta, laakiinse uu mar dambe helo wax ku filan inuu dhulkiisii ku soo furto,
english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,

kikuyu: markaas ha tiriyo sannadaha la iibiyey, oo waxa dheeraadka ah ha u celiyo ninkii uu ka iibiyey; oo hantidiisii ha ku noqdo.
english: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadduusan soo ceshan karin, markaas wixii uu iibiyey waxay ku sii jiri doonaan kii ka iibsaday gacantiisa tan iyo sannadda yubilii ah, oo sannadda yubiliiga ah ayaa waxaasu gacantiisa ka bixi doonaan, oo isna markaasuu hantidiisii ku noqon doonaa.
english: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

kikuyu: Oo qof hadduu iibiyo guri lagu hoydo oo magaalo deyr leh ku yaal, markaas intii sannad dhan ah wuu soo furan karaa gurigiisii uu iibiyey, waayo, sannad dhan ah wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu soo furto.
english: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

kikuyu: Oo haddaan la soo furan intii sannad dhan ah, markaas gurigii magaalada deyran ku yiil waa inuu weligii hanti u ahaadaa qofkii iibsaday, oo tan iyo ab ka ab isagaa iska leh, oo sannadda yubilii ahna gacantiisa ka bixi maayo.
english: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

kikuyu: Laakiinse guryaha ku dhex yaal tuulooyinka aan lahayn deyr ku wareegsan ha lagu tiriyo beeraha duurka ku yaal, oo iyaga waa la soo furan karaa, oo sannadda yubilii ahna gacanta kii iibsaday way ka bixi doonaan.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee magaalooyinka reer Laawi saas ma aha, oo reer Laawi mar kasta way soo furan karaan guryaha ku dhex yaal magaalooyinka ay iyagu hantida u leeyihiin.
english: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.

kikuyu: Oo mid reer Laawi ahu hadduu soo furto, markaas gurigii la iibiyey iyo magaaladii hantidiisa ahaydba waxay bixi doonaan wakhtiga yubilii ah, waayo, guryaha ku dhex yaal magaalooyinka reer Laawi waa hantidooda oo ku dhex jirta reer binu Israa'iil.
english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waa inaan la iibin beertii ku taal agagaarka magaalooyinkooda, waayo, taasu waa hantidooda weligeed ah.
english: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.

kikuyu: Oo haddii walaalkaa miskiin noqdo, oo intuu ku ag joogo masruufkiisa waayo, adigu waa inaad taageertaa, oo isagu waa inuu kuula degganaado sidii shisheeye iyo nin socoto ah.
english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaadan isaga ka qaadan korsocod ama wax dheeraad ah toona, laakiinse Ilaahaaga ka cabso, oo walaalkaa ha kula degganaado.
english: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaadan lacagtaada korsocod ku deymin, ama aadan quudkaaga u siin si aad wax dheeraad ah kaga qaadatid.
