english: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

kikuyu: Aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah oo dalkii Masar idiinka soo bixiyey inaan idin siiyo dalka Kancaan oo aan Ilaah idiin noqdo aawadeed.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

kikuyu: Oo haddii walaalkaa miskiin noqdo isagoo kula jooga oo uu iska kaa iibiyo, waa inaadan isaga ka dhigin inuu kuugu adeego sidii addoon oo kale,
english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

kikuyu: laakiinse waa inuu kuula joogaa sidii midiidin la kiraysto iyo sidii mid socoto ah, oo waa inuu kuu adeegaa tan iyo sannadda yubilii ah,
english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

kikuyu: oo dabadeedna ha kaa tago, isaga iyo carruurtiisaba, oo ha ku noqdo reerkiisii iyo hantidii awowayaashiis.
english: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu waa addoommadaydii aan dalkii Masar ka soo bixiyey, oo waa inaan loo iibin sidii addoommo.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

kikuyu: Waa inaadan cadaadis ugu talin, laakiinse Ilaahaaga ka cabso.
english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

kikuyu: Oo ragga iyo dumarka addoommada ah oo aad lahaanaysaan waxaad ka iibsan doontaan quruumaha hareerahiinna ku wareegsan. Iyaga waa inaad ka iibsataan rag iyo dumar addoommo ah.
english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaad ka iibsataan shisheeyayaasha idin dhex deggan iyo reerahooda idinla joogaba, kuwaasoo ay dalkiinna ku dhaleen, oo waxay ahaan doonaan hantidiin.
english: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga waa inaad dhaxal uga dhigtaan carruurtiinna idinka dambaysa, si ay iyana hanti ahaan ugu haystaan; oo iyagu waa kuwa aad weligiin addoommo ka dhiganaysaan, laakiinse walaalihiinna reer binu Israa'iil waa inaan midkiinna midka kale cadaadis ugu talin.
english: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

kikuyu: Oo haddii shisheeye ama socoto kula joogo uu taajir noqdo, oo walaalkaana uu agtiisa miskiin ku noqdo oo uu markaas iska iibiyo shisheeyaha ama socotada kula jooga amase shisheeyaha qoladiisii,
english: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,

kikuyu: markii la iibiyo dabadeed waa la soo furan karaa. Walaalihiis mid ka mid ahu waa soo furan karaa,
english: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

kikuyu: ama adeerkiis ama ina-adeerkiis way soo furan karaan, amase midkii xigaal u dhow ah oo qoladiisa ahu waa soo furan karaa, amase isaga qudhiisu hadduu taajir noqdo waa isfuran karaa.
english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

kikuyu: Isaga iyo kan isaga iibsaday waa inay tiriyaan sannadihii u dhexeeyey sannaddii uu iibsaday iyo sannadda yubilii ah, oo qiimihii iibka waa inuu ahaadaa si waafaqsan tiradii sannadaha, oo wakhtiguu la joogay waa inuu ahaadaa sida wakhtiga shaqaale la kiraysto.
english: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.

kikuyu: Oo haddii sannado badanu ay weli dhiman yihiin, inta ay yihiin oo kale iyaga ha uga celiyo qiimihii furashadiisa oo ha uga bixiyo lacagtii lagu iibsaday.
english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii sannado yaru ay ka dhiman yihiin sannadda yubilii ah, markaas waa inuu isaga la xisaabtamo, oo inta sannadihiisu ay yihiin oo kale waa inuu ka celiyaa qiimihii furashadiisa.
english: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

kikuyu: Oo waa inuu isaga ula joogaa sida shaqaale la kiraysto sannad ka sannad, oo isagu waa inuusan cadaadis hortaada ugaga talin.
english: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

kikuyu: Oo isaga haddaan sidan lagu soo furan, markaasuu sannadda yubilii ah bixi doonaa, isaga iyo carruurtiisaba.
english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.

kikuyu: Waayo, reer binu Israa'iil anigay addoommo ii yihiin, oo iyagu waa addoommadaydii aan ka soo bixiyey dalkii Masar. Aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Waa inaydaan sanamyo samaysan, ama aydaan qotonsan ekaan la qoray amase tiir, oo waa inaydaan dalkiinna dhagax la qoray u dhex dhigin inaad u sujuuddaan, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Waa inaad iidahayga dhawrtaan, oo aad meeshayda quduuska ah maamuustaan, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Haddaad qaynuunnadayda ku socotaan, oo aad amarradayda dhawrtaan oo yeeshaan,
english: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,

kikuyu: markaasaan roobkiinna idin siinayaa xilligiisa, oo dhulkuna wuxuu dhali doonaa midhihiisa, dhirta duurkuna midhahooday dhali doonaan.
english: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

kikuyu: Tumidda hadhuudhkiinnu waxay gaadhi doontaa guridda canabkiinna, guridda canabkuna waxay gaadhi doontaa ilaa wakhtiga beeridda, oo cuntadiinna ayaad cuni doontaan ilaa aad dheregtaan, oo dalkiinnana ammaan baad ku degganaan doontaan.
english: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

kikuyu: Oo anigu waxaan dalka idinku siin doonaa nabaadiino, oo idinna waad iska jiifsan doontaan, oo waxba idinma cabsiin doonaan, oo anna dugaagga xun dalkiinna waan ka baabbi'in doonaa, oo seefuna dalkiinna innaba ma dhex mari doonto.
english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

kikuyu: Oo idinku cadaawayaashiinnaad eryan doontaan, oo iyana hortiinnay seef kaga baabbi'i doonaan.
english: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

kikuyu: Oo shan idinka ahu boqol nin bay eryan doonaan, oo boqol idinka ahuna toban kun oo nin bay eryan doonaan, oo cadaawayaashiinnuna hortiinnay seef kaga baabbi'i doonaan.
english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

kikuyu: Oo anigu waan idiin soo jeesan doonaa, waanan idin badin doonaa oo idin tarmin doonaa, oo axdigaygii aan idinla dhigtayna waan sii adkayn doonaa.
english: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad cuni doontaan midhihii hore oo aad wakhti dheer kaydsateen, oo waxaad soo bixin doontaan midhihii hore si aad kuwa cusub meel ugu heshaan.
english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

kikuyu: Oo anna taambuuggaygaan idinka dhex dhisan doonaa, oo naftayduna idinma karhi doonto.
english: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

kikuyu: Oo dhexdiinnaan ku socon doonaa, oo Ilaahiinnaan ahaan doonaa, oo idinkuna dadkaygaad ahaan doontaan.
english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah, oo idiinka soo bixiyey dalkii Masar si aydaan u sii ahaan addoommadoodii. Qataarradii harqoodkiinna waan idinka jebiyey, oo waxaan idinka dhigay inaad madaxfurnaan ku socotaan.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddaad i dhegaysan weydaan, oo aydaan amarradan oo dhan wada yeelin,
english: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,

kikuyu: iyo haddaad qaynuunnadayda diiddaan, iyo haddii naftiinnu xukummadayda karahdo, oo aad amarradayda oo dhan wada yeeli weydaan, illowse aad igu axdi furtaan,
english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

kikuyu: markaasaan aniguna waxyaalahan idinku samayn doonaa. Naxdin baan idinku soo dejin doonaa, taasoo ah baabbi'id iyo qandho indhaha idinka ridda oo naftana idinka dullaysa, oo abuurkiinnana waxtarla'aan baad u beeran doontaan, waayo, waxaa iska cuni doona cadaawayaashiinna.
english: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

kikuyu: Oo anna gees baan idinka noqon doonaa, oo cadaawayaashiinna hortooda baa laydinku layn doonaa, oo waxaa idiin talin doona kuwo idin neceb, waadna iska carari doontaan iyadoo aan ninna idin eryanayn.
english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

kikuyu: Oo weliba haddaydnan waxyaalahaas daraaddood ii dhegaysan, haddana toddoba jeer oo kale ayaan dembiyadiinna aawadood idiin edbin doonaa.
english: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

kikuyu: Waanan jebin doonaa kibirka xooggiinna, oo samadiinnana waxaan ka dhigi doonaa sida bir oo kale, dhulkiinnana sida naxaas oo kale.
english: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.

kikuyu: Oo xooggiinnuna waxtarla'aan buu idinkaga dhammaan doonaa, waayo, dhulkiinnu midho ma dhali doono, oo dhirta dalka ku taalna midho kama soo bixin doonaan.
english: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

kikuyu: Oo haddaad i sii caasisaan oo aydaan i dhegaysan, toddoba jeer oo kale ayaan belaayo idiinku soo dejin doonaa siday dembiyadiinnu yihiin.
english: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan dhexdiinna ku soo dayn doonaa dugaagga duurka, kuwaasoo carruurtiinna idinka dhifan doona, oo xoolihiinna baabbi'in doona, oo idin kala yarayn doona, oo jidadkiinnuna cidla bay noqon doonaan.
english: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxyaalahaas daraaddood haddaad edeb ku soo yeelan weydaan, laakiinse aad i sii caasisaan,
english: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,

kikuyu: markaas aniguna gees baan idinka ahaan doonaa oo waan idin layn doonaa, xataa toddoba jeer ayaan dembiyadiinna aawadood idiin layn doonaa.
english: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan idinku soo dejin doonaa seef idinka aargudda aanadii axdiga, oo magaalooyinkiinna waad ku soo wada ururi doontaan, oo anna belaayo waan idinku dhex ridi doonaa, markaasaad cadowga u gacangeli doontaan.
english: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

kikuyu: Oo markaan usha kibistiinna jebiyo, toban naagood ayaa kibistiinna isku foorno ku dubi doonta, oo haddana waxay kibistiina idinku siin doonaan miisaan, oo kolkaad cuntaanna kama dhergi doontaan.
english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

kikuyu: Oo haddaad waxyaalahaas oo dhan igu dhegaysan weydaan, illowse aad i sii caasisaan,
english: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

kikuyu: markaasaan aniguna gees idinka ahaan doonaa, waanan xanaaqi doonaa, oo dembiyadiinna aawadoodna ayaan toddoba jeer oo kale idiin edbin doonaa.
english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad cuni doontaan hilibka wiilaashiinna, oo waxaad cuni doontaan hilibka gabdhihiinna.
english: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

kikuyu: Oo anigu meelihiinna sarsare waan dumin doonaa, oo sanamyadiinna qorraxdana waan wada baabbi'in doonaa, oo meydadkiinnana waxaan ku dul xoori doonaa meydka sanamyadiinna; oo naftayduna way idin karhi doontaa.
english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkiinna baabba' waan ka dhigi doonaa, oo meeshiinna quduuska ahna cidla waan ka dhigi doonaa, oo weliba carafta fooxiinna udgoon ma aan ursan doono.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

kikuyu: Oo weliba dalkana cidla baan ka dhigi doonaa, oo cadaawayaashiinna dalka dhex degganuna taas way la yaabi doonaan.
english: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan idinku kala dhex firdhin doonaa quruumaha, oo seef gal la' waan idinla daba geli doonaa, dalkiinnuna cidla buu noqon doonaa, oo magaalooyinkiinnuna baabba' bay noqon doonaan.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaa dalku sabtiyadiisa ku raaxaysan doonaa intuu cidla yahay oo idinku aad joogtaan dalka cadaawayaashiinna oo dhan; oo wakhtigaas oo dhan dalku wuu iska nasan doonaa, oo wuxuu ku raaxaysan doonaa sabtiyadiisa.
english: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

kikuyu: Oo dalku intuu cidla yahay oo dhan wuu iska nasan doonaa, nasashadaas oo ah mid uusan sabtiyadiinna helin markaad degganaydeen.
english: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.

kikuyu: Oo intii idinka hadhana waxaan qalbigooda ku ridi doonaa fulanimo, iyagoo dalalka cadaawayaashooda dhex jooga, oo sanqadha caleen dabaylu kaxaynayso ayaa iyaga eryan doonta, oo waxay uga carari doonaan sida qof seef uga cararo, oo iyadoo aan ninna eryanayn ayay iska daadan doonaan.
english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

kikuyu: Oo iyagoo aan ninna eryanayn ayaa midkoodba midka kale ku turunturoon doonaa sidii iyagoo seef ka baqanaya. Oo innaba ma aad yeelan doontaan itaal aad cadaawayaashiinna isku hor taagtaan.
english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

kikuyu: Waxaad ku dhex baabbi'i doontaan quruumaha, oo dalka cadaawayaashiinnuna waa idin dhammaysan doonaa.
english: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

kikuyu: Oo intii idinka hadhana iyagoo dalka cadaawayaashiinna jooga ayay xumaatadooda u dulloobi doonaan, oo weliba xumaatooyinkii awowayaashoodna ayay u dulloobi doonaan.
english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

kikuyu: Wayna qiran doonaan xumaatadoodii iyo xumaatadii awowayaashood, iyo xadgudubkii ay igu xadgudbeen, iyo weliba caasinimadii ay igu caasiyeen
english: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

kikuyu: oo aan aawadeed iyaga gees uga noqday, oo aan dalkii cadaawayaashooda u geeyey. Markaas hadday qalbigooda buuryoqabka ah hoosaysiiyaan, oo ay aqbalaan taqsiirta xumaatadooda,
english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

kikuyu: ayaan soo xusuusan doonaa axdigaygii aan Yacquub la dhigtay, iyo weliba axdigaygii aan Isxaaq la dhigtay, oo weliba waxaan kaloo soo xusuusan doonaa axdigaygii aan Ibraahim la dhigtay, oo dalkana waan soo xusuusan doonaa.
english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu dalka way ka tegi doonaan, oo wuxuu ku raaxaysan doonaa sabtiyadiisa intuu cidla yahay oo iyagu ay ka maqan yihiin oo dhan; oo iyaguna way aqbali doonaan taqsiirta xumaatadooda, maxaa yeelay, way diideen xukummadaydii, oo naftooduna qaynuunnadayday karahday.
english: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

kikuyu: Laakiinse in kastoo ay saas sameeyeen anigu intay dalka cadaawayaashooda joogaan oo dhan iyaga diidi maayo, karhina maayo, wada baabbi'inna maayo, oo axdigaygii aan la dhigtay jebin maayo, waayo, aniga ayaa ah Rabbiga Ilaahooda ah.
english: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Laakiinse iyaga daraaddood ayaan u xusuusan doonaa axdigii aan la dhigtay awowayaashood, kuwaasoo aan, iyadoo ay quruumuhu u jeedaan, dalkii Masar uga soo bixiyey si aan iyaga Ilaah ugu ahaado, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waa qaynuunnadii iyo xukummadii iyo sharciyadii uu Rabbigu u dhexaysiiyey isaga qudhiisa iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo uu Muuse ugu soo dejiyey Buur Siinay.
english: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Dadka reer binu Israa'iil la hadal oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Haddii nin nidar galo, qofafka waa inay Rabbiga ugu ahaadaan sidaad ugu qiimaysa.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,

kikuyu: Oo inta labka ah oo jirta labaatan sannadood iyo ilaa lixdan sannadood qiimayntooda aad qiimayso waa inay ahaataa konton sheqel oo lacag ah oo le'eg sheqelka meesha quduuska ah.
english: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Oo qofku hadduu dhaddig yahayna markaas qiimayntaadu ha ahaato soddon sheqel.
english: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

kikuyu: Oo qofku hadduu shan sannadood jiro iyo ilaa labaatan sannadood, markaas kii lab waxaad ku qiimaysaa labaatan sheqel, oo tii dhaddigna waxaad ku qiimaysaa toban sheqel.
english: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

kikuyu: Oo haddii qofku jiro bil iyo ilaa shan sannadood, markaas qofkii lab waxaad ku qiimaysaa shan sheqel oo lacag ah, tii dhaddigna waxaad ku qiimaysaa saddex sheqel oo lacag ah.
english: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

kikuyu: Oo haddii qofku lixdan jir yahay amase ka sii weyn yahay, hadduu lab yahay waxaad ku qiimaysaa shan iyo toban sheqel, hadduu dhaddig yahayna waxaad ku qiimaysaa toban sheqel.
english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

kikuyu: Laakiinse qofku hadduu ka miskiinsan yahay intaad ku qiimaysay, markaas waa in la soo taagaa wadaadka hortiisa, oo wadaadku waa inuu qiimeeyaa, oo qofkii nidarka galay intuu awoodo waa in wadaadku ku qiimeeyaa.
english: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

kikuyu: Oo neef Rabbiga qurbaan loogu bixiyo hadduu yahayna, wax alla wixii qofi Rabbiga saas ugu bixiyaa quduus bay ahaan doonaan.
english: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.

kikuyu: Oo isagu waa inuusan doorin, ama waa inuusan neef fiican mid xun ku beddelin, ama neef xun mid fiican ku beddelin, oo hadduu neef neef kale ku beddelo, markaas neefkii hore iyo kii lagu beddelayba waa inay quduus wada ahaadaan.
english: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.

kikuyu: Oo neefku hadduu yahay neef nijaas ah oo aan Rabbiga qurbaan loogu bixin, markaas isagu neefka ha soo taago wadaadka hortiisa,
english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

kikuyu: oo wadaadku ha qiimeeyo, hadduu xun yahay iyo hadduu fiican yahayba, oo adiga wadaadka ahu intii aad ku qiimayso waa inay ahaataa.
english: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.

kikuyu: Laakiinse isagu hadduu doonayo inuu furto, waa inuu ku sii daraa intii aad ku qiimaysay oo shan meelood loo dhigay meesheed.
english: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

kikuyu: Oo haddii qof doonayo inuu gurigiisa quduus uga dhigo Rabbiga, markaas wadaadku waa inuu qiimeeyaa hadduu xun yahay iyo hadduu fiican yahayba, oo sidii wadaadku ku qiimeeyo ha ahaato.
english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.

kikuyu: Oo kii quduus ka dhigay hadduu doonayo inuu gurigiisii soo furto, markaas ha ku sii daro lacagtii aad ku qiimaysay oo shan meelood loo dhigay meesheed, markaas isagaa lahaan doona.
english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin doonayo inuu Rabbiga quduus uga dhigo qaar ka mid ah beertuu leeyahay, markaas waxaad ku qiimaysaa inta abuurkeedu dhan yahay; xomeer muggiis oo shaciir abuur ah waa in lagu qiimeeyaa konton sheqel oo lacag ah.
english: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

kikuyu: Oo beertiisa hadduu quduus ka dhigo oo uu ka bilaabo sannadda yubilii ah, markaas intaad ku qiimaysay ha ahaato.
english: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadduu beertiisa quduus ka dhigo sannadda yubilii ah dabadeed, markaas wadaadku waa inuu lacagta u xisaabaa intay yihiin sannadaha ka dhiman sannadda yubilii ah, oo intaad ku qiimaysayna waa in wax laga sii dhimaa.
english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

kikuyu: Oo kii beerta quduus ka dhigay hadduu doonayo inuu soo furto markaas waa inuu ku sii daraa lacagtii aad ku qiimaysay oo shan meelood loo dhigay meesheed, oo dabadeedna mar labaad buu mulkin doonaa.
english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadduusan doonayn inuu beerta soo furto, ama hadduu beerta nin kale ka iibiyey, markaas mar dambe waa inaan la soo furan,
english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

kikuyu: laakiin beertu markay wareegto sannadda yubilii ah, waxay quduus u ahaan doontaa Rabbiga sidii beer isaga loo soocay, hantideedana waxaa yeelan doona wadaadka.
english: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu Rabbiga quduus uga dhigo beer uu soo iibsaday oo aan ahayn beerta hantidiisa ah,
english: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

kikuyu: markaas wadaadku waa inuu xisaabaa qiimihii aad ku qiimaysay tan iyo sannadda yubilii ah, oo isla maalintaas isagu waa inuu wixii aad beerta ku qiimaysay u bixiyaa sida wax Rabbiga quduus u ah.
english: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo sannadda yubilii ahna beertu waxay u noqon doontaa kii laga soo iibsaday, kaasoo ah kii dhulka hanti u leh.
english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

kikuyu: Oo waxa aad wax ku qiimayso oo dhammu waa inay waafaqsanaadaan sheqelka meesha quduuska ah, oo sheqelku waa inuu ahaadaa labaatan geeraah.
english: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

kikuyu: Laakiinse xayawaanka curadkooda Rabbiga gooni ahaanta loogu soocay ninna waa inuusan quduus ka dhigin, hadduu dibi yahay iyo hadduu ido yahayba, waayo, waxaa iska leh Rabbiga.
english: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to the LORD as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is the LORD’s.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu yahay neef nijaas ah markaas isagu waa inuu ku furtaa intii aad ku qiimayso, oo weliba waa inuu ku sii daraa intaas oo shan meelood loo dhigay meesheed, oo haddaan la soo furanna waa in lagu iibiyaa intii aad ku qiimayso.
english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee wixii gooni loo sooco, oo qof waxyaalihiisa oo dhan Rabbiga uga sooco, hadday waxaasu yihiin qof, ama neef, ama beerta hantidiisa ah, waa inaan innaba la iibin ama la furan, waayo, wax kasta oo gooni loo sooco waa wax Rabbiga ugu wada quduusan.
english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo qof alla qofkii gooni loo sooco oo dadka laga sooco oo dhan waa inaan innaba la soo furan, laakiinse hubaal waa in la dilaa.
english: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo meeltobnaadka waxa dalka ka baxa oo dhan hadday yihiin dhulka iniinihiisa ama hadday yihiin midhaha dhirtaba, Rabbigaa iska leh, oo waa wax Rabbiga quduus u ah.
english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD’s. It is holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo haddii qof doonayo inuu wax meeltobnaadkiisii ah furto waa inuu ku daraa waxaas oo shan meelood loo dhigay meeshood.
english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

kikuyu: Oo kulli meeltobnaadka lo'da ah ama kan adhiga ah oo dhan, wax alla wixii lagu tiriyo ee hoos maro usha adhijirka, meeltobnaadku waa inuu Rabbiga quduus u ahaadaa.
english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo neefkaasu inuu xun yahay iyo inuu fiican yahay, isagu waa inuusan kala hubsan, waana inuusan beddelin, oo kolnaba hadduu beddelo, markaas isagii iyo kii lagu beddelayba waa inay quduus wada ahaadaan ee aan la soo furan.
english: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa amarradii Rabbigu Muuse kaga amray Buur Siinay oo uu reer binu Israa'iil ugu soo dhiibay.
english: These are the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse kula hadlay cidladii Siinay, isagoo ku jira teendhadii shirka, bishii labaad maalinteedii kowaad, oo ah sannaddii labaad oo ay dalkii Masar ka soo bexeen dabadeed, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: Shirka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan u soo tiriya qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sida ay tirada magacyadoodu tahay, nin kasta madax madax u tiriya.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

kikuyu: Oo waxaad tirisaa intii labaatan sannadood jirta iyo intii ka sii weyn. Inta reer binu Israa'iil oo dagaal u bixi karta oo dhan adiga iyo Haaruun waa inaad koox koox u tirisaan.
english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

kikuyu: Oo waa inuu idinla jiraa qabiil kasta nin ka mid ah oo reerka aabbihiis madax u ah.
english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

kikuyu: Oo nimanka isla kiin taagi doona magacyadooduna waa kuwan: reer Ruubeen waxaa ka iman Eliisuur ina Shedeeyuur.
english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

kikuyu: Reer Simecoonna waxaa ka iman Shelumii'eel ina Suuriishadday.
english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

kikuyu: Reer Yahuudahna waxaa ka iman Naxshoon ina Cammiinaadaab.
english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

kikuyu: Reer Isaakaarna waxaa ka iman Netaneel ina Suucaar.
english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: Reer Sebulunna waxaa ka iman Elii'aab ina Xeelon.
english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa reer Yuusufna waxaa reer Efrayim ka iman Eliishaamaac ina Cammiihuud: oo waxaa reer Manaseh ka iman Gamalii'eel ina Fedaahsuur.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

kikuyu: Oo reer Benyaamiinna waxaa ka iman Abiidaan ina Gidconii.
english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

kikuyu: Oo reer Daanna waxaa ka iman Axiiceser ina Cammiishadday.
english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

kikuyu: Oo reer Aasheerna waxaa ka iman Fagcii'eel ina Cokraan.
english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gaadna waxaa ka iman Eliyaasaaf ina Decuu'eel.
english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

kikuyu: Oo reer Naftaalina waxaa ka iman Axiirac ina Ceynaan.
english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa kuwa shirka looga yeedhay oo amiirro u ahaa qabiilooyinka aabbayaashood, oo waxay ahaayeen madaxdii kumanyaalka reer binu Israa'iil.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse iyo Haaruun waxay kaxaysteen nimankaas la magacaabay,
english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

kikuyu: oo shirkii oo dhan ayay isu soo ururiyeen bishii labaad maalinteedii kowaad, oo waxay u soo abtirsadeen qolo qolo iyo reer reer, oo ay madax madax u tiriyeen sida tirada magacyadoodu ay ahayd intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba.
english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

kikuyu: Oo Muusena wuxuu iyagii cidlada Siinay ugu tiriyey sidii Rabbigu ku amray.
english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Oo reer Ruubeen oo ahaa curadkii Israa'iil farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd markii madax madax loo tiriyey, nin kasta oo labaatan sannadood jiray iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Ruubeen waxay ahaayeen lix iyo afartan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Simecoon farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, kuwii iyaga laga tiriyey sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd markii madax madax loo tiriyey, nin kasta oo labaatan sannadood jiray iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Simecoon waxay ahaayeen sagaal iyo konton kun iyo saddex boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gaadna farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Gaad waxay ahaayeen shan iyo afartan kun iyo lix boqol iyo konton.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yahuudahna farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Yahuudah waxay ahaayeen afar iyo toddobaatan kun iyo lix boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Isaakaarna farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Isaakaar waxay ahaayeen afar iyo konton kun iyo afar boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Sebulunna farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Sebulun waxay ahaayeen toddoba iyo konton kun iyo afar boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa reer Yuusuf oo ahaa reer Efrayim farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilkii reer Efrayim waxay ahaayeen afartan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Manasehna farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Manaseh waxay ahaayeen laba iyo soddon kun iyo laba boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Benyaamiinna farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Benyaamiin waxay ahaayeen shan iyo soddon kun iyo afar boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Daanna farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Daan waxay ahaayeen laba iyo lixdan kun iyo toddoba boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Aasheerna farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Aasheer waxay ahaayeen kow iyo afartan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Naftaalina farcankoodii, qolo qolo iyo reer reer, sidii ay tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan,
english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: intii iyaga laga tiriyey oo ahayd qabiilka reer Naftaali waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo konton kun iyo afar boqol.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waa kuwii la tiriyey, oo ay tiriyeen Muuse iyo Haaruun iyo amiirradii reer binu Israa'iil oo laba iyo toban nin ahaa oo midkood kastaba loo soocay reerkii aabbihiis.
english: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

kikuyu: Haddaba intii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan ee reerihii aabbayaashood laga tiriyey, intii labaatan sannadood jirtay iyo intii ka sii weynaydba, in alla intii dagaal u bixi kartay oo dhan oo reer binu Israa'iil dhex joogtay,
english: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—

kikuyu: xataa intii la tiriyey oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen lix boqol iyo saddex kun, iyo shan boqol iyo konton.
english: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Laakiinse qabiilkii reer Laawi reer reer looma tirin.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu waa la hadlay Muuse oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Laawi oo keliya waa inaadan tirin, oo reer binu Israa'iilna waa inaadan tiradooda ku dhex darin,
english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

kikuyu: laakiinse reer Laawi waxaad u doorataa inay u taliyaan taambuugga maragga, iyo alaabtiisa oo dhan, iyo waxa uu isagu leeyahay oo dhan. Iyagu waa inay taambuugga iyo alaabtiisa oo dhan sidaan, oo ay u adeegaan, oo ay taambuugga hareerihiisa degaan.
english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

kikuyu: Oo markii taambuuggu hor u dhaqaaqayo reer Laawi waa inay furaan, markii taambuugga la dhisayona reer Laawi waa inay dhisaan, oo shisheeyihii u soo dhowaadana waa in la dilaa.
english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna markay teendhooyinkooda dhistaan, nin waluba tiisa xeradiisa ha ka dhisto, oo nin waluba calankiisa ha uga ag dhisto sida ciidammadoodu yihiin.
english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

kikuyu: Laakiinse reer Laawi waa inay teendhooyinkooda ka dhistaan taambuugga maragga hareerihiisa, si aan cadho ugu soo degin shirka reer binu Israa'iil; oo reer Laawi waa inay u taliyaan taambuugga maragga.
english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil sidaasay yeeleen; oo sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray oo dhan ayay wada yeeleen.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu la hadlay Muuse iyo Haaruun, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil waa in nin waluba teendhadiisa ka ag dhistaa calankiisa, iyagoo ag jooga bandiiradihii reerka aabbahood, oo waa inay teendhooyinkooda ka dhistaan meel teendhada shirka ka hor jeedda oo hareeraheeda ah.
english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa ka dhistaa xagga bari dhanka qorrax ka soo baxa waa inay ahaadaan kuwa calanka xerada reer Yahuudah sida ciidammadoodu yihiin, oo amiirka reer Yahuudahna waa inuu ahaadaa Naxshoon ina Cammiinaadaab.
english: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen afar iyo toddobaatan kun iyo lix boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa ku xiga oo agtiisa ka dhistaana waa inay ahaadaan qabiilka reer Isaakaar, oo amiirka reer Isaakaarna waa inuu ahaadaa Netaneel ina Suucaar.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen afar iyo konton kun iyo afar boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Sebulunna, oo amiirka reer Sebulunna waa inuu ahaadaa Elii'aab ina Xeelon.
english: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyeyna waxay ahaayeen toddoba iyo konton kun iyo afar boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intii xerada reer Yahuudah laga tiriyey oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen boqol iyo lix iyo siddeetan kun iyo afar boqol, siday ciidammadoodu yihiin, oo iyagu waa inay marka hore baxaan.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

kikuyu: Oo xagga koonfureedna waa inuu ahaadaa calanka xerada reer Ruubeen, siday ciidammadoodu yihiin, oo amiirka reer Ruubeenna waa inuu ahaadaa Eliisuur ina Shedeeyuur.
english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen lix iyo afartan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa ku xigaana waa inay ahaadaan qabiilka reer Simecoon. Oo amiirka reer Simecoonna waa inuu ahaadaa Shelumii'eel ina Suuriishadday.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen sagaal iyo konton kun iyo saddex boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Gaadna, oo amiirka reer Gaadna waa inuu ahaadaa Eliyaasaaf ina Recuu'eel.
english: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen shan iyo afartan kun iyo lix boqol iyo konton.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intii xeradii reer Ruubeen laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen boqol iyo kow iyo konton kun iyo afar boqol iyo konton, siday ciidammadoodu ahaayeen. Oo iyana waa inay marka labaad baxaan.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna teendhada shirku waa inay baxdaa, iyadoo kooxda reer Laawi ku dhex jirta kooxaha kale, oo siday u degaan waa inay u baxaan, nin kasta oo meeshiis ku jira oo calankooda ag jooga.
english: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

kikuyu: Oo dhanka galbeedna waa inuu ahaadaa calanka xerada reer Efrayim siday ciidammadoodu yihiin, oo amiirka reer Efrayimna waa inuu ahaadaa Eliishaamaac ina Cammiihuud.
english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen afartan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilka reer Manaseh waa inuu ku xigaa; oo amiirka reer Manasehna waa inuu ahaadaa Gamalii'eel ina Fedaahsuur.
english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen laba iyo soddon kun iyo laba boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Qabiilkii reer Benyaamiinna, oo amiirka reer Benyaamiinna waa inuu ahaadaa Abiidaan ina Gidconii.
english: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen shan iyo soddon kun iyo afar boqol.
english: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intii xerada reer Efrayim laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen boqol iyo siddeed kun iyo boqol, siday ciidammadoodii ahaayeen. Oo iyana waa inay marka saddexaad baxaan.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

kikuyu: Oo dhanka woqooyina waa inuu ahaadaa calanka xerada reer Daan siday ciidammadoodu yihiin, oo amiirka reer Daanna waa inuu ahaadaa Axiiceser ina Cammiishadday.
english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen laba iyo lixdan kun iyo toddoba boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilka reer Aasheer waa inuu ku xigaa, oo amiirka reer Aasheerna waa inuu ahaadaa Fagcii'eel ina Cokraan.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen kow iyo afartan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Qabiilkii reer Naftaalina, oo amiirka reer Naftaalina waa inuu ahaadaa Axiirac ina Ceynaan.
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

kikuyu: Oo ciidankiisii kuwii laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo konton kun iyo afar boqol.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intii xerada reer Daan laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen boqol iyo toddoba iyo konton kun iyo lix boqol. Oo iyagu waa inay baxaan marka ugu dambaysa, iyagoo calammadooda ag jooga.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waa intii laga tiriyey reer binu Israa'iil siday reerahoodu ahaayeen. Kulli intii xerooyinka laga tiriyey sidii ciidammadoodii ahaayeen waxay ahaayeen lix boqol iyo saddex kun iyo shan boqol iyo konton.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Laakiinse reer Laawi laguma tirin reer binu Israa'iil, waayo, sidaas ayaa Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Sidaasay reer binu Israa'iil yeeleen, oo kulli wixii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray, sidaasay dhammaan uga ag dhisteen calammadoodii, oo sidaasay ugu bexeen siday qoladoodii iyo reerahoodii ahaayeen.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waxa weeye farcammadii Haaruun iyo Muuse waagii Rabbigu Muuse kula hadlay Buur Siinay.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanu waa wiilashii Haaruun magacyadoodii, Naadaab oo curadkii ahaa, iyo Abiihuu, iyo Elecaasaar, iyo Iitaamaar.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waa wiilashii Haaruun magacyadoodii, oo waa wadaaddadii la subkay oo uu gooni uga dhigay inay adeegaan shuqulka wadaadnimada.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Naadaab iyo Abiihuu waxay ku dhinteen Rabbiga hortiisa, markay dab qalaad ku bixiyeen Rabbiga hortiisa iyagoo cidlada Siinay jooga, oo iyagu carruurna ma ay lahayn. Markaasay Elecaasaar iyo Iitaamaar shuqulkii wadaadnimada kaga adeegi jireen aabbahood Haaruun hortiisa.
english: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Laawi soo dhowee oo wadaadka Haaruun hortiisa keen inay isaga u adeegaan.
english: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu waa inay amarkiisa iyo amarka shirka oo dhan ku yeelaan teendhada shirka horteeda si ay hawsha taambuugga u sameeyaan.
english: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo waa inay dhawraan alaabta teendhada shirka oo dhan, iyo amarka reer binu Israa'iil, si ay hawsha taambuugga u sameeyaan.
english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo adigu waa inaad reer Laawi siisaa Haaruun iyo wiilashiisaba, oo iyaga dhammaantood waa la siiyey reer binu Israa'iil aawadood.
english: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa doorataa, oo iyagu waa inay dhawraan wadaadnimadooda, oo shisheeyihii u soo dhowaadana waa in la dilaa.
english: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, anna waxaan reer Laawi kala dhex baxay reer binu Israa'iil intii aan ka qaadan lahaa curadyada reer binu Israa'iil ee maxalka furta oo dhan, oo reer Laawi waxay ahaanayaan kuwaygii,
english: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

kikuyu: waayo, curadyada oo dhan anigaa iska leh. Maalintii aan curadyadii Masar oo dhan wada laayay ayaan quduus ka wada dhigtay curadyada reer binu Israa'iil, dad iyo duunyoba, oo iyagu kuwaygay ahaanayaan, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse kula hadlay cidlada Siinay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

kikuyu: Reer Laawi oo dhan u soo wada tiri reer reer iyo qolo qolo. Nin kasta oo bil jira ama ka sii weyn waa inaad tirisaa.
english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse iyagii u tiriyey sidii eraygii Rabbigu ahaa oo uu isaga ugu amray.
english: Moses counted them according to the LORD’s word, as he was commanded.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Laawi magacyadoodii: Gershoon, iyo Qohaad, iyo Meraarii.
english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waa magacyadii wiilashii Gershoon siday qolooyinkoodu yihiin, Libnii iyo Shimcii.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Qohaad siday qolooyinkoodu yihiin waa Camraam, iyo Isehaar, iyo Xebroon, iyo Cusii'eel.
english: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Meraariina siday qolooyinkoodu yihiin waa Maxlii iyo Mushii, kuwanu waa qolooyinkii reer Laawi siday reerahoodu yihiin.
english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Oo Gershoon waxaa ka soo farcamay reer Libnii iyo reer Shimcii, kuwaasu waa qolooyinkii reer Gershoon.
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii iyaga laga tiriyey siday ahayd tiradii kuwii lab ahaa oo dhan, intii bil jirtay ama ka sii weynayd, kulli intoodii la tiriyey waxay ahaayeen toddoba kun iyo shan boqol.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gershoon qolooyinkoodii waa inay taambuugga dabadiisa xagga galbeedka teendhooyinkooda ka dhistaan.
english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

kikuyu: Oo amiirka reer Gershoonna waa inuu ahaadaa Eliyaasaaf ina Laa'eel.
english: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gershoonna waa inay teendhada shirka ugu taliyaan taambuuga, iyo Teendhada, iyo dedkeeda, iyo daaha iridda teendhada shirka,
english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: iyo barxadda daahyadeeda, iyo daaha iridda barxadda oo taambuugga iyo meesha allabariga ku wareegsan iyo xadhkihii hawsha lagu qabto oo dhan.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

kikuyu: Oo Qohaadna waxaa ka soo farcamay reer Camraam, iyo reer Isehaar, iyo reer Xebroon, iyo reer Cusii'eel; kuwaasu waa qolooyinkii reer Qohaad.
english: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

kikuyu: Siday ahayd tiradii kuwii lab ahaa oo dhan intii bil jirtay ama ka sii weynayd waxay ahaayeen siddeed kun iyo lix boqol, oo waxay u taliyeen meesha quduuska ah.
english: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Oo qolooyinka reer Qohaad waa inay taambuugga dhankiisa koonfureed teendhooyinkooda ka dhistaan.
english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo amiirka reer Qohaadna waa inuu ahaadaa Eliisaafaan ina Cusii'eel.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay u talin doonaan sanduuqa, iyo miiska, iyo laambadda, iyo meelaha allabariga, iyo weelasha meesha quduuska ah oo ay ku adeegaan, iyo daaha, iyo hawsha oo dhan.
english: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.

kikuyu: Oo Elecaasaar ina wadaadka Haaruun waa inuu ahaadaa amiirka amiirrada reer Laawi, oo wuxuu korka ka ilaalin doonaa kuwa u taliya meesha quduuska ah.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Oo Meraariina waxaa ka soo farcamay reer Maxlii iyo reer Mushii, kuwaasu waa qolooyinkii reer Meraarii.
english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

kikuyu: Oo kuwoodii loo tiriyey siday ahayd tiradii kuwii labka ahaa oo dhan, intii bil jirtay ama ka sii weynayd, waxay ahaayeen lix kun iyo laba boqol.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilka reer Meraarii amiirkoodii wuxuu ahaa Surii'eel ina Abiixayil, oo iyana waa inay taambuugga dhankiisa woqooyi teendhooyinkooda ka dhistaan.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo reer Meraarii waxaa loo amray inay u taliyaan taambuugga looxyadiisa, iyo ulihiisa gudban, iyo tiirarkiisa, iyo saldhigyadiisa, iyo alaabtiisa oo dhan, iyo hawshiisa oo dhan,
english: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

kikuyu: iyo tiirarka barxadda ku wareegsanna, iyo saldhigyadooda, iyo musaamiirtooda iyo xadhkahooda.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa teendhooyinkooda ka dhistaa taambuugga xaggiisa bari iyo teendhada shirka horteeda xagga qorrax ka soo baxa waa inay ahaadaan Muuse iyo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa, oo waxay reer binu Israa'iil ugu talinayaan meesha quduuska ah; oo shisheeyaha u soo dhowaadana waa in la dilaa.
english: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intii reer Laawi ah ee la tiriyey, oo Muuse iyo Haaruun ay qolo qolo ugu tiriyeen amarkii Rabbiga, kuwii lab ahaa oo dhan oo bil jiray ama ka sii weynaa, waxay ahaayeen laba iyo labaatan kun.
english: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Tiri curadyada labka ah oo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, intii bil jirta ama ka sii weyn, oo magacyadooda ku soo xisaab.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad ii qaaddaa reer Laawi intii aad ii qaadi lahayd curadyada reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, oo waa inaad xoolaha reer Laawina ii qaaddaa intii aad ii qaadi lahayd curadyada xoolaha reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse curadyadii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan u tiriyey sidii Rabbigu ugu amray.
english: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo curadyadii labka ahaa oo dhammu, sidii tirada magacyadoodu ahayd, intii bil jirtay ama ka sii weynayd, kuwii iyaga laga soo tiriyey waxay ahaayeen laba iyo labaatan kun iyo laba boqol iyo saddex iyo toddobaatan.
english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Reer Laawi ii qaad intii aad ii qaadi lahayd curadyada reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, oo xoolaha reer Laawina ii qaad intii aad ii qaadi lahayd xoolaha reer binu Israa'iil, oo reer Laawi kuwaygay ahaanayaan, waayo, aniga ayaa Rabbiga ah.
english: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo labada boqol iyo saddex iyo toddobaatanka curad oo reer binu Israa'iil oo ka sii badan reer Laawi,
english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

kikuyu: madaxtiriskiiba waxaad iigu madax furataa shan sheqel oo le'eg sheqelka meesha quduuska ah. (Sheqelku waa labaatan geeraah.)
english: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

kikuyu: Oo tiradooda dheeraadka ah lacagta lagu madax furtay waa inaad Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa siisaa.
english: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse lacagtii ka qaaday kuwii ka sii badnaa kuwii lagu madax furtay reer Laawi.
english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

kikuyu: Oo curadyadii reer binu Israa'iil ayuu ka qaaday lacagtii, oo ahayd kun iyo saddex boqol iyo shan iyo lixdan sheqel oo le'eg sheqelka meesha quduuska ah.
english: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

kikuyu: Oo Muuse lacagtii madaxfurashada ahayd wuxuu u dhiibay Haaruun iyo wiilashiisii, siduu ahaa eraygii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse iyo Haaruun la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: Reer Qohaad qolo qolo iyo reer reer uga soo tiri reer Laawi,
english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: intii soddon sannadood jirta iyo intii ka sii weyn ilaa tan iyo konton jir dhammaan intii hawsha gasha si ay shuqulka teendhada shirka u sameeyaan.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Tanu waa hawshii reer Qohaad ee ku jirtay teendhada shirka. Waa inay waxyaalaha ugu wada quduusan ka adeegaan.
english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

kikuyu: Markii dadkii xeradu ay guurayaan Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu waa inay galaan oo iyagu waa inay daaha ilxidhka ah soo dejiyaan oo ku daboolaan sanduuqa maragga.
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

kikuyu: Oo markaas dushooda waa inay ded ah harag adhidibadeed saaraan, oo ay ku kala dul bixiyaan maro kulligeed buluug ah, oo waa inay ulaha lagu qaado sudhaan.
english: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

kikuyu: Oo miiska kibista tusniintana waa inay ku kala bixiyaan maro buluug ah, oo ay dusheedana saaraan suxuunta, iyo malqacadaha, iyo maddiibadaha, iyo koobabka wax lagaga shubo, oo kibista joogtada ahuna waa inay saarnaataa,
english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

kikuyu: oo markaas waa inay dushooda maro cas ku kala bixiyaan oo ay isla taasna dedka ah haragga adhidibadeedka ku daboolaan, oo ay markaas ulaha lagu qaado sudhaan.
english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

kikuyu: Oo markaas waa inay maro buluug ah qaadaan oo ay ku daboolaan laambadda iftiinka, iyo laambadaheeda, iyo birqaabyadeeda, iyo alaabteeda lagu safeeyo, iyo weelasha saliidda oo dhan oo ay kaga adeegaan.
english: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

kikuyu: Oo iyada iyo alaabteeda oo dhanba waa inay dhex geliyaan harag adhidibadeed oo markaas waa inay usha lagu qaado sudhaan.
english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

kikuyu: Oo meesha allabariga oo dahabka ahna waa inay maro buluug ah ku daboolaan, oo ay ku dedaan ded harag adhidibadeed ah, oo markaas waa inay ulaha lagu qaado sudhaan.
english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

kikuyu: Oo waa inay qaadaan alaabta lagu adeego oo dhan oo ay kaga adeegaan meesha quduuska ah, waana inay maro buluug ah ku wada dhex ridaan oo ay ded ah harag adhidibadeed ku dedaan, oo ay usha lagu qaado sudhaan.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

kikuyu: Oo waa inay meesha allabariga dambaska ka daadiyaan, oo ay maro guduudan ku kala dul bixiyaan.
english: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

kikuyu: Waana inay saaraan alaabteeda oo dhan oo ay kaga adeegaan, kuwaas oo ah idammada, iyo mudacyada, iyo majarafadaha, iyo maddiibadaha, iyo weelashii meesha allabariga oo dhan, oo markaas waa inay ku kala dul bixiyaan ded ah harag adhidibadeed, oo ay ulaha lagu qaado sudhaan.
english: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu markay dhammeeyaan inay dedaan meesha quduuska ah iyo alaabta meesha quduuska ah oo dhan, oo ay dadkii xeradu guurayaan, reer Qohaad ha yimaadeen oo ha qaadeen; laakiinse iyagu waa inaanay taaban waxyaalaha quduuska ah si aanay u dhiman. Waxyaalahaasu waa waxa teendhada shirka ku jira oo ay tahay in reer Qohaad qaadaan.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo wadaadka Haaruun ah wiilkiisa Elecaasaar ahuna waa inuu u taliyaa saliidda laambadda, iyo fooxa udgoon, iyo qurbaanka hadhuudhka oo joogtada ah, iyo saliidda lagu subkado, iyo shuqulka taambuugga oo dhan, iyo waxa ku jira oo dhan, kuwaasoo ah meesha quduuska ah iyo alaabteedaba.
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu la hadlay Muuse iyo Haaruun oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: Reer Qohaad qolooyinkooda ha ka gooynina reer Laawi dhexdooda,
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

kikuyu: laakiinse sidan ku sameeya si ay u noolaadaan oo aanay u dhiman markay u soo dhowaadaan waxyaalaha ugu wada quduusan. Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu waa inay gudaha galaan, oo ay iyaga u amraan hawshooda iyo waxqaadkooda,
english: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

kikuyu: laakiinse iyagu waa inaanay xataa daqiiqad u gelin inay waxyaalaha quduuska ah arkaan, yaanay dhimane.
english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana Rabbigu Muusuu la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Reer Gershoonna qolo qolo iyo reer reer u soo tiri.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

kikuyu: Intii soddon sannadood jirta iyo intii ka sii weyn ilaa tan iyo konton jirka waa inaad soo tirisaa, kulli inta hawsha gasha si ay shuqulka teendhada shirka u sameeyaan.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Tanu waa hawshii qolooyinka reer Gershoon oo ah adeegidda iyo waxqaadkaba.
english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

kikuyu: Iyagu waa inay qaadaan daahyada taambuugga, iyo teendhada shirka, iyo dedkeeda, iyo dedka ah haragga adhidibadeedka oo kor saaran, iyo ilxidhka iridda teendhada shirka,
english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: iyo daahyada barxadda, iyo ilxidhka iridda barxadda ku ag taal taambuugga iyo meesha allabariga ee ku wareegsan, iyo xadhkahooda, iyo alaabta hawshooda oo dhan, oo wax alla wixii iyaga lagu sameeyo oo dhan, xaggooda waa inay kaga adeegaan.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gershoon waa inay amarka Haaruun iyo wiilashiisa ku qabtaan waxa ay qaadaan iyo shuqulka ay qabtaan oo dhan; oo idinku waa inaad ku amartaan waxay qaadayaan.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

kikuyu: Oo tanuna waa qolooyinka reer Gershoon hawshooda ku saabsan teendhada shirka; oo shuqulkooduna waa inuu ka hooseeyaa gacanta Iitaamaar ina Haaruun ee wadaadka ah.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Oo reer Meraariina waa inaad qolo qolo iyo reer reer u soo tirisaa.
english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

kikuyu: Intii soddon sannadood jirta iyo intii ka sii weyn ilaa tan iyo konton jirka waa inaad soo tirisaa, mid kasta oo hawsha gala si uu shuqulka teendhada shirka u sameeyo.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo tanuna waa hawsha ay teendhada shirka ku leeyihiin ee ah waxa loo amray inay qaadaan: looxyada taambuugga, iyo ulihiisa gudban, iyo tiirarkiisa, iyo saldhigyadiisa,
english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

kikuyu: iyo tiirarka barxadda ku wareegsan, iyo saldhigyadooda, iyo musaamiirtooda, iyo xadhkahooda, iyo alaabtooda oo dhan, iyo hawshooda oo dhan. Oo magac magac waa inaad ugu amartaan alaabta ay qaadayaan.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.

kikuyu: Taasu waa hawshii qolooyinka reer Meraarii, sida ay tahay dhammaan hawshooda ku saabsan teendhada shirka, oo waxay ka hoosaysaa gacantii Iitaamaar ina Haaruun ee wadaadka ah.
