kikuyu: Oo sidaas daraaddeed kuwa maahmaahyo ku hadlaa waxay yidhaahdaan, War Xeshboon kaalaya, Magaaladii Siixon ha la dhiso oo ha la xoojiyo,
english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

kikuyu: Waayo, dab baa ka soo baxay Xeshboon, Taasoo ah magaaladii Siixon oo olol ka soo baxay. Wuxuu baabbi'iyey Caartii reer Moo'aab, Iyo sayidyadii meelaha sare oo Arnoon.
english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

kikuyu: Moo'aabay, waa kuu hoog! Waad baabba'day, dadka reer Khemooshow. Wiilashiisii wuxuu u sii daayay sida laajiyo, Gabdhihiisiina wuxuu maxaabiis ahaan ugu sii daayay Boqorka reer Amor oo Siixon ahaa.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

kikuyu: Iyaga waannu toogannay; oo Xeshboon waa baabba'day tan iyo Diibon, Oo annagu waxaannu baabbi'innay tan iyo Nofax, Taasoo gaadha tan iyo Meedebaa.
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

kikuyu: Oo sidaasay reer binu Israa'iil u degeen dalkii reer Amor.
english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse diray rag soo basaasa Yacser, oo iyana way qabsadeen magaalooyinkeedii, oo reer Amorkii halkaas degganaana way ka eryeen.
english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

kikuyu: Oo intay leexdeen ayay waxay tageen xagga jidka Baashaan loo maro. Markaasaa waxaa ku soo baxay Coog oo ahaa boqorkii Baashaan, isagii iyo dadkiisii oo dhanba, inay kula diriraan Edrecii.
english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse ku yidhi, Ha ka cabsan, waayo, gacantaadaan geliyey isaga iyo dadkiisa oo dhan iyo dalkiisa, oo waxaad isaga ku samayn doontaa sidii aad ku samaysay Siixon oo ahaa boqorkii reer Amor oo Xeshboon degganaa.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay dileen isagii, iyo wiilashiisii, iyo dadkiisii oo dhan ilaa ayan isagii waxba u hadhin, oo dalkiisiina way qabsadeen.
english: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer binu Israa'iil guureen, oo waxay degeen bannaanka Moo'aab oo Webi Urdun ka shisheeya oo Yerixoo ka soo hor jeeda.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Oo Baalaaq ina Sifoor wuxuu arkay kulli wixii ay reer binu Israa'iil ku sameeyeen reer Amor.
english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

kikuyu: Oo reer Moo'aab dadka bay ka cabsadeen, maxaa yeelay, iyagu aad bay u badnaayeen, oo reer Moo'aab aad iyo aad bay u welweleen reer binu Israa'iil aawadood.
english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Moo'aab waxay ku yidhaahdeen odayaashii reer Midyaan, Sida dibi u dhammaysto cawska berrinka ayaa dadkan faraha badanu waxa hareerahayaga ku wareegsan oo dhan u dhammaysanayaan. Oo wakhtigaas waxaa reer Moo'aab boqor u ahaa Baalaaq ina Sifoor.
english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

kikuyu: Oo wargeeyayaal buu u diray Balcaam ina Becoor oo joogay Fetoor oo Webiga ku ag taal oo ah dalkii dadkiisa si ay ugu yeedhaan oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eeg, halkan waxaa jooga dad Masar ka yimid, oo dhulkii oo dhan way qarinayaan, oo waxay deggan yihiin hortayda.
english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

kikuyu: Haddaba waan ku baryayaaye kaalay oo dadkan ii habaar, waayo, way iga xoog badan yihiin, oo mindhaa waan ka adkaanayaa si aannu ugu layno, oo dalka uga erinno, waayo, waan ogahay in kii aad u ducaysaa wuu ducaysan yahay, kii aad habaartaana wuu habaaran yahay.
english: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa odayaashii reer Moo'aab iyo odayaashii reer Midyaan waxay gacantooda ku qaadeen abaalgudkii habaaridda, oo waxay u tageen Balcaam, oo isagay kula hadleen erayadii Baalaaq.
english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu ku yidhi iyagii, Caawa halkan ku barya oo anna war dambaan idiinka keenayaa wixii Rabbigu igula hadlo. Markaasay amiirradii reer Moo'aab la hoydeen Balcaam.
english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ilaah Balcaam u yimid, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, War nimanka kula joogaa yay yihiin?
english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Balcaam wuxuu Ilaah ku yidhi, Baalaaq ina Sifoor oo ah boqorkii reer Moo'aab ayaa ii soo diray oo yidhi,
english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

kikuyu: Bal eeg, dadka Masar ka yimid waxay qarinayaan dhulka oo dhan, haddaba kaalay oo ii habaar, oo mindhaa waan karayaa inaan iyaga la diriro oo aan eryado.
english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Balcaam ku yidhi, Waa inaanad iyaga raacin, oo waa inaanad dadka habaarin, waayo, iyagu waa barakaysan yihiin.
english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”

kikuyu: Aroortii dambe ayaa Balcaam kacay, oo wuxuu amiirradii Baalaaq ku yidhi, Dalkiinnii taga, waayo, Rabbigu fasax buu ii diidaa inaan idin raaco.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for the LORD refuses to permit me to go with you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa amiirradii reer Moo'aab kaceen, oo Baalaaq u tageen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Balcaam waa diiday inuu na soo raaco.
english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

kikuyu: Oo Baalaaq haddana wuxuu diray amiirro kale oo kuwii hore ka sii badan oo ka sii derejo weyn.
english: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.

kikuyu: Oo iyana Balcaam bay u tageen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Baalaaq ina Sifoor wuxuu kugu leeyahay, Waan ku baryayaaye inaad ii timaado yaanay waxba kaa hor joogsan.
english: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

kikuyu: Waxaan ku siinayaa derejo sharaf ah, oo wax alla wixii aad igu tidhaahdona waan samaynayaa. Haddaba waan ku baryayaaye kaalay oo dadkan ii habaar.
english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Balcaam jawaabay, oo wuxuu addoommadii Baalaaq ku yidhi, Haddii Baalaaq i siiyo gurigiisa oo lacag iyo dahab ka buuxo, anigu kama tallaabsan karo erayga Rabbiga Ilaahayga ah inaan sameeyo wax ka yar iyo wax ka badan toona.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

kikuyu: Haddaba waan idin baryayaaye, Bal caawa halkan isaga hoyda, bal aan soo ogaado waxa kaloo Rabbigu igula hadlee.
english: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”

kikuyu: Oo habeennimadii ayaa Ilaah Balcaam u yimid, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddii nimanku u yimaadeen inay kuu yeedhaan, kac oo iyaga raac; laakiinse waxaad yeeshaa aan kugula hadlo oo keliya.
english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

kikuyu: Oo subaxdii dambe ayaa Balcaam kacay oo dameertiisii kooraystay, kolkaasuu raacay amiirradii reer Moo'aab.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah cadhadiisiina way kululaatay, maxaa yeelay, Balcaam baa tegey. Markaasaa malaa'igtii Rabbigu jidka istaagtay iyadoo cadow ku ah isaga. Haddaba isagu wuxuu iska fuushanaa dameertiisii, oo labadiisii addoonna way la socdeen.
english: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dameertii waxay aragtay malaa'igtii Rabbiga oo jidka taagan oo seefteedii oo galka ka baxsan gacanta ku haysata. Kolkaasay dameertii jidka ka leexatay oo berrinka gashay. Oo Balcaamna dameertii wax buu ku dhuftay si uu jidka ugu soo celiyo.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaa'igtii Rabbigu waxay istaagtay surun beercanabyada ku dhex yaal oo dhankan deyr ka yahay, dhanka kalena deyr ka yahay.
english: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

kikuyu: Oo haddana dameertii waxay aragtay malaa'igtii Rabbiga, markaasay derbiga isku jiidday, oo Balcaam cagtiisii ayay derbigii kula qabatay, oo isna haddana wax buu ku dhuftay.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaa'igtii Rabbigu hore u sii socotay oo waxay istaagtay meel cidhiidhi ah oo aan meel looga leexdo lahayn midig iyo bidix toona.
english: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

kikuyu: Oo haddana dameertii waxay aragtay malaa'igtii Rabbiga, markaasay iska jiifsatay Balcaam hoostiisa, Balcaamna wuu cadhooday, oo dameertii usha ku dhuftay.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu afka dameerta furay oo waxay Balcaam ku tidhi, War maxaan kugu sameeyey oo aad saddexdan jeer ii dishay?
english: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Balcaam dameertii ku yidhi, Maxaa yeelay, adigu waad igu majaajilootay. Oo weliba waxaan jeclaan lahaa in seefu gacantayda ku jirto, waayo, waan ku dili lahaa hadda.
english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dameertii Balcaam ku tidhi, War sow ma ahi dameertaadii aad cimrigaaga oo dhan fuuli jirtay ilaa maantadan? Oo miyaan hore sidan oo kale weligay kugu sameeyey? Oo isna wuxuu ku yidhi, Maya.
english: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu Balcaam indhaha u furay oo wuxuu arkay malaa'igtii Rabbiga oo jidka dhex taagan oo seefteedii oo galka ka baxsan gacanta ku haysata. Markaasuu madaxa foororiyey oo sujuuday.
english: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa malaa'igtii Rabbigu waxay isagii ku tidhi, War maxaad dameertaada u dishay saddexdan jeer? Bal eeg, anigu waxaan u soo baxay cadow ahaan, maxaa yeelay, jidkaagu hortayda waa ku qalloocan yahay.
english: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

kikuyu: Oo dameertuna anay i aragtay oo saddexdan jeerba hortayday ka leexatay. Oo haddaanay iga leexan, hubaal waan ku dili lahaa, iyadase waan badbaadin lahaa.
english: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

kikuyu: Oo Balcaam wuxuu malaa'igtii Rabbiga ku yidhi, Waan dembaabay, waayo, ma aan ogayn inaad jidka taagan tahay adigoo iga gees ah. Haddaba haddii sidaasu ku xumayso, dib baan u noqonayaa.
english: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaa'igtii Rabbigu Balcaam ku tidhi, Orod oo nimanka raac; laakiinse hadalkii aan kula hadlo oo keliya waa inaad ku hadashaa. Sidaas daraaddeed Balcaam wuxuu raacay amiirradii Baalaaq soo diray.
english: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

kikuyu: Oo Baalaaq markuu maqlay in Balcaam yimid ayuu u baxay inuu isaga ku qaabbilo magaaladii Moo'aab oo ku taal soohdinta Arnoon oo ah soohdinta darafkeeda.
english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq wuxuu Balcaam ku yidhi, War sow degdeg dad kuuguma soo dirin inay kuu yeedhaan? Maxaad iigu iman weyday? Miyaanan awoodin inaan derejo weyn ku siiyo?
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Balcaam wuxuu Baalaaq ku yidhi, Haddaba waa i kan oo waan kuu imid. War anigu ma waxaan leeyahay awood aan wax kaga hadlo innaba ha ahaatee? Ereygii Ilaah afkayga geliyo ayaan ku hadli doonaa.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Balcaam raacay Baalaaq, oo waxay yimaadeen Qiryad Xusood.
english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq allabari u bixiyey dibi iyo ido, oo wax buu u diray Balcaam iyo amiirradii isaga la joogay.
english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

kikuyu: Oo subaxdii dambe ayaa Baalaaq kaxaystay Balcaam, oo wuxuu keenay meelihii sare oo Bacal, oo halkaas wuxuu ka arkay dadka darafkii ugu shisheeya.
english: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

kikuyu: Oo Balcaam wuxuu Baalaaq ku yidhi, Halkan iiga dhis toddoba meelood oo allabari, oo halkan iigu soo diyaari toddoba dibi iyo toddoba wan.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq sameeyey sidii Balcaam ku hadlay, oo Baalaaq iyo Balcaam meel kasta oo allabariba waxay ku dul bixiyeen dibi iyo wan.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Balcaam Baalaaq ku yidhi, Allabarigaaga la gubo ah istaag, oo anna waan tegayaa, mindhaa Rabbigu waa iga hor iman doonaa, oo wax alla wixii uu i tuso waan kuu sheegi doonaa. Markaasuu meel sare oo bannaan tegey.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ilaah Balcaam ka hor yimid, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaan diyaariyey toddobada meelood oo allabari, oo meel kastaba waxaan ku dul bixiyey dibi iyo wan.
english: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu eray Balcaam afka u geliyey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Baalaaq ku noqo oo sidatan ula hadal.
english: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

kikuyu: Oo isna markaasuu ku noqday, oo wuxuu arkay isagoo ag taagan allabarigiisii la gubo, isagii iyo amiirradii reer Moo'aab oo dhan.
english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

kikuyu: Markaasuu hadalkiisii bilaabay oo wuxuu yidhi, Baalaaq oo ah boqorkii reer Moo'aab oo ka yimid xagga buuraha bariga Ayaa iga keenay Araam, oo yidhi, Kaalay oo reer Yacquub ii habaar, Oo kaalay, cadhadaadu reer binu Israa'iil ha ku dhacdo.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

kikuyu: Bal sidee baan u habaaraa mid aan Ilaah habaarin? Oo sidee baan ugu cadhoodaa mid aan Rabbigu ka cadhaysnayn?
english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?

kikuyu: Waayo, dhagaxyada dushooda ayaan ka arkaa, Oo xagga buuraha ayaan uga jeedaa, Oo bal eeg, waa dad gooni u deggan, Iyagana quruumaha kale laguma tirin doono.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

kikuyu: Bal yaa qiyaasi kara reer Yacquub oo sida boodhka ah? Amase yaa tirin kara reer binu Israa'iil rubuciis? Anigu aan u dhinto sida kuwa xaqa ahu u dhintaan, Oo ugu dambaystayduna ha ahaato sida tooda oo kale.
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Baalaaq wuxuu Balcaam ku yidhi, War waa maxay waxa aad igu samaysay? Waxaan ku soo watay inaad cadaawayaashayda habaartid, laakiinse bal eeg, waad u wada ducaysay.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Sow waajib iguma aha inaan isjiro si aan ugu hadlo wixii Rabbigu afkayga geliyo?
english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq isagii ku yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, Kaalay, oo meel kale ii raac inaad halkaas iyaga ka aragtid. Waxaad arki doontaa darafkooda, oo kulligood ma arki doontid; haddaba halkaas iiga habaar.
english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu isagii geeyey berrinkii Sofiim xagga Buur Fisgaah dhaladeeda, oo halkaasuu ka dhisay toddoba meelood oo allabari, oo meel kasta wuxuu ku dul bixiyey dibi iyo wan.
english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

kikuyu: Oo markaasuu Baalaaq ku yidhi, Halkan allabarigaaga la gubo ag istaag intaan Rabbiga xaggaas shishe kaga hor tegayo.
english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu ka hor yimid Balcaam, oo eray buu afka u geliyey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Baalaaq ku noqo, oo sidatan ula hadal.
english: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu isagii u yimid, oo wuxuu arkay isagoo ag taagan allabarigiisii la gubo, oo waxaa isaga la jiray amiirradii reer Moo'aab. Kolkaasaa Baalaaq isagii ku yidhi, War Rabbigu muxuu ku hadlay?
english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu hadalkiisii sii watay, oo wuxuu yidhi, Baalaaq, kac oo maqal, Bal aniga i dhegayso, ina Sifoorow.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

kikuyu: Ilaah ma aha nin been sheego; Mana aha binu-aadmi qoomameeyo. Ma wuxuu yidhi buusan samaynayn? Ama ma wuxuu ku hadlay buusan yeelayn?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxaa laygu amray inaan u duceeyo. Isagaa barakeeyey, anna barakadaas ma aan beddeli karo.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

kikuyu: Isagu reer Yacquub dembi kuma uu arag, Oo reer binu Israa'iil qalloocsanaan ugama uu jeedin. Rabbiga Ilaahood ah ayaa iyaga la jira, Oo waxaa dhexdooda ka yeedhaysa boqor qayladiis.
english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa iyaga Masar ka soo bixiyey, Iyagu waxay leeyihiin xoog gisiyeed oo kale,
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

kikuyu: Hubaal sixir reer Yacquub kuma dhaco, Oo reer binu Israa'iil innaba fal ma qabto, Haddaba Yacquub iyo Israa'iil waxaa laga sheegi doonaa, Bal fiiri waxa Ilaah sameeyey!
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

kikuyu: Bal eeg, dadku wuxuu u kacaa sidii gool oo kale, Oo sidii aar oo kale ayuu isu qaadaa: Oo isagu jiifsan maayo jeeruu ugaadh cuno, Oo uu dhiigga ka cabbo waxa uu dishay.
english: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq wuxuu Balcaam ku yidhi, War iyaga hana habaarin, hana u ducayn innaba.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse Balcaam ayaa jawaabay oo wuxuu Baalaaq ku yidhi, Sow kuuma sheegin oo kuguma odhan, Wixii Rabbigu ku hadlo oo dhan waa inaan sameeyaa?
english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq wuxuu Balcaam ku yidhi, Haddaba kaalay, meel kalaan ku geeynayaaye, mindhaa Ilaah waa ku farxi doonaa inaad iyaga halkaas iiga habaartid.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq wuxuu Balcaam geeyey Buur Fecoor dhaladeeda taasoo lamadegaanka hoos u soo fiirisa.
english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

kikuyu: Oo Balcaam wuxuu Baalaaq ku yidhi, Halkan iiga dhis toddoba meelood oo allabari, oo halkan iigu soo diyaari toddoba dibi iyo toddoba wan.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq sameeyey sidii Balcaam ku yidhi, oo meel kasta oo allabariba wuxuu ku dul bixiyey dibi iyo wan.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

kikuyu: Oo Balcaamna markuu arkay in Rabbigu ku farxay inuu reer binu Israa'iil barakeeyo, ma uu tegin sidii mararkii kale inuu sixir doondoono, laakiinse wuxuu wejigiisii u jeediyey xagga cidlada.
english: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Balcaam indhaha kor u qaaday, oo wuxuu arkay reer binu Israa'iil oo qabiil qabiil u deggan, kolkaasaa waxaa isagii ku soo degay ruuxii Ilaah.
english: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu hadalkiisii watay oo wuxuu yidhi, Balcaam ina Becoor wuxuu leeyahay, Oo ninkii ishiisu daboolnaan jirtay wuxuu leeyahay,
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kikuyu: Wuxuu leeyahay kii erayadii Ilaah maqla Oo tusniintii Ilaaha Qaadirka ah arka, Oo dhaca isagoo indhihiisu furan yihiin,
english: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: Teendhooyinkiinnu wanaagsanaa, Reer Yacquubow, Oo taambuugyadiinnu qurxoonaa, Reer binu Israa'iilow!
english: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

kikuyu: Waxay u fidsan yihiin sidii dooxooyin, Iyo sidii beero webiga barbarkiisa ku yaal, Iyo sidii geedo dacar ah oo Rabbigu beeray, Iyo sidii geedo kedar ah oo biyo ku ag yaal.
english: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

kikuyu: Baaldiyadooda waxaa ka daadan doona biyo, Oo farcankoodu wuxuu ku jiri doonaa biyo badan, Oo boqorkooduna wuu ka sarrayn doonaa Agag, Oo boqortooyadoodana waa la sarraysiin doonaa.
english: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa iyaga Masar ka soo bixiyey, Oo iyagu waxay leeyihiin xoog gisiyeed oo kale, Oo waxay cuni doonaan quruumaha cadaawayaashooda ah, Oo lafahooda way jejebin doonaan, Oo waxay iyaga ka mudhbixin doonaan fallaadhahooda.
english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

kikuyu: Iyagu hoos bay isu gaabiyeen, oo sida aar bay u jiifsadeen, Iyo sida gool libaax; haddaba bal yaa kicin doona? Duco ha ku dhacdo ku alla kii idiin duceeya, Oo habaarna ha ku dhaco ku alla kii idin habaara.
english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baalaaq aad ugu cadhooday Balcaam, oo gacmihiisuu isku dhuftay. Oo Baalaaq wuxuu Balcaam ku yidhi, Waxaan kuugu yeedhay inaad cadaawayaashayda ii habaartid, oo bal eeg, saddexdan jeer baad u wada ducaysay.
english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

kikuyu: Haddaba meeshaadii ku carar. Anigu waxaan damacsanaa inaan derejo weyn ku siiyo, laakiinse Rabbigu dib buu kaaga celiyey derejadii.
english: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Balcaam wuxuu Baalaaq ku yidhi, War kuwii farriin kaa waday miyaanan u sheegin oo aanan ku odhan,
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

kikuyu: Haddii Baalaaq i siiyo gurigiisa oo lacag iyo dahab ka buuxo, anigu kama tallaabsan karo erayga Rabbiga inaan maankayga ka sameeyo xumaan iyo samaan toona. Wixii Rabbigu ku hadlo, kaas uun baan ku hadli doonaa.
english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan u tegayaa dadkaygii, oo bal kaalay aan kuu sheego waxay dadkanu dadkaaga ku samayn doonaan maalmaha ugu dambaysta.
english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu hadalkiisii sii watay oo wuxuu yidhi, Balcaam ina Becoor wuxuu leeyahay, Oo ninkii ishiisu daboolnaan jirtay wuxuu leeyahay,
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kikuyu: Wuxuu leeyahay kii erayadii Ilaah maqla, Oo yaqaan aqoonta Kan ugu sarreeya, Oo tusniintii Ilaaha Qaadirka ah arka, Oo dhaca, isagoo indhihiisu furan yihiin,
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: Isagaan arkaa, haddase ma aha, Waan u jeedaa, mase dhowa, Reer Yacquub xiddig baa ka soo bixi doonta, Reer binu Israa'iil waxaa ka soo kici doonta ul boqortooyo, Oo waxay burburin doontaa rukummada Moo'aab, Oo waxay baabbi'in doontaa dadka Sheed oo dhan.
english: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

kikuyu: Oo dalka Edom wuxuu noqonayaa hantidooda, Oo Seciir oo isna cadowgooda ahaa hantidooduu noqonayaa. Oo reer binu Israa'iil way xoogaysan doonaan.
english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

kikuyu: Oo mid reer Yacquub ka soo farcamay ayaa xukun yeelan doona, Oo wuxuu baabbi'in doonaa kuwa magaalada ka hadha.
english: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Camaaleq eegay, oo hadalkiisii sii watay oo yidhi, Camaaleq wuxuu ahaa kan quruumaha ugu horreeya, Laakiinse ugudambaysta wuu halligmi doonaa.
english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana wuxuu eegay reer Qeyn, markaasuu hadalkiisii sii watay oo yidhi, Meeshaad deggan tihiin waa adag tahay, Oo buulkiinnana dhagaxaa laga dhisay.
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee waa laydin baabbi'in doonaa, reer Qeynow, Jeer ay reer Ashuur maxaabiis ahaan idiin kaxaystaan.
english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu hadalkiisii sii watay oo wuxuu yidhi, Hoogay, ee bal yaa sii noolaan doona markii Ilaah waxan sameeyo?
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

kikuyu: Laakiinse doonniyo waxay ka iman doonaan xeebta Kitiim, Oo waxay dhibi doonaan Ashuur, oo waxay dhibi doonaan Ceeber, Oo isna wuu halligmi doonaa.
english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Balcaam kacay oo ku noqday meeshiisii; Baalaaqna wuu iska tegey.
english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna waxay iska degeen Shitiim, markaasay dadkii bilaabeen inay ka dhillaystaan gabdhihii reer Moo'aab,
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

kikuyu: waayo, dadkii bay ugu yeedheen allabaryadii ilaahyadooda, markaasay dadkii wax cuneen, oo waxay u sujuudeen ilaahyadoodii.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay isku dareen Bacal Fecoor. Markaasaa Rabbiga cadhadiisii aad ugu kululaatay reer binu Israa'iil.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu Muuse ku yidhi, Dadka madaxdiisa oo dhan soo wado oo maalin cad ku deldel Rabbiga hortiisa in cadhadii kululayd oo Rabbigu ay ka soo noqoto reer binu Israa'iil.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Muuse wuxuu xaakinnadii reer binu Israa'iil ku yidhi, Idinka mid waluba ha dilo nimankiisii Bacal Fecoor isku daray.
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, mid reer binu Israa'iil ah ayaa walaalihiis ula yimid naag reer Midyaan ah Muuse hortiisa iyo shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan hortooda iyagoo ku ooyaya iriddii teendhadii shirka horteeda.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo Fiinexaas ina Elecaasaar oo ahaa wadaadkii Haaruun wiilkiisii markuu taas arkay ayuu shirka dhexdiisii ka kacay oo wuxuu gacanta ku qaatay waran.
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

kikuyu: Oo teendhadii ayuu uga daba galay ninkii reer binu Israa'iil, oo ninkii reer binu Israa'iil iyo naagtii labadiiba calooshuu ka wareemay. Markaasaa belaayadii laga joojiyey reer binu Israa'iil.
english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo intii belaayadii u dhimatay waxay ahaayeen afar iyo labaatan kun.
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaa cadhadaydii reer binu Israa'iil ka celiyey Fiinexaas ina Elecaasaar oo ah wiilkii wadaadka Haaruun ah, waayo, dhexdooda ayuu iiga qiirooday, oo sidaas daraaddeed anigu qiiradaydii kuma aan baabbi'in reer binu Israa'iil.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waxaad tidhaahdaa, Bal eeg, anigu waxaan isaga la dhiganayaa axdigaygii nabadda.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

kikuyu: Oo isaga iyo farcankiisa ka dambeeyaba buu u ahaan doonaa axdiga wadaadnimo weligeed ah, maxaa yeelay, Ilaahiis buu qiiro u qabay, oo reer binu Israa'iil ayuu u kafaaro guday.
english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Haddaba ninkii reer binu Israa'iil oo la dilay, oo naagtii reer Midyaan lala dilay, magiciisu wuxuu ahaa Simrii ina Saaluu oo amiir u ahaa qoladiisa reer Simecoon.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

kikuyu: Oo naagtii reer Midyaan oo la dilay magaceedu wuxuu ahaa Kaasbii ina Suur, oo aabbeheed wuxuu madax u ahaa qolo ka mid ah reer Midyaan.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Reer Midyaan dhib oo laa iyaga,
english: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

kikuyu: waayo, waxay idinku dhibeen khiyaanadooda ay idinku khiyaaneeyeen xagga xaalkii Fecoor iyo xaalkii Kaasbii oo ahayd gabadhii amiirka reer Midyaan oo walaashood ahayd, taasoo maalintii belaayada la dilay xaalkii Fecoor aawadiis.
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

kikuyu: Oo belaayadii dabadeed ayaa Rabbigu la hadlay Muuse iyo Elecaasaar oo ahaa wadaadkii Haaruun wiilkiisii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

kikuyu: Shirka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan u soo tiriya reer reer, intii labaatan sannadood jirta iyo intii ka sii weyn, kuwaas oo ah inta reer binu Israa'iil ee dagaal u bixi karta oo dhan.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa iyagii kula hadleen bannaankii Moo'aab oo Webi Urdun ku ag yaal oo Yerixoo ka soo hor jeeda.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Dadka inta labaatan sannadood jirta iyo inta ka sii weyn soo tiriya, sidii Rabbigu ku amray Muuse iyo dadkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dalkii Masar ka soo baxay.
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ruubeen wuxuu ahaa curadkii Israa'iil, oo waxaa reer Ruubeen ka soo farcamay Xanoog oo dhalay qabiilka reer Xanoog, iyo Falluu oo dhalay qabiilka reer Falluu,
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

kikuyu: iyo Xesroon oo dhalay qabiilkii reer Xesroon, iyo Karmii oo dhalay qabiilkii reer Karmii.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Ruubeen, oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo afartan kun iyo toddoba boqol iyo soddon.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Reer Falluu waxaa ka dhashay Elii'aab.
english: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Elii'aabna waxay ahaayeen Nemuu'eel iyo Daataan iyo Abiiraam. Daataankan iyo Abiiraamkanu waa kuwii shirka ururin jiray oo la diriray Muuse iyo Haaruun oo ku jiray kooxdii Qorax markii ay Rabbiga la dirireen,
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD;

kikuyu: oo uu dhulku afka kala qaaday oo liqay iyagii iyo Qorax markii kooxdaasu ay dhinteen, kolkii dabku baabbi'iyey labada boqol iyo kontonka nin oo ay calaamad noqdeen.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee Qorax wiilashiisii ma ay dhiman.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Simecoon iyo qabiilooyinkoodii ka soo farcamay waa kuwan: Nemuu'eel oo dhalay qabiilka reer Nemuu'eel, iyo Yaamiin oo dhalay qabiilka reer Yaamiin, iyo Yaakiin oo dhalay qabiilkii reer Yaakiin,
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

kikuyu: iyo Serax oo dhalay qabiilkii reer Serax, iyo Shaa'uul oo dhalay qabiilkii reer Shaa'uul.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Simecoon, oo waxay ahaayeen laba iyo labaatan kun iyo laba boqol.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Gaad iyo qabiilooyinkii ka soo farcamay waa kuwan: Sefoon oo dhalay qabiilka reer Sefoon, iyo Xaggii oo dhalay qabiilka reer Xaggii, iyo Shuunii oo dhalay qabiilka reer Shuunii,
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

kikuyu: iyo Aasnii oo dhalay qabiilka reer Aasnii, iyo Ceerii oo dhalay qabiilka reer Ceerii,
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

kikuyu: iyo Arood oo dhalay qabiilka reer Arood, iyo Areelii oo dhalay qabiilka reer Areelii.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Gaad, oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen afartan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Yahuudahna waxay ahaayeen Ceer iyo Oonaan; oo Ceer iyo Oonaanna waxay ku dhinteen dalkii Kancaan.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Yahuudah iyo qabiilooyinkoodiina waxay ahaayeen: Sheelaah oo dhalay qabiilka reer Sheelaah, iyo Feres oo dhalay qabiilka reer Feres, iyo Serax oo dhalay qabiilka reer Serax.
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

kikuyu: Feres wiilashiisiina waxay ahaayeen: Xesroon oo dhalay qabiilka reer Xesroon, iyo Xaamuul oo dhalay qabiilka reer Xaamuul.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Yahuudah oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen lix iyo toddobaatan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Isaakaar iyo qabiilooyinkoodii waa kuwan: Toolac oo dhalay qabiilka reer Toolac, iyo Fuwaah oo dhalay qabiilka reer Fuwaah,
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

kikuyu: iyo Yaashuub oo dhalay qabiilka reer Yaashuub, iyo Shimroon oo dhalay qabiilka reer Shimroon.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Isaakaar, oo intii iyaga laga tiriyeyna waxay ahaayeen afar iyo lixdan kun iyo saddex boqol.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Sebulun iyo qabiilooyinkoodiina waa kuwan: Sered oo dhalay qabiilka reer Sered, iyo Eeloon oo dhalay qabiilka reer Eeloon, iyo Yaxle'eel oo dhalay qabiilka reer Yaxle'eel.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Sebulun, oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen lixdan kun iyo shan boqol.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Yuusuf iyo qabiilooyinkoodii waxay ahaayeen Manaseh iyo Efrayim.
english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Manaseh waa kuwan: Maakiir oo dhalay qabiilka reer Maakiir, oo Maakiirna wuxuu dhalay Gilecaad, Gilecaadna waxaa ka soo farcamay qabiilka reer Gilecaad.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Gilecaad waa kuwan: Iiceser oo dhalay qabiilka reer Iiceser, iyo Xeeleq oo dhalay qabiilka reer Xeeleq,
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

kikuyu: iyo Asrii'eel oo dhalay qabiilka reer Asrii'eel, iyo Shekem oo dhalay qabiilka reer Shekem,
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

kikuyu: iyo Shemiidaac oo dhalay qabiilka reer Shemiidaac, iyo Heefer oo dhalay qabiilka reer Heefer.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

kikuyu: Oo Selaafexaad oo ahaa ina Heefer wiilal ma uu lahayn gabdho mooyaane. Oo Selaafexaad gabdhihiisa magacyadoodu waxay ahaayeen Maxlaah iyo Nocaah iyo Xoglaah iyo Milkaah iyo Tirsaah.
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Manaseh, oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen laba iyo konton kun iyo toddoba boqol.
english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Efrayim iyo qabiilooyinkoodii waa kuwan: Shuutelax oo dhalay qabiilka reer Shuutelax, iyo Beker oo dhalay qabiilka reer Beker, iyo Tahan oo dhalay qabiilka reer Tahan.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

kikuyu: Intanuna waa wiilashii Shuutelax: Ceeraan oo dhalay qabiilka reer Ceeraan.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii wiilashii Efrayim, oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen laba iyo soddon kun iyo shan boqol. Kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Yuusuf iyo qabiilooyinkoodii.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Benyaamiin iyo qabiilooyinkoodiina waa kuwan: Belac oo dhalay qabiilka reer Belac, iyo Ashbeel oo dhalay qabiilka reer Ashbeel, iyo Axiiraam oo dhalay qabiilka reer Axiiraam,
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

kikuyu: iyo Shefuufaan oo dhalay qabiilka reer Shefuufaan, iyo Xuufaam oo dhalay qabiilka reer Xuufaam.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Belac waxay ahaayeen Ared iyo Nacamaan. Oo Ared wuxuu dhalay qabiilka reer Ared, Nacamaanna wuxuu dhalay qabiilka reer Nacamaan.
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa wiilashii Benyaamiin iyo qabiilooyinkoodii, oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen shan iyo afartan kun iyo lix boqol.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Daan iyo qabiilooyinkoodiina waa kuwan: Shuuxaam oo dhalay qabiilka reer Shuuxaam. Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Daan, siday qabiilooyinkoodii ahaayeen.
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilooyinkii reer Shuuxaam oo dhan intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen afar iyo lixdan kun iyo afar boqol.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Aasheer iyo qabiilooyinkoodiina waa kuwan: Yimnaah oo dhalay qabiilka reer Yimnaah, iyo Yishwii oo dhalay qabiilka reer Yishwii, iyo Beriicaah oo dhalay reer Beriicaah.
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Beriicaah waxaa ka soo farcamay: Xeber oo dhalay qabiilka reer Xeber, iyo Malkii'eel oo dhalay qabiilka reer Malkii'eel.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

kikuyu: Oo Aasheer gabadhiisii magaceediina wuxuu ahaa Serax.
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

kikuyu: Oo intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Aasheer, oo intii iyaga laga tiriyeyna waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo konton kun iyo afar boqol.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii Naftaali iyo qabiilooyinkoodii waa kuwan: Yaxse'eel oo dhalay qabiilka reer Yaxse'eel, iyo Guunii oo dhalay qabiilka reer Guunii;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

kikuyu: iyo Yeser oo dhalay qabiilka reer Yeser, iyo Shilleem oo dhalay qabiilka reer Shilleem.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Naftaali sidii ay qabiilooyinkoodu ahaayeen. Oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen shan iyo afartan kun iyo afar boqol.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa intii laga tiriyey reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxay kulligood ahaayeen lix boqol oo kun iyo toddoba boqol iyo soddon.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Kuwan ayaa dalka dhaxal ahaan loogu qaybin doonaa sida ay tahay tirada magacyadoodu.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

kikuyu: Kuwii badan waa inaad siisaa dhaxal badan oo kuwii yarna waa inaad siisaa dhaxal yar. Oo mid kasta sida kuwii laga tiriyey ay ahaayeen dhaxalka ha loo siiyo.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee dhulka waa in saami loo ritaa marka la qaybsanayo. Sida magacyada qabiilooyinka awowayaashoodu ahaayeen ha u dhaxleen.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa badan iyo kuwa yarba dhaxalkooda saami ha lagu kala qaybiyo.
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

kikuyu: Kuwii laga tiriyey reer Laawi iyo qolooyinkoodii waa kuwan: Gershoon oo dhalay qabiilka reer Gershoon, iyo Qohaad oo dhalay qabiilka reer Qohaad, iyo Meraarii oo dhalay qabiilka reer Meraarii.
english: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

kikuyu: Intanu waa qabiilooyinkii reer Laawi: qabiilkii reer Libnii, iyo qabiilkii reer Xebroon, iyo qabiilkii reer Maxlii, iyo qabiilkii reer Mushii, iyo qabiilkii reer Qorax. Oo Qohaadna wuxuu dhalay Camraam.
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

kikuyu: Oo Camraam naagtiisu waxay ahayd Yookebed ina Laawi, taasoo Laawi ugu dhalatay dalkii Masar. Oo iyana waxay Camraam u dhashay Haaruun iyo Muuse iyo walaashood Maryan.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

kikuyu: Oo Haaruun waxaa u dhashay Naadaab iyo Abiihuu iyo Elecaasaar iyo Iitaamaar.
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Oo Naadaab iyo Abiihuu way dhinteen markay Rabbiga hortiisa ku bixiyeen dab qalaad.
english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo intii iyaga laga tiriyey waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo labaatan kun, mid kasta oo lab ah oo bil jira iyo intii ka sii weyn, waayo, iyaga laguma tirin reer binu Israa'iil, maxaa yeelay, dhaxal laguma siin reer binu Israa'iil dhexdooda.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waa kuwii ay tiriyeen Muuse iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa oo ku tiriyey reer binu Israa'iil bannaankii Moo'aab oo webi Urdun ku ag yaal oo Yerixoo ka soo hor jeeda.
english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwaas nin keliyuhu kagama jirin kuwii ay Muuse iyo wadaadkii Haaruun ahaa tiriyeen markay reer binu Israa'iil ku tiriyeen cidladii Siinay.
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu iyaga ka yidhi, Hubaal cidlada bay ku dhiman doonaan. Oo nin qudhuhu kama hadhin, Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh iyo Yashuuca ina Nuun mooyaane.
english: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa soo dhowaaday gabdhihii Selaafexaad ina Heefer ina Gilecaad oo ahaa ina Maakiir ina Manaseh, oo ahaa reer Manaseh ina Yuusuf; oo magacyadii gabdhihiisiina waa kuwan: Maxlaah iyo Nocaah iyo Xoglaah iyo Milkaah iyo Tirsaah.
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Oo iyana markaasay is-hor taageen Muuse, iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa, iyo amiirradii iyo shirka oo dhan, xagga iriddii teendhada shirka, oo waxay yidhaahdeen,
english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

kikuyu: Aabbahayo wuxuu ku dhintay cidladii, laakiinse isagu kuma uu jirin kooxdii is-urursatay oo Rabbiga geesta ka ahayd, oo kooxdii Qorax ahayd, illowse isagu wuxuu u dhintay dembi uu isagu lahaa, oo isagu wiilalna ma uu lahayn.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

kikuyu: In kastoo uusan wiilal lahayn magicii aabbahayo maxaa qabiilkiisa looga dhex baabbi'inayaa? Haddaba aabbahayo walaalihiis dhul dhaxal ah nagu dhex sii.
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse arrintoodii keenay Rabbiga hortiisa.
english: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Gabdhaha Selaafexaad wax qumman bay ku hadleen. Haddaba hubaal waa inaad dhul dhaxal ah aabbahood walaalihiis ka dhex siisaa, oo waa inaad iyaga aabbahood ka dhaxalsiisaa.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad reer binu Israa'iil la hadashaa, oo waxaad iyaga ku tidhaahdaa, Haddii nin dhinto oo uusan wiil lahayn, markaas waa inaad gabadhiisa dhaxalsiisaan.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

kikuyu: Oo hadduusan gabadhna lahayn, markaas waa inaad dhaxalsiisaan walaalihiis.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

kikuyu: Oo hadduusan walaalo lahaynna markaas waa inaad adeerradiis dhaxalsiisaan.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

kikuyu: Oo hadduusan aabbihiis walaalo lahaynna markaas waa inaad dhaxalsiisaan mid xigtadiisa ah oo isagu ha lahaado. Oo taasu qaynuun xukun ah bay u ahaan doontaa reer binu Israa'iil, sida Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.’”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu Muuse ku yidhi, Buurtan Cabaariim soo fuul, oo bal fiiri dalka aan reer binu Israa'iil siiyey.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo markaad aragtid dabadeed dadkaagii dhintay waad ku darman doontaa, sidii walaalkaa Haaruunba ugu darmaday,
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, eraygayga baad kaga caasideen cidladii Sin markay dadka shirku dirireen ee aad aniga quduus igaga dhigi weydeen biyaha agtooda, iyagoo u jeeda. (Kuwaasu waa biyihii Meriibaah oo ku yaal Qaadeesh oo ah cidlada Sin.)
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse Rabbiga la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbiga ah Ilaaha ruuxyada binu-aadmiga oo dhan, ha doorto nin u taliya shirka,
english: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

kikuyu: oo hortooda dibadda ugu baxa, oo hortooda gudaha soo gala, oo iyaga dibadda u hoggaamiya, oo gudaha soo geliya inaan shirka Rabbigu ahaan sidii ido aan idojir lahayn.
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse ku yidhi, Waxaad soo waddaa Yashuuca ina Nuun oo ah nin Ruuxu ku jiro, oo gacanta dul saar isaga.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad isaga soo hor taagtaa wadaadka Elecaasaar ah iyo shirka oo dhan, oo hortooda amar ku sii.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad isaga dul saartaa sharaftaadii, si shirka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu ay isaga u addeecaan.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

kikuyu: Oo isagu waa inuu is-hor taagaa wadaadka Elecaasaar ah oo isaga wax ugu weyddiin doona xukunka Uuriimka Rabbiga hortiisa. Iyagu eraygiisay dibadda ugu bixi doonaan, oo eraygiisay gudaha ku soo geli doonaan, isaga iyo reer binu Israa'iilka isaga la jiraaba, kuwaas oo ah shirka oo dhan.
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse yeelay sidii Rabbigu ku amray, oo wuxuu soo waday Yashuuca, kolkaasuu soo hor taagay wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa iyo shirkii oo dhan.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

kikuyu: Oo gacmuhuu dul saaray, oo amar buu siiyey, sidii Rabbigu Muuse kula hadlay.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil amar, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Qurbaankayga oo ah cuntada qurbaannada dabka la iigu sameeyo oo carafta udgoon ii ah waa inaad dhawrtaan inaad wakhtigoodii bixisaan.
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

kikuyu: Oo waxaad iyaga ku tidhaahdaa, Kanu waa qurbaanka dabka lagu sameeyo oo aad Rabbiga u bixisaan laba wan oo gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn oo aad maalin kasta qurbaan la gubo oo joogto ah u bixisaan.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Waa inaad wan bixisaa aroortii, wanka kalena makhribkii.
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

kikuyu: Oo waxaad la bixisaa oo qurbaan hadhuudh ka dhigtaa eefaah bur ah oo toban meelood loo dhigay meeshiis oo lagu daray hiin rubuceed oo ah saliid saafi ah.
english: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

kikuyu: Kaasu waa qurbaan la gubo oo joogto ah oo Buur Siinay laga amray inuu ahaado qurbaan dab loogu sameeyo Rabbiga oo caraf udgoon u ah.
english: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo wan qurbaankiisa cabniinku waa inuu ahaadaa hiin rubuceed, oo meesha quduuska ah waa inaad Rabbiga ugu shubtaa qurbaan cabniin oo ah khamri culus.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

kikuyu: Oo wanka kalena waa inaad makhribka bixisaa, oo qurbaankiisii hadhuudhka iyo qurbaankiisii cabniinka waa inaad isaga la bixisaa sida kii aroortii oo kale, waayo, waa qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo oo Rabbiga u ah caraf udgoon.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta sabtidana waxaad bixisaa laba wan oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn, iyo eefaah bur ah oo toban meelood loo dhigay labadiis meelood ee qurbaan hadhuudh ah oo saliid lagu daray iyo qurbaankiisii cabniinka.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

kikuyu: Kaasu waa qurbaanka la gubo oo sabtida, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinku ku jirin.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo bilowga bilihiinnana waa inaad Rabbiga qurbaan la gubo ugu bixisaan laba dibi oo yaryar, iyo wan weyn, iyo toddoba wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn,
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

kikuyu: oo eefaah bur ah toban meelood loo dhigay saddexdiis meelood oo saliid lagu daray waa inaad qurbaan hadhuudh ula bixisaan dibi kasta, oo eefaah bur ah oo toban meelood loo dhigay labadiis meelood oo saliid lagu daray waa inaad qurbaan hadhuudh ula bixisaan wanka weyn.
english: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

kikuyu: Oo wan kasta oo yarna waxaad qurbaan hadhuudh ula bixisaan eefaah bur ah oo toban meelood loo dhigay meeshiis oo saliid lagu daray, kaasoo wada ah qurbaan la gubo oo caraf udgoon ah oo Rabbiga dab loogu sameeyo.
english: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo qurbaannadooda cabniinkuna waa inay ahaadaan hiin nuskeed khamri ah dibigiiba, iyo hiin saddex daloolkeed oo wanka weyn la socdaa, iyo hiin rubuceed oo wanka yar la socdaa. Intaasu waa qurbaanka la gubo oo ay tahay inaad bixisaan bil kasta bilaha sannaddii oo dhan.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi Rabbiga ugu bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinku ku jirin.
english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo bisha kowaad maalinteeda afar iyo tobnaadna waa wakhtiga Kormaridda Rabbiga.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.

kikuyu: Oo bishaas maalinteeda shan iyo tobnaadna waa in iidi jirtaa. Toddoba maalmood waa in kibis aan khamiir lahayn la cunaa.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta kowaadna waa in la yeesho shir quduus ah. Idinku waa inaydaan innaba shuqul caadi ah samayn,
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

kikuyu: laakiinse waa inaad bixisaan qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo, kaas oo ah qurbaan loo gubo Rabbiga, oo ah laba dibi oo yaryar, iyo wan weyn, iyo toddoba wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah. Waa inay idiin ahaadaan kuwa aan iin lahayn.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

kikuyu: Oo qurbaankooda hadhuudhkuna wuxuu ahaan doonaa bur saliid lagu daray. Burka toban meelood loo dhigay saddexdiis meelood waa inaad dibiba la bixisaan, labadiis meeloodna wanka weyn,
english: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

kikuyu: iyo meeshiisna toddobada wan oo yaryar midkood kasta.
english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi qurbaan dembi u bixisaan si laydiinku kafaaro gudo.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Kuwaas waa inaad bixisaan iyadoo uusan ku jirin qurbaanka la gubo oo subaxnimada, kaasoo ah qurbaan la gubo oo joogto ah.
english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Sidan waa inaad maalin kasta intii toddoba maalmood ah u bixisaan cuntada ah qurbaanka dabka lagu sameeyo oo Rabbiga caraf udgoon u ah. Taas waa in la bixiyaa iyadoo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta toddobaadna waa inaad yeelataan shir quduus ah, oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul caadi ah samayn.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Oo weliba maalinta midhaha hore la goosto, markaad qurbaan hadhuudh oo cusub Rabbiga ugu bixisaan iidda toddobaadyada waa inaad shir quduus ah yeelataan; oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul caadi ah samayn.
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

kikuyu: Laakiinse waa inaad qurbaan la gubo oo caraf udgoon ah Rabbiga ugu bixisaan laba dibi oo yaryar, iyo wan weyn, iyo toddoba wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah,
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

kikuyu: oo waxaad la bixisaan qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah oo ah bur saliid lagu daray, oo burkii tobankii meelood dibigii kasta saddex meelood la bixi, oo wankana laba meelood la bixi,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

kikuyu: oo toddobada wan oo yaryarna midkood kasta meel la bixi.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad bixisaan orgi laydiinku kafaaro gudo.
english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga iyo qurbaannadooda cabniinka waa inaad bixisaan iyadoo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ahu ku jirin (oo waa inay idiin ahaadaan kuwa aan iin lahayn).
english: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

kikuyu: Oo bisha toddobaad, maalinteeda kowaad, waa inaad yeelataan shir quduus ah; oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul caadi ah samayn, waayo, waa maalin buunan laydiin afuufo.
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad qurbaan la gubo oo caraf udgoon ah Rabbiga ugu bixisaan dibi yar iyo wan weyn iyo toddoba wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn,
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: oo waxaad la bixisaan qurbaankoodii hadhuudhka ah oo ah bur saliid lagu daray, oo burkii tobankii meelood saddex meelood dibiga la bixi, wankana laba meelood,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

kikuyu: oo toddobada wan oo yaryarna wankiiba meel la bixi.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi qurbaan dembi u bixisaan si laydiinku kafaaro gudo,
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

kikuyu: oo ayan ku jirin qurbaanka la gubo ee bisha cusub, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaannadooda cabniinka ah, sidii qaynuunkoodu ahaa, kuwaasoo wada ah caraf udgoon ee ah qurbaan Rabbiga dab loogu sameeyo.
english: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo bishaas toddobaad, maalinteeda tobnaad, waxaad yeeshaan shir quduus ah, oo waa inaad nafihiinna dhibtaan, oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul samayn cayn kasta ha ahaadee,
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

kikuyu: laakiinse waa inaad Rabbiga qurbaan la gubo oo caraf udgoon ah ugu bixisaan dibi yar iyo wan weyn iyo toddoba wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah, oo waa inay idiin ahaadaan kuwa aan iin lahayn,
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

kikuyu: oo waxaad la bixisaan qurbaankoodii hadhuudhka ah oo ah bur saliid lagu daray, oo burka tobankii meelood saddex meelood dibiga la bixi, wankana laba meelood,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

kikuyu: oo toddobada wan oo yaryarna wankiiba meel la bixi.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi qurbaan dembi u bixisaan, oo ayan qurbaanka dembiga oo kafaaraggudka ah, iyo qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisii hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaannadooda cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: Oo bisha toddobaad maalinteeda shan iyo tobnaad waa inaad yeelataan shir quduus ah, oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul caadi ah samayn, oo waa inaad inta toddoba maalmood ah Rabbiga iid u samaysaan.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad bixisaan qurbaan la gubo oo ah qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo oo Rabbiga caraf udgoon u ah, oo ah saddex iyo toban dibi oo yaryar, iyo laba wan oo waaweyn, iyo afar iyo toban wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah, oo waa inay ahaadaan kuwo aan iin lahayn,
english: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

kikuyu: oo waxaad la bixisaan qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah oo ah bur saliid lagu daray, oo burkii tobankii meelood saddex meelood saddex iyo tobanka dibi midkiiba la bixi, oo labada wan oo waaweynna midkiiba laba meelood la bixi,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

kikuyu: oo saddex iyo tobanka wan oo yaryarna mid kasta meel la bixi.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

kikuyu: Oo weliba orgi waa inaad u bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta labaadna waxaad bixisaan laba iyo toban dibi oo yaryar, iyo laba wan oo waaweyn, iyo afar iyo toban wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Oo dibida iyo wananka waaweyn iyo wananka yaryarba qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaankooda cabniinka ahba waa inaad u bixisaan sida tiradoodu tahay oo qaynuunka waafaqsan.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi u bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta saddexaadna waxaad bixisaan kow iyo toban dibi, iyo laba wan oo waaweyn, iyo afar iyo toban wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn.
english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Oo dibida iyo wananka waaweyn iyo wananka yaryarba qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaankooda cabniinka ahba waa inaad u bixisaan sida tiradoodu tahay oo qaynuunka waafaqsan.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi u bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta afraadna waxaad bixisaan toban dibi, iyo laba wan oo waaweyn, iyo afar iyo toban wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Oo dibida iyo wananka waaweyn iyo wananka yaryarba qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaankooda cabniinka ahba waa inaad u bixisaan sida tiradoodu tahay oo qaynuunka waafaqsan.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi u bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta shanaadna waxaad bixisaan sagaal dibi, iyo laba wan oo waaweyn, iyo afar iyo toban wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn.
english: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Oo dibida iyo wananka waaweyn iyo wananka yaryarba qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaankooda cabniinka ahba waa inaad u bixisaan sida tiradoodu tahay oo qaynuunka waafaqsan.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi u bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta lixaadna waxaad bixisaan siddeed dibi, iyo laba wan oo waaweyn, iyo afar iyo toban wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn.
english: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Oo dibida iyo wananka waaweyn iyo wananka yaryarba qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaankooda cabniinka ahba waa inaad u bixisaan sida tiradoodu tahay oo qaynuunka waafaqsan.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi u bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta toddobaadna waxaad bixisaan toddoba dibi, iyo laba wan oo waaweyn, iyo afar iyo toban wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn.
english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
