kikuyu: Oo dibida iyo wananka waaweyn iyo wananka yaryarba qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaankooda cabniinka ahba waa inaad u bixisaan sida tiradoodu tahay oo qaynuunka waafaqsan.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi u bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta siddeedaadna waa inaad yeelataan shir quduus ah, oo waa inaydaan innaba shuqul caadi ah samayn,
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

kikuyu: laakiinse waxaad bixisaan qurbaan la gubo, kaasoo ah qurbaan dab lagu sameeyo oo Rabbiga u ah caraf udgoon, oo waa dibi iyo wan weyn iyo toddoba wan oo yaryar oo wada gu jir ah oo aan iin lahayn.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Oo dibiga iyo wanka weyn iyo wananka yaryarba qurbaankooda hadhuudhka ah iyo qurbaankooda cabniinka ahba waa inaad u bixisaan sida tiradoodu tahay oo qaynuunka waafaqsan.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad orgi u bixisaan qurbaan dembi, oo ayan qurbaanka la gubo oo joogtada ah, iyo qurbaankiisa hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaankiisa cabniinka ahu ku jirin.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Kuwaas waa inaad Rabbiga u bixisaan iidihiinna xilligooda, kuwaasoo ayan ku jirin nidarradiinna iyo qurbaannadiinna ikhtiyaarka ah, kuwaasu waa qurbaannadiinna la gubo, iyo qurbaannadiinna hadhuudhka ah, iyo qurbaannadiinna cabniinka ah, iyo qurbaannadiinna nabaadiinada.
english: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil u sheegay kulli wixii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray oo dhan.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Muuse madaxdii qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Intanu waa wixii Rabbigu amray.
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.

kikuyu: Markii nin Rabbiga nidar u nidro, amase uu dhaar ugu dhaarto oo uu naftiisa sidaas ugu xidho, waa inuusan eraygiisa jebin. Waa inuu sameeyaa kulli wixii afkiisa ka soo baxay oo dhan.
english: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Qof dumar ahuna markay Rabbiga nidar u nidarto oo ay sidaas nafteeda ugu xidho, oo ay gurigii aabbaheed joogto iyadoo dhallinyaro ah,
english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

kikuyu: haddii aabbaheed maqlo nidarkeeda iyo dhaarteedii ay nafteeda ku xidhay, oo uu markaas iska aamuso, de markaas nidarradeedii oo dhammu way taagnaan doonaan, oo dhaar kastoo ay nafteeda ku xidhayna waa taagnaan doontaa.
english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii aabbaheed u diido maalintii uu maqlo, nidarradeedii iyo dhaaraheedii ay nafteeda ku xidhay midkoodna taagnaan maayo, oo Rabbiguna wuu cafiyayaa iyada, maxaa yeelay, aabbaheed baa u diiday.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

kikuyu: Oo hadday nin leedahay iyadoo ay kor saaran yihiin nidarradeedii iyo hadalkii degdegga ahaa oo bushimaheeda ka baxay oo ay nafteeda ku xidhay,
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

kikuyu: haddii ninkeedu maqlo oo uu iska aamuso maalintii uu maqlo, markaas nidarradeedii way taagnaan doonaan, oo dhaaraheedii ay nafteeda ku xidhayna way taagnaan doonaan.
english: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii ninkeedu u diido maalintii uu maqlo, markaasuu burin doonaa nidarkii saarnaa iyo hadalkii degdegga ahaa oo bushimaheeda ka baxay oo ay nafteeda ku xidhay; oo Rabbiguna iyada wuu cafiyi doonaa.
english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.

kikuyu: Laakiinse carmal laga dhintay, amase tii la furay, nidarkeeda iyo xataa waxa kastoo ay nafteeda ku xidhayba way taagnaan doonaan.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

kikuyu: Oo hadday nidar gasho ama ay nafteeda dhaar ku xidho iyadoo guriga ninkeeda joogta,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

kikuyu: oo haddii ninkeedu maqlo oo uu iska aamuso ee uusan iyada u diidin, markaas nidarradeedii oo dhammu way taagnaan doonaan, oo dhaar kastoo ay nafteeda ku xidhayna way taagnaan doontaa.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii ninkeedu uu iyaga buriyo maalintii uu maqlay, markaas wax alla wixii bushimaheeda ka soo baxay oo nidarradeeda ku saabsan amase ku saabsan dhaartii ay nafteeda ku xidhay ma ay taagnaan doonaan, waayo, ninkeedii baa buriyey, oo Rabbiguna wuu cafiyi doonaa iyada.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.

kikuyu: Nidar kasta iyo dhaar kasta oo nafta lagu xidho in lagu dhibo aawadeed, ninkeedaa adkayn kara ama ninkeedaa burin kara.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii ninkeedu maalin ka maalin ka aamuso iyada, markaas wuu adkeeyaa nidarradeedii oo dhan iyo dhaaraheedii iyada saarnaa oo dhan. Wuu adkeeyey, maxaa yeelay, wuu isaga aamusay maalintii uu maqlay.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadduu buriyo markuu maqlay dabadeed, de markaas isagaa qaadaya dembigeedii.
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa qaynuunnadii Rabbigu ku amray Muuse, ee u dhexeeya nin iyo naagtiis, oo u dhexeeya aabbe iyo gabadhiis dhallinyaro ah oo guriga aabbaheed joogta.
english: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil uga aargud reer Midyaan, oo taas dabadeedna dadkaagaad ku darman doontaa.
english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse dadkii la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, War idinku dhexdiinna rag dagaal uga diyaariya, oo hub siiya, inay reer Midyaan ku kacaan, oo ay Rabbiga reer Midyaan uga aargudaan.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan waa inaad qabiil kastaba kun ka soo bixisaan oo dagaal u dirtaan.
english: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kumanyaalkii reer binu Israa'iil qabiil kasta waxaa laga soo bixiyey kun nin, oo waxay ahaayeen laba iyo toban kun oo nin oo dagaal hub u sita.
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse qabiilba kun dagaalka uga diray, iyagii iyo Fiinexaas wadaadkii Elecaasaar wiilkiisii ahaa isagoo wada alaabtii meesha quduuska ah iyo turumbooyinkii dhawaaqa digtoonaanta oo gacanta ugu jira.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

kikuyu: Oo waxay la dirireen reer Midyaan sidii Rabbigu Muuse ugu amray, oo waxay dileen mid kasta oo lab ahaa.
english: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.

kikuyu: Oo boqorradii reer Midyaan ayay la dileen kuwii kaloo la laayay, oo shantii boqor oo reer Midyaan waxay ahaayeen Ewii, iyo Reqem, iyo Suur, iyo Xuur, iyo Rebac; oo Balcaam oo ahaa ina Becoorna seef bay ku dileen.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay maxaabiis ahaan u wateen dumarkii reer Midyaan iyo dhallaankoodiiba; oo lo'doodii oo dhan, iyo idahoodii oo dhan, iyo alaabtoodii oo dhanna way wada dheceen.
english: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkoodii ku yiil meelihii ay degganaayeen iyo xerooyinkoodii oo dhan way wada gubeen.
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

kikuyu: Oo dad iyo duunyaba way dheceen oo booli bay u qaateen.
english: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

kikuyu: Oo maxaabiistii iyo boolidii iyo wixii la soo dhacay waxay u keeneen Muuse iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa iyo shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan oo joogay xeradii ku tiil bannaankii Moo'aab oo Webi Urdun u dhowaa oo Yerixoo ka soo hor jeeday.
english: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa iyo shirka amiirradiisii oo dhammu waxay u bexeen inay kaga hor tagaan xerada dibaddeeda.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse u cadhooday saraakiishii ciidanka, kuwaas oo ahaa kun-u-taliyayaashii iyo boqol-u-taliyayaashii ka yimid hawshii dagaalka.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, War dumarkii oo dhan miyaad badbaadiseen?
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, taladii Balcaam aawadeed kuwanu waxay reer Israa'iil ka dhigeen inay Rabbiga kaga xadgudbaan xaalkii Fecoor, oo sidaas daraaddeed belaayadaa uga dhex dhacday shirkii Rabbiga.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed dila dhallaanka mid kastoo lab ah, oo dila naag kastoo nin la seexatay.
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

kikuyu: Laakiinse carruurta dhaddig oo aan rag la seexan daysta.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

kikuyu: Oo idinna xerada dibaddeeda dega intii toddoba maalmood ah. Oo ku alla kii qof dilay, iyo ku alla kii qof la dilay taabtayba, maalinta saddexaad iyo maalinta toddobaad ha isdaahiriyo, idinka iyo maxaabiistiinnuba.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad kaloo daahirsataan dhar kasta iyo inta haragga laga sameeyey oo dhan, iyo wax kasta oo dhogor riyaad ah, iyo alaab kasta oo qoryo laga sameeyeyba.
english: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

kikuyu: Oo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaana wuxuu ku yidhi raggii dagaalka u baxay, Kanu waa qaynuunkii sharciga oo Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee dahabka, iyo lacagta, iyo naxaasta, iyo birta, iyo waxa daasadda ah, iyo waxa rasaasta ah,
english: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

kikuyu: iyo wax kasta oo dab u adkaysta waa inaad dab dhex marisaan, oo markaas nadiif bay ahaan doonaan; hase ahaatee waa in lagu daahiriyaa biyaha nijaasta daahiriya, oo wixii aan dabka u adkaysanna waa inaad biyaha dhex marisaan.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

kikuyu: Oo dharkiinnana waa inaad maalinta toddobaad maydhaan, oo markaas daahir baad ahaanaysaan oo kolkaas dabadeed waa inaad xerada soo gashaan.
english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Soo tiriya boolida la soo dhacay, dad iyo duunyaba, adiga iyo wadaadka Elecaasaar ah iyo madaxda qabiilooyinka shirka,
english: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

kikuyu: oo boolida laba meelood u kala qaybi, oo kala sii ragga dagaalyahanka ah ee dagaalka u baxay, iyo intii kale ee shirka oo dhan;
english: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

kikuyu: oo Rabbiga canshuur uga qaad raggii dagaalka u baxay; oo shantii boqolba mid ka soo bixi dadka, iyo lo'da, iyo dameerrada, iyo idaha,
english: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

kikuyu: badhkooda intaas ka qaad, oo waxaad wadaadka Elecaasaar ah u siisaa Rabbiga qurbaankiisa sare loo qaado.
english: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil badhkoodana kontonkiiba mid ka soo bixi dadka, iyo lo'da, iyo dameerrada, iyo idaha, iyo xataa xoolaha oo dhan, oo waxaad siisaa reer Laawi oo haya shuqulka taambuugga Rabbiga.
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa waxay sameeyeen sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Haddaba boolidii aan lagu tirin wixii nimankii dagaalyahannada ahaa soo dhaceen waxay ahayd lix boqol iyo shan iyo toddobaatan kun oo ido ah,
english: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

kikuyu: iyo laba iyo toddobaatan kun oo lo' ah,
english: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: iyo kow iyo lixdan kun oo dameer,
english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

kikuyu: oo dadkuna kulligiis wuxuu ahaa laba iyo soddon kun oo ah dumarkii aan rag la seexan.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

kikuyu: Oo badhkii ahaa kuwii dagaalka u baxay qaybtoodii waxay ahayd saddex boqol iyo toddoba iyo soddon kun iyo shan boqol oo ido ah.
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga canshuurtiisii idaha ka go'day waxay ahayd lix boqol iyo shan iyo toddobaatan neef.
english: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

kikuyu: Oo lo'duna waxay ahayd lix iyo soddon kun, oo Rabbiga canshuurtiisii ka go'dayna waxay ahayd laba iyo toddobaatan neef.
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.

kikuyu: Oo dameerraduna waxay ahaayeen soddon kun iyo shan boqol, oo Rabbiga canshuurtiisii ka go'dayna waxay ahayd kow iyo lixdan neef.
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.

kikuyu: Oo dadkuna wuxuu ahaa lix iyo toban kun, oo Rabbiga canshuurtiisii ka go'dayna waxay ahayd laba iyo soddon qof.
english: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

kikuyu: Oo canshuurtii ahayd Rabbiga qurbaankiisii sare loo qaado Muuse wuxuu siiyey wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil badhkoodii wuxuu Muuse gooni uga dhigay qaybtii raggii dagaallamay.
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

kikuyu: (Haddaba shirka badhkiisii wuxuu ahaa saddex boqol iyo toddoba iyo soddon kun iyo shan boqol oo ido ah,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

kikuyu: iyo lix iyo soddon kun oo lo' ah,
english: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: iyo soddon kun iyo shan boqol oo dameerro ah,
english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

kikuyu: iyo lix iyo toban kun oo qof.)
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

kikuyu: Oo xataa reer binu Israa'iil badhkoodii Muuse kontonkiiba mid buu ka soo saaray dad iyo duunyaba, oo wuxuu siiyey reer Laawi oo haya shuqulkii taambuuggii Rabbiga, sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa Muuse u yimid saraakiishii ahayd kun-u-taliyayaashii iyo boqol-u-taliyayaashii oo u sarreeyey kumanyaalkii ciidanka ahaa,
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

kikuyu: oo waxay Muuse ku yidhaahdeen, Annagoo addoommadaada ah waan soo tirinnay ragga dagaalyahannada ah oo aannu u talinno, oo nin qudhuhu nagama dhinna.
english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

kikuyu: Oo annagu waannu keennay qurbaankii Rabbiga, kaas oo ah wixii dahab ah oo nin waluba helay, kuwaasoo ah silsilado, iyo dugaagado, iyo kaatunno, iyo hilqado, iyo murriyado, inaannu naftayada Rabbiga hortiisa u kafaaro gudno.
english: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Oo Muuse iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa iyagay ka qaadeen dahabkii oo ahaa wax kasta oo laysku sharxo oo dahab laga sameeyey.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

kikuyu: Oo dahabkii qurbaanka sare loo qaado oo dhan oo ay kun-u-taliyayaasha iyo boqol-u-taliyayaashu Rabbiga u bixiyeen wuxuu ahaa lix iyo toban kun iyo toddoba boqol iyo konton sheqel.
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

kikuyu: (Waayo, raggii dagaalyahannada ahaa nin waluba wuxuu qaatay wixii uu soo dhacay.)
english: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa dahabkii ka qaadeen kun-u-taliyayaashii iyo boqol-u-taliyayaashii, oo waxay soo geliyeen teendhadii shirka inuu reer binu Israa'iil Rabbiga hortiisa xusuus ugu ahaado.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

kikuyu: Haddaba reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaad waxay lahaayeen xoolo faro badan, oo markay arkeen dalkii Yacser iyo dalkii Gilecaad inay meeshaasu xoolo u wanaagsan tahay,
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

kikuyu: ayay reer Gaad iyo reer Ruubeen u yimaadeen Muuse iyo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa iyo amiirradii shirka, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen,
english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

kikuyu: Cataarood, iyo Diboon, iyo Yacser, iyo Nimraah, iyo Xeshboon, iyo Elecaaleeh, iyo Sebaam, iyo Neboo, iyo Becon,
english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

kikuyu: oo ah dalkii Rabbigu wax kaga dhuftay reer binu Israa'iil hortooda waa dal xoolo u wanaagsan, oo annagoo addoommadaada ahuna xoolo baannu leennahay.
english: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxay yidhaahdeen, Haddaad raalli naga tihiin, annagoo addoommadaada ah dalkan inaannu hantinno noo sii, oo Webi Urdun ha naga gudbin.
english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse wuxuu reer Gaad iyo reer Ruubeen ku yidhi, War, walaalihiin ma dagaalkay galayaan oo idinku aad iska fadhiisanaysaan?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

kikuyu: Oo maxaad reer binu Israa'iil uga qalbi jebinaysaan inay u gudbaan oo galaan dalkii Rabbigu iyaga siiyey?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?

kikuyu: Aabbayaashiinna sidaasay yeeleen markaan iyaga ka diray Qaadeesh Barneeca inay dalka soo arkaan aawadeed.
english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

kikuyu: Waayo, markay tageen dooxadii Eshkol oo ay dalkii arkeen ayay reer binu Israa'iil qalbi jebiyeen si ayan u gelin dalkii Rabbigu iyaga siiyey.
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

kikuyu: Maalintaas Rabbigu aad buu u cadhooday, oo intuu dhaartay ayuu yidhi,
english: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

kikuyu: Hubaal dadkii Masar ka soo baxay intii labaatan sannadood jirta ama ka sii weyn, midkoodna ma arki doono dalkii aan ugu dhaartay Ibraahim, iyo Isxaaq, iyo Yacquub, maxaa yeelay, qalbiga igama ay wada raacin,
english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

kikuyu: Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh oo ahaa reer Qenes, iyo Yashuuca ina Nuun mooyaane; maxaa yeelay, iyagu qalbigay Rabbiga ka wada raaceen.
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu reer binu Israa'iil u cadhooday, oo wuxuu iyagii ka dhigay inay intii afartan sannadood ah cidlada hor iyo dib ugu warwareegaan, ilamaa qarnigii Rabbiga hortiisa xumaanta ku sameeyey oo dhan la wada baabbi'iyey.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal eega, idinku meeshii aabbayaashiin baad ka kacdeen, oo waxaad tihiin niman dembi miidhan ah oo soo kordhay inaad Rabbiga kaga sii cadhaysiisaan reer binu Israa'iil.
english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaad Rabbiga ka noqotaan, cidlada dhexdeeda ayuu haddana iyaga kaga tegi doonaa, oo dadkan oo dhan waad wada baabbi'in doontaan.
english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

kikuyu: Markaasay isagii u soo dhowaadeen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Annagu halkanaannu xoolahayaga xeryo uga oodaynaa, dhallaankayagana magaalooyin waannu uga dhisaynaa,
english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

kikuyu: laakiinse annaga qudhayadu diyaar baannu ahaanaynaa annagoo hub leh, oo reer binu Israa'iil baannu hor kacaynaa ilamaa aannu iyaga geeyno meeshoodii, oo kuwa dhulka deggan aawadood dhallaankayagu waxay deganaanayaan magaalooyinka deyrarka leh.
english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

kikuyu: Oo annagu guryahayaga ku soo noqon mayno ilamaa reer binu Israa'iil nin waluba dhaxalkiisa dhaxlo.
english: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

kikuyu: Waayo, annagu iyaga la dhaxli mayno Webi Urdun dhankiisa kale iyo xaggaas hore toona, maxaa yeelay, dhaxalkayagii wuxuu noogu dhacay Webi Urdun dhankiisan bari.
english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Muuse wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Haddaad waxan samaynaysaan, oo aad Rabbiga hortiisa hub ugu qaadanaysaan dagaalka,
english: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,

kikuyu: oo aad raggiinna hubka leh oo dhammu Webi Urdun ku dhaafaysaan Rabbiga hortiisa ilamaa uu isagu cadaawayaashiisa ka wada eryo hortiisa,
english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

kikuyu: oo dalkana Rabbiga hortiisa lagaga adkaado, markaas dabadeed idinku waad soo noqonaysaan, oo xagga Rabbiga iyo reer binu Israa'iilba waad ka eedla'aanaysaan, oo dalkanuna Rabbiga hortiisa hanti buu idiinku ahaan doonaa.
english: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddaydnan sidaas yeelin, bal eega, Rabbigaad ku dembaabteen, oo bal ogaada, dembigiinnuna wuu idinku soo bixi doonaa.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.

kikuyu: Haddaba dhallaankiinna magaalooyin u dhista, idihiinnana xeryo u oota, oo sameeya wixii afkiinna ka soo baxay.
english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Gaad iyo reer Ruubeen la hadleen Muuse, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Annagoo addoommadaada ah waannu samaynaynaa wixii aad nagu amartay, sayidkayagiiyow.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

kikuyu: Haddaba dhallaankayaga, iyo afooyinkayaga, iyo idahayaga, iyo xoolahayaga oo dhammu halkaasay wada joogi doonaan xagga magaalooyinka Gilecaad;
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

kikuyu: laakiinse annagoo addoommadaada ah kulli intayada dagaalka hub u leh oo dhammu Webi Urdun waannu gudbaynaa, oo Rabbiga hortiisa ayaannu ku dagaal galaynaa sidaad tidhi, sayidkayagiiyow.
english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ayaa Muuse amar iyaga ku saabsan siiyey wadaadkii Elecaasaar iyo Yashuuca ina Nuun iyo madaxdii reeraha qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil.
english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Haddii reer Gaad iyo reer Ruubeen Webi Urdun idinla gudbaan, intooda Rabbiga hortiisa dagaalka hub u leh oo dhammu, oo dalka lagaga adkaado hortiinna, markaas waa inaad iyaga hanti u siisaan dalka Gilecaad.
english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddayan idinla gudbin iyagoo hub leh, waxay hanti ku yeelan doonaan dhexdiinna dalka reer Kancaan.
english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Gaad iyo reer Ruubeen u jawaabeen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sidii Rabbigu nagu yidhi, annagoo addoommadaada ah, ayaannu yeelaynaa.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.

kikuyu: Annagoo hub leh ayaannu gudbaynaa oo Rabbiga hortiisa waxaannu galaynaa dalka reer Kancaan, oo hantidii aan dhaxalka u helnayna waxay noogu hadhaysaa Webi Urdun dhinacan.
english: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse reer Gaad iyo reer Ruubeen iyo qabiilkii reer Manaseh oo ahaa wiilkii Yuusuf badhkood wuxuu siiyey boqorkii reer Amor oo ahaa Siixon boqortooyadiisii, iyo boqorkii Baashaan oo ahaa Coog boqortooyadiisii, oo wuxuu waddankii ugu qaybshay sidii ay ahaayeen magaalooyinka iyo soohdintoodii, xataa magaalooyinkii dalka iyaga ku wareegsan oo dhan.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Gaad waxay dhisteen Diboon, iyo Cataarood, iyo Carooceer,
english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

kikuyu: iyo Catrood Shoofaan, iyo Yacser, iyo Yaagbehaah,
english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

kikuyu: iyo Beytnimraah, iyo Beyd Haaraan, kuwaasoo ah magaalooyin deyrar leh, iyo xeryo idaad.
english: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

kikuyu: Oo reer Ruubeenna waxay dhisteen Xeshboon, iyo Elecaaleeh, iyo Qiryaatayim,
english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

kikuyu: iyo Neboo, iyo Bacal Mecoon, (kuwaasoo magacyadoodii la beddelay,) iyo Sibmaah; oo magacyo kalay u bixiyeen magaalooyinkii ay dhisteen.
english: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

kikuyu: Oo reer Maakiir oo ahaa Manaseh wiilkiisiina waxay tageen dalkii Gilecaad, oo way qabsadeen, oo dadkii reer Amor oo halkaas degganaa ayay hanti tireen.
english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wuxuu Gilecaad siiyey reer Maakiir oo ahaa wiilkii Manaseh, oo iyana halkaasay degeen.
english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yaa'iir ina Manasehna wuu tegey Gilecaad, oo magaalooyinkeedii qabsaday, oo wuxuu magacyadoodii u bixiyey Hawood Yaa'iir.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

kikuyu: Oo Nobaxna wuu tegey oo wuxuu qabsaday Qenaad iyo tuulooyinkeediiba, markaasuu u bixiyey magiciisa Nobax.
english: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil sodcaalladoodii waa kuwan markay gacanta Muuse iyo Haaruun koox koox ugaga soo bexeen dalkii Masar.
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wuxuu amarka Rabbiga ugu qoray bixitimmadoodii sidii sodcaalladoodu ahaayeen, oo sodcaalladoodii sidii bixitimmadoodu ahaayeen waa kuwan.
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

kikuyu: Oo bishii kowaad maalinteedii shan iyo tobnaad ayay Racmeses ka guureen. Habeenkii Kormaridda maalintii ka dambaysay ayay reer binu Israa'iil gacan sarraysa ku bexeen iyadoo Masriyiintii oo dhammu ay u jeedaan,
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

kikuyu: intii Masriyiintu ay aasayeen curadyadoodii uu Rabbigu ku dhex laayay oo dhan. Oo ilaahyadoodiina Rabbigu xukummo buu ku soo dejiyey.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil Racmeses bay ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Sukod.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

kikuyu: Oo Sukodna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Eetaam oo ku taal cidlada darafkeeda.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Oo haddana Eetaam bay ka guureen, oo waxay dib ugu noqdeen Fiihaahiirod oo ku hor taal Bacal Sefoon; kolkaasay degeen Migdol horteeda.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

kikuyu: Oo Haxiirod horteedana way ka guureen, oo badday dhex mareen oo waxay gaadheen cidlada, oo cidladii Eetaam ayay saddex maalmood socodkood ku dhex socdeen, kolkaasay Maaraah degeen.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

kikuyu: Oo Maaraahna way ka guureen, oo waxay yimaadeen Eelim, oo Eelim waxaa ku yiil laba iyo toban ilood oo biyo ah iyo toddobaatan geed oo timir ah, kolkaasay halkaas degeen.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

kikuyu: Oo haddana Eelim way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Badda Cas agteeda.
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Oo Badda Cas way ka guureen, oo waxay dhex degeen cidlada Siin la yidhaahdo.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

kikuyu: Oo cidladii Siinna way ka guureen, kolkaasay degeen Daafqaah.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

kikuyu: Oo Daafqaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Aaluush.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

kikuyu: Oo Aaluushna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Refiidiim, meeshaas oo aan lahayn biyo ay dadku cabbaan.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

kikuyu: Oo Refiidiimna way ka guureen, oo waxay dhex degeen cidladii Siinay.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Oo cidladii Siinayna way ka guureen, kolkaasay degeen Qibrood Xatawaah.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

kikuyu: Oo Qibrood Xatawaahna way ka guureen, kolkaasay degeen Xaseerood.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

kikuyu: Oo Xaseeroodna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Ritmaah.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

kikuyu: Oo Ritmaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Rimmon Feres.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

kikuyu: Oo Rimmon Feresna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Libnaah.
english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

kikuyu: Oo Libnaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Risaah.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

kikuyu: Oo Risaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Qeheelaataah.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

kikuyu: Oo Qeheelaataahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Buur Shefer.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

kikuyu: Oo haddana Buur Shefer way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Xaraadaah.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

kikuyu: Oo Xaraadaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Maqheelod.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

kikuyu: Oo Maqheelodna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Taxad.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

kikuyu: Oo Taxadna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Terax.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

kikuyu: Oo Teraxna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Mitqaah.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

kikuyu: Oo Mitqaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Xashmonaah.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

kikuyu: Oo Xashmonaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Mooseerood.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

kikuyu: Oo Mooseeroodna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Bini Yacaqaan.
english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

kikuyu: Oo Bini Yacaqaanna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Xor Haggidgaad.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

kikuyu: Oo Xor Haggidgaadna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Yaatbaataah.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

kikuyu: Oo haddana Yaatbaataah way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Cabronaah.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

kikuyu: Oo Cabronaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Cesyoon Geber.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

kikuyu: Oo Cesyoon Geberna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen cidladii Sin (taasoo ah Qaadeesh).
english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

kikuyu: Oo Qaadeeshna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Buur Xor oo ku taal dalka reer Edom darafkiisa.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii Haaruun ahaa wuxuu Buur Xor ku fuulay amarka Rabbiga, oo halkaasuu ku dhintay sannaddii afartanaad bishii shanaad maalinteedii kowaad markay reer binu Israa'iil dalkii Masar ka soo bexeen dabadeed.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

kikuyu: Haaruunna markuu Buur Xor ku dhintay wuxuu jiray boqol iyo saddex iyo labaatan sannadood.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Oo boqorkii Caraad oo reer Kancaan ahaa oo degganaa xagga koonfureed ee dalka reer Kancaan wuxuu maqlay in reer binu Israa'iil soo socdaan.
english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ka guureen Buur Xor, kolkaasay degeen Salmonaah.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

kikuyu: Oo Salmonaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Fuunon.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

kikuyu: Oo Fuunonna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Obod.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

kikuyu: Oo Obodna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Ciyee Hacabaariim, oo ku taal soohdinta dalka Moo'aab.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

kikuyu: Oo Ciyiimna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Diibon Gaad.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

kikuyu: Oo Diibon Gaadna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen Calmoon Diblaatayimaah.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

kikuyu: Oo Calmoon Diblaatayimaahna way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen buuraha Cabaariim oo Neboo ku hor yaal.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

kikuyu: Oo haddana buurihii Cabaariim way ka guureen, oo waxay degeen bannaanka dalka Moo'aab oo Webi Urdun u dhow ee Yerixoo ka soo hor jeeda.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxay degeen Webi Urdun agtiisa tan iyo Beytyeshimood iyo xataa tan iyo Aabeel Shitiim oo ku yaal bannaanka dalka Moo'aab.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse kula hadlay bannaankii dalka Moo'aab oo Webi Urdun u dhowaa ee Yerixoo ka soo hor jeeday, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil la hadal, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Markaad Webi Urdun gudubtaan oo aad dalka Kancaan gashaan,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: waa inaad dadka dalka deggan oo dhan hortiinna ka eridaan, oo aad dhagaxyadooda sawirrada ah oo dhan wada baabbi'isaan, oo aad sanamyadooda la shubay oo dhan wada burburisaan, oo aad meelahooda sarsare oo dhan wada dumisaan.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

kikuyu: Markaas waa inaad dalka hanti ahaan u qaadataan oo aad iska dhex degtaan; waayo, dalka idinkaan idin siiyey inaad lahaataan.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

kikuyu: Oo dalka waa inaad qabiil qabiil saami ugu dhaxashaan. Inta badan waxaad siisaan dhaxalka badan, oo inta yarna waxaad siisaan dhaxalka yar. Oo meel alla meeshii nin saami ugu dhaco halkaas isagaa iska lahaanaya, oo sida qabiilooyinkii awowayaashiin yihiin waa inaad u dhaxashaan.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddaydnan dadka dalka deggan hortiinna ka eryin, markaas kuwii aad daysaan waxay idinku noqon doonaan sidii wax indhihiinna muda, iyo sidii qodxan dhinacyada idinkaga jira, oo waxay idinku dhibi doonaan dalka aad deggan tihiin.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

kikuyu: Oo sidii aan ku talaggalay inaan iyaga ku sameeyo ayaan idinka idinku samayn doonaa.
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil waxaad ku amartaa oo ku tidhaahdaa, Markaad gashaan dalka Kancaan, (kaas oo ah dalka dhaxal idiinku dhici doona oo ah dalka Kancaan siday soohdimihiisu yihiin,)
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

kikuyu: waaxdiinna koonfureed waxay ahaan doontaa cidlada Sin iyo tan iyo dhinaca Edom, oo soohdintiinna koonfureedna waxay ka bilaaban doontaa Badda Cusbada leh darafkeeda bari,
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

kikuyu: oo soohdintiinnuna waxay la soo wareegi doontaa xagga koonfureed oo jiirtii Caqrabbiim, oo waxay u gudbi doontaa ilamaa Sin, oo dhammaadkeeduna wuxuu ahaan doonaa Qaadeesh Barneeca xaggeeda koonfureed, oo waxay u sii bixi doontaa xagga Hasar Addaar, oo waxay u sii dhaafi doontaa ilaa Casmoon.
english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay la soo wareegi doontaa Casmoon ilaa tan iyo durdurka Masar, oo dhammaadkeeduna wuxuu ahaan doonaa xagga badda.
english: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

kikuyu: Oo soohdinta galbeedna waxaad yeelan doontaan badda weyn iyo soohdinteedaba. Intaasu waxay ahaan doontaa soohdintiinna galbeed.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

kikuyu: Oo intanuna waxay ahaan doontaa soohdintiinna woqooyi, waxaad ka tilmaansataan badda weyn ilaa tan iyo Buur Xor.
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Oo Buur Xorna waxaad ka tilmaansataan ilaa tan iyo meesha Hamaad laga galo, oo soohdinta dhammaadkeeduna wuxuu ahaan doonaa Sedaad.
english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay u bixi doontaa xagga Sifron, oo dhammaadkeeduna wuxuu ahaan doonaa Hasar Eenaan. Taasu waxay ahaan doontaa soohdintiinna woqooyi.
english: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintiinna barina waxaad ka tilmaansataan Hasar Eenaan ilamaa tan iyo Shefaam.
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay hoos uga dhaadhici doontaa Shefaam iyo ilamaa Riblaah oo ah Cayn xaggeeda bari, oo soohdintu waxay hoos ugu dhaadhici doontaa oo gaadhi doontaa badda Kinnered dhinaceeda bari.
english: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay hoos ugu dhaadhici doontaa Webi Urdun oo dhammaadkeeduna wuxuu ahaan doonaa Badda Cusbada leh. Intaasu waxay ahaan doontaa dalkiinna siday soohdimihiisu u wareegsan yihiin.
english: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse amray reer binu Israa'iil, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa kan dalka aad saamiga ku dhaxli doontaan oo Rabbigu amray in la siiyo sagaalka qabiil iyo qabiilka badhkiis,
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

kikuyu: waayo, qabiilkii Ruubeen sida reerahoodu yihiin, iyo qabiilkii Gaad sida reerahoodu yihiin, iyo qabiilkii Manaseh badhkiis horay u heleen dhaxalkoodii.
english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

kikuyu: Labadaas qabiil iyo qabiilka badhkiis waxay dhaxalkoodii u heleen Webi Urdun shishadiisa, ee Yerixoo barigeeda ah, xagga qorrax ka soo baxa.
english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Nimanka dalka dhaxal idiinku qaybin doonaa magacyadoodii waa kuwan: wadaadka Elecaasaar ah iyo Yashuuca ina Nuun.
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Oo qabiil kastana waa inaad amiir kala soo baxdaan inay dalka dhaxal u kala qaybiyaan.
english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

kikuyu: Oo nimankaas magacyadoodiina waa kuwan: qabiilka reer Yahuudah kala soo baxa Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh.
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Simecoonna, Shemuu'eel ina Cammiihuud.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Benyaamiinna, Eliidaad ina Kisloon.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Daanna waxaad kala baxdaan amiir, kaas oo ah Buqii ina Yaaglii.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

kikuyu: Reer Yuusufna, qabiilka reer Manaseh waxaad kala soo baxdaan amiir, kaas oo ah Xannii'eel ina Eefod.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Efrayimna waxaad kala soo baxdaan amiir, kaas oo ah Qemuu'eel ina Shiftaan.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Sebulunna waxaad kala baxdaan amiir, kaas oo ah Eliisaafaan ina Farnaag.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Isaakaarna waxaad kala soo baxdaan amiir, kaas oo ah Faltii'eel ina Casaan.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Aasheerna waxaad kala soo baxdaan amiir, kaas oo ah Axiihuud ina Shelomii.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

kikuyu: Qabiilka Naftaalina waxaad kala soo baxdaan amiir, kaas oo ah Fedaheel ina Cammiihuud.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waa inta Rabbigu ku amray inay reer binu Israa'iil dhaxalka ugu qaybiyaan dalka Kancaan.
english: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse kula hadlay bannaankii Moo'aab oo Webi Urdun u dhowaa ee Yerixoo ka soo hor jeeday, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaad reer binu Israa'iil ku amartaa inay dhaxalkooda hantida ah reer Laawi ka siiyaan magaalooyin ay degaan, oo magaalooyinkaas agagaarkooda ku wareegsanna reer Laawi siiya.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinka iyagaa lahaanayaan inay degaan, agagaarkooduna waxay u ahaan doonaan lo'dooda, iyo alaabtooda, iyo xoolahooda oo dhan.
english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinka aad reer Laawi siin doontaan agagaarkooda ha laga bilaabo magaalo kasta derbigeeda, oo dibadda ha uga baxo kun dhudhun oo hareeraheeda ku wareegsan ah.
english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

kikuyu: Oo magaalada dibaddeeda waa inaad ka qiyaastaan xagga bari laba kun oo dhudhun, dhanka koonfureedna waa inaad ka qiyaastaan laba kun oo dhudhun, dhanka galbeedna waa inaad ka qiyaastaan laba kun oo dhudhun, dhanka woqooyina waa inaad ka qiyaastaan laba kun oo dhudhun, oo magaaladuna dhexda ha ahaato. Oo intaasaa iyaga u ahaan doonta agagaarka magaalooyinka.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinka aad reer Laawi siin doontaan waxay ahaan doonaan lixda magaalo oo magangalka ah oo aad siin doontaan si uu gacankudhiigluhu ugu cararo, oo kuwaas mooyaane waxaad kaloo iyaga siisaan laba iyo afartan magaalo.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinka aad reer Laawi siin doontaan oo dhammu waxay ahaan doonaan siddeed iyo afartan magaalo, oo waxaad siin doontaan iyaga iyo agagaarkoodaba.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Oo waxa ku saabsan magaalooyinka aad reer Laawi hantida uga siin doontaan reer binu Israa'iil waa sidan, waa inaad kuwii badan magaalooyin badan ka qaaddaan, kuwii yarna waa inaad magaalooyin yar ka qaaddaan, oo mid waluba dhaxalkiisii uu dhaxlay magaalooyinkiisa reer Laawi wax ha ka siiyo.
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Muuse la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil la hadal, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Markaad Webi Urdun dhaaftaan oo aad gashaan dalka Kancaan,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: waa inaad doorataan magaalooyin idiin ahaada magaalooyin aad magan gashaan, si uu gacankudhiigluhu qof kama' u dilaa halkaas ugu cararo.
english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkaasu waxay idiin ahaan doonaan meel aad ka magan gashaan kan aardoonka ah, si uusan gacankudhiigluhu u dhiman intuusan shirka hortiisa xukun isu soo taagin.
english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinka aad bixin doontaan waxay idiin ahaan doonaan lix magaalo oo magangal ah.
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

kikuyu: Oo Webi Urdun shishadiisa waa inaad ka bixisaan saddex magaalo, dalka Kancaanna waa inaad ka bixisaan saddex magaalo, oo iyagu waa inay ahaadaan magaalooyin magangal ah.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

kikuyu: Oo lixdaas magaalo waxaa magangeli doona reer binu Israa'iil iyo shisheeyaha iyo qariibka iyaga dhex deggan, si uu ku alla kii qof kama' u dilaa ugu cararo.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadduu wax bir ah ku dhufto, oo uu sidaas ku dhinto, markaas isagu waa gacankudhiigle, oo gacankudhiiglaha hubaal waa in la dilaa.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu ku dhufto dhagax uu gacanta ku haysto oo qof u dhiman karo, oo uu sidaas ku dhinto, markaas isagu waa gacankudhiigle, oo gacankudhiiglaha hubaal waa in la dilaa.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Amase hadduu ku dhufto hub qori ah oo uu gacanta ku haysto oo qof u dhiman karo, oo uu sidaas ku dhinto, markaas isagu waa gacankudhiigle, oo gacankudhiiglaha hubaal waa in la dilaa.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo aardoonka dhiigga doonayaa qudhiisu ha dilo gacankudhiiglaha. Markuu isaga helo ha dilo.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu nacayb aawadiis u riixdo, ama intuu u gabbado uu wax ku tuuro, oo uu markaas dhinto,
english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

kikuyu: amase hadduu cadownimo aawadeed gacanta ugu dhufto, oo uu sidaas ku dhinto, kii wax ku dhuftay hubaal waa in la dilaa, waayo, isagu waa gacankudhiigle, oo aardoonka dhiigga doonayaa gacankudhiiglaha ha dilo markuu helo.
english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadduu kama' u riixo isagoo aan cadownimo ku jirin, amase uu wax ku tuuro isagoo aan u gabban,
english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

kikuyu: amase hadduu ku dhufto dhagax qof u dhiman karo, oo isagoo aan arkayn uu ku tuuro, oo uu sidaas ku dhinto, oo hadduusan cadowgiis ahayn ama uusan waxyeelladiisa doondoonayn,
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

kikuyu: markaas kii wax dilay iyo kan ah aardoonka dhiigga doonayo, shirku waa inuu ugu kala garsooraa sida xukummadanu yihiin.
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

kikuyu: Oo shirku waa inuu gacankudhiiglaha ka samatabbixiyaa gacanta kan ah aardoonka dhiigga doonayo, oo shirku waa inuu isaga ku celiyaa magaaladiisii uu magangalay, oo uu ku cararay, oo isagu waa inuu halkaas degganaado jeer uu dhinto wadaadka sare oo lagu subkay saliiddii quduuska ahayd.
english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

kikuyu: Laakiinse gacankudhiigluhu mar kasta ha ahaatee hadduu ka gudbo soohdinta magaaladiisii uu magangalay oo uu ku cararay,
english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

kikuyu: oo markaas kii ahaa aardoonka dhiigga doonayo uu ka helo meel dibadda ka ah soohdinta magaaladiisii uu magangalay, kolkaas kii ahaa aardoonka dhiigga doonayo hadduu gacankudhiiglaha dilo, isagu ma ahaan doono mid dhiig qaba,
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

kikuyu: waayo, waxaa isaga waajib ku ahaa inuu iska joogo magaaladiisii uu magangalay ilamaa uu wadaadka sare dhinto, laakiinse markuu wadaadka sare dhinto gacankudhiigluhu waa inuu markaas dabadeed ku noqdo dalkiisii hantida u ahaa.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

kikuyu: Oo waxyaalahanu waa inay qaynuun xukun ah degmooyinkiinna oo dhan idiinku ahaadaan ab ka abkiin.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii qof dila, gacankudhiiglaha waa in la dilaa markii lagu marag furo, laakiinse qofnaba yaan lagu dilin markhaati keliya maragfurkiis.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waa inaydaan innaba furan nafta gacankudhiigle dhimasho lagu xukumay, laakiinse hubaal waa in la dilaa.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waa inaydaan furan kii ku cararay magaaladiisa magangalka ah, si uu ugu noqdo oo uu u dego dalkiisa ilamaa uu wadaadka sare dhinto.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

kikuyu: Dalka aad deggan tihiin waa inaydaan nijaasayn, waayo, dhiigu dalka waa nijaaseeyaa, oo dalka dhiiggii lagu dhex daadshay wax loogu kafaaro gudi karo lama arko, dhiigga kii daadshay mooyaane.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaydaan nijaasayn dalka aad dhex deggan tihiin, oo anna aan dhexdiisa degganahay, waayo, aniga Rabbiga ahu waxaan dhex degganahay reer binu Israa'iil.
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Markaas madaxdii qabiilka reer Gilecaad oo ahaa ina Maakiir, ina Manaseh oo ka mid ahaa qabiilooyinkii ilma Yuusuf way soo dhowaadeen, oo waxay ku hor hadleen Muuse iyo amiirradii ahaa madaxdii qolooyinka reer binu Israa'iil,
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Sayidkayagiiyow, Rabbigu wuxuu kugu amray inaad reer binu Israa'iil dalka dhaxal ahaan saami ugu kala qaybiso, oo weliba, sayidkayagiiyow, waxaa Rabbigu kugu amray inaad walaalkayo Selaafexaad gabdhihiisa dhaxalka siiso.
english: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

kikuyu: Oo hadday guursadaan wiilasha qabiilooyinka kale oo reer binu Israa'iil, markaas dhaxalkoodii waa laga gooynayaa dhaxalka awowayaashayo, oo waxaa lagu dari doonaa dhaxalka qabiilka ay ka guursadeen, oo sidaasaa looga qaadan doonaa qaybtii dhaxalkayaga.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

kikuyu: Oo markii reer binu Israa'iil ay gaadhaan sannaddii Yubilii, ayaa dhaxalkooda lagu dari doonaa dhaxalka qabiilka ay ka guursadeen, oo sidaasaa dhaxalkooda looga qaadi doonaa dhaxalka qabiilka awowayaashayo.
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse reer binu Israa'iil ku amray sidii uu eraygii Rabbigu ahaa, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Qabiilka ilma Yuusuf wax qumman bay ku hadleen.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.

kikuyu: Waxyaalaha ku saabsan Selaafexaad gabdhihiisa oo Rabbigu amray waa kuwan, oo wuxuu yidhi, Iyagu ha guursadeen kii la wanaagsan iyaga, laakiinse qabiilka aabbahood uun ha ka guursadeen.
english: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

kikuyu: Sidaasaanu dhaxalka reer binu Israa'iil qabiil uga tagayn oo qabiil kale ugu dhaafayn, waayo, reer binu Israa'iil nin waluba waa inuu sii xajiyaa dhaxalkii qabiilka awowayaashiis.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

kikuyu: Oo gabadh kasta oo dhaxal ku leh qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil middood waa inay afo u ahaato mid ka mid ah qolada qabiilka aabbaheed, si reer binu Israa'iil nin waluba u lahaado dhaxalkii awowayaashiis.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

kikuyu: Sidaasaanu dhaxalna qabiil uga tagayn oo qabiil kale ugu dhaafayn, waayo, qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil mid waluba waa inuu dhaxalkiisa sii xajiyaa.
english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

kikuyu: Oo sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray ayay Selaafexaad gabdhihiisu yeeleen,
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:

kikuyu: waayo, Maxlaah, iyo Tirsaah, iyo Xoglaah, iyo Milkaah, iyo Nocaah, oo ahaa Selaafexaad gabdhihiisii, waxay wada guursadeen ilma-adeerradood.
english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ka guursadeen qabiilooyinkii ilma Manaseh oo ahaa ina Yuusuf, oo dhaxalkoodii wuxuu ku hadhay qabiilkii reerka aabbahood.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa amarradii iyo xukummadii uu Rabbigu u soo dhiibay Muuse oo uu ku amray reer binu Israa'iil oo jooga bannaankii Moo'aab oo Webi Urdun u dhowaa ee Yerixoo ka soo hor jeeday.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa erayadii Muuse kula hadlay reer binu Israa'iil markay joogeen Webi Urdun shishadiisa cidlada dhexdeeda, oo ah Caraabaah oo ka soo hor jeedda Suuf, meel u dhexaysa Faaraan, iyo Tofel, iyo Laabaan, iyo Xaseerood, iyo Diisaahaab.
english: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

kikuyu: Oo koob iyo toban maalmood ayaa looga socdaa Xoreeb xagga Buur Seciir ilaa tan iyo Qaadeesh Barneeca.
english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Oo sannaddii afartanaad bisheedii koob iyo tobnaad, maalinteedii kowaad ayaa Muuse reer binu Israa'iil kula hadlay kulli amarradii Rabbigu ugu soo dhiibay oo dhan.
english: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them,

kikuyu: Taasuna waa ka dambaysay diliddii uu dilay Siixon oo ahaa boqorkii reer Amor oo degganaa Xeshboon, iyo Coog oo ahaa boqorkii reer Baashaan oo degganaa Cashtarod ee Edrecii ku taal.
english: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

kikuyu: Oo meeshaas ee Webi Urdun ka shishaysa oo ku taal dalka reer Moo'aab ayaa Muuse ka bilaabay inuu caddeeyo sharcigan, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu wuxuu inala hadlay intaan Xoreeb joognay oo wuxuu inagu yidhi, Buurtan in idinku filan waad degganaydeen,
english: “The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.

kikuyu: haddaba noqda oo guura oo waxaad tagtaan dalka buuraha leh oo reer Amor, iyo meelaha halkaas u dhow oo dhan oo ah Caraabaah, iyo dalka buuraha leh, iyo dooxooyinka, iyo xagga koonfureed, iyo badda xeebteeda, kuwaasoo ah dalka reer Kancaan, iyo Lubnaan, iyo tan iyo webiga weyn oo Yufraad.
english: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Bal eega, dalka waan idin hor dhigay, haddaba gala oo hantiya dalkii Rabbigu ugu dhaartay awowayaashiin oo ahaa Ibraahim iyo Isxaaq iyo Yacquub inuu siinayo iyaga iyo farcankooda ka dambeeyaba
english: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”

kikuyu: Oo anna markaas waan idinla hadlay oo waxaan idhi, Anigu idinma aan qaadi karo keli ahaantay.
english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu wuu idin tarmiyey, oo bal eega, maanta waxaad u faro badan tihiin sida xiddigaha samada oo kale.
english: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Rabbiga ah Ilaaha awowayaashiin ha idinka dhigo kun jeer in ka sii badan intaad haatan tihiin, oo ha idiin barakeeyo siduu idin ballanqaaday!
english: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!

kikuyu: Oo bal anigoo keligay ah sidee baan u qaadi karaa culayskiinna iyo rarkiinna iyo rabshaddiinna?
english: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?

kikuyu: Haddaba siday qabiilooyinkiinnu yihiin waxaad kala soo baxdaan rag xigmad leh oo waxgarad ah oo caan ah, oo anna waxaan iyaga ka dhigayaa madax idiin talisa.
english: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

kikuyu: Oo idinna waad ii jawaabteen oo waxaad igu tidhaahdeen, Waxaad ku hadashay waa noo wanaagsan yihiin inaannu samayno.
english: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaan soo kaxaystay madaxdii qabiilooyinkiinna oo ah rag xigmad leh oo caan ah, oo waxaan ka dhigay madax idiin talisa, oo ah kun u taliyayaal, iyo boqol-u-taliyayaal, iyo konton-u-taliyayaal, iyo toban u taliyayaal, iyo saraakiil, siday qabiilooyinkiinnu ahaayeen.
english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

kikuyu: Oo waagaas ayaan xaakinnadiinna amray, oo waxaan ku idhi, Maqla dacwadaha walaalihiin dhex yaal, oo caddaalad ugu kala garsoora nin iyo walaalkiis iyo shisheeyaha isaga la jira.
english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

kikuyu: Oo xagga garsooridda dadka ha u kala eexanina. Kii yar iyo kii weynba waa inaad isku si u maqashaan, oo ninna wejigiisa ha ka cabsanina, waayo, garsooridda Ilaah baa iska leh, oo dacwaddii idinku adagna ii keena, oo anna taas waan maqli doonaa.
english: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”

kikuyu: Oo waagaas waxaan idinku amray wixii aad samayn lahaydeen oo dhan.
english: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

kikuyu: Markaasaynu ka soo guurnay Xoreeb oo waxaynu dhex marnay cidladaas weyn oo aad looga cabsado ee aad soo aragteen ee ku taal jidka loo maro dalka buuraha leh oo reer Amor, siduu inagu amray Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu, oo waxaynu nimid Qaadeesh Barneeca.
english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Oo anna markaas waxaan idinku idhi, War waxaad timaadeen dalka buuraha leh oo reer Amor ee Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu ina siinayo.
english: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.

kikuyu: Bal eega, Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu dalkii buu idin hor dhigay. Haddaba u kaca, oo hanti u qaata sidii Rabbiga ah Ilaaha awowayaashiin uu idiin sheegay, oo ha cabsanina, hana qalbi jabina.
english: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the LORD the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

kikuyu: Oo mid kastoo idinka mid ahuba wuu ii soo dhowaaday oo wuxuu igu yidhi, War aynu niman iska hor marinno, si ay dalka inoogu soo baadhaan, oo ay inoogu soo sheegaan jidka aan marayno iyo magaalooyinka aan tegayno.
english: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”

kikuyu: Oo anna taas aad baan ugu farxay, markaasaan idinkala soo baxay laba iyo toban nin, oo qabiil kastaba nin baan ka soocay.
english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay noqdeen oo buurtii u kaceen, oo waxay gaadheen dooxadii Eshkol, wayna soo basaaseen.
english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

kikuyu: Oo waxay gacmahooda ku soo qaadeen dalka midhihiisii, oo innagay inoo keeneen, oo haddana intay inoo war keeneen ayay yidhaahdeen, Dalku waa dal wanaagsan oo Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu ina siinayo.
english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which the LORD our God gives to us.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku waad diiddeen inaad u kacdaan, oo waxaad ku caasiyowdeen amarkii Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Oo teendhooyinkiinna ayaad ku dhex gunuunacdeen, oo waxaad tidhaahdeen, Rabbigu nacaybka uu inoo qabo aawadiis ayuu dalkii Masar inooga soo bixiyey inuu ina geliyo gacanta reer Amor oo ay ina baabbi'iyaan.
english: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.

kikuyu: Bal xaggee baynu u sii kacnaa? Waayo, walaalaheen ayaa qalbigeennii aad u cabsiiyey, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Dadku waa inaga badan yahay, wayna inaga dhaadheer yihiin, oo magaalooyinkuna way waaweyn yihiin oo deyr samada ku tolan ayaa ku wareegsan, oo weliba waxaan kaloo halkaas ku soo aragnay reer Canaaq.
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

kikuyu: Oo markaasaan idinku idhi, Ha cabsanina, hana ka baqina.
english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa idiin dagaallami doona Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah ee idin hor socda, si waafaqsan kulli wixii uu indhihiinna hortooda idiinku sameeyey dalkii Masar,
english: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

kikuyu: iyo cidladii oo aad ku soo aragteen sidii Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu, sida nin wiilkiisa u sido, uu idiinku siday jidkii aad soo marteen oo dhan ilamaa aad meeshan timaadeen.
english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxyaalahaas kuma aydaan rumaysan Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah
english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe the LORD your God,

kikuyu: oo jidkii aad soo marteen idinku soo hor kacay si uu idiinku doondoono meel aad teendhooyinkiinna ka dhisataan, isagoo habeenkii dab ku dhex jira, maalintiina daruur, si uu idiin tuso jidka aad mari lahaydeen.
english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuu maqlay codkii erayadiinna, markaasuu cadhooday oo intuu dhaartay ayuu yidhi,
english: The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

kikuyu: Hubaal dadka qarnigan sharka ah midkoodna ma arki doono dalka wanaagsan oo aan ku dhaartay inaan awowayaashiin siinayo,
english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,
