kikuyu: Oo Yashuuca wuxuu wada qabsaday boqorradaas magaalooyinkoodii oo dhan, iyo boqorradoodii oo dhan, oo wuxuu ku wada laayay seef, oo wuu wada baabbi'iyey; sidii uu addoonkii Rabbiga oo Muuse ahaa ku amray.
english: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

kikuyu: Laakiinse reer binu Israa'iil waxba kama gubin magaalooyinkii buurahoodii ku yiil, Xaasoor mooyaane, taasna waxaa gubay Yashuuca.
english: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkaas alaabtoodii oo dhan iyo xoolahoodii oo dhanba reer binu Israa'iil way dhaceen, laakiinse nin kasta waxay ku dileen seef ilaa ay wada baabbi'iyeen, oo waxba kama ay reebin intii neefsatay oo dhan.
english: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.

kikuyu: Wixii Rabbigu addoonkiisii Muuse ahaa ku amray ayuu Muusena Yashuuca ku amray, oo Yashuucana sidaasuu yeelay, oo kulli wixii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray wax aanu samayn ma jirin.
english: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo Yashuuca wuxuu qabsaday dalkaas oo dhan, kaas oo ahaa dalkii buuraha lahaa, iyo Koonfur oo dhan, iyo dalkii Goshen oo dhan, iyo dalkii dooxada ahaa, iyo bankii Caraabaah, iyo dalkii reer binu Israa'iil oo buuraha lahaa, iyo intiisii dooxada ahayd,
english: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,

kikuyu: haddii laga bilaabo Buur Haalaaq, taasoo kor u kacsan ilaa Seciir, iyo xataa tan iyo Bacal Gaad oo ku taal dooxadii Lubnaan oo ka hoosaysa Buur Xermoon; oo wuxuu wada qabsaday boqorradoodii oo dhan, oo intuu dilay buu wada laayay.
english: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

kikuyu: Oo Yashuuca wakhti dheer buu la dirirayay boqorradaas oo dhan.
english: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

kikuyu: Oo lama arag magaalo la nabadday reer binu Israa'iil, reer Xiwi oo Gibecoon degganaa mooyaane: oo dagaal bay kulligood ku wada qabsadeen.
english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.

kikuyu: Waayo, xagga Rabbiga ayay ka timid inuu qalbigooda adkeeyo, si ay dagaal ugu soo baxaan reer binu Israa'iil, oo uu dhammaantood u baabbi'iyo, oo aanay waxba inna raallinimo ka helin, laakiinse uu u wada baabbi'iyo sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray.
english: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaa Yashuuca yimid, oo wuxuu reer Canaaq ka tiray dalkii buuraha lahaa, kaas oo ahaa Xebroon, iyo Debiir, iyo Canaab, iyo xaggii dalkii reer Yahuudah oo buuraha lahaa oo dhan, iyo dalkii reer binu Israa'iil oo buuraha lahaa oo dhan; oo Yashuuca dhammaan iyagii iyo magaalooyinkoodiiba wuu wada baabbi'iyey.
english: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

kikuyu: Oo dalkii reer binu Israa'iil mid reer Canaaq ahu kuma hadhin, laakiinse waxaa wuxoogaa ku hadhay Gaasa, iyo Gad, iyo Ashdood oo keliya.
english: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.

kikuyu: Sidaasuu Yashuuca u wada qabsaday dalkii oo dhan, oo wuxuu wada yeelay sidii Rabbigu kula hadlay Muuse; oo Yashuuca wuxuu dalkii dhaxal u siiyey reer binu Israa'iil, oo wuxuu ugu qaybiyey sidii qabiilooyinkoodu ahaayeen. Oo dalkiina dagaal wuu ka nastay.
english: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa boqorradii dalka, oo ay reer binu Israa'iil laayeen oo ay dalkoodii ka qaateen meel Webi Urdun ka shishaysa oo qorrax ka soo baxa ka xigta, markii laga bilaabo dooxadii Arnoon iyo tan iyo Buur Xermoon, iyo inta banka Caraabaah xagga bari ka xigta oo dhan:
english: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

kikuyu: oo waxay ahaayeen boqorkii reer Amor oo ahaa Siixon, oo degganaa Xeshboon, oo xukumi jiray Carooceer oo ku tiil dooxadii Arnoon darafteeda, iyo magaaladii ku tiil dooxadii dhexdeeda, iyo Gilecaad badhkeed, iyo tan iyo Webi Yabboq, kaasoo ku yiil soohdintii reer Cammoon,
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: iyo bankii Caraabaah iyo tan iyo baddii Kinnered, iyo xagga bari, iyo tan iyo baddii Caraabaah, taas oo ah Badda Cusbada leh, oo bari, ee ku taal jidkii Beytyeshimood, ee xagga koonfureed, ee ka hoosaysay dhaadhacyadii Fisgaah:
english: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

kikuyu: iyo xuduudkii Coog oo ahaa boqorkii Baashaan, oo ka hadhay reer Rafaa ee Cashtarod agteeda joogay, Edrecii agteedana joogay.
english: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

kikuyu: Kaasu wuxuu xukumi jiray Buur Xermoon, iyo Salkaah, iyo Baashaan oo dhan, iyo tan iyo soohdinta reer Geshuur iyo kan reer Macakaad iyo Gilecaad badhkeed, iyo xuduudka Siixon oo boqor u ahaa Xeshboon.
english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

kikuyu: Addoonkii Rabbiga oo Muuse ahaa iyo reer binu Israa'iil baa laayay iyagii, oo addoonkii Rabbiga oo Muuse ahaa ayaa reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkood hanti ahaan u siiyey.
english: Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanu waa boqorradii Yashuuca iyo reer binu Israa'iil ka laayeen Webi Urdun shishadiisa xagga galbeed ka xigta, markii laga bilaaba Bacal Gaad oo ku tiil dooxadii Lubnaan iyo tan iyo Buur Xaalaaq oo kor u kacsan Seciir; oo Yashuuca wuxuu siiyey qabiilooyinkii reer binu Israa'iil, oo hanti ahaan buu ugu qaybiyey,
english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

kikuyu: xagga dalkii buuraha lahaa, iyo dalkii dooxooyinka ahaa, iyo bankii Caraabaah, iyo dhaadhacyadii, iyo cidladii, iyo xagga Koonfureed, iyo reer Xeed, iyo reer Amor, iyo reer Kancaan, iyo reer Feris, iyo reer Xiwi, iyo reer Yebuus.
english: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

kikuyu: Oo waa kuwan boqorradii, boqorkii Yerixoo, iyo boqorkii Aacii tii u dhowayd Beytel,
english: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Yeruusaalem, iyo boqorkii Xebroon,
english: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Yarmuud, iyo boqorkii Laakiish,
english: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Cegloon, iyo boqorkii Geser,
english: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Debiir, iyo boqorkii Geder,
english: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Xormaah, iyo boqorkii Caraad,
english: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Libnaah, iyo boqorkii Cadullaam,
english: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Maqeedaah, iyo boqorkii Beytel,
english: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Tafuu'ax iyo boqorkii Heefer,
english: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Afeeq, iyo boqorkii Lashaaroon,
english: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Maadoon, iyo boqorkii Xaasoor,
english: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Shimroon Meroon, iyo boqorkii Akshaaf,
english: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Tacanaag, iyo boqorkii Megiddoo,
english: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Qedesh, iyo boqorkii Yoqnecaam oo Karmel tiil,
english: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Door oo ku tiil meesha ugu dheer Door, iyo boqorkii quruumaha degganaa Gilgaal,
english: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

kikuyu: iyo boqorkii Tirsaah. Oo boqorradii oo dhammuna waxay ahaayeen kow iyo soddon.
english: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.

kikuyu: Yashuuca waa da' weynaa, gaboowna wuu la dhacay, oo kolkaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu isagii ku yidhi, Adigu waad da' weyn tahay oo gaboowna waad la dhacday, laakiinse weliba waxaa hadhay dal badan in la hantiyo.
english: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. The LORD said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

kikuyu: Oo dalka weli hadhay waxa weeye kan: gobollada reer Falastiin oo dhan iyo reer Geshuur oo dhan,
english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

kikuyu: tan iyo Shiixoorta ku taal Masar horteeda, iyo xataa tan iyo soohdinta Ceqroon ee xagga woqooyi, ee loo tiriyo reer Kancaan, iyo shanta amiir ee reer Falastiin oo u taliya reer Gaasa, iyo reer Ashdood, iyo reer Ashqeloon, iyo reer Gad, iyo reer Ceqroon,
english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,

kikuyu: iyo xataa reer Caw oo xagga koonfureed xiga, iyo dalka reer Kancaan oo dhan, iyo Mecaaraah tan ay reer Siidoon leeyihiin, iyo ilaa Afeeq, iyo tan iyo soohdinta reer Amor,
english: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

kikuyu: iyo dalka reer Gebal iyo Lubnaan oo dhan, xagga qorrax ka soo baxa, inta laga bilaabo Bacal Gaad tan ku taal Buur Xermoon hoosteeda, iyo tan iyo meesha laga galo Xamaad.
english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

kikuyu: Dadka deggan dalka buuraha leh oo dhan, tan iyo Lubnaan iyo ilaa Misrefood Mayim, iyo xataa reer Siidoon oo dhan kulligood waxaan ka eryi doonaa reer binu Israa'iil hortooda; laakiinse waa inaad dhaxal ahaan ugu qori riddaa reer binu Israa'iil sidaan kugu amray.
english: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

kikuyu: Haddaba dalkan dhaxal ahaan ugu qaybi sagaalka qabiil iyo qabiilka reer Manaseh badhkiis,
english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

kikuyu: Kuwaasoo ay reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaadba la heleen dhaxalkoodii uu Muuse ka siiyey xagga bari oo Webi Urdun ka shishaysa, xataa sidii addoonkii Rabbiga oo Muuse ahaa uu u siiyey iyaga,
english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:

kikuyu: tan iyo Carooceer oo ku taal dooxadii Arnoon darafkeeda, iyo magaalada ku taal dooxada dhexdeeda, iyo banka Meedebaa oo dhan iyo xataa tan iyo Diibon,
english: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

kikuyu: iyo dhammaan magaalooyinkii Siixon oo boqor u ahaa reer Amor uu ku xukumi jiray Xeshboon, tan iyo soohdinta reer Cammoon,
english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: iyo Gilecaad, iyo soohdinta reer Geshuur, iyo reer Macakaad, iyo Buur Xermoon oo dhan, iyo Baashaan oo dhan iyo ilaa Salkaah,
english: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

kikuyu: iyo boqortooyadii Baashaan ku tiil oo dhan oo Coog ka xukumi jiray Cashtarod iyo Edrecii (Isagu wuxuu ka hadhay reer Rafaa), waayo, kuwaas waxaa laayay Muuse, wuuna eryay.
english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee reer binu Israa'iil ma ay eryin reer Geshuur iyo reer Macakaad toona; laakiinse reer Geshuur iyo reer Macakaad waxay dhex deggan yihiin reer binu Israa'iil ilaa maantadan la joogo.
english: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

kikuyu: Oo waxaanu dhaxal siin qabiilkii reer Laawi oo keliya. Sidii Rabbigu kula hadlay isaga, waxaa dhaxal u ahaa qurbaannada loo bixiyo Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil.
english: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wuxuu reer Ruubeen qabiilkoodii wax u siiyey sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo xuduudkoodu wuxuu ka bilaaban jiray Carooceer taas oo ku taal dooxada Arnoon darafkeeda, iyo magaalada ku taal dooxada dhexdeeda, iyo kulli banka Meedebaa u dhow oo dhan,
english: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

kikuyu: iyo Xeshboon, iyo kulli magaalooyinkeeda banka ku yaal oo dhan, kuwaasoo ah, Diibon iyo Baamood Bacal, iyo Beyd Bacal Mecoon,
english: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

kikuyu: iyo Yahas, iyo Qedemood, iyo Mefacad,
english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

kikuyu: iyo Qiryatayim, iyo Sibmaah, iyo Sered Shahar oo ku taal buurta dooxada,
english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,

kikuyu: iyo Beytfecoor, iyo dhaadhacyadii Fisgaah, iyo Beytyeshimood,
english: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,

kikuyu: iyo kulli magaalooyinkii banka oo dhan, iyo boqorkii reer Amor oo Siixon ahaa boqortooyadiisii oo dhan, kaas oo xukumi jiray Xeshboon, oo Muuse la dilay madaxdii reer Midyaan, kuwaasoo ahaa Ewii, iyo Reqem, iyo Suur, iyo Xuur, iyo Rebac, oo ahaa amiirradii Siixon oo dalkaas degganaa.
english: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

kikuyu: Weliba faaliyaha Balcaam oo ahaa ina Becoor ayay reer binu Israa'iil seef kula dileen dadkii kaloo ay laayeen.
english: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.

kikuyu: Reer Ruubeen dalkooduna wuxuu ahaa Urdun, iyo inta soohdintiisa ah oo dhan. Kanu waa dhaxalkii reer Ruubeen iyo sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen, iyo magaalooyinkoodii iyo tuulooyinkoodiiba.
english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

kikuyu: Oo Muuse wax buu siiyey qabiilkii reer Gaad, oo wuxuu wax u siiyey reer Gaad sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo xuduudkooduna wuxuu ka koobnaa Yacser, iyo magaalooyinkii Gilecaad oo dhan, iyo dalkii reer Cammoon badhkiis, iyo tan iyo Carooceer oo ku hor taal Rabbaah,
english: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;

kikuyu: iyo ilaa Xeshboon iyo tan iyo Raamad-misfaah, iyo Betoniim, iyo tan iyo Maxanayim iyo ilaa soohdinta Debiir,
english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

kikuyu: iyo kuwii dooxadii ku dhex yiil oo ahaa Beytaaraam, iyo Beytnimraah, iyo Sukod, iyo Saafoon oo ahaa boqorkii Xeshboon oo Siixon ahaa boqortooyadiisii intii ka hadhay, iyo Urdun iyo soohdintiisii, iyo meesha ugu fog badda Kinnered ee ka shishaysa Webi Urdun ee xagga bari ka xigta.
english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

kikuyu: Kanu waa dhaxalkii ay reer Gaad u heleen sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen iyo magaalooyinkoodii iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

kikuyu: Oo Muusena wuxuu dhaxal siiyey qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiis. Wuxuu u ahaa qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiis sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo xuduudkoodu wuxuu ka koobnaa Maxanayim, iyo Baashaan oo dhan, iyo boqorkii Baashaan oo Coog ahaa boqortooyadiisii oo dhan, iyo magaalooyinkii Yaa'iir oo Baashaan ku yiil oo dhan, kuwaasoo ahaa lixdan magaalo;
english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

kikuyu: iyo Gilecaad badhkeed, iyo Cashtarod, iyo Edrecii, kuwaas oo ahaa magaalooyinkii boqortooyadii Coog oo Baashaan ku yiil, waxaa la siiyey reer Maakiir kaasoo ahaa ina Manaseh, oo waxaa loo siiyey reer Maakiir badhkood sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa dhaxalkii Muuse ku qaybiyey banaankii Moo'aab, oo ka shisheeya Webi Urdun, meel u dhow Yerixoo, oo xagga bari ka xigta.
english: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.

kikuyu: Laakiinse qabiilkii reer Laawi Muuse dhaxal ma uu siin. Waxaa dhaxal u ah Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, sidii uu kula hadlay iyaga.
english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa dhaxalkii ay reer binu Israa'iil ka qaateen dalkii reer Kancaan, oo wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa, iyo Yashuuca ina Nuun, iyo madaxdii qabiilooyinkii reer binu Israa'iil ay u qaybiyeen.
english: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,

kikuyu: Oo sidii Rabbigu ku amray Muuse sagaal qabiil iyo qabiil badhkiis saami bay ku heleen dhaxalkoodii.
english: by the lot of their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

kikuyu: Waayo, Muuse wuxuu laba qabiil iyo qabiil badhkiis dhaxal ka siiyey Webi Urdun shishadiisa: laakiinse reer Laawi innaba dhaxal ma uu siin.
english: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, reer Yuusuf waxay ahaayeen laba qabiil, oo kala ah reer Manaseh iyo reer Efrayim; oo dhulkii qayb lagama siin reer Laawi magaalooyinkii ay degganaayeen mooyaane, iyo agagaarkoodii ay xoolahoodii iyo alaabtoodii ku hayn jireen.
english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

kikuyu: Oo sidii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray ayay reer binu Israa'iil yeeleen, oo dalkiina way qaybsadeen.
english: The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Yahuudah waxay u soo dhowaadeen Yashuuca oo Gilgaal joogay; oo Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh, oo ahaa reer Qenes, wuxuu isagii ku yidhi, Waad garanaysaa wixii aniga iyo adiga inagu saabsanaa oo Rabbigu u sheegay Muuse oo ahaa nin Ilaah, markaynu Qaadeesh Barneeca joognay.
english: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Afartan sannadood baan jiray markii addoonkii Ilaah oo Muuse ahaa iga diray Qaadeesh Barneeca inaan dalka soo basaaso; oo sidii qalbigayga ku jirtay ayaan ugu soo war celiyey.
english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee walaalahaygii i raacay ayaa dadka qalbi dhalaaliyey, laakiinse anigu daacad baan u raacay Rabbiga Ilaahayga ah.
english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas ayuu Muuse dhaartay, oo yidhi, Hubaal dhulkii cagtaadu ku joogsatay wuxuu dhaxal u ahaan doonaa adiga iyo carruurtaada weligiin, maxaa yeelay, daacad baad u raacday Rabbiga Ilaahayga ah.
english: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’

kikuyu: Oo haddaba bal eeg, Rabbigu waa i soo gaadhsiiyey ilaa haatan, anoo nool, siduu ku hadlay, oo shan iyo afartankan sannadood baa ka dambaysay markii Rabbigu Muuse eraygan kula hadlay, oo waxay ahayd intii ay reer binu Israa'iil cidlada dhex socdeen; oo haatanna maanta waxaan jiraa shan iyo siddeetan sannadood.
english: “Now, behold, the LORD has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.

kikuyu: Oo weliba maanta iyo maalintii Muuse i diray isku xoog baan ahay; oo intii itaalkaygu waagaas ahaa ayuu haatanna yahay inaan dagaal galo, iyo inaan baxo, soona galo.
english: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed i sii buurtan Rabbigu maalintaas ka hadlay, waayo, waad maqashay maalintaas in reer Canaaq halkaas joogay, oo ay magaalooyinkoodu waaweynaayeen, deyrarna lahaayeen. Mindhaa Rabbigaa ila jiri doona, waanan eryi doonaa sidii Rabbigu ku hadlay.
english: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which the LORD spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that the LORD will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as the LORD said.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca u duceeyey isagii, oo Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh dhaxal u siiyey Xebroon.
english: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ilaa maantadan la joogo Xebroon waxay dhaxal u noqotay Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh oo ahaa reer Qenes, maxaa yeelay, daacad buu u raacay Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil.
english: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

kikuyu: Oo waagii hore Xebroon magaceeda waxaa la odhan jiray Qiryad Arbac; oo Arbacna wuxuu ahaa ninkii ugu weynaa reer Canaaq. Oo dalkiina dagaal wuu ka xasillay.
english: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yahuudah qabiilkoodii waxay qayb u heleen sidii ay reerahoodu ahaayeen ilaa soohdinta Edom, iyo tan iyo xataa cidlada Sin ee xagga koonfureed ka xigta, iyo xagga koonfureed ee ugu shishaysa.
english: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintooda koonfureedna waxay gaadhsiisnayd xagga ugu shishaysa ee Badda Cusbada leh, iyo tan iyo gacanka koonfur u jeeda,
english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

kikuyu: oo waxay u baxday xagga koonfureed ee jiirta Caqrabbiim, oo waxay u dhaaftay xagga Sin, oo haddana waxay martay xagga koonfureed oo Qaadeesh Barneeca, oo ay martay xagga Xesroon, oo waxay kor ugu baxday xagga Addaar, oo u laabatay xagga Qarqaacaa;
english: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

kikuyu: oo waxay u sii dhaaftay xagga Casmoon, oo haddana waxay u baxday xagga durdurka Masar, oo soohdinta waxaa dhammaadkeedu ahaa badda; taasu waxay ahaan doontaa soohdintiinna koonfureed.
english: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

kikuyu: Oo soohdinta barina waxay ahayd ilaa Badda Cusbada leh, iyo tan iyo meesha uu Webi Urdun ku dhammaado. Oo waaxda woqooyi soohdinteeduna waxay ahayd badda gacankeeda u dhow meesha uu Webi Urdun ku dhammaado;
english: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.

kikuyu: oo soohdintu waxay martay ilaa Beytxoglaah, oo waxay sii martay xagga woqooyi oo u dhow Beytcaraabaah; oo soohdintu waxay martay dhagaxii Bohan ina Ruubeen;
english: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

kikuyu: oo soohdintu waxay sii martay Debiir, marka laga tago dooxadii Caakoor, iyo xagga woqooyi ee ku soo jeedda Gilgaal, taasu waxa weeyaan meel ku toosan jiirta Adummiim, taasoo ku taal webiga dhiniciisa koonfureed; oo soohdintu waxay sii martay biyaha Ceyn Shemesh, oo dhammaadkeedu wuxuu ahaa Ceyn Rogeel agteeda;
english: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

kikuyu: oo soohdintu waxay sii martay dooxadii ina Xinnom iyo ilaa xagga koonfureed ee Yebuus. Taasu waa Yeruusaalem. Oo soohdintu waxay kor ugu baxday buurta ku taal dooxadii Xinnom horteeda ee xaggeeda galbeed, taasoo ku taal dooxada xagga woqooyi oo ugu fog ee reer Rafaa.
english: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay ka soo baxday buurta dhaladeeda ilaa isha biyaha ee Neftoo'ax, oo ay u baxday xagga magaalooyinkii ku yiil Buur Cefroon; oo soohdintu waxay sii martay xagga Bacalaah, (taasu waxa weeyaan Qiryad Yecaariim),
english: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

kikuyu: markaasay soohdintu ka laabatay Bacalaah galbeedkeeda ilaa Buur Seciir, oo waxay sii martay Buur Yecaariim dhinaceeda woqooyi (taasuna waxa weeyaan Kesaaloon), oo waxay hoos ugu dhaadhacday xagga Beytshemesh, oo waxay sii martay Timneh;
english: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

kikuyu: markaasay soohdintu u baxday dhinaca woqooyi oo Ceqroon; oo haddana soohdintu waxay u baxday Shikeroon, oo waxay sii martay Buur Bacalaah, oo waxay u baxday Yabne'eel agteeda; oo soohdinta dhammaadkeedu wuxuu ahaa badda.
english: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

kikuyu: Oo soohdinta xagga galbeedna waxay ahayd tan iyo badda weyn iyo xeebteeda. Intaasu waa soohdintii ku soo wareegi jirtay reer Yahuudah sida reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh qayb ka siiyey reer Yahuudah dhexdooda, sidii Rabbigu Yashuuca ugu amray, oo qaybtaas wuxuu ahaa Qiryad Arbac, kaas oo ahaa Canaaq aabbihiis (taasuna waxa weeyaan Xebroon).
english: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

kikuyu: Oo Kaaleebna halkaas wuxuu ka eryay saddexdii wiil oo Canaaq, kuwaasoo ahaa Sheeshay, iyo Axiiman, iyo Talmay, oo ahaa ilma Canaaq.
english: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

kikuyu: Oo halkaasuu ka tegey oo la diriray dadkii Debiir degganaa; oo waagii hore Debiir magaceeda waxaa la odhan jiray Qiryad Sefer.
english: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

kikuyu: Oo Kaaleeb wuxuu yidhi, Kii Qiryad Sefer intuu wax ku dhufta qabsada, waxaan u guurin doonaa gabadhayda Caksaah.
english: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa magaaladii waxaa qabsaday Cotnii'eel oo ahaa ina Qenas kii Kaaleeb walaal u ahaa, markaasuu Caksaah u guuriyey.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

kikuyu: Oo markay isagii u timid waxay ku deddejisay inuu aabbeheed beer weyddiisto: oo markay dameerkeedii ka soo degtay ayaa Kaaleeb ku yidhi, Maxaad doonaysaa?
english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay ku tidhi, Hadiyad i sii, waayo, waxaad i siisay dalka Koonfureed, weliba i sii ilo biyo ah. Markaasuu siiyey ilihii sare iyo ilihii hoose.
english: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

kikuyu: Intanu waa dhaxalkii ay reer Yahuudah heleen sidii ay reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Yahuudah magaalooyinkoodii ugu fogaa xagga soohdinta koonfureed oo Edom waxay ahaayeen Qabse'eel, iyo Ceeder, iyo Yaaguur,
english: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

kikuyu: iyo Qiinaah, iyo Diimoonaah, iyo Cadcaadaah,
english: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

kikuyu: iyo Qedesh, iyo Xaasoor, iyo Itnaan,
english: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

kikuyu: iyo Siif, iyo Telem, iyo Becaalood,
english: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

kikuyu: iyo Xaasoor Xadataah, iyo Qiryood Xesroon (oo taasuna waa Xaasoor qudheeda),
english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

kikuyu: iyo Amaam, iyo Shemac, iyo Molaadaah,
english: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

kikuyu: iyo Xasar Gaddaah, iyo Xeshmoon, iyo Beytfeled,
english: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

kikuyu: iyo Xasar Shuucaal, iyo Bi'ir Shebac, iyo Bisyootiyaah,
english: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

kikuyu: iyo Bacalaah, iyo Ciyiim, iyo Cesem,
english: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

kikuyu: iyo Eltoolad, iyo Kesiil, iyo Xormaah,
english: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

kikuyu: iyo Siiqlag, iyo Madmannaah, iyo Sansannaah,
english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

kikuyu: iyo Lebaa'ood, iyo Shilxiim, iyo Cayn, iyo Rimmon, oo magaalooyinka oo dhan iyo tuulooyinkooduba waa sagaal iyo labaatan.
english: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo dalka dooxadana waxay ku lahaayeen Eshtaa'ool, iyo Sorcaah, iyo Ashnaah,
english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

kikuyu: iyo Saanoo'ax, iyo Ceyn Ganniim, iyo Tafuu'ax, iyo Ceynaam,
english: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

kikuyu: iyo Yarmuud, iyo Cadullaam, iyo Sokoh, iyo Caseeqaah,
english: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

kikuyu: iyo Shacarayim, iyo Cadiitayim, iyo Gedeeraah, iyo Gedeerootayim, oo iyana waa afar iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Iyo Senaan, iyo Xadaashaah, iyo Migdal Gaad,
english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

kikuyu: iyo Dilcaan, iyo Misfaah, iyo Yoqte'eel,
english: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

kikuyu: iyo Laakiish, iyo Bosqad, iyo Cegloon,
english: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

kikuyu: iyo Kabboon, iyo Laxmaam, iyo Kitliish,
english: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,

kikuyu: iyo Gedeerood, iyo Beytdagoon, iyo Nacamaah, iyo Maqeedaah, iyana waa lix iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Libnaah, iyo Ceter, iyo Caashaan,
english: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

kikuyu: iyo Yiftaax, iyo Ashnaah, iyo Nesiib,
english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

kikuyu: iyo Qeciilaah, iyo Aksiib, iyo Maareeshaah, oo iyana waa sagaal magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Ceqroon, iyo magaalooyinkeedii iyo tuulooyinkeedii,
english: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

kikuyu: iyo Ceqroon iyo ilaa badda, iyo kulli intii u dhowayd Ashdood iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

kikuyu: Ashdood iyo magaalooyinkeedii iyo tuulooyinkeedii, iyo Gaasa iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo tuulooyinkeedii, iyo ilaa durdurkii Masar, iyo ilaa badda weyn, iyo soohdinteeda.
english: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

kikuyu: Iyo dalkii buuraha lahaa oo dhan, iyo Shamiir, iyo Yatiir, iyo Sokoh,
english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

kikuyu: iyo Dannaah, iyo Qiryad Sannaah (taasoo Debiir ah),
english: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

kikuyu: iyo Canaab, iyo Eshtemoh, iyo Caaniim,
english: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

kikuyu: iyo Goshen, iyo Xolon, iyo Giloh, iyana waa koob iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Araab, iyo Duumah, iyo Eshecaan,
english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

kikuyu: iyo Yaaniim iyo Beyd Tafuu'ax, iyo Afeeqaah,
english: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

kikuyu: Xumtaah, iyo Qiryad Arbac (taasoo ah Xebroon), iyo Siicor, iyana waa sagaal magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Iyo Maacoon, iyo Karmel, iyo Siif, iyo Yutaah,
english: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,

kikuyu: iyo Yesreceel, iyo Yokdecaam, iyo Saanoo'ax,
english: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

kikuyu: Kayn, iyo Gibecaah, iyo Timneh, iyana waa toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Xalxuul, iyo Beytsuur, iyo Gedoor,
english: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

kikuyu: iyo Macaraad, iyo Beytcanood, iyo Elteqon, iyana waa lix magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Qiryad Bacal (taasoo ah Qiryad Yecaariim), iyo Rabbaah, iyana waa laba magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Xagga cidladana waxay ku lahaayeen Beytcaraabaah, iyo Middiin, iyo Sekaakaah,
english: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

kikuyu: iyo Nibshaan iyo Magaalada Cusbada leh iyo Ceyn Gedii, iyana waa lix magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Xagga reer Yebuus, kuwaasoo Yeruusaalem degganaa, reer Yahuudah way eryi kari waayeen; laakiinse reer Yebuus Yeruusaalem bay la degganaayeen reer Yahuudah ilaa maantadan la joogo.
english: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yuusuf qaybtoodiina wuxuu ka bilaabmay Webi Urdun oo Yerixoo ku ag yaal, biyaha Yerixoo dhankooda bari, taasoo ah xagga cidlada, iyo markii laga tago Yerixoo oo la dhex maro dalka buuraha leh ilaa Beytel,
english: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ka baxay Beytel ilaa Luus, oo wuxuu sii maray ilaa soohdinta reer Arkii iyo ilaa Cataarood;
english: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

kikuyu: oo wuxuu dhanka galbeed ka maray soohdinta reer Yaafleetii iyo ilaa soohdinta Beytxooroonta hoose iyo tan iyo xataa Geser; oo soohdinta dhammaadkeedu wuxuu ahaa xagga badda.
english: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yuusuf, oo ahaa reer Manaseh iyo reer Efrayim, dhaxalkoodii way qaateen.
english: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

kikuyu: Oo reer Efrayim sidii ay reerahoodu ahaayeen soohdintoodii sidan bay ahayd; dalkii ay dhaxalka u heleen dhinaca bari waxaa u xigay Cataarood Addaar, iyo Beytxooroonta sare;
english: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

kikuyu: oo soohdintu waxay galbeed ka mari jirtay Mikmetaah tan ku taal xagga woqooyi, oo soohdintu waxay ka soo wareegtay oo bari ka martay Ta'anad Shiloh, oo waxay bari ka martay Yaanooxaah;
english: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

kikuyu: oo intay Yaanooxaah ka tagto ayay sii martay Cataarood, iyo ilaa Nacaraah, oo waxay gaadhay Yerixoo, markaasay ka sii baxday Webi Urdun.
english: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.

kikuyu: Oo xagga Tafuu'axna soohdintu waxay galbeed ka sii martay durdurka reer Qaanaah; oo waxaa dhammaadkeedu ahaa xagga badda. Intaasu waa dhaxalkii reer Efrayim qabiilkoodii u heleen sidii reerahoodii ay ahaayeen,
english: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

kikuyu: iyo xataa kulli magaalooyinkii loo soocay reer Efrayim ee ku dhex yiil dhaxalkii reer Manaseh, kuwaas oo ahaa magaalooyinkii oo dhan iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo ma ay eryin reer Kancaankii degganaa Geser; laakiinse reer Kancaan waxay dhex degganaayeen reer Efrayim ilaa maantadan la joogo, oo waxay u noqdeen addoommo u hawshooda.
english: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.

kikuyu: Oo intanuna waxay ahayd qaybtii qabiilka reer Manaseh, waayo, isagu wuxuu ahaa curadkii Yuusuf. Maakiir oo ahaa curadkii Manaseh oo aabbe u ahaa Gilecaad, wuxuu helay Gilecaad iyo Baashaan, maxaa yeelay, isagu wuxuu ahaa dagaalyahan.
english: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

kikuyu: Oo reer Manaseh iyo reerahoodii intii hadhay iyana qayb bay heleen; kuwaas oo ahaa reer Abiiceser, iyo reer Xeeleq, iyo reer Asrii'eel, iyo reer Shekem, iyo reer Heefer, iyo reer Shemiidaac; intaasu waxay ahaayeen ilmihii labka ahaa ee Manaseh ina Yuusuf sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen.
english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Seloofexaad ina Heefer, ina Gilecaad, ina Maakiir, ina Manaseh wiilal ma uu lahayn gabdho mooyaane, oo magacyadii gabdhihiisu waa kuwan: Maxlaah, Nocaah, Xoglaah, Milkaah, iyo Tirsaah.
english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Oo waxay u dhowaadeen wadaadkii la odhan jiray Elecaasaar, iyo Yashuuca ina Nuun, iyo amiirradii, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Rabbigu wuxuu Muuse ku amray inuu walaalahayo dhexdooda dhaxal naga siiyo. Oo sidaas daraaddeed amarkii Rabbiga aawadiis ayuu Yashuuca dhaxal ku siiyey walaalihii aabbahood dhexdooda.
english: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

kikuyu: Oo reer Manaseh waxaa ku soo hagaagay toban meelood oo aan ahayn dalkii Gilecaad iyo Baashaan oo Webi Urdun ka shishaysa;
english: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, gabdhihii Manaseh waxay dhaxal ka dhex heleen wiilashiisii; oo dalkii Gilecaadna waxaa lahaa wiilashii Manaseh intoodii hadhay.
english: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintii reer Manasehna waxay ahayd ilaa Aasheer iyo tan iyo Mikmetaah, taasoo ku hor taal Shekem, oo soohdintu waxay ka baxday xagga midigta, iyo ilaa dadkii degganaa Ceyn Tafuu'ax.
english: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

kikuyu: Oo dalkii Tafuu'axna waxaa iska lahaa reer Manaseh; laakiinse Tafuu'ax tii ku tiil soohdinta waxaa iska lahaa reer Efrayim.
english: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay u baxday durdurkii Qaanaah, oo durdurka xagga koonfureed ka ahaa. Magaalooyinkaas ku dhex yiil magaalooyinkii reer Manaseh waxaa lahaa reer Efrayim. Soohdintii Efrayimna waxay ahayd durdurka xaggiisa woqooyi, oo waxaa soohdintii dhammaadkeedu ahaa badda.
english: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.

kikuyu: Dhanka koonfureed waxaa lahaa reer Efrayim, dhanka woqooyina waxaa lahaa reer Manaseh, oo badduna waxay ahayd soohdintiisa, oo waxay gaadheen ilaa reer Aasheer oo woqooyi jira, iyo tan iyo reer Isaakaar oo ku yaal xagga bari.
english: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

kikuyu: Oo reer Manaseh waxay reer Isaakaar iyo reer Aasheer ku dhex lahaayeen Beytshe'aan, iyo magaalooyinkeedii oo dhan, iyo Yiblecaam iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo dadkii degganaa Door iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo dadkii degganaa Ceyn Door iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo dadkii degganaa Tacanaag, iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo dadkii degganaa Megiddoo iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo xataa saddexdii meelood ee dhaadheerayd.
english: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

kikuyu: Laakiin reer Manaseh ma ay eryi karin dadkii degganaa magaalooyinkaas; reer Kancaanse waxay doonayeen inay dalkaas sii degganaadaan.
english: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

kikuyu: Oo markii reer binu Israa'iil aad u xoogaysteen ayay hawl saareen reer Kancaan, oo ma ay wada eryin.
english: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

kikuyu: Oo reerkii Yuusuf Yashuuca bay la hadleen, oo ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaad qayb keliya dhaxal noogu siisay? Maxaa yeelay, annagu waxaannu nahay dad badan, oo Rabbigu waa na barakeeyey ilaa haatan.
english: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Haddaad dad badan tihiin, haddaba kaca oo duudda taga, oo waxaad soo goosataan dalka reer Feris iyo kan reer Rafaa; maxaa yeelay, dalka buuraha leh oo reer Efrayim waa idinku cidhiidhi.
english: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa reerkii Yuusuf waxay yidhaahdeen, Dalka buuraha lahu naguma filna; oo reer Kancaanka deggan dalka dooxada leh oo dhammu waxay leeyihiin gaadhifardood bir ah, kuwooda deggan Beytshe'aan iyo magaalooyinkeeda, iyo kuwooda deggan dooxadii Yesreceelba.
english: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca wuxuu la hadlay reer Yuusuf, kuwaasoo ahaa reer Efrayim iyo reer Manaseh, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinku waxaad tihiin dad badan, oo waxaad leedihiin xoog badan; haddaba qayb keliya heli maysaan;
english: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

kikuyu: laakiinse dalka buuraha leh idinkaa yeelan doona; waayo, in kastoo uu duud yahay, waad jari doontaan, oo meelaha laga baxona idinkaa yeelan doona, maxaa yeelay, waxaad eryi doontaan reer Kancaan in kastay leeyihiin gaadhifardood bir ah, oo ay xoog badan yihiin.
english: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”

kikuyu: Oo shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu Shiiloh bay dhammaantood isugu soo urureen, oo waxay halkaas ka dhiseen teendhadii shirka; oo dadkii waddankana waa laga adkaaday.
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil dhexdooda waxaa ku hadhay toddoba qabiil oo aan weli helin qaybtii ay dhaxalka u lahaayeen.
english: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil ku yidhi, Dalkii uu Rabbiga ah Ilaaha awowayaashiin idin siiyey ilaa goormaad ka raagaysaan inaad gashaan si aad dalka u hantidaan?
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?

kikuyu: Haddaba qabiil walba saddex nin kala soo baxa; oo anigu iyaga waan diri doonaa, markaas waa inay kacaan, oo dalka dhex maraan, oo soo kala tilmaamaan siday u kala dhaxlayaan, oo markaas waa inay ii yimaadaan.
english: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

kikuyu: Oo waa inay dalka u kala qaybiyaan toddoba meelood. Reer Yahuudah waa inay degganaadaan soohdintooda ah xagga koonfureed, oo reer Yuusufna waa inay degganaadaan soohdintooda ah xagga woqooyi.
english: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

kikuyu: Oo waa inaad dalka u soo kala tilmaantaan toddoba meelood, oo aad tilmaanta ii keentaan, oo markaasaan halkan idiinku saami ridi doonaa Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah hortiisa.
english: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, reer Laawi dhexdiinna qayb dhaxal ah kuma laha; waayo wadaadnimada Rabbiga ayaa dhaxal u ah. Oo reer Gaad iyo reer Ruubeen iyo qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkood waxay dhaxal u qaateen meel Webi Urdun ka shishaysa oo xagga bari ka xigta, oo Muuse oo addoonkii Rabbiga ahaa uu iyaga siiyey.
english: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa raggii kaceen oo tageen; oo kuwii tegey inay dalka soo tilmaamaan Yashuuca ayaa ku amray, oo ku yidhi, Taga oo dalka dhex mara, oo soo tilmaama, oo haddana aniga ii kaalaya, oo markaasaan halkan Shiiloh ah idiinku saami ridi doonaa Rabbiga hortiisa.
english: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”

kikuyu: Markaasay raggii tageen oo dalkii soo dhex mareen, oo waxay soo kala tilmaameen magaalooyinkii oo toddoba meelood u kala qaybsan, oo waxayna ku soo qoreen buug, oo markaasay u yimaadeen Yashuuca oo joogay xerada Shiiloh ku taal.
english: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca Shiiloh ugu saami riday iyagii Rabbiga hortiisa; oo halkaasaa Yashuuca reer binu Israa'iil ugu qaybshay dalkii sidii ay u kala qaybsanaayeen.
english: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Benyaamiin saamigoodii ay u heleen sidii ay reerahoodii kala ahaayeen ayaa u soo hor baxay; oo soohdintoodii ay saamiga u heleen waxay kala dhex mari jirtay reer Yahuudah iyo reer Yuusuf.
english: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintoodu xagga waaxda woqooyi waxay ka bilaabatay Webi Urdun; oo soohdintu waxay u baxday Yerixoo dhinaceeda woqooyi, oo waxay dhex martay dalka buuraha leh xaggiisa galbeed; oo dhammaadkeedii wuxuu u baxay cidladii Beytaawen.
english: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay halkaas uga gudubtay Luus (taasoo ah Beytel), iyo ilaa dhinaceeda koonfureed, oo soohdintu waxay ku dhaadhacday Cataarood Addaar, taasoo u dhow buurta ku taal Beytxooroonta hoose xaggeeda koonfureed.
english: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay u baxday oo ka laabatay waaxda galbeed xaggeeda koonfureed, iyo xagga buurta ku hor taal Beytxooroon xaggeeda koonfureed; oo soohdinta dhammaadkeedu wuxuu u baxay Qiryad Bacal taasoo ah Qiryad Yecaariim ee ahayd magaalo ay reer Yahuudah leeyihiin, intaasu waxay ahayd waaxdii galbeed.
english: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

kikuyu: Oo waaxdii koonfureedna waxay ka bilaabatay meesha ugu fog Qiryad Yecaariim, oo soohdintu waxay martay xagga galbeed, oo waxay u baxday ishii biyaha ahayd oo Neftoo'ax;
english: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

kikuyu: oo soohdintu waxay ku dhaadhacday meesha ugu fog buurta ku hor taal dooxadii ina Xinnom, taasoo ku taal xagga woqooyi oo dooxada reer Rafaa, oo waxay ku dhaadhacday ilaa dooxadii Xinnom, iyo ilaa dhinaca reer Yebuus xaggooda koonfureed, oo waxay kaloo sii martay Ceyn Rogeel,
english: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

kikuyu: oo waxay u leexatay xagga woqooyi, oo waxay martay Ceyn Shemesh agteeda; oo waxay u baxday Geliilood, taasoo ka soo hor jeedda jiirta Adummiim; oo haddana waxay u baxday dhagaxii Bohan ina Ruubeen;
english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

kikuyu: oo waxay sii martay dhinaca ka soo hor jeeda Caraabaah xaggeeda woqooyi, oo waxay ku dhaadhacday Caraabaah;
english: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

kikuyu: oo soohdintu waxay sii martay Beytxoglaah dhinaceeda woqooyi; oo soohdinta dhammaadkeedu wuxuu ahaa xagga gacanka woqooyi oo Badda Cusbada leh, ee ku yaal Webi Urdun dhammaadkiisa koonfureed meesha uu ku dhammaado; intaasu waa soohdintii koonfureed.
english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

kikuyu: Waaxda bari soohdinteeduna waxay ahayd Webi Urdun. Intaasu waxay ahayd dhaxalkii reer Benyaamiin iyo soohdimihii ku wareegsanaa, ee ay u heleen sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.

kikuyu: Haddaba magaalooyinkii reer Benyaamiin siday reerahoodu ahaayeen waxay ahaayeen Yerixoo, iyo Beytxoglaah, iyo Dooxadii Qesiis,
english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

kikuyu: iyo Beytcaraabaah, iyo Semaarayim, iyo Beytel,
english: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

kikuyu: iyo Cawiim, iyo Faaraah, iyo Cofraah,
english: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

kikuyu: iyo Kefar reer Cammoon, iyo Cofnii, iyo Gebac, oo intaasu waa laba iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii,
english: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

kikuyu: iyo Gibecoon, iyo Raamaah, iyo Bi'irod,
english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

kikuyu: iyo Misfaah, iyo Kefiiraah, iyo Mosaah,
english: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

kikuyu: iyo Reqem, iyo Yirfe'eel, iyo Taralaah,
english: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

kikuyu: iyo Seelac, iyo Elef, iyo Yebuus (taasoo ah Yeruusaalem), iyo Gibecaad, iyo Qiryad, oo intaasu waa afar iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii. Intaasu waa dhaxalkii reer Benyaamiin siday reerahoodii ahaayeen.
english: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo saamigii labaadna wuxuu u soo baxay reer Simecoon, oo waa dhaxalkii ay qabiilkii reer Simecoon u heleen siday reerahoodu ahaayeen. Oo dhaxalkooduna wuxuu ku dhex jiray dhaxalkii reer Yahuudah.
english: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

kikuyu: Oo waxay dhaxal u heleen: Bi'ir Shebac, ama Shebac, iyo Molaadaah,
english: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

kikuyu: iyo Hasar Shuucaal, iyo Baalaah, iyo Cesem,
english: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

kikuyu: iyo Eltoolad, iyo Betuul, iyo Hormaah,
english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

kikuyu: iyo Siiqlag, iyo Beytmarkaabod, iyo Hasar Suusaah,
english: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

kikuyu: iyo Beytlebaa'ood, iyo Shaaruuhen, oo intaasu waa saddex iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii,
english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

kikuyu: Cayn, iyo Rimmon, iyo Ceter, iyo Caashaan, oo intaasu waa afar magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii,
english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

kikuyu: iyo tuulooyinkii ku wareegsanaa magaalooyinkaas oo dhan ee ku yiil tan iyo Bacalad Bi'ir, iyo Raamaahda Koonfureed. Intaasu waa dhaxalkii qabiilkii reer Simecoon sidii ay reerahoodii ahaayeen.
english: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo qaybtii reer Yahuudah waxaa ku jiray dhaxalkii reer Simecoon, maxaa yeelay, reer Yahuudah qaybtoodu waa ku badnaa; sidaas daraaddeed reer Simecoon waxay dhaxal ka heleen dhaxalkii reer Yahuudah dhexdiisa.
english: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

kikuyu: Oo saamigii saddexaadna wuxuu u soo baxay reer Sebulun siday reerahoodu ahaayeen, oo dhaxalkoodii soohdintiisuna waxay ahayd ilaa Saariid.
english: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintoodu waxay u baxday xagga galbeed, iyo xataa ilaa Marcalaah, oo waxay gaadhay tan iyo Dabbaashed, oo haddana waxay gaadhay tan iyo durdurka ku yaal Yoqnecaam horteeda;
english: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

kikuyu: oo waxay Saariid uga leexatay xagga bari ee qorraxdu ka soo baxdo, ilaa soohdinta Kislod Taabor, kolkaasay waxay u baxday xagga Daberad, oo haddana kor ugu baxday Yaafiica,
english: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

kikuyu: oo halkaasna waxay uga gudubtay xagga bari oo martay Gad Heefer iyo tan iyo Citaah Qaasiin, oo waxay u baxday xagga Rimmon oo gaadhaa ilaa Neecaah,
english: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

kikuyu: soohdintu waxay xagga woqooyi ugu laabatay Xannaatoon, oo soohdinta dhammaadkeedu wuxuu ahaa dooxadii Yiftax'eel,
english: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

kikuyu: iyo Qataad, iyo Nahalaal, iyo Shimroon, iyo Idalaah, iyo Beytlaxam, intaasu waa laba iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa dhaxalkii ay reer Sebulun u heleen sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen, iyo xataa magaalooyinkan iyo tuulooyinkooduba.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo saamigii afraadna reer Isaakaar buu u soo baxay sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintooduna waxay ahayd ilaa Yesreceel, iyo Kesullood, iyo Shuuneem,
english: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

kikuyu: iyo Xafaarayim, iyo Shii'oon, iyo Anaaxaraad,
english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

kikuyu: iyo Rabbiid, iyo Qiishyoon, iyo Ebes,
english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

kikuyu: iyo Remed, iyo Ceyn Ganniim, iyo Ceyn Xaddaah, iyo Beytfasees,
english: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

kikuyu: oo soohdintu waxay gaadhay ilaa Taaboor, iyo Shaxasimaah, iyo Beytshemesh, oo soohdintooda dhammaadkeedu wuxuu ahaa xagga Webi Urdun, oo intaasuna waa lix iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo intaasu waa dhaxalkii ay qabiilkii reer Isaakaar u heleen sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen, iyo xataa magaalooyinkan iyo tuulooyinkooduba.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo saamigii shanaadna wuxuu u soo baxay reer Aasheer sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen.
english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintooduna waxay ahayd Xelqad, iyo Xali, iyo Beten, iyo Akshaaf,
english: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

kikuyu: iyo Allammeleg, iyo Camcaad, iyo Mishaal; oo wuxuu gaadhay Karmel xaggeeda galbeed, iyo ilaa Shiihoor Libnaad,
english: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

kikuyu: oo waxay u leexatay xagga qorraxdu ka soo baxdo, ee ah Beytdaagoon, oo waxay gaadhay tan iyo Sebulun, iyo dooxadii Yiftax'eel xaggeeda woqooyi iyo ilaa Beytcemeq iyo Necii'eel, oo waxay u baxday xagga bidix ee ah Kabuul,
english: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

kikuyu: iyo Cebroon, iyo Rexob, iyo Xammoon, iyo Qaanaah, iyo xataa Siidoonta weyn;
english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

kikuyu: oo soohdintii waxay u leexatay xagga Raamaah, iyo xagga magaaladii deyrka lahayd oo Turos, oo haddana soohdintu waxay u leexatay xagga Xosaah, oo dhammaadkeedu wuxuu ahaa xagga badda ee Aksiib dhinaceeda ah,
english: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

kikuyu: iyo Cummaah, iyo Afeeq, iyo Rexob, oo intaasu waa laba iyo labaatan magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo intaasu waa dhaxalkii ay qabiilkii reer Aasheer u heleen sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen, iyo xataa magaalooyinkan iyo tuulooyinkooduba
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo saamigii lixaadna reer Naftaali buu u soo baxay sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen.
english: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintoodu waxay ka bilaabatay Xelef, tan iyo geedka ku yaal Sacananniim, iyo Adaamii Neqeb, iyo Yabne'eel, iyo ilaa Laquum; oo dhammaadkeedu wuxuu ahaa xagga Webi Urdun.
english: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintu waxay u leexatay xagga galbeed tan iyo Asnood Taaboor, oo halkaasna waxay ugu baxday xagga Xuqoq; oo waxay gaadhay ilaa xagga koonfureed oo Sebulun, oo haddana waxay gaadhay xagga galbeed oo Aasheer, iyo tan iyo reer Yahuudah oo Webi Urdun xagga qorraxdu ka soo baxdo ka xiga.
english: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkii deyrka lahaa waxay ahaayeen Siddiim, iyo Seer, iyo Xammad, iyo Raqad, iyo Kinnered,
english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

kikuyu: iyo Adaamaah, iyo Raamaah, iyo Xaasoor,
english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

kikuyu: iyo Qedesh, iyo Edrecii, iyo Ceyn Xaasoor,
english: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

kikuyu: iyo Yiroon, iyo Migdal Eel, iyo Xoreem, iyo Beytcanaad iyo Beytshemesh, waxay ahaayeen sagaal iyo toban magaalo iyo tuulooyinkoodii.
english: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo intaasu waa dhaxalkii ay qabiilkii reer Naftaali u heleen sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen, iyo xataa magaalooyinka iyo tuulooyinkooduba
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Oo saamigii toddobaadna wuxuu u soo baxay qabiilkii reer Daan sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen.
english: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintii ay dhaxalka u heleenna waxay ahayd Sorcaah, iyo Eshtaa'ool, iyo Ciir Shemesh,
english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

kikuyu: iyo Shacalabbiin, iyo Ayaaloon, iyo Yitlaah,
english: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

kikuyu: iyo Eeloon, iyo Timnaataah, iyo Ceqroon,
english: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

kikuyu: iyo Elteqeeh, iyo Gibbetoon, iyo Bacalad,
english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

kikuyu: iyo Yehud, iyo Bini Beraaq, iyo Gad Rimmoon,
english: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

kikuyu: iyo Meey Yarqoon, iyo Raqoon, iyo soohdinta ka soo hor jeedda Yaafaa.
english: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

kikuyu: Oo soohdintii reer Daan iyagay ka baxday, oo intay reer Daan tageen ayay la dirireen Leshem, oo way qabsadeen, oo dadkii degganaana waxay ku laayeen seef markaasay Leshem hantiyeen oo iska degeen, oo waxay u bixiyeen Daan, kaas oo ahaa magicii awowgood Daan.
english: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

kikuyu: Oo intaasu waa dhaxalkii ay qabiilkii reer Daan u heleen sidii reerahoodii ahaayeen, iyo xataa magaalooyinkan iyo tuulooyinkooduba.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

kikuyu: Sidaasay ku dhammeeyeen qaybintii dhulkii ay dhaxalka u qaybsanayeen siday soohdimihiisu ahaayeen, oo reer binu Israa'iil dhaxal bay Yashuuca ina Nuun dhexdooda ka siiyeen,
english: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

kikuyu: oo sidii Rabbigu ku amray waxay isagii siiyeen magaaladii uu weyddiistay taasoo ahayd Timnad Serah oo ku tiil dalka buuraha leh oo reer Efrayim; markaasuu magaaladii dhistay oo dhex degay.
english: According to the LORD’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa qaybihii dhaxalka ahaa ee wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa, iyo Yashuuca ina Nuun, iyo madaxdii reer binu Israa'iil qabiilooyinkoodii, ay saamiga ugu qaybiyeen Rabbiga hortiisa, iyagoo jooga Shiiloh, oo fadhiya teendhadii shirka iriddeeda. Wayna dhammeeyeen qaybintii dhulka.
english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Yashuuca la hadlay, oo ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

kikuyu: La hadal reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Sooca magaalooyinkii magangalka oo aan idiinku sheegay Muuse,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,

kikuyu: in gacankudhiiglihii qof dilaa, isagoo aan u kasayn oo aan badheedh u samayn, uu halkaas u cararo; oo waxay idiin noqonayaan meeshaad ka magangeli lahaydeen kan dhiigga ka aarsada.
english: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkaas middood waa inuu u cararaa, oo waa inuu istaagaa iridda magaalada laga soo galo, oo xaalkiisa waa inuu u caddeeyaa odayaasha magaalada, oo iyana waa inay magaalada soo geliyaan, oo meel siiyaan inuu la degganaado.
english: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

kikuyu: Oo haddii kan dhiigga ka aarsadaa uu soo eryado, markaas waa inaanay gacankudhiiglihii gacantiisa gelin, maxaa yeelay, kaasu wuxuu deriskiisa ku dilay kama' oo horena ma uu nebcaan jirin.
english: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

kikuyu: Oo magaaladaas waa inuu degganaadaa ilaa uu xukun isu hor taago shirka, iyo ilaa uu ka dhinto wadaadka sare oo jiri doona waayahaas, oo markaas ka dib gacankudhiigluhu waa inuu noqdaa, oo waa inuu magaaladiisii yimaadaa, iyo gurigiisii, ilaa magaaladii uu markii hore ka cararay.
english: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

kikuyu: Oo waxay sooceen Qedesh oo ku tiil Galili oo ah dalka buuraha leh oo reer Naftaali, iyo Shekem oo iyana ku tiil dalka buuraha leh oo reer Efrayim, iyo Qiryad Arbac (oo ah Xebroon) ee ku tiil dalka buuraha leh oo reer Yahuudah.
english: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

kikuyu: Oo Webi Urdun shishadiisa meel Yerixoo u dhow oo bari ka xigta waxay ka sooceen Beser oo ku tiil cidladii ku tiil bannaankii qabiilka reer Ruubeen, iyo Raamod oo ku tiil Gilecaad oo ay qabiilkii reer Gaad lahaayeen, iyo Goolaan oo ku tiil Baashaan oo ay qabiilkii reer Manaseh lahaayeen.
english: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Intaasu waa magaalooyinkii loo doortay reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, iyo qariibkii dhexdooda degganaa, in ku alla kii qof dilaa, isagoo aan u kasayn, uu halkaas ku carari karo inaanu ku dhiman gacanta kan dhiigga ka aarsada, ilaa uu hor istaago shirka.
english: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.

kikuyu: Markaasaa madaxdii reer Laawi waxay u soo dhowaadeen wadaadkii Elecaasaar ahaa, iyo Yashuuca ina Nuun, iyo madaxdii reer binu Israa'iil qabiilooyinkoodii.
english: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Wayna kula hadleen, iyagoo jooga Shiiloh oo ku taal dalkii reer Kancaan, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Rabbigu wuxuu noogu amray Muuse in nala siiyo magaalooyin aan degno iyo agagaarkoodii ay xoolahayagu daaqaan.
english: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer binu Israa'iil waxay dhaxalkoodii reer Laawi ka siiyeen magaalooyinkaas iyo agagaarkooda sidii amarka Rabbigu ahaa.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Markaasaa saami u soo baxay qolooyinkii reer Qohaad; oo reerkii wadaadkii Haaruun ahaa, kuwaasoo reer Laawi ka mid ahaa, waxay saami kaga heleen reer Yahuudah iyo reer Simecoon, iyo reer Benyaamiin saddex iyo toban magaalo.
english: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Oo reer Qohaad intoodii hadhay waxay saami kaga heleen qolooyinkii reer Efrayim, iyo reer Daan, iyo reer Manaseh badhkood toban magaalo.
english: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gershoonna waxay saami kaga heleen qolooyinkii reer Isaakaar, iyo reer Aasheer, iyo reer Naftaali, iyo reer Manaseh badhkoodii degganaa Baashaan saddex iyo toban magaalo.
english: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

kikuyu: Oo reer Meraariina sidii ay reerahoodii ahaayeen waxay ka heleen reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Sebulun laba iyo toban magaalo.
english: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil magaalooyinkaas iyo agagaarkoodiiba waxay saami ku siiyeen reer Laawi sidii Rabbigu ku amray Muuse.
english: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as the LORD commanded by Moses.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa laga siiyey qabiilkii reer Yahuudah iyo qabiilkii reer Simecoon magaalooyinkan magacooda halkan lagu sheegayo.
english: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:

kikuyu: Oo waxaa iska lahaa reerkii Haaruun ee ahaa qolooyinkii reer Qohaad, kuwaasoo ka mid ahaa reer Laawi; maxaa yeelay, iyagaa saamiga hore lahaa.
english: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa la siiyey Qiryad Arbac, oo Arbacna wuxuu ahaa Canaaq aabbihiis (oo taasuna waa Xebroon), oo waxay ku tiil dalka buuraha leh ee reer Yahuudah, iyada iyo agagaarkeeda ku wareegsanba.
english: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

kikuyu: Laakiinse magaalada beeraheedii iyo tuulooyinkeediiba waxay siiyeen Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh inuu hanti ahaan u qaato.
english: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

kikuyu: Oo wadaadkii Haaruun ahaa reerkiisii waxay siiyeen Xebroon iyo agagaarkeedii, oo taasu waxay ahayd magaaladii magangalka u ahayd gacankudhiiglaha, iyo Libnaah iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Yatiir iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Eshtemooca iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Xolon iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Debiir iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Cayn iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Yutaah iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Beytshemesh iyo agagaarkeedii, oo labadaas qabiil waxay ka heleen sagaal magaalo.
english: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Benyaamiinna waxay ka heleen Gibecoon iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Geeraa iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Canaatood iyo agagaarkeedii, intaasu waxay ahayd afar magaalo.
english: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Oo wadaadkii Haaruun ahaa reerkiisii magaalooyinkoodii oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo toban magaalo iyo agagaarkoodii.
english: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
