kikuyu: Oo qolooyinkii reer Qohaad oo ahaa reer Laawi, xataa reer Qohaad intoodii hadhay, waxay magaalooyin saami uga heleen qabiilkii reer Efrayim.
english: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Oo waxay iyagii siiyeen Shekem iyo agagaarkeedii, oo waxay ku tiil dalka reer Efrayim oo buuraha leh, oo waxayna ahayd magaaladii magangalka u ahayd gacankudhiiglaha, iyo Geser iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Qibsayim iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Beytxooroon iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd afar magaalo.
english: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Daanna waxay ka heleen Elteqaah iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Gibbetoon iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Ayaaloon iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Gad Rimmoon iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd afar magaalo.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiisna waxay ka heleen Tacanaag iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Gad Rimmoon iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd laba magaalo.
english: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.

kikuyu: Oo qolooyinkii reer Qohaad intoodii hadhay magaalooyinkoodii oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen toban iyo agagaarkoodii.
english: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gershoon oo ahaa reer Laawi waxaa qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiis laga siiyey Goolaan, oo Baashaan ku dhex taal iyo agagaarkeedii, oo taasu waxay ahayd magaaladii magangalka u ahayd gacankudhiiglaha, iyo weliba Beceshteraah iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd laba magaalo.
english: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.

kikuyu: Oo waxay qabiilkii reer Isaakaarna ka heleen Qiishyoon iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Daaberad iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Yarmuud iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Ceyn Ganniim iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd afar magaalo.
english: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Oo waxay qabiilkii reer Aasheerna ka heleen Mishaal iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Cabdoon iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Xelqad iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Rexob iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd afar magaalo.
english: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Oo waxay qabiilkii reer Naftaalina ka heleen Qedesh oo ku taal Galili iyo agagaarkeedii, oo taasu waxay ahayd magaaladii magangalka u ahayd gacankudhiiglaha, iyo Xammod Door iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Qartaan iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd saddex magaalo.
english: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkii reer Gershoon oo dhan, sidii qolooyinkoodu ahaayeen, saddex iyo toban magaalo iyo agagaarkoodii bay ahaayeen.
english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Oo qolooyinkii reer Meraarii oo ahaa intii ka hadhay reer Laawi waxay qabiilkii reer Sebulun ka heleen Yoqnecaam iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Qartaah iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Dimnaah iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Nahalaal iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd afar magaalo.
english: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Oo waxay qabiilkii reer Ruubeenna ka heleen Beser iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Yahas iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Qedemood iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Mefacad iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu waxay ahayd afar magaalo.
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

kikuyu: Oo waxay qabiilkii reer Gaadna ka heleen Raamod oo ku dhex taal Gilecaad iyo agagaarkeedii, oo taasu waxay ahayd magaaladii magangalka u ahayd gacankudhiiglaha, iyo Maxanayim iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Xeshboon iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Yaser iyo agagaarkeedii, oo intaasu dhammaantood waxay ahaayeen afar magaalo.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intaas oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen magaalooyinkii qolooyinkii reer Meraarii iyo xataa reer Laawi intoodii hadhay, oo qaybtoodii waxay ahayd laba iyo toban magaalo.
english: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.

kikuyu: Oo reer Laawi magaalooyinkoodii ay qaybta u heleen ee ku dhex yiil dalkii hantida u ahaa reer binu Israa'iil kulligood waxay ahaayeen siddeed iyo afartan magaalo iyo agagaarkoodii.
english: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Magaalooyinkaas mid waluba waxay lahayd agagaarkeedii ku wareegsanaa; oo magaalooyinku dhammaantood sidaasay ahaayeen.
english: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.

kikuyu: Sidaasuu Rabbigu reer binu Israa'iil u siiyey dhulkii u awowayaashood ugu dhaartay inuu siiyo oo dhan, oo iyana way hantiyeen, wayna iska degeen.
english: So the LORD gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu iyagii ka nasiyey dadkii ku wareegsanaa, siduu awowayaashood ugu dhaartay oo dhan: oo nin cadaawayaashoodii oo dhan ka mid ihi hortooda isma taagin, oo Rabbigu cadaawayaashoodii oo dhan gacantuu u soo geliyey.
english: The LORD gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. The LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

kikuyu: Oo waxba kama baaqan innaba wixii wanaagsanaa oo Rabbigu u sheegay reer binu Israa'iil; laakiinse kulli way wada ahaadeen.
english: Nothing failed of any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca u yeedhay reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis,
english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waad xajiseen kulli wixii uu addoonkii Rabbiga oo Muuse ahaa idinku amray, oo codkaygana waad dhegaysateen oo waad yeesheen kulli wixii aan idinku amray.
english: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

kikuyu: Oo waagaas ilaa maantadan la joogo walaalihiin kama aydnaan tegin, laakiinse waad xajiseen amarkii Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Oo haatan Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu walaalihiin buu nasiyey, siduu markii hore kula hadlay; haddaba noqda, oo taga teendhooyinkiinnii, iyo dalkii hantida idiin ahaa, oo addoonkii Rabbiga oo Muuse ahaa idinka siiyey Webi Urdun shishadiisa.
english: Now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan.

kikuyu: Laakiinse aad iyo aad u dadaala inaad yeeshaan amarkii iyo sharcigii uu addoonkii Rabbiga ee Muuse ahaa idinku amray, kuwaasoo ah inaad Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah jeclaataan, oo aad ku socotaan jidadkiisa oo dhan, oo aad amarradiisa xajisaan, oo aad isaga aad u sii xajisataan, oo aad qalbigiinna oo dhan iyo naftiinna oo dhan ugu adeegtaan.
english: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yashuuca u duceeyey oo iska diray, oo iyana waxay tageen teendhooyinkoodii.
english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

kikuyu: Oo reer Manaseh badhkiis Muuse wuxuu dhaxal ka siiyey Baashaan dhexdeeda; laakiinse badhkii kale Yashuuca ayaa dal ka siiyey walaalahood dhexdooda meel Webi Urdun ka shishaysa oo xagga galbeed ka xigta. Oo weliba Yashuuca markuu iyagii iska diray, oo ay teendhooyinkoodii tageen, ayuu u duceeyey iyaga,
english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

kikuyu: oo intuu la hadlay ayuu ku yidhi, Teendhooyinkiinnii kula noqda maal badan, iyo lo' aad u tiro badan, iyo lacag, iyo dahab, iyo naxaas, iyo bir, iyo dhar aad u badan; oo boolidii cadaawayaashiinna laga helay walaalihiin la qaybsada.
english: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis ayaa noqday, oo ka tegey reer binu Israa'iil oo joogay Shiiloh taasoo ku taal dalkii Kancaan, inay u kacaan dalkii Gilecaad, kaasoo ahaa dalkii hantidooda ahaa, ee ay ku hantiyeen amarkii Rabbigu Muuse u soo dhiibay.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: Oo markay yimaadeen gobolkii u dhowaa Webi Urdun oo ku yaalay dalkii Kancaan ayay reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis Webi Urdun agtiisa ka dhiseen meel allabari oo muuq weyn.
english: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer binu Israa'iil waxay maqleen in la yidhi, Reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis ayaa meel allabari ka dhisay darafka dalka Kancaan, meeshaas oo ah gobolka u dhow Webi Urdun oo ah dinaca ay leeyihiin reer binu Israa'iil.
english: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Oo markii reer binu Israa'iil ay taas maqleen ayaa shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu ku ururay Shiiloh inay dagaal ugu baxaan iyaga.
english: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay xagga reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis oo joogay dalkii Gilecaad u direen Fiinexaas oo ahaa wiilkii wadaadkii ahaa Elecaasaar.
english: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

kikuyu: Oo waxay isagii ku dareen toban amiir, oo amiirba wuxuu ka socday qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil midkood, oo mid waluba wuxuu ahaa kii madaxda u ahaa reerahooda ku jira kumanyaalka reer binu Israa'iil.
english: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasay u yimaadeen reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis oo joogay dalkii Gilecaad, oo intay la hadleen ayay ku yidhaahdeen,
english: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

kikuyu: Shirkii Rabbiga oo dhammu sidan bay leeyihiin, Waa maxay xadgudubkan aad ku samayseen Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, idinkoo ka leexday inaad Rabbiga la socotaan, oo meel allabari dhistay, si aad maanta Rabbiga ugu caasiyowdaan?
english: “The whole congregation of the LORD says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following the LORD, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against the LORD?

kikuyu: Miyuu nagu yar yahay dembigii Fecoor oo aannan iska nadiifin ilaa maantadan la joogo in kastoo ay belaayo ku soo degtay shirka Rabbiga,
english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of the LORD,

kikuyu: inaad maanta ka leexataan inaad Rabbiga la socotaan? Oo caasinimadii aad maanta Rabbiga ku caasiyowdeen aawadeed ayuu berrito ugu cadhoon doonaa shirka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan.
english: that you must turn away today from following the LORD? It will be, since you rebel today against the LORD, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee, haddii dalkii hantidiinna ahaa aanu nadiif ahayn, de markaas u soo gudba dalka Rabbiga hantidiisa ah, oo uu taambuuggii Rabbigu ku dhex jiro, oo nala qayb qaata; laakiinse Rabbiga ha ku caasiyoobina, oo annagana ha nagu caasiyoobina, oo ha dhisina meel allabari oo aan ahayn tii Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah.
english: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of the LORD, in which the LORD’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than the LORD our God’s altar.

kikuyu: Caakaan ina Serax miyaanu ku xadgudbin alaabtii la nidray, oo taas daraaddeed miyaan cadho ugu dhicin shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan? Oo ninkaasu keligiis kuma uu dhiman dembigiisii.
english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaad iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis waxay u jawaabeen oo la hadleen kuwii madaxda u ahaa kumanyaalka reer binu Israa'iil, oo ku yidhaahdeen,
english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

kikuyu: Rabbiga ah Ilaaha ilaahyada, Rabbiga ah Ilaaha ilaahyadu wuu og yahay, oo reer binu Israa'iilna waa inuu ogaadaa, haddii taasu caasinimo tahay, ama xadgudub Rabbiga ka gees ah (maanta ha na badbaadin),
english: “The Mighty One, God, the LORD, the Mighty One, God, the LORD, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against the LORD (don’t save us today),

kikuyu: iyo haddii aan meel allabari u dhisannay inaannu Rabbiga kaga leexanno, ama haddii aannu u dhisnay in lagu dul bixiyo qurbaan la gubo, ama qurbaan hadhuudh ah, ama in lagu dul bixiyo allabari ah qurbaanno nabaadiino, sidaas hadday tahay, Rabbiga qudhiisu ha na weyddiiyo;
english: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following the LORD; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let the LORD himself require it.

kikuyu: oo haddii aannan taas u samaynin feejignaan iyo sabab aawadood, annagoo leh, Waa dambe carruurtiinnu waxay la hadli doonaan carruurtayada, oo waxay ku odhan doonaan, Maxaa idinka galay Rabbiga Ilaaha u ah reer binu Israa'iil?
english: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu Webi Urdun ka dhigay soohdin inoo dhexaysa annaga iyo idinka, reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaadow. Qayb kuma lihidin Rabbiga. Oo sidaasay carruurtiinnu carruurtayada uga joojin doonaan cabsida Rabbiga.
english: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in the LORD.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo sidaas daraaddeed waxaannu isnidhi, Haddaba aynu isu diyaarinno inaynu dhisanno meel allabari, oo aan lagu bixin qurbaan la gubo ama allabari,
english: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;

kikuyu: laakiinse waxay noqon doontaa markhaati inoo dhexeeya annaga iyo idinka, iyo farcankeenna inaga dambeeya, si aannu Rabbiga hortiisa ugu adeegno annagoo wadna qurbaannadayada la gubo, iyo allabaryadayada, iyo qurbaannadayada nabaadiinada, inaan carruurtiinnu waa dambe ku odhan carruurtayada, Qayb kuma lihidin Rabbiga.
english: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in the LORD.’

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaannu isnidhi, Markay sidaas waa dambe inagu yidhaahdaan innaga ama farcankeenna, waxay noqon doontaa oo aannu ku odhan doonnaa, Bal eega, hannaankii meeshii allabariga oo Rabbiga, ee ay awowayaasheen dhiseen oo aan lagu bixin qurbaanno la gubo ama allabari, laakiinse waa markhaati inoo dhexeeya annaga iyo idinka.
english: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of the LORD’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’

kikuyu: Ilaah ha naga fogeeyo inaannu Rabbiga ku caasiyowno, oo aannu ka leexanno lasocodkii Rabbiga, oo aannu meel allabari u dhisno qurbaan la gubo, iyo qurbaan hadhuudh ah, ama allabari, taasoo aan ahayn meeshii allabariga Rabbiga Ilaaheen ah ee ku hor taal taambuuggiisa.
english: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn away today from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides the LORD our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”

kikuyu: Oo wadaadkii Fiinexaas ahaa iyo amiirradii shirka, oo ahaa madaxdii kumanyaalka reer binu Israa'iil oo isaga la socday, kolkay maqleen warkii ay reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis ku hadleen ayay aad ugu farxeen.
english: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii ahaa Fiinexaas ina Elecaasaar wuxuu ku yidhi reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaad iyo reer Manaseh, Maanta waannu og nahay in Rabbigu ina dhex joogo, maxaa yeelay, idinku xadgudubkan kuma aydnaan samayn Rabbiga. Haddaba idinku waxaad reer binu Israa'iil ka samatabbixiseen gacantii Rabbiga.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against the LORD. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of the LORD’s hand.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii ahaa Fiinexaas ina Elecaasaar, iyo amiirradii waxay ka noqdeen reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaad oo joogay dalkii Gilecaad, oo waxay tageen dalkii reer Kancaan, oo reer binu Israa'iil ayay warkii u sheegeen.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna waa ku farxeen warkaas. Markaasaa reer binu Israa'iil Ilaah ammaaneen, oo mar dambena kuma ay hadlin inay dagaal ugu kacaan, oo ay baabbi'iyaan dalka ay reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaad deggan yihiin.
english: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Ruubeen iyo reer Gaad waxay meeshii allabariga u bixiyeen Markhaati; waayo, waxay yidhaahdeen, Waa markhaati na dhex yaal in Rabbigu Ilaah yahay.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that the LORD is God.”

kikuyu: Maalmo badan dabadood, markii Rabbigu reer binu Israa'iil ka nasiyey cadaawayaashoodii ku wareegsanaa, Yashuucana da' weynaa, gabowna la dhacay,
english: After many days, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

kikuyu: ayaa Yashuuca u yeedhay reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, iyo waayeelladoodii, iyo madaxdoodii, iyo xaakinnadoodii, iyo saraakiishoodii, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Anigu waan da' weynahay oo gabow baan la dhacay;
english: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.

kikuyu: oo idinkuna waad aragteen kulli wixii Rabbigu quruumahan oo dhan ku sameeyey idinka aawadiin; waayo, kan idiin diriray waa Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: You have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is the LORD your God who has fought for you.

kikuyu: Bal eega waan idiin qaybiyey quruumahan hadhay inay qabiilooyinkiinna dhaxal u ahaadaan, tan iyo Webi Urdun iyo kulli quruumihii aan gooyay, iyo xataa tan iyo xagga gabbalku u dhaco ee badda weyn.
english: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu iyaga hortiinnuu ka tuuri doonaa, oo idinka hor eryi doonaa, oo markaasaad dalkooda hantiyi doontaan, sidii Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu idinkula hadlay.
english: The LORD your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as the LORD your God spoke to you.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed aad u dhiirranaada inaad xajisaan oo yeeshaan kulli waxa ku qoran kitaabkii sharcigii Muuse, iyo inaydnaan sharcigaas uga leexan xagga midigta iyo xagga bidixda toona.
english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;

kikuyu: Oo iska jira inaydnaan quruumahaas dhex iman, kuwaasoo ah kuwa idinku dhex hadhay, oo magacyada ilaahyadoodana marnaba ha soo hadalqaadina, ninnana ha ku dhaaranina, hana u adeegina, hana u sujuudina kolnaba,
english: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;

kikuyu: laakiin Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah aad u sii xajista sidaad ilaa maantadan la joogo yeesheen.
english: but hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu hortiinna ka eryay quruumo waaweyn oo xoog badan; oo weliba idinka ninna idinma hor istaagin ilaa maantadan la joogo.
english: “For the LORD has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.

kikuyu: Nin keliya oo idinka mid ahu kun buu eryi doonaa; waayo, kan idiin diriraa waa Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah siduu idinkula hadlay.
english: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is the LORD your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.

kikuyu: Haddaba isjira oo jeclaada Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah.
english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Haddaadse dib ugu noqotaan oo aad u xajisataan kuwa ka hadhay quruumahan, kuwaas oo ah kuwa idinku dhex hadhay, haddaad guursataan oo aad isdhex gashaan, oo iyana ay idin dhex galaan,
english: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;

kikuyu: markaas xaqiiq ahaan u ogaada inuusan Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu mar dambe quruumahaas hortiinna ka eryayn, laakiinse waxay idinku noqon doonaan siriq iyo dabin, oo markaasay dhinacyada idinka karbaashi doonaan, oo indhahana qodxan idinkaga mudi doonaan, ilaa aad ka baabba'daan dalkan wanaagsan oo Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu idin siiyey.
english: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.

kikuyu: Bal eega, maanta waxaan mari doonaa jidka dadka dhulka jooga oo dhan; idinkuna waad ku og tihiin qalbigiinna oo dhan iyo naftiinna oo dhan, inaan wax keliyuhu ka baaqan kulli wixii wanaagsanaa oo Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu xaggiinna kaga hadlay; laakiinse kulligood way idiin wada ahaadeen oo mid keliyuhu kama baaqan.
english: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.

kikuyu: Oo siday waxyaalihii wanaagsanaa idiinku soo wada degeen, kuwaasoo ahaa kuwii Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu idinkula hadlay, ayaa Rabbigu idiinku soo dejin doonaa waxyaalaha sharka ah oo dhan, ilaa uu idinka baabbi'iyo dalkan wanaagsan oo Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu idin siiyey.
english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which the LORD your God spoke to you, so the LORD will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you,

kikuyu: Markaad ku xadgudubtaan axdigii Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu idinku amray, oo aad ka tagtaan, ee aad u adeegtaan ilaahyo kale, oo aad iyaga u sujuuddaan, de markaasaa cadhada Rabbigu idinku kululaan doontaa, oo aad haddiiba ka baabbi'i doontaan dalka wanaagsan oo uu idin siiyey.
english: when you disobey the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then the LORD’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca qabiilooyinkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan ku soo ururshay Shekem, oo wuxuu u yeedhay waayeelladii reer binu Israa'iil, iyo madaxdoodii, iyo xaakinnadoodii, iyo saraakiishoodii, oo waxay kulligood ku soo urureen Ilaah hortiisa.
english: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

kikuyu: Oo Yashuuca wuxuu dadkii oo dhan ku yidhi, Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil wuxuu leeyahay, Awowayaashiin waxay waa hore degganaan jireen Webigii shishadiisa, oo waxaa ka mid ahaa Terax oo ahaa aabbihii Ibraahim iyo Naaxoor; waxayna u adeegi jireen ilaahyo kale.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.

kikuyu: Markaasaan awowgiin Ibraahim ka soo kexeeyey Webiga shishadiisa, oo aan dhex mariyey dalka Kancaan oo dhan, oo farcankiisiina waan badiyey, oo waxaan siiyey Isxaaq.
english: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.

kikuyu: Isxaaqna waxaan siiyey Yacquub iyo Ceesaw; Ceesawna waxaan Buur Seciir u siiyey inuu hantiyo, oo Yacquub iyo carruurtiisiina waxay ku dhaadhaceen xagga dalka Masar.
english: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaan soo diray Muuse iyo Haaruun, oo Masarna belaayaan ku riday, sidii wixii aan dhexdooda ku sameeyey; oo dabadeedna waan idinka soo saaray.
english: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

kikuyu: Oo awowayaashiin waxaan ka soo saaray Masar, oo markaasaad timaadeen badda; oo Masriyiintiina awowayaashiin ayay ku sii eryadeen gaadhifardood, iyo fardooley, ilaa ay yimaadeen Badda Cas.
english: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Oo markay Rabbiga u qayshadeen ayuu gudcur kala dhex dhigay idinka iyo Masriyiintii, oo badduu ku soo daayay oo ku daboolay; oo indhihiinnaad ku aragteen wixii aan ku sameeyey Masar; oo idinna maalmo badan ayaad cidlada degganaydeen.
english: When they cried out to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaan idin keenay dalkii reer Amor, kuwaasoo degganaa Webi Urdun shishadiisa, oo iyana way idinla dirireen; kolkaasaan gacanta idiin geliyey, oo dalkoodiina waad hantideen, iyagiina hortiinna waan ka baabbi'iyey.
english: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna waxaa kacay boqorkii Moo'aab oo ahaa Baalaaq ina Sifoor, oo wuxuu la diriray reer binu Israa'iil, markaasuu u yeedhay oo idiinku soo diray inuu idin habaaro Balcaam ina Becoor.
english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu Balcaam ma aanan dhegaysan; sidaas daraaddeed weliba wuu idiin sii duceeyey; oo sidaasaan gacantiisii idiinka samatabbixiyey.
english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

kikuyu: Oo idinku waxaad ka soo gudubteen Webi Urdun oo aad timaadeen Yerixoo, oo dadkii reer Yerixoo way idinla dagaallameen, kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen reer Amor, iyo reer Feris, iyo reer Kancaan, iyo reer Xeed, iyo reer Girgaash, iyo reer Xiwi, iyo reer Yebuus, oo anna dhammaantood gacantaan idiin geliyey.
english: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan idinka hor mariyey xoonkii hortiinna ka eryay iyagii oo ahaa xataa labadii boqor oo reer Amor, oo kuwaas kuma aadan eryin seeftaada iyo qaansadaada toona.
english: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan idin siiyey dal aydnaan u hawshoon, iyo magaalooyin aydnaan dhisan, oo waad iska dhex degtaan, oo waxaad ka cuntaan canab iyo saytuun aydnaan beeran.
english: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbiga ka cabsada, oo daacad iyo run ugu adeega; oo iska fogeeya ilaahyadii awowayaashiin ugu adeegi jireen Webiga shishadiisa, iyo dalka Masar dhexdiisa, oo idinku waxaad u adeegtaan Rabbiga.
english: “Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo hadday shar idinla tahay inaad Rabbiga u adeegtaan, haddaba maanta doorta kii aad u adeegi doontaan, ama ha noqoto ilaahyadii awowayaashiin ugu adeegi jireen Webiga shishadiisa, ama ilaahyada reer Amor, kuwaas oo aad dalkoodii deggan tihiin; laakiinse aniga iyo reerkayguba waxaannu u adeegi doonaa Rabbiga.
english: If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa dadkii waxay ugu jawaabeen, Ilaah ha naga fogeeyo inaannu Rabbiga ka tagno oo aannu u adeegno ilaahyo kale;
english: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

kikuyu: waayo, Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu waa kii innaga iyo awowayaasheenba inaga soo saaray dalkii Masar oo ahaa gurigii addoonsiga, oo isagu waa kii calaamooyinkaas waaweyn ku sameeyey horteenna oo inagu dhawrayay jidkii aan soo marnay oo dhan, oo inaga samatabbixiyey dadkii aynu soo dhex soconnay oo dhan.
english: for it is the LORD our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu horteenna ka eryay dadkii oo dhan, iyo xataa reer Amor oo dalka degganaa; oo sidaas daraaddeed annaguna waxaannu u adeegi doonnaa Rabbiga, maxaa yeelay, isagu waa Ilaahayo.
english: The LORD drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve the LORD; for he is our God.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca wuxuu dadkii ku yidhi, Rabbiga uma aad adeegi kartaan; waayo, isagu waa Ilaah quduus ah; oo waa Ilaah masayr ah, oo isagu idinkama cafiyi doono xadgudubkiinna iyo dembiyadiinna toona.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve the LORD, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

kikuyu: Oo markuu wax wanaagsan idiin sameeyo dabadeed, haddaad Rabbiga ka tagtaan, oo aad u adeegtaan ilaahyo qalaad, de markaas wuu soo jeesan doonaa oo wax xun buu idinku samayn doonaa, oo wuu idin baabbi'in doonaa.
english: If you forsake the LORD, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii waxay Yashuuca ku yidhaahdeen, Maya; laakiinse annagu Rabbiga waannu u adeegi doonnaa.
english: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve the LORD.”

kikuyu: Yashuucana wuxuu dadkii ku yidhi, Idinka qudhiinnaa isku marag furaya inaad doorateen Rabbiga oo aad isaga u adeegaysaan. Kolkaasay yidhaahdeen, Annagaa ka marag ah.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu yidhi, Haddaba iska fogeeya ilaahyada qalaad oo idinku dhex jira, oo qalbigiinna u jeediya Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil.
english: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the LORD, the God of Israel.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii waxay Yashuuca ku yidhaahdeen, Annagu waxaannu u adeegi doonnaa Rabbiga Ilaahayaga ah, oo weliba codkiisaannu maqli doonnaa.
english: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed maalintaas ayaa Yashuuca dadkii axdi la dhigtay, oo Shekem buu ugu dejiyey qaynuun iyo amar.
english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca erayadan ku qoray kitaabkii sharcigii Ilaah; oo dhagax weyn buu qaaday, oo wuxuu hoos qotonshay geedkii ku ag yiil taambuugga quduuskaa oo Rabbiga.
english: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

kikuyu: Yashuucana wuxuu dadkii oo dhan ku yidhi, Bal ogaada, dhagaxanaa inagu marag furi doonee; waayo, wuxuu maqlay erayadii Rabbiga oo uu inagula hadlay oo dhan; sidaas daraaddeed wuxuu idinku noqon doonaa marag, si aydnaan Ilaahiinna u inkirin.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all the LORD’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yashuuca dadkii kala diray oo nin waluba wuxuu tegey dalkii dhaxalkiisa ahaa.
english: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

kikuyu: Oo taas dabadeed addoonkii Rabbiga oo ahaa Yashuuca ina Nuun ayaa dhintay, isagoo jira boqol iyo toban sannadood.
english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku aaseen dalkii uu dhaxalka u helay oo ahaa Timnad Serah oo ku tiil dalkii buuraha lahaa oo reer Efrayim, oo xagga woqooyi ka xigta buurta Gacash.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iilna Rabbigay u adeegi jireen waagii Yashuuca oo dhan, iyo waagii odayaashii ka nolol dambeeyey Yashuuca oo dhan, kuwaas oo ogaa kulli shuqulkii Rabbigu u sameeyey reer binu Israa'iil.
english: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of the LORD, that he had worked for Israel.

kikuyu: Oo lafihii Yuusuf oo reer binu Israa'iil ka soo saareen Masar, waxay ku aaseen Shekem taasoo ah dhulkii yaraa oo Yacquub ka iibsaday reer Xamoor oo ahaa Shekem aabbihiis oo uu ka siistay boqol gogo' oo lacag ah; oo meeshaasu waxay dhaxal u noqotay reer Yuusuf.
english: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

kikuyu: Oo Elecaasaar ina Haaruunna wuu dhintay, oo waxay isna ku aaseen buurtii wiilkiisa Fiinexaas oo isaga laga siiyey dalkii buuraha lahaa oo reer Efrayim.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Markii Yashuuca dhintay dabadeed ayay reer binu Israa'iil Rabbiga weyddiiyeen, oo yidhaahdeen, Yaa marka hore xagga reer Kancaan noo hor kici doona oo noo dagaal geli doona?
english: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu ku yidhi, Reer Yahuudah ha baxeen, oo anna dalka gacantoodaan geliyey.
english: The LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Yahuudah waxay ku yidhaahdeen walaalahood reer Simecoon, Kaalaya oo markayaga na raaca aynu la dagaallanno reer Kancaane; oo annana sidaas oo kale markiinnaan idin raaci doonnaaye. Markaasay reer Simecoon raaceen.
english: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay reer Yahuudah tageen, oo Rabbiguna wuxuu gacantoodii geliyey reer Kancaan iyo reer Feris, oo waxay Beseq kaga laayeen toban kun oo nin.
english: Judah went up, and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.

kikuyu: Oo waxay Beseq ka heleen Adonii Beseq, oo way la dagaallameen, oo waxay laayeen reer Kancaan iyo reer Feris.
english: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Adonii Beseq waa cararay, oo iyana way eryoodeen, wayna qabteen isagii, oo waxay ka gooyeen suulashiisii gacmaha iyo kuwiisii lugaha.
english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Adonii Beseq wuxuu yidhi, Toddobaatan boqor oo suulashoodii gacmaha iyo kuwoodii lugahu ka go'an yihiin ayaa cuntadooda ka urursan jiray miiskayga hoostiisa; oo sidii aan yeelay ayaa Rabbigu ii abaalmariyey. Markaasay isagii keeneen Yeruusaalem, oo halkaasuu ku dhintay.
english: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

kikuyu: Oo Reer Yahuudah waxay la dirireen reer Yeruusaalem, oo intay magaaladii qabsadeen ayay dadkeedii ku laayeen seef, magaaladiina dab bay qabadsiiyeen.
english: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

kikuyu: Oo dabadeedna reer Yahuudah waxay u kaceen inay la diriraan reer Kancaankii degganaa dalkii buuraha lahaa, iyo kuwii xagga koonfureed, iyo kuwii degganaa dalkii dooxada ahaa.
english: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yahuudah waxay ku duuleen dadkii reer Kancaan oo degganaa Xebroon, (oo waagii hore Xebroon magaceeda waxaa la odhan jiray Qiryad Arbac), oo waxay laayeen Sheeshay iyo Axiiman iyo Talmay.
english: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

kikuyu: Oo intay halkaas ka tageen ayay dadkii degganaa Debiir ku duuleen. (Oo waagii hore Debiir magaceedu wuxuu ahaa Qiryad Sefer).
english: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

kikuyu: Markaasaa Kaaleeb wuxuu yidhi, Kii la dirira Qiryad Sefer oo qabsada, kaas waxaan u guurin doonaa gabadhayda Caksaah.
english: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Cotnii'eel ina Qenas, kaasoo ahaa Kaaleeb walaalkiisii yaraa, magaaladii qabsaday; markaasuu wuxuu u guuriyey gabadhiisii Caksaah.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.

kikuyu: Oo markay u timid ayay kula talisay inuu aabbeheed berrin ka baryo; markaasay dameerkeedii ka soo degtay, oo Kaaleeb wuxuu ku yidhi iyadii, Maxaad doonaysaa?
english: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”

kikuyu: Markaasay ku tidhi, Ii ducee, oo waxaad i siisaa ilo biyo ah, maxaa yeelay, waxaad i siisay dalkii koonfureed. Kolkaasaa Kaaleeb wuxuu siiyey ilihii sare iyo kuwii hooseba.
english: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

kikuyu: Markaasay kii reer Qeyn oo ahaa Muuse seeddigiis reerkiisii ka tageen magaaladii lahayd geedaha timirta ah, oo waxay reer Yahuudah u raaceen xagga cidladii reer Yahuudah taasoo ku taal Caraad xaggeeda koonfureed; oo intay tageen ayay dadkii la degeen.
english: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yahuudahna waxay raaceen walaalahood reer Simecoon, oo waxay laayeen reer Kancaan oo Sefad degganaa, oo dhammaanteedna way baabbi'iyeen. Oo magaaladii magaceediina waxaa la odhan jiray Xormaah.
english: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yahuudah waxay qabsadeen haddana Gaasa iyo xuduudkeedii, iyo Ashqeloon iyo xuduudkeedii, iyo Ceqroon iyo xuduudkeedii.
english: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu waa la jiray reer Yahuudah, oo wuxuu hortooda ka eryay dadkii degganaa dalkii buuraha lahaa; maxaa yeelay, ma ay eryi karin dadkii dooxadii degganaa, waayo, waxay lahaayeen gaadhifardood bir ah.
english: The LORD was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

kikuyu: Oo markaasay Xebroon siiyeen Kaaleeb, sidii Muuse markii hore u sheegay; oo halkaas wuxuu ka eryay Canaaq saddexdiisii wiil.
english: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.

kikuyu: Oo reer Benyaamiin ma ay eryin dadkii reer Yebuus oo Yeruusaalem degganaa; laakiinse reer Yebuus waxay Yeruusaalem la degganaayeen reer Benyaamiin ilaa maantadan la joogo.
english: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yuusufna waxay ku kaceen Beytel; oo Rabbiguna wuu la jiray iyagii.
english: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the LORD was with them.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yuusufna waxay Beytel u direen ilaallo soo basaasta. (Magaaladaas markii hore waxaa magaceeda la odhan jiray Luus.)
english: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)

kikuyu: Markaasaa ilaaladii waxay arkeen nin magaalada ka soo baxaya, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Waannu ku baryaynaaye, na tus iridda magaalada laga galo, oo annaguna wanaag baannu kuu falaynaa.
english: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu iyagii tusay iriddii magaalada laga geli jiray, oo waxay dadkii magaalada ku laayeen seef, laakiinse ninkii iyo xaaskiisii oo dhanba way iska sii daayeen.
english: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.

kikuyu: Markaasaa ninkii wuxuu tegey dalkii reer Xeed, oo halkaasuu magaalo ka dhisay, oo magaceediina wuxuu u bixiyey Luus, kaasoo ah magaceeda ilaa maantadan la joogo.
english: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.

kikuyu: Oo reer Manasehna ma ay eryin dadkii degganaa Beytshe'aan iyo magaalooyinkeedii, ama kuwii Tacanaag iyo magaalooyinkeedii, ama dadkii degganaa Door iyo magaalooyinkeedii, ama dadkii degganaa Yiblecaam iyo magaalooyinkeedii, ama dadkii degganaa Megiddoo iyo magaalooyinkeedii, laakiinse reer Kancaan waxay doonayeen inay dalkaas degganaadaan.
english: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

kikuyu: Oo markii ay reer binu Israa'iil xoogaysteen ayay reer Kancaan addoonsadeen oo mana ay wada eryin.
english: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

kikuyu: Oo reer Efrayimna ma ay eryin dadkii reer Kancaan oo degganaa Geser; laakiinse reer Kancaan iyagay la degganaayeen Geser.
english: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

kikuyu: Oo reer Sebulunna ma ay eryin dadkii degganaa Qitroon, iyo dadkii degganaa Nahalaal, laakiinse reer Kancaan waxay degganaayeen iyaga dhexdooda, oo addoommo ayay u noqdeen.
english: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: Oo reer Aasheerna ma ay eryin dadkii degganaa Cakoo, ama dadkii degganaa Siidoon, ama kuwii Axlaab, ama kuwii Aksiib, ama kuwii Xelbaah, ama kuwii Afiiq, ama kuwii Rexob.
english: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;

kikuyu: Laakiinse reer Aasheer waxay dhex degganaayeen reer Kancaan oo ahaa dadkii dalka degganaa, maxaa yeelay, iyagu ma ay eryin.
english: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.

kikuyu: Oo reer Naftaalina ma ay eryin dadkii degganaa Beytshemesh ama dadkii degganaa Beytcanaad; laakiinse wuxuu degganaa reer Kancaan dhexdooda, kuwaasoo ahaa dadkii dalka degganaa; habase yeeshee dadkii degganaa Beytshemesh iyo Beytcanaad addoommo ayaa u noqdeen iyaga.
english: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Amor waxay ku dirqiyeen reer Daan dalkii buuraha ahaa, maxaa yeelay, ma ay u oggolaan inay u soo degaan xagga dooxada.
english: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;

kikuyu: Laakiinse reer Amor waxay doonayeen inay degganaadaan Buur Xeres oo ku taal Ayaaloon iyo Shacalbiim; laakiinse waxaa ka adkaatay gacantii reer Yuusuf, oo sidaas daraaddeed addoommo ayay u noqdeen.
english: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.

kikuyu: Oo xuduudkii reer Amorna wuxuu ka bilaabmayay meesha laga koro Caqrabbiim marka laga bilaabo Selac iyo inta ka sarraysa.
english: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaa'igtii Rabbigu waxay ka soo kacday Gilgaal oo Bokiim timid, oo waxay tidhi, Anigaa idinka soo bixiyey dalkii Masar, oo waxaan idin keenay dalkii aan ugu dhaartay awowayaashiin, oo waxaan idhi, Anigu weligay jebin maayo axdigayga aan idinla dhigtay.
english: The LORD’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

kikuyu: Idinkuna waa inaydnaan axdi la dhigan dadka dalkan deggan; oo waa inaad jejebisaan meelahooda allabariga. Laakiinse idinku ma aydnaan dhegaysan codkaygii. De haddaba maxaad sidan u yeesheen?
english: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaa kaloo aan idhi, Hortiinna kama eryi doono iyaga, laakiinse waxay idinku noqon doonaan sida qodxan dhinacyada idinkaga jirta, oo ilaahyadooduna waxay idinku noqon doonaan dabin.
english: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”

kikuyu: Oo markay malaa'igtii Rabbigu erayadan kula hadashay reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan ayay dadkii codkoodii kor u qaadeen oo ooyeen.
english: When the LORD’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.

kikuyu: Oo meeshaas magaceedii waxay u bixiyeen Bokiim; oo halkaasay allabari Rabbiga ugu bixiyeen.
english: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to the LORD.

kikuyu: Haddaba markii Yashuuca dadkii diray ayaa reer binu Israa'iil mid waluba u kacay dhaxalkiisii inuu hantiyo dalka.
english: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

kikuyu: Oo dadkuna Rabbigay u adeegeen wakhtigii Yashuuca noolaa oo dhan, iyo wakhtigii odayaashii Yashuuca ka nolol dambeeyey oo dhan, kuwaasoo wada arkay kulli shuqulkii weynaa oo Rabbigu u sameeyey reer binu Israa'iil.
english: The people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of the LORD that he had worked for Israel.

kikuyu: Yashuuca oo ahaa ina Nuun oo addoonkii Rabbiga ahaa wuxuu dhintay isagoo boqol iyo toban sannadood jira.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku aaseen dalkii uu dhaxalka u helay oo ahaa Timnad Xeres, oo ku tiil dalkii buuraha lahaa oo reer Efrayim, oo xagga woqooyi ka xigta buurta Gacash.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

kikuyu: Oo weliba dadkii qarnigaas oo dhammu waxay ku darmadeen awowayaashood; oo waxaa ka daba kacay kuwo qarni kale ah oo aan aqoon Rabbiga, ama shuqulkii uu u sameeyey reer binu Israa'iil.
english: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know the LORD, nor the work which he had done for Israel.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay sameeyeen wax Rabbiga hortiisa ku xun, oo waxay u adeegeen Bacaliimka.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals.

kikuyu: Wayna ka tageen Rabbigii ahaa Ilaahii awowayaashood oo iyaga ka soo bixiyey dalkii Masar, oo waxay raaceen ilaahyo kale, kuwaasoo ahaa ilaahyadii dadkii iyaga ku wareegsanaa, wayna u sujuudeen; oo Rabbigana way ka xanaajiyeen.
english: They abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked the LORD to anger.

kikuyu: Oo intay Rabbiga ka tageen ayay u adeegeen Bacal iyo Cashtarod.
english: They abandoned the LORD, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

kikuyu: Markaasaa cadhadii Rabbigu aad ugu kululaatay reer binu Israa'iil, oo wuxuu iyagii ku riday kuwii iyaga dhacay gacmahoodii, oo wuxuu ka iibiyey gacmihii cadaawayaashoodii ku wareegsanaa, sidaas daraaddeed mar dambe ma ay hor istaagi karin cadaawayaashooda.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.

kikuyu: Oo meel kasta oo ay tageenba gacanta Rabbigu dhib bay u ahayd, sidii Rabbigu ku hadlay, iyo sidii Rabbigu iyaga ugu dhaartay; oo iyana aad bay u dhibaataysnaayeen.
english: Wherever they went out, the LORD’s hand was against them for evil, as the LORD had spoken, and as the LORD had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu kiciyey xaakinno iyaga ka badbaadiyey gacantii kuwii dhacayay.
english: The LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.

kikuyu: Oo weliba xaakinnadoodiina ma ay dhegaysan, maxaa yeelay, ilaahyo kalay raaceen sidii naag ninkeedii ka dhillowday, wayna u sujuudeen; oo haddiiba gees bay uga leexdeen jidkii ay awowayaashood mareen iyagoo addeecaya amarradii Rabbiga; laakiinse iyagu sidaas ma ay yeelin.
english: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying the LORD’s commandments. They didn’t do so.

kikuyu: Oo markii Rabbigu iyaga u kiciyey xaakinno ayuu Rabbigu la jiray xaakinkii, oo wakhtigii xaakinkii noolaa oo dhan wuxuu iyagii ka badbaadiyey gacantii cadaawayaashooda; waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu ka qoomamooday taahiddii ay ka taahayeen kuwii iyaga dulmay oo caddibay.
english: When the LORD raised up judges for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved the LORD because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.

kikuyu: Oo haddana markii xaakinkii dhintay ayay dib u noqdeen, oo waxay ku kaceen wax ka sii xun wixii awowayaashood ay ku kici jireen, oo waxay raaceen ilaahyo kale inay u adeegaan oo ay u sujuudaan. Kama ay joogsan falimahoodii, iyo madax adkaantoodii.
english: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.

kikuyu: Oo cadhadii Rabbigu aad bay ugu kululaatay reer binu Israa'iil, oo wuxuu yidhi, Quruuntanu way ku xadgudbeen axdigii aan ku amray awowayaashood, oo codkaygiina ma ay dhegaysan;
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,

kikuyu: sidaas daraaddeed hadda ka dib ka eryi maayo hortooda mid ka mid ah quruumihii Yashuuca ka tegey markuu dhintay;
english: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;

kikuyu: si aan iyaga ugu tijaabiyo reer binu Israa'iil bal inay xajiyaan oo ku socdaan jidka Rabbiga, sidii ay awowayaashood u xajiyeen iyo in kale.
english: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep the LORD’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Rabbigu wuu daayay quruumahaas, oo degdegna uma eryin; oo weliba iyagii sooma uu gelin gacantii Yashuuca.
english: So the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa quruumihii Rabbigu u daayay inuu reer binu Israa'iil ku tijaabiyo, oo waxay ahaayeen in alla intii aan ogayn dagaalladii reer Kancaan oo dhan;
english: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

kikuyu: inay reer binu Israa'iil ogaadaan oo uu iyaga baro dagaal ayan waxba ka aqoon jirin.
english: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

kikuyu: Oo kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen shantii amiir oo reer Falastiin, iyo reer Kancaan oo dhan, iyo reer Siidoon, iyo reer Xiwi, oo degganaa Buur Lubnaan, iyo tan iyo Buur Bacal Xermoon, iyo tan iyo meesha laga galo Xamaad.
english: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

kikuyu: Oo kuwaas waxaa loo daayay in reer binu Israa'iil lagu tijaabiyo, in la ogaado bal inay dhegaysanayaan amarradii Rabbiga oo uu ku amray awowayaashood oo uu Muuse soo faray iyo in kale.
english: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the LORD’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay dhex degeen reer Kancaan, kuwaas oo ahaa reer Xeed, iyo reer Amor, iyo reer Feris, iyo reer Xiwi, iyo reer Yebuus.
english: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

kikuyu: Oo gabdhahoodiina way ka guursadeen, oo kuwoodiina wiilashoodii bay u guuriyeen, oo waxay u adeegeen ilaahyadoodii.
english: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna waxay sameeyeen wax Rabbiga hortiisa ku xun, oo Rabbiga Ilaahooda ahna way illoobeen, wayna u adeegeen Bacaliimkii iyo geedihii Asheeraah.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and forgot the LORD their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed cadhadii Rabbigu aad bay ugu kululaatay reer binu Israa'iil, oo wuxuu iyagii ka iibiyey boqorkii Mesobotamiya oo ahaa Kuushan Rishcaatayim; oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay Kuushan Rishcaatayim u adeegayeen siddeed sannadood.
english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

kikuyu: Oo markii reer binu Israa'iil ay Rabbiga u qayshadeen, Rabbigu wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil u kiciyey badbaadiye, kaasoo badbaadiyey, oo wuxuu ahaa Cotnii'eel ina Qenas oo ahaa Kaaleeb walaalkiisii yaraa.
english: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

kikuyu: Oo kaas waxaa ku soo degay Ruuxa Rabbiga, oo wuxuu xukumi jiray reer binu Israa'iil. Dagaal buuna u baxay, oo Rabbiguna wuxuu gacantiisii u geliyey boqorkii Mesobotamiya oo ahaa Kuushan Rishcaatayim, oo isna wuu ka gacan sarreeyey Kuushan Rishcaatayim.
english: The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dalkii xasilloonaa afartan sannadood. Oo Cotnii'eel ina Qenas wuu dhintay.
english: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil mar kalay sameeyeen wax Rabbiga hortiisa ku xun; markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu xoog u yeelay oo reer binu Israa'iil ku diray boqorkii reer Moo'aab oo ahaa Cegloon, maxaa yeelay, waxay sameeyeen wax Rabbiga hortiisa ku xun.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu soo urursaday reer Cammoon iyo reer Camaaleq; kolkaasuu intuu tegey laayay reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxay qabsadeen magaaladii lahayd geedo timireedka.
english: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay boqorkii reer Moo'aab oo Cegloon ahaa u adeegayeen siddeed iyo toban sannadood.
english: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

kikuyu: Laakiinse markii reer binu Israa'iil ay Rabbiga u qayshadeen, Rabbigu wuxuu u kiciyey badbaadiye, kaasoo ahaa Eehuud ina Geeraa, oo reer Benyaamiin, oo ahaa nin gurran. Isaga ayay reer binu Israa'iil hadiyad ugu soo dhiibeen Cegloon kii ahaa boqorkii reer Moo'aab.
english: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

kikuyu: Oo Eehuudna wuxuu samaystay seef laba af leh, oo dhererkeedu yahay dhudhun, oo wuxuu ku xidhay meel dharkiisa ka hoosaysa oo ah bowdadiisa midig.
english: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu hadiyaddii u dhiibay boqorkii reer Moo'aab oo ahaa Cegloon; Cegloonna wuxuu ahaa nin aad u buuran.
english: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

kikuyu: Oo markuu dhammeeyey bixintii hadiyadda ayuu diray dadkii hadiyadda siday.
english: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Eehuud wuxuu ka soo noqday dhagaxyadii qorqornaa Gilgaal agteeda, oo wuxuu yidhi, Boqorow, anigu waxaan kuu wadaa farriin qarsoon. Markaasuu yidhi, Iska aamus. Oo dadkii hareerihiisa taagnaa oo dhammuna dibadday uga baxeen isagii.
english: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Eehuud u yimid isagii; oo isna wuxuu keligiis fadhiyey qowladdii uu ku laydhsan jiray, markaasaa Eehuud wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaan farriin kaaga wadaa Ilaah. Markaasuu ka soo kacay kursigiisii.
english: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

kikuyu: Oo Eehuudna wuxuu soo bixiyey gacantiisii bidix, oo wuxuu seeftii kala soo baxay dhinaca bowdadiisii midig, markaasuu Cegloon caloosha kaga muday,
english: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

kikuyu: oo xataa daabkiina waa galay afkii dabadiis, oo seefta afkeediina waxaa qariyey xaydhii, waayo, seeftii kama uu soo bixin calooshiisii; oo uus baa ka yimid.
english: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Eehuud wuxuu u baxay xagga qolqolka, oo uu soo xidhay qowladda albaabbadeedii, wuuna qufulay.
english: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

kikuyu: Haddaba markuu tegey waxaa yimid addoommadii Cegloon, markaasay intay wax fiiriyeen arkeen albaabbadii qowladda oo qufulan; kolkaasay waxay isyidhaahdeen, Hubaal wuu isku deday qowladdiisa uu ku laydhsado.
english: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

kikuyu: Oo way sugeen ilaa ay isla yaabeen; oo bal eeg isna albaabbadii qowladda ma uu furin, sidaas daraaddeed furahay qaadeen oo albaabbaday fureen, oo markaasay arkeen sayidkoodii oo dhulka ku dhacay oo meyd ah.
english: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

kikuyu: Eehuudna waa baxsaday intay sugayeen, oo wuxuu dhaafay dhagaxyadii qorqornaa, oo wuxuu u fakaday xagga Seciiraah.
english: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

kikuyu: Oo markuu yimid dalkii buuraha lahaa oo reer Efrayim ayuu afuufay buun, oo reer binu Israa'iilna isagay kala dhaadhaceen dalkii buuraha lahaa, oo isna wuu hor socday.
english: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, I soo raaca, waayo, Rabbigu gacantiinnuu soo geliyey reer Moo'aab oo cadaawayaashiinnii ah. Oo iyana isagay ka daba dhaadhaceen, oo waxay reer Moo'aab ka qabsadeen meeshii webiga Urdun laga gudbi jiray, oo ninna uma ay oggolaan inuu ka gudbo.
english: He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

kikuyu: Oo markaasay reer Moo'aab ka laayeen rag toban kun ku dhow, kuwaas oo ahaa kuwo xoog wada leh, oo xataa nin keliyuhu kama baxsan.
english: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

kikuyu: Sidaasay reer Moo'aab ku hoos galeen reer binu Israa'iil; dalkiina wuu xasilloonaa siddeetan sannadood.
english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

kikuyu: Oo isagii ka dibna waxaa kacay Shamgar ina Canaad, kaasoo reer Falastiin lix boqol oo nin kaga laayay usha dibida lagu shuqeeyo, oo isaguna reer Israa'iil wuu badbaadiyey.
english: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iil waxay haddana sameeyeen wax Rabbiga hortiisa ku xun, markii uu Eehuud dhintay dabadeed.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, when Ehud was dead.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu iyagii ka iibiyey boqorkii reer Kancaan oo ahaa Yaabiin oo xukumi jiray Xaasoor; oo sirkaalkii ciidankiisu wuxuu ahaa Siiseraa kaas oo degganaa Xaroshed tii Quruumaha.
english: The LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna waxay u qayshadeen Rabbiga, waayo, ninkaasu wuxuu lahaa sagaal boqol oo gaadhifardood oo bir ah, oo kaasu labaatan sannadood buu reer binu Israa'iil aad u cadaadinayay.
english: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.

kikuyu: Oo waagaas waxaa reer binu Israa'iil xaakimad u ahayd Debooraah, naagtii Lafiidood, taasoo nebiyad ahayd.
english: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.

kikuyu: Oo waxay hoos fadhiyi jirtay geedkii timirta ahaa oo Debooraah, oo u dhexeeyey Raamaah iyo Beytel, oo ku yiil dalkii buuraha lahaa oo reer Efrayim; oo reer binu Israa'iilna iyaday ugu iman jireen inay u gar naqdo.
english: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

kikuyu: Oo iyana cid bay u dirtay, oo Baaraaq ina Abiinocam ayay uga yeedhay Qedesh Naftaali, oo waxay ku tidhi, Miyaan Rabbiga Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil ahu kugu amrin, oo kugu odhan, Tag oo u dhowow Buur Taaboor, oo waxaad kaxaysataa toban kun oo nin oo ah reer Naftaali iyo reer Sebulun?
english: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

kikuyu: Oo anna waxaan Webi Qiishoon kuugu soo dhowayn doonaa Siiseraa oo ah sirkaalka ciidanka Yaabiin, isaga iyo gaadhifardoodkiisa iyo dadkiisa badanba oo gacantaadaan gelin doonaa.
english: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baaraaq wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaad i raacdid, waan tegi doonaa, laakiinse haddaanad i raacin, tegi maayo.
english: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay ku tidhi, Hubaal waan ku raacayaa; habase yeeshee socdaalka aad tegaysaa ahaan maayo mid adiga sharaf kuu leh, waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu Siiseraa ka iibin doonaa naag gacanteed. Kolkaasay Debooraah kacday oo Baaraaq u raacday xagga Qedesh.
english: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for the LORD will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Baaraaq wuxuu Qedesh isugu yeedhay reer Sebulun iyo reer Naftaali; oo waxaa isaga raacay toban kun oo nin; oo Debooraahna isagay raacday.
english: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.

kikuyu: Haddaba Xeber oo ahaa reer Qeyn ayaa hore isaga soocay reer Qeyn, kuwaas oo ahaa reer Xoobaab, Muuse seeddigiis, oo wuxuu meel iyaga ka fog teendhadiisii ka dhistay xagga geedkii ku yiil Sacananniim oo u dhow Qedesh.
english: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

kikuyu: Oo waxay Siiseraa u sheegeen, inuu Baaraaq ina Abiinocam koray Buur Taaboor.
english: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Siiseraa wuxuu gaadhifardoodkiisii oo dhan, kuwaasoo ahaa sagaal boqol oo gaadhifardood oo bir ah, iyo kulli dadkii isaga la joogay oo dhan, ka soo wada urursaday Xaroshed tii Quruumaha, oo wuxuu ku soo urursaday Webi Qiishoon.
english: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

kikuyu: Oo Debooraahna waxay Baaraaq ku tidhi, Kac, waayo, maanta waa maalintii Rabbigu Siiseraa gacantaada soo geliyey. Rabbigu miyaanu ku hor socon? Sidaas daraaddeed Baaraaq wuxuu ka dhaadhacay Buur Taaboor, isagoo ay toban kun oo nin daba socdaan.
english: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t the LORD gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu seef ku dhibay Siiseraa, iyo gaadhifardoodkiisii oo dhan, iyo ciidankiisii oo dhan Baaraaq hortiisa; oo Siiseraa intuu ka degay gaadhifaraskiisii ayuu cagihiisii ku cararay.
english: The LORD confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Baaraaq wuxuu eryooday gaadhifardoodkii iyo ciidankii ilaa Xaroshed tii Quruumaha; oo Siiseraa ciidankiisii oo dhan waxaa lagu laayay seef, oo xataa nin keliyuhu kama hadhin.
english: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Siiseraa cagihiisuu ugu cararay teendhadii Yaaceel taasoo ahayd naagtii Xeber kii reer Qeyn, waayo, nabad baa ka dhexaysay boqorkii Xaasoor oo ahaa Yaabiin iyo reerkii Xeber kii reer Qeyn.
english: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

kikuyu: Oo Yaaceelna intay dibadda u soo baxday inay ka hor tagto Siiseraa, waxay isagii ku tidhi, Soo leexo, sayidkaygiiyow, ii soo leexo, oo ha cabsan. Oo isna intuu ku leexday ayuu galay teendhada, oo markaasay buste ku dedday.
english: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu iyadii ku yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, i sii in yar oo biyo ah oo aan cabbo, waayo, waan harraadsanahay. Kolkaasay u soo furtay sibraar caano ah, oo intay dhansiisay ayay haddana dedday isagii.
english: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu iyadii ku yidhi, Teendhada iriddeeda istaag, oo haddii dad kuu yimaado oo ay i kaa weyddiiyaan, oo ku yidhaahdaan, Halkan nin ma jooga? waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Maya.
english: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa naagtii Xeber oo ahayd Yaaceel ayaa qaadatay qori dhidib ah, oo gacantana waxay ku qabsatay dubbe, oo intay tartiib ugu dhowaatay ayay dhidibkii kaga dhufatay dhafoorka, oo intuu dhidibkii ka dusay ayuu dhulka muday, maxaa yeelay, isagu hurdo weyn buu ku jiray oo aad buu u daalay, oo sidaasuu u dhintay.
english: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, Baaraaq intuu raacdaynayay Siiseraa, ayay Yaaceel u soo baxday inay isagii ka hor timaado, oo waxay ku tidhi, Bal kaalay oo waan ku tusi ninkaad doonaysid. Markaasuu u yimid, oo wuxuu arkay Siiseraa oo jiifa oo meyd ah, oo dhafoorkiisa dhidib ka taagan yahay.
english: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.

kikuyu: Sidaasaa Ilaah maalintaas boqorkii reer Kancaan oo ahaa Yaabiin ugu hoosaysiiyey reer binu Israa'iil hortooda.
english: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.

kikuyu: Oo gacantii reer binu Israa'iil aad iyo aad bay uga sii adkaanaysay boqorkii reer Kancaan oo Yaabiin ahaa, ilaa ay baabbi'iyeen boqorkii reer Kancaan oo Yaabiin ahaa.
english: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

kikuyu: Deedna maalintaas waxaa gabyay Debooraah iyo Baaraaq ina Abiinocam, oo waxay yidhaahdeen,
english: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

kikuyu: Madaxdii baa reer binu Israa'iil hoggaamisay, Dadkiina iyagoo oggol ayay isbixiyeen, Taas aawadeed Rabbiga ammaana.
english: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, LORD!

kikuyu: Bal maqla, Boqorradow; oo dhegaysta, Amiirradow, Anigu anaa u gabyi doona Rabbiga; Ammaan baan ugu gabyi doonaa Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil.
english: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to the LORD. I will sing praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, markaad Seciir ka baxday, Iyo markaad ku socotay berrinkii Edom, Ayaa dhulku gariiray, oo samadiina waa soo da'day, Daruurihiina biyay soo daadsheen.
english: “LORD, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.

kikuyu: Buurihiina way u gariireen Rabbiga aawadiis, Xataa Siinaydaasu way u gariirtay Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil aawadiis.
english: The mountains quaked at the LORD’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Shamgar ina Canaad, Iyo wakhtigii Yaaceel, jidadka waaweynu cidlay ahaayeen, Oo socotooyinkuna waxay mari jireen waddooyin qalqalloocan.
english: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.

kikuyu: Taliyayaashu way ka joogsadeen reer binu Israa'iil, Way joogsadeen ilaa aan anigoo Debooraah ahu kacay, Ilaa aan kacay anigoo reer binu Israa'iil hooyo u ah.
english: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.
