english: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu ku yidhi, Colkaas ma ii geeynaysaa? Isna wuxuu yidhi, Ilaah iigu dhaaro inaadan i dilayn, sayidkaygiina ii gacangelinayn, oo anna colkaas waan kuu geeynayaa.
english: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”

kikuyu: Oo markuu keenay waxay ku kala firidhsanaayeen dhulka oo dhan, iyagoo wax cabbaya, oo wax cunaya, oo cayaaraya, maxaa yeelay, maal badan bay ka soo dhaceen dalkii reer Falastiin iyo dalkii Yahuudahba.
english: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna wuxuu laynayay iyagii fiidkii ilaa fiidkiisii kale, oo nin iyagii ahuna ma baxsan, afar boqol oo dhallinyaro ah oo intay awr fuuleen ku carartay mooyaane.
english: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna wuu soo wada dhiciyey waxay reer Camaaleq la tageen oo dhan; oo labadiisii naagoodna Daa'uud waa soo badbaadiyey.
english: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

kikuyu: Oo waxba kama maqnayn iyagii, wax yar iyo wax weyn toona, ama wiilal iyo gabdho toona, ama booli iyo wixii ay la tageen oo dhan toona; oo Daa'uudna wuu soo wada celiyey kulligood.
english: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud kaxaystay idihii iyo lo'dii oo dhan, oo waxay ku hor kexeeyeen xoolihii kale, oo yidhaahdeen, Intanu waa boolidii Daa'uud.
english: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna wuxuu u yimid labadii boqol oo nin oo intay daaleen Daa'uud raaci kari weyday, oo ay durdurkii Besoor agtiisa kaga tageen, oo iyana waxay u soo baxeen inay ka hor tagaan Daa'uud iyo dadkii la jiray; oo Daa'uudna markuu dadkii u soo dhowaaday ayuu nabdaadiyey.
english: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

kikuyu: Markaasay raggii sharka lahaa ee waxmatarayaasha ahaa oo Daa'uud raacay oo dhammuba waxay ugu jawaabeen, Maalkii aannu soo dhacsannay iyaga waxba ka siin mayno, maxaa yeelay, nama ay raacin, laakiinse nin kasta waxaannu siinaynaa naagtiisii iyo carruurtiisii, ee ha kaxaysteen oo ha iska tageen.
english: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu yidhi, Walaalahayow, waa inaydnaan saas ku samayn wixii Rabbigu ina siiyey, kaasoo ah kii ina badbaadiyey, oo weliba inoo soo gacangeliyey colkii ina soo weeraray.
english: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which the LORD has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal yaa waxaa idinka maqlaya? Ka dagaalka u baxaa siduu qayb u helo ayuu ka alaabta ku hadhaana qayb u helayaa; isku si waa inay u qaybsadaan.
english: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”

kikuyu: Maalintaas intay ka bilaabanto ilaa maantadan la joogo, wuxuu taas uga dhigay reer binu Israa'iil, qaynuun iyo amar.
english: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna markuu Siiqlag yimid ayuu boolidii qaarkeed odayaashii dalkii Yahuudah u diray, iyo xataa saaxiibbadiis, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eega, tanu waa hadiyad ka mid ah boolidii aan cadaawayaashii Rabbiga ka soo dhacay,
english: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”

kikuyu: oo wuxuu u wada diray kuwii Beytel joogay, iyo kuwii Raamod tii koonfureed joogay, iyo xataa kuwii Yatiir joogay,
english: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

kikuyu: iyo kuwii Carooceer joogay, iyo kuwii Sifmood joogay, iyo kuwii Eshtemooca joogay,
english: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

kikuyu: iyo kuwii Raakaal joogay, iyo kuwii magaalooyinka reer Yeraxme'eel joogay, iyo kuwii magaalooyinka reer Qeyn joogay,
english: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

kikuyu: iyo kuwii Xormaah joogay, iyo kuwii Koor Caashaan joogay, iyo kuwii Cataag joogay,
english: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

kikuyu: iyo kuwii Xebroon joogay, oo xataa wuu u wada diray kuwii joogay meelihii Daa'uud iyo raggiisu ku noqnoqon jireen oo dhan.
english: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

kikuyu: Haddaba reer Falastiin waxay la dirireen reer binu Israa'iil, oo raggii reer binu Israa'iilna way ka carareen reer Falastiin, oo Buur Gilboca ayay ku daateen iyagoo la laayay.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Oo reer Falastiinna aad bay u eryadeen Saa'uul iyo wiilashiisii, markaasaa reer Falastiin waxay dileen Yoonaataan, iyo Abiinaadaab, iyo Melkiishuuca oo ahaa Saa'uul wiilashiisii.
english: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

kikuyu: Oo dagaalkiina aad buu ugu sii kululaaday Saa'uul, oo waxaa isagii gaadhay qaansoleydii, oo isna qaansoleydii aawadeed ayuu dhib badan ula kulmay.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Saa'uul wuxuu kii hubka u siday ku yidhi, War seeftaada la soo bax oo iga mudhbixi, waaba intaasoo buuryoqabyadanu yimaadaan oo ay intay seef iga mudhbixiyaan i caayaane. Laakiinse kii hubka u siday wuu diiday, waayo, aad buu u cabsaday. Sidaas daraaddeed Saa'uul wuxuu qaatay seeftiisii, markaasuu ku dul dhacay.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

kikuyu: Oo kii hubka u sidayna markuu arkay in Saa'uul dhintay, isna wuxuu ku dul dhacay seeftiisii, wuuna la dhintay.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed maalintaas waxaa wada dhintay Saa'uul, iyo saddexdiisii wiil, iyo kii hubka u siday, iyo raggiisii oo dhan.
english: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.

kikuyu: Oo raggii reer binu Israa'iil oo dooxadii dhankeeda kale joogay, iyo kuwii Webi Urdun shishadiisa joogay, markay arkeen in raggii reer binu Israa'iil carareen oo Saa'uul iyo wiilashiisii ay dhinteen ayay magaalooyinkii ka tageen oo carareen; markaasaa reer Falastiin yimaadeen oo iska degeen.
english: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: Oo maalintii dambe markay reer Falastiin u yimaadeen inay dharka ka furtaan kuwii la dilay waxay heleen Saa'uul iyo saddexdiisii wiil oo Buur Gilboca ku dhintay.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Markaasay madaxii ka gooyeen, oo hubkiisiina way ka furteen, oo waxay u cid direen dalkii reer Falastiin oo ku wareegsanaa inay u wargeeyaan gurigii sanamyadooda iyo dadkiiba.
english: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.

kikuyu: Oo hubkiisiina gurigii Cashtarod ayay dhigeen, meydkiisiina derbigii Beytshaan bay ku xidheen.
english: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

kikuyu: Oo dadkii Yaabeesh Gilecaad degganaa markay maqleen waxyaalihii ay reer Falastiin Saa'uul ku sameeyeen,
english: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

kikuyu: waxaa kacay raggii xoogga lahaa oo dhan, oo habeenkii oo dhan ayay sii guuraynayeen, markaasay Beytshaan derbigiisii ka soo qaadeen Saa'uul meydkiisii iyo meydadkii wiilashiisa, kolkaasay yimaadeen Yaabeesh, oo halkaasay ku gubeen.
english: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.

kikuyu: Markaasay lafahoodii qaadeen oo ku aaseen geed Yaabeesh ku yiil hoostiisa, toddoba maalmoodna way soomeen.
english: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

kikuyu: Dhimashadii Saa'uul dabadeed, markii Daa'uud ka soo noqday layntii reer Camaaleq oo uu Daa'uud laba maalmood Siiqlag sii joogay
english: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,

kikuyu: ayaa xataa maalintii saddexaad nin ka yimid xeradii Saa'uul isagoo maryo jeexjeexan, madaxana ciidu kaga taal, oo markuu Daa'uud u yimid ayuu dhulka ku dhacay oo sujuuday.
english: on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the earth and showed respect.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud ku yidhi, Xaggee baad ka timid? Markaasuu isna wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan ka soo baxsaday xeradii reer binu Israa'iil.
english: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”

kikuyu: Daa'uudna wuxuu ku yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, sidee baa wax u dhaceen? Bal ii sheeg. Oo isna wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Dadkii dagaalkii way ka carareen, oo dadkii badidiisiina way le'deen; oo Saa'uul iyo wiilkiisii Yoonaataanba waa dhinteen.
english: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu ku yidhi ninkii dhallinyarada ahaa, oo u soo warramay, War sidee baad u ogaatay in Saa'uul iyo wiilkiisii Yoonaataanba ay dhinteen?
english: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa ninkii dhallinyarada ahaa oo u soo warramay, wuxuu ku yidhi, Markaan si lamafilaan ah Buur Gilboca u soo gaadhay, waxaan arkay Saa'uul oo ku tiirsan warankiisii, gaadhifardoodkii iyo fardooleydiina aad bay u eryanayeen.
english: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him.

kikuyu: Oo markuu gadaashiisa dhugtay ayuu i arkay, oo ii yeedhay. Oo anna waxaan ugu jawaabay, Waa i kan.
english: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu igu yidhi, Yaad tahay? Oo anna waxaan ugu jawaabay, Nin reer Camaaleq ah baan ahay.
english: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu igu yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, bal i soo ag joogso, oo i dil, waayo, wareer baa i haya; waayo, weli naftii waa igu jirtaa.
english: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’

kikuyu: Saas aawadeed waan ag joogsaday oo waan dilay, maxaa yeelay, waan hubay markuu dhacay dabadeed inuusan noolaanayn; oo markaasaan ka soo qaaday taajkii madaxa u saarnaa, iyo dugaagaddii gacanta ugu jirtay, waanan kuu keenay, sayidkaygiiyow.
english: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud dharkiisii jeexjeexay; oo raggii isaga la jiray oo dhammuna saasoo kalay wada yeeleen,
english: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.

kikuyu: wayna u baroorteen, oo u ooyeen, oo u soomeen ilaa fiidkii Saa'uul, iyo wiilkiisii Yoonaataan, iyo dadkii Rabbiga, iyo reer binu Israa'iil aawadood; maxaa yeelay, seef bay ku le'deen.
english: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Daa'uud ku yidhi ninkii dhallinyarada ahaa oo u soo warramay, Xaggee baad ka timid? Isna wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Waxaan ahay nin qalaad wiilkiis oo reer Camaaleq ah.
english: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”

kikuyu: Daa'uudna wuxuu ku yidhi isagii, Sidee baad uga cabsan weyday inaad gacantaada u qaaddo Rabbiga kiisa subkan?
english: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”

kikuyu: Dabadeedna Daa'uud wuxuu u yeedhay raggii dhallinyarada ahaa midkood, oo ku yidhi, U dhowow oo dil. Markaasuu dilay, isna wuu dhintay.
english: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.

kikuyu: Daa'uudna wuxuu ku yidhi, Dhiiggaagu madaxaaga ha saarnaado; waayo, afkaagaa kugu marag furay, oo waxaad tidhi, Rabbiga kiisa subkan ayaan dilay.
english: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain the LORD’s anointed.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud baroortan ugu baroortay Saa'uul iyo wiilkiisii Yoonaataan,
english: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku amray inay carruurta dalka Yahuudah baraan gabayga qaansada; oo bal eeg, kaasu wuxuu ku qoran yahay kitaabka Yaashaar.
english: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iilow, Ammaantiinnii waxaa lagu dilay meelihiinna sarsare! Bal eega kuwa xoogga leh siday u dhaceen!
english: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!

kikuyu: Haddaba taas Gad ha ku sheegina, Oo jidadka Ashqeloonna ha ku caddaynina; Waaba intaasoo ay naagaha reer Falastiin ku farxaane, Waaba intaasoo ay buuryoqabyada naagahoodu ku guulaystaane.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

kikuyu: Buuraha Gilbocow, Dharab iyo roob midna yaan laydinku arkin, beerihii qurbaanyadu ka bixi jireenna yaanay jirin, Waayo, kuwii xoogga lahaa gaashaankoodii ayaa halkaas lagu tuuray, Xataa gaashaankii Saa'uul oo ahaa sida mid aan saliid lagu subkin.
english: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields of offerings; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away, the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.

kikuyu: Kuwii la laayay dhiiggoodii, iyo kuwii xoogga lahaa xaydhoodii, Yoonaataan qaansadiisii dib ugama ay soo noqon, Oo Saa'uul seeftiisiina madhnaan kuma ay soo noqon.
english: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow didn’t turn back. Saul’s sword didn’t return empty.

kikuyu: Intay noolaayeen Saa'uul iyo Yoonaataan waxay ahaayeen kuwo la jecel yahay, oo macaan, Markay dhinteenna, lama kala geeyn, Gorgorrada way ka dheereeyeen, Libaaxyadana way ka xoog badnaayeen.
english: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.

kikuyu: Gabdhaha reer binu Israa'iilow, Saa'uul u ooya, Kii dhar cas si raaxa leh idiin huwiyey, Oo dharkiinnana dahab ku sharraxay.
english: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.

kikuyu: Kuwii xoogga badnaa siday dagaalka ugu dhex dhaceen! Yoonaataan waxaa lagu dilay meelihiinna sarsare.
english: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places.

kikuyu: Anigu daraaddaa baan u dhibtooday, walaalkay Yoonaataanow; Adigu aad baad iigu macaanayd, Oo jacaylkaad ii qabtay wuxuu ahaa mid yaab leh, Oo xataa caashaqa naagaha dhaafaya.
english: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.

kikuyu: Bal eeg kuwii xoogga badnaa siday u dhaceen, Hubkii dagaalkuna siduu u hallaabay!
english: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”

kikuyu: Markaas dabadeed Daa'uud baa Rabbiga wax weyddiiyey, oo yidhi, Magaalooyinka dalka Yahuudah middood ma u kacaa? Rabbiguna wuxuu ku yidhi, Haah, u kac. Markaasaa Daa'uud yidhi, Xaggee baan u kacaa? Isna wuxuu yidhi, Xebroon tag.
english: After this, David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” The LORD said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”

kikuyu: Saas daraaddeed Daa'uud halkaasuu u kacay, oo labadiisii naagoodna way raaceen, kuwaas oo ahaa Axiinocam tii reer Yesreceel, iyo Abiigayil oo u dhaxday Naabaal kii reer Karmel.
english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

kikuyu: Oo raggiisii isaga la jirayna Daa'uud wuu kaxaystay, iyadoo nin waluba reerkiisii wato; oo waxay degeen magaalooyinkii Xebroon.
english: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii dalka Yahuudah yimid, oo halkaasay Daa'uud ugu subkeen inuu ahaado boqor u taliya dalka Yahuudah. Waxaana Daa'uud loo sheegay, oo lagu yidhi, Kuwii Saa'uul aasay waxay ahaayeen dadka reer Yaabeesh Gilecaad.
english: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wargeeyayaal u diray dadkii reer Yaabeesh Gilecaad, oo ku yidhi, Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, waayo, waad u roonaateen oo aasteen sayidkiinnii Saa'uul ahaa.
english: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by the LORD, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbigu ha idiin roonaado oo runtana ha idin tuso; oo anna waan idiinka abaalgudi doonaa roonaantaas, maxaa yeelay, idinku waxaas baad samayseen.
english: Now may the LORD show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

kikuyu: Haddaba gacmihiinnu ha xoogaysteen, oo idinna xoog yeesha, waayo, sayidkiinnii Saa'uul waa dhintay, oo reer Yahuudahna anigay ii subkeen inaan u ahaado boqor u taliya.
english: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Abneer oo ahaa ina Neer, oo Saa'uul ciidankiisa sirkaal u ahaa ayaa soo kaxaystay Iishboshed oo ahaa ina Saa'uul, oo wuxuu u soo gudbiyey xagga Maxanayim;
english: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu boqor uga dhigay reer Gilecaad, iyo reer Ashuur, iyo Yesreceel, iyo reer Efrayim, iyo Benyaamiin, iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan.
english: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

kikuyu: (Oo Iishboshed oo ahaa ina Saa'uul afartan sannadood buu jiray markii uu bilaabay inuu boqor u noqdo reer binu Israa'iil, oo wuxuuna boqor u ahaa laba sannadood.) Laakiinse reer Yahuudah waxay raaceen Daa'uud.
english: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigii Daa'uud Xebroon boqorka ugu ahaa reer Yahuudah wuxuu ahaa toddoba sannadood iyo lix bilood.
english: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abneer oo ahaa ina Neer, iyo addoommadii Iishboshed ina Saa'uul, Maxanayim ka soo baxeen, oo waxay tageen Gibecoon.
english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Yoo'aab oo ay Seruuyaah dhashay, iyo addoommadii Daa'uud soo baxeen, oo waxay ku wada kulmeen balligii Gibecoon agtiisa; oo iyana qolo waxay balliga ka fadhiisatay dhinac, qoladii kalena waxay balliga ka fadhiisteen dhinacii kale.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abneer wuxuu Yoo'aab ku yidhi, Waan ku baryayaaye, ragga dhallinyarada ahu ha kaceen oo horteenna ha ku cayaareen. Yoo'aabna wuxuu yidhi, Waa yahay ee ha kaceen.
english: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab said, “Let them arise!”

kikuyu: Markaasay kaceen oo tiro ku gudbeen; oo waxay ahaayeen laba iyo toban reer Benyaamiin ah, oo ka socda xaggii Iishboshed oo ahaa ina Saa'uul, iyo laba iyo toban ka socda addoommadii Daa'uud.
english: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.

kikuyu: Oo mid waluba ninkiisii ayuu madaxa qabsaday, oo seeftiisii ayuu dhinaca ka daray midkii uu haystay. Sidaasay dhammaantood u wada dhaceen. Saas aawadeed meeshaas oo Gibecoon ku taal waxaa loo baxshay Xelqad Hasuriim.
english: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

kikuyu: Oo dagaalkiina aad buu u kululaaday maalintaas; oo waxaa laga adkaaday Abneer, iyo raggii reer binu Israa'iil, waxaana ka reeyey addoommadii Daa'uud.
english: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.

kikuyu: Oo saddexdii wiil ee ay Seruuyaah dhashay halkaas ayay wada joogeen, kuwaasoo ahaa Yoo'aab iyo Abiishay iyo Casaaheel. Casaaheelna wuxuu u cago fududaa sida cawsha duurka.
english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Casaaheel wuxuu eryaday Abneer, oo intuu Abneer eryanayayna uma uu leexan midig iyo bidix toona.
english: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abneer gadaashiisa dhugtay, oo wuxuu yidhi, War ma adigii baa, Casaaheelow? Oo isna wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Haah, waa anigii.
english: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abneer wuxuu ku yidhi, War midigta ama bidixda u leexo, oo ragga dhallinyarada ah midkood qabso, oo ka soo qaado hubkiisa dagaalka. Laakiinse Casaaheel wuu diiday inuu isaga ka leexdo.
english: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abneer haddana Casaaheel ku yidhi, War ha i eryane, gees iiga leexo; maxaan dhulka kuugu dhufanayaa? Haddaba sidee baan wejiga u siin karayaa walaalkaa Yoo'aab?
english: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee wuu diiday inuu gees uga leexdo; sidaas daraaddeed Abneer waranka dabadiisii ayuu caloosha kaga dhuftay, warankiina dib buu uga mudhbaxay; markaasuu halkaas ku dhacay, oo isla meeshaasuu ku dhintay; oo in alla intii soo gaadhay meeshii Casaaheel ku dhacay oo ku dhintay way wada istaageen.
english: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Yoo'aab iyo Abiishay waxay eryadeen Abneer; oo qorraxdiina way dhacday markii ay yimaadeen buurtii Ammaah oo ku hor taal Giyax ee ku ag taal waddada cidlada Gibecoon.
english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Benyaamiin dhammaantood soo wada urureen oo Abneer soo daba galeen, oo waxay noqdeen guuto keliya, markaasay buur isku dul taageen.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna Abneer wuxuu u dhawaaqay Yoo'aab, oo ku yidhi, War seeftu miyey weligeed baabbi'inaysaa? Ugudambaystase inay qadhaadh noqonayso sow ma ogid? Haddaba ilaa goormay noqonaysaa markaad dadka kala hadlayso inay ka hadhaan walaalahooda ay eryanayaan?
english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yoo'aab wuxuu yidhi, Rabbiga noloshiisaan ku dhaartaye, haddaadan hadlin, hubaal dadku subaxda waa iska tegi lahaa oo ninnaba walaalkiis ma eryadeen.
english: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Yoo'aab buunkii buu afuufay, oo dadkii oo dhammu way wada istaageen, oo mar dambe reer binu Israa'iilna ma ayan eryan, kol kalena ma ay diririn.
english: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

kikuyu: Oo Abneer iyo raggiisiina habeenkii oo dhan ayay sii dhex guuraynayeen Caraabaah; wayna ka gudbeen Webi Urdun, oo Bitroon oo dhanna way dhex mareen, oo waxay yimaadeen Maxanayim.
english: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

kikuyu: Oo Yoo'aabna wuu ka noqday eryadkii uu Abneer eryanayay; oo markuu dadkii oo dhan soo urursaday, waxaa addoommadii Daa'uud ka dhinnaaday sagaal iyo toban nin iyo Casaaheel.
english: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.

kikuyu: Laakiinse addoommadii Daa'uud wax bay reer Benyaamiin iyo raggii Abneer ka laayeen, oo waxaa ka dhintay saddex boqol iyo lixdan nin.
english: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin and Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.

kikuyu: Markaasay Casaaheel qaadeen oo ku aaseen qabrigii aabbihiis, oo ku yiil Beytlaxam. Oo Yoo'aab iyo raggiisiina habeenkii oo dhan ayay guureeyeen oo waxaa waagu ugu beryay Xebroon.
english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa jiray dagaal dheer oo dhex maray reer Saa'uul iyo reer Daa'uud; oo Daa'uudna waa sii xoog badnaanayay, laakiinse reer Saa'uul way sii xoog yaraanayeen.
english: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna wiilal baa ugu dhashay Xebroon. Curadkiisu wuxuu ahaa Amnoon, oo waxaa dhashay Axiinocam tii reer Yesreceel.
english: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

kikuyu: Wiilkiisii labaadna wuxuu ahaa Kile'aab, oo waxaa dhashay Abiigayil oo u dhaxday Naabaal kii reer Karmel. Kan saddexaadna wuxuu ahaa Absaaloom oo waxaa dhashay Macakaah oo ahayd boqorkii Geshuur oo Talmay ahaa gabadhiisii.
english: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

kikuyu: Kan afraadna wuxuu ahaa Adoniiyaah oo waxaa dhashay Xaggiid. Kan shanaadna wuxuu ahaa Shefatyaah oo waxaa dhashay Abiital.
english: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

kikuyu: Kan lixaadna wuxuu ahaa Yitrecaam, oo waxaa dhashay Ceglaah oo Daa'uud u dhaxday. Intaasu waxay Daa'uud ugu dhasheen Xebroon.
english: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

kikuyu: Intii ay reer Saa'uul iyo reer Daa'uud dagaallamayeen ayaa Abneer aad ugu xoogaystay reerkii Saa'uul.
english: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.

kikuyu: Haddaba Saa'uul wuxuu lahaa naag addoon ah oo magaceedana la odhan jiray Risfaah, waxayna ahayd ina Ayah; oo Iishboshed wuxuu Abneer ku yidhi, War maxaad ugu tagtay addoontii aabbahay?
english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abneer aad ugu cadhooday erayadii Iishboshed, oo wuxuu yidhi, Anigu ma waxaan ahay madax eey oo reer Yahuudah leeyihiin? Bal maanta raxmad baan tusayaa reerkii aabbahaa Saa'uul, iyo walaalihiis, iyo saaxiibbadiis, oo adigana kuuma aan gacangelin Daa'uud, oo weliba maanta waxaad igu eedaynaysaa wax ku saabsan naagtan.
english: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!

kikuyu: Haddaba sidii Rabbigu ugu dhaartay Daa'uud, Ilaah saas iyo si ka sii badanba anoo Abneer ah, ha igu sameeyo haddaanan saas oo kale isaga ku samayn,
english: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as the LORD has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:

kikuyu: taasoo ah inaan boqortooyada ka wareejiyo reer Saa'uul, iyo inaan carshiga Daa'uud u qotomiyo reer binu Israa'iil iyo reer binu Yahuudah, iyo tan iyo Daan iyo ilaa Bi'ir Shebac.
english: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

kikuyu: Oo isna eray dambe wuu ugu jawaabi waayay Abneer, maxaa yeelay, wuu ka cabsanayay.
english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abneer wuxuu Daa'uud u soo diray wargeeyayaal magiciisa ku hadlaya, oo leh, War dhulka yaa leh? Oo wuxuu kaloo ku yidhi, Heshiis ila dhigo, anna gacan baan ku siinayaa, inaan kuu soo wada jeediyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan.
english: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Waa hagaag; heshiis baan kula dhiganayaa, laakiinse wax baan kaa doonayaa, taasuna waxaa weeyaan, markaad ii timaadid waa inaadan i hor iman adoo marka hore Miikaal oo ah ina Saa'uul i soo hor taaga mooyaane.
english: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna wargeeyayaal buu u diray Iishboshed oo ahaa ina Saa'uul, isagoo leh, Ii keen naagtaydii Miikaal, oo aan ku guursaday boqol buuryo oo reer Falastiin.
english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Iishboshed rag u diray oo iyadii ka soo kexeeyey ninkeedii, kaasoo ahaa Faltii'eel ina Layish.
english: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

kikuyu: Markaasaa ninkeedii soo raacay iyadii, isagoo ooyaya intuu socday oo dhan, oo wuxuu iyadii daba socday tan iyo Baxuuriim. Markaasaa Abneer ku yidhi, War orod, oo iska noqo. Kolkaasuu iska noqday.
english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.

kikuyu: Oo Abneerna wuxuu la arrinsaday odayaashii reer binu Israa'iil, oo ku yidhi, Waa hore waxaad doonayseen in Daa'uud boqor idiin noqdo.
english: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

kikuyu: Haddaba haatan sidii yeela, waayo, Rabbigu Daa'uud buu ka hadlay, oo yidhi, Addoonkayga Daa'uud gacantiisa ayaan dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil kaga badbaadin doonaa gacanta reer Falastiin iyo gacanta cadaawayaashooda oo dhanba.
english: Now then do it! For the LORD has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”

kikuyu: Oo Abneer wuxuu kaloo la hadlay reer Benyaamiin; oo weliba Abneer wuxuu Daa'uud ugu yimid Xebroon si uu ugu sheego waxa la wanaagsan reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, iyo reer Benyaamiin oo dhanba.
english: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Saas aawadeed Abneer wuxuu Daa'uud ugu yimid Xebroon, labaatan nin baana la socday. Oo Daa'uudna diyaafad ayuu Abneer iyo raggii la socdayba u sameeyey.
english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Abneer Daa'uud ku yidhi, Anigu waan kacayaa, waanan tegayaa, oo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhanna waan kuu soo wada ururin doonaa, boqorow, sayidkaygiiyow, inay axdi kula dhigtaan oo adna aad xukuntid in alla intii naftaadu doonayso. Markaasaa Daa'uud Abneer iska diray; oo isna nabad buu ku tegey.
english: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, Daa'uud addoommadiisii iyo Yoo'aabba waxay ka yimaadeen duulaan, iyagoo dhac badan wada, laakiinse Abneer Daa'uud lama joogin Xebroon, waayo, wuu iska diray, oo isna nabad buu ku tegey.
english: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

kikuyu: Oo markii Yoo'aab iyo ciidankii la jiray oo dhammu ay yimaadeen waxaa Yoo'aab loo sheegay, oo lagu yidhi, Waxaa boqorka u yimid Abneer ina Neer, oo isna wuu iska diray, markaasuu nabad ku tegey.
english: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yoo'aab boqorkii u yimid, oo ku yidhi, Maxaad samaysay? Bal eeg, Abneer baa kuu yimid, maxaad u dirtay oo uu u tegey?
english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?

kikuyu: Abneer oo ah ina Neer waad garanaysaa inuu kuugu yimid inuu ku khiyaaneeyo, iyo inuu ogaado bixiddaada iyo soo geliddaada, iyo weliba inuu sii ogaado waxaad samaysid oo dhanba.
english: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”

kikuyu: Yoo'aabna markuu Daa'uud ka soo baxay ayuu rag ka daba diray Abneer, oo waxay ka soo celiyeen ceelkii Siraah, laakiinse taas Daa'uud ma ogayn.
english: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.

kikuyu: Oo markuu Abneer ku soo noqday Xebroon ayaa Yoo'aab gees ula baxay oo iridda la dhex galay si uu ula faqo, markaasuu caloosha ka dooxay si uu u dhinto, maxaa yeelay, dhiiggii walaalkiis Casaaheel ayuu daadshay.
english: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna markuu Daa'uud taas maqlay ayuu yidhi, Aniga iyo boqortooyadayda midna eed kuma lahayn Rabbiga hortiisa xagga dhiigga Abneer ina Neer.
english: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

kikuyu: Yoo'aab madaxiisa ha saarnaado, iyo reerka aabbihiis, oo reer Yoo'aabna yaan laga waayin mid cudur dheecaan leh qaba, iyo mid baras qaba, iyo mid ul ku tukubaya, iyo mid seef lagu dilo, ama mid cunto la'.
english: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”

kikuyu: Sidaasay Yoo'aab iyo walaalkiis Abiishay u dileen Abneer, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu walaalkood Casaaheel ku dilay dagaalkii Gibecoon.
english: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu ku yidhi Yoo'aab iyo dadkii isaga la jiray oo dhan, Dharkiinna jeexjeexa oo dhar joonyad ah guntada, oo Abneer hortiisa ku baroorta. Oo Boqor Daa'uudna wuxuu raacay naxashkii.
english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.

kikuyu: Oo Abneer waxaa lagu aasay Xebroon, boqorkiina codkiisii kor buu u qaaday, oo qabrigii Abneer ku dul ooyay; oo dadkii oo dhammuna way wada ooyeen.
english: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

kikuyu: Oo boqorkiina wuxuu u baroortay Abneer, oo yidhi, Miyey habboon tahay in Abneer u dhinto sida nacas u dhinto oo kale?
english: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?

kikuyu: Gacmahaagu ma xidhnayn, cagahaaguna ma dabranayn, Sida nin ugu dhaco dad dembi leh hortooda ayaad u dhacday. Markaasaa dadkii oo dhammu mar kale u ooyay isagii.
english: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All the people wept again over him.

kikuyu: Markaasay dadkii oo dhammu yimaadeen oo damceen inay Daa'uud wax cunsiiyaan intii ay maalinnimada ahayd; laakiinse Daa'uud wuu dhaartay, oo yidhi, Ilaah taasoo kale ha igu sameeyo, iyo weliba tu ka sii badan, haddaan kibis dhadhansho, iyo wax kale toona, ilaa ay qorraxdu dhacdo.
english: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii oo dhammu taas u fiirsadeen, wayna la wanaagsanayd, oo wax alla wixii boqorku sameeyey ayaa la wanaagsanaa dadkii oo dhan.
english: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

kikuyu: Sidaasay dadkii oo dhan iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu maalintaas u garteen inuusan boqorku doonaynin in Abneer oo ahaa ina Neer la dilo.
english: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

kikuyu: Oo boqorkii wuxuu addoommadiisii ku yidhi, War miyeydnaan ogayn maanta inuu reer binu Israa'iil ku dhex dhintay amiir iyo nin weyn?
english: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?

kikuyu: Oo anigu maanta in kastoo lay boqray, waan taag yarahay; oo nimankan ay Seruuyaah dhashay ayaa iga xoog badan. Kii shar sameeya Rabbigu ha ugu abaalgudo sida sharkiisu yahay.
english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May the LORD reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”

kikuyu: Oo Saa'uul wiilkiisii Iishboshed ahaa markuu maqlay in Abneer Xebroon ku dhintay ayaa gacmihiisii taag beeleen, oo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammuna way nexeen.
english: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

kikuyu: Oo Saa'uul wiilkiisii Iishboshed ahaana wuxuu lahaa laba nin oo askartiisa saraakiil u ahaa. Mid magiciisu wuxuu ahaa Bacanaah, oo kan kale magiciisuna wuxuu ahaa Reekaab, oo waxayna ahaayeen ilmo Rimmon kii reer Bi'irod, oo waxayna ahaayeen reer Benyaamiin (waayo, Bi'irod waxaa lagu tiriyey reer Benyaamiin,
english: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;

kikuyu: oo reer Bi'irodna waxay u carareen xagga Gitayim, oo halkaasay degganaayeen ilaa maantadan).
english: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today).

kikuyu: Yoonaataan ina Saa'uul wuxuu lahaa wiil curyaan ah. Oo isagu shan jir buu ahaa markii war ku saabsan Saa'uul iyo Yoonaataan Yesreceel laga keenay, ee ay naagtii isaga dhawraysay kor u qaadatay, oo carartay. Oo intay ku degdegaysay inay cararto ayuu ka dhacay, oo markaasuu curyaan noqday. Oo magiciisuna wuxuu ahaa Mefiiboshed.
english: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

kikuyu: Oo Rimmonkii reer Bi'irod wiilashiisii oo ahaa Reekaab iyo Bacanaah way tageen, oo wakhti kulul ayay gurigii Iishboshed yimaadeen, isagoo hadhkii nasanaya.
english: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.

kikuyu: Oo gurigay soo galeen, sidii iyagoo sarreen qaadanaya; markaasay caloosha ka dooxeen. Markaasaa Reekaab iyo walaalkiis Bacanaah baxsadeen.
english: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

kikuyu: Markay guriga soo galeen, isagoo sariirta ku jiifa oo qolka la seexdo ku jira, ayay garaaceen oo dileen, oo madaxiina way ka gooyeen oo la tageen, markaasay jidkii Caraabaah habeenkii oo dhan sii guuraynayeen.
english: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, killed him, beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.

kikuyu: Oo Iishboshed madaxiisii ayay Daa'uud ugu keeneen Xebroon, oo waxay boqorkii ku yidhaahdeen, Bal eeg madaxii Iishboshed ee uu dhalay Saa'uul kii cadowgaaga ahaa oo doonayay inuu nafta kaa qaado; haddaba sayidkaygiiyow, boqorow, Rabbigu maanta waa kaaga aar guday Saa'uul iyo farcankiisiiba.
english: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! The LORD has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud ugu jawaabay Reekaab iyo walaalkiis Bacanaah, oo ahaa ilma Rimmonkii reer Bi'irod, Waxaan ku dhaartay nolosha Rabbigii naftayda ka badbaadshay cidhiidhi oo dhan,
english: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

kikuyu: markii mid ii soo sheegay inuu Saa'uul dhintay, isagoo u malaynaya inuu war wanaagsan ii sido, waan qabtay oo Siiqlag baan ku dilay, taasuna waxay ahayd abaalgudkii aan warkiisii ka siiyey.
english: when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.

kikuyu: Haddaba idinkoo ah niman shar leh, markaad disheen qof xaq ah oo sariirtii gurigiisa ku jiifa, miyaanan in ka sii badan dhiiggiisii gacmihiinna weyddiinayn, oo miyaanan dhulka idinka qaadayn?
english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud amray raggiisii dhallinyarada ahaa, wayna dileen iyagii, oo waxay ka jareen gacmihii iyo cagihii, oo ka soo lalmiyeen balliga Xebroon ku yaal agtiisa. Laakiinse Iishboshed madaxiisii intay qaadeen ayay ku aaseen qabrigii Abneer oo Xebroon ku yiil.
english: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.

kikuyu: Markaasaa qabiilooyinkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay Daa'uud ugu yimaadeen Xebroon, oo intay la hadleen ayay ku yidhaahdeen, Annagu waxaannu nahay laftaada iyo jidhkaaga.
english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

kikuyu: Waagii hore oo Saa'uul boqorka noo ahaa, adiguu ahaa kii reer binu Israa'iil dibadda u bixin jiray oo gudaha soo gelin jiray; oo Rabbiguna wuxuu kugu yidhi, Adigu waxaad quudin doontaa dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil, oo amiir baanad u ahaan doontaa reer binu Israa'iil.
english: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. The LORD said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed odayaashii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay boqorkii ugu yimaadeen Xebroon; oo Boqor Daa'uudna wuxuu iyagii axdi kula dhigtay Xebroon Rabbiga hortiisa, oo iyana waxay Daa'uud u boqreen inuu ahaado boqor reer binu Israa'iil u taliya.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna soddon sannadood buu jiray markuu bilaabay inuu boqor noqdo, oo wuxuuna boqor ahaa afartan sannadood.
english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

kikuyu: Oo reer Yahuudahna wuxuu Xebroon ugu talinayay toddoba sannadood iyo lix bilood, oo reer Israa'iil oo dhan iyo reer Yahuudahna wuxuu Yeruusaalem ugu talinayay saddex iyo soddon sannadood.
english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

kikuyu: Oo boqorkii iyo raggiisiiba waxay tageen Yeruusaalem, inay ku duulaan reer Yebuus oo ahaa dadkii dalka degganaa, kuwaasoo la hadlay Daa'uud oo ku yidhi, Adoo kuwa indhaha la' iyo curyaannada qaada mooyaane halkan iman maysid, waayo, waxay u maleeyeen inuusan Daa'uud halkaas iman karin.
english: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee Daa'uud waa qabsaday qalcaddii Siyoon, oo taasuna waa magaaladii Daa'uud.
english: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud maalintaas wuxuu yidhi, Ku alla kii reer Yebuus laayaa, ha tago meesha biyomareenka ah, oo ha ku laayo curyaannada iyo indhoolayaasha oo neceb Daa'uud naftiisa. Sidaas daraaddeed waxay leeyihiin, Indhoolayaasha iyo curyaannadu yaanay guriga soo gelin.
english: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna qalcaddii ayuu degay, wuxuuna u bixiyey magaaladii Daa'uud. Oo Daa'uudna wuxuu dhisay hareeraheedii iyo tan iyo Millo ilaa gudaha.
english: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna aad iyo aad buu u sii xoogaystay; waayo, waxaa isaga la jiray Rabbiga ah Ilaaha ciidammada.
english: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD, the God of Armies, was with him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Xiiraam oo ahaa boqorkii Turos ayaa Daa'uud wargeeyayaal u soo diray, iyo geedo kedar la yidhaahdo, iyo nijaarro iyo wastaadyo, oo iyana guri bay Daa'uud u dhiseen.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna wuxuu ogaaday in Rabbigu isaga u taagay inuu ahaado boqor u taliya reer binu Israa'iil, iyo inuu boqortooyadiisa u sarraysiiyey dadkiisa reer binu Israa'iil aawadood.
english: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna weliba Yeruusaalem ayuu ka guursaday addoommo iyo naago kale markuu Xebroon ka yimid dabadeed, oo weliba waxaa Daa'uud u dhashay wiilal iyo gabdho.
english: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waa kuwii isaga Yeruusaalem ugu dhashay magacyadoodii: Shammuuca, iyo Shoobaab, iyo Naataan, iyo Sulaymaan,
english: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

kikuyu: iyo Yibxaar, iyo Eliishuuca, iyo Nefeg, iyo Yaafiica,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: iyo Eliishaamaac, iyo Elyaadaac, iyo Eliifeled.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

kikuyu: Oo reer Falastiinna markay maqleen in Daa'uud loo subkay inuu boqor u ahaado reer binu Israa'iil ayay reer Falastiin oo dhammu u soo baxeen inay Daa'uud doondoonaan; oo Daa'uudna taas wuu maqlay, markaasuu dhufayskii hoos ugu dhaadhacay.
english: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

kikuyu: Haddaba reer Falastiin way yimaadeen, oo waxay ku firdheen dooxadii Refaa'iim.
english: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud Rabbiga wax weyddiiyey, oo yidhi, Miyaan reer Falastiin ku kacaa? Miyaad ii soo gacangelinaysaa? Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Daa'uud ku yidhi, Haah, ku kac, waayo, hubaal reer Falastiin waan kuu soo gacangelinayaa.
english: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud yimid Bacal Feraasiim, oo halkaasaa Daa'uud iyagii ku laayay, oo yidhi, Rabbigu cadaawayaashaydii ayuu hortayda degdeg ugu qabtay, sida biyaha butaacayaa u degdegaan oo kale. Sidaas daraaddeed meeshaas magaceedii wuxuu u bixiyey Bacal Feraasiim.
english: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “The LORD has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

kikuyu: Iyana halkaasay sanamyadoodii kaga tageen, waxaana qaaday Daa'uud iyo raggiisii.
english: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.

kikuyu: Haddana reer Falastiin mar kalay soo kaceen oo dooxadii Refaa'iim ku firdheen.
english: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna markuu Rabbiga wax weyddiiyey ayaa Rabbigu ku yidhi, Waa inaadan ku kicin, laakiinse xagga dambe ka mar oo waxaad ku weerartaa meel ka soo hor jeedda geedaha bukaa la yidhaahdo.
english: When David inquired of the LORD, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.

kikuyu: Oo markaad sanqadha askarta socodkeeda ka maqashid geedaha bukaa dushooda, kolkaas waa inaad dhaqsataa, waayo, Rabbigu waa kaaga hor baxay inuu ciidanka reer Falastiin laayo.
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then the LORD has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna sidii buu yeelay sidii Rabbigu ku amray, oo wuxuu reer Falastiin ku laynayay ilaa Gebac iyo tan iyo Geser.
english: David did so, as the LORD commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud haddana soo ururiyey raggii reer binu Israa'iil oo la doortay oo dhan, waxayna ahaayeen soddon kun.
english: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna Daa'uud baa kacay, oo la tegey dadkii isaga la jiray ee ka yimid Bacale Yahuudah oo dhan, inay xaggaas ka soo qaadaan sanduuqii Ilaah, kaasoo lagu magacaabo Magaca, waxa weeye Magaca Rabbiga ciidanka ee dhex fadhiya keruubiimta.
english: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of the LORD of Armies who sits above the cherubim.

kikuyu: Oo sanduuqii Ilaah gaadhi cusub bay saareen, iyagoo ka soo bixiyey gurigii Abiinaadaab oo buurta ku yiil; markaasaa gaadhigii cusbaa waxaa waday Abiinaadaab wiilashiisii oo ahaa Cuusaah iyo Axiyoo.
english: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.

kikuyu: Oo sidaasay uga soo bixiyeen gurigii Abiinaadaab, oo buurta ku yiil, iyagoo wada sanduuqii Ilaah; oo Axiyoo ayaa sanduuqii hor maray.
english: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.

kikuyu: Daa'uud iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammuna Rabbiga hortiisay ku cayaareen iyagoo haysta cayn kasta oo alaabta muusikada ah oo ah qori beroosh la yidhaahdo, oo alaabtaasu waxay ahaayeen kataarado, iyo shareerado, iyo dafaf, iyo shuguxshugux iyo suxuun laysku garaaco.
english: David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.

kikuyu: Oo markay yimaadeen meeshii hadhuudhka lagu tumi jiray oo Naakoon ayaa Cuusaah gacanta ku fidiyey sanduuqii Ilaah, wuuna qabtay; maxaa yeelay, dibidii sidday ayaa turunturootay.
english: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu aad ugu cadhooday Cuusaah; oo Ilaahna halkaasuu ku dilay qaladkiisii aawadiis, oo sanduuqii Ilaah agtiisa ayuu ku dhintay.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna taas buu ka xumaaday, maxaa yeelay, Rabbigu degdeg buu u qabtay Cuusaah, oo meeshaas magaceediina wuxuu u bixiyey Feres Cuusaah, oo ilaa maantadanna waa la yidhaahdaa.
english: David was displeased because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna Rabbiga wuu ka baqay maalintaas, oo wuxuu isyidhi, Sanduuqa Rabbigu sidee buu iigu imanayaa?
english: David was afraid of the LORD that day; and he said, “How could the LORD’s ark come to me?”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Daa'uud wuu diiday inuu wado sanduuqii Rabbiga oo uu geeyo magaaladii Daa'uud; laakiinse Daa'uud sanduuqii buu gees ugu leexshay gurigii Cobeed Edoom kii reer Gad.
english: So David would not move the LORD’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

kikuyu: Oo saddex bilood ayaa sanduuqii Rabbigu gurigii Cobeed Edoom yiil; oo Rabbiguna wuu barakeeyey Cobeed Edoom iyo reerkiisii oo dhanba.
english: The LORD’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud loo soo sheegay oo lagu yidhi, Rabbigu waa barakeeyey Cobeed Edoom reerkiisii, iyo wixii uu lahaa oo dhan, taasuna waa sanduuqa Ilaah aawadiis. Markaasaa Daa'uud tegey oo sanduuqii Ilaah ka soo qaaday gurigii Cobeed Edoom oo farax ku soo geliyey magaaladii Daa'uud.
english: King David was told, “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.

kikuyu: Oo markii kuwii sanduuqa Rabbiga siday ay lix tallaabo socdeen wuxuu allabari u qalay dibi iyo nef kale oo shilis.
english: When those who bore the LORD’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna Rabbiga hortiisuu xooggiisii oo dhan ugu cayaaray, wuxuuna guntanaa eefod dhar wanaagsan laga sameeyey.
english: David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.

kikuyu: Sidaasay Daa'uud iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu u soo qaadeen sanduuqii Rabbiga, iyagoo qaylinaya oo buunna ka dhawaajinaya.
english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the LORD’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.

kikuyu: Oo markuu sanduuqii Rabbigu soo galay magaaladii Daa'uud ayaa Miikaal oo ahayd ina Saa'uul dariishadda wax ka fiirisay, oo waxay aragtay Boqor Daa'uud oo boodboodaya oo Rabbiga hortiisa ku cayaaraya; markaasay quudhsatay.
english: As the LORD’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.

kikuyu: Sanduuqii Rabbigana gudahay soo geliyeen oo meeshiisii bay dhigeen, taasoo ahayd teendhadii Daa'uud u dhisay badhtankeeda; kolkaasaa Daa'uud Rabbiga hortiisa ku bixiyey qurbaanno la gubo iyo qurbaanno nabaadiino.
english: They brought in the LORD’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna markuu dhammeeyey qurbaankii la gubayay iyo qurbaannadii nabaadiinada ee uu bixinayay ayuu dadkii ugu duceeyey magicii Rabbiga ciidammada.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu dadkii oo dhan, iyo xataa dadkii badnaa oo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, rag iyo dumarba, mid kasta siiyey xabbad kibis ah, iyo cad hilib ah, iyo fud sabiib ah. Markaasaa dadkii oo dhan mid waluba gurigiisii tegey.
english: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud u noqday inuu reerkiisii u duceeyo. Oo Miikaal oo ahayd ina Saa'uul ayaa u soo baxday inay Daa'uud ka hor timaado, oo waxay ku tidhi, Boqorka reer binu Israa'iil qurux badnaa maanta, kaasoo maanta isku hor qaawiyey gabdhihii addoommadiisa sida waxmatarayaasha midkood isugu qaawiyo oo kale!
english: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud Miikaal ku yidhi, Waxay ahayd Rabbiga hortiisa, kii iga doortay aabbahaa iyo reerkiisii oo dhan, oo iga dhigay amiir u taliya dadka Rabbiga, kuwaas oo ah reer binu Israa'iil; oo sidaas daraaddeed ayaan Rabbiga hortiisa ugu cayaarayaa.
english: David said to Michal, “It was before the LORD, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of the LORD, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo weliba intaas waan ka sii liidanayaa, oo waan isla xumaanayaa, laakiinse gabdhihii aad ka hadashay xaggooda derejaan ka lahaan doonaa.
english: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”

kikuyu: Oo Miikaal oo ahayd ina Saa'uulna ilaa maalintii ay dhimatay ilmo ma dhalin.
english: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay markii boqorkii gurigiisii degay oo uu Rabbigu nasasho ka siiyey cadaawayaashiisii ku wareegsanaa oo dhan,
english: When the king lived in his house, and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

kikuyu: in boqorkii Nebi Naataan ku yidhi, Bal eeg haatan, anigu waxaan degganahay guri qori kedar ah laga sameeyey, laakiinse sanduuqii Ilaah wuxuu dhex yaal daahyo.
english: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Naataan wuxuu boqorkii ku yidhi, Tag, oo wax alla wixii qalbigaaga ku jira samee, waayo, Rabbiga ayaa kula jira.
english: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.”

kikuyu: Oo isla habeenkaas Rabbiga eraygiisii baa Naataan u yimid oo ku yidhi,
english: That same night, the LORD’s word came to Nathan, saying,

kikuyu: Tag, oo waxaad addoonkayga Daa'uud ku tidhaahdaa, Rabbigu wuxuu ku leeyahay, War guri aan dego ma ii dhisaysaa?
english: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘The LORD says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?

kikuyu: Waayo, guri ma degin ilaa maalintii aan reer binu Israa'iil ka soo bixiyey dalkii Masar iyo tan iyo maantadan, laakiinse waxaan ku dhex socday teendho iyo taambuug.
english: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

kikuyu: Oo meel kasta oo aan kula socday reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil oo aan ku amray inay quudiyaan dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil ma midkood baan eray kula hadlay oo miyaan ku idhi, War maxaad iigu dhisi weydeen guri kedar ah?
english: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaad addoonkayga Daa'uud ku tidhaahdaa, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Anaa kaa soo kexeeyey xeradii idaha iyo idihii aad raacaysay, inaad ahaatid amiir u taliya dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil,
english: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.

kikuyu: waanan kula jiray meel kastoo aad tagtayba, oo cadaawayaashaadii oo dhanna hortaadaan ka baabbi'iyey. Oo waxaan kuu bixin doonaa magac weyn, oo la mid ah magacyada kuwa waaweyn oo dhulka jooga.
english: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

kikuyu: Oo dadkayga reer binu Israa'iilna meel baan u dooran doonaa, oo waan ku beeri doonaa inay meeshooda degganaadaan oo ayan mar dambe dhaqdhaqaaqin, ama ayan ilmaha sharku mar dambe dhibin sidii markii hore,
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,

kikuyu: iyo tan iyo maalintii aan xaakinno ku amray inay dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil u taliyaan. Oo adiga waan kaa nasin doonaa cadaawayaashaada oo dhan. Oo weliba Rabbigu wuxuu kuu sheegayaa inuu reer kuu yeeli doono.
english: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover the LORD tells you that the LORD will make you a house.

kikuyu: Oo markii cimrigaagu dhammaado, oo aad la seexato awowayaashaa, farcankaaga kaa dambeeya oo kaa soo bixi doona ayaan sara kicin doonaa, oo boqortooyadiisana waan dhisi doonaa.
english: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

kikuyu: Oo isna guri buu magacayga u dhisi doonaa, oo xoog baan u yeeli doonaa carshiga boqortooyadiisa weligiis.
english: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

kikuyu: Oo anigu aabbaan u ahaan doonaa, isna wiil buu ii ahaan doonaa, oo hadduu dembi galona, waxaan ku edbin doonaa usha dadka iyo garaacidda binu-aadmiga,
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;

kikuyu: laakiinse naxariistaydu ka dhammaan mayso isaga, sidii aan Saa'uul uga dhammeeyey oo kale, kaasoo ahaa kii aan hortaa fogeeyey.
english: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

kikuyu: Oo reerkaaga iyo boqortooyadaadaba waxaa laga dhigi doonaa kuwo weligood hortaada ku raaga, oo carshigaaguna weligiis wuu dhisnaan doonaa.
english: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”

kikuyu: Haddaba siday erayadaas oo dhan iyo tusniintaas oo dhammu ahaayeen ayaa Naataan kula hadlay Daa'uud.
english: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Daa'uud gudaha galay oo Rabbiga hor fadhiistay, oo wuxuu yidhi, Sayidow, Rabbow, bal yaan ahay? Reerkayguna waa maxay oo aad halkan ii soo gaadhsiisay?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxanu hortaada wuu ku yaraa, Sayidow, Rabbow, laakiinse waxaad kaloo ka sii hadashay reerkaygu wuxuu wakhti dheer noqon doono, oo Sayidow, Rabbow, taasu ma caadada dadkaa?
english: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord GOD, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord GOD!

kikuyu: Sayidow, Rabbow! Bal maxaan kaloo kugu odhan karaa? Waayo, waad i garanaysaa anoo addoonkaaga ah, Rabbow Ilaahow.
english: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord GOD.

kikuyu: Eraygaaga aawadiis iyo qalbigaagu siduu yahay ayaad waxyaalahan waaweyn oo dhan u samaysay, inaad i ogeysiisid anoo addoonkaaga ah.
english: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

kikuyu: Haddaba, Rabbow Ilaahow, waad weyn tahay, waayo, mid kula mid ahu ma jiro, oo adiga mooyaane Ilaah kale ma jiro, siday ahaayeen kulli wixii aannu dhegahayaga ku maqalnay oo dhammu.
english: Therefore you are great, LORD God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

kikuyu: Bal quruuntee baa dunida joogta oo la mid ah dadkaaga reer binu Israa'iil, kuwaasoo adiga qudhaadu aad soo furatay inay dad kuu ahaadaan, iyo inaad magac isu yeesho, oo aad waxyaalo waaweyn isu samayso, iyo inaad dalkaaga aawadiis waxyaalo cabsi leh ugu samayso dadkaaga hortiisa, kuwaasoo aad ka soo furatay dalkii Masar, iyo quruumaha iyo ilaahyadooda?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

kikuyu: Oo waxaad dhisatay dadkaagii reer binu Israa'iil inay dad kuu ahaadaan weligood, oo Ilaahood baad noqotay, Rabbiyow.
english: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

kikuyu: Haddaba, Rabbow Ilaahow, eraygii aad ku hadashay oo igu saabsanaa anoo addoonkaaga ah oo ku saabsanaa reerkayga weligaa adkee oo sidaad ugu hadashay yeel.
english: “Now, LORD God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

kikuyu: Oo magacaaguna ha weynaado weligiis, hana la yidhaahdo, Rabbiga ciidammadu waa Ilaaha u taliya reer binu Israa'iil, oo anoo addoonkaaga Daa'uud ah reerkayguna wuu ku dhismi doonaa hortaada.
english: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadow, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iilow, anoo addoonkaaga ah wax baad ii muujisay, oo waxaad igu tidhi, Reer baan kuu dhisi doonaa, sidaas daraaddeed waan ku dhiirranahay inaan baryadan ku baryo.
english: For you, LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

kikuyu: Haddaba, Sayidow, Rabbow, waxaad tahay Ilaah, oo erayadaaduna waa run, oo waxan wanaagsanna waad ii ballanqaadday anoo addoonkaaga ah.
english: “Now, O Lord GOD, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

kikuyu: Haddaba, Sayidow, Rabbow, waan ku baryayaaye, anoo addoonkaaga ah, barakee reerkayga inuu weligiisba hortaada ku sii raago, waayo, adigaa taas ku hadlay, oo reerkayguna weligiis ha barakaysnaado.
english: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord GOD, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”

kikuyu: Oo taas dabadeed ayaa Daa'uud reer Falastiin laayay, oo jebiyey, oo Daa'uudna wuxuu gacantii reer Falastiin ka qaaday magaalada la yidhaahdo Meteg Ammaah.
english: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu kaloo laayay reer Moo'aab, oo intuu dhulka jiifiyey ayuu xadhig ku qiyaasay, oo markaasuu laba xadhig wuxuu u qiyaasay in la dilo, xadhig buuxana wuu la hadhay iyagoo nool. Oo reer Moo'aabna addoommay Daa'uud u noqdeen, oo baad bay u keeneen.
english: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

kikuyu: Daa'uudna wuxuu kaloo dilay boqorkii Soobaah, oo ahaa Hadadceser ina Rexob, intuu ku socday inuu dowladnimadiisii ku soo ceshado Webiga agtiisa.
english: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud wuxuu isagii ka qabsaday kun iyo toddoba boqol oo fardooley ah, iyo labaatan kun oo nin oo lug ah; oo Daa'uudna wuxuu boqno jaray fardihii gaadhiyada waday oo dhan, laakiinse iyagii boqol gaadhifaras buu uga reebay.
english: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

kikuyu: Oo reer Suuriyihii Dimishaqna markay u yimaadeen inay u hiiliyaan boqorkii Soobaah oo ahaa Hadadceser, Daa'uud wuxuu reer Suuriya ka laayay laba iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

kikuyu: Daa'uudna wuxuu reer Dimishaq oo Suuriya jooga dhex dhigay rugo askareed, oo reer Suuriyana Daa'uud bay addoommo u noqdeen oo baad u keeneen. Oo Rabbiguna Daa'uud guul buu siiyey meel kastoo uu tegeyba.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud soo qaaday gaashaammadii dahabka ahaa oo ay wateen addoommadii Hadadceser, wuxuuna keenay Yeruusaalem.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkii Hadadceser oo ahaa Betax, iyo Beerootay Boqor Daa'uud wuxuu ka soo qaaday naxaas aad iyo aad u badan.
english: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

kikuyu: Oo Tocii oo ahaa boqorkii Xamaad markuu maqlay in Daa'uud laayay ciidankii Hadadceser oo dhan,
english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

kikuyu: ayaa Tocii wiilkiisii Yooraam u soo diray inuu soo salaamo Boqor Daa'uud oo uu u soo duceeyo, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu la diriray oo dilay Hadadceser; waayo, Hadadceser wuxuu la diriri jiray Tocii. Oo Yooraamna wuxuu keenay weelal lacag ah, iyo weelal dahab ah iyo weelal naxaas ah,
english: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: oo kuwaasna Boqor Daa'uud wuxuu quduus uga dhigay Rabbiga, oo wuxuu ku daray lacagtii iyo dahabkii uu quduuska ka dhigay oo uu ka soo dhacay quruumihii uu jebiyey oo dhan;
english: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

kikuyu: kuwaas oo ahaa reer Suuriya, iyo reer Moo'aab, iyo reer Cammoon, iyo reer Falastiin, iyo reer Camaaleq, iyo dhicii uu boqorkii Soobaah oo ahaa Hadadceser ina Rexob ka helay.
english: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna magac buu isu yeelay markuu ka soo noqday layntii uu reer Suuriya Dooxadii Cusbada kaga laayay siddeed iyo tobanka kun oo nin.
english: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu Edom dhex dhigay rugo askareed; oo Edom oo dhanna wuxuu dhex dhigay rugo askareed, oo reer Edom oo dhammuna Daa'uud bay addoommo u noqdeen. Oo Rabbiguna Daa'uud guul buu siiyey meel kastoo uu tegeyba.
english: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan buu u taliyey; oo Daa'uud wuxuu dadkiisii oo dhan ugu gar qaybshay xukun iyo caddaalad.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa ciidanka u sarrayn jiray Yoo'aab oo ay Seruuyaah dhashay; oo taariikhdana waxaa qori jiray Yehooshaafaad ina Axiiluud,
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,

kikuyu: oo wadaaddona waxaa ahaa Saadooq ina Axiituub, iyo Axiimeleg ina Aabyaataar, oo Seraayaahna wuxuu ahaa karraani;
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,

kikuyu: Benaayaah ina Yehooyaadaacna wuxuu u taliyey reer Kereetiim iyo reer Feleetii, oo Daa'uud wiilashiisuna waxay ahaayeen wasiiro.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud yidhi, War reerkii Saa'uul wax ka hadhay ma jiraan, aan Yoonaataan aawadiis ugu roonaadee?
english: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

kikuyu: Reerkii Saa'uulna waxaa halkaas ka joogay addoon magiciisa la yidhaahdo Siibaa, oo isagii bay Daa'uud ugu yeedheen. Boqorkiina wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma Siibaad baad tahay? Oo isna ku yidhi, Haah, waan ahay anoo addoonkaaga ah.
english: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii yidhi, Miyaan reerkii Saa'uul wax ka hadhin aan Ilaah aawadiis ugu roonaadee? Siibaana wuxuu boqorkii ku yidhi, Waxaa ka hadhay wiil Yoonaataan dhalay, oo curyaan ah.
english: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa boqorkii isagii ku yidhi, Xaggee buu joogaa? Siibaana wuxuu boqorkii ku yidhi, Wuxuu joogaa guriga Maakiir oo ah ina Cammii'eel ee deggan Loo Debaar.
english: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Daa'uud u cid diray, oo ka soo kexeeyey gurigii Maakiir oo ahaa ina Cammii'eel, oo ku yiil Loo Debaar.
english: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna waxaa Daa'uud u yimid Mefiiboshed, oo ahaa ina Yoonaataan, ina Saa'uul, oo intuu wejiga u dhacay ayuu u sujuuday. Kolkaasaa Daa'uud yidhi, War Mefiiboshedow. Oo isna wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Way kan anoo addoonkaaga ah.
english: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud isagii ku yidhi, Ha cabsan, waayo, xaqiiqa waxaan kuugu roonaan doonaa aabbahaa Yoonaataan aawadiis, oo weliba waxaan kuu celin doonaa dhulkii awowgaa Saa'uul oo dhan; oo miiskaygana had iyo goor wax baad ka cuni doontaa.
english: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”
