kikuyu: Wiilashii Yahuudahna waxay ahaayeen Ceer, iyo Oonaan, iyo Sheelaah, oo saddexdaas waxaa isaga u dhashay Batshuuca oo reer Kancaan ahayd. Oo Ceer oo ahaa curadkii Yahuudah wuxuu ahaa mid Rabbiga hortiisa shar ku ah, oo isna Rabbigu wuu dilay.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.

kikuyu: Oo Taamaar oo uu soddog u ahaa ayaa isaga u dhashay Feres iyo Serax. Wiilashii Yahuudah oo dhammuna waxay ahaayeen shan.
english: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Feresna waxay ahaayeen Xesroon, iyo Xaamuul.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Seraxna waxay ahaayeen Simrii, iyo Eetaan, iyo Heemaan, iyo Kalkol, iyo Daarac, oo dhammaantoodna waxay ahaayeen shan.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

kikuyu: Ina Karmiina wuxuu ahaa Caakaar oo ahaa kii reer binu Israa'iil dhibay, oo ku xadgudbay alaabtii la xaaraameeyey.
english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

kikuyu: Ina Eetaanna wuxuu ahaa Casaryaah.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Xesroon wiilashiisii u dhashay waxay ahaayeen Yeraxme'eel, iyo Raam, iyo Keluubay.
english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

kikuyu: Oo Raam wuxuu dhalay Cammiinaadaab, Cammiinaadaabna wuxuu dhalay Naxshoon, oo reer Yahuudah amiir u ahaan jiray.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

kikuyu: Oo Naxshoon wuxuu dhalay Salmaa, Salmaana wuxuu dhalay Bocas,
english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

kikuyu: Bocasna wuxuu dhalay Coobeed, Coobeedna wuxuu dhalay Yesay,
english: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

kikuyu: Yesayna wuxuu dhalay curadkiisii oo ahaa Elii'aab, iyo Abiinaadaab oo ahaa wiilkiisii labaad, iyo Shimcaa oo ahaa wiilkiisii saddexaad,
english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

kikuyu: iyo Netaneel oo ahaa kii afraad, iyo Radday oo ahaa kii shanaad,
english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

kikuyu: iyo Osem oo ahaa kii lixaad, iyo Daa'uud oo ahaa kii toddobaad,
english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

kikuyu: oo walaalahoodii gabdhaha ahaana waxay ahaayeen Seruuyaah iyo Abiigayil, oo Seruuyaah wiilasheediina waxay ahaayeen saddex, Abishay iyo Yoo'aab iyo Casaaheel.
english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

kikuyu: Abiigayilna waxay dhashay Camaasaa, oo Camaasaa aabbihiisna wuxuu ahaa Yeter oo reer Ismaaciil ahaa.
english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

kikuyu: Kaaleeb ina Xesroonna wuxuu carruur ka dhalay naagtiisii Casuubaah, iyo Yeriicood, oo kuwanuna waxay ahaayeen wiilasheedii, waana Yeesher, iyo Shoobaab, iyo Ardoon.
english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

kikuyu: Oo Casuubaahna way dhimatay, oo Kaaleeb wuxuu guursaday Efraad, oo iyana isagay u dhashay Xuur.
english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

kikuyu: Xuurna wuxuu dhalay Uurii, Uuriina wuxuu dhalay Besaleel.
english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

kikuyu: Oo taas dabadeedna Xesroon wuxuu u tegey inantii Maakiir oo ahaa Gilecaad aabbihiis, oo taas wuxuu guursaday isagoo lixdan sannadood jira, oo waxayna isaga u dhashay Seguub.
english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

kikuyu: Seguubna wuxuu dhalay Yaa'iir, oo dalka reer Gilecaad ku lahaa saddex iyo labaatan magaalo.
english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: Oo Geshuur iyo Araam ayaa waxay qaateen magaalooyinkii reer Yaa'iir, iyo Qenaad, iyo tuulooyinkeedii, waxayna wada ahaayeen lixdan magaalo. Oo kulli intaasu waxay wada ahaayeen wiilashii Maakiir oo ahaa Gilecaad aabbihiis.
english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

kikuyu: Oo Xesroon markuu Kaaleeb Efraataah ku dhintay dabadeed ayaa Abiiyaah oo ahayd Xesroon naagtiisii waxay isagii u dhashay Ashxuur oo ahaa Teqooca aabbihiis.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

kikuyu: Oo Yeraxme'eel oo ahaa curadkii Xesroon wiilashiisiina waxay ahaayeen Raam oo curadkiisii ahaa, iyo Buunaah, iyo Oren, iyo Osem, iyo Axiiyaah.
english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

kikuyu: Oo Yeraxme'eelna wuxuu qabay naag kale, oo magaceeda la odhan jiray Cataaraah, oo iyana waxay ahayd Oonaam hooyadiis.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

kikuyu: Oo Raam oo ahaa curadkii Yeraxme'eel wiilashiisii waxay ahaayeen Macas, iyo Yaamiin, iyo Ceeqer.
english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Oonaamna waxay ahaayeen Shammay, iyo Yaadaac, wiilashii Shammayna waxay ahaayeen Naadaab iyo Abiishuur.
english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

kikuyu: Oo naagtii Abiishuur magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Abiixayil, iyana waxay isagii u dhashay Axbaan iyo Mooliid.
english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Naadaabna waxay ahaayeen Seled, iyo Afayim, laakiinse Seled wiilalla'aan buu ku dhintay.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

kikuyu: Ina Afayimna wuxuu ahaa Yishcii. Ina Yishciina wuxuu ahaa Sheeshaan. Ina Sheeshaanna wuxuu ahaa Axlay.
english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

kikuyu: Shammay walaalkiisii oo Yaadaac ahaa wiilashiisiina waxay ahaayeen Yeter, iyo Yoonaataan, Yeterna wiilalla'aan buu ku dhintay.
english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yoonaataanna waxay ahaayeen Feled, iyo Saasaa. Kuwaasu waxay wada ahaayeen wiilashii Yeraxme'eel.
english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

kikuyu: Haddaba Sheeshaan wiilal ma lahayn, gabdho mooyaane. Oo Sheeshaan wuxuu lahaa addoon Masri ah, oo magiciisana waxaa la odhan jiray Yarxaac.
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Sheeshaan gabadhiisii u guuriyey addoonkiisii Yarxaac la odhan jiray, oo iyana waxay isagii u dhashay Catay.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

kikuyu: Catayna wuxuu dhalay Naataan, Naataanna wuxuu dhalay Saabaad,
english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

kikuyu: Saabaadna wuxuu dhalay Eflaal, Eflaalna wuxuu dhalay Coobeed,
english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

kikuyu: Coobeedna wuxuu dhalay Yeehuu, Yeehuuna wuxuu dhalay Casaryaah,
english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

kikuyu: Casaryaahna wuxuu dhalay Xeles, Xelesna wuxuu dhalay Elecaasaah,
english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

kikuyu: Elecaasaahna wuxuu dhalay Sismay, Sismayna wuxuu dhalay Shalluum,
english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

kikuyu: Shalluumna wuxuu dhalay Yeqamyaah, Yeqamyaahna wuxuu dhalay Eliishaamaac.
english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

kikuyu: Yeraxme'eel walaalkiis Kaaleeb wiilashiisiina waxay ahaayeen curadkiisii Meeshaac, oo Siif aabbihiis ahaa, iyo wiilashii Maareeshaah oo ahaa Xebroon aabbihiis.
english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Xebroonna waxay ahaayeen Qorax, iyo Tafuu'ax, iyo Reqem, iyo Shemac.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

kikuyu: Shemacna wuxuu dhalay Raxam, oo ahaa Yorqecaam aabbihiis, Reqemna wuxuu dhalay Shammay.
english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

kikuyu: Shammay wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Maacoon, Maacoonna wuxuu ahaa Beytsuur aabbihiis.
english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

kikuyu: Ceefah oo ahayd Kaaleeb naagtiisii addoonta ahaydna waxay dhashay Xaaraan, iyo Moosaa, iyo Gaasees, oo Xaaraanna wuxuu dhalay Gaasees.
english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yaahdayna waxay ahaayeen Regem, iyo Yootam, iyo Geeshaan, iyo Feled, iyo Ceefah, iyo Shacaf.
english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

kikuyu: Macakaah oo ahayd Kaaleeb naagtiisii addoonta ahaydna waxay dhashay Sheber iyo Tirxanaah.
english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

kikuyu: Oo waxay kaloo dhashay Shacaf oo ahaa Madmannaah aabbihiis, iyo Shewaa oo ahaa Makbeenaa aabbihiis, iyo Gibecaa aabbihiis, oo Kaaleeb gabadhiisana waxaa la odhan jiray Caksaah.
english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanu waxay wada ahaayeen ilmaha Kaaleeb, kaasoo ahaa ina Xuur, oo ahaa curadkii Efraataah, iyo Shoobaal oo ahaa Qiryad Yecaariim aabbihiis,
english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

kikuyu: iyo Salmaa oo ahaa Beytlaxam aabbihiis, iyo Xaareef oo ahaa Beytgaadeer aabbihiis.
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

kikuyu: Shoobaal oo ahaa Qiryad Yecaariim aabbihiisna wuxuu lahaa wiilal, Haaro'eh iyo reer Menuxood badhkiis.
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

kikuyu: Oo reer Qiryad Yecaariim qolooyinkoodiina waxay ahaayeen reer Yeter, iyo reer Fuutii, iyo reer Shumaatii, iyo reer Mishraacii, oo kuwaas waxaa ka soo farcamay reer Sorcaah, iyo reer Eshtaa'ool.
english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Salmaana waxay ahaayeen Beytlaxam, iyo reer Netofaah, iyo Cataarood Beytyoo'aab, iyo reer Maanahad badhkiis, iyo reer Sorcii.
english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

kikuyu: Oo karraaniyadii Yacbees degganaa qolooyinkoodiina waxay ahaayeen reer Tircaatii, iyo reer Shimcaatiim, iyo reer Suukaatiim. Intaasu waa reer Qeynkii ka soo farcamay Xammad oo ahaa reer Reekaab aabbahood.
english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Daa'uud, oo isaga ugu dhashay Xebroon, oo curadkiisu wuxuu ahaa Amnoon, oo ay dhashay Axiinocam tii reer Yesreceel, oo kii labaadna wuxuu ahaa Daanyeel, oo ay dhashay Abiigayil tii reer Karmel,
english: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

kikuyu: oo kii saddexaadna wuxuu ahaa Absaaloom oo ay dhashay Macakaah oo ahayd boqorkii Geshuur oo Talmay ahaa gabadhiisii, oo kii afraadna wuxuu ahaa Adoniiyaah oo ay Haggiid dhashay,
english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

kikuyu: kii shanaadna wuxuu ahaa Shefatyaah oo ay Abiital dhashay, kii lixaadna, wuxuu ahaa Yitrecaam oo uu ka dhalay naagtiisii Ceglaah.
english: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

kikuyu: Lix waxay ugu dhasheen Xebroon, oo Xebroon wuxuu boqor ka ahaa toddoba sannadood iyo lix bilood, oo Yeruusaalemna wuxuu boqor ku ahaa saddex iyo soddon sannadood.
english: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waxay isaga ugu dhasheen Yeruusaalem: Shimcaa, iyo Shoobaab, iyo Naataan, iyo Sulaymaan, afartaas oo ay dhashay Batshuuca oo ahayd ina Cammii'eel,
english: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

kikuyu: iyo Yibxaar, iyo Eliishaamaac, iyo Eliifeled,
english: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

kikuyu: iyo Nogah, iyo Nefeg, iyo Yaafiica,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: iyo Eliishaamaac, iyo Elyaadaac, iyo Eliifeled, oo iyana waxay ahaayeen sagaal.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

kikuyu: Oo kuwaas oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen ilmaha Daa'uud, oo wiilashiisii uu addoommaha ka dhalayna kuma ay jirin, oo Taamaarna waxay ahayd walaashood.
english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

kikuyu: Oo Sulaymaan wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Rexabcaam, Rexabcaam wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Abiiyaah, Abiiyaah wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Aasaa, wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Yehooshaafaad,
english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

kikuyu: wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Yooraam, wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Axasyaah, wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Yoo'aash,
english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

kikuyu: wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Amasyaah, wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Casaryaah, wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Yootam,
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

kikuyu: wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Aaxaas, wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Xisqiyaah, wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Manaseh,
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

kikuyu: wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Aamoon, wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Yoosiyaah.
english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yoosiyaahna waa kuwan: curadkiisii Yooxaanaan, kii labaadna Yehooyaaqiim, kii saddexaadna Sidqiyaah, kii afraadna Shalluum.
english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yehooyaaqiimna waxay ahaayeen: wiilkiisii Yekonyaah, iyo wiilkiisii Sidqiyaah.
english: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

kikuyu: Oo maxbuuskii Yekonyaah ahaa wiilashiisii waxay ahaayeen:
english: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

kikuyu: wiilkiisii Salaatii'eel, iyo Malkiiraam, iyo Fedaayaah, iyo Shen'asar, iyo Yeqamyaah, iyo Hooshaamaac, iyo Nedabyaah.
english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Fedaayaahna waxay ahaayeen Serubaabel, iyo Shimcii, oo wiilashii Serubaabelna waxay ahaayeen Meshullaam, iyo Xananyaah, oo Shelomiidna waxay ahayd walaashood,
english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

kikuyu: iyo Xashubaah, iyo Ohel, iyo Berekyaah, iyo Xasadyaah, iyo Yuushabxesed, oo iyana waxay ahaayeen shan.
english: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Xananyaahna waxay ahaayeen Felatyaah, iyo Yeshaacyaah, oo waxaa kaloo jiray wiilashii Refaayaah, iyo wiilashii Arnaan, iyo wiilashii Cobadyaah, iyo wiilashii Shekaanyaah.
english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Shekaanyaahna waxay ahaayeen Shemacyaah, wiilashii Shemacyaahna waxay ahaayeen Xatuush, iyo Yigaal, iyo Baarii'ax, iyo Necaryaah, iyo Shaafaad, oo waxay ahaayeen lix.
english: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Necaryaahna waxay ahaayeen Eliyooceenay, iyo Xisqiyaah, iyo Casriiqaam, oo waxay ahaayeen saddex.
english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Eliyooceenayna waxay ahaayeen, Hoodawyaah, iyo Eliyaashiib, iyo Felaayaah, iyo Caquub, iyo Yooxaanaan, iyo Delaayaah, iyo Canaanii, waxayna ahaayeen toddoba.
english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yahuudahna waxay ahaayeen Feres, iyo Xesroon, iyo Karmii, iyo Xuur, iyo Shoobaal.
english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

kikuyu: Oo Re'aayaah oo ahaa ina Shoobaalna wuxuu dhalay Yaaxad, Yaaxadna wuxuu dhalay Axuumay iyo Lahad. Kuwanu waa qolooyinkii reer Sorcaah.
english: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waxay ahaayeen wiilashii uu dhalay Ceetaam aabbihiis, oo waa Yesreceel, iyo Yishmaa, iyo Yidbaash, oo walaashood magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Haselelfoonii,
english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

kikuyu: iyo Fenuu'eel oo ahaa Gedoor aabbihiis, iyo Ceser oo ahaa Xuushaah aabbihiis. Kuwanu waa wiilashii Xuur, kaasoo ahaa curadkii Efraataah, oo ahaa Beytlaxam aabbihiis.
english: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

kikuyu: Oo Ashxuur oo ahaa Teqooca aabbihiisna wuxuu qabay laba naagood, oo waxay ahaayeen Xelaah iyo Nacaraah.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

kikuyu: Oo Nacaraah waxay isagii u dhashay Axuusaam, iyo Heefer, iyo Teemnii, iyo Haa'axashtaarii. Intaasu waxay ahaayeen Nacaraah wiilasheedii.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

kikuyu: Xelaah wiilasheediina waxay ahaayeen Sered, iyo Isehaar, iyo Etnaan.
english: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

kikuyu: Haqoosna wuxuu dhalay Caanuub, iyo Sobeebaah, iyo qolooyinka reer Axarxeel oo ahaa ina Haaruum.
english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

kikuyu: Yacbeesna wuu ka ciso badnaa walaalihiis oo dhan, oo hooyadiis ayaa isagii ku magacawday Yacbees, oo waxay tidhi, Maxaa yeelay, isaga waxaan ku dhalay tiiraanyo.
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

kikuyu: Oo Yacbeesna wuxuu baryay Ilaahii reer binu Israa'iil, oo ku yidhi, Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad i barakaysid, oo aad soohdintayda ii ballaadhisid, iyo in gacantaadu ila jirto, oo aad sharka iga dhawrtid, si aanan u tiiraanyoon! Oo Ilaahna wuu siiyey wixii uu weyddiistay.
english: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

kikuyu: Keluub oo ahaa Shuuxah walaalkiisna wuxuu dhalay Mexiir, oo ahaa Eshtoon aabbihiis.
english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

kikuyu: Eshtoonna wuxuu dhalay Beytraafaa, iyo Faasee'ax, iyo Texinnaah oo ahaa Ciirnaaxaash aabbihiis. Oo kuwanu waa nimankii Reekaah.
english: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Qenasna waxay ahaayeen, Cotnii'eel, iyo Seraayaah, oo Cotnii'eelna wuxuu dhalay Xatad.
english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

kikuyu: Mecoonotayna wuxuu dhalay Cofraah, oo Seraayaahna wuxuu dhalay Yoo'aab oo ahaa Geharashiim aabbihiis, waayo, iyagu waxay ahaayeen rag saaniciin ah.
english: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

kikuyu: Kaaleeb ina Yefunneh wiilashiisiina waxay ahaayeen Iiruu, iyo Eelaah, iyo Nacam, ina Eelaahna wuxuu ahaa Qenas.
english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yehaleleelna waxay ahaayeen Siif iyo Siifaah, iyo Tiiryaa, iyo Asareel.
english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

kikuyu: Ilmaha Cesraahna waxay ahaayeen Yeter, iyo Mered, iyo Ceefer, iyo Yaaloon, oo iyana waxay dhashay Maryan, iyo Shammay, iyo Yishbax oo ahaa Eshtemooca aabbihiis.
english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

kikuyu: Naagtiisii Yahuudiyadda ahaydna waxay dhashay Yered oo ahaa Gedoor aabbihiis, iyo Xeber oo ahaa Sookoo aabbihiis, iyo Yequutii'eel oo ahaa Saanoo'ax aabbihiis. Oo kuwanuna waa wiilashii Bityaah oo ahayd ina Fircoon oo uu Mered guursaday.
english: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

kikuyu: Oo Hoodiyaah naagtiisii oo ahayd Naxam walaashiis wiilasheediina waxay ahaayeen Qeciilaah kii reer Garmii aabbihiis, iyo Eshtemooca oo ahaa reer Macakaad.
english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Shiimoonna waxay ahaayeen Cammoon, iyo Rinnaah, iyo Benxaanaan, iyo Tiiloon. Wiilashii Yishciina waxay ahaayeen Sooxeed iyo Bensooxeed.
english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

kikuyu: Sheelaah ina Yahuudah wiilashiisiina waxay ahaayeen Ceer oo ahaa Leekaah aabbihiis, iyo Lacadaah oo ahaa Maareeshaah aabbihiis, iyo qolooyinka reerka kuwa dhar wanaagsan samayn jiray oo ka soo farcamay reer Ashbeeca,
english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

kikuyu: iyo Yooqiim, iyo dadka reer Kosebaa, iyo Yoo'aash, iyo Saaraaf oo u talin jiray Moo'aab, iyo Yaashubilexem. Oo taariikhduna waa wax aad u gaboobay.
english: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waxay ahaayeen dheryodhoobyadii, oo waxay degganaan jireen Netaa'iim iyo Gedeeraah, oo halkaas ayay la degganaan jireen boqorka si ay shuqulkiisa u sameeyaan.
english: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Simecoonna waxay ahaayeen Nemuu'eel, iyo Yaamiin, iyo Yaariib, iyo Serax, iyo Shaa'uul
english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

kikuyu: oo dhalay Shalluum, oo isna dhalay Mibsam, oo isna dhalay Mishmaac.
english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

kikuyu: Mishmaac farcankiisuna wuxuu ahaa Xamuu'eel oo dhalay Sakuur, oo isna dhalay Shimcii.
english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

kikuyu: Shimciina wuxuu lahaa lix iyo toban wiil iyo lix gabdhood, laakiinse walaalihiis carruur badan ma ay lahayn, oo qoladooda oo dhammuna uma ay tarmin, sida reer Yahuudah oo kale.
english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu waxay degganaayeen Bi'ir Shebac, iyo Molaadaah, iyo Xasar Shuucaal,
english: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

kikuyu: iyo Bilhah, iyo Cesem, iyo Toolad,
english: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

kikuyu: iyo Betuu'eel, iyo Xormaah, iyo Siiqlag,
english: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

kikuyu: iyo Beytmarkabood, iyo Xasar Suusiim, iyo Beytbirii, iyo Shacarayim. Intaasu waxay ahaayeen magaalooyinkoodii ay degganaayeen tan iyo waagii Daa'uud boqortooyada haystay.
english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

kikuyu: Oo tuulooyinkoodiina waxay ahaayeen Ceetaam, iyo Cayn, iyo Rimmon, iyo Token, iyo Caashaan, oo waxay ahaayeen shan magaalo,
english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

kikuyu: iyo kulli tuulooyinkoodii ku wareegsanaa isla magaalooyinkaas ilaa tan iyo Bacal. Kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen rugahoodii ay degganaayeen, oo iyagu abtirisna way leeyihiin.
english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

kikuyu: Oo Meshoobaab, iyo Yamleeg, iyo Yooshaah oo ahaa ina Amasyaah,
english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

kikuyu: iyo Yoo'eel, iyo Yeehuu oo ahaa ina Yooshibyaah ina Seraayaah, ina Casii'eel,
english: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

kikuyu: iyo Eliyooceenay, iyo Yacaqobaah, iyo Yeshooxaayaah, iyo Casaayaah, iyo Cadii'eel, iyo Yesiimi'eel, iyo Benaayaah,
english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

kikuyu: iyo Siisaa oo ahaa ina Shifcii ina Alloon oo ahaa reer Yedacyaah oo ka ahaa reer Shimrii oo ka sii ahaa reer Shemacyaah,
english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

kikuyu: intaas magacyadooda la sheegay waxay ahaayeen amiirradii qolooyinkooda, oo reerahooduna aad bay si weyn ugu kordheen.
english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

kikuyu: Oo waxay tageen meesha Gedoor laga galo iyo xataa tan iyo dooxadii dhankeeda bari si ay idahooda daaq ugu doondoonaan.
english: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

kikuyu: Oo waxay halkaas ka heleen daaq cosob ah oo wanaagsan, oo dhulkuna wuu ballaadhnaa, wuxuuna ahaa dal xasilloon oo nabdoon, waayo, kuwii halkaas waagii hore degganaan jiray waxay ahaayeen reer Xaam.
english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

kikuyu: Oo kuwan magacyadooda la qoray waxay dalka soo galeen waagii boqorkii reer Yahuudah, oo Xisqiyaah ahaa, oo waxay dumiyeen teendhooyinkoodii oo laayeen reer Mecuuniimkii halkaas laga helay, dhammaantoodna way wada baabbi'iyeen, ilaa maantadan la joogo, oo meeshoodii bay degeen, maxaa yeelay, meeshaasu waxay lahayd daaq ay idahoodu daaqaan.
english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga qaarkood oo ahaa reer Simecoon oo tiradoodu ahayd shan boqol oo nin waxay tageen Buur Seciir, oo waxaa saraakiil u ahaa Felatyaah, iyo Necaryaah, iyo Refaayaah, iyo Cusii'eel oo wada ahaa wiilashii Yishcii.
english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

kikuyu: Oo waxay soo laayeen kuwii reer Camaaleq ka hadhay oo baxsaday, oo halkaasay deggan yihiin ilaa maantadan la joogo.
english: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waa wiilashii Ruubeen kaasoo ahaa curadkii Israa'iil, (laakiinse isagu wuxuu nijaaseeyey gogoshii aabbihiis oo sidaas daraaddeed curadnimadiisii waxaa la siiyey wiilashii Yuusuf ina Israa'iil, oo abtiriskiisiina laguma tirin xagga curadnimadiisii.
english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

kikuyu: Yahuudah walaalihiis wuu ka xoog badnaa, oo isaga xaggiisuu amiirku ka yimid, laakiinse curadnimada waxaa iska lahaa Yuusuf:)
english: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

kikuyu: oo wiilashii Ruubeen oo ahaa curadkii Israa'iil waxay ahaayeen Xanoog, iyo Falluu, iyo Xesroon, iyo Karmii.
english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

kikuyu: Farcankii Yoo'eelna wuxuu ahaa Shemacyaah oo dhalay Juuj, oo isna dhalay Shimcii, oo isna dhalay Miikaah,
english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Re'aayaah, oo isna dhalay Bacal,
english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Be'eeraah, oo ahaa kii boqorkii Ashuur oo Tilgad Filneser la odhan jiray uu maxaabiis ahaanta u kaxaystay, oo isna wuxuu ahaa amiirkii reer Ruubeen.
english: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

kikuyu: Oo qolooyiinkii walaalihiis ahaa markii abtiriskii dhalashadooda la tiriyey waxay ahaayeen duqii Yecii'eel iyo Sekaryaah,
english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

kikuyu: iyo Belac oo ahaa ina Caasaas ina Shemac oo ahaa ina Yoo'eel oo degganaan jiray Carooceer, iyo xataa tan iyo Nebo iyo Bacal Mecoon,
english: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

kikuyu: oo xagga barina wuxuu degganaan jiray tan iyo xataa meesha laga galo cidlada markii laga soo bilaabo Webi Yufraad, maxaa yeelay, xoolahoodii ayaa ku tarmay dalkii Gilecaad.
english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigii Saa'uul ayay la dagaallameen reer Hagrii'iim, oo iyaga gacantooda ku baabba'ay, oo iyana waxay degeen teendhooyinkoodii ku dhex yiil dalkii Gilecaad bari ka xigay oo dhan.
english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa meel iyaga ka soo hor jeedda, oo ah dalka Baashaan iyo tan iyo Salkaah degganaa wiilashii Gaad
english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

kikuyu: kuwaasoo ahaa Yoo'eel oo madax ahaa, iyo Shaafaam oo ahaa kii labaad, iyo Yacnay, iyo Shaafaad, waxay wada joogeen Baashaan,
english: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

kikuyu: oo walaalahood oo ay isku reer ahaayeen waxay ahaayeen Miikaa'eel, iyo Meshullaam, iyo Shebac, iyo Yooray, iyo Yackaam, iyo Siica, iyo Ceeber, oo waxay ahaayeen toddoba.
english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Abiixayil ina Xuurii, oo ahaa ina Yaaroo'ax, oo ahaa ina Gilecaad, oo ahaa ina Miikaa'eel, oo ahaa ina Yeshiishay, oo ahaa ina Yaxdoo, oo ahaa ina Buus;
english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

kikuyu: Axii ina Cabdii'eel oo ahaa ina Guunii madax buu u ahaa reerahoodii.
english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Oo waxay degganaayeen Gilecaad oo Baashaan ku tiil iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo Shaaroon agagaarkeedii oo dhan, iyo tan iyo soohdintooda meesha ugu fog.
english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

kikuyu: Oo kuwan oo dhan abtiriskooda waxaa la tiriyey wakhtigii Yootam oo boqorkii dalka Yahuudah ahaa iyo wakhtigii Yaaraabcaam oo boqorkii dalka Israa'iil ahaa.
english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiis raggoodii xoogga lahaa oo awoodda u lahaa inay gaashaan iyo seef qaadaan, iyo inay qaansooyin ganaan, oo dagaalyahannada ahaa waxay ahaayeen afar iyo afartan kun iyo toddoba boqol iyo lixdan nin oo wada awooda inay dagaal u baxaan.
english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu waxay la dagaallameen reer Hagrii'iim iyo reer Yetuur, iyo reer Naafiish, iyo reer Naadaab.
english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

kikuyu: Oo iyagiina waa looga hiiliyey, markaasaa reer Hagrii'iim waxaa la soo geliyey gacantoodii, iyagii iyo kuwii kale oo la jiray oo dhanba, waayo, intay dagaalka ku jireen ayay Ilaah u qayshadeen, wuuna aqbalay, maxaa yeelay, isagay isku halleeyeen.
english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

kikuyu: Oo waxay iyagii ka dhaceen xoolahoodii kuwaasoo ahaa geel ah konton kun, iyo ido ah laba boqol iyo konton kun, iyo dameerro ah laba kun, iyo dad tiradiisu tahay boqol qof.
english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

kikuyu: Oo qaar badan baa laga laayay, maxaa yeelay, dagaalku wuxuu ka yimid xag Ilaah. Oo meeshoodii bayna degeen tan iyo waagii maxaabiisnimada.
english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkoodna dalkay degeen, oo waxay ku kordheen tan iyo Baashaan, iyo ilaa Bacal Xermoon, iyo tan iyo Seniir, iyo ilaa Buur Xermoon.
english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii reerahooda madaxda u ahaana waxay ahaayeen Ceefer, iyo Yishcii, iyo Elii'eel, iyo Casrii'eel, iyo Yeremyaah, iyo Hoodawyaah, iyo Yaxdii'eel, oo intaasu waxay wada ahaayeen rag xoog badan oo magac leh oo reerahooda madax u ah.
english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu waxay ku xadgudbeen Ilaahii awowayaashood, oo sidii naag ninkeedii ka dhillowday ayay raaceen ilaahyadii dadkii dalka degganaa, oo Ilaah hortooda ku baabbi'iyey.
english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaa Ilaah wuxuu kiciyey boqorkii Ashuur ee Fuul ahaa, kaasoo ahaa boqorkii Ashuur oo Tilgad Filneser ahaa, oo isna iyagii buu kaxaystay xataa reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiis, oo wuxuu iyagii geeyey Xalax, iyo Xaaboor, iyo Haaraa, iyo tan iyo webiga Goosaan, oo halkaasay joogaan ilaa maantadan.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Laawina waxay ahaayeen Gershoon, iyo Qohaad, iyo Meraarii.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Qohaadna waxay ahaayeen Camraam, iyo Isehaar, iyo Xebroon, iyo Cusii'eel.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Ilmaha Camraamna waxay ahaayeen Haaruun, iyo Muuse, iyo Maryan. Wiilashii Haaruunna waxay ahaayeen Naadaab, iyo Abiihuu, iyo Elecaasaar, iyo Iitaamaar.
english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Elecaasaar wuxuu dhalay Fiinexaas, Fiinexaasna wuxuu dhalay Abiishuuca,
english: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

kikuyu: Abiishuucana wuxuu dhalay Buqii, Buqiina wuxuu dhalay Cusii,
english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

kikuyu: Cusiina wuxuu dhalay Seraxyaah, Seraxyaahna wuxuu dhalay Meraayood,
english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

kikuyu: Meraayoodna wuxuu dhalay Amaryaah, Amaryaahna wuxuu dhalay Axiituub,
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Axiituubna wuxuu dhalay Saadooq, Saadooqna wuxuu dhalay Axiimacas,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

kikuyu: Axiimacasna wuxuu dhalay Casaryaah, Casaryaahna wuxuu dhalay Yooxaanaan,
english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

kikuyu: Yooxaanaanna wuxuu dhalay Casaryaah, (isagu wuxuu ahaa kii hawsha wadaadnimada ka qaban jiray gurigii Sulaymaan Yeruusaalem ka dhisay, )
english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Casaryaahna wuxuu dhalay Amaryaah, Amaryaahna wuxuu dhalay Axiituub,
english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Axiituubna wuxuu dhalay Saadooq, Saadooqna wuxuu dhalay Shalluum,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

kikuyu: Shalluumna wuxuu dhalay Xilqiyaah, Xilqiyaahna wuxuu dhalay Casaryaah,
english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

kikuyu: Casaryaahna wuxuu dhalay Seraayaah, Seraayaahna wuxuu dhalay Yehoosaadaaq,
english: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

kikuyu: Yehoosaadaaqna maxaabiis ahaan buu tegey waagii Rabbigu dadkii Yahuudah iyo Yeruusaalem uu gacantii Nebukadnesar ku kaxeeyey.
english: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Laawina waxay ahaayeen Gershoom, iyo Qohaad, iyo Meraarii.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa magacyadii wiilashii Gershoom, Libnii iyo Shimcii.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Qohaadna waxay ahaayeen Camraam, iyo Isehaar, iyo Xebroon, iyo Cusii'eel.
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Meraariina waxay ahaayeen Maxlii iyo Mushii. Oo intaasu waa qolooyinkii reer Laawi iyo sidii ay reerahoodu ahaayeen.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Gershoom waxaa ka soo farcamay wiilkiisii Libnii oo dhalay Yaaxad, oo isna dhalay Simmaah,
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Yoo'aax, oo isna dhalay Iddo, oo isna dhalay Serax, oo isna dhalay Ye'ateray.
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

kikuyu: Qohaadna waxaa ka soo farcamay wiilkiisii Cammiinaadaab, oo dhalay Qorax, oo isna dhalay Asiir,
english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Elqaanaah, oo isna dhalay Ebiyaasaaf, oo isna dhalay Asiir,
english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Taxad, oo isna dhalay Uurii'eel, oo isna dhalay Cusiyaah, oo isna dhalay Shaa'uul.
english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Elqaanaahna waxay ahaayeen Camaasay iyo Axiimood.
english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

kikuyu: Oo xagga Elqaanaahna waxaa ka soo farcamay Soofay, oo dhalay Nahad,
english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Elii'aab, oo isna dhalay Yeroxaam, oo isna dhalay Elqaanaah.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Samuu'eelna waxay ahaayeen curadkiisii oo ahaa Yoo'eel, iyo kii labaad oo ahaa Abiiyaah.
english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

kikuyu: Farcankii Meraariina wuxuu ahaa Maxlii, oo dhalay Libnii, oo isna dhalay Shimcii, oo isna dhalay Cuusaah,
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Shimcaa, oo isna dhalay Xaggiyaah, oo isna dhalay Casaayaah.
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa kuwii Daa'uud u sarraysiiyey hawshii gabayga oo gurigii Rabbiga ku dhex jirtay markii sanduuqii axdiga meeshaas la dhigay dabadeed.
english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu taambuugga teendhadii shirka horteeda ayay gabay kaga adeegi jireen, ilaa Sulaymaan uu Yeruusaalem ka dhex dhisay gurigii Rabbiga, oo iyana hawshooda waxay u qaban jireen siday u kala horhorreeyeen.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

kikuyu: Oo intanu waa kuwii adeegi jiray iyo wiilashoodii. Kuwii ka mid ahaa reer Qohaad waxay ahaayeen Heemaan oo gabayaa ahaa, ina Yoo'eel, ina Samuu'eel,
english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

kikuyu: ina Elqaanaah, ina Yeroxaam, ina Elii'eel, ina Too'ax,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

kikuyu: ina Suuf, ina Elqaanaah, ina Maxad, ina Camaasay,
english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

kikuyu: ina Elqaanaah, ina Yoo'eel, ina Casaryaah, ina Sefanyaah,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

kikuyu: ina Taxad, ina Asiir, ina Ebiyaasaaf, ina Qorax,
english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

kikuyu: ina Isehaar, ina Qohaad, ina Laawi, ina Israa'iil.
english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

kikuyu: Walaalkiis Aasaaf oo gacantiisii midig istaagi jiray wuxuu ahaa Aasaaf ina Berekyaah, ina Shimcaa,
english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

kikuyu: ina Miikaa'eel, ina Bacaseeyaah, ina Malkiiyaah,
english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

kikuyu: ina Etnii, ina Serax, ina Cadaayaah,
english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

kikuyu: ina Eetaan, ina Simmaah, ina Shimcii,
english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

kikuyu: ina Yaxad, ina Gershoom, ina Laawi.
english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga gacantooda midigtana waxaa istaagi jiray walaalahood oo ahaa reer Meraarii, Eetaan oo ahaa ina Qiishii, ina Cabdii, ina Malluug,
english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

kikuyu: ina Xashabyaah, ina Amasyaah, ina Xilqiyaah,
english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

kikuyu: ina Amsii, ina Baanii, ina Shemer,
english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

kikuyu: ina Maxlii, ina Mushii, ina Meraarii, ina Laawi.
english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: Oo walaalahood oo ahaa reer Laawina waxaa loo doortay inay ka adeegaan taambuuggii guriga Ilaah oo dhan.
english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Haaruun iyo wiilashiisu waxay meesha allabariga la gubo iyo girgiraha fooxa wax ugu bixin jireen shuqulkii meesha ugu quduuska ah oo dhan iyo inay reer binu Israa'iil kafaaraggud ugu sameeyaan, sidii dhammaan addoonkii Ilaah ee Muuse ahaa amray.
english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waa farcankii Haaruun, wiilkiisii Elecaasaar, oo dhalay Fiinexaas, oo isna dhalay Abiishuuca,
english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Buqii, oo isna dhalay Cusii, oo isna dhalay Seraxyaah,
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Meraayood, oo isna dhalay Amaryaah, oo isna dhalay Axiituub,
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Saadooq, oo isna dhalay Axiimacas.
english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa meelahoodii ay degi jireen iyo sidii degmooyinkoodu ahaayeen kuwaasoo ku dhex yiil soohdimahooda. Reer Haaruun oo ah qolooyinka reer Qohaad, oo saamiga kowaad lahaa,
english: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

kikuyu: waxaa la siiyey Xebroon oo ku dhex tiil dalka reer Yahuudah, iyo agagaarkeedii ku wareegsanaa oo dhanba.
english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

kikuyu: Laakiinse magaalada beeraheedii iyo tuulooyinkeediiba waxaa la siiyey Kaaleeb oo ahaa ina Yefunneh.
english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: Reer Haaruunna waxaa la siiyey magaalooyinkii magangalka oo ah Xebroon, iyo Libnaah iyo weliba agagaarkeed, iyo Yatiir, iyo Eshtemooca iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Xiileen iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Debiir iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Caashaan iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Beytshemesh iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Oo dalkii qabiilka reer Benyaamiinna waxaa laga siiyey Gebac iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Calemed iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Canaatood iyo agagaarkeedii. Oo kulli magaalooyinkoodii oo qolooyinkooda oo dhan ku dhex yiil waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo toban magaalo.
english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

kikuyu: Oo reer Qohaad intiisii hadhayna waxaa saami loo siiyey toban magaalo oo ay ka dhex heleen reerka qabiilka iyo qabiilka badhkiisii, kaasoo ah qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiis.
english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gershoomna sidii ay reerahoodu ahaayeen ayay saddex iyo toban magaalo uga heleen qabiilka reer Isaakaar, iyo qabiilka reer Aasheer, iyo qabiilka reer Naftaali, iyo qabiilka reer Manaseh oo Baashaan dhex deggan.
english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

kikuyu: Oo reer Meraarii waxaa saami loogu siiyey siday reerahoodu ahaayeen laba iyo toban magaalo oo ay ka dhex heleen qabiilka reer Ruubeen, iyo qabiilka reer Gaad, iyo qabiilka reer Sebulun.
english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna waxay reer Laawi siiyeen magaalooyinkii iyo agagaarkoodii oo dhan.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Oo saami ahaan ayay magaalooyinkan la magacaabay uga siiyeen qabiilka reer Yahuudah, iyo qabiilka reer Simecoon, iyo qabiilka reer Benyaamiin.
english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

kikuyu: Reerihii Qohaad qaarkoodna waxay magaalooyin ku lahaayeen meelo soohdintooda ah oo ay ka heleen qabiilka reer Efrayim.
english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga waxaa la siiyey magaalooyinkii magangalka, oo waxayna ahaayeen Shekem oo ku dhex tiil dalka buuraha leh oo reer Efrayim iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo weliba Geser iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Yoqmecaam iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Beytxooroon iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Ayaaloon iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Gad Rimmoon iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiisna waxaa laga dhex siiyey Caaneer iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Bilcaam iyo agagaarkeedii, reer Qohaad intooda hadhay aawadood.
english: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

kikuyu: Oo reer Gershoomna waxaa qabiilka reer Manaseh badhkiisii laga siiyey Goolaan oo Baashaan ku taal iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Cashtarod iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Oo qabiilka reer Isaakaarna waxaa laga siiyey Qedesh iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Daaberad iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Raamod iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Caaneem iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Aasheerna waxaa laga siiyey Maashaal iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Cabdoon iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Xuuqoq iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Rexob iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Oo qabiilkii reer Naftaalina waxaa laga siiyey Qedesh oo Galili ku taal iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Xammoon iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Qiryaatayim iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: Oo reer Laawi intoodii hadhay oo ahayd reer Meraarii waxaa qabiilka reer Sebulun laga siiyey Rimmoonoo iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Taaboor iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Oo Webi Urdun shishadiisa oo ah Yerixoo agteeda oo ah Webi Urdun xaggiisa bari waxaa qabiilka reer Ruubeenna laga siiyey Beser oo cidlada ku taal iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Yahsaah iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Qedemood iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Mefacad iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Oo qabiilka reer Gaadna waxaa laga siiyey Raamod oo Gilecaad ku taal iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Maxanayim iyo agagaarkeedii,
english: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: iyo Xeshboon iyo agagaarkeedii, iyo Yacser iyo agagaarkeedii.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Isaakaarna waxay ahaayeen Toolac, iyo Fuwaah, iyo Yaashuub, iyo Shimroon, afar bay ahaayeen.
english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Toolacna waxay ahaayeen Cusii, iyo Refaayaah, iyo Yerii'eel, iyo Yahmay, iyo Yibsaam, iyo Shemuu'eel, oo waxay ahaayeen madaxdii reerahoodii oo ahaa reer Toolac, oo qarnigoodiina rag xoog badan bay ku ahaayeen. Wakhtigii Daa'uud joogayna tiradoodu waxay ahayd laba iyo labaatan kun iyo lix boqol.
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Farcankii Cusiina waxay ahaayeen Yisraxyaah, iyo wiilashii Yisraxyaah oo ahaa Miikaa'eel, iyo Cobadyaah, iyo Yoo'eel, iyo Yishiyaah, oo waxay isku ahaayeen shan, dhammaantoodna waxay ahaayeen rag madax ah.
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga waxaa la jiray guutooyin ah ciidankii dagaalka sidii ay u kala dhasheen iyo sidii reerahoodu ahaayeen, waxayna ahaayeen lix iyo soddon kun oo nin, waayo, waxay lahaayeen naago iyo wiilal badan.
english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

kikuyu: Oo walaalahoodii qolooyinka reer Isaakaar ku dhex jiray oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen rag xoog badan, oo kulligoodna abtiriskooda la tiriyey, oo waxayna ahaayeen toddoba iyo siddeetan kun oo qof.
english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Benyaamiinna waxay ahaayeen Belac, iyo Beker, iyo Yediica'eel, oo ahaa saddex.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Belacna waxay ahaayeen Esboon, iyo Cusii, iyo Cusii'eel, iyo Yeriimood, iyo Ciirii, oo ahaa shan, oo reerahoodana madax bay u ahaayeen, rag xoog badan bayna ahaayeen, oo abtiriskoodana waa la tiriyey, oo waxay ahaayeen laba iyo labaatan kun iyo afar iyo soddon nin.
english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Bekerna waxay ahaayeen Semiiraah, iyo Yoo'aash, iyo Eliiceser, iyo Eliyooceenay, iyo Comrii, iyo Yereemood, iyo Abiiyaah, iyo Canaatood, iyo Calemed. Oo intaas oo dhammu waxay wada ahaayeen wiilashii Beker.
english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga sidii abtiriskoodii ahaa waa loo tiriyey iyo sidii ay u kala dhasheen, oo waxay ahaayeen madaxdii reerahooda oo ah rag xoog badan, tiradooduna waxay ahayd labaatan kun iyo laba boqol.
english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Farcankii Yediica'eelna waxay ahaayeen Bilhaan, iyo wiilashii Bilhaan oo ahaa Yecuush iyo Benyaamiin, iyo Eehuud, iyo Kenacanaah, iyo Seetaan, iyo Tarshiish, iyo Axiishaxar.
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

kikuyu: Oo intaas oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen farcankii Yediica'eel sidii ay ahaayeen madaxdii reerahoodu, rag xoog badan bayna ahaayeen, oo intoodii dagaal aawadiis ciidanka u geli kartay waxay ahaayeen toddoba iyo toban kun iyo laba boqol,
english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

kikuyu: iyo weliba Shufiim iyo Xufiim oo ahaa wiilashii Ciir, iyo Xushiim oo ahaa ina Axeer.
english: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Naftaalina waxay ahaayeen Yaxsii'eel, iyo Guunii, iyo Yeser, iyo Shalluum, oo intaasu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Bilhah.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Manasehna waxay ahaayeen Casrii'eel, oo ay naagtiisii dhashay: (oo naagtiisii addoonta ahaydna waxay u dhashay Maakiir oo ahaa Gilecaad aabbihiis,
english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

kikuyu: Maakiirna wuxuu guursaday walaashii Xufiim iyo Shufiim, oo magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Macakaah, ) oo wiilkii labaad magiciisana waxaa la odhan jiray Selaafexaad, oo Selaafexaadna wuxuu lahaa gabdho.
english: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

kikuyu: Oo Macakaah oo ahayd Maakiir naagtiisiina waxay dhashay wiil, oo magiciisiina waxay u bixisay Feresh, oo walaalkiis magiciisana waxaa la odhan jiray Shereesh, wiilashiisiina waxay ahaayeen Uulaam iyo Raaqem.
english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

kikuyu: Ina Uulaamna wuxuu ahaa Bedaan. Kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Gilecaad oo ahaa ina Maakiir, oo ka sii ahaa ina Manaseh.
english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Oo walaashiis Hammolekedna waxay dhashay Iishood, iyo Abiiceser, iyo Maxlaah.
english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Shemiidaacna waxay ahaayeen Axyaan, iyo Shekem, iyo Liqxii, iyo Aniicaam.
english: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

kikuyu: Farcankii Efrayimna waxay ahaayeen Shuutelax oo dhalay Bered, oo isna dhalay Taxad, oo isna dhalay Elcaadaah, oo isna dhalay Taxad,
english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Saabaad, oo isna dhalay Shuutelax, iyo weliba Ceser, iyo Elcaad oo ay dileen dadkii reer Gad oo dalka ku dhashay, maxaa yeelay, iyagu waxay u soo degeen inay xoolahooda dhacaan.
english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

kikuyu: Oo aabbahood Efrayimna maalmo badan ayuu aawadood u barooranayay, laakiinse waxaa isaga u yimid walaalihiis inay tacsiyeeyaan.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

kikuyu: Oo isna markaasuu naagtiisii u tegey, kolkaasay uuraysatay oo waxay dhashay wiil. Markaasuu magiciisii u bixiyey Beriicaah, maxaa yeelay, belaayaa reerkiisii ku dhacday.
english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

kikuyu: Oo gabadhiisana waxaa la odhan jiray She'eraah, oo iyadu waxay dhistay Beytxooroon tan hoose iyo tan sareba, iyo weliba Useen She'eraah.
english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dhalay Refax, oo isna dhalay Reshef, iyo wiilkiisii Telax, oo isna dhalay Tahan,
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Lacdaan, oo isna dhalay Cammiihuud, oo isna dhalay Eliishaamaa,
english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

kikuyu: oo isna dhalay Nuun, oo isna dhalay Yashuuca.
english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

kikuyu: Oo hantidoodii iyo hoygoodiiba waxay ahaayeen Beytel iyo magaalooyinkeeda, iyo xagga bari Nacaraan, iyo xagga galbeed Geser, iyo magaalooyinkeeda, iyo weliba Shekem iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo Casaah iyo magaalooyinkeedii,
english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

kikuyu: iyo xagga reer Manasehna Beytshe'aan iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo Tacanaag iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo Megiddoo iyo magaalooyinkeedii, iyo Door iyo magaalooyinkeedii. Magaalooyinkaas waxaa degganaa reer Yuusuf ina Israa'iil.
english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

kikuyu: Ilma Aasheerna waxay ahaayeen Yimnaah, iyo Yishwaah, iyo Yishwii, iyo Beriicaah, iyo Serax oo ahayd walaashood.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Beriicaahna waxay ahaayeen Xeber, iyo Malkii'eel oo ahaa Birsaawid aabbihiis.
english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

kikuyu: Oo Xeber wuxuu dhalay Yafleed, iyo Shomeer, iyo Xootaam, iyo walaashood Shuucaa.
english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yafleedna waxay ahaayeen Faasag, iyo Bimhaal, iyo Cashwaad. Intaasu waa ilma Yafleed.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Shemerna waxay ahaayeen Axii, iyo Raahgaah, iyo Yehubbaah, iyo Araam.
english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

kikuyu: Oo walaalkiisii Xeelem wiilashiisiina waxay ahaayeen Soofax, iyo Yimnaac, iyo Sheelesh iyo Caamaal.
english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Soofaxna waxay ahaayeen Suu'ax, iyo Xarnefer, iyo Shuucaal, iyo Beerii, iyo Yimraah,
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

kikuyu: iyo Beser, iyo Xood, iyo Shammaa, iyo Shilshaah, iyo Yitraan, iyo Be'eeraa.
english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Yeterna waxay ahaayeen Yefunneh, iyo Fisfaah, iyo Araa.
english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Cullaana waxay ahaayeen Aarax, iyo Xannii'eel, iyo Risyaa.
english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intaas oo dhammuna waxay wada ahaayeen ilma Aasheer oo ah madaxdii reerahooda, oo waxay ahaayeen rag xoog badan oo la doortay, oo weliba waxay ahaayeen madaxdii amiirrada. Oo tiradoodii abtiriska loogu tiriyey hawsha dagaalka waxay ahayd lix iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

kikuyu: Oo Benyaamiinna wuxuu dhalay Belac oo ahaa curadkiisii, iyo Ashbeel oo ahaa kii labaad, iyo Axrax oo ahaa kii saddexaad,
english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

kikuyu: iyo Nooxaah oo ahaa kii afraad, iyo Rafaa oo ahaa kii shanaad.
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

kikuyu: Oo Belacna wiilal buu lahaa, oo waxay ahaayeen Addaar, iyo Geeraa, iyo Abiihuud,
english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

kikuyu: iyo Abiishuuca, iyo Nacaman, iyo Axoo'ax,
english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

kikuyu: iyo Geeraa, iyo Shefuufaan, iyo Xuuraam.
english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waa wiilashii Eehuud, oo waxay ahaayeen madaxdii reerahooda oo ahaa dadkii Gebac degganaa, oo iyaga maxaabiis ahaan waa loogu kaxaystay Maanahad.
english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu maxaabiis ahaan u kaxaystay Nacaman, iyo Axiiyaah, iyo Geeraa, oo wuxuu dhalay Cuusaah iyo Axiixud.
english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

kikuyu: Oo Shaxarayimna wuxuu carruur ku dhalay dalkii Moo'aab markuu iska diray naagihiisii ahaa Xushiim iyo Bacaraa dabadeed.
english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

kikuyu: Oo naagtiisii Xodeshna wuxuu ka dhalay Yoobaab, iyo Sibyaa, iyo Meeshaa, iyo Malkaam,
english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

kikuyu: iyo Yecuus, iyo Shaakyaah, iyo Mirmaah. Intaasu waa wiilashiisii oo waxay ahaayeen madaxdii reerahooda.
english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Oo Xushiimna wuxuu ka dhalay Abiituub iyo Elfacal.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Elfacalna waxay ahaayeen Ceeber iyo Mishcaam iyo Shemed oo ahaa kii dhisay Oonoo iyo Lod iyo magaalooyinkooda oo dhan,
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

kikuyu: iyo Beriicaah, iyo Shemac, oo ahaa madaxdii reeraha dadkii Ayaaloon degganaa oo ahaa kuwii eryay dadkii Gad degganaa,
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

kikuyu: iyo Axiyoo, iyo Shaashaq, iyo Yereemood,
english: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

kikuyu: iyo Sebadyaah, iyo Caraad, iyo Ceeder,
english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

kikuyu: iyo Miikaa'eel, iyo Yishfaah, iyo Yooxaa, oo ahaa wiilashii Beriicaah,
english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

kikuyu: iyo Sebadyaah, iyo Meshullaam, iyo Xisqii, iyo Xeber,
english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

kikuyu: iyo Yishmeray, iyo Isliyaah, iyo Yoobaab, oo ahaa wiilashii Elfacal,
english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

kikuyu: iyo Yaaqiim, iyo Sikrii, iyo Sabdii,
english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

kikuyu: iyo Eliiceenay, iyo Silletay, iyo Elii'eel,
english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

kikuyu: iyo Cadaayaah, iyo Beraayaah, iyo Shimraad, oo wada ahaa wiilashii Shimcii,
english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

kikuyu: iyo Yishfaan, iyo Ceeber, iyo Elii'eel,
english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

kikuyu: iyo Cabdoon, iyo Sikrii iyo Xaanaan,
english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

kikuyu: iyo Xananyaah, iyo Ceelaam, iyo Cantotiyaah,
english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

kikuyu: iyo Yifdeyaah, iyo Fenuu'eel, oo wada ahaa wiilashii Shaashaq,
english: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

kikuyu: iyo Shamsheray, iyo Shexaryaah, iyo Catalyaah,
english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

kikuyu: iyo Yacareshyaah, iyo Eliiyaah, iyo Sikrii, oo wada ahaa wiilashii Yeroxaam.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

kikuyu: Oo kuwaasu qarniyadoodii oo dhan waxay ahaayeen madaxdii reerahooda, oo waxay degganaayeen Yeruusaalem.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo Gibecoonna waxaa degganaa Gibecoon aabbihiis Yecii'eel, oo naagtiisa magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Macakaah,
english: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

kikuyu: iyo curadkiisii Cabdoon ahaa, iyo Suur, iyo Qiish, iyo Bacal,
english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

kikuyu: iyo Naadaab, iyo Gedoor, iyo Axiyoo, iyo Seker.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

kikuyu: Miqloodna wuxuu dhalay Shime'aah. Iyana walaalahood ayay la degganaayeen Yeruusaalem meel walaalahood ka soo hor jeedda.
english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

kikuyu: Neerna wuxuu dhalay Qiish, Qiishna wuxuu dhalay Saa'uul, Saa'uulna wuxuu dhalay Yoonaataan, iyo Melkiishuuca, iyo Abiinaadaab, iyo Eshbacal.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

kikuyu: Wiilkii Yoonaataanna wuxuu ahaa Meriibacal, Meriibacalna wuxuu dhalay Miikaah.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Miikaahna waxay ahaayeen Fiitoon, iyo Meleg, iyo Tareeca, iyo Aaxaas.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Aaxaasna wuxuu dhalay Yehoocaddaah, Yehoocaddaahna wuxuu dhalay Calemed, iyo Casmaawed, iyo Simrii, Simriina wuxuu dhalay Moosaa.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

kikuyu: Moosaana wuxuu dhalay Bincaa, oo wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Rafaah, oo dhalay Elecaasaah, oo isna dhalay Aaseel.
english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

kikuyu: Aaseelna wuxuu lahaa lix wiil, oo magacyadoodiina waa kuwan: Casriiqaam, iyo Bokeruu, iyo Ismaaciil, iyo Shecaryaah, iyo Cobadyaah, iyo Xaanaan. Oo kulli intaas oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Aaseel.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

kikuyu: Ceesheq oo ahaa walaalkiis wiilashiisiina waa kuwan, Uulaam oo curadkiisii ahaa, iyo Yecuush oo ahaa kii labaad, iyo Eliifeled oo ahaa kii saddexaad.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Uulaamna waxay ahaayeen rag xoog badan, iyo qaansoley, oo waxay lahaayeen wiilal badan iyo wiilal ay wiilashoodu sii dhaleen, oo isku ah boqol iyo konton nin. Oo intaas oo dhammuna waxay ka yimaadeen wiilashii Benyaamiin.
english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Sidaasaa reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan loogu abtiriyey, oo bal eeg, iyagu waxay ku qoran yihiin kitaabkii boqorrada reer binu Israa'iil. Oo dadkii Yahuudahna xadgudubkoodii aawadiis ayaa maxaabiis ahaan loogu kaxaystay Baabuloon.
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwii ugu horreeyey oo degay dalkii ay hantiyeen iyo magaalooyinkoodii waxay ahaayeen reer binu Israa'iil, wadaaddadii, iyo kuwii reer Laawi, iyo reer Netiiniim.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

kikuyu: Oo Yeruusaalem waxaa ka degganaa reer Yahuudah, iyo reer Benyaamiin, iyo reer Efrayim, iyo reer Manaseh:
english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

kikuyu: Cuutay oo ahaa ina Cammiihuud, ina Coomrii, ina Imrii, ina Baanii oo ahaa reer Feres oo ahaa wiilkii Yahuudah.
english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

kikuyu: Oo reer Shiilohna waxaa ka degganaa Casaayaah oo ahaa curadkii iyo wiilashiisii.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

kikuyu: Reer Seraxna waxaa ka joogay Yecuu'eel iyo walaalahood, oo waxay ahaayeen lix boqol iyo sagaashan.
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

kikuyu: Oo reer Benyaamiinna waxaa ka joogay Sallu oo ahaa ina Meshullaam, ina Hoodawyaah, ina Hasenu'aah,
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

kikuyu: iyo Yibneyaah oo ahaa ina Yeroxaam, iyo Eelaah oo ahaa ina Cusii, ina Mikrii, iyo Meshullaam oo ahaa ina Shefatyaah, ina Recuu'eel, ina Yibniyaah,
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

kikuyu: iyo walaalahood oo ahaa sidii dhalashadoodu ahayd, oo waxayna ahaayeen sagaal boqol iyo lix iyo konton. Oo nimankaas oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen madaxdii reerahooda siday kala reer u ahaayeen.
english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Oo wadaaddadiina waxaa ka joogay Yedacyaah, iyo Yehooyaariib, iyo Yaakiin,
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

kikuyu: iyo Casaryaah oo ahaa ina Xilqiyaah, ina Meshullaam, ina Saadooq, ina Meraayood, ina Axiituub oo ahaa taliyihii guriga Ilaah,
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

kikuyu: iyo Cadaayaah oo ahaa ina Yeroxaam, ina Fashxuur, ina Malkiiyaah, iyo Macsay oo ahaa ina Cadii'eel, ina Yaxseraah, ina Meshullaam, ina Meshilleemiid, ina Immeer,
english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

kikuyu: iyo walaalahood oo ahaa madaxdii reerahooda, oo tiradooduna ahayd kun iyo toddoba boqol iyo lixdan, oo waxayna ahaayeen rag aad karti ugu leh shuqulka adeegidda guriga Ilaah.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

kikuyu: Oo reer Laawina waxaa ka joogay Shemacyaah oo ahaa ina Xashuub, ina Casriiqaam, ina Xashabyaah oo ahaa reer Meraarii,
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

kikuyu: iyo Baqbaqar, iyo Xeresh, iyo Gaalaal, iyo Matanyaah oo ahaa ina Miikaa, ina Sikrii, ina Aasaaf,
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

kikuyu: iyo Cobadyaah oo ahaa ina Shemacyaah, ina Gaalaal, ina Yeduutuun, iyo Berekyaah oo ahaa ina Aasaa, ina Elqaanaah, kaasoo degganaan jiray tuulooyinkii reer Netofaah.
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

kikuyu: Oo iridjoogayaashiina waxaa ka joogay Shalluum, iyo Caquub, iyo Talmon, iyo Axiiman, iyo walaalahood, oo waxaa iyaga madax u ahaa Shalluum,
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

kikuyu: oo ilaa maantadan la joogo boqorka iriddiisa xaggeeda bari joogi jiray, oo iyagu waxay iridjoogayaal u ahaayeen xeradii reer Laawi.
english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

kikuyu: Oo Shalluum ina Qore oo ahaa ina Ebiyaasaaf, ina Qorax, iyo walaalihiis oo ahaa reer Qorax, waxay u talin jireen shuqulkii adeegidda, oo waxay ahaayeen waardiyayaashii irdaha taambuugga, oo awowayaashoodna waxay u talin jireen xeradii Rabbiga, oo waxay ahaayeen waardiyayaashii iridda.
english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.

kikuyu: Oo waagii hore waxaa iyaga madax u ahaan jiray Fiinexaas oo ahaa ina Elecaasaar, oo Rabbiguna isaga wuu la jiri jiray.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

kikuyu: Oo Sekaryaah ina Meshelemyaahna wuxuu ahaan jiray iridjoogihii iridda teendhadii shirka.
english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Oo kulligood intaas loo doortay inay iridjoogayaal ahaadaan waxay dhammaantood ahaayeen laba boqol iyo laba iyo toban. Oo kuwaas abtiriskooda waxaa lagu tiriyey tuulooyinkoodii, kuwaasoo Daa'uud iyo Samuu'eel oo ahaa waxarkihii ay u doorteen shuqulkoodii lagu aaminay.
english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

kikuyu: Haddaba iyaga iyo carruurtooduba waxay u sarrayn jireen irdaha guriga Rabbiga, kaasoo ahaa gurigii taambuugga iyagoo waardiyayaal ah.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

kikuyu: Oo afarta dhinacba waxaa joogay iridjoogayaashii xagga bari, iyo xagga galbeed, iyo xagga woqooyi, iyo xagga koonfureedba.
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

kikuyu: Oo walaalahoodii tuulooyinkooda joogayna had iyo goor toddobadii maalmoodba way u iman jireen inay iyaga la joogaan,
english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

kikuyu: waayo, afarta iridjooge oo sare oo ahaa reer Laawi waxay ku jireen jagooyin joogto ah, oo waxay u talin jireen qolalka, iyo khasnadihii guriga Ilaah.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu waxay u hoyan jireen guriga Ilaah hareerihiisa, maxaa yeelay, ilaalinta gurigu iyagay saarnayd, oo waxaa iyaga joogto u ahaa inay subax kasta furaan.
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga qaarkoodna waxay u talin jireen weelasha lagu adeego, waayo, weelasha tiraa lagu soo gelin jiray, oo tiraa lagu bixin jiray.
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga qaarkood kalena waxaa loo doortay inay u taliyaan alaabta guriga iyo weelasha meesha quduuska ah oo dhan, iyo burka, iyo khamriga, iyo saliidda, iyo fooxa, iyo uunsiga.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii wadaaddada qaarkoodna waxay hagaajin jireen cadarkii uunsiga lahaa.
english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

kikuyu: Oo Matityaah oo ka mid ahaa reer Laawi, oo ahaa curadkii Shalluum oo ahaa reer Qorax shuqulkiisii joogtada ahaa wuxuu ahaa inuu ilaaliyo waxyaalaha digsiyada lagu dubo.
english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

kikuyu: Oo walaalahood qaarkood oo reer Qohaad ahaana waxay u talin jireen kibistii tusniinta, si ay sabti kasta u diyaariyaan.
english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
