kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waa nimankii gabayaaga ahaa oo ahaa madaxdii qolooyinka reer Laawi, oo waxay joogi jireen qolalka oo hawl kalena ma ay hayn, waayo, iyagu habeen iyo maalinba waxay qabanayeen shuqulkoodii.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen madaxdii qolooyinka reer Laawi, oo qarniyadoodii oo dhan waxay ahaayeen rag madax ah, oo waxay degganaan jireen Yeruusaalem.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo Gibecoonna waxaa degganaa Gibecoon aabbihiis oo la odhan jiray Yecii'eel, oo naagtiisa magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Macakaah,
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

kikuyu: iyo curadkiisii Cabdoon ahaa, iyo Suur, iyo Qiish, iyo Bacal, iyo Neer, iyo Naadaab,
english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

kikuyu: iyo Gedoor, iyo Axiyoo, iyo Sekaryaah, iyo Miqlood.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

kikuyu: Miqloodna wuxuu dhalay Shime'aam. Iyana walaalahood ayay la degganaayeen Yeruusaalem meel walaalahood ka soo hor jeedda.
english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

kikuyu: Neerna wuxuu dhalay Qiish, Qiishna wuxuu dhalay Saa'uul, Saa'uulna wuxuu dhalay Yoonaataan, iyo Malkiishuuca, iyo Abiinaadaab, iyo Eshbacal.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

kikuyu: Wiilkii Yoonaataanna wuxuu ahaa Meriibacal, Meriibacalna wuxuu dhalay Miikaah.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Miikaahna waxay ahaayeen Fiitoon, iyo Meleg, iyo Taxreeca iyo Aaxaas.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Aaxaasna wuxuu dhalay Yacraah, Yacraahna wuxuu dhalay Calemed, iyo Casmaawed, iyo Simrii, Simriina wuxuu dhalay Moosaa.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

kikuyu: Moosaana wuxuu dhalay Bincaa, oo wiilkiisiina wuxuu ahaa Refaayaah, oo dhalay Elecaasaah, oo isna dhalay Aaseel,
english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

kikuyu: Aaseelna wuxuu lahaa lix wiil, oo magacyadoodiina waa kuwan: Casriiqaam, iyo Bokeruu, iyo Ismaaciil, iyo Shecaryaah, iyo Cobadyaah, iyo Xaanaan. Intaasu waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Aaseel.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

kikuyu: Haddaba reer Falastiin waxay la dirireen reer binu Israa'iil, oo raggii reer binu Israa'iilna way ka carareen reer Falastiin, oo Buur Gilboca ayay ku daateen iyagoo la laayay.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Oo reer Falastiin aad bay u eryadeen Saa'uul iyo wiilashiisii, markaasaa reer Falastiin waxay dileen Yoonaataan, iyo Abiinaadaab, iyo Malkiishuuca oo ahaa Saa'uul wiilashiisii.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

kikuyu: Oo dagaalkiina aad buu ugu sii kululaaday Saa'uul, oo waxaa isagii gaadhay qaansoleydii, oo isna qaansoleydii aawadeed ayuu dhib badan ula kulmay.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Saa'uul wuxuu kii hubka u siday ku yidhi, War seeftaada la soo bax oo iga mudhbixi, waaba intaasoo buuryoqabyadanu yimaadaan oo ay i caayaane. Laakiinse kii hubka u siday wuu diiday, waayo, aad buu u cabsaday. Sidaas daraaddeed Saa'uul wuxuu qaatay seeftiisii, markaasuu ku dul dhacay.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

kikuyu: Oo kii hubka u sidayna markuu arkay in Saa'uul dhintay isna wuxuu ku dul dhacay seeftiisii, wuuna dhintay.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaa wada dhintay Saa'uul iyo saddexdiisii wiil, oo reerkiisii oo dhammu way wada dhinteen.
english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

kikuyu: Oo raggii reer binu Israa'iil oo dooxada joogay oo dhammu markay arkeen inay iyagu carareen, oo Saa'uul iyo wiilashiisii ay dhinteen ayay magaalooyinkoodii ka tageen, oo carareen, markaasaa reer Falastiin yimaadeen oo iska degeen.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: Oo maalintii dambe markay reer Falastiin u yimaadeen inay dharka ka furtaan kuwii la dilay waxay heleen Saa'uul iyo wiilashiisii oo Buur Gilboca ku dhintay.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Markaasay furteen oo waxay qaateen madaxiisii iyo hubkiisii, oo waxay u cid direen dalkii reer Falastiin oo ku wareegsanaa inay u wargeeyaan sanamyadooda iyo dadkiiba.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

kikuyu: Oo hubkiisiina gurigii ilaahyadooda ayay dhigeen, oo madaxiisiina waxay ku dhejiyeen gurigii Daagoon.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

kikuyu: Oo dadkii Yaabeesh Gilecaad oo dhammu markay maqleen waxyaalihii ay reer Falastiin Saa'uul ku sameeyeen oo dhan,
english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

kikuyu: waxaa kacay raggii xoogga lahaa oo dhan, oo waxay soo qaadeen Saa'uul meydkiisii iyo meydadkii wiilashiisa, kolkaasay keeneen Yaabeesh, oo lafahoodii waxay ku aaseen geedkii Yaabeesh ku yiil hoostiisa, toddoba maalmoodna way soomeen.
english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

kikuyu: Haddaba Saa'uul wuxuu u dhintay xadgudubkiisii uu isagu Rabbiga ku xadgudbay, maxaa yeelay, isagu Eraygii Rabbiga ma uu dhawrin, oo weliba isagu wuxuu talo weyddiistay mid ruuxaan lahayd, si uu iyada wax u weyddiisto,
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

kikuyu: oo Rabbiga wax ma uu weyddiisan, oo sidaas aawadeed ayaa Rabbigu isaga u dilay, oo boqortooyadiina wuxuu u wareejiyey Daa'uud oo ahaa ina Yesay.
english: and didn’t inquire of the LORD. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay Daa'uud ugu soo shireen Xebroon, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Annagu waxaannu nahay laftaada iyo jidhkaaga.
english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

kikuyu: Waagii hore markii Saa'uul boqorka ahaa adiguu ahaa kii reer binu Israa'iil dibadda u bixin jiray oo gudaha soo gelin jiray, oo Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ahuna wuxuu kugu yidhi, Adigu waxaad quudin doontaa dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil, oo amiir baanad u ahaan doontaa dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil.
english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed odayaashii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay boqorkii ugu yimaadeen Xebroon, oo Daa'uudna wuxuu iyagii axdi kula dhigtay Xebroon Rabbiga hortiisa; oo iyana waxay Daa'uud u boqreen inuu ahaado boqor reer binu Israa'iil u taliya, siduu ahaa Eraygii Rabbiga oo uu u soo dhiibay Samuu'eel.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay tageen Yeruusaalem (taasoo ah Yebuus), oo halkaasna waxaa joogay dadkii dalka degganaa oo ahaa reer Yebuus.
english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii Yebuus degganaa waxay Daa'uud ku yidhaahdeen, Adigu halkan soo geli maysid. Habase yeeshee Daa'uud waa qabsaday qalcaddii Siyoon, oo taasuna waa magaaladii Daa'uud.
english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu yidhi, Ku alla kii marka hore reer Yebuus laayaa wuxuu noqon doonaa madax iyo sirkaal. Oo waxaa markii hore baxay Yoo'aab oo ay Seruuyaah dhashay, oo isagii ayaa waxaa laga dhigay madax.
english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna qalcaddii ayuu degay, oo sidaas daraaddeed waxaa loo bixiyey magaaladii Daa'uud.
english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dhisay magaalada hareeraheedii, iyo tan iyo Millo wareeggeeda. Oo Yoo'aabna wuxuu cusboonaysiiyey magaalada inteedii kale.
english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna aad iyo aad buu u sii xoogaystay, waayo, waxaa isaga la jiray Rabbigii ciidammada.
english: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa kuwii u horreeyey ee nimankii xoogga badnaa oo Daa'uud haystay, kuwaasoo ismuujiyey inay isaga iyo boqortooyadiisa aad iyo aad ula jiraan si ay boqor uga dhigtaan iyadoo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu ay la wada jiraan, siduu ahaa Eraygii Rabbiga oo reer binu Israa'iil ku saabsanaa.
english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.

kikuyu: Oo tanuna waa tiradii raggii xoogga badnaa oo Daa'uud haystay: Yaashaabcaam oo ahaa reer Xakmoonii oo ahaa ka ugu horreeya soddonka, isagu wuxuu warankiisa u qaaday saddex boqol oo nin, oo isku mar buuna laayay.
english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

kikuyu: Oo isaga dabadiisna waxaa jiray Elecaasaar ina Doodoo, oo ahaa reer Axoo'ax, oo isna wuxuu ahaa saddexdii nin oo xoogga badnaa midkood.
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

kikuyu: Oo isagu wuxuu Daa'uud la joogay Fasdammiim, oo halkaasna waxaa dagaal ugu soo ururay reer Falastiin, meeshaas oo ahayd dhul beero ah oo shaciir ka buuxo, oo dadkiina way ka carareen reer Falastiin hortooda.
english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

kikuyu: Oo beertii bay isdhex taageen oo daafaceen, wayna laayeen reer Falastiin, oo Rabbiguna wuxuu iyagii ku badbaadiyey guul weyn.
english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.

kikuyu: Oo soddonkii ugu horreeyey saddex ka mid ah ayaa hoos ugu dhaadhacay dhagixii weynaa ee Daa'uud joogay, oo waxay galeen godkii Cadullaam, oo ciidankii reer Falastiinna waxay soo degeen dooxadii Refaa'iim.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Oo markaas Daa'uud wuxuu ku jiray dhufayskii, oo ciidankii reer Falastiin xeradooduna waxay ahayd Beytlaxam.
english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna intuu biyo u xiisooday ayuu yidhi, Waxaan jeclaan lahaa in biyo layga siiyo ceelka Beytlaxam, ee iridda ku ag yaal!
english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa saddexdii ayaa dhex maray ciidankii reer Falastiin, oo waxay biyo ka soo dhaamiyeen ceelkii Beytlaxam ee iridda ku ag yiil, oo intay soo qaadeen ayay Daa'uud u keeneen, laakiinse Daa'uud wuu diiday inuu cabbo biyahaas, Rabbiguuse u daadshay.
english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Anigu inaan saas yeelo Ilaahaygu ha ii diido, ma waxaan cabbaa dhiiggii nimankan naftooda biimeeyey? Waayo, iyagu biyahan waxay ku keeneen naftoodii oo halis ku jirta. Sidaas daraaddeed wuu diiday inuu cabbo. Oo saddexdii nin oo xoogga badnaana saasay yeeleen.
english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

kikuyu: Oo saddexdoodana waxaa madax u ahaa Abiishay oo ahaa Yoo'aab walaalkiis, waayo, isagu wuxuu warankiisa u qaaday saddex boqol oo nin, wuuna laayay, saddexdiina magac buu ku lahaa.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

kikuyu: Oo isagu labada kaleba wuu ka ciso badnaa, oo waxaa looga dhigay sirkaal, habase yeeshee saddexdii hore ma uu gaadhin.
english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

kikuyu: Benaayaah ina Yehooyaadaac, oo uu dhalay nin xoog weyn oo reer Qabse'eel ahu, kaasoo sameeyey falimo waaweyn wuxuu dilay labadii wiil oo Arii'eel kii reer Moo'aab, oo haddana wuu tegay oo libaax buu god ku dhex dilay wakhtiga barafka,
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu kaloo dilay nin Masri ah oo ahaa nin aad u dheer, oo dhererkiisuna wuxuu ahaa shan dhudhun, oo Masriguna wuxuu gacanta ku haystay waran le'eg dharsameeyaha looxiisa, oo isna wuxuu ula tegey ul, oo warankii ka dhufsaday gacantii Masriga, oo isagii ku dilay warankiisii.
english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

kikuyu: Oo waxyaalahan waxaa sameeyey Benaayaah oo ahaa ina Yehooyaadaac, oo isna saddexdii nin ee xoogga badnaa magac buu ku lahaa.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, isagu wuu ka ciso badnaa soddonka, laakiinse ma uu gaadhin saddexdii hore, oo Daa'uudna wuxuu isaga madax uga dhigay lataliyayaashiisii.
english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

kikuyu: Oo weliba raggii ciidammada ku jiray oo xoogga badnaa waxay ahaayeen Casaaheel oo Yoo'aab walaalkiis ahaa, iyo Elxaanaan oo ahaa ina Doodoo oo reer Beytlaxam ahaa,
english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

kikuyu: iyo Shammood oo ahaa reer Xarod, iyo Xeles oo ahaa reer Feloonii,
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

kikuyu: iyo Ciiraa ina Ciqeesh oo ahaa reer Teqooca, iyo Abiiceser oo ahaa reer Canaatood,
english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

kikuyu: iyo Sibbekay oo ahaa reer Xushaad, iyo Ciilay oo ahaa reer Axoo'ax,
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

kikuyu: iyo Maharay oo ahaa reer Netofaah, iyo Xeeled ina Bacanaah oo ahaa reer Netofaah,
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

kikuyu: iyo Iitay ina Riibay oo ahaa reer Gibecaah oo qoladiisu ahayd reer Benyaamiin, iyo Benaayaah oo ahaa reer Fircaatoon,
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

kikuyu: iyo Xuuray oo ka yimid durdurradii Gacash, iyo Abii'eel oo ahaa reer Caraabaah,
english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

kikuyu: iyo Casmaawed oo ahaa reer Baxuuriim, iyo Elyaxbaa oo ahaa reer Shacalbiim,
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

kikuyu: iyo ina Haasheem oo ahaa reer Gisonii, iyo Yoonaataan ina Shaagee oo ahaa reer Haraarii,
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

kikuyu: iyo Axiyaam oo ahaa ina Saakaar oo ahaa reer Haraarii, iyo Eliifaal oo ahaa ina Uur,
english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

kikuyu: iyo Heefer oo ahaa reer Mekeeraatii, iyo Axiiyaah oo ahaa reer Feloonii,
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

kikuyu: iyo Xesroo oo ahaa reer Karmel, iyo Nacaray oo ahaa ina Esbay,
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

kikuyu: iyo Yoo'eel oo ahaa Naataan walaalkiis, iyo Mibxaar oo ahaa ina Hagrii,
english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

kikuyu: iyo Seleq oo ahaa reer Cammoon, iyo Naxaray oo ahaa reer Beerod, oo ahaa kii gaashaanka u qaadi jiray Yoo'aab oo ay Seruuyaah dhashay,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

kikuyu: iyo Ciiraa oo ahaa reer Yeter, iyo Gaareeb oo ahaa reer Yeter,
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

kikuyu: iyo Uuriyaah oo ahaa reer Xeed, iyo Soobaad oo ahaa ina Axlay,
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

kikuyu: iyo Cadiinaa oo ahaa ina Shiisaa oo ahaa reer Ruubeen, oo weliba madax u ahaa reer Ruubeen iyo soddon isaga la jirtay,
english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

kikuyu: iyo Xaanaan oo ahaa ina Macakaah, iyo Yooshaafaad oo ahaa reer Mitnii,
english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

kikuyu: iyo Cusiyaa oo ahaa reer Cashteraatii, iyo Shamac, iyo Yecii'eel oo ahaa wiilashii Xootaam oo ahaa reer Carooceer,
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

kikuyu: iyo Yediica'eel oo ahaa ina Shimrii, iyo Yooxaa oo ahaa isaga walaalkiis oo qoladoodu ahayd reer Tiisii,
english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

kikuyu: iyo Elii'eel oo ahaa reer Maxawiim, iyo Yeriibay, iyo Yooshawiyaah oo ahaa wiilashii Elnacam, iyo Yitmaah oo ahaa reer Moo'aab,
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

kikuyu: iyo Elii'eel, iyo Coobeed, iyo Yacasii'eel oo ahaa reer Mesobaayaah.
english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

kikuyu: Haddaba intanu waa kuwii Daa'uud ugu yimid Siiqlag, intuu weli ka dhumanayay Saa'uul ina Qiish, oo iyagu waxay ku jireen ragga xoogga badan oo la dagaal galay.
english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu qaansooyin bay siteen, oo gacanta midigta iyo tan bidixdaba dhagaxyo way ku wadhfin kareen, fallaadhona qaansooyin way kaga gani kareen, oo iyagu waxay ahaayeen reer Benyaamiin oo Saa'uul walaalihiis ah.
english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa madax ahaa Axiiceser, dabadeedna Yoo'aash, oo ahaa ina Shemaacaah oo ahaa reer Gibecaad, iyo Yesii'eel iyo Feled oo ahaa wiilashii Casmaawed, iyo Beraakaah, iyo Yeehuu oo ahaa reer Canaatood,
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

kikuyu: iyo Yishmacyaah oo ahaa reer Gibecoon oo ahaa nin xoog badan oo soddonka ka mid ahaa, oo weliba soddonka ka wada sarreeyey, iyo Yeremyaah, iyo Yaxasii'eel, iyo Yooxaanaan, iyo Yoosaabaad oo ahaa reer Gedeeraad,
english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

kikuyu: iyo Elcuusay, iyo Yeriimood, iyo Becalyaah, iyo Shemaryaah, iyo Shefatyaah oo ahaa reer Xaruuf,
english: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

kikuyu: iyo Elqaanaah, iyo Yishiyaah, iyo Casareel, iyo Yooceser, iyo Yaashaabcaam oo ahaa reer Qorax,
english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

kikuyu: iyo Yooceelaah iyo Sebadyaah oo ahaa wiilashii Yeroxaam oo ahaa reer Gedoor.
english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa reer Gaad Daa'uud isaga soocay oo ugu tegey dhufayskii cidlada ku yiil rag xoog badan oo ah rag dagaal loo tababbaray, oo gaashaan iyo waran qaadan karay, oo wejigooduna wuxuu ahaa sida weji libaax oo kale, oo waxay u dheereeyeen sida cawsha buuraha joogta.
english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

kikuyu: Oo iyaga waxaa madax ahaa Ceser, Cobadyaahna wuxuu ahaa kii labaad, Elii'aabna kii saddexaad,
english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

kikuyu: Mishmannaahna kii afraad, Yeremyaahna kii shanaad,
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

kikuyu: Catayna kii lixaad, Elii'eelna kii toddobaad,
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

kikuyu: Yooxaanaanna kii siddeedaad, Elsaabaadna kii sagaalaad,
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

kikuyu: Yeremyaahna kii tobnaad, Makbannayna kii kow iyo tobnaad.
english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo ahaa reer Gaad waxay ahaayeen saraakiishii ciidanka, oo kii iyaga ugu yaraa wuxuu u dhigmaa boqol nin, kii ugu weynaana kun nin.
english: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.

kikuyu: Oo kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen kuwii bishii kowaad ka gudbay Webi Urdun oo buuxdhaafay oo qararka oo dhan ka daatay, oo iyagu waxay kala eryeen dadkii dooxooyinka degganaa oo dhan, xagga bari, iyo xagga galbeedba.
english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhufayska Daa'uud ugu yimid reer Benyaamiin iyo reer Yahuudah qaarkooda.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud u baxay inuu iyaga ka hor tago, oo intuu jawaabay ayuu ku yidhi, Haddaad nabdoon iigu timaadeen inaad i caawisaan qalbigaygu wuu idinla jiri doonaa, laakiinse haddaad iigu timaadeen inaad cadaawayaashayda ii gacangelisaan, Ilaahii awowayaasheen taas ha fiiriyo oo ha canaanto, maxaa yeelay, gacmahayga wax xumaan ahu kuma jiraan.
english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa ruuxii ku soo degay Camaasay oo soddonkii nin madax u ahaa, oo wuxuu yidhi, Daa'uudow, ina Yesayow, annagu waxaannu nahay kuwaagii, waannuna ku garab taagan nahay. Nabad. Nabad ha kula jirto, oo kaalmeeyayaashaadana nabad ha la jirto, waayo, waxaa ku caawiya Ilaahaaga. Markaasaa Daa'uud iyagii soo dhoweeyey oo wuxuu ka dhigay saraakiishii guutada.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

kikuyu: Oo weliba reer Manasehna qaar baa Daa'uud geestiisa soo maray markuu raacay reer Falastiin oo Saa'uul dagaal ugu yimid, laakiinse iyagii ma ay caawiyin, waayo, saraakiishii reer Falastiin talay isagii ku eryeen, oo waxay isyidhaahdeen, Isagu intuu madaxyadeenna khatar geliyo ayuu sayidkiisii Saa'uul garab geli doonaa.
english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

kikuyu: Oo markuu Siiqlag tegey waxaa geestiisa reer Manaseh ka soo maray Cadnaah, iyo Yoosaabaad, iyo Yediica'eel, iyo Miikaa'eel, iyo Yoosaabaad, iyo Eliihuu, iyo Silletay, oo dhammaantood ahaa saraakiil u taliya kun kun reer Manaseh ah.
english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Oo waxay Daa'uud ka caawiyeen guutadii wax dhacaysay, waayo, waxay ahaayeen rag xoog badan oo ahaa saraakiishii ciidanka.
english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

kikuyu: Waayo, maalin ka maalin waxaa Daa'uud u iman jiray kuwo isaga caawiya, ilamaa ay noqdeen ciidan weyn, oo ah sidii ciidanka Ilaah.
english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

kikuyu: Oo tanuna waa tiradii kuwii madaxda u ahaa kuwii dagaalka hubka u lahaa, oo Daa'uud ugu yimid Xebroon inay boqortooyada Saa'uul isaga u rogaan sidii uu eraygii Rabbigu ahaa.
english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Kuwii reer Yahuudah ee gaashaan iyo waran qaadayay waxay ahaayeen lix kun iyo siddeed boqol oo nin, oo dagaal hub u leh.
english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii reer Simecoon ee xoogga badnaa, dagaalkana u darbanaa waxay ahaayeen toddoba kun iyo boqol.
english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

kikuyu: Reer Laawina waxaa ka joogay afar kun iyo lix boqol.
english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Oo Yehooyaadaacna wuxuu ahaa madaxdii reer Haaruun, oo isagana waxaa la socday saddex kun iyo toddoba boqol oo nin.
english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

kikuyu: Saadooqna wuxuu ahaa nin dhallinyar oo xoog badan, oo waxaa la jiray laba iyo labaatan sirkaal oo reerkiisii wada ah.
english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

kikuyu: Oo reer Benyaamiin oo ahaa Saa'uul walaalihiisna waxaa ka joogay saddex kun oo nin, waayo, ilaa waagaas iyaga intoodii badnayd waxay daacad u sii ahaayeen reerkii Saa'uul.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

kikuyu: Oo reer Efrayimna waxaa ka joogay labaatan kun iyo siddeed boqol oo nin, oo ah rag xoog badan oo dhammaantood reerahooda caan ku ah.
english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Oo reer Manaseh badhkiisiina waxaa ka joogay siddeed iyo toban kun oo nin, oo loo magacaabay inay yimaadaan oo ay Daa'uud boqraan.
english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

kikuyu: Oo reer Isaakaarna waxaa ka joogay rag garasho u leh wakhtiyada iyo waxa reer binu Israa'iil waajibka ku ah inay sameeyaan, oo iyaga madaxdoodu waxay ahaayeen laba boqol oo nin oo walaalahood oo dhanna iyagaa xukumay.
english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

kikuyu: Oo reer Sebulunna waxaa ka joogay kuwo ciidanka geli kara oo dagaalka isu safi kara, iyagoo wata cayn kasta oo ah alaabta dagaalka, oo isdiyaarin kara, oo aan labaqalbiilayaal ahayn, oo tiradooduna waxay ahayd konton kun oo nin.
english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

kikuyu: Oo reer Naftaalina waxaa ka joogay kun sirkaal oo ay la socdaan toddoba iyo soddon kun oo nin oo waran iyo gaashaan wada sita.
english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: Oo reer Daanna waxaa ka joogay siddeed iyo labaatan kun iyo lix boqol oo nin oo dagaalka isu safi kara.
english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Oo reer Aasheerna waxaa ka joogay afartan kun oo nin oo ciidanka geli kara oo dagaalka isu safi kara.
english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

kikuyu: Oo Webi Urdun dhankiisa kalena waxaa ka yimid boqol iyo labaatan kun oo nin oo wata cayn kasta oo ah alaabta dagaalka, oo waxayna ahaayeen reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo reer Manaseh badhkiis.
english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

kikuyu: Intaas oo dhan oo wada ahaa rag dagaalyahan ah oo dagaalka isu safi kara waxay Xebroon ula yimaadeen qalbi qumman inay Daa'uud reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan u boqraan, oo reer binu Israa'iil intooda hadhay oo dhammuna isku qalbi bay ku ahaayeen inay Daa'uud boqraan.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

kikuyu: Oo iyana halkaasay Daa'uud la joogeen intii saddex maalmood ah, iyagoo wax cunaya oo wax cabbaya, waayo, walaalahood baa sooryo u diyaariyey.
english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

kikuyu: Oo weliba dadkii iyaga u dhowaa ee ahaa ilaa reer Isaakaar iyo reer Sebulun iyo reer Naftaali waxay cunto ku soo rareen dameerro, iyo awr, iyo baqlo, iyo dibi, oo waxay keeneen bur, iyo fudad berde ah, iyo rucubo sabiib ah, iyo khamri, iyo saliid, iyo dibi, iyo ido, dhammaanna aad iyo aad bay u badnaayeen, maxaa yeelay, reer binu Israa'iil dhexdooda farxad baa jirtay.
english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu la arrinsaday saraakiishii kun kun u taliyey iyo kuwii boqol boqol u taliyey iyo xataa hoggaamiye kasta.
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu shirkii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan ku yidhi, Hadday idinla wanaagsan tahay iyo hadday tahay tan Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah aynu meel kasta ugu cid dirno walaalaheenna ku hadhay dalka Israa'iil oo dhan, kuwaasoo ah kuwa wadaaddada iyo reer Laawi ay la dhex joogaan magaalooyinkooda agagaarka leh, si ay iyaguna inoogu soo ururaan.
english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

kikuyu: Oo weliba aynu sanduuqii Ilaaheenna mar kale soo ceshanno, waayo, isagii waynu iska daynay wakhtigii Saa'uul noolaa.
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa shirkii oo dhammu waxay yidhaahdeen, Haah, oo sidaasaynu yeelaynaa, maxaa yeelay, taasu dadkii oo dhan ayay la qummanayd.
english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Daa'uud soo wada shiriyey reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, oo wuxuu ka soo ururiyey tan iyo Shiixoor oo ah durdurka Masar iyo xataa tan iyo meesha Xamaad laga galo in sanduuqii Ilaah Qiryad Yecaariim laga soo qaado.
english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay tageen Bacalaah, oo ah Qiryad Yecaariim, oo ay reer Yahuudah iska leeyihiin, inay halkaas ka soo qaadaan sanduuqii Ilaah oo ah meesha Rabbiga Keruubiimta kala dhex fadhiya magiciisa lagu baryo.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

kikuyu: Oo sanduuqii Ilaah gaadhi cusub bay saareen, markay ka soo bixiyeen gurigii Abiinaadaab, oo gaadhigiina waxaa waday Cuusaa iyo Axiyoo.
english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay Ilaah hortiis ku cayaareen xooggooda oo dhan, oo gabayo, iyo kataarado, iyo shareerado, iyo dafaf, iyo suxuun laysku garaaco, iyo turumbooyin ayay ku cayaareen.
english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

kikuyu: Oo markay yimaadeen meeshii hadhuudhka lagu tumi jiray oo Kiidon ayaa Cuusaa gacanta fidiyey si uu u qabto sanduuqii, waayo, dibidii sidday ayaa turunturootay.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu aad ugu cadhooday Cuusaa, wuuna dilay, maxaa yeelay, isagu wuxuu gacanta ku fidiyey sanduuqa, oo halkaasuu ku dhintay Ilaah hortiisa.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna taas buu ka xumaaday, maxaa yeelay, Rabbigu degdeg buu u qabtay Cuusaa, oo meeshaas magaceedii wuxuu u bixiyey Feres Cuusaa, oo ilaa maantadanna waa la yidhaahdaa.
english: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna maalintaas wuu ka baqay Ilaah, oo wuxuu isyidhi, Sanduuqa Ilaah bal sidee baan magaaladayda u geeysanayaa?
english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Daa'uud sanduuqii ma geeyn magaaladiisii, laakiinse gees buu ugu leexshay gurigii Cobeed Edoom kii reer Gad.
english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

kikuyu: Oo saddex bilood ayaa sanduuqii Ilaah gurigii Cobeed Edoom xaaskiisa la yiil, oo Rabbiguna wuu barakeeyey Cobeed Edoom reerkiisii iyo wixii uu haystay oo dhan.
english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Xiiraam oo ahaa boqorkii Turos ayaa Daa'uud wargeeyayaal u soo diray, iyo geedo kedar la yidhaahdo, iyo wastaadyo, iyo nijaarro, inay guri u dhisaan.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud wuxuu ogaaday in Rabbigu isaga u taagay inuu ahaado boqor u taliya reer binu Israa'iil, waayo, boqortooyadiisii waa la sarraysiiyey dadkiisa reer binu Israa'iil aawadood.
english: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna naago kale buu Yeruusaalem ku guursaday, oo wuxuu dhalay wiilal iyo gabdho kale.
english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Oo carruurtii Yeruusaalem ugu dhalatay magacyadoodiina waa kuwan: Shammuuca, iyo Shoobaab, iyo Naataan, iyo Sulaymaan,
english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

kikuyu: iyo Yibxaar, iyo Eliishuuca, iyo Elfaaled,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

kikuyu: iyo Nogah, iyo Nefeg, iyo Yaafiica,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: iyo Eliishaamaac, iyo Becelyaadaac, iyo Eliifeled.
english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

kikuyu: Oo reer Falastiinna markay maqleen in Daa'uud loo subkay inuu boqor u ahaado reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan ayay reer Falastiin oo dhammu u soo baxeen inay Daa'uud doondoonaan, oo Daa'uudna taas wuu maqlay, oo isna iyagii ayuu ku baxay.
english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

kikuyu: Haddaba reer Falastiin way yimaadeen, oo waxay ku firdheen dooxadii Refaa'iim.
english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud Rabbiga wax weyddiiyey oo yidhi, Miyaan reer Falastiin ku kacaa? Miyaad ii soo gacangelinaysaa? Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu ku yidhi, Haah, ku kac, waayo, iyaga waan kuu soo gacangelinayaa.
english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

kikuyu: Hadda waxay yimaadeen Bacal Feraasiim, oo halkaasaa Daa'uud iyagii ku laayay, oo Daa'uud wuxuu yidhi, Rabbigu cadaawayaashaydii ayuu gacantayda degdeg ugu qabtay, sida biyaha butaacayaa u degdegaan oo kale. Sidaas daraaddeed meeshaas magaceedii waxaa loo bixiyey Bacal Feraasiim.
english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

kikuyu: Iyana halkaasay ilaahyadoodii kaga tageen, markaasaa Daa'uud amar ku bixiyey in la gubo.
english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

kikuyu: Haddana reer Falastiin mar kalay dooxadii ku soo firdheen.
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna mar kaluu Rabbiga wax weyddiiyey, oo Ilaahna wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa inaanad ka daba kicin, laakiinse iyaga ka leexo, oo waxaad ku weerartaa meel ka soo hor jeedda geedaha bukaa la yidhaahdo.
english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

kikuyu: Oo markaad sanqadha askarta socodkeeda ka maqashid geedaha bukaa dushooda, markaas dagaalka hore ugu bax, waayo, Ilaah waa kaaga hor baxay inuu ciidanka reer Falastiin laayo.
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna wuxuu yeelay sidii Ilaah ku amray, oo waxay ciidankii reer Falastiin ku laynayeen ilaa Gibecoon iyo tan iyo Geser.
english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud warkiisiina wuxuu gaadhay dalalka oo dhan, oo Rabbiguna cabsi isaga ka timid ayuu ku riday quruumihii kale oo dhan.
english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu magaaladii Daa'uud ka dhistay guryo, oo sanduuqii Ilaahna meel buu u hagaajiyey, teendhona buu u dhisay.
english: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud yidhi, Waa inaan ninna qaadin sanduuqa Ilaah reer Laawi mooyaane, waayo, Rabbigu iyaguu u doortay inay qaadaan sanduuqa Ilaah, iyo inay isaga u adeegaan weligood.
english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan wuxuu ku soo wada ururiyey Yeruusaalem in sanduuqii Rabbiga la keeno meeshiisii uu u hagaajiyey.
english: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.

kikuyu: Oo haddana Daa'uud wuxuu soo wada ururiyey reer Haaruun iyo reer Laawi.
english: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

kikuyu: Kuwii reer Qohaad waxay ahaayeen Uurii'eel oo madax ahaa, iyo walaalihiis oo ahaa boqol iyo labaatan nin,
english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

kikuyu: kuwii reer Meraariina, Casaayaah oo madax ahaa, iyo laba boqol iyo labaatan nin oo walaalihiis ahaa,
english: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

kikuyu: kuwii reer Gershoomna, Yoo'eel oo madax ahaa, iyo boqol iyo soddon nin oo walaalihiis ahaa,
english: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;

kikuyu: kuwii reer Eliisaafaanna, Shemacyaah oo madax ahaa, iyo laba boqol oo nin oo walaalihiis ahaa,
english: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

kikuyu: kuwii reer Xebroonna, Elii'eel oo madax ahaa, iyo siddeetan nin oo walaalihiis ahaa,
english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

kikuyu: kuwii reer Cusii'eelna, Cammiinaadaab oo madax ahaa, iyo boqol iyo laba iyo toban nin oo walaalihiis ahaa.
english: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud u yeedhay Saadooq iyo Aabyaataar oo wadaaddada ahaa, iyo kuwii reer Laawi oo ahaa Uurii'eel, iyo Casaayaah, iyo Yoo'eel, iyo Shemacyaah, iyo Elii'eel, iyo Cammiinaadaab,
english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinku waxaad tihiin madaxdii qolooyinka reer Laawi, haddaba idinka iyo walaalihiinba isdaahiriya si aad sanduuqii Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil ugu soo qaaddaan meeshii aan u hagaajiyey.
english: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, indinku markii hore ma aydnaan qaadin, oo sidaas daraaddeed ayaa Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu degdeg inoogu qabtay, waayo, sidii qaynuunku ahaa wax kuma aynan weyddiin.
english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed ayaa wadaaddadii iyo kuwii reer Laawi isdaahiriyeen inay soo qaadaan sanduuqii Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil.
english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa reer Laawi garbaha ku qaadeen sanduuqii Ilaah iyagoo ulihiisii ku sida, sidii Muuse amray oo uu eraygii Rabbigu ahaa.
english: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud madaxdii reer Laawi ku yidhi, Walaalihiin rag ka dhex doorta inay ahaadaan niman gabayaa ah oo sita alaabtii muusikada, oo ah shareerado, iyo kataarado, iyo suxuun laysku garaaco, oo aad ha uga dhawaajiyeen oo farxad aawadeed codka kor ha u qaadeen.
english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed reer Laawi waxay doorteen Heemaan oo ahaa ina Yoo'eel iyo walaalihiis oo ahaa Aasaaf ina Berekyaah, oo walaalahood reer Meraariina waxay ka doorteen Eetaan ina Quushaayaah,
english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

kikuyu: oo iyaga waxaa la jiray walaalahood oo ahaa darajadii labaad, waxayna ahaayeen Sekaryaah, iyo Been, iyo Yacasii'eel, iyo Shemiiraamood, iyo Yexii'eel, iyo Cunnii, iyo Elii'aab, iyo Benaayaah, iyo Macaseeyaah, iyo Matityaah, iyo Eliifeleehuu, iyo Miqneeyaah, iyo Cobeed Edoom, iyo Yecii'eel oo dhammaantood wada ahaa iridjoogayaal.
english: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kuwii gabayaagii ahaa oo ahaa Heemaan, iyo Aasaaf, iyo Eetaan waxay siteen suxuun naxaas ah oo laysku garaaco si ay aad ugaga dhawaajiyaan,
english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

kikuyu: oo Sekaryaah, iyo Casii'eel, iyo Shemiiraamood iyo Yexii'eel, iyo Cunnii, iyo Elii'aab, iyo Macaseeyaah, iyo Benaayaahna waxay siteen shareerado si ay ugu dhuftaan wax Calaamood lagu luuqeeyo,
english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

kikuyu: oo Matityaah, iyo Eliifeleehuu, iyo Miqneeyaah, iyo Cobeed Edoom, iyo Yecii'eel, iyo Casasyaahna waxay siteen kataarado ay ku hoggaamiyaan wax Shemiiniid lagu luuqeeyo.
english: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

kikuyu: Oo Kenanyaah oo madax u ahaa reer Laawina wuxuu u sarreeyey gabaygii, oo isagu wuxuu dadkii wax ka baray gabaygii, maxaa yeelay, aad buu u yiqiin.
english: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

kikuyu: Oo Berekyaah iyo Elqaanaahna waxay iridjoogayaal u ahaayeen sanduuqii.
english: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

kikuyu: Oo wadaaddadii ahaa Shebanyaah, iyo Yehooshaafaad, iyo Netaneel, iyo Camaasay, iyo Sekaryaah, iyo Benaayaah, iyo Eliiceserna turumbooyin ayay ku hor afuufayeen sanduuqii Ilaah, oo Cobeed Edoom iyo Yexiyaahna iridjoogayaal ayay sanduuqii u ahaayeen.
english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Daa'uud iyo odayaashii reer binu Israa'iil iyo kuwii kun kun u taliyeyba waxay u tageen inay sanduuqii axdiga Rabbiga ka soo qaadaan gurigii Cobeed Edoom iyagoo faraxsan.
english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

kikuyu: Oo markii Ilaah caawiyey kuwii reer Laawi oo qaaday sanduuqii axdiga Rabbiga ayay toddoba dibi iyo toddoba wan ku allabaryeen.
english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna wuxuu xidhnaa dhar aad u wanaagsan, isaga iyo kuwii reer Laawi oo sanduuqa qaaday oo dhan, iyo nimankii gabayaaga ahaa, iyo Kenanyaah oo ahaa madaxdii gabayga oo la jiray nimankii gabayaaga ahaa, oo Daa'uudna wuxuu qabay eefod maro wanaagsan ah.
english: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

kikuyu: Haddaba reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu saasay u soo qaadeen sanduuqii axdiga Rabbiga iyagoo dhawaaqaya, oo afuufaya buun iyo turumbooyin, oo ka dhawaajinaya suxuun laysku garaaco, iyo shareerado iyo kataarado.
english: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

kikuyu: Oo markii sanduuqii axdiga Rabbigu uu magaaladii Daa'uud imanayay ayay Miikaal oo ahayd ina Saa'uul daaqadda ka eegtay, oo kolkay aragtay Boqor Daa'uud oo cayaaraya ayay qalbiga ka quudhsatay.
english: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

kikuyu: Oo iyana sanduuqii Ilaah gudahay soo geliyeen, oo dhex dhigeen teendhadii Daa'uud u dhisay, oo waxay Ilaah hortiisa ku bixiyeen qurbaanno la gubo iyo qurbaanno nabaadiino.
english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna markuu dhammeeyey qurbaankii la gubayay iyo qurbaannadii nabaadiinada ee uu bixinayay ayuu dadkii ugu duceeyey magicii Rabbiga.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Oo markaasuu reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, nin iyo naagba, mid kasta siiyey xabbad kibis ah, iyo cad hilib ah, iyo fud sabiib ah.
english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii reer Laawi qaarkoodna wuxuu u doortay inay ka adeegaan sanduuqa Rabbiga hortiisa, iyo inay xusuustaan oo ku mahadnaqaan oo ammaanaan Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil,
english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

kikuyu: kuwaasoo ahaa Aasaaf oo kii kowaad ahaa, iyo Sekaryaah oo ahaa kii labaad, iyo Yecii'eel, iyo Shemiiraamood, iyo Yexii'eel, iyo Matityaah, iyo Elii'aab, iyo Benaayaah, iyo Cobeed Edoom, iyo Yecii'eel oo haysan jiray shareerado iyo kataarado, oo Aasaafna wuxuu aad uga dhawaajin jiray suxuun laysku garaaco.
english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

kikuyu: Oo Benaayaah iyo Yaxasii'eel oo wadaaddo ahaana turumbooyin ayay had iyo goorba ku haysan jireen sanduuqii axdiga Ilaah hortiisa.
english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas ayaa Daa'uud markii ugu horraysay ku amray inay Aasaaf iyo walaalihiis Rabbiga ku mahadnaqaan.
english: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku mahadnaqa, oo magiciisa ku barya, Falimihiisana dadyowga ka dhex sheega.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Isaga u gabya, oo ammaan ugu gabya, Shuqulladiisa yaabka badan oo dhanna ka hadla.
english: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

kikuyu: Ku faana magiciisa quduuska ah, Kuwa Rabbiga doondoona qalbigoodu ha reyreeyo.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

kikuyu: Rabbiga iyo xooggiisa doondoona, Oo weligiinba wejigiisa doondoona.
english: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

kikuyu: Xusuusta shuqulladiisii yaabka badnaa oo uu sameeyey, Iyo cajaa'ibyadiisii iyo xukummadii afkiisa,
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

kikuyu: Kuwiinna farcanka addoonkiisii Israa'iilow, Kuwiisa uu doortay oo reer Yacquub ahow.
english: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: Isagu waa Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah, Xukummadiisiina waxay ku jiraan dhulka oo dhan.
english: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

kikuyu: Bal idinku weligiin xusuusta axdigiisa, Kaasoo ah hadalkiisii uu dadkii kun qarni ku amray;
english: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

kikuyu: Kaasu waa axdigii uu Ibraahim la dhigtay, Oo uu Isxaaq ugu dhaartay,
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.

kikuyu: Oo isla kaas wuxuu u adkeeyey oo qaynuun uga dhigay Yacquub, Oo Israa'iilna wuxuu uga dhigay axdi weligiis jiraya,
english: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Dalka Kancaan waxaan kuu siinayaa Inuu ahaado qaybtii dhaxalkiinna,
english: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”

kikuyu: Markaad dad tiro yar ahaydeen, Oo aad aad u yaraydeen, qariibna dalka ku ahaydeen.
english: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

kikuyu: Oo iyaguna quruunba quruun bay uga baxeen. Oo intay boqortooyo ka tageen ayay dad kale u gudbeen.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

kikuyu: Isagu ninna uma oggolaanin inuu wax yeelo, Haah, oo daraaddood ayuu boqorro u canaantay,
english: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ha taabanina kuwayga subkan, Oo nebiyadaydana waxba ha yeelina.
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

kikuyu: Dadka dhulka oo dhammow, Rabbiga u gabya, Oo badbaadintiisana muujiya maalin ka maalin.
english: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

kikuyu: Ammaantiisana quruumaha dhexdooda ka sheega, Oo shuqulladiisa yaabka badanna dadyowga oo dhan ka dhex sheega.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu waa weyn yahay, waana mudan yahay in aad loo ammaano, Isaga waa in laga cabsado in ka sii badan ilaahyada oo dhan.
english: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

kikuyu: Waayo, dadyowga ilaahyadooda oo dhammu waa sanamyo, Laakiinse Rabbigu isagaa sameeyey samooyinka.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

kikuyu: Sharaf iyo haybaduba hortiisay yaalliin, Xoog iyo farxaduna meeshiisay ku jiraan.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

kikuyu: Dadka qolooyinkiisow, Rabbiga ammaana, Waxaad Rabbiga ka sheegtaan ammaan iyo xoog.
english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!

kikuyu: Waxaad Rabbiga ka sheegtaan ammaanta magiciisu mudan yahay, Qurbaan u keena, oo hortiisa kaalaya, Rabbiga ku caabuda quruxda quduusnimada,
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

kikuyu: Dadka dhulka oo dhammow, hortiisa ku gariira. Duniduna waxay u dhisan tahay si aan la dhaqaajin karin.
english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Haddaba samooyinku ha farxeen, dhulkuna ha reyreeyo, Oo quruumaha dhexdooda ha laga yidhaahdo, Rabbigu waa boqor.
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”

kikuyu: Badda iyo waxa ka buuxaba ha guuxeen, Berriga iyo waxa ku jira oo dhammuna ha farxeen,
english: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

kikuyu: Oo markaasay dhirta duurka Rabbiga hortiisa ku gabyi doonaan farxad daraaddeed, Waayo, isagu waa u imanayaa inuu dhulka xukumo.
english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku mahadnaqa, waayo, isagu waa wanaagsan yahay, Oo naxariistiisuna way sii waartaa weligeedba.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad tidhaahdaan, Ilaaha badbaadadayadow, Na badbaadi, Oo na soo wada ururi oo quruumahana naga samatabbixi, Si aannu magacaaga quduuska ah ugu mahadnaqno, Oo aannu ammaantaada ugu guulaysanno.
english: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

kikuyu: Waxaa mahad leh Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, Tan iyo weligiis iyo weligiisba. Markaasaa dadkii oo dhammu waxay yidhaahdeen, Aamiin, oo Rabbigay ammaaneen.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu halkaas sanduuqii axdiga Rabbiga hortiisa kaga tegey Aasaaf iyo walaalihiis inay had iyo goor ka adeegaan sanduuqa hortiisa sidii maalin walba shuqulkeeda loo doonayay,
english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

kikuyu: isaga iyo Cobeed Edoom oo ay la jiraan siddeed iyo lixdan nin oo walaalahood ah, oo weliba Cobeed Edoom oo ahaa ina Yeduutuun iyo Xosaahna wuxuu uga tegey inay ahaadaan iridjoogayaal.
english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

kikuyu: Oo wadaadkii Saadooq iyo wadaaddadii walaalihiis ahaana wuxuu kaga hor tegey taambuuggii Rabbiga oo ku yiil meeshii sare oo Gibecoon,
english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

kikuyu: in had iyo goor subax iyo habeenba meeshii qurbaanka la gubo ay Rabbiga ugu dul bixiyaan qurbaanno la gubo kuwaasoo ahaa sidii dhammaan waxa ku qoran sharciga Rabbiga, oo uu reer binu Israa'iil ku amray.
english: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu kaloo la reebay Heemaan iyo Yeduutuun iyo kuwii kaloo la doortay oo loo magacaabay inay Rabbiga ku mahadnaqaan, maxaa yeelay, naxariistiisu weligeedba way waartaa.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Oo waxaa iyaga la jiray Heemaan iyo Yeduutuun oo haystay turumbooyin iyo suxuun laysku garaaco oo ay leeyihiin kuwa aad wax uga dhawaajiya, iyo alaabtii lagu qaadi jiray gabayadii Ilaah, oo ilma Yeduutuunna wuxuu kaga tegey inay iridda joogaan.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii oo dhan qof waluba gurigiisii tegey, oo Daa'uudna wuxuu u noqday inuu reerkiisii u duceeyo aawadeed.
english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay markii Daa'uud gurigiisii degay, in Daa'uud Nebi Naataan ku yidhi, Bal eeg, anigu waxaan degganahay guri qori kedar ah laga sameeyey, laakiinse sanduuqii axdiga Rabbigu wuxuu yaal daahyo hoostood.
english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Naataan wuxuu Daa'uud ku yidhi, Wax alla wixii qalbigaaga ku jira oo dhan samee, waayo, Ilaah baa kula jira.
english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

kikuyu: Oo isla habeenkaas eraygii Ilaah baa u yimid Naataan oo ku yidhi,
english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

kikuyu: Tag, oo waxaad addoonkayga Daa'uud ku tidhaahdaa, Rabbigu wuxuu ku leeyahay, Waxba guri aan dego ha ii dhisin,
english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

kikuyu: waayo, guri ma degin ilaa maalintii aan reer binu Israa'iil soo bixiyey iyo tan iyo maantadan, laakiinse teendhaba teendho kalaan uga bixi jiray oo taambuugna mid kalaan uga bixi jiray.
english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

kikuyu: Oo meel kasta oo aan kula socday reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, xaakinnadii reer binu Israa'iil oo aan ku amray inay quudiyaan dadkayga ma midkood baan eray kula hadlay, oo miyaan ku idhi, War maxaad iigu dhisi weydeen guri kedar ah?
english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaad addoonkayga Daa'uud ku tidhaahdaa, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Anaa kaa soo kaxeeyey xeradii idaha iyo idihii aad raacaysay, inaad ahaatid amiir u taliya dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil,
english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

kikuyu: waanan kula jiray meel kastoo aad tagtayba, oo cadaawayaashaadii oo dhanna hortaadaan ka baabbi'iyey. Oo waxaan kuu bixin doonaa magac la mid ah magacyada kuwa waaweyn oo dhulka jooga.
english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

kikuyu: Oo dadkayga reer binu Israa'iilna meel baan u dooran doonaa, oo waan ku beeri doonaa, inay meeshooda degganaadaan oo ayan mar dambe dhaqdhaqaaqin, ama ayan ilmaha sharku mar dambe dhibin sidii markii hore,
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

kikuyu: iyo tan iyo maalintii aan xaakinno ku amray inay dadkayga reer binu Israa'iil u taliyaan. Cadaawayaashaada oo dhanna waan jebin doonaa. Oo weliba waxaan kaloo kuu sheegayaa inuu Rabbigu reer kuu yeeli doono.
english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.

kikuyu: Oo markii cimrigaagu dhammaado, oo aad awowayaashaa la jiri doonto sida waajibka ah, ayaan sara kicin doonaa farcankaaga kaa dambeeya oo wiilashaada midkood ahaan doona, oo boqortooyadiisana waan dhisi doonaa.
english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

kikuyu: Oo isna guri buu ii dhisi doonaa, oo xoog baan u yeeli doonaa carshigiisa weligiis.
english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

kikuyu: Oo anigu aabbaan u ahaan doonaa, isna wiil buu ii ahaan doonaa, oo anna naxariistayda kama fogayn doono, sidii aan uga fogeeyey kii kaa horreeyey,
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

kikuyu: laakiinse waxaan isaga dhex taagi doonaa weligiisba gurigayga iyo boqortooyadayda, oo carshigiisuna weligiis wuu dhisnaan doonaa.
english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

kikuyu: Haddaba siday erayadaas oo dhan iyo tusniintaas oo dhammu ahaayeen ayaa Naataan kula hadlay Daa'uud.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Daa'uud gudaha galay oo Rabbiga hor fadhiistay, oo wuxuu yidhi, Rabbow Ilaahow, bal yaan ahay? Reerkayguna waa maxay oo aad halkan ii soo gaadhsiisay?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

kikuyu: Oo waxanu hortaada wuu ku yaraa, Ilaahow, laakiinse waxaad kaloo ka sii hadashay reerkaygu wuxuu wakhti dheer noqon doono, anoo addoonkaaga ah, oo weliba Rabbow Ilaahow, waxaad iiga fikirtay sidii nin darajo weyn leh.
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.

kikuyu: Bal maxaan kaloo kugu odhan karaa taasoo ku saabsan cisadii aad ii samaysay anoo addoonkaaga ah? Waayo, waad i garanaysaa.
english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

kikuyu: Rabbow, aniga daraadday, iyo qalbigaaga siduu yahay, ayaad waxyaalahan waaweyn oo dhan u samaysay, inaad waxyaalahan waaweyn oo dhan wada muujiso.
english: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, mid kula mid ahu ma jiro, oo adiga mooyaane Ilaah kale ma jiro, siday ahaayeen kulli wixii aannu dhegahayaga ku maqalnay oo dhammu.
english: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

kikuyu: Bal quruuntee baa dunida joogta oo la mid ah dadkaaga reer binu Israa'iil, kuwaasoo adiga qudhaadu aad soo furatay inay dad kuu ahaadaan iyo inaad magac isugu yeesho waxyaalo waaweyn oo cabsi badan, markaad quruumaha ka eriday dadkaaga hortiisa, kuwaasoo aad ka soo furatay dalkii Masar?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

kikuyu: Waayo, dadkaaga reer binu Israa'iil waxaad ka dhigtay inay dadkaaga ahaadaan weligood, oo Ilaahood baad noqotay, Rabbiyow.
english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbow, eraygii aad ku hadashay oo igu saabsanaa anoo addoonkaaga ah, oo ku saabsanaa reerkayga, weligaa adkee oo sidaad ku hadashay yeel.
english: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

kikuyu: Oo magacaaguna ha xoogaysto oo ha weynaado weligiis, hana la yidhaahdo, Rabbiga ciidammadu waa Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, isagu wuxuu Ilaah u yahay reer binu Israa'iil, oo anoo addoonkaaga Daa'uud ah reerkaygu hortaaduu ku dhisan yahay.
english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaahayow, anoo addoonkaaga ah wax baad ii muujisay, oo waxaad igu tidhi, Reer baan kuu dhisi doonaa, sidaas daraaddeed waan ku dhiirranahay inaan baryadan hortaada kugu baryo.
english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbiyow, adigu waxaad tahay Ilaah, oo waxan wanaagsan baad ii ballanqaadday, anoo addoonkaaga ah,
english: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

kikuyu: oo waxaad ku faraxday inaad barakaysid reerkayga anoo addoonkaaga ah, inuu weligiisba hortaada ku sii raago, waayo, Rabbiyow, adigu waad barakaysay, oo wuu barakaysan yahay weligiis.
english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

kikuyu: Oo taas dabadeed ayaa Daa'uud reer Falastiin laayay oo jebiyey, oo Gad iyo magaalooyinkeediiba gacantii reer Falastiin wuu ka qaaday.
english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu kaloo laayay reer Moo'aab, oo reer Moo'aabna addoommay Daa'uud u noqdeen, oo baad bay u keeneen.
english: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

kikuyu: Oo ilaa Xamaad Daa'uud wuxuu dilayay boqorkii Soobaah oo ahaa Hadarceser, intuu ku socday inuu dowladnimadiisa ku ag dhiso Webi Yufraad.
english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud wuxuu isagii ka qabsaday kun gaadhifaras, iyo toddoba kun oo fardooley ah, iyo labaatan kun oo nin oo lug ah, oo Daa'uudna wuxuu boqno jaray fardihii gaadhiyada waday oo dhan, laakiinse boqol gaadhifaras buu uga reebay.
english: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

kikuyu: Oo reer Suuriyihii Dimishaqna markay u yimaadeen inay u hiiliyaan boqorkii Soobaah oo ahaa Hadarceser, Daa'uud wuxuu iyagii ka laayay laba iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

kikuyu: Daa'uudna wuxuu reer Dimishaq oo Suuriya jooga dhex dhigay rugo askareed, oo reer Suuriyana Daa'uud bay addoommo u noqdeen oo baad u keeneen. Oo Rabbiguna Daa'uud buu siiyey meel kastoo uu tegeyba.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud soo qaaday gaashaammadii dahabka ahaa oo ay wateen addoommadii Hadarceser, wuxuuna keenay Yeruusaalem.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkii Hadarceser oo ahaa Tibxad iyo Kuun Daa'uud wuxuu ka soo qaaday naxaas aad u badan, taasoo uu Sulaymaan ka sameeyey berkeddii naxaasta ahayd iyo tiirarkii iyo weelashii naxaasta ahaa.
english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Oo Tocuu oo ahaa boqorkii Xamaad markuu maqlay in Daa'uud laayay Hadarceser oo ahaa boqorkii Soobaah ciidankiisii oo dhan
english: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

kikuyu: ayuu Daa'uud wiilkiisii Hadooraam u soo diray inuu soo salaamo oo uu u soo duceeyo, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu la diriray oo dilay Hadarceser, waayo, Hadarceser wuxuu la diriri jiray Tocuu, oo wuxuu keenay weelal cayn kasta ah oo ah dahab iyo lacag iyo naxaasba.
english: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

kikuyu: Oo kuwaasna Boqor Daa'uud wuxuu quduus uga dhigay Rabbiga, oo wuxuu ku daray lacagtii iyo dahabkii uu ka soo dhacay quruumihii oo dhan, kuwaasoo ahaa reer Edom, iyo reer Moo'aab, iyo reer Cammoon, iyo reer Falastiin, iyo reer Camaaleq.
english: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Abiishay oo ay Seruuyaah dhashayna wuxuu reer Edom Dooxadii Cusbada kaga laayay siddeed iyo toban kun oo nin.
english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu Edom dhex dhigay rugo askareed, oo reer Edom oo dhammuna Daa'uud bay addoommo u noqdeen. Oo Rabbiguna Daa'uud guul buu siiyey meel kastoo uu tegeyba.
english: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan buu u taliyey, oo wuxuu dadkiisa oo dhan ugu gar qaybshay xukun iyo caddaalad.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa ciidanka u sarrayn jiray Yoo'aab oo ay Seruuyaah dhashay, oo taariikhdana waxaa qori jiray Yehooshaafaad ina Axiiluud,
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

kikuyu: oo wadaaddona waxaa ahaa Saadooq ina Axiituub, iyo Abiimeleg ina Aabyaataar, Shawshaana wuxuu ahaa karraani.
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

kikuyu: Oo Benaayaah ina Yehooyaadaacna wuxuu u taliyey reer Kereetiim iyo reer Feleetii, oo Daa'uud wiilashiisuna waxay ahaayeen madaxda boqorka u dhow.
english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

kikuyu: Taas dabadeedna Naaxaash oo boqor u ahaa reer Cammoon ayaa dhintay, meeshiisiina waxaa boqor ka noqday wiilkiisii.
english: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud yidhi, Anigu waxaan u roonaan doonaa Xaanuun ina Naaxaash, maxaa yeelay, aabbihiis baa ii roonaaday. Sidaas daraaddeed Daa'uud wuxuu u diray wargeeyayaal inay u tacsiyeeyaan aabbihiis. Markaasaa Daa'uud addoommadiisii waxay dalkii reer Cammoon ugu yimaadeen Xaanuun inay isaga u tacsiyeeyaan.
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

kikuyu: Laakiinse amiirradii reer Cammoon waxay Xaanuun ku yidhaahdeen, Ma waxaad u malaynaysaa in Daa'uud aabbahaa cisaynayo oo uu sidaas daraaddeed kuugu soo diray kuwa tacsiyada wada? Addoommadiisu sow kuuguma iman inay dalka baadhaan oo basaasaan oo afgembiyaan?
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Xaanuun wuxuu qabsaday Daa'uud addoommadiisii, oo intuu iyagii u xiiray ayuu dharkoodiina dhexda ka kala gooyay xataa ilaa dabada, markaasuu iska eryay.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

kikuyu: Markaasaa la tegey oo Daa'uud loo soo sheegay sidii nimankii loo galay. Oo isna wuxuu iyagii u diray dad ka hor taga, waayo, nimankii aad bay u ceeboobeen. Boqorkiina wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Yerixoo iska jooga ilaa gadhku idiin soo baxo, dabadeedna soo noqda.
english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

kikuyu: Oo reer Cammoonna markay ogaadeen inay Daa'uud isnacsiiyeen ayaa Xaanuun iyo reer Cammoon sii dhiibeen kun talanti oo lacag ah inay gaadhifardood iyo rag fardooley ah kaga soo kiraystaan Mesobotamiya, iyo Aram Macakaah, iyo Soobaah.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

kikuyu: Sidaasay u soo kiraysteen laba iyo soddon kun oo gaadhifaras, iyo boqorkii Macakaah iyo dadkiisii, kuwaasoo yimid oo Meedebaa horteeda degay. Oo reer Cammoonna waxay iska soo wada urursadeen magaalooyinkoodii, oo dagaal bay u soo baxeen.
english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uudna markuu taas maqlay ayuu diray Yoo'aab iyo ciidankii raggii xoogga lahaa oo dhan.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

kikuyu: Oo reer Cammoonna way soo baxeen, oo waxay dagaal isugu soo diyaariyeen magaalada iriddeeda, oo boqorradii yimidna duurkay keli ahaantood joogeen.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

kikuyu: Haddaba Yoo'aab markuu arkay in dagaal looga soo kacshay hore iyo dibba, ayuu raggii reer binu Israa'iil ka xushay kuwii xuladka ahaa oo dhan, oo wuxuu u soo diyaariyey inay reer Suuriya la dagaallamaan.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

kikuyu: Oo dadkii intiisii kalena wuxuu u dhiibay walaalkiis Abiishay, oo iyana waxay isu soo diyaariyeen inay reer Cammoon la dagaallamaan.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu walaalkiis ku yidhi, Haddii reer Suuriya iga xoog bataan waa inaad i soo caawisaa, laakiinse haddii reer Cammoon kaa xoog bataan, markaasaan ku soo caawin doonaa.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

kikuyu: Haddaba si fiican u dhiirranow, oo aynu rag u ahaanno dadkeenna iyo magaalooyinka Ilaaheen aawadood, oo Rabbiguna ha sameeyo wixii la wanaagsan.
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Yoo'aab iyo dadkii la jirayba waxay ugu soo dhowaadeen inay la dagaallamaan reer Suuriya, oo iyana markaasay hortiisa ka carareen.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

kikuyu: Oo reer Cammoonna markay arkeen in reer Suuriya carareen ayay iyana walaalkiis Abiishay hortiisa saasoo kale uga carareen, oo waxay galeen magaaladii. Markaasaa Yoo'aab Yeruusaalem yimid.
