english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo reer Suuriya markay arkeen in iyaga looga adkaaday reer binu Israa'iil hortooda ayay wargeeyayaal u direen oo soo kaxeeyeen reer Suuriyihii Webiga ka shisheeyey, iyagoo uu madax u yahay Shoofag oo ahaa sirkaalkii ciidanka Hadarceser.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

kikuyu: Taas waxaa loo soo sheegay Daa'uud, kolkaasuu reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan soo wada ururiyey, oo intuu Webi Urdun ka soo gudbay ayuu reer Suuriya u yimid, oo ciidankiisii ayuu weerar ugu soo diyaariyey, haddaba Daa'uud markuu raggiisii u diyaariyey inay reer Suuriya la dagaallamaan ayay iyana la dirireen.
english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

kikuyu: Oo reer Suuriyana way ka carareen reer binu Israa'iil hortooda. Daa'uudna wuxuu reer Suuriya ka laayay toddoba kun oo gaadhifaras raggoodii, iyo afartan kun oo nin oo lug ah, oo wuxuu dilay Shoofag oo ahaa sirkaalkii ciidanka.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

kikuyu: Oo markii Hadarceser addoommadiisii arkeen in reer binu Israa'iil hortooda looga adkaaday ayay la nabdeen Daa'uud, wayna u adeegeen, oo reer Suuriyana way diideen inay mar dambe reer Cammoon caawiyaan.
english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

kikuyu: Oo isla xilligii sannaddii dambe, markay boqorradu dagaalka u soo bixi jireen ayaa Yoo'aab kaxaystay xooggii ciidanka oo dhan oo baabbi'iyey dalkii reer Cammoon, oo haddana intuu soo kacay ayuu Rabbaah hareereeyey. Yoo'aab wuxuu dagaal ku dhiftay Rabbaah, wuuna afgembiyey, laakiinse Daa'uud baa Yeruusaalem iska joogay.
english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud boqorkoodii madaxiisii taajkii ka qaaday, oo wuxuu ogaaday in miisaankiisu yahay talanti dahab ah, dhagxan qaali ahna wuu lahaa, markaasaa Daa'uud madaxa loo saaray. Oo wuxuu dibadda u soo bixiyey dhacii magaalada oo aad iyo aad u badnaa.
english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

kikuyu: Dibadduu u soo bixiyey dadkii magaalada ku jiray, oo wuxuu hoos dhigay miinshaaro iyo biro wax lagu qodo, iyo faasas. Oo magaalooyinkii reer Cammoon oo dhan Daa'uud saasuu u wada galay. Markaasaa Daa'uud iyo dadkii oo dhammu ku noqdeen Yeruusaalem.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo taas dabadeed waxay noqotay in reer Falastiin haddana Geser lagula diriray, oo Sibbekay oo reer Xushaad ahaa wuxuu dilay Sifay, oo ahaa mid ka mid ah wiilashii Rafaa, oo iyagiina waa la jebiyey.
english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

kikuyu: Oo haddana reer Falastiin waa lala diriray, oo Elxaanaan ina Yaaciir wuxuu dilay Laxmii oo ahaa Goli'ad kii reer Gad walaalkiis, oo samayda warankiisuna waxay le'ekayd dharsameeyaha looxiisa.
english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaa dagaal ka dhacay Gad, halkaasna waxaa joogay nin aad u dheer, oo farihiisa gacmeed iyo farihiisa lugeedna waxay ahaayeen afar iyo labaatan, oo gacan kasta wuxuu ku lahaa lix, cag kastana wuxuu ku lahaa lix, oo isna wuxuu u dhashay Rafaa.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

kikuyu: Oo isna markuu reer binu Israa'iil caayay waxaa isagii dilay Yoonaataan oo uu Daa'uud walaalkiisii Shimcaa ahaa dhalay.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waxay Rafaa ugu dhasheen Gad, oo waxay ku dhinteen Daa'uud gacantiisii iyo gacantii addoommadiisa.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

kikuyu: Haddaba Shayddaan baa ku kacay reer binu Israa'iil oo wuxuu Daa'uud ku dhaqaajiyey inuu reer binu Israa'iil tiriyo.
english: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud ku yidhi Yoo'aab iyo amiirradii, Taga oo reer binu Israa'iil soo tiriya tan iyo Bi'ir Shebac iyo ilaa Daan, oo war ii keena si aan u ogaado dadka tiradiisa.
english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yoo'aab yidhi, Rabbigu dadkiisa ha ka dhigo boqol jeer in ka sii badan inta ay haatan yihiin, laakiinse boqorow sayidkaygiiyow, iyagu kulligood sow ma aha addoommadaada? Maxaadse waxan u doonaysaa, sayidkaygiiyow? Oo maxaadse reer binu Israa'iil sabab ay ku dembaabaan ugu noqonaysaa?
english: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee boqorka hadalkiisii waa ka adkaaday hadalkii Yoo'aab. Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Yoo'aab wuu tegey, oo wuxuu dhex maray reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, dabadeedna Yeruusaalem buu yimid.
english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yoo'aab Daa'uud siiyey tiradii dadka, oo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen kun kun iyo boqol kun oo nin oo seefqaad ah, oo reer Yahuudahna waxay ahaayeen afar boqol iyo toddobaatan kun oo nin oo seefqaad ah.
english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

kikuyu: Laakiinse isagu sooma uu tirin reer Laawi iyo reer Benyaamiin, maxaa yeelay, Yoo'aab waa karaahiyeystay boqorka hadalkiisii.
english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

kikuyu: Haddaba taas ayaa Ilaah ugu cadhooday, markaasuu laayay reer binu Israa'iil.
english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud Ilaah ku yidhi, Waxaan sameeyey aad baan ugu dembaabay, haddaba waan ku baryayaaye, iga fogee dembigayga anoo addoonkaaga ah, waayo, nacasnimo weyn baan sameeyey.
english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu la hadlay Gaad oo ahaa Daa'uud waxarkihiisa, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

kikuyu: Tag oo Daa'uud la hadal oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Rabbigu wuxuu kugu leeyahay, Saddexdan waxyaalood baan ku siinayaa, ee ka dooro mid aan kugu sameeyo.
english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Gaad baa Daa'uud u yimid oo ku yidhi, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Midkaad doonaysid dooro,
english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:

kikuyu: saddex sannadood oo abaar ah, ama saddex bilood oo aad ku baabba'did cadaawayaashaada hortooda iyadoo seefta cadaawayaashaadu ay ku gaadhayso, amase haddii kale saddex maalmood oo seefta Rabbigu iyadoo belaayo ah ay dalka dhex marayso, oo ay malaa'igtii Rabbiga dadka baabbi'inayso kulli dalka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan. Haddaba bal ka fiirso jawaabta aan u celiyo kii i soo diray.
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu Gaad ku yidhi, Cidhiidhi weyn baan ku jiraa, Rabbiga gacantiisa aan ku dhaco, waayo, naxariistiisu waa badan tahay, laakiinse yaanan dad gacantiis ku dhicin.
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

kikuyu: Saas aawadeed Rabbigu belaayo ayuu ku soo dejiyey reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxaa reer binu Israa'iil ka dhintay toddobaatan kun oo nin.
english: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

kikuyu: Oo haddana Rabbigu wuxuu Yeruusaalem u soo diray malag wax baabbi'iya, oo markuu u dhowaaday inuu baabbi'iyo ayaa Rabbigu fiiriyey, oo belaayadii ka qoomamooday, oo wuxuu malaggii wax baabbi'inayay ku yidhi, Bes weeye, haddaba gacanta soo celi. Oo malaggii Rabbigu wuxuu ag joogay meeshii hadhuudhka lagu tumi jiray oo uu Aarnaankii reer Yebuus lahaa.
english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud indhihii kor u taagay oo wuxuu arkay malaggii Rabbiga oo taagan dhulka iyo samada dhexdooda oo gacanta ku haysta seef gal la' oo Yeruusaalem ku kor fidsan. Markaasay Daa'uud iyo odayaashiiba, iyagoo dhar joonyad ah qaba, wejiga dhulka saareen.
english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu Ilaah ku yidhi, Kii amray in dadka la soo tiriyo sow aniga ma aha? Kii dembaabay oo waxa aad u xun sameeyey waa aniga, laakiinse idahanu maxay sameeyeen? Haddaba Rabbiyow Ilaahayow, waan ku baryayaaye, gacantaadu ha ka gees noqoto aniga iyo reerka aabbahay, laakiinse dadkaaga yaanay ka gees noqon oo aanay belaayo ku dhicin.
english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaggii Rabbigu Gaad ku amray inuu Daa'uud ku yidhaahdo, Tag oo Rabbiga meel allabari ugu dhis meeshii wax lagu tumi jiray ee Aarnaankii reer Yebuus leeyahay.
english: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud baa ku tegey wixii uu Gaad yidhi, oo uu ku hadlay magicii Rabbiga.
english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Aarnaan soo jeestay oo arkay malaggii, oo afartiisii wiil oo isaga la joogayna way dhuunteen. Haddaba Aarnaan wuxuu tumayay sarreen.
english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

kikuyu: Oo markii Daa'uud u yimid Aarnaan ayaa Aarnaan arkay Daa'uud, oo intuu meeshii ka baxay ayuu u sujuuday Daa'uud, wejigana dhulkuu saaray.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu Aarnaan ku yidhi, Meeshan wax lagu tumo i sii, aan meel allabari Rabbiga uga dhisee. Waxaad igu siinaysaa qiima buuxa in belaayadu ay dadka ka joogsato.
english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Aarnaan wuxuu Daa'uud ku yidhi, Boqorow sayidkaygiiyow, qaado oo samee wixii kula wanaagsan, bal eeg, dibida waxaan kuu siinayaa qurbaanno la gubo aawadiis, oo alaabta wax lagu tumona qoryo aawadood, sarreenkana qurbaan aawadiis, anigu kulli waan ku wada siinayaa.
english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Daa'uud wuxuu Aarnaan ku yidhi, Maya, laakiinse sida runta ah qiima buuxa ayaan kaaga iibsanayaa, waayo, Rabbiga u qaadi maayo wax aad adigu leedahay, oo qurbaan la gubo oo aanan waxba ka bixin anigu Ilaah ugu bixin maayo.
english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Daa'uud wuxuu Aarnaan meeshii ka siiyey dahab miisaankiisu yahay lix boqol oo sheqel.
english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud halkaas Rabbiga uga dhisay meel allabari, oo wuxuu u bixiyey qurbaanno la gubo iyo qurbaanno nabaadiino, oo Rabbiguu baryay, oo isna wuxuu isagii samada ugaga jawaabay dab ku soo kor dhacay meeshii qurbaanka la gubo.
english: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu amray malaggii, isna seeftiisuu ku celiyey galkeedii.
english: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

kikuyu: Oo isla markaasba Daa'uud markuu arkay in Rabbigu isaga uga jawaabay meeshii wax lagu tumi jiray oo uu lahaa Aarnaan oo ahaa reer Yebuus ayuu halkaas ku allabaryay.
english: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

kikuyu: Waayo, taambuuggii Rabbiga ee Muuse cidlada ku dhex sameeyey iyo meeshii qurbaanka la guboba markaas waxay dhex yiilleen meesha sare ee Gibecoon ku taal.
english: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Daa'uud meeshaas ma uu hor tegi karin inuu Ilaah wax soo weyddiisto, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu ka baqayay seeftii malagga Rabbiga.
english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud yidhi, Kanu waa gurigii Rabbiga Ilaaha ah, oo tanuna waa meeshii qurbaanka la gubo oo reer binu Israa'iil.
english: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud amray in la soo wada ururiyo shisheeyayaashii dalka reer binu Israa'iil degganaa oo dhan, oo wuxuu kaloo amray in wastaadyo dhagxan soo qoraan in la dhiso gurigii Ilaah aawadeed.
english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud wuxuu diyaariyey bir faro badan in musmaarro looga dhigo albaabbada irdaha iyo qabsatooyinka, oo wuxuu kaloo diyaariyey naxaas tiro badan oo aan miisaan lahayn,
english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

kikuyu: iyo geedo kedar ah oo aan tiro lahayn, waayo, reer Siidoon iyo reer Turos waxay Daa'uud u keeneen geedo kedar ah oo tiro badan.
english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud yidhi, Wiilkayga Sulaymaan waa yar yahay, waana tabar daranyahay, oo guriga Rabbiga loo dhisayaana waa inuu ahaado mid aad iyo aad u weyn, oo magac iyo ammaan ku leh kulli waddammada oo dhan, haddaba wax baan u sii diyaarin doonaa. Sidaas daraaddeed Daa'uud waxyaalo faro badan ayuu diyaariyey intuusan dhiman ka hor.
english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wiilkiisii Sulaymaan u yeedhay oo wuxuu ku amray inuu guri u dhiso Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil.
english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo haddana Daa'uud wuxuu wiilkiisii Sulaymaan ku yidhi, Waxaa qalbigayga ku jiray inaan guri u dhiso magaca Rabbiga Ilaahayga ah.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaa ii yimid Eraygii Rabbiga oo leh, Adigu waxaad daadisay dhiig badan, oo aad baad u dagaallantay. Waa inaadan guri u dhisin magacayga, maxaa yeelay, dhiig badan ayaad dhulka ku daadisay anigoo u jeeda.
english: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa kuu dhalan doona wiil, kaasoo ahaan doona nin nasasho, oo waxaan ka nasin doonaa cadaawayaashiisa ku wareegsan oo dhan, oo isaga magiciisu wuxuu ahaan doonaa Sulaymaan, oo wakhtigiisa waxaan reer binu Israa'iil siin doonaa nabad iyo xasilloonaan.
english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

kikuyu: Oo guri buu magacayga u dhisi doonaa, oo wuxuu ahaan doonaa wiilkaygii, oo anna waxaan u ahaan doonaa aabbihiis, oo waxaan carshiga boqortooyadiisa u xoogayn doonaa inuu weligiis u taliyo reer binu Israa'iil.
english: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

kikuyu: Haddaba wiilkaygiiyow, Rabbigu ha kula jiro, oo u barwaaqow, oo gurigii Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah u dhis siduu kaaga hadlay.
english: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu ha ku siiyo xigmad iyo waxgarasho, oo amarka reer binu Israa'iilna ha kuu dhiibo si aad u dhawrtid sharciga Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah.
english: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Markaas waad barwaaqoobi doontaa haddaad dhawrto oo yeesho qaynuunnadii iyo xukummadii Rabbigu Muuse ku amray oo uu reer binu Israa'iil ugu soo dhiibay; xoog yeelo, oo aad u dhiirranow, ha cabsan, hana qalbi jabin.
english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal eeg, anoo dhibaataysan waxaan guriga Rabbiga u diyaarshay boqol kun oo talanti oo dahab ah, iyo kun kun oo talanti oo lacag ah, iyo naxaas iyo bir aan miisaan lahayn, waayo, aad bay u badan yihiin, oo weliba waxaan kaloo diyaariyey alwaax iyo dhagxan, oo adiguna intaas wax baad ku sii dari karaysaa.
english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaa kula jira rag shaqaale ah oo faro badan, kuwaasoo ah kuwa qora oo ka shaqeeya dhagxanta iyo alwaaxdaba, iyo rag kasta oo yaqaan sanco kasta,
english: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

kikuyu: oo ah tan dahabka, iyo tan lacagta, iyo tan naxaasta, iyo tan birta, iyagu tiro ma leh, haddaba kac oo shaqee, oo Rabbiguna ha kula jiro.
english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana Daa'uud wuxuu amiirradii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan ku amray inay caawiyaan wiilkiisa Sulaymaan.
english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, War sow Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ahu idinlama jiro? Oo sow dhan kastaba nasasho idinkama siin? Waayo, dadyowgii dalka degganaa oo dhan ayuu soo geliyey gacantayda, oo dalkiina waxaa lagu jebshay Rabbiga iyo dadkiisa hortooda.
english: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.

kikuyu: Haddaba qalbigiinna iyo naftiinna u jeediya inaad Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah doondoontaan, oo sidaas daraaddeed kaca oo dhisa meesha quduuska ah oo Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah, in sanduuqii axdiga Rabbiga iyo weelashii Ilaah oo quduuska ahaa la soo geliyo guriga loo dhisayo magaca Rabbiga.
english: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Daa'uud wuu gaboobay, wuuna da' weynaa, markaasuu reer binu Israa'iil boqor uga dhigay wiilkiisii Sulaymaan.
english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu soo wada ururiyey amiirradii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, iyo wadaaddadii iyo kuwii reer Laawiba.
english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

kikuyu: Markaasaa la tiriyey reer Laawi intoodii soddon sannadood jirtay ama ka sii weynayd, oo markii nin nin loo tiriyey, dhammaantood tiradoodii waxay noqotay siddeed iyo soddon kun oo nin.
english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

kikuyu: Oo kuwaas afar iyo labaatan kun oo ka mid ahu waxay ahaayeen kuwo ilaaliya hawsha guriga Rabbiga, oo lix kunna waxay ahaayeen saraakiil iyo xaakinno,
english: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

kikuyu: oo afar kunna waxay ahaayeen iridjoogayaal, oo afar kunna waxay Rabbiga ku ammaani jireen alaabtii aan u sameeyey in isaga lagu ammaano ayuu Daa'uud yidhi.
english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud wuxuu iyagii u kala qaybiyey koox koox sidii ay ahaayeen wiilashii Laawi, kuwaas oo ahaa: Gershoon, iyo Qohaad, iyo Meraarii.
english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Reer Gershoon waxaa ahaa Lacdaan iyo Shimcii.
english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Lacdaan waxay ahaayeen saddex, waana Yexii'eel oo madax ahaa, iyo Seetaam, iyo Yoo'eel.
english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Shimciina waxay ahaayeen saddex, waana Shelomood, iyo Xasii'eel, iyo Xaaraan, kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen madaxdii qolooyinkii reer Lacdaan.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa wiilashii Shimcii ahaa Yaaxad, iyo Siinaa, iyo Yecuush, iyo Beriicaah. Afartaasuba waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Shimcii.
english: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa madax ahaa Yaaxad, Siisaahna wuxuu ahaa kii labaad, laakiinse Yecuush iyo Beriicaah wiilal badan ma ay lahayn, oo sidaas daraaddeed iyaga waxaa loo tiriyey isku reer.
english: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Qohaadna waxay ahaayeen afar, waana Camraam, iyo Isehaar, iyo Xebroon iyo Cusii'eel.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Camraamna waxay ahaayeen Haaruun iyo Muuse, oo Haaruun waxaa gooni looga dhigay inay isagii iyo wiilashiisuba weligood quduus ka dhigaan waxyaalaha ugu wada quduusan iyo inay Rabbiga hortiisa foox ku shidaan, oo ay u adeegaan oo ay weligoodba magiciisa ku duceeyaan.
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Muuse oo ahaa nin Ilaah wiilashiisii waxaa lagu tiriyey qabiilka reer Laawi.
english: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Muusena waxay ahaayeen Gershoom iyo Eliiceser.
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

kikuyu: Ina Gershoomna wuxuu ahaa Shebuu'eel oo madax ahaa.
english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

kikuyu: Ina Eliiceserna wuxuu ahaa Rexabyaah oo madax ahaa. Oo Eliiceser innaba wiilal kale ma lahayn, laakiinse Rexabyaah wiilashiisu aad bay u badnaayeen.
english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

kikuyu: Ina Isehaarna wuxuu ahaa Shelomiid oo madax ahaa.
english: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Xebroonna waxay ahaayeen Yeriyaah oo madax ahaa, iyo Amaryaah oo ahaa kii labaad, iyo Yaxasii'eel oo ahaa kii saddexaad, iyo Yeqamcaam oo ahaa kii afraad.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Cusii'eelna waxay ahaayeen Miikaah oo madax ahaa, iyo Yishiyaah oo ahaa kii labaad.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Meraariina waxay ahaayeen Maxlii iyo Mushii. Wiilashii Maxliina waxay ahaayeen Elecaasaar iyo Qiish.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

kikuyu: Oo Elecaasaarna wuxuu dhintay isagoo gabdho keliya mooyaane aan wiilal lahayn, oo waxaa gabdhihiisii guursaday reer Qiish oo ahaa ilma-adeerradood.
english: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Mushiina waxay ahaayeen saddex, waana Maxlii iyo Ceeder iyo Yereemood.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen reer Laawi sidii qolooyinkoodu kala ahaayeen, waana kuwii ahaa madaxdii reeraha kuwii la tiriyey, oo magacyadooda nin nin loo tiriyey, kuwaasoo samayn jiray shuqulkii hawsha guriga Rabbiga, waana intii labaatan sannadood jirtay ama ka sii weynayd.
english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

kikuyu: Waayo, Daa'uud wuxuu yidhi, Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil dadkiisuu nasiyey, oo weligiis wuxuu deggan yahay Yeruusaalem.
english: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

kikuyu: Weliba reer Laawina mar dambe uma baahan doonaan inay qaadaan taambuugga iyo weelashiisa lagaga adeego oo dhan.
english: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud dardaarankiisii ayaa reer Laawi lagu tiriyey, intoodii labaatan sannadood jirtay ama ka sii weynayd.
english: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

kikuyu: Waayo, shuqulkoodu wuxuu ahaa inay reer Haaruun amarkooda ku adeegaan oo ay qabtaan hawshii guriga Rabbiga, iyo inay ka adeegaan barxadaha iyo qowladaha, iyo inay daahiriyaan waxyaalaha quduuska ah oo dhan, kaasu wuxuu ahaa shuqulka hawsha guriga Rabbiga.
english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxay kala hagaajin jireen kibistii tusniinta iyo burkii laga dhigi jiray qurbaan jidhiidh ah, hadduu ahaa kibis aan khamiir lahayn ama tii digsiga lagu dubi jiray, amase tii la qoyn jiray, iyo cayn kasta oo ah qiyaas iyo miisaan,
english: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

kikuyu: iyo inay subax kasta u istaagaan inay Rabbiga ku mahadnaqaan oo ammaanaan, oo haddana habeenkiina saasoo kalay yeeli jireen.
english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxay had iyo goor Rabbiga hortiisa ku bixin jireen qurbaanno la gubo oo dhan, waxayna bixin jireen sabtiyada, iyo markay bilaha cusubu dhashaan, iyo iidaha, waxayna u bixin jireen si waafaqsan tiradoodii qaynuunka ku qornayd,
english: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;

kikuyu: wayna ilaalin jireen teendhada shirka, iyo meesha quduuska ah, iyo reer Haaruun oo iyaga walaalahood ah, oo saasay uga adeegi jireen guriga Rabbiga.
english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Oo kooxihii reer Haaruunna waa kuwan. Wiilashii Haaruun waxay ahaayeen Naadaab, iyo Abiihuu, iyo Elecaasaar, iyo Iitaamaar.
english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Naadaab iyo Abiihuuba aabbahood way ka hor dhinteen, oo carruurna ma ay lahayn, haddaba sidaas daraaddeed hawshii wadaadnimada waxaa samayn jiray Elecaasaar iyo Iitaamaar.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud oo ay la jiraan Saadooq oo ahaa reer Elecaasaar iyo Axiimeleg oo ahaa reer Iitaamaar ayaa iyagii u kala qaybiyey sidii hawshoodu kala ahayd.
english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

kikuyu: Oo reer Elecaasaar waxaa laga dhex helay niman madax ah oo ka badan intii reer Iitaamaar laga helay, oo iyagii sidanaa loo kala qaybiyey, reer Elecaasaar waxaa ku jiray lix iyo toban nin, oo qolooyin madax u ah, oo reer Iitaamaarna waxaa ku jiray siddeed, sidii qolooyinkoodu kala ahaayeen.
english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

kikuyu: Oo sidanaa iyagii saami loogu kala qaybiyey, oo caynba caynkii kale waa lagu daray, waayo, waxaa jiray amiirro meesha quduuska ah, iyo amiirro Ilaah oo ahaa reer Elecaasaar iyo reer Iitaamaar labadaba.
english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

kikuyu: Oo Shemacyaah ina Netaneel oo karraanigii ahaa, oo ahaa reer Laawi ayaa iyagii ku hor qoray boqorkii, iyo amiirradii, iyo wadaadkii Saadooq, iyo Axiimeleg ina Aabyaataar, iyo madaxdii qolooyinkii wadaaddada iyo reer Laawi ahaa, in reer loo qaado reer Elecaasaar, reerna loo qaado reer Iitaamaar.
english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

kikuyu: Haddaba saamigii kowaad wuxuu u soo baxay Yehooyaariib, kii labaadna Yedacyaah,
english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

kikuyu: kii saddexaadna Haarim, kii afraadna Secoriim,
english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

kikuyu: kii shanaadna Malkiiyaah, kii lixaadna Miyaamin,
english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

kikuyu: kii toddobaadna Haqoos, kii siddeedaadna Abiiyaah,
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

kikuyu: kii sagaalaadna Yeeshuuca, kii tobnaadna Shekaanyaah,
english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

kikuyu: kii kow iyo tobnaadna Eliyaashiib, kii laba iyo tobnaadna Yaaqiim,
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

kikuyu: kii saddex iyo tobnaadna Xufaah, kii afar iyo tobnaadna Yeshebe'aab,
english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

kikuyu: kii shan iyo tobnaadna Bilgaah, kii lix iyo tobnaadna Immeer,
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

kikuyu: kii toddoba iyo tobnaadna Xeesiir, kii siddeed iyo tobnaadna Hafisees,
english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

kikuyu: kii sagaal iyo tobnaadna Fetaxyaah, kii labaatanaadna Yexesqeel,
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

kikuyu: kii kow iyo labaatanaadna Yaakiin, kii laba iyo labaatanaadna Gaamuul,
english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

kikuyu: kii saddex iyo labaatanaadna Dalaayaah, kii afar iyo labaatanaadna Macasyaah.
english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

kikuyu: Kaasu wuxuu ahaa qaynuunkii ay u kala qaybsanaayeen oo ay hawshooda ku qaban jireen, inay gurigii Rabbiga ku soo galaan qaynuunkii iyaga lagu soo dhiibay awowgood Haaruun, sidii Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil uu isaga ku amray.
english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

kikuyu: Oo reer Laawi intii hadhayna waxaa ka mid ahaa kuwan, wiilashii Camraam waxaa ka joogay Shuubaa'eel, wiilashii Shuubaa'eelna waxaa ka joogay Yexdeyaah.
english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

kikuyu: Reer Rexabyaahna waxaa wiilashii Rexabyaah ka joogay Yishyaah oo madax ahaa.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

kikuyu: Reer Isehaarna waxaa ka joogay Shelomoo, wiilashii Shelomoodna waxaa ka joogay Yaaxad.
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Xebroonna waxaa ka joogay Yeriyaah oo madax ahaa, iyo Amaryaah oo ahaa kii labaad, iyo Yaxasii'eel oo ahaa kii saddexaad, iyo Yeqamcaam oo ahaa kii afraad.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Cusii'eelna waxaa ka joogay Miikaah, wiilashii Miikaahna waxaa ka joogay Shaamiir.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

kikuyu: Oo Miikaah walaalkiisna wuxuu ahaa Yishyaah, wiilashii Yishyaahna waxaa ka joogay Sekaryaah.
english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Meraariina waxaa ka joogay Maxlii iyo Mushii, wiilashii Yacasiyaahna waxaa ka joogay Benoo.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Meraariina, waxaa reer Yacasiyaah ka joogay Benoo, iyo Shoham, iyo Sakuur, iyo Cibrii.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

kikuyu: Reer Maxliina waxaa ka joogay Elecaasaar, oo aan waxba wiilal lahayn.
english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

kikuyu: Reer Qiishna waxaa ka joogay ina Qiish, oo ahaa Yeraxme'eel.
english: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

kikuyu: Reer Mushii waxaa ka joogay Maxlii, iyo Ceeder, iyo Yeriimood. Kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen reer Laawi siday qolooyinkoodu kala ahaayeen.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanu iyana waxay riteen saami sidii walaalahood reer Haaruun ay yeeleen oo kale, oo waxay ku hor riteen Boqor Daa'uud, iyo Saadooq, iyo Axiimeleg, iyo kuwii madaxda u ahaa qolooyinkii wadaaddada iyo reer Laawi. Kan qolooyinkii madaxda u ahaa waxaa lagala mid dhigay sida kuwa walaalkiisa yar.
english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Daa'uud iyo saraakiishii ciidanku waxay adeegiddii u sooceen kuwa ah reer Aasaaf, iyo reer Heemaan, iyo reer Yeduutuun, kuwaasoo wax ku sii sheega kataarado iyo shareerado iyo suxuun laysku garaaco, oo kuwa shuqulka qabta sidii adeegiddoodu kala ahayd tiradoodii waxay ahayd:
english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

kikuyu: reer Aasaaf oo ahaa Sakuur, iyo Yuusuf, iyo Netanyaah, iyo Asareelaah, intaasu waxay ahaayeen reer Aasaaf oo ka hooseeya Aasaaf kaasoo markii boqorku amro wax sii sheegi jiray,
english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

kikuyu: iyo reer Yeduutuun, oo wiilashii Yeduutuunna waxay ahaayeen lix, oo ahaa Gedalyaah, iyo Serii, iyo Yeshacyaah, iyo Xashabyaah, iyo Matityaah, oo waxay ka wada hooseeyeen aabbahood Yeduutuun oo kataaradda lahaa oo wax sii sheegi jiray markuu Rabbiga u mahadnaqayo oo ammaanayo,
english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.

kikuyu: iyo reer Heemaan: oo wiilashii Heemaanna waxay ahaayeen Buqiyaah, iyo Matanyaah, iyo Cusii'eel, iyo Shebuu'eel, iyo Yeriimood, iyo Xananyaah, iyo Xanaanii, iyo Elii'aataah, iyo Giddaltii, iyo Romamtii Ceser, iyo Yaashbeqaashaah, iyo Mallootii, iyo Hootiir, iyo Maxasii'ood.
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

kikuyu: Oo kuwaas oo dhammuna waxay ahaayeen wiilashii Heemaan kaasoo ahaa waxarkihii boqorka u sheegi jiray erayadii Ilaah, oo geeska kor u qaadi jiray. Oo Ilaahna wuxuu Heemaan siiyey afar iyo toban wiil iyo saddex gabdhood.
english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Oo intaas oo dhammu waxay ka hooseeyeen aabbahood inay gurigii Rabbiga ku dhex gabyaan iyagoo haysta suxuun laysku garaaco, iyo shareerado, iyo kataarado, inay ka adeegaan guriga Ilaah, oo boqorku wuxuu saas ku amray Aasaaf iyo Yeduutuun iyo Heemaan.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

kikuyu: Oo iyagii iyo walaalahood la jiray ee la baray inay Rabbiga u gabyaan kuwaasoo dhammaan farsamada yiqiin tiradoodu waxay ahayd laba boqol iyo siddeed iyo siddeetan nin.
english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

kikuyu: Oo iyana hawshoodii waxay u riteen saami iswada le'eg, oo way isle'ekaysteen, kan ugu yar iyo kan ugu weyn, iyo xataa macallin iyo ardayba, waxba isma dheeraysan.
english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

kikuyu: Haddaba saamigii kowaad wuxuu u soo baxay reer Aasaaf oo waxaa helay Yuusuf. Kii labaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Gedalyaah, oo isaga iyo walaalihiis iyo wiilashiisiiba waxay isku ahaayeen laba iyo toban.
english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

kikuyu: Kii saddexaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Sakuur, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban nin.
english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii afraadna wuxuu u soo baxay Yisrii, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii shanaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Netanyaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii lixaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Buqiyaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii toddobaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Yeshareelaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii siddeedaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Yeshacyaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii sagaalaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Matanyaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Shimcii, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii kow iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Casareel, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii laba iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Xashabyaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii saddex iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Shuubaa'eel, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii afar iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Matityaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii shan iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Yereemood, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii lix iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Xananyaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii toddoba iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Yaashbeqaashaah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii siddeed iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Xanaanii, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii sagaal iyo tobnaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Mallootii, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii labaatanaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Elii'aataah, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii kow iyo labaatanaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Hootiir, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii laba iyo labaatanaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Giddaltii, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii saddex iyo labaatanaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Maxasii'ood, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Kii afar iyo labaatanaadna wuxuu u soo baxay Romamtii Ceser, iyo wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiisba oo ahaa laba iyo toban.
english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

kikuyu: Oo kooxihii iridjoogayaashiina waa kuwan: reer Qorax waxaa laga doortay Meshelemyaah ina Qore oo ahaa reer Aasaaf.
english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

kikuyu: Oo Meshelemyaahna wuxuu lahaa wiilal, oo curadkiisii wuxuu ahaa Sekaryaah, kii labaadna Yediica'eel, kii saddexaadna Sebadyaah, kii afraadna Yatnii'eel,
english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

kikuyu: kii shanaadna Ceelaam, kii lixaadna Yehooxaanaan, kii toddobaadna Eliihooceenay.
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

kikuyu: Oo Cobeed Edoomna wuxuu lahaa wiilal, oo curadkiisii wuxuu ahaa Shemacyaah, kii labaadna Yehoosaabaad, kii saddexaadna Yoo'aax, kii afraadna Saakaar, kii shanaadna Netaneel,
english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

kikuyu: kii lixaadna Ammii'eel, kii toddobaadna Isaakaar, kii siddeedaadna Fecultay, waayo, Ilaah baa isaga barakeeyey.
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wiilkiisii Shemacyaahna wiilal baa u dhashay, oo iyagaa u talin jiray reerkii aabbahood, waayo, waxay ahaayeen rag xoog badan.
english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Shemacyaahna waxay ahaayeen Cotnii, iyo Refa'eel, iyo Coobeed, iyo Elsaabaad, walaalahoodna oo ah Eliihuu iyo Semakiyaah waxay ahaayeen rag xoog badan.
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intaasoo dhammu waxay ahaayeen reer Cobeed Edoom, oo iyaga iyo wiilashoodii iyo walaalahoodba waxay ahaayeen rag xoog iyo karti adeegidda u leh, waxayna ahaayeen laba iyo lixdan nin oo reer Cobeed Edoom wada ah.
english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

kikuyu: Oo Meshelemyaahna wuxuu lahaa siddeed iyo toban nin oo ahaa rag xoog badan, waxayna wada ahaayeen wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiis.
english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Xosaah oo ahaa reer Meraariina wuxuu lahaa wiilal, waxaana ugu weynaa Shimrii (waayo, in kastoo uusan curadkii ahayn haddana aabbihiis ayaa madax ka dhigay),
english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

kikuyu: kii labaadna wuxuu ahaa Xilqiyaah, kii saddexaadna Tebalyaah, kii afraadna Sekaryaah. Oo Xosaah wiilashiisii iyo walaalihiis oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen saddex iyo toban.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

kikuyu: Oo iridjoogayaasha kooxahooduna intaasay ka koobnaayeen, waxayna ahaayeen rag madax ah, oo sida walaalahood hawl madax ka ah inay guriga Rabbiga ka dhex adeegaan.
english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Oo iyana midkooda ugu yar iyo midka ugu weynba, sidii ay qolooyinkoodu kala ahaayeen ayay irid kasta saami ugu riteen.
english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

kikuyu: Oo saamigii dhanka bari wuxuu u soo baxay Shelemyaah. Oo haddana waxay saami u rideen wiilkiisii Sekaryaah, oo ahaa lataliye xigmad badan, oo saamigiisiina wuxuu ku helay dhankii woqooyi.
english: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

kikuyu: Cobeed Edoomna waxaa u soo baxay dhankii koonfureed, oo wiilashiisiina waxaa u soo baxay guryihii wax lagu kaydin jiray.
english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

kikuyu: Shufiim iyo Xosaahna waxaa u soo baxay dhankii galbeed oo u dhowaa iriddii Shalleked la odhan jiray, oo ku ag tiil jidka kor u baxa, oo waardiyeba waardiyaha kaluu ka soo hor jeeday.
english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

kikuyu: Dhanka bari waxaa joogi jiray lix reer Laawi ah, dhanka woqooyina maalintiiba waxaa dhawri jiray afar nin, dhanka koonfureedna maalintiiba waxaa dhawri jiray afar nin, oo guryaha wax lagu kaydiyana waxaa dhawri jiray laba laba nin.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

kikuyu: Oo Farbaar dhankeedii galbeed, oo u dhow jidkiina waxaa dhawri jiray afar, oo Farbaarna waxaa dhawri jiray laba.
english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

kikuyu: Intaasu waxay ahaayeen kooxihii iridjoogayaasha, oo waxayna ahaayeen reer Qorax iyo reer Meraarii.
english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

kikuyu: Oo mid ka mid ahaa reer Laawi oo Axiiyaah ahaana wuxuu u talin jiray khasnadihii guriga Ilaah, iyo khasnadihii ay alaabta quduuska ahu tiil.
english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

kikuyu: Kuwii reer Lacdaan ee reer Gershoon oo uu lahaa Lacdaan, oo ahaa madaxdii reerahooda oo uu lahaa Lacdaan oo ahaa reer Gershoon, waxay ahaayeen Yexii'eelii,
english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

kikuyu: iyo wiilashii Yexii'eelii oo ahaa Seetaam, iyo Yoo'eel oo walaalkiis ahaa, waxayna u talin jireen khasnadihii guriga Rabbiga.
english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Oo waxaana jiray reer Camraam, iyo reer Isehaar, iyo reer Xebroon, iyo reer Cusii'eel.
english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

kikuyu: Oo Shebuu'eel oo ahaa ina Gershoom, oo ahaa reer Muusena wuxuu ahaa taliye xukuma khasnadihii.
english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

kikuyu: Waxaana la jiray walaalihiis ahaa reer Eliiceser, kuwaasoo ahaa wiilkiisii Rexabyaah, iyo isagii wiilkiisii Yeshacyaah, iyo isagii wiilkiisii Yooraam, iyo isagii wiilkiisii Sikrii, iyo isagii wiilkiisii Shelomood.
english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

kikuyu: Oo kuwan oo ah Shelomood iyo walaalihiis waxay u talin jireen khasnadihii alaabta quduuska ah, kuwaasoo ay quduus ka dhigeen Boqor Daa'uud, iyo madaxdii qolooyinka, iyo kuwii kun kun u taliyey iyo kuwii boqol boqol u taliyey, iyo saraakiishii ciidanku.
english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

kikuyu: Maalkii boolida ahaa oo dagaalka lagu soo dhacay waxay quduus uga dhigeen si loogu cusboonaysiiyo gurigii Rabbiga.
english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Oo kulli waxyaalihii ay quduus ka dhigeen Samuu'eel oo wax arke ahaa, iyo Saa'uul ina Qiish, iyo Abneer ina Neer, iyo Yoo'aab oo ay Seruuyaah dhashay, iyo wax alla wixii quduus laga dhigay oo dhammu waxay ku jireen gacantii Shelomood iyo tii walaalihiis.
english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

kikuyu: Oo Kenanyaah iyo wiilashiisii oo ahaa reer Isehaarna waxay saraakiil iyo xaakinno u ahaayeen hawlaha dibadda oo reer binu Israa'iil.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

kikuyu: Oo Xashabyaah iyo walaalihiis oo ahaa reer Xebroon, oo weliba ahaa rag xoog badan, oo tiradoodu ahayd kun iyo toddoba boqol oo nin, waxay u talin jireen reer binu Israa'iilkii dhanka galbeed oo Webi Urdun ka shisheeyey, iyo shuqulkii Rabbiga oo dhan, iyo adeegiddii boqorkaba.
english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.

kikuyu: Oo reer Xebroonna Yeriyaah madax buu ahaa, intaasu waa reer Xebroon sidii dadka reerahoodu u kala dhasheen. Oo waxaa iyaga la doondoonay sannaddii afartanaad oo boqortooyadii Daa'uud, oo waxaa iyaga dhexdoodii laga helay rag xoog badan oo jooga Yacser tii reer Gilecaad.
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

kikuyu: Oo walaalihiis oo ahaa rag xoog badanuna waxay ahaayeen laba kun iyo toddoba boqol oo nin, oo ah madaxdii qolooyinka kuwaasoo boqor Daa'uud uu ka dhigay inay taliyayaal ugu ahaadaan reer Ruubeen, iyo reer Gaad, iyo qabiilkii reer Manaseh badhkiis, xagga wax kasta oo xag Ilaah ku saabsan, iyo xagga danaha boqorkaba.
english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

kikuyu: Haddaba waa tan reer binu Israa'iil sidii tiradoodu ay ahayd, waxayna ahaayeen madaxdii qolooyinka, iyo kuwii kun kun u taliyey, iyo kuwii boqol boqol u taliyey, iyo saraakiishoodii boqorka uga adeegi jiray wax kasta oo ku saabsan kooxihii soo geli jiray oo bixi jiray bil kasta oo ah bilaha sannadda oo dhan; koox kasta tiradeedu waxay ahayd afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo kooxdii kowaad ee bixi jirtay bishii kowaad waxaa madax u ahaa Yaashaabcaam ina Sabdii'eel, oo kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo isagu wuxuu ahaa reer Feres, wuxuuna ugu wada sarreeyey saraakiishii ciidanka oo bishii kowaad bixi jiray oo dhan.
english: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

kikuyu: Oo kooxdii bishii labaadna waxaa madax u ahaa Doday oo ahaa reer Axoo'ax, oo kooxdiisa waxaa ku jiray Miqlood oo taliye ahaa, oo kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii saddexaad ee ciidanka oo bishii saddexaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Benaayaah oo madax ahaa oo ahaa ina wadaadkii ahaa Yehooyaadaac, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo kaasu waa Benaayaah oo ahaa kii ugu xoog badnaa soddonkii, oo weliba soddonka madax u ahaa, oo kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray wiilkiisii Cammiisaabaad.
english: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii afraad ee bishii afraad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Casaaheel oo ahaa Yoo'aab walaalkiis, wiilkiisii Sebadyaahna wuu ku xigay, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii shanaad ee bishii shanaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Shamhuud oo ahaa reer Yisraax, oo kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii lixaad oo bishii lixaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Ciiraa ina Ciqeesh oo ahaa reer Teqooca, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii toddobaad ee bishii toddobaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Xeles oo ahaa reer Feloonii, oo ka ahaa reer Efrayim, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii siddeedaad oo bishii siddeedaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Sibbekay oo ahaa reer Xushaad, oo ka ahaa reer Serax, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii sagaalaad ee bishii sagaalaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Abiiceser oo ahaa reer Canaatood, oo ka ahaa reer Benyaamiin, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii tobnaad ee bishii tobnaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Maharay oo ahaa reer Netofaah oo ka ahaa reer Serax, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii kow iyo tobnaad ee bishii kow iyo tobnaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Benaayaah oo ahaa reer Fircaatoon, oo ka ahaa reer Efrayim, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo sirkaalkii laba iyo tobnaad ee bishii laba iyo tobnaad bixi jirayna wuxuu ahaa Xelday oo ahaa reer Netofaah, oo ka ahaa reer Cotnii'eel, oo isaga kooxdiisana waxaa ku jiray afar iyo labaatan kun oo nin.
english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaa qabiilooyinkii reer binu Israa'iil u talinayay kuwan: reer Ruubeen waxaa u talinayay Eliiceser ina Sikrii oo taliye ahaa, reer Simecoonna waxaa u talinayay Shefatyaah ina Macakaah,
english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

kikuyu: reer Laawina waxaa u talinayay Hashabyaah ina Qemuu'eel, reer Haaruunna waxaa u talinayay Saadooq,
english: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

kikuyu: reer Yahuudahna waxaa u talinayay Eliihuu, oo Daa'uud walaalihiis ka mid ahaa, reer Isaakaarna waxaa u talinayay Coomrii ina Miikaa'eel,
english: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

kikuyu: reer Sebulunna waxaa u talinayay Yishmacyaah ina Cobadyaah, reer Naftaalina waxaa u talinayay Yereemood ina Casrii'eel,
english: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

kikuyu: reer Efrayimna waxaa u talinayay Hoosheeca ina Casasyaah, oo reer Manaseh badhkiisna waxaa u talinayay Yoo'eel ina Fedaayaah,
english: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

kikuyu: reer Manaseh badhkiisii kale oo joogay dalka Gilecaadna waxaa u talinayay Iddo ina Sekaryaah, reer Benyaamiinna waxaa u talinayay Yacasii'eel ina Abneer,
english: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

kikuyu: reer Daanna waxaa u talinayay Casareel ina Yeroxaam. Oo kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen saraakiishii qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil.
english: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Daa'uud ma uu tirinin intoodii labaatan sannadood ka yarayd, maxaa yeelay, Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi inuu reer binu Israa'iil u badinayo sida xiddigaha samada oo kale.
english: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

kikuyu: Yoo'aab oo ay Seruuyaah dhashay ayaa bilaabay inuu dadka tirsho, laakiinse ma uusan dhammayn, oo tirintaas aawadeed ayaa reer binu Israa'iil cadho ugu soo degtay, oo tiradiina laguma darin xisaabtii kitaabkii taariikhda oo Boqor Daa'uud.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

kikuyu: Oo boqorka khasnadihiisana waxaa u talinayay Casmaawed ina Cadii'eel, oo guryihii wax lagu kaydiyey ee beeraha ku yiil, iyo kuwii ku yiil magaalooyinka, iyo tuulooyinka, iyo qalcadahaba waxaa u talinayay Yoonaataan ina Cusiyaah.
english: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

kikuyu: Oo kuwii samayn jiray shuqulka beeraha inay dhulka qodaanna waxaa u talinayay Cesrii ina Keluub.
english: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

kikuyu: Oo beeraha canabka ahna waxaa u talinayay Shimcii oo ahaa reer Raamad, oo guryihii lagu kaydiyey khamrigii laga helay beeraha canabka ahna waxaa u talinayay Sabdii oo ahaa reer Shifmii.
english: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.

kikuyu: Oo dhirtii saytuunka ahayd iyo dhirtii darayga ahayd oo dalkii dooxada ahaa ku yiilna waxaa u talinayay Bacal Xaanaan oo ahaa reer Geder, guryihii saliidda lagu kaydiyeyna waxaa u talinayay Yoo'aash.
english: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.

kikuyu: Oo lo'dii Shaaroon daaqi jirtayna waxaa u talinayay Shitray oo ahaa reer Shaaroon, oo lo'dii dooxooyinka joogtayna waxaa u talinayay Shaafaad ina Adlay.
english: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.

kikuyu: Oo geelashana waxaa u talinayay Oobiil oo ahaa reer Ismaaciil, oo dameerahana waxaa u talinayay Yexdeyaah oo ahaa reer Meeronotii,
english: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

kikuyu: oo adhyahana waxaa u talinayay Yaasiis oo ahaa reer Hagrii. Oo kulli intaas oo dhammu waxay ahaayeen taliyayaashii maalkii Boqor Daa'uud.
english: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Yoonaataan oo ahaa Daa'uud adeerkiis wuxuu ahaa lataliye waxgarasho weyn leh, iyo karraaniba, oo Yexii'eel ina Xakmooniina wuxuu la jiray boqorka wiilashiisa.
english: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

kikuyu: Oo Axiitofelna wuxuu ahaa boqorka lataliyihiisa, oo Xuushay oo ahaa reer Arkiina wuxuu ahaa boqorka saaxiibkiis.
english: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

kikuyu: Oo Axiitofelna waxaa ku xigay Yehooyaadaac ina Benaayaah, iyo Aabyaataar, oo boqorka ciidankiisana waxaa sirkaal u ahaa Yoo'aab.
english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu Yeruusaalem ku soo wada shiriyey amiirradii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, iyo amiirradii qabiilooyinka, iyo saraakiishii kooxihii boqorka mile milaha ugu adeegi jiray, iyo kuwii kun kun u talin jiray iyo kuwii boqol boqol u talin jiray, iyo taliyayaashii xukumi jiray maalka iyo hantidii boqorka iyo tii wiilashiisaba, iyo saraakiishii iyo raggii xoogga badnaa, xataa kulli raggii xoogga badnaa oo dhanba.
english: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Daa'uud cagaha isku taagay, oo wuxuu yidhi, Walaalahay iyo dadkaygiiyow, i maqla. Aniga waxaa qalbigayga ku jirtay inaan guri nasasho u dhiso sanduuqa axdiga Rabbiga iyo meel uu Ilaaheennu cago saaro, oo dhismihiina alaab baan u diyaariyey.
english: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaah baa igu yidhi, Waa inaadan guri u dhisin magacayga aawadiis, maxaa yeelay, waxaad tahay nin dagaal, oo dhiig baad daadisay.
english: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee Rabbiga Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil ahu wuxuu iga doortay reerkii aabbahay oo dhan inaan weligay ahaado boqor reer binu Israa'iil u taliya, waayo, isagu wuxuu Yahuudah u doortay inuu amiir ahaado, oo reer Yahuudahna wuxuu ka doortay reerkii aabbahay, oo wiilashii aabbahayna aniguu igala dhex baxay oo igu farxay inuu iga dhigo boqor u taliya reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan.
english: However the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wiilal badan buu i siiyey oo wuxuu wiilashaydii oo dhan ka doortay wiilkayga Sulaymaan inuu carshiga boqortooyada Rabbiga ku fadhiisto oo uu reer binu Israa'iil u taliyo.
english: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Wiilkaaga Sulaymaan ayaa dhisi doona gurigayga iyo barxadahaygaba, waayo, waxaan isaga u doortay inuu ahaado wiilkaygii, oo anna waxaan isaga u ahaan doonaa aabbihiis.
english: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

kikuyu: Oo anigu boqortooyadiisaan xoogayn doonaa weligeed, hadduu ku sii adkaado inuu sameeyo amarradayda iyo xukummadayda, siday maantadan tahay.
english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan oo ah shirkii Rabbiga hortooda, iyo iyadoo uu Ilaaheennu ina maqlayo, dhawra oo doondoona amarrada Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah oo dhan inaad idinku hantidaan dalkan wanaagsan oo aad weliba carruurtiinna idinka dambaysana uga tagtaan dhaxal weligiis raagaya.
english: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

kikuyu: Haddaba Sulaymaanow, wiilkaygiiyow, Ilaahii aabbahaa garo, oo ugu adeeg qalbi qumman iyo maan raalli ah, waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu baadhaa qalbiyada oo dhan, wuuna wada gartaa malayaasha fikirrada oo dhan, oo haddaad isaga doondoontid waad heli doontaa, laakiinse haddaad isaga ka tagtid wuu ku xoori doonaa weligaaba.
english: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

kikuyu: Haddaba iska jir, waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu kuu doortay inaad meesha quduuska ah guri u dhistid. Xoog yeelo oo samee.
english: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wiilkiisii Sulaymaan siiyey tilmaantii balbaladii macbudka, iyo tii guryihiisa, iyo tii khasnadihiisa, iyo tii qowladihiisa sare, iyo tii qolalkiisa hoose, iyo tii meeshii daboolka kafaaraggudka.
english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu kaloo siiyey kulli wixii uu ruuxii ku hayay tilmaantoodii oo dhan, kuwaasoo ah barxadihii guriga Rabbiga, iyo qolalkii ku wareegsanaa oo dhan, iyo khasnadihii guriga Ilaah, iyo khasnadihii alaabta quduuska ah la dhigi lahaa,
english: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the LORD’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

kikuyu: iyo weliba tilmaantii kooxihii ahaa wadaaddada iyo reer Laawi, iyo shuqulkii laga qaban lahaa guriga Rabbiga oo dhan, iyo weelashii guriga lagaga adeegi lahaa oo dhan,
english: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the LORD’s house, and for all the vessels of service in the LORD’s house—

kikuyu: iyo tilmaantii dahabkii loo miisaami lahaa weelasha dahabka ah, oo ah kulli weelasha lagu adeegi lahaa cayn kasta oo adeegid ah, iyo tii lacagtii loo miisaami lahaa kulli weelasha lacagta ah oo ah kulli weelasha lagu adeegi lahaa cayn kasta oo adeegid ah,
english: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

kikuyu: iyo weliba tii dahabkii loo miisaami lahaa laambadaha dahabka ah, iyo laambadahooda yaryar ee dahabka ah oo dhan, laambad kasta iyo laambadaheeda yaryarba miisaankooda, iyo tii lacagtii loo miisaami lahaa laambadaha lacagta ah, laambad kasta iyo laambadaheeda yaryarba miisaankooda, si waafaqsan wixii laambad kasta lagu qaban lahaa,
english: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

kikuyu: iyo tii dahabkii loo miisaami lahaa miisaska kibista tusniinta, miis kasta miisaankiisa, iyo tii lacagtii miisaska lacagta ah,
english: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

kikuyu: iyo tilmaantii mudacyada, iyo maddiibadaha, iyo koobabka laga samayn lahaa dahab saafi ah, oo baaquliyada dahabka ahna baaquli kasta dahabkiisii miisaankiisa, oo baquliyada lacagta ahna baquli kasta lacagtiisii miisaankeeda,
english: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

kikuyu: iyo tilmaantii girgiraha fooxa dahabkiisa la safeeyey miisaankiisa, iyo tilmaantii dahabka loo miisaami lahaa naqshadda gaadhifaraska, iyo keruubiimtii baalashooda kala bixisay oo ku qarisay sanduuqii axdiga Rabbiga.
english: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD’s covenant.

kikuyu: Oo Daa'uud wuxuu yidhi, Waxan oo dhan waxaa laygu garansiiyey qorniin laga helay gacantii Rabbiga, si aan ku garto tilmaantan shuqulkeeda oo dhan.
english: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Daa'uud wuxuu wiilkiisii Sulaymaan ku yidhi, Xoog yeelo oo aad u dhiirranow, oo hawshan samee, oo ha cabsan, hana qalbi jabin, waayo, Rabbiga Ilaaha ah oo ah Ilaahayga ayaa kula jira, oo isagu kuma gabi doono, kumana dayrin doono, jeer la wada dhammeeyo kulli shuqulka adeegidda guriga Rabbiga oo dhan.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa jooga kooxaha ah wadaaddada iyo reer Laawi, inay dhammaan qabtaan adeegidda guriga Ilaah, oo waxaa kula jiri doona oo hawl kasta qaban doona nin kasta oo adeegid kasta sanco u yaqaan oo raalli ah, oo weliba saraakiisha iyo dadka oo dhammuna amarkaaga way oggolaan doonaan.
english: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Daa'uud shirkii oo dhan ku yidhi, Wiilkayga Sulaymaan oo Ilaahu keligiis doortay, weli wuu yar yahay, waana tabar daranyahay, oo shuqulkuna waa weyn yahay, waayo, guriga nin loo dhisi maayo, laakiinse waxaa loo dhisayaa Rabbiga Ilaaha ah.
english: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

kikuyu: Haddaba xooggaygii oo dhan ayaan gurigii Ilaahayga u diyaarshay dahabka laga sameeyo alaabta dahabka, iyo lacagta laga sameeyo alaabta lacagta ah, iyo naxaasta laga sameeyo alaabta naxaasta ah, iyo birta laga sameeyo alaabta birta ah, iyo qoriga laga sameeyo alaabta qoriga ah, iyo dhagaxyo onika la yidhaahdo, iyo dhagaxyada la dejiyo oo wax lagu qurxiyo oo midabyo kala cayncayn ah, iyo cayn kasta oo dhagaxyo qaaliya ah, iyo dhagaxyo badan oo marmar ah.
english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

kikuyu: Oo weliba anigu aad baan u jeclahay guriga Ilaahayga, oo taas daraaddeed waxaan guriga Ilaahayga siinayaa khasnad mulkigayga ah oo dahab iyo lacag ah, taasoo aan ku jirin wixii aan u diyaariyey gurigii quduuska ah,
english: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

kikuyu: waxa weeye saddex kun oo talanti oo dahab ah oo weliba ah dahabkii Oofir, iyo toddoba kun oo talanti oo ah lacag la safeeyey, in lagu dahaadho guryaha derbiyadoodii oo dhan,
english: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

kikuyu: iyo in dahab laga sameeyo alaab dahab ah, iyo in lacag laga sameeyo alaab lacag ah, iyo shuqul kasta oo ay kuwa sancada yaqaan gacmahooda ku qabtaan. Haddaba yaa raalli ka ah oo maantadan nafsaddiisa Rabbiga u bixinaya?
english: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”

kikuyu: Markaas amiirradii reeraha iyo amiirradii qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil iyo kuwii kun kun u taliyey, iyo kuwii boqol boqol u taliyey, iyo taliyayaashii boqorka hawshiisa xukumi jirayba waxay bixiyeen wax ay raalli ka yihiin.
english: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

kikuyu: Oo adeegidda guriga Ilaah daraaddeed waxay u bixiyeen shan kun oo talanti iyo toban kun oo dirham oo dahab ah, iyo toban kun oo talanti oo lacag ah, iyo siddeed iyo toban kun oo talanti oo naxaas ah, iyo boqol kun oo talanti oo bir ah.
english: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii dhagxanta qaaliga ah laga helayna waxay siiyeen khasnaddii guriga Rabbiga, waxaana loo dhiibay gacantii Yexii'eel oo ahaa reer Gershoon.
