Oo waxaa gooni ahaan loo soocay wadaadkii Cesraa ahaa, iyo kuwo madax ah oo ka socda qolooyinkoodii, oo kulligoodna magacyadooda loogu wada yeedhay, oo iyana bishii tobnaad maalinteedii kowaad ayay u fadhiisteen inay xaalkan soo baadhaan.
english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

kikuyu: Oo waxay xaalka ku saabsan raggii naagaha qalaad guursaday oo dhan dhammeeyeen bishii kowaad maalinteedii kowaad.
english: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashii wadaaddada waxaa laga dhex helay kuwo naago qalaad guursaday; waxayna ahaayeen wiilashii Yeeshuuca, ina Yoosaadaaq iyo walaalihiis oo ahaa Macaseeyaah, iyo Eliiceser, iyo Yaariib iyo Gedalyaah.
english: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay gacantooda ku dhiibeen oo ku ballanqaadeen inay naagahooda eryaan, oo iyagoo xujo leh waxay xujadooda ugu bixiyeen wan idaha laga soo qabtay.
english: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Immeerna waxaa laga helay Xanaanii iyo Sebadyaah.
english: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Xaarimna, Macaseeyaah, iyo Eliiyaah, iyo Shemacyaah, iyo Yexii'eel, iyo Cusiyaah.
english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Fashxuurna, Eliyooceenay, iyo Macaseeyaah, iyo Ismaaciil, iyo Netaneel, iyo Yoosaabaad, iyo Elcaasaah.
english: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

kikuyu: Oo reer Laawina, Yoosaabaad, iyo Shimcii, iyo Qeelaayaah (kaasu waa Qeliitaa), iyo Fetaxyaah, iyo Yahuudah, iyo Eliiceser.
english: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

kikuyu: Raggii gabayaaga ahaana waxaa laga helay Eliyaashiib; irid-dhawryadiina waxaa laga helay Shalluum, iyo Telem, iyo Uurii.
english: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna waxaa laga helay wiilashii Farcosh oo ahaa Ramyaah, iyo Yisyaah, iyo Malkiiyaah, iyo Miyaamin, iyo Elecaasaar, iyo Malkiiyaah, iyo Benaayaah.
english: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Ceelaamna, Matanyaah, iyo Sekaryaah, iyo Yexii'eel, iyo Cabdii, iyo Yereemood, iyo Eliiyaah.
english: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Satuuna, Eliyooceenay, iyo Eliyaashiib, iyo Matanyaah, iyo Yereemood, iyo Saabaad, iyo Casiisaa.
english: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Beebayna, Yehooxaanaan, iyo Xananyaah, iyo Sabbay, iyo Catlay.
english: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Baaniina, Meshullaam, iyo Malluug, iyo Cadaayaah, iyo Yaashuub, iyo She'aal, iyo Yereemood.
english: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Faxad Moo'aabna, Cadnaa, iyo Kelaal, iyo Benaayaah, iyo Macaseeyaah, iyo Matanyaah, iyo Besaleel, iyo Binnuwii, iyo Manaseh.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Haarimna, Eliiceser, iyo Yishiyaah, iyo Malkiiyaah, iyo Shemacyaah, iyo Shimcoon,
english: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

kikuyu: Benyaamiin, iyo Malluug, iyo Shemaryaah.
english: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Xaashumna, Matenay, iyo Matataah, iyo Saabaad, iyo Eliifeled, iyo Yereemay, iyo Manaseh, iyo Shimcii.
english: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Baaniina, Macaday, iyo Camraam, iyo Uu'eel,
english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

kikuyu: iyo Benaayaah, iyo Beedyaah, iyo Keluux,
english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

kikuyu: iyo Wanyaah, iyo Mereemood, iyo Eliyaashiib,
english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

kikuyu: iyo Matanyaah, iyo Matenay, iyo Yacasay,
english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

kikuyu: iyo Baanii, iyo Binnuwii, iyo Shimcii,
english: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

kikuyu: iyo Shelemyaah, iyo Naataan, iyo Cadaayaah,
english: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

kikuyu: Maknadbay, iyo Shaashay, iyo Shaaray,
english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

kikuyu: iyo Casareel, iyo Shelemyaah, iyo Shemaryaah,
english: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

kikuyu: iyo Shalluum, iyo Amaryaah, iyo Yuusuf.
english: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

kikuyu: Wiilashii Nebona, Yecii'eel, iyo Matityaah, iyo Saabaad, iyo Sebiinaa, iyo Iddo, iyo Yoo'eel, iyo Benaayaah.
english: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intaasoo dhammu waxay wada guursadeen naago qalaad, oo qaarkood waxay qabeen naago ay carruur ka dhaleen.
english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.

kikuyu: Kanu waa hadalkii Nexemyaah oo ahaa ina Xakalyaah. Hadda intaan joogay Shuushan oo ah hoygii boqorka, sannaddii labaatanaad bisheedii Kislee'u,
english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Susa the palace,

kikuyu: waxaa yimid Xanaanii oo walaalahayga midkood ahaa, isaga iyo niman kale oo dalka Yahuudah ka yimid; oo markaasaan weyddiiyey wax ku saabsan Yuhuuddii baxsatay, oo maxaabiistii ka hadhay, iyo wax ku saabsan Yeruusaalem.
english: Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men out of Judah; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay igu yidhaahdeen, Kuwii maxaabiista ka hadhay oo gobolkii jira waxay ku jiraan dhibaato weyn iyo ceeb; oo derbigii Yeruusaalemna waa la dumiyey, oo irdaheediina dab baa lagu gubay.
english: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”

kikuyu: Oo markaan erayadaas maqlay ayaan meel fadhiistay oo ooyay, oo intii ayaamo ah ayaan baroortay; waanan soomay, oo waxaan ku tukaday Ilaaha samada hortiisa,
english: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept, and mourned several days; and I fasted and prayed before the God of heaven,

kikuyu: oo idhi, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha samadow, Ilaaha weyn oo laga cabsadow, oo axdiga xajiya, oo u naxariista kuwa isaga jecel oo amarradiisa xajiyow, waan ku baryayaaye,
english: and said, “I beg you, LORD, the God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

kikuyu: Dhegahaagu ha maqleen, indhahaagana fur, inaad maqashid baryadayda anoo addoonkaaga ah. Wakhtigan habeen iyo maalinba waxaan kuu baryayaa reer binu Israa'iil oo addoommadaada ah, anigoo qiraya dembiyadii aan aniga iyo reer binu Israa'iil kugu dembaabnay; haah, aniga iyo reerka aabbahayba waannu dembaabnay.
english: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against you. Yes, I and my father’s house have sinned.

kikuyu: Oo si aad u xun ayaannu kula macaamiloonnay, oo ma aannan xajin amarradii, iyo qaynuunnadii, iyo xukummadii aad ku amartay addoonkaagii Muuse ahaa.
english: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances, which you commanded your servant Moses.

kikuyu: Waan ku baryayaaye, bal xusuuso eraygii aad ku amartay addoonkaagii Muuse ahaa, oo aad ku tidhi, Haddaad xadgudubtaan, waxaan idinku kala dhex firdhin doonaa dadyowga,
english: “Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you among the peoples;

kikuyu: laakiinse haddaad ii soo noqotaan oo aad amarradayda xajisaan oo aad yeeshaan, in kastoo kuwiinna la tuuray ay joogaan meesha samada ugu fog, halkaasaan ka soo ururin doonaa, oo waxaan keeni doonaa meeshii aan u doortay inaan ka dhigo in magacaygu joogo.
english: but if you return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens, yet I will gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen, to cause my name to dwell there.’

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa addoommadaada iyo dadkaaga aad ku soo furtay xooggaagii iyo gacantaadii xoogga badnayd.
english: “Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand.

kikuyu: Sayidow, waan ku baryayaaye, hadda dhegahaagu ha maqleen baryadayda anoo addoonkaaga ah, iyo baryada addoommadaada ku farxa inay ka cabsadaan magacaaga; waan ku baryayaaye, maanta i guulee, anoo addoonkaaga ah, oo ka dhig inaan ninkan hortiisa naxariis ka helo. (Anigu waxaan ahaa koobsidaha boqorka.)
english: Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name; and please prosper your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” Now I was cup bearer to the king.

kikuyu: Bishii Niisaan oo ahayd sannaddii labaatanaad oo boqor Artaxshasta, iyadoo khamri hor yaal isaga ayaan khamrigii qaaday oo boqorkii siiyey. Hadda ka hor anigu boqorka hortiisa caloolxumo kuma joogi jirin.
english: In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad before in his presence.

kikuyu: Oo boqorkii wuxuu igu yidhi, War maxaa wejigaagu u murugaysan yahay adigoo aan bukayn? Tanu wax kale ma aha waase tiiraanyo qalbiga ku jirta. Markaasaan aad u baqay,
english: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then I was very much afraid.

kikuyu: oo waxaan boqorkii ku idhi, Boqorow, weligaaba noolow. Bal maxaa wejigaygu la murugaysnaan waayay, iyadoo magaalada ah meeshii awowayaashay xabaalahoodu ahaayeen ay baabba' tahay, oo irdaheediina dab lagu gubay?
english: I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu igu yidhi, Hadda maxaad iga baryaysaa? Kolkaasaan Ilaaha samada baryay.
english: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan boqorkii ku idhi, Boqorow, hadday ku farxiso, oo haddaad raalli iga tahay anoo addoonkaaga ah, waxaan doonayaa inaad ii dirtid dalka Yahuudah oo ay ku taal magaalada awowayaashay xabaalahoodu yihiin, inaan dhiso.
english: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa boqorkii wuxuu igu yidhi, (iyadoo boqoraddiina agtiisa fadhido) Sodcaalkaagu tan iyo goormuu ahaanayaa? Goormaadse soo noqonaysaa? Markaasuu boqorku ku farxay inuu i diro; oo waxaan u qabtay wakhti.
english: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time for him.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan boqorkii ku idhi, Boqorow, haddaad raalli ka tahay, ha lay siiyo warqado aan u geeyo taliyayaasha webiga ka shisheeya, si ay igu oggolaadaan inaan dhex maro dalkooda ilaa aan gaadho dalka Yahuudah;
english: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;

kikuyu: iyo warqad kaloo aan siiyo Aasaaf oo ah kan dhawra dhirta boqorka, si uu ii siiyo alwaax aan ku sameeyo waxa haya saqafka irdaha qalcadda ee guriga u dhow, iyo derbiga magaalada iyo guriga aan geli doono. Oo boqorkiina wuu ii wada oggolaaday sidii ay gacantii wanaagsanayd ee Ilaahay ii saarnayd.
english: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.” The king granted my requests, because of the good hand of my God on me.

kikuyu: Markaasaan u imid taliyayaashii webiga ka shisheeyey, oo iyagii siiyey warqadihii boqorka. Oo weliba waxaa boqorku igu daray saraakiil ciidanka ka tirsan iyo fardooley.
english: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

kikuyu: Oo Sanballad oo ahaa reer Xoron, iyo addoonkii ahaa Toobiyaah oo ahaa reer Cammoon markay maqleen inuu yimid nin doonaya wanaagga reer binu Israa'iil ayay aad iyo aad u murugoodeen.
english: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaan Yeruusaalem imid, oo halkaasaan saddex maalmood iska joogay.
english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

kikuyu: Oo habeennimadii ayaan kacay, anigoo ay dhawr nin ila socdaan, oo ninna uma aan sheegin waxa Ilaahay qalbigayga geliyey inaan Yeruusaalem u sameeyo. Oo neefna ilama jirin neefkii aan fuushanaa mooyaane.
english: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.

kikuyu: Oo habeennimo ayaan ka baxay Iriddii Dooxada, oo ku tiil xagga Ceelkii Maska, oo waxaan maray xagga Iriddii Digada, waanan fiiriyey derbiyadii Yeruusaalem oo wada dunsanaa, iyo irdaheedii dabka lagu gubay.
english: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaan tegey Iriddii Isha biyaha iyo xaggii Balligii Boqorka; laakiinse neefkii aan fuushanaa meeluu maro ma jirin.
english: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaan habeennimo tegey xaggii durdurka, oo derbigii baan fiiriyey, kolkaasaan dib u noqday, oo magaaladii ka soo galay xaggii Iriddii Dooxada, oo saasaan u soo noqday.
english: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.

kikuyu: Oo taliyayaashiina ma ay ogayn meel aan tegey iyo wixii aan sameeyey toona; oo weli waxba uma aan sheegin Yuhuuddii, iyo wadaaddadii, iyo kuwii gobta ahaa, iyo taliyayaashii, iyo intii kaloo shuqulka samaysay toona.
english: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.

kikuyu: Markaasaan ku idhi, War waad aragtaan xaalka xun oo aan ku jirno, iyo sida Yeruusaalem u baabba'day, iyo in irdaheedii dab lagu gubay. Haddaba kaalaya oo aan dhisno derbiga Yeruusaalem, si aynaan mar dambe u sii ceebaysnaan.
english: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”

kikuyu: Oo waxaan iyagii wax uga sheegay gacantii Ilaahay oo korkayga ku wanaagsanayd, iyo weliba erayadii uu boqorku igula hadlay. Oo iyana waxay yidhaahdeen, Ina kiciya aan dhisnee. Sidaasay gacmahoodii shuqulkii wanaagsanaa ugu xoogeeyeen.
english: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Sanballad oo ahaa reer Xoron, iyo addoonkii ahaa Toobiyaah oo ahaa reer Cammoon, iyo Geshem oo ahaa Carab, markay taas maqleen ayay nagu qosleen, oo na quudhsadeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, War waxaad samaynaysaan waa maxay? Ma boqorkaad ku caasiyoobaysaan?
english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”

kikuyu: Markaasaan jawaabay oo ku idhi, Ilaaha samadu wuu na liibaanin doonnaa, oo sidaas daraaddeed annagoo addoommadiisa ah waannu kici doonnaa, wax baannuna dhisi doonnaa, laakiinse idinku Yeruusaalem kuma lihidin qayb, ama xaq, amase xusuus toona.
english: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Eliyaashiib oo ahaa wadaadkii sare ayaa la kacay wadaaddadii walaalihiis ahaa, oo waxay dhiseen Iriddii Idaha, oo intay quduus ka dhigeen ayay albaabbadeedii qotomiyeen, oo waxay quduus ka dhigeen tan iyo Munaaraddii Mee'aah iyo ilaa Munaaraddii Xananeel.
english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it, and set up its doors. They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah, to the tower of Hananel.

kikuyu: Oo intii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa dhisay dadkii Yerixoo, oo intii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa dhisay Sakuur ina Imrii.
english: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.

kikuyu: Iriddii Kalluunkana waxaa dhisay reer Hasenaa'aah, oo waxay saareen alwaaxdii saqafka haysay, wayna taageen albaabbadeedii oo geliyeen handarraabbadeedii iyo qataarradeedii.
english: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

kikuyu: Oo intii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Mereemood ina Uuriyaah, oo ahaa reer Xaqoos. Oo intii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Meshullaam ina Berekyaah oo ahaa ina Mesheysabeel. Oo intii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Saadooq ina Bacanaa.
english: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey reer Teqooca, laakiinse kuwoodii gobta ahaa waxba kama qaban shuqulkii sayidkooda.
english: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.

kikuyu: Iriddii Gabowdayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Yooyaadaac oo ahaa ina Faasee'ax iyo Meshullaam oo ahaa ina Besoodyaah, oo waxay saareen alwaaxdii saqafka haysay, wayna taageen albaabbadeedii oo geliyeen handarraabbadeedii iyo qataarradeedii.
english: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Melatyaah oo ahaa reer Gibecoon, iyo Yaadoon oo ahaa reer Meeronotii, iyo dadkii reer Gibecoon, iyo kuwii reer Misfaah, oo ku hoos jiray carshiga taliyaha webiga ka shisheeya.
english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Cusii'eel oo ahaa ina Xarhayaah oo ka mid ahaa dahabtumayaashii. Oo meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Xananyaah oo ka mid ahaa dawosameeyayaashii, oo waxay Yeruusaalem adkeeyeen tan iyo derbiga ballaadhan.
english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Refaayaah oo ahaa ina Xuur oo ahaa taliyihii degmada Yeruu saalem badhkiis.
english: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii iyaga ku xigtay oo ka soo hor jeedday gurigiisa waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Yedacyaah oo ahaa ina Xaruumaf. Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa dhisay Xatuush oo ahaa ina Xashabneyaah.
english: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

kikuyu: Malkiiyaah ina Xaarim iyo Xashuub ina Faxad Moo'aabna waxay cusboonaysiiyeen meel kale iyo Munaaraddii Foornooyinka.
english: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Shalluum ina Hallooxeesh oo ahaa taliyihii dhistariga Yeruusaalem badhkiis, isagii iyo gabdhihiisii.
english: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs.

kikuyu: Iriddii Dooxadana waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Xaanuun iyo dadkii Saanoo'ax degganaa. Iyagu way dhiseen, oo waxay qotomiyeen albaabbadeedii oo geliyeen handarraabbadeedii iyo qataarradeedii, oo waxay dhiseen kun dhudhun oo derbigii ah tan iyo Iriddii Digada.
english: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.

kikuyu: Iriddii Digadana waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Malkiiyaah ina Reekaab oo ahaa taliyihii degmada Beyd Hakerem; wuu dhisay, wuuna qotomiyey albaabbadeedii oo geliyey handarraabbadeedii iyo qataarradeedii.
english: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

kikuyu: Iriddii Isha biyaha ahna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Shalluun ina Kaalxoseh oo ahaa taliyihii degmada Misfaah, wuu dhisay oo deday, oo wuxuu qotomiyey albaabbadeedii oo geliyey handarraabbadeedii iyo qataarradeedii, oo derbigii Warta Shelax oo beerta boqorka u dhowaana wuu dhisay, oo wuxuu gaadhsiiyey tan iyo jaranjarada hoos uga degata magaalada Daa'uud.
english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.

kikuyu: Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Nexemyaah ina Casbuuq oo ahaa taliyihii degmada Beytsuur badhkiis, oo isagu wuxuu dhisay tan iyo meesha ka soo hor jeedda xabaalihii Daa'uud, iyo tan iyo balligii la sameeyey, iyo tan iyo gurigii ragga xoogga badan.
english: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.

kikuyu: Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey reer Laawi oo Rexuum ina Baanii ka mid ahaa. Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Xashabyaah oo ahaa taliyihii degmada Qeciilaah badhkiis oo degmadiisa aawadiis ayuu u dhisay.
english: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

kikuyu: Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey walaalahood oo uu ka mid ahaa Baway ina Xeenaadaad oo ahaa taliyihii degmada Qeciilaah badhkiis.
english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

kikuyu: Meel kale oo isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Ceser ina Yeeshuuca oo ahaa taliyihii Misfaah, taas oo ahayd meel ka soo hor jeedda meesha loo fuulo maqsinka hubka oo ku ag yiil meeshuu derbigu ka leexdo.
english: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.

kikuyu: Meel kale oo isaga ku xigtayna waxaa dadaal ku cusboonaysiiyey Baaruug ina Sabbay, tan iyo leexashada derbiga iyo ilaa albaabkii guriga Eliyaashiib oo ahaa wadaadka sare.
english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

kikuyu: Meel kale oo isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Mereemood ina Uuriyaah oo ahaa reer Xaqoos, tan iyo guriga Eliyaashiib albaabkiisa iyo ilaa guriga Eliyaashiib dabadiisa.
english: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

kikuyu: Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey wadaaddadii ahaa dadkii Bannaanka.
english: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.

kikuyu: Meeshii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Benyaamiin iyo Xashuub taas oo ahayd meel guryahooda ka soo hor jeedday. Meeshii iyaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Casaryaah ina Macaseeyaah oo ahaa reer Cananyaah, taas oo ahayd gurigiisa dhinaciisa.
english: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.

kikuyu: Meel kale oo isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Binnuwii ina Xeenaadaad, taas oo ka bilaabmaysay gurigii Casaryaah ilaa meeshuu derbigu ka leexdo iyo tan iyo derbiga geeskiisii.
english: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.

kikuyu: Faalaal ina Uusayna wuxuu cusboonaysiiyey meel leexashadii derbiga ka soo hor jeedday iyo munaaraddii ka taagnayd gurigii boqorka oo sare ee u dhowaa barxaddii waardiyayaasha, oo meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Fedaayaah ina Farcosh.
english: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

kikuyu: (Haddaba reer Netiiniim waxay degganaayeen Cofel iyo tan iyo meel ka soo hor jeedday Iridda Biyaha oo xagga bari, iyo ilaa munaaraddii kor u taagnayd.)
english: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)

kikuyu: Meel kale oo isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey reer Teqooca, taasoo ka soo hor jeedday munaaraddii weynayd oo kor u taagnayd, iyo tan iyo derbigii Cofel.
english: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.

kikuyu: Iriddii Faraska korkeedana waxaa cusboonaysiiyey wadaaddadii, oo mid waluba wuxuu sameeyey meeshii gurigiisa ka soo hor jeedday.
english: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

kikuyu: Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Saadooq ina Immeer, taasoo ahayd meel gurigiisa ka soo hor jeedday. Meel kale oo isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Shemacyaah ina Shekaanyaah oo ahaa kii dhawri jiray Iridda Bari.
english: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, made repairs.

kikuyu: Meel kale oo isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Xananyaah ina Shelemyaah iyo Xaanuun oo ahaa Saalaaf wiilkiisii lixaad. Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Meshullaam ina Berekyaah, taasoo ahayd meel qolkiisii ka soo hor jeedday.
english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

kikuyu: Meeshii isaga ku xigtayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey Malkiiyaah oo ahaa dahabtumayaasha midkood oo wuxuu dhisay tan iyo gurigii reer Netiiniim iyo baayacmushtariyada oo ka soo hor jeedday Iridda Mifqaad iyo ilaa meeshii geeska laga fuulo.
english: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.

kikuyu: Oo meeshii geeska laga fuulo iyo Iriddii Idaha intii u dhaxaysayna waxaa cusboonaysiiyey dahabtumayaashii iyo baayacmushtariyadii.
english: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

kikuyu: Laakiinse markii Sanballad maqlay inaannu derbigii dhisaynay ayuu cadhooday, oo aad u dhirfay, oo Yuhuuddiina wuu ku majaajilooday.
english: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ka hor hadlay walaalihiis iyo ciidankii Samaariya, oo wuxuu yidhi, War Yuhuuddan itaalka daranu waxay samaynayaan waa maxay? Iyaga ma la daynayaa? Oo miyey allabaryayaan? Oo ma maalin bay hawshaas ku dhammaynayaan? Oo dhagxantii miyey ka soo noolaynayaan tuulmooyinkii waxyaalaha baabba'ay oo gubtay?
english: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”

kikuyu: Oo haddana Toobiyaah oo ahaa reer Cammoon oo agtiisa taagnaa wuxuu yidhi, Waxa ay dhisayaan oo dhan xataa haddii dawaco fuusho way kala burburinaysaa derbigooda dhagaxa ah.
english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”

kikuyu: Ilaahayagow, bal maqal, waayo, waa nala quudhsadaye; caydooda dib ugu celi madaxooda, oo iyaga u gacangeli dal dhaca oo maxaabiis ahaan u kaxaysta.
english: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.

kikuyu: Oo xumaantoodana ha dedin, oo dembigoodana yaan hortaada laga tirtirin, waayo, kuwii wax dhisayay hortooda ayay kaaga xanaajiyeen.
english: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”

kikuyu: Haddaba derbigii waannu dhisnay; oo derbigii oo dhan waa lays qabadsiiyey ilaa qotonkiisii badhkiis la gaadhsiiyey, waayo dadku waxay maanka ku hayeen inay shaqeeyaan.
english: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.

kikuyu: Laakiinse markii Sanballad, iyo Toobiyaah, iyo kuwii Carbeed, iyo reer Cammoon, iyo reer Ashdood ay maqleen in derbiyadii Yeruusaalem cusboonaysiintoodii ay hore u socotay iyo in la bilaabay in daldaloolladii la fureeyo ayay aad u cadhoodeen.
english: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;

kikuyu: Markaasay dhammaantood shirqool ku wada arrinsadeen inay soo kacaan oo Yeruusaalem la diriraan, iyo inay dhexdeeda qas ka ridaan.
english: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaannu barinnay Ilaahayo, oo iyaga aawadood ayaannu yeelnay waardiyayaal naga ilaaliya habeen iyo maalinba.
english: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii dalka Yahuudah waxay yidhaahdeen, Kuwa culaysyada qaada xooggoodii waa yaraaday, oo waxaa jira waxyaalo dundumay oo badan, sidaa daraaddeed derbiga ma dhisi karno.
english: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall.”

kikuyu: Oo cadaawayaashayadiina waxay yidhaahdeen, Iyagu ma ay ogaan doonaan, mana ay arki doonaan jeeraan dhex tagno oo aan iyaga layno, oo shuqulkana aan joojinno.
english: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”

kikuyu: Oo markii Yuhuuddii iyaga ag degganayd ay yimaadeen, waxay toban jeer nagu yidhaahdeen, Idinku waa inaad meel walba nooga soo noqotaan.
english: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed meeshii ugu hoosaysay oo derbiga ka dambaysay oo meelaha bannaan ku yiil ayaan taagay dadkii qoloqolo u safan oo wada haysta seefahoodii, iyo warmahoodii, iyo qaansooyinkoodiiba.
english: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

kikuyu: Oo intaan wax fiiriyey ayaan kacay oo waxaan ku idhi kuwii gobta ahaa, iyo taliyayaashii, iyo dadka intiisii kaleba, Iyaga ha ka cabsanina, ee waxaad xusuusataan Sayidka weyn oo laga cabsado, oo waxaad u dirirtaan walaalihiin, iyo wiilashiinna, iyo gabdhihiinna, iyo naagihiinna, iyo guryihiinnaba.
english: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”

kikuyu: Haddaba markii cadaawayaashayadii ay maqleen inaannu taas ogaannay, oo uu Ilaah taladoodii kala riday, ayaannu kulligayo ku noqonnay derbigii oo mid waluba wuxuu qabtay shuqulkiisii.
english: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.

kikuyu: Oo intii markaas ka dambaysay midiidinnadaydii badhkood shuqulkii bay sameeyeen, oo badhkoodii kalena waxay hayeen warmihii, iyo gaashaammadii, iyo qaansooyinkii, iyo jubbado bir ah, oo taliyayaashii oo dhammuna way daba taagnaayeen dadkii dalka Yahuudah oo dhan.
english: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii derbiga dhisayay iyo kuwii wax culus isa saarayba mid waluba gacmihiisa middood wuxuu ku sameeyey shuqulkii, midda kale wuxuu ku haystay hubkiisii dagaalka.
english: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii wax dhisayayna mid walba seeftiisu dhinaca ayay ugu xidhnayd, oo sidaasayna wax u dhisayeen. Oo kii buunka yeedhin jirayna aniguu i ag joogay.
english: Among the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan ku idhi kuwii gobta ahaa, iyo taliyayaashii, iyo dadka intiisii kaleba, Shuqulku waa weyn yahay, wuuna ballaadhan yahay, annana derbiga dushiisa waannu ku kala firidhsan nahay, oo midba midka kale wuu ka fog yahay.
english: I said to the nobles, and to the rulers and to the rest of the people, “The work is great and widely spread out, and we are separated on the wall, far from one another.

kikuyu: Meel alla meeshii aad ka maqashaan dhawaaqa buunka, halkaas noogu soo urura; waxaa inoo diriri doona Ilaaheenna.
english: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us. Our God will fight for us.”

kikuyu: Sidaasaannu shuqulkii u qabannay; oo dadka badhkiisna waxay warmaha haysteen markii waagu beryay iyo tan iyo jeeray xiddiguhu muuqdeen.
english: So we did the work. Half of the people held the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appeared.

kikuyu: Oo sidaas oo kale isla markaas waxaan dadkii ku idhi, Mid kasta iyo midiidinkiisu ha ku soo hoydeen Yeruusaalem, si ay habeenkii waardiyayaal noogu noqdaan, maalintiina ay u hawshoodaan.
english: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, “Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed aniga iyo walaalahay, iyo midiidinnadaydii, iyo raggii waardiyaha ahaa oo i daba socday toona midkayana dharkiisii iskama furin, oo mid kastaaba isagoo hubkiisii u xidhan yahay ayaa biyaha xaggooda tegey.
english: So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me took off our clothes. Everyone took his weapon to the water.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa dadkii iyo afooyinkooda ka kacay qaylo weyn oo ay kaga cabanayeen walaalahooda Yuhuudda ah.
english: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa jiray dad yidhi, Annaga iyo wiilashayada iyo gabdhahayagu waannu badan nahay, haddaba aan hadhuudh helno si aannu u cunno oo ugu noolaanno.
english: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaa kaloo jiray qaar yidhi, Annagu waxaannu rahaamad u dhiibaynaa beerahayaga iyo beerahayaga canabka ah iyo guryahayaga, si aannu u helno hadhuudh abaarta aawadeed.
english: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”

kikuyu: Oo waxaa kaloo jiray kuwo yidhi, Gabbaradii uu boqorku ka doonayay beerahayagii iyo beerahayagii canabka ahaa ayaannu lacag u amaahannay.
english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.

kikuyu: Haddaba jiidhkayagu waa sida jiidhka walaalahayo, oo carruurtayaduna waa sida carruurtooda oo kale, oo bal eeg, wiilashayadii iyo gabdhahayagii ayaannu u bixinaynaa inay addoommo noqdaan, oo gabdhahayagii qaarkood mar horaa la addoonsaday; oo annana ma lihin itaal aan wax kaga tarno, waayo, dad kalaa wada haysta beerahayagii iyo beerahayagii canabka ahaa oo dhan.
english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”

kikuyu: Oo anna aad baan u cadhooday markii aan maqlay qayladoodii iyo erayadan.
english: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

kikuyu: Markaasaan isla arrinsaday, waanan la diriray kuwii gobta ahaa iyo taliyayaashii, oo waxaan ku idhi, Idinka mid waluba wuxuu walaalkiis ka qaataa korsocod. Oo anigu waxaan qabtay shir weyn oo iyaga ka gees ah.
english: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan ku idhi, Innagu walaalaheennii Yuhuudda ahaa oo quruumaha laga iibiyey, waan soo furannay intii aan awoodnay oo dhan, haddaba idinku ma waxaad doonaysaan inaad walaalihiin iibisaan? Oo ma annagaa nalaga iibinayaa? Markaasay shib iska yidhaahdeen oo eray ay ku hadlaan way garan waayeen.
english: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan idhi, War waxaad samaysaan ma wanaagsana. Sow waajib idinkuma aha inaad ku socotaan ka cabsashada Ilaaheenna cayda quruumaha cadaawayaasheenna ah aawadeed?
english: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?

kikuyu: Oo sidaasoo kale aniga iyo walaalahay iyo midiidinnadayda lacag iyo hadhuudh baan korsocod ku amaahinnaa. Waan idin baryayaaye aan iska dayno korsocodkan.
english: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan idinka baryayaa inaad maantadan u celisaan beerahoodii, iyo beerahoodii canabka ahaa, iyo beerahoodii saytuunka ahaa, iyo guryahoodii, oo lacagtii, iyo hadhuudhkii, iyo khamrigii, iyo saliiddii aad korsocodka uga qaadateenna boqolkii meelood meel u celiya.
english: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”

kikuyu: Markaasay yidhaahdeen, Waxoodii waan u celinaynaa, oo wax dambena weyddiisan mayno innaba. Waxaannu yeelaynaa sidaad tidhaahdo. Markaasaan u yeedhay wadaaddadii, oo waxaan ku dhaariyey inay ballankan siduu yahay oofiyaan.
english: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.

kikuyu: Markaasaan maradii dhabtayda hurgufay oo waxaan idhi, Ilaahay sidaas ha uga hurgufo gurigiisa iyo hawshiisa nin alla ninkii aan oofin ballankan; sidaas oo kale isaga ha loo hurgufo oo ha loo madhiyo. Markaasaa ururkii oo dhammu waxay yidhaahdeen, Aamiin, Rabbigana way ammaaneen. Oo dadkiina way sameeyeen sidii ballankaasu ahaa.
english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD. The people did according to this promise.

kikuyu: Oo weliba tan iyo waagii la ii doortay inaan taliye u ahaado dalka Yahuudah waagaasoo ahaa boqorkii Artaxshasta sannaddiisii labaatanaad ilaa tan iyo sannaddiisii laba iyo soddonaad inta u dhex leh intaasoo ahayd laba iyo toban sannadood, aniga iyo walaalahay midna ma cunin cuntadii taliyaha.
english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.

kikuyu: Laakiinse taliyayaashii hore oo iga sii horreeyey dadka culays bay ku hayeen, oo waxay ka qaadan jireen cunto iyo khamri iyo weliba afartan sheqel oo lacag ah, oo xataa midiidinnadoodu dadka way xukumi jireen. Laakiinse anigu saas ma aan yeelin, maxaa yeelay, waxaan ka cabsadaa Ilaah.
english: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan hore u sii waday shuqulkii derbigan, oo annagu waxba dhul ma aannu iibsan. Oo midiidinnadaydii oo dhammuna halkaasay shuqulka aawadiis ku soo wada urureen.
english: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaa miiskayga wax ka cuni jiray boqol iyo konton nin oo ah Yuhuud iyo taliyayaal oo ayan ku jirin kuwii nooga yimid quruumihii hareerahayaga ku wareegsanaa.
english: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.

kikuyu: Haddaba maalintiiba waxaa naloo diyaarin jiray dibi iyo lix neef oo wanaagsan oo ido ah; oo weliba waxaa la ii diyaarin jiray digaag, oo tobankii maalmoodba mar baa naloo keeni jiray cayn kasta oo khamri ah; oo weliba intaas oo dhan anigu marna ma weyddiisan cuntadii taliyaha, maxaa yeelay, addoonnimada dadkan saarnayd aad bay u cuslayd.
english: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, wanaag igu xusuuso wixii aan dadkan u sameeyey oo dhan aawadiis.
english: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.

kikuyu: Haddaba markii Sanballad iyo Toobiyaah iyo Geshem kii Carabka ahaa, iyo cadaawayaashayadii kale loo sheegay inaan derbigii dhisay iyo inaan innaba daldalool lagu arag (in kastoo wakhtigaas aanan weli qotomin albaabbadii irdaha),
english: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),

kikuyu: ayay Sanballad iyo Geshem ii soo cid direen oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Kaalay oo aan ku wada kulanno tuulooyinka bannaanka Oonoo ku yaal middood. Laakiinse waxay ku fikireen inay belaayo igu sameeyaan.
english: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan u diray wargeeyayaal, oo ku idhi, Waxaan samaynayaa shuqul weyn oo sidaas daraaddeed ma iman karo. Bal maxaa shuqulku u joogsanayaa markaan ka tago oo aan idiin imaado?
english: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”

kikuyu: Oo fartiin caynkaas ah ayay afar jeer ii soo direen; oo anna isla sidii baan ugu jawaabay.
english: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.

kikuyu: Oo haddana isla sidaas oo kale Sanballad wuxuu markii shanaad ii soo diray midiidinkiisii oo gacanta ku sida warqad furan.
english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

kikuyu: Oo waxaa ku qornaa, Waxaa quruumaha dhexdooda laga sheegay, Gashmuuna uu leeyahay, in adiga iyo Yuhuudduba aad ku talo jirtaan inaad fallaagowdaan, oo waa taas daraaddeed waxaad derbiga u dhisaysaa, oo sida waafaqsan erayadan la soo sheegay waxaad doonaysaa inaad boqor u ahaatid.
english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaad dooratay nebiyo si ay wax kugu saabsan dadka Yeruusaalem ugu wacdiyaan, iyagoo leh, Dalka Yahuudah waxaa jooga boqor. Haddaba erayadan waxaa loo sheegi doonaa boqorka. Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed kaalay, oo aan tashannee.
english: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”

kikuyu: Markaasaan u cid diray oo ku idhi, Waxaad leedahay oo kale halkan innaba laguma samayn, laakiinse adigaa qalbigaaga ka soo hindisay.
english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

kikuyu: Waayo, dhammaantood waxay doonayeen inay na cabsiiyaan, oo waxay isyidhaahdeen, Shuqulkay ka daali doonaan, mana dhammayn doonaan. Laakiinse, Ilaahow, xoog ii yeel.
english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.

kikuyu: Markaasaan tegey gurigii Shemacyaah ina Delaayaah oo ahaa ina Meheetabeel oo xidhnaa; oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Guriga Rabbiga oo ah macbudka dhexdiisa aan ku kulanno, oo aan xidhanno albaabbada macbudka, waayo, iyagu waxay u iman doonaan inay ku dilaan. Haah, oo habeennimada ayay u soo iman doonaan inay ku dilaan.
english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”

kikuyu: Aniguse waxaan ku idhi, Nin anigoo kale ahu miyuu cararaa? Bal waase kee, kan aniga ila mid ah oo macbudka u geli lahaa inuu naftiisa ku badbaadiyo? Geli maayo.
english: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

kikuyu: Markaasaan gartay inaan Ilaah isaga soo dirin, laakiinse hadal iga gees ah ayuu ugu hadlay sidii nebi oo kale, waayo, waxaa soo kiraystay Toobiyaah iyo Sanballad.
english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

kikuyu: Oo taas aawadeed baa isaga loo soo kiraystay inaan cabsado oo saas yeelo oo aan dembaabo, iyo inay iyagu sabab u helaan war xun si ay iigu ceebeeyaan.
english: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ilaahayow, sida shuqulladoodu yihiin u xusuuso Toobiyaah iyo Sanballad iyo weliba nebiyaddii Noocadyaah iyo nebiyadii kale oo damcay inay i cabsigeliyaan.
english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”

kikuyu: Oo sidaasaa derbigii laba iyo konton maalmood loogu dhammeeyey bishii Eluul maalinteedii shan iyo labaatanaad.
english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

kikuyu: Oo markii cadaawayaashayadii oo dhammu ay taas maqleen ayay kulli quruumihii hareerahayaga ku wareegsanaa oo dhammu wada cabsadeen, oo aad bay u ceeboobeen, waayo, waxay garteen in shuqulkan laga sameeyey Ilaahayaga xaggiisa.
english: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waagaas kuwii gobta ahaa oo dalka Yahuudah warqado badan bay u direen Toobiyaah, oo iyagana waxaa u yimid warqadihii Toobiyaah.
english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

kikuyu: Waayo, dalka Yahuudah waxaa joogay kuwo badan oo isaga u dhaartay, maxaa yeelay, isaga waxaa soddog u ahaa Shekaanyaah ina Aarax; oo wiilkiisii Yehooxaanaanna wuxuu guursaday Meshullaam ina Berekyaah gabadhiisii.
english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxay hortayda kaga hadleen falimihiisii wanaagsanaa, oo hadalkaygana isagay u sheegeen. Toobiyaahna warqaduu iigu soo diray inuu i cabsiiyo.
english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

kikuyu: Haddaba markii derbigii la dhisay, oo aan taagay albaabbadii, oo irid-dhawryadii iyo kuwii gabayaaga ahaa iyo kuwii reer Laawi la doortay,
english: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

kikuyu: ayaan Yeruusaalem madax uga dhigay walaalkay Xanaanii, iyo Xananyaah oo ahaa taliyihii qalcadda, waayo, wuxuu ahaa nin aamin ah, oo cabsida Ilaahna dad badan buu kaga horreeyey.
english: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan iyagii ku idhi, Jeer ay qorraxdu kululaato yaan la furin irdaha Yeruusaalem, oo intay waardiyayaashu taagan yihiin albaabbada ha la xidho, oo idinku qataara, dadka Yeruusaalem degganna waardiyayaal ka doorta, oo mid waluba ha dhawro meel gurigiisa ka soo hor jeedda.
english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

kikuyu: Haddaba magaaladu way ballaadhnayd, wayna weynayd, laakiinse dadku way ku yaraayeen, oo guryihiina ma ay dhisnayn.
english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu qalbigayga geliyey inaan soo wada ururiyo kuwii gobta ahaa, iyo taliyayaashii, iyo dadkii oo dhanba in abtiriskooda la tiriyo. Oo waxaan helay buuggii uu ku qornaa abtiriskii kuwii markii hore yimid, oo waxaan ka helay oo gudihiisa ku qornaa:
english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwanu waa dadkii gobolka ee ka soo noqday maxaabiisnimadii, oo ku jiray kuwii la kaxaystay, oo Nebukadnesar oo ahaa boqorkii Baabuloon uu u kaxaystay Baabuloon, oo ku soo noqday Yeruusaalem iyo dalkii Yahuudah, mid waluba magaaladiisii,
english: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

kikuyu: oo waxay la yimaadeen Serubaabel, Yeeshuuca, Nexemyaah, Casaryaah, Racamyaah, Naxamaanii, Mordekay, Bilshaan, Misfered, Bigway, Nexuum, iyo Bacanaah. Haddaba waa tan tiradii dadkii reer binu Israa'iil:
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

kikuyu: Reer Farcosh waxaa ka soo noqday laba kun iyo boqol iyo laba iyo toddobaatan,
english: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

kikuyu: reer Shefatyaahna saddex boqol iyo laba iyo toddobaatan,
english: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.

kikuyu: reer Aaraxna lix boqol iyo laba iyo konton,
english: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.

kikuyu: reer Fahad Moo'aab oo ahaa reer Yeeshuuca iyo reer Yoo'aabna laba kun iyo siddeed boqol iyo siddeed iyo toban,
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

kikuyu: reer Ceelaamna kun iyo laba boqol iyo afar iyo konton,
english: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

kikuyu: reer Satuuna siddeed boqol iyo shan iyo afartan,
english: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.

kikuyu: reer Sakayna toddoba boqol iyo lixdan,
english: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.

kikuyu: reer Binnuwiina lix boqol iyo siddeed iyo afartan,
english: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.

kikuyu: reer Beebayna lix boqol iyo siddeed iyo labaatan,
english: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: reer Casgaadna laba kun iyo saddex boqol iyo laba iyo labaatan,
english: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

kikuyu: reer Adoniiqaamna lix boqol iyo toddoba iyo lixdan,
english: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.

kikuyu: reer Bigwayna laba kun iyo toddoba iyo lixdan,
english: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.

kikuyu: reer Caadiinna lix boqol iyo shan iyo konton,
english: The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.

kikuyu: reer Aateer oo ahaa reer Xisqiyaahna siddeed iyo sagaashan,
english: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

kikuyu: reer Xaashumna saddex boqol iyo siddeed iyo labaatan,
english: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: reer Beesayna saddex boqol iyo afar iyo labaatan,
english: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.

kikuyu: reer Xaariifna boqol iyo laba iyo toban,
english: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.

kikuyu: reer Gibecoonna shan iyo sagaashan,
english: The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.

kikuyu: raggii reer Beytlaxam iyo reer Netofaahna boqol iyo siddeed iyo siddeetan,
english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.

kikuyu: raggii reer Canaatoodna boqol iyo siddeed iyo labaatan,
english: The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.

kikuyu: raggii reer Beytasmaawedna laba iyo afartan,
english: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.

kikuyu: raggii reer Qiryad Yecaariim, iyo reer Kefiiraah, iyo reer Bi'iroodna toddoba boqol iyo saddex iyo afartan,
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.

kikuyu: raggii reer Raamaah iyo reer Gebacna lix boqol iyo kow iyo labaatan,
english: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.

kikuyu: raggii reer Mikmaasna boqol iyo laba iyo labaatan,
english: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.

kikuyu: raggii reer Beytel iyo reer Aaciina boqol iyo saddex iyo labaatan,
english: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.

kikuyu: raggii reer Nebona laba iyo konton,
english: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.

kikuyu: reerkii Ceelaamtii kalena kun iyo laba boqol iyo afar iyo konton,
english: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

kikuyu: reer Haarimna saddex boqol iyo labaatan,
english: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.

kikuyu: reer Yerixoona saddex boqol iyo shan iyo afartan,
english: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.

kikuyu: reer Lod, iyo reer Xaadiid, iyo reer Oonoona toddoba boqol iyo kow iyo labaatan,
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.

kikuyu: reer Senaacaahna saddex kun iyo sagaal boqol iyo soddon.
english: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Oo wadaaddadiina waxay ahaayeen reer Yedacyaah oo ahaa reer Yeeshuuca oo ahaa sagaal boqol iyo saddex iyo toddobaatan,
english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.

kikuyu: reer Immeerna kun iyo laba iyo konton,
english: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.

kikuyu: reer Fashxuurna kun iyo laba boqol iyo toddoba iyo afartan,
english: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

kikuyu: reer Haarimna kun iyo toddoba iyo toban.
english: The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.

kikuyu: Kuwii reer Laawina waxay ahaayeen reer Yeeshuuca kii reer Qadmii'eel oo ahaa reer Xoodawyaah afar iyo toddobaatan.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.

kikuyu: Oo nimankii gabayaaga ahaa oo reer Aasaaf ahaana waxay ahaayeen boqol iyo siddeed iyo afartan.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii irdaha dhawri jiray oo ahaa reer Shalluum, iyo reer Aateer, iyo reer Talmon, iyo reer Caquub, iyo reer Xatiitaa, iyo reer Shobay waxay isku ahaayeen boqol iyo siddeed iyo soddon.
english: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

kikuyu: Oo reer Netiiniimna waxay ahaayeen reer Siixaa, iyo reer Xasufaa, iyo reer Tabbaacood,
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

kikuyu: iyo reer Qeeros, iyo reer Siicaa, iyo reer Faadoon,
english: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

kikuyu: iyo reer Lebaanaa, iyo reer Xagaabaah, iyo reer Shalmay,
english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

kikuyu: iyo reer Xaanaan, iyo reer Giddeel, iyo reer Gaxar,
english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

kikuyu: iyo reer Re'aayaah, iyo reer Resiin, iyo reer Neqoodaa,
english: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

kikuyu: iyo reer Gasaam, iyo reer Cuusaa, iyo reer Faasee'ax,
english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,

kikuyu: iyo reer Beesay, iyo reer Mecuuniim, iyo reer Nefiishesiim,
english: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,

kikuyu: iyo reer Baquuq, iyo reer Xaquufaa, iyo reer Xarxuur,
english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

kikuyu: iyo reer Basliid, iyo reer Mexiidaa, iyo reer Xarshaa,
english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

kikuyu: iyo reer Barqoos, iyo reer Siiseraa, iyo reer Temax,
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

kikuyu: iyo reer Nesiyax, iyo reer Xatiifaa.
english: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.

kikuyu: Oo ilmihii addoommadii Sulaymaanna waxay ahaayeen reer Sotay, iyo reer Sofered, iyo reer Feriidaa,
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

kikuyu: iyo reer Yacalaa, iyo reer Darqoon, iyo reer Giddeel,
english: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

kikuyu: iyo reer Shefatyaah, iyo reer Xatiil, iyo reer Fokered Hasebaayiim, iyo reer Aamoon.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.

kikuyu: Oo reer Netiiniim oo dhan iyo ilmihii addoommadii Sulaymaan waxay isku ahaayeen saddex boqol iyo laba iyo sagaashan.
english: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

kikuyu: Oo kuwanuna waxay ahaayeen kuwii ka tegey Teel Melax, iyo Teel Xarshaa, iyo Keruub, iyo Addoon, iyo Immeer, laakiinse iyagu ma ay sheegi karin qabiilkoodii ama jilibkoodii, iyo inay reer binu Israa'iil ahaayeen iyo in kale toona,
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

kikuyu: oo reer Delaayaah, iyo reer Toobiyaah, iyo reer Neqoodaa waxay isku ahaayeen lix boqol iyo laba iyo afartan.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii wadaaddada ahaa waxay ahaayeen reer Xaabaayaah, iyo reer Xaqoos, iyo reer Barsillay oo naag ka guursaday gabdhaha Gilecaad oo iyaga lagu magacaabay.
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waxay magacyadoodii ka doondooneen buuggii abtiriska, laakiinse lagama helin, sidaas aawadeed wadaadnimadii waa laga saaray sidii iyagoo nijaas ah.
english: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

kikuyu: Oo taliyihii baa iyagii ku amray inayan waxyaalaha ugu quduusan wax ka cunin jeer wadaad Uuriim iyo Tummiim leh kaco.
english: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

kikuyu: Oo ururka oo dhammu wuxuu giddigiis isku ahaa laba iyo afartan kun iyo saddex boqol iyo lixdan,
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

kikuyu: oo intaas waxaa gooni ka ahaa raggii addoommadooda ahaa iyo naagihii addoommahooda ahaa, oo iyana waxay ahaayeen toddoba kun iyo saddex boqol iyo toddoba iyo soddon, oo waxay lahaayeen laba boqol iyo shan iyo afartan oo ah rag iyo naago gabya.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

kikuyu: Fardahoodu waxay ahaayeen toddoba boqol iyo lix iyo soddon, baqlahooduna laba boqol iyo shan iyo afartan,
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

kikuyu: geelooduna afar boqol iyo shan iyo soddon, dameerahooduna lix kun iyo toddoba boqol iyo labaatan.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

kikuyu: Oo madaxdii qabiilooyinka qaarkood ayaa shuqulkii wax u bixiyey. Taliyuhu wuxuu khasnadda siiyey kun dirham oo dahab ah, iyo konton maddiibadood, iyo shan boqol iyo soddon khamiis oo ah dhar wadaadood.
english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

kikuyu: Oo madaxdii qabiilooyinka qaarkood ayaa khasnaddii shuqulka geliyey labaatan kun oo dirham oo dahab ah, iyo laba kun iyo laba boqol oo mina oo lacag ah.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

kikuyu: Oo dadka intiisii kale wixii ay bixiyeen waxay ahaayeen labaatan kun oo dirham oo dahab ah, iyo laba kun oo mina oo lacag ah, iyo toddoba iyo lixdan khamiis oo ah dhar wadaadood.
english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

kikuyu: Haddaba wadaaddadii, iyo kuwii reer Laawi, iyo irid-dhawryadii, iyo nimankii gabayaaga ahaa, iyo dadkii qaarkiis, iyo reer Netiiniim, iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu waxay degeen magaalooyinkoodii. Oo markii bishii toddobaad la gaadhay reer binu Israa'iil waxay joogeen magaalooyinkoodii.
english: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.

kikuyu: Oo dadkii oo dhammu iyagoo ah sidii nin keliya ayay dhammaantood ku soo wada urureen meesha bannaan oo iridda biyaha ka horraysa; oo karraanigii Cesraa ahaa ayay kula hadleen oo u sheegeen inuu keeno kitaabkii sharciga Muuse oo Rabbigu ku amray reer binu Israa'iil.
english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii Cesraa sharcigii hor keenay ururkii ahaa rag iyo dumar iyo in alla intii waxgarasho ku maqli kartay oo dhan, oo waxayna ahayd bishii toddobaad maalinteedii kowaad.
english: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

kikuyu: Oo isna wixii kitaabkii ku qornaa ayuu ku akhriyey meeshii bannaanayd oo iridda biyaha ka horraysay, oo wuxuu akhriyeyey aroortii ilaa hadhkii, wuxuuna ku hor akhriyey raggii iyo dumarkii iyo kuwii garan karayay; oo dadkii oo dhammuna aad bay u dhegaysanayeen kitaabkii sharciga.
english: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

kikuyu: Oo karraanigii Cesraa ahaa wuxuu kor taagnaa meel sare oo alwaax laga sameeyey oo sababtaas aawadeed loo dhisay; oo dhankiisa midigta waxaa taagnaa Matityaah, iyo Shemac, iyo Canaayaah, iyo Uuriyaah, iyo Xilqiyaah, iyo Macaseeyaah; oo dhankiisa bidixdana waxaa taagnaa Fedaayaah, iyo Miishaa'eel, iyo Malkiyaah, iyo Xaashum, iyo Xashbaddaanaah, iyo Sekaryaah, iyo Meshullaam.
english: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Cesraa kitaabkii furay iyadoo dadkii oo dhammu wada arkaan, (waayo, wuu ka wada korreeyey dadka oo dhan;) oo markuu furay ayaa dadkii oo dhammu wada istaagay.
english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Cesraa ammaanay Rabbiga ah Ilaaha weyn, oo dadkii oo dhammuna intay gacmaha kor u qaadeen ayay ku jawaabeen, Aamiin, Aamiin; oo intay madaxa foororiyeen ayay Rabbiga u sujuudeen oo wejiga dhulka saareen.
english: Then Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaa kaloo dadkii sharciga garansiiyey Yeeshuuca, iyo Baanii, iyo Sheereebyaah, iyo Yaamiin, iyo Caquub, iyo Shabbetay, iyo Hoodiyaah, iyo Macaseeyaah, iyo Qeliitaa, iyo Casaryaah, iyo Yoosaabaad, iyo Xaanaan, iyo Felaayaah, iyo kuwii reer Laawi, oo dadkiina meeshoodii ayay istaageen.
english: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.

kikuyu: Oo kitaabkii sharciga Ilaah si bayaan ah ayaa loo akhriyey, waana la micneeyey si dadku u garto waxa la akhriyey.
english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Nexemyaah oo taliyaha ahaa, iyo wadaadkii Cesraa oo karraaniga ahaa, iyo kuwii reer Laawi oo dadka wax bari jiray, waxay dadkii oo dhan ku wada yidhaahdeen, Maanta waxay Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah u tahay maalin quduus ah, haddaba ha barooranina, hana ooyina, maxaa yeelay, dadkii oo dhammu way wada ooyeen markay maqleen erayadii sharciga.
english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to the LORD your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

kikuyu: Oo haddana wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Taga, oo baruurta cuna, oo wax macaan cabba, oo kii aan wax u diyaarsanaynna qayb u dira, waayo, maanta waxay Rabbigeenna u tahay maalin quduus ah, hana murugoonina, waayo, idinka waxaa xoog idiin ah farxadda Rabbiga.
english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwii reer Laawi ayaa dadkii oo dhan aamusiiyey, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, War maanta waa quduuse iska aamusa oo ha murugoonina.
english: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”

kikuyu: Markaasay dadkii oo dhammu iska tageen inay wax cunaan, oo wax cabbaan, oo ay qaybo diraan, oo ay aad u farxaan, maxaa yeelay, waxay garteen erayadii loo caddeeyey.
english: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

kikuyu: Oo madaxdii qabiilooyinka dadka oo dhan, iyo wadaaddadii, iyo kuwii reer Laawi ayaa maalintii labaad karraanigii Cesraa ugu soo wada urureen inay erayada sharciga aad u dhegaystaan.
english: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa sharcigii ku qornaa oo ay ka dhex heleen in Rabbigu Muuse ku amray in reer binu Israa'iil ay waabab ku hoydaan inta lagu jiro iidda bisha toddobaad,
english: They found written in the law how the LORD had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;

kikuyu: iyo inay iyaga waajib ku tahay inay kaga dhawaaqaan oo ka naadiyaan magaalooyinkooda oo dhan iyo xataa Yeruusaalem gudaheeda, oo ay yidhaahdaan, Buurta taga oo ka soo gura laamo saytuun ah, iyo kuwo saytuun dibadeed ah, iyo laamo ah geedo hadaas la yidhaahdo, iyo laamo cawbaar ah, iyo geedo waaweyn laamahood in laga sameeyo waabab sida qoran.
english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed dadkii way bexeen, oo laamihii keeneen, oo waxay dhisteen waabab, oo mid waluba wuxuu ka dhistay saqafka gurigiisa, iyo barxadahooda, iyo barxadihii guriga Ilaah, iyo meeshii bannaanayd oo Iridda Biyaha, iyo meeshii bannaanayd oo Iridda Efrayim.
english: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.

kikuyu: Oo kulli intii maxaabiisnimada ka soo noqotay ururkoodii oo dhammu waxay dhisteen waabab oo waxay degeen waababkii; waayo, reer binu Israa'iil saas ma ay yeelin tan iyo wakhtigii Yashuuca ina Nuun iyo ilaa maalintaas. Oo ayaantaas waxaa jirtay farxad aad u weyn.
english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.

kikuyu: Oo maalintii ugu horraysay ilaa maalintii ugu dambaysay ayuu maalin kasta kitaabkii sharciga Ilaah akhriyi jiray. Oo toddoba maalmood way iidayeen, oo maalintii siddeedaadna waxaa jiray shir iidda lagu dhammaynayay sida qaynuunka waafaqsanayd.
english: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

kikuyu: Haddaba bisha afar iyo labaatankeedii ayaa reer binu Israa'iil soo shireen iyagoo sooman oo dhar joonyad ah guntan oo ciid isku shubay.
english: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa farcankii reer binu Israa'iil waxay iska sooceen dad qalaad oo dhan, oo intay istaageen ayay qirteen dembiyadoodii iyo xumaatooyinkii awowayaashood.
english: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay meeshoodii istaageen oo akhriyeen kitaabkii sharciga Rabbiga Ilaahooda ah intii maalin rubuceed ah; oo haddana rubuc kale ayay wax qirteen, wayna u sujuudeen Rabbiga Ilaahooda ah.
english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Markaasaa darajadii reer Laawi waxaa ku kor istaagay Yeeshuuca, iyo Baanii, iyo Qadmii'eel, iyo Shebanyaah, iyo Bunnii, iyo Sheereebyaah, iyo Baanii, iyo Kenaanii, oo cod weyn ayay ugu qayshadeen Rabbiga Ilaahooda ah.
english: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Markaasaa kuwii reer Laawi oo ahaa Yeeshuuca, iyo Qadmii'eel, iyo Baanii, iyo Xashabneyaah, iyo Sheereebyaah, iyo Hoodiyaah, iyo Shebanyaah, iyo Fetaxyaah, waxay dadkii ku yidhaahdeen, War istaaga oo Rabbiga Ilaahiinna ah ammaana weligiis iyo weligiis, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Magacaaga ammaanta badan ha la ammaano, kaasoo ka wada sarreeya kulli mahad iyo ammaan oo dhan.
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

kikuyu: Adigaa Rabbiga ah oo keligaa baa ah. Waxaad samaysay samada, taasoo ah samada samooyinka, iyo ciidankooda oo dhan, iyo dhulka iyo waxa kor jooga oo dhan, iyo badaha iyo waxa ku jira oo dhan, dhammaantood adigaa sii nooleeya, oo ciidanka samaduna adigay kuu sujuudaan.
english: You are the LORD, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

kikuyu: Adigaa ah Rabbiga Ilaaha ah oo Aabraam doortay, oo isaga ka soo bixiyey Uur tii reer Kaldayiin, oo u bixiyey magaca Ibraahim la yidhaahdo,
english: You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,

kikuyu: oo dabadeedna ogaaday in qalbigiisu hortaada aamin ku yahay, oo isagii axdi kula dhigtay inaad isaga siinaysid dalka reer Kancaan, iyo reer Xeed, iyo reer Amor, iyo reer Feris, iyo reer Yebuus, iyo reer Girgaash, xataa inaad dalkaas siinaysid farcankiisa; oo erayadaadiina waad oofisay, maxaa yeelay, xaq baad tahay.
english: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.

kikuyu: Adigu waxaad aragtay dhibkii awowayaashayo dalka Masar ku qabeen, waanad maqashay qayladoodii ay Badda Cas agteeda ka qaysheen;
english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

kikuyu: oo weliba Fircoon iyo addoommadiisii oo dhan, iyo kulli dadkii dalkiisa oo dhan waxaad tustay calaamooyin iyo yaabab, waayo, waad ogayd inay iyaga ku kibreen, oo halkaas magac baad ku heeshay siday maanta tahay.
english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.

kikuyu: Oo iyagii hortood ayaad baddii kala qaybisay, oo waxay mareen badda dhexdeedii, oo dhul engegan bay ku socdeen, oo kuwii iyaga eryanayayna sidii dhagax biyo xoog badan lagu dhex riday ayaad moolka ugu tuurtay.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

kikuyu: Oo weliba maalintii waxaad ku hoggaamisay tiir daruur ah, habeenkiina tiir dab ah, si aad ugu iftiimiso jidkii ay marayeen.
english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

kikuyu: Waxaad weliba ku soo kor degtay Buur Siinay, oo iyagaad kala hadashay xagga samada, oo waxaad siisay xukummo qumman, iyo sharciyaal xaq ah, iyo qaynuunno wanwanaagsan, iyo amarro,
english: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

kikuyu: oo waxaad ogeysiisay Sabtidaada quduuska ah, oo ku amartay amarro, iyo qaynuunno, iyo sharci aad ugu soo dhiibtay addoonkaagii Muuse.
english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,
