kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu isagii u dhiibay naqilka warqaddii oo amarku ku qornaa oo Shuushan lagu faafiyey si Yuhuudda loo wada baabbi'iyo, wuxuuna taas u siiyey inuu Esteer tuso oo uu iyada u warramo, oo wuxuu iyada ku amray inay boqorka u gasho, oo ay barido oo ay isaga hortiisa wax ka weyddiisato dadkeeda aawadiis.
english: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them, to show it to Esther, and to declare it to her, and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Hatag yimid oo wuxuu Esteer u sheegay erayadii Mordekay.
english: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna Esteer baa la hadashay Hatag oo waxay farriin ugu sii dhiibtay Mordekay oo ku tidhi,
english: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:

kikuyu: Boqorka addoommadiisa oo dhan iyo dadka boqorka gobolladiisa deggan oo dhammu way wada og yihiin in ku alla kii, isagoo aan loo yeedhin, boqorka ugu soo gala barxadda dhexe, ama nin ha ahaado ama naag ha ahaatee, qaynuun baa loo hayaa, waana in isaga la dilo, haddaan boqorku usha dahabka ah fidin, si uu u noolaado aawadeed; laakiinse aniga la iima yeedhin inaan boqorka u soo galo intii soddon maalmood ah.
english: “All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that whoever, whether man or woman, comes to the king into the inner court without being called, there is one law for him, that he be put to death, except those to whom the king might hold out the golden scepter, that he may live. I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Mordekay loo soo sheegay Esteer erayadeedii.
english: They told Esther’s words to Mordecai.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Mordekay iyagii jawaab ugu sii dhiibay Esteer, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ha moodin inaad adiga qudhaadu guriga boqorka ku baxsan doontid iyadoo aanay Yuhuudda ka baxsan.
english: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaad wakhtigan iska aamustid, waxaa Yuhuudda meel kale uga kici doona furasho iyo samatabbax, laakiinse adiga iyo reerka aabbahaaba waad halligmi doontaan. Bal yaase garanaya inaad wakhtigan oo kale daraaddiis boqortooyada u soo gashay?
english: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Esteer waxay iyaga u sheegtay inay Mordekay jawaab ku celiyaan, oo waxay ku tidhi,
english: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai,

kikuyu: Tag, oo soo wada ururi Yuhuudda Shuushan joogta oo dhan, oo ii sooma, oo intii saddex maalmood ah, habeen iyo maalin toona, waxba ha cunina, waxna ha cabbina; oo aniga iyo gabdhahayguna sidaas oo kalaan u soomaynaa; oo kolkaasaan boqorka u gelayaa, taasoo aan sharciga waafaqsanayn; oo haddii aan halligmona, waan halligmayaa.
english: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day. I and my maidens will also fast the same way. Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Mordekay iska tegey oo sameeyey wax alla wixii Esteer ku amartay oo dhan.
english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

kikuyu: Haddaba maalintii saddexaad Esteer baa gashatay dharkeedii boqornimada, oo waxay soo istaagtay guriga boqorka barxaddiisa dhexe, taasoo ka soo hor jeedday guriga boqorka; oo boqorkuna wuxuu ku fadhiyey carshigiisii boqornimada oo ku dhex yiil guriga boqornimada, wuxuuna ka soo hor jeeday iridda guriga laga soo galo.
english: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, next to the king’s house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.

kikuyu: Oo markii boqorkii arkay Boqorad Esteer oo barxadda dhex taagan ayuu raalli ka noqday iyada, oo boqorkiina wuxuu Esteer ku soo fidiyey ushii dahabka ahayd oo gacantiisa ku jirtay. Markaasaa Esteer soo dhowaatay oo taabatay usha dusheedii.
english: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, she obtained favor in his sight; and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. So Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu boqorkii ku yidhi, Boqorad Esteeray, maxaad doonaysaa? Oo maxaad i weyddiisanaysaa? Xataa hadday boqortooyada badhkeed tahay waa lagu siinayaaye.
english: Then the king asked her, “What would you like, queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Esteer waxay tidhi, Boqorow, hadday kula wanaagsan tahay, maanta adiga iyo Haamaanba kaalaya martiqaadka aan u diyaariyey.
english: Esther said, “If it seems good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu yidhi, Haamaan haddiiba ha dhaqsado, si loo yeelo waxay Esteer tidhi. Oo sidaas daraaddeed boqorkii iyo Haamaanba waxay yimaadeen martiqaadkii ay Esteer u diyaarisay.
english: Then the king said, “Bring Haman quickly, so that it may be done as Esther has said.” So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

kikuyu: Oo intii martiqaadkii khamriga la joogay ayuu boqorkii Esteer ku yidhi, Baryadaadu waa maxay? Maxaad i weyddiisanaysaa? Xataa hadday boqortooyada badhkeed tahay waa laguu yeelayaaye.
english: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Esteer jawaabtay oo tidhi, Baryadayda iyo weyddiisashadaydu waxay tahay,
english: Then Esther answered and said, “My petition and my request is this.

kikuyu: Boqorow, haddaad raalli iga tahay, oo aad ku faraxdid inaad ii samaysid waxaan kaa baryay, oo aad yeeshid waxaan ku weyddiistay, haddaba adiga iyo Haamaan kaalaya martiqaadka aan idiin diyaarin doono, oo aniguna berri baan yeelayaa sidaad tidhi, boqorow.
english: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Haamaan maalintaas wuxuu dibadda u baxay isagoo faraxsan oo qalbiga ka rayraynaya. Laakiinse Haamaan markuu arkay Mordekay oo jooga boqorka iriddiisa, oo aan isaga u istaagin, una gariirin, ayuu Mordekay aad iyo aad ugu cadhooday.
english: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart, but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he didn’t stand up nor move for him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.

kikuyu: Habase ahaatee Haamaan wuu isceliyey oo gurigiisuu tegey. Markaasuu u cid dirsaday oo u yeedhay saaxiibbadiis iyo naagtiisii Seresh.
english: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Haamaan wuxuu iyagii uga sheekeeyey ammaanta maalkiisa, iyo badnaanta carruurtiisa, iyo kulli derejadihii boqorku isaga u dalliciyey oo dhan, iyo sidii boqorku ugu wada sarraysiiyey boqorka amiirradiisa iyo addoommadiisa oo dhan.
english: Haman recounted to them the glory of his riches, the multitude of his children, all the things in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

kikuyu: Oo Haamaan weliba wuxuu kaloo yidhi, Xataa boqoradda Esteer ninna uma ay oggolaan inuu boqorka u soo raaco martiqaadkii ay diyaarisay aniga mooyaane; oo weliba berrina anigoo boqorka la jira ayay i martiqaadday.
english: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaas oo dhammu waxba ii tari maayaan intaan arkayo Yuhuudiga Mordekay oo boqorka iriddiisa fadhiya.
english: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa naagtiisii Seresh iyo saaxiibbadiis oo dhammu waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Ha la sameeyo qori wax lagu deldelo oo dhererkiisu konton dhudhun yahay, oo subaxda waxaad boqorka ku tidhaahdaa, Mordekay meeshaas ha lagu deldelo. Oo markaas dabadeed adigoo faraxsan boqorka martiqaadka u raac. Kolkaasaa hadalkaasu ka farxiyey Haamaan; oo wuxuu amray in meeshii deldelaadda la sameeyo.
english: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, “Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet.” This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.

kikuyu: Habeenkaasna boqorkii wuu seexan kari waayay, kolkaasuu amray in loo keeno buuggii taariikhda wakhtigaas, oo waxaa lagu akhriyey boqorka hortiisa.
english: On that night, the king couldn’t sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa laga dhex helay oo ku qornaa in Mordekay sheegay Bigtaan iyo Teresh oo ahaa boqorka labadiisii midiidin oo ka mid ahaa kuwii iridda dhawri jiray, kuwaas oo doonay inay Boqor Ahashwerus dilaan.
english: It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs, who were doorkeepers, who had tried to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu yidhi, Taas aawadeed maxaa maamuus iyo derejo ah oo Mordekay loo sameeyey? Kolkaasaa addoommadii boqorka u adeegi jiray waxay isagii ku yidhaahdeen, Waxba looma samayn.
english: The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?” Then the king’s servants who attended him said, “Nothing has been done for him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu yidhi, Yaa barxadda jooga? Haddaba Haamaan ayaa yimid guriga boqorka barxaddiisa dibadda ah inuu boqorka kala hadlo in Mordekay lagu deldelo qorigii deldelaadda oo uu isaga u diyaariyey.
english: The king said, “Who is in the court?” Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king’s house, to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorka addoommadiisii waxay isaga ku yidhaahdeen, Bal eeg, Haamaan baa taagan barxadda. Kolkaasaa boqorkii yidhi, Ha soo galo.
english: The king’s servants said to him, “Behold, Haman stands in the court.” The king said, “Let him come in.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Haamaan soo galay, oo boqorkii wuxuu ku yidhi, Ninkii boqorku ku farxo inuu maamuuso maxaa loo yeelaa? Haddaba Haamaan wuxuu qalbigiisa iska yidhi, Bal yaa boqorku ku farxi lahaa inuu maamuuso in ka badan intuu i maamuuso?
english: So Haman came in. The king said to him, “What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor?” Now Haman said in his heart, “Who would the king delight to honor more than myself?”

kikuyu: Oo Haamaan wuxuu boqorkii ku yidhi, Ninkii boqorku ku farxo inuu maamuuso
english: Haman said to the king, “For the man whom the king delights to honor,

kikuyu: ha loo keeno dharkii boqornimada oo boqorku xidhan jiray, iyo faraska boqorku fuulo, oo madaxana ha loo saaro taajka boqorka,
english: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set.

kikuyu: oo dharka iyo faraska gacanta ha loo geliyo boqorka amiirradiisa sharafta leh midkood, in loo lebbiso ninkii boqorku ku farxo inuu maamuuso. Oo isaga inta faras la fuushiiyo, jidka magaalada dhexdeeda ha la mariyo, oo hortiisa ha laga naadiyo, Ninkii boqorku ku farxo inuu maamuuso sidaasaa loo yeelaa.
english: Let the clothing and the horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man whom the king delights to honor with them, and have him ride on horseback through the city square, and proclaim before him, ‘Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu Haamaan ku yidhi, Haddaba soo dhaqso, oo waxaad soo qaaddaa dharkii iyo faraskii aad sheegtay, oo wixii aad sheegtay oo dhan u samee Mordekay oo ah Yuhuudiga fadhiya boqorka iriddiisa; oo wixii aad sheegtay oo dhan yaan waxba ka dhinnaan.
english: Then the king said to Haman, “Hurry and take the clothing and the horse, as you have said, and do this for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king’s gate. Let nothing fail of all that you have spoken.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Haamaan wuxuu soo qaaday dharkii iyo faraskii oo wuxuu u lebbisay Mordekay, oo isagoo faraskii fuushan ayuu mariyey jidka magaalada, oo wuxuu hortiisa ka naadiyey, Sidaasaa loo yeelaa ninkii boqorku ku farxo inuu maamuuso.
english: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and had him ride through the city square, and proclaimed before him, “Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!”

kikuyu: Haddaba Mordekay wuxuu mar kale ku soo noqday boqorka iriddiisii. Laakiinse Haamaan isagoo murugaysan oo hagoogan ayuu gurigiisii dhaqso u tegey.
english: Mordecai came back to the king’s gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Haamaan wuxuu naagtiisii Seresh iyo saaxiibbadiis oo dhan uga sheekeeyey wixii isaga ku dhacay oo dhan. Kolkaasaa raggiisii xigmadda lahaa iyo naagtiisii Seresh waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Mordekay oo aad bilowday inaad hortiisa ku dhacdo, hadduu yahay farcanka Yuhuudda, ka adkaan maysid, laakiinse hubaal hortiisaad ku dhici doontaa.
english: Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, “If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba intay isagii la sii hadlayeen waxaa yimid boqorka midiidinnadiisii, oo u soo dhaqsaday inay haddiiba Haamaan keenaan martiqaadkii Esteer diyaarisay.
english: While they were yet talking with him, the king’s eunuchs came, and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

kikuyu: Haddaba boqorkii iyo Haamaan waxay u yimaadeen inay Boqorad Esteer martiqaadkeedii ka qayb galaan.
english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

kikuyu: Oo haddana maalintii labaad intii la fadhiyey martiqaadkii khamriga ayaa boqorkii Esteer ku yidhi, Boqorad Esteeray, baryadaadu waa maxay? Waa lagu siinayaaye. Maxaad i weyddiisanaysaa? Xataa hadday boqortooyada badhkeed tahay, waa laguu yeelayaaye.
english: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqorad Esteer jawaabtay oo waxay tidhi, Boqorow, haddaad raalli iga tahay oo aad ku faraxdid, baryadayda aawadeed naftayda ha la ii bixiyo, oo weyddiisashadayda aawadeedna dadkaygu ha ii badbaado,
english: Then Esther the queen answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

kikuyu: waayo, aniga iyo dadkaygiiba waxaa loo iibiyey in nala baabbi'iyo, oo nala laayo oo aan halaaganno. Laakiinse haddii naloo iibiyey inaan ahaanno rag iyo dumar addoommo ah, waan iska aamusi lahaa, in kastoo cadowgu aanu boqorka khasaaradiisa ka xaq marin karin.
english: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Ahashwerus wuxuu Boqorad Esteer ku yidhi, Yuu yahay, xaggee buuse joogaa, kan ku dhaca oo qalbigiisa sidaas kaga fikiray inuu waxaas yeelo?
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Esteer waxay tidhi, Cadow iyo col waxaa ah Haamaankan sharka leh. Markaasaa Haamaan boqorkii iyo boqoraddii hortooda ku cabsaday.
english: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa boqorkii isagoo cadhaysan, ka kacay martiqaadkii khamriga, oo wuxuu u baxay xagga beerta hoyga boqorka; oo Haamaan ayaa u istaagay inuu Boqorad Esteer naftiisa u baryo, waayo, wuxuu arkay in boqorku belaayo la damacsan yahay.
english: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii beertii ka soo noqday oo galay meeshii martiqaadka khamriga lagu dhigay, Haamaanna wuxuu ku sii dhacayay sariirtay Esteer fuushanayd. Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu yidhi, Xataa ma boqoradduu hortayda ku xoogayaa iyadoo guriga joogta? Oo isla markii eraygaasu boqorka afkiisii ka soo baxay ayaa Haamaan wejigiisii la deday.
english: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Xarboona oo ahaa boqorka midiidinnadiisa midkood oo boqorka hortiisa joogay ayaa yidhi, Weliba bal eeg, waxaa Haamaan gurigiisa ag qotoma qoriga deldelaadda oo dhererkiisu yahay konton dhudhun, oo Haamaan u sameeyey inuu ku deldelo Mordekay oo boqorka wax wanaagsan kaga hadlay. Markaasaa boqorkii yidhi, Halkaas ku deldela.
english: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.” The king said, “Hang him on it!”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Haamaan waxaa lagu deldelay meeshii deldelaadda oo uu u diyaarshay inuu Mordekay ku deldelo, oo markaasaa boqorkii cadho baxay.
english: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.

kikuyu: Oo isla maalintaas ayaa Boqor Ahashwerus wuxuu gurigii Haamaan oo ahaa cadowgii Yuhuudda siiyey Boqorad Esteer. Mordekayna wuxuu yimid boqorka hortiisii, waayo, Esteer ayaa boqorka u sheegtay wuxuu iyada u ahaa.
english: On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews’ enemy, to Esther the queen. Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was to her.

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu iska soo bixiyey kaatunkiisii uu Haamaan ka soo qaatay, oo wuxuu siiyey Mordekay. Esteerna gurigii Haamaan ayay Mordekay madax uga dhigtay.
english: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

kikuyu: Oo Esteer boqorka hortiisii ayay haddana ka hadashay, oo intay cagihiisa ku dhacday ayay iyadoo ooyaysa ka bariday inuu baabbi'iyo belaayadii Haamaan kii reer Agag iyo xeeladdiisii uu Yuhuudda ku samaynayay.
english: Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu Esteer u soo fidiyey ushii dahabka ahayd. Oo taas daraaddeed Esteer way kacday oo waxay istaagtay boqorka hortiisii.
english: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.

kikuyu: Oo kolkaasay tidhi, Boqorow, haddaad ku faraxsan tahay, oo aad raalli iga tahay, oo haddii xaalkaasu kula wanaagsan yahay, oo aad ii bogtay, ha la qoro warqado lagu beddelo warqadihii uu xeeladda ku qoray Haamaan ina Hamedaata oo ahaa reer Agag, kuwaasoo uu u qoray in lagu baabbi'iyo Yuhuudda boqorka gobolladiisa deggan oo dhan.
english: She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seems right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king’s provinces.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal sidee baan ugu adkaysan karaa inaan arko belaayada dadkayga ku dhacaysa? Amase sidee baan ugu adkaysan karaa inaan arko baabbi'inta dadkayga?
english: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Ahashwerus wuxuu Boqorad Esteer iyo Yuhuudigii Mordekay ku yidhi, Bal eega, gurigii Haamaan ayaan Esteer siiyey, isagiina waxaa lagu deldelay meesha deldelaadda, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu gacan ku fidiyey Yuhuudda.
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.

kikuyu: Haddaba idinku sidaad doonaysaan Yuhuudda warqado ugu qora. Magaca boqorka ku qora, oo ku shaabadeeya kaatunka boqorka, waayo, qorniinkii lagu qoro boqorka magiciisa, oo haddana kaatunka boqorka lagu shaabadeeyo, ninna ma beddeli karo.
english: Write also to the Jews as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”

kikuyu: Oo markaasaa isla wakhtigaasba waxaa loo yeedhay boqorka karraaniyadiisii. Oo waxayna ahayd bisha Siwaan, oo ah bisha saddexaad, maalinteedii saddex iyo labaatanaad. Oo waxaa la qoray wax alla wixii Mordekay uu ku amray Yuhuuddii iyo saraakiishii iyo taliyayaashii iyo amiirradii joogay gobolladii ku yiil Hindiya iyo Itoobiya inta ka dhex leh, oo ahaa boqol iyo toddoba iyo labaatan gobol, oo waxaa gobol kasta loogu qoray fartiisii, dad kastana waxaa loogu qoray afkoodii, oo Yuhuuddiina waxaa loogu qoray fartoodii iyo afkoodiiba.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu warqadihii ku qoray Boqor Ahashwerus magiciisii, oo ku shaabadeeyey kaatunkii boqorka, markaasuu u sii dhiibay warqaadayaal fuushan fardo iyo baqlo iyo rakuubbo.
english: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.

kikuyu: Oo boqorkii wuxuu u oggolaaday Yuhuuddii magaalo kasta degganayd inay isa soo wada urursadaan oo ay daaficidda naftooda isu taagaan, oo ay baabbi'iyaan, oo laayaan, oo halaag ku ridaan kulli xooggii dadka iyo gobolkii doonayay inay weeraraan iyaga iyo dhallaankooda iyo dumarkoodaba, iyo inay maalkooda booli ahaan u dhacaan.
english: In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions,

kikuyu: Oo amarkii wuxuu ahaa in Boqor Ahashwerus gobolladiisa oo dhan saas isku maalin laga yeelo, taas oo ah maalinta saddex iyo tobnaad oo bisha laba iyo tobnaad ee Adaar la yidhaahdo.
english: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

kikuyu: Oo warqaddii amarku ku qornaa naqilkeedii ayaa lagu faafiyey gobol kasta, oo waxaa loo sii dhiibay dadyowga oo dhan, taasoo leh, Maalintaas Yuhuuddu diyaar ha u ahaadeen inay ka aarsadaan cadaawayaashooda.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

kikuyu: Oo sidaas daraaddeed warqaadayaashii fuushanaa baqlo iyo rakuubbo way ambabbexeen, iyagoo degdegsan oo ku dhaqsanaya boqorka amarkiisa; oo amarkiina waxaa lagu naadiyey Shuushan oo ahayd hoygii boqorka.
english: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Mordekay wuxuu ka tegey boqorka hortiisii isagoo qaba dhar boqortooyo oo ah buluug iyo caddaan, oo madaxana waxaa u saarnaa taaj weyn oo dahab ah, wuxuuna huwanaa shulug laga sameeyey maro wanaagsan oo guduudan, oo magaaladii Shuushanna waa laga qayliyey oo laga farxay.
english: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.

kikuyu: Oo Yuhuuddiina waxaa u ahaaday iftiin iyo farxad iyo rayrayn iyo sharaf.
english: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.

kikuyu: Oo gobol kasta iyo magaalo kasta oo boqorka amarkiisii iyo naadadiisii ay gaadheen, Yuhuuddii waxaa u ahaaday farxad iyo rayrayn, iyo iid iyo maalin wanaagsan. Oo qaar badan oo ka mid ahaa dadyowgii dalka degganaa waxay noqdeen Yuhuud, maxaa yeelay, waxaa iyaga ku dhacday cabsidii ay Yuhuudda ka cabsanayeen.
english: In every province and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast and a holiday. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.

kikuyu: Haddaba bishii laba iyo tobnaad, oo ahayd bisha Adaar, maalinteedii saddex iyo tobnaad, markii boqorka amarkiisii iyo naadadiisii ay soo dhowaadeen in la oofiyo, maalintaas oo ahayd maalintii Yuhuudda cadaawayaashoodii ay rajaynayeen inay Yuhuudda u taliyaan, laakiin loo beddelay oo ay noqotay maalintii ay Yuhuuddii u taliyeen kuwii iyaga nebcaa,
english: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),

kikuyu: ayaa Yuhuuddii iska soo wada urursadeen magaalooyinkoodii ku yiil gobolladii Boqor Ahashwerus oo dhan inay gacan u qaadaan kuwii doonayay inay iyaga wax yeelaan; oo mana jirin nin iyaga hor istaagi karay, maxaa yeelay, cabsidoodii baa ku dhacday dadyowgii oo dhan.
english: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them. No one could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen on all the people.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa Yuhuuddii caawiyey amiirradii gobollada oo dhan, iyo saraakiishii, iyo taliyayaashii, iyo kuwii boqorka hawshiisii qaban jiray oo dhan, maxaa yeelay, iyagu waxay ka cabsanayeen Mordekay.
english: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.

kikuyu: Waayo, Mordekay wuxuu ku weynaa gurigii boqorka, oo warkiisuna wuxuu wada gaadhay gobollada oo dhan, maxaa yeelay, ninkii Mordekay ahaa aad iyo aad buu u sii weynaaday.
english: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.

kikuyu: Oo Yuhuuddiina cadaawayaashoodii oo dhan waxay la dhaceen seef, wayna laayeen, oo baabbi'iyeen, oo waxay iyagii ku sameeyeen wixii ay doonayeen inay kuwa iyaga neceb ku sameeyaan.
english: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.

kikuyu: Oo Shuushan oo ahayd hoygii boqorka ayay Yuhuuddu shan boqol oo nin ku laayeen oo ku baabbi'iyeen.
english: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa kuwaas ka mid ahaa Farshandaataa iyo Dalfoon iyo Asfaataa,
english: They killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,

kikuyu: iyo Fooraataa iyo Adaliyaa iyo Ariidaataa,
english: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,

kikuyu: iyo Farmashtaa iyo Ariisay iyo Ariiday iyo Waysaataa,
english: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, and Vaizatha,

kikuyu: oo dhammaantood ahaa tobankii wiil oo uu dhalay Haamaan ina Hamedaata oo ahaa Yuhuudda cadowgoodii. Kuwaasay wada dileen, laakiinse maalkoodii far ma ay saarin.
english: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas intii lagu laayay Shuushan oo ahayd hoygii boqorka tiradoodii waxaa la keenay boqorka hortiisa.
english: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu Boqorad Esteer ku yidhi, Yuhuuddii waxay Shuushan oo ah hoygayga ku laayeen oo ku baabbi'iyeen shan boqol oo nin, iyo Haamaan tobankiisii wiil. Oo gobolladayda intooda kale maxay ku sameeyeen! Haddaba baryadaadu waa maxay, waa lagu siinayaaye? Amase maxaad kaloo weyddiisanaysaa? Waa laguu samaynayaaye.
english: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Esteer waxay tidhi, Haddii boqorku raalli ku yahay, Yuhuudda Shuushan joogta ha la siiyo fasax ay berrito ku sameeyaan si waafaqsan amarkan maanta dhacay, oo Haamaan tobankiisa wiilba ha lagu deldelo meesha deldelaadda.
english: Then Esther said, “If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu amray in saas la yeelo, oo amar baa Shuushan lagu naadiyey, oo Haamaan wiilashiisiina waa la deldelay.
english: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

kikuyu: Oo haddana Yuhuuddii Shuushan joogtay dhammaantood way isa soo wada urursadeen bishii Adaar, maalinteedii afar iyo tobnaad, oo waxay Shuushan ku laayeen saddex boqol oo nin, laakiinse maalkoodii far ma ay saarin.
english: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Oo Yuhuuddii kale oo joogay boqorka gobolladiisa iyana dhammaantood way isa soo wada urursadeen, oo ay daaficidda naftooda isu taageen, oo way ka raysteen cadaawayaashoodii, oo waxay kuwii iyaga nebcaa ka laayeen shan iyo toddobaatan kun oo qof, laakiinse maalkoodii far ma ay saarin.
english: The other Jews who were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Oo taasuna waxay dhacday bishii Adaar, maalinteedii saddex iyo tobnaad, oo bishaas maalinteedii afar iyo tobnaadna way nasteen, oo waxay ka dhigeen maalin iid ah oo farxad badan.
english: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Yuhuuddii Shuushan joogtay way isa soo wada urursadeen bishaas, maalinteedii saddex iyo tobnaad, iyo maalinteedii afar iyo tobnaad, oo isla bishaas, maalinteedii shan iyo tobnaadna way nasteen, oo waxay ka dhigeen maalin iid ah oo farxad badan.
english: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month; and on the fifteenth day of that month, they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

kikuyu: Haddaba Yuhuuddii tuulooyinka joogtay oo degganayd magaalooyinka aan derbiga lahayn, bisha Adaar, maalinteeda afar iyo tobnaad, waxay ka dhigaan maalin farxadeed oo iid ah, oo maalin wanaagsan ah, iyo maalin waxyaalo wanaagsan mid ba midka kale u diro.
english: Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a holiday, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Mordekay waxyaalahaas oo dhan qoray, oo wuxuu warqado u diray kulli Yuhuuddii joogtay Boqor Ahashwerus gobolladiisa oo dhan, kuwii dhowaa iyo kuwii fogaaba,
english: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, both near and far,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku amray iyagii inay sannad walba bisha Adaar, afar iyo tobankeeda iyo shan iyo tobankeeda, dhawraan,
english: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,

kikuyu: oo ay ka dhigaan maalmihii Yuhuuddii ay cadaawayaashoodii ka raysteen iyo bishii xaggooda ay murugtii farxad u beddelantay, baroortiina maalin wanaagsan; inay ka dhigaan maalmo iid ah oo farxad badan, oo mid ba midka kale waxyaalo wanwanaagsan u diro, oo masaakiintana hadiyado la siiyo.
english: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.

kikuyu: Oo Yuhuuddiina waxay aqbaleen inay sameeyaan wixii ay bilaabeen, iyo sidii Mordekay uu iyaga u soo qoray,
english: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, Haamaan ina Hamedaata oo ahaa reer Agag, oo Yuhuudda oo dhan cadowgooda ahaa, xeelad buu ku sameeyey Yuhuudda inuu iyaga baabbi'iyo, oo wuxuu riday saami Fuur la odhan jiray, si uu u laayo oo uu u baabbi'iyo.
english: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;

kikuyu: Laakiinse markuu xaalkaasu boqorka hortiisa yimid, wuxuu amray oo warqado ku qoray in xeeladdiisii uu Yuhuudda ku sameeyey ay madaxiisa ku soo noqoto, iyo in isaga iyo wiilashiisiiba lagu deldelo meesha deldelaadda.
english: but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed maalmahaas waxay u bixiyeen FUURIIM, oo waxay ugu yeedheen saamigii magiciisii FUUR la odhan jiray. Saas aawadeed warqaddan erayadeedii oo dhan, iyo wixii xaalkan ku saabsanaa oo ay arkeen, iyo wixii iyaga u yimid,
english: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,

kikuyu: Yuhuuddu waxay amreen oo dul saareen iyaga iyo farcankooda, iyo in alla intii iyaga ku darmatay, inaanay ka baaqan, inay labadaas maalmood u dhawraan sannad kasta sida waafaqsan waxa laga qoray, iyo goor waafaqsan xilligii la yidhi;
english: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;

kikuyu: iyo in qarni kastaa, iyo qolo kastaa, iyo dal kastaa, iyo magaalo kastaaba ay maalmahaas xusuustaan oo dhawraan, iyo in maalmahaas FUURIIM la yidhaahdo aanay Yuhuuddu ka baaqan, oo aanay xusuustooduna xataa farcankooda dambe ka baabbi'in.
english: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqorad Esteer oo ahayd ina Abiixayil, iyo Yuhuudigii Mordekay ahaa waxay amar buuxa ku qoreen, si ay u adkeeyaan warqaddan labaad oo ku saabsan FUURIIM.
english: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa warqado loo diray kulli Yuhuuddii joogtay boqol iyo toddoba iyo labaatankii gobol oo boqortooyadii Ahashwerus, oo waxaa loogu dhawaaqay hadal nabaadiino iyo run ah,
english: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth,

kikuyu: si loo adkeeyo maalmahaas FUURIIM la yidhaahdo wakhtigooda, sidii ay u amreen Yuhuudigii Mordekay iyo Boqorad Esteer, iyo sidii ay iyagu nafsaddooda iyo farcankooda ugu amreen xaalkii soonka iyo qayladoodii.
english: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed, and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning.

kikuyu: Oo Esteer amarkeediina wuxuu sii adkeeyey xaalkan ku saabsan FUURIIM; oo buug baa lagu qoray.
english: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqor Ahashwerus wuxuu baad saaray dhulkii iyo gasiiradihii baddaba.
english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

kikuyu: Oo falimihii uu xooggiisii iyo itaalkiisii ku sameeyey oo dhan, iyo warkii Mordekay weynaantiisii uu boqorku isaga u sara mariyey sow kuma wada qornayn buuggii taariikhda oo boqorradii Maaday iyo Faaris?
english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

kikuyu: Haddaba Yuhuudigii Mordekay ahaa wuxuu ahaa ninkii ku xigay Boqor Ahashwerus, oo xagga Yuhuuddana wuxuu ahaa nin weyn, oo walaalihiisa badanuna way aqbaleen; oo wuxuuna ahaa nin doondoonaa wanaagga dadkiisa oo nabaadiino kula hadla farcankiisa oo dhan.
english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

kikuyu: Dalka Cuus la yidhaahdo waxaa joogi jiray nin magiciisa Ayuub la odhan jiray, oo ninkaasuna wuxuu ahaa nin qumman oo toosan, wuxuuna ahaa mid Ilaah ka cabsada oo sharka ka fogaada.
english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa isaga u dhashay toddoba wiil iyo saddex gabdhood.
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Oo weliba xoolihiisuna waxay ahaayeen toddoba kun oo ido ah, iyo saddex kun oo geel ah, iyo shan boqol oo dibi oo laba laba ah, iyo shan boqol oo dameerood oo dhaddig ah, oo weliba wuxuu kaloo lahaa addoommo aad u badan, oo sidaas daraaddeed ninkaasu wuxuu ahaa kan ugu wada weyn dadka bariga oo dhan.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashiisii way tegi jireen, oo midkood kastaaba maalintiisa ayuu gurigiisa diyaafad ku samayn jiray, oo waxay u cid direen oo u yeedheen saddexdii gabdhood oo walaalahood ahaa inay wax la cunaan oo wax la cabbaan aawadeed.
english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

kikuyu: Oo maalmihii ay diyaafaddii hayn jireen markay dhammaadaan ayaa Ayuub carruurtiisii u cid diri jiray oo daahirin jiray, oo intuu aroor hore kaco ayuu intay ahaayeen oo dhan u bixin jiray qurbaanno la gubo, waayo, Ayuub wuxuu isyidhi, Waaba intaasoo wiilashaydu ay dembaabeen, oo ay qalbigooda Ilaah wax xun kaga sheegeen. Oo Ayuubna sidaasuu yeeli jiray had iyo goorba.
english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa jirtay maalin ay Ilaah wiilashiisu u yimaadeen inay Rabbiga hortiisa isa soo taagaan, oo weliba Shayddaanna wuu soo dhex galay.
english: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Shayddaan ku yidhi, War xaggee baad ka timid? Oo Shayddaan wuxuu Rabbiga ugu jawaabay, Waxaan ka imid dhulkii aan maray, oo aan hor iyo dibba ugu dhex socday.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Shayddaan ku yidhi, Addoonkayga Ayuub ma ka fikirtay? Maxaa yeelay, isaga oo kale dhulka ma joogo, waayo, isagu waa nin qumman oo toosan, oo ah mid Ilaah ka cabsada oo sharka ka fogaada.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Shayddaan Rabbiga u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal Ayuub ma waxtarla'aan buu Ilaah uga cabsadaa?
english: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

kikuyu: Sow deyr kuma aad wareejin isaga, iyo reerkiisa, iyo waxa uu haysto oo dhanba? Shuqulkii gacmihiisaad barakaysay, oo xoolihiisiina dhulkay aad ugu bateen.
english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddaba bal gacantaada soo fidi, oo wuxuu haysto oo dhan taabo, oo isna sida runta ah, hortaada wax xun buu kaaga sheegi doonaa.
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

kikuyu: Markaaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Shayddaan ku yidhi, Bal eeg, wuxuu haysto oo dhammu gacantaaday ku jiraan, laakiinse isaga nafsaddiisa waa inaadan far saarin. Markaasaa Shayddaan Rabbiga hortiisii ka tegey.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo maalin ay wiilashiisii iyo gabdhihiisii wax ku cunayeen oo khamri ku cabbayeen gurigii walaalkoodii ugu weynaa ayaa
english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

kikuyu: waxaa Ayuub u yimid mid wargeeye ah oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Iyadoo dibidii ay beerta jeexayaan oo dameerihiina ay agtooda daaqayaan
english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

kikuyu: ayaa waxaa na soo weeraray reer Shebaa, oo waxay dheceen xoolihii, oo weliba midiidinnadiina seef bay ku laayeen, oo anigoo keliya ayaa ka soo baxsaday inaan warka kuu soo sheego.
english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Oo weli intii kaasu sii hadlayay ayuu mid kale yimid, oo wuxuu yidhi, Ilaah dabkiisii ayaa samada ka soo dhacay, oo wuxuu wada gubay oo baabbi'iyey idihii iyo midiidinnadii la jirayba, oo anigoo keliya ayaa ka soo baxsaday inaan warka kuu soo sheego.
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Oo weli intii kaasu sii hadlayay ayuu mid kale yimid, oo wuxuu yidhi, Reer Kaldayiin oo saddex koox ah ayaa geelii soo weeraray, oo dhammaantiisna way dheceen, oo weliba midiidinnadiina seef bay ku laayeen, oo anigoo keliya ayaa ka soo baxsaday inaan warka kuu soo sheego.
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Oo weli intii kaasu sii hadlayay ayuu mid kale yimid, oo wuxuu yidhi, Wiilashaadii iyo gabdhahaagii waxay wax ku cunayeen oo khamri ku cabbayeen gurigii walaalkooda ugu weyn,
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

kikuyu: oo bal eeg, waxaa cidlada ka timid dabayl weyn, oo gurigii afartiisa rukun bay ku dhufatay, kolkaasuu ku dumay raggii dhallinyarada ahaa, oo dhammaantood way dhinteen, oo anigoo keliya ayaa ka soo baxsaday inaan warka kuu soo sheego.
english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub sara joogsaday, oo huwiskiisii jeexjeexay, oo madaxiisiina wuu xiiray, oo intuu dhulka ku dhacay ayuu sujuuday,
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu yidhi, Anigoo qaawan baan uurkii hooyaday ka soo baxay, oo haddana anigoo qaawan baan halkaas ku noqon doonaa. Rabbigaa wax i siiyey, oo haddana Rabbigaa iga qaatay, ammaan waxaa leh magaca Rabbiga.
english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Oo waxyaalahaas oo dhan Ayuub innaba kuma uu dembaabin, oo Ilaahna eed kama uu sheegin.
english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa kaloo jirtay maalin kale oo ay Ilaah wiilashiisu u yimaadeen inay Rabbiga hortiisa isa soo taagaan, oo weliba Shayddaanna wuu soo dhex galay, si uu isna Rabbiga isu soo hor taago.
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Shayddaan ku yidhi, War xaggee baad ka timid? Oo Shayddaan wuxuu Rabbiga ugu jawaabay, Waxaan ka imid dhulkii aan maray, oo aan hor iyo dibba ugu dhex socday.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Shayddaan ku yidhi, Addoonkayga Ayuub ma ka fikirtay? Maxaa yeelay, isaga oo kale dhulka ma joogo, waayo, isagu waa nin qumman oo toosan, oo ah mid Ilaah ka cabsada oo sharka ka fogaada. Oo weliba isagu daacadnimadiisii wuu sii haystaa, in kastoo aad igu dirtay, si aan isaga sababla'aan ugu halligo.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Shayddaan wuxuu Rabbiga ugu jawaabay, Haragba harag baa loo baxshaa, oo nin wuxuu haysto oo dhan ayuu naftiisa u baxshaa.
english: Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

kikuyu: Laakiinse bal haatan gacantaada soo fidi, oo lafihiisa iyo jiidhkiisa taabo, oo isna markaasuu hortaada wax xun kaaga sheegi doonaa.
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Shayddaan ku yidhi, Bal eeg, gacantaaduu ku jiraa, waxaadse u daysaa naftiisa.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Shayddaan Rabbiga hortiisii ka tegey, oo wuxuu Ayuub tin iyo cedhib ku dhuftay boogo xunxun.
english: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub wuxuu qaatay dheri burburkiis inuu isku xoqo, oo wuxuu dhex fadhiistay dambas.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

kikuyu: Markaasaa naagtiisii waxay ku tidhi, War ma weli baad daacadnimadaadii sii haysanaysaa? War hoy, Ilaah wax xun ka sheeg, oo iska dhimo.
english: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse wuxuu iyadii ku yidhi, Waxaad u hadlaysaa sida naagaha nacasyada ah middood. Naa waa sidee? Ilaah gacantiisa intaynu samaan ka qaadanno, miyaynan xumaanna ka qaadanayn? Oo in kastoo waxyaalahaas oo dhammu ay ku dheceen Ayuub innaba afkiisa kuma dembaabin.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ayuub saddexdiisii saaxiib markay maqleen xumaantii isaga ku dhacday oo dhan ayuu midkood kastaaba meeshiisii ka yimid. Oo kuwaasu waxay ahaayeen Eliifas oo ahaa reer Teemaan, iyo Bildad oo ahaa reer Shuuxii, iyo Soofar oo ahaa reer Nacamaatii, oo iyana waxay dhammaantood ballan ku dhigteen inay u yimaadaan si ay isaga ugu tacsiyeeyaan oo ay u qalbi qaboojiyaan.
english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

kikuyu: Oo markay isagii meel fog ka arkeen oo ay aqoon waayeen ayay codkoodii kor u qaadeen oo ooyeen, oo midkood waluba wuxuu jeexjeexay huwiskiisii, oo intay boodh xagga samada u tuureen ayay madaxa isaga shubeen.
english: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

kikuyu: Oo toddoba maalmood iyo toddoba habeen ayay isagii dhulka la fadhiyeen, oo midkoodna eray keliya kuma odhan, waayo, waxay arkeen inuu aad iyo aad u xanuunsanayo.
english: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

kikuyu: Markaas dabadeed Ayuub intuu afkiisa furay ayuu habaaray maalintii uu dhashay.
english: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

kikuyu: Oo Ayuub intuu hadal bilaabay ayuu yidhi:
english: Job answered:

kikuyu: Dharaartii aan dhashay ha baabba'do Iyo habeenkii la yidhi, Wiil baa calool galay.
english: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

kikuyu: Maalintaasu gudcur ha ahaato; Oo Ilaah yuusan iyada xagga sare kaga fiirsan, Oo nuurkuna yuusan iftiimin.
english: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

kikuyu: Gudcur iyo hooska dhimashadu iyada mulki ha ka dhigteen. Daruuru ha ku degto, Oo wixii maalin madoobeeya oo dhammu ha cabsiiyeen.
english: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

kikuyu: Oo habeenkaasna gudcur weynu ha qabsado, Oo ayaamaha sannadda yuusan ka dhex rayrayn. Oo yuusan soo dhex gelin bilaha tiradooda.
english: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, habeenkaasu cidla ha noqdo; Oo cod faraxsan yaanu ka dhex yeedhin.
english: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

kikuyu: Oo isaga ha habaareen kuwa maalinta habaaraa, Oo kicin kara bahalka la yidhaahdo Lewiiyaataan.
english: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

kikuyu: Fiidka xiddigihiisu gudcur ha noqdeen, Iftiin ha doondoono oo yuusan helin; Oo innaba yuusan arkin kaaha waaberiga.
english: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, isagu ma uu awdin irdihii maxalka hooyaday, Oo indhahaygana dhib kama uu qarin.
english: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

kikuyu: Bal maxaan u dhiman waayay markaan uurka ka soo baxay? Oo maxaa naftu iiga bixi weyday isla markaan caloosha ka soo baxay?
english: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

kikuyu: Bal jilbuhu maxay ii aqbaleen? Amase naasuhu inaan nuugo?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

kikuyu: Waayo, hadda xasilloonaan baan ku jiifi lahaa; Oo waan iska seexan lahaa, oo waan nasan lahaa,
english: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

kikuyu: Aniga iyo boqorrada iyo lataliyayaasha dunida Oo nafsaddooda taallooyin u dhistay,
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

kikuyu: Iyo amiirradii dahabka lahaan jiray, Oo guryahooda lacagta ka buuxsaday;
english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

kikuyu: Bal dhicis qarsoon maxaan u ahaan waayay? Ama sida dhallaan aan innaba iftiinka arag?
english: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

kikuyu: Halkaas kuwa sharka ahu cidna kuma sii dhibaan, Oo kuwa daallanuna halkaasay ku nastaan.
english: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

kikuyu: Maxaabiistuna halkaasay dhammaantood ku wada istareexaan, Mana ay maqlaan kii dulmi jiray codkiisa.
english: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

kikuyu: Yar iyo weynba halkaasaa la wada joogaa, Oo addoonkuna sayidkiisa waa ka xor.
english: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

kikuyu: Bal iftiin maxaa loo siiyaa kan dhibaataysan? Maxaase loo nooleeyaa kan naftiisu la qadhaadhaatay,
english: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

kikuyu: Oo dhimasho u xiisooda, oo ayan u imanayn, Oo daraaddeed dhulka u qodqoda intuu khasnado qarsoon qodi lahaa in ka sii badan,
english: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

kikuyu: Kuwaasoo aad u reyreeya, Oo farxa hadday qabriga heli karaan?
english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

kikuyu: Bal maxaa iftiin loo siiyaa nin jidkiisu qarsoon yahay, Oo Ilaah deyr ku wareejiyey?
english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

kikuyu: Waayo, intaanan wax cunin ayaan taahaa, Oo cabaadkayguna wuxuu u shubmaa sida biyo oo kale.
english: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

kikuyu: Waayo, hadba wixii aan ka cabsado ayaa igu soo dega, Oo wixii aan ka baqo ayaa ii yimaada.
english: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

kikuyu: Ma aan istareexsani, mana aan xasillooni, mana aan nasto; Laakiinse hadba dhibaato baa ii timaada.
english: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Eliifas kii reer Teemaan u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: Mid hadduu isku dayo inuu kula hadlo, ma ka xumaanaysaa? Laakiinse bal yaa hadal iska celin kara?
english: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, adigu kuwa badan wax baad bartay, Oo gacmihii itaalka darnaana waad xoogaysay.
english: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

kikuyu: Erayadaadu way tiiriyeen kii sii dhacayay, Oo jilbihii tabarta yaraana waad adkaysay.
english: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan dhibaatadu aday kuu timid, oo waad taag yaraanaysaa, Wayna ku soo gaadhay, oo waad dhibaataysan tahay.
english: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

kikuyu: War kalsoonidaadu sow ma aha cabsida aad Ilaahaaga ka cabsato, Rajadaaduse sow ma aha daacadnimada jidadkaaga?
english: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

kikuyu: Waan ku baryayaaye bal wax xusuuso, bal yaa weligiis halligmay isagoo aan xaq qabin? Amase xaggee baa mid qumman lagu halaagay?
english: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

kikuyu: Sidaan anigu arkay, weligoodba kuwii xumaan tacbadaa, Oo belaayo beertaa, isla waxaasay goostaan.
english: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

kikuyu: Iyagu waxay ku baabba'aan Ilaah neeftiisa, Oo waxay ku dhammaadaan afuufidda cadhadiisa.
english: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

kikuyu: Libaaxa cidiisii, iyo aarka cadhaysan codkiisii, Iyo libaaxyada yaryar miciyahoodiiba waa jajabaan.
english: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

kikuyu: Libaaxa duqa ahu ugaadhla'aanta buu u bakhtiyaa, Oo goosha dhasheediina way kala firdhaan.
english: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Haddaba war baa qarsoodi la iigu keenay, Oo dhegtayduna faqiisay qabsatay.
english: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

kikuyu: Habeenkii markay riyooyinku fikirro kiciyaan, Oo ay dadku hurdo weyn ku fogaadaan,
english: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

kikuyu: Ayaa cabsi iyo gariiru igu dhacay, Oo lafahayga oo dhammuna way wada ruxruxmadeen.
english: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

kikuyu: Markaasaa ruux wejigayga soo hor maray, Oo timihii jidhkayguna waa soo wada istaageen.
english: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

kikuyu: Oo isagii wuu joogsaday, laakiinse muuqashadiisii waan kala saari waayay; Muuqaal baa indhahayga hortooda joogay; Intii mudda ah aamusnaan baa jirtay, dabadeedna waxaan maqlay cod leh,
english: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

kikuyu: War nin dhiman karaa miyuu Ilaah ka sii caaddilsanaan karaa? Mase nin baa ka sii daahirsanaan kara kii isaga abuuray?
english: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, isagu addoommadiisa iskuma halleeyo; Oo malaa'igihiisana nacasnimuu ku eedeeyaa.
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

kikuyu: Intee ka sii badan buu eedeeyaa kuwa guryaha dhoobada ah deggan, Oo aasaaskoodii boodhka ku jiro, Oo sida balanbaallis u burbura!
english: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

kikuyu: Subaxdii iyo fiidkii inta ka dhex leh ayay baabba'aan; Weligoodba way halligmaan iyadoo aan ciduna ka fikirayn.
english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

kikuyu: Xadhkaha teendhooyinkoodii sow lama siibo? Way dhintaan iyagoo aan xigmad lahayn.
english: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

kikuyu: Hadda bal u yeedh, mid kuu jawaabayaa ma jiraa? Balse kuwa quduuska ah midkoodee baad u jeesanaysaa?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

kikuyu: Waayo, ninkii nacas ah xanaaqiisaa dila, Oo kii doqon ahna ciilkiisaa dila.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

kikuyu: Anba waxaan arkay nacas xidid yeeshay. Laakiinse degdeg baan u habaaray rugtiisii.
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

kikuyu: Carruurtiisu nabaadiino way ka fog yihiin, Oo iridda agteeda ayaa iyaga lagu burburiyaa, Mana jiro mid samatabbixiyaa.
english: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

kikuyu: Kuwaas beertay goostaan waxaa cuna kuwa gaajaysan, Oo xataa qodxanta way kala soo dhex bixiyaan, Oo maalkoodana waxaa afka u kala haya siriq.
english: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

kikuyu: Waayo, belaayo kama soo baxdo ciidda, Dhibaatona kama soo dhex booddo dhulka,
english: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

kikuyu: Laakiinse binu-aadmigu dhibaato buu u dhashay, Sida dhimbiiluhu kor ugu duulaan.
english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

kikuyu: Aniguse Ilaah baan baryi lahaa, Oo xaalkaygana Ilaah baan u dhiibi lahaa,
english: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

kikuyu: Kaasoo sameeya waxyaalo waaweyn oo aan la baadhi karin, Iyo waxyaalo yaab badan oo aan la tirin karin,
english: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

kikuyu: Oo dhulka roob ku di'iya, Beerahana biyo u soo dira.
english: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

kikuyu: Oo kuwa hooseeyana kor buu u qaadaa, Kuwa baroortana nabaadiinuu ku sarraysiiyaa.
english: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

kikuyu: Madhnaan buu ka dhigaa talada khaa'innada, Si ayan gacmahoodu u oofin karin farsamadoodii.
english: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

kikuyu: Isagu kuwa xigmadda leh ayuu khiyaanadooda ku qabtaa; Oo kuwa qalloocan taladoodana degdeg baa loo rogaa.
english: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

kikuyu: Oo maalinnimada ayay gudcur helaan, Oo hadhka ayay wax haabhaabtaan sida habeennimada oo kale.
english: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

kikuyu: Laakiinse isagu kuwa baahan ayuu ka badbaadiyaa seefta afkooda, Iyo kuwa xoogga badan gacantooda.
english: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kii miskiin ahu rajuu leeyahay, Xumaantuse afkeeday xidhaa.
english: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxaa faraxsan ninkii Ilaah canaanto, Haddaba ha quudhsan Qaadirka edbintiisa.
english: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wax buu nabar u yeelaa, waana duubaa; Wuu dhaawacaa, gacmihiisuna way bogsiiyaan.
english: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

kikuyu: Wuxuu kaa samatabbixin doonaa lix dhibaato, Oo marka toddobaadna belaayo kuma taaban doonto innaba.
english: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

kikuyu: Wakhtiga abaarta ah dhimashuu kaa furan doonaa, Wakhtiga dagaalkana xoogga seefta.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

kikuyu: Waad ka qarsoonaan doontaa karbaashidda carrabka; Oo baabbi'iddu markay timaadana kama aad cabsan doontid innaba.
english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

kikuyu: Waad ku qosli doontaa baabbi'idda iyo abaarta, Oo dugaagga dhulkana kama aad baqi doontid.
english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: Waayo, axdi baad la yeelan doontaa dhagaxyada berrinka, Oo dugaagga duurkana heshiis baad la ahaan doontaa.
english: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad ogaan doontaa in teendhadaadu nabdoon tahay, Oo xeradaada waad soo booqon doontaa, oo waxba kama waayi doontid innaba.
english: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaad ogaan doontaa in farcankaagu badnaan doono, Oo dhashaaduna sida cawska dhulka bay ahaan doontaa.
english: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

kikuyu: Oo cimri dheer baad qabrigaaga ku geli doontaa, Sida xidhmo hadhuudh ah xilliga loo soo xidho.
english: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, annagu xaalkan waannu baadhnay, oo sidaas bayna tahay, Haddaba bal maqal, oo nafsaddaada u ogow.
english: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Hahe haddii dhibkayga la miisaami lahaa, Oo masiibadayda kafado la wada saari lahaa!
english: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

kikuyu: Wuu ka sii cuslaan lahaa cammuudda badaha, Sidaas daraaddeed hadalkaygii degdeg buu noqday.
english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaaha Qaadirka ah fallaadhihiisii ayaa igu dhex jira, Oo naftayduna waabaydoodii way cabbaysaa, Oo Ilaah cabsiintiisiina anigay igu soo kacdaa.
english: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

kikuyu: Dameerdibadeedku miyuu ciyaa markuu caws haysto? Dibiguse miyuu ciyaa markii cunto la siiyo?
english: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

kikuyu: Wixii aan dhadhan lahayn miyaa cusbola'aan la cuni karaa? Ukunta xabkeeduse miyuu dhadhan leeyahay?
english: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

kikuyu: Naftaydu way diidaa inay taabato, Waxay ii yihiin sida cunto la naco oo kale.
english: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

kikuyu: Hahe bal maan helo waxa aan u baryootamo, Oo Ilaah bal muu i siiyo waxa aan u xiisoodo!
english: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

kikuyu: Oo xataa Ilaah bal muu iska jeclaado inuu i burburiyo, Oo bal muu gacantiisa iga sii daayo oo i baabbi'iyo!
english: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

kikuyu: Markaas waan istareexi lahaaye, Oo waxaan u adkaysan lahaa xanuun aan ii tudhayn, Waayo, ma aanan diidin Kan Quduuska ah erayadiisii.
english: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

kikuyu: Bal xooggaygu waa maxay inaan sugo aawadeed? Aakhirkayguse waa maxay inaan dulqaato aawadeed?
english: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

kikuyu: War xooggaygu ma xoogga dhagaxyada baa? Mise jidhkaygu ma naxaas baa?
english: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

kikuyu: War sow ma aha inaanan iscaawiyi karayn? Sowse xigmaddu igama fogaan?
english: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

kikuyu: Kii diyaar u ah inuu qalbi jabo waa in saaxiibkiis u naxariisto Waaba intaasoo uu ka tago cabsida Ilaaha Qaadirka ahe.
english: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Walaalahay waa u khiyaano badnaayeen sida durdur oo kale, Sida biyaha durdurrada ee iska baabba'a,
english: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

kikuyu: Kuwaasoo barafka la madoobaaday, Oo uu barafka cad isku qariyo.
english: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

kikuyu: Markay qorraxoodaan way libdhaan, Oo markay kululaadaanna meeshooday ka baabba'aan.
english: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

kikuyu: Kuwa safraa gees bay uga leexdaan, Waxay u baxaan xagga cidlada oo halkaasay ku dhintaan.
english: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

kikuyu: Waxaa fiiriyey kuwa Teemaa ka safray, Oo socotooyinkii Shebaa ayaa fishay.
english: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

kikuyu: Way ceeboobeen, waayo, way rajeeyeen, Halkaasay yimaadeen, oo way hungoobeen.
english: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

kikuyu: Waayo, hadda idinku sidaasaad ii noqoteen, Waxaad aragteen belaayo, waanad baqdeen.
english: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

kikuyu: Bal anigu miyaan idhi, Wax i sii? Amase, Maalkaaga hadiyad iiga keen?
english: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

kikuyu: Amase, Cadowga gacantiisa iga samatabbixi? Amase, Iga furo gacanta kan i dulma?
english: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

kikuyu: Bal wax i bar, oo anna waan iska aamusayaa; Oo i garansii wixii aan ku qaldamay.
english: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

kikuyu: Erayo runu xoog badanaa! Laakiinse bal canaantiinna muranka ahu maxay caddaysaa?
english: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

kikuyu: Ma waxaad u malaynaysaan inaad erayo canaanataan? Maxaa yeelay, kii quustay hadalkiisu waa sida dabayl oo kale.
english: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

kikuyu: Waxaad saami u ridan lahaydeen maalka agoonta, Oo saaxiibkiinna waad ka faa'iidaysan lahaydeen.
english: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

kikuyu: Haddaba raalli ahaada oo bal i fiiriya, Waayo, sida runta ah been idiin sheegi maayo.
english: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

kikuyu: Haddaba waan idin baryayaaye iska noqda, yaan caddaaladla'aanu dhicin, Ee mar kale iska noqda, waayo, xaalkaygu waa xaq.
english: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

kikuyu: War ma caddaaladla'aan baa carrabkayga saaran? Mase carrabkaygaan waxyaalo xunxun dhadhamin karin?
english: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

kikuyu: War sow hawl diyaar uma aha binu-aadmiga dhulka jooga? Sowse maalmihiisu ma aha sida kuwa shaqaale oo kale?
english: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

kikuyu: Sida addoon hoos u xiisooda, Iyo sida shaqaale mushahaaradiisa filanaya,
english: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

kikuyu: Sidaasoo kale waxaa lay siiyaa bilo aan waxtar lahayn, Oo waxaa lay siiyaa habeenno daal badan.
english: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

kikuyu: Haddaba markaan jiifsado waxaan idhaahdaa, Bal goormaan kici doonaa? Laakiinse habeenku waa dheer yahay Oo tan iyo waaberiga waan rogrogmadaa.
english: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

kikuyu: Jidhkaygii waxaa ku dedan dirxiyo iyo qolfo ciid ah, Haddaba dubkaygu waa isqabsadaa dabadeedna wuu sii dillaacaa.
english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

kikuyu: Cimrigaygu waa ka dheereeyaa dungudbiyaha dharsameeyaha, Oo rajola'aan baan ku noolahay.
english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

kikuyu: Bal xusuusta in noloshaydu tahay dabayl uun, Ishayduna mar dambe samaan ma arki doonto.
english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

kikuyu: Kii i fiiriya ishiisu mar dambe ima arki doonto, Indhahaagu way i fiirin doonaan, laakiinse anigu ma jiri doono.
english: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

kikuyu: Sida daruurtu ay u libidho oo ay u baabba'do, Sidaasoo kale ayaa kii She'ool hoos u galaa uusan mar dambe kor uga soo noqonayn.
english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

kikuyu: Isagu mar dambe gurigiisii kuma soo noqon doono, Oo meeshiisiina mar dambe ma ay aqoon doonto.
english: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed anigu afkayga celin maayo; Waxaan ku hadli doonaa cidhiidhiga qalbigayga, Oo waxaan ku caban doonaa tiiraanyada qadhaadh oo naftayda.
english: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: War anigu ma bad baan ahay, mase nibiriga badda, Bal maxaad ii daawanaysaa?
english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

kikuyu: Markaan idhaahdo, Sariirtaydaa ii raxayn doonta, Oo gogoshaydaa cabatinkayga iga sahali doonta,
english: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

kikuyu: Ayaad riyooyin igu bajisaa, Oo waxaad igu cabsiisaa muuqashooyin.
english: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed naftaydu waxay lafahayga ka doorataa Ceejin iyo geeri.
english: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

kikuyu: Noloshayda waan nacsanahay, oo dooni maayo inaan weligay sii noolaado; War iska kay daa, waayo, cimrigaygu waa neefsasho oo kale.
english: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

kikuyu: Bal binu-aadmigu muxuu yahay oo aad u weynaynaysaa, Balse maxaad uga fikiraysaa isaga?
english: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

kikuyu: Bal maxaad subax kasta u soo booqanaysaa, Oo aad daqiiqad kasta u tijaabinaysaa?
english: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

kikuyu: Bal ilaa goormaadan iga sii jeesanayn, Oo aadan iska kay daynayn intaan candhuuftayda liqayo?
english: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

kikuyu: Oo haddii aan dembaabay bal maxaan kuu sameeyaa Kaaga dadka ilaaliyow? Bal maxaad iiga dhigatay calaamad, Si aan nafsaddayda culaab ugu noqdo?
english: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

kikuyu: Oo bal maxaad xadgudubkayga iiga saamaxi weyday? Oo dembigaygana maxaad iiga fogayn weyday? Waayo, haatan ciiddaan ku dhex jiifsan doonaa, Aad baadna ii doondooni doontaa, laakiinse siima aan jiri doono.
english: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bildad oo ahaa reer Shuuxii u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: Ilaa goormaad waxyaalahan ku hadlaysaa? Oo ilaa goormaa erayada afkaagu ahaanayaan sida dabayl xoog badan?
english: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

kikuyu: War ma Ilaah baa garsooridda qalloociya? Mase Ilaaha Qaadirka ah baa caddaaladda qalloociya?
english: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

kikuyu: Haddii carruurtaadii ay isaga ku dembaabeen, Wuxuu iyagii u gacangeliyey xadgudubkoodii.
english: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

kikuyu: Haddaad aad u barido Ilaah, Oo aad baryootankaaga hor dhigto Qaadirka,
english: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

kikuyu: Haddaad daahir ahaan lahayd oo aad qummanaan lahayd, Sida xaqiiqada ah haatan wuu kuu toosi lahaa, Oo hoyga xaqnimadaadana wuu barwaaqayn lahaa.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

kikuyu: Oo in kastoo bilowgaagii yaraa, Haddana ugudambaystaadu aad bay u weynaan lahayd.
english: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

kikuyu: Waan ku baryayaaye bal qarniyadii hore wax weyddii, Oo bal soo garwaaqso waxyaalihii ay awowayaashood fatasheen,
english: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

kikuyu: (Waayo, innagu waxaynu nahay qoonkii shalayto oo qudha, oo waxba garan mayno, Maxaa yeelay, cimrigeenna aan dhulka joognaa waa sida hoos oo kale.)
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

kikuyu: War sow iyagu wax kuma bari doonaan, oo wax kuuma sheegi doonaan, Oo sow qalbigooda kaalama hadli doonaan?
english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

kikuyu: War miyaa cawdu ka bixi kartaa meel aan dhoobo lahayn? Cawsduurkuse miyuu bixi karaa biyola'aantood?
english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

kikuyu: Intuu weli cagaarka yahay oo aan la gooyn, Wuu ka hor engegaa dhalatada kale oo dhan.
english: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

kikuyu: Kuwa Ilaah illooba oo dhan wadiiqooyinkoodu waa sidaas oo kale, Oo ninkii cibaadalaawe ah rajadiisuna way baabba'daa.
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

kikuyu: Oo kaas kalsoonaantiisu way kala jajabtaa, Oo aaminaaddiisuna waa sida xuubcaaro oo kale.
english: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku tiirsan doonaa gurigiisa, laakiinse gurigiisu ma taagnaan doono. Aad buu u xajin doonaa, laakiinse siima uu adkaan doono innaba.
english: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

kikuyu: Isagu waa ku cagaar qorraxda, Oo laamihiisa curdanka ahuna waxay ka soo kor baxaan beertiisa.
english: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

kikuyu: Oo xididdadiisuna waxay isku duuduubaan taallo dhagaxyo ah, Oo wuxuu fiiriyaa meesha dhagaxyada.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

kikuyu: Isaga haddii meeshiisa laga baabbi'iyo, Markaasay inkiri doontaa isaga, oo waxay odhan doontaa, Anigu kumaba arag.
