english: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

kikuyu: Farxadda jidkiisu waa sidaas, Oo waxaa dhulka ka soo bixi doona kuwa kaleto.
english: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

kikuyu: Ilaah marnaba xoori maayo nin qumman, Kuwa sharka falase tiirin maayo.
english: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

kikuyu: Wuxuu afkaaga ka buuxin doonaa qosol, Bushimahaagana qaylo farxad leh,
english: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

kikuyu: Kuwa ku neceb waxay xidhan doonaan ceeb, Teendhada sharrowyaduna mar dambe siima jiri doonto.
english: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Sida runta ah waan ogahay inay sidaas tahay, Laakiinse sidee baa nin xaq ugu noqon karaa Ilaah hortiisa?
english: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

kikuyu: Oo hadduu doonayo inuu la doodo isaga, Kunkii erayba mid qudha ugama jawaabi karo.
english: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

kikuyu: Qalbigiisu waa xigmad miidhan, oo xooggiisuna waa badan yahay; Bal yaa intuu isaga ka qalafsanaaday barwaaqoobay?
english: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu rujiyaa buuraha, oo iyana ma ay yaqaaniin, Markuu cadhadiisa ku afgembiyo.
english: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

kikuyu: Dhulka wuu ka ruxruxaa meeshiisa, Oo tiirarkiisuna way wada gariiraan.
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

kikuyu: Wuxuu amraa qorraxda, oo iyana sooma ay baxdo, Xiddigahana wuu xidhaa.
english: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

kikuyu: Isagoo keliya ayaa samooyinka kala bixiya, Oo wuxuu ku dul socdaa hirarka badda.
english: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu sameeyey ururrada xiddigaha oo la yidhaahdo Orsada iyo Oriyon iyo Toddobaadyada, Iyo xiddigaha koonfureed.
english: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

kikuyu: Wuxuu sameeyaa waxyaalo waaweyn oo aan la baadhi karin, Oo ah waxyaalo yaab badan oo aan la tirin karin.
english: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

kikuyu: Wuu i ag maraa, aniguse uma jeedo isaga, Oo wuu iga gudbaa, aniguse waxba kama ogi.
english: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

kikuyu: Bal wax buu qabsadaa ee, yaa ka hor joogsan kara? Oo bal yaa ku odhan doona, War maxaad samaynaysaa?
english: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

kikuyu: Ilaah cadhadiisa ka soo celin maayo; Oo kalmeeyayaasha kibirka lahuna isagay hoos foororaan.
english: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal anigu sidee baan ugu jawaabi karaa, Oo aan erayadayda kala doortaa si aan isaga kula hadlo?
english: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

kikuyu: In kastoo aan xaq ahaan lahaa, weliba uma aanan jawaabeen isaga, Illowse waxaan iska baryi lahaa Kan i xukumaya.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

kikuyu: Haddaan baryi lahaa oo uu ii jawaabi lahaa, Ma aanan rumaysteen xataa inuu codkayga maqlay.
english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu igu jejebiyaa duufaan, Oo nabrahaygana sababla'aan buu u sii kordhiyaa.
english: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

kikuyu: Isagu iima oggola inaan neefsado, Laakiinse qadhaadh buu iga buuxiyaa.
english: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

kikuyu: Bal haddaan xagga xoogga ka hadalno isagu waa itaal miidhan, Balse xagga xukunka yaa wakhti ii sheegaya?
english: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

kikuyu: In kastoo aan xaq ahay, afkayga ayaa i xukumi doona, In kastoo aan qummanahay, waxaa igu caddaan doonta qalloocnaan.
english: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.

kikuyu: Anigu waan qummanahay, oo nafsaddayda kama fikiro, Noloshaydana waan quudhsadaa.
english: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

kikuyu: Kulli waa isku mid, oo sidaas daraaddeed waxaan idhaahdaa, Isagu wuu wada baabbi'iyaa kan qumman iyo kan sharka ahba.
english: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

kikuyu: Haddii belaayadu haddiiba wax disho, Wuu ku majaajiloon doonaa jirrabaadda kuwa aan xaqa qabin.
english: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

kikuyu: Dhulka waxaa gacanta loo geliyey kan sharka ah; Oo isna wuxuu indhasaabaa xaakinnadii dhulka. Bal hadduusan isaga ahayn, haddaba waa ayo?
english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

kikuyu: Haddaba cimrigaygu waa ka sii dheereeyaa nin orda, Wuu iga cararaa, oo wanaagna ma arko.
english: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ii dhaafay sida doonniyaha dheereeya, Iyo sida gorgor raq ku soo deganaya.
english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

kikuyu: Haddaan odhan lahaa, Cabatinkayga waan illoobi doonaa, Oo tiiraanyada jaaha iga saaran waan iska tuuri doonaa, oo waan faraxsanaan doonaa,
english: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’

kikuyu: Waxaan ka baqayaa caloolxumadayda oo dhan, Waayo, waan ogahay inaadan ii haysanayn sidii mid aan xaq qabin.
english: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.

kikuyu: Kolleyba waa lay xukumayaaye, Bal maxaan waxtarla'aan u hawshoodaa?
english: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

kikuyu: Haddaan biyo baraf ah ku maydho, Oo aan gacmahayga aad iyo aad u nadiifiyo,
english: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

kikuyu: Adigu waxaad igu dhex tuuri doontaa bohol, Oo xataa dharkaygu waa i nici doonaa.
english: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu nin ma aha, sidaydoo kale, si aan isaga ugu jawaabo, Oo aannu labadayaduba xukun u wada galno.
english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

kikuyu: Ma jiro nin noo dhexeeya, Oo labadayadaba gacantiisa na saari kara.
english: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

kikuyu: Isagu ushiisa ha iga fogeeyo, Oo cabsidiisuna yaanay i bajin.
english: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

kikuyu: Markaas waan hadli lahaa, oo isaga kama aanan baqeen; Waayo, anigu sidaas ma ahi.
english: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.

kikuyu: Naftaydu noloshadayday la daallan tahay, Oo joojinla'aan waan ku sii caban doonaa, Oo qadhaadhka naftayda waan ku hadli doonaa.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: Waxaan Ilaah ku odhan doonaa, Ha i xukumine. Bal waxaad i tustaa waxa aad aawadood iila diriraysid.
english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

kikuyu: Bal miyey kuu wanaagsan tahay inaad cidhiidhisid Oo aad quudhsatid shuqulkii gacantaada, Oo haddana aad iftiimisid kuwa sharka ah taladooda?
english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

kikuyu: Ma waxaad leedahay indho binu-aadmi, Mase sida dadkaad wax u aragtaa?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

kikuyu: Wakhtigaagu ma sida wakhtiga dadkoo kalaa? Cimrigaaguse ma sida cimriga dadkoo kalaa?
english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

kikuyu: Oo bal ma sidaas daraaddeed baad xumaantayda u daba joogtaa, Oo aad dembigayga u baadhaysaa,
english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

kikuyu: In kastoo aad ogtahay inaanan sharrow ahayn, Oo uusan jirin mid gacantaada iga samatabbixinaya?
english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

kikuyu: Gacmahaaga ayaa i qabanqaabiyey oo i dhisay dhammaantay, Laakiin haddana intaad igu soo jeesato ayaad i duminaysaa.
english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

kikuyu: Bal xusuuso waan ku baryayaaye inaad ii dhoobtay sidii wax dhoobo laga sameeyey, Haddaba ma boodhkaad dib iigu celinaysaa?
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

kikuyu: War sow sidii caano iima aadan daadin, Oo sidii gadhoodh oo kale sow iigama aadan dhigin?
english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

kikuyu: Waxaad i huwisay harag iyo hilib, Oo waxaad dhammaantay igu dhistay lafo iyo seedo.
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

kikuyu: Waxaad i siisay nolol iyo raallinimo, Oo booqashadaadiina waxay xannaanaysay ruuxayga.
english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxyaalahaas qalbigaaga waad ku qarisay; Oo waan ogahay in taasu ay kugu jirto.
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

kikuyu: Haddaan dembaabo waad iska kay fiirsataa, Oo ma aad caddaysid inaan dembi la'ahay.
english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

kikuyu: Haddaan sharrow ahay, anaa iska hoogay, Oo haddaan xaq ahayna, innaba madaxayga kor u qaadi maayo Anigoo ceeb ka buuxa Oo dhibaatadayda fiirinaya.
english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

kikuyu: Oo haddii madaxaygu kor isu qaadona, waxaad ii ugaadhsataa sida libaax oo kale, Oo haddana wax laga yaabo ayaad igu samaysaa.
english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

kikuyu: Waxaad ii keensataa markhaatiyaal cusub, Oo dhirifkaagana waad igu sii kordhisaa, Oo hadba waxaad igu soo daysaa col iyo belaayo isu kay bedbeddela.
english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

kikuyu: Bal maxaad iiga soo bixisay uurkii hooyaday? Waxaa wanaagsanaan lahayd in naftu iga baxdo iyadoo aan iluna i arag!
english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

kikuyu: Waxaa igu habboonaan lahayd inaan ahaado sidii wax aan jirin, Oo waxaa ii roonaan lahayd in qabriga la ii qaado isla markii aan uurka hooyaday ka soo baxay.
english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

kikuyu: War cimriga noloshaydu sow wax yar ma aha? Haddaba iska kay daa Oo i dhaaf, aan in yar nastee,
english: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

kikuyu: Intaanan tegin meesha aanan ka soo noqonayn, Oo ah dalka gudcur iyo hooska dhimashada,
english: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

kikuyu: Kaasoo ah gudcur qaro weyn oo ah sida mugdi dam ah, Dalkaas oo ah hooska dhimashada, oo aan innaba nidaam lahayn, Halkaas oo iftiinku yahay sida mugdi oo kale.
english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Soofar oo ahaa reer Nacamaatii u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

kikuyu: War sow waajib ma aha in laga jawaabo erayada faraha badan? Balse ninka hadalka badan xaq ma laga dhigaa?
english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

kikuyu: Amase faankaagu miyuu dadka aamusiin karaa? Oo markaad majaajilootid miyaan ninna ku kashifi karin?
english: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad leedahay, Cilmigaygu waa daahir, Oo nadiif baan ku ahay indhahaaga hortooda.
english: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

kikuyu: Bal muu Ilaah hadlo! Oo bal muu bushimihiisa furo isagoo kaa gees ah!
english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

kikuyu: Oo bal muu ku tuso waxyaalaha qarsoon ee xigmadda ah, Waayo, way badan yihiin. Haddaba bal ogow in Ilaah kaa jisaynayo in ka sii yar ciqaabta dembigaagu istaahilo.
english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

kikuyu: War miyaad baadhi kartaa Ilaah axwaalkiisa moolka dheer? Miyaadse Ilaaha Qaadirka ah si kaamil ah u garan kartaa?
english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

kikuyu: Xigmaddiisu way u sarraysaa sida samada, ee bal maxaad samayn kartaa? Oo She'oolna way ka sii mool dheer tahay, ee maxaad garan kartaa?
english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

kikuyu: Qiyaasteeduna waa ka sii dheer tahay dhulka, waana ka sii ballaadhan tahay badda oo dhan.
english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

kikuyu: Oo isagu hadduu dhex gudbo, wax kastana xidho, Oo uu garsoorid isugu yeedho, bal yaa isaga hor joogsan kara?
english: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

kikuyu: Waayo, wuu gartaa dadka waxmatarayaasha ah, Weliba xumaantana wuu arkaa, sow kama fikirin?
english: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ninkii waxmatare ahu waxgarasho waa ka madhan yahay, Hubaal dadku wuxuu u dhashaa sida qayl dameerdibadeed,
english: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

kikuyu: Haddaad qalbigaaga hagaajisid, Oo aad isaga gacmaha u fidsatid,
english: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

kikuyu: Haddii xumaanu gacantaada ku jirto iska fogee, Oo xaqdarrona yaanay teendhooyinkaaga degin.
english: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

kikuyu: Hubaal markaasaad wejigaaga kor u qaadi doontaa isagoo aan ceeb lahayn; Oo waad adkaan doontaa, mana aad baqi doontid,
english: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

kikuyu: Waayo, dhibaatadaada waad illoobi doontaa, Oo waxaad u xusuusan doontaa sidii biyo ku dhaafay,
english: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

kikuyu: Oo noloshaaduna way ka sii dhalaal dheeraan doontaa hadhkii, Oo in kastoo gudcur jiro, waxay ahaan doontaa sida subaxda.
english: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

kikuyu: Oo ammaan baad ahaan doontaa, maxaa yeelay, rajaa jirta, Hareerahaagaad fiirin doontaa, oo nabaadiinona waad ku nasan doontaa.
english: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

kikuyu: Weliba waad jiifsan doontaa, oo waxba kuma cabsiin doonaan; Hubaal kuwa badan ayaa raallinimo kaa baryi doona.
english: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa sharka ahu way indhabbeeli doonaan. Mana ay heli doonaan jid ay ku cararaan, Rajadooduna waxay ahaan doontaa nafta oo ka dhacda.
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Shakila'aan waxaad tihiin dadkii, Oo xigmad baa idinla dhiman doonta.
english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

kikuyu: Laakiinse aniguba waxgarasho baan leeyahay sidiinna oo kale, Oo weliba idinkama aan liito. Bal waxyaalahan oo kale kan aan garanaynu waa ayo?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

kikuyu: Waxaan la mid ahay sida mid saaxiibkiisu ku maadaysto, Anoo Ilaah baryay oo isna uu ii jawaabay, Ninkii xaq ah oo qumman waa lagu maadaystaa.
english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

kikuyu: Kii istareexsan fikirkiisu waa yaraystaa nasiibdarrada, Laakiinse diyaar bay u tahay kuwa cagtoodu simbiriirixato.
english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

kikuyu: Kuwa wax dhaca teendhooyinkoodu way barwaaqoobaan, Oo kuwa Ilaah ka cadhaysiiyaana ammaan bay ku joogaan, Oo Ilaahna gacmahooduu wax kasta uga buuxshaa.
english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan bal xayawaanka wax weyddii, oo iyana wax bay ku bari doonaan, Iyo haadka hawada, oo iyana wax bay kuu sheegi doonaan,
english: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

kikuyu: Amase bal dhulka la hadal, oo isna wax buu ku bari doonaa, Oo kalluunka badduna wax buu kuu sheegi doonaa.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

kikuyu: Bal yuu yahay kan aan waxyaalahan oo dhan ka garanayn Inay gacanta Rabbigu waxan samaysay?
english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,

kikuyu: Kaasoo gacantiisa ku haya nafta wax kasta oo nool Iyo neefta binu-aadmiga oo dhan.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

kikuyu: War sow dhegtu erayada ma kala soocdo, Sida dhanxanagguba cuntadiisa u dhadhamiyo?
english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

kikuyu: Odayaashu waxay leeyihiin xigmad, Oo cimriga dheerna waxaa laga helaa waxgarasho.
english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu leeyahay xigmad iyo xoog, Oo wuxuu leeyahay talo iyo waxgarasho.
english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, isagu wax buu dumiyaa, Oo wuxuu dumiyana mar dambe lama dhisi karo, Nin buu xidhaa oo wax furi kara lama arko.
english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

kikuyu: Biyuhuu celiyaa, oo way iska gudhaan, Oo haddana wuu soo daayaa, markaasay dhulka qarqiyaan.
english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

kikuyu: Xoog iyo xigmaduba isagay la jiraan, Oo kan la khiyaaneeyey iyo kan wax khiyaaneeyaba isagaa iska leh.
english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

kikuyu: Taliyayaasha wuxuu u kaxaystaa sida booli la dhacay, Xaakinnadana nacasyo buu ka dhigaa.
english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

kikuyu: Wuxuu furaa boqorrada xidhan, Oo dhex-xidh buuna u xidhaa.
english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

kikuyu: Wadaaddadana sida booli la dhacay buu u kaxaystaa, Oo kuwa xoogga badanna wuu afgembiyaa.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

kikuyu: Kuwa la aaminayna wuu hadal beeliyaa, Oo odayaashana waxgarashaduu ka qaadaa.
english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

kikuyu: Amiirrada wuxuu ku shubaa quudhsasho, Kuwa xoogga badanna suunkooduu debciyaa.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

kikuyu: Wuxuu gudcurka ka soo saaraa waxyaalo mool dheer, Oo hooska dhimashadana iftiinkuu u soo bixiyaa.
english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Quruumaha wuu badiyaa, oo haddana wuu wada baabbi'iyaa, Oo quruumaha wuu ballaadhiyaa, oo haddana wuu kexeeyaa,
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

kikuyu: Wuxuu caqliga ka qaadaa madaxda dadyowga dhulka, Oo wuxuu iyaga ku warwareejiyaa meel cidla ah oo aan jid lahayn.
english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

kikuyu: Waxay wax ka haabhaabtaan gudcurka iyagoo aan iftiin lahayn, Oo wuxuu iyaga ka dhigaa inay u dhacdhacaan sida nin sakhraan ah.
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

kikuyu: Bal eega, waxan oo dhan ishaydu waa aragtay, Dhegtayduna waa maqashay oo way garatay.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

kikuyu: Wixii aad taqaaniin, anna waan aqaan sidoo kale, Anigu idinkama liito innaba.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

kikuyu: Sida xaqiiqada ah waxaan doonayaa inaan Ilaaha Qaadirka ah la hadlo, Oo waxaan jeclahay inaan Ilaah la xaajoodo.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku waxaad tihiin kuwa beenta hindisa, Oo dhammaantiin waxaad tihiin dhakhtarro aan waxtar lahayn.
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

kikuyu: Bal maad iska aamustaan! Taasu xigmad bay idiin ahaan lahayd.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal xaajadayda maqla, Oo baryootanka bushimahayga dhegaysta.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

kikuyu: War ma Ilaah aawadiis baad xaqdarro wax ugu odhanaysaan, Oo ma isaga aawadiis baad khiyaano ugu hadlaysaan?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

kikuyu: War ma isagaad u eexanaysaan? Oo ma Ilaah aawadiis baad u diriraysaan?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

kikuyu: War miyey idiin wanaagsan tahay inuu idin baadho? Mase sida nin loo khiyaaneeyo ayaad isaga u khiyaanaynaysaan?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

kikuyu: Sida xaqiiqada ah haddaad qarsoodi dadka ugu kala eexatan Isagu wuu idin canaanan doonaa.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

kikuyu: War sow sarraysnaantiisu idin cabsiin mayso? Oo sow baqdintiisu idinku dhici mayso?
english: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

kikuyu: Hadalkiinna xusuusta lahu waa maahmaahyo dambas ah, Oo dhufaysyadiinnuna waa dhufaysyo dhoobo ah.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

kikuyu: Haddaba iska aamusa, oo iska kay daaya aan iska hadlee, Oo wixii dhici lahaaba ha igu dheceen.
english: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

kikuyu: Haddaba hilibkayga ayaan ilkahayga ku qaadayaa, Oo noloshaydana gacantaydaan ku ridayaa.
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

kikuyu: Oo in kastoo uu i dilo, weli waan rajaynayaa, Habase yeeshee hortiisaan kula xaajoonayaa.
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

kikuyu: Oo weliba kaasu wuxuu ahaan doonaa badbaadadayda, Waayo, nin aan cibaado lahaynu hortiisa iman maayo.
english: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

kikuyu: Hadalkayga aad u dhegaysta, Oo warramiddaydu dhegihiinna ha gasho.
english: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

kikuyu: Bal eega, hadda xaalkayga waan soo hagaajiyey, Oo waan ogahay in xaq layga dhigayo.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

kikuyu: Bal yuu yahay kan ila doodayaa? Waayo, hadda waan iska aamusayaa oo naftuna waa iga dhacaysaa.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

kikuyu: Laba waxyaalood oo keliya ha igu samayn, Oo anna markaas nafsaddayda wejigaaga ka qarin maayo.
english: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

kikuyu: Gacantaada iga fogee, Oo waxyaalahaaga laga cabsadona yaanay i bajin.
english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

kikuyu: Oo markaas ii yeedh, oo anna waan kuu jawaabi doonaa, Amase anigu aan hadlo oo adigu ii jawaab.
english: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

kikuyu: Bal xumaatooyinkayga iyo dembiyadaydu waa immisa? Bal xadgudubkayga iyo dembigayga i ogeysii.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

kikuyu: Bal maxaad wejigaaga u qarinaysaa, Oo aad iigu haysataa sidii mid cadow kuu ah?
english: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

kikuyu: Ma waxaad dhibaysaa caleen iska bidaysa? Oo ma waxaad eryanaysaa xaab engegay?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

kikuyu: Waayo, waxyaalo qadhaadh baad iga qortaa, Oo waxaad i dhaxalsiisaa xumaatooyinkii dhallinyaranimadayda.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

kikuyu: Oo weliba cagahayga waxaad gelisaa jeebbooyin, Oo jidadkayga oo dhanna waad wada fiirisaa, Cagahaygana xad baad u dhigtaa.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

kikuyu: Oo waxaan la mid ahay wax qudhmay oo baabba'aya, Iyo sida dhar aboor cunay oo kale.
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

kikuyu: Ninkii naagu dhashaba Cimrigiisu waa maalmo yar iyo dhibaato miidhan.
english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u soo baxaa sida ubax oo kale, oo haddana waa la gooyaa, Oo wuxuu u cararaa sida hoos oo kale, oo innaba siima raago.
english: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

kikuyu: Haddaba ma mid sidaas oo kalaad indhaha u kala qaadaysaa? Oo ma anigaad xukun ila soo gelaysaa?
english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

kikuyu: Bal yaa wax wasakh ah wax nadiif ah ka soo bixin kara? Xataa mid qudha oo saas yeeli karaa ma jiro.
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, dadka cimrigiisu waa go'an yahay, oo inta bilood oo uu jirayo tiradoodana adigaa haya, Oo waxaad u dhigtay soohdin uusan dhaafi karin.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

kikuyu: Bal ha nastee isaga ka sii jeeso, Ilaa uu cimrigiisa ka dhammaysanayo sida shaqaale maalintiisa u dhammaysto.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

kikuyu: Waayo, geed dheer haddii la gooyo rajuu leeyahay inuu mar kale soo biqlo, Iyo in laantiisa curdanka ahu ayan joogsan.
english: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

kikuyu: In kastoo xididkiisu uu ciidda ku dhex gaboobo, Oo ay jirriddiisiina dhulka dhexdiisa ku dhimato,
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

kikuyu: Biyaha urkooda ayuu ku biqli doonaa, Oo waxaa ka soo bixi doona laamo curdan ah oo dhalato la moodo.
english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ninku wuu dhintaa, wuuna iska baabba'aa, Oo ninka naftu waa ka dhacdaa, oo bal xaggee buu joogaa isagu?
english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

kikuyu: Biyuhu badda way ka dhammaadaan, Oo webiguna waa gudhaa oo waa iska engegaa,
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalaa dadku u jiifsada oo mana uu kaco, Oo jeeray samooyinku wada baabba'aan iyagu sooma toosi doonaan, Oo hurdadoodana kama kici doonaan.
english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

kikuyu: Hahe bal maad She'ool igu qarisid, Oo bal maad meel qarsoon igu haysid ilaa cadhadaadu dhaafto, Oo bal maad wakhti go'an ii qabatid, oo aad i soo xusuusatid!
english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

kikuyu: Mar hadduu nin dhinto, miyuu soo noolaanayaa? Maalmaha dadaalkayga oo dhan waan iska sugi lahaa Ilaa uu isbeddelkaygu yimaado.
english: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

kikuyu: Waad ii yeedhi lahayd, oo anna waan kuu jawaabi lahaa; Oo adna waxaa damac kaa geli lahaa shuqulkii gacmahaaga.
english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan waad tirisaa tallaabooyinkayga, Balse miyaadan dembigayga isha ku hayn?
english: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

kikuyu: Xadgudubkaygii kolay baa lagu xidhay, Oo xumaantaydiina meel baad ku dhuujisay.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

kikuyu: Oo sida xaqiiqada ah buurtii dhacdaa waa baabba'daa, Oo dhagaxiina meeshiisii wuu ka dhaqaaqaa.
english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

kikuyu: Biyuhu dhagaxyaday lisaan, Oo daadkooduna wuxuu qaada ciidda dhulka, Oo adna sidaasoo kalaad u baabbi'isaa binu-aadmiga rajadiisa.
english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

kikuyu: Weligaaba waad ka adkaataa isaga, oo isna wuu iska baxaa, Oo jaahiisa waad beddeshaa, oo waad iska dirtaa isaga.
english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

kikuyu: Wiilashiisa waa la sharfaa, laakiinse isagu waxba kama oga; Oo haddana hoos baa loo ridaa, laakiinse isagu waxba kama garto iyaga.
english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

kikuyu: Laakiinse xanuunka jidhkiisa oo keliya buu gartaa, Oo nafsaddiisa oo keliya ayuu u baroortaa.
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Eliifas kii reer Teemaan isagii u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: War nin xigmad lahu miyuu ku jawaabaa aqoon aan waxba tarayn, Oo bal miyuu calooshiisa ka buuxiyaa dabaysha bari?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

kikuyu: Miyayse ku habboon tahay inuu ku xaajowdo hadal aan faa'iido lahayn, Amase hadallo uusan innaba wanaag ku samayn karin?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

kikuyu: Cabsida waad baabbi'isaa, Oo cibaadadana Ilaah hortiisa waad ka joojisaa.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

kikuyu: Waayo, afkaaga waxaa wax bara xumaantaada, Oo waxaad doorataa carrabka khaa'inka.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa ku xukuma afkaaga oo aniga ma aha; Hubaal bushimahaaga qudhooda ayaa kugu marag fura.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

kikuyu: War ma ninkii binu-aadmiga ugu hor dhashaad tahay? Mase buuraha hortood baad soo dhalatay?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

kikuyu: War talada qarsoon oo Ilaah miyaad maqashay? Oo nafsaddaada miyaad xigmad ula hadhay?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

kikuyu: War maxaad og tahay, oo aannan annagu ogayn? Oo bal maxaad garanaysaa, oo aannan garanayn?
english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

kikuyu: Waxaa nala jooga rag cirro leh iyo odayaal da' weyn, Oo aabbahaa ka sii fil weyn.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

kikuyu: Ma kugu yar yihiin qalbiqabowjiska Ilaah Iyo erayga sida qabow kuula macaamiloodaa?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

kikuyu: Bal maxaa qalbigaagu kuu fogeeyaa? Maxaase indhahaagu u gabgab leeyihiin?
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

kikuyu: Oo aad ruuxaaga Ilaah ugu soo jeedisaa, Oo erayo caynkaas ah aad afkaaga uga soo daysaa?
english: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

kikuyu: Bal binu-aadmigu muxuu yahay oo uu daahir ahaado? Kii naagu dhashayse muxuu yahay oo uu xaq ahaado?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, Ilaah ma aamino kuwiisa quduuska ah, Oo xataa samooyinku hortiisa daahir kuma aha.
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

kikuyu: Haddaba bal sidee buu u daahir ahaanayaa nin karaahiyo iyo wasakhaan ah, Oo dembiga sida biyo u cabbaa!
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

kikuyu: Bal i maqal, wax baan ku tusayaa, Oo wixii aan arkay oo dhan waan kuu sheegayaa;
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

kikuyu: (Kuwaasoo rag xigmad lahu ay awowayaashood ka heleen, Oo ayan qarin,
english: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

kikuyu: Kuwaasoo dalka keligood la siiyey, Oo uusan shisheeye innaba dhex mari jirin.)
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

kikuyu: Ninkii shar ahu sida naag u foolato oo kale ayuu u xanuunsadaa cimrigiisa oo dhan, Intaas oo ah sannadihii loo kaydiyey kuwa wax dulma.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

kikuyu: Oo sanqadh cabsi leh ayaa dhegihiisa gasha, Oo wakhtiga barwaaqadana baabbi'iyuhu waa u soo iman doonaa.
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

kikuyu: Isagu ma rumaysto inuu gudcurka ka noqon doono, Iyo inay seeftu isaga sugayso.
english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

kikuyu: Meel meel buu cunto u wareegaa isagoo leh, Meeday? Oo wuxuu og yahay inay maalinta gudcurku isaga u diyaar tahay.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

kikuyu: Waxaa isaga bajiya dhib iyo cidhiidhi, Oo isagay uga adkaadaan sida boqor dagaal isu diyaariyey,
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, isagu gacantiisuu Ilaah ku taagay, Oo Ilaaha Qaadirka ah kibir buu ku caasiyaa.
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

kikuyu: Wuxuu kula ordaa madax adag Iyo gaashaammadiisa biro ku taagan yihiin.
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, wejiga ayuu ka cayilay, Oo bowdooyinkana baruur buu ku yeeshay,
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu degay magaalooyin baabba' ah, Iyo guryo aan lagu hoyan, Oo u diyaarsan inay tuulmooyin burbur ah noqdaan.
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

kikuyu: Isagu taajir noqon maayo, oo maalkiisuna sii raagi maayo, Oo dhulkana ku sii waari maayo.
english: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

kikuyu: Isagu marnaba gudcur ka bixi maayo, Oo laamihiisa olol baa qallajin doona, Oo neefta afkiisa ayaa qaadi doonta.
english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

kikuyu: Yuusan wax aan waxba tarayn isku hallayn, isagoo iskhiyaaneeya, Waayo, wax aan waxba tarayn ayaa abaalgudkiisa ahaan doona.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

kikuyu: Wakhtigiisii ka hor buu dhammaan doonaa, Oo laantiisuna ma cagaaroobi doonto.
english: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

kikuyu: Sida canabka ayuu midhihiisa ceedhiin iska ridi doonaa, Oo sida saytuunka ayuu ubaxiisa iska daadin doonaa.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

kikuyu: Waayo, ururka cibaadalaawayaashu wuxuu ahaan doonaa wax aan waxba dhalin, Oo teendhooyinka kuwa laaluushka qaatana dab baa baabbi'in doona.
english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

kikuyu: Iyagu waxay uuraystaan belaayo, xumaanna way dhalaan, Oo calooshooduna waxay diyaarisaa khiyaano.
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Anigu waan maqlay waxyaalo badan oo caynkaas ah. Idinku dhammaantiin waxaad tihiin qalbiqabowjiyayaal qalqalloocan.
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

kikuyu: Hadal dabayl ahu miyuu dhammaadaa? Balse maxaa kaa dhirfinaya oo aad u jawaabaysaa?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

kikuyu: Haddii naftiinnu ahaan lahayd naftayda, Anigu waan u hadli kari lahaa sidiinna oo kale, Oo hadal waan idinku kor tuuli kari lahaa, Oo madaxaygana waan idinku ruxruxi kari lahaa.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu afkayga waan idinku xoogayn lahaa, Oo tacsiyaynta bushimahayguna way idin qalbi qabowjin lahayd.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

kikuyu: Anigu haddaan hadlo xanuunkaygu igama yaraado, Oo haddaan iska aamusona miyaan in ka yar xanuunsadaa?
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan wuu i daaliyey, Oo guutadaydii oo dhan cidlo baad ka dhigtay.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.

kikuyu: Waad i qabsatay, taasuna waa marag iga gees ah, Oo waxaa igu kaca macluulkayga, oo fool ka fool ayuu igu markhaati furaa.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

kikuyu: Isagoo cadhaysan ayuu i dildillaacsaday, oo wuu i silciyey, Wuuna igu ilko jirriqsaday, Oo cadowgaygii indhuhuu igu caddeeyey.
english: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

kikuyu: Iyagu afkay ii kala qaadeen, Oo quudhsasho ayay dhabanka igaga dharbaaxeen, Oo dhammaantoodna way isu kay wada urursadaan.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu gacantooda i geliyaa cibaadalaawayaasha, Oo wuxuu igu dhex tuuraa gacmaha kuwa sharka ah.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

kikuyu: Anigoo iska istareexsan ayuu i kala jejebiyey, Oo intuu surka i qabtay ayuu i kala burburiyey, Oo weliba intuu meel i qotomiyey ayuu goolibaadh iga dhigtay.
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

kikuyu: Qaansoolayaashiisii ayaa i hareereeya, Oo kelyahaygii ayuu kala googooyaa, Oo xammeetidaydiina dhulkuu ku daadshaa.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

kikuyu: Isagu wuu i jejebiyaa oo nabarba nabar buu iiga kor mariyaa; Oo sidii nin xoog badan ayuu orod igula soo kacaa.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.

kikuyu: Korkayga waxaan ku tolay joonyad, Oo xooggaygiina ciiddaan ku riday.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

kikuyu: Wejigaygii oohin buu la beddelmay, Oo indhaha daboolkoodana waxaa ii jooga hooskii dhimashada,
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

kikuyu: In kastoo aanay xaqdarro ku jirin gacmahayga, Oo uu baryootankayguna daahir yahay.
english: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

kikuyu: Dhulkow, dhiiggayga ha qarinin, Oo qayladayduna yaanay meelay ku nasato lahaan.
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

kikuyu: Oo hadda bal eeg, markhaatigaygii wuxuu joogaa samada, Oo kii ii dammiintaana xagga saruu joogaa.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

kikuyu: Saaxiibbaday way igu qoslaan, Laakiinse indhahaygu ilmo bay u daadiyaan xag Ilaah.
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

kikuyu: Bal muu jiro mid dadka Ilaah ula hadla, Siduu nin deriskiisa ugu hadlo oo kale.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

kikuyu: Waayo, markii dhawr sannadood dhaafaan, Waxaan mari doonaa jidka aanan mar kale dib uga soo noqonayn.
english: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.

kikuyu: Ruuxaygii waa tabardarnaaday, cimrigaygiina waa dhammaaday, Oo qabrigu waa ii diyaar.
english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

kikuyu: Sida xaqiiqada ah waxaa ila jooga majaajilowyo, Oo ishayduna waxay fiiro u leedahay ka cadhaysiintooda.
english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

kikuyu: Haddaba rahaamad i sii, oo dammiin ii noqo; Bal yaa jooga oo gacanta dhaar iigu dhiibaya?
english: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

kikuyu: Waayo, qalbigooda waxgarashadii waad ka qarisay, Oo sidaas daraaddeed iyaga ma aad sarraysiin doontid.
english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

kikuyu: Kii saaxiibbadiis u yeedha inay maal ka qaybgeliyaan, Carruurtiisu way indha beeli doonaan.
english: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

kikuyu: Oo weliba isagu wuxuu iga dhigay wax ay dadku ku halqabsadaan, Oo waxaan noqday mid ay dadku candhuuf ku tufaan.
english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

kikuyu: Indhahaygii murug bay la arag daranyihiin, Oo xubnahaygii oo dhammuna waxay noqdeen sidii hoos oo kale.
english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

kikuyu: Dadkii toolmoonu waxan way la yaabayaan, Oo kan aan xaqa qabinuna wuxuu ku kacayaa cibaadalaawaha.
english: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kii xaq ahu jidkiisa wuu ku sii adkaysan doonaa, Oo kii gacmo nadiifsan lahuna aad iyo aad buu u sii xoogaysan doonaa.
english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku dhammaantiin bal soo noqda oo ii kaalaya, Oo anna nin xigmad leh idinkama heli doono.
english: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

kikuyu: Cimrigaygii waa dhammaaday, Oo qasdigaygii iyo fikirradii qalbigayguba waa baabbe'een.
english: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

kikuyu: Habeenka waxay u beddelaan maalin, Oo waxay yidhaahdaan, Iftiinku waa u dhow yahay gudcurka.
english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

kikuyu: Haddaan She'ool u rajeeyo sida gurigaygii oo kale, Ama haddaan gogoshayda gudcurka ku dhex fidsado,
english: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

kikuyu: Oo haddaan qudhunka ku idhaahdo, Adigu waxaad tahay aabbahay, Oo aan dirxigana ku idhaahdo, Adigu waxaad tahay hooyaday iyo walaashay,
english: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

kikuyu: Bal markaas meeday rajadaydu? Oo bal yaase rajadayda arki doona?
english: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

kikuyu: Waxay hoos ugu dhaadhici doontaa qataarrada She'ool, Markaannu ciidda wada galno.
english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bildad oo ahaa reer Shuuxii u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: War ilaa goormaad hadallo sii wadaysaan? War bal fiirsada, oo annana dabadeed baannu hadlaynaa.
english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

kikuyu: War bal maxaa sida xayawaan naloogu tiriyaa? Oo bal maxaannu hortiinna ugu nijaasownay?
english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

kikuyu: War waa adiga xanaaq daraaddiis isla jeexjeexayaye Dhulka ma daraaddaa baa looga tegayaa? Mase dhagaxa ayaa meeshiisa laga rujinayaa?
english: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

kikuyu: Hubaal iftiinka sharrowgu wuu demi doonaa, Oo ololka dabkiisuna siima iftiimi doono.
english: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

kikuyu: Iftiinka teendhadiisu wuxuu ahaan doonaa gudcur, Oo laambaddiisa kor taalna way demi doontaa.
english: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

kikuyu: Tallaabooyinka itaalkiisu way iscidhiidhin doonaan, Oo taladiisu isagay hoos u ridi doontaa.
english: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu cagta gashadaa shabag, Oo wuxuu ku kor socdaa dabin.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

kikuyu: Waxaa isaga cedhibta ku dhegi doona dabin, Oo qool baana qabsan doona.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhulka ugu qarsan siriq, Oo jidkana waxaa u yaal dabin.
english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

kikuyu: Dhinac kasta waxaa ka bajin doona cabsi, Oo xataa gadaalna way ka soo eryan doontaa.
english: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

kikuyu: Xooggiisa waxaa dili doonta gaajo, Oo belaayona agtiisay diyaar ku tahay.
english: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

kikuyu: Oo waxay baabbi'in doontaa xubnaha jidhkiisa, Oo curadka dhimashada ayaa xubnihiisa baabbi'in doona.
english: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

kikuyu: Oo isaga waa laga rujin doonaa teendhadiisa uu isku halleeyo, Oo waxaa loo keeni doonaa boqorka cabsida.
english: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

kikuyu: Teendhadiisa waxaa ku jiri doona wax aan wixiisii ahayn, Oo hoygiisana waxaa lagu soo kor firdhin doonaa baaruud.
english: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

kikuyu: Xididdadiisa hoose way qallali doonaan, Oo laamihiisa sarena waa la jari doonaa.
english: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

kikuyu: Dhulka laguma xusuusan doono, Oo jidkana magac kuma uu yeelan doono.
english: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

kikuyu: Isaga iftiin baa gudcur looga kaxayn doonaa, Oo dunidana waa laga eryi doonaa.
english: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

kikuyu: Oo isagu dadkiisa kuma dhex lahaan doono wiil uu dhalay iyo mid uu wiilkiisii dhalay toona, Ama mid ku hadha meelihii uu degganaan jiray.
english: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

kikuyu: Dadka ka dambeeyaa waxay ka yaabi doonaan wakhtigiisa, Sidii ay kuwii horeba uga baqeen.
english: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

kikuyu: Sida xaqiiqada ah guryaha kuwa aan xaqa ahayn waa sidaas oo kale, Oo kii aan Ilaah aqoon meeshiisiina waa tan.
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub u jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: War ilaa goormaad naftayda dhibaysaan Oo aad erayo igu burburinaysaan?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

kikuyu: Toban jeer baad i caydeen, Haddaba miyaydaan ka xishoonayn inaad saas oo xun iila macaamilootaan?
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

kikuyu: Oo sida xaqiiqada ah haddaan qaldamay, Qaladkaygu aniguu igu hadhayaa.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

kikuyu: Oo sida xaqiiqada ah haddaad iska kay weynaynaysaan, Oo aad ceebtayda igu caddaysaan inaan dembi leeyahay,
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

kikuyu: Haddaba bal ogaada in Ilaah i afgembiyey, Oo uu shabagtiisii igu wareejiyey.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

kikuyu: Bal eega, dulunka daraaddiis waan u qayliyaa, laakiin lay maqli maayo, Oo caawimaad waan u qayshadaana, caddaaladduse ma jirto.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

kikuyu: Jidkaygii ayuu ooday si aanan u dhaafi karin, Oo wadiiqooyinkaygiina gudcur buu ka dhigay.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

kikuyu: Ammaantaydii wuu iga xayuubiyey, Oo taajkiina madaxayga wuu ka qaaday.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

kikuyu: Xagga iyo xaggaaba wuu iga dumiyey, oo baabba' waan noqday, Oo rajadaydiina sidii geed oo kale ayuu u rujiyey.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

kikuyu: Aad buu iigu cadhooday, Oo sida mid cadowgiisa ah ayuu igu tiriyaa.
english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

kikuyu: Ciidammadiisii oo dhammu way wada yimaadaan, Oo jid bay dhistaan si ay iigu kacaan, Oo teendhadayda hareeraheeda ayay degaan.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

kikuyu: Walaalahay wuu iga fogeeyey, Oo kuwii aan iqiinna way iga wada shisheeyoobeen.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

kikuyu: Ehelkaygii way i dayriyeen, Oo saaxiibbadaydiina way i illoobeen.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

kikuyu: Kuwa reerkayga ku hoyda, iyo gabdhaha addoommahayga ahuba waxay igu tiriyaan shisheeye, Oo hortooda waxaan ku ahay ajanabi.
english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

kikuyu: Waxaan u yeedhaa addoonkaygii, Oo in kastoo aan afkayga ku baryo, iima jawaabo innaba.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

kikuyu: Naagtaydu waxay nacdaa neeftayda, Oo carruurtii hooyaday dhashayna waxay nacaan baryootankayga.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

kikuyu: Xataa dhallaanka yaryaru way i quudhsadaan, Oo haddaan sara joogsado way i caayaan.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

kikuyu: Saaxiibbadaydii aan ku kalsoonaa oo dhammu way i karahsadaan, Oo kuwii aan jeclaana way igu soo jeesteen.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

kikuyu: Haraggayga iyo hilibkaygu waxay ku dhegaan lafahayga, Oo dirqi baan ku baxsaday.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

kikuyu: Saaxiibbadayow, ii naxa, oo ii naxa, Waayo, gacantii Ilaah baa i taabatay.
english: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

kikuyu: Maxaad sidii Ilaah iigu silcisaan? Oo bal maxaad dhibaatada jidhkayga uga dhergi weydeen?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa in erayadayda la qoro! Iyo in kitaab gudihiis lagu qoro!
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

kikuyu: Iyo inay weligood dhagax kula qornaadaan Qalin bir ah iyo rasaas!
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

kikuyu: Laakiinse waan ogahay in kii i soo furtay nool yahay, Iyo inuu ugudambaysta dhulka ku istaagi doono.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

kikuyu: Oo markii haraggaygu sidaas u baabba'o dabadeed, Ayaan anigoo aan jiidh lahayn Ilaah arki doonaa,
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

kikuyu: Kaasoo aan aniga qudhaydu arki doono, Oo indhahaygu ay fiirin doonaan, oo aanay kuwa mid kale arkayn. Qalbigaygu waa taag daranyahay.
english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

kikuyu: Haddaad istidhaahdaan, War xaalkan salkiisu isagaa laga helay, Bal maxaannu isaga u silcinnaa?
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

kikuyu: Si aad u ogaataan in xukun jiro, Waxaad ka cabsataan seefta, Maxaa yeelay, cadhadu waxay keentaa taqsiirta seefta.
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Soofar oo ahaa reer Nacamaatii u jawaabay, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa ii jawaaba fikirradayda, Oo sababtu waxay tahay degdegga igu jira.
english: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

kikuyu: Waxaan maqlay canaanta i ceebaysa, Oo waxaa ii jawaabta waxgarashadayda.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

kikuyu: Miyaadan ogayn in waayihii hore iyo Tan iyo waagii binu-aadmiga dhulka la saaray
english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

kikuyu: Ay guulaysashada sharrowyadu gaaban tahay, Oo farxadda cibaadalaawayaashuna ay daqiiqad qudha tahay?
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

kikuyu: In kastoo sarrayntiisu ay samada korto, Oo madaxiisuna uu daruuraha gaadho,
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

kikuyu: Wuxuu weligiis u baabbi'i doonaa sida saxaradiisa oo kale. Oo kuwii isaga arki jiray waxay odhan doonaan, War meeh isagii?
english: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

kikuyu: Sida riyo ayuu u libdhi doonaa, oo lama heli doono, Hubaal waxaa loo eryi doonaa sida riyada habeenka.
english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

kikuyu: Ishii isaga aragtay mar dambe ma ay arki doonto, Oo meeshiisiina mar dambe uma ay jeedi doonto.
english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

kikuyu: Carruurtiisu waxay wax ka baryi doonaan masaakiinta, Oo gacmahooduna dib bay u celin doonaan maalkiisa.
english: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

kikuyu: Lafihiisana waxaa ka buuxa xoogga dhallinyaranimada, Laakiinse ciidda dhexdeeduu la jiifsan doonaa.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

kikuyu: In kastoo xumaantu afkiisa la macaan tahay, In kastoo uu carrabkiisa ku hoos qarsado,
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

kikuyu: In kastoo uu kaydsado, oo uusan iska sii dayn, Laakiinse uu afkiisa ku sii haysto,
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

kikuyu: Kolleyba cuntadiisu mindhicirkiisay ku beddelantaa, Oo waxay uurkiisa ku noqataa waabayo jilbis.
english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

kikuyu: Isagu maal buu liqay, laakiinse mar kaluu soo mantagi doonaa, Oo Ilaah baa calooshiisa ka soo saari doona.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

kikuyu: Wuxuu nuugi doonaa mariidka jilbisyada, Oo waxaa isaga dili doona mas carrabkiis.
english: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

kikuyu: Oo ma uu fiirin doono webiyada, Iyo durdurrada la barwaaqaysan malabka iyo subagga.
english: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

kikuyu: Wixii uu ku hawshooday wuu soo celin doonaa, oo ma uu liqi doono, Oo maalka uu faa'iidada u helayna siduu yahay uguma uu farxi doono.
english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu dulmay oo dayriyey masaakiinta, Oo wuxuu xoog ku qaatay guri uusan dhisin.
english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

kikuyu: Uurkiisu xasilloonaan ma lahayn, Taas daraaddeed waxa uu jecel yahay oo dhan waxba kama uu badbaadin doono.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

kikuyu: Wuxuu liqay wax ka hadhay lama arkin, Sidaas daraaddeed barwaaqadiisu siima raagi doonto.
english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

kikuyu: Markuu dheregsan yahay ayuu cidhiidhi dhex geli doonaa, Oo mid kasta oo belaayaysan gacantiisa ayaa ku soo degi doonta.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

kikuyu: Markuu ku dhow yahay inuu calooshiisa buuxsado, Ayaa Ilaah wuxuu ku soo tuuri doonaa kulaylka cadhadiis, Oo wuu ku soo shubi doonaa intuu wax cunayo.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

kikuyu: Wuu ka carari doonaa hubka birta ah, Oo qaansada naxaasta ahu fallaadh bay ka dhex dusin doontaa.
english: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

kikuyu: Wuu soo jiidaa, kolkaasay jidhkiisa ka soo baxdaa, Hubaal caaradda dhalaalaysa ayaa beerkiisa ka soo baxda, Oo cabsi baa isaga ku dhacda.
english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

kikuyu: Gudcurka oo dhanna waxaa meel loogu kaydiyey khasnadihiisa; Oo dab aan la afuufin ayaa isaga dhammayn doona, Wuuna baabbi'in doonaa waxa teendhadiisa ku dhex hadhay.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

kikuyu: Samooyinku waxay daaha ka qaadi doonaan xumaantiisa, Oo dhulkuna isaguu ku kici doonaa.
english: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

kikuyu: Hodanka reerkiisu wuu ka dhammaan doonaa, Oo maalinta cadhada Ilaah ayaa maalkiisu libdhi doonaa.
english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

kikuyu: Intaasu waxaa weeye qaybta ninkii shar ahu uu xagga Ilaah ka helayo, Iyo wixii Ilaah dhaxal ahaan ugu amray.
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Maqla oo warkayga aad u dhegaysta, Oo tanuna ha noqoto wixii aad igu qalbiqabowjisaan.
english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

kikuyu: Bal mar ii oggolaada aan hadlee, Oo kolkii aan hadlo dabadeed iska sii majaajilooda.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

kikuyu: Balse anigu ma dad baan ka ashtakoonayaa? Maxaan u ahaan waayay mid aan dulqaadan?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

kikuyu: Bal i eega, oo yaaba, Oo afkiinna gacanta saara.
english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

kikuyu: Oo xataa markaan soo xusuusto waan welwelaa, Oo jidhkaygana waa hoog iyo ba'.
english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

kikuyu: Bal maxay kuwa sharka ahu u noolaanayaan? Oo ay u gaboobayaan? Balse maxay xoog badan u yeeshaan?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

kikuyu: Farcankoodu iyagoo la jooga hortooduu ku xoogaystaa, Oo dhashoodiina hortooday ku dhisan yihiin.
english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

kikuyu: Reerahoodu cabsi way ka ammaan galeen, Oo ushii Ilaahna iyaga ma kor saarna.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

kikuyu: Dibidoodu way dhalaan, oo marnaba madhalays ma noqdaan, Sacyahooduna way dhalaan, dhicis mana keenaan.
english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

kikuyu: Dhallaankooda dibadday u baxshaan sidii adhi oo kale, Oo carruurtooduna way cayaaraan.
english: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

kikuyu: Waxay ku gabyaan daf iyo kataarad, Oo dhawaaqa biibiilaha way ku reyreeyaan.
english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

kikuyu: Cimrigooda waxay ku dhammaystaan barwaaqo, Oo dabadeedna daqiiqad ayay She'ool ku dhaadhacaan.
english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxay Ilaah ku yidhaahdeen, War naga tag, Waayo, dooni mayno aqoonta jidadkaaga.
english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

kikuyu: Waa maxay Ilaaha Qaadirka ah, oo aan u adeegayno? Balse maxaa faa'iido ah oo aannu ka helaynaa, haddaan isaga u tukanno?
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

kikuyu: Bal eeg, barwaaqadoodii gacantooda kuma jirto, Kuwa sharka ahna taladoodu way iga fog tahay.
english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

kikuyu: Immisa jeer baa laambadda kuwa sharka ah la demiyaa? Oo immisa jeer baa belaayo ku kor degtaa? Oo immisa jeer baa Ilaah isagoo cadhaysan xanuun u qaybiyaa?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

kikuyu: Oo ay sababtaas aawadeed u noqdaan sidii xaab dabayl ka horreeya, Iyo sidii buunshe uu duufaanu kaxeeyo?
english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad tidhaahdaan, Ilaah xumaantiisii wuxuu u kaydiyaa sharrowga carruurtiisa. Haddaba isagu sharrowga ha ugu abaalgudo si uu laftigiisu u ogaado aawadeed.
english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

kikuyu: Indhihiisu ha arkeen halligaaddiisa, Oo isagu ha cabbo Ilaaha Qaadirka ah cadhadiisa.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Waayo, waa maxay farxadda uu reerkiisa ka helo, Markii cimrigiisa dhexda laga gooyo?
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

kikuyu: Bal ma Ilaah baa wax la baraa? Maxaa yeelay, isagaa xukuma xataa kuwa sare.
english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

kikuyu: Mid baa dhinta isagoo xooggiisu ku dhan yahay, Oo istareexsan oo xasilloon,
english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

kikuyu: Oo aad u buuran, Oo dhuuxa lafihiisuna qoyan yahay.
english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

kikuyu: Oo mid kalena wuxuu ku dhintaa naf qadhaadh, Isagoo aan weligiis wanaag dhedhemin.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee isku si bay ciidda u dhex jiifsadaan, Oo dirxi baa korkooda daboola.
english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

kikuyu: Bal eega, anigu waan ogahay fikirradiinna, Iyo xeesha aad qaldan igu hindisaysaan.
english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad tidhaahdaan, War meeh gurigii amiirku? Oo meeday teendhadii sharrowgu ku dhex hoyan jiray?
english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

kikuyu: Miyeydaan weyddiin kuwa jidka mara? Oo miyeydaan garanayn calaamooyinkooda?
english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

kikuyu: Iyo in ninkii sharrow ah loo celiyey maalinta belaayada? Iyo in hore loogu sii kaxaynayo maalinta cadhada?
english: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

kikuyu: Bal yaa jidkiisa isaga hortiisa ugu caddayn doona? Oo bal yaa isaga ka abaalmarin doona wixii uu sameeyey?
english: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

kikuyu: Laakiinse isaga waxaa loo qaadi doonaa xabaasha, Oo qabrigiisa waa la ilaalin doonaa.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

kikuyu: Waxaa isaga u macaanaan doonta ciidda dooxada, Oo dadka oo dhammuna isagay soo daba kici doonaan, Sida kuwii aan tirada lahayn oo isagii ka horreeyeyba ay u dhinteen.
english: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal maxaad si aan waxba tarayn iigu qalbiqabowjinaysaan, Maxaa yeelay, jawaabihiinnii been oo keliya ayaa ku hadhay?
english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Eliifas oo ahaa reer Teemaan u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: Ma nin baa Ilaah wax u tari kara? Hubaal kii xigmad lahu isagaa wax isu tara.
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

kikuyu: Balse ma Ilaaha Qaadirka ah baa xaqnimadaada ku farxa? Mase faa'iido bay u tahay isaga inaad jidkaaga qummaatisid?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

kikuyu: War ma cabsidaada daraaddeed buu kuu canaantaa? Oo saas daraaddeed miyuu dacwad kuula galaa?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

kikuyu: Sow sharkaagu ma badna? Xumaatooyinkaagu dhammaad ma laha.
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

kikuyu: Waayo, sababla'aan baad walaalkaa rahaamad uga qaadatay, Oo kuwii arradnaana dharkoodii baad ka mudhuxsatay.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

kikuyu: Kii daallanaana ma aadan siin biyo uu cabbo, Oo kii gaajaysnaana cunto baad ka hagratay.
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ninkii xoog badnaa isagaa dhulka haystay; Oo ninkii sharaf lahaana isagaa dalka degganaa.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

kikuyu: Carmallada baad gacan madhnaan ku eriday, Oo agoonta gacmahoodiina waa la jebiyey.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaa hareerahaaga ku wareegsan dabinno, Oo waxaa ku dhibaya cabsi kedis ah,
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

kikuyu: Ama gudcur aadan waxba ku arki karin, Oo waxaa ku qariya biyo aad u badan.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

kikuyu: War sow Ilaah kuma jiro samada sare? Oo bal eega xiddigaha dheeraantooda iyo siday u sarreeyaan!
english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

kikuyu: Oo adna waxaad leedahay, War Ilaah muxuu yaqaan? Oo gudcurka qarada leh miyuu wax ku dhex xukumi karaa?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

kikuyu: Waxaa isaga ku wareegsan daruuro qaro waaweyn, si uusan wax u arag, Oo isagu wuxuu ku socdaa wareegga samada.
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

kikuyu: War ma waxaad doonaysaa inaad sii haysatid jidkii hore Ee sharrowyadu ku socon jireen?
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

kikuyu: Iyaba waxaa la dhufsaday wakhtigoodii ka hor, Oo aasaaskoodiina daad baa baabbi'iyey.
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

kikuyu: Waxay Ilaah ku yidhaahdeen, War naga tag, Bal maxaa Ilaaha Qaadirka ahu nagu samayn karaa?
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

kikuyu: Laakiin isagu wuxuu guryahooda ka buuxiyey waxyaalo wanwanaagsan; Talada sharrowguse way iga fog tahay.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ahu way arkaan oo way farxaan, Oo kuwa aan xaqa qabinuna way ku qoslaan oo ku majaajiloodaan,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

kikuyu: Waxayna yidhaahdaan, Sida xaqiiqada ah kuwii nagu kacay waa la baabbi'iyey, Oo kuwoodii hadhayna dab baa liqay.
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

kikuyu: Haddaba isaga la heshii, oo iska nabdoonow, Waayo, sidaasaa wanaag kuugu iman doonaa.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

kikuyu: Haddaba waan ku baryayaaye, sharciga afkiisa ka aqbal, Oo erayadiisana qalbigaaga geli.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

kikuyu: Waa lagu dhisi doonaa haddaad Ilaaha Qaadirka ah u noqotid, Oo aad xaqdarrada teendhooyinkaaga ka fogaysid.
english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

kikuyu: Khasnaddaada waxaad ku xoortaa ciidda, Oo dahabka Oofirna waxaad ku dhex tuurtaa dhagaxyada durdurka,
english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaaha Qaadirka ahuna wuxuu kuu noqon doonaa khasnad, Iyo lacag qiime badan.
english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaad Ilaaha Qaadirka ah ku farxi doontaa, Oo wejigaagana Ilaah baad kor ugu qaadi doontaa.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

kikuyu: Oo isagaad u tukan doontaa, oo isna wuu ku maqli doonaa, Oo adna waxaad bixin doontaa waxyaalihii aad nidartay.
english: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

kikuyu: Adiguna wax baad amri doontaa, oo waa laguu adkayn doonaa; Oo jidadkaaguna iftiin bay lahaan doonaan.
english: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

kikuyu: Markii hoos laguu tuuro, waxaad odhan doontaa, Waa lay sarraysiinayaa, Oo qofkii hooseeyana isagaa badbaadin doona.
english: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu samatabbixin doonaa kii aan xaq qabin; Hubaal isaga waxaa lagu samatabbixin doonaa nadiifsanaanta gacmahaaga.
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Xataa maantadan guryankayga cabashada ahu waa qadhaadh yahay, Oo gacanta i saaranuna waa ka sii daran tahay cabashadayda.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan ogaado meeshaan isaga ka heli karo, Si aan kursigiisa ugu imaado!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

kikuyu: Dacwadayda ayaan hortiisa ku diyaarin lahaa, Oo afkaygana hadallo dood ah baan ka buuxin lahaa.
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan ogaado erayada uu iigu jawaabayo, Oo aan garto bal waxa uu igu odhanayo.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

kikuyu: Ma wuxuu igula diriri lahaa xooggiisa badan? Maya, laakiinse wuu i maqli lahaa.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

kikuyu: Kii qummanu halkaasuu isaga kula xaajoon kari lahaa, Oo anna saasaan xaakinkayga uga samatabbixi lahaa weligayba.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

kikuyu: Bal eega, hore baan u socdaa, laakiinse isagu halkaas ma joogo, Oo dib baan u socdaa, laakiinse ma aan heli karo.
english: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan tagaa xagga bidix markuu shaqaynayo, laakiinse uma aan jeedi karo; Oo wuxuu ku dhuuntaa xagga midig laakiinse kama arki karo.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

kikuyu: Laakiinse wuu yaqaan jidkaan maro, Oo markuu i tijaabiyo waxaan u soo bixi doonaa sida dahab oo kale.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

kikuyu: Cagtaydu waxay ku adkaatay tallaabooyinkiisa, Jidkiisii waan xajiyey, oo dhanna ugama aan leexan.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

kikuyu: Dib ugama noqon amarkii bushimihiisa, Oo erayadii afkiisana waxaan u hayay wax ka qiimo badan cuntada aanan ka maarmin.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

kikuyu: Laakiinse wax qudha ayuu goostay, bal yaa ka leexin kara? Oo wixii naftiisu doonaysaba wuu sameeyaa.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu oofiyaa wixii la ii amray, Oo waxyaalo badan oo saasoo kale ah ayuu maankiisa ku hayaa.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ayaan hortiisa uga naxaa, Oo markaan ka fikiraba waan ka baqaa isaga.
english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah ayaa qalbigayga itaal darreeyey, Oo Ilaaha Qaadirka ah ayaa iga nixiyey,
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, gudcurka hortiis layma baabbi'in, Oo gudcurkii qarada lahaana wejigayga kama uu daboolin.
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

kikuyu: Ilaaha Qaadirka ahu muxuu wakhtiyo u kaydin waayaa? Kuwa isaga yaqaanse maxay maalmihiisa u arki waayaan?
english: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

kikuyu: Waxaa jira kuwa soohdinta dalka durkiya, Oo waxay xoog ku dhacaan adhyo, kolkaasay daajiyaan.
english: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

kikuyu: Oo waxay iska kaxaystaan dameerka agoonta, Oo waxay rahaamad u qaataan naag carmal ah dibigeed.
english: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

kikuyu: Saboolka baahan ayay jidka ka leexiyaan, Oo masaakiinta dhulkana dhammaantood way wada dhuuntaan.
english: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, sida dameerdibadeedyo lamadegaanka jooga Ayay shuqulkooda ugu baxaan, iyagoo cunto aad u doonaya; Cidladuna carruurtooda cuntay u soo bixisaa.
english: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

kikuyu: Cuntadooda waxay ka goostaan berrinka, Oo waxay xaabxaabaan canabka kuwa sharrowyada ah.
english: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

kikuyu: Oo habeenkii oo dhan iyagoo qaawan oo aan dhar lahayn ayay jiifsadaan, Oo dhaxanta waxay ka huwadaanna ma leh.
english: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

kikuyu: Waxaa iyaga qoya roobka buuraha, Oo gabbaadla'aan daraaddeed ayay dhagaxa u dugsadaan.
english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira kuwa agoonta naaska ka dhufsada, Oo masaakiintana rahaamad ka qaata,
english: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxay warwareegaan iyagoo qaawan oo aan dhar qabin, Oo iyagoo gaajaysan ayay xidhmooyinka sidaan.
english: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

kikuyu: Waxay saliid ku sameeyaan nimankaas derbiyadooda gudahooda, Macsarooyinkoodana way tuntaan, iyagoo harraadsan.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

kikuyu: Dadku magaalooyinka way ka cabaadaan, Oo nafta kuwa dhaawacanuna way qaylisaa, Laakiinse Ilaah nacasnimadaa ma fiiriyo.
english: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waxay ka mid yihiin kuwa nuurka ku caasiyooba, Oo jidadkiisa ma ay yaqaaniin, Oo dhabbayaashiisana ma ay sii hayaan.
english: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

kikuyu: Gacankudhiigluhu kaaha waaberi wuu la soo kacaa, oo wuxuu dilaa miskiinka iyo saboolka baahan, Oo habeenkiina isagu waa sida tuug oo kale.
english: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

kikuyu: Oo isha dhillayguna waxay sugtaa fiidka, Oo wuxuu isyidhaahdaa, Ninna ima arki doono, Oo wuu hagoogtaa.
