english: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

kikuyu: Oo goor gudcur ah ayay guryaha dhacaan, Oo maalinnimadana meel bay isku xidhaan, Oo iftiinka maba yaqaaniin.
english: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

kikuyu: Waayo, subaxnimadu dhammaantood waxay u tahay sida hooska dhimashada, Maxaa yeelay, waxay yaqaaniin cabsida hooska dhimashada.
english: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

kikuyu: Isagu biyaha dushooda wuu ku dheereeyaa, Qaybtoodii dhulkaa lagu habaaray, Isagu uma leexdo xagga jidka beeraha canabka ah.
english: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

kikuyu: Biyaha barafka waxaa dhammaysta abaar iyo kulayl, Oo sidaasoo kalaa She'oolna u galaa kuwii dembaabay.
english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

kikuyu: Uurkii hooyadiis waa illoobi doonaa isaga; jidhkiisana waxaa cuni doona oo macaansan doona dirxiga, Oo mar dambena isaga lama xusuusan doono, Oo kii xaqdaranuna wuxuu u jabi doonaa sida geed oo kale.
english: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu baabbi'iyaa madhashada aan carruurta dhalin; Oo carmalkana wax wanaagsan uma sameeyo.
english: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

kikuyu: Oo weliba kii xoog badanna itaalkiisuu ku jiidaa; Oo markuu kacana nafta waa laga rajo beelaa.
english: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu iyaga siiyaa meel ammaan ah, oo halkaasay isku halleeyaan, Jidadkoodana ishuu ku hayaa.
english: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

kikuyu: Iyaga waa la sarraysiiyaa, laakiin in yar dabadeed way wada baabba'aan; Hubaal iyaga waa la hoosaysiiyaa, oo jidka ayaa looga tuuraa sida kuwa kale oo dhan, Oo waxaa loo jaraa sida sabuul hadhuudh oo kale.
english: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

kikuyu: Oo haddayan saas ahayn, yaa igu caddayn kara inaan beenlow ahay, Oo hadalkaygase yaa ka dhigi kara wax aan waxtar lahayn?
english: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bildad oo ahaa reer Shuuxii u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: Dowladnimo iyo cabsiba isagaa leh, Oo meelihiisa sarena nabad buu ka dhigaa.
english: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

kikuyu: Ciidammadiisu ma tiray leeyihiin? Oo yuu yahay kan aan iftiinkiisu ku soo bixin?
english: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

kikuyu: Balse sidee baa nin u kari karaa inuu Ilaah hortiisa xaq ku ahaado? Mid naagu dhashayse sidee buu u karaa inuu nadiif ahaado?
english: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, xataa dayuxu hortiisa nuur kuma leh, Oo xiddiguhuna hortiisa daahir kuma aha.
english: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

kikuyu: Intee buu ka sii liitaa nin dirxi ahu! Iyo binu-aadmiga dirxiga ahu!
english: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: Sidee baad u caawisay midka aan itaalka lahayn! Oo kan ayan gacantiisu xoogga lahayn sidee baad u badbaadisay!
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

kikuyu: Sidee baad ula talisay kan aan xigmadda lahayn! Oo aad u muujisay aqoon wanaagsan!
english: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

kikuyu: Yaad erayo kula hadashay? Oo yaa ruuxiisu xaggaaga ka soo baxay?
english: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

kikuyu: Kuwii dhintayna way ku hoos gariiraan Biyaha iyo waxyaalaha dhex deggan.
english: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

kikuyu: She'ool hortiisuu yaal isagoo qaawan, Oo Halligaadduna dabool ma leh.
english: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

kikuyu: Isagu woqooyiga wuxuu ku kala bixiyaa meel madhan, Oo dhulkana wuxuu ka laalaadshaa wax aan waxba ahayn.
english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

kikuyu: Biyaha wuxuu ku xidhaa daruurihiisa qarada waaweyn; Oo daruurtuna hoostooda kama dillaacdo.
english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

kikuyu: Wuxuu xidhaa wejiga carshigiisa, Oo daruurtiisana wuu ku kala bixiyaa.
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

kikuyu: Biyaha dushooda wuxuu ku wareejiyey soohdin Kala xidha nuurka iyo gudcurka.
english: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

kikuyu: Tiirarka samadu way gariiraan, Oo waxay ka yaabaan canaantiisa.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

kikuyu: Badda ayuu xooggiisa ku aamusiiyaa, Oo kibirkana waxgarashadiisuu ku dhuftaa.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

kikuyu: Samooyinka waxaa lagu sharraxay Ruuxiisa, Gacantiisuna waxay mudday abeesada dheeraysa.
english: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxanu waa darafyadii jidadkiisa uun; Oo inta isaga laga maqlaana yaraan badanaa! Laakiinse bal yaa onkodka xooggiisa garan kara?
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

kikuyu: Oo haddana Ayuub ayaa hadalkiisii sii waday, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

kikuyu: Waxaan ku dhaartay Ilaaha nool oo xaqayga iga qaaday, Kaasoo ah Ilaaha Qaadirka ah oo naftayda dhibay;
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

kikuyu: (Waayo, naftaydii weli waa igu jirtaa, Oo ruuxii Ilaahna weli wuxuu ku jiraa sankayga labadiisa dul.)
english: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

kikuyu: Hubaal bushimahaygu xaqdarro ku hadli maayaan, Oo carrabkayguna khiyaano sheegi maayo.
english: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

kikuyu: Ilaah ha iga fogeeyo inaan xaq idinka dhigo, Jeeraan dhinto daacadnimadayda iska tuuri maayo.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

kikuyu: Xaqnimadayda waan xajisanayaa, oo iska sii dayn maayo, Oo qalbigaygu i ceebayn maayo intaan noolahay oo dhan.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

kikuyu: Cadowgaygu sida sharrow ha noqdo, Oo kii igu kacaana sida mid xaqdaran ha noqdo.
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

kikuyu: In kastoo uu faa'iido helo, cibaadalaawaha rajadiisu waa maxay, Markii Ilaah naftiisa qaado?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

kikuyu: Ilaah miyuu qayladiisa maqli doonaa, Markii dhib ku yimaado?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

kikuyu: Miyuu Ilaaha Qaadirka ah ku farxi doonaa? Oo miyuu goor kasta Ilaah baryi doonaa?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

kikuyu: Waxaan idin barayaa wax gacanta Ilaah ku saabsan, Oo waxa Ilaaha Qaadirka ah la jirana idinka qarin maayo.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

kikuyu: Bal eega, idinku kulligiin waad aragteen, Haddaba bal maxaad dhammaantiin nacasyo u wada noqoteen?
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

kikuyu: Intanu waa qaybta uu Ilaah ninkii sharrow ah u kaydiyo, Iyo dhaxalka kuwa dadka dulma ay Ilaaha Qaadirka ah ka helaan.
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

kikuyu: Carruurtiisu hadday tarmaan, kolleyba waxaa dili doonta seef, Oo carruurtiisuna cunto kama dhergi doonaan.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: Kuwii isaga ka hadhana dhimashaa xabaali doonta, Oo carmalladiisuna uma ay barooran doonaan.
english: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

kikuyu: In kastoo uu lacag u taalaysto sida ciidda oo kale, Oo uu dharna u diyaarsado sida dhoobada oo kale,
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

kikuyu: Isagaa diyaarin doona, laakiinse waxaa xidhan doona kan xaqa ah, Oo lacagtana waxaa qaybsan doona kan aan xaqa qabin.
english: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

kikuyu: Gurigiisa wuxuu u dhisaa sida buul caaro oo kale, Iyo sida waab waardiye samaysto.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

kikuyu: Isagoo taajir ah ayuu seexdaa, laakiinse lama soo ururin doono, Indhihiisuu kala qaadaa, oo waxba ma jiro.
english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

kikuyu: Naxdin baa isaga qarqin doonta sida biyo daad ah, Oo habeenkiina waxaa isaga la tegi doona duufaan.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

kikuyu: Waxaa isaga kaxaysa dabaysha bari, oo isna wuu tagaa, Oo meeshiisana way ka xaaqdaa.
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah baa isaga wax ku tuuri doona, umana tudhi doono; Oo sharrowgu wuxuu jeclaan lahaa inuu gacantiisa ka cararo.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

kikuyu: Dadku way ku sacbin doonaan isaga, Oo meeshiisana foodhi bay kaga saari doonaan.
english: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

kikuyu: Hubaal lacagtu waxay leedahay god laga qodo, Oo dahabkuna wuxuu leeyahay meel lagu safeeyo.
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

kikuyu: Birta waxaa laga soo bixiyaa ciidda, Oo naxaastana waxaa laga dhalaaliyaa dhagaxa.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

kikuyu: Dadku gudcurkuu dhammeeyaa, Oo tan iyo soohdinta ugu shishaysana waxay baadhaan Dhagaxyada ku jira gudcurka qarada leh iyo hooska dhimashada.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

kikuyu: Isagu god dheer ayuu ka qodaa meel ka fog meesha dadku deggan yahay. Iyaga waxaa illooba qofka ag mara; Oo waxay ka laallaadaan meel dadka ka fog, oo hor iyo dib bay u ruxmadaan.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

kikuyu: Cuntadu dhulkay ka soo baxdaa, Oo dhankiisa hoosena wuu rogmadaa sida wax dabku rogo oo kale.
english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

kikuyu: Dhagaxyadiisu waa meeshii dhagaxyo safayr ah, Wuxuuna leeyahay dahab boodh ah.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

kikuyu: Wadiiqadaas haadka adagu ma yaqaan, Oo gorgorka ishiisuna ma ay arag,
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

kikuyu: Bahallada kibirka lahu kuma ay joogsan, Oo libaaxa cadhaysanina ma uu ag marin.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

kikuyu: Isagu gacantiisuu soo fidiyaa oo wuxuu saaraa dhagaxa adag, Oo buurahana wuu afgembiyaa oo xididdaduu ku rujiyaa.
english: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

kikuyu: Dhagaxyada dhexdooda wuxuu ka jeexaa keliyo, Oo ishiisuna wax kasta oo qaali ah way aragtaa.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

kikuyu: Wuxuu xidhaa durdurrada si ayan u dareerin, Oo waxa qarsoonna wuxuu u soo bannaan bixiyaa iftiinka.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waa xaggee meesha xigmadda laga helaa? Oo waxgarashada meesheeduse waa xaggee?
english: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

kikuyu: Dadku qiimaheeda ma yaqaan, Oo kuwa nool dalkoodana lagama helo.
english: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Moolku wuxuu leeyahay, Iguma jirto, Badduna waxay leedahay, Aniga ilama jirto.
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

kikuyu: Dahab laguma heli karo, Lacagna looma miisaamo.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

kikuyu: Laguma qiimayn karo dahabka Oofir, Ama dhagaxa qaaliga ah oo onika la yidhaahdo ama xataa dhagaxa safayr la yidhaahdo.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

kikuyu: Dahab iyo madarad toona uma qalmi karaan, Oo beddelkeeduna ma noqon karo jawhar laga sameeyo dahab saafi ah.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

kikuyu: Waxba lagama sheegi doono dhagax cas oo raamood la yidhaahdo, amase madarad, Hubaal xigmadda qiimaheedu waa ka sii sarreeyaa luul.
english: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

kikuyu: Dhagaxa tobasiyos la yidhaahdo ee Itoobiya ka yimaadana uma qalmi doono, Oo xataa dahab saafi ahna laguma qiimayn doono.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

kikuyu: Haddaba xigmaddu xaggee bay ka timaadaa? Oo waxgarashada meesheeduse waa xaggee?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, way ka qarsoon tahay kuwa nool indhahooda, Oo haadka hawadana waa laga deday.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Halligaadda iyo Dhimashadu waxay leeyihiin, Dhegahayaga ayaannu warkeeda ku maqalnay.
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

kikuyu: Ilaah ayaa jidkeeda garanaya, Oo isagaa meesheeda yaqaan.
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu fiiriyaa dunida darfaheeda, Oo wuxuu u jeedaa inta samada ka hoosaysa oo dhan,
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

kikuyu: Markuu dabaysha miisaamo, Oo uu biyahana qiyaaso.
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

kikuyu: Markuu roobka qaynuun u sameeyey, Oo uu hillaaca onkodkana jid u sameeyey,
english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

kikuyu: Ayuu arkay, oo ka hadlay, Oo intuu adkeeyey ayuu weliba baadhay.
english: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dadka ku yidhi, Bal eega, Sayidka ka cabsashadiisa ayaa xigmad ah, Oo in sharka laga fogaadona waa waxgarasho.
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

kikuyu: Oo haddana Ayuub hadalkiisuu sii waday, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan ahaado sidii waayihii hore, Iyo sidii aan ahaan jiray markii Ilaah i dhawri jiray,
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

kikuyu: Markay laambaddiisu madaxayga ku ifin jirtay, Oo aan nuurkiisa gudcurka ku dhex mari jiray,
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

kikuyu: Markii aan xoog lahaan jiray, Oo qarsoodiga Ilaahna teendhadayda saarnaan jiray,
english: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

kikuyu: Markii Ilaaha Qaadirka ahu ila jiri jiray, Oo carruurtayduna ay hareerahayga joogi jireen,
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

kikuyu: Markay tallaabooyinkaygu subagga la barwaaqoobi jireen, Oo ay webiyaasha saliidda ahu dhagaxa iiga soo shubmi jireen!
english: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

kikuyu: Markaan magaalada iriddeeda u bixi jiray, Oo aan kursigayga meel bannaan ku diyaarin jiray.
english: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

kikuyu: Dhallinyaradu intay i arkaan ayay dhuuman jireen, Oo odayaashuna intay sara joogsadaan ayay istaagi jireen,
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

kikuyu: Amiirraduna intay hadalka joojiyaan, Ayay afka gacanta saari jireen.
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

kikuyu: Ragga gobta ahuna way aamusi jireen, Oo carrabkoodiina dhabxanagguu ku dhegi jiray.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

kikuyu: Waayo, markii dhegu i maqasho, way ii ducayn jirtay, Oo iluna markay i aragto, way ii marag furi jirtay.
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, waxaan samatabbixin jiray miskiinka qaylinaya, Iyo weliba agoonka aan wax u kaalmeeya lahayn.
english: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

kikuyu: Ka halligaadda ku dhow ducadiisa ayaa igu soo degi jirtay, Oo ta carmalka ahna qalbigeeda waan ka farxin jiray ilaa ay gabay la rayrayso.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

kikuyu: Waxaan huwan jiray xaqnimo, oo iyana dhar bay ii noqon jirtay, Oo caddaaladdayduna waxay ii ahaan jirtay sida khamiis iyo cimaamad oo kale.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

kikuyu: Kuwa indhaha la' indho baan u ahaan jiray, Kuwa curyaanka ahna cago baan u ahaan jiray.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

kikuyu: Aabbaan u ahaan jiray saboolka baahan, Oo ka aanan aqoonna xaalkiisa waan baadhi jiray.
english: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Ka xaqa daran daamankiisa waan jebin jiray, Oo wixii uu dhufsadana ilkihiisaan ka soo bixin jiray.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

kikuyu: Markaasaan is-idhi, Buulkaygaan ku dhex dhiman doonaa, Oo cimrigayguna wuxuu u badan doonaa sida cammuudda oo kale.
english: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

kikuyu: Xididkaygu biyaha xaggooduu u faafayaa, Oo laamahaygana habeenkii oo dhan waxaa saaran sayax.
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

kikuyu: Sharaftaydu way igu cusub tahay, Oo qaansadayduna gacantayday ku cusboonaatay.
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

kikuyu: Dadku dhegtuu ii dhigi jiray, oo i sugi jiray, Oo taladayda aawadeedna way u aamusi jireen.
english: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

kikuyu: Weligood igama ay daba hadlin, Oo hadalkayguna korkooduu ku soo dhibci jiray.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ii dhawri jireen sidii roobka oo kale, Oo waxay afkooda u kala furi jireen sidii roobka dambe loo sugo.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

kikuyu: Waan u af caddayn jiray markay qalbi jabaan, Oo nuurkii jaahaygana hoos uma ay tuuri jirin.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

kikuyu: Waxaan dooran jiray jidkooda, oo sida nin madax ah ayaan u fadhiisan jiray, Oo waxaan u dhaqmi jiray sidii boqor ciidan dhex fadhiya, Iyo sidii mid u tacsiyeeya kuwa baroorta.
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan waxaa igu majaajilooda kuwa iga da' yar Oo aan aabbayaashood quudhsan jiray inay xataa la fadhiistaan eeyaha adhigayga.
english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

kikuyu: Nimanka xooggoodu dhammaaday Itaalka gacmahoodu muxuu ii tarayaa?
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

kikuyu: Waxay la weydoobeen baahi iyo abaar, Oo waxay u cararaan dhul engegan, kaasoo ah lamadegaan gudcur iyo cidlo ah.
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

kikuyu: Waxay gurtaan geed cusbeed oo kaynta ku yaal, Oo cuntadooduna waxa weeye geed rotem la yidhaahdo xididdadiisa.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

kikuyu: Iyaga dadka waa laga dhex eryaa, Oo waxaa looga daba qayliyaa sida tuug looga daba qayliyo oo kale.
english: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

kikuyu: Waa inay ku hoydaan haadaamaha dooxooyinka, Iyo boholaha dhulka iyo dhagaxyada dhexdooda.
english: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

kikuyu: Waxay ka qayliyaan kaynta dhexdeeda, Oo waxay dhammaantood ku soo ururaan maraboob hoosteed.
english: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

kikuyu: Iyagu waa nacasyo iyo ceebaalowyo carruurtood, Oo dhulka waxaa lagaga saaray karbaash.
english: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

kikuyu: Oo haatan gabay cay ah baan u noqday, Oo halqabsi baan u ahay.
english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

kikuyu: Way i karahsadaan, oo meel fog bay iga istaagaan, Oo inay candhuufo wejiga iiga tufaanna iskama ay qabtaan.
english: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa xadhiggaygii debciyey, wuuna i dhibay, Oo taas aawadeed iyagu hortayda iskuma celiyaan.
english: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

kikuyu: Xagga midigtayda waxaa ka kaca ciyaalasuuq, Oo cagtaydana way iska riixaan, Oo waxay igu hor tuuraan jidadkoodii halligaadda.
english: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

kikuyu: Jidadkayga way halleeyaan, Oo waxay soo deddejiyaan masiibadayda; Oo mid caawiyaana ma jiro.
english: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

kikuyu: Jabniin ballaadhan ayay ka soo dusaan, Oo burburka dhexdiisa ayay igaga soo dhacaan.
english: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

kikuyu: Waxaa igu soo jeesta cabsi weyn, Oo sharaftayda waxaa loo kaxeeyaa sida dabayshu wax u kaxayso oo kale. Barwaaqadaydiina waxay u dhammaatay sidii daruur oo kale.
english: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

kikuyu: Haddaba naftaydaa igu dhex daadatay, Oo waxaan la kulmay wakhti dhibaato badan.
english: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

kikuyu: Habeenkii lafahaygaa i muda, Oo xanuunka i cunayaana ima daayo innaba.
english: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

kikuyu: Xoogga weyn oo cudurkayga daraaddiis ayaa dharkaygii ku xumaaday, Oo wuxuu iigu cidhiidhisan yahay sidii jubbaddayda qoorteeda.
english: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu igu tuuray dhoobada dhexdeeda, Oo waxaan noqday sidii boodh iyo dambas oo kale.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

kikuyu: Anigu waan kuu qayshadaa, adiguse iima aad jawaabtid, Waan ku soo hor istaagaa, adiguse ima aad aragtid.
english: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

kikuyu: Calooladeeg baad igula soo jeesatay, Oo gacantaada itaalkeeda ayaad igu silcisaa.
english: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

kikuyu: Kor baad iigu qaaddaa dabaysha, Oo waxaad i fuushisaa dusheeda, Oo haddana waxaad igu baabbi'isaa duufaanka.
english: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

kikuyu: Waayo, waan ogahay inaad ii kaxaynaysid dhimasho, Iyo guriga inta nool oo dhammu ku wada kulmayaan.
english: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ninkii hoos u dhacaya sow gacantiisa sooma fidiyo? Markuu halligmayose sow ma qayshado?
english: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

kikuyu: Oo ninka dhibaataysan anigu sow uma ooyi jirin? Naftayduse sow masaakiinta uma murugoon jirin?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

kikuyu: Laakiinse markaan wanaagga filanayo waxaa ii iman jiray xumaanta, Oo markaan nuurka sugana waxaa ii iman jiray gudcurka.
english: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

kikuyu: Qalbigaygu welwel buu la kacsan yahay, mana nasto, Oo waxaan la kulmay wakhti dhibaato badan.
english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

kikuyu: Anigoo barooranaya ayaan qorraxda la'aanteed socdaa, Waxaan ka dhex istaagaa shirka, oo caawimaad waan u qayshadaa.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

kikuyu: Waxaan noqday walaalka dawacooyinka, Iyo saaxiibka gorayada.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

kikuyu: Dubkaygu intuu gubto ayuu iska diirmaa, Oo lafahayguna kulayl bay ku gubtaan.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kataaradaydii waxay u rogmatay baroorasho, Oo biibiilahaygiina wuxuu u rogmaday kuwa ooya codkooda.
english: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

kikuyu: Waxaan axdi la dhigtay indhahayga, Haddaba bal sidee baan gabadh u fiirinayaa?
english: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

kikuyu: Waayo, waa maxay qaybta laga helo Ilaaha xagga sare jooga, Iyo dhaxalka laga helo Ilaaha Qaadirka ah oo sarreeya?
english: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

kikuyu: Sow belaayo uma aha kuwa xaqa daran, Iyo masiibo kuwa xumaanta ka shaqeeya?
english: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

kikuyu: Isagu sow uma jeedin socodkayga oo dhan? Oo sow ma tirinin tallaabooyinkayga oo dhan?
english: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

kikuyu: Haddaan hawo been ah ku socday, Oo ay cagtaydu khiyaano u dheeraysay,
english: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

kikuyu: (Ha laygu miisaamo miisaan siman, Si Ilaah ku ogaado daacadnimadayda, )
english: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

kikuyu: Haddii tallaabadaydu jidka gees uga leexatay, Oo qalbigaygu uu indhahayga raacay, Iyo haddii ay bar ceeb ahu gacmahayga ku dhegtay,
english: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

kikuyu: Markaas anigu aan wax beero, oo mid kale ha cuno, Oo xataa waxa beertayda ka soo baxa ha la wada rujiyo.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

kikuyu: Haddii qalbigayga ay naagu sasabatay, Oo aan albaabka deriskayga ku ag dhuuntay,
english: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

kikuyu: Markaas naagtaydu nin kale wax ha u shiiddo, Oo kuwa kale ha ku kor foororsadeen iyada.
english: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

kikuyu: Waayo, kaasu waa dembi baas, Oo waa xumaan ay xaakinnadu ciqaabi lahaayeen,
english: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

kikuyu: Waayo, kaasu waa dab wax dhammeeya ilaa uu baabbi'iyo, Oo waxa ii soo baxa oo dhan wuu wada rujin lahaa.
english: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

kikuyu: Haddaan addoonkayga ama addoontayda dacwadooda quudhsaday, Markay ila mudacayeen,
english: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

kikuyu: Haddaba bal maxaan samayn doonaa markii Ilaah sara joogsado? Oo markuu i soo booqdose bal maxaan ugu jawaabi doonaa?
english: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

kikuyu: Kii uurka dhexdiisa igu abuuray sow isagana ma abuurin? Oo sow uurka nalaguma dhex samayn?
english: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

kikuyu: Haddaan miskiin u diiday wax uu doonayay, Ama aan indhaha carmalka illin ka keenay,
english: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

kikuyu: Amase haddaan quudkayga keligay cunay, Oo ayan agoontu wax ka cunin,
english: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

kikuyu: (Saas ma aha, laakiinse isaga tan iyo yaraantaydii waan koriyey sidii mid aabbihiis koriyo oo kale, Oo tan iyo markaan uurkii hooyaday ka soo baxayna waxaan iyada u ahaan jiray horseed, )
english: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

kikuyu: Haddaan arkay qof arrad daraaddiis u dhimanaya, Amase sabool baahan oo aan dhar haysan,
english: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

kikuyu: Hadduusan uurka iiga ducayn, Amase hadduusan isku kululayn dhogorta idahayga,
english: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

kikuyu: Caawimaaddaydii oo aan iridda uga jeeday daraaddeed, Haddaan agoon gacantayda u qaaday,
english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

kikuyu: Markaas garabkaygu ha kala fakado, Oo gacantayduna kalagooyska ha ka jabto.
english: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

kikuyu: Waayo, masiibo xag Ilaah ka timid ayaa i cabsiisay, Oo sarraysnaantiisa daraaddeedna anigu waxba ma aanan samayn karin.
english: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

kikuyu: Haddaan dahab rajo ka dhigtay, Oo aan dahabka saafiga ah ku idhi, Kalsoonidayda baad tahay,
english: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

kikuyu: Haddaan ku reyreeyey maalkayga badan daraaddiis, Iyo waxyaalaha badan oo gacantaydu heshay daraaddood,
english: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

kikuyu: Haddaan fiiriyey qorraxda oo dhalaalaysa, Ama dayaxa oo iftiin ku socda,
english: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

kikuyu: Oo markaas qalbigayga haddii qarsoodi loo sasabtay, Oo anoo caabudaya aan afkayga gacanta ugu dhunkaday,
english: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

kikuyu: Kaasu weliba waa dembi ay xaakinnadii ciqaabi lahaayeen, Waayo, waxaan daacadlaawe u ahaan lahaa Ilaaha wax walba ka sarreeya.
english: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

kikuyu: Haddaan ku reyreeyey kan i neceb halligaaddiisa, Ama aan aad u farxay markii belaayadu isaga heshay,
english: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

kikuyu: (Afkayga uma aanan oggolaan inuu ku dembaabo Naftiisa oo aan habaar u weyddiisto;)
english: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

kikuyu: Dadka teendhadayda jooga haddayan isku odhan, Yaa heli kara mid aan hilibkiisa ka dhergin?
english: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

kikuyu: Shisheeyuhu jidka kuma baryi jirin, Laakiinse socotada ayaan albaabbadayda u furi jiray,
english: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

kikuyu: Haddaan xadgudubkaygii daboolay sidii binu-aadmiga oo kale, Anigoo xumaantayda laabtayda ku qarinaya,
english: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, dadka badan waan ka baqay, Oo quudhsiga qaraabaday ayaa i cabsiiyey, Oo saas aawadeed ayaan ku aamusay, oo dibadda uma bixin.
english: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

kikuyu: Hoogaye haddaan lahaan lahaa mid i maqla! (Bal eeg, waa tan calaamaddaydii, haddaba Ilaaha Qaadirka ahu ha ii jawaabo;) Yaa i siinaya eedayntii uu cadowgaygu iga qoray!
english: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

kikuyu: Sida xaqiiqada ah garabkaygaan ku qaadan lahaa, Oo weliba madaxaan ku xidhan lahaa sidii taaj oo kale.
english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan isaga u sheegi lahaa tirada tallaabooyinkaygu inta ay tahay; Oo waxaan isaga ugu soo dhowaan lahaa sidii amiir oo kale.
english: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

kikuyu: Haddii dalkaygu uu iga qayliyo, Oo jeexjeexiisu ay dhammaantood wada ooyaan,
english: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

kikuyu: Haddaan midhihiisa lacagla'aan ku cunay, Ama aan sabab u noqday in kuwii lahaa ay dhintaan,
english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

kikuyu: Sarreenka meeshiisii yamaarug ha ka soo baxo, Oo shiciirka meeshiisiina gocondho ha ka soo baxdo. Ayuub erayadiisii way dhammaadeen.
english: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

kikuyu: Markaasay saddexdaas nin iska daayeen inay Ayuub u jawaabaan, maxaa yeelay, isagu xaq buu isla ahaa.
english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa cadhooday Eliihuu ina Barakeel oo ahaa reer Buus oo qoladiisu ahayd reer Raam, oo aad buu Ayuub ugu xanaaqay, maxaa yeelay, isagu xaq buu isu qaatay intuu Ilaah xaq u qaadan lahaa.
english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu aad ugu cadhooday saddexdiisii saaxiib, maxaa yeelay, iyagu jawaab ma ay helin, ee weliba Ayuub way xukumeen.
english: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

kikuyu: Haddaba Eliihuu inuu Ayuub la hadlo ayuu sugayay, maxaa yeelay, iyagu isaga way ka waaweynaayeen.
english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

kikuyu: Oo Eliihuu markuu arkay inaan jawaab afka saddexdaas nin lagu arag ayuu aad u cadhooday.
english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

kikuyu: Oo Eliihuu ina Barakeel oo ahaa reer Buus ayaa jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay nin dhallinyar, idinkuse odayaal baad tihiin, Sidaas daraaddeed ayaan dib isugu celiyey, oo aan ugu dhici waayay inaan ra'yigayga idiin caddeeyo.
english: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

kikuyu: Waxaan is-idhi, Waxaa roon kuwa da'da waaweynu inay hadlaan, Kuwa cimriga dheeruna inay xigmad na baraan.
english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

kikuyu: Laakiinse binu-aadmiga ruux baa ku jira, Oo Ilaaha Qaadirka ah neeftiisa ayaa iyaga waxgarasho siisa.
english: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

kikuyu: Kuwa cimriga weynu ma aha kuwa xigmadda leh, Odayaashuna ma aha kuwa garsooridda garta.
english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaan idin leeyahay, Bal i dhegaysta; Aniguna ra'yigayga waan idiin caddaynayaa.
english: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

kikuyu: Bal eega, erayadiinnii waan sugayay, Oo xigmaddiinniina waan dhegaysanayay, Intaad baadhbaadhayseen wixii aad odhan lahaydeen.
english: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

kikuyu: Sida runta ah aad baan idiin dhegaysanayay, Oo bal eega, laydinkuma arag mid Ayuub rumaysiiyey, Amase mid erayadiisii uga jawaabay.
english: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

kikuyu: Isjira inaydaan odhan, Annagu xigmad waannu helnay; Ilaah baa isaga ka adkaan kara, laakiinse dadi ma kari karo.
english: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu erayadiisii iguma uu soo jeedin, Oo anigu hadalladiinnii isaga ugu jawaabi maayo.
english: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

kikuyu: Iyagii way yaabsan yihiin, oo mar dambena ma ay jawaabaan; Oo wax ay ku yidhaahdaanna ma leh.
english: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

kikuyu: Haddaba anigu miyaan u sii sugaa, hadalka ay waayeen daraaddiis, Iyo istaagiddooda daraaddeed, oo ay mar dambe jawaabi waayeen?
english: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

kikuyu: Haddaba aniguna qaybtayda waan ka jawaabayaa, Oo ra'yigaygana waan caddaynayaa.
english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa iga buuxa erayo; Oo ruuxa gudahayga ku jira ayaa i qasba.
english: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

kikuyu: Bal eega, calooshaydu waa sidii khamri sibraar ku jirta oo aan lahayn meelay ka neefsato, Xataa sidii sibraarro ku dhow inay qarxaan.
english: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

kikuyu: Anigu waan hadli doonaa, si aan u qalbi qabowsado; Oo bushimahayga waan kala qaadi doonaa, waanan jawaabi doonaa.
english: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

kikuyu: Waan idin baryayaaye, yaanan ninna u eexan, Oo weliba ninna u bixin maayo magacyo faanid ah.
english: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu ma aan aqaan si loo bixiyo magacyo faanid ah, Haddii kalese Kii i sameeyey ayaa haddiiba i qaadi lahaa.
english: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

kikuyu: Habase ahaatee, Ayuubow, waan ku baryayaaye, hadalkayga maqal, Oo erayadayda oo dhanna dhegta u dhig.
english: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

kikuyu: Bal eeg haatan, afkaygaan furay, Oo carrabkaygu wuxuu ku dhex hadlay afkayga.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

kikuyu: Erayadaydu waxay sheegi doonaan qummanaanta qalbigayga, Oo bushimahayguna wixii ay yaqaaniin si daacad ah ayay ugu hadli doonaan.
english: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

kikuyu: Waxaa i sameeyey Ruuxa Ilaah, Oo waxaa i noolaysa Ilaaha Qaadirka ah neeftiisa.
english: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaad kartid ii jawaab, Oo hortayda erayada si hagaagsan ugu sheeg oo istaag.
english: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, aniguba xag Ilaah waxaan ahay sidaada oo kale; Oo anigana waxaa layga uumay dhoobo.
english: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, nixintaydu kuma cabsiin doonto, Oo gacantayduna kuguma cuslaan doonto.
english: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

kikuyu: Sida xaqiiqada ah dhegahaygaad ku hadashay, Waanan maqlay codkii erayadaada oo leh,
english: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

kikuyu: Anigu nadiif baan ahay, oo xadgudubna ma lihi, Xaq ma qabo, oo xumaanuna iguma jirto innaba.
english: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, sabab uu igu eedeeyo ayuu iga helaa, Oo wuxuu igu tiriyaa inaan cadowgiisa ahay;
english: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

kikuyu: Cagahayga wuxuu geliyaa jeebbooyin, Oo jidadkayga oo dhanna wuu wada fiiriyaa.
english: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waan kuu jawaabi doonaa, haddaba waxan xaq kuma tihid, Waayo, Ilaah baa binu-aadmiga ka sii weyn.
english: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

kikuyu: Haddaba maxaad isaga ula asaraartantaa? Waayo, isagu axwaalkiisa midnaba jawaab kama baxsho.
english: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah wuxuu hadlaa mar, Ama laba jeer, in kastoo aan laga fiirsanayn.
english: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

kikuyu: Riyada iyo muujinta habeennimo, Markii hurdo weynu dadka ku soo degto, Oo sariirta lagu gam'o,
english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

kikuyu: Markaasuu dhegaha binu-aadmiga furaa, Oo waxa iyaga lagu waaniyey ayuu xaqiijiyaa,
english: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

kikuyu: Si uu dadka uga soo celiyo qasdigooda xun, Oo uu binu-aadmiga kibir uga qariyo,
english: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

kikuyu: Oo naftiisana wuxuu dib uga hayaa yamayska, Oo noloshiisana wuxuu ka hayaa seefta.
english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaa sariirtiisa lagu kor edbiyaa xanuun, Iyo dagaal joogto ah oo lafihiisa ku dhex jira.
english: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed nafsaddiisu kibista way karahsataa, Naftiisuna cuntada macaan way nacdaa.
english: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

kikuyu: Hilibkiisu waa ka mudhuxsan yahay, oo mar dambe lama arki karo; Oo lafihiisii aan la arki jirinuna way soo baxaan.
english: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

kikuyu: Hubaal naftiisu waxay ku dhow dahay yamayska, Oo noloshiisuna waxay ku dhow dahay kuwii baabbi'in lahaa.
english: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

kikuyu: Hadday la joogi lahayd malaa'ig dhexdhexaadeye ah Oo ah mid kun ka mid ahu, Inay dadka tusto waxa ku qumman,
english: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

kikuyu: Markaas Ilaah baa u naxariista, oo wuxuu leeyahay, Yamayska uu ku sii dhacayo ka samatabbixi, Waayo, furasho baan helay.
english: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

kikuyu: Hilibkiisu waa ka sii jilicsanaan doonaa kan ilmaha; Oo wuxuu ku noqdaa wakhtigii dhallinyaranimadiisa.
english: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

kikuyu: Isagu Ilaah buu baryaa, oo isna raalli buu ka noqdaa, Sidaas daraaddeed wejigiisa farxad buu ku arkaa; Oo wuxuu dadka u soo celiyaa xaqnimadiisa.
english: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

kikuyu: Isagu dadka hortiisa buu ku gabyaa, oo wuxuu leeyahay, Waan dembaabay, oo waxaan qalloociyey wixii qummanaa, Oo taasuna layguma abaalgudin.
english: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

kikuyu: Isagu naftayduu ka soo furtay yamayskii ay ku dhacaysay, Oo noloshayduna iftiin bay arki doontaa.
english: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxyaalahan oo dhan Ilaah baa binu-aadmiga ku sameeya, Laba ama saddex jeer,
english: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

kikuyu: Si uu naftiisa yamayska uga soo celiyo, In isaga lagu iftiimiyo iftiinka kuwa nool.
english: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

kikuyu: Ayuubow, i maqal oo aniga i dhegayso: Adigu iska aamus, oo anna waan hadli doonaa.
english: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

kikuyu: Haddaad wax odhan lahayd, ii jawaab, Oo hadal, waayo, waxaan jeclahay inaan xaq kaa dhigo.
english: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

kikuyu: Haddii kalese, bal i dhegayso: Iska aamus, oo anna xigmad baan ku bari doonaa.
english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba Eliihuu wuu jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

kikuyu: Raggiinna xigmadda lahow, erayadayda maqla; Oo kuwiinna aqoonta lahow, i dhegaysta.
english: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhegtu waxay hadalka u kala soocdaa Sida dhabxanaggu cuntada u dhedhemiyo oo kale.
english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

kikuyu: Aynu dooranno waxa qumman, Oo aynu dhexdeenna ka ogaanno waxa wanaagsan.
english: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ayuub wuxuu yidhi, Anigu xaq baan ahay, Laakiinse Ilaah baa gartaydii ii diiday.
english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

kikuyu: Oo in kastoo aan xaq ahay haddana waxaa laygu tiriyey inaan beenlow ahay; Oo in kastoo aanan xadgudub lahayn, haddana nabarkaygu waa mid aan bogsan karin.
english: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

kikuyu: Ninkee baa Ayuub la mid ah, Oo quudhsashada u cabba sida biyaha oo kale,
english: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

kikuyu: kaasoo raaca kuwa xumaanta ka shaqeeya, Oo dadka sharka ah la socda?
english: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu yidhi, Ninna wax uma tarto Inuu Ilaah ku farxo.
english: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed i dhegaysta, raggiinna waxgaradka ahow; Ilaah inuu xaqdarro sameeyo way ka fog tahay; Oo Ilaaha Qaadirka ahna inuu xumaan falo way ka fog tahay.
english: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

kikuyu: Waayo, nin walba shuqulkiisuu ka abaalmariyaa, Oo nin kastana siduu socodkiisu ahaa ayuu ugu abaalgudaa.
english: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hubaal Ilaah xaqdarro ma uu samayn doono, Oo Kan Qaadirka ahuna garta ma uu qalloocin doono.
english: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

kikuyu: Bal yaa isaga ku amray inuu dhulka u taliyo? Yaase isaga dusha ka saaray dunida oo dhan?
english: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

kikuyu: Hadduu keligiis iska fikiri lahaa, Oo uu ruuxiisa iyo neeftiisa soo urursan lahaa,
english: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

kikuyu: Dadka oo dhammu waa wada baabbi'i lahaa, Oo binu-aadmiguna ciidduu ku noqon lahaa.
english: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaad waxgarad tahay, waxan maqal; Oo erayadayda codkooda dhegayso.
english: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

kikuyu: War mid xaqnimada neceb miyuu wax u talinayaa? Oo ma waxaad xukumaysaa midka xaqa ah oo xoogga badan?
english: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

kikuyu: Ma waxaa boqor lagu yidhaahdaa, Shar baad tahay? Amase kuwa gobta ah, Cibaadalaawayaal baad tihiin?
english: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

kikuyu: Haddaba ma saasaad ku odhan lahayd kan aan amiirrada u eexan, Ama aan taajirka uga roonayn kan miskiinka ah? Waayo, iyagu dhammaantood waa shuqulkii gacmihiisu sameeyeen.
english: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

kikuyu: Iyagu daqiiqad bay ku dhintaan, Dadku habeenbadhkiiba way gariiraan oo naftaa ka baxda, Kuwa xoogga badanuna way libdhaan iyadoo aan gacanna la saarin.
english: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

kikuyu: Waayo, indhihiisu waxay fiiriyaan jidadka binu-aadmiga, Wuxuuna wada arkaa socodkiisa oo dhan.
english: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

kikuyu: Ma jiro gudcur ama hoosdhimasho toona Oo ay kuwa xumaanta sameeyaa ku dhuuntaan.
english: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu uma baahna inuu in kale binu-aadmiga ka sii fikiro, Inuu isagu Ilaah hortiisa garsoorid u tago.
english: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

kikuyu: Ragga xoogga badan ayuu u kala jejebiyaa siyaalo aan la baadhi karin, Oo meeshoodiina kuwa kaluu ka kiciyaa.
english: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, isagu shuqulladooda wuu yaqaan; Oo habeennimuu afgembiyaa si ay u burburaan.
english: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

kikuyu: Sharkooda daraaddiis ayuu iyaga wax ku dhuftaa, Iyagoo dadka kale u jeedo,
english: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, lasocodkiisii way ka leexdeen, Oo waxay diideen inay jidadkiisa midnaba ka fikiraan.
english: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

kikuyu: Sidaasay qaylada masaakiinta isaga soo gaadhsiiyeen, Oo isna qaylada kuwa dhibaataysan ayuu maqlay.
english: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

kikuyu: Haddii quruun lagu sameeyo iyo haddii qof lagu sameeyaba, Markuu nasiyo yaa belaayo kicin kara? Oo markuu wejigiisa qariyana bal yaa isaga fiirin kara?
english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

kikuyu: Inaan cibaadalaawe boqornimada qabsan, Si uusan u jirin mid dadka shirqool u dhiga.
english: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

kikuyu: Waayo, ninna miyuu Ilaah ku yidhi, Anigu edbintii waan qaatay, oo mar dambe ninna xumayn maayo,
english: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaanan u jeedin i bar, Oo haddaan xumaan sameeyeyna mar dambe u noqon maayo?
english: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

kikuyu: Abaalgudkiisu ma wuxuu ahaan doonaa sidaad doonaysid, inaad diiddid aawadeed? Waayo, waa inaad adigu doorataa, mana aha aniga; Haddaba waxaad taqaanid ku hadal.
english: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

kikuyu: Nin kasta oo xigmad leh oo i maqla iyo dadka waxgaradka ahuba Waxay igu odhan doonaan,
english: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

kikuyu: Ayuub aqoonla'aan buu ku hadlaa, Oo hadalkiisana xigmadu kuma jirto.
english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa in Ayuub tan iyo ugudambaysta la sii imtixaamo, Maxaa yeelay, wuxuu u jawaabaa sida dadka sharka ah.
english: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

kikuyu: Waayo, dembigiisii wuxuu ku sii darsadaa caasinimo, Oo dhexdeenna ayuu ka sacab tuntaa, Erayadiisana wuxuu ku sii badiyaa Ilaah.
english: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba Eliihuu wuu sii jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

kikuyu: Ma waxaad u malaynaysaa in taasu xaq tahay, Amase ma waxaad leedahay, Xaqnimadaydu way ka sii badan tahay tan Ilaah?
english: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

kikuyu: Miyey kugu habboon tahay inaad tidhaahdid, Maxay ii taraysaa? Oo waa maxay faa'iidada aan ka helayo oo ka sii badan haddaan dembaabay?
english: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan u jawaabayaa Adiga iyo saaxiibbadaada kula jiraba.
english: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

kikuyu: Bal indhahaaga kor u qaad oo samooyinka eeg, Oo bal daruuraha kaa sarreeya fiiri.
english: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

kikuyu: Haddaad dembaabtay maxaa xumaan ah oo aad yeeshaa? Oo xadgudubyadaadu hadday bataanse maxaad isaga ku samaysaa?
english: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

kikuyu: Haddaad xaq tahayse bal maxaad isaga siisaa? Isaguse muxuu gacantaada ka helaa?
english: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

kikuyu: Xumaantaadu waxay wax u dhintaa nin sidaadoo kale ah, Oo xaqnimadaaduna waxay wax ku tartaa binu-aadmiga.
english: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

kikuyu: Dulmiga ku batay daraaddiis ayay u qayliyaan, Oo kan xoogga badan gacantiisa daraaddeed ayay caawimaad ugu qayshadaan.
english: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ninna ma yidhaahdo, Meeh Ilaahii i abuuray, Oo habeenkii gabayo i siiya,
english: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

kikuyu: Oo wax na bara in ka sii badan xayawaanka dunida jooga, Oo weliba naga sii xigmad badiya haadda samada duusha?
english: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

kikuyu: Dadka sharka ah kibirkooda daraaddiis Ayay iyagu halkaas uga qayliyaan, laakiinse ninna uma jawaabo.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

kikuyu: Hubaal Ilaah maqli maayo wax aan waxba ahayn, Oo Kan Qaadirka ahuna innaba ka fiirsan maayo.
english: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

kikuyu: In kastoo aad tidhaahdaa, Isaga ma arko, Dacwadii isagay hor taal, oo adna waa inaad isaga sugtaa.
english: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan, isagu cadhadiisii kuma uu soo booqan, Oo xumaantana si weyn ugama uu fikiro;
english: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed ayaa Ayuub hadalka aan waxtarka lahayn afkiisa ugu furaa, Oo isagoo aan aqoon lahayn ayuu erayo badiyaa.
english: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba Eliihuu hadalkiisii buu watay oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Elihu also continued, and said,

kikuyu: Weliba in yar ii sii kaadi, oo anna wax baan ku tusayaa, Waayo, weli waxaan hayaa wax aan Ilaah daraaddiis u odhanayo.
english: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

kikuyu: Aqoontayda meel fog baan ka keeni doonaa, Oo xaqnimana waan ka sheegi doonaa kii i abuuray.
english: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida runta ah erayadaydu been ma aha; Oo mid aqoontu kaamil ku tahay ayaa kula jooga.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, Ilaah waa xoog badan yahay, oo isagu ninna ma quudhsado, Oo itaalka waxgarashada wuu ku xoog badan yahay.
english: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

kikuyu: Isagu uma daayo kan sharka ahu inuu sii noolaado, Laakiinse kuwa dhibaataysan xaqooduu siiyaa.
english: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

kikuyu: Isagu indhihiisa kama qaado kuwa xaqa ah, Laakiinse wuxuu weligoodba la fadhiisiyaa boqorrada carshiga ku fadhiya, Oo iyaga waa la sarraysiiyaa.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

kikuyu: Oo haddii silsilado lagu xidho, Oo xadhkaha dhibka lagu kaxaysto,
english: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

kikuyu: Markaas wuxuu iyaga ku caddeeyaa falimahooda, Iyo xadgudubyadoodii ay kibirka u sameeyeen.
english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

kikuyu: Oo dhegtoodana wuxuu u furaa waxbaridda, Oo wuxuu ku amraa inay xumaanta ka soo noqdaan.
english: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

kikuyu: Hadday isaga maqlaan oo ay u adeegaan, Cimrigooda waxay ku dhammaysan doonaan barwaaqo, Oo sannadahoodana waxay ku waari doonaan nimco.
english: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadday maqli waayaan, seef bay ku baabbi'i doonaan, Oo waxay dhiman doonaan iyagoo aan aqoon lahayn.
english: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa cibaadalaawayaasha ah oo qalbigoodu beloobay waxay isa soo gaadhsiiyaan cadho, Oo markuu iyaga xidhana caawimaad uma qayshadaan.
english: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

kikuyu: Dhallinyaranimay ku dhintaan, Oo naftooduna waxay ku halligantaa khaniisiinta dhexdooda.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

kikuyu: Isagu kii dhibban ayuu dhibaatadiisa ku samatabbixiyaa, Oo dhegahana buu u furaa markay dhib la kulmaan.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

kikuyu: Isagu dhibaato wuu kaa bixin lahaa, Oo wuxuu ku geeyn lahaa meel ballaadhan oo aan cidhiidhi ahayn, Oo miiskaaga waxa saaran oo dhammuna waxay ahaan lahaayeen baruur miidhan.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

kikuyu: Laakiinse xukunka kuwa sharka ah ayaa kaa buuxa, Oo garsoorid iyo caddaalad ayaa ku qabsada.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

kikuyu: Iska jir yaanay cadho ku sasabin si aad wax u majaajilootid, Oo furashada weynaanteeduna yaanay ku leexin.
english: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

kikuyu: Taajirnimadaada iyo xoogga itaalkaaga oo dhammu Miyey kugu filan yihiin inay dhibaato kaa saaraan?
english: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

kikuyu: Habeenka ha doonin, Markay dadyowgu meeshooda ku wada baabba'aan.
english: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

kikuyu: Iska jir oo xumaan ha u jeedin, Waayo, taasaad ka dooratay dhibaato.
english: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, Ilaah baa xooggiisa ku sarreeya; Waa ayo macallinka isaga la mid ahu?
english: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

kikuyu: Jidkiisa yaa u amray? Yaase isaga ku odhan kara, Waxaad samaysay xaqdarro?
english: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

kikuyu: Xusuuso inaad weynaysid shuqulkiisii Ay dadku ka gabyeen.
english: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

kikuyu: Dadka oo dhammu way wada fiiriyeen, Oo binu-aadmiguna meel fog buu ka arkaa.
english: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, Ilaah waa weyn yahay, oo annana isaga ma aannu naqaan; Oo cimrigiisu intuu yahayna lama soo baadhi karo.
english: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu kor u jiitaa dhibicyaha biyaha, Oo wuxuu ka dhigaa ceeryaamo roob noqota,
english: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

kikuyu: Oo daruuraha ka soo da'a, Oo binu-aadmiga aad ugu dul shubma.
english: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

kikuyu: Ninna miyuu garan karaa daruuraha kala faafintooda, Iyo onkodyada taambuuggiisa?
english: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, isagu hareerihiisa wuxuu ku faafiyaa nuurkiisa, Oo badda salkeedana wuu daboolaa.
english: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu kuwaasuu dadyowga ku xukumaa, Oo cunto badanna wuu siiyaa.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

kikuyu: Gacmihiisuu hillaac ku daboolaa, Oo wuxuu ku amraa inuu ku dhaco calaamadda uu ku liishaamay.
english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

kikuyu: Sanqadhiisu isagay wax ka sheegtaa, Oo weliba xayawaankuna wax bay ka sheegaan waxa soo socda.
english: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

kikuyu: Oo weliba taas aawadeed qalbigaygu wuu gariiraa, Oo meeshiisiina wuu ka dhaqaaqaa.
english: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

kikuyu: Haddaba dhegaysta qaylada codkiisa Iyo sanqadha afkiisa ka baxaysa.
english: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Wuxuu taas u diraa inta samada ka hoosaysa oo dhan, Oo hillaaciisana wuxuu u diraa dhulka darfihiisa oo dhan.
english: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Dabadiisna wax baa aad uga sanqadha, Isagu wuxuu ku onkodaa haybaddiisa codkeeda; Oo markii codkiisa la maqlona iyaga ma uu joojiyo.
english: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

kikuyu: Ilaah si yaab ah ayuu codkiisa ugu onkodaa, Oo wuxuu sameeyaa waxyaalo waaweyn oo aynan garan karin.
english: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu barafka cad ku yidhaahdaa, Dhulka ku da'; Oo sidaasoo kaluu ku yidhaahdaa roobka yar Iyo roobkiisa weynba.
english: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu shaabadeeyaa nin kasta gacantiisa, In nin kasta oo uu sameeyeyba ogaado.
english: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

kikuyu: Markaasaa bahalladu hogag galaan, Oo waxay iska joogaan boholahooda.
english: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

kikuyu: Koonfurta waxaa ka soo baxa duufaanka, Oo qabowguna wuxuu ka yimaadaa woqooyiga.
english: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

kikuyu: Barafku wuxuu ku yimaadaa Ilaah neeftiisa, Oo biyaha ballaadhanuna way barafoobaan.
english: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

kikuyu: Daruurta qarada weyn ayuu ka buuxiyaa qoyaan, Oo wuxuu kala firdhiyaa daruurta hillaaciisa,
english: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa lagu soo wareejiyaa hoggaamintiisa, Inay sameeyaan wax alla wixii uu kugu amro Dunida la dego dusheeda oo dhan,
english: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

kikuyu: Hadday tahay hagaajin aawadeed, ama dalkiisa aawadiis, Ama naxariis aawadeed, kolleyba wuxuu ka dhigay inay kuwaasu noqdaan.
english: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

kikuyu: Ayuubow, bal tan dhegayso, Istaag oo bal ka fiirso shuqullada Ilaah oo yaabka miidhan ah.
english: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

kikuyu: War miyaad taqaan siduu iyaga u amro, Iyo siduu hillaaca daruurtiisa u iftiimiyo?
english: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

kikuyu: Miyaad taqaan miisaaminta daruuraha, Amase kan aqoontu kaamilka ku tahay shuqulladiisa yaabka leh?
english: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

kikuyu: Miyaad taqaan wuxuu dharkaagu u kulul yahay, Markuu Ilaah dhulka ku xasilliyo dabaysha koonfureed?
english: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

kikuyu: Miyaad isaga la kala bixin kartaa cirka U xoogga badan sidii muraayad la shubay?
english: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

kikuyu: Na bar wixii aan isaga ku odhan lahayn, Waayo, annagu hadalkayagii waxaannu la odhan kari waynay gudcur aawadiis.
english: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

kikuyu: Isaga ma loo sheegi doonaa inaan hadli doono? Ninse miyuu jecel yahay in isaga la liqo?
english: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

kikuyu: Oo hadda dadku ma fiirin karo iftiinka cirka ka dhalaalaya, Laakiinse dabayshu waa soo gudubtaa, oo iyagay safaysaa.
english: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

kikuyu: Woqooyi waxaa ka soo baxa iftiin sida dahab u dhalaalaya, Ilaahna wuxuu leeyahay haybad cabsi badan.
english: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

kikuyu: Annagu ma heli karno Ilaaha Qaadirka ah, waayo, isagu wuu xoog badan yahay; Oo isagoo garsoorid iyo caddaalad ka buuxa ninna ma uu dhibi doono.
english: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed dadku isagay ka cabsadaan; Oo isagu ma uu fiiriyo kuwa qalbigooda xigmaddu ka buuxdo.
english: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Ayuub uga jawaabay dabaysha cirwareenta ah, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,

kikuyu: Waa kuma kan talada ku madoobeeya Erayada aan aqoonta lahayn?
english: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

kikuyu: Haddaba sida nin rag ah dhexda u gunto, Waayo, wax baan ku weyddiinayaa, oo adna waa inaad ii sheegtaa.
english: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

kikuyu: Markaan dunida aasaaskeeda dhigay xaggee baad joogtay? Haddaad waxgarad tahay, taas ii sheeg.
english: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

kikuyu: Haddaadse taqaanid yaa qiyaasteeda amray? Amase yaa xadhiggii lagu qiyaasay ku kor fidiyey?
english: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

kikuyu: Aasaaskeedase bal xaggee baa lagu dejiyey? Amase yaa dhigay dhagaxa geeska ah
english: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

kikuyu: Markay xiddigaha aroorya isla wada heeseen, Oo ay carruurta Ilaah oo dhammu farxad la qayliyeen?
english: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

kikuyu: Amase yaa badda albaabbo ku xidhay markay u soo faruurantay Sidii wax maxal ka soo baxay,
english: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

kikuyu: Iyo markaan daruurta dharka uga dhigay, Oo aan gudcurka maro lagu duudduubo uga dhigay,
english: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

kikuyu: Oo aan hareeraheeda xad u amray, Oo aan u yeelay qataarro iyo albaabbo,
english: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

kikuyu: Oo aan ku idhi, Ilaa halkan soo gaadh, laakiinse innaba ha soo dhaafin, Oo hirarkaaga kibirka lahu waa inay halkan ku joogsadaan?
english: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

kikuyu: Tan iyo waagii aad dhalatay marna subaxda ma amartay? Waaberigase ma meeshiisaad ogeysiisay,
english: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

kikuyu: Si uu u qabsado dhulka darfihiisa, Oo sharrowyada looga hurgufo?
english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

kikuyu: Waa loo beddelaa sidii dhoobo shaabad ka hoosaysa, Oo wax kastaaba waxay kor uga muuqdaan sidii dhar oo kale,
english: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

kikuyu: Oo sharrowyadana iftiinkooda waa loo diiday, Oo gacantii sarraysayna waa la jebiyey.
english: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

kikuyu: Adigu miyaad badda ilaheeda dhex gashay? Miyaadse moolka salkiisa martay?
english: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

kikuyu: Geerida irdaheeda miyaa laguu muujiyey? Miyaadse aragtay irdaha hooska dhimashada?
english: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

kikuyu: Miyaad garanaysaa dhulka ballaadhkiisa? Haddaad waxaas wada taqaanid ii sheeg.
english: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

kikuyu: Rugta iftiinka jidka loo maraa waa xaggee? Gudcurkase meeshiisu waa xaggee,
english: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

kikuyu: Si aad soohdintiisa u martid, Oo aad u garatid wadiiqooyinka gurigiisa loo maro?
english: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

kikuyu: Shakila'aan waad taqaan, waayo, adigu wakhtigaas waad dhalanayd Oo cimrigaaguna wuu dheer yahay!
english: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

kikuyu: Adigu miyaad dhex gashay meesha barafka cad lagu kaydiyo? Miyaadse aragtay meesha roobdhagaxyaalaha la dhigo,
english: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

kikuyu: Kuwaasoo aan u kaydsaday wakhtiga dhibaatada, Iyo maalinta dirirta iyo dagaalka?
english: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

kikuyu: Iftiinka jidkee baa lagu kala qaybiyaa? Dabaysha barise sidee baa dhulka loogu kor firdhiyaa?
english: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

kikuyu: Bal yaa jid u sameeyey biyaha daadka ah, Amase hillaaca onkodka,
english: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

kikuyu: Si roob ugu da'o dhul aan binu-aadmina joogin, Iyo cidlada aan ninna degganayn,
english: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

kikuyu: Si uu u dherjiyo dhulka cidlo iyo baabba' ah, Oo uu doog jilicsan uga soo bixiyo?
english: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

kikuyu: Roobku ma aabbuu leeyahay? Yaase dhalay dhibicyaha sayaxa?
english: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

kikuyu: Barafkuse bal yuu maxalkiisa ka soo baxay? Yaase dhalay sayaxa barafoobay ee cirka ka yimaada?
english: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

kikuyu: Biyihii waxay u adkaadeen sidii dhagax oo kale, Oo moolka korkiisiina wuu barafoobay.
english: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

kikuyu: Adigu miyaad xidhi kartaa ururka xiddigaha ee Toddobaadyada la yidhaahdo? Miyaadse furi kartaa ururka Oriyon la yidhaahdo?
english: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

kikuyu: Miyaad kartaa inaad xiddigaha Masarood la yidhaahdo xilligooda soo saarto? Miyaadse ururka xiddigaha ee Orsada la yidhaahdo carruurtiisa la kaxayn kartaa?
english: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

kikuyu: Miyaad taqaan amarrada samooyinka? Dowladnimadoodana ma dhulkaad ku dhisi kartaa?
english: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

kikuyu: Codkaaga miyaad daruuraha kor ugu qaadi kartaa, Si biyo badanu ay kuu daboolaan daraaddeed?
english: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

kikuyu: Miyaad hillaaca diri kartaa, si ay u tagaan, Oo ay kuugu yidhaahdaan, Waa na kan?
english: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

kikuyu: Bal yaa qalbiga xigmadda geliyey? Yaase maanka waxgarashada siiyey?
english: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

kikuyu: Bal yaa daruuraha xigmad ku tirin kara? Yaase qarbeddada samada biyo ka shubi kara,
english: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

kikuyu: Markii boodhku taallooyin noqdo, Oo ciidduna ay isku dhegto?
english: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

kikuyu: Miyaad karaysaa inaad gool libaax u ugaadhid? Miyaadse dhal libaax dherjin kartaa,
english: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

kikuyu: Markay boholahooda ku dhex dhuuntaan, Oo ay hogga u joogaan inay wax gaadaan?
english: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

kikuyu: Bal yaa tukaha cunto ku quudiya, Markii dhashiisu Ilaah u qayshadaan, Oo ay cuntola'aan daraaddeed u warwareegaan?
english: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

kikuyu: War miyaad taqaan markay ri'dibadeedda qarka joogta dhasho? Miyaadse arki kartaa markay deerooyinku dhalaan?
english: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

kikuyu: Miyaad tirin kartaa bilaha sidkoodu ku buuxsamo? Miyaadse taqaan wakhtiga ay dhalaan?
english: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

kikuyu: Intay arruntaan ayay ubadkooda dhalaan, Oo fooshoodana way iska saaraan.
english: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

kikuyu: Oo ubadkooda yaryaruna way kobcaan, oo waxay ku koraan berrin bannaan, Oo intay baxaan ayaanay mar dambe soo noqon.
english: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

kikuyu: Bal yaa dameerdibadeedka xoreeyey? Yaase dameerdibadeedka xadhkihiisii ka furay?
english: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

kikuyu: Kaas gurigiisa waxaan ka dhigay cidlada, Oo rugtiisuna waa dalka cusbada.
english: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

kikuyu: Magaalada buuqeeda wuu quudhsadaa, Oo kexeeyaha qayladiisana ma maqlo.
english: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

kikuyu: Xidhiidhka buurahu waa daaqiisa, Oo wuxuu raadiyaa wax kasta oo cagaar ah.
english: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

kikuyu: Dibidibadeedku miyuu raalli ku noqon doonaa inuu kuu adeego? Miyuuse qabaalka xeradaada ku ag hoyan doonaa?
english: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

kikuyu: Dibidibadeedka miyaad xadhko ku xidhi kartaa si uu beerta u qodo? Miyuuse dooxooyinka kaa daba hagaajin?
english: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

kikuyu: Xooggiisa badan daraaddiis miyaad isugu hallaynaysaa? Hawshaadase ma isagaad u daynaysaa?
english: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

kikuyu: Ma waxaad isaga ugu kalsoon tahay inuu midhahaaga guriga keeno, Oo uu kuu soo urursho hadhuudhka goobkaaga wax lagu tumo?
english: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

kikuyu: Gorayada garabkeedu farxad buu la ruxmadaa, Laakiinse garbaheeda iyo baalasheedu ma wax bay u roon yihiin?
english: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

kikuyu: Waayo, iyadu ugaxdeeda waxay kaga tagtaa dhulka dushiisa, Oo ciidday ku diirisaa,
english: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

kikuyu: Oo waxay illowdaa inay cagtu burburinayso, Iyo inuu dugaaggu ku tumanayo.
english: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

kikuyu: Waxay ku adkaataa dhasheeda, sidii iyagoo aan kuweedii ahayn, Oo in kastoo ay waxtarla'aan u hawshooto haddana iyadu cabsi ma qabto,
english: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, Ilaah baa iyada xigmad u diiday, Oo waxgarashona ma uu siin.
english: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

kikuyu: Oo markay kor isu qaaddo inay carartona, Waxay quudhsataa faraska iyo kii fuushanba.
english: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

kikuyu: War ma adigaa faraska xooggiisa siiyey? Surkiisase ma adigaa guudka ruxma huwiyey?
english: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

kikuyu: War ma adigaa ka dhigay inuu sida ayaxa u boodo? Haybadda bururufta sankiisu way cabsi badan tahay.
