english: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

kikuyu: Dooxaduu qoobka ku garaacaa, oo xooggiisuu ku reyreeyaa, Oo intuu baxo ayuu ka hor tagaa ragga hubka sita.
english: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

kikuyu: Cabsida wuu ku qoslaa, oo ma uu baqo, Oo seeftana dib ugama noqdo.
english: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

kikuyu: Korkiisa waxaa ka sanqadha gabooye, Iyo waran birbirqaya iyo hoto.
english: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

kikuyu: Isagu dhulkuu ku liqaa gariir iyo cadho, Oo buunka codkiisa hadduu maqlona ma istaago.
english: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

kikuyu: Oo mar alla markii buunku dhawaaqo ayuu "Haw" yidhaahdaa, Oo meel fog ayuu dagaalka ka uriyaa, Wuxuuna maqlaa saraakiisha qayladooda onkodaysa iyo hugunka.
english: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

kikuyu: Haadka adagu ma xigmaddaaduu kor ugu duulaa? Garbihiisase xagga koonfureed ma u fidiyaa?
english: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

kikuyu: Baqalyaduse ma amarkaagay kor ugu duushaa? Oo ma saasay buulkeeda meelaha sarsare uga dhisataa?
english: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

kikuyu: Waxay ku hoyataa qarka dheer korkiisa, oo hoygeeduna halkaasuu ku yaal, Xagga qarka dheer dhaladiisa, iyo meesha adag dusheeda.
english: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

kikuyu: Oo iyadoo halkaas joogta ayay ugaadh ka fiirsataa, Oo indhaheeduna meel fog bay wax ka arkaan.
english: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

kikuyu: Dhasheeda yaryaru dhiig bay nuugaan, Oo iyana waxay joogtaa hadba meeshii raqu taal.
english: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba Rabbigu Ayuub buu u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Moreover the LORD answered Job,

kikuyu: Kii murmayaa ma Ilaaha Qaadirka ah buu la diriri karaa? Kii Ilaah la doodayaa ha ka jawaabo taas.
english: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub Rabbiga u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Job answered the LORD,

kikuyu: Bal eeg, wax yar baan ahay, haddaba bal maxaan kuugu jawaabaa? Afkaan gacanta saarayaa.
english: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

kikuyu: Mar baan hadlay, jawaab dambena u noqon maayo, Laba jeer oo qudha ayaan hadlay, laakiinse hadda ka dib sii wadi maayo.
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu Ayuub uga dhex jawaabay dabaysha cirwareenta ah, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:

kikuyu: Haddaba sidii nin rag ah dhexda u gunto, Waayo, wax baan ku weyddiinayaa, oo adna waa inaad ii sheegtaa.
english: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

kikuyu: War ma xukunkaygaad burinaysaa? Oo ma waxaad ii xukumaysaa inaad xaq noqotid?
english: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

kikuyu: Adiguse ma waxaad leedahay Ilaah gacantiisa oo kale? Oo codkiisa oo kale miyaad ku onkodi kartaa?
english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaad isku sharraxdaa sarraysnaan iyo derejo, Oo waxaad huwataa sharaf iyo haybad.
english: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

kikuyu: Haddaba cadhadaada buuxdhaafkeeda soo daadi, Oo waxaad fiirisaa mid kasta oo kibir leh, oo isaga hoos u soo deji.
english: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

kikuyu: Mid kasta oo kibir leh soo fiiri oo hoosaysii, Oo kuwa sharka ah meel alla meeshay istaagaan ku joogso.
english: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

kikuyu: Dhammaantood ciidda ku qari, Oo wejigoodana meel qarsoon ku xidh.
english: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

kikuyu: Oo anna markaas waxaan kuu qiran doonaa In gacantaada midig ay ku badbaadin karto.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal eeg jeerta aan u sameeyey sidaan kuu sameeyey oo kale, Cawska bay u daaqdaa sida dibi oo kale.
english: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal eeg, xooggeedu wuxuu ugu jiraa dhexdeeda, Oo itaalkeeduna wuxuu ku jiraa muruqyada caloosheeda.
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

kikuyu: Oo dabadeedana waxay u taagtaa sida geed kedar ah oo kale, Oo seedaha bowdooyinkeeduna way isku wada tidcan yihiin.
english: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

kikuyu: Oo lafaheeduna waa sidii tuubbooyin naxaas ah; Oo addimmadeeduna waa sidii wax bir ah.
english: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

kikuyu: Iyadu jidadka Ilaah waa u madax, Oo kii abuuray oo keliya ayaa seeftiisa u dhowayn kara.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

kikuyu: Sida xaqiiqada ah waxaa iyada cunto u soo bixiya Buuraha ay xayawaanka duurka oo dhammu ku cayaaraan.
english: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

kikuyu: Oo waxay hoos jiifsataa dhirta hooska badan, Iyo meesha qarsoon ee cawsduurka iyo biyagaleenka.
english: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

kikuyu: Dhirta hooska badan ayaa hadhkooda ku qariya, Oo waxaa iyada ku wareegsan geedaha safsaafka ah ee durdurka ku ag yaal.
english: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, haddii webigu buuxdhaafo iyadu ma gariirto, In kastoo Webi Urdun afka ka galo, haddana iyadu way isku kalsoon tahay.
english: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

kikuyu: Ninna miyuu iyada qaban karaa iyadoo u jeedda? Miyaase sanka dabin lagaga duleelin karaa?
english: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

kikuyu: War bahalbadeedka Lewiiyaataan la yidhaahdo miyaad jillaab kalluun ku soo bixin kartaa? Carrabkiisase ma hoos baad xadhig ugu adkayn kartaa?
english: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

kikuyu: Ma sankiisaad xadhig ku xidhi kartaa? Mase daankiisaad jillaab ku duleelin kartaa?
english: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

kikuyu: Isagu ma aad buu kuu baryi doonaa? Mase hadal macaan buu kugula hadli doonaa?
english: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

kikuyu: Ma axdi buu kula dhigan doonaa, Si aad addoon uga dhigatid weligiisba?
english: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

kikuyu: Ma waxaad isaga ula cayaari doontaa sidaad shimbir ula cayaartid oo kale? Miyaadse gabdhahaaga u xidhi doontaa?
english: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

kikuyu: Kalluumaystayaashu miyey isaga iibin doonaan? Mase baayacmushtariyaasha bay u qaybin doonaan?
english: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

kikuyu: Haraggiisa miyaad hotooyin ka buuxin kartaa? Madaxiisase miyaad warmaha kalluunka lagu qabsado ka buuxin kartaa?
english: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

kikuyu: Gacantaada isaga kor saar, Markaas dagaalka xusuuso, oo mar dambe saas yeeli maysid!
english: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, in isaga la qabto rajo ma leh, Xataa haddii isaga la arko, sow hoos loo dhici maayo?
english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

kikuyu: Ma jiro mid ku dhaca inuu isaga kiciyo, Haddaba waa ayo kan aniga i hor istaagi kara?
english: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

kikuyu: Bal yaa hore wax ii siiyey oo aan haatan u celiyaa? Waxa samada ka hooseeya oo dhan anigaa leh.
english: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

kikuyu: Anigu ka aamusi maayo waxa ku saabsan addimmadiisa, Ama itaalkiisa xoogga leh, ama jidhkiisa quruxda badan.
english: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal yaa dharkiisa kore ka furan kara? Oo bal yaa gowsihiisa soo geli kara?
english: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

kikuyu: Bal yaa albaabbada wejigiisa furi kara? Ilkihiisa aad baa looga cabsadaa.
english: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

kikuyu: Qolfihiisa adag waa wuxuu ku kibro, Oo waxay isugu wada xidhan yihiin sida wax shaabad lagu adkeeyo.
english: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

kikuyu: Midba midda kale way ku dhow dahay, Oo innaba dabaylu dhexdooda kama dusi karto.
english: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

kikuyu: Middoodba midda kale way haysataa, Oo way isku wada dheggan yihiin, oo innaba lama kala fujin karo.
english: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

kikuyu: Hindhisooyinkiisa waxaa ka soo widhwidha iftiin, Oo indhihiisuna waa sidii kaaha waaberiga.
english: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

kikuyu: Afkiisa waxaa ka soo baxa wax ololaya, Oo waxaa ka soo duula dhimbiilo dab ah.
english: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

kikuyu: Dulalka sankiisa qiiq baa ka soo baxa Sida dheri karaya iyo cawsduur ololaya.
english: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

kikuyu: Neeftiisu dhuxulay shiddaa, Oo olol baa afkiisa ka soo baxa.
english: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Luquntiisu xoog bay leedahay, Oo cabsina hortiisay ku booddaa.
english: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

kikuyu: Duudduubyada jidhkiisu way isku wada dheggan yihiin, Wayna ku adag yihiin oo innaba lama dhaqaajin karo.
english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Qalbigiisu wuxuu u adag yahay sida dhagax oo kale, Hubaal wuxuu u adag yahay sida dhagaxa shiidka ee hoose.
english: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

kikuyu: Markuu sara joogsado ayay kuwa xoogga badanu baqaan, Oo naxdin daraaddeed ayay la waashaan.
english: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

kikuyu: In kastoo lagula kaco seef, Iyo waran, iyo fallaadh, iyo hoto, kolleyba waxba kama tari karaan.
english: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

kikuyu: Isagu birta wuxuu ku tiriyaa sida caws engegan oo kale, Naxaastana wuxuu ku tiriyaa sida qori bololay.
english: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

kikuyu: Fallaadhu isaga ma eryi karto, Oo dhagaxyada wadhafkuna waxay isaga u noqdaan sidii xaab oo kale.
english: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

kikuyu: Budhadhkuna waxay isaga la yihiin sidii xaab oo kale, Oo hotada ruxmashadeedana wuu ku qoslaa.
english: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

kikuyu: Boggiisa hoose waa sida dheryo burburradooda afaysan, Oo wuxuu dhoobada ugu kor dhaqaaqaa sida gaadhi hadhuudh lagu tumo.
english: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

kikuyu: Isagu moolkuu u kariyaa sidii dheri oo kale, Oo baddana wuxuu ka dhigaa sida weel cadar ku jiro oo kale.
english: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

kikuyu: Xaggiisa dambe wuxuu noqdaa jid wax ka iftiimo, Oo moolkana waxaa loo maleeyaa sidii cirro oo kale.
english: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

kikuyu: Dhulka ma joogo mid sidiisa oo kale, Oo cabsila'aan la abuuray.
english: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu fiiriyaa waxyaalaha sare oo dhan, Oo inta kibirsan oo dhan boqor buu u yahay.
english: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub Rabbiga u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Then Job answered the LORD:

kikuyu: Waan ogahay inaad wax walba kartid, Iyo inaan qasdigaaga innaba la joojin karin.
english: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

kikuyu: Bal waa ayo kan aan aqoonta lahayn oo talada qariyaa? Haddaba anigu waxaan ku hadlay wax aanan garanayn, Oo ah waxyaalo aad iiga yaabiyey oo aanan innaba aqoon.
english: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Waan ku baryayaaye i maqal aan kula hadlee, Oo wax baan ku weyddiinayaaye ii sheeg.
english: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

kikuyu: Markii hore ayaan wax kugu saabsan dhegaha ku maqlay, Laakiinse haatan indhahaan kugu arkayaa,
english: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waan isnacayaa, Waanan toobadkeenayaa anigoo boodh iyo dambas ku fadhiya.
english: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

kikuyu: Oo markii Rabbigu erayadaas Ayuub kula hadlay dabadeed wuxuu Eliifas oo reer Teemaan ahaa ku yidhi, Cadhadaydii baa ku kululaatay adiga iyo labadaadii saaxiibba, waayo, idinku wixii xaqa ahaa igama aydaan sheegin, sidii addoonkayga Ayuub uu yeelay oo kale.
english: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waxaad soo wadataan toddoba dibi iyo toddoba wan, oo waxaad u tagtaan addoonkayga Ayuub, oo waxaad nafsaddiinna daraaddeed u bixisaan qurbaan la gubo; oo addoonkayga Ayuub wuu idiin ducaynayaa, waayo, isagaan ka aqbalayaa, si aanan idinkula macaamiloon sidii nacasnimadiinnii ahayd, waayo, idinku wixii xaqa ahaa igama aydaan sheegin sidii addoonkayga Ayuub uu yeelay oo kale.
english: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Eliifas oo ahaa reer Teemaan, iyo Bildad oo ahaa reer Shuuxii, iyo Soofar oo ahaa reer Nacamaatii way tageen oo waxay u sameeyeen sidii Rabbigu ku amray, oo Rabbiguna Ayuub wuu aqbalay.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ayaa Ayuub axwaalkiisii beddelay markuu saaxiibbadiis u duceeyey; oo Rabbiguna Ayuub wuxuu siiyey wixii uu markii hore lahaa laba jibbaarkood.
english: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub waxaa u yimid walaalihiis oo dhan, wiilal iyo gabdhoba, iyo kuwii isaga hore u yiqiin oo dhan, oo gurigiisii ayay kibis kula cuneen, wayna u tacsiyeeyeen, oo waxay uga qalbi qaboojiyeen masiibadii Rabbigu isaga ku soo dejiyey oo dhan. Oo nin kastaaba wuxuu isagii siiyey in lacag ah iyo hilqad dahab ah.
english: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

kikuyu: Oo sidaasuu Rabbigu Ayuub ugudambaystiisii u barakeeyey in ka sii badan bilowgiisii hore; oo wuxuu lahaa afar iyo toban kun oo ido ah, iyo lix kun oo geel ah, iyo laba kun oo dibi, iyo kun dameerood.
english: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu lahaa toddoba wiil iyo saddex gabdhood.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Oo middii kowaad magaceedii wuxuu u bixiyey Yemiimaah, tii labaad magaceediina wuxuu u bixiyey Qasicaah, tii saddexaad magaceediina wuxuu u bixiyey Qeren Hafuug.
english: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

kikuyu: Oo waddankaas oo dhanna laguma arag dumar u qurxoon sida gabdhaha Ayuub, oo aabbahoodna dhaxal buu walaalahood la siiyey.
english: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas dabadeed Ayuub wuxuu noolaa boqol iyo afartan sannadood, oo wuxuu arkay wiilashiisii, iyo wiilashiisa wiilashoodiiba, tan iyo intii afar fac ah.
english: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ayuub dhintay isagoo duq ah oo cimri weyn.
english: So Job died, being old and full of days.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninkii aan ku socon talada kuwa sharka leh, Oo aan istaagin jidka dembilayaasha, Oo aan ku fadhiisan kursiga kuwa wax quudhsada.
english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaa isaga ka farxiya sharciga Rabbiga, Oo habeen iyo maalinba sharcigiisuu ka fikiraa.
english: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ahaan doonaa sida geed lagu beeray durdurrada biyaha agtooda, Oo midhihiisa dhala xilligooda, Oo aan caleentiisuna engegin. Oo wax alla wuxuu sameeyoba wuu ku liibaani doonaa.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa sharka lahu sidaas ma aha, Iyaguse waxay la mid yihiin buunshaha dabayshu kaxayso.
english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kuwa sharka lahu isma dhex taagi doonaan xukunka, Dembilayaashuna sooma dhex geli doonaan kuwa xaqa ah ururkooda.
english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu waa yaqaan kuwa xaqa ah jidkooda, Laakiinse kuwa sharka ah jidkoodu waa baabbi'i doonaa.
english: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

kikuyu: Bal quruumuhu maxay u cadhoodaan, Dadkuna maxay ugu fikiraan wax aan waxba ahayn?
english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

kikuyu: Boqorrada dhulku col bay u taagan yihiin, Taliyayaashuna waxay u wada tashadaan Rabbiga iyo Masiixiisa, iyagoo leh,
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,

kikuyu: Silsiladahooda aan gooyno Oo xadhkahoodana aan iska fogayno.
english: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

kikuyu: Kan samada fadhiyaa wuu qosli doonaa, Oo Sayidku iyaga wuu ku majaajiloon doonaa.
english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

kikuyu: Markaasuu isagoo cadhaysan iyaga la hadli doonaa, Oo wuxuu iyaga ku dhibi doonaa dhirifkiisa isagoo leh,
english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

kikuyu: Anigu boqorkaygii waxaan fadhiisiyey Buurtayda quduuska ah oo Siyoon.
english: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

kikuyu: Amarkii ayaan wax ka sheegi doonaa, Rabbigu wuxuu igu yidhi, Adigu waxaad tahay wiilkayga, Maantaan ku dhalay.
english: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

kikuyu: I bari oo waxaan dhaxal ahaan kuu siin doonaa quruumaha, Oo dunida meelaha ugu fogfogna hanti ahaan baan kuu siin doonaa.
english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

kikuyu: Waxaad iyaga ku jejebin doontaa ul bir ah, Oo waxaad u burburin doontaa sida weelka dheryasameeyaha.
english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed, Boqorradow, caqli yeesha, Oo xaakinnada dhulkow, edeb yeesha.
english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

kikuyu: Rabbiga cabsi ugu adeega, Oo reyreeya idinkoo gariiraya.
english: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

kikuyu: Wiilka dhunkada, waaba intaasoo uu idiin cadhoodaa oo aad jidka ku baabba'daane. Waayo, cadhadiisu haddiiba way kululaan doontaa. Waxaa barakaysan kuwa isaga isku halleeya oo dhan.
english: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, cadaawayaashaydu fara badanaa! Kuwa igu kacaa aad bay u badan yihiin.
english: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Way badan yihiin kuwa naftayda wax ka sheegaa, iyagoo leh, Ilaah isaga caawin maayo. (Selaah)
english: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

kikuyu: Laakiinse, Rabbiyow, adigu waxaad tahay gaashaan igu wareegsan, Iyo sharaftayda, iyo kan madaxayga kor u qaada.
english: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

kikuyu: Codkayga ayaan Rabbiga ugu qayliyaa, Oo isaguna wuxuu iiga jawaabaa buurtiisa quduuska ah. (Selaah)
english: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

kikuyu: Anigu waan jiifsaday oo waan iska seexday, Oo haddana waan soo toosay, waayo, Rabbiga ayaa i xannaaneeya.
english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.

kikuyu: Ka baqi maayo dadka kumanyaalkaa, Oo gees kasta iga hareereeyey.
english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

kikuyu: Kac, Rabbiyow, oo i badbaadi, Ilaahayow, Waayo, cadaawayaashaydii oo dhan waxaad ku dhufatay dhabanka, Oo kuwa sharka leh ilkahoodiina waad jejebisay.
english: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Badbaado waxaa leh Rabbiga, Barakadaadu dadkaaga ha ku soo degto. (Selaah)
english: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

kikuyu: Ilaaha xaqnimadaydow, markii aan ku baryo i maqal, Markii aan cidhiidhi ku jirayba meel baad ii bannaysay, Ii naxariiso oo baryadayda maqal.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

kikuyu: Binu-aadmigow, ilaa goormaa sharaftaydu sharafjab u rogmanaysaa? Ilaa goormaad wax aan micne lahayn jeclaanaysaan? Oo ilaa goormaad been doondoonaysaan? (Selaah)
english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ogaada in Rabbigu gooni ahaan isugu soocay kii cibaado leh, Rabbigu wuu maqli doonaa markii aan u yeedho isaga.
english: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

kikuyu: Cadhooda oo ha dembaabina, Qalbigiinna la hadla markii aad sariirtiinna ku jiiftaan, oo aamusa. (Selaah)
english: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

kikuyu: Bixiya allabaryadii xaqnimada, Oo Rabbiga isku halleeya.
english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira kuwo badan oo yidhaahda, Bal yaa wanaag na tusaya? Rabbiyow, iftiinka wejigaaga nagu ifi.
english: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.

kikuyu: Waxaad qalbigayga gelisay farxad Ka sii badan tan ay helaan markii hadhuudhkooda iyo khamrigoodu ay kordhaan.
english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

kikuyu: Nabad baan ku jiifsanayaa oo aan ku seexanayaa, Waayo, Rabbiyow, adigoo keliya ayaa ammaan igu bariiya.
english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, bal hadalladayda dhegta u dhig, Oo ka fiirso fikirradayda.
english: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.

kikuyu: Boqorkayga iyo Ilaahaygow, bal maqal codka baryadayda, Waayo, adigaan kuu tukanayaa.
english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, codkayga aroorta baad maqli doontaa, Oo aroorta ayaan tukashadayda kugu soo hagaajin doonaa, oo waan soo jeedi doonaa.
english: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

kikuyu: Waayo, adigu ma ihid Ilaah xumaanta ku farxa, Oo shar adiga kula jiri maayo.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

kikuyu: Kan ismadax-weyneeya hortaada soo istaagi maayo, Oo waxaad neceb tahay xumaanfalayaasha oo dhan.
english: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Waad wada baabbi'in doontaa kuwa beenta ku hadla, Rabbigu aad buu u karhaa kan dhiigyacabka ah iyo khaa'inkaba.
english: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu kalgacaylkaaga badan ayaan gurigaaga ku soo gelayaa, Oo anigoo kaa cabsanaya ayaan xagga macbudkaaga quduuska ah u soo tukan doonaa.
english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, cadaawayaashayda daraaddood xaqnimadaada igu hoggaami, Oo jidkaaga hortayda ku toosi.
english: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

kikuyu: Waayo, afkooda daacadnimo kuma jirto, Oo uurkooda hoosena waa xumaan miidhan, Hungurigooduna waa qabri af bannaan, Oo carrabkooduna waa sasabasho miidhan.
english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, iyaga kuwo eed leh ku tiri, Oo iyagu taladooda ha ku baabbe'een, Oo xadgudubkooda batay daraaddiis u tuur iyaga, Waayo, way kugu caasiyoobeen.
english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa adiga isku kaa halleeya oo dhammu ha reyreeyeen, Oo farxad ha ku qayliyeen weligoodba, maxaa yeelay, adigaa daafaca iyaga, Kuwa magacaaga jeceluna adiga ha kugu farxeen.
english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiyow, kii xaq ah waad barakayn doontaa, Oo waxaad hareerihiisa ku wareejinaysaa raallinimo sidii gaashaan oo kale.
english: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, cadhadaada ha igu canaanan, Oo dhirifkaaga kululna ha igu edbin.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ii naxariiso, waayo, anigu waan taagdaranahay, Rabbiyow, i bogsii, waayo, lafahaygu way dhib qabaan.
english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

kikuyu: Oo weliba naftayduna aad iyo aad bay u dhibaataysan tahay, Adiguse, Rabbiyow, ilaa goormaad sugaysaa?
english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, soo noqo oo naftayda samatabbixi, Oo igu badbaadi raxmaddaada daraaddeed.
english: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

kikuyu: Waayo, geeridu ma leh xusuus adiga lagugu xusuusto, Bal yaase She'ool kaaga mahadnaqi doona?
english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

kikuyu: Waxaan la daalay jibaadkayga, Habeen kasta sariirtayda oohin baan ku qoyaa. Gogoshaydana waxaan ku qoyaa ilmadayda.
english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

kikuyu: Ishaydu waxay la gudhaysaa tiiraanyo, Oo cadaawayaashayda daraaddood ayay la gabowdaa.
english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

kikuyu: Iga taga, kuwiinna xaqdarrada ka shaqeeya oo dhammow, Waayo, Rabbigu waa maqlay codkii oohintayda.
english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa maqlay baryootankaygii, Oo Rabbigu waa aqbalayaa tukashadayda.
english: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashayda oo dhammu way wada ceeboobi doonaan, oo aad iyo aad bay u dhibtoon doonaan, Dib bay u noqon doonaan, oo si kediso ah ayay u ceeboobi doonaan.
english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaahayow, adigaan isku kaa halleeyaa, Haddaba iga badbaadi kuwa i eryanaya oo dhan, oo iga samatabbixi,
english: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

kikuyu: Waaba intaasoo ay naftayda sida libaax oo kale u kala dildillaaciyaane, Oo ay i kala jeexjeexaan intii aanay jirin cid iga samatabbixisaa.
english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaahayow, haddii aan waxan sameeyey, Haddii xumaanu gacmahayga ku jirto,
english: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

kikuyu: Haddii aan shar ugu abaalguday mid ila nabad ah, (Haah, oo waxaan samatabbixiyey kii sababla'aan cadowga iigu ahaa,)
english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

kikuyu: De markaas cadowgu naftayda ha eryado, oo ha qabsado, Oo isagu ha igu tunto, Oo sharaftaydana ciidda ha ku rido. (Selaah)
english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, cadhadaada la kac, Oo ku kac dhirifka cadaawayaashayda, Aniga daraadday u sara joogso, waayo, waxaad amartay xukun.
english: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

kikuyu: Oo dadyowga ururradoodu ha ku hareereeyeen, Oo adna iyaga xagga sare uga noqo.
english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

kikuyu: Rabbigu dadyowga buu u garsooraa, Rabbiyow, ii xukun siday xaqnimadaydu tahay, iyo siday daacadnimadayda igu jirtaa tahay.
english: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka leh sharkoodu ha dhammaado, laakiinse xoogee kuwa xaqa ah, Waayo, Ilaaha xaqa ahu wuxuu imtixaamaa qalbiga iyo uurka.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

kikuyu: Gaashaankaygu wuxuu la jiraa Ilaaha Badbaadiya kuwa qalbigoodu qumman yahay.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Ilaah waa xaakin xaq ah, Oo waa Ilaah maalin kasta dhirifsan.
english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

kikuyu: Haddii aan laga noqon, isagu seeftiisuu afaysan doonaa, Qaansadiisana wuu xootay, oo wuu diyaarsaday.
english: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu diyaarsaday alaabtii dhimashada, Oo fallaadhihiisana wuxuu ka dhigtaa kuwo ololaya.
english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

kikuyu: Bal eega, ninku wuxuu la dhibtoodaa xumaan, Oo wuxuu wallacay belaayo, oo wuxuu dhalay been.
english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

kikuyu: Booraan buu sameeyey, oo uu qoday, Oo wuxuu ku dhacay bohoshii uu isagu sameeyey.
english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

kikuyu: Belaayadiisu waxay dib ugu noqonaysaa madaxiisa, Oo dulmigiisuna dhaladiisuu ku soo degayaa.
english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

kikuyu: Rabbiga waan ugu mahadnaqayaa sida ay xaqnimadiisu tahay, Oo waxaan u ammaanayaa magaca Rabbiga ah Ilaaha ugu sarreeya.
english: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Sayidkayagiiyow, Magacaagu dunida oo dhan ku fiicanaa! Waayo, sharaftaadii waxaad ka sarraysiisay samooyinka.
english: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

kikuyu: Waxaad xoog u yeeshay afka ilmaha yaryar iyo caanonuugga, Waana cadaawayaashaada daraaddood, Si aad u aamusiisid cadowga iyo aardoonka.
english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

kikuyu: Markaan ka fiirsado samooyinka farahaaga lagu sameeyey, Iyo dayaxa iyo xiddigaha aad amartay,
english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

kikuyu: Bal waa maxay dadku oo aad u xusuusataa isaga? Iyo wiilka aadanaha oo aad u soo booqataa?
english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad isaga wax yar ka hoosaysiisay malaa'igaha, Waxaanad taaj uga dhigtay ammaan iyo murwad.
english: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad isaga ka dhigtay inuu u taliyo shuqullada gacmahaaga, Oo wax walbana cagihiisaad ka hoosaysiisay,
english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

kikuyu: Idaha iyo lo'da oo dhan, Iyo xayawaanka duurka joogaba,
english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

kikuyu: Iyo haadka hawada, iyo kalluunka badda, Iyo wax alla waxa ku dhex socda waddooyinka badaha.
english: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Sayidkayagiiyow, Magacaagu dunida oo dhan ku fiicanaa!
english: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

kikuyu: Qalbigayga oo dhan ayaan Rabbiga ugu mahadnaqi doonaa, Waxaan muujin doonaa shuqulladaada yaabka leh oo dhan.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

kikuyu: Waan kugu farxi doonaa oo kugu rayrayn doonaa, Kaaga ah kan ugu sarreeyow, magacaaga ayaan ammaan ugu gabyi doonaa.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashaydu markii ay dib u noqdaan, Way kufaan, oo waxay ku halligmaan hortaada.
english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

kikuyu: Waayo, adigu xaqaygii iyo dacwadaydiiba waad ilaalisay, Carshigaad ku fadhiday adigoo si xaq ah wax u xukumaya.
english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

kikuyu: Quruumaha ayaad canaanatay, oo kuwa sharka lehna waad baabbi'isay, Oo magacoodiina waad tirtirtay weligiis iyo weligiis.
english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashii way dhammaadeen, oo weligoodba waa baabba', Oo magaalooyinkii aad afgembidayna Xataa xusuustoodii waa baabba'day.
english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbigu wuxuu weligiis u fadhiyaa sida boqor, Oo carshigiisiina wuxuu u diyaarsaday garsoorid.
english: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

kikuyu: Oo dunida xaqnimuu ku xukumi doonaa. Oo dadyowgana qummanaan buu ugu garsoori doonaa.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Rabbigu wuxuu kuwa la dulmay u noqon doonaa magangal. Oo kolkii ay dhibaataysan yihiinna magangal buu u ahaan doonaa,
english: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa magacaaga yaqaanna way isku kaa hallayn doonaan, Waayo, adigu Rabbiyow, ma aad dayrisid kuwa ku doondoona.
english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Siyoon deggan ammaan ugu gabya, Oo waxyaalahuu sameeyey dadka dhexdiisa ka caddeeya.
english: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa iyaga xusuusta ka dhiigga ka aarguda, Oo isagu ma illoobo qaylada masaakiinta.
english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ii naxariiso, Bal eeg dhibaatada ay kuwa i necebu igu hayaan. Waxaad kor iiga qaaddaa irdaha dhimashada,
english: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

kikuyu: Si aan u muujiyo ammaantaada oo dhan, Badbaadadaada aawadeed ayaan ugu farxi doonaa irdaha Siyoon.
english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: Quruumihii waxay ku dheceen yamayskii ay qodeen, Oo cagtoodiina waxaa qabsaday shabaggii ay qariyeen.
english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa ismuujiyey, oo xukun buu dejiyey, Kii shar lahaa waxaa dabay shuqulkii gacmihiisa. (Higgayoon. Selaah)
english: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu waxay ku noqonayaan She'ool, Waana quruumaha Ilaah illoobay oo dhan.
english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

kikuyu: Waayo, kan baahan mar walba lama illoobi doono, Oo masaakiinta waxfilashadooduna weligeed ma baabba'sanaan doonto.
english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, sara joogso, oo dadku yaanay adkaan. Quruumaha hortaada ha lagu xukumo.
english: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, iyaga cabsi geli, Oo quruumuhu ha is-ogaadeen inay dad uun yihiin. (Selaah)
english: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, maxaad meesha fog u istaagtay? Oo maxaad u dhuumataa markii dhibaato jirto?
english: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

kikuyu: Kii shar leh oo kibir badan ayaa miskiinka si kulul u eryada, Xeeladdii ay hindiseen iyaga ha la rogmato.
english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii shar lahu wuxuu ku faanaa waxa qalbigiisu jecel yahay, Oo kii damaci ahuna Rabbiga wuu nacaa, wuuna quudhsadaa.
english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.

kikuyu: Kii shar lahu isagoo wejigiisa kibir ka muuqdo wuxuu yidhaahdaa, Isagu waxba i weyddiisan maayo. Fikirradiisa oo dhammu waxaa weeye, Ilaah ma jiro.
english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

kikuyu: Jidadkiisuu ku adag yahay had iyo goorba, Xukummadaaduna waa ka sarreeyaan isaga, waana ka fog yihiin, Oo cadaawayaashiisa oo dhanna wuu wada fudaydsadaa.
english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu isyidhaahdaa, Anigu weligay dhaqdhaqaaqi maayo, Oo tan iyo ka ab ka ab xumaanu i heli mayso.
english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

kikuyu: Afkiisa waxaa ka buuxa habaar iyo khiyaano iyo dulmi, Oo carrabkiisana waxaa ku hoos jira belaayo iyo xumaan.
english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu fadhiistaa tuulooyinka meelahooda lagu dhuunto, Oo kan aan xaqa qabinna wuxuu ku dilaa meelaha qarsoon, Oo indhihiisuna waxay si qarsoon hoos uga fiiriyaan miskiinka.
english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu ku dhuuntaa meel qarsoon sida libaax godkiisa ku jira, Oo wuxuu u gaadaa inuu miskiinka qabsado, Oo intuu miskiinka qabsado ayuu ku soo jiitaa shabaggiisa.
english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

kikuyu: Wuu foororsadaa, oo hoos isu gaabiyaa, Oo masaakiinta waxaa ridda gacanta kuwiisa xoogga badan.
english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu isyidhaahdaa, Ilaah waa i illoobay, Oo wejigiisiina wuu qariyey, weligiisna ima arki doono.
english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaahow, sara joogso, oo gacantaada kor u qaad, Oo masaakiinta ha illoobin.
english: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

kikuyu: Bal kii shar lahu muxuu Ilaah u quudhsadaa? Oo muxuu qalbigiisa uga leeyahay, Adigu waxba i weyddiisan maysid?
english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

kikuyu: Waxaas baad aragtay, waayo, waad u jeeddaa belaayada iyo xanaaqa, inaad gacantaada ku aargudatid aawadeed, Miskiinku adiguu isu kaa dhiibaa, Waayo, adigu waxaad tahay agoonka kaalmeeyihiisa.
english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

kikuyu: Kii shar leh gacantiisa jebi, Oo sharrowga xumaantiisana doondoon ilaa aad mid dambe weydid.
english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa boqor weligiis iyo weligiisba, Oo quruumaha oo dhammuna dalkiisa way ka wada baabba'aan.
english: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waad maqashay waxay kuwa is-hoosaysiiyaa doonayaan, Oo qalbigooda waad diyaarin doontaa, oo dhegtaadana waad u dhigi doontaa,
english: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

kikuyu: Si aad gartooda u naqdid agoonta iyo kuwa la dulmay, Si aan dadka dunidu mar dambe u noqon kuwo laga cabsado.
english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

kikuyu: Anigu Rabbigaan isku halleeyaa, Haddaba idinku sidee baad naftayda ugu tidhaahdaan, Sida shimbir oo kale buurtiinnii ku carara?
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eega, kuwa sharka lahu waxay xoodaan qaansada, Fallaadhoodana waxay ku diyaariyaan xadhigga, Inay kan qalbiga ka qumman goor gudcur ah ku ganaan.
english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Haddii aasaaska la dumiyo, Kan xaqa ahu bal muxuu samayn karaa?
english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu ku jiraa macbudkiisa quduuska ah, Rabbiga carshigiisu wuxuu yaal samada, Indhihiisu way eegaan, oo indhihiisa daboolkooduna way imtixaamaan binu-aadmiga.
english: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa tijaabiyaa kii xaq ah, Laakiinse kii shar leh iyo kii dulmi jecelba naftiisu way neceb tahay.
english: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

kikuyu: Kuwa shar leh wuxuu ku soo kor daadin doonaa dabinno, Oo qaybta koobkooduna waxaa weeye dab iyo baaruud iyo dabayl hanfi ah.
english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu waa xaq, oo isagu xaqnimaduu jecel yahay, Kuwa qummanuna wejigiisay arki doonaan.
english: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, dadkaaga caawi, waayo, nin cibaado leh waa la waayayaa, Waayo, binu-aadmiga intii aaminka ahayd way ka dhammaadeen.
english: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

kikuyu: Mid walba deriskiisa wuxuu kula hadlaa been, Oo waxay ku hadlaan bushimo sasabasho miidhan ah iyo laba qalbi.
english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu wada baabbi'in doonaa bushimaha sasabashada badan oo dhan, Iyo carrabka waxyaalaha waaweyn ku hadlaba.
english: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waxay yidhaahdeen, Annagu waxaan ku adkaan doonnaa carrabkayaga, Oo bushimahayagana annagaa iska leh. Haddaba bal yaa annaga sayid noo ah?
english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu haatan waxaan u kacayaa Masaakiinta la dhacayo, iyo kuwa baahan taahiddooda daraaddood, Oo kan ay fudaydsanayaanna waan ammaan gelinayaa.
english: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

kikuyu: Rabbiga erayadiisu waa erayo daahir ah, Oo waa sida lacag foorno kulul oo dhulka ku taal lagu kala miiray, Oo toddoba jeer la safeeyey.
english: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waad dhawri doontaa, Oo qarnigan ayaad iyaga ka xannaanayn doontaa weligood.
english: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

kikuyu: Markii nijaasta binu-aadmiga dhexdiisa lagu jecel yahay, Kuwa sharka lahu waxay ku socdaan dhinac kasta.
english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ilaa goormaad i illoobaysaa? Ma weligaa baa? Oo ilaa goormaad wejigaaga iga qarinaysaa?
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

kikuyu: Ilaa goormaan naftayda la tashanayaa, Anigoo maalinta oo dhan calool xun? Ilaa goormuu cadowgaygu iga sarraynayaa?
english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

kikuyu: Rabbiyow Ilaahayow, waxaas u fiirso, oo ii jawaab, Indhahayga iftiimi, yaanan hurdadii geerida seexanine,
english: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

kikuyu: Waaba intaasoo cadowgaygu yidhaahdaa, Anigu isagaan ka adkaaday, Oo ay cadaawayaashaydu farxaan markii lay dhaqaajiyo.
english: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waxaan isku halleeyey naxariistaada, Oo qalbigayguna wuxuu ku rayrayn doonaa badbaadintaada.
english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

kikuyu: Rabbigaan u gabyi doonaa, Maxaa yeelay, wax badan oo wanaagsan buu ii sameeyey.
english: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.

kikuyu: Nacasku wuxuu qalbigiisa iska yidhaahdaa, Ilaah ma jiro. Iyagu way kharriban yihiin, oo waxay sameeyeen shuqullo karaahiyo ah, Ma jiro mid wanaag sameeya.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

kikuyu: Rabbigu samaduu ka soo fiiriyey binu-aadmiga, Inuu arko haddii ay jiraan kuwo wax garanaya, Oo Ilaah doondoona.
english: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

kikuyu: Dhammaantood gees bay u wada leexdeen, oo way wada nijaasoobeen, Mid wanaag falaa ma jiro, midnaba.
english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: Xumaanfalayaasha oo dhammu miyaanay aqoon lahayn? Iyagoo dadkayga cuna, siday kibista u cunaan, Mana ay baryaan Rabbiga.
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

kikuyu: Halkaasay aad ugu cabsadeen, Maxaa yeelay, Ilaah wuxuu la jiraa qarniga xaqa ah.
english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad ceebaysaan talada miskiinka, Laakiin Rabbigu waa magangalkiisa.
english: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

kikuyu: Badbaadada reer binu Israa'iil bal may Siyoon ka timaado! Marka Rabbigu dadkiisa maxaabiisnimada ka soo celiyo, Ayaa reer Yacquub rayrayn doonaa, oo reer binu Israa'iilna farxi doonaa.
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, bal yaa taambuuggaaga ku fadhiyaya? Oo bal yaa buurtaada quduuska ah degganaanaya?
english: A Psalm by David. LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

kikuyu: Waa kii si qumman u socda, oo xaqnimo sameeya, Oo qalbigiisa run kaga hadla.
english: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

kikuyu: Waana kii aan carrabkiisa wax ku xaman, Ama aan saaxiibkiis xumaan ku samayn, Ama aan deriskiisa cay ku soo hadal qaadin,
english: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

kikuyu: Kii indhihiisu ay nejiska quudhsadaan, Oo isagu murweeya kuwa Rabbiga ka cabsada, Kii hadduu dhaarto oo ay waxyeello ku tahay, aan isbeddelin,
english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

kikuyu: Kii aan lacagtiisa u soo bixin korsocod, Ama aan laaluush u qaadan inuu wax yeelo kuwa aan xaqa qabin. Kii waxyaalahaas sameeya weligiis lama dhaqaajin doono.
english: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, i dhawr, waayo, adigaan isku kaa halleeyaa.
english: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Waxaan Rabbiga ku idhi, Sayidkayga baad tahay, Oo innaba wanaag ma haysto la'aantaa.
english: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

kikuyu: Quduusiinta dhulka joogtaa Waxaa weeye kuwa sharafta leh oo aan aad iyo aad ula faraxsanahay.
english: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

kikuyu: Kuwa ilaaha kale u dheereeya murugtoodu waa badnaan doontaa, Laakiinse anigu bixin maayo qurbaankooda cabniinka oo dhiigga ah, Oo magacyadoodana bushimahayga ku soo qaadi maayo.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waxaa weeye qaybtii dhaxalkayga iyo koobkayga, Adigu qaybtayda waad xannaanaysaa.
english: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

kikuyu: Dhulqaybsigii meelo wacan baan ku helay, Haah, oo waxaan leeyahay dhaxal wanaagsan.
english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ammaanayaa Rabbiga i waaniyey, Habeenkiina uurkaygu wax buu i baraa.
english: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

kikuyu: Had iyo jeerba Rabbigaan hortayda ku xusuustaa, Oo anigu innaba dhaqdhaqaaqi maayo, Maxaa yeelay, isagu wuxuu joogaa midigtayda.
english: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Taas aawadeed qalbigaygu waa faraxsan yahay oo naftayduna way rayraysaa, Oo weliba jidhkayguna ammaan buu ku jiri doonaa.
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, naftayda She'ool kuma dayn doontid, Kaaga quduuska ahna uma dayn doontid inuu qudhun arko.
english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

kikuyu: Waxaad i tusi doontaa jidka nolosha, Hortaada farxad baa ka buuxda, Gacantaada midigna nimco baa ku jirta weligeed.
english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, xaqa maqal, oo qayladayda u jeeso, Oo baryadayda dhegta u dhig, taasoo aan ka bixin bushimo khiyaano leh.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

kikuyu: Xukunkaygu ha ka yimaado hortaada, Oo indhahaaguna caddaalad ha fiiriyeen.
english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

kikuyu: Qalbigayga waad tijaabisay, oo habeennimaad i soo booqatay, Waad i imtixaantay, oo wax shar ah igama aad helin, Waxaan u qasdiyey inaanu afkaygu xadgudbin.
english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

kikuyu: Shuqulladii dadkana waan ka hadhay, Oo erayada bushimahaaga ayaan kaga joogsaday jidadkii kuwa wax dulma oo dhan.
english: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

kikuyu: Si aanay cagahaygu u simbiriirixan, Tallaabooyinkayga ku adkee waddooyinkaaga.
english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, waan ku baryay, waayo, waad ii jawaabi doontaa, Bal dhegta ii dhig, oo hadalkayga maqal.
english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

kikuyu: Bal muuji raxmaddaada yaabka leh, Adigoo kuwa isku kaa halleeya gacantaada midig kaga badbaadiya Kuwa ku kaca iyaga.
english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

kikuyu: Ii dhawr sida isha inankeeda, Oo igu qari hooska baalashaada.
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

kikuyu: Waxaad iga qarisaa kuwa sharka leh oo i kharriba, Kuwaas oo ah cadaawayaasha naftayda oo hareerahayga ku wareegsan.
english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

kikuyu: Qalbigooday xidheen, Oo afkooduna wuxuu ku hadlaa waxyaalo kibir miidhan ah.
english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

kikuyu: Oo haatan waxay cidhiidhiyeen tallaabooyinkayagii, Oo waxay noogu dhaygageen inay dhulka nagu tuuraan aawadeed.
english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

kikuyu: Isagu waa sida aar libaax ugaadhsi damacsan, Iyo sida aaran libaax oo meelo qarsoon ku dhuunta.
english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, kac, Oo isaga ka hor tag, oo dhulka hoos ugu tuur, Oo naftaydana kan sharka leh seeftaada kaga samatabbixi,
english: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waxaad dadka igaga samatabbixisaa gacantaada, Kuwaas oo ah dadka dunida, oo qaybtoodu ku jirto nolosha adduunkan, Oo aad calooshooda ka buuxisaa khasnaddaada, Iyagu waxay ka dhergeen carruur, Oo maalkooda hadhayna waxay uga tagaan dhallaankooda.
english: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu xaqnimaan wejigaaga ku fiirin doonaa, Oo waa i deeqi doonaa markii aan ammaantaada arko, oo aan ekaantaada la soo tooso.
english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, xooggaygiiyow, anigu waan ku jeclahay.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, LORD, my strength.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa dhagax weyn oo ii gabbaad ah iyo qalcaddayda, iyo samatabbixiyahayga, Iyo Ilaahay, iyo gabbaadkayga adag, oo isagaan isku hallayn doonaa, Isagu waa gaashaankayga, iyo geeska badbaadadayda, iyo munaaraddayda dheer.
english: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

kikuyu: Waxaan baryayaa Rabbiga istaahila in la ammaano, Oo sidaasaan cadaawayaashayda kaga badbaadi doonaa.
english: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

kikuyu: Waxaa i hareereeyey xadhkihii dhimashada, Oo waxaa i cabsiiyey daadkii cibaadala'aanta.
english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

kikuyu: Waxaa igu wareegsanaa xadhkihii She'ool, Oo waxaa i qabsaday dabinnadii dhimashada.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

kikuyu: Anigoo cidhiidhi ku jira ayaan Rabbiga baryay, Oo waxaan u qayshaday Ilaahay, Isna codkayguu macbudkiisa ka maqlay, Oo qayladayda hortiisa ka yeedhaysaana dhegihiisay gashay.
english: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dhulku ruxmay oo gariiray, Oo buuraha aasaaskoodiina wuu dhaqdhaqaaqay, Oo wuu ruxmay, maxaa yeelay, Ilaah waa cadhaysnaa.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

kikuyu: Dulalka sankiisa waxaa ka soo baxay qiiq, Afkiisana waxaa ka soo baxay dab wax gubaya, oo dhuxulaa ka shidmay isaga.
english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

kikuyu: Oo weliba samooyinka wuu soo foorarshay, oo hoos buu u soo degay, Oo cagihiisana waxaa hoos yiil gudcur weyn.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu fuulay keruub, wuuna duulay, Haah, oo wuxuu si dheeraysa ugu duulay oo fuulay dabaysha baalasheeda.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Wuxuu gudcurka ka dhigtay meeshiisii dhuumashada, iyo taambuuggiisa hareerihiisa ku wareegsan, Iyo biyo gudcur ah, iyo daruuraha qarada waaweyn oo cirka.
english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

kikuyu: Nuurkii hortiisa yiil aawadiis ayay daruurihii qarada waaweynaa tageen, Roobkii dhagaxyada lahaa iyo dhuxulihii dabka ahaana way carareen.
english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu ka onkoday samooyinka, Sarreeyuhuna wuxuu ku hadlay codkiisii, Oo soo daayay roob dhagaxyaale iyo dhuxulo dab ah.
english: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: Markaasuu fallaadhihiisii soo ganay oo kala firdhiyey iyagii, Haah, oo wuxuu u soo diray hillaac badan, wuuna baabbi'iyey iyagii.
english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, canaantaadii aawadeed iyo dulalka sankaaga neefta ka soo baxaysa aawadeed Ayaa durdurradii biyuhu la muuqdeen, Oo aasaaskii duniduna wuu soo bannaan baxay.
english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

kikuyu: Xagga sare ayuu cid ka soo diray, oo wuu i qaaday, Oo wuxuu iga soo dhex bixiyey biyo badan.
english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

kikuyu: Wuxuu iga samatabbixiyey cadowgaygii xoogga badnaa, Iyo kuwii i necbaaba, waayo, iyagu way iga xoog badnaayeen.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

kikuyu: Waxay igu soo kediyeen maalintii aan belaayaysnaa, Laakiinse Rabbigu wuxuu ii ahaa tiir.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu i keenay meel ballaadhan, Wuu i soo samatabbixiyey, maxaa yeelay, wuu igu farxay.
english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu iigu abaalguday sidii ay xaqnimadaydii ahayd, Oo sidii ay nadiifsanaantii gacmahaygu ahayd ayuu iigu abaalguday.
english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu waan xajiyey jidadkii Rabbiga, Oo Ilaahayna si caasinimo ah ugama tegin.
english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

kikuyu: Waayo, xukummadiisii oo dhammu hortayday yiilleen, Oo qaynuunnadiisiina anigu iskama tuurin.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

kikuyu: Oo weliba xaggiisana waan ku qummanaa, Oo waan iska dhawray xumaantaydii.
english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ayaa Rabbigu iigu abaalguday sidii ay xaqnimadaydii ahayd, Iyo sidii nadiifsanaanta gacmahaygu ay ku ahayd indhihiisa hortooda.
english: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

kikuyu: Kii naxariis leh waad u naxariisanaysaa, Oo ninkii qummanna waad u qummanaanaysaa.
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

kikuyu: Kii daahir ahna daahir baad u ahaanaysaa, Oo kii qalloocanna mid maroorsan baad u ahaanaysaa.
english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad badbaadinaysaa dadka dhibaataysan, Laakiinse indhaha kibirsan waad soo dejinaysaa.
english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad daaraysaa laambaddayda, Rabbiga Ilaahayga ah ayaa gudcurkayga iftiiminaya.
english: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.

kikuyu: Waayo, adaan col kuugu dhex ordaa, Oo Ilaahay caawimaaddiisa ayaan derbi kaga boodaa.
english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

kikuyu: Ilaah jidkiisu waa qumman yahay, Rabbiga eraygiisuna waa mid la tijaabiyey, Isagu wuxuu gaashaan u yahay kuwa isaga isku halleeya oo dhan.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal yaa Ilaah ah, Rabbiga mooyaane? Oo bal yaa dhagax weyn ah, Ilaahayaga mooyaane?
english: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,

kikuyu: Kaasoo ah Ilaaha ii guntiya xoog, Jidkaygana qummaatiya.
english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

kikuyu: Isagu cagahayga wuxuu ka dhigaa sida cagaha deerada, Oo wuxuu igu fadhiisiyaa meelahayga sare.
english: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

kikuyu: Gacmahaygana wuxuu baraa dagaalka, Oo sidaas daraaddeed gacmahaygu waxay xoodaan qaanso naxaas ah.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

kikuyu: Weliba waxaad kaloo i siisay gaashaankii badbaadintaada, Oo waxaa kor ii qaadday gacantaada midig, Oo roonaantaada ayaa i weynaysay.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

kikuyu: Adigu tallaabooyinkayga waxaad ku ballaadhisay hoostayda, Oo cagahayguna ma ay simbiriirixan.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan eryan doonaa cadaawayaashayda, oo waan gaadhi doonaa, Oo jeeray wada baabba'aanna dib uga soo noqon maayo.
english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

kikuyu: Waan wada layn doonaa si aanay mar dambe u awoodin inay kacaan, Oo cagahaygay ku soo hoos dhici doonaan.
english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

kikuyu: Waayo, xoog baad iigu guntisay dagaalka aawadiis, Oo kuwii igu kacayna hoostaydaad ku soo tuurtay.
english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

kikuyu: Oo weliba cadaawayaashaydii waxaad ka dhigtay inay dhabarka ii jeediyaan, Si aan u kala gooyo kuwa i neceb.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

kikuyu: Iyagu way qayshadeen, laakiinse way waayeen mid iyaga badbaadiya, Oo xataa Rabbiga way baryeen, laakiinse uma uu jawaabin.
english: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

kikuyu: Markaasaan iyagii u duqeeyey sida boodhka dabaysha hor kaca, Oo waxaan iyagii dibadda ugu tuuray sidii dhoobada jidadka taal oo kale.
english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

kikuyu: Waxaad iga samatabbixisay murankii dadka, Oo waxaad iga dhigtay quruumaha madaxdoodii, Oo dad aanan aqoon ayaa ii adeegi doona.
english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

kikuyu: Oo mar alla markii ay warkayga maqlaan way i addeeci doonaan, Oo shisheeyayaashuna way isu kay dhiibi doonaan,
english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

kikuyu: Shisheeyayaashu way libdhi doonaan, Oo iyagoo gariiraya ayay qolalkooda ka soo bixi doonaan.
english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa nool yahay, oo mahad waxaa leh dhagaxayga weyn, Oo Ilaaha i badbaadiyeyna ha sarreeyo,
english: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

kikuyu: Kaasoo ah Ilaaha aniga ii aarguda, Oo dadkana hoostayda ku soo tuura.
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu iga badbaadiyaa cadaawayaashayda, Haah, oo adigu waxaad iga sara marisaa kuwa igu kaca, Oo waxaad iga samatabbixisaa ninka dulmiga badan.
english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, Rabbiyow, anigu waxaan kuugu mahadnaqi doonaa quruumaha dhexdooda, Oo magacaaga ammaan baan ugu gabyi doonaa.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

kikuyu: Rabbigu si weyn buu boqorkiisa u samatabbixiyaa, Oo wuxuu weligiis raxmad u sameeyaa kii uu subkaday, Kaasoo ah Daa'uud, iyo farcankiisaba weligiis iyo weligiis.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

kikuyu: Samooyinku waxay caddeeyaan ammaanta Ilaah, Cirkuna wuxuu muujiyaa sancadii gacantiisa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

kikuyu: Maalinba maalinta ka dambaysaa waxay ku hadashaa hadal, Oo habeenba habeenka ka dambeeyaa wuxuu caddeeyaa aqoon.
english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

kikuyu: Ma jiro hadal ama af Aan codkooda laga maqlin.
english: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

kikuyu: Codkoodii wuxuu dhex maray dhulka oo dhan, Hadalkoodiina wuxuu gaadhay dunida meesha ugu dambaysa. Oo dhexdooda wuxuu taambuug u dhigay qorraxda,
english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

kikuyu: Taasoo la mid ah aroos qolladdiisii ka soo baxaya, Oo waxay u faraxdaa sida nin xoog leh oo baratamaya.
english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

kikuyu: Waxay ka soo baxdaa samada darafkeeda, Oo waxay ku soo wareegtaa hareeraheeda, Oo kulaylkeedana wax ka qarsoonu ma jiraan.
english: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

kikuyu: Sharciga Rabbigu waa kaamil, oo nafta wuu soo celiyaa, Maragfurka Rabbigu waa aamin, oo garaadlaawaha ayuu u caqliyeeyaa.
english: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

kikuyu: Qaynuunnada Rabbigu waa hagaagsan yihiin, oo qalbiga ayay ka farxiyaan, Amarka Rabbigu waa daahir oo indhaha ayuu nuuriyaa.
english: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

kikuyu: Cabsida Rabbigu waa nadiif, weligeedna way raagtaa, Xukummada Rabbigu waa run, waana wada xaq dhammaantood.
english: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

kikuyu: Iyagu waa wax xataa dahab laga sii jeclaado, haah, xataa dahab badan oo saafi ah, Oo weliba way ka sii macaan yihiin malab iyo awlallada malabka.
english: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

kikuyu: Oo weliba addoonkaagana iyagaa loogu digay, Oo xajintoodana waxaa ku jira abaalgud weyn.
english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

kikuyu: Bal yaa qaladdadiisa garan kara? Rabbow, iga nadiifi dembiyo qarsoon.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

kikuyu: Anoo addoonkaaga ah iga hay waxyaalo aan ku kibro, Oo yaanay ii talin, Oo markaas kaamil baan ahaan doonaa, Oo xadgudub weynna daahir baan ka ahaan doonaa.
english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, xooggayga iyo bixiyahaygiiyow, Erayada afkayga iyo fikirka qalbigaygu ha ahaadeen kuwo hortaada lagu aqbalo.
english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

kikuyu: Rabbigu ha kuu jawaabo maalinta dhibta, Ilaaha Yacquub magiciisu meel sare ha ku taago,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

kikuyu: Caawimaadna ha kaaga soo diro meesha quduuska ah, Oo Siyoonna ha kaa xoogeeyo,
english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

kikuyu: Ha xusuusto qurbaannadaadii oo dhan, Oo ha aqbalo allabarigaagii gubnaa, (Selaah)
english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

kikuyu: Oo ha ku siiyo waxa qalbigaagu doono, Oo ha kuu yeelo muraadkaaga oo dhan.
english: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

kikuyu: Innagu waxaynu ku guulaysanaynaa badbaadintaada, Oo calammadeennana waxaynu ku sudhaynaa magaca Ilaaheenna, Rabbigu ha ku siiyo waxaad weyddiisato oo dhan.
english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.

kikuyu: Anigu hadda waan ogahay in Rabbigu badbaadiyo kii uu isagu subkaday, Oo wuxuu isaga uga soo jawaabi doonaa samadiisa quduuska ah, Oo wuxuuna ugu jawaabi doonaa xooggiisa wax badbaadiya oo gacantiisa midig.
english: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

kikuyu: Qaar waxay isku halleeyaan gaadhifardoodyo, qaarna waxay isku halleeyaan fardo, Laakiinse innagu waxaynu xusuusanaynaa magaca Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah.
english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

kikuyu: Iyagu way foororsadeen, wayna dheceen, Laakiinse innagu waynu kacnay, oo waynu taagan nahay.
english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ina badbaadi, Oo Boqorku ha inoo jawaabo markii aynu u qayshanno.
english: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, boqorku wuxuu ku farxi doonaa xooggaaga, Oo badbaadintaadana aad buu ugu rayrayn doonaa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

kikuyu: Waxaad isaga siisay wixii qalbigiisu doonayay, Oo wixii bushimihiisu ku weyddiisteenna uma aad diidin. (Selaah)
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad isaga hor dhigtaa barakooyinka wanaagga, Oo madaxiisana waxaad saartaa taaj dahab saafi ah.
english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

kikuyu: Wuxuu kaa baryay nolol, oo adna waad siisay isaga, Oo waxaad siisay cimri dheer oo waaraya weligiis iyo weligiisba.
english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ammaantiisu waxay ku weyn tahay xagga badbaadintaada, Oo waxaad isaga saartaa murwad iyo haybad.
english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad isaga ka dhigtaa mid weligiisba aad u barakaysan, Oo waxaad ka dhigtaa inuu hortaada farxad kula reyreeyo.
english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

kikuyu: Waayo, boqorku wuxuu isku halleeyaa Rabbiga, Oo Ilaaha ugu sarreeya raxmaddiisa aawadeed isaga innaba lama dhaqaajin doono.
english: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Gacantaadu waxay heli doontaa cadaawayaashaada oo dhan, Oo midigtaaduna waxay heli doontaa kuwa ku neceb.
english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

kikuyu: Oo markii aad cadhootid waxaad iyaga ka dhigi doontaa sida foorno dab ah. Oo Rabbigu wuxuu iyaga ku liqi doonaa cadhadiisa, Oo dab baa gubi doona.
english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

kikuyu: Midhahooda dhulkaad ka baabbi'inaysaa, Farcankoodana binu-aadmiga dhexdiisa.
english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu waxay ku talo jireen inay xumaan kugu sameeyaan, Oo waxay hindiseen xeel ayan iyagu dhammayn karin.
english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad iyaga ka dhigi doontaa inay dib u jeestaan, Oo xadhigga qaansadaadana waxaad ku diyaarin doontaa wejigooda hortiisa.
english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigu xooggaaga ku sarree, Markaasaannu gabyi doonnaa, oo waxaannu ammaani doonnaa itaalkaaga.
english: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, Ilaahayow, maxaad ii dayrisay? Oo aad uga fogaatay caawimaaddayda iyo hadalka hinraaggayga?
english: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, maalintii waan kuu qayshadaa, adiguse iima jawaabtid, Oo habeennimadana waan qayliyaa oo ma nasto.
english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu quduus baad tahay, Oo kursigaaga waxaad ka dhigtaa ammaanta reer binu Israa'iil.
english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

kikuyu: Awowayaashayo adigay isku kaa halleeyeen, Iyagu way isku kaa halleeyeen, oo adna waad samatabbixisay.
english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

kikuyu: Adigay kuu qayshadeen, oo way samatabbexeen, Way isku kaa halleeyeen, oo mana ay ceeboobin.
english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waxaan ahay dixiri, oo dad ma ahi, Waxaan ahay mid la caayo, oo dadku quudhsado.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa i arka oo dhammu way igu qoslaan, Bushimahay yuubaan, oo madaxay lulaan, iyagoo leh,
english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbiguu isku halleeyey, ha samatabbixiyo, Bal isagu waa kan ku faraxsane hadda ha samatabbixiyo.
