english: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu waxaad tahay kii uurka iga soo bixiyey, Oo intaan naasaha hooyaday nuugayay, waxaad iga dhigtay mid ku aaminsan.
english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

kikuyu: Aniga dushaadaa laygu soo tuuray markaan uurka ka soo baxay, Xataa tan iyo intaan uurkii hooyaday ku jiray, Ilaahaygaad ahayd.
english: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

kikuyu: Ha iga fogaan, waayo, dhib baa soo dhow, Qof i caawiyaana ma jiro.
english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

kikuyu: Waxaa i hareereeyey dibiyo badan, Oo kuwii Baashaan oo xoogga badnaa ayaa hareerahayga isku wareejiyey.
english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

kikuyu: Afkooday iigu fureen, Sidii libaax hamuunsan oo ciyaya.
english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

kikuyu: Waxaan u shubmay sidii biyo oo kale, Oo lafahaygii oo dhammuna xubnihii way ka kala bexeen, Oo qalbigaygii wuxuu noqday sidii shamac oo kale, Oo wuxuu ku dhex dhalaalay xiidmahayga.
english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

kikuyu: Xooggaygii wuxuu u engegay sidii dheri burburkiisa oo kale, Oo carrabkaygiina daamankayguu ku dhegay, Oo waxaad i gelisay ciiddii dhimashada.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa i hareereeyey eeyo, Oo waxaa hareerahayga isku wareejiyey shirkii xumaanfalayaasha, Oo waxay iga mudeen gacmaha iyo cagaha.
english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

kikuyu: Lafahaygii oo dhan waan tirin karaa, Oo iyagu way i fiiriyaan oo igu dhaygagaan,
english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

kikuyu: Dharkayga bay qaybsadaan, Oo maradaydana saami bay u ritaan.
english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

kikuyu: Laakiinse, Rabbiyow, ha iga fogaan, Tageerehaygiiyow, dhaqso ii caawi.
english: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

kikuyu: Naftayda ka samatabbixi seefta, Noloshaydana ka samatabbixi xoogga eeyga.
english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

kikuyu: Iga badbaadi libaaxa afkiisa, Haah, xataa geesihii gisiyada waad iiga jawaabtay.
english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

kikuyu: Magacaaga waan u sheegi doonaa walaalahay, Oo ururka dhexdiisa ayaan kugu ammaani doonaa.
english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna Rabbiga ka cabsadow, ammaana isaga, Farcanka Yacquubow, sharfa isaga, Oo kuwiinna Israa'iil ka soo farcamayow, isaga ka wada cabsada.
english: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu ma quudhsan, mana karhin kan la dhibay dhibkiisa, Oo wejigiisiina kama uu qarin isagii, Laakiinse markuu u qayshaday ayuu maqlay.
english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

kikuyu: Xaggaaga ayaa ammaantaydu kaga imanaysaa shirka weyn dhexdiisa, Oo nidarradayda waxaan ku bixinayaa kuwa isaga ka cabsada hortooda.
english: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa wax cuni doona oo ka dhergi doona kuwa camalka qabow, Kuwa Rabbiga doondoonaa isagay ammaani doonaan, Qalbigiinnu weligiis ha noolaado.
english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

kikuyu: Dunida darafyadeeda oo dhammu waxay soo xusuusan doonaan oo u soo jeesan doonaan Rabbiga. Oo qolooyinka quruumaha oo dhammu waxay ku sujuudi doonaan hortaada.
english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

kikuyu: Waayo, boqortooyada waxaa leh Rabbiga, Oo isagu waa taliyihii quruumaha.
english: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

kikuyu: Dunida kuweeda buurbuuran oo dhammu wax bay cuni oo Ilaah bay caabudi doonaan, Oo inta ciidda gasha oo dhammuna hortiisay ku sujuudi doonaan, Xataa kii aan naftiisa sii noolayn karin.
english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

kikuyu: Farcan baa isaga u adeegi doona, Oo Sayidka waxaa looga sheekayn doonaa qarniga iman doona.
english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu way iman doonaan oo waxay dadka dhalan doona u sheegi doonaan Xaqnimadiisa iyo inuu sameeyeyba.
english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa adhijirka i jira; waxba u baahan maayo.
english: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

kikuyu: Wuxuu i fadhiisiyaa doog qoyan dhexdiis, Oo wuxuu ii hoggaamiyaa biyaha deggan dhinacooda.
english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

kikuyu: Naftayda wuu soo celiyaa. Oo magiciisa aawadiis wuxuu igu hor kacaa waddooyinka xaqnimada.
english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

kikuyu: In kastoo aan ku dhex socdo dooxada hooska dhimashada, Sharna ka baqi maayo, waayo, waad ila jirtaa, Ushaada iyo hangoolkaaga ayaa ii raaxeeya.
english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashayda hortooda waxaad iigu diyaarisaa miis, Oo saliid baad madaxayga ku subagtaa, koobkayguna waa buuxdhaafaa.
english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

kikuyu: Hubaal cimrigayga oo dhan waxaa i raaci doona wanaag iyo naxariis, Oo weligay guriga Rabbiga ayaan degganaan doonaa.
english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

kikuyu: Rabbigaa iska leh dhulka iyo waxa ka buuxa oo dhan, Iyo dunida iyo kuwa degganba.
english: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagaa badaha dushooda ka aasaasay, Oo wuxuu ka dul dhisay webiyaasha.
english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

kikuyu: Bal yaa fuuli doona Rabbiga buurtiisa? Oo bal yaa dhex istaagi doona meeshiisa quduuska ah?
english: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

kikuyu: Waa kii gacmihiisu nadiifsan yihiin, oo qalbigiisu daahir yahay, Oo aan naftiisa hawo been ah kor ugu qaadin, Oo aan si khiyaano leh u dhaaran.
english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

kikuyu: Kaasu wuxuu Rabbiga ka heli doonaa barako, Ilaaha badbaadadiisana xaqnimo.
english: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

kikuyu: Kanu waxaa weeye qarnigii kuwa isaga doondoona, Oo waa kuwa wejigaaga doondoona, Ilaaha Yacquubow. (Selaah)
english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Irdahow, madaxiinna kor u qaada, Oo albaabbada daa'imiska ahow, kor ha laydiin qaado, Oo waxaa soo geli doona Boqorka ammaanta.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

kikuyu: Bal waa ayo Boqorka ammaantu? Waa Rabbiga xoog iyo itaal badan, Waa Rabbiga dagaalka ku xoog badan.
english: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

kikuyu: Irdahow, madaxiinna kor u qaada, Oo albaabbada daa'imiska ahow, madaxiinna kor u qaada, Oo waxaa soo geli doona Boqorka ammaanta.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

kikuyu: Bal waa ayo Boqorkan ammaantu? Waa Rabbiga ciidammada, Isaga weeye Boqorka ammaantu. (Selaah)
english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, naftayda xaggaagaan kor ugu qaadaa.
english: By David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, adigaan isku kaa halleeyey, Haddaba yaanan ceeboobin, Oo yaan cadaawayaashaydu ii faanin.
english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

kikuyu: Kuwa adiga ku suga midkoodna ceeboobi maayo, Laakiinse waxaa ceeboobi doona kuwa khiyaanada ku macaamilooda sababla'aan.
english: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, jidadkaaga i tus, Oo waddooyinkaagana i bar.
english: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

kikuyu: Runtaada igu hoggaami, oo i bar, Waayo, waxaad tahay Ilaaha badbaadadayda, Oo maalinta oo dhan adaan ku sugaa.
english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, xusuuso naxariistaada iyo raxmaddaada, Waayo, weligoodba way jireen.
english: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

kikuyu: Ha xusuusan dembiyadii dhallinyaranimadayda iyo xadgudubyadaydii, Laakiinse ii xusuuso sida raxmaddaadu tahay, Iyo wanaaggaaga aawadiis, Rabbiyow.
english: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa wanaagsan yahay, waana qumman yahay, Sidaas daraaddeed wuxuu dembilayaasha ku hanuunin doonaa jidka.
english: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

kikuyu: Kuwa camalka qabow wuxuu ku hanuunin doonaa xaqa, Oo kuwa camalka qabow wuxuu bari doonaa jidkiisa.
english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

kikuyu: Rabbiga waddooyinkiisa oo dhammu waxay raxmad iyo run u yihiin Kuwa axdigiisa iyo markhaatifurkiisa xajiya.
english: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, dembigayga iga cafi magacaaga daraaddiis, Waayo, aad buu u weyn yahay.
english: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

kikuyu: Bal waa ayo ninka Rabbiga ka cabsadaa? Kaas wuxuu ku hanuunin doonaa jidkii uu isagu doorto.
english: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

kikuyu: Naftiisu wanaag bay ku jiri doontaa, Oo farcankiisuna wuxuu dhaxli doonaa dalka.
english: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

kikuyu: Rabbiga taladiisa qarsoon waxay la jirtaa kuwa isaga ka cabsada, Oo wuxuu iyaga tusi doonaa axdigiisa.
english: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

kikuyu: Weligayba indhahaygu waxay u jeedaan xagga Rabbiga, Waayo, wuxuu cagahayga ka bixin doonaa dabinka.
english: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

kikuyu: Bal xaggayga u soo jeeso, oo ii naxariiso, Waayo, waan cidloobay, oo dhib baa i haysa.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

kikuyu: Dhibaatooyinka qalbigaygu way sii ballaadheen, Cidhiidhigayga iga bixi.
english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

kikuyu: Bal fiiri dhibkayga iyo qaxarkayga, Oo dembiyadayda oo dhan iga cafi.
english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

kikuyu: Bal fiiri cadaawayaashayda, waayo, way badan yihiin, Oo waxay igu neceb yihiin nacayb dulmi miidhan ah.
english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

kikuyu: Naftayda dhawr, oo i samatabbixi, Oo yaanan ceeboobin, waayo, waan isku kaa halleeyaa.
english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Daacadnimo iyo qummanaanu ha i dhawreen, Waayo, adaan ku sugaa.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, reer binu Israa'iil ka samatabbixi Dhibaatooyinkooda oo dhan.
english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, i xukun, waayo, waxaan ku socday daacadnimadayda, Oo weliba waxaan Rabbiga isugu halleeyey rogrogmashola'aan.
english: By David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, i imtixaan, oo i tijaabi, Oo uurkayga iyo qalbigaygana baadh.
english: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

kikuyu: Waayo, raxmaddaadu waxay taal indhahayga hortooda, Oo waxaan ku socday runtaada.
english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

kikuyu: Lama aan fadhiisan waxmatarayaal, Oo kuwa isyeelyeelana gudaha la geli maayo.
english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

kikuyu: Waan necbahay ururka xumaanfalayaasha, Oo kuwa sharka lehna la fadhiisan maayo.
english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

kikuyu: Gacmahayga waxaan ku maydhan doonaa eedla'aanta, Markaasaan ku wareegi doonaa meeshaada allabariga, Rabbiyow,
english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,

kikuyu: Si aan codka mahadnaqidda dadka u maqashiiyo, Oo aan uga sheekeeyo shuqulladaada yaabka leh oo dhan.
english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, rugta gurigaaga waan jeclahay, Iyo meesha ammaantaadu joogto.
english: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

kikuyu: Naftayda ha la ururin dembilayaal, Noloshaydana ha la ururin dhiigyocabyada,
english: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

kikuyu: Gacmahooda belaayadu ku jirto, Gacantooda midigna laaluush ka buuxo.
english: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waxaan ku socon doonaa daacadnimadayda, Haddaba i madaxfuro, oo ii naxariiso.
english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

kikuyu: Cagtaydu waxay ku taagan tahay meel siman, Oo Rabbigaan ku ammaani doonaa shirarka dhexdooda.
english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa nuurkayga iyo badbaadadayda, bal yaan ka cabsadaa? Oo Rabbigu waa xoogga noloshayda, bal yaan ka baqaa?
english: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

kikuyu: Markii xumaanfalayaashu iigu yimaadeen inay hilibkayga cunaan, Kuwaasoo ah cadaawayaashayda iyo colkayga, way turunturoodeen, wayna dheceen.
english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

kikuyu: In kastoo ciidan col ah i ag dego, Qalbigaygu cabsan maayo, In kastoo dagaal igu soo kaco, Xataa markaas waan kalsoonaanayaa.
english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

kikuyu: Wax keliya ayaan Rabbiga ka baryay, oo taas aad baan u doonayaa, Waana inaan cimrigayga oo dhan dhex degganaado guriga Rabbiga, Oo aan fiiriyo Rabbiga quruxdiisa, oo aan wax ku baryo macbudkiisa.
english: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu maalinta dhibta wuxuu igu qarin doonaa teendhadiisa, Oo meesha qarsoon oo taambuuggiisa ayuu igu xasayn doonaa, Kor buu ii qaadi doonaa oo dhagax weyn buu i saari doonaa.
english: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

kikuyu: Imminka waxaa madaxayga laga sarraysiin doonaa cadaawayaashayda igu wareegsan, Oo waxaan taambuugga Rabbiga ku dhex bixin doonaa allabari dhawaaq farxadeed leh, Waan gabyi doonaa, haah, ammaan baan Rabbiga ugu gabyi doonaa.
english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, markaan codkayga ku qayliyo, i maqal, Weliba ii naxariiso, oo ii jawaab.
english: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

kikuyu: Markaad tidhi, Wejigayga doondoona, ayaa qalbigaygu wuxuu kugu yidhi, Rabbiyow, wejigaaga waan doondoonayaa.
english: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

kikuyu: Ilaaha badbaadadaydow, wejigaaga ha iga qarin, Anoo addoonkaaga ah cadho ha igu eryin, Caawimaad baad ii ahayde, Ha i xoorin, hana i dayrin.
english: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

kikuyu: Waayo, aabbahay iyo hooyaday way i dayriyeen, Laakiinse Rabbigaa i qaadan doona.
english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, cadaawayaashayda daraaddood Jidkaaga i bar, Oo igu hoggaami waddo bannaan.
english: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

kikuyu: Oo gacanta ha ii gelin cadaawayaashayda, Waayo, waxaa igu kacay markhaatiyaal been ah iyo kuwa nacweynaanta ku hadla.
english: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

kikuyu: Waan itaal darnaan lahaa haddaanan rumaysnayn Inaan wanaagga Rabbiga ku arkayo dalka kuwa nool.
english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Rabbiga sug, Adkayso, oo qalbigaagu ha dhiirranaado, Haah, Rabbiga sug.
english: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigaan kuu qayshan doonaa, Dhagaxayga weynow, ha iska kay dhega tirin, Waaba intaas oo haddaad iga aamusto, Aan noqdaa sida kuwa yamayska hoos ugu dhaadhaca.
english: By David. To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Maqal codka baryootankayga markaan kuu qayshado, Oo aan gacmahayga u soo taago xagga meeshaada quduuska ah.
english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

kikuyu: Ha ila jiidin kuwa sharka leh, Iyo xumaanfalayaasha Oo deriskooda nabadda kula hadla, Laakiinse belaayadu qalbigooda ku jirto.
english: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

kikuyu: Iyaga u abaalmari sida shuqulkoodu yahay, iyo sida ay xumaanta falimahoodu tahay, Iyaga u abaalmari sida shuqulka gacmahoodu yahay, Oo waxa ay galabsadaan sii.
english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

kikuyu: Iyaga wuu dumin doonaa, mana uu dhisi doono mar dambe, Maxaa yeelay, kama ay fikirin Rabbiga shuqulladiisii Iyo hawshii gacmihiisa toona.
english: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

kikuyu: Mahad waxaa leh Rabbiga, Maxaa yeelay, codkii baryootankayguu maqlay.
english: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa xooggayga iyo gaashaankayga, Qalbigaygu isaguu isku halleeyey, oo waa lay caawiyey, Sidaas daraaddeed qalbigaygu aad iyo aad buu u reyreeyey, Oo gabaygaygaan isaga ku ammaani doonaa.
english: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu dadkiisa u yahay xoog, Oo kiisa subkanna wuxuu u yahay qalcad lagu badbaado.
english: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

kikuyu: Dadkaaga badbaadi, oo dhaxalkaagana barakee, Oo weliba quudi, oo weligaaba kor u hay.
english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna carruurta Ilaah ahow, Rabbiga ammaana, Rabbiga ka sheega ammaan iyo xoog.
english: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku ammaana ammaanta magiciisu mudan yahay, Rabbiga ku caabuda quruxda quduuska ah.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

kikuyu: Rabbiga codkiisu wuxuu dul joogaa biyaha, Ilaaha ammaantu wuu onkodaa, Oo xataa Rabbigu wuxuu ka kor onkodaa biyo badan.
english: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

kikuyu: Rabbiga codkiisu waa xoog badan yahay, Rabbiga codkiisu waa haybad badan yahay.
english: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

kikuyu: Rabbiga codkiisu wuxuu jebiyaa geedaha kedarka ah, Haah, oo Rabbigu wuxuu kala jebjebiyaa geedaha kedarka ah oo Lubnaan.
english: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu iyaga ka dhigaa inay u boodboodaan sida weyl oo kale, Lubnaan iyo Siryonba wuxuu ka dhigaa sida gisi yar.
english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

kikuyu: Rabbiga codkiisu wuxuu googooyaa ololka dabka.
english: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

kikuyu: Rabbiga codkiisu wuxuu ruxruxaa cidlada, Rabbigu wuxuu ruxruxaa cidlada Qaadeesh.
english: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

kikuyu: Rabbiga codkiisu wuxuu dhaliyaa deerooyinka, Oo kayntana caleemaha wuu ka daadiyaa, Oo wax kasta oo macbudkiisa ku jiraana waxay yidhaahdaan, Ammaan.
english: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu dul fadhiyaa daadka, Haah, oo Rabbigu wuxuu weligiisba u fadhiyaa sida boqor oo kale.
english: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

kikuyu: Rabbigu dadkiisuu xoogayn doonaa, Oo Rabbigu nabad buu dadkiisa ku barakayn doonaa.
english: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waan ku sarraysiinayaa, waayo, kor baad iga yeeshay, Oo weliba igama aad dhigin in cadaawayaashaydu ii faanaan.
english: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaahayow, Waan kuu qayshaday oo adna waad i bogsiisay.
english: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waxaad naftaydii kor uga qaadday She'ool, Oo waad i sii noolaysay si aanan yamayska ugu dhicin.
english: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

kikuyu: Quduusiintiisoy, Rabbiga ammaan ugu gabya, Oo mahad ku naqa magiciisa quduuska ah.
english: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

kikuyu: Waayo, cadhadiisu waa daqiiqad keliya, Laakiinse raallinimadiisu waa cimriga, Habeenka waxaa jirta oohin, Laakiinse aroorta farxad baa timaada.
english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

kikuyu: Aniguse intaan barwaaqaysnaa waxaan idhi, Weligay dhaqdhaqaaqi maayo.
english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, raallinimadaada aawadeed ayaad buurtayda ka dhigtay inay si adag u taagnaato, Wejigaagaad qarisay, oo anna waan argaggaxay.
english: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigaan kuu soo qayshaday, Oo baryootankaygii waxaan gaadhsiiyey Rabbiga.
english: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:

kikuyu: Bal markaan yamayska ku dego, maxaa faa'iido ah oo dhiiggayga ku jirta? Ma ciiddaa ku ammaanaysa? Oo ma runtaaday sheegaysaa?
english: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, i maqal oo ii naxariiso, Rabbiyow, kaalmeeyahayga ahow.
english: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

kikuyu: Baroortaydii waxaad iigu beddeshay cayaar, Oo dharkaygii joonyadaha ahaana waad iga furtay, oo waxaad ii guntisay farxad,
english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

kikuyu: Taasuna waa si nafsaddaydu ay ammaan kuugu gabaydo, oo aanay u aamusin. Rabbiyow, Ilaahayow, weligayba waan kugu mahadnaqayaa.
english: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigaan isku kaa halleeyaa, yaanan weligayba ceeboobin, Oo xaqnimadaada igu samatabbixi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

kikuyu: Dhegtaada ii soo dhig, oo dhaqso ii samatabbixi, Dhagax weyn oo xoog leh ii ahow, iyo guri laysku daafaco si aad ii badbaadisid.
english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad tahay dhagax weyn oo ii gabbaad ah iyo qalcaddayda, Haddaba magacaaga daraaddiis ii hoggaami oo ii hanuuni.
english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

kikuyu: Oo iga bixi shabagga dabinka ah oo ay qarsoodiga iigu dhigeen, Waayo, waxaad tahay qalcaddayda.
english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

kikuyu: Gacantaada ayaan ruuxayga u dhiibayaa, Waayo, waad i soo furatay, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha runta ahow.
english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

kikuyu: Waan neceb ahay kuwa hawada beenta ah ka fikira, Laakiinse Rabbigaan isku halleeyaa.
english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Naxariistaada waan ku farxi doonaa, waanan ku rayrayn doonaa, Waayo, dhibaatadii igu dhacday waad aragtay, Waanad ogayd qaxarka naftaydu ku jirtay,
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

kikuyu: Oo weliba iguma aad xidhin gacantii cadowga, Oo cagtayda waxaad taagtay meel ballaadhan.
english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ii naxariiso, waayo, cidhiidhi baan ku jiraa, Oo murug baan la il go'aa, oo naftayda iyo jidhkayguba way taag darnaadaan.
english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

kikuyu: Waayo, noloshaydu waxay ku dhammaatay caloolxumo, cimrigayguna taahid, Oo dembigayga daraaddiis ayaa xooggaygii ii gabay, lafahaygiina way wada kharribmeen.
english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashayda oo dhan daraaddood ayaan waxaan noqday mid ceebaysan, Xataa deriskayga aad iyo aad baan ugu hor ceeboobay, oo kuwa i yaqaanna way iga cabsadeen, Oo xataa kuwii dibadda igu arkay way iga carareen.
english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

kikuyu: Sida qof dhintay oo laga samray ayaa layska kay illoobay, Oo waxaan ahay sida weel jabay.
english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan maqlay kuwo badan oo caytamaya, Iyo cabsi dhan kasta igaga wareegsan, Oo intay ii wada tashadeen, Ayay waxay ku arrinsadeen inay nafta iga qaadaan.
english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbiyow, adigaan isku kaa halleeyey, Oo waxaan idhi, Waxaad tahay Ilaahay.
english: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”

kikuyu: Wakhtigaygu gacantaaduu ku jiraa, Haddaba iga samatabbixi gacanta cadaawayaashayda, iyo weliba kuwa i silciya gacantooda.
english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

kikuyu: Wejigaaga anoo addoonkaaga ah igu iftiimi, Oo igu badbaadi raxmaddaada.
english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, yaanan ceeboobin, waayo, adigaan kuu qayshaday, Kuwa sharka lahu ha ceeboobeen, oo She'ool ha ku dhex aamuseen.
english: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

kikuyu: Ha carrab beeleen kuwa beenta sheegaa, Oo kan xaqa ah si qallafsan wax uga sheega, Iyagoo kibir iyo quudhsasho leh.
english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

kikuyu: Wanaaggaagu weynaan badanaa, kan aad u kaydisay kuwa kaa cabsada, Oo weliba aad binu-aadmiga hortiisa ugu diyaarisay kuwa isku kaa halleeya.
english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

kikuyu: Dadka sirqoolladiisa waxaad iyaga kaga qarinaysaa joogistaada qarsoon, Oo carrabka dirirtiisana waxaad iyaga kaga qarinaysaa taambuug.
english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

kikuyu: Mahad waxaa leh Rabbiga, Waayo, wuxuu raxmaddiisa yaabka leh igu tusay magaalo xoog weyn.
english: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waxaan degdeg ku idhi, Indhahaaga hortooda waan ka go'ay, Habase yeeshee, codkii baryootankayga waad maqashay markii aan kuu qayshaday.
english: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

kikuyu: Quduusiintiisa oo dhammay, Rabbiga jeclaada, Rabbigu wuu ilaaliyaa kuwa aaminka ah, Kan waxa kibirka ah falase aad iyo aad buu u abaalmariyaa.
english: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna Rabbiga wax ka rajaynaya oo dhammow, Adkaysta, oo qalbigiinnu ha dhiirranaado.
english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kii xadgudubkiisa la cafiyey, oo dembigiisa la daboolay.
english: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninkii aanu Rabbigu dembi ku tirin, Oo ruuxiisa aanay khiyaano ku jirin.
english: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

kikuyu: Markii aan iska aamusay, lafahaygii way gaboobeen, Maxaa yeelay, maalintii oo dhan baan cabaadayay.
english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

kikuyu: Waayo, habeen iyo maalinba gacantaadu way igu cuslayd, Oo qoyaankaygii wuxuu u beddelmay sidii engegga diraacda. (Selaah)
english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

kikuyu: Dembigaygii adigaan kuu qirtay, oo xumaantaydiina ma aan qarin, Waxaan idhi, Xadgudubkayga waxaan u qiranayaa Rabbiga, Oo adna waad iga cafiday xumaanta dembigayga. (Selaah)
english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed mid kastoo cibaado lahu ha ku soo baryo wakhti lagu heli karo, Hubaal markii biyaha badanu dhulka qarqiyaan, isaga sooma ay gaadhi doonaan.
english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

kikuyu: Waxaad tahay meeshaan ku dhuunto, oo dhib baad iga ilaalin doontaa, Oo waxaad igu wareejin doontaa gabayadii samatabbixinta. (Selaah)
english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

kikuyu: Waan ku hanuunin doonaa oo waxaan ku bari doonaa jidka aad ku socon lahayd, Oo waxaan kula talin doonaa iyadoo ay ishaydu kula jirto.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

kikuyu: Ha noqonina sida faraska ama baqalka aan garaadka lahayn, Kuwaasoo hoggaankoodu yahay xakame iyo birtiisa in lagu hayo, Haddii kalese innaba kuu soo dhowaan maayaan.
english: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

kikuyu: Kii shar leh waxaa ku dhici doona waxyaalo badan oo murug leh, Laakiinse kii Rabbiga isku halleeya waxaa ku wareegsanaan doona naxariis.
english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna xaqa ahow, Rabbiga ku farxa oo reyreeya, Oo inta qalbigoodu qumman yahayow, kulligiin farxad la dhawaaqa.
english: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

kikuyu: Kuwiinna xaqa ahow, Rabbiga ku reyreeya, Waayo, kuwa qumman ammaan baa u habboon.
english: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ugu mahadnaqa kataarad, Oo isaga ammaan ugu heesa idinkoo ka dhawaajinaya shareerad toban xadhig leh.
english: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

kikuyu: Gabay cusub isaga ugu gabya, Oo si farsamo wanaagsan ugaga dhawaajiya cod weyn.
english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga eraygiisu waa toosan yahay, Oo shuqulkiisa oo dhanna waxaa lagu sameeyey aaminnimo.
english: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

kikuyu: Wuxuu jecel yahay xaqnimo iyo caddaalad, Dhulka waxaa ka buuxda Rabbiga raxmaddiisa.
english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

kikuyu: Samooyinka waxaa lagu sameeyey Rabbiga eraygiisa, Oo guutooyinkooda oo dhanna waxaa lagu uumay neefta afkiisa.
english: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

kikuyu: Isagu biyaha badda intuu isku ururiyo ayuu wuxuu ka dhigaa sidii taallo oo kale, Oo moolalka dhaadheerna wuxuu dhex dhigaa maqsinno.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

kikuyu: Inta dhulka joogta oo dhammu Rabbiga ha ka cabsadeen, Inta dunida deggan oo dhammu isaga ha ka baqeen.
english: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuu hadlay, wayna noqotay, Oo wuu amray, wayna adkaatay.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

kikuyu: Rabbigu quruumaha taladooda wuu baabbi'iyaa, Oo dadyowga fikirradoodana wuu buriyaa.
english: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbiga taladiisu weligeedba way adkaataa, Oo fikirrada qalbigiisuna waxay adkaadaan tan iyo ka ab ka ab.
english: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan quruunta Ilaaheedu Rabbiga yahay, Taasoo ah dadka uu isagu u doortay dhaxalkiisa.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

kikuyu: Rabbigu samaduu wax ka soo fiiriyaa, Oo wuxuu arkaa binu-aadmiga oo dhan,
english: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

kikuyu: Oo meesha isaga rugta u ah Ayuu wuxuu ka soo fiiriyaa kuwa dhulka deggan oo dhan,
english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

kikuyu: Waa isaga kan qalbiyadooda oo dhan sameeya, Oo shuqulladooda oo dhan u wada fiirsada.
english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

kikuyu: Ma jiro boqor ku badbaada ciidan weyn, Ninkii xoog badanuna iskuma samatabbixiyo xoog badan.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

kikuyu: Faras waa waxmatare in badbaado laysugu halleeyo, Oo weliba ninnaba kuma samatabbixiyo xooggiisa badan.
english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

kikuyu: Bal eega, Rabbiga ishiisu waxay la jirtaa kuwa isaga ka cabsada, Waana kuwa naxariistiisa rajeeya,
english: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

kikuyu: Inuu naftooda dhimashada ka samatabbixiyo, Iyo inuu wakhtiga abaartaa sii nooleeyo iyaga.
english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

kikuyu: Nafteennu waxay sugtay Rabbiga, Waayo, isagu wuxuu inoo yahay caawimaad iyo gaashaan.
english: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

kikuyu: Haddaba qalbigeennu isaguu ku rayrayn doonaa, Maxaa yeelay, innagu waxaynu isku halleeynay magiciisa quduuska ah.
english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha noogu soo degto, Sidii aannu kaa rajaynay.
english: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

kikuyu: Wakhti kasta ayaan Rabbiga ammaani doonaa, Oo had iyo goorba ammaantiisu afkaygay ku jiri doontaa.
english: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay ku faani doontaa Rabbiga, Oo waxaa maqli doona kuwa camalka qabow, oo weliba way ku farxi doonaan.
english: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ila weyneeya, Oo aynu magiciisa wada sarraysiinno.
english: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

kikuyu: Rabbigaan doondoonay, oo isna wuu ii jawaabay, Oo wuxuu iga samatabbixiyey waxyaalihii aan ka cabsaday oo dhan.
english: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

kikuyu: Iyagu waxay fiiriyeen isaga, oo way iftiimeen, Oo wejigooduna weligood ceeboobi maayo.
english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

kikuyu: Ninkan miskiinka ahu wuu qayshaday, oo Rabbiguna wuu maqlay, Oo wuxuu ka badbaadshay dhibaatooyinkiisii oo dhan.
english: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Malaa'igta Rabbigu waxay hareeraysaa kuwa isaga ka cabsada, Oo weliba way samatabbixisaa.
english: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

kikuyu: Bal dhadhamiya oo arka in Rabbigu wanaagsan yahay, Waxaa barakaysan ninkii isaga isku halleeya.
english: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna quduusiintiisa ahow; Rabbiga ka cabsada, Waayo, kuwa isaga ka cabsadaa waxba uma baahna.
english: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

kikuyu: Aaranka libaaxa wax baa ka dhimman, wayna gaajoodaan, Laakiinse kuwa Rabbiga doondoonaa wax wanaagsan uma baahnaan doonaan.
english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

kikuyu: Carruurtoy, kaalaya oo i dhegaysta, Oo anna waxaan idin bari doonaa Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisa.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: Bal waa ayo ninka nolol jecel, Oo cimriga dheer doonayaa, Si uu wanaag u arko?
english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

kikuyu: Carrabkaaga shar ka jooji, Bushimahaagana inay khiyaano ku hadlaan ka ilaali.
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

kikuyu: Shar ka leexo, oo wanaag samee, Nabad doondoon, oo raacdayso iyada.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

kikuyu: Rabbiga indhihiisu waxay fiiriyaan kuwa xaqa ah, Oo dhegihiisuna waxay u furan yihiin baryadooda.
english: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

kikuyu: Wejiga Rabbigu waa ka gees kuwa sharka sameeya Inuu iyaga xusuustooda dhulka ka baabbi'iyo.
english: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ahu way qayshadeen, oo Rabbigaa maqlay, Oo wuxuu iyaga ka samatabbixiyey dhibaatooyinkoodii oo dhan.
english: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa u dhow yahay kuwa dembigooda ka caloolyaysan, Oo kuwa ruuxoodu qoomamaysan yahayna wuu badbaadiyaa.
english: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah dhibaatooyinkiisu way tiro badan yihiin, Laakiinse Rabbigu waa ka samatabbixiyaa dhammaantoodba.
english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu dhawraa lafihiisa oo dhan, Oo middoodna ma jabna.
english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

kikuyu: Xumaan baa dili doonta kuwa sharka leh, Oo kuwa neceb kan xaqa ahna waa la eedayn doonaa.
english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

kikuyu: Rabbigu nafta addoommadiisa wuu soo furtaa, Oo kuwa isaga isku halleeya, midkoodna lama eedayn doono.
english: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, la dirir kuwa ila dirira, Oo la dagaallan kuwa ila dagaallama.
english: By David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

kikuyu: Gaashaan iyo gabbaad qaado. Oo caawimaaddayda daraaddeed u istaag.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

kikuyu: Waran la soo bax, oo kuwa i eryanaya jidka ka goo, Oo naftayda waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Anigu waxaan ahay badbaadadaada.
english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

kikuyu: Kuwa naftayda doondoonayaa ha ceeboobeen, oo sharafdarro ha ku soo degto, Oo kuwa waxyeelladayda u arrinsanayana dib ha loo celiyo, oo ha wareereen.
english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

kikuyu: Ha noqdeen sida buunshe dabaysha hor socda, Oo malaa'igta Rabbigu horay u sii kaxaynayso.
english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

kikuyu: Jidkoodu ha noqdo gudcur iyo meel simbiriirixo leh, Oo malaa'igta Rabbigu ha eryato.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu sababla'aan bay dabin god iigu qarsheen, Oo sababla'aan bay naftayda god ugu qodeen.
english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

kikuyu: Isagoo aan iska jirin halligaadu ha ku soo degto, Oo dabinkiisuu qariyey isaga ha qabsado, Oo isagu halligaaddaas ha ku dhaco.
english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

kikuyu: Oo naftayduna Rabbigay aad ugu farxi doontaa, Oo waxay ku rayrayn doontaa badbaadintiisa.
english: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

kikuyu: Lafahayga oo dhammu waxay odhan doonaan, Rabbiyow, bal yaa kula mid ah? Kaaga kii miskiin ah ka samatabbixiya kii isaga ka xoog badan, Haah, oo kii miskiin ah iyo kan baahanba ka samatabbixiya kii dhaca.
english: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

kikuyu: Waxaa kaca markhaatiyaal xaqdarro ah, Oo waxay i weyddiiyaan waxyaalo aanan ogayn.
english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

kikuyu: Wanaag xumaan bay iigaga abaalgudaan Oo naftayda way gacal tiraan.
english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

kikuyu: Laakiinse markay bukeen, dharkaygu wuxuu ahaa joonyado, Oo naftaydana soon baan ku dhibay, Oo tukashadayduna laabtayday ku soo noqotay.
english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan u qaatay sidii isagoo ah saaxiibkay ama walaalkay, Oo waxaan la foororsaday baroorasho sida mid hooyadiis u baroorta.
english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu markaan turunturooday ayay reyreeyeen, oo way isa soo wada urursadeen, Oo waxmatarayaashii ayaa dhammaantood ii wada shiray, oo anna ma aan ogayn innaba, Way i dildillaacsadeen oo imana ay dayn.
english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

kikuyu: Sida labawejiilayaashu diyaafado uga dhex majaajiloodaan Ayay igu ilko jirriqsadeen.
english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

kikuyu: Sayidow, ilaa goormaad sii fiirinaysaa? Naftayda halligaaddooda ka badbaadi, Noloshaydana libaaxyada ka badbaadi.
english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

kikuyu: Waxaan kaaga mahadnaqi doonaa shirka weyn dhexdiisa, Oo dad fara badan dhexdooda ayaan kugu ammaani doonaa.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

kikuyu: Kuwa sida qaladka ah cadowga iigu ahi, yaanay igu rayrayn, Oo kuwa sababla'aanta ii necebuna yaanay isu il jebin.
english: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu nabad kuma hadlaan, Laakiinse waxay hadallo khiyaano miidhan ah ugu hindisaan kuwa dalka ku xasilloon.
english: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

kikuyu: Afkoodii aad bay iigu fureen, Oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Ahaa, ahaa, annagaa indhahayaga ku aragnay.
english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigu waad aragtay, haddaba ha iska aamusin, Sayidow, ha iga fogaan.
english: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: Sara joogso, oo garsooriddayda u toos, Oo dacwadayda dhegayso, Ilaahayow, Sayidkayow.
english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaahayow, igu xukun sida ay xaqnimadaadu tahay, Oo yaanay igu rayrayn.
english: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

kikuyu: Yaanay qalbigooda iska odhan, Ahaa, sidaasaannu doonaynaa, Yaanay odhan, Isagii waannu liqnay.
english: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

kikuyu: Kuwa waxyeelladayda ku reyreeyaa ha wada ceeboobeen oo ha isku wareereen dhammaantood, Oo iyagu ha huwadeen ceeb iyo sharafdarro kuwa iska kay weynaysiiyaa.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqnimadayda jecelu farxad ha ku dhawaaqeen, oo ha farxeen, Oo had iyo goorba ha yidhaahdeen, Rabbiga ha la weyneeyo, Waayo, isagu wuxuu ku farxaa barwaaqada addoonkiisa.
english: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

kikuyu: Oo maalinta oo dhan carrabkaygu wuxuu ka hadli doonaa Xaqnimadaada iyo ammaantaadaba.
english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

kikuyu: Kii shar leh xadgudubkiisu wuxuu qalbigiisa ka yidhaahdaa, Ilaah ka cabsashadiisu indhahayga ma hor taal.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

kikuyu: Waayo, wuu isfaaniyaa inaan dembigiisa la garan karin Oo aan la nebcaanayn.
english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

kikuyu: Erayada afkiisu waa xumaan iyo khiyaano, Oo inuu caqliyaysto iyo inuu wax wanaagsan sameeyoba wuu iska daayay.
english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

kikuyu: Wuxuu sariirtiisa ku hindisaa xumaan, Oo wuxuu joogsadaa jid aan wanaagsanayn, Oo weliba sharka ma naco.
english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, raxmaddaadu samooyinkay ku jirtaa, Aaminnimadaaduna daruurahay gaadhaa.
english: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: Xaqnimadaadu waa sida buuraha Ilaah, Oo xukummadaaduna waa mool dheer, Rabbiyow, waxaad nabad gelisaa dadka iyo duunyadaba.
english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, raxmaddaadu qaalisanaa! Oo binu-aadmiguna wuxuu magangalaa hooska baalashaada.
english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Aad bay uga dhergi doonaan barwaaqada gurigaaga, Oo waxaad iyaga ka waraabin doontaa webiga farxaddaada.
english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

kikuyu: Waayo, isha noloshu aday kula jirtaa, Oo iftiinkaagaannu iftiin ku aragnaa.
english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

kikuyu: Raxmaddaada ugu sii wad kuwa ku yaqaan, Oo xaqnimadaadana kuwa qalbigoodu qumman yahay.
english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Cagta kuwa kibirsan yaanay ii iman, Oo kuwa sharka leh gacantooduna yaanay i eryin.
english: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

kikuyu: Xumaanfalayaashu halkaasay ku dhaceen, Iyaga hoos baa loo riday, oo mana ay kari doonaan inay mar dambe soo kacaan.
english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

kikuyu: Ha isku dhibin xumaanfalayaasha aawadood, Hana uga hinaasin kuwa xaqdarrada sameeya.
english: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyaga haddiiba waxaa loo jari doonaa sida cawska oo kale, Oo waxay u engegi doonaan sida geedo yaryar oo qoyan.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

kikuyu: Rabbiga isku hallee oo wanaag samee, Oo sidaasaad dalka ku degganaan doontaa, oo ammaan baad ku daaqi doontaa.
english: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbiga ku farax, Oo wuxuu ku siin doonaa waxa qalbigaagu doonayo.
english: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

kikuyu: Jidkaaga Rabbiga ku aamin, Isagana isku hallee, wuuna samaynayaaye.
english: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

kikuyu: Xaqnimadaada wuxuu u soo bixin doonaa sida nuurka oo kale, Gartaadana sida duhurka oo kale.
english: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku hor xasilloonow, oo isaga samir ku sug, Oo ha isku dhibin kii jidkiisa ku barwaaqaysan Iyo ninkii hindisooyin shar ah sameeya toona.
english: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

kikuyu: Cadhada ka joogso, oo dhirifka ka tag, Hana isku dhibin inaad shar samaysid.
english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

kikuyu: Waayo, xumaanfalayaashu way go'i doonaan, Laakiinse kuwa Rabbiga sugaa dalkay dhaxli doonaan.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

kikuyu: Wakhti yar dabadeedna kan sharka lahu ma jiri doono, Bal meeshiisa aad baad ugu fiirsan doontaa, oo isna ma jiri doono.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa camalka qabow dalkay dhaxli doonaan, Oo waxay ku farxi doonaan nabad badan.
english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

kikuyu: Kan sharka lahu wuxuu shirqool u dhigaa kan xaqa ah, Oo isaga ayuu u ilko jirriqsadaa.
english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

kikuyu: Oo Sayidku wuu ku qosli doonaa isaga, Waayo, wuxuu arkaa in maalintiisu soo dhowaanayso.
english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu waxay la bexeen seeftoodii, qaansadoodiina way xooteen, Si ay miskiinka iyo kan baahan hoos ugu tuuraan, Oo ay laayaan kuwa jidkooda ku qumman.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

kikuyu: Seeftoodu waxay mudi doontaa wadnahooda, Oo qaansooyinkooduna way kala jebi doonaan.
english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

kikuyu: Inta yar oo mid xaq ahu haystaa Way ka sii wanaagsan tahay kuwa sharka leh maalkooda badan.
english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwa sharka leh gacmahoodu way jebi doonaan, Laakiinse Rabbigu kuwa xaqa ah wuu tiiriyaa.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuu yaqaan kuwa kaamilka ah cimrigooda, Oo dhaxalkooduna weligiisba wuu waarayaa.
english: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

kikuyu: Iyagu ma ceeboobi doonaan wakhtiga shar jiro, Oo wakhtiga abaaru dhacdona way dhergi doonaan.
english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa sharka lahu way halligmi doonaan, Cadaawayaasha Rabbiguna waxay ahaan doonaan sida inta wanaagsan oo doogga, Way baabbi'i doonaan, sida qiiqa oo kale way u baabbi'i doonaan.
english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

kikuyu: Kii shar lahu wax buu amaahdaa, mana bixiyo mar dambe, Laakiinse kan xaqa ahu wuu naxariistaa, waxna wuu bixiyaa.
english: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

kikuyu: Oo kuwuu barakeeyo ayaa dalka dhaxli doona, Laakiinse kuwuu habaaraa way go'i doonaan.
english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Dadka socodkiisa waxaa hagaajiya Rabbiga, Oo jidkiisuu ku farxaa.
english: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

kikuyu: Oo in kastoo uu kufo, haddana ma wada dhici doono, Waayo, Rabbiga ayaa gacantiisa ku tiiriya.
english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

kikuyu: Waan dhallin yaraan jiray, oo haatanna waan gaboobay, Oo weligay ma arag mid xaq ah oo la dayriyey, Ama carruurtiisa oo cunto tuugsanaysa.
english: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

kikuyu: Maalinta oo dhan wuu naxariistaa oo wax buu amaahiyaa, Oo carruurtiisuna way barakaysan yihiin.
english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

kikuyu: Sharka ka fogow, oo wanaag samee, Oo weligaa baad degganaan doontaa.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu jecel yahay caddaaladda, Mana uu dayrsho quduusiintiisa, Laakiinse iyaga weligoodba waa la ilaashaa, Illowse kuwa sharka leh carruurtoodu way go'i doonaan.
english: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ahu dalkay dhaxli doonaan, Oo weligoodna way dhex degganaan doonaan.
english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah afkiisu wuxuu ka hadlaa xigmadda, Carrabkiisuna wuxuu ku hadlaa caddaaladda.
english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaahiisa sharcigiisu waa ku jiraa qalbigiisa, Oo tallaabooyinkiisana midnaba dib uma simbiriirixan doonto.
english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

kikuyu: Kan sharka lahu wuxuu fiiriyaa kan xaqa ah, Oo wuxuu doondoonaa inuu isaga dilo.
english: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

kikuyu: Rabbigu isaga gacantiisa ku dayn maayo, Oo eedayn maayo marka la xukumo isaga.
english: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

kikuyu: Rabbiga sug, oo jidkiisa xaji, Oo wuxuu kuu sara marin doonaa inaad dalka dhaxasho, Waad arki doontaa marka kuwa sharka lahu go'aan.
english: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

kikuyu: Waxaan arkay ku shar leh oo dulun badan, Oo isu kala bixiya sida geed cagaar ah oo dhulkiisii ka baxay.
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa la ag maray, oo isagii lama arag, Oo waan doondoonay, laakiinse waa la waayay.
english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

kikuyu: Bal fiiri ninka kaamilka ah, oo bal eeg, kan qumman, Waayo, ninkaas ugu dambaystiisu waa nabad.
english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa xadgudbaa dhammaantood wadajir bay u baabbi'i doonaan, Oo kuwa sharka lahuna ugu dambaystooda way go'i doonaan.
english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ahse badbaadadoodu waa xagga Rabbiga, Oo wakhtiga dhibaatada isagu waa qalcaddooda.
english: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu iyaguu caawiyaa, wuuna samatabbixiyaa, Oo wuxuu iyaga ka samatabbixiyaa kuwa sharka leh, wuuna badbaadiyaa, Maxaa yeelay, isagay magangaleen.
english: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, cadhadaada ha igu canaanan, Oo dhirifkaaga kululna ha igu edbin.
english: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

kikuyu: Waayo, fallaadhahaagii aad bay ii mudeen, Oo gacantaaduna way igu soo degtay.
english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

kikuyu: Jidhkaygu fayoobaan ma leh, waana xanaaqaaga daraaddiis, Oo lafahayguna caafimaad ma leh, waana dembigayga daraaddiis.
english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

kikuyu: Waayo, xumaatooyinkaygii waxay ka sare mareen madaxayga, Sida rar culus ayay igu culus yihiin aad iyo aad.
english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

kikuyu: Nabrahaygu way urayaan, wayna qudhmuun yihiin, Waana nacasnimadayda daraaddeed.
english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

kikuyu: Waan xanuunsanayaa, oo aad baan hoos ugu gotay, Oo maalinta oo dhanna oohin baan la wareegaa.
english: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhexdayda waxaa ka buuxa olol, Oo jidhkayguna fayoobaan ma leh.
english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

kikuyu: Waan itaal daranahay, oo aad baan u burbursanahay, Oo waxaan la cabaaday buuqa qalbigayga ku jira.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

kikuyu: Sayidow, waxaan jeclahay oo dhammu waxay yaalliin hortaada, Oo taahiddayduna kaama qarsoona.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

kikuyu: Wadnahaa i fig leh, oo xooggaygiina waa i gabay, Oo weliba iftiinkii indhahayguna waa iga tegey.
english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

kikuyu: Kuwa i jecel iyo saaxiibbadayba belaayadayda way ka durkaan, Oo xigaaladaydiina meel fog bay istaagaan.
english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa naftayda doondoonaana dabinno bay ii dhigaan, Oo kuwa inay wax i yeelaan doonayaana waxay ku hadlaan waxyaalo xun, Oo maalinta oo dhan waxay ku tashadaan khiyaano.
english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waxba kama maqlo sida nin dhega la', Oo waxaan la mid ahay nin carrab la' oo aan afkiisa kala qaadin.
english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: Haah, oo waxaan la mid ahay nin aan waxba maqlin, Oo aan afkiisa murammo ku jirin.
english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiyow, adaan wax kaa rajaynayaa, Oo adna waad ii jawaabi doontaa, Sayidow Ilaahaygiiyow.
english: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idhi, Yaanay igu rayrayn, Oo markii cagtaydu simbiriirixato, yaanay iska kay weynayn.
english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan ku dhowahay inaan dhaco, Oo tiiraanyadayduna had iyo goorba way i hor taalaa.
english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

kikuyu: Haddaba anigu xumaantayda waan sheegi doonaa, Oo dembigaygana waan ka qoomamoon doonaa.
english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

kikuyu: Laakiinse cadaawayaashaydu waa dadaal badan yihiin, xoogna way leeyihiin, Oo kuwa gardarrada igu necebuna way tarmeen.
english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

kikuyu: Oo weliba kuwa sharka wanaagga ku gudaana Waa cadaawayaashayda, maxaa yeelay, waxaan raacaa waxa wanaagsan.
english: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ha i dayrin, Ilaahayow, ha iga fogaan.
english: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: Soo dhaqso oo i caawi, Sayidow, badbaadadaydow.
english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

kikuyu: Waxaan idhi, Jidadkaygaan iska jiri doonaa, Si aanan carrabkayga ugu dembaabin, Oo afkayga waxaan ku qaban doonaa xakame inta kii shar lahu i hor joogo.
english: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

kikuyu: Waan carrab beelay oo shib baan iska idhi, oo waan ka aamusay xataa wixii wanaagsanaa, Tiiraanyadaydiina waa kacday.
english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

kikuyu: Qalbigaygu uurkayguu ku kululaaday, Oo intii aan fikirayay ayaa dabkii shidmay, Markaasaan carrabkaygii ku hadlay, oo idhi,
english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, i ogaysii ugu dambaystayda Iyo cimrigayga dhererkiisu intuu yahay, Oo i ogaysii inta tabardarradaydu tahay.
english: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, maalmahayga waxaad ka dhigtay calaacal ballaadhkeed Oo cimrigayguna hortaada waxba kuma aha, Hubaal nin kastaba marka xaalkiisu ugu wanaagsan yahay dhammaantiis waa bilaash. (Selaah)
english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: Hubaal nin kastaaba wuxuu ku socdaa hawo been ah, Hubaal waxay ku rabshaysan yihiin hawo been ah, Isagu maal buu tuulaa, mana uu yaqaan kii urursan doona.
english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

kikuyu: Haddaba Sayidow, bal maxaan sugaa? Waayo, rajadaydu adigay kugu xidhan tahay.
english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

kikuyu: Xadgudubyadayda oo dhan iga samatabbixi, Oo ha iga dhigin mid nacasyadu caayaan.
english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

kikuyu: Anigu waan carrab la'aa, oo afkaygana ma aan kala qaadin, Maxaa yeelay, sidaasaad yeeshay.
english: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

kikuyu: Haddaba belaayadaada iga durki, Maxaa yeelay, waxaa i baabbi'iyey weerarka gacantaada.
english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

kikuyu: Markaad dadka canaanta ku edbisid xumaanta daraaddeed, Waxaad quruxdiisa ka dhigtaa inay u baabba'do sidii balanbaallis oo kale, Hubaal nin kastaaba waa bilaash. (Selaah)
english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, baryadayda maqal, oo qayladaydana dhegta u dhig, Oo ilmadaydana ha iskaga aamusin, Waayo, waxaan ahay qariib kula jooga Oo masaafir ah, sidii awowayaashay oo dhammu ay ahaan jireen.
english: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

kikuyu: Ii tudh, itaalkaygu mar ha igu soo noqdee, Intaanan meesha tegin oo aanan mar dambe ka soo noqonayn.
english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

kikuyu: Anigu Rabbiga samir baan ku sugay, Oo isna wuu i soo jalleecay, qayladaydiina wuu maqlay,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu iga soo bixiyey yamays baabba' ah, iyo dhoobada dhiriqda ah, Oo wuxuu cagaha ii saaray dhagax weyn, oo socodkaygiina wuu xoogeeyey.
english: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

kikuyu: Oo afkaygiina wuxuu geliyey gabay cusub, kaas oo ah ammaanta Ilaaheenna. Kuwo badan baa arki doona, wayna cabsan doonaan, Rabbigayna isku hallayn doonaan.
english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninkii Rabbiga isku halleeya, Oo aan u jeedin kuwa kibirsan ama kuwa beenta ku leexda.
english: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaahayow, shuqullada yaabka badan oo aad samaysay way badan yihiin, Oo fikirradaada aad naga qabtidna way badan yihiin, Oo iyaga lama xisaabi karo, Haddii aan sheego oo ka hadlo, Iyagu way ka sii badan yihiin wax la tirin karo.
english: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

kikuyu: Allabari iyo qurbaan kuma aad faraxsanid, Oo anna dhegahaygii waad ii furtay, Qurbaan la gubo iyo qurbaanka dembiga midna ima aad weyddiisan.
english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaan idhi, Bal eeg, anigu waan imid, Oo kitaabka duudduuban wax igu saabsan baa ku qoran.
english: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, waxaan jeclahay inaan sameeyo doonistaada, Haah, oo sharcigaagu wuxuu ku dhex jiraa qalbigayga.
english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

kikuyu: Xaqnimo baan shirka weyn ku dhex wacdiyey, Oo bal eeg, inaanan bushimahayga ka joojin, Waad og tahay, Rabbiyow.
english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

kikuyu: Xaqnimadaada qalbigayga kuma aan qarin, Aaminnimadaada iyo badbaadintaadana waan sheegay, Oo raxmaddaada iyo runtaadana kama aan qarin shirka weyn.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, naxariistaada ha iga ceshan, Raxmaddaada iyo runtaaduna had iyo goorba ha i dhawreen.
english: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

kikuyu: Waayo, xumaatooyin aan la tirin karin ayaa i hareereeyey, Oo dembiyadaydii ayaa i qabsaday, sidaas daraaddeed kor ma fiirin karo, Iyagu way ka badan yihiin timaha madaxayga, oo qalbigaygiina waa i gabay.
english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waan ku baryayaaye, i samatabbixi, Rabbiyow, u soo dhaqso inaad i caawiso.
english: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.

kikuyu: Kuwa doonaya inay naftayda halligaan ha ceeboobeen, Oo dhammaantood ha wareereen, Oo kuwa waxyeelladayda ku farxana Dib ha loo celiyo, oo sharafdarro ha ku soo degto.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

kikuyu: Kuwa aniga, Ahaa, Ahaa, igu yidhaahda, Ceebtooda daraaddeed ha la fajeceen.
english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Kuwa adiga ku doondoona oo dhammu ha reyreeyeen oo ha kugu farxeen, Oo kuwa badbaadintaada jecelu had iyo goorba ha yidhaahdeen, Rabbiga ha la weyneeyo!
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waxaan ahay miskiin iyo mid baahan, Sayidkuse waa i xusuustaa. Ilaahayow, waxaad tahay caawimaaddayda iyo samatabbixiyahayga, Haddaba ha iga raagin.
english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kii ka fikira miskiinka, Maalinta shar jiro Rabbigu waa samatabbixin doonaa isaga.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuu dhawri doonaa, wuuna sii noolayn doonaa, oo isaguna dhulkuu ku barakaysnaan doonaa. Rabbow, isaga ha u gacangelin sida cadaawayaashiisu rabaan.
english: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu isaga ku gargaari doonaa sariirta taagdarradiisa. Oo markuu bukana sariirtiisa oo dhan waad u hagaajisaa.
english: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan idhi, Rabbiyow, ii naxariiso, Oo naftayda bogsii, waayo, waan kugu dembaabay.
english: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashaydu shar bay iga sheegaan, oo waxay yidhaahdaan, War goormuu dhiman doonaa, oo magiciisu baabbi'i doonaa?
english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

kikuyu: Oo midkood hadduu i soo booqdona been buu ku hadlaa, Oo qalbigiisuna xumaatuu urursadaa; oo markuu dibadda u baxo ayuu ka warramaa.
english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

kikuyu: Kuwa i neceb oo dhammu anigay ii wada faqaan, Oo waxay iigu wada tashadaan si ay wax ii yeelaan.
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

kikuyu: Waxay yidhaahdaan, Cudur xun baa isagii ku dhacay, Oo haatan wuu jiifaa, mar dambena sooma uu kici doono.
english: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

kikuyu: Xataa saaxiibkaygii aan isku halleeyey, oo kibistaydii cunay, Ayaa cedhibtiisa ii qaaday.
english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

kikuyu: Laakiinse, Rabbiyow, ii naxariiso, oo mar i sara jooji, Aan iyaga ka aar goostee.
english: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

kikuyu: Tan ayaan ku garanayaa inaad igu faraxsan tahay, Maxaa yeelay, cadowgaygu igama guulaysto.
english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

kikuyu: Laakiinse aniga waxaad ii tiirisaa daacadnimadayda aawadeed, Oo weligaaba waxaad i fadhiisisaa wejigaaga hortiisa.
english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

kikuyu: Weligiis iyo weligiisba Waxaa mahad leh Rabbiga ah Ilaaha Israa'iil. Aamiin iyo Aamiin.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

kikuyu: Sida deeradu biyaha durdurka ugu harraaddo, Ayay naftaydu kuugu harraaddaa, Ilaahayow.
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay u oomman tahay Ilaah, kaasoo ah Ilaaha nool. Goormaan u tegi doonaa oo aan Ilaah hortiisa ka muuqan doonaa?
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

kikuyu: Habeen iyo maalinba waxaa cunto ii noqday ilmadaydii, Intay had iyo goorba i leeyihiin, Ilaahaagu meeh?
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

kikuyu: Haddaba waan qarracmaa markaan soo xusuusto waxyaalahan, Sidaan guutada u raaci jiray, oo aan iyaga ugu hor kici jiray guriga Ilaah, Annagoo ku heesayna cod farxad ah iyo ammaan, oo ah dad fara badan oo iidaya.
english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, bal maxaad u murugaysan tahay? Oo bal maxaad gudahayga ugu rabshaysan tahay? Ilaah ku kalsoonow, waayo, weli waxaan isaga u ammaanayaa caawimaadda wejigiisa.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, naftaydu waa igu murugaysan tahay, Oo sidaas daraaddeed waxaan ka xusuusnahay dalkii Urdun, Iyo fiiqfiiqyada Buur Xermoon iyo Buur Miscaar.
english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

kikuyu: Moolba mool buu u yeedhaa markay biya dhacu qaylinayaan, Hirarkaagii iyo mawjadahaagii oo dhammu dushayday mareen.
english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbigu maalinnimada wuxuu soo diri doonaa raxmaddiisa, Oo habeennimadana waxaa ila jiri doona gabaygiisa, Iyo baryootanka aan Ilaaha noloshayda baryo.
english: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

kikuyu: Waxaan Ilaaha dhagaxayga weyn ah ku odhan doonaa, Bal maxaad ii illowday? Dulmiga cadowga daraaddiis bal maxaan ula sii cabaadaa?
english: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

kikuyu: Sida iyadoo seefu lafahayga burburinayso, ayaa cadaawayaashaydu i caayaan, Intay had iyo goorba i leeyihiin, Ilaahaagu meeh?
english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, bal maxaad u murugaysan tahay? Oo bal maxaad gudahayga ugu rabshaysan tahay? Ilaah ku kalsoonow, waayo, weli waxaan ammaanayaa Isagoo ah caawimaadda wejigayga iyo Ilaahay.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, ii gar soor, oo dacwadayda kala muddac quruun aan cibaado lahayn, Iga samatabbixi ninka khiyaanada badan oo xaqa daran.
english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad tahay Ilaaha xoogga ii ah, bal maxaad ii xoortay? Dulmiga cadowga daraaddiis bal maxaan ula sii cabaadaa?
english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

kikuyu: Nuurkaaga iyo runtaada ii soo dir, oo ha i hoggaamiyeen, Oo ha i keeneen buurtaada quduuska ah, iyo taambuugyadaada.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaan tegi doonaa meesha allabariga Ilaah, Iyo Ilaaha ah farxaddayda weyn, Ilaahow, Ilaahaygiiyow, kataaradda waan kugu ammaani doonaa.
english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, bal maxaad u murugaysan tahay? Oo bal maxaad gudahayga ugu rabshaysan tahay? Ilaah ku kalsoonow, waayo, weli waxaan ammaanayaa Isagoo ah caawimaadda wejigayga iyo Ilaahay.
