english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, dhegahayagaannu ku maqallay, oo waxaa noo sheegay awowayaashayo Shuqulkii aad samaysay wakhtigoodii oo ahaa waa hore.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

kikuyu: Quruumihii gacantaadaad ku eriday, oo meeshoodii awowayaashayo baad ku beertay, Dadyowgii waad dhibtay, oo dibaddaad ku kala firdhisay.
english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu dalka kuma hantiyin seeftooda, Oo cududdooduna ma ay badbaadin, Laakiinse midigtaada iyo cududdaada iyo nuurka wejigaaga ayaa badbaadshay iyaga, Maxaa yeelay, raalli baad ka ahayd.
english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, waxaad tahay boqorkayga, Haddaba reer Yacquub samatabbixin u amar.
english: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

kikuyu: Adiga daraaddaa ayaannu cadaawayaashayada hoos ugu riixaynaa, Oo magacaaga daraaddiis ayaan kula tumanaynaa kuwa nagu kaca.
english: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

kikuyu: Waayo, qaansadayda isku hallayn maayo, Oo seeftayduna i badbaadin mayso.
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu cadaawayaashayadaad naga badbaadisay, Oo kuwa na necebna waad ceebaysay.
english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

kikuyu: Maalinta oo dhan waxaannu ku faannaa Ilaah, Oo annana weligayo waxaannu ku mahadnaqaynaa magacaaga. (Selaah)
english: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan waad na xoortay, oo sharafdarrona waad nagu soo dejisay, Oo weliba ciidammadayadana ma aad hor kacdid.
english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

kikuyu: Waxaa dib nooga celisaa cadowgayaga hortiisa, Oo kuwa na necebuna way na dhacaan.
english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

kikuyu: Waxaad naga dhigtay sidii ido la qalayo, Oo waxaad nagu kala firdhisay quruumaha dhexdooda.
english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

kikuyu: Dadkaaga qiimola'aan baad ku iibisaa, Oo maalkaagana kuma aad kordhin qiimahoodii.
english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

kikuyu: Deriskayaga waxaad nooga dhigtaa cay, Oo kuwa hareerahayaga ku wareegsanna waxaad nooga dhigtaa quudhsasho iyo qosol.
english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Quruumaha dhexdooda waxaad nooga dhigtaa halqabsi, Dadyowga dhexdoodana waxaad nooga dhigtaa kuwa madaxa laga lulo.
english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

kikuyu: Maalinta oo dhan sharafdarradaydu way i hor taal, Oo waxaa iga muuqatay ceebtii wejigayga,
english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

kikuyu: Waayo, sababtu waxaa weeye codka kan i caaya oo i af xumeeya, Iyo cadowga iyo kan iga aarguta daraaddood.
english: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas oo dhammu way nagu dhaceen, laakiinse weli kuma aannu illoobin, Axdigaagana khiyaano kuma aannu samayn.
english: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

kikuyu: Qalbigayagu dib uma noqon, Oo tallaabooyinkayaguna jidkaaga kama baydhin,
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

kikuyu: Adiguse waxaad si xun noogu jebisay meeshii dawacooyinka, Oo waxaad nagu qarisay hooskii dhimashada.
english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Haddii aannu illownay magicii Ilaahayaga, Ama aannu gacmahayaga u kala bixinnay ilaah qalaad,
english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

kikuyu: Ilaah miyaanu waxaas baadhayn? Waayo, isagu waa wada og yahay qalbiga waxyaalihiisa qarsoon.
english: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

kikuyu: Haah, oo adiga daraaddaa ayaa naloo laayaa maalinta oo dhan, Oo waxaannu noqonnaa sida ido la qalayo.
english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

kikuyu: Toos, maxaad u huruddaa, Sayidow? Sara joogso, oo ha na xoorin weligaa.
english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

kikuyu: Bal maxaad wejiga nooga qarsanaysaa, Oo aad u illoobaysaa dhibaatada iyo dulmiga aan ku dhex jirno?
english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

kikuyu: Waayo, naftayadu ciidday ku foororsatay, Oo calooshayaduna dhulkay ku dhegtaa.
english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

kikuyu: Caawimaaddayada daraaddeed u sara joogso, Oo raxmaddaada daraaddeed noo furo.
english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

kikuyu: Qalbigaygu wuxuu la buuxdhaafaa hadal wanaagsan, Oo waxaan boqorka u sheegayaa waxyaalihii aan sameeyey, Carrabkaygu waa sida karraani dhaqsiyo badan qalinkiis.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

kikuyu: Adigu waad ka sii quruxsan tahay binu-aadmiga, Oo bushimahaaga waxaa ka buuxda nimco, Sidaas daraaddeed ayaa Ilaah kuu barakeeyey weligaaba.
english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

kikuyu: Seeftaadu bowdadaada ha saarnaato, kaaga xoogga badanow, Oo quruxda iyo haybadda lahow.
english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

kikuyu: Runta iyo camalqabowga iyo xaqnimada daraaddood, Waxaad faraskaaga ku fuushaa haybad adigoo barwaaqaysan, Oo gacantaada midigna waxay ku bari doontaa waxyaalo cabsi badan.
english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

kikuyu: Fallaadhahaagu waa af badan yihiin, Oo waxay wadnaha ka mudaan boqorka cadaawayaashiisa, Dadyowguna hoostaaday ku soo dhacaan.
english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

kikuyu: Carshigaagu, Ilaahow, waa weligiis iyo weligiis, Oo ul caddaaladdeedna waa usha boqortooyadaada.
english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

kikuyu: Adigu xaqnimada waad jeclayd, oo xumaantana waad necbayd, Sidaas daraaddeed Ilaaha Ilaahaaga ahi wuxuu kuugu subkay Saliidda farxadda, oo kuwa ku weheliyana wuu kaa sarraysiiyey.
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

kikuyu: Dharkaaga oo dhan waxaa ka soo carfa malmal, iyo cuud, iyo qasica. Oo qasriyo fool maroodi ah ayaa kaaga farxiyey alaab muusiko xadhko leh.
english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

kikuyu: Dumarkaaga sharafta leh waxaa ku jira gabdhaha boqorrada, Midigtaadana waxaa taagan boqoradda oo isku sharraxday dahabkii Oofir.
english: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

kikuyu: Haddaba, gabadhoy, bal i maqal, oo fiirso, oo dhegta soo dhig, Oo weliba waxaad illowdaa dadkaagii iyo gurigii aabbahaa;
english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

kikuyu: Markaasuu boqorku quruxdaada jeclaanayaa, Waayo, isagu waa sayidkaaga, oo adna isaga u sujuud.
english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa halkaas joogi doonta gabadha reer Turos, iyadoo hadiyad wadda, Xataa taajiriinta dadka ku jirtaa waxay kaa baryi doonaan raallinimo.
english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

kikuyu: Gabadha boqorka oo hoyga boqorka joogtaa waa qurux miidhan, Dharkeeda dahab baa lagu dhex sameeyey.
english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

kikuyu: Waxaa boqorka loo geeyn doonaa iyadoo sharraxan, Bikradaha saaxiibadaheeda ah oo iyada daba socdana waa laguu keeni doonaa.
english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

kikuyu: Waxaa iyaga lagu hoggaamin doonaa farxad iyo rayrayn, Oo waxay soo geli doonaan hoyga boqorka.
english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

kikuyu: Meeshii awowayaashaa waxaa joogi doona wiilashaada, Kuwaas oo aad dunida oo dhan amiirro uga dhigi doonto.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

kikuyu: Magacaaga waxaan ka dhigi doonaa mid ka ab ka ab la xusuusto, Sidaas daraaddeed dadyowgu mahad bay kuu naqi doonaan weligood iyo weligood.
english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ilaah waa magangalkeenna iyo xooggeenna, Oo waa caawimaad inoo diyaar ah wakhtiga dhibaatada.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed cabsan mayno in kastoo dhulku beddelmo, Iyo in kastoo buurahu badda uurkeeda ku dhex dhaqaaqaan,
english: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

kikuyu: Iyo in kastoo biyaheedu guuxaan oo qasmaan, Iyo in kastoo ay buurahu kibirkooda la ruxruxmaan. (Selaah)
english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira webi durdurradiisu ay ka farxiyaan magaalada Ilaah, Taasoo ah meesha quduuska ah ee Ilaaha ugu sarreeya taambuugyadiisa.
english: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa iyada ku dhex jira, mana ay dhaqaaqi doonto, Oo Ilaah baa iyada ku caawin doona marka waagu beryo.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

kikuyu: Quruumihii way cabaadeen, oo boqortooyooyinkiina way dhaqdhaqaaqeen, Codkiisii buu ku hadlay, oo dhulkii baa dhalaalay.
english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu waa inala jiraa, Oo Ilaaha Yacquub baa magangalkeenna ah. (Selaah)
english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

kikuyu: Bal kaalaya arka shuqullada Rabbiga, Iyo halaagga uu ku sameeyey dhulka.
english: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

kikuyu: Dagaallada wuu ku joojiyaa tan iyo dunida meesha ugu dambaysa, Qaansada wuu jebiyaa, oo warankana wuu jaraa, Oo gaadhifardoodkana dab buu ku gubaa.
english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

kikuyu: Iska daaya oo ogaada inaan anigu Ilaah ahay, Waa laygu sarraysiin doonaa quruumaha dhexdooda, dhulkana waa laygu sarraysiin doonaa.
english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu waa inala jiraa, Oo Ilaaha Yacquub baa magangalkeenna ah. (Selaah)
english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

kikuyu: Dadyowga oo dhammow, kulligiin sacabka tuma, Oo Ilaah cod guuleed ugu qayliya.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga ah Ilaaha ugu sarreeya waa cabsi miidhan, Oo isagu waa boqor weyn oo dhulka oo dhan u taliya.
english: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

kikuyu: Isagu dadyowga wuxuu gelin doonaa hoosteenna, Quruumahana wuxuu ka hoos marin doonaa cagaheenna.
english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

kikuyu: Isagu dhaxalkeenna ayuu inoo dooran doonaa, Kaasoo ah ammaanta Yacquub uu jecel yahay. (Selaah)
english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

kikuyu: Ilaah qaylo buu la kacay, Oo wuxuu Rabbiguna la kacay dhawaaqa buunka.
english: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

kikuyu: Ilaah ammaan ugu heesa, ammaan ugu heesa, Ammaan ugu heesa Boqorkeenna, ammaan heesa.
english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah waa dunida oo dhan Boqorkeeda, Haddaba sabuur ammaan ah ku heesa.
english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu u taliyaa quruumaha, Ilaahna carshigiisa quduuska ah ayuu ku fadhiistaa.
english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

kikuyu: Dadyowga amiirradoodii oo dhammu waxay isu soo wada urursadeen Inay dadka Ilaaha Ibraahim noqdaan, Waayo, dhulka gaashaammadiisa waxaa iska leh Ilaah. Oo isaga aad iyo aad baa loo sarraysiiyey.
english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa weyn yahay, waana in aad loogu ammaanaa Ilaaheenna magaaladiisa, iyo buurtiisa quduuska ah.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhererka ku quruxsan, oo farxad u ah dunida oo dhan Buur Siyoon oo dhanka woqooyi ah, Meeshaas oo ah magaalada Boqorka weyn.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu daaraheeda dhaadheer isku muujiyey inuu magangal yahay.
english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eeg, boqorradii way iswada urursadeen, Dhammaantood way wada dhaafeen.
english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

kikuyu: Oo kolkay arkeen ayay yaabeen, Oo argaggexeen, markaasay haddiiba carareen.
english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

kikuyu: Iyagii halkaasay ku gariireen, Wayna ku xanuunsadeen sida naag foolanaysa.
english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

kikuyu: Doonniyaha Tarshiish waxaad ku jejebisaa Dabaysha bari.
english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

kikuyu: Annagu sidaan maqalnay, ayaan ku dhex aragnay Magaalada Rabbiga ciidammada, taasoo ah magaalada Ilaaheenna, Ilaah ayaa weligeedba adkayn doona. (Selaah)
english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, raxmaddaada ayaan ka fikirnay Markaan macbudkaaga ku jirnay.
english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, sida magacaagu yahay Ayaa ammaantaaduna ku tahay dhulka darafyadiisa oo dhan, Gacantaada midigna waxaa ka buuxda xaqnimo.
english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

kikuyu: Buur Siyoon ha faraxdo, Oo gabdhaha reer Yahuudah ha ku reyreeyeen xukummadaada daraaddood.
english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

kikuyu: Siyoon hareeraheeda socda, oo ku soo wareega, Oo munaaradaheeda tiriya.
english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

kikuyu: Bal aad ugu fiirsada qalcadaheeda, Oo ka fikira daaraheeda dhaadheer, Si aad ugu sheekaysaan farcanka soo socda.
english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

kikuyu: Waayo, weligiis iyo weligiisba Ilaahan ayaa Ilaah inoo ah, Oo isagaa hoggaamiye inoo ahaan doona xataa tan iyo dhimashada.
english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

kikuyu: Dadyowga oo dhammow, bal tan maqla, Dunida kuwiinna degganow, kulligiin dhegta u dhiga,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

kikuyu: Kuwiinna hoose iyo kuwiinna sare, Taajirrada iyo masaakiintoy, dhammaantiin wada maqla.
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

kikuyu: Afkaygu wuxuu ku hadli doonaa xigmad, Qalbigayguna wuxuu ka fikiri doonaa waxgarasho.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

kikuyu: Dhegtayda waxaan u dhigi doonaa masaal, Xujadaydana waxaan ku muujin doonaa kataaradda.
english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal maxaan u cabsanayaa wakhtiga shar jiro, Markii xumaanu cedhbahayga ku wareegsanto?
english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

kikuyu: Kuwa maalkooda isku halleeya, Oo ku faana hodantinimadooda faraha badan,
english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

kikuyu: Midkoodna walaalkiis ma furan karo, Daraaddiisna Ilaah madaxfurasho uma siin karo,
english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

kikuyu: (Waayo, furashada naftoodu waa qaali aad iyo aad, Kumana filna weligeedba,)
english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

kikuyu: Inuu isagu weligiis sii noolaado, Oo aanu halligaad arkin weligiis.
english: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu arkaa inay dadka xigmadda lahu wada dhintaan, Iyo in nacasyada iyo doqonnaduba ay wada baabba'aan, Oo ay maalkooda kuwa kale uga tagaan.
english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

kikuyu: Waxay ismoodsiiyaan inay guryahoodu weligoodba sii jirayaan, Iyo in meelaha rugtooda ahu ay sii raagayaan tan iyo qarniyada oo dhan, Oo dhulalkoodana way isku magacaabaan.
english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

kikuyu: Laakiinse binu-aadmigu sharaf kuma waaro, Wuxuu la mid yahay sida xayawaanka iska baabba'a.
english: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: Jidkoodanu waa kalsoonidooda nacasnimada ah, Laakiinse dadka iyaga ka dambeeya ayaa hadalkoodii u boga. (Selaah)
english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

kikuyu: Iyagu waxaa weeye adhi She'ool loo wado, Oo waxaa sida adhijir u ahaan doona dhimasho, Oo kuwa qumman ayaa iyaga subaxda u talin doona, Oo quruxdoodana waxaa baabbi'in doona She'ool, inaanay iyagu rug yeelan innaba.
english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaah naftayda wuu ka soo furan doonaa xoogga She'ool, Waayo, wuu i aqbali doonaa. (Selaah)
english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

kikuyu: Ha baqin markii mid taajiroobo, Oo ammaanta reerkiisu aad u korodho,
english: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu markuu dhinto waxba sii qaadan maayo, Oo ammaantiisuna ka daba geli mayso.
english: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

kikuyu: In kastoo uu naftiisa u duceeyey markuu noolaa, Oo dad adiga ku ammaana, kolkaad wax wanaagsan isu samaysid,
english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu u tegi doonaa qarniyadii awowayaashiis, Oo iyana weligood iftiinka ma ay arki doonaan.
english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

kikuyu: Ninkii sharaf leh oo aan garaad lahaynu Wuxuu la mid yahay sida xayawaanka iska baabba'a.
english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: Ilaah, oo ah Ilaaha Rabbiga ah ayaa hadlay, Oo qorrax-soo-baxa ilaa qorraxdhaca dhulkuu u yeedhay.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

kikuyu: Siyoon oo ah meesha quruxda kaamilka ah Ayaa Ilaah ka soo iftiimay.
english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

kikuyu: Ilaaheen wuu iman doonaa, iskamana aamusi doono, Hortiisa ayaa dab wax baabbi'in doonaa, Hareerihiisana waxaa jiri doona duufaan weyn.
english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu u yeedhi doonaa samooyinka sare, Iyo dhulkaba, inuu dadkiisa xukumo aawadeed.
english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu odhan doonaa, Quduusiintayda ii soo wada ururiya, Kuwii axdi igula dhigtay allabari.
english: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

kikuyu: Oo samooyinka ayaa xaqnimadiisa sheegi doona, Waayo, Ilaah qudhiisu waa xaakin. (Selaah)
english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

kikuyu: Dadkaygiiyow, i maqla, oo anna waan hadli doonaa, Israa'iilow, i maqal oo anna waan kuu markhaati furi doonaa, Anigu waxaan ahay Ilaah, oo ah Ilaahaaga.
english: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

kikuyu: Anigu kugu canaanan maayo allabaryadaada, Oo qurbaannadaada gubanu had iyo goorba hortayday yaalliin.
english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

kikuyu: Reerkaaga dibi ka qaadan maayo, Xerooyinkaagana orgi kala bixi maayo.
english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

kikuyu: Waayo, xayawaanka duudda jooga oo dhan anigaa iska leh, Iyo xataa xoolaha kunka buurood jooga oo dhan.
english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

kikuyu: Waan wada aqaan haadda buuraha joogta oo dhan, Oo dugaagga duurka jooga oo dhanna anigaa iska leh.
english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

kikuyu: Haddaan gaajaysnahay, kuuma aan sheegeen, Waayo, dunida iyo waxa ka buuxaba anigaa iska leh.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

kikuyu: Miyaan cuni doonaa hilibka dibida, Miyaanse cabbi doonaa dhiigga riyaha?
english: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

kikuyu: Ilaah u bixi allabariga mahadnaqiddaa, Oo Ilaaha ugu sarreeyana nidarradaadii u oofi,
english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

kikuyu: Oo i bari maalinta dhibi jirto, Oo anna waan ku samatabbixin doonaa, kolkaasaad i ammaani doontaa.
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaah wuxuu kan sharka leh ku yidhaahdaa, Maxaad qaynuunnadayda u sheegaysaa, Oo aad axdigayga afkaaga ugu soo qaadaysaa?
english: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

kikuyu: Adigoo tacliinta neceb, Oo weliba erayadaydana dabadaada ku tuura.
english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

kikuyu: Markaad tuug aragtay waad oggolaatay, Oo waxaad la qayb qaadatay dhillayo.
english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

kikuyu: Afkaaga waxaad u daysaa inuu shar ku hadlo, Oo carrabkaaguna wuxuu hindisaa khiyaano.
english: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

kikuyu: Waad fadhiisataa oo wax ka sheegtaa walaalkaa, Oo weliba waxaad xamataa inahooyadaa.
english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas baad samaysay, oo anna waan iska aamusay, Waxaad moodday inaan ahay mid kula mid ah, Laakiinse waan ku canaanan doonaa, oo iyaga ayaan indhahaaga hortooda ku hagaajin doonaa.
english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna Ilaah illoobayow, bal waxan ka fiirsada, Waaba intaasoo aan cadcad idiin jeexjeexaaye, oo aad wax idin samatabbixiya weydaane,
english: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii allabariga mahadnaqidda bixiyaa waa i ammaanaa, Oo kii socodkiisa si qumman u hagaajiyana Waxaan tusi doonaa badbaadinta Ilaah.
english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

kikuyu: Ilaahow, iigu naxariiso sida raxmaddaadu tahay, Oo xadgudubyadaydana igaga tirtir sida naxariistaada badnaanteedu tahay.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

kikuyu: Xumaantayda iga wada maydh, Oo iga nadiifi dembigayga.
english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu waan ogahay xadgudubyadayda, Oo dembigayguna hortayduu yaallaa had iyo goorba.
english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

kikuyu: Adiga keliya ayaan kugu dembaabay, Oo waxaan sameeyey wax hortaada ku xun, Inaad xaq ahaatid markaad hadashid, Oo aad daahir ahaatid markaad wax xukunto.
english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, aniga waxaa laygu qabanqaabiyey xumaan, Oo waxaa hooyaday igu uuraysatay dembi.
english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxaad uurka ka jeceshahay run, Oo meesha qarsoon waxaad iga ogeysiinaysaa xigmad.
english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

kikuyu: Haddaba geed husob ah igu daahiri, oo anna nadiif baan ahaan doonaa, I maydh, oo anna baraf cad waan ka sii caddaan doonaa.
english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

kikuyu: I maqashii farxad iyo rayrayn, Inay lafihii aad jejebisay farxaan.
english: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

kikuyu: Wejigaaga ka qari dembiyadayda, Oo iga tirtir xumaatooyinkayga oo dhan.
english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, igu dhex abuur qalbi nadiif ah, Oo igu dhex cusboonaysii ruux qumman.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

kikuyu: Hortaada ha iga xoorin, Oo Ruuxaaga quduuska ah ha iga qaadin.
english: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

kikuyu: Farxaddii badbaadintaada ii soo celi, Oo ruux raalli ah igu tiiri.
english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

kikuyu: Oo markaas kuwa xadgudba jidkaagaan bari doonaa, Oo dembilayaashuna adigay kuu soo noqon doonaan.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, Ilaaha badbaadadaydow, dhiiggelidda iga samatabbixi, Markaasaa carrabkaygu wuxuu aad uga gabyi doonaa xaqnimadaada.
english: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

kikuyu: Sayidow, bushimahayga fur, Oo afkaygu wuxuu ku hadli doonaa ammaantaada.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

kikuyu: Waayo, adigu kuma faraxdid allabari, haddii kalese waan bixin lahaa, Qurbaan gubanna kuma cajebiyo.
english: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

kikuyu: Allabaryada Ilaah waa ruux is-hoosaysiintiisa, Ilaahow, adigu quudhsan maysid qalbi hoosaysan oo qoomamaysan.
english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

kikuyu: Siyoon wanaag ugu samee sidaad doonayso, Oo Yeruusaalem derbiyadeedana dhis.
english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo markaas adigu waxaad ku farxi doontaa allabaryada xaqnimada iyo qurbaan guban, iyo allabari wada guban dhammaantiis, Oo markaasay dibiyo ku dul bixin doonaan meeshaada allabariga.
english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

kikuyu: Ninka xoogga badanow, bal maxaad xumaanta ugu faanaysaa? Naxariista Ilaah had iyo goorba way sii waartaa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

kikuyu: Carrabkaagu wuxuu hindisaa xumaato weyn, Oo sida mandiil afaysan ayuu ka shaqeeyaa khiyaano.
english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

kikuyu: Wanaagga waxaad ka jeceshahay xumaanta, Oo inaad xaqnimo ku hadashidna waxaad ka jeceshahay beensheegidda. (Selaah)
english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

kikuyu: Waxaad jeceshahay erayada wax baabbi'iya oo dhan, Iyo carrab khiyaano miidhan ah.
english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

kikuyu: Ilaahna sidaas oo kaluu kuu halligi doonaa weligaaba, Oo isna kor buu kuu qaadi doonaa, oo wuxuu kaa bixin doonaa teendhadaada, Oo wuxuu kaa saari doonaa kuwa nool dalkooda. (Selaah)
english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ahuna way arki doonaan, oo way cabsan doonaan, Wayna ku qosli doonaan, oo waxay odhan doonaan,
english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

kikuyu: Waa kan ninkii aan Ilaah xooggiisa ka dhiganu, Laakiinse wuxuu isku halleeyey hodantinimadiisa badan, Oo wuxuu ku xoogaystay xumaatadiisii.
english: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waxaan la mid ahay sida geed qoyan oo saytuun ah, oo guriga Ilaah ku dhex yaal, Anigu weligay iyo weligayba waxaan isku hallaynayaa naxariista Ilaah.
english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

kikuyu: Weligayba waan kugu mahadnaqayaa, maxaa yeelay, adigu waad samaysay, Oo magacaaga ayaan wax ku rajaynayaa, waayo, wuu ku wanaagsan yahay quduusiintaada hortooda.
english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

kikuyu: Nacaskaa qalbigiisa iska yidhi, Ilaah ma jiro. Iyagu waa qudhun, oo waxay faleen xumaan karaahiyo ah, Oo mid wanaag falaa ma jiro.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu samada hoos uga soo fiiriyey binu-aadmiga, Bal inuu arko hadday kuwo wax garanaya oo Ilaah doondoonaa jiraan.
english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

kikuyu: Midkood kastaaba dib buu u noqday, oo dhammaantood waxay wada noqdeen dad nijaas ah, Oo mid wanaag falaa ma jiro, midnaba.
english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: Miyaanay aqoon lahayn xumaanfalayaasha dadkaygii u cuna siday kibista u cunaan, Oo aanay Ilaah baryin?
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

kikuyu: Iyagu halkaasay aad ugu cabsadeen meel aan cabsiyu jirin, Waayo, kii ku ag degay inuu kugu soo duulo Ilaah baa lafihiisii kala firdhiyey, Oo iyagaad ceebaysay, maxaa yeelay, Ilaah baa iyaga diiday.
english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

kikuyu: Badbaadada reer binu Israa'iil bal may Siyoon ka timaado! Marka Ilaah dadkiisa maxaabiisnimada ka soo celiyo, Ayaa reer Yacquub rayrayn doonaa oo reer binu Israa'iilna farxi doonaa.
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, magacaaga igu badbaadi, Oo xooggaaga iigu garsoor.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, baryadayda maqal, Oo erayada afkayga dhegta u dhig,
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Waayo, shisheeyayaal baa igu kacay, Oo rag dulmi badan ayaa doonayay inay nafta iga qaadaan, Iyagu Ilaah kama fikirin. (Selaah)
english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

kikuyu: Bal eega, Ilaah waa gargaarahayga, Oo Sayidkuna wuxuu la jiraa kuwa naftayda tiiriya.
english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

kikuyu: Isagu sharka wuxuu ku celin doonaa cadaawayaashayda, Iyaga runtaada ku baabbi'i.
english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

kikuyu: Waxaan kuu qali doonaa qurbaan ikhtiyaar ah, Rabbiyow, magacaaga waan ku mahadnaqi doonaa, waayo wuu wanaagsan yahay.
english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu iga samatabbixiyey dhibaato oo dhan, Oo ishayduna waxay cadaawayaashayda ku aragtay wixii aan doonayay.
english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, tukashadayda dhegta u dhig, Oo baryootankaygana ha iska qarin.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

kikuyu: I maqal, oo ii jawaab, Waxaan la nasan waayaa calaacalkayga, waanan la taahaa,
english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

kikuyu: Sababtuna waxaa weeye codka cadowga daraaddiis, Iyo kan sharka leh cadaadintiisa daraaddeed, Waayo, iyagu xumaan bay igu tuuraan, Maxaa yeelay, cadho ayay igu silciyaan.
english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

kikuyu: Wadnuhu aad buu ii xanuunayaa, Oo waxaa igu dhacday cabsida dhimashada.
english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Baqdin iyo gariir ayaa igu soo degay, Oo naxdin baa i dabooshay.
english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

kikuyu: Oo anna waxaan is-idhi, Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan baalal yeesho sida qoolley oo kale! Markaasaan iska duuli lahaa oo nasan lahaa.
english: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, markaasaan iska warwareegi lahaa meel fog, Oo waxaan degganaan lahaa cidlada. (Selaah)
english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

kikuyu: Waxaan gabbaad kaga carari lahaa Dabaysha hufada ah iyo duufaanka.
english: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

kikuyu: Sayidow, iyaga baabbi'i, oo afafkoodana kala duw Waayo, waxaan magaalada ku arkay dulmi iyo dirir.
english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

kikuyu: Maalin iyo habeenba derbiyadeeday ku dul wareegaan, Oo weliba waxaa ku dhex jira xumaan iyo belaayo.
english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

kikuyu: Dhexdeedana waxaa ku jira shar, Dulmi iyo khiyaanona kama tagaan jidadkeeda.
english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii i caayay cadaawe ma ahayn, Maxaa yeelay, waan u adkaysan kari lahaa, Mana ahayn kii i necbaa oo iska kay weyneeyey, Maxaa yeelay, waan ka dhuuman lahaa isaga,
english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

kikuyu: Laakiinse wuxuu ahaa adiga oo ah nin ila mid ah, Iyo jaalkay iyo saaxiibkay.
english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

kikuyu: Si wanaagsan baynu u wada sheekaysan jirnay, Oo waxaynu ku dhex socon jirnay guriga Ilaah, innagoo guuto badan la soconna.
english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

kikuyu: Dhimasho ha ku soo kediso iyaga, Oo iyagoo noolnool She'ool ha ku dhaceen, Waayo, xumaan baa ku jirta hoygooda iyo dhexdooda.
english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu Ilaah baan baryi doonaa, Oo Rabbigaa i badbaadin doona.
english: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

kikuyu: Fiidka, iyo subaxda, iyo duhurkaba, anigu waan cataabi doonaa, oo waan taahi doonaa, Oo isna codkayguu maqli doonaa.
english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

kikuyu: Naftayda nabadduu kaga samatabbixiyey dagaalkii iga geesta ahaa, Waayo, kuwii ila diriray way badnaayeen.
english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

kikuyu: Ilaah oo ah kan weligiis waara, Wuu maqli doonaa oo u jawaabi doonaa iyaga, Kuwaas oo aan beddelmin, (Selaah) Oo aan Ilaah ka cabsan.
english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu u gacan qaaday kii isaga heshiiska la ahaa, Oo axdigiisiina wuu buriyey.
english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

kikuyu: Afkiisu wuxuu u nuglaa sidii subag oo kale, Laakiinse qalbigiisu wuxuu ahaa dagaal, Erayadiisu saliid way ka jilicsanaayeen, Laakiinse waxay ahaayeen seefo galkii laga siibay.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

kikuyu: Culaabtaada Rabbiga saar, oo isna wuu ku xanaanayn doonaa, Waayo, isagu kan xaqa ah marnaba u dayn maayo in la dhaqaajiyo.
english: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

kikuyu: Laakiinse, Ilaahow, iyaga waxaad ku dhaadhicin doontaa yamayska halligaadda, Dhiigyocabyada iyo dadka khaa'innada ahu cimrigooda nus ma kadban doonaan, Laakiinse anigu waan isku kaa hallayn doonaa.
english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, ii naxariiso, waayo dad baa waxay doonayaan inay i liqaan; Maalinta oo dhan isagoo diriraya ayuu i dulmaa.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashaydu maalinta oo dhan waxay doonayaan inay i liqaan, Waayo, kuwa kibirka igula diriraa waa tiro badan yihiin.
english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

kikuyu: Markaan cabsado, Waan isku kaa hallaynayaa.
english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

kikuyu: Ilaah caawimaaddiisa ayaan eraygiisa ku ammaani doonaa, Waayo, Ilaah baan isku halleeyey, oo innaba baqi maayo, Haddaba bal binu-aadmigu muxuu igu samayn karaa?
english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

kikuyu: Maalinta oo dhan erayadayda way qalloociyaan, Fikirradooda oo dhammu waa igu col si ay shar iigu sameeyaan.
english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

kikuyu: Way isa soo wada urursadaan, oo way dhuuntaan, Oo waxay fiirsadaan tallaabooyinkayga, Markay gaadayaan naftayda.
english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

kikuyu: Iyagu ma xumaan bay ku baxsan doonaan? Ilaahow, dadyowga adoo cadhaysan hoos u tuur.
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

kikuyu: Waad og tahay warwareeggayga, Bal ilmadayda qaruuraddaada ku shub, Waayo, miyaanay buuggaaga ku qorrayn?
english: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

kikuyu: Markaasaa cadaawayaashaydu dib u noqon doonaan maalinta aan kuu yeedho, Waayo, waxaan ogahay in Ilaah ila jiro.
english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

kikuyu: Ilaah caawimaaddiisa ayaan eraygiisa ku ammaani doonaa, Oo Rabbigana caawimaaddiisa ayaan eraygiisa ku ammaani doonaa.
english: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.

kikuyu: Ilaah baan isku halleeyey, oo innaba baqi maayo, Haddaba bal dad muxuu igu samayn karaa?
english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: Ilaahow, nidarradaada waan qabaa, Oo waxaan kuu bixinayaa qurbaanno mahadnaqid ah.
english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

kikuyu: Waayo, naftaydaad ka samatabbixisay dhimasho, Sow cagahayga dhicitin kama aad samatabbixin? Inaan Ilaah hortiisa ku socdo Iftiinka kuwa nool.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

kikuyu: Ii naxariiso, Ilaahow, ii naxariiso, Waayo, naftaydu adigay ku magan gashaa, Haah, waxaan magangeli doonaa hooska baalashaada, Ilaa ay belaayooyinkanu gudbayaan.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

kikuyu: Waxaan u qayshanayaa Ilaaha ugu sarreeya, Oo ah Ilaaha wax kasta ii sameeya.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

kikuyu: Isagu samaduu caawimaad ka soo diri doonaa, wuuna i badbaadin doonaa, Markuu kan i liqi lahaa i caayo, (Selaah) Ilaah wuxuu soo diri doonaa naxariistiisa iyo runtiisa.
english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay ku dhex jirtaa libaaxyo, Oo anigu waxaan dhex jiifaa kuwo dab lagu shiday, Kuwaasoo ah binu-aadmiga oo ilkahoodu yihiin warmo iyo fallaadho, Oo carrabkooduna yahay seef af badan.
english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, samooyinka ka sara mar, Oo ammaantaaduna dhulka oo dhan ha ka sarrayso.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

kikuyu: Dabin bay cagahayga u diyaariyeen, Oo naftaydii baa foororsatay, Oo waxay hortayda ka qodeen god, Oo iyaga qudhoodii baa ku dhex dhacay. (Selaah)
english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

kikuyu: Qalbigaa ii fadhiya, Ilaahow, qalbigaa ii fadhiya, Haddaba waan gabyi doonaa, haah, ammaan baan ku gabyi doonaa.
english: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, toos, shareerad iyo kataaradoy, toosa, Aniga qudhayduna waxaan toosi doonaa aroor hore.
english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

kikuyu: Sayidow, dadyowga dhexdooda ayaan kaaga mahadnaqi doonaa, Oo quruumaha dhexdooda ayaan ammaan kuugu gabyi doonaa.
english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

kikuyu: Waayo, naxariistaadu waa weyn tahay oo waxay gaadhaa samooyinka, Oo runtaaduna waxay gaadhaa daruuraha.
english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, samooyinka ka sara mar, Oo ammaantaaduna dhulka oo dhan ha ka sarrayso.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

kikuyu: Hubaal xaqnimada aamusnaan ma ku sheegtaan? Binu-aadmigow, si qumman wax ma u xukuntaan?
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

kikuyu: Hubaal qalbiga waxaad ka samaysaan xumaato, Oo waxaad ka fikirtaan dulmiga gacmihiinna oo aad dhulka ku samaysaan.
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu waxay qalaad ku noqdaan uurkii hooyadood, Oo mar alla markii ay dhashaan ayay habaabaan iyagoo been sheegaya.
english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

kikuyu: Suntoodu waa sida abeesada waabaydeeda oo kale, Iyagu waa sida jilbis dhega la' oo dhegihiisa fureeya,
english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

kikuyu: Kaasoo aan maqlin codka saaxiriinta, Iyagoo si caqli ah u sixraya.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, ilkahooda afkooda ku dhex burburi, Rabbiyow, libaaxyada aaranka ah miciyahooda jejebi.
english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

kikuyu: Ha u dhalaaleen sida biyo aad u durduraya. Markuu fallaadhihiisa wax ku liishaamo, ha noqdeen sida wax kala jabay.
english: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

kikuyu: Ha noqdeen sida alalaxayda dhalaasha oo iska baabba'da, Iyo sida dhicis naageed oo aan qorraxda arkin.
english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

kikuyu: Intaan dheryihiinnu qodxaha taaban, Ayuu kuwa qoyan iyo kuwa ololayaba ku kala firdhin doonaa dabayl cirwareen ah.
english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ahu wuu rayrayn doonaa markuu arko aargudashada, Oo wuxuu ku cago maydhan doonaa kan sharka leh dhiiggiisa.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed dadku wuxuu odhan doonaa, Hubaal kii xaq ahu abaalgud buu leeyahay, Hubaal waxaa jira Ilaah dhulka xukuma.
english: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, cadaawayaashayda iga samatabbixi, Oo kuwa igu kacayna meel sare iga saar.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Iga samatabbixi xumaanfalayaasha, Oo dadka dhiigyocabyada ahna iga badbaadi.
english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eeg, waxay gaadaan naftayda, Oo kuwa xoogga badanuna way isu kay wada urursadaan, Rabbiyow, weliba ma aha xadgudubkayga aawadiis iyo dembigayga aawadiis toona.
english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

kikuyu: Waxay u ordaan oo isu diyaariyaan wax aanan eed ku lahayn, Dartay u kac inaad i caawiso oo aad i eegto.
english: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammadow, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iilow, Sara joogso oo quruumaha oo dhan soo booqo, Oo innaba ha u naxariisan xadgudbayaasha. (Selaah)
english: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

kikuyu: Fiidkay soo noqdaan, oo waxay u ciyaan sida eey oo kale, Oo waxay ku warwareegaan magaalada hareeraheeda.
english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

kikuyu: Afkooda waxaa ka qubmaysa cay, Bushimahoodana waxaa ku jira seefo, Waayo, waxay isyidhaahdaan, Bal yaa na maqla?
english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbiyow, iyagaad ku qosli doontaa, Quruumaha oo dhan waad quudhsan doontaa.
english: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

kikuyu: Xooggaygiiyow, adigaan ku sugi doonaa, Waayo, Ilaah waa qalcaddayda.
english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

kikuyu: Ilaahayga naxariista leh ayaa i hor iman doona, Oo waxaan doonayana Ilaah wuxuu iga tusi doonaa cadaawayaashayda.
english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

kikuyu: Sayidow, gaashaankayagiiyow, Iyaga ha layn, waaba intaasoo ay dadkaygu illoobaane, Laakiinse iyaga xooggaaga ku kala firdhi, oo hoos u soo deji.
english: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

kikuyu: Kibirkoodu iyaga ha dabo Dembiga afkooda iyo erayada bushimahooda aawadood, Iyo weliba habaarka iyo beenta ay ku hadlaan aawadood.
english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

kikuyu: Iyaga cadho ku baabbi'i, si aanay mar dambe u jirin iyaga baabbi'i, Oo ha ogaadeen in Ilaah u taliyo reer Yacquub Tan iyo dhulka darafkiisa. (Selaah)
english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu fiidka ha soo noqdeen, oo sida eey oo kale ha u ciyeen, Oo magaalada hareeraheeda ha ku warwareegeen.
english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

kikuyu: Waxay u warwareegayaan inay cunto helaan, Oo haddaanay dherginna habeenkii oo dhan way sii joogayaan.
english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waxaan ka gabyi doonaa xooggaaga, Haah, oo aroortii ayaan naxariistaada aad uga gabyi doonaa, Waayo, waxaad ahayd qalcaddaydii, Oo maalintii aan dhibaataysnaana magangal baad ii ahayd.
english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

kikuyu: Xooggaygiiyow, adigaan ammaan kuugu gabyi doonaa, Waayo, Ilaah waa qalcaddayda, waana Ilaaha naxariistayda.
english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, adigu waad na xoortay, oo waad na dudumisay, Oo waad nagu cadhootay, haddaba bal mar na soo celi.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

kikuyu: Dhulkii waad gariirisay, oo waad kala dildillaacisay, Haddaba dildillaaciisa bogsii, waayo, wuu ruxmadaa.
english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

kikuyu: Dadkaagii waxaad tustay waxyaalo adag, Oo waxaad na cabsiisay khamri lala dhacdhaco.
english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

kikuyu: Calan baad siisay kuwa kaa cabsada, In runta loo soo bandhigo aawadeed. (Selaah)
english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

kikuyu: Si ay kuwaad jeceshahay u samatabbaxaan, Gacantaada midig ku badbaadi oo ii jawaab.
english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu ku hadlay quduusnimadiisa oo yidhi, Anigu waan farxi doonaa, Shekem waan kala qaybin doonaa, oo waxaan qiyaasi doonaa dooxada Sukod.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kikuyu: Gilecaad anigaa iska leh, Manasehna anigaa iska leh, Oo weliba Efrayimna waa daafacaaddii madaxayga, Yahuudahna waa ushayda boqornimo.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Moo'aab waa weelkaygii aan ku maydhan jiray, Edomna kabahaygaan ku dul tuuri doonaa, Falastiinay, qayli aawaday.
english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

kikuyu: Bal yaa i geeyn doona magaalada xoogga leh? Yaase xagga Edom ii kaxayn doona?
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

kikuyu: Ilaahow, sow nama aadan xoorin? Ilaahow, lama soo baxdid ciidammadayada.
english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

kikuyu: Cadowga naga caawi, Waayo, binu-aadmiga caawimaaddiisu waxtar ma leh.
english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: Ilaah caawimaaddiisa ayaannu wax xoog leh ku samayn doonaa, Waayo, isagaa ah kan cadaawayaashayada ku tuman doona.
english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, qayladayda maqal, Oo baryadaydana dhegta u dhig.
english: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

kikuyu: Markii qalbigaygu itaal darnaado, waxaan kaaga qayshan doonaa darafka dhulka ugu shisheeya, Ii hoggaami dhagaxa iga dheer.
english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad ii ahayd magangal, Iyo qalcad adag oo aan cadowga ka galo.
english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

kikuyu: Anigu weligayba waxaan degganaan doonaa taambuuggaaga, Oo waxaan magangeli doonaa baalashaada meeshooda qarsoon. (Selaah)
english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaahow, nidarradaydii waad maqashay, Oo waxaad i siisay kuwa magacaaga ka cabsada dhaxalkooda.
english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

kikuyu: Boqorka noloshiisa waad dheeraynaysaa, Oo cimrigiisuna wuxuu noqon doonaa sida qarniyo badan.
english: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

kikuyu: Oo weligiisba wuxuu joogi doonaa Ilaah hortiisa, Raxmad iyo run u diyaari, inay isaga dhawraan.
english: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

kikuyu: Markaasaan weligayba magacaaga ammaan ugu gabyi doonaa, Si aan maalin kasta nidarradayda u oofiyo.
english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay sugtaa Ilaah oo keliya, Oo badbaadadayduna waxay ka timaadaa xaggiisa.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

kikuyu: Isaga oo qudha ayaa dhagaxayga weyn iyo badbaadadaydaba ah, Isagu waa munaaraddayda, oo aniga aad lay dhaqaajin maayo.
english: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

kikuyu: Balse idinku ilaa goormaad nin ku weeraraysaan, Inaad kulligiin isaga dumisaan, Sida derbi dhacaya, iyo deyr ligliganaya?
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

kikuyu: Iyagu waxay keliyahoo ku tashadaan si ay isaga sharaftiisa uga dejiyaan, Oo waxay ku farxaan beensheegidda, Afka way ka duceeyaan, laakiinse uurka way ka habaartamaan. (Selaah)
english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, Ilaah oo qudha sug, Waayo, isagaan wax ka filanayaa.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

kikuyu: Isaga oo qudha ayaa dhagaxayga weyn iyo badbaadadaydaba ah, Isagu waa munaaraddayda, oo aniga layma dhaqaajin doono.
english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

kikuyu: Badbaadadayda iyo ammaantayduba waxay la jiraan Ilaah, Dhagaxii xooggayga iyo magangalkaygaba waa xagga Ilaah.
english: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

kikuyu: Dadkow, isaga isku halleeya wakhti kastaba, Oo qalbigiinna waxba ha kula hadhina Ilaah hortiisa, Waayo, Ilaah baa magangal inoo ah. (Selaah)
english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

kikuyu: Hubaal dad gun ahu waa xumbo, Oo dad gob ahuna waa been, Markii la miisaamo way kor mari doonaan, Oo iyagu dhammaantood xumbo way ka fudud yihiin.
english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

kikuyu: Dulmiga ha isku hallaynina, Waxdhiciddana ha ku kibrina. Maal hadduu idinku batona qalbigiinna ha raacinina.
english: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

kikuyu: Ilaah mar buu hadlay, Oo laba goor baan maqlay, In Ilaah xoogga iska leeyahay,
english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

kikuyu: Oo weliba, Sayidow, adigu naxariis baad leedahay, Waayo, nin kasta waxaad ugu abaalguddaa sidii camalladiisu ahaayeen.
english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, waxaad tahay Ilaahay, oo anna goor hore ayaan ku doondooni doonaa, Naftaydu adigay kuu oomman tahay, jidhkayguna aduu kuu xiisoodaa, Anoo jooga dhul engegan oo daal miidhan ah oo aan biyo lahayn.
english: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

kikuyu: Si aan u arko xooggaaga iyo ammaantaadaba aawadeed, Ayaan kaa fiiriyey meesha quduuska ah.
english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

kikuyu: Waayo, raxmaddaadu way ka sii wanaagsan tahay nolol, Haddaba bushimahaygu way ku ammaani doonaan.
english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waan kugu mahadnaqayaa intaan noolahay, Oo gacmahaygana kor baan ugu qaadi doonaa magacaaga aawadiis.
english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay u dhergi doontaa sida mid dhuux iyo baruur uga dhergo, Oo afkayguna wuxuu kugu ammaani doonaa bushimo faraxsan
english: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

kikuyu: Kolkaan sariirtayda kugu soo xusuusto Oo aan kaa fikiro habeenka markaan soo jeedo.
english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad ii ahayd caawimaad, Oo hooska baalashaada ayaan ku rayrayn doonaa.
english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Naftaydu adigay ku raacdaa, Oo gacantaada midigna way i tiirisaa. (Selaah)
english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa naftayda u doondoonaya inay halligaan aawadeed, Waxay geli doonaan dhulka meelaha ugu hooseeya.
english: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

kikuyu: Waxaa iyaga loo gacangelin doonaa xoogga seefta, Oo waxay qayb u noqon doonaan dawacooyinka.
english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

kikuyu: Laakiinse boqorku wuxuu ku rayrayn doonaa Ilaah, Mid kasta oo isaga ku dhaartaa wuu faani doonaa, Waayo, kuwa beenta sheega afkooda waa la aamusiin doonaa.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, codkayga maqal markii aan kuu soo cawdo, Oo naftayda ka ilaali cadowga cabsidiisa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

kikuyu: Oo iga qari talada qarsoon oo kuwa sharka ka shaqeeya, Iyo tirabadnaanta xumaanfalayaasha,
english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

kikuyu: Oo carrabkooda u afeeyey sidii seef oo kale, Oo fallaadhahoodii liishaamay kuwaas oo ah erayo qadhaadh,
english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

kikuyu: Si ay meelo qarsoon kan qumman fallaadh ugaga ganaan, Haddiiba si kedis ah ayay ugu ganaan, mana cabsadaan.
english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

kikuyu: Qasdi shar ah bay isku dhiirrigeliyaan, Waxay ku arrinsadaan inay si qarsoon dabinno u dhigaan, Oo ay isyidhaahdaan, Bal yaa arki doona?
english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

kikuyu: Waxay baadhaan xumaatooyin, iyagoo leh, Annagu baadhid caqli ah ayaannu ebinnay, Fikirka ku jira uurka nin walba iyo qalbiguba waa mool dheer yihiin.
english: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaah waa toogan doonaa, Oo haddiiba iyaga waxaa dhaawici doonta fallaadh.
english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waa la kufin doonaa, iyagoo carrabkoodu col u yahay naftooda, Wax alla wixii iyaga arka oo dhammu way carari doonaan.
english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

kikuyu: Oo dadka oo dhammu way cabsan doonaan, Oo waxay sheegi doonaan shuqulka Ilaah, Oo si caqli ah ayay uga fikiri doonaan wuxuu sameeyey.
english: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ahu waxay ku farxi doonaan Rabbiga, oo isagay isku hallayn doonaan, Oo inta qalbigoodu toosan yahay oo dhammuna way faani doonaan.
english: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

kikuyu: Ilaahow, ammaan baa Siyoon kugu sugaysa, Oo nidarkana waa in adiga laguu oofiyo.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

kikuyu: Kaaga baryootanka maqlow, Dadka oo dhammu adigay kuu iman doonaan.
english: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

kikuyu: Waxaa iga adkaada xumaatooyin, Xadgudubkayagase waad naga nadiifin doontaa.
english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninkii aad dooratid, oo aad ka dhigto inuu kuu soo dhowaado, Inuu degganaado barxadahaaga. Waxaan ka dhergi doonnaa wanaagga gurigaaga, Kaas oo ah meesha quduuska ah oo macbudkaaga.
english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

kikuyu: Ilaaha badbaadadayadow, Waxyaalo cabsi badan ayaad xaqnimo noogu jawaabi doontaa, Waxaad tahay kalsoonida kuwa dunida darfaheeda oo dhan, Iyo kuwa badda fogba,
english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

kikuyu: Kaas oo xooggiisa buuraha ku adkeeya, Isagoo dhexda xoog ku xidhay.
english: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

kikuyu: Wuxuu aamusiiyaa guuxa badaha, iyo guuxa hirarkooda, Iyo dadyowga buuqooda.
english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

kikuyu: Oo weliba kuwa dhulka meelaha ugu fog deggan waxay ka cabsadaan calaamooyinkaaga, Oo adigu waad ka farxisaa meelaha ay subaxda iyo fiidkaba ka baxaan.
english: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

kikuyu: Dhulka waad soo booqataa, oo waad biyaysaa, Oo aad baad u barwaaqaysaa, Webiga Ilaahna biyaa ka buuxa, Waxaad iyaga siisaa hadhuudh, markii aad dhulka sidaas u diyaarisay.
english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

kikuyu: Adigu beerta jeexjeexeeda aad baad u waraabisaa, Oo waxaad dejisaa jeexjeexa tuurahooda, Oo tiixtiix baad ku jilcisaa, Oo waxa ka soo baxana waad barakaysaa.
english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

kikuyu: Sannadda waxaad taaj uga dhigtaa wanaaggaaga, Oo waddooyinkaagana waxaa ka tifqa subag.
english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

kikuyu: Waxay ku tifqaan daaqa cidlada, Oo buuruhuna waxay guntadaan farxad.
english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

kikuyu: Berrimmada daaqu waxay huwadaan tirooyin adhyo ah, Dooxooyinkana waxaa qariya hadhuudh, Markaasay farxad la qayliyaan, oo weliba gabyaan.
english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

kikuyu: Dadka dhulka oo dhammow, Ilaah farxad ugu qayliya,
english: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

kikuyu: Oo ammaanta magiciisa ku gabya, Ammaantiisana qurxiya.
english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

kikuyu: Ilaah waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Shuqulladaadu cabsi badanaa! Weynaanta xooggaaga aawadiis ayaa cadaawayaashaadu isugu kaa dhiibi doonaan.
english: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

kikuyu: Dadka dhulka oo dhammu adigay ku caabudi doonaan, Wayna kuu gabyi doonaan, Magacaagay u gabyi doonaan. (Selaah)
english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

kikuyu: Bal kaalaya, oo arka shuqullada Ilaah, Xagga binu-aadmiga wuxuu ku sameeyey waa cabsi badan yihiin.
english: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

kikuyu: Wuxuu baddii ka dhigay dhul engegan, Oo iyagu webiga dhexdiisa waxay ku mareen lug, Oo halkaasaan isaga ku rayraynay.
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

kikuyu: Isagu weligiisba wuxuu ku taliyaa xooggiisa, Oo indhihiisuna waxay fiiriyaan quruumaha, Haddaba caasiyiintu yaanay kor isu qaadin. (Selaah)
english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

kikuyu: Dadyahow, Ilaaheenna ammaana, Oo codka ammaantiisa ha la maqlo,
english: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

kikuyu: Kaasoo nafteenna nolol ku haya, Oo cagaheennana aan u oggolayn in la dhaqdhaqaajiyo.
english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaahow, adigu waad na imtixaantay, Oo waxaad noo tijaabisay sida lacagta loo tijaabiyo.
english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

kikuyu: Waxaad na gelisay shabagga dabinka ah, Oo waxaad simaha naga saartay culaab weyn.
english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

kikuyu: Dad baad madaxa naga saartay, Oo waxaannu dhex galnay dab iyo biyo, Laakiinse ugudambaysta waxaad na keentay meel barwaaqo ah.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

kikuyu: Haddaba anigu gurigaaga waxaan la soo geli doonaa allabaryo la gubo, Oo waxaan kuu oofinayaa nidarradaydii
english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

kikuyu: Bushimahaygu ay ku hadleen, Oo afkaygu sheegay markii aan dhibaataysnaa.
english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan allabaryo la gubo kuugu soo bixinayaa xoolo buurbuuran Iyo wanan iyo fooxood, Oo waxaan kuu soo bixin doonaa dibiyo iyo orgiyo. (Selaah)
english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

kikuyu: Kulli intiinna Ilaah ka cabsataay, kaalaya oo maqla, Oo waxaan sheegayaa wuxuu naftayda u sameeyeye.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

kikuyu: Isagaan afkayga ugu qayshaday, Oo waxaan ku ammaanay carrabkayga.
english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

kikuyu: Haddaan dembi qalbigayga ku arkay, Sayidku ima uu maqleen,
english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

kikuyu: Laakiinse sida runta ah Ilaah waa i maqlay, Oo codkii baryadaydana dhegtuu u dhigay.
english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

kikuyu: Mahad waxaa leh Ilaaha Aan baryadayda diidin oo aan naxariistiisana gees iga marin.
english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, noo naxariiso, oo na barakee, Oo wejigaaguna ha na iftiimiyo, (Selaah)
english: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

kikuyu: In jidkaaga laga ogaado dhulka, Quruumaha oo dhan dhexdoodana laga wada ogaado caafimaadkaaga wax badbaadiya.
english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

kikuyu: Ilaahow, dadyowgu ha ku ammaaneen, Dadyowga oo dhammu ha ku ammaaneen.
english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Quruumuhu ha farxeen oo ha gabyeen farxad aawadeed, Waayo, dadyowga waxaad ku xukumi doontaa caddaalad, Oo quruumahana dhulkaad ugu talin doontaa. (Selaah)
english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, dadyowgu ha ku ammaaneen, Dadyowga oo dhammu ha ku ammaaneen.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Dhulku wuxuu soo saaray midhihiisii, Waxaa ina barakayn doona Ilaah, oo ah Ilaaheenna qudhiisa.
english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

kikuyu: Ilaah waa ina barakayn doonaa, Oo dhulka darafyadiisa oo dhammuna way ka cabsan doonaan isaga.
english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

kikuyu: Ilaah ha sara joogsado, oo cadaawayaashiisuna ha kala firdheen, Kuwa necebuna hortiisa ha ka carareen.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

kikuyu: Sida qiiqu u kala firdho, iyagana sidaasoo kale u kala firdhi, Sida shamacu dabka ugu dhalaalo, Sidaasoo kale kuwa sharka lahu Ilaah hortiisa ha ku baabbe'een.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ahu ha farxeen, oo Ilaah hortiisa ha ku reyreeyeen, Haah, oo farxad ha ku reyreeyeen.
english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

kikuyu: Ilaah u gabya, oo magiciisa ammaan ugu gabya, Kan lamadegaanka dhex mara jid weyn u fala, Magiciisu waa Yaah, ee hortiisa ku reyreeya.
english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu rugtiisa quduuskaa ku yahay Agoonta aabbahood iyo carmallada xaakinkooda.
english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

kikuyu: Kuwa cidlaysan Ilaah reero ayuu u yeelaa, Oo maxaabiistana intuu soo bixiyo ayuu barwaaqo dhex geeyaa, Laakiinse caasiyiintu waxay degganaadaan dhul oommane ah.
english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, markaad dadkaaga hor kacday, Markaad lamadegaanka ku dhex socotay, (Selaah)
english: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

kikuyu: Dhulku waa gariiray, Samooyinkuna waxay ku de'een Ilaah hortiisa, Xataa Buur Siinay nafteedu waxay ka gariirtay Ilaah hortiisa, kaasoo ah Ilaaha Israa'iil.
english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, waxaad soo daysay roob badan, Oo kuwa dhaxalkaagu markay daallanaayeenna waad xoogaysay.
english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

kikuyu: Ururkaagu halkaasuu dhex degganaa, Ilaahow, wanaaggaaga aawadiis wax baad u diyaarisay masaakiinta.
english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

kikuyu: Sayidku wuxuu bixiyey erayga, Kuwa warka faafiyaana waa guuto weyn.
english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

kikuyu: Boqorrada ciidammadu way cararaan, way cararaan, Oo tan guriga ku hadha ayaa dhaca qaybisa.
english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

kikuyu: Xeryaha idaha miyaad iska dhex jiifaysaan, Sidii baadad qoolley oo lacag lagu dahaadhay, Iyo baalasheeda oo dahab cas lagu dahaadhay?
english: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

kikuyu: Markii Qaadirku boqorrada halkaas ku kala dhex firdhiyey, Waxay ahayd sida marka baraf cad ku da'o Salmoon.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

kikuyu: Buur Ilaah waxaa ah Buur Baashaan. Oo buur dheer waxaa ah Buur Baashaan.
english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

kikuyu: Buurihiinnan dhaadheerow, bal maxaad u quudhsanaysaan Buurta Ilaah uu jeclaaday inuu hoygiisii ka dhigto? Haah, oo Rabbigu halkaasuu degganaan doonaa weligiisba.
english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.

kikuyu: Ilaah gaadhifardoodyadiisu waa labaatan kun, iyo xataa kumanyaal iyo kumaankun, Sayidku wuu ku dhex jiraa iyaga, siduu Siinay ugu jiri jiray xagga meesha quduuska ah.
english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Adigu kor baad u baxday, oo waxaad qabatay oo kaxaysay kuwii maxaabiista ahaan jiray. Oo waxaad hadiyado ka qaadatay dadka dhexdiisa, Iyo xataa caasiyiintaba, in Rabbiga Ilaah ahu halkaas joogo aawadeed.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

kikuyu: Waxaa mahad leh Sayidka maalin kasta culaabteenna inoo qaada, Kaasoo ah Ilaaha ina badbaadiya. (Selaah)
english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu inoo yahay Ilaaha samatabbixinta, Ilaaha Sayidka ah ayaa iska leh dhimashada kabixiddeeda.
english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaah wuxuu wax ku dhufan doonaa madaxa cadaawayaashiisa, Iyo dhalada timaha leh oo kan xadgudubyadiisa ku sii socdaba.
english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

kikuyu: Sayidku wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan iyaga ka soo celin doonaa xagga Baashaan, Oo waxaan ka soo bixin doonaa badda moolkeeda,
english: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

kikuyu: Inaad cagtaada dhiig darsatid, Iyo in eeyahaaga carrabkoodu uu qayb ka helo cadaawayaashaada.
english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

kikuyu: Ilaahow, waxay arkeen tegiddaadii, Taas oo ah tegiddii Ilaahay oo ah Boqorkayga oo uu galay meesha quduuska ah.
english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Gabayayaashii way hor mareen, muusikaystayaashiina way raaceen, Dhexdana waxaa ku jiray hablo daf ku cayaaraya.
english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

kikuyu: Kuwiinnan isha Israa'iil ka soo farcamayow, Shirarka ku dhex ammaana Ilaaha Sayidka ah.
english: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

kikuyu: Waxaa jooga Benyaamiin yar oo ah taliyahooda, Iyo amiirrada reer Yahuudah iyo guddigooda, Iyo amiirrada reer Sebulun iyo amiirrada reer Naftaali.
english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Ilaahaagu xooggaaguu amray, Ilaahow, waxaad noo samaysay noo xoogee.
