english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

kikuyu: Macbudkaaga Yeruusaalem ku yaal daraaddiis Ayaa boqorro waxay kuugu keeni doonaan hadiyado.
english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.

kikuyu: Canaano dugaagga cawsduurka ku dhex jira, Iyo dibida tirada badan, iyo weylaha dadka Oo ku tumanaya lacagta gogo'a ah, Isagu wuu kala firdhiyey dadyowga dagaalka jecel.
english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

kikuyu: Masar waxaa ka iman doona amiirro, Itoobiyana haddiiba gacmaheeday u hoorsan doontaa Ilaah.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

kikuyu: Boqortooyooyinka dhulkow, Ilaah u gabya, Ammaan ugu gabya Sayidka, (Selaah)
english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—

kikuyu: Kaasoo kor fuushan samada samooyinka sare, oo weligoodba jiray, Bal eega, wuxuu ku hadlaa codkiisa, oo weliba codkiisu waa xoog badan yahay.
english: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

kikuyu: Ilaah xoog ka sheega, Waayo, sharaftiisu waxay dul joogtaa reer binu Israa'iil, Oo xooggiisuna wuxuu ku jiraa samooyinka.
english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, meelahaaga quduuska ah waxaad ka tahay mid laga cabsado, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil wuxuu dadkiisa siiyaa xoog iyo itaal. Mahad waxaa leh Ilaah.
english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

kikuyu: Ilaahow, i badbaadi, Waayo, biyaa naftii ii keenay.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

kikuyu: Waxaan ku dhex liimbadaa dhoobo mool dheer oo aan lahayn meel laysku taago, Waxaan ku dhacay biyo mool dheer, oo daad baa halkaas igu qarqinaya.
english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku daalay qayladaydii, oo hungurigaygu waa qallalay, Oo intii aan Ilaahay sugayo ayay indhahaygu dem yidhaahdaan.
english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

kikuyu: Kuwa sababla'aanta ii nebcaadaa way ka sii badan yihiin timaha madaxayga, Kuwa doonaya inay i baabbi'iyaan iyagoo cadaawayaashayda gardarro igu ah waa xoog badan yihiin, Markaasaan magdhabay wax aanan qaadan.
english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, waad og tahay nacasnimadayda, Oo dembiyadayduna kaama qarsoona.
english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

kikuyu: Sayidow, Ilaaha ciidammadow, kuwa ku sugaya yaanan ceeb u soo jiidin, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iilow, kuwa ku doondoonaya yaanan sharafjab u soo jiidin.
english: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, adiga daraaddaa ayaan cay u qaaday, Oo waxaa wejigaygii ka muuqatay ceeb.
english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

kikuyu: Waxaan walaalahay u noqday shisheeye, Oo ilma hooyadayna waxaan u noqday ajanabi.
english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

kikuyu: Qiiradii aan gurigaaga u qabay ayaa i gubtay, Oo caydii kuwii ku caayay ayaa igu kor dhacday.
english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Markaan ooyay, oo aan naftayda soon ku edbiyey, Taasu waxay igu noqotay ceeb.
english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

kikuyu: Markaan joonyado dhar ka dhigtayna, Waxaan iyagii u noqday masaal.
english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

kikuyu: Kuwa iridda fadhfadhiyaa way igu sheekaystaan, Oo kuwa sakhraanka ahuna way igu gabyaan.
english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigaan ku baryayaa wakhti la aqbali karo, Rabbiyow, Ilaahow, naxariistaada badan Iyo runta badbaadintaada iigu jawaab.
english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

kikuyu: Dhoobada iga samatabbixi, oo yaanan ku liimban, Oo ha layga samatabbixiyo kuwa i neceb, iyo biyaha moolka dheer.
english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

kikuyu: Biyaha daadka ahuna yaanay i qarqin, Oo yaan moolku i liqin, Oo yamayskuna yaanu afkiisa igu qabsan.
english: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ii jawaab, waayo, raxmaddaadu waa wanaagsan tahay, Naxariistaada badnaanteeda aawadeed iigu soo jeeso.
english: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

kikuyu: Oo wejigaaga ha iga qarin anoo addoonkaaga ah, Waayo, waan dhibaataysnahay, ee haddiiba ii jawaab.
english: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

kikuyu: Naftayda u soo dhowow, oo furo, Oo cadaawayaashayda daraaddood ii samatabbixi.
english: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

kikuyu: Waad og tahay caydayda iyo ceebtayda iyo sharafdarradayda, Oo cadaawayaashayda oo dhammu hortaaday joogaan.
english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

kikuyu: Cay baa i qalbi jebisay, waanan quusanayaa, Oo waxaan doondoonay mid ii jixinjixa, laakiinse waan waayay, Oo waxaan doondoonay kuwo i qalbi qaboojiya, laakiinse ma aanan helin.
english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxay cunto ahaan ii siiyeen xammeeti, Oo markaan harraadsanaana waxay i cabsiiyeen khal.
english: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

kikuyu: Miiskoodu hortooda ha ku noqdo dabin, Oo markay nabdoon yihiinna shirqool ha ku noqdo.
english: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

kikuyu: Indhahoodu ha madoobaadeen si aanay waxba u arkin, Oo simahooduna had iyo goorba ha gariireen.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

kikuyu: Xanaaqaaga iyaga ku deji, Oo cadhadaada kulaylkeeduna ha qabsado.
english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

kikuyu: Gurigoodu cidla ha noqdo, Ninnana yaanu teendhooyinkooda degin,
english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu waxay silciyaan kii aad dishay, Oo waxay ka sheekeeyaan kuwaad dhaawacday murugtooda.
english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

kikuyu: Xumaantooda xumaan ugu sii dar, Oo yaanay xaqnimadaada soo gelin.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

kikuyu: Magacooda ha laga tirtiro kitaabka kuwa nool, Oo yaan iyaga lala qorin kuwa xaqa ah.
english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu miskiin baan ahay, waanan murug badnahay, Ilaahow, badbaadintaadu meel sare ha i saarto.
english: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

kikuyu: Rabbiga magiciisa ayaan gabay ku ammaani doonaa, Oo waxaan isaga ku weynayn doonaa mahadnaqid.
english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Oo taasuna Rabbiga way ka farxin doontaa in ka sii wanaagsan intii uu ku farxi lahaa dibi, Ama dibi sange ah oo geeso iyo qoobab leh.
english: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

kikuyu: Kuwa camal qabow way arkeen, waana faraxsan yihiin, Kuwiinna Ilaah doondoonow, qalbigiinnu ha noolaado.
english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuu maqlaa kuwa baahan, Oo maxaabiistiisana ma uu quudhsado.
english: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

kikuyu: Samada, iyo dhulka, iyo badaha, Iyo waxa ku dhex dhaqaaqa oo dhammuba isaga ha ammaaneen.
english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah Siyoon wuu badbaadin doonaa, oo magaalooyinka reer Yahuudahna wuu dhisi doonaa, Oo iyana halkaasay degi doonaan, oo hanti ahaan bay u lahaan doonaan.
english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaa halkaas dhaxli doona farcanka addoommadiisa, Oo kuwa magiciisa jecelna way dhex degganaan doonaan.
english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, soo dhaqso oo i samatabbixi, Rabbiyow, soo dhaqso oo i caawi.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.

kikuyu: Kuwa doondoonaya inay naftayda iga qaadaan Ha ceeboobeen oo ha wareereen, Oo kuwa waxyeelladayda ku farxaana Dib ha u noqdeen oo ha sharaf beeleen.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

kikuyu: Kuwa Ahaa, Ahaa, lahu, Ceebtooda dib ha ula noqdeen.
english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Kuwa adiga ku doondoona oo dhammu ha reyreeyeen oo ha kugu farxeen, Oo kuwa badbaadintaada jeceluna had iyo goorba ha yidhaahdeen, Ilaah ha la weyneeyo.
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

kikuyu: Laakiinse miskiin iyo mid baahan baan ahay, Ilaahow, ii soo dhaqso, Waxaad tahay caawimaaddayda iyo samatabbixiyahayga. Rabbiyow, ha iga raagin.
english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigaan isku kaa halleeyaa, Yaanan weligay wareerin.
english: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Xaqnimadaada igu samatabbixi oo i nabad geli, Dhegta ii dhig, oo i badbaadi.
english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

kikuyu: Ii noqo dhagax weyn oo rug ah, oo aan had iyo goorba ku noqnoqdo, Waxaad amar ku bixisay in lay badbaadsho, Waayo, adigu waxaad tahay dhagax weyn oo ii gabbaad ah iyo qalcaddayda.
english: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, iga badbaadi kan sharka leh gacantiisa, Iyo gacanta xaqlaawaha iyo ninka nacabkaa.
english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

kikuyu: Waayo, Sayidow Ilaahow, waxaad tahay rajadayda, Oo waxaad tahay kii aan isku hallaynayay tan iyo yaraantaydii.
english: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

kikuyu: Tan iyo uurkii hooyaday adigaa i tiirinayay, Waxaad tahay kii iga soo bixiyey uurkii hooyaday, Had iyo goorba adigaan ku ammaani doonaa.
english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

kikuyu: Anigu kuwo badan baan u ahay sidii wax yaab leh, Laakiinse adigu waxaad ii tahay magangal xoog leh.
english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

kikuyu: Maalin kasta waxaa afkayga ka buuxi doona Ammaantaada iyo sharaftaada.
english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

kikuyu: Ha i tuurin markaan gaboobo, Oo ha i dayrin markaan itaal darnaado.
english: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

kikuyu: Waayo, cadaawayaashaydu waxay ka hadlaan wax igu saabsan, Oo kuwa naftayda inay iga qaadaan doonayaana way wada arrinsadaan,
english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

kikuyu: Oo waxay isyidhaahdaan, Ilaah baa dayriyey, Haddaba ka daba taga oo qabta, waayo, ma jiro mid samatabbixinayaa.
english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

kikuyu: Ilaahow, ha iga fogaan, Ilaahayow, soo dhaqso oo i caawi.
english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

kikuyu: Kuwa naftayda cadaawayaal ku ahu ha ceeboobeen oo ha baabba'een, Oo kuwa waxyeelladayda doondoonayana ceeb iyo sharafdarro ha ku bateen.
english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu had iyo goorba wax baan rajaynayaa, Oo weliba waan kuu sii ammaanayaa aad iyo aad.
english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

kikuyu: Afkaygu wuxuu maalinta oo dhan ka sheekayn doonaa xaqnimadaada, iyo badbaadintaada, Waayo, anigu ma aqaan intay tiro le'eg yihiin.
english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

kikuyu: Waxaan la imanayaa Sayidka Ilaahaa shuqulladiisa xoogga leh, Oo waxaan ka hadli doonaa xaqnimadaada, taasoo ah taada oo keliya.
english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, wax baad i bari jirtay tan iyo yaraantaydii, Oo ilaa haatanna waxaan caddayn jiray shuqulladaada yaabka badan.
english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, ha i dayrin, xataa markaan gaboobo oo madaxaygu cirroobo, Jeeraan xooggaaga uga warramo farcanka dambe Oo aan itaalkaaga uga sheekeeyo mid kasta oo hadda ka dib imanaya.
english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, xaqnimadaadu aad iyo aad bay u sarraysaa, Ilaahow, adiga oo waxyaalaha waaweyn sameeyey, Bal yaa kula mid ah?
english: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

kikuyu: Adiga oo na tusay dhibaatooyin badan oo aad u xun, Ayaa haddana na noolayn doona, Oo haddana waxaad naga soo saari doontaa dhulka moolkiisa.
english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: Weynaantayda ii sii kordhi, Oo intaad soo jeesatid i qalbi qabooji.
english: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, waxaan kugu ammaani doonaa alaab muusiko ah, Oo runtaadaan ammaani doonaa, Israa'iil kiisa Quduuska ahow, Waxaan ammaan kuugula gabyi doonaa kataarad.
english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Bushimahaygu aad bay ugu farxi doonaan, markaan ammaan kuugu gabyo, Oo xataa naftaydii aad soo furatayna way rayrayn doonta.
english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

kikuyu: Oo weliba carrabkayguna maalinta oo dhan wuxuu ka sheekayn doonaa xaqnimadaada, Waayo, kuwa waxyeelladayda doondoonayaa way ceeboobaan, oo way isku wareeraan.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, boqorka xukummadaada sii, Oo wiilka boqorkana xaqnimadaada sii.
english: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

kikuyu: Isagu dadkaaga wuxuu ku xukumi doonaa xaqnimo, Oo masaakiintaadana caddaalad.
english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

kikuyu: Buuruhu waxay dadka u keeni doonaan nabad, Kuruhuna waxay nabad ugu keeni doonaan xaqnimada.
english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu u garsoori doonaa dadka masaakiintiisa, Oo wuxuu badbaadin doonaa ka baahan carruurtiisa, Oo kan wax dulmana cadcad buu u kala jejebin doonaa.
english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

kikuyu: Way kaa cabsan doonaan inta qorraxdu jirto, Iyo inta dayaxu jiro tan iyo ka ab ka ab.
english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu u soo degi doonaa sida roob caws la jaray ku dul hoora, Iyo sida tiixyo dhulka biyeeya.
english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

kikuyu: Wakhtigiisa ayaa kan xaqa ahu barwaaqoobi doonaa, Oo nabadduna way badan doontaa tan iyo inta dayaxu aanu mar dambe jiri doonin.
english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

kikuyu: Oo isagu wuxuu u talin doonaa bad ilaa ka bad, Iyo tan iyo Webiga iyo ilaa dhulka darfihiisa.
english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Kuwa cidlada degganu hortiisay ku sujuudi doonaan; Oo cadaawayaashiisuna ciidday leefleefi doonaan.
english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

kikuyu: Boqorrada Tarshiish iyo kuwa gasiiraduhuba waxay isaga u keeni doonaan gabbaro, Boqorrada Shebaa iyo kuwa Sebaana waxay isaga siin doonaan hadiyado.
english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

kikuyu: Haah, oo boqorrada oo dhammu hortiisay ku wada sujuudi doonaan, Oo quruumaha oo dhammuna isagay u adeegi doonaan.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu samatabbixin doonaa kan baahan markuu qayliyo, Iyo miskiinka aan mid caawiya lahayn.
english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u nixi doonaa miskiinka iyo kan baahan, Oo kuwa baahan naftoodana wuu badbaadin doonaa.
english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

kikuyu: Naftooduu ka furan doonaa khiyaano iyo dulmi, Oo dhiiggooduna hortiisuu qaali ku ahaan doonaa,
english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

kikuyu: Oo isagu wuu noolaan doonaa, oo waxaa la siin doonaa dahabka Shebaa; Had iyo goorba dadku way u ducayn doonaan, Oo weliba maalinta oo dhan isagay ammaani doonaan.
english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

kikuyu: Oo dhulka waxaa jiri doona hadhuudh badan xagga buuraha dushooda, Oo midhihiisuna waxay u soo ruxmi doonaan sida Lubnaan oo kale, Oo kuwa magaalada joogaana waxay u barwaaqoobi doonaan sida doogga dhulka.
english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

kikuyu: Magiciisu weligiis buu waari doonaa, Magiciisu waa sii jiri doonaa in alla intay qorraxdu jirto; Oo dadku way ku barakoobi doonaan isaga, Quruumaha oo dhammuna waxay ugu yeedhi doonaan farxaan.
english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

kikuyu: Mahad waxaa leh Rabbiga Ilaahaa oo ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, Oo keligiis sameeya waxyaalo yaab badan,
english: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

kikuyu: Magiciisa ammaanta badanu mahad ha lahaado weligiisba, Oo dhulka oo dhanna ammaantiisu ha ka buuxsanto. Aamiin iyo Aamiin.
english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

kikuyu: Daa'uud ina Yesay baryootannadiisii way dhammaadeen.
english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Hubaal Ilaah waa u roon yahay reer binu Israa'iil, Iyo xataa kuwa qalbigoodu daahirka yahay.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu waan turunturoon gaadhay, Oo tallaabooyinkayguna waxay u dhowaadeen inay simbiriirixdaan.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan ka hinaasay kuwa qabka weyn, Markaan arkay barwaaqada ay kuwa sharka lahu haystaan.
english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

kikuyu: Waayo, geeridoodu xanuun ma leh, Laakiinse xooggoodu waa adag yahay.
english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

kikuyu: Iyagu dhib kuma jiraan sida dadka kale, Oo sida dadka kalena uma belaayaysna.
english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kibir wuxuu yahay sida silsilad qoorta u sudhan, Oo dulmi bay sida maro u huwan yihiin.
english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

kikuyu: Indhahoodu baruur bay la bararsan yihiin, Oo waxay haystaan in ka sii badan waxa qalbigoodu doonayo.
english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

kikuyu: Wax bay ku qoslaan, oo xumaan daraaddeed dulmi bay ku hadlaan, Waxay hadlaan iyagoo kor isu qaadaya.
english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

kikuyu: Afkoodii waxay gaadhsiiyeen samooyinka, Oo carrabkooduna wuxuu dhex maraa dhulka oo dhan.
english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed dadkiisii halkanay ku soo noqdaan, Oo koob biyo ka buuxa ayay madhsadeen.
english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

kikuyu: Oo waxay yidhaahdaan, Ilaah sidee buu wax u yaqaan? Kan ugu sarreeyana aqoonu ma ku jirtaa?
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

kikuyu: Bal eeg, kuwanu waa kuwa sharka leh, Oo mar kasta iyagoo istareexsan ayay hodantinimadoodu sii korodhaa.
english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

kikuyu: Hubaal wax aan micne lahayn ayaan qalbigaygii ku nadiifshay, Oo aan ku faraxashay anigoo aan eed lahayn,
english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

kikuyu: Waayo, maalintii oo dhan waa lay dhibayay, Oo subax kastana waa lay edbinayay.
english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

kikuyu: Haddaan odhan lahaa, Sidaasaan ku hadli doonaa, Bal eeg, waan khiyaanayn lahaa farcanka carruurtaada.
english: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

kikuyu: Markaan ku fikiray si aan tan ku ogaado, Aad bay iigu xanuun badnayd,
english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

kikuyu: Ilaa aan galay meesha quduuska ah ee Ilaah, Oo aan ka fiirsaday ugudambaystooda.
english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

kikuyu: Hubaal waxaad iyaga ku taagtaa meelo sibiibix ah, Oo waxaad hoos ugu tuurtaa si ay u baabba'aan.
english: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

kikuyu: Sidee bay daqiiqad ugu noqdeen meel cidla ah! Dhammaantood waxay ku baabba'een cabsi.
english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

kikuyu: Sayidow, sidii mid riyo ka toosay Markaad toostid, waxaad quudhsan doontaa ekaantooda.
english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

kikuyu: Waayo, qalbigaygu wuu murugooday, Oo waxaa layga muday kelyaha,
english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

kikuyu: Waxaan ahaa doqon iyo jaahil, Oo hortaada waxaan ku ahaa sidii xoolo oo kale.
english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee had iyo goorba waan kula joogaa, Oo waxaad i qabatay gacanta midig.
english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

kikuyu: Waxaad igu hoggaamin doontaa taladaada, Oo dabadeedna waxaad igu dhowayn doontaa ammaanta.
english: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

kikuyu: Bal, yaan samada ku leeyahay adiga mooyaane? Oo dhulkana laguma arko mid aan kaa jeclahay.
english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

kikuyu: Jiidhkayga iyo qalbigayguba waa itaal darnaadeen, Laakiinse Ilaah wuxuu weligiis ii yahay xooggii qalbigayga iyo qaybtayda.
english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eeg, kuwa kaa fogu way halligmi doonaan, Oo waad wada baabbi'isay kuwii kaa caasiyoobay oo dhan.
english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

kikuyu: Laakiinse aniga waxaa ii roon inaan Ilaah u soo dhowaado, Waayo, Sayidka Ilaahaa waxaan ka dhigtay magangalkayga, Inaan ka sheekeeyo shuqulladaada oo dhan.
english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, bal maxaad weligaaba noo xoortay? Oo bal maxaa cadhadaadu ugu kululaataa idaha daaqsintaada?
english: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

kikuyu: Bal soo xusuuso ururkaaga aad waa hore soo iibsatay, Oo aad u soo furatay inay ahaadaan qabiilkaad dhaxashay, Oo weliba Buur Siyoon oo aad degganaatana soo xusuuso.
english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

kikuyu: Tallaabooyinkaaga u soo qaad xagga baabba'a weligiis ah, Iyo xagga xumaanta uu cadowgu meesha quduuska ah ku sameeyey oo dhan.
english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashaadii waxay ka qayliyeen shirkaaga dhexdiisa, Oo waxay calaamad ahaan u qotonsadeen calammadoodii.
english: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

kikuyu: Waxay u ekaadeen sidii niman faasas u qaatay hawd jiq ah.
english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

kikuyu: Haddaba shuqulkiisii la qoray oo dhan Waxay ku wada dumiyaan gudmo iyo dubbayaal.
english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

kikuyu: Meeshaada quduuska ah dab bay ku dhejiyeen, Oo waxay wada nijaaseeyeen meeshii magacaaga hoyga u ahayd.
english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

kikuyu: Waxay qalbigooda iska yidhaahdeen, Kaalaya aan dhammaantood baabbi'innee, Waxay wada gubeen sunagogyadii Ilaah oo dalka ku dhex yiil oo dhan.
english: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

kikuyu: Annagu calaamadahayagii ma aragno, Oo innaba mar dambe nebi ma jiro, Dhexdayadana ma joogo mid garanaya ilaa goorma.
english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, ilaa goormaa cadowgu caytamayaa? Cadowgu miyuu magacaaga caayayaa weligiisba?
english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

kikuyu: Bal maxaad gacantaada midig dib ugu celisaa? Laabtaada ka soo bixi oo iyaga baabbi'i.
english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaah waa boqorkayga tan iyo waa hore, Isagoo badbaadin ka dhex samaynaya dhulka.
english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

kikuyu: Xooggaagaad badda ku kala qaybisay, Oo masbadeedyada ku dhex jirana madaxaad ka jebisaa.
english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

kikuyu: Waxaad kala burburisay madaxyada bahalbadeedyada oo Lewiiyaataan la odhan jiray, Oo cunto ahaan ayaad u siisay dadkii cidlada degganaa.
english: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

kikuyu: Waxaad kala furtay ilo iyo durdurro, Oo waxaad qallajisay webiyo waaweyn.
english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

kikuyu: Maalinta adigaa iska leh, habeenkana adigaa iska leh, Oo adigaa diyaariyey iftiinka iyo qorraxdaba.
english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

kikuyu: Adigu waxaad samaysay dhulka soohdimihiisa oo dhan, Oo adigaa sameeyey diraac iyo xagaaba.
english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, xusuuso in cadowgu caytamay, Iyo in dad nacas ahu magacaaga caayay.
english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

kikuyu: Qoolleydaada nafteeda ha u gacangelin dugaagga, Weligaaba ha illoobin nafta masaakiintaada,
english: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

kikuyu: Bal soo fiiri axdigaaga, Dhulka meelihiisa gudcurka ah waxaa ka buuxa hoyaalka dulmiga.
english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

kikuyu: Kuwa la dulmay yaanay dib u noqon iyagoo ceeboobay, Miskiinka iyo kan baahanu magacaaga ha ammaaneen.
english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, sara joogso, oo dacwadaada u muddac. Bal xusuuso siday dadka nacaska ahu maalinta oo dhan kuu caayaan.
english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

kikuyu: Ha illoobin codka cadaawayaashaada, Kuwa kugu kaca buuqoodu had iyo goorba wuu soo kacaa.
english: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, adaan kuu mahadnaqnaa, Waannu kuu mahadnaqnaa, waayo, magacaagu waa noo dhow yahay, Dadku waxay ka sheekeeyaan shuqulladaada yaabka badan.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Wakhtiga aan qawimay, Ayaan si qumman wax u xukumi doonaa.
english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

kikuyu: Dhulka iyo waxa kor deggan oo dhammuba way wada dhalaaleen, Tiirarkiisa anigaa qotomiyey. (Selaah)
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

kikuyu: Kuwa kibirka leh waxaan ku idhi, Ha kibrina, Kuwa sharka lehna waxaan ku idhi, Geeskiinna kor ha u taagina,
english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

kikuyu: Geeskiinna kor ha u taagina, Oo madaxadayg ha ku hadlina.
english: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

kikuyu: Waayo, sarrayntu kama timaado xagga bari ama xagga galbeed, Ama xataa xagga koonfureed toona.
english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaah baa xaakin ah, Isagu mid buu dejiyaa, ku kalena wuu sarraysiiyaa.
english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga gacantiisa waxaa ku jira koob, oo waxaa ka xumbaynaysa khamri, Oo waxaa ka buuxa wax laysku qooshay, oo kaasuu wax ka shubaa, Hubaal huubadiisa waxaa heenheensan doona oo cabbi doona dunida kuweeda sharka leh oo dhan.
english: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu weligayba waan rayrayn doonaa, Oo waxaan ammaan ugu gabyi doonaa Ilaaha Yacquub.
english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Oo weliba kuwa sharka leh geesahooda oo dhan waan wada jejebin doonaa, Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ah geesahooda waa la sarraysiin doonaa.
english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa reer Yahuudah lagu dhex yaqaan, Oo magiciisuna reer binu Israa'iil dhexdooda waa ku weyn yahay.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

kikuyu: Oo taambuuggiisu wuxuu ku yaal Saalem, Hoygiisuna wuxuu ku yaal Siyoon.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

kikuyu: Oo halkaas wuxuu ku jejebiyey fallaadhihii qaansada, Iyo gaashaankii, iyo seeftii, iyo dagaalkiiba. (Selaah)
english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

kikuyu: Adigu waxaad ka ammaan iyo haybad badan tahay buuraha ugaadha leh.
english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

kikuyu: Kuwii qalbiga adkaa waa la dhacay, oo hurdadoodii ayay wada gam'een, Oo raggii xoogga badnaana midkoodna gacmihiisii waxba kuma samayn.
english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

kikuyu: Ilaaha Yacquubow, canaantaadii aawadeed Ayaa gaadhifardood iyo fardoba waxay kula dhex dheceen hurdo weyn.
english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

kikuyu: Adigase waa in lagaa cabsadaa, Bal yaa hortaada istaagi kara mar haddaad cadhootid?
english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

kikuyu: Waxaad ka dhigtay in xukun samada laga maqlo, Oo dhulkiina waa baqay, oo wuu aamusay,
english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

kikuyu: Markuu Ilaah xukunka u sara kacay Inuu badbaadsho kuwa camalka qabow oo dhulka jooga oo dhan. (Selaah)
english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Hubaal waxaa ku ammaani doonta dadka cadhadiisa, Oo waxaad dhexda ku xidhan doontaa cadhada inteeda hadhay.
english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaahiin ah wax u nidra, oo u oofiya, Inta hareerihiisa ku wareegsan oo dhammu isaga hadiyado ha u keeneen kan ay waajibka tahay in laga cabsado.
english: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu gooyn doonaa amiirrada ruuxooda, Boqorrada dunidana wuu u cabsi badan yahay.
english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

kikuyu: Anigu codkaygaan Ilaah ugu qayshan doonaa, Xataa Ilaah ayaan codkayga ugu qayshan doonaa, oo isaguna wuu i dhegaysan doonaa.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

kikuyu: Maalintii aan dhibaataysnaa waxaan doondoonay Sayidka, Gacantaydu way fidsanayd habeennimadii, mana ay nasan, Oo naftaydiina way diidday in la qaboojiyo.
english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

kikuyu: Waxaan soo xusuustaa Ilaah, markaasaan welwelaa, Waan cawdaa, markaasay naftaydu taag darnaataa. (Selaah)
english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

kikuyu: Indhahaygii waad soo jeedisay, Aad baan u dhibaataysnahay si aanan u hadli karin.
english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

kikuyu: Waxaan ka fikiray wakhtigii hore, Iyo sannadihii waa hore ahaa.
english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

kikuyu: Habeenka waxaan soo xusuustaa gabaygayga, Oo waxaan la sheekaystaa qalbigayga, Oo ruuxaygiina aad buu wax u doondoonay.
english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

kikuyu: Sayidku weligiisba ma i xoorayaa? Oo miyaanu mar dambe raalli iga ahaanaynin?
english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

kikuyu: Naxariistiisii miyey wada dhammaatay weligeedba? Ballankiisiina miyuu baaqanayaa ka ab ka ab?
english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

kikuyu: Ilaah miyuu illoobay inuu ahaado mid raxmad badan? Naxariistiisiina ma isagoo cadhaysan buu xidhay? (Selaah)
english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan idhi, Tanu waa itaaldarradayda, Laakiinse waxaan xusuusan doonaa sannadihii gacanta midig oo Ilaaha ugu sarreeya.
english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

kikuyu: Waxaan ka soo sheekayn doonaa Rabbiga falimihiisa, Waayo, waxaan soo xusuusan doonaa cajaa'ibyadaadii hore.
english: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

kikuyu: Waxaan ka fikiri doonaa shuqulkaaga oo dhan, Oo falimahaaga oo dhanna waan u fiirsan doonaa.
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, jidkaagu wuxuu ku dhex yaal meesha quduuska ah, Ilaahee baa sida Ilaah u weyn?
english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

kikuyu: Waxaad tahay Ilaah cajaa'ibyo sameeya, Xooggaagii waxaad ogeysiisay dadyowga.
english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Gacantaadaad dadkaagii ku soo furatay, Kuwaasoo ah ilma Yacquub iyo Yuusuf. (Selaah)
english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, biyuhu way ku arkeen, Biyuhu way ku arkeen, oo way cabsadeen, Oo moolalkuna way gariireen.
english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

kikuyu: Daruuruhuna biyay soo daayeen, Cirkuna wuxuu diray dhawaaq, Oo weliba fallaadhahaaguna way bexeen.
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

kikuyu: Codkii onkodkaaguna wuxuu ku dhex jiray cirwareenta, Hillaacuna wuxuu iftiimiyey dunida, Dhulkuna wuu gariiray oo wuu ruxmaday.
english: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

kikuyu: Jidkaaguna badduu dhex maray, Waddooyinkaaguna waxay dhex mareen biyo badan, Oo raadadkaagana lama aqoon.
english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

kikuyu: Dadkaaga waxaad u hor kacday sidii adhi oo kale, Oo waxaad iyaga ku hoggaamisay gacanta Muuse iyo tan Haaruun.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Dadkaygiiyow, sharcigayga dhegaysta, Oo dhegahana u dhiga erayada afkayga.
english: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Afkayga waxaan ku furi doonaa masaal, Oo waxaan ku dhawaaqi doonaa xujooyin hore,
english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

kikuyu: Kuwaasoo aynu maqalnay oo aynu niqiin, Oo ay awowayaasheen inoo sheegeen.
english: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

kikuyu: Ka qarin mayno carruurtooda, Laakiin waxaynu farcanka soo socda u sheegaynaa Rabbiga ammaantiisa, Iyo xooggiisa, iyo shuqulladiisii yaabka badnaa oo uu sameeyey.
english: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

kikuyu: Waayo, markhaati buu reer Yacquub ka dhex dhisay, Oo sharci buu reer binu Israa'iil u dejiyey, Kaasoo uu ku amray awowayaasheen, Inay carruurtooda dambe ogeysiiyaan aawadeed,
english: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

kikuyu: Iyo in farcanka soo socdaa ay iyaga ogaadaan, kuwaasoo ah carruurta hadda ka dib dhalanaysa, Kuwaasoo iyana kici doona oo carruurtooda u sheegi doona,
english: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

kikuyu: Inay rajadooda Ilaah ku xidhaan, Oo aanay illoobin Ilaah shuqulladiisii, Laakiinse ay xajiyaan amarradiisa,
english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

kikuyu: Oo aanay sidii awowayaashood oo kale noqon Farcan madax adag oo caasi badan, Kaasoo ah farcan aan qalbigoodu qummanayn, Oo naftooduna aanay xagga Ilaah aamin ku ahayn.
english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

kikuyu: Reer Efrayim iyagoo hub iyo qaansooyin sita Ayay maalintii dagaalka dib u noqdeen.
english: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

kikuyu: Axdigii Ilaah ma ay xajin, Oo waxay diideen inay sharcigiisii ku socdaan,
english: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

kikuyu: Oo waxay illoobeen falimihiisa Iyo shuqulladiisii yaabka badnaa oo uu iyaga tusay.
english: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

kikuyu: Waxyaalo yaab badan ayuu awowayaashood ku hor sameeyey, Markay joogeen dalkii Masar iyo berrinkii Socan.
english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

kikuyu: Isagu badduu kala gooyay, oo iyagii dhex marsiiyey, Oo biyihiina wuxuu ka dhigay inay sidii taallo u taagnaadaan.
english: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

kikuyu: Oo weliba maalinnimadii wuxuu ku hoggaamiyey daruur, Oo habeennimadii oo dhanna wuxuu ku hoggaamiyey dab iftiinkiis.
english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

kikuyu: Wuxuu kala jebiyey dhagaxyadii cidlada, Oo wuxuu iyaga ka siiyey cabniin aad u badan oo ah sidii kan moolka laga helo.
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu dhagaxa weyn ka soo faruuray durdurro, Oo wuxuu biyo u qulquliyey sidii webiyada oo kale.
english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

kikuyu: Laakiinse iyagu weli way ku sii socdeen inay isaga ku dembaabaan, Inay ku caasiyoobaan Ilaaha ugu sarreeya intii ay cidladii joogeen.
english: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Ilaah waxay ku tijaabiyeen qalbigooda Kolkii ay hilib u weyddiisteen damacooda aawadiis.
english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah bay wax ka sheegeen, Oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Ilaah ma miis buu cidlada ku diyaarin karaa?
english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, dhagaxii ayuu wax ku dhuftay, markaasaa biyo ka soo buqdeen Oo durdurraa ka soo buuxdhaafay, Haddaba miyuu kibisna bixin karaa? Miyuu dadkiisa hilib siin karaa?
english: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Rabbigu taas buu maqlay, wuuna cadhooday, Oo reer Yacquub dab baa ku shidmay, Reer binu Israa'iilna cadhaa ku dhacday,
english: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, Ilaah ma ay rumaysan, Oo badbaadintiisana iskuma ay hallayn.
english: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

kikuyu: Laakiin isagu wuxuu amray cirka sare Oo albaabbadii samadana wuu furay;
english: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku soo daayay maanna ay cunaan, Oo wuxuu iyagii wax ka siiyey hadhuudhkii samada.
english: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

kikuyu: Dadkii waxay cuneen kibistii malaa'igaha, Oo weliba wuxuu iyaga u soo diray hilib ay ka dhergaan.
english: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu samada ka kiciyey dabaysha bari, Oo dabaysha koonfureedna xooggiisuu ku hoggaamiyey.
english: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

kikuyu: Oo korkoodana hilib buu ugu soo daadiyey sidii ciidda oo kale, Oo wuxuu ku soo daayay haad baalal leh oo ah sidii cammuudda badaha,
english: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku soo daadiyey xeradooda dhexdeeda, Iyo rugahooda hareerahooda.
english: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed iyagii way cuneen, oo aad bay uga dhergeen, Oo isna wuxuu iyagii siiyey wixii ay u jeellanaayeen.
english: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

kikuyu: Iyagu jeelkii damacooda kama ay xiisa dhicin, Oo cuntadoodii weli afkooday ku jirtay,
english: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

kikuyu: Markii cadhada Ilaah ay iyaga ku dhacday, Oo ay dishay kuwii iyaga ugu buurbuurnaa, Oo ay laysay raggii dhallinyarada ahaa oo reer binu Israa'iil.
english: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

kikuyu: In kastoo waxyaalahaas oo dhammu ay ku dheceen, Weli way sii dembaabeen, Oo mana ay rumaysan shuqulladiisii yaabka badnaa.
english: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed maalmahoodii wuxuu ku dhammeeyey wax aan waxtar lahayn, Cimrigoodiina cabsi.
english: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

kikuyu: Markii uu iyaga laayay ayay isaga dooneen, Oo haddiiba way soo noqdeen oo Ilaah goor hore doondooneen.
english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

kikuyu: Oo waxay xusuusteen in Ilaah ahaa dhagaxoodii weynaa, Iyo in Ilaaha ugu sarreeyaa uu ahaa Bixiyahooda.
english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxay isaga ku faansheen afkooda, Oo carrabkoodana been bay ugu sheegeen.
english: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

kikuyu: Waayo, qalbigoodu xaggiisa kuma hagaagsanayn, Oo axdigiisiina daacad uma ay ahayn.
english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

kikuyu: Laakiinse isagoo raxmad miidhan ah ayuu xumaantoodii cafiyey, oo mana uu baabbi'in iyagii, Haah, oo marar badan ayuu cadhadiisii ka leexiyey, Oo cadhadiisii oo dhanna ma uu wada kicin.
english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu xusuustay inay iyagu yihiin binu-aadmi, Iyo dabayl iska gudubta oo aan mar dambe soo noqon.
english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

kikuyu: Immisa jeer bay isaga ku caasiyoobeen markay cidlada joogeen, Oo immisa jeer bay calool xumeeyeen markay lamadegaanka dhex joogeen!
english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

kikuyu: Oo haddana way soo noqdeen oo waxay tijaabiyeen Ilaah, Oo waxay ka xanaajiyeen reer binu Israa'iil Kooda Quduuska ah.
english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Sooma ay xusuusan gacantiisii, Iyo maalintii uu iyaga ka soo furtay cadowga toona,
english: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

kikuyu: Iyo xataa siduu calaamooyinkiisii Masar ugu dhex sameeyey, Yaababkiisiina berrinkii Socan.
english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

kikuyu: Iyo siduu webiyaashoodii dhiigga ugu beddelay, Durdurradoodiina, si aanay waxba uga cabbi karin.
english: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku soo dhex daayay duqsiyo badan, wayna cuneen, Iyo xataa rahyo, oo iyana way baabbi'iyeen.
english: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wixii u baxay wuxuu siiyey diir, Oo waxay ku hawshoodeenna wuxuu siiyey ayax.
english: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

kikuyu: Geedcanabkoodii wuxuu ku baabbi'iyey roobdhagaxyaale, Oo dhirtoodii darayga ahaydna wuxuu ku baabbi'iyey sayax barafoobay.
english: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

kikuyu: Xoolahoodii wuxuu ku soo daayay roobdhagaxyaalaha, Adhyahoodiina danabyo kulul.
english: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku soo daayay kulaylkii cadhadiisa, Iyo xanaaq, iyo dhirif, iyo dhib, Iyo guuto ah malaa'igo shar ah.
english: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

kikuyu: Isagu cadhadiisii wadduu u sameeyey, Oo naftoodiina dhimasho ugama uu lexejeclaan, Laakiinse noloshoodii wuxuu u daayay belaayada,
english: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dalkii Masar ku laayay curadyadii oo dhan, Kuwaas oo ahaa xooggoodii u horreeyey oo uu ku dhex laayay teendhooyinkii Xaam,
english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

kikuyu: Laakiinse isagu dadkiisii sidii ido oo kale ayuu u hor kacay, Oo cidladuu ku dhex hoggaamiyey iyaga sidii adhi oo kale.
english: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

kikuyu: Oo ammaan buu ku hoggaamiyey, si aanay u baqin, Laakiinse cadaawayaashoodii baddaa qarqisay.
english: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyagii keenay xuduudkii meeshiisa quduuska ah, Iyo ilaa buurtan ay midigtiisu iibsatay.
english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

kikuyu: Oo weliba hortoodana wuxuu ka eryay quruumaha, Oo dhaxal ahaan buu ugu qaybiyey. Oo qabiilooyinkii reer binu Israa'iilna wuxuu dejiyey teendhooyinkoodii.
english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Laakiin way jirrabeen oo ku caasiyoobeen Ilaaha ugu sarreeya, Oo markhaatifurkiisiina ma ay xajin,
english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

kikuyu: Laakiinse dib bay u noqdeen, oo sidii awowayaashood ayay si aan daacad ahayn ula dhaqmeen, Oo iyagu waxay u leexdeen sidii qaanso khiyaano badan.
english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay isaga kaga xanaajiyeen meelahoodii sarsare, Oo waxay isaga uga hinaasiyeen sanamyadooda la qoray.
english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

kikuyu: Ilaah markuu taas maqlay ayuu cadhooday, Oo aad buu reer binu Israa'iil u karhay,
english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed taambuuggii Shiiloh wuu dayriyey, Kaasoo ah teendhadii uu dadka dhex dhigay,
english: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

kikuyu: Oo xooggiisii wuxuu u gacangeliyey maxaabiisnimo, Ammaantiisiina wuxuu ku riday cadowga gacantiisii.
english: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

kikuyu: Dadkiisiina wuxuu u gacangeliyey seef, Oo wuxuu u cadhooday dhaxalkiisii.
english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

kikuyu: Raggoodii dhallinyarada ahaa dab baa laastay, Gabdhahoodiina buraanbur aroos looma tirin.
english: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

kikuyu: Wadaaddadoodii waxay ku dhinteen seef, Carmalladoodiina uma ay barooran.
english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Sayidku wuxuu u kacay sidii mid hurdo ka toosay, Sidii nin xoog badan oo la qaylinaya khamri daraaddiis.
english: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashiisiina wuu ku dhuftay oo dib buu u celiyey, Oo wuxuu saaray ceeb aan weligeed ka hadhayn.
english: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuu diiday teendhadii reer Yuusuf, Qabiilkii reer Efrayimna ma uu dooran,
english: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

kikuyu: Laakiinse wuxuu doortay qabiilkii reer Yahuudah, Iyo Buur Siyoon oo uu jeclaaday.
english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

kikuyu: Oo meeshiisii quduuska ahayd wuxuu u dhisay sidii meelaha sare, Iyo sidii dhulka uu weligiis adkeeyey.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna doortay addoonkiisii Daa'uud, Oo wuxuu isaga ka soo waday xeryaha idaha,
english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

kikuyu: Wuxuu ka soo waday laxihii ilmo nuujinayay oo uu raacayay, Inuu daajiyo reer Yacquub oo dadkiisa ah, iyo reer binu Israa'iil oo dhaxalkiisa ah.
english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

kikuyu: Haddaba wuxuu u daajinayay si waafaqsan daacadnimada qalbigiisa, Oo wuxuu ku hoggaaminayay farsamada gacmihiisa.
english: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, quruumihii kale waxay u soo galeen dhaxalkaagii, Macbudkaagii quduuska ahaana way nijaaseeyeen, Oo Yeruusaalemna waxay ka dhigeen tuulmooyin.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

kikuyu: Meydadkii addoommadaada waxay cunto uga dhigeen haadka samada, Oo hilibkii quduusiintaadana waxay cunto uga dhigeen dugaagga dhulka.
english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: Dhiiggoodiina waxay Yeruusaalem hareeraheeda ugu daadiyeen sidii biyo oo kale, Cid aastaana ma jirin.
english: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

kikuyu: Waxaannu cay u noqonnay derisyadayadii, Kuwa nagu wareegsanna wax la quudhsado oo lagu qoslo.
english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ilaa goormaad noo cadhaysnaan doontaa? Ma weligaa baa? Masayrkaagu ma sida dab buu u ololi doonaa?
english: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

kikuyu: Cadhadaada ku soo deji quruumaha aan ku aqoon, Iyo boqortooyooyinka aan magacaaga kugu baryin.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay laayeen reer Yacquub, Rugtoodiina way baabbi'iyeen.
english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

kikuyu: Ha noo xusuusnaan dembiyadii awowayaashayo, Naxariistaadu dhaqsiyo ha noogu timaado, Waayo, aad baa lanoo dhibay.
english: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

kikuyu: Ilaaha badbaadadayadow, magacaaga ammaantiisa daraaddeed noo caawi, Oo magacaaga daraaddiis noo samatabbixi, oo dembiyadayada naga nadiifi.
english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

kikuyu: Bal maxaa quruumuhu u leeyihiin, Ilaahoodu meeh? Dhiiggii addoommadaada oo ay daadiyeen aargoosashadiisii Ha lagu ogaado quruumaha dhexdooda annagoo arkayna.
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

kikuyu: Maxbuuska taahiisu hortaada ha yimaado, Xooggaaga weynaantiisa ku badbaadi kuwa dhimashada lagu xukumay.
english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

kikuyu: Sayidow, derisyadayada toddoba jibbaar ugu abaalmari, Oo laabta u geli caydii ay kugu caayeen.
english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

kikuyu: Haddaba annagoo ah dadkaaga iyo idihii daaqsintaada Waannu kugu mahadnaqaynaa weligayo, Oo ammaantaada waannu ka sheekaysan doonnaa tan iyo ka ab ka ab.
english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

kikuyu: Na maqal, Adhijirka reer binu Israa'iil jirow, Kaaga reer Yuusuf sida adhi u hor kacow, Kaaga Keruubiimta ku dul fadhiyow, soo iftiin.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

kikuyu: Reer Efrayim iyo reer Benyaamiin iyo reer Manaseh hortooda xooggaaga ku kici, Oo kaalay oo na badbaadi.
english: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

kikuyu: Ilaahow, mar kale na soo celi, Oo wejigaaga noo iftiimi, oo waannu badbaadi doonnaa.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow Ilaaha ciidammadow, Ilaa goormaad u cadhaysnaan doontaa baryootanka dadkaaga?
english: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

kikuyu: Waxaad ku quudisay kibistii ilmada, Oo ilmo aad u badanna ayaad cabsiisay.
english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

kikuyu: Waxaad nala dirirsiisay derisyadayada, Oo cadaawayaashayadiina way nagu qoslaan.
english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

kikuyu: Ilaaha ciidammadow, mar kale na soo celi, Oo wejigaaga noo iftiimi, oo waannu badbaadi doonnaa.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Geed canab ah ayaad dalkii Masar ka keentay, Oo intaad quruumihii ka eriday ayaad meel ku beertay.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

kikuyu: Meel baad hortiisa ku diyaarisay, Oo wuxuu yeeshay xididdo dhaadheer, kolkaasuu dhulkii buuxiyey.
english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

kikuyu: Oo buurihii waxaa qariyey hooskiisii, Oo laamihiisiina waxay noqdeen sidii geedaha la yidhaahdo kedar oo Ilaah.
english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

kikuyu: Laamihiisii wuxuu gaadhsiiyey tan iyo badda, Dhudihiisiina waxay gaadheen tan iyo Webiga.
english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

kikuyu: Bal maxaad deyrkiisii u dumisay Si ay kuwa jidka maraa oo dhammu u goostaan?
english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

kikuyu: Waxaa kharriba doofaarka kaynta, Oo waxaa iska daaqda ugaadha duurka.
english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

kikuyu: Ilaaha ciidammadow, waannu ku baryaynaaye noo soo noqo, Samada hoos nooga soo fiiri oo intaad soo eegtid, geedkan canabka ah soo booqo,
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

kikuyu: Oo ilaali wixii ay gacantaada midig beertay, Iyo laantii aad adkaysatay.
english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

kikuyu: Dab baa lagu gubay, oo waa la gooyay, Oo waxay ku halligmeen canaantii jaahaaga.
english: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

kikuyu: Gacantaadu ha kor saarnaato ninka gacantaada midig jooga, Iyo binu-aadmigii aad nafsaddaada u xoogaysatay.
english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

kikuyu: Markaas dib kaaga noqon mayno, Na noolee, oo markaasaannu magacaaga ku baryootamaynaa.
english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow Ilaaha ciidammadow, mar kale na soo celi, Oo wejigaaga noo iftiimi, oo waannu badbaadi doonnaa.
english: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Aad ugu gabya Ilaaha xooggeenna ah, Oo farxad ugu qayliya Ilaaha Yacquub.
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

kikuyu: Sabuurka kor u qaada, oo waxaad halkan keentaan dafka, Iyo kataaradda lagu farxo, iyo shareeradda.
english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

kikuyu: Buunka afuufa markay bishu dhalato, Iyo markuu dayaxu caddo buuxda yahay, iyo maalinta iiddeenna quduuska ah.
english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

kikuyu: Waayo, taasu qaynuun bay u tahay reer binu Israa'iil, Waana amar ka yimid Ilaaha Yacquub.
english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu reer Yuusuf dhexdooda ka dhigay markhaati, Markii uu dalkii Masar ku soo baxay, Halkaas oo aan ka maqlay af aanan aqoon.
english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Garbihiisa waxaan ka qaaday culaabtii saarnayd, Gacmihiisana waxaa laga xoreeyey dambiishii.
english: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

kikuyu: Waad ii dhawaaqatay markii dhib kuu yimid, oo anna waan ku soo samatabbixiyey, Waxaan kaaga jawaabay onkodka meeshiisa qarsoon, Oo waxaan kugu tijaabiyey biyihii Meriibaah. (Selaah)
english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

kikuyu: Dadkaygiiyow, bal i maqla, Oo anna waan idiin digi doonaa, Reer binu Israa'iilow, bal haddaad i maqli lahaydeen!
english: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

kikuyu: Waa inaan ilaah qalaad idinku dhex jirin, Oo waa inaydaan innaba ilaah qalaad caabudin.
english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah, Oo kaa soo bixiyey dalkii Masar, Afkaaga aad u kala qaad, oo anna waan buuxin doonaa.
english: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

kikuyu: Laakiinse dadkaygii ma ay dhegaysan codkaygii, Oo reer binu Israa'iilna ima aqbalin.
english: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaan u daayay inay ku socdaan madaxadayggooda. Si ay taladooda ugu socdaan.
english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

kikuyu: Bal may dadkaygu i dhegaystaan, Oo reer binu Israa'iil bal may jidkayga ku socdaan!
english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

kikuyu: Oo waxaan haddiiba jebin lahaa cadaawayaashooda, Oo gacantaydana waan ku jeedin lahaa colkooda.
english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

kikuyu: Kuwa Rabbiga necebu waxay hoos geli lahaayeen isaga, Laakiinse wakhtigoodu weligiis wuu waari lahaa.
english: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu iyaga ku quudin lahaa sarreenka ugu wanaagsan, Oo waxaan ka dhergin lahaa malabka dhagaxa ka soo baxa.
english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu dhex istaagaa ururka Ilaah, Oo wuxuu wax ku xukumaa ilaahyada dhexdooda,
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

kikuyu: Ilaa goormaad xaqdarro wax ku xukumaysaan? Oo ilaa goormaad kuwa sharka leh u eexanaysaan? (Selaah)
english: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

kikuyu: Miskiinka iyo agoonka gar siiya, Oo caddaalad ugu garsoora kan dhibaataysan iyo saboolka.
english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

kikuyu: Badbaadiya miskiinka iyo kan baahan, Oo ka samatabbixiya gacanta kuwa sharka leh.
english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

kikuyu: Iyagu waxba ma yaqaaniin, waxna garan maayaan, Oo gudcur bay hor iyo dib ugu socdaan, Dhulka aasaaskiisii oo dhammu waa wada dhaqdhaqaaqay.
english: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

kikuyu: Waxaan idhi, Idinku waxaad tihiin ilaahyo, Oo dhammaantiin waxaad tihiin Ilaaha uga sarreeya wiilashiisii.
english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee waxaad u dhiman doontaan sida dadka oo kale, Oo waxaad u dhici doontaan sida amiirrada midkood.
english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

kikuyu: Ilaahow, sara joogso oo dhulka xukun, Waayo, waxaad dhaxli doontaa quruumaha oo dhan.
english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, shib ha odhan, Oo ha aamusin, afkana ha haysan, Ilaahow.
english: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eeg, cadaawayaashaadu way buuqaan, Oo kuwii ku nebcaana madaxay kor u qaadeen.
english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

kikuyu: Dadkaagay xeelad ugu tashadaan, Oo waxay dhammaantood u arrinsadaan kuwaad qarisay.
english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

kikuyu: Waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Kaalaya, aan baabbi'innee, yaanay mar dambe quruun ahaanine. Si aan magaca Israa'iil dib loogu soo xusuusan.
english: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagoo isku waafaqsan ayay ku arrinsadeen, Oo axdi kaa gees ah ayay isla dhigtaan,
english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

kikuyu: Teendhooyinkii reer Edom iyo reer Ismaaciil, Iyo reer Moo'aab iyo reer Hagariim,
english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

kikuyu: Reer Gebal iyo reer Cammoon iyo reer Camaaleq, Reer Falastiin iyo kuwii Turos degganaa,
english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

kikuyu: Oo xataa reer Ashuurna way ku darsameen, Oo waxay kaalmeeyeen ilma Luud. (Selaah)
english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

kikuyu: Iyaga ku samee wixii aad ku samaysay reer Midyaan, Iyo Siiseraa iyo Yaabiin markii ay ag joogeen Webi Qiishoon,
english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

kikuyu: Waxay ku halligmeen Ceyn Door, Oo waxay dhulka u noqdeen digo.
english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

kikuyu: Nimankooda gobta ah oo dhan waxaad ka dhigtaa sida Cooreeb iyo Se'eeb, Oo amiirradooda oo dhanna sida Sebah iyo Salmunnac,
english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo isyidhi, War aan iska qaadanno oo hantinno Ilaah degmooyinkiisa.
english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, iyaga ka dhig sida boodhka warwareega, Iyo sida xaab dabaysha ka horreeya,
english: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

kikuyu: Sida dabka duurka guba, Iyo sida ololka buuraha huriya,
english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

kikuyu: Sidaasoo kale iyaga duufaankaaga ku eri, Hufadaadana ku cabsii.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, wejigoodu wareer ha ka buuxsamo, Si ay magacaaga u doondoonaan.
english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

kikuyu: Weligood ha ceeboobeen, hana baqeen, Ha wareereen, hana baabbe'een,
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

kikuyu: Si ay u ogaadaan in adigoo magacaagu Ilaah yahay Aad tahay Ilaaha ugu sarreeya dunida oo dhan.
english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadow, taambuugyadaadu sidee bay u yihiin wax la jeclaado!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay u xiisaysan tahay Rabbiga barxadihiisa, Qalbigayga iyo jiidhkayguba waxay u dhawaaqaan Ilaaha nool.
english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

kikuyu: Haah, shimbirtu waxay nafsaddeeda u heshay guri, Dabafallaadhuna buul ay yaryarkeeda ku dhasho, Kaas oo ah meelaha allabarigaaga, Rabbiga ciidammadow, Boqorkaygiiyow, Ilaahaygiiyow.
english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa gurigaaga deggan, Weligoodba way ku sii ammaani doonaan.
english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninkii xooggiisu xaggaaga ka yimaado, Oo ay jidadka sare oo Siyoon qalbigiisa ku jiraan.
english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

kikuyu: Markay dhex maraan Dooxadii Oohinta waxay ka dhigaan meel ilo badan leh, Haah, oo roobka hore ayaa barakooyin ka buuxiya.
english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

kikuyu: Way xoogaystaan, oo weliba way sii xoogaystaan, Oo midkood kastaaba Ilaah buu ka hor muuqdaa Siyoon dhexdeeda.
english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammadow, baryadayda maqal, Ilaaha Yacquubow, bal dhegta ii dhig, (Selaah)
english: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, gaashaankayagiiyow, bal eeg, Oo bal kaaga la subkay wejigiisa fiiri.
english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

kikuyu: Waayo, maalin barxadahaaga la joogo way ka sii wanaagsan tahay kun maalmood oo kale. Intaan teendhooyinka sharka joogi lahaa, Waxaan ka sii jeclaan lahaa inaan guriga Ilaah iridjooge u ahaado.
english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga Ilaaha ahu waxa weeye qorrax iyo gaashaan, Rabbigu wax wanaagsan kalama hadhi doono kuwa si qumman u socda. Wuxuuna siin doonaa naxariis iyo sharaf.
english: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadow, Waxaa barakaysan ninkii isku kaa halleeya.
english: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, dalkaagii waad u roonaatay, Oo waxaad soo celisay maxaabiistii reer Yacquub.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

kikuyu: Xumaantii dadkaagana waad cafiday, Oo dembigoodii oo dhanna waad qarisay. (Selaah)
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Cadhadaadii oo dhan waad fogaysay, Oo waad ka soo noqotay kulaylkii xanaaqaaga.
english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

kikuyu: Ilaaha Badbaadadayadow, na soo celi, Oo dhirifkaaga naga jooji.
english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

kikuyu: Miyaad weligaaba noo cadhaysnaanaysaa? Oo xanaaqaaga miyaad sii dheeraynaysaa tan iyo ka ab ka ab?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

kikuyu: Miyaanad mar dambe na soo noolaynayn, Si ay dadkaagu kuugu reyreeyaan?
english: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, naxariistaada na tus, Oo badbaadadaada na sii.
english: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.

kikuyu: Waan maqli doonaa waxa Ilaaha Rabbiga ahu ku hadlo, Waayo, nabad buu kula hadli doonaa dadkiisa iyo quduusiintiisa, Laakiin yaanay nacasnimo ku noqon.
english: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

kikuyu: Hubaal badbaadadiisu way u dhow dahay kuwa isaga ka cabsada, Si ay ammaanu dalkayaga u degganaato.
english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

kikuyu: Naxariis iyo runu way isla kulmeen, Xaqnimo iyo nabaduna way isdhunkadeen.
english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

kikuyu: Runtu waxay ka soo baxdaa dhulka, Xaqnimaduna waxay hoos ka soo fiirisaa samada.
english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

kikuyu: Haah, Rabbigu wuxuu ina siin doonaa waxa wanaagsan, Oo dalkeennuna wuxuu soo bixin doonaa midhihiisa.
english: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

kikuyu: Hortiisa waxaa socon doonta xaqnimo, Oo waxay tallaabooyinkiisa ka dhigi doontaa jid la maro.
english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, dhegtaada ii soo dhig, oo ii jawaab, Waayo, waxaan ahay miskiin iyo mid baahane.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

kikuyu: Naftayda dhawr, waayo, waxaan ahay mid cibaado leh, Ilaahayow, i badbaadi anigoo ah addoonkaaga isku kaa halleeya.
english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Sayidow, ii naxariiso, Waayo, maalinta oo dhan adaan kuu qayshadaa.
english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

kikuyu: Sayidow, addoonkaaga naftiisa ka farxi, Waayo, naftayda adigaan kor kuugu soo qaadaa.
english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Waayo, Sayidow, waad wanaagsan tahay, oo waxaad diyaar u tahay inaad dembidhaafto, Waanad u naxariis badan tahay kuwa ku barya oo dhan.
english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, baryadayda dhegta u dhig, Oo codka baryootankayga maqal.
english: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Maalinta aan dhibaataysnahay adaan ku baryi doonaa, Waayo, waad ii jawaabi doontaa.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

kikuyu: Sayidow, adigoo kale ilaahyada kuma jiro, Oo shuqulladaadana wax la mid ahu ma jiraan.
english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

kikuyu: Sayidow, quruumihii aad samaysay oo dhammu way iman doonaan oo hortaaday ku sujuudi doonaan, Waxay ammaani doonaan magacaaga.
english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

kikuyu: Waayo, adigu waad weyn tahay, oo waxyaalo yaab badanna waad samaysaa, Oo adiga keliya ayaa Ilaah ah.
english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, jidkaaga i bar, oo anna runtaadaan ku socon doonaa, Qalbigayga mid ka dhig si aan magacaaga uga cabsado.
english: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

kikuyu: Sayidow Ilaahayow, qalbigayga oo dhan waan kugu ammaanayaa, Oo weligayba waxaan ammaani doonaa magacaaga.
english: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

kikuyu: Waayo, naxariistaadu xaggayga way ku weyn tahay, Naftaydana waxaad ka soo samatabbixisay She'oolka ugu hooseeya.
english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, kuwa kibirka lahu way igu keceen, Ururka dadka dulmiga badanna waxay doonayeen inay nafta iga qaadaan, Oo adigana kuuma ay soo jeesan.
english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu Sayidow, waxaad tahay Ilaah ay raxmad iyo nimco ka buuxaan, Oo cadhada u gaabiya, oo naxariis iyo runba badan.
english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

kikuyu: Ii soo jeeso, oo ii naxariiso, Oo anoo addoonkaaga ah xoog i sii, Oo i badbaadi anoo wiilka addoontaada ah.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

kikuyu: Calaamad wanaaggaaga lagu garto i tus, Si ay kuwa i necebu u arkaan, oo ay u ceeboobaan, Maxaa yeelay, Rabbiyow, waad i caawisay, oo waad i qalbi qaboojisay.
english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.

kikuyu: Aasaaskiisu wuxuu ku jiraa buuraha quduuska ah.
english: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

kikuyu: Rabbigu degmooyinka reer Yacquub oo dhan Wuxuu ka jecel yahay irdaha Siyoon.
english: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

kikuyu: Magaalada Ilaahay, Waxyaalo ammaan badan ayaa lagaa sheegaa. (Selaah)
english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
