kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ka sheekayn doonaa Rahab iyo Baabuloon sidii kuwo i yaqaan, Bal eeg, Falastiin, iyo Turos, iyo Itoobiya. Midkanu halkaasuu ku dhashay.
english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

kikuyu: Haah, oo Siyoonna waxaa laga odhan doonaa, Midkan iyo midkaasuba iyaduu ku dhashay, Oo Ilaaha ugu sarreeya ayaa iyada dhisi doona.
english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuu tirin doonaa markuu dadka qorayo, Midkanu halkaasuu ku dhashay. (Selaah)
english: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

kikuyu: Kuwa gabya iyo kuwa cayaaraaba waxay odhan doonaan, Waxaa kugu jira ilahayga oo dhan.
english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaaha badbaadadaydow, Habeen iyo maalinba hortaadaan ka qayliyey,
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

kikuyu: Baryootankaygu hortaada ha yimaado, Oo qayladayda dhegta u dhig,
english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

kikuyu: Waayo, naftayda waxaa ka buuxa dhibaatooyin, Oo noloshayduna waxay ku dhowaanaysaa She'ool.
english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

kikuyu: Waxaa laygu tiiriyey kuwa hoos ugu dhaadhaca yamayska, Oo waxaan ahay sida nin aan xoog lahayn,
english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

kikuyu: Oo meydadka lagu dhex tuuray, Sida kuwa la laayay oo xabaalaha yaal, Oo aanad mar dambe soo xusuusnayn, Kuwaas oo ah kuwa gacantaada ka go'ay.
english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

kikuyu: Waxaad igu ridday yamayska ugu hooseeya, Iyo gudcurka, iyo meelaha dhaadheer.
english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

kikuyu: Cadhadaadii baa igu soo degtay, Oo waxaad igu dhibtay hirarkaagii oo dhan. (Selaah)
english: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

kikuyu: Kuwii aan iqiin waad iga fogaysay, Oo karaahiyaad iga dhigtay xaggooda. Waa lay xidhay, oo sooma aan bixi karo.
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

kikuyu: Indhahaygu waxay la gudheen dhibaatada daraaddeed, Rabbiyow, maalin kasta waan kuu yeedhay, Oo gacmahaygana adigaan kuu hoorsaday.
english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

kikuyu: Ma yaabab baad tusaysaa meydadka? Kuwii dhintay miyey soo sara kacayaan oo ku ammaanayaan? (Selaah)
english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

kikuyu: Raxmaddaada miyaa qabriga lagu sheegayaa? Aaminnimadaadana miyaa halligaadda laga dhex sheegayaa?
english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

kikuyu: Yaababkaaga miyaa gudcurka lagu ogaanayaa? Xaqnimadaadana ma waxaa lagu ogaanayaa dalka illoobidda?
english: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbiyow, adigaan kuu qayshaday, Oo baryootankayguna subaxduu hortaada imanayaa.
english: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, bal maxaad naftayda u xooraysaa? Oo bal maxaad wejigaaga iiga qarinaysaa?
english: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

kikuyu: Waan dhibaataysnaa oo waxaan ku dhowaa inaan dhinto tan iyo yaraantaydiiba, Intaad cabsidaada igu riddayna waan caataysnaa.
english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

kikuyu: Cadhadaadii kululayd ayaa i kor martay, Oo waxaa i baabbi'iyey waxyaalihii aad igu cabsiisay.
english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

kikuyu: Maalintii oo dhan waxay hareerahayga ugu wareegsanaayeen sidii biyo oo kale, Dhammaantood way i wada hareereeyeen.
english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

kikuyu: Kii i jeclaa iyo saaxiibkayba waad iga fogaysay, Oo kuwii aan iqiinna gudcur baad iga gelisay.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

kikuyu: Anigu weligayba waxaan ku gabyi doonaa Rabbiga waxyaalihiisa naxariista leh, Oo aaminnimadaadana afkaygaan ka ab ka ab ku ogeysiinayaa.
english: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idhi, Naxariistu weligeedba way dhisnaan doontaa, Oo aaminnimadaadana waxaad ku adkayn doontaa samooyinka qudhooda.
english: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

kikuyu: Axdi baan la dhigtay kii aan doortay, Oo waxaan u dhaartay addoonkaygii Daa'uud, oo ku idhi,
english: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

kikuyu: Farcankaaga weligayba waan sii adkayn doonaa, Oo carshigaaguna wuu dhisnaan doonaa tan iyo ka ab ka ab. (Selaah)
english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, samooyinku waxay ammaani doonaan yaababkaaga, Oo weliba aaminnimadaadana waxaa laga dhex sheegi doonaa shirka kuwa quduuska ah.
english: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal yaa cirka ku jira oo Rabbiga lala simi karaa? Bal yaase ku dhex jira wiilasha kuwa xoogga badan oo Rabbiga la mid ah,
english: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

kikuyu: Kaas oo ah Ilaaha ugu cabsida badan guddiga kuwa quduuska ah, Oo waajibka tahay in kuwa hareerihiisa ku wareegsan oo dhammu ay ka cabsadaan.
english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

kikuyu: Rabbiyow Ilaaha ciidammadow, Bal yaa sidaada u xoog badan, Rabbiyow? Aaminnimadaadu hareerahaagay ku wareegsan tahay.
english: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

kikuyu: Adigaa u taliya badda kibirkeeda, Oo markii hirarkeedu kacaan adigaa dejiya.
english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

kikuyu: Rahab waxaad u kala burburisay sidii mid la dilay, Oo cadaawayaashaadiina waxaad ku kala firdhisay gacanta xooggaaga.
english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

kikuyu: Samooyinka adigaa iska leh, dhulkana adigaa iska leh, Dunida iyo waxaa ka buuxana adigaa aasaasay.
english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

kikuyu: Woqooyi iyo koonfurba adigaa abuuray, Taaboor iyo Xermoonba magacaagay ku reyreeyaan.
english: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

kikuyu: Adigu waxaad leedahay dhudhun itaal weyn, Gacantaaduna way xoog badan tahay, midigtaaduna way sarraysaa.
english: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

kikuyu: Carshigaaga aasaaskiisu waxa weeye xaq iyo caddaalad, Oo naxariista iyo runtuna way ku hor socdaan.
english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan dadka yaqaan dhawaaqa farxadda leh, Rabbiyow, waxay ku socdaan wejigaaga iftiinkiisa,
english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

kikuyu: Maalinta oo dhan waxay ku reyreeyaan magacaaga, Oo waxay ku sara marayaan xaqnimadaada.
english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad tahay ammaantii xooggooda, Oo raallinimadaada daraaddeed ayaa geeskayaga kor loogu sarraysiin doonaa.
english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

kikuyu: Waayo, gaashaankayaga waxaa iska leh Rabbiga, Oo boqorkayagana waxaa iska leh Kan quduuska ah oo reer binu Israa'iil.
english: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaas quduusiintaada waxaad kula hadashay muuqasho, Oo waxaad ku tidhi, Waxaan caawimaad kor saaray mid xoog badan, Oo waxaan sarraysiiyey mid dadka laga doortay.
english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

kikuyu: Waxaan helay addoonkaygii Daa'uud ahaa, Oo waxaan ku subkay saliiddaydii quduuska ahayd,
english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

kikuyu: Oo gacantaydu isagay la jiri doontaa, Dhudhunkayguna isaguu xoogayn doonaa.
english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

kikuyu: Cadowgu ma dulmi doono, Wiilka sharnimaduna ma dhibi doono.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

kikuyu: Oo cadaawayaashiisa hortiisaan ku wada burburin doonaa, Oo kuwa isaga necebna waan layn doonaa.
english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

kikuyu: Laakiinse aaminnimadayda iyo naxariistaydu isagay la jiri doonaan, Oo geeskiisana waxaa lagu sarraysiin doonaa magacayga.
english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

kikuyu: Oo weliba gacantiisa waxaan ka sarraysiin doonaa badda, Midigtiisana webiyaasha.
english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

kikuyu: Aniguu ii qayshan doonaa, oo wuxuu odhan doonaa, Adigu waxaad tahay aabbahay, Iyo Ilaahay, iyo dhagaxii weynaa oo badbaadadayda.
english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan isaga ka dhigi doonaa curadkayga, Oo wuxuu ahaan doonaa boqorrada dunida kan ugu wada sarreeya.
english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

kikuyu: Weligayba waxaan isaga u hayn doonaa naxariistayda, Oo axdigayguna isaguu ku sii adkaan doona.
english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

kikuyu: Oo weliba farcankiisana waxaan ka dhigi doonaa mid weligiis waara, Carshigiisana sida wakhtiga samada.
english: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

kikuyu: Carruurtiisu hadday sharcigayga ka tagaan, Oo aanay ku socon xukummadayda,
english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

kikuyu: Hadday qaynuunnadayda jebiyaan, Oo aanay amarradayda dhawrin,
english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

kikuyu: Markaas xadgudubkooda waxaan kaga abaalmarin doonaa ul, Xumaantoodana jeedal.
english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

kikuyu: Laakiinse naxariistayda oo dhan kama wada qaadi doono, Aaminnimadayduna inay isaga gabto uma oggolaan doono.
english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

kikuyu: Axdigayga ma jebin doono, Oo wixii afkayga ka soo baxayna ma beddeli doono.
english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

kikuyu: Mar baan waxaan ku dhaartay quduusnimadayda, Oo Daa'uud been uma sheegi doono,
english: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

kikuyu: Farcankiisu weligiisuu waari doonaa, Carshigiisuna wuxuu u waari doonaa sida qorraxda hortayda ka ifaysa.
english: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu weligiisba u sii jiri doonaa sida dayaxa, Iyo sida markhaatiga daacadda ah oo cirka jooga. (Selaah)
english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu waad xoortay oo waad nacday, Oo waxaad u cadhootay kaaga subkan.
english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

kikuyu: Axdigii addoonkaaga waad nacday, Oo taajkiisiina waad nijaasaysay oo dhulka ku tuurtay.
english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

kikuyu: Deyrarkiisii oo dhan waad dumisay, Oo qalcadihiisii oo dhanna waad burburisay.
english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

kikuyu: Wax alla wixii jidka soo mara oo dhanba isagay dhacaan, Oo derisyadiisana wuxuu u noqday cay.
english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

kikuyu: Waxaad kor u qaadday midigtii kuwii dulmayay, Cadaawayaashiisii oo dhanna waad ka farxisay.
english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

kikuyu: Oo weliba afka seeftiisana dib baad u celisaa, Isagiina kama aad dhigin inuu dagaalka ku sii adkaysto.
english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

kikuyu: Iftiinkiisii waad demisay, Carshigiisiina dhulkaad ku tuurtay.
english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

kikuyu: Cimrigii dhallinyaranimadiisii waad soo gaabisay, Oo waxaad isagii ka muujisay ceeb. (Selaah)
english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ilaa goormaad isqarin doontaa? Ma weligaa baa? Oo ilaa goormay cadhadaadu sida dab u ololi doontaa?
english: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

kikuyu: Bal xusuuso sida wakhtigaygu u gaaban yahay, Waayo, sidaad binu-aadmiga oo dhan u abuurtay micnedarnaa!
english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

kikuyu: Bal waa ninkee kan iska noolaan doona isagoo aan dhimasho arkin, Oo naftiisa ka samatabbixin doona xoogga She'ool? (Selaah)
english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

kikuyu: Sayidow, meeday naxariistaadii hore, Oo aad Daa'uud aaminnimadaada ugu dhaaratay?
english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

kikuyu: Sayidow, bal soo xusuuso cayda addoommadaada, Iyo sida aan laabta ugu sido cayda dadka badan oo dhan,
english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waana tii ay cadaawayaashaadu igu caayeen, Oo waa tii ay ku caayeen tallaabooyinka kaaga subkan.
english: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

kikuyu: Mahad waxaa leh Rabbiga tan iyo weligiisba. Aamiin, iyo aamiin.
english: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, tan iyo ka ab ka ab Adigu waxaad noo ahayd meesha aannu degganaanno.
english: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

kikuyu: Intaan buuruhu dhalan ka hor, Iyo intaanad samayn dhulka iyo dunida, Iyo xataa weligeed iyo weligeedba adigu waxaad tahay Ilaah.
english: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

kikuyu: Dadka waxaad ku soo celisaa baabba', Oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Noqda, binu-aadmigow.
english: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

kikuyu: Waayo, kun sannadood waxay hortaada ku yihiin Sida shalay oo kale markay dhammaadaan. Oo waxay la mid yihiin sida wakhti la soo jeedo oo habeennimo.
english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

kikuyu: Waxaad iyaga u qaaddaa sida daadku wax u qaado, oo iyagu waxa weeye sida hurdo oo kale, Oo subaxdana waxay u baxaan sida doog oo kale.
english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

kikuyu: Subaxda way cagaaraan, wayna soo baxaan, Oo fiidkana waa la jaraa, wayna engegaan.
english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

kikuyu: Waayo, annagu cadhadaadii baannu ku baabba'nay, Oo waxaan ku dhibtoonnay xanaaqaagii.
english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

kikuyu: Xumaatooyinkayagii waxaad dhigtay hortaada, Oo dembiyadayadii qarsoonaana waxaad dhigtay iftiinka wejigaaga.
english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

kikuyu: Waayo, maalmahayagii oo dhammu waxay nagu dhaafeen cadhadaada, Oo cimrigayagiina wuxuu u dhammaaday sidii sheeko la sheegay.
english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

kikuyu: Waayo, wakhtiga cimrigayagu waxa weeye toddobaatan sannadood, Oo xataa hadduu xoog aawadiis ku sii dheeraado waa siddeetan sannadood, Laakiinse faankiisu waa hawl iyo caloolxumo miidhan, Waayo, haddiiba wuu iska dhammaadaa, oo annana waannu duulnaa.
english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

kikuyu: Bal yaa yaqaan cadhadaada xooggeeda, Iyo xanaaqaaga kaas oo waafaqsan cabsida kugu habboon in lagaa cabsado?
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

kikuyu: Haddaba na bar inaannu tirinno maalmaha cimrigayaga, Si aannu u helno qalbi xigmad leh.
english: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, soo noqo, ilaa goormaad soo noqonaysaa? Oo raalli ka ahow addoommadaada.
english: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

kikuyu: Aroorta naxariistaada naga dhergi, Si aannu u rayrayno oo aannu u faraxsanaano maalmaha cimrigayaga oo dhan.
english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

kikuyu: Nooga farxi intii ay ahaayeen maalmihii aad na dhibtay, Iyo sannadihii aan sharka aragnay in le'eg.
english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

kikuyu: Shuqulkaagu ha u muuqdo addoommadaada, Ammaantaaduna carruurtooda.
english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga Ilaahayaga ah nicmadiisu ha na dul joogto, Oo korkayaga ku adkee shuqulka gacmahayaga, Haah, shuqulka gacmahayaga adkee.
english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

kikuyu: Kan dega Ilaaha ugu sarreeya meeshiisa qarsoon Wuxuu joogi doonaa hooska Qaadirka.
english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Waxaan Rabbiga ka odhan doonaa, Isagu waa magangalkayga iyo qalcaddayda Oo waa Ilaahayga aan isku halleeyo.
english: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu kaa samatabbixin doonaa dabinka ugaadhsadaha, Iyo belaayada aad u xun.
english: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu kugu dedi doonaa baalashiisa, Oo waxaad magangeli doontaa baadadkiisa, Runtiisuna waxay tahay gaashaan iyo gabbaad.
english: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

kikuyu: Waa inaanad ka cabsan naxdinta habeennimada, Iyo fallaadha dharaarnimada duulaysa toona,
english: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

kikuyu: Ama belaayada gudcurka ku socota, Iyo halligaadda duhurka wax baabbi'isa.
english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

kikuyu: Dhinacaaga waxaa ku dhici doona kun, Midigtaadana waxaa ku ag dhici doona toban kun, Innabase kuuma soo dhowaan doonto.
english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

kikuyu: Laakiinse indhaha uun baad ku fiirin doontaa, Oo waxaad arki doontaa kuwa sharka leh abaalgudkooda.
english: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad tidhi, Rabbigu waa magangalkayga, Oo Kan ugu sarreeya ayaa degmadayda ah.
english: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

kikuyu: Shar kuguma dhici doono, Belaayona teendhadaada uma soo dhowaan doonto.
english: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu malaa'igihiisa ku amri doonaa Inay jidadkaaga oo dhan kugu ilaaliyaan.
english: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

kikuyu: Oo iyaguna gacmahooday sare kuugu qaban doonaan Inaanay cagtaadu dhagax ku dhicin.
english: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

kikuyu: Libaaxa iyo jilbiska ayaad ku joogsan doontaa, Oo waxaad ku tuman doontaa aaran libaax iyo abeesada.
english: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi, Isagu aad buu ii jeclaaday, oo sidaas daraaddeed ayaan u samatabbixin doonaa, Meel sare ayaan ku fadhiisin doonaa, maxaa yeelay, magacayguu yiqiin.
english: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

kikuyu: Wuu i baryi doonaa, oo waan u jawaabi doonaa, Oo markuu dhibaataysan yahay, waan la jiri doonaa, Oo waan samatabbixin doonaa, waanan murwayn doonaa.
english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

kikuyu: Cimri dheer ayaan ka dhergin doonaa, Oo waxaan tusi doonaa badbaadintayda.
english: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

kikuyu: Waa wanaagsan tahay in Rabbiga lagu mahadnaqo, Iyo in magacaaga ammaan loogu gabyo, Ilaaha ugu sarreeyow,
english: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

kikuyu: Iyo in raxmaddaada aroorta la muujiyo, Habeen kastana aaminnimadaada,
english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

kikuyu: Iyo in loogu heeso alaabta muusikada oo tobanka xadhig leh, iyo shareeradda, Iyo dhawaaqa kataaradda.
english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiyow, waxaad igaga farxisay shuqulkaagii, Oo shuqullada gacmahaagana waan ku guulaysan doonaa.
english: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, shuqulladaadu waaweynaa! Oo fikirradaaduna aad bay u mool dheer yihiin.
english: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.

kikuyu: Doqonku taas ma yaqaan, Kii nacas ahuna ma garan karo.
english: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu markii ay sida doog u soo baxaan, Iyo markii xumaanfalayaasha oo dhammu ay barwaaqoobaan, Waa in weligoodba la baabbi'iyo,
english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbiyow, adigu waad sarraysaa weligaa iyo weligaaba.
english: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiyow, bal eeg cadaawayaashaada, Bal eeg, cadaawayaashaadu way wada baabbi'i doonaane, Oo xumaanfalayaasha oo dhammuna way kala firidhsanaan doonaan.
english: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

kikuyu: Laakiinse geeskayga waxaad u sarraysiisay sida geeska gisiga Oo waxaa laygu subkay saliid cusub.
english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

kikuyu: Indhahayguna waxay arkeen wixii aan cadaawayaashayda la jeclaa, Oo dhegahayguna waxay maqleen wixii aan la jeclaa sharfalayaasha igu kaca.
english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ahu wuxuu u barwaaqoobi doonaa sida geed timireed, Oo wuxuu u bixi doonaa sida geed kedar la yidhaahdo oo Lubnaan.
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

kikuyu: Kuwa guriga Rabbiga lagu dhex beeray Waxay ku barwaaqoobi doonaan barxadaha Ilaahayaga.
english: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

kikuyu: Oo weliba midho bay dhali doonaan iyagoo gaboobay, Oo waxaa ka buuxi doona muud, wayna cagaari doonaan,
english: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

kikuyu: Si ay u muujiyaan in Rabbigu qumman yahay, Isagu waa dhagaxayga gabbaadka ah, oo xaqdarro kuma jirto.
english: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

kikuyu: Rabbigaa taliya, oo wuxuu huwan yahay haybad, Rabbigu waa huwan yahay, oo wuxuu dhexda ku xidhay xoog, Duniduna waxay u dhisan tahay si aan la dhaqaajin karin.
english: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Carshigaagu wuxuu dhismay waa hore, Oo adiguna waxaad jirtay tan iyo weligaa.
english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, webiyadii kor bay u kaceen, Webiyadii codkooday kor u qaadeen, Oo webiyadii waxay kor u qaadeen hirarkoodii.
english: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

kikuyu: Biyaha badan codkooda, Iyo mawjadaha badda oo waaweynba Waxaa ka sii xoog badan Rabbiga sare.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, markhaatifurkaagu waa hubaal, Oo weligaaba waxaa gurigaaga ku habboon quduusnimo.
english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaaha aargudashada lahow, Ilaaha aargudashada lahow, soo iftiin.
english: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

kikuyu: Xaakinka dunidow, sara joogso, Oo kuwa kibray abaalkooda mari.
english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, kuwa sharka lahu ilaa goormay, Kuwa sharka lahu ilaa goormay guulaysanayaan?
english: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

kikuyu: Way bulxamaan, oo kibir bay ku hadlaan, Oo xumaanfalayaasha oo dhammu way faanaan.
english: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, iyagu waxay burburiyaan dadkaaga, Oo dhaxalkaagay silciyaan.
english: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

kikuyu: Carmalka iyo shisheeyaha ayay laayaan, Oo agoontay nafta ka qaadaan.
english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

kikuyu: Oo waxay isyidhaahdaan, Waxan Rabbigu ma arki doono, Oo Ilaaha reer Yacquubna kama fikiri doono.
english: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

kikuyu: Kuwiinna doqonnada ah oo dadka ku dhex jirow, fiirsada, Oo kuwiinna nacasyada ahow, goormaad caqli yeelanaysaan?
english: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

kikuyu: Kii dhegta abuuray, sow wax maqli maayo? Kii isha sameeyeyna, sow wax arki maayo?
english: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

kikuyu: Kan quruumaha edbiyaa, sow wax hagaajin maayo? Kaasoo ah kan dadka aqoonta bara?
english: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa og yahay fikirrada binu-aadmigu Inay micnela'aan yihiin.
english: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waxaa barakaysan ninkii aad edbiso, Oo aad sharcigaaga wax ka barto,
english: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

kikuyu: Si aad uga nasiso maalmaha belaayada Inta kan sharka lahaa godka loo qodayo.
english: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu dadkiisa xoori maayo, Oo dhaxalkiisana dayrin maayo.
english: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

kikuyu: Waayo, garsooriddu waxay ku soo noqon doontaa xaqnimada, Oo inta qalbigoodu qumman yahay oo dhammuna way raaci doonaan.
english: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

kikuyu: Bal yaa ii kacaya oo sharfalayaasha iga hor joogsanaya? Oo yaa ii soo istaagaya oo xumaanfalayaasha iga celinaya?
english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

kikuyu: Rabbigu haddaanu i caawin, Hadda naftaydu waxay joogi lahayd meesha aamusnaanta.
english: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

kikuyu: Markaan idhi, Rabbiyow, cagtaydu waa simbiriirixanaysaa, Waxaa kor ii qaadday naxariistaada.
english: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

kikuyu: Kolkay fikirro badan igu dhex jiraan Waxaa naftayda ka farxiya qalbiqaboojintaada.
english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

kikuyu: Carshiga sharnimadu ma xidhiidh buu kula yeelanayaa, Kaasoo belaayo qaynuun ku qabanqaabiya?
english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

kikuyu: Waxay dhammaantood isu soo wada urursadaan kan xaqa ah naftiisa, Oo waxay xukumaan dhiig aan eed lahayn.
english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbigu waxa weeye munaaraddayda, Ilaahayna waa dhagaxii magangalkayga.
english: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dushooda ku soo celiyey xumaatadoodii, Oo wuxuu iyaga ku dhex baabbi'in doonaa sharnimadooda, Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu wuu wada baabbi'in doonaa.
english: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.

kikuyu: Kaalaya, aynu Rabbiga u gabaynee, Oo aynu farxad ugu qaylinno dhagaxa badbaadadeenna.
english: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

kikuyu: Aynu hortiisa la nimaadno mahadnaq, Oo aynu isaga farxad ugu qaylinno innagoo sabuurro ugu gabyayna.
english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu waa Ilaah weyn, Waana boqor weyn oo ilaahyada oo dhan ka wada sarreeya.
english: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

kikuyu: Dhulka meelihiisa ugu mool dheeru gacantiisay ku jiraan, Oo buuraha dheeraantoodana isagaa iska leh.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

kikuyu: Baddana isagaa iska leh, oo isagaa sameeyey, Oo dhulka engeganna isagaa gacmihiisa ku sameeyey.
english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

kikuyu: Haddaba kaalaya aynu isaga caabudnee oo u sujuudnee, Oo Rabbiga ina abuuray aan hortiisa ku jilba joogsanno,
english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu waa Ilaaheen, Oo innaguna waxaynu nahay dadkii daaqsintiisa, iyo idaha gacantiisa ku jira. Bal maanta maad codkiisa maqashaan!
english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

kikuyu: Qalbigiinna ha adkaynina, sidii markii Meriibaah la joogay, Iyo sidii maalintii la joogay Masaah oo cidlada ku dhex taal,
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

kikuyu: Markay awowayaashiin i jirrabeen, Oo ay i tijaabiyeen, oo ay shuqulkaygii arkeen.
english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

kikuyu: Dadkii qarnigaas afartan sannadood waan u cadhaysnaa, Oo waxaan idhi, Waa dad qalbigooda ka qaldama, Oo iyagu ma ay aqoon jidadkaygii,
english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed anigoo cadhaysan waxaan ku dhaartay Inaanay nasashadayda gelin.
english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

kikuyu: Rabbiga gabay cusub ugu gabya, Dadka dhulka oo dhammow, Rabbiga u gabya.
english: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

kikuyu: Rabbiga u gabya, oo magiciisa ammaana, Oo badbaadintiisana muujiya maalin ka maalin.
english: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

kikuyu: Ammaantiisa quruumaha dhexdooda ka sheega, Oo shuqulkiisa yaabka badanna dadyowga oo dhan ka dhex sheega.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu waa weyn yahay, waana mudan yahay in aad loo ammaano. Isaga waa in laga cabsadaa in ka sii badan ilaahyada oo dhan.
english: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

kikuyu: Waayo, dadyowga ilaahyadooda oo dhammu waa sanamyo, Laakiinse Rabbigu isagaa sameeyey samooyinka.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

kikuyu: Sharaf iyo haybaduba hortiisay yaalliin, Xoog iyo quruxuna meeshiisa quduuska ah ayay ku jiraan.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

kikuyu: Dadka qolooyinkiisow, Rabbiga ammaana, Waxaad Rabbiga ka sheegtaan ammaan iyo xoog.
english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

kikuyu: Waxaad Rabbiga ka sheegtaan ammaanta magiciisu mudan yahay, Qurbaan keena, oo barxadihiisa soo gala.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku caabuda quruxda quduusnimada, Dadka dhulka oo dhammow, hortiisa ku gariira.
english: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

kikuyu: Quruumaha dhexdooda waxaad ka tidhaahdaan, Rabbigaa taliya, Oo duniduna waxay u dhisan tahay si aan la dhaqaajin karin, Dadyowgana wuxuu ugu garsoori doonaa caddaalad.
english: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

kikuyu: Haddaba samooyinku ha farxeen, dhulkuna ha reyreeyo, Oo badda iyo waxa ka buuxaaba, ha guuxeen,
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

kikuyu: Berriga iyo waxa ku jira oo dhammuna ha farxeen, Oo markaasay dhirta duurka oo dhammu Rabbiga hortiisa ku gabyi doonaan farxad daraaddeed,
english: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu waa imanayaa, Oo wuxuu u imanayaa inuu dunida xukumo. Isagu wuxuu dunida ku xukumi doonaa xaqnimo, Dadyowgana runtiisa.
english: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

kikuyu: Rabbigu isagaa taliya, haddaba dhulku ha reyreeyo, Oo gasiiradaha badanuna ha wada farxeen.
english: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

kikuyu: Isaga waxaa ku wareegsan daruuro iyo gudcur, Oo carshigiisana waxaa aasaas u ah xaqnimo iyo garsoorid.
english: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

kikuyu: Waxaa hortiisa socda dab, Oo wuxuu wada gubaa cadaawayaashiisa ku wareegsan.
english: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

kikuyu: Hillaaciisii ayaa dunida iftiimiyey, Dhulkuna wuu arkay, wuuna gariiray.
english: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

kikuyu: Buurihii waxay Rabbiga hortiisa ugu dhalaaleen sidii shamac oo kale, Iyagoo hor jooga Sayidka dhulka oo dhan.
english: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Samooyinku waxay sheegaan xaqnimadiisa, Oo dadyowga oo dhammuna waxay arkaan ammaantiisa.
english: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

kikuyu: Kuwa sanamyada la qoray u adeega Iyo weliba kuwa sanamyada ku faana oo dhammu ha ceeboobeen, Ilaahyada oo dhammow, isaga caabuda.
english: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Siyoon way maqashay, wayna faraxday, Oo gabdhihii reer Yahuudahna waxay ku reyreeyeen garsooriddaadii.
english: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiyow, adigu waad ka sarraysaa dhulka oo dhan, Oo aad baa lagaaga sarraysiiyey ilaahyada oo dhan.
english: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna Rabbiga jeclow, sharka nebcaada, Isagu wuxuu dhawraa nafaha quduusiintiisa, Oo wuxuu iyaga ka samatabbixiyaa gacanta kuwa sharka leh.
english: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

kikuyu: Waxaa kuwa xaqa ah loo beeray iftiin, Kuwa qalbigoodu qumman yahayna, farxad.
english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna xaqa ahow, Rabbiga ku farxa, Oo magiciisa quduuska ah ku mahadnaqa.
english: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

kikuyu: Rabbiga gabay cusub ugu gabya, Waayo, isagu wuxuu sameeyey waxyaalo yaab badan, Gacantiisa midig iyo dhudhunkiisa quduuska ahuna waxay keeneen badbaado.
english: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu dadka ogeysiiyey badbaadadiisii, Oo xaqnimadiisiina wuxuu bayaan ugu muujiyey quruumaha hortooda.
english: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu soo xusuustay naxariistiisii iyo aaminnimadiisii uu u qabay reerka binu Israa'iil, Dadka dhulka darfihiisa jooga oo dhammu way wada arkeen badbaadinta Ilaaheenna.
english: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

kikuyu: Inta dhulka joogta oo dhammay, Rabbiga farxad ugu qayliya, Dhawaaqa, oo farxad ku gabya, oo ammaan ku gabya.
english: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaan ugu gabya idinkoo kataarad haysta, Kataarad iyo codka heeska ugu gabya.
english: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

kikuyu: Boqorka Rabbiga ah hortiisa farxad kaga dhawaajiya Turumbooyin iyo buunan.
english: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

kikuyu: Badda iyo waxa ka buuxaaba ha guuxeen, Dunida iyo kuwa dhex deggan oo dhammuna ha dhawaaqeen,
english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

kikuyu: Webiyadu ha sacbiyeen, Oo buuruhuna dhammaantood farxad ha kaga gabyeen Rabbiga hortiisa,
english: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu u imanayaa inuu dhulka xukumo, Wuxuu dunida ku xukumi doonaa xaqnimo, Dadyowgana caddaalad.
english: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

kikuyu: Rabbigu isagaa taliya, dadyowgu ha gariireen, Isagu wuxuu ku fadhiyaa keruubiimta, dhulku ha dhaqdhaqaaqo.
english: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

kikuyu: Rabbigu Siyoon dhexdeeda waa ku weyn yahay, Oo dadyowga oo dhanna wuu ka wada sarreeyaa.
english: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

kikuyu: Iyagu ha ammaaneen magacaaga weyn oo laga cabsado, Isagu waa quduus.
english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

kikuyu: Oo weliba boqorka xooggiisu wuxuu jecel yahay garsoorid, Caddaalad baad adkaysaa, Garsoorid iyo xaqnimo baad u samaysaa reer Yacquub.
english: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah sarraysiiya, Oo meeshuu cagaha saartona ku sujuuda, Isagu waa quduus.
english: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

kikuyu: Muuse iyo Haaruun waxay ka mid ahaayeen wadaaddadiisa, Samuu'eelna wuxuu ka mid ahaa kuwa magiciisa u yeedha, Iyagu waxay baryeen Rabbiga, oo isna wuu u jawaabay.
english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.

kikuyu: Wuxuu iyagii kala dhex hadlay tiirkii daruurta ahaa, Iyana waxay xajiyeen markhaatifurkiisii iyo qaynuunkii uu iyaga siiyey.
english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow Ilaahayagiiyow, waad u jawaabtay, Oo waxaad ahayd Ilaah iyaga cafiyey, In kastoo aad falimahoodii ka aargoosatay.
english: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah sarraysiiya, Oo isaga ku caabuda buurtiisa quduuska ah, Waayo, Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu waa quduus.
english: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!

kikuyu: Inta dhulka deggan oo dhammay, Rabbiga farxad ugu qayliya.
english: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

kikuyu: Rabbiga farxad ugu adeega, Oo hortiisa gabay la kaalaya.
english: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

kikuyu: Ogaada in Rabbigu Ilaah yahay, Waxaa ina sameeyey isaga, oo waxaynu nahay kuwiisii, Waxaynu nahay dadkiisii iyo idihii daaqsintiisa.
english: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

kikuyu: Irdihiisa mahadnaqid la gala, Barxadihiisana ammaan. Isaga u mahadnaqa, oo magiciisa ammaana.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu waa wanaagsan yahay, naxariistiisuna weligeed way sii waartaa, Aaminnimadiisuna tan iyo ka ab ka ab.
english: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Waxaan ka gabyi doonaa naxariis iyo garsoorid, Rabbiyow, waxaan kuugu gabyi doonaa ammaan.
english: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan u dhawrsan doonaa si qumman oo caqliya, Bal goormaad ii iman doontaa? Waxaan gurigayga ku dhex socon doonaa qalbi qumman.
english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

kikuyu: Indhahayga hortooda wax xun ma dhigi doono, Waan necbahay kuwa leexda shuqulkooda, Oo innaba iguma dhegi doono.
english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

kikuyu: Qalbi qalloocanu wuu iga fogaan doonaa, Oo innaba wax shar ah ma aqoon doono.
english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

kikuyu: Kii qarsoodi u xanta deriskiisa, kaas waan baabbi'in doonaa, Kii isla madax weyn oo qalbigiisu kibirsan yahayna uma dulqaadan doono.
english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

kikuyu: Indhahaygu waxay la jiri doonaan kuwa aamiinka ah oo dalka deggan, si ay iila joogaan aawadeed, Kii si qumman u socda ayaa ii adeegi doona.
english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

kikuyu: Kii khiyaano ka shaqeeyaase gurigayga ma joogi doono, Kii been ku hadlaana hortayda kuma xoogaysan doono.
english: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

kikuyu: Subax ilaa ka subax ayaan wada baabbi'in doonaa kuwa sharka leh oo dalka deggan oo dhan, Si aan magaalada Rabbiga uga baabbi'iyo kuwa xumaanta ka shaqeeya oo dhan.
english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, baryootankayga maqal, Qayladayduna ha ku soo gaadho.
english: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.

kikuyu: Wejigaaga ha iga qarin maalinta aan dhibaataysnahay, Dhegta ii dhig, Oo maalinta aan ku baryo, dhaqso iigu soo jawaab.
english: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

kikuyu: Waayo, maalmahaygu waxay u dhammaadaan sida qiiq oo kale, Oo lafahayguna waxay u gubtaan sida qori ololaya oo kale.
english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

kikuyu: Wadnahayga wax baa lagu dhuftay, sida caws oo kalena wuu engegay, Waayo, waan iska illoobaa inaan kibistayda cuno.
english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

kikuyu: Codkii taahiddayda daraaddiis Ayaa lafahaygu jidhkayga ku dhegaan.
english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan la mid ahay haad cantalyaa ah oo cidlada joogta, Oo waxaan la mid noqday haad guumays ah oo lamadegaanka dhex joogta.
english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

kikuyu: Waan soo jeedaa, oo waxaan noqday Sidii shimbir yar oo keligeed guri dhaladiis saaran.
english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

kikuyu: Maalinta oo dhan cadaawayaashaydu way i caayaan, Oo kuwa ii cadhaysanuna magacaygay ku caytamaan.
english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

kikuyu: Waayo, dambas baan u cunay sidii kibis oo kale, Oo cabniinkaygiina waxaan ku darsaday ilmadaydii.
english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

kikuyu: Sababtuna waa dhirifkaagii iyo cadhadaadii aawadood, Waayo, kor baad ii qaadday, dabadeedna waad i xoortay.
english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

kikuyu: Cimrigaygu waa sida hoos sii libdhaya, Oo waxaan u engegay sida caws oo kale.
english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbiyow, adigu weligaaba waad sii jiri doontaa, Oo waa lagu sii xusuusan doonaa ka ab ka ab.
english: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

kikuyu: Waad sara joogsan doontaa, oo Siyoon baad u naxariisan doontaa, Waayo, waa wakhtiga iyada loo jixinjixo, haah, oo wakhtigii la ballamay waa yimid.
english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

kikuyu: Waayo, addoommadaadu waxay u bogaan dhagaxyadeeda, Oo waxay u jixinjixaan ciiddeeda.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

kikuyu: Haddaba quruumuhu waxay ka cabsan doonaan magaca Rabbiga, Boqorrada dunida oo dhammuna ammaantaada,
english: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu dhisay Siyoon, Oo wuxuu ka dhex muuqday ammaantiisii,
english: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u fiirsaday kuwa dan daraysan tukashadoodii, Oo baryadoodiina ma uu quudhsan.
english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

kikuyu: Tan waxaa loo qori doonaa farcanka soo socda, Oo dad la abuuri doono ayaa Rabbiga ammaani doona.
english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu wax ka soo fiiriyey meeshiisa sare oo quduuska ah, Rabbigu dhulkuu ka soo eegay samada,
english: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,

kikuyu: Inuu maqlo taaha maxbuuska, Iyo inuu sii daayo kuwa dilka lagu xukumay,
english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

kikuyu: Si dadku magaca Rabbiga uga sheego Siyoon dhexdeeda, Ammaantiisana Yeruusaalem dhexdeeda,
english: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Markii dadyowgu isu soo wada ururaan, Iyo xataa boqortooyooyinkuba, inay Rabbiga u adeegaan aawadeed.
english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

kikuyu: Isagu xooggayguu ku dhex dhimay jidka, Oo cimrigaygiina wuu gaabiyey.
english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan idhi, Ilaahayow, ha i sii qaadin cimrigayga oo badh ah, Sannadahaagu waxay sii waaraan tan iyo ka ab ka ab.
english: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Waa hore ayaad aasaaska dhulka dhigtay, Samooyinkuna waa shuqulkii gacmahaaga.
english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Iyagu way baabbi'i doonaan, adiguse waad sii waari doontaa, Haah, oo kulligood waxay u duugoobi doonaan sida dhar oo kale, Oo waxaad iyaga u beddeli doontaa sida maro oo kale, wayna beddelmi doonaan,
english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu isku si uun baad tahay had iyo goorba, Oo sannadahaaguna ma idlaan doonaan.
english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

kikuyu: Carruurta addoommadaadu way sii jiri doonaan, Oo farcankooduna hortaaday ku xoogaysan doonaan.
english: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, Rabbiga ammaan, Oo inta igu jirta oo dhammay, ammaana magiciisa quduuska ah.
english: By David. Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, Rabbiga ammaan, Oo ha illoobin wanaagga uu kuu sameeyo oo dhan.
english: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

kikuyu: Isagaa kaa cafiya dembiyadaada oo dhan, Oo kaa bogsiiya cudurradaada oo dhan,
english: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

kikuyu: Oo naftaada ka badbaadiya halligaadda, Oo raxmad iyo naxariis kugu barakeeya,
english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

kikuyu: Oo kaa dhergiya waxyaalaha wanwanaagsan, Si ay dhallinyaranimadaadu ugu cusboonaato sida gorgorka oo kale.
english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu falaa xaqnimo, Gar buuna u gooyaa kuwa dulman oo dhan.
english: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu Muuse garansiiyey jidadkiisii, Reer binu Israa'iilna falimihiisii.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa raxmad badan yahay, waana nimco miidhan, Cadho wuu u gaabiyaa, waana naxariis badan yahay.
english: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

kikuyu: Isagu had iyo goor wax canaanan maayo, Oo sii cadhaysnaan maayo ilaa weligiis.
english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

kikuyu: Isagu inoolama uu macaamiloon sidii dembiyadeennu ahaayeen, Oo inooguma uu abaalmarin sidii xumaatooyinkeennu ahaayeen.
english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida samadu dhulka uga sarrayso, Sidaas oo kalaa naxariistiisu ugu weyn tahay kuwa isaga ka cabsada.
english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

kikuyu: Sida barigu uga fog yahay galbeedka, Sidaas oo kaluu xadgudubkeennii inooga fogeeyey.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

kikuyu: Sida aabbe carruurtiisa ugu naxo oo kale Ayaa Rabbigu ugu naxaa kuwa isaga ka cabsada.
english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

kikuyu: Waayo, abuuristeennuu og yahay, Oo wuu xusuusan yahay inaan innagu ciid nahay.
english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

kikuyu: Laakiinse dadka cimrigiisu waa sida doog oo kale, Sida ubaxa berrinka ayuu u barwaaqoobaa.
english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

kikuyu: Waayo, dabayl baa dul marta, wuuna baabba'aa, Oo meeshiisiina mar dambe ma aqoon doonto.
english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbigu wuxuu u naxariistaa kuwa isaga ka cabsada weligiis iyo weligiisba, Oo xaqnimadiisuna waxay la jirtaa carruurta carruurteeda,
english: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo ah kuwa axdigiisa xajiya Iyo kuwa amarradiisa xusuusta oo wada yeela.
english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

kikuyu: Rabbigu carshigiisii wuxuu ka dhistay samooyinka, Oo boqortooyadiisuna wax walbay u talisaa.
english: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

kikuyu: Malaa'igihiisa xoogga badan oo eraygiisa oofiya Oo codka hadalkiisa maqlow, Rabbiga ammaana.
english: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana, ciidammadiisa oo dhammow, Idinkoo ah midiidinyadiisa wuxuu doonayo sameeyow,
english: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

kikuyu: Shuqulladiisa oo dhammow, Rabbiga ku ammaana Meel kasta oo dowladnimadiisa ahba, Naftaydoy, Rabbiga ammaan.
english: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, Rabbiga ammaan. Rabbiyow Ilaahayow, aad baad u weyn tahay, Oo waxaad huwan tahay murwad iyo haybad.
english: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

kikuyu: Waxaad sida maro u huwataa nuur, Oo samooyinkana waxaad u kala bixisaa sida daah oo kale.
english: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

kikuyu: Waxa qolkaaga saqafka u hayana waxaad dhigtaa biyaha dhexdooda, Daruurahana waxaad ka dhigataa gaadhifaras, Oo waxaad ku kor socotaa dabaysha baalasheeda,
english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Waxaad dabaysha ka dhigataa wargeeyayaashaada, Oo waxaad midiidinyadaada ka dhigataa dab ololaya,
english: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

kikuyu: Adigaa dhigay aasaaska dhulka, Si aanu weligiis u dhaqdhaqaaqin.
english: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

kikuyu: Waxaad ku dabooshay mool sidii dhar oo kale, Biyihiina waxay joogsadeen buuraha korkooda.
english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

kikuyu: Canaantaadii ayay ku carareen, Oo codkii onkodkaaga ayay haddiiba ka baxsadeen,
english: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

kikuyu: Waxay kor u fuuleen buuraha, oo waxay hoos ugu dhaadheceen dooxooyinka, Ilaa meeshii aad u samaysay.
english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

kikuyu: Waxaad iyaga u dhigtay xudduud aanay soo dhaafin, Si aanay mar kale u noqon oo aanay dhulka u daboolin.
english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

kikuyu: Isagu dooxooyinka wuxuu ku soo daayaa ilo, Iyana waxay durduraan buuraha dhexdooda,
english: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

kikuyu: Waxay waraabiyaan xayawaanka duurka jooga oo dhan, Oo dameerdibadeedyaduna way harraad beelaan.
english: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

kikuyu: Haadda samadu iyagay ag degganaadaan, Oo waxay ka dhex gabyaan laamaha.
english: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

kikuyu: Buuraha wuxuu ka waraabiyaa qolalkiisa, Dhulkuna wuxuu ka dheregsan yahay midhihii shuqulladaada.
english: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu ka dhigaa in dooggu xoolaha u soo baxo, Oo geedaha yaryarna wuxuu u soo bixiyey in dadku ku isticmaalo, Inuu dhulka cunto ka soo bixiyo,
english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

kikuyu: Iyo khamri ka farxiya dadka qalbigiisa, Iyo saliid uu wejiga ku dhaashado, Iyo kibis qalbiga dadka xoogaysa.
english: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

kikuyu: Rabbiga dhirtiisu waa dheregsan tahay, Kuwaas oo ah geedaha kedar la yidhaahdo oo Lubnaan oo uu isagu beeray,
english: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo ah meesha shimbirruhu buulkooda ay ka samaystaan, Xuurtuna gurigeeda waxay ka kor dhisataa geedaha waaweyn.
english: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

kikuyu: Buuraha dhaadheer waxaa leh riyaha dibadda, Dhagaxyada waaweynuna waxay gabbaad u yihiin walooyinka.
english: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

kikuyu: Isagu dayaxa wuxuu u sameeyey xilliyo, Oo qorraxduna dhicitinkeeda way taqaan.
english: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

kikuyu: Waxaad samaysaa gudcur, oo habeen baa yimaada, Markaasay xayawaanka duurku soo wada baxaan.
english: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

kikuyu: Libaaxyada aaranka ahu waxay u ciyaan ugaadhsigooda, Cuntadoodana waxay ka sugaan xagga Ilaah.
english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

kikuyu: Oo kolkii qorraxdu soo baxdana way noqdaan, Oo waxay iska seexdaan godadkooda.
english: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

kikuyu: Dadku waa u soo baxaa shuqulkiisa Iyo hawshiisa ilaa tan iyo fiidka.
english: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, shuqulladaadu tiro badanaa! Kulligoodna xigmad baad ku samaysay, Dhulka waxaa ka buuxa hodantinimadaada.
english: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

kikuyu: Halkoo waxaa ku taal bad weyn oo ballaadhan, Gudaheedana waxaa ku jira waxyaalo gurguurta oo aan la tirin karin, Iyo xayawaan waaweyn iyo kuwo yaryarba.
english: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

kikuyu: Halkaas waxaa ku socda doonniyo, Oo waxaa halkaas yaal bahal badeed oo Lewiiyaataan la odhan jiray oo aad u abuurtay inuu ku dhex cayaaro.
english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo dhammu adigay kaa sugaan, Inaad cuntadooda siiso wakhti ku habboon.
english: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad iyaga siiso ayay isu soo urursadaan, Gacantaadaad furtaa oo waxay ka dhergaan waxyaalo wanaagsan.
english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

kikuyu: Wejigaagaad qarisaa, oo way dhibtoodaan, Naftoodaad ka qaaddaa oo way dhintaan, Oo waxay ku noqdaan ciiddoodii.
english: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

kikuyu: Waxaad soo dirtaa ruuxaaga, kolkaasay iyagu abuurmaan, Dhulkana waad cusboonaysiisaa.
english: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaantiisu ha sii raagto weligeedba, Oo Rabbigu ha ku reyreeyo shuqulladiisa.
english: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

kikuyu: Isagu dhulkuu eegaa, oo wuu gariiraa, Wuxuu taabtaa buuraha, oo way qiiqaan.
english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

kikuyu: Intaan noolahay oo dhan ayaan Rabbiga u gabyi doonaa, Oo Ilaahay ayaan ammaan ugu gabyi doonaa intaan jiro oo dhan.
english: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

kikuyu: Fikirkaygu isaga ha u macaanaado, Rabbigaan ku rayrayn doonaa.
english: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

kikuyu: Dembilayaashu dhulka ha ka baabbe'een, Oo kuwa sharka lahuna yaanay mar dambe sii jirin. Naftaydoy, Rabbiga ammaan. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku mahadnaqa, oo magiciisa ku barya, Falimihiisana dadyowga ka dhex sheega.
english: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Isaga u gabya, oo ammaan ugu gabya, Shuqulladiisa yaabka badan oo dhanna ka hadla.
english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

kikuyu: Ku faana magiciisa quduuska ah, Kuwa Rabbiga doondoona qalbigoodu ha reyreeyo.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

kikuyu: Rabbiga iyo xooggiisa doondoona, Oo weligiinba wejigiisa doondoona.
english: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

kikuyu: Xusuusta shuqulladiisii yaabka badnaa oo uu sameeyey, Iyo cajaa'ibyadiisii iyo xukummadii afkiisa,
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

kikuyu: Kuwiinna farcankii addoonkiisii Ibraahim ahow, Kuwiisa uu doortay oo reer Yacquub ahow.
english: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: Isagu waa Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah, Xukummadiisuna waxay ku jiraan dhulka oo dhan.
english: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

kikuyu: Axdigiisuu soo xusuustay weligiisba, Kaasoo ah hadalkiisii uu kun farcan ku amray,
english: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

kikuyu: Kaasu waa axdigii uu Ibraahim la dhigtay, Oo uu Isxaaq ugu dhaartay,
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

kikuyu: Oo isla kaas wuxuu u adkeeyey oo qaynuun uga dhigay Yacquub, Oo Israa'iilna wuxuu uga dhigay axdi weligiis jiraya,
english: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Dalka Kancaan waxaan kuu siinayaa Inuu ahaado qaybtii dhaxalkiinna,
english: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

kikuyu: Markay dad tiro yar ahaayeen, Oo ay aad u yaraayeen, qariibna dalka ku ahaayeen,
english: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu quruunba quruun bay uga bexeen, Oo intay boqortooyo ka tageen ayay dad kale u gudbeen.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

kikuyu: Isagu ninna uma oggolaanin inuu wax yeelo, Haah, oo daraaddood ayuu boqorro u canaantay,
english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ha taabanina kuwayga subkan, Oo nebiyadaydana waxba ha yeelina.
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

kikuyu: Dhulkiina abaar buu ugu yeedhay inay ku dhacdo, Ushii cuntada oo ay ku tiirsanaayeen oo dhanna wuu wada jebiyey.
english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

kikuyu: Oo nin buu iyaga ka sii hor diray, Kaas oo ahaa Yuusuf oo loo iibiyey addoon ahaan.
english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

kikuyu: Cagihiisii waxay ku xanuujiyeen bircago, Oo naftiisii waxay gashay silsilado bir ah,
english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

kikuyu: Ilaa wakhtigii eraygiisu noqday Eraygii Rabbiga ayaa isaga tijaabiyey.
english: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii u cid diray oo furay, Kaas oo ahaa taliyihii dadyowga, wuuna sii daayay.
english: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu isagii ka dhigay sayidkii reerkiisa, Iyo taliyihii maalkiisa oo dhan,
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

kikuyu: Inuu amiirradiisa xidho markuu doonayoba, Oo uu odayaashiisana xigmad baro.
english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

kikuyu: Israa'iilna wuxuu yimid dalkii Masar, Yacquubna wuxuu qariib ahaan u joogay dalkii Xaam.
english: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

kikuyu: Oo isagu dadkiisii aad buu u badiyey, Oo wuxuu ka dhigay inay ka xoog bataan cadaawayaashoodii.
english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

kikuyu: Qalbigoodii wuxuu u beddelay si ay dadkiisa u nebcaadaan, Iyo si ay addoommadiisa u khiyaaneeyaan.
english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u soo diray addoonkiisii Muuse, Iyo Haaruun oo uu doortay.
english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

kikuyu: Oo waxay dhexdooda ku sameeyeen calaamooyinkiisii, Oo dalkii Xaamna waxay ku sameeyeen yaabab.
english: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u soo diray gudcur, dalkiina gudcur buu ka dhigay, Oo iyana hadalkiisii kuma ay caasiyoobin.
english: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

kikuyu: Biyahoodii wuxuu u beddelay dhiig, Oo kalluunkoodiina wuu wada laayay.
english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

kikuyu: Rahyo waa ku bateen dhulkoodii Iyo qolalka boqorkoodiiba.
english: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

kikuyu: Isagu waa hadlay, markaasaa waddankoodii oo dhan Waxaa yimid duqsi faro badan iyo injir.
english: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

kikuyu: Oo roob ahaan wuxuu u siiyey roob dhagaxyaale, Dalkoodiina wuxuu ku soo daayay dab ololaya.
english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

kikuyu: Wuxuu wax ku dhuftay geedahoodii canabka ahaa iyo geedahoodii berdaha ahaaba, Oo dhirtii waddankooda ku tiilna wuu jejebiyey.
english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

kikuyu: Wuu hadlay, markaasaa waxaa yimid ayax, Iyo diir aan la tirin karin,
english: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

kikuyu: Oo waxay wada cuneen geedo yaryar oo kasta oo dalkooda ku yiil, Wayna dhammaysteen midhihii dhulkooda.
english: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu wada laayay curadyadii dalkooda oo dhan, Kuwaas oo ahaa bilowgii xooggooda.
english: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dibadda u bixiyey reer binu Israa'iil iyagoo wata lacag iyo dahab, Oo qabiilooyinkiisiina mid taagdarani kuma uu jirin.
english: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

kikuyu: Reer Masarna way ku farxeen kolkay ambabbexeen, Waayo, cabsidoodii baa ku dhacday.
english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

kikuyu: Wuxuu korkooda ku kala bixiyey daruur inay qariso, Iyo dab habeenkii iftiin u noqda.
english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

kikuyu: Wax bay weyddiisteen, markaasuu u keenay digaag duur, Oo wuxuu ka dhergiyey kibistii samada.
english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

kikuyu: Dhagaxii ayuu dillaaciyey, markaasay biyo ka soo buqdeen, Oo meelihii engegnaa ayay ku durdureen sidii webi oo kale.
english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu soo xusuustay eraygiisii quduuska ahaa, Oo uu kula hadlay addoonkiisii Ibraahim.
english: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

kikuyu: Dadkiisiina wuxuu soo bixiyey iyagoo faraxsan, Kuwii uu doortayna iyagoo gabyaya.
english: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyagii siiyey dalalkii quruumaha, Oo iyana waxay hanti ahaan u qaadeen waxay dadyowgu ku hawshoodeen,
english: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

kikuyu: Inay amarradiisa dhawraan, Oo ay qaynuunnadiisa xajiyaan. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Rabbiga ku mahadnaqa, waayo, isagu waa wanaagsan yahay, Oo naxariistiisuna weligeedba way waartaa.
english: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Yaa sheegi kara Rabbiga falimihiisa waaweyn? Amase yaa muujin kara ammaantiisa oo dhan?
english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa xukunka dhawra, Oo xaqnimada ka shaqeeya wakhti kastaba.
english: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, igu soo xusuuso naxariista aad dadkaaga u qabto, Oo igu soo booqo badbaadintaada,
english: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

kikuyu: Inaan arko kuwaaga aad dooratay barwaaqadooda, Oo aan ku reyreeyo farxadda quruuntaada, Iyo inaan la faano dadka dhaxalkaaga ah.
english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

kikuyu: Waxaannu la dembaabnay awowayaashayo, Xumaanna waannu samaynay, oo si shar ah ayaannu wax u samaynay.
english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

kikuyu: Awowayaashayo ma ay garan yaababkii aad dalka Masar ku samaysay. Oo ma ay xusuusan badnaantii naxariistaada, Laakiinse way ku ag caasiyoobeen badda, taas oo ah Badda Cas.
english: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee wuxuu iyagii u badbaadiyey magiciisa daraaddiis, Inuu xooggiisa weyn ka dhigo mid la yaqaan.
english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Badda Cas ayuu canaantay, kolkaasay engegtay, Sidaas daraaddeed wuxuu iyagii ku hor kacay moolka dhexdiisii sidii iyagoo maraya cidlada dhexdeeda.
english: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyagii ka badbaadiyey kii iyaga necbaa gacantiisii, Oo wuxuu ka furtay gacantii cadowga.
english: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

kikuyu: Biyihiina waxay qariyeen cadaawayaashoodii. Xataa mid qudhahu kama hadhin.
english: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

kikuyu: Markaasay rumaysteen erayadiisii, Oo ammaantiisay ku gabyeen.
english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

kikuyu: Haddiiba way illoobeen shuqulladiisii, Oo taladiisiina ma ay sugin,
english: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

kikuyu: Laakiinse aad bay wax u damacsanaayeen intay cidladii dhex joogeen, Oo Ilaahna way ku jirrabeen lamadegaanka dhexdiisa.
english: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu siiyey wixii ay weyddiisteen, Laakiinse wuxuu naftoodii u soo diray caatow.
english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxay xerada dhexdeedii kaga hinaaseen Muuse Iyo Haaruun oo ahaa Rabbiga kiisii quduuska ahaa.
english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.

kikuyu: Oo dhulkiina waa kala furmay oo wuxuu liqay Daataan, Oo weliba wuxuu qariyey Abiiraam guutadiisii.
english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

kikuyu: Oo guutadoodiina dab baa ka dhex shidmay, Ololkiina wuxuu wada gubay kuwii shar lahaa.
english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

kikuyu: Waxay samaysteen weyl markii ay Xoreeb joogeen, Oo waxay caabudeen sanam la shubay.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

kikuyu: Oo sidaasay ammaantoodii ugu beddeleen Dibi caws daaqa ekaantiis.
english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

kikuyu: Waxay illoobeen Ilaahii Badbaadiyahooda ahaa, Oo waxyaalo waaweyn ku sameeyey dalkii Masar,
english: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

kikuyu: Shuqullo yaab badanna ku sameeyey dalkii Xaam, Waxyaalo cabsi badanna ku sameeyey Badda Cas agteeda.
english: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed isagu wuxuu yidhi, Waan baabbi'inayaa. Laakiinse Muuse oo ahaa kii uu doortay ayaa hortiisa u istaagay xidhiidhla'aantii u dhexaysay, Inuu Ilaah cadhadiisa ka leexiyo aawadeed si aanu iyaga u baabbi'in.
english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

kikuyu: Waxay quudhsadeen dalkii wacnaa, Mana ay rumaysan eraygiisii,
english: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

kikuyu: Laakiinse teendhooyinkooday ku dhex gunuunaceen, Mana ay dhegaysan codkii Rabbiga.
english: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed gacantiisuu kor ugu taagay iyaga, Oo wuxuu ku dhaartay inuu iyaga cidladii ku afgembiyo,
english: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

kikuyu: Iyo inuu farcankooda ku afgembiyo quruumaha dhexdooda, Oo uu iyaga ku kala firdhiyo dalalka.
english: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxay isku dareen Bacal Fecoor, Oo waxay cuneen allabarigii kuwii dhintay.
english: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

kikuyu: Sidaasay isaga shuqulladoodii ugaga xanaajiyeen, Markaasay belaayadu ka dhex dillacday.
english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa istaagay Fiinexaas, oo wuxuu ku soo dejiyey xukun, Oo sidaasaa belaayada lagu joojiyey.
english: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

kikuyu: Oo taas waxaa isagii loogu tiriyey xaqnimo U sii waaraysa qarni kasta iyo weligeedba.
english: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxay isagii kaga cadhaysiiyeen biyihii Meriibaah agtooda, Sidaas daraaddeed dhib baa ku dhacday Muuse iyaga aawadood,
english: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, iyagu waxay ku caasiyoobeen ruuxiisii, Kolkaasuu fiirola'aan u hadlay.
english: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

kikuyu: Dadyowgiina uma ay baabbi'in, Sidii Rabbigu ugu amray iyaga,
english: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,

kikuyu: Laakiinse iyagu waxay ku dhex qasmeen quruumihii, Shuqulladoodiina way barteen,
english: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

kikuyu: Oo waxay u adeegeen sanamyadoodii, Kuwaasoo iyaga dabin u noqday,
english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

kikuyu: Haah, oo waxay wiilashoodii iyo gabdhahoodii allabari ahaan ugu qaleen jinniyo,
english: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

kikuyu: Oo waxay daadiyeen dhiig aan eed lahayn, kaasoo ah dhiiggii wiilashooda iyo kii gabdhahooda Oo ay allabari ahaan ugu qaleen sanamyadii reer Kancaan, Oo dalkiina wuxuu ku nijaasoobay dhiig.
english: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaasay shuqulladoodii ugu nijaasoobeen, Oo falimahoodii ayay ku caasiyoobeen sidii dhillo oo kale.
english: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ayaa Rabbigu dadkiisii aad ugu cadhooday, Oo isna wuxuu karhay dadkii dhaxalkiisii ahaa.
english: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyagii u gacangeliyey quruumaha, Oo kuwii iyaga necbaa ayaa u taliyey.
english: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

kikuyu: Oo weliba cadaawayaashoodii ayaa dulmay, Oo iyagoo gacantooda ka hooseeya ayay addoonsadeen.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

kikuyu: Marar badan ayuu samatabbixiyey, Laakiinse waxay ku caasiyoobeen taladoodii, Oo waxaa lagu hoosaysiiyey dembigoodii.
english: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee isagu waa ka fiirsaday cidhiidhigoodii, Markuu qayladoodii maqlay,
english: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyagii u soo xusuustay axdigiisii, Kolkaasuu naxariistiisa badan aawadeed u qoomamooday.
english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu ka dhigay inay Kuwii iyaga maxaabiis ahaanta u kaxaystay oo dhammu u naxaan.
english: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow Ilaahayagow, na badbaadi, Oo quruumaha naga soo dhex ururi, Si aannu magacaaga quduuska ah ugu mahadnaqno, Oo aannu ammaantaada ugu guulaysanno.
