english: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

kikuyu: Waxaa mahad leh Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil Tan iyo weligiis iyo weligiisba. Oo dadka oo dhammu ha yidhaahdo, Aamiin. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku mahadnaqa, waayo, isagu waa wanaagsan yahay, Oo naxariistiisuna weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Kuwa Rabbigu soo furtay sidaas ha yidhaahdeen, Waana kuwa uu isagu ka soo furtay gacantii cadowga,
english: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

kikuyu: Oo uu ka soo ururiyey dalalka, Xagga bari, iyo xagga galbeed, Xagga woqooyi, iyo xagga koonfureedba.
english: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

kikuyu: Waxay dhex wareegi jireen cidlada iyo jid lamadegaan ah, Mana ay helin magaalo ay degaan.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

kikuyu: Way gaajoodeen, wayna harraadeen, Oo naftoodiina way ku dhex taag darnaatay.
english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

kikuyu: Markaasay Rabbiga u qayshadeen iyagoo dhibban, Oo isna wuu ka samatabbixiyey dhibaatooyinkoodii.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Oo weliba wuxuu iyagii ku hoggaamiyey jid toosan, Si ay u tagaan magaalo ay degaan.
english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

kikuyu: Dadku muu Rabbiga ku ammaano wanaaggiisa, Iyo shuqulladiisa yaabka badan oo uu binu-aadmiga u sameeyo!
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu dhergiyaa nafta aad wax u doonaysa, Oo nafta gaajaysanna wuxuu ka dhergiyaa wanaagga.
english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

kikuyu: Kuwii dhex fadhiyey gudcurkii iyo hooskii dhimashada, Oo ku xidhnaa dhibaatada iyo birta,
english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

kikuyu: Waxay ku caasiyoobeen erayadii Ilaah, Oo waxay fududaysteen taladii Ilaaha ugu sarreeya,
english: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ayuu qalbigoodii daal ku soo dejiyey, Wayna dheceen, mid iyaga caawiyaana ma jirin.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

kikuyu: Markaasay Rabbiga u qayshadeen iyagoo dhibban, Oo isna wuu ka badbaadiyey dhibaatooyinkoodii.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ka soo dhex bixiyey gudcurkii iyo hooskii dhimashada, Silsiladihii ku xidhnaana wuu kala jejebiyey.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

kikuyu: Dadku muu Rabbiga ku ammaano wanaaggiisa, Iyo shuqulladiisa yaabka badan oo uu binu-aadmiga u sameeyo!
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: Waayo, irdihii naxaasta ahaa wuu kala jejebiyey, Qataarradii birta ahaana wuu burburiyey.
english: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

kikuyu: Nacasyadu waxay u dhibban yihiin xadgudubkooda aawadiis, Iyo xumaatooyinkooda aawadood.
english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

kikuyu: Naftoodu waxay nacdaa cunto kasta, Oo waxay ku soo dhowaadaan irdaha dhimashada.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

kikuyu: Markaasay Rabbiga u qayshadaan iyagoo dhibban, Oo isna wuxuu ka soo badbaadiyaa dhibaatooyinkooda.
english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Wuxuu soo diraa eraygiisa, wuuna bogsiiyaa iyaga, Oo wuxuu ka samatabbixiyaa halligaaddooda.
english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

kikuyu: Dadku muu Rabbiga ku ammaano wanaaggiisa, Iyo shuqulladiisa yaabka badan oo uu binu-aadmiga u sameeyo!
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: Iyagu allabariga mahadnaqidda ha bixiyeen, Oo shuqulladiisa gabay ha ku sheegeen.
english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

kikuyu: Kuwa badda doonniyaha ku mara, Oo shuqulkooda ku sameeya biyaha badan,
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

kikuyu: Kuwaasu waxay arkaan Rabbiga shuqulladiisa, Iyo yaababkiisa moolka ku jira.
english: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu amraa oo kiciyaa dabaysha duufaanka, Taas oo kor u qaadda hirarka badda.
english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

kikuyu: Waxay u kacaan xagga samada, oo haddana waxay hoos ugu soo dhacaan moolalka, Naftoodiina waxay ku dhalaashay dhibaato daraaddeed.
english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

kikuyu: Hore iyo dib bay isaga daba noqdaan, oo sida nin sakhraan ah bay dhacdhacaan, Oo waxay sameeyaan ayay garan waayaan.
english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

kikuyu: Markaasay Rabbiga u qayshadaan iyagoo dhibban, Oo isna wuxuu ka soo bixiyaa dhibaatooyinkooda.
english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

kikuyu: Wuxuu dejiyaa duufaanka, Si ay hirarkiisu u xasillaan.
english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

kikuyu: Way farxaan, maxaa yeelay, way xasilloon yihiin, Oo sidaasuu iyaga ku keenaa marsada ay doonayaan.
english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

kikuyu: Dadku muu Rabbiga ku ammaano wanaaggiisa, Iyo shuqulladiisa yaabka badan oo uu binu-aadmiga u sameeyo!
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

kikuyu: Iyagu ha ku sarraysiiyeen shirka dadka dhexdiisa, Oo ha ku ammaaneen fadhiga odayaasha.
english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

kikuyu: Isagu webiyo wuxuu u beddelaa cidlo, Oo ilo biyo ahna wuxuu u beddelaa dhul oommane ah,
english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

kikuyu: Oo dhul barwaaqaysanna wuxuu u beddelaa lamadegaan cusbo leh, Oo waana kuwa halkaas deggan xumaantooda aawadeed.
english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Cidlada wuxuu u beddelaa balli biyo ah, Oo dhul engeganna wuxuu u beddelaa ilo biyo ah.
english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

kikuyu: Oo halkaasuu kuwa gaajaysan dejiyaa, Si ay u samaystaan magaalo ay degaan,
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

kikuyu: Oo ay beeraha u abuurtaan, oo ay beero canab ah u beertaan, Oo ay u helaan midho tiro badan.
english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

kikuyu: Oo weliba iyaga wuu barakeeyaa, sidaas daraaddeed aad bay u tarmaan, Oo weliba uma uu oggolaado in xoolahoodu yaraadaan.
english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

kikuyu: Oo haddana way sii dhinmaan, oo waxay la foororsadaan Dulmi iyo dhib iyo murug.
english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

kikuyu: Amiirro wuxuu ku soo daayaa quudhsasho, Oo wuxuu ka dhigaa inay ku wareegaan cidlada aan jid lahayn.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

kikuyu: Oo weliba kan baahanna dhibaatada ayuu ka sara mariyaa, Oo wuxuu u yeelaa qolooyin ah sidii adhi oo kale.
english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

kikuyu: Kuwa qummanuna way arki doonaan, wayna ku farxi doonaan, Oo kolkaas xumaanta oo dhammu afkeeday xidhi doontaa.
english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii caqli lahu wuu dhawri doonaa waxyaalahan, Oo iyana way ka fiirsan doonaan Rabbiga naxariistiisa.
english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, qalbigaa ii fadhiya, Waan gabyi doonaa, haah, waxaan kuugu gabyi doonaa ammaantayda.
english: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

kikuyu: Shareerad iyo kataaradow, toosa, Aroorta hore waan toosi doonaa.
english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, mahad baan kuugu naqi doonaa dadyowga dhexdooda, Oo waxaan ammaan kuugu gabyi doonaa quruumaha dhexdooda.
english: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

kikuyu: Waayo, naxariistaadu way ku weyn tahay samooyinka korkooda, Oo runtaaduna waxay gaadhaa ilaa daruuraha.
english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, samooyinka ka sarree, Oo ammaantaaduna dhulka oo dhan ha ka sarrayso,
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

kikuyu: Si ay kuwaad jeceshahay u samatabbaxaan aawadeed, Gacantaada midig ku badbaadi, oo ii jawaab.
english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu ku hadlay quduusnimadiisa oo yidhi, Anigu waan farxi doonaa, Shekem waan kala qaybin doonaa, oo waxaan qiyaasi doonaa dooxada Sukod,
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kikuyu: Gilecaad anigaa iska leh, Manasehna anigaa iska leh, Oo weliba Efrayimna waa daafacaaddii madaxayga, Yahuudahna waa ushaydii boqornimo.
english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Moo'aab waa weelkaygii aan ku maydhan jiray, Edomna kabahaygaan ku dul tuuri doonaa, Oo Falastiinna waan ku qaylin doonaa.
english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

kikuyu: Bal yaa i geeyn doona magaalada deyrka leh? Yaase xagga Edom ii kaxayn doona?
english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

kikuyu: Ilaahow, sow nama aadan xoorin? Ilaahow, lama soo baxdid ciidammadayada.
english: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

kikuyu: Cadowga naga caawi, Waayo, binu-aadmiga caawimaaddiisu waxtar ma leh.
english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: Ilaah caawimaaddiisa ayaannu wax xoog leh ku samayn doonnaa, Waayo, isagaa ah kan cadaawayaashayada ku tuman doona.
english: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

kikuyu: Ilaaha ammaantaydow, ha iska aamusin,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay igu kala qaadeen afka kan sharka leh iyo kan khiyaanada lehba, Oo waxay igula hadleen carrab been sheega.
english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxay igu hareereeyeen erayo nacayb badan, Oo sababla'aan bay igula dirireen.
english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

kikuyu: Anigoo jecel bay cadow ii yihiin, Laakiinse anigu Ilaah baan baryaa.
english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

kikuyu: Wanaag waxay iigaga abaalgudeen xumaan, Jacaylna nacayb.
english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

kikuyu: Nin shar leh ka sarraysii isaga, Oo Shayddaan ha istaago midigtiisa.
english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

kikuyu: Markii la xukumo, ha soo baxo isagoo dembi lagu helay, Oo tukashadiisiina dembi ha noqoto.
english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

kikuyu: Cimrigiisu ha yaraado, Jagadiisana mid kale ha qaato.
english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

kikuyu: Carruurtiisu ha agoontoobeen, Naagtiisuna carmal ha noqoto.
english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

kikuyu: Carruurtiisu kuwa warwareega ha noqdeen oo ha dawarsadeen, Cuntadoodana ha ka doondooneen meelahooda cidlada ah.
english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

kikuyu: Midka korsaarta qaataa ha qabsado wuxuu haysto oo dhan, Oo shisheeyayaalna ha ka dheceen wixii uu ku hawshooday.
english: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

kikuyu: Yaanu jirin mid isaga u sii naxariistaa, Oo yaanu jirin mid u naxa carruurtiisa agoonta ah.
english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

kikuyu: Farcankiisu ha baabba'o, Oo qarniga soo socda magacooda ha la tirtiro.
english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

kikuyu: Xumaantii awowayaashiis Rabbigu ha soo xusuusto, Oo dembigii hooyadiisna yaan la tirtirin.
english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ha hor joogeen had iyo goorba, Si uu xusuustooda uga gooyo dhulka.
english: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, isagu wuu xusuusan waayay inuu u naxariisto Miskiinka, iyo kan baahan, iyo kan qalbiga ka murugaysan, Laakiinse wuxuu u silciyey inuu iyaga laayo aawadeed.
english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

kikuyu: Wuxuu jeclaaday habaaridda, markaasaa habaar ku soo degay, Ducaynta kuma farxin, ducona way ka sii fogaatay isaga.
english: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

kikuyu: Oo weliba isagu wuxuu sidii dharkiisii u huwaday habaaridda, Oo iyana waxay gashay uurkiisa hoose sidii biyo oo kale, Oo lafihiisana waxay u gashay sidii saliid.
english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

kikuyu: Isaga ha u ahaato sida marada uu huwado, Iyo sida dhex-xidhka uu ku xidho had iyo goorba,
english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

kikuyu: Tanu waa abaalmarinta cadaawayaashaydu ay xagga Rabbiga ka helaan, Iyo kuwa naftayda xumaan ka sheegaba.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaahow, Sayidow, magacaaga daraaddiis wax iigu yeel, Naxariistaadu waa wanaagsan tahay, ee sidaas daraaddeed ii samatabbixi,
english: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu waxaan ahay miskiin iyo mid baahan, Oo qalbigayguna wuu igu dhex dhaawacmay.
english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

kikuyu: Waxaan u dhammaaday sida hoos sii libdhaya, Waxaan u gilgilmaa sida ayax oo kale.
english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

kikuyu: Jilbahaygu soon bay la taag darnaadaan, Oo jidhkayguna baruurla'aanteed wuu la caatoobaa.
english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan iyaga u noqday cay, Oo kolkay i arkaan ayay madaxa ruxruxaan.
english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaahayow, i caawi, Oo igu badbaadi si naxariistaada waafaqsan,
english: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

kikuyu: Si ay u ogaadaan in tanu tahay shaqadii gacaantaada, Iyo inaad taas samaysay, Rabbiyow.
english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

kikuyu: Iyagu ha habaartameen, adiguse i barakee, Kolkay kacaan, way ceeboobi doonaan, laakiinse anigoo addoonkaaga ah waan rayrayn doonaa.
english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashaydu sharafdarro ha xidheen, Oo ceebtooda ha u huwadeen sida go' oo kale.
english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

kikuyu: Afkaygaan aad ugaga mahadnaqi doonaa Rabbiga, Haah, oo waxaan isaga ku ammaani doonaa dadka badan dhexdiisa.
english: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu isa soo taagi doonaa miskiinka midigtiisa, Si uu uga badbaadiyo kuwa naftiisa xukuma.
english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu Sayidkayga ku yidhi, Midigtayda fadhiiso, Ilaa aan cadaawayaashaada ka dhigo meeshaad cagahaaga saaratid.
english: A Psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu Siyoon ka soo diri doonaa ushii xooggaaga, Cadaawayaashaada dhexdooda ka tali.
english: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

kikuyu: Dadkaagu iyagoo raalli ah bay isbixiyaan maalintii xooggaaga, Iyagoo leh quruxda quduusnimada, ee ka timaada uurka waaberiga, Adigaa leh sayaxa dhallinyaranimadaada.
english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuu dhaartay, kana soo noqon maayo, oo wuxuu yidhi, Adigu weligaaba wadaad baad tahay, Sidii derejadii Malkisadaq.
english: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Sayidka midigtaada joogaa Wuxuu maalinta cadhadiisa dooxi doonaa boqorro.
english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

kikuyu: Isagu quruumaha dhexdooda ayuu wax ku xukumi doonaa, Oo meel walba wuxuu ka buuxin doonaa meydad, Oo waddammo badan ayuu madaxda ka dili doonaa.
english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Intuu jidka socdo ayuu durdurka ka cabbi doonaa, Oo sidaas daraaddeed ayuu madaxa kor u qaadi doonaa.
english: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Qalbigayga oo dhan ayaan Rabbiga ugaga mahadnaqi doonaa Guddiga kuwa qumman dhexdiisa iyo ururka dhexdiisaba.
english: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

kikuyu: Shuqullada Rabbigu way waaweyn yihiin, Oo waxaa doondoona kuwa ku faraxsan oo dhan.
english: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

kikuyu: Shuqulkiisu waa sharaf iyo haybad, Oo xaqnimadiisuna weligeedba way waartaa.
english: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ka dhigay in la sii xusuusto shuqulladiisa yaabka badan, Rabbigu waa nimco miidhan, oo waxaa ka buuxda raxmad.
english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

kikuyu: Wuxuu cunto siiyey kuwa isaga ka cabsada, Oo weligiisna wuxuu xusuusnaan doonaa axdigiisii.
english: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

kikuyu: Wuxuu dadkiisii tusay xooggii shuqulladiisa, Markii uu iyaga siiyey quruumaha dhaxalkoodii.
english: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

kikuyu: Shuqullada gacmihiisu waa run iyo garsoorid, Oo amarradiisa oo dhammuna waa hubaal.
english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

kikuyu: Way sii adag yihiin weligood iyo weligoodba, Oo waxaa lagu sameeyey run iyo qummanaan.
english: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

kikuyu: Wuxuu dadkiisa u soo diray furasho, Oo wuxuu amray in axdigiisu ahaado mid weligiisba waara, Magiciisu waa quduus, waana mid laga cabsado.
english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisu waa bilowga xigmadda, Kuwa sidaas yeela oo dhammu waxay leeyihiin waxgarasho wanaagsan, Ammaantiisu way waartaa weligeedba.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Waxaa barakaysan ninkii Rabbiga ka cabsada, Oo aad ugu farxa amarradiisa.
english: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.

kikuyu: Farcankiisu wuxuu ku xoog badnaan doonaa dhulka, Kuwa qumman farcankooduna wuu barakoobi doonaa.
english: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

kikuyu: Gurigiisa waxaa ku jira maal iyo taajirnimo, Xaqnimadiisuna weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Kuwa qumman iftiin baa gudcurka uga soo baxa, Isagu waa nimco miidhan, oo waxaa ka buuxda raxmad, waana xaq.
english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

kikuyu: Waxaa nimcaysan ninkii naxariis leh oo dadka wax amaahiya, Kaasu danihiisuu ku wadi doonaa caddaalad.
english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

kikuyu: Waayo, isaga weligiis lama dhaqaajin doono, Oo kii xaq ah weligiisba waa la xusuusan doonaa.
english: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

kikuyu: Isagu innaba kama cabsan doono war xun, Qalbigaa u fadhiya, oo wuxuu isku halleeyaa Rabbiga.
english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

kikuyu: Qalbigaa u fadhiya, oo ma uu cabsan doono, Ilaa uu wuxuu doonayay ku arko cadaawayaashiisa.
english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

kikuyu: Wax buu kala qaybshay, oo wuxuu wax siiyey kuwii baahnaa, Xaqnimadiisuna way sii waartaa weligeedba, Geeskiisana waxaa lagu sarraysiin doonaa sharaf.
english: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

kikuyu: Kii shar lahu wuu arki doonaa, wuuna cadhoon doonaa, Wuu ilko jirriqsan doonaa, oo wuu dhalaali doonaa, Kuwa sharka leh doonistoodu way baabbi'i doontaa.
english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Rabbiga addoommadiisow, ammaana. Rabbiga magiciisa ammaana.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Hadda intii ka bilaabata iyo tan iyo weligeedba Rabbiga magiciisu mahad ha lahaado.
english: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Qorraxdu markay soo baxdo iyo markay dhacdo inta ka dhex leh Magaca Rabbiga waa in la ammaano.
english: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

kikuyu: Rabbigu quruumaha oo dhan wuu ka wada sarreeyaa, Ammaantiisuna samooyinka way ka sii sarraysaa.
english: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

kikuyu: Bal yaa la mid ah Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah, Oo kursigiisa ku leh xagga sare,
english: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,

kikuyu: Oo hoos u eega Waxyaalaha samada ku jira iyo waxyaalaha dhulka yaalba?
english: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

kikuyu: Wuxuu miskiinka kor uga qaadaa ciidda, Oo kan baahanna wuxuu sara uga qaadaa meesha digada,
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

kikuyu: Inuu isaga la fadhiisiyo amiirro, Kuwaas oo ah amiirrada dadkiisa.
english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

kikuyu: Oo naagtii madhalays ahna wuxuu ka dhigaa inay reer hayso, Iyo inay ahaato hooyo faraxsan oo carruur leh. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Markay reer binu Israa'iil Masar ka soo bexeen, Oo ay reerkii Yacquub dad af qalaad ka soo bexeen,
english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

kikuyu: Ayaa Yahuudah noqday meeshiisa quduuska ah, Israa'iilna noqday meeshuu u talinayay.
english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

kikuyu: Baddii way aragtay, wayna carartay, Webi Urdunna dib baa loo celiyey.
english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

kikuyu: Buurihii waxay u boodboodeen sidii wanan, Kurihiina sidii baraar.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

kikuyu: Baddoy, bal maxaa kugu dhacay oo aad u cararaysaa? Webi Urdunow, maxaad dib ugu noqonaysaa?
english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

kikuyu: Buurahow, bal maxaad ugu boodboodaysaan sida wanan? Kuraha yaryarow, bal maxaad ugu boodboodaysaan sida baraar?
english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

kikuyu: Dhulkow, ku gariir Sayidka hortiisa, Ilaaha reer Yacquub hortiisa ku gariir,
english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

kikuyu: Kaas oo dhagaxii u beddelay balli biyo ah, Oo dhagaxmadowgiina u beddelay il biyo ah.
english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, yaanay noo ahaan, yaanay noo ahaan, Laakiinse magacaaga ammaani ha u ahaato, Naxariistaada iyo runtaada daraaddood.
english: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

kikuyu: Bal maxay quruumuhu u odhanayaan, Haddaba Ilaahoodu meeh?
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaahayagu samooyinkuu ku jiraa, Oo wax alla wixii uu doonayayna wuu sameeyey.
english: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

kikuyu: Sanamyadoodu waa lacag iyo dahab, Oo waa wax dad gacmaha ku sameeyey.
english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: Waxay leeyihiin af, laakiinse ma hadlaan, Indhona way leeyihiin, laakiinse waxba ma arkaan,
english: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

kikuyu: Dhegona way leeyihiin, laakiinse waxba ma maqlaan, Sanna way leeyihiin, laakiinse waxba ma urshaan,
english: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

kikuyu: Gacmo way leeyihiin, laakiinse waxba ma qabtaan, Cagona way leeyihiin, laakiinse ma socdaan, Oo hungurigoodana hadal kama soo saaraan.
english: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

kikuyu: Kuwa iyaga sameeyaana sidooda oo kale ayay noqon doonaan, Iyo xataa mid kasta oo iyaga isku halleeyaba.
english: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iilow, Rabbiga isku halleeya, Isagu waa caawimaaddooda iyo gaashaankooda.
english: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Reer Haaruunow, Rabbiga isku halleeya, Isagu waa caawimaaddooda iyo gaashaankooda.
english: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna Rabbiga ka cabsadow, Rabbiga isku halleeya, Isagu waa caawimaaddooda iyo gaashaankooda.
english: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Rabbigu aad buu inoo xusuusnaa, wuu ina barakayn doonaa, Reerka Israa'iilna wuu barakayn doonaa, Reerka Haaruunna wuu barakayn doonaa.
english: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna barakayn doonaa kuwa Rabbiga ka cabsada, Yar iyo weynba.
english: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

kikuyu: Rabbigu aad iyo aad ha idiin kordhiyo, Idinka iyo carruurtiinnaba.
english: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.

kikuyu: Rabbiga sameeyey samada iyo dhulka Ayaa idin barakeeyey.
english: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Samooyinku waa samooyinkii Rabbiga, Laakiinse dhulka wuxuu siiyey binu-aadmiga.
english: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

kikuyu: Kuwii dhintay Rabbiga ma ay ammaanaan, Kuwa hoos ugu dhaadhaca meesha aamusnaantana ma ay ammaanaan isaga,
english: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,

kikuyu: Laakiinse annagu Rabbiga waannu ammaani doonnaa Haatan intii ka bilaabata iyo tan iyo weligeedba. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga waan jeclahay, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu maqlay Codkaygii iyo baryootankaygii.
english: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

kikuyu: Dhegtuu ii dhigay, Sidaas daraaddeed isagaan baryi doonaa intaan noolahay oo dhan.
english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

kikuyu: Xadhkihii dhimashada ayaa i hareereeyey, Xanuunkii She'oolna waa i qabsaday. Oo waxaan la kulmay dhib iyo murug.
english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

kikuyu: Markaasaan ku baryootamay magaca Rabbiga, Anigoo leh, Rabbiyow, naftayda samatabbixi.
english: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa nimco miidhan, waana xaq, Haah, oo Ilaaheennu waa naxariis badan yahay.
english: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

kikuyu: Rabbigu kuwa garaadka daran wuu dhawraa, Hoos baa la ii soo dejiyey, kolkaasuu i badbaadshay.
english: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

kikuyu: Naftaydoy, nasashadaadii ku noqo, Waayo, Rabbigu wax badan oo wanaagsan buu kuu sameeyey.
english: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

kikuyu: Waayo, naftayda waxaad ka samatabbixisay dhimasho, Indhahaygana ilmo, Cagahaygana kufid.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku socon doonaa Rabbiga hortiisa Anigoo dhex jooga dalka kuwa nool.
english: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Waan rumaysnaa, oo markaan hadlay Aad baa la ii dhibay,
english: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

kikuyu: Anigoo degdegsan baan waxaan idhi, Dadka oo dhammu waa beenaalayaal.
english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

kikuyu: Bal maxaan Rabbiga uga celiyaa Waxyaalihii uu ii taray oo dhan?
english: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

kikuyu: Waxaan qaadan doonaa koobka badbaadada, Oo magaca Rabbiga ayaan ku baryootami doonaa.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ayaan u oofin doonaa nidarradaydii, Oo weliba waxaan ku bixin doonaa dadkiisa oo dhan hortooda.
english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.

kikuyu: Rabbiga hortiisa dhimashada quduusiintiisa Ayaa qiimo weyn ku leh.
english: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, sida runta ah waxaan ahay addoonkaaga, Waxaan ahay addoonkaaga, oo ah wiilka addoontaada, Silsiladahaygii waad iga furtay.
english: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

kikuyu: Waxaan kuu soo bixin doonaa allabarigii mahadnaqidda, Oo magaca Rabbiga ayaan ku baryootami doonaa.
english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ayaan u oofin doonaa nidarradaydii, Oo weliba waxaan ku bixin doonaa dadkiisa oo dhan hortooda,
english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,

kikuyu: Iyo guriga Rabbiga barxadihiisa, Iyo dhexdaada, Yeruusaalemay. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Quruumaha oo dhammow, Rabbiga ammaana, Dadyowga oo dhammow, ammaana isaga.
english: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

kikuyu: Waayo, naxariistiisu xaggeenna waa ku weyn tahay, Rabbiga runtiisuna weligeedba way waartaa. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku mahadnaqa, maxaa yeelay, isagu waa wanaagsan yahay, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way waartaa.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Haddaba reer binu Israa'iil ha yidhaahdeen, Naxariistiisu weligeedba way waartaa.
english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Oo reerka Haaruun hadda ha yidhaahdeen, Naxariistiisu weligeedba way waartaa.
english: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa Rabbiga ka cabsadaa hadda ha yidhaahdeen, Naxariistiisu weligeedba way waartaa.
english: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Anigoo cidhiidhi ku jira ayaan Rabbiga u qayshaday, Markaasaa Rabbigu ii jawaabay, oo wuxuu i taagay meel ballaadhan.
english: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa ila jiraa, oo anigu ma cabsan doono, Bal maxaa dad igu samayn karaa?
english: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa ila jiraa, oo wuxuu ku dhex jiraa kuwa i caawinaya, Haddaba waxaan kuwa i neceb ku arki doonaa waxaan doonayo.
english: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

kikuyu: Intii dad lagu kalsoonaan lahaa Waxaa ka wanaagsan in Rabbiga laysku halleeyo.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

kikuyu: Intii amiirro lagu kalsoonaan lahaa Waxaa ka wanaagsan in Rabbiga laysku halleeyo.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

kikuyu: Quruumihii oo dhammu way i wada hareereeyeen, Oo anna magaca Rabbiga ayaan ku baabbi'in doonaa.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: Way i hareereeyeen, haah, oo way i hareereeyeen, Oo anna magaca Rabbiga ayaan ku baabbi'in doonaa.
english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.

kikuyu: Waxay ii hareereeyeen sida shinni oo kale, oo iyaga waxaa loo demiyey sida dabka qodxanta oo kale, Oo anna magaca Rabbiga ayaan ku baabbi'in doonaa.
english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: Adigu aad baad igu mudday si aan u dhaco aawadeed, Laakiinse Rabbigaa i caawiyey.
english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa xooggayga iyo gabaygayga, Oo wuxuu ii noqday badbaadadayda.
english: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaq ah teendhooyinkooda waxaa ku jira codkii rayraynta iyo badbaadada, Gacanta midig oo Rabbiguna wax xoog leh bay samaysaa.
english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

kikuyu: Gacanta midig oo Rabbiga waa la sarraysiiyey, Gacanta midig oo Rabbiguna wax xoog leh bay samaysaa.
english: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”

kikuyu: Anigu ma dhiman doono, laakiinse waan noolaan doonaa, Oo waxaan sheegi doonaa shuqullada Rabbiga.
english: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

kikuyu: Rabbigu aad buu ii edbiyey, Laakiinse dhimasho iima uu dhiibin.
english: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

kikuyu: Irdaha xaqnimada iga fura, Oo anna waan geli doonaa, oo Rabbigaan ku mahadnaqi doonaa.
english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

kikuyu: Tanu waa iriddii Rabbiga, Oo waxaa geli doona kuwa xaqa ah.
english: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.

kikuyu: Waan kugu mahadnaqi doonaa, waayo, waad ii jawaabtay, Oo waxaad ii noqotay badbaadadayda.
english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

kikuyu: Dhagaxii kuwa wax dhisaa ay diideen, Kaasu wuxuu noqday madaxa rukunka.
english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

kikuyu: Tanu xagga Rabbiga bay ka timid, Oo waa ku yaab indhahayaga.
english: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

kikuyu: Tanu waa maalinta Rabbigu sameeyey, Waannu rayrayn doonnaa oo waannu farxi doonnaa.
english: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waan ku baryaynaaye, haatan na badbaadi, Oo waan ku baryaynaaye, Rabbiyow, haatan barwaaqo noo soo dir.
english: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kan Rabbiga magiciisa ku imanaya, Waxaannu idinka ammaannay guriga Rabbiga.
english: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa Ilaah, oo wuxuu na siiyey iftiin, Allabariga xadhko ku xidha tan iyo meesha allabariga geeseheeda.
english: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

kikuyu: Waxaad tahay Ilaahay, oo anna waan kugu mahadnaqi doonaa, Waxaad tahay Ilaahay, oo waan ku sarraysiin doonaa.
english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku mahadnaqa, waayo, isagu waa wanaagsan yahay, Oo naxariistiisuna weligeedba way waartaa.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa jidka ku qumman, Oo sharciga Rabbiga ku socda.
english: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa dhawra markhaatifurkiisa, Oo Rabbiga ku doondoona qalbiga oo dhan.
english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

kikuyu: Haah, oo xaqdarro ma sameeyaan, Jidadkiisase way ku socdaan.
english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

kikuyu: Waxaad nagu amartay amarradaada, Inaan aad u dhawrno.
english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

kikuyu: Aad baan u jeclaan lahaa in jidadkayga la hagaajiyo Inaan qaynuunnada dhawro!
english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

kikuyu: Markaas anigu ceeboobi maayo, Markaan dhawro amarradaada oo dhan.
english: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

kikuyu: Markaan barto xukummadaada xaqa ah Ayaan qummanaanta qalbiga kuugu mahadnaqi doonaa.
english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

kikuyu: Waxaan dhawri doonaa qaynuunnadaada, Rabbow, ha i dayrin weligay.
english: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

kikuyu: Bal nin dhallinyaro ahu muxuu jidkiisa ku nadiifiyaa? Waa inuu aad ugu fiirsado si eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

kikuyu: Waxaan kugu doondoonay qalbigayga oo dhan, Yaanan amarradaada ka leexan.
english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Waxaan eraygaagii qalbigayga ugu kaydsaday Si aanan kuugu dembaabin.
english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigaa mahad leh, Haddaba qaynuunnadaada i bar.
english: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Waxaan bushimahayga ku sheegay Xukummadii afkaaga oo dhan.
english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku reyreeyey jidka markhaatifurkaaga, Sidaan ugu rayrayn lahaa taajirnimada oo dhan.
english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

kikuyu: Waxaan aad ugu fiirsan doonaa amarradaada, Oo jidadkaagaan dhawri doonaa.
english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

kikuyu: Qaynuunnadaada waan ku farxi doonaa, Eraygaagana ma illoobi doono.
english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

kikuyu: Anoo addoonkaaga ah wax badan oo wanaagsan ii samee, si aan u noolaado, Oo sidaasaan eraygaaga u dhawri doonaa.
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

kikuyu: Indhahayga fur Si aan waxyaalo yaab badan sharcigaaga uga arko.
english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

kikuyu: Socotaan dhulka ku ahay, Haddaba amarradaada ha iga qarin.
english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay u xiisootay Jacaylkay had iyo goorba u qabto xukummadaada.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

kikuyu: Waxaad canaanatay kuwa kibirsan oo inkaaran, Oo amarrada ka leexda.
english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Cay iyo ceeb iga fogee, Waayo, markhaatifurkaaga waan xajiyey,
english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

kikuyu: Oo weliba amiirraa fadhiistay oo wax iga gees ah ka wada hadlay, Laakiinse anoo addoonkaaga ah aad baan uga fiirsaday qaynuunnadaada.
english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

kikuyu: Markhaatifurkaagu waa waxa iga farxiya, Waana lataliyayaashayda.
english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay ku dhegtaa ciidda, Haddaba ii noolee si eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

kikuyu: Waxaan kuu sheegay jidadkaygii, oo adna waad ii jawaabtay, Bal qaynuunnadaada i bar.
english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Jidka amarradaada i garansii, Oo sidaasaan aad ugu fiirsan doonaa shuqulladaada yaabka badan.
english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay la dhacdaa murug, Haddaba ii xoogee si eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

kikuyu: Jidka beenta iga fogee, Oo si raxmad leh sharcigaaga ii sii.
english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

kikuyu: Waxaan doortay jidka aaminnimadaada, Oo waxaan hortayda dhigay xukummadaadii.
english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

kikuyu: Markhaatifurkaaga waan xajiyaa, Rabbiyow, ha i ceebayn.
english: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku ordi doonaa jidka amarradaada Markii aad qalbigayga ballaadhisid.
english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, jidka qaynuunnadaada i bar, Waanan xajin doonaa tan iyo ugu dambaysta.
english: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

kikuyu: Waxgarasho i sii, oo anna sharcigaaga waan xajin doonaa, Haah, oo waxaan ku dhawri doonaa qalbigayga oo dhan.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

kikuyu: Igu kexee waddada amarradaada, Waayo, kaasaan ku farxaa.
english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

kikuyu: Qalbigayga u soo jeedi xagga markhaatifurkaaga, Oo ha u leexin xagga faa'iidada xaqdarrada ah.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

kikuyu: Indhahayga inay fiiriyaan wax aan micne lahayn ka sii jeedi, Oo jidadkaaga igu noolee.
english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

kikuyu: Eraygaaga ii xaqiiji anoo addoonkaaga ah Oo doonaya inaan kaa cabsado.
english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

kikuyu: Caydayda aan ka cabsanayo iga leexi, Waayo, xukummadaadu waa wanaagsan yihiin.
english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxaan u xiisooday amarradaada, Haddaba xaqnimadaada igu soo noolee.
english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, naxariistaada iyo weliba badbaadintaadu Ha iigu yimaadeen si eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.

kikuyu: Markaasaan jawaab u heli doonaa kan i caaya, Waayo, waxaan isku halleeyaa eraygaaga.
english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

kikuyu: Oo erayga runta ahna dhammaantiis afkayga ha ka gooyn, Waayo, waxaan rajo ku qabay xukummadaada.
english: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

kikuyu: Markaasaan had iyo goorba dhawri doonaa sharcigaaga Weligay iyo weligayba.
english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan ku socon doonaa xorriyad, Waayo, waxaan doondoonay amarradaada.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan markhaatifurkaaga ka sheegi doonaa boqorro hortooda, Mana ceeboobi doono.
english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan ku farxi doonaa amarradaada Aan jeclaaday.
english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan gacmaha u hoorsan doonaa amarradaada aan jeclaaday, Oo aad baan ugu fiirsan doonaa qaynuunnadaada.
english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

kikuyu: Xusuuso eraygii aad anoo addoonkaaga ah igula hadashay, Oo aad igu rajo gelisay.
english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

kikuyu: Oo taasu waa i qalbi qaboojisaa markii aan dhibaataysnahay, Waayo, eraygaagaa i soo nooleeyey.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

kikuyu: Kuwa kibirsan aad bay iigu qosleen, Laakiinse sharcigaaga kama aan leexan.
english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, tan iyo mar hore waxaan soo xusuusnaa xukummadaada, Waanan isqalbi qaboojiyey.
english: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.

kikuyu: Aad baan u xanaaqay, Waana kuwa sharka leh oo sharcigaaga ka tegey aawadood.
english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

kikuyu: Qaynuunnadaadu waxay ii ahaayeen heeso Markaan ku jiray gurigii aan socotada ku ahaa.
english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, habeenkaan magacaaga soo xusuustay, Oo sharcigaagaan dhawray.
english: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.

kikuyu: Taasu waa ii ahaatay, Maxaa yeelay, amarradaadii baan xajiyey.
english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa qaybtayda, Oo anigu waxaan idhi, Waxaan dhawrayaa erayadaada.
english: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

kikuyu: Qalbigayga oo dhan ayaan kugu baryay inaad raalli iga ahaato, Si eraygaaga waafaqsan iigu naxariiso.
english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

kikuyu: Waxaan ka fikiray jidadkayga, Kolkaasaan cagahayga u soo duway xagga markhaatifurkaaga.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

kikuyu: Waan u degdegay, oo kama aan raagin Inaan amarradaada dhawro.
english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

kikuyu: Waxaa isku kay duudduubay xadhkihii kuwa sharka leh, Laakiinse sharcigaaga ma aan illoobin.
english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Waxaan kici doonaa habeenbadhka inaan kugu mahadnaqo, Waana xukummadaada caddaaladda ah daraaddood.
english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan wehel la ahay kuwa kaa cabsada oo dhan, Iyo kuwa amarradaada dhawraba.
english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, dhulka waxaa ka buuxda naxariistaada, Haddaba qaynuunnadaada i bar.
english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, anoo addoonkaaga ah waxaad iila macaamilootay Si wanaagsan oo eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.

kikuyu: Haddaba i bar kaladoorasho wanaagsan iyo aqoon, Waayo, waxaan rumaystay amarradaada.
english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

kikuyu: Intaan lay dhibin ka hor ayaan ambaday, Laakiinse haatan eraygaaga waan dhawraa.
english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

kikuyu: Waad wanaagsan tahay, oo wanaag baad samaysaa, Haddaba qaynuunnadaada i bar.
english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Kuwa kibirka lahu been bay iga sheegeen, Aniguse amarradaada ayaan ku xajin doonaa qalbigayga oo dhan.
english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

kikuyu: Qalbigoodu wuu qallafsanaaday, Aniguse waxaan ku farxaa sharcigaaga.
english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

kikuyu: Waa ii wanaagsanayd in lay dhibo, Si aan qaynuunnadaada u barto.
english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

kikuyu: Sharciga afkaagu waa iiga sii fiican yahay Kumanyaal dahab iyo lacag ah.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

kikuyu: Waxaa i sameeyey oo i qabanqaabiyey gacmahaaga, Haddaba i sii waxgarasho aan amarradaada ku barto.
english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

kikuyu: Kuwa kaa cabsadaa way i arki doonaan, wayna farxi doonaan, Maxaa yeelay, waxaan rajo ku qabay eraygaaga.
english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waan ogahay in xukummadaadu ay xaq yihiin, Iyo inaad aaminnimo igu dhibtay.
english: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

kikuyu: Waan ku baryayaaye raxmaddaadu ha ii noqoto qalbiqaboojin Si waafaqsan eraygii aad anoo addoonkaaga ah igula hadashay.
english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

kikuyu: Naxariistaadu ha ii timaado si aan u noolaado, Waayo, waxaa iga farxiya sharcigaaga.
english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Kuwa kibirka lahu ha ceeboobeen, waayo, si gardarro ah ayay igu afgembiyeen, Aniguse waxaan aad uga fiirsan doonaa amarradaada.
english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

kikuyu: Kuwa kaa cabsadaa ha ii soo noqdeen, Oo waxay ogaan doonaan markhaatifurkaaga.
english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

kikuyu: Qalbigaygu qaynuunnadaada ha ku qummanaado, Si aanan u ceeboobin.
english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

kikuyu: Naftaydu waa u taag darnaataa badbaadintaada aan u xiisoodo aawadeed, Laakiinse eraygaagaan rajo ku qabaa.
english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Sidii aan u lahaa, Goormaad i qalbi qaboojinaysaa? Ayaa indhahaygu u gudheen eraygaaga aawadiis.
english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan noqday sidii sibraar qiiq ku dhex jiro, Laakiinse innaba qaynuunnadaada ma aan illoobo.
english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

kikuyu: Anoo addoonkaaga ah cimrigaygu waa intee? Oo goormaad xukun ku soo dejinaysaa kuwa i silciya?
english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

kikuyu: Kuwa kibirka leh oo aan sharcigaaga waafaqsanayn Ayaa ii qoday godad.
english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

kikuyu: Amarradaada oo dhammu waa wada daacad, Si gardarro ah ayay ii silciyaan, haddaba i caawi,
english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

kikuyu: Dhulka ayay iga baabbi'in gaadheen, Aniguse kama aan tegin amarradaadii.
english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

kikuyu: Raxmaddaada igu soo noolee, Oo anna waxaan dhawri doonaa markhaatifurka afkaaga.
english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, eraygaagu weligiisba Wuxuu taagan yahay samada.
english: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.

kikuyu: Aaminnimadaaduna waxay gaadhaa tan iyo ka ab ka ab; Dhulkaad dhistay, wuuna sii jirayaa.
english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

kikuyu: Maantadan waxay u joogaan si qaynuunnadaada waafaqsan, Waayo, wax waluba waa addoommadaada.
english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

kikuyu: Haddaanu sharcigaagu iga farxin, Waxaan kol hore ku halligmi lahaa dhibaatadii i haysatay.
english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

kikuyu: Weligay amarradaada ma aan illoobi doono, Waayo, iyagaad igu soo noolaysay.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay kaaga, haddaba i badbaadi, Waayo, waxaan doondoonay amarradaada.
english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu way ii sugeen inay i baabbi'iyaan, Aniguse waxaan ka fiirsan doonaa markhaatifurkaaga.
english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

kikuyu: Waxaan arkay in wax kasta oo kaamil ah ay dhammaad leeyihiin, Amarkaaguse aad buu u ballaadhan yahay.
english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM

kikuyu: Aad baan sharcigaaga u jeclahay! Maalinta oo dhan isagaan u fiirsadaa.
english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

kikuyu: Amarradaadu waxay iga dhigaan ku ka sii caqli badan cadaawayaashayda. Waayo, weligayba way ila jiraan.
english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

kikuyu: Waan ka sii waxgarasho badnahay macallimiintayda oo dhan, Waayo, waxaan u fiirsadaa markhaatifurkaaga.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

kikuyu: Waan ka sii waxgarasho badnahay odayaasha, Waayo, waxaan xajiyey amarradaada.
english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

kikuyu: Cagahayga waan ka joojiyey jid kasta oo shar leh, Si aan eraygaaga u dhawro.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

kikuyu: Xukummadaada gees ugama aan leexan, Waayo, wax baad i bartay.
english: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

kikuyu: Erayadaadu dhanxanaggayga u macaan badanaa! Afkayga malab way uga sii macaan badan yihiin!
english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

kikuyu: Amarradaada ayaan waxgarasho ku helaa, Oo sidaas daraaddeed ayaan jid kasta oo been ah u necbahay.
english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

kikuyu: Eraygaagu wuxuu cagahayga u yahay laambad, Waddooyinkaygana iftiin.
english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku dhaartay oo aan weliba xaqiijiyey Inaan dhawrayo xukummadaada xaqa ah.
english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Aad iyo aad baan u dhibaataysnahay, Haddaba Rabbiyow, igu soo noolee si eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waan ku baryayaaye, aqbal qurbaannada ikhtiyaarka ah oo afkayga, Xukummadaadana i bar.
english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.

kikuyu: Naftaydu had iyo goorba waxay ku jirtaa khatar, Habase yeeshee sharcigaaga ma illoobo.
english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu waxay ii dhigeen dabin, Laakiinse amarradaada kama aan amban.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

kikuyu: Markhaatifurkaaga waxaan u qaatay sida dhaxal weligiis waaraya, Waayo, kaasu waxa weeye waxa qalbigaygu ku reyreeya.
english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

kikuyu: Qalbigayga waxaan u jeediyey inaan qaynuunnadaada oofiyo, Tan iyo weligay iyo ilaa ugu dambaysta.
english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

kikuyu: Waan necbahay kuwa labada qalbi leh, Laakiinse sharcigaaga waan jeclahay.
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

kikuyu: Waxaad tahay gabbaadkayga iyo gaashaankayga, Oo waxaan rajo ku qabaa eraygaaga.
english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna xumaanta falow, iga taga, Si aan amarrada Ilaahayga u xajiyo.
english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ii tiiri si eraygaaga waafaqsan si aan u noolaado, Oo yaanan rajadayda ku ceeboobin.
english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

kikuyu: Kor ii hay, oo waan badbaadi doonaa, Oo had iyo goorba waxaan u fiirsan doonaa qaynuunnadaada.
english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

kikuyu: Kuwa qaynuunnadaada ka habaabay oo dhan waad fudaydsatay, Waayo, khiyaanadoodu waa wax been ah.
english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka leh oo dhulka oo dhan waxaad u fogaysaa sida wasakh oo kale, Oo sidaas daraaddeed baan markhaatifurkaaga u jeclahay.
english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

kikuyu: Jidhkaygu wuxuu la gariiraa cabsidaada, Oo waxaan ka baqaa xukummadaada.
english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

kikuyu: Waxaan sameeyey xukun iyo caddaalad, Haddaba ha iiga tegin kuwa i dulma.
english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

kikuyu: Anoo addoonkaaga ah wanaag daraaddiis ii dammiino, Oo kuwa kibirsanu yaanay i dulmin.
english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

kikuyu: Indhahaygii waxay u gudheen jacaylkay badbaadintaada u qabaan, Iyo eraygaaga xaqa ah daraaddiis.
english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

kikuyu: Anoo addoonkaaga ah iila macaamilow si naxariistaada waafaqsan, Oo qaynuunnadaada i bar.
english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Waxaan ahay addoonkaaga, haddaba waxgarasho i sii, Si aan markhaatifurkaaga u ogaado.
english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

kikuyu: Waa wakhtiga aad shaqayn lahayd, Rabbiyow, Waayo, sharcigaaga way buriyeen.
english: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.

kikuyu: Haddaba amarradaada waan ka sii jeclahay Dahab, haah, xataa dahab saafi ah.
english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed amarradaada oo dhammu waxay ila yihiin wax hagaagsan, Oo waan necbahay jid kasta oo been ah.
english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

kikuyu: Markhaatifurkaagu waa yaab badan yahay, Oo sidaas daraaddeed ayay naftaydu u xajisaa.
english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

kikuyu: Erayadaada furniinkoodu wax buu iftiimiyaa, Oo wuxuu waxgarasho siiyaa kuwa garaadka daran.
english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

kikuyu: Afka aad baan u kala qaaday, oo waan harraaday, Waayo, waxaan u xiisooday amarradaada.
english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

kikuyu: Ii soo jeeso, oo ii naxariiso, Sidaad kuwa magacaaga jecel u samaysid.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

kikuyu: Tallaabooyinkayga ku toosi eraygaaga, Oo dembina yaanu ii talin.
english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

kikuyu: Dadka dulmigiisa iga bixi, Oo anna waxaan dhawri doonaa amarradaada.
english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

kikuyu: Anoo addoonkaaga ah wejigaaga iigu iftiimi, Oo qaynuunnadaada i bar.
english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Indhahayga waxaa ka shubma durdurro biyo ah, Maxaa yeelay, sharcigaaga lama dhawrin.
english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, xaq baad tahay, Oo xukummadaaduna waa qumman yihiin.
english: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.

kikuyu: Markhaatifurkaaga waxaad ku amartay xaqnimo Iyo daacadnimo oo dhan.
english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

kikuyu: Waxaa i baabba'shay qiirada aan kuu qabo, Maxaa yeelay, cadaawayaashaydu waxay illoobeen erayadaada.
english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

kikuyu: Eraygaagu aad buu u daahirsan yahay, Sidaas daraaddeed anoo addoonkaaga ah waan jeclahay.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

kikuyu: Anigu waan yarahay, oo waa lay quudhsadaa, Laakiinse amarradaada ma illoobo.
english: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

kikuyu: Xaqnimadaadu waa xaqnimo weligeed sii waaraysa, Oo sharcigaaguna waa run.
english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

kikuyu: Dhib iyo cidhiidhi baa i qabsaday. Laakiinse amarradaadu waa waxa iga farxiya.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

kikuyu: Markhaatifurkaagu weligiisba waa xaq, Haddaba waxgarasho i sii, oo anna waan sii noolaan doonaa.
english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH

kikuyu: Waxaan ku qayshaday qalbigayga oo dhan, haddaba Rabbiyow, ii jawaab, Oo anna waxaan xajin doonaa qaynuunnadaada.
english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.

kikuyu: Waan kuu qayshaday ee i badbaadi, Oo markhaatifurkaaga waan dhawri doonaa.
english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

kikuyu: Waan ka soo hor maray waaga berigiisii, oo waan qayliyey, Oo waxaan rajo ku qabay erayadaada.
english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

kikuyu: Indhahaygu way ka hor mareen wakhtiga la soo jeedo oo habeennimo, Si aan eraygaaga uga fikiro.
english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

kikuyu: Codkayga u maqal si raxmaddaada waafaqsan, Rabbiyow, igu soo noolee si xukummadaada waafaqsan.
english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: Kuwii xumaatada raaci jiray way soo dhowaanayaan, Iyagu sharcigaaga way ka fog yihiin.
english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigu waad dhow dahay, Oo amarradaada oo dhammuna waa wada run.
english: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.

kikuyu: Waxaan markhaatifurkaaga waa hore ka iqiin Inaad u aasaastay si ay weligood u sii waaraan.
english: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH

kikuyu: Dhibaatadayda ka fiirso oo i samatabbixi, Waayo, anigu sharcigaaga ma illoobo.
english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Dacwadayda ii muddac, oo i soo furo, Igu soo noolee si eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka leh badbaadadu waa ka fog tahay, Waayo, qaynuunnadaada ma ay doondoonaan.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu waa badan tahay, Igu soo noolee si xukummadaada waafaqsan.
english: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: Kuwa i silciya iyo cadaawayaashayduba way badan yihiin, Laakiinse anigu kama aan leexan markhaatifurkaaga.
english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

kikuyu: Waxaan arkay khaa'innada, kolkaasaan murugooday, Maxaa yeelay, iyagu eraygaaga ma ay dhawraan.
english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

kikuyu: Bal ka fiirso sida aan amarradaada u jeclahay, Rabbiyow, igu soo noolee si raxmaddaada waafaqsan.
english: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Eraygaaga dhammaantiisu waa run, Mid kasta oo xukummadaada xaqa ah ka mid ahu wuu sii waaraa weligiisba.
english: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN

kikuyu: Amiirraa sababla'aan ii silciyey, Laakiinse qalbigaygu wuxuu ka baqaa erayadaada.
english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

kikuyu: Waxaan eraygaaga ugu reyreeyaa Sidii mid booli badan helay.
english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

kikuyu: Beenta waan necbahay oo waan karahsaday, Laakiinse sharcigaaga waan jeclahay.
english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

kikuyu: Maalintiiba toddoba jeer baan ku ammaanaa, Waana xukummadaada xaqa ah daraaddood.
english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharcigaaga jecelu waxay haystaan nabad weyn, Oo wax iyaga turuntureeyaa ma jiraan.
english: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, badbaadintaada waan u xiisooday, Oo amarradaadiina waan oofiyey.
english: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay dhawrtay markhaatifurkaaga, Oo anna aad iyo aad baan u jeclahay.
english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

kikuyu: Waxaan dhawray amarradaada iyo markhaatifurkaaga, Waayo, jidadkayga oo dhammu hortaaday wada yaalliin.
english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, qayladaydu ha ku soo dhowaato hortaada, Oo waxgarasho ii sii si eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.

kikuyu: Baryootankaygu hortaada ha yimaado, Oo ii samatabbixi si eraygaaga waafaqsan.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

kikuyu: Bushimahaygu ammaan ha ku hadleen, Waayo, waxaad i bartaa qaynuunnadaada.
english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Carrabkaygu ha ku gabyo eraygaaga, Waayo, amarradaada oo dhammu waa wada xaqnimo.
english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

kikuyu: Gacantaadu diyaar ha u ahaato inay i caawiso, Waayo, amarradaadaan doortay.
english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, badbaadintaada, waan u xiisooday, Oo sharcigaaguna waa waxa iga farxiya.
english: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Naftaydu ha iska noolaato, wayna ku ammaani doontaa, Oo xukummadaaduna ha i caawiyaan.
english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

kikuyu: Waxaan u hallaabay sidii lax luntay, haddaba anigoo addoonkaaga ah i doondoon, Waayo, amarradaada ma aan illoobo.
english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

kikuyu: Anigoo cidhiidhi ku jira ayaan Rabbiga u qayshaday, Oo isna wuu ii jawaabay.
english: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, naftayda ka samatabbixi bushimo been sheega, Iyo carrab khiyaano badan.
english: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

kikuyu: Carrabka khiyaanada badanow, bal maxaa lagu siin doonaa? Oo maxaa kaloo laguu samayn doonaa?
english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

kikuyu: Adoo ah sida ku xoog badan oo fallaadhihiisa afaysan, Kuwaas oo wata dhuxulo geed rotem la yidhaahdo.
english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

kikuyu: Anaa hoogay, waayo, Mesheg baan qariib ku noqday, Oo waxaan dhex degay teendhooyinkii Qedaar!
english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay wakhti dheer la degganayd Mid nabadda neceb.
english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

kikuyu: Waxaan ahay mid nabad jecel, Laakiinse kolkii aan hadlo, iyagu waa kuwa dagaal jecel.
english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

kikuyu: Buurahaan indhahayga ku taagi doonaa, Caawimaaddaydu xaggee bay ka iman doontaa?
english: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

kikuyu: Caawimaaddaydu waxay ka timaadaa Rabbiga sameeyey samada iyo dhulka.
english: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Isagu uma oggolaan doono in cagtaada la dhaqaajiyo, Kan ku dhawraa ma gam'i doono.
english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, kan reer binu Israa'iil dhawraa Ma gam'i doono, mana seexan doono.
english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

kikuyu: Kan ku dhawraa waa Rabbiga, Rabbigu waa hooskaaga midigtaada taagan.
english: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

kikuyu: Qorraxdu maalinta waxba kuma yeeli doonto. Habeenkana dayaxu waxba kuma yeeli doono.
english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ayaa kaa dhawri doona shar kasta, Isagu wuxuu dhawri doonaa naftaada.
english: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

kikuyu: Hadda intii ka bilaabata iyo tan iyo weligeedba Rabbigu wuxuu dhawri doonaa bixiddaada iyo soo geliddaadaba.
english: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

kikuyu: Waan farxay markay igu yidhaahdeen, Ina keena, aan guriga Rabbiga tagnee.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”

kikuyu: Yeruusaalemay, cagahayagu Waxay taagan yihiin irdahaaga gudahooda,
english: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

kikuyu: Yeruusaalem waxaa loo dhisay Sida magaalo isku wada dheggan,
english: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

kikuyu: Halkaasay qabiilooyinka, oo ah qabiilooyinka Rabbigu kor ugu baxaan Inay Israa'iil u marag furaan, Iyo inay magaca Rabbiga ku mahadnaqaan.
english: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa yaalla carshiyo garsoorid loo dhigay, Waana carshiyadii reerka Daa'uud.
english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

kikuyu: Yeruusaalem nabad ugu duceeya. Kuwa ku jecelu way barwaaqoobi doonaan.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

kikuyu: Nabadu ha ku jirto derbiyadaada gudahooda, Barwaaqona ha ku jirto daarahaaga dhaadheer.
english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

kikuyu: Walaalahay iyo rafiiqyadayda daraaddood Ayaan hadda waxaan odhanayaa, Nabadu gudahaaga ha ku jirto.
english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaahayaga gurigiisa daraaddiis Ayaan wanaaggaaga u doondooni doonaa.
english: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

kikuyu: Kaaga samooyinka dhex fadhiyow, Adigaan indhahayga kor kuugu taagaa.
english: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, sida ay indhaha addoommadu u fiiriyaan gacanta sayidkooda, Iyo sida ay gabadh indhaheedu u fiiriyaan gacanta sayidaddeeda Ayay indhahayagu u fiiriyaan Rabbiga Ilaahayaga ah, Ilaa uu noo naxariisto.
english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso, annaga noo naxariiso, Waayo, waxaa aad nooga buuxda quudhsasho.
english: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

kikuyu: Naftayadii waxaa aad uga batay Qosolka kuwa istareexsan Iyo quudhsashadii kuwa kibirsan.
english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

kikuyu: Haddaan Rabbigu inala jirin Hadda reer binu Israa'iil ha yidhaahdeen,
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,

kikuyu: Haddaan Rabbigu inala jirin, Markii dadku inagu kacay,
english: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

kikuyu: Kolkaasay innagoo noolnool ina wada liqliqi lahaayeen, Markay aad inoogu cadhoodeen,
english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

kikuyu: Kolkaasay biyuhu ina qarqin lahaayeen, Durdurna nafteennuu dul mari lahaa,
english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

kikuyu: Oo kolkaasay biyaha kibirsanu nafteenna dul mari lahaayeen.
english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

kikuyu: Waxaa mahad leh Rabbiga Aan inaga dhigin ugaadh ilkahoodu ay qabsadaan.
english: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

kikuyu: Nafteennu waxay u baxsatay sida shimbir uga baxsato dabinka shimbirrodabtaha, Dabinkii wuu go'ay, innaguna waynu baxsannay.
english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

kikuyu: Caawimaaddeennu waxay ku jirtaa magaca Rabbiga Sameeyey samada iyo dhulkaba.
english: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Kuwa Rabbiga isku halleeyaa Waa sida Buur Siyoon oo aan la dhaqaajin karin, laakiinse weligeedba sii jirta.
english: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

kikuyu: Sida buuruhu Yeruusaalem ugu wareegsan yihiin Ayuu Rabbigu dadkiisa ugu wareegsan yahay, Hadda intii ka bilaabata iyo tan iyo weligeedba.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Waayo, usha xumaantu ku dhici mayso qaybta kuwa xaqa ah, Si aan kuwa xaqa ahu gacmahooda xumaan ugu soo fidin.
english: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, kuwa wanaagsan wanaag u samee, Iyo weliba kuwa qalbigoodu qumman yahay.
english: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa geesta ugu leexda jidadkooda qalloocan Rabbigu wuxuu iyaga la kaxayn doonaa xumaanfalayaasha. Reer binu Israa'iil korkooda nabadu ha ahaato.
english: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

kikuyu: Markii Rabbigu soo celiyey maxaabiistii Siyoon, Waxaynu noqonnay sida kuwa riyooda.
english: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

kikuyu: Markaasaa afkeenna waxaa ka buuxsamay qosol, Carrabkeennana gabay, Kolkaasaa quruumaha waxaa laga dhex yidhi, Rabbigu waxyaalo waaweyn ayuu iyaga u sameeyey.
english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu inoo sameeyey waxyaalo waaweyn, Oo aynu ku faraxsan nahay.
english: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, maxaabiisnimada mar kale nooga soo celi Sida durdurrada koonfureed.
english: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.

kikuyu: Kuwa ilmada wax ku abuurtaa, farxad bay ku goosan doonaan.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

kikuyu: Kii iska taga isagoo ooyaya oo abuurkiisa sita, Wuxuu soo noqon doonaa isagoo faraxsan oo xidhmooyinkiisa sita.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

kikuyu: Haddaan Rabbigu guriga dhisin, Kuwa dhisaya, waxtarla'aan bay u hawshoodaan, Haddaan Rabbigu magaalada dhawrin, Waardiyuhu micnela'aan buu u soo jeedaa.
english: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

kikuyu: Faa'iido idiinma leh inaad aroor hore kacdaan oo aad goor dambe seexataan, Oo aad kibista dhibka cuntaan, Waayo, wuxuu kuwuu jecel yahay siiyaa hurdo.
english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, carruurtu waa dhaxal xagga Rabbiga laga helo. Oo midhaha maxalku waa abaalgudkiisa.
english: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

kikuyu: Sida fallaadho ku jira nin xoog badan gacantiis, Sidaasoo kale weeye carruurta dhallinyaranimadu.
english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninkii gabooyihiisa ka buuxsada iyaga, Iyagu ma ay ceeboobi doonaan Markay cadaawayaashooda kula hadlaan xagga iridda.
