english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan mid kasta oo Rabbiga ka cabsada, Oo jidadkiisa ku socda.
english: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

kikuyu: Waayo, waad cuni doontaa waxa gacmahaagu ku hawshoodeen, Waadna farxi doontaa, oo waad barwaaqoobi doontaa.
english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

kikuyu: Naagtaadu waxay gurigaaga ku dhex ahaan doontaa sida geed canab ah oo midho badan dhala. Carruurtaaduna waxay noqon doonaan sida geedo saytuun ah oo miiskaaga ku wareegsan.
english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, sidaasuu u barakoobi doonaa Ninka Rabbiga ka cabsadaa.
english: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

kikuyu: Rabbigu Siyoon buu kaa barakayn doonaa, Oo cimrigaaga oo dhan waxaad arki doontaa wanaagga Yeruusaalem.
english: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Haah, oo waxaad arki doontaa carruurtaada carruurtooda. Reer binu Israa'iil korkooda nabadu ha ahaato.
english: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

kikuyu: Tan iyo yaraantaydii marar badan bay i dhibeen, Reer binu Israa'iil hadda ha yidhaahdeen,
english: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

kikuyu: Tan iyo yaraantaydii marar badan bay i dhibeen, Laakiinse igama ay adkaan.
english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

kikuyu: Kuwa beerta jeexa ayaa dhabarkayga jeexay, Oo jeexjeexoodiina way dheereeyeen.
english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa xaq, Oo isagu wuxuu kala gooyay xadhkihii kuwa sharka leh.
english: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

kikuyu: Inta Siyoon neceb oo dhammu, Ha ceeboobeen oo dib ha u noqdeen.
english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

kikuyu: Ha noqdeen sida cawska guryaha korkooda ka baxa Oo engega intaanu korin,
english: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

kikuyu: Oo aan beergooyuhu gacantiisa ka buuxin, Kan xidhmooyinka xidhaana aanu laabtiisa ka buuxin.
english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa ag maraana ma yidhaahdaan, Barakadii Rabbigu korkiinna ha ahaato. Waxaan idiinku ducaynaynaa magaca Rabbiga.
english: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waxaan kaaga qayshaday moolalka.
english: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

kikuyu: Sayidow, codkayga maqal, Oo dhegahaagu ha noqdeen kuwo u digtoon Codka baryootankayga.
english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, haddaad dembiyada u fiirsatid, Bal yaa istaagi doona, Sayidow?
english: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaa kula jirta dembidhaafid, In adiga lagaa cabsado daraaddeed.
english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

kikuyu: Waxaan sugaa Rabbiga, Naftayduna way sugtaa, oo eraygiisa ayaan rajo ku qabaa.
english: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

kikuyu: Naftaydu waxay Sayidka u dhawrtaa In ka sii badan sida waardiyuhu u dhawro waaga berigiisa, Haah, in ka sii badan sida waardiyuhu u dhawro waaga berigiisa.
english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iilow, Rabbiga rajo ku qaba, Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay naxariis Iyo weliba furasho aad iyo aad u badan.
english: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu reer binu Israa'iil ka soo furan doonaa Dembiyadooda oo dhan.
english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, qalbigaygu kor isuma qaado, indhahayguna ma kibirsana, Oo anna iskuma dhex tuuro axwaal waaweyn, Ama waxyaalihii igu yaab badan.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

kikuyu: Hubaal naftaydii waan dejiyey, oo waan xasilliyey, Sida ilmo naas laga gudhiyey oo hooyadiis la jooga, Naftaydu waxay iigu jirtaa sida ilmo naas laga gudhiyey.
english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iilow, Rabbiga rajo ku qaba, Haddeer intii laga bilaabo iyo tan iyo weligiinba.
english: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, bal xusuuso Daa'uud Dhibaatooyinkiisii oo dhan,
english: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction,

kikuyu: Iyo siduu Rabbiga ugu dhaartay, Oo nidar ugu galay Ilaaha Xoogga leh oo Yacquub, isagoo leh,
english: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

kikuyu: Hubaal anigu geli maayo teendhada gurigayga, Sariirtaydana fuuli maayo,
english: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

kikuyu: Indhahayga seexasho isugu qaban maayo, Il iyo baalna isu keeni maayo,
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

kikuyu: Ilaa aan meel u helo Rabbiga, Oo aan taambuug u helo Kan Xoogga leh oo Yacquub.
english: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

kikuyu: Bal eeg, annagu waxaan ku maqalnay Efraataah, Oo waxaan ka helnay berrinkii duurka.
english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

kikuyu: Waxaan geli doonnaa taambuugyadiisa, Oo waxaan ku sujuudi doonnaa meeshuu cagaha saarto.
english: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, sara joogso, oo meeshaada nasashada gal, Adiga iyo sanduuqa xooggaaguba.
english: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

kikuyu: Wadaaddadaadu xaqnimo ha huwadeen, Quduusiintaaduna farxad ha la qayliyeen.
english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

kikuyu: Addoonkaagii Daa'uud daraaddiis Ha sii jeedin kaaga subkan wejigiisa.
english: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

kikuyu: Rabbigu run buu Daa'uud ugu dhaartay, Oo dhaartiisiina ka soo noqon maayo, Midhaha jidhkaaga midkood ayaan carshigaaga ku fadhiisin doonaa.
english: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

kikuyu: Carruurtaadu hadday xajiyaan axdigayga Iyo markhaatifurkayga aan iyaga bari doono, De markaas carruurtooduna weligood bay ku fadhiisan doonaan carshigaaga.
english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuu doortay Siyoon, Oo wuxuu u jeclaystay inuu rugtiisii ka dhigto.
english: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

kikuyu: Halkanu waa meeshaydii nasashada weligeedba, Halkanaan degganaan doonaa, waayo, waan jeclaystay.
english: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

kikuyu: Waxaan iyada aad iyo aad ugu barakayn doonaa quud, Oo masaakiinteeda waxaan ka dhergin doonaa cunto.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

kikuyu: Wadaaddadeedana waxaan huwin doonaa badbaado, Quduusiinteeduna aad bay ula qaylin doonaan farxad.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

kikuyu: Halkaas waxaan ka dhigi doonaa in gees Daa'uud u soo baxo, Waxaan laambad u diyaariyey kii aan subkaday.
english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

kikuyu: Cadaawayaashiisa waxaan huwin doonaa ceeb, Laakiinse taajkiisu madaxiisuu ku waari doonaa.
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

kikuyu: Bal eeg, siday u wanaagsan tahay oo ay u wacan tahay Inay walaalo wadajir ku degganaadaan!
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

kikuyu: Waa sida saliidda qaaliga ah ee madaxa, Oo ku soo dareertay gadhka, Kaasoo ahaa gadhkii Haaruun, Oo waxay soo gaadhay daraftii dharkiisa,
english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

kikuyu: Waana sida dharabka Buur Xermoon, Oo ku soo dega buuraha Siyoon, Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu amray inay halkaas ku dhacdo barako, Taasoo ah nolosha tan iyo weligeedba.
english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

kikuyu: Bal eega, Rabbiga ammaana, Rabbiga addoommadiisa oo dhammow, Kuwiinna goor habeennimo ah guriga Rabbiga dhex taaganow.
english: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!

kikuyu: Gacmaha u taaga macbudka xaggiisa, Oo Rabbiga ammaana.
english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbigu Siyoon ha idinka soo barakeeyo, Kaasoo ah kii sameeyey samada iyo dhulkaba.
english: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Ammaana magaca Rabbiga, Rabbiga addoommadiisow, isaga ammaana,
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,

kikuyu: Kuwiinna guriga Rabbiga Iyo barxadaha guriga Ilaaheenna dhex taaganow.
english: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana, waayo, Rabbigu waa wanaagsan yahay, Magiciisa ammaan ugu gabya, waayo, wuu wacan yahay.
english: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu reer Yacquub nafsaddiisuu u doortay, Hantidiisa gaarka ah ayuu u doortay reer binu Israa'iil.
english: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

kikuyu: Waayo, waan ogahay in Rabbigu weyn yahay, Iyo in Sayidkeennu ka wada sarreeyo ilaahyada oo dhan.
english: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wax alla wixii uu jeclaystayba wuu ku sameeyey Samada iyo dhulka, iyo badaha iyo moolalka oo dhan dhexdooda.
english: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

kikuyu: Isagaa ka dhiga in dhulka darafyadiisa uumi ka soo kaco, Roobkana wuxuu u sameeyaa hillaac, Oo dabayshana isagaa khasnadihiisa ka soo saara.
english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

kikuyu: Isagaa laayay curadyadii Masar, Kuwii dadka iyo kuwii duunyadaba.
english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

kikuyu: Masaray, isagu wuxuu dhexdaada u soo diray calaamooyin iyo yaabab, Oo wax buu ku soo kor daayay Fircoon iyo addoommadiisii oo dhanba.
english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna laayay quruumo badan, Oo wuxuu dilay boqorro xoog badan, kuwaas oo ahaa
english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

kikuyu: Siixon oo ahaa boqorkii reer Amor, Iyo Coog oo ahaa boqorkii Baashaan, Iyo boqortooyooyinkii reer Kancaan oo dhan,
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

kikuyu: Oo dalkoodiina dhaxal ahaan buu u bixiyey, Oo wuxuu dhaxal u siiyey dadkiisa reer binu Israa'iil.
english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, magacaagu weligiisba wuu waaraa, Rabbiyow, xusuustaadu waxay gaadhaa qarni kasta.
english: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu dadkiisuu u garsoori doonaa, Oo addoommadiisana wuu u naxariisan doonaa.
english: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

kikuyu: Sanamyada quruumuhu waa lacag iyo dahab, Oo waa wax ay dad gacmaha ku sameeyeen.
english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: Afaf way leeyihiin, laakiinse ma hadlaan, Indhona way leeyihiin, laakiinse waxba ma arkaan,
english: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

kikuyu: Dhegona way leeyihiin, laakiinse waxba ma maqlaan, Oo afkoodana neefu kuma jirto.
english: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

kikuyu: Kuwa iyaga sameeyaana sidooda oo kale ayay noqon doonaan, Iyo xataa mid kasta oo iyaga isku halleeyaaba.
english: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iilow, Rabbiga ammaana, Reer Haaruunow, Rabbiga ammaana,
english: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Reer Laawiyow, Rabbiga ammaana, Kuwiinna Rabbiga ka cabsadow, Rabbiga ammaana.
english: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga Yeruusaalem deggan ha laga ammaano Siyoon. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku mahadnaqa, waayo, isagu waa wanaagsan yahay, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Ku mahadnaqa Ilaaha ilaahyada, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Ku mahadnaqa Sayidka sayidyada, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan keligiis sameeya yaabab waaweyn, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan samada waxgarashada ku sameeyey, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan dhulka biyaha korkooda ku goglay, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan sameeyey iftiimmo waaweyn, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Qorraxdu inay maalinta xukunto, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Dayaxa iyo xiddiguhuna inay habeenka xukumaan, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan Masar curadyadii ka laayay, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna ka soo dhex saaray, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan kaga soo bixiyey gacan xoog badan iyo cudud fidsan, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan Badda Cas kala qaybiyey, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Oo reer binu Israa'iilna dhex marshay iyada, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Laakiinse Fircoon iyo ciidankiisiiba wuu ku afgembiyey Badda Cas dhexdeeda, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan dadkiisa cidlada dhex hoggaamiyey, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan boqorro waaweyn wax ku dhuftay, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Oo laayay boqorro caan ah, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo ahaa Siixon oo ahaa boqorkii reer Amor, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Iyo Coog oo ahaa boqorkii Baashaan, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Oo dalkoodiina u bixiyey dhaxal ahaan, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kaasoo ahaa dhaxalkii uu siiyey addoonkiisii Israa'iil, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan ina soo xusuustay markaan gunta ahayn, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Oo inaga soo samatabbixiyey cadaawayaasheennii, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kan cunto siiya wax kastoo jidh leh, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Ku mahadnaqa Ilaaha samada, Waayo, naxariistiisu weligeedba way sii waartaa.
english: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Waxaannu ag fadhiisannay webiyaashii Baabuloon, Oo waannu ooynay markii aannu Siyoon soo xusuusannay.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

kikuyu: Oo waxaannu kataaradahayagii sudhannay geedaha safsaafkaa.
english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwii maxaabiis ahaanta noo watay ayaa halkaas gabayo nagu weyddiistay, Oo kuwii na silciyey ayaa farxad na weyddiistay, oo waxay nagu yidhaahdeen, Noogu gabya gabayadii Siyoon midkood.
english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

kikuyu: Bal sidee baannu gabaygii Rabbiga ugu gabaynaa Dal qalaad dhexdiis?
english: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

kikuyu: Yeruusaalemay, haddaan ku illoobo, Gacantayda midig ha illowdo sancadeedii.
english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

kikuyu: Carrabkayguna ha ku dhego dhanxanagga afkayga, Haddaanan ku xusuusan, Iyo haddaanan Yeruusaalem ka sii jeclaan Farxaddayda ugu weyn.
english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, soo xusuuso reer Edom, Kuwaasoo maalintii Yeruusaalem yidhi, Dumiya, dumiya, tan iyo aasaaskeeda.
english: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

kikuyu: Gabadha Baabuloonay, waa lagu baabbi'in doonaa, Waxaa faraxsanaan doona kii kaa abaalmariya Sidii aad nagu samaysay.
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

kikuyu: Waxaa faraxsanaan doona kii dhallaankaaga qabsada Oo dhagaxa weyn ku dul tuura.
english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

kikuyu: Qalbigayga oo dhan ayaan kugu mahadnaqi doonaa, Oo ilaahyada hortooda ayaan ammaan kuugu gabyi doonaa,
english: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

kikuyu: Waxaan u soo tukan doonaa macbudkaaga quduuska ah xaggiisa, Oo magacaagana waxaan ugu mahadnaqi doonaa raxmaddaada iyo runtaada aawadood, Waayo, eraygaaga ayaad ka sii weynaysay magacaaga oo dhan.
english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

kikuyu: Maalintii aan qayshaday waad ii jawaabtay, Waanad igu kalsooni gelisay xooggii aad naftayda u yeeshay.
english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, boqorrada dhulka jooga oo dhammu way kugu mahadnaqi doonaan, Waayo, waxay maqlaan erayada afkaaga.
english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

kikuyu: Haah, way ka gabyi doonaan jidadka Rabbiga, Waayo, ammaanta Rabbigu waa weyn tahay.
english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

kikuyu: Waayo, in kastoo Rabbigu sarreeyo, haddana wuu fiiriyaa kuwa hooseeya, Laakiinse kan kibra meel fog buu ka yaqaan.
english: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

kikuyu: In kastoo aan ku dhex socdo dhibaato waad i soo noolayn doontaa, Oo waxaad gacantaada ku soo fidin doontaa cadhada cadaawayaashayda, Oo gacantaada midigna way i badbaadin doontaa.
english: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

kikuyu: Rabbigaa kaamil ka dhigi doona waxa igu saabsan, Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu weligeedba way sii waartaa, Ha ka tegin shuqulladii gacmahaaga.
english: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waad i baadhay, oo waad i soo ogaatay.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.

kikuyu: Waad og tahay fadhiisashadayda iyo sara kiciddaydaba, Oo fikirkaygana meel fog baad ka garataa.
english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

kikuyu: Socodkayga iyo seexashadaydaba waad baadhaa, Oo jidadkayga oo dhanna waad wada taqaan.
english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiyow, eray aanad aqoonu carrabkayga kuma jiro, Laakiinse adigu waad wada og tahay.
english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.

kikuyu: Adigu hor iyo dibba waad iga xidhay, Oo gacantaadaad i saartay.
english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

kikuyu: Aqoontaas oo kale aad iyo aad bay iigu yaab badan tahay, Waa wax sare, oo anigu ma aan gaadhi karo.
english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

kikuyu: Bal xaggee baan ruuxaaga ka tagaa? Xaggee baanse wejigaaga uga cararaa?
english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

kikuyu: Haddaan samada koro, halkaasaad joogtaa, Haddaan sariirtayda She'ool dhex dhigtona, bal eeg, halkaasna waad joogtaa.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

kikuyu: Haddaan qaato baalasha subaxda, Iyo haddaan dego badda darafyadeeda ugu shisheeyaba,
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

kikuyu: Xataa halkaas gacantaada ayaa i hoggaamin doonta, Oo midigtaada ayaa i soo qaban doonta.
english: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

kikuyu: Haddaan idhaahdo, Hubaal gudcurkaa i qarin doona, Oo iftiinka igu wareegsanu habeennimuu noqon doonaa,
english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

kikuyu: Xataa gudcurku igama kaa qariyo, Laakiinse habeenku wuxuu u iftiimaa sida maalinta oo kale, Gudcurka iyo iftiinku waa isugu kaa mid.
english: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

kikuyu: Waayo, kelyahayga adigaa sameeyey, Oo adigaa igu daboolay maxalkii hooyaday.
english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Waan kugu mahadnaqi doonaa, waayo, waxaa la ii sameeyey si cabsi iyo yaab badan, Shuqulladaadu waa yaab badan yihiin, Oo naftayduna taas aad bay u taqaan.
english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

kikuyu: Lafahaygu kaama qarsoonayn, Markii laygu sameeyey qarsoodiga, Oo farsamada yaabka leh laygu sameeyey dhulka meesha ugu hoosaysa.
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: Indhahaagu way i arkeen markaan uurjiifka ahaa, Oo xubnahaygu kitaabkaagay ku wada qornaayeen, Kuwaas oo maalin ka maalin la qabanqaabiyey Intaan midkoodna jirin ka hor.
english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, fikirradaadu ila qiimo badanaa! Oo tiro badanaa!
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

kikuyu: Haddaan tiriyo, way ka sii tiro badan yihiin ciidda, Oo markaan tooso weli adigaan kula joogaa.
english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, hubaal waxaad layn doontaa kuwa sharka leh, Haddaba iga taga, raggiinna dhiigyocabyada ahow.
english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu si xun ayay wax kaaga sheegaan, Oo cadaawayaashaaduna micnela'aan bay magacaaga ku soo qaadqaadaan.
english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, sow ma aan nebci kuwa ku neceb? Oo sow kama aan murugaysni kuwa kugu kaca?
english: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

kikuyu: Nacayb dhan ayaan ku necbahay iyaga, Oo waxaan iyaga u haystaa cadaawayaashayda.
english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, i baadh, oo qalbigayga garo, I tijaabi, oo fikirradayda ogow,
english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

kikuyu: Oo bal fiiri inuu jid xumaan ahu igu jiro iyo in kale, Oo igu hoggaami jidka weligiis ah.
english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ninka sharka leh iga samatabbixi, Oo iga ilaali ninka dulmiga badan,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

kikuyu: Kuwaasoo qalbigooda kaga fikira belaayooyin, Had iyo goorna dagaal bay isu soo urursadaan.
english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

kikuyu: Waxay carrabkoodii u afaysteen sidii abeeso oo kale, Oo bushimahoodana waxaa ku hoos jirta waabaydii jilbiska. (Selaah)
english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, gacmaha kuwa sharka leh iga dhawr, Oo iga ilaali ninka dulmiga badan, Kuwaasoo u qasdiyey inay tallaabooyinkayga dhinac u leexiyaan.
english: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

kikuyu: Kuwa kibirka badanu waxay ii qariyeen dabin iyo xadhko, Oo jidka dhinaciisana waxay ii gogleen shabag, oo siriq bay ii qooleen. (Selaah)
english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

kikuyu: Waxaan Rabbiga ku idhi, Waxaad tahay Ilaahayga, Haddaba, Rabbiyow, bal dhegta u dhig codka baryootankayga.
english: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

kikuyu: Ilaahow Sayidow, xooggii badbaadadaydow, Maalintii dagaalka madaxaygaad dabooshay.
english: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, kuwa sharka leh ha siin waxay doonayaan, Oo horay ha u sii wadin xeeladdooda sharka ah, waaba intaasoo ay kor isu qaadaane. (Selaah)
english: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa igu wareegsan madaxoodana Belaayada bushimahooda ka soo baxaysa ha daboosho.
english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

kikuyu: Dhuxulo ololaya ha ku soo dul daateen, Oo iyaga ha lagu dhex tuuro dabka, Iyo godad aad u dhaadheer, si aanay mar dambe u soo sara kicin.
english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

kikuyu: Ninka sharka ku hadlaa yaanu dhulka ku sii waarin, Sharku wuxuu u ugaadhsan doonaa ninka dulmiga badan inuu afgembiyo aawadeed.
english: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

kikuyu: Waan ogahay in Rabbigu kuwa dhibban dacwadooda u gar qaadi doono, Oo uu kuwa baahanna xaqooda siin doono.
english: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

kikuyu: Hubaal kuwa xaqa ahu waxay ku mahadnaqi doonaan magacaaga, Oo kuwa qummanuna waxay joogi doonaan hortaada.
english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigaan kuu qayshaday, haddaba ii soo dhaqso, Oo markaan kuu qayshado, codkayga dhegta u dhig.
english: A Psalm by David. LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

kikuyu: Baryootankaygu ha noqdo sida foox hortaada la dhigay, Oo gacma-koruqaadiddayduna ha noqoto sida allabariga fiidnimo.
english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, afkayga waardiye hor jooji, Oo albaabka bushimahaygana dhawr.
english: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

kikuyu: Qalbigayga ha u duwin wax shar ah, Yaanu falimo xumaan ah la gelin Dadka xumaanta ka shaqeeya, Oo yaanan wax ka cunin waxyaalahooda macaan.
english: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ahu ha i dilo, raxmad bay ii ahaan doontaa, Oo ha i canaanto, waxay ii noqon doontaa sida saliid madaxa lagu shubto, Madaxayguna yaanu diidin, Waayo, xataa intay sharkooda ku sii jiraan ayaan tukashadayda ka geesta ah sii wadaa.
english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

kikuyu: Xaakinnadoodii waxaa lagu tuuray dhagaxa dhinacyadiisa, Oo iyagu waxay maqli doonaan erayadayda, waayo, way macaan yihiin.
english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

kikuyu: Sida markii beerta la qodo oo dhulka la jeexo Ayaa lafahayagii ugu firidhsan yihiin She'ool afkiisa.
english: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaahow Sayidow, indhahaygu xaggaagay ku soo jeedaan, Oo adigaan isku kaa halleeyaa, haddaba naftayda ha dayrin.
english: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

kikuyu: Iga dhawr dabinka ay ii dhigeen, Iyo siriqda ay xumaanfalayaashu qooleen.
english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu ha ku dhex dheceen shabagyadooda Markaan anigu ka baxsado.
english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

kikuyu: Anigu codkaygaan Rabbiga ugu qayshadaa, Oo codkaygaan Rabbiga ku baryaa.
english: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.

kikuyu: Oo hortiisaan ku cawdaa, Oo dhibaatadaydana hortiisaan ku muujiyaa.
english: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

kikuyu: Markii naftaydu gudahayga ku itaal darnaatay, waddadayda waad tiqiin, Jidka aan ku socdona dabin bay iigu qariyeen.
english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

kikuyu: Bal fiiri xaggayga midig, oo bal arag, Waayo, nin i yaqaan ma jiro, Meel aan magangalo ayaan waayay, ninna naftayda dan kama leh.
english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, adigaan kuu qayshaday, Oo waxaan idhi, Waxaad tahay magangalkayga, Iyo qaybta aan dalka kuwa nool ku leeyahay.
english: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

kikuyu: Qayladayda dhegayso, waayo, aad baa hoos laygu dejiyey, Kuwa i silciya iga samatabbixi, waayo, iyagu way iga xoog badan yihiin.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

kikuyu: Naftayda xabsiga ka soo bixi, si aan magacaaga ugu mahadnaqo, Kuwa xaqa ah ayaa igu hareeraysnaan doona, Waayo, wax badan oo wanaagsan baad ii samayn doontaa.
english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, tukashadayda maqal, oo baryootankayga dhegta u dhig, Oo daacadnimadaada iyo xaqnimadaada iigu jawaab.
english: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

kikuyu: Anoo addoonkaaga ah xukun ha i gelin, Waayo, inta nool oo dhan ma jiro nin hortaada lagu caddayn doonaa inuu xaq yahay.
english: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

kikuyu: Waayo, cadowgaa naftayda silciyey, Noloshaydiina dhulkuu ku tuuray, Oo wuxuu iga dhigay inaan meelo gudcur ah dego, sidii kuwii waagii hore dhintay.
english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ayaa ruuxaygu iigu dhex itaal darnaadaa, Qalbigayguna gudahayguu ku cidloobay.
english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

kikuyu: Waxaan soo xusuustaa wakhtigii hore, Falimahaaga oo dhanna waan ka fikiraa, Oo waxaan fiiro u yeeshaa shuqulkii gacmahaaga.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Gacmahaygaan kuu hoorsadaa, Oo naftaydu adigay kuu harraaddaa sida dhul oommane ah. (Selaah)
english: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, dhaqso iigu soo jawaab, waayo, naftaydu way itaal darnaataa. Wejigaaga ha iga qarin, Waaba intaasoo aan noqdaa sida kuwa godka ku dhaca oo kale.
english: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Aroorta naxariistaada i maqashii, Waayo, adigaan isku kaa halleeyaa, I garansii sidii aan u socon lahaa, Waayo, naftaydaan kor kuugu qaadaa.
english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, cadaawayaashayda iga samatabbixi, Waayo, adaan kugu soo cararaa inaad i qariso.
english: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

kikuyu: I bar si aan doonistaada u sameeyo, waayo, waxaad tahay Ilaahayga, Ruuxaaga wanaagsanu ha igu dhex hoggaamiyo dalka qummanaanta.
english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ii soo noolee magacaaga daraaddiis, Oo xaqnimadaada naftayda kaga soo bixi dhibaato.
english: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

kikuyu: Oo raxmaddaada cadaawayaashayda ku wada tirtir, Kuwa naftayda dhiba oo dhanna baabbi'i, Waayo, waxaan ahay addoonkaaga.
english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

kikuyu: Mahad waxaa leh Rabbiga dhagaxayga weyn ah, Oo gacmahayga dagaalka bara, Farahaygana dirirta bara,
english: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

kikuyu: Kaasoo ah raxmaddayda, iyo qalcaddayda, Munaaraddayda, iyo samatabbixiyahayga, Iyo gaashaankayga, iyo kan aan isku halleeyo, Oo dadkayga ka yeela kuwo iga hooseeya.
english: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waa maxay dadku oo aad u xusuusataa isaga? Ama wiilka aadanaha oo aad ka fikirtaa isaga?
english: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

kikuyu: Dadku waa sida wax aan waxtar lahayn, Oo cimrigiisuna waa sida hooska libdha.
english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, samooyinkaaga foorori, oo soo dhaadhac, Buuraha taabo, oo iyana way qiiqi doonaan.
english: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

kikuyu: Hillaac soo tuur, oo iyaga kala firdhi, Fallaadhahaaga soo gan, oo iyaga jebi.
english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

kikuyu: Gacantaada kor ka soo fidi, Oo i badbaadi, oo iga samatabbixi biyaha badan, Iyo gacanta shisheeyayaasha,
english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

kikuyu: Kuwaasoo afkoodu wax bilaash ah ku hadlo, Gacantooda midigna tahay midig beeneed.
english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

kikuyu: Ilaahow, gabay cusub ayaan kuugu gabyi doonaa, Oo waxaan ammaan kuugu gabyi doonaa shareerad toban xadhig leh.
english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

kikuyu: Waa isaga kan boqorrada badbaadiyaa, Oo addoonkiisa Daa'uud ka badbaadiya seefta sharka leh.
english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

kikuyu: I badbaadi, oo iga samatabbixi gacanta shisheeyayaasha, Kuwaasoo afkoodu wax bilaash ah ku hadlo, Gacantooda midigna tahay midig beeneed.
english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

kikuyu: Markii wiilashayadu ay noqdaan sidii geedo yaraantoodii ku koray, Oo gabdhahayaguna ay noqdaan sidii dhagaxyada rukunka oo loo qoray qaabkii guriga boqorka,
english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

kikuyu: Markii maqsinnadayadu ay buuxsamaan iyagoo na siinaya alaab cayn kasta ah, Idahayaguna ay noo dhalaan kumanyaal iyo kumaankun oo berrimmada noo jooga,
english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

kikuyu: Markii dibidayadu ay aad u xoogaystaan, Markaan la arag weerarid iyo qaxid, Oo aan cabasho jirin jidadkayaga dhexdooda,
english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

kikuyu: Waxaa faraxsan dadkii xaalkoodu sidaas yahay, Haah, oo waxaa faraxsan dadkii Rabbigu Ilaahooda yahay.
english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

kikuyu: Ilaahayow, Boqorow, anigu waan ku sarraysiin doonaa, Oo magacaagana waan ammaani doonaa weligay iyo weligayba.
english: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Maalin kasta mahad baan kuu naqi doonaa, Oo magacaagana waan ammaani doonaa weligay iyo weligayba.
english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa weyn yahay, oo waa in aad loo ammaano, Weynaantiisuna waa mid aan la baadhi karin.
english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

kikuyu: Farcanba farcan ayuu shuqulladaada u ammaani doonaa, Oo waxay ka warrami doonaan falimahaaga waaweyn.
english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ka fikiri doonaa haybadda ammaanta leh oo sharaftaada, Iyo shuqulladaada yaabka badan.
english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Dadku waxay ka hadli doonaan xooggii falimahaaga cabsida badan, Oo anna waxaan sheegi doonaa weynaantaada.
english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

kikuyu: Waxay ku hadli doonaan wanaaggaaga badan xusuustiisa, Xaqnimadaadana way ka gabyi doonaan.
english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa nimco miidhan, oo waxaa ka buuxda raxmad, Cadhona wuu u gaabiyaa, wuuna naxariis badan yahay.
english: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wax kasta wuu u roon yahay, Naxariistiisuna waxay ka sarraysaa shuqulladiisa oo dhan.
english: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, shuqulladaada oo dhammu way kugu mahadnaqi doonaan, Oo quduusiintaaduna way ku ammaani doonaan.
english: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

kikuyu: Waxay ka hadli doonaan sharafta boqortooyadaada, Oo waxay ka sheekaysan doonaan xooggaaga,
english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

kikuyu: Si ay binu-aadmiga u ogeysiiyaan Ilaah falimihiisa waaweyn, Iyo ammaanta haybadda boqortooyadiisa.
english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

kikuyu: Boqortooyadaadu waa boqortooyo daa'imis ah, Oo dawladnimadaaduna way sii waartaa tan iyo ab ka ab.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuu tiiriyaa kuwa kufa oo dhan, Oo wuxuu toosiyaa kuwa gota oo dhan.
english: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

kikuyu: Wax kasta indhahoodu adigay wax kaa sugayaan, Oo quudkoodana waad siisa xilligiisa.
english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

kikuyu: Gacantaadaad furtaa, Oo waxaad dherjisaa wax kasta oo nool.
english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

kikuyu: Rabbigu jidadkiisa oo dhan wuu ku qumman yahay, Oo shuqulladiisa oo dhanna wuu ku nimco badan yahay.
english: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa u dhow yahay inta isaga barida oo dhan, Kuwaas oo ah inta runta ku barida oo dhan.
english: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

kikuyu: Kuwa isaga ka cabsada waxay doonayaanba wuu siin doonaa, Oo weliba qayladoodana wuu maqli doonaa, wuuna badbaadin doonaa iyaga.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

kikuyu: Rabbigu inta isaga jecel oo dhan wuu ilaaliyaa, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh oo dhan wuu wada baabbi'in doonaa.
english: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

kikuyu: Afkaygu wuxuu ku hadli doonaa ammaanta Rabbiga, Oo inta jidh leh oo dhammuna magiciisa quduuska ah ha ammaaneen weligood iyo weligoodba.
english: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Naftaydoy, Rabbiga ammaan.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.

kikuyu: Intaan noolahay oo dhan Rabbiga waan ammaani doonaa, Oo ammaan baan Ilaahay ugu gabyi doonaa intaan jiro oo dhan.
english: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

kikuyu: Ha isku hallaynina amiirrada Iyo binu-aadmiga aan waxba caawimi karin.
english: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

kikuyu: Naftiisu way ka baxdaa, oo wuxuu ku noqdaa dhulkiisii. Oo isla maalintaas ayaa fikirradiisu baabba'aan.
english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

kikuyu: Waxaa faraxsan ninkii ay caawimaaddiisu tahay Ilaaha reer Yacquub, Oo rajadiisuna ay ku xidhan tahay Rabbiga Ilaahiisa ah,
english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,

kikuyu: Oo sameeyey cirka iyo dhulka, Iyo badda iyo waxyaalaha ku jira oo dhan, Oo runtana dhawra weligiisba,
english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

kikuyu: Oo kuwa la dulmay u garsoora, Oo kuwa gaajaysanna quud siiya. Rabbigu maxaabiistuu furaa.
english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.

kikuyu: Rabbigu indhahuu u bixiyaa indhoolayaasha, Oo kuwa gotana Rabbigaa toosiya, Oo kuwa xaqa ahna Rabbigu waa jecel yahay.
english: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa ilaaliyaa kuwa qariibka ah, Oo isagaa taageera agoonta iyo carmallada, Laakiinse jidka kuwa sharka leh wuu qalloociyaa.
english: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

kikuyu: Rabbigu xukun buu haysan doonaa weligiis, Siyoonay, Ilaahaagaa boqor ah tan iyo ab ka ab. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Waayo, way wanaagsan tahay in Ilaaheenna ammaan loogu gabyo, Waayo, taasu way wacan tahay, oo ammaantuna way habboon tahay.
english: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

kikuyu: Rabbigu Yeruusaalem buu dhisaa, Oo wuxuu isu soo wada ururiyaa kuwa la naco oo reer binu Israa'iil ah.
english: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

kikuyu: Isagaa bogsiiya kuwa qalbi jabay, Oo nabrahoodana wuu duubaa.
english: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

kikuyu: Wuxuu sheegaa xiddigaha tiradooda, Oo kulligoodna magacyo buu u bixiyaa.
english: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

kikuyu: Sayidkeennu waa weyn yahay, wuuna xoog badan yahay, Waxgarashadiisuna waa mid aan la koobi karayn.
english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuu tiiriyaa kuwa camalka qabow, Oo kuwa sharka lehna dhulkuu ku soo tuuraa.
english: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

kikuyu: Rabbiga mahadnaqid ugu gabya, Oo kataaradda ammaan ugu gabya Ilaaheenna,
english: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

kikuyu: Kaasoo samada daruuro ku qariya, Oo dhulka roob u diyaarsha, Buurahana doog ka soo bixiya.
english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

kikuyu: Wuxuu quud siiyaa xayawaanka, Iyo tukayaasha yaryar markay qayliyaanba.
english: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

kikuyu: Isagu kuma farxo xoogga faraska, Oo kuma reyreeyo lugaha dadka.
english: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu ku reyreeyaa kuwa isaga ka cabsada, Iyo kuwa naxariistiisa rajada ka qaba.
english: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

kikuyu: Yeruusaalemay, Rabbiga ammaan, Siyoonay, Ilaahaaga ammaan.
english: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu xoogeeyey qataarrada irdahaaga, Carruurtaadana wuu kugu dhex barakeeyey.
english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

kikuyu: Soohdimahaaga nabad buu ka dhigaa, Oo wuxuu kaa dhergiyaa sarreenka ugu wanaagsan.
english: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

kikuyu: Amarkiisa wuxuu u soo diraa dhulka, Eraygiisuna aad buu u dheereeyaa.
english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

kikuyu: Baraf cad wuxuu u soo daadshaa sida dhogor oo kale, Sayax barafoobayna wuxuu u kala firdhiyaa sida dambas oo kale.
english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

kikuyu: Barafkiisa wuxuu u soo ridaa sida jajab oo kale, Bal yaa qabowgiisa hor istaagi kara?
english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

kikuyu: Wuxuu soo diraa eraygiisa, oo wuu dhalaaliyaa iyaga, Dabayshiisana wuxuu ka dhigaa inay dhacdo, biyuhuna way qulqulaan.
english: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

kikuyu: Eraygiisa wuxuu tusaa reer Yacquub, Qaynuunnadiisa iyo xukummadiisana reer binu Israa'iil.
english: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

kikuyu: Quruunna sidaas oo kale uma uu samayn. Xukummadiisiina ma ay garanaynin, Rabbiga ammaana.
english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Rabbiga samooyinka ka ammaana, Meelaha sarsarena ka ammaana.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

kikuyu: Malaa'igihiisa oo dhammow, ammaana isaga, Ciidankiisa oo dhammow, ammaana isaga.
english: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

kikuyu: Qorraxda iyo dayaxow, ammaana isaga, Xiddigaha iftiinka oo dhammow, ammaana isaga.
english: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

kikuyu: Ammaana isaga, samooyinka samooyinkow, Iyo biyaha samooyinka ka sarreeyow.
english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

kikuyu: Iyagu magaca Rabbiga ha ammaaneen, Waayo, isagu wuu amray, oo iyana way abuurmeen.
english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

kikuyu: Oo weliba isagaa adkeeyey iyaga weligood iyo weligoodba, Oo wuxuu sameeyey xad aan la gudbi doonayn.
english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

kikuyu: Rabbiga dhulka ka ammaana, Masbadeedyo iyo moolal oo dhammow,
english: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

kikuyu: Dab iyo roobdhagaxyaale, baraf cad iyo ceeryaamow, Iyo dabayl duufaan ah oo eraygiisa oofiyow,
english: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

kikuyu: Buuro iyo kuro oo dhammow, Dhir midho badan iyo dhir kedar la yidhaahdo oo dhammow,
english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

kikuyu: Dugaag iyo xoolo oo dhammow, Waxa gurguurta iyo haadda duusha oo dhammow,
english: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

kikuyu: Boqorrada dhulka iyo dadyowga oo dhammow, Amiirrada iyo xaakinnada dhulka oo dhammow,
english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

kikuyu: Barbaar iyo hablow, Odayaal iyo carruuray,
english: both young men and maidens, old men and children.

kikuyu: Ha ammaaneen magaca Rabbiga, Waayo, magiciisa oo keliya ayaa la sarraysiiyaa, Ammaantiisu dhulka iyo cirkaba way ka korraysaa.
english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu sare u qaaday geeskii dadkiisa, Iyo ammaantii quduusiintiisa oo dhan, Waana reer binu Israa'iil oo ah dad isaga u dhow. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Rabbiga gabay cusub ugu gabya, Oo ammaantiisana shirka quduusiinta kaga dhex gabya.
english: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil kii iyaga uumay ha ku reyreeyeen, Oo reer Siyoonna boqorkooda ha ku farxeen.
english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

kikuyu: Magiciisa cayaarta ha ku ammaaneen, Oo ammaan ha ugu gabyeen iyagoo sita daf iyo kataarad.
english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu ku farxaa dadkiisa, Wuxuu kuwa camalka qabowna ku qurxin doonaa badbaado.
english: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

kikuyu: Quduusiintu ammaan ha ku reyreeyeen, Oo farxad ha ku gabyeen iyagoo sariirahooda jiifa.
english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

kikuyu: Ammaanta sare oo Ilaah afkooda ha ku jirto, Seef laba af lahuna gacantooda ha ku jirto,
english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

kikuyu: Si ay quruumaha uga aargutaan, Oo ay dadyowgana u ciqaabaan,
english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

kikuyu: Si ay boqorradooda silsilado ugu soo xidhaan, Oo ay raggooda gobta ahna jeebbooyin bir ah ugu soo xidhaan,
english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

kikuyu: Si ay iyaga ugu soo dejiyaan xukunka qoran, Quduusiintiisa oo dhammuna waxay leeyihiin sharaftan. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ammaana. Ilaah ku dhex ammaana meeshiisa quduuska ah, Ku dhex ammaana samada xooggiisa.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

kikuyu: Falimihiisa waaweyn aawadood u ammaana, U ammaana si waafaqsan weynaantiisa sare.
english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

kikuyu: Dhawaaqa buunka ku ammaana, Oo shareerad iyo kataarad ku ammaana.
english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

kikuyu: Ku ammaana daf iyo cayaar, Oo ku ammaana alaab xadhko leh oo muusiko ah iyo biibiile.
english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

kikuyu: Suxuunta laysku garaaco oo codka dheer ku ammaana, Ku ammaana suxuunta sanqadha dheer.
english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

kikuyu: Wax kasta oo neef lahuba Rabbiga ha ammaaneen. Rabbiga ammaana.
english: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa maahmaahyadii Sulaymaan ina Daa'uud oo ahaa boqorkii reer Binu Israa'iil,
english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

kikuyu: Wuxuu u qoray si loo ogaado xigmadda iyo edbinta, Oo loo garto erayada waxgarashada,
english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

kikuyu: In la helo edbinta ku saabsan xigmadda, Iyo xaqnimada iyo garta iyo caaddilnimada;
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

kikuyu: Si miyir loo siiyo garaadlaawaha, Oo aqoon iyo digtoonaanna loo yeelo ninka dhallinyarada ah.
english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

kikuyu: Ninkii caqli lahu wuu maqli doonaa, oo wuxuu korodhsan doonaa waxbarasho, Oo ninkii garaad lahuna wuxuu qabsan doonaa talada wanaagsan,
english: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

kikuyu: Si lagu garto maahmaahda, iyo micnaynta, Iyo hadallada kuwa caqliga leh iyo xujooyinkooda.
english: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

kikuyu: Waxaa aqoonta ugu horreeya Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisa; Laakiinse nacasyadu waxay quudhsadaan xigmadda iyo edbinta.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, edbinta aabbahaa maqal, Oo amarka hooyadaana ha ka tegin,
english: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay madaxaaga u noqon doonaan wax sharraxsan, Oo waxay kuu noqon doonaan silsilado qoorta kuu sudhan.
english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, haddii dembilayaal ku sasabtaan, Ha oggolaan.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

kikuyu: Hadday kugu yidhaahdaan, Na soo raac, Aan gaadno inaynu dhiig daadinno, Oo aynu sababla'aan kuwa aan eedda lahayn si qarsoon ugu dhuumanno;
english: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

kikuyu: Oo iyagoo nool aynu u liqno sida qabriga oo kale, Dhammaantoodna aan juq siinno sida kuwa yamayska ku dhaca;
english: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Waxaynu heli doonnaa maal qaali ah oo cayn kasta ah, Oo guryaheennana waxaynu ka buuxsan doonnaa booli;
english: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

kikuyu: Nasiibkaaga iskula kaaya soo dar, Oo kulligeenna aynu kiishad qudha wada lahaanno;
english: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, iyaga jidka ha la marin; Oo cagtaadana wadiiqadooda dib uga jooji;
english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

kikuyu: Waayo, cagahoodu waxay u ordaan shar, Oo waxay u degdegaan inay dhiig daadiyaan.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

kikuyu: Waayo, waa waxtarla'aan dabinka loo dhigaa Iyadoo ay shimbirtu u jeeddo;
english: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

kikuyu: Iyagu waxay u gaadaan si dhiiggooda loo daadiyo, Oo waxay si qarsoon ugu dhuuntaan si naftooda looga qaado.
english: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalay yihiin jidadka mid kasta oo faa'iido u hunguri weyn, Oo nafta ka qaada kuwa leh.
english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

kikuyu: Xigmaddu aad bay uga qaylisaa jidka; Oo codkeedana waxay kor uga qaaddaa bannaanka;
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

kikuyu: Waxay ka qaylisaa meesha suuqa ugu weyn; Oo iridda magaalada laga soo galo Ayay erayadeeda kaga hadashaa, iyadoo leh,
english: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

kikuyu: Kuwiinna garaadlaawayaasha ahow, ilaa goormaad garaadla'aanta sii jeclaanaysaan? Oo kuwa wax quudhsadaana, ilaa goormay quudhsashadooda ku sii farxayaan? Nacasyaduna, ilaa goormay aqoonta sii necbaanayaan?
english: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

kikuyu: Canaantayda u soo noqda; Bal eega, anigu waxaan idinku shubi doonaa ruuxayga, Oo waxaan idin ogeysiin doonaa erayadayda.
english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

kikuyu: Anigu waan idiin yeedhay, laakiinse waad i diiddeen; Oo anigu gacantaydaan soo fidiyey, oo ninnana dan kama yeelan;
english: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku taladaydii oo dhan waad fududaysateen, Oo canaantaydiina ma aydin doonaynin;
english: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed aniguna waan idinku qosli doonaa markay belaayo idinku dhacdo; Waanan idinku majaajiloon doonaa markay cabsiyu idinku soo degto;
english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

kikuyu: Markay cabsidiinnu u timaado sida duufaan oo kale, Oo belaayadiinnuna u timaado sida dabayl cirwareen ah; Oo dhibaato iyo cidhiidhi idinku yimaadaan.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

kikuyu: Markaasay ii yeedhan doonaan, laakiinse anigu uma aan jawaabi doono; Oo horay ii doondooni doonaan, laakiinse ima ay heli doonaan;
english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay nebcaadeen aqoonta, Oo Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisana ma ay dooran;
english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: Iyagu taladaydii innaba ma ay doonaynin; Oo canaantaydii oo dhanna way quudhsadeen;
english: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

kikuyu: Haddaba iyagu waxay cuni doonaan midhihii jidkooda, Oo waxay ka dhergi doonaan taladoodii.
english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

kikuyu: Waayo, garaadlaawayaasha dibunoqoshadooda ayaa iyaga dili doonta, Oo nacasyadana waxaa baabbi'in doonta barwaaqadooda.
english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ku alla kii aniga i maqlaa, ammaan buu u fadhiyi doonaa, Wuuna xasilloonaan doonaa, isagoo aan shar ka cabsanaynin.
english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, haddaad erayadayda aqbashid, Oo aad amarradayda qalbigaaga ku haysatid,
english: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

kikuyu: Si aad dhegta xigmadda ugu dhigtid, Oo aad qalbigaagana waxgarashada ugu qabatid;
english: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

kikuyu: Haddaad wax-kala-garashada ka daba qaylisid, Oo aad codkaaga waxgarashada kor ugu qaaddid;
english: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

kikuyu: Haddaad iyada u raadisid sida lacagta oo kale, Oo aad u doondoontid sida maal qarsoon,
english: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

kikuyu: Markaas waxaad garan doontaa Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisa, Oo waxaad heli doontaa aqoonta Ilaah.
english: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu isagaa bixiya xigmadda, Oo afkiisa waxaa ka soo baxa aqoonta iyo waxgarashada.
english: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

kikuyu: Isagu kuwa xaqa ah xigmad buu u kaydiyaa, Oo kuwa daacadnimada u socdana waa u gaashaan.
english: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu dhawraa waddooyinka garta, Oo wuxuu xannaaneeyaa jidka quduusiintiisa.
english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

kikuyu: Markaasaad garan doontaa xaqnimada, iyo garta, Iyo caaddilnimada, iyo jid kasta oo wanaagsan.
english: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa qalbigaaga soo geli doonta xigmadda, Oo aqoontuna waxay ka farxin doontaa naftaada;
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

kikuyu: Digtoonaanta baa ku xanaanayn doonta, Oo waxaa ku dhawri doonta waxgarashada,
english: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

kikuyu: Si lagaaga samatabbixiyo jidka kan sharka ah, Iyo dadka waxyaalaha qalloocan ku hadla,
english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

kikuyu: Oo qummanaanta waddooyinkeeda ka taga, Si ay jidadka gudcurka ugu socdaan,
english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

kikuyu: Oo ay ku reyreeyaan inay xumaan falaan, Oo ay qalloocnaanta kan sharkaa ku farxaan;
english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

kikuyu: Oo jidadkoodu maroorsan yihiin, Oo waddooyinkooduna qalloocan yihiin,
english: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

kikuyu: In lagaa samatabbixiyo naagta qalaad, Xataa naagta qalaad oo hadalladeeda kugu sasabata,
english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

kikuyu: Taasoo ka tagta horseedkii yaraanteeda, Oo illowda axdigii Ilaaheeda;
english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

kikuyu: Waayo, gurigeedu wuxuu ku foororaa dhimasho, Oo waddooyinkeeduna waxay ku dhaadhacaan kuwii dhintay.
english: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Kuwa iyada u gala midkoodna sooma noqdo, Oo waddooyinka noloshana ma ay helaan.
english: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

kikuyu: Waa inaad ku socotid jidka dadka wanaagsan, Oo aad dhawrtid waddooyinka kuwa xaqa ah.
english: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwa qummanu dhulkay fadhiyi doonaan, Oo kuwa kaamilka ahuna way sii joogi doonaan.
english: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa sharkaa waa laga gooyn doonaa dhulka, Oo khaayinnadana waa laga rujin doonaa.
english: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, waxbariddayda ha illoobin, Laakiin qalbigaagu amarradayda ha hayo,
english: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu waxay kuu kordhin doonaan Maalmo badan iyo cimri dheer iyo nabad.
english: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

kikuyu: Naxariista iyo runtu yaanay kaa tegin, Iyaga qoorta ku xidh, Oo looxa qalbigaaga ku qor,
english: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: Sidaasaad Ilaah iyo dadka hortooda Nicmo iyo sharaf uga heli doontaa.
english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

kikuyu: Qalbigaaga dhammaantii Rabbiga ku aamin, Oo waxgarashadaadana ha isku hallayn.
english: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

kikuyu: Jidadkaaga oo dhan isaga ku qiro, Oo isna waddooyinkaaguu toosin doonaa.
english: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

kikuyu: Ha isla weynaan; Rabbiga ka cabso; oo sharka ka fogow.
english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

kikuyu: Taasu waxay xundhurtaada u noqon doontaa caafimaad, Oo lafahaagana waxay u noqon doontaa dhuux.
english: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ku murwee maalkaaga Iyo midhaha ugu horreeya waxa kuu kordha oo dhan;
english: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

kikuyu: Sidaasay maqsinnadaadu barwaaqo uga buuxsami doonaan, Macsarooyinkaaguna waxay la buuxdhaafi doonaan khamri cusub.
english: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, Rabbiga edbintiisa ha quudhsan, Oo canaantiisana ha ka daalin,
english: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu ninkuu jecel yahay wuu canaantaa Sida aabbe u canaanto wiilkii uu ku faraxsan yahay.
english: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninkii xigmadda hela, Iyo ninkii waxgarashada mulkiya.
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

kikuyu: Waayo, baayacmushtarigeedu waa ka sii wanaagsan yahay baayacmushtariga lacagta, Oo faa'iidadeeduna waa ka sii wanaagsan tahay dahabka saafiga ah.
english: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

kikuyu: Way ka sii qaalisan tahay luulka, Oo waxaad jeclaan kartid oo dhanna iyada lalama simo.
english: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

kikuyu: Gacanteeda midig waxaa ku jira cimri dheeri; Gacanteeda bidixna waxaa ku jira hodonnimo iyo sharaf.
english: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

kikuyu: Jidadkeedu waa jidad farxadeed, Oo waddooyinkeeda oo dhammuna waa nabad.
english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

kikuyu: Kuwii iyada qabsada waxay u tahay geed nololeed; Oo waxaa barakaysan ku alla kii iyada xajista.
english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu dhulka ku aasaasay xigmadda, Oo samooyinkana wuxuu ku dhisay waxgarashada.
english: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

kikuyu: Aqoontiisa ayaa moolalku ku dillaaceen, Oo cirkuna wuxuu soo daadiyaa sayax.
english: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, waxyaalahanu yaanay indhahaaga ka tegin. Xigmadda iyo digtoonaanta xajiso.
english: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

kikuyu: Sidaasay naftaada nolol ugu noqon doonaan, Qoortaadana nimco.
english: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

kikuyu: Markaasaad jidkaaga ammaan ku mari doontaa, Oo cagtaaduna ma turunturoon doonto.
english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

kikuyu: Markaad jiifsatidna ma cabsan doontid; Haah, waad jiifsan doontaa, oo hurdadaaduna way kuu macaanaan doontaa.
english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

kikuyu: Ha ka baqin cabsi kedis ah, Iyo baabbi'inta kuwa sharka leh toona markii ay timaado.
english: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu kuu ahaan doonaa Kan aad ku kalsoonaan karto. Oo cagtaadana wuu dhawri doonaa si aan loo qabsan.
english: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

kikuyu: Wanaag ha u diidin kuwa uu ku habboon yahay in loo sameeyo, Markaad awood u leedahay inaad u samayso.
english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

kikuyu: Deriskaaga ha ku odhan, Tag oo soo noqo, Berri baan ku siin doonaaye, Haddii aad markaas haysid.
english: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

kikuyu: Deriskaaga innaba xumaan ha u fikirin, Maxaa yeelay, isagu nabadgelyo buu kuu ag fadhiyaa.
english: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

kikuyu: Ninna sababla'aan ha kula diririn, Haddaanu xumaan kugu samayn.
english: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

kikuyu: Ha ka hinaasin nin dadka dulmiya, Oo jidadkiisana midnaba ha dooran.
english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, kuwa qalloocanu waa u karaahiyo Rabbiga, Laakiinse wuxuu sir la leeyahay kuwa qumman.
english: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu inkaaraa guriga kii shar leh, Laakiinse rugta kuwa xaqa ah wuu barakeeyaa.
english: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Hubaal kuwa wax quudhsada ayuu isagu quudhsadaa, Kuwa is-hoosaysiiyase nicmuu siiyaa.
english: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

kikuyu: Kuwa xigmadda leh waxay dhaxli doonaan sharaf, Laakiinse nacasyadu waxay u dallici doonaan ceeb.
english: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

kikuyu: Wiilashoy, aabbe edbintiisa maqla, Oo u jeesta inaad wax garataan.
english: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu waxaan idin siiyaa tacliin wanaagsan, Haddaba cilmigayga ha ka tegina.
english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

kikuyu: Waayo, aniguba waxaan aabbahay u ahaa wiil, Oo mid yar oo bacbac ah oo madi ah ayaan u ahaa hooyaday.
english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

kikuyu: Isagu wax buu i baray, oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Qalbigaagu erayadayda ha xajisto; Amarradaydana dhawr, oo waad noolaan doontaa.
english: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

kikuyu: Xigmadda doono, waxgarashadana doono; Hana illoobin, oo erayada afkaygana dib ha uga noqon.
english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Xigmadda ha ka tegin, oo way ku nabad gelin doontaa. Jeclow, oo way ku dhawri doontaa.
english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

kikuyu: Xigmaddu wax walbay ugu horraysaa, sidaas daraaddeed xigmadda doono; Wax kastoo aad hesho weliba waxgarasho doono.
english: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

kikuyu: Iyada sarraysii, oo iyana way ku dallicin doontaa; Oo sharaf bay kuu yeeli doontaa markaad iyada isku duubtid.
english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

kikuyu: Iyadu waxay madaxaaga siin doontaa wax sharraxsan, Oo waxayna kuu yeeli doontaa taaj quruxsan.
english: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, maqal oo hadalladayda aqbal. Oo sannadaha cimrigaaguna way badnaan doonaan.
english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ku baray jidkii xigmadda; Oo waxaan kugu hoggaamiyey waddooyinkii qummanaanta.
english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

kikuyu: Markii aad socotid tallaabooyinkaagu cidhiidhi ma noqon doonaan, Oo haddaad oroddidna ma turunturoon doontid.
english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

kikuyu: Edbinta xajiso, oo ha iska sii deyn; Hayso, waayo, iyadu waa noloshaada,
english: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

kikuyu: Waddada kuwa sharka leh ha gelin, Oo jidka xumaanfalayaashana ha qaadin.
english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

kikuyu: Ka leexo, hana marin, Ka noqo oo hareer ka mar.
english: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu ma seexdaan haddaanay xumaan falin, Oo hurdadoodana waa laga qaadaa iyagoo cid kufiya mooyaane.
english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu waxay cunaan kibistii sharnimada, Oo waxay cabbaan khamrigii dulmiga.
english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waddada kuwa xaqa ahu waa sida iftiinka waaberiga oo kale, Kaas oo hadba soo kordha ilaa uu noqdo maalin cad.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

kikuyu: Jidka kuwa sharka lahuna waa sida gudcurka oo kale. Oo iyagu garan maayaan waxay ku turunturoodaan.
english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, erayadayda dhegayso, Oo hadalladaydana dhegta u dhig.
english: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

kikuyu: Indhahaaga hortooda yaanay ka fogaan, Oo qalbigaaga dhexdiisa ku hayso,
english: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu waa u nolol kuwa hela, Oo jidhkooda oo dhanna waa u caafimaad.
english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

kikuyu: Digtoonaan qalbigaaga u dhawr, Waayo, isagay noloshu ka soo baxdaaye.
english: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

kikuyu: Af qalloocan iska saar, Oo bushimo maroorsanna iska fogee.
english: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

kikuyu: Indhahaagu qummaati wax ha u fiiriyeen, Oo indhahaaga daboolkooduna si toosan hortaada ha u eegeen.
english: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

kikuyu: Waddada cagahaaga aad ugu fiirso, Oo jidadkaaga oo dhammuna ha toosnaadeen.
english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

kikuyu: Xagga midigta iyo xagga bidixda toona ha u leexan, Oo cagtaadana xumaanta ka fogee.
english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, xigmaddayda dhegayso, Oo waxgarashadaydana dhegta u dhig;
english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

kikuyu: Si aad digtoonaan u dhawrtid, Oo ay bushimahaaguna aqoon u xejiyaan.
english: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

kikuyu: Waayo, naagta qalaad bushimaheedu waxay daadiyaan malab, Oo afkeeduna saliid buu ka sii macaan yahay,
english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

kikuyu: Laakiinse aakhirkeedu wuxuu u qadhaadh yahay sida geed dacareed oo kale, Wuuna af badan yahay sida seef laba af leh.
english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

kikuyu: Cagaheedu dhimashay ku dhaadhacaan, Oo tallaabooyinkeeduna waxay u jeedaan xagga She'ool,
english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

kikuyu: Waddada nolosha iyadu aad uguma fiirsato. Jidadkeedu waa leexleexdaan, oo garan kari maysid,
english: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed, wiilashoy, bal i maqla, Oo erayada afkayga ha ka tegina.
english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Jidkaaga ka fogee iyada, Oo albaabka gurigeeda ha u dhowaan,
english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

kikuyu: Si aanad sharaftaada kuwa kale u siin, Oo aanad sannadahaaga kuwa caloosha adag u siin,
english: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
