kikuyu: Si aan shisheeyayaal maalkaaga uga dhergin; Oo aanay wixii aad u hawshootay guri ajnabi u gelin,
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

kikuyu: Si aanad ugu dambaysta u barooran, Markay hilibkaaga iyo jidhkaaguba baabba'aan,
english: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

kikuyu: Oo aad tidhaahdaan, Sidee baan edbin u nebcaaday, Oo qalbigayguna canaantii u quudhsaday!
english: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

kikuyu: Codkii macallimiintaydii ma aan addeecin, Oo dhegtana uma aan dhigin kuwii wax i baray!
english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan u dhowaa inaan shar kasta falo Anigoo ku dhex jira shirka iyo ururka.
english: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

kikuyu: Berkeddaada biyo ka cab, Oo ceelkaagana biyo qulqulaya ka cab.
english: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

kikuyu: Ma hagaag baa in ilahaagu dibadda u daataan. Oo ay durdurraduna dariiqyada maraan?
english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

kikuyu: Iyagu ha ahaadeen kuwaaga oo keliya, Oo yaanay u ahaan shisheeyayaal adiga kula jira.
english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

kikuyu: Ishaadu ha barakaysnaato, Oo naagtaadii aad yaraanta ku guursatay ku faraxsanow.
english: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

kikuyu: Iyadu ha kuu ahaato sida deerada jacaylka badan iyo sida cawsha quruxsan, Goor walbana naasaheedu ha ku deeqeen Oo had iyo goorna jacaylkeeda ku faraxsanow.
english: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

kikuyu: Haddaba wiilkaygiiyow, bal maxaad naag qalaad ugu faraxsanaanaysaa, Maxaadse naag shisheeye ah naasaheeda u qabsanaysaa?
english: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

kikuyu: Waayo, jidadka dadku waxay hor yaalliin indhaha Rabbiga Oo isagaa fiiriya waddooyinkiisa oo dhan.
english: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

kikuyu: Kan sharka leh waxaa qabsan doonta xumaantiisa, Oo waxaa isaga lagu soo xidhi doonaa xadhkaha dembigiisa.
english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u dhiman doonaa edbinla'aanta, Oo isagu wuxuu ku dhex amban doonaa badnaanta nacasnimadiisa.
english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, haddaad deriskaaga dammiin u noqotid, Ama haddaad shisheeye gacanta dhaar ugu dhiibtid,
english: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa lagugu dabay erayada afkaaga, Oo waxaa lagugu qabtay erayada afkaaga.
english: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

kikuyu: Haddaba, wiilkaygiiyow, bal waxan samee oo isa samatabbixi, Waayo, gacantii deriskaagii waad gashay; U tag, oo is-hoosaysii, oo deriskaaga bari.
english: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

kikuyu: Indhahaaga hurdo ha isugu keenin, Oo indhahaaga daboolkoodana lulo ha isugu qaban.
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

kikuyu: Isu samatabbixi sida cawl gacanta ugaadhsadaha uga baxsato, Iyo sida shimbir gacanta shimbirdabaha uga baxsato.
english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

kikuyu: Kaaga caajiska ahow, bal qudhaanjada u tag, Oo bal jidadkeeda u fiirso oo caqli yeelo,
english: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

kikuyu: Iyadoo aan lahayn madaxweyne, Sirkaal iyo taliye toona,
english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

kikuyu: Ayay guga cuntadeeda soo diyaarsataa, Oo quudkeedana waxay soo urursataa wakhtiga beeraha la goosto.
english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

kikuyu: Haddaba kaaga caajiska ahow, ilaa goormaad hurdaysaa? Goormaadse hurdadaada ka toosaysaa?
english: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

kikuyu: Weliba, in yar baad seexataa, in yar baad lulootaa, Oo in yar baad gacmaha hurdo aawadeed u laabataa,
english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

kikuyu: Hadda caydhinimadaadu waxay u iman doontaa sida mid dad dhaca, Oo baahidaaduna waxay u iman doontaa sida nin hub wata.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

kikuyu: Qofkii waxmatare ah, iyo ninkii sharrow ahuba, Wuxuu ku socdaa af qalloocan;
english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

kikuyu: Indhihiisuu ku baaqaa, oo cagihiisuu ku hadlaa, Oo faruhuu wax ku baraa;
english: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

kikuyu: Qalbigiisa qalloocnaan baa ku jirta, had iyo goorna wuxuu ku fikiraa shar, Oo wuxuu beeraa muran.
english: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed masiibadiisu degdeg bay u iman doontaa, Oo dhaqso buu u jabi doonaa, dawona ma leh.
english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira lix waxyaalood oo uu Rabbigu neceb yahay, Haah, toddoba ayaa naftiisu aad u karahdaa,
english: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

kikuyu: Waana indho kibir badan, carrab been sheega, Iyo gacmo dhiig aan eed lahayn daadiya,
english: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

kikuyu: Qalbi male shar ah hindisa, Iyo cago xumaan ku degdega,
english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

kikuyu: Markhaati been ah oo been sheega, Iyo kii muran dad walaalo ah ku dhex beera.
english: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, qaynuunka aabbahaa xaji, Oo amarka hooyadaana ha ka tegin.
english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

kikuyu: Had iyo goorba qalbiga ku sido, Oo qoortana ku xidho.
english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

kikuyu: Markaad socotid wuu ku hoggaamin doonaa, Oo markaad seexatidna wuu ku dhawri doonaa, Markaad toostidna wuu kula hadli doonaa.
english: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

kikuyu: Waayo, qaynuunku waa laambad, amarkuna waa iftiin, Oo canaanashada edbintuna waa jidkii nolosha,
english: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

kikuyu: Inay kaa dhawraan naagta sharka ah, Iyo sasabashada carrabka naagta qalaad.
english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

kikuyu: Quruxdeeda qalbigaaga ha ka damcin, Oo yaanay indhaheeda daboolkooda kugu sasaban.
english: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

kikuyu: Waayo, naag dhillo ah aawadeed waxaa nin la gaadhsiiyaa go' kibis ah, Oo dhilladuna waxay ugaadhsataa nafta qaaligaa.
english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

kikuyu: Miyuu nin laabta dab ku qaadi karaa, Iyadoo aan dharkiisu guban?
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

kikuyu: Miyuu mid dhuxul kulul ku kor socon karaa, Iyadoo aan cagihiisu guban?
english: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas oo kaluu noqdaa kii naagta deriskiisa u tagaa, Oo ku alla kii iyada taabtaaba ma taqsiir la'aan doono.
english: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Dadku tuug ma quudhsadaan hadduu wax xado Inuu naftiisa dhergiyo markuu gaajoodo,
english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii isaga la qabto waa inuu toddoba jibbaar u magdhabaa, Waa inuu ku bixiyaa waxa gurigiisa yaal oo dhan.
english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

kikuyu: Kii naag ka sinaystaa wuu caqli daranyahay, Oo kii sidaas yeelaa naftiisuu halligaa.
english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu heli doonaa dhaawacyo iyo sharafdarro; Oo ceebtiisana lama tirtiri doono innaba.
english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

kikuyu: Waayo, hinaaso waa nin cadhadiis. Maalinta aarsashadana isagu ma tudhi doono.
english: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

kikuyu: Isagu innaba mag kaa qaadan maayo, oo sinaba kuula heshiin maayo, In kastoo aad hadiyado badan siisid.
english: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, erayadayda xaji, Oo amarradaydana xaggaaga ku kaydso.
english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

kikuyu: Amarradayda xaji aad noolaatide, Oo sharcigaygana sida ishaada inankeeda u dhawr.
english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

kikuyu: Farahaaga ku xidho, Oo looxa qalbigaagana ku qoro.
english: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: Waxaad xigmadda ku tidhaahdaa, Adigu waxaad tahay walaashay, Oo waxgarashadana waxaad ugu yeedhaa, saaxiibadday gacalisoy,
english: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

kikuyu: Si ay iyagu kaaga celiyaan naagta qalaad, Taasoo erayadeeda kugu sasabata.
english: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigoo jooga daaqadda gurigayga Ayaan shabagga daaqadda wax ka fiiriyey,
english: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa garaadka daran ayaan fiiriyey, oo waxaan barbaarrada ku dhex arkay Nin dhallinyaraa oo aan innaba waxgarasho lahayn,
english: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

kikuyu: Isagoo maraya dariiqa xaafaddeeda u dhow, Oo wuxuu raacay jidkii gurigeeda,
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

kikuyu: Oo waxay ahayd gabbaldhac oo makhribka ah, markii habeenkii madoobaanayay oo gudcur noqonayay.
english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa isagii ka hor timid naag Sidii dhillo u lebbisan, oo qalbigeedu khiyaano miidhan yahay.
english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

kikuyu: Iyadu waa rabshad badan tahay, waana caasiyad, Oo gurigeeda cag sooma dhigto.
english: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

kikuyu: Mar dibadday joogtaa, marna dariiqyaday maraysaa, Oo rukun kasta wax bay ku sugtaa.
english: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

kikuyu: Haddaba isagii way qabsatay, oo dhunkatay; Iyadoo aan wejigeedu xishood lahayn ayay waxay isagii ku tidhi,
english: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan hayaa allabaryo nabdeed, Oo maanta ayaan nidarradaydii bixiyey.
english: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan u soo baxay inaan kula kulmo, Oo aan aad iyo aad wejigaaga u doondoono, waanan ku helay.
english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

kikuyu: Sariirtaydii waxaan ku goglay durraaxado daabac leh, Iyo marooyin duntii Masar laga sameeyey.
english: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

kikuyu: Waxaan sariirtaydii ku cadariyey Malmal iyo cuud iyo qorfe.
english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

kikuyu: Kaalay, oo aan caashaq ka dheregno ilaa aroorta, Oo aynu jacayl ku faraxsanaanno.
english: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

kikuyu: Waayo, ninkaygii guriga ma joogo, Oo meel fog buu u sodcaalay,
english: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

kikuyu: Kiish lacag ahna wuu qaatay, Oo wuxuu guriga ku soo noqon doonaa markuu dayaxu caddaado.
english: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

kikuyu: Hadalkeedii badnaa oo macaanaa ayay isagii isku yeelsiisay, Oo waxay isagii ku qasabtay faankii beenta ahaa oo bushimeheeda.
english: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

kikuyu: Oo haddiiba iyadii buu daba galay, Sidii dibi loo wado in la gowraco, Ama sidii nacas loo wado in silsilado lagu jebiyo,
english: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

kikuyu: Jeer fallaadh beerka lagaga wareemo, Sida shimbiru dabinka degdeg ku gasho, Iyadoo aan ogayn in loo dhigay si nafteeda loo qaado.
english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed, wiilashoy, bal i maqla, Oo erayada afkayga dhegaysta.
english: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Qalbigiinnu yaanu jidadkeeda u leexan, Oo waddooyinkeedana ha ku dhex habaabina.
english: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

kikuyu: Waayo, iyadu waxay ridday kuwa badan oo dhaawacan, Sida xaqiiqada kuway laysay aad bay u badan yihiin.
english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

kikuyu: Gurigeedu waa jidkii She'ool, Oo wuxuu hoos ugu dhaadhacaa dhimashada qolladaheeda.
english: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

kikuyu: Haddaba xigmaddu sow ma dhawaaqin? Waxgarashaduna codkeedii sow kor uma qaadin?
english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

kikuyu: Waxay taagan tahay meelaha sarreeya Oo jidka agtiisa ah, meesha waddooyinku ku kulmaan.
english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ka qaylisaa irdaha agtooda, Meesha magaalada laga soo galo, Iyo meesha albaabbada laga soo galoba.
english: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

kikuyu: Nimanyahow, idinkaan idiin dhawaaqayaa, Oo codkayguna wuxuu u yeedhayaa binu-aadmiga.
english: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

kikuyu: Garaadlaawayaashow, miyir lahaada, Nacasyadoy, waxgarasho qalbiga ku haysta.
english: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

kikuyu: I maqla, waayo, waxaan ku hadlayaa waxyaalo wanaagsan, Oo waxaan bushimaha u kala qaadayaa waxyaalo qumman.
english: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, afkaygu run buu ku hadlayaa; Oo bushimahayguna shar bay karhaan.
english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

kikuyu: Erayada afkayga oo dhammi waa xaq, Oo innaba wax qalloocan ama maroorsan lagama helo.
english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

kikuyu: Iyagu dhammaantood waa u cad yihiin kii wax garanaya, Oo waana u qumman yihiin kuwa aqoonta hela.
english: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

kikuyu: Edbintayda qaata, lacagse ha qaadanina, Oo aqoontana ka hor doorta dahabka saafiga ah.
english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

kikuyu: Waayo, xigmaddu waa ka sii wanaagsan tahay luulka, Oo wax alla waxa la damci karo oo dhanna iyada lalama simi karo.
english: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

kikuyu: Anigoo xigmad ahu, waxaan la fadhiyaa miyir, Oo waxaan helaa aqoon iyo digtoonaan.
english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisu waa in sharka la naco. Kibirka, iyo madaxweynaanta, iyo jidka sharka, Iyo afka qalloocan ayaan anigu necbahay.
english: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

kikuyu: Talo iyo xigmad anigaa iska leh, Oo waxaan ahay waxgarasho, xoogna waan leeyahay.
english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

kikuyu: Boqorradu gacantayday wax ku xukumaan, Oo amiirraduna amarkaygay garta ku gooyaan.
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

kikuyu: Taliyayaasha iyo saraakiisha iyo weliba xaakinnada dunida oo dhammuna Anigay wax iigu taliyaan.
english: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

kikuyu: Anigu kuwa i jecel waan jeclahay, Oo kuwa aad iyo aad ii doonaana way i heli doonaan.
english: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

kikuyu: Anigaa iska leh taajirnimo iyo sharaf. Iyo weliba maal raagaya iyo xaqnimoba.
english: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

kikuyu: Midhahaygu way ka sii wanaagsan yihiin dahab, haah, oo xataa dahab aad u wanaagsan way ka sii wanaagsan yihiin, Oo waxa ii kordhaana way ka sii wanaagsan yihiin lacag la doortay.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ku socdaa jidka xaqnimada, Iyo waddooyinka garta dhexdooda,
english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

kikuyu: Si aan kuwa i jecel uga dhigo inay maal dhaxlaan, Oo aan khasnadahooda ugu buuxiyo.
english: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu i lahaan jiray bilowgii jidkiisa Iyo shuqulladiisii hore ka hor.
english: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

kikuyu: Aniga aakhirada hore waa lay taagay, waxaan jiray bilowgii ugu horreeyey, Ama intaan dunidu jirin ka hor.
english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan dhashay intaan moolal jirin ka hor, Iyo intaanay jirin ilo biyo ka buuxaan.
english: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

kikuyu: Intaan la qotomin buuraha Iyo kuraha ka hor ayaan anigu dhashay,
english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

kikuyu: Intaanuu isagu samayn dhulka iyo berrimmada, Amase ciiddii dunida ugu horraysay.
english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

kikuyu: Markuu samooyinka hagaajiyey anigu waan joogay, Markuu xariijinta ku wareejiyey moolka dushiisa,
english: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

kikuyu: Markuu cirka sare taagay, Markii ilaha moolku xoog yeesheen,
english: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

kikuyu: Markuu badda xad u yeelay Si aan biyuhu amarkiisa ugu xadgudbin, Markuu aasaaskii dhulka dhigay,
english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

kikuyu: Markaas anigu isagaan dhinac joogay, anigoo ah sidii hawlhoggaamiye, Oo anigu maalin kasta faraxiisaan ahaa, Oo mar kasta hortiisaan ku rayrayn jiray;
english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

kikuyu: Waxaan ku rayrayn jiray inta dhulkiisa la degay, Oo waxaan ku farxi jiray binu-aadmiga.
english: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed, wiilashoy, bal i maqla; Waayo, waxaa barakaysan kuwa jidadkayga xajiya.
english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

kikuyu: Edbinta dhegaysta, oo caqli yeesha, Oo ha diidina.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninka i maqla, Oo maalin kasta irdahayga igu dhawra, Oo albaabbadayda igu suga.
english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

kikuyu: Waayo, ku alla kii i helaa wuxuu helaa nolol, Oo Rabbiguna raalli buu ka ahaan doonaa.
english: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kii igu dembaabaa naftiisuu wax yeelaa, Kuwa aniga i neceb oo dhammu waxay jecel yihiin dhimasho.
english: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

kikuyu: Xigmaddu gurigeeday dhisatay, Toddobadeedii tiirna way xaradhay.
english: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

kikuyu: Neefafkeedii ayay qashay, oo waxay isku dartay khamrigeedii; Miiskeediina way diyaarisay.
english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

kikuyu: Oo gabdhaheedii midiidinnada ahaa ayay dirtay, oo waxay ka qaylinaysaa Magaalada meelaha ugu sarreeya, iyadoo leh,
english: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

kikuyu: Ku alla kii garaaddaranu, halkan ha u soo leexdo. Oo kii waxgarasho u baahanna waxay ku leedahay,
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kikuyu: Kaalaya oo kibistayda wax ka cuna, Oo khamriga aan isku darayna wax ka cabba.
english: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

kikuyu: Garaadlaawayaashow, nacasnimada iska daaya, oo noolaada, Oo jidka waxgarashadana mara.
english: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

kikuyu: Kii mid wax quudhsada toosiyaa, cay buu isu soo jiidaa, Oo kii kan sharka leh canaantana, ceeb baa ku dhacda.
english: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

kikuyu: Mid wax quudhsada ha canaanan, waaba intaas oo uu ku necbaadaaye, Nin caqli leh canaano, oo isna wuu ku jeclaan doonaa.
english: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

kikuyu: Nin caqli leh wax bar, oo isna caqli wuu sii yeelan doonaa. Nin xaq ah wax bar, oo isna waxbarasho wuu sii korodhsan doonaa.
english: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

kikuyu: Rabbiga in laga cabsado waa xigmadda bilowgeeda, Oo Kan quduuska ah in la aqoonsadona waa waxgarasho.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

kikuyu: Waayo, maalmahaagu anigay igu badan doonaan, Oo cimrigaaguna waa sii kordhi doonaa.
english: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

kikuyu: Haddaad caqli leedahay naftaadaad caqli u leedahay, Laakiinse haddaad wax quudhsato, adiga uun baa waxquudhsashadaada xambaaran doona.
english: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

kikuyu: Naagta nacasadda ahu waa qaylo badan tahay, Iyadu way garaaddaran tahay, oo waxba ma taqaan.
english: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay fadhiisataa illinka gurigeeda, Oo kursi bay ku fadhiisataa meelaha sarsare ee magaalada,
english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

kikuyu: Inay u yeedho kuwa jidka maraya, Iyagoo jidadkooda iska sii soconaya,
english: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

kikuyu: Ku alla kii garaaddaranu halkan ha u soo leexdo, Oo kii waxgarasho u baahanna waxay ku leedahay,
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kikuyu: Biyo la soo xaday way macaan yihiin. Oo cunto qarsoodi loo cunaana wax bay ka farxisaa.
english: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse isagu garan maayo in kuwii dhintay ay halkaas joogaan, Iyo in martideedii ay She'ool guntiisa ku jiraan.
english: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

kikuyu: Maahmaahyadii Sulaymaan. Wiilka caqliga lahu aabbihiisuu ka farxiyaa, Laakiinse wiilka nacaska ahu waa u caloolxumo hooyadiis.
english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

kikuyu: Qasnadaha sharnimadu faa'iido ma leh, Laakiinse xaqnimada ayaa dhimasho kaa samatabbixisa.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ah naftiisu inay gaajooto Rabbigu u oggolaan maayo, Laakiinse doonista kuwa sharka leh ayuu ridaa.
english: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

kikuyu: Kii gacan caajis ah lahu wuu caydhoobaa, Laakiinse kuwa dadaala gacantoodu hodan bay ka dhigtaa.
english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

kikuyu: Kii guga wax soo urursadaa waa wiil caqli leh, Laakiinse kii wakhtiga beergooyska seexdaa waa wiil ceeb sameeya.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

kikuyu: Barako waxay saaran tahay kan xaqa ah madaxiisa, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh afkooda dulmi baa qariya.
english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah xusuustiisu barako bay leedahay, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh magacoodu waa qudhmi doonaa.
english: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

kikuyu: Kii qalbiga caqli ku lahu amarro buu aqbalaa, Laakiinse kan bushimaha ka nacaska ahu afgembi buu u dhacaa.
english: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

kikuyu: Kii qummanaan ku socdaa ammaan buu ku socdaa; Laakiinse kii jidadkiisa qalqalloociya waa la ogaan doonaa.
english: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

kikuyu: Kii indhaha ku baaqaa murug buu keenaa. Laakiinse kan bushimaha ka nacaska ahu afgembi buu u dhacaa.
english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

kikuyu: Ninkii xaq ah afkiisu waa il nololeed, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh afkooda dulmi baa qariya.
english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Necbaantu waxay kicisaa isqabashada, Laakiinse jacaylku xadgudubyada oo dhan buu qariyaa.
english: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

kikuyu: Kii waxgarasho leh bushimihiisa waxaa laga helaa xigmad, Laakiinse ushu waxay u taal kan garaadka daran dhabarkiisa.
english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Dadkii caqli lahu waxay kaydsadaan aqoon, Laakiinse nacaska afkiisu waa baabba' dhow.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

kikuyu: Ninkii hodan ah maalkiisu waa u magaalo xoog leh, Laakiinse masaakiinta caydhnimadoodu waa u baabba'.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ah hawshoodu waxay u waddaa nolol, Laakiinse waxa kan sharka leh u kordhaa, dembi bay u sii kexeeyaan.
english: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

kikuyu: Kii edbinta xajistaa wuxuu ku socdaa jidka nolosha, Laakiinse kii canaanta diidaa wuu qaldamaa.
english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

kikuyu: Kii necbaanta qariyaa wuxuu leeyahay bushimo been badan, Oo kii xanta ku hadlaana waa nacas.
english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

kikuyu: Hadal badan dembi lagama waayo, Laakiinse kii bushimihiisa ceshaa caqli buu leeyahay.
english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ah carrabkiisu waa sida lacag la doortay, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh qalbigoodu waa qiimo yar yahay.
english: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ah bushimahiisu waxay masruufaan kuwa badan, Laakiinse nacasyadu waxgarashola'aantooda ayay u dhintaan.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

kikuyu: Rabbiga barakadiisu hodan bay kaa dhigtaa, Oo isna caloolxumo kuma daro.
english: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

kikuyu: Nacasku inuu xumaan sameeyo waa u sidii cayaareed, Laakiinse ninka garaadka lahu xigmad buu leeyahay.
english: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

kikuyu: Kii shar leh wuxuu ka cabsado ayaa ku soo dul degi doona, Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ah waxay doonayaan waa la siin doonaa.
english: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

kikuyu: Markii dabaysha cirwareenta ahu dhaafto, ka sharka leh mar dambe la arki maayo, Laakiinse kii xaq ahu waa aasaas weligiis waaraya.
english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

kikuyu: Khalku siduu ilkaha u yahay, iyo sida qiiqu indhaha u yahay, Ayaa kan caajiska ahu u yahay kuwa isaga dirta.
english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisu cimrigay dheeraysaa, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh cimrigoodu waa soo gaaban doonaa.
english: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ah rajadoodu waa farxad, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh filashadoodu way baabbi'i doontaa.
english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Rabbiga jidkiisu waa u qalcad kuwa qumman; Laakiinse xumaanfalayaasha waa u baabba'.
english: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah weligiis la dhaqaajin maayo, Laakiinse kuwa sharka lahu dhulka ma fadhiyi doonaan.
english: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah afkiisa waxaa ka soo baxda xigmad, Laakiinse carrabkii qalloocan waa la gooyn doonaa.
english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah bushimahiisu waxay yaqaaniin waxa la aqbali karo, Laakiinse kan sharka leh afkiisu qallooc buu ku hadlaa.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

kikuyu: Kafaddii khiyaano ah Rabbigu aad buu u karhaa, Laakiinse dhagaxii miisaanka oo xaq ah wuu ku farxaa.
english: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

kikuyu: Markuu kibir yimaado, waxaa timaada ceeb; Laakiinse xigmaddu waxay la jirtaa kuwa is-hoosaysiiya.
english: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

kikuyu: Kuwa qumman waxaa kaxayn doonta daacadnimadooda, Laakiinse khaayinnada qalloocnaantoodu waa baabbi'in doontaa iyaga.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

kikuyu: Maalinta cadhada maal faa'iido ma leh, Laakiinse xaqnimada ayaa dhimasho kaa samatabbixisa.
english: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: Ninkii kaamil ah xaqnimadiisu jidkiisay toosisaa, Laakiinse kan sharka lahu wuxuu ku kufi doonaa sharkiisa.
english: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

kikuyu: Kuwa qumman xaqnimadoodaa samatabbixin doonta, Laakiinse khaayinnada waxaa qabsan doona damacooda xun.
english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

kikuyu: Nin shar lahu markuu dhinto, wuxuu filanayay way baabbi'i doontaa, Oo xumaanfalayaasha rajadooduna way baabba'daa.
english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ah waxaa laga samatabbixiyaa dhibaato, Oo meeshiisana waxaa yimaada kii shar leh.
english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

kikuyu: Labawejiilahu afkiisuu deriskiisa ku halligaa, Laakiinse kan xaqa ahu aqoon buu ku samatabbixi doonaa.
english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ahu markay barwaaqoobaan, magaaladu way rayraysaa, Laakiin kuwa sharka lahu markay halligmaan farax baa lagu dhawaaqaa.
english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

kikuyu: Kuwa qumman ducadooda magaaladu sare bay ugu kacdaa, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh afkoodu magaaladuu dumiyaa.
english: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Kii deriskiisa quudhsadaa waa caqli daranyahay, Laakiinse ninkii garaadka lahu wuu iska aamusaa.
english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

kikuyu: Kii sida mid xan badan u warwareegaa wuxuu daaha ka qaadaa waxyaalo qarsoon, Laakiinse kii ruuxiisu aamin yahay xaalkuu qariyaa.
english: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

kikuyu: Markaanay talo jirin, dadku waa dhacaa, Laakiinse taliyayaasha badnaantoodu waxay leedahay nabadgelyo.
english: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

kikuyu: Kii qof qalaad dammiintaa, xumaan buu ka helaa, Laakiinse kii dammiinashada necebu ammaan buu u fadhiyaa.
english: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

kikuyu: Naag nimcaysan sharaf bay haysataa, Oo niman xoog lahuna maal bay haystaan.
english: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

kikuyu: Ninkii naxariis badanu naftiisuu wanaag u sameeyaa, Laakiinse kii aan naxariis lahaynu jidhkiisuu dhibaa.
english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

kikuyu: Kan sharka lahu wuxuu shaqaystaa mushahaaro khiyaano miidhan ah, Laakiinse kii xaqnimada beeraa wuxuu heli doonaa abaalgud la hubo.
english: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

kikuyu: Xaqnimadu waxay u kacdaa xagga nolosha, Sidaas oo kalena kii sharka raacaa wuxuu u raacaa dhimashadiisa.
english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

kikuyu: Kuwa qalbigoodu qalloocan yahay Rabbigu aad buu u karhaa; Laakiinse kuwa jidkooda ku qumman wuu ku farxaa.
english: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

kikuyu: Waxaan aad idiinku xaqiijinayaa inaan kan sharka lahu taqsiirla'aan doonayn. Laakiinse farcanka kuwa xaqa ah waa la samatabbixin doonaa.
english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

kikuyu: Naag qurux badan oo aan digtoonaan lahaynu Waa sida dahab gafuurka doofaarka ku jira.
english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ah waxay doonayaan wanaag keliya, Laakiinse kuwa sharka ah filashadoodu waa cadho.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira mid wax firdhiya, oo haddana sii korodhsada; Oo waxaa jira mid ceshada wax ka sii badan in ku habboon, oo haddana sii caydhooba.
english: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

kikuyu: Qofkii deeqsi ah baa la barwaaqaysiin doonaa, Oo kii wax waraabiyana, isna waa la waraabin doonaa.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

kikuyu: Kii hadhuudh ceshada, dadka ayaa habaari doona, Laakiinse kii iibiya, duco ayaa ku dhici doonta.
english: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

kikuyu: Kii wanaag aad u doonaa wuxuu doonayaa raallinimo, Laakiinse kii xumaan doona, way u iman doontaa.
english: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

kikuyu: Kii maalkiisa isku halleeyaa wuu dhici doonaa, Laakiinse kii xaq ahu wuxuu u barwaaqoobi doonaa sida caleen cagaar ah.
english: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

kikuyu: Kii gurigiisa dhibaa dabayshu dhaxli doonaa, Oo nacaskuna wuxuu midiidin u ahaan doonaa kan qalbigiisu caqliga leeyahay.
english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah midhihiisu waa geed nololeed, Oo kii nafo soo hanuuniyaana caqli buu leeyahay.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

kikuyu: Bal eega, kan xaqa ahu abaalkiisuu dhulka ku heli doonaa, Haddaba immisa abaalgud oo ka sii badan bay heli doonaan kan sharka leh iyo dembiluhu.
english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

kikuyu: Ku alla kii edbinta jecelu aqoon buu jecel yahay, Laakiinse kii canaanta necebu waa doqon.
english: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

kikuyu: Rabbigu ninka wanaagsan raalli buu ka ahaan doonaa. Laakiinse khaayinka wuu xukumi doonaa.
english: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

kikuyu: Ninna shar kuma dhismi doono, Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ah xididkooda weligiis lama dhaqaajin doono.
english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Naagtii toolmoonu waxay ninkeeda u tahay taaj, Laakiinse tii ceebalay ahu waa sida qudhun isaga lafaha kaga jira.
english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ah fikirradoodu waa qumman yihiin, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh taladoodu waa khiyaano.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka leh erayadoodu waa gabbasho ay u gabbadaan si ay dhiig u daadiyaan, Laakiinse kuwa qumman afkooda ayaa samatabbixin doona.
english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka leh waa la afgembiyaa, oo mar dambena lama arki doono, Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ah gurigoodu waa sii taagnaan doonaa.
english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

kikuyu: Nin waxaa loogu bogi doonaa sida xigmaddiisu tahay, Laakiinse kii qalbigiisu qalloocan yahay waa la quudhsan doonaa.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

kikuyu: Kii la fudaydsado oo midiidin lahu Waa ka wanaagsan yahay kii isweyneeya oo cunto u baahan.
english: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

kikuyu: Nin xaq ahu waa u tudhaa neefkiisa, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh naxdintoodu waa naxariisla'aan oo keliya.
english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

kikuyu: Kii dhulkiisa beertaa cunto badan buu ka dhergi doonaa, Laakiinse kii waxmatarayaal raacaa waa garaad daranyahay.
english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Kan sharka lahu wuxuu damcaa dabinka xumaanfalayaasha, Laakiinse xididka kuwa xaqa ahu midhuu dhalaa.
english: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

kikuyu: Kan sharka leh waxaa u dabin ah xadgudubka bushimihiisa, Laakiinse kan xaqa ahu dhibaatada wuu ka bixi doonaa.
english: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

kikuyu: Nin wuxuu wanaag kaga dhergi doonaa midhaha afkiisa, Oo nin walbana waxa gacmihiisu sameeyaan ayaa loo abaalgudi doonaa.
english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

kikuyu: Nacaska jidkiisu waa la qumman yahay isaga, Laakiinse kii caqli lahu taladuu maqlaa.
english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

kikuyu: Nacaska xanaaqiisa haddiiba waa la gartaa, Laakiinse ninkii miyir lahu ceebtuu qariyaa.
english: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

kikuyu: Kii runta ku hadlaa wuxuu muujiyaa xaqnimada, Laakiinse markhaatiga beenta ahu wuxuu muujiyaa khiyaanada.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira mid u hadla sida seef wax mudaysa, Laakiinse kan caqliga leh carrabkiisu waa caafimaad.
english: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

kikuyu: Bushintii runta sheegtaa weligeedba way sii taagnaan doontaa, Laakiinse carrabkii beenta sheegaa daqiiqad buu joogaa.
english: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka ku fikira qalbigooda khiyaanaa ku jirta, Laakiinse taliyayaasha nabaddu farxad bay leeyihiin.
english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

kikuyu: Sharna kan xaqa ah ku dhici maayo, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh xumaan baa ka buuxsami doonta.
english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

kikuyu: Bushimaha beenta sheega Rabbigu wuu karhaa. Laakiinse kuwa runta ku shaqeeya wuu ku farxaa.
english: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.

kikuyu: Ninkii miyir lahu aqoontuu qariyaa, Laakiinse qalbiga nacasyadu wuxuu naadiyaa nacasnimo.
english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

kikuyu: Kuwa dadaala gacantoodu wax bay xukumi doontaa, Laakiinse caajisiinta hawl baa la saari doonaa.
english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

kikuyu: Ninkii caloolxumo gashaa wuu soo gotaa, Laakiinse eray wanaagsanu waa ka farxiyaa isaga.
english: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ahu deriskiisuu hanuuniyaa, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh jidkoodu wuu ambiyaa iyaga.
english: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

kikuyu: Ninkii caajis ahu ma dubto wuxuu soo ugaadhsaday, Laakiinse ninkii dadaala maalkiisu waa qaali.
english: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

kikuyu: Jidka xaqnimada nolol baa taal; Oo waddadeedana dhimasho kuma jirto.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

kikuyu: Wiilkii caqli lahu wuxuu maqlaa edbinta aabbihiis, Laakiinse kii wax quudhsadaa canaanta ma maqlo.
english: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

kikuyu: Nin wuxuu wax wanaagsan ku cuni doonaa midhaha afkiisa, Laakiinse khaayinnada naftoodu waxay cuni doontaa midhaha dulmiga.
english: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

kikuyu: Kii afkiisa dhawraa wuxuu dhawraa naftiisa, Laakiinse kii bushimihiisa aad u kala qaadaa wuu baabbi'i doonaa.
english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

kikuyu: Kii caajis ah naftiisu wax bay damacdaa, mana hesho, Laakiinse nafta kii dadaala waa la barwaaqaysiin doonaa.
english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

kikuyu: Ninkii xaq ahu beenta wuu neceb yahay, Laakiinse ninkii shar lahu waa karaahiyo, wuuna ceeboobaa.
english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

kikuyu: Xaqnimadu kii jidkiisu qumman yahay ayay ilaalisaa, Laakiinse sharnimadu dembilaha ayay afgembidaa.
english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira nin hodan iska dhiga laakiinse aan waxba haysan, Oo waxaa jira mid miskiin iska dhiga laakiinse maal badan leh.
english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

kikuyu: Nin wuxuu noloshiisa ku furtaa maalkiisa, Laakiinse miskiinku canaanta ma maqlo.
english: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

kikuyu: Iftiinka kuwa xaqa ahu weligii wuu reyreeyaa, Laakiinse laambadda kuwa sharka leh waa la bakhtiin doonaa.
english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

kikuyu: Isqabasho oo keliya ayaa kibir ka timaada, Laakiinse kii waanada qaata waxaa la jirta xigmad.
english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

kikuyu: Maalkii degdeg lagu helaa wuu dhinmi doonaa, Laakiinse kan hawl wax ku soo urursadaa waa sii korodhsan doonaa.
english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

kikuyu: Rajadii raagtaa qalbigay bukaysiisaa, Laakiinse markii wixii la doonayay la helo waa geed nololeed.
english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii erayga quudhsadaa halligaad ayuu isu keenaa, Laakiinse kii amarka ka cabsada waa loo abaalgudi doonaa.
english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

kikuyu: Ninkii caqli leh waxbariddiisu waa il nololeed, In dabinnada dhimashada laga leexdo.
english: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

kikuyu: Waxgarashadii wanaagsan raalli baa laga noqdaa, Laakiinse jidka khaayinnadu waa xun yahay.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

kikuyu: Nin kasta oo miyir lahu aqoon buu ku shaqeeyaa, Laakiinse nacasku nacasnimuu fidiyaa.
english: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

kikuyu: Wargeeyihii shar lahu xumaan buu ku dhex dhacaa, Laakiinse ergadii aamin ahu waa caafimaad.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

kikuyu: Caydhnimo iyo ceebba waxaa lahaan doona kii edbinta diida, Laakiinse kii canaanta maqla waa la murwayn doonaa.
english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

kikuyu: Wixii la doonayay oo la gaadhay nafta way u macaan tahay, Laakiinse nacasyadu aad bay u karhaan inay sharka ka fogaadaan.
english: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

kikuyu: Kii kuwa caqliga leh la socdaa, caqli buu yeelan doonaa, Laakiinse kii nacasyada raacaa waa baabbi'i doonaa.
english: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

kikuyu: Dembilayaasha waxaa eryada shar, Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ah abaal wanaagsan baa loo gudi doonaa.
english: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

kikuyu: Ninkii wanaagsanu dhaxal buu uga tagaa carruurta carruurtiisa, Oo maalka dembilahana waxaa loo kaydiyaa kuwa xaqa ah.
english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

kikuyu: Beerta masaakiinta waxaa ku taal cunto badan, Laakiinse gardarro aawadeed in baa loo baabbi'iyaa.
english: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

kikuyu: Kii ushiisa ceshadaa wiilkiisuu neceb yahay; Laakiinse kii wiilkiisa jecelu aad buu u edbiyaa.
english: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ahu wax buu cunaa ilaa naftiisu dheregto, Laakiinse caloosha kuwa sharka lahu way baahnaan doontaa.
english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

kikuyu: Naag kastoo caqli lahu gurigeeday dhistaa, Laakiinse nacasaddu gacmaheeday ku dumisaa.
english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

kikuyu: Kii qummanaantiisa ku socda ayaa Rabbiga ka cabsada, Laakiinse kii jidkiisa ku qalloocan wuu quudhsadaa isaga.
english: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

kikuyu: Afka nacasyada waxaa ka soo biqla kibir; Laakiinse kuwa caqliga leh bushimahooda ayaa iyaga dhawri doona.
english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

kikuyu: Meeshii aan dibi joogin qabaalkii ay wax ka cuni jireen waa baabbah; Laakiinse kordhinta badanu waxay ku timaadaa xoogga dibiga.
english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

kikuyu: Markhaatigii aamin ahu been ma sheego, Laakiinse markhaatigii been ahu been buu ku hadlaa.
english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

kikuyu: Kii wax quudhsadaa xigmad buu doondoonaa, mana helo, Laakiinse aqoontu waa u fudud dahay kii waxgarasho leh.
english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

kikuyu: Nacaska hortiisa ka fogow, Waayo, bushimihiisa aqoon ka heli maysid.
english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

kikuyu: Ninkii miyir leh xigmaddiisu waa inuu jidkiisa gartaa, Laakiinse nacasyada nacasnimadoodu waa khiyaano.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

kikuyu: Nacasyadu dembigay ku majaajiloodaan, Laakiinse kuwa qumman waxaa ku dhex jirta raallinimo.
english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

kikuyu: Qalbigu qadhaadhnimadiisuu yaqaan, Oo shisheeyena farxaddiisa lama qaybsado.
english: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

kikuyu: Guriga kuwa sharka leh waa la afgembiyi doonaa, Laakiinse taambuugga kuwa qummanu waa barwaaqoobi doonaa.
english: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

kikuyu: Waxaa jirta waddo dadka la hagaagsan, Laakiinse dhammaadkeedu waa waddooyinka dhimashada.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Qalbigu xataa qosol waa ku murugoodaa, Oo farxad dhammaadkeeduna waa caloolxumo.
english: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

kikuyu: Kii xaqnimada qalbigiisa dib ugaga noqdaa jidkiisuu ka dhergi doonaa, Oo ninkii wanaagsanuna wuxuu ka dhergi doonaa naftiisa.
english: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

kikuyu: Kii garaaddaranu eray kasta wuu rumaystaa, Laakiinse kii miyir lahu socodkiisa aad buu u fiiriyaa.
english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

kikuyu: Ninkii caqli lahu waa cabsadaa, oo sharka wuu ka noqdaa; Laakiinse nacasku waa ciishoodaa, wuuna isku kalsoon yahay.
english: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

kikuyu: Kii degdeg u cadhoodaa nacasnimuu wax ku sameeyaa, Oo ninkii sharnimo hindisana waa la neceb yahay.
english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

kikuyu: Garaadlaawayaashu nacasnimay dhaxlaan, Laakiinse kuwii miyir leh waxaa madaxa loo saaraa taaj aqoon ah.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu kuwa wanaagsan hortooda ayay ku foororsadaan, Oo kuwa xunxunna waxay ku foororsadaan irdaha kuwa xaqa ah.
english: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

kikuyu: Miskiinka xataa deriskiisu waa neceb yahay, Laakiinse taajirku saaxiibbo badan buu leeyahay.
english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

kikuyu: Kii deriskiisa quudhsadaa wuu dembaabaa, Laakiinse kii miskiinka u naxariistaa waa barakaysan yahay.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka ku fikiraa sow ma qaldamaan? Laakiinse kuwa wanaagga ku fikira waxaa u ahaan doona naxariis iyo run.
english: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

kikuyu: Hawl kasta faa'iidaa ku jirta, Laakiinse hadalka bushimuhu wuxuu keenaa caydhnimo keliya.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

kikuyu: Kuwa caqliga leh taajkoodu waa maalkooda, Laakiinse nacasyada nacasnimadoodu waa nacasnimo keliya.
english: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

kikuyu: Markhaatigii run ahu nafuu samatabbixiyaa, Laakiinse kii been sheegaa waa khaayin.
english: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisu waxay leedahay kalsoonaan xoog leh, Oo carruurtiisuna waxay lahaan doonaan meel ay magangalaan.
english: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisu waa il nololeed, Si dabinnada dhimashada looga leexdo.
english: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

kikuyu: Sharafta boqorku waxay ku jirtaa dadka badnaantiisa, Laakiinse baabba'a amiirku wuxuu ku jiraa dadka yaraantiisa.
english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

kikuyu: Kii cadhada u gaabiyaa waa garasho badan yahay; Laakiinse kii degdeg u cadhoodaa nacasnimuu sarraysiiyaa.
english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

kikuyu: Qalbigii degganu waa nolosha jidhka, Laakiinse hinaaso waa qudhunka lafaha.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

kikuyu: Kii miskiinka dulmaa wuxuu caayaa Kan sameeyey, Laakiinse kii ka baahan u naxariistaa wuu murweeyaa.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

kikuyu: Kii shar leh waxaa lagu afgembiyaa sharnimadiisa, Laakiinse kan xaqa ahu rajuu leeyahay markuu dhinto.
english: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

kikuyu: Xigmaddu waxay taal kii garasho leh qalbigiisa, Laakiinse wixii nacasyada uurkooda ku jiraa waa ismuujiyaa.
english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

kikuyu: Xaqnimadu quruun way sarraysiisaa, Laakiinse dembigu waa u ceeb dad kasta.
english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

kikuyu: Boqorka raallinimadiisa waxaa leh midiidinkii caqli ku shaqeeya, Laakiinse wuxuu u cadhoon doonaa kii ceeb sameeya.
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

kikuyu: Jawaabta qaboobu cadhada way qaboojisaa, Laakiinse hadalkii qallafsanu xanaaq buu kiciyaa.
english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

kikuyu: Kuwa caqliga leh carrabkoodu aqoon buu ku hadlaa, Laakiinse afka nacasyadu wuxuu shubaa nacasnimo.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

kikuyu: Rabbiga indhihiisu meel kastay jiraan, Iyagoo fiirinaya kuwa xun iyo kuwa wanaagsan.
english: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

kikuyu: Carrabka wanaagsanu waa geed nololeed Laakiinse carrabka qalloocan ayaa qalbigu ku jabaa.
english: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

kikuyu: Nacasku edbinta aabbihiis wuu quudhsadaa, Laakiinse kii canaanta maqlaa miyir buu yeeshaa.
english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah gurigiisa khasnad weyn baa taal, Laakiinse waxa kan sharka leh u kordhaa waa dhib.
english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

kikuyu: Kuwa caqliga leh bushimahoodu aqoon bay faafiyaan, Laakiinse qalbiga nacasyadu sidaas ma aha.
english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

kikuyu: Allabariga kuwa sharka lahu Rabbiga waa u karaahiyo, Laakiinse kuwa qumman baryadoodu isagay ka farxisaa.
english: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

kikuyu: Jidka kan sharka lahu Rabbiga waa u karaahiyo, Laakiinse isagu waa jecel yahay kii xaqnimada raaca.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

kikuyu: Kii jidka ka taga waa u taqsiir kulul, Oo kii canaanta necebuna wuu dhiman doonaa.
english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

kikuyu: She'ool iyo halligaaduba Rabbiga hortiisay yaalliin, Haddaba intee in ka sii badan buu arkaa qalbiga binu-aadmiga?
english: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

kikuyu: Kii wax quudhsadaa ma jecla in la canaanto, Oo dooni maayo inuu kuwa caqliga leh u tago.
english: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

kikuyu: Qalbigii faraxsanu wejiguu nuuriyaa, Laakiinse caloolxumaanta ayaa qalbigu ku jabaa.
english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

kikuyu: Kii garasho leh qalbigiisu aqoon buu doondoonaa, Laakiinse nacasyada afkoodu wuxuu cunaa nacasnimo.
english: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

kikuyu: Kuwa dhibaataysan maalmahooda oo dhammu waa xunxun yihiin, Laakiinse kii qalbigiisu faraxsan yahay had iyo goorba waa u iid.
english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

kikuyu: Wax yar oo Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisu la jirto Ayaa ka wanaagsan khasnado badan oo dhib la jirto.
english: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.

kikuyu: Cunto khudaareed oo jacayl la jiro Ayaa ka wanaagsan dibi la cayiliyey oo nacayb la jiro.
english: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

kikuyu: Ninkii cadho badanu muran buu kiciyaa, Laakiinse kii cadhada u gaabiyaa murankuu qaboojiyaa.
english: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

kikuyu: Ninkii caajis ah jidkiisu waa sida meel qodxan leh oo kale, Laakiinse kii xaq ah jidkiisu waa dariiq bannaan.
english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

kikuyu: Wiilkii caqli lahu aabbihiisuu ka farxiyaa, Laakiinse ninkii nacas ahu hooyadiisuu quudhsadaa.
english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

kikuyu: Nacasnimadu waa u farxad ninkii caqlidaran, Laakiinse ninkii garasho lahu si qumman buu u socdaa.
english: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

kikuyu: Meeshii aan talo jirin xaajooyinku waa baabba', Laakiinse taliyayaashii badan ayay ku hagaagaan.
english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

kikuyu: Nin wuxuu farxad ka helaa jawaabta afkiisa, Oo eraygii wakhti ku habboon la yidhaahdaana sidee buu u wanaagsan yahay!
english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

kikuyu: Jidka noloshu waa u kor kii caqli leh, Si uu uga tago She'oolka hoose.
english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuu dumin doonaa guriga kuwa kibirka leh, Laakiinse dhulka carmalka xadkiisa wuu adkayn doonaa.
english: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

kikuyu: Rabbigu fikirrada sharka ah aad buu u karhaa, Laakiinse kuwa daahirkaa hadal wanaagsan bay ku hadlaan.
english: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

kikuyu: Kan faa'iido u hunguri weynu reerkiisuu dhibaa, Laakiinse kii hadiyadaha necebu wuu noolaan doonaa.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

kikuyu: Kan xaqa ah qalbigiisu wuxuu ka fikiraa sida loo jawaabo, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh afkoodu wuxuu shubaa waxyaalo shar ah.
english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

kikuyu: Rabbigu kuwa sharka leh wuu ka fog yahay, Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ah baryadooduu maqlaa.
english: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

kikuyu: Indhaha nuurkoodu qalbiguu ka farxiyaa, Oo warkii wanaagsanuna lafahuu barwaaqaysiiyaa.
english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

kikuyu: Dhegtii canaanta nolosha maqashaa Waxay joogi doontaa kuwa caqliga leh dhexdooda.
english: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

kikuyu: Kii edbinta diidaa naftiisuu quudhsadaa, Laakiinse kii canaanta maqlaa waxgarashuu helaa.
english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisu waa edbinta xigmadda, Oo sharaftana waxaa ka horreeya is-hoosaysiinta.
english: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

kikuyu: Qalbiga qasdiyadiisa dadkaa leh, Laakiinse carrabka jawaabtiisu xagga Rabbigay ka timaadaa.
english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Nin jidadkiisa oo dhammu waa la nadiifsan yihiin isaga, Laakiinse Rabbigu ruuxyaduu miisaamaa.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

kikuyu: Shuqulladaada Rabbiga ku aamin, Oo fikirradaaduna way taagnaan doonaan.
english: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wax kastuu isu abuuray, Haah, oo xataa ka sharka leh wuxuu u abuuray maalinta sharkaa.
english: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii qalbiga ka kibirsanu Rabbiga waa u karaahiyo, Waxaan aad idiin ku xaqiijinayaa inaan isagu taqsiir la'aan doonayn.
english: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Waxaa dembiga lagu kafaaraggudaa naxariis iyo run, Oo dadkuna waxay sharka kaga fogaadaan Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisa.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

kikuyu: Markii Rabbigu ku farxo nin jidadkiis, Wuxuu nabad dhex dhigaa isaga iyo xataa cadaawayaashiisa.
english: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

kikuyu: Wax yar oo xaqnimo la jirto Ayaa ka wanaagsan wax badan oo kordha oo xaqdarro la jirto.
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

kikuyu: Nin walba qalbigiisaa jidkiisa u fiirsada, Laakiinse Rabbigaa tallaabooyinkiisa toosiya.
english: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

kikuyu: Xukunka Rabbigu wuxuu ku jiraa bushimaha boqorka, Afkiisuna kuma xadgudbo garsooridda.
english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

kikuyu: Miisaankii iyo kafadihii xaq ah Rabbigaa leh, Dhagaxyada miisaanka oo kiishka ku jira oo dhammuna waa shuqulkiisa.
english: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

kikuyu: Waa u karaahiyo boqorrada inay xumaan falaan. Waayo, carshigu xaqnimuu ku dhismaa.
english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

kikuyu: Boqorradu bushimaha xaqa ah way ku farxaan, Oo kii si qumman u hadlana way jecel yihiin.
english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

kikuyu: Boqor cadhadiisu waa sida warqaadayaal geeriyeed, Laakiinse nin caqli leh ayaa qaboojin doona.
english: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

kikuyu: Nuurka wejiga boqorka nolol baa ku jirta, Oo raallinimadiisuna waa sida daruurta roobka dambe.
english: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

kikuyu: In xigmad la helaa intee bay ka sii wanaagsan tahay in dahab la helo! In waxgarasho la helaana waa laga doortaa in lacag la helo.
english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

kikuyu: Kuwa qumman jidkoodu waa inay sharka ka leexdaan, Kii jidkiisa dhawraa naftiisuu ilaaliyaa.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

kikuyu: Kibirku wuxuu hor socdaa baabba', Oo madaxweynaanuna waxay hor socotaa dhicid.
english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

kikuyu: In kuwa kibirsan booli lala qaybsado Waxaa ka sii wanaagsan in kuwa hooseeya laysla sii hoosaysiiyo.
english: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

kikuyu: Kii hadalka dhegaystaa wax wanaagsan buu heli doonaa, Oo ku alla kii Rabbiga aaminaana waa barakaysan yahay.
english: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

kikuyu: Kii qalbigiisu caqli leeyahay waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa mid miyir leh, Oo bushimaha macaankooduna waxbarashuu kordhiyaa.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

kikuyu: Waxgarashadu waa u il nololeed kii haysta, Laakiinse edbinta nacasyadu waa nacasnimo.
english: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

kikuyu: Kii caqli leh qalbigiisu afkiisuu wax baraa, Oo waxbarashuu bushimihiisa u kordhiyaa.
english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

kikuyu: Hadalkii wacanu waa sida awlallo shinniyeed oo kale, Nafta wuu u macaan yahay, oo lafahana waa u caafimaad.
english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

kikuyu: Waxaa jirta waddo dadka la qumman, Laakiinse dhammaadkeedu waa jidadkii dhimashada.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Kii hawshooda gaajadiisuu u hawshoodaa, Waayo, afkiisaa qasba isaga.
english: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

kikuyu: Ninkii waxmatare ahu xumaan buu qodqodaa, Oo bushimihiisana waxaa ku jira dab wax gubaya.
english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

kikuyu: Ninkii qalloocanu muran buu beeraa, Oo kii xan badanuna wuxuu kala kaxeeyaa saaxiibbo.
english: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

kikuyu: Ninka wax dulmaa deriskiisuu sasabtaa, Oo wuxuu u kaxeeyaa jid aan wanaagsanayn.
english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

kikuyu: Kii indhaha isugu qabta inuu wax qalloocan hindiso, Oo bushimihiisa qaniinaa, shar buu soo wadaa.
english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

kikuyu: Madaxa cirro lahu waa taaj sharfeed Haddii laga helo jidka xaqnimada.
english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

kikuyu: Kii cadhada u gaabiyaa waa ka wanaagsan yahay kii xoog badan, Oo kii ruuxiisa xukumaana waa ka wanaagsan yahay kii magaalo qabsada.
english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

kikuyu: Saamiga waxaa lagu tuuraa dhabta, Laakiinse go'aankiisa oo dhan Rabbigaa leh.
english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Wuxoogaa cunto qallalan ah oo xasilloonaanu la jirto Ayaa ka wanaagsan guri hilib allabari ka buuxo oo diriru la jirto.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

kikuyu: Addoonkii caqli lahu wuxuu xukumi doonaa wiilkii ceeb soo jiida, Oo walaalaha ayuu la dhaxal geli doonaa.
english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

kikuyu: Weelka lacagta lagu safeeyo lacagtaa iska leh, oo foornadana dahabkaa iska leh, Laakiinse Rabbigu qalbiyaduu imtixaamaa.
english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.

kikuyu: Xumaanfaluhu wuxuu maqlaa bushimaha shar leh, Oo beenaaluhuna wuxuu dhegaystaa carrabka xun.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii miskiinka ku majaajiloodaa wuxuu caayaa Kan sameeyey, Kii belaayooyin ku farxaana ma taqsiir la'aan doono.
english: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Odayaasha waxaa taaj u ah carruurta carruurtooda, Oo sharafta carruurtuna waa aabbayaashood.
english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

kikuyu: Hadalkii weynu nacas uma eka, Sidaas oo kalena bushimihii been sheegaa amiir uma eka.
english: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

kikuyu: Hadiyaddu waxay kii haysta la tahay sida dhagax qaali ah, Oo meel alla meeshay u leexataba way ku barwaaqowdaa.
english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

kikuyu: Kii xadgudub qariyaa jacayl buu doondoonaa, Laakiinse kii xaal ku noqnoqdaa saaxiibbuu kala kaxeeyaa.
english: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

kikuyu: Canaantu waxay ninkii garasho leh u tartaa In ka badan boqol jeedal oo nacas lagu dhuftay ay u taraan.
english: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

kikuyu: Ninkii shar lahu wuxuu doondoonaa caasinimo keliya, Sidaas daraaddeed waxaa isaga lagu diri doonaa farriingeeye aan naxariis lahayn.
english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

kikuyu: Nin ha la kulmo orso dhasheeda laga xaday, Intuu nacas nacasnimo samaynaya la kulmi lahaa.
english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii wanaag xumaan ku celiyaa, Gurigiisa xumaanu ka fogaan mayso.
english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

kikuyu: Muranka bilowgiisu waa sida biyo la soo faruuray. Haddaba isqabashada iska daa intaan lays ilaaqin.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

kikuyu: Kii kan sharka leh xaq ka dhiga, iyo kii kan xaqa ah gardarro ku xukuma, Labadaba Rabbigu aad buu u karhaa.
english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

kikuyu: Lacagta nacaska gacantiisa ku jirtaa bal maxay u tartaa inuu xigmad ku soo iibsado, Waayo, isagu garasho ma leh?
english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

kikuyu: Had iyo goor saaxiibba saaxiibkii wuu jecel yahay, Walaalna wuxuu u dhashay dhibaato.
english: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

kikuyu: Ninkii garaaddaranu gacan buu dhaar ugu dhiibaa, Oo wuxuu dammiin ku noqdaa deriskiisa hortiisa.
english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

kikuyu: Kii xadgudub jecelu muran buu jecel yahay, Oo kii iriddiisa sarraysiiyaana wuxuu doondoontaa baabba'.
english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

kikuyu: Kii qalbi qalloocan lahu wanaag ma helo, Oo kii carrab maroorsan lahuna wuxuu ku dhex dhacaa belaayo.
english: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

kikuyu: Kii nacas dhalaa murugtiisuu u dhalaa, Oo nacas aabbihiisna farxad ma leh.
english: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

kikuyu: Qalbigii faraxsanu waa dawo wanaagsan, Laakiinse qalbigii jabanu lafahuu engejiyaa.
english: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

kikuyu: Ninkii shar lahu laabtuu laaluush ka qaataa, Si uu jidadka garta u qalloociyo.
english: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

kikuyu: Xigmaddu waxay hor joogtaa kii garasho leh; Laakiinse nacaska indhihiisu waxay eegaan dhulka darafkiisa.
english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Wiilkii nacas ahu waa u murug aabbihiis, Waana u qadhaadh tii dashay.
english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

kikuyu: Weliba ma wanaagsana in kii xaq ah la taqsiiro, Ama in kuwa sharafka leh qummanaantooda aawadeed wax loogu dhufto.
english: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

kikuyu: Kii hadalkiisa yareeyaa, aqoon buu leeyahay, Oo kii qalbigiisu qabow yahayna waa nin garasho leh.
english: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

kikuyu: Xataa nacasku markuu iska aamusan yahay waxaa loo yaqaan mid caqli leh, Kii bushimihiisa isku qabtana nin miyir leh.
english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

kikuyu: Kii gooni isu soocaa, wuxuu doondoonaa damaciisa, Oo xigmadda oo dhanna wuu ku kacaa.
english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

kikuyu: Nacasku waxgarashada kuma farxo, Laakiinse wuxuu ku farxaa uun inuu waxa qalbigiisa ku jira muujiyo.
english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

kikuyu: Markii kii shar lahu yimaado waxaa kaloo timaada quudhsasho, Sharafla'aantana waxaa la timaada ceeb.
english: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

kikuyu: Nin afkiis erayada ku jiraa waa sida biyo gun dheer, Oo isha xigmadduna waa sida durdur socda.
english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

kikuyu: Ma wanaagsana in kan sharka leh loo eexdo, Ama in kan xaqa ah garta lagu afgembiyo.
english: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

kikuyu: Nacaska bushimihiisu waxay keenaan muran, Oo afkiisuna wuxuu u yeedhaa karbaash.
english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

kikuyu: Nacaska afkiisu waa u baabba', Oo bushimihiisuna naftiisay dabin u noqdaan.
english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

kikuyu: Kii xan badan erayadiisu waa sida cunto macaan, Oo waxay ku degaan meelaha caloosha ugu hooseeya.
english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

kikuyu: Kii shuqulkiisa caajis ku ahu, Wuxuu walaal u yahay kii wax kharriba.
english: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

kikuyu: Rabbiga magiciisu waa noobiyad xoog leh, Kii xaq ahu iyaduu ku cararaa, meel sarena wuu ku nabad galaa.
english: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

kikuyu: Ninkii taajir ah maalkiisu waa u magaalo xoog leh, Oo waa u derbi dheer sida ay la tahay isaga.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

kikuyu: Dadka qalbigiisu waa kibraa intaanu baabbi'in ka hor, Oo sharaftana waxaa ka horraysa is-hoosaysiinta.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

kikuyu: Kii xaajo ka jawaabaa isagoo aan maqlin, Waa u nacasnimo iyo ceeb.
english: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

kikuyu: Nin qalbigiisu waa u adkaysan karaa cudurkiisa, Laakiinse qalbi jaban bal yaa u dulqaadan kara?
english: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

kikuyu: Kii miyir leh qalbigiisu wuxuu helaa aqoon, Oo kuwa caqliga leh dhegtooduna waxay doondoontaa aqoon.
english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

kikuyu: Nin hadiyaddiisu meel bay u bannaysaa. Oo waxay isaga hor keentaa rag waaweyn.
english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

kikuyu: Kii dacwaddiisa u hor mara, mid xaq ah baa la moodaa, Laakiinse deriskiisaa ka daba yimaada oo imtixaama isaga.
english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

kikuyu: Saamigu wuxuu joojiyaa murammo, Oo wuxuu kala kaxeeyaa kuwa xoogga badan.
english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

kikuyu: In walaal la xumeeyey la soo celiyo waa ka sii adag tahay in magaalo xoog leh la qabsado, Oo murammona waa ka xoog badan yihiin qalcad biraheeda.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

kikuyu: Nin calooshiisu waxay ka buuxsami doontaa midhaha afkiisa, Oo wuxuu isagu ka dhergi doonaa waxa bushimihiisa u kordha.
english: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

kikuyu: Geeri iyo nololuba waxay ku jiraan itaalka carrabka, Oo kuwa jeceluna waxay cuni doonaan midhihiisa.
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii afo helaa wuxuu helaa wax wanaagsan, Oo Rabbigana raallinimuu ka helaa.
english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

kikuyu: Miskiinku baryootan buu ku hadlaa, Laakiinse taajirku si qallafsan buu ugu jawaabaa.
english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

kikuyu: Ninkii saaxiibbo badsadaa naftiisuu kharribaa, Laakiin waxaa jira saaxiib walaalkaa kaaga dhow.
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

kikuyu: Miskiinka daacadnimadiisa ku socda ayaa ka wanaagsan Nacaska bushimihiisu qalloocan yihiin.
