english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

kikuyu: Oo weliba in naftu aqoon la'aato ma wanaagsana, Oo kii cagihiisu degdegaanna wuu ambadaa.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

kikuyu: Nin nacasnimadiisu jidkiisay qalloocisaa, Oo isagu qalbigiisa ayuu Rabbiga uga cadhoodaa.
english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

kikuyu: Maalku wuxuu badiyaa saaxiibbo, Laakiinse miskiinku saaxiibkiisa buu ka soocmaa.
english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

kikuyu: Markhaatigii been ahu ma taqsiir la'aan doono, Oo kii been ku hadlaana ma baxsan doono.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

kikuyu: Kuwa badan ayaa deeqsiga raallinimo ka baryi doona, Oo nin kastaaba waa u saaxiib kii hadiyado bixiya.
english: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

kikuyu: Miskiinka walaalihiis oo dhammu way neceb yihiin, Haddaba saaxiibbadiisuna intee bay ka fogaan doonaan! Isagu hadal buu kala daba tagaa iyaga, laakiinse way tageen.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

kikuyu: Kii xigmadda helaa naftiisuu jecel yahay, Oo kii waxgarashada xajistaana wax wanaagsan buu heli doonaa.
english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

kikuyu: Markhaatigii been ahu ma taqsiir la'aan doono, Oo kii been ku hadlaana wuu halligmi doonaa.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

kikuyu: Nacaska raaxo uma eka, Waxaana taas ka sii liita in addoon amiirro xukumo.
english: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

kikuyu: Nin miyirkiisu cadho buu ka celiyaa, Oo waxaa isaga ammaan u ah inuu xadgudub dhaafo.
english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

kikuyu: Boqorka cadhadiisu waa sida libaaxa cidiisa, Laakiinse raallinimadiisu waa sida sayaxa cawska ku dega.
english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

kikuyu: Wiilkii nacas ahu waa u belaayo aabbihiis, Oo naag murammadeeduna waa sida dhibicyo aan kala go'in.
english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

kikuyu: Hoy iyo hanti aabbayaashaa laga dhaxlaa, Laakiinse afo miyir leh xagga Rabbigaa laga helaa.
english: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Caajisnimo waxay keentaa hurdo weyn, Oo qofkii caajis ahuna wuu gaajoon doonaa.
english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

kikuyu: Kii amarka dhawraa naftiisuu dhawraa, Laakiinse kii jidadkiisa fudaydsadaa wuu dhiman doonaa.
english: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

kikuyu: Kii miskiinka u naxaa Rabbiguu wax amaahiyaa, Oo wanaaggii uu sameeyeyna wuu u celin doonaa.
english: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

kikuyu: Wiilkaaga edbi intay rajo jirto, Laakiinse naftaada ha ku qasbin si uu u dhinto.
english: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

kikuyu: Ninkii cadho badan waa la taqsiiri doonaa, Waayo, haddaad mar isaga samatabbixiso, haddana waa inaad mar kale sidii oo kale ku samaysaa.
english: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

kikuyu: Talada maqal, oo edbinta qaado, Si aad ugu dambaystaada caqli u yeelatid.
english: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

kikuyu: Nin qalbigiisa waxaa ku jira hindisooyin badan, Habase ahaatee waxaa taagnaan doonta talada Rabbiga.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

kikuyu: Nin waxaa loo doonayaa waa raxmaddiisa, Oo miskiinkuna waa ka wanaagsan yahay beenaalaha.
english: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

kikuyu: Kii Rabbiga ka cabsada waxaa loo kaxeeyaa xagga nolosha, Wuuna sii dheregsanaan doonaa, Oo sharna loo keeni maayo.
english: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

kikuyu: Ninkii caajis ahu wuxuu gacanta geliyaa xeedhada, Oo mar dambe xagga afkiisa uma soo celiyo.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

kikuyu: Kan wax quudhsada garaac, oo garaadlaawaha ayaa miyir yeelan doona, Oo kii garasho leh canaano, oo isna aqoon buu sii korodhsan doonaa.
english: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

kikuyu: Kii aabbihiis kharriba, hooyadiisna erya, Waa wiil ceeb keena oo cay soo jiida.
english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow ka joogso in markaad edbinta maqashid Aad dabadeed hadalka aqoonta ka ambatid.
english: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

kikuyu: Markhaatigii waxmatare ahu gartuu quudhsadaa, Oo kan sharka leh afkiisuna wuxuu liqaa xumaan.
english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

kikuyu: Kuwa wax quudhsada waxaa loo diyaariyey xukunno, Oo dhabarka nacasyadana waxaa loo diyaariyey karbaash.
english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

kikuyu: Khamri waa dadquudhsade, waxa lagu sakhraamona waa qaylokiciye, Oo ku alla kii ku qaldamaana caqli ma laha.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

kikuyu: Boqorka cabsigeliddiisu waa sida libaaxa cidiisa, Oo ku alla kii ka xanaajiyaa, naftiisuu ku dembaabaa.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

kikuyu: Nin inuu dirir ka joogsado waa u sharaf, Laakiinse nacas waluba wuu ilaaqtamaa.
english: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

kikuyu: Kii caajis ahu qabowga aawadiis beer ma jeexo, Oo sidaas daraaddeed wakhtiga beergooyska wuu baryootami doonaa, oo waxba ma heli doono.
english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

kikuyu: Talada dadka qalbigiisa ku jirtaa waa sida biyo gun dheer, Laakiinse ninkii garasho leh ayaa ka soo dhaansan doona.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

kikuyu: Dadka intooda badanu waxay naadiyaan raxmaddooda, Laakiinse nin aamin ah bal yaa heli kara?
english: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

kikuyu: Ninka xaqa ah oo daacadnimadiisa ku socda, Carruurtiisu way barakaysnaadaan isaga dabadiis.
english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

kikuyu: Boqorkii carshiga garsooridda ku fadhiyaa Indhihiisuu sharka oo dhan ku kala firdhiyaa.
english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

kikuyu: Bal yaa odhan kara, Qalbigayga waan nadiifiyey, Oo dembigayga waan ka daahirsanahay?
english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

kikuyu: Miisaanno kala cayn ah iyo qiyaaso kala cayn ah, Labaduba Rabbiga waa u karaahiyo.
english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

kikuyu: Xataa ilmo yar waxaa lagu yaqaan falimihiisa, Inuu shuqulkiisu daahir yahay iyo inuu hagaagsan yahayba.
english: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

kikuyu: Dhegta wax maqasha iyo isha wax aragtaba, Labadaba Rabbigaa sameeyey.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

kikuyu: Hurdo ha jeclaan, waaba intaas oo aad caydhowdaaye. Indhaha kala qaad, oo cuntaad ka dhergi doontaa.
english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: Kan wax iibsadaa wuxuu yidhaahdaa, Waa xun yahay, waa xun yahay, Laakiinse markuu tago ayuu faanaa.
english: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira dahab iyo luul badan, Laakiinse bushimihii aqoon lahu waa jawharad qaali ah.
english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

kikuyu: Kii qof qalaad dammiinta dharkiisa ka qaad, Oo markuu shisheeyayaal dammiinto, isaga rahmad ahaan u hay.
english: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

kikuyu: Cuntadii khiyaano lagu helaa dadka way u macaan tahay, Laakiinse dabadeed afkiisa waxaa ka buuxsami doona quruurux.
english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

kikuyu: Qasdi kasta waxaa lagu taagaa talo, Oo waano wanaagsan ku dagaallan.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

kikuyu: Kii sida mid xan badan u warwareegaa wuxuu daaha ka qaadaa waxyaalo qarsoon, Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed kii bushimihiisa kala qaada ha ku darsamin.
english: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

kikuyu: Kii aabbihiis ama hooyadiis caaya, Laambaddiisa waxaa lagu bakhtiin doonaa gudcur dam ah.
english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

kikuyu: Dhaxalkii markii hore degdeg lagu helay, Ugu dambaysta ma barakoobi doono.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

kikuyu: Ha odhan, Shar baan ka abaalgudayaa. Rabbiga sug, oo isna wuu ku badbaadin doonaa.
english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

kikuyu: Miisaanno kala cayn ahu Rabbiga waa u karaahiyo, Oo kafaddii khiyaano ahuna ma wanaagsana.
english: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

kikuyu: Nin socodkiisu waa xagga Rabbiga, Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed dad sidee buu jidkiisa u garan karaa?
english: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

kikuyu: Waa u dabin nin inuu nacasnimo ku yidhaahdo, Waa quduus, Oo uu dabadeed u nidraa inuu wax weyddiiyo.
english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

kikuyu: Boqorkii caqli lahu kuwa sharka leh wuu hufaa, Oo wuxuu dushooda marsiiyaa giringirta.
english: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

kikuyu: Dadka ruuxiisu waa laambaddii Rabbiga, Oo wuxuu baadhaa caloosha meelaha ugu hooseeya oo dhan.
english: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

kikuyu: Naxariista iyo runtu boqorkay ilaaliyaan, Oo carshigiisuna wuxuu ku taagnaadaa naxariis.
english: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

kikuyu: Dhallinyarada xooggoodu waa ammaantooda, Oo cirrada odayaashuna waa quruxdooda.
english: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

kikuyu: Garaaciddii nabro yeeshaa waxay dadka ka nadiifisaa sharka, Oo dilidda karbaashkuna sidaas oo kalay u gashaa caloosha meelaha ugu hooseeya.
english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Boqorka qalbigiisu wuxuu ku jiraa gacanta Rabbiga sida webiyada biyaha ah, Oo wuxuu u leexiyaa meel alla meeshuu doonayo.
english: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

kikuyu: Nin jidkiis waluba waa la qumman yahay isaga, Laakiinse Rabbigu qalbiyaduu miisaamaa.
english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

kikuyu: Waxaa Rabbigu allabari ka sii jecel yahay In xaqnimo iyo gar la sameeyo.
english: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

kikuyu: Indho qab weyn iyo qalbi kibirsan, Kuwaas oo ah kuwa sharka leh laambaddoodu waa dembi.
english: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

kikuyu: Kuwa dadaala fikirradoodu waxay u geeyaan barwaaqo. Laakiinse ku alla kii degdeg badanu wuxuu u degdegaa inuu wax u baahdo oo keliya.
english: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

kikuyu: Khasnadihii carrab been badan lagu helaa waa sida ceeryaamo hor iyo dib loo kaxeeyey, Oo kuwa doondoontaana dhimashay doonaan.
english: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka leh dhacoodu iyaguu baabbi'in doonaa, Maxaa yeelay, iyagu waxay diidaan inay gar sameeyaan.
english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

kikuyu: Ninkii eed badan qaba jidkiisu aad buu u qalloocan yahay, Laakiinse kii daahirsan shuqulkiisu waa hagaagsan yahay.
english: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

kikuyu: In guriga dushiisa dhinac laga joogo ayaa ka roon In guri weyn naag muran badan lala joogo.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

kikuyu: Kii shar leh naftiisu xumaan bay doonaysaa, Oo deriskiisuna raallinimo kama helo hortiisa.
english: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

kikuyu: Markii mid wax quudhsada la taqsiiro, garaadlaawahu wuu caqliyaystaa, Oo kii caqli leh marka la edbiyona aqoon buu helaa.
english: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ahu wuxuu ka fikiraa kii shar leh gurigiisa, Iyo sida kuwa sharka leh loogu afgembiyo sharnimadooda daraaddeed.
english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

kikuyu: Kii dhegihiisa u fureeyaa si aanu qaylada miskiinka u maqlin, Isaga qudhiisuna wuu qaylin doonaa, laakiinse lama maqli doono.
english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

kikuyu: Hadiyaddii qarsoodi lagu bixiyaa xanaaqay qabowjisaa, Oo laaluushkii laabta laysu geliyaana cadho kulul buu qabowjiyaa.
english: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ahu inuu gar sameeyo waa u farxad, Laakiinse kuwa xumaanta ka shaqeeya waa u baabba'.
english: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Ninkii jidka waxgarashada ka habaabaa Wuxuu la joogi doonaa ururka kuwii dhintay.
english: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Kii raaxaysi jecelu miskiin buu ahaan doonaa, Oo kii khamri iyo saliid jeceluna taajir ma noqon doono.
english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

kikuyu: Kii shar lahu wuxuu furasho u noqon doonaa kii xaq ah, Khaayinkuna wuxuu furasho u noqon doonaa kii qumman.
english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

kikuyu: In lamadegaanka la joogo ayaa ka roon In naag muran iyo cadho badan lala joogo.
english: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

kikuyu: Khasnad qaali ah iyo saliid baa ku jira kan caqliga leh gurigiisa, Laakiinse nacasku wixiisa wuu wada liqaa.
english: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

kikuyu: Kii xaqnimo iyo naxariis raacaa Wuxuu helaa nolol iyo xaqnimo iyo sharaf.
english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

kikuyu: Kii caqli lahu kor buu ugu baxaa magaalada kuwa xoogga badan derbigeeda, Oo weliba xoogga ay isku hallaynayaan oo dhan ayuu hoos u ridaa.
english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii afkiisa iyo carrabkiisa dhawraa Naftiisuu dhibaatooyin ka dhawraa.
english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

kikuyu: Ninkii kibirsan ee qab weyn waxaa magiciisa la yidhaahdaa quudhsade, Oo wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa cadhada kibirka.
english: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

kikuyu: Ninkii caajis ah waxaa dila damaciisa, Waayo, gacmihiisu waxay diidaan inay hawshoodaan.
english: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira kuwo maalinta oo dhan si hunguri weyn wax u damca, Laakiinse kii xaq ahu wax buu bixiyaa oo ma ceshado.
english: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

kikuyu: Ka sharka leh allabarigiisu waa karaahiyo, Oo markuu niyo xun ku bixiyona way ka sii daran tahay!
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

kikuyu: Markhaatifuraha beenta ahu waa baabbi'i doonaa, Laakiinse ninkii wax maqla hadalkiisu waa raagi doonaa.
english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

kikuyu: Ninkii shar lahu wejigiisuu adkeeyaa, Laakiinse kii qummanu jidadkiisuu u fiirsadaa.
english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

kikuyu: Ma jirto xigmad ama waxgarasho Ama talo Rabbiga ka gees ah.
english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

kikuyu: Faraska waxaa loo diyaariyaa maalinta dagaalka, Laakiinse guusha waxaa leh Rabbiga.
english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

kikuyu: Magac wanaagsan baa laga doortaa maal badan, Oo nimcana waa ka wanaagsan tahay lacag iyo dahab.
english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

kikuyu: Taajirka iyo miskiinku way wada kulmaan, Oo Rabbigu waa kii kulligood sameeyey.
english: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.

kikuyu: Ninkii miyir lahu sharkuu arkaa, wuuna dhuuntaa, Laakiinse garaadlaawayaashu way iska sii maraan, waana la taqsiiraa.
english: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

kikuyu: Is-hoosaysiinta iyo Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisa abaalgudkoodu Waxaa weeyaan hodantinimo iyo sharaf iyo nolol.
english: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.

kikuyu: Qodxan iyo dabinnaba waxay yaalliin jidka ninka qalloocan, Laakiinse kii naftiisa dhawraa waa ka fogaan doonaa iyaga.
english: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

kikuyu: Ilmo u rabbee siduu ku socon lahaa, Oo isna xataa markuu gaboobo kama leexan doono.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

kikuyu: Taajirku masaakiintuu u taliyaa Oo kii wax amaahdaana midiidin buu u yahay kii wax amaahiya.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

kikuyu: Kii xumaan beeraa wuxuu goosan doonaa belaayo, Oo usha cadhadiisuna way dhammaan doontaa.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

kikuyu: Kii il deeqsiya lahu wuu barakoobi doonaa, Waayo, isagu wuxuu cuntadiisa wax ka siiyaa masaakiinta.
english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

kikuyu: Kan wax quudhsada eri, oo muranku wuu bixi doonaa, Dirirta iyo cayduna way dhammaan doonaan.
english: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

kikuyu: Kii daahirsanaanta qalbiga jecel, Oo bushimihiisu nimco leeyihiin, xataa boqorka ayaa saaxiibkiis ahaan doona.
english: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

kikuyu: Indhaha Rabbigu waxay dhawraan ka aqoonta leh, Laakiinse isagu wuxuu afgembiyaa erayada khaayinka.
english: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

kikuyu: Kii caajis ahu wuxuu yidhaahdaa, Libaax baa dibadda jooga, Oo jidka dhexdiisa ayaa laygu dili doonaa.
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

kikuyu: Naago qalaad afkoodu waa god dheer, Oo waxaa ku dhici doona kii xagga Rabbiga laga nacay.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.

kikuyu: Nacasnimadu waxay ku xidhan tahay qalbiga ilmaha. Laakiinse usha edbintu way ka fogayn doontaa.
english: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

kikuyu: Kii miskiinka u dulma inuu maal korodhsado, Iyo kii taajirka wax siiyaaba hubaal way baahnaan doonaan.
english: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

kikuyu: Dhegta u dhig, oo erayada kuwa caqliga leh maqal, Oo qalbigana aqoontayda u jeedi.
english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

kikuyu: Waayo, waa wax wanaagsan haddii aad uurka ku haysatid, Oo hadday dhammaantood bushimahaaga diyaar ku ahaadaan.
english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, adigaan maanta iyaga ku ogeysiiyey, Inaad Rabbiga aaminsan tahay.
english: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.

kikuyu: Miyaanan waxyaalo wanaagsan kuugu qorin Talooyinka iyo aqoonta,
english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

kikuyu: Si aan kuu ogeysiiyo hubaasha erayada runta, Inaad erayada runta uga jawaabtid kuwii ku soo diray?
english: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

kikuyu: Miskiinka ha dhicin, waayo, isagu waa miskiin, Oo kan dhibaataysanna meesha iridda ha ku dulmin,
english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga ayaa dacwadooda u qaadi doona, Oo kuwa iyaga dhaca naftoodana wuu dhici doonaa.
english: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

kikuyu: Ha la saaxiibin nin xanaaq badan, Oo nin cadho kululna waa inaanad la socon,
english: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

kikuyu: Waaba intaas oo aad jidkiisa baratid, Oo aad naftaadana dabin ku riddid.
english: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

kikuyu: Ha noqonin sida kuwa gacanta dhaar ugu dhiiba, Ama sida kuwa deyman u dammiinta.
english: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

kikuyu: Haddaanad haysan wax aad bixiso, Bal muxuu sariirtaada hoostaada uga la bixi?
english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

kikuyu: Soohdinta hore oo ay awowayaashu dhigeen Innaba ha durkin.
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

kikuyu: Miyaad aragtaa nin shuqulkiisa ku dadaala? Isagu wuxuu istaagi doonaa boqorro hortood. Oo kuwa hoose hortoodana ma istaagi doono.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

kikuyu: Markaad u fadhiisatid inaad taliye wax la cuntid, Aad uga fiirso waxa hortaada yaal,
english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

kikuyu: Oo mindi cunaha iska saar Haddaad tahay nin hunguri weyn.
english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

kikuyu: Cuntadiisa macaan ha damcin, Waayo, waa cunto khiyaaneed.
english: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

kikuyu: Ha isku daalin si aad taajir ku noqotid. Oo xigmaddaadana ka joogso.
english: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

kikuyu: Ma waxaad indhaha ku dayaysaa wax aan jirin? Waayo, hubaal maalku wuxuu yeeshaa baalal, Sida gorgor samada u duula oo kale.
english: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

kikuyu: Kan isha sharka leh kibistiisa ha cunin, Cuntadiisa macaanna ha damcin,
english: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu waxaa weeye siduu qalbiga kaga fikiro; Wuxuu kugu leeyahay, Cun oo cab, Laakiinse qalbigiisu kulama jiro.
english: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

kikuyu: Wixii aad cuntay waad soo mantagi doontaa, Oo erayadaadii macaanaana way kaa lumi doonaan.
english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

kikuyu: Nacas waxba ha kula hadlin, Waayo, isagu xigmadda hadalkaaga wuu quudhsan doonaa.
english: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

kikuyu: Soohdintii hore ha durkin, Beeraha agoommadana ha dhex gelin,
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

kikuyu: Waayo, bixiyahoodu waa xoog badan yahay; Oo isaga ayaa dacwadooda kugu qaadi doona.
english: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

kikuyu: Qalbigaaga edbinta u jeedi, Oo dhegahana erayada aqoonta.
english: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

kikuyu: Ilmaha edbin ha u diidin, Waayo, haddaad isaga ul ku garaacdid, ma dhiman doono.
english: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

kikuyu: Ul baad isaga ku garaaci doontaa, Oo naftiisaad She'ool ka samatabbixin doontaa.
english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, haddii qalbigaagu caqli leeyahay, Qalbigayguna wuu farxi doonaa.
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

kikuyu: Haah, oo xataa uurkaygu wuu rayrayn doonaa, Markay bushimahaagu wax qumman ku hadlaan.
english: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

kikuyu: Qalbigaagu yaanu dembilayaal ka hinaasin, Laakiinse maalinta oo dhan Rabbiga ka cabso.
english: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.

kikuyu: Waayo, hubaal waxaa jira abaalgud, Oo rajadaaduna kaama go'i doonto.
english: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, i maqal, oo caqli yeelo, Oo qalbigaagana jidka ku toosi.
english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

kikuyu: Ha dhex joogin khamriyacabyada Iyo kuwa hunguriweynaanta hilibka u cuna,
english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

kikuyu: Waayo, kii sakhraan ah iyo kii hunguri weynuba way caydhoobi doonaan, Oo lulona nin calal bay u xidhi doontaa.
english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

kikuyu: Dhegayso aabbahaagii ku dhalay, Oo hooyadaana ha quudhsan markay gabowdo.
english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

kikuyu: Runta soo iibso, oo ha sii iibin, Oo weliba waxaad ku sii darsataa xigmadda iyo edbinta iyo waxgarashada.
english: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ah aabbihiis aad buu u farxi doonaa, Oo kii ilmo caqli leh dhalaana farxad buu ka heli doonaa.
english: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

kikuyu: Aabbahaa iyo hooyadaaba ha farxeen, Oo tii ku dhashayna ha rayrayso.
english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, qalbigaaga i sii, Oo indhahaaguna jidadkayga ha dhawreen.
english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhillo waa booraan dheer, Oo naag qalaadna waa god cidhiidhi ah.
english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

kikuyu: Sida tuug oo kale ayay u gabbataa, Oo waxay dadka ku dhex badisaa khaayinnada.
english: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

kikuyu: Bal yaa hoog leh? Oo yaa caloolxumo leh? Oo yaa murammo leh? Oo yaa calaacal badan leh? Oo yaa u dhaawacan sababla'aan? Oo yaa indho casaan ah leh?
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

kikuyu: Waa kuwa wakhti dheer ku raaga khamriga, Waana kuwa u taga inay doondoontaan khamri laysku daray.
english: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

kikuyu: Ha fiirin khamrigu markuu casaado, Markuu koobka ka dhex dhalaalo, Iyo markuu si wanaagsan u shubmayoba.
english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

kikuyu: Ugu dambaysta wuxuu wax u qaniinaa sida abeesada, Oo sida jilbiskana wax buu u qaniinaa.
english: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

kikuyu: Indhahaagu waxay arki doonaan naago qalaad, Oo qalbigaaguna wuxuu ku hadli doonaa waxyaalo qalloocan.
english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad ahaan doontaa sida kan badda dhexdeeda jiifsada, Ama sida ka dakhalka dhaladiisa sare seexda.
english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

kikuyu: Waxaad odhan doontaa, Wax bay igu dhufteen, laakiin waxba ima yeelin. Way i garaaceen, iskamana aanan garan; Bal goormaan toosi doonaa? Weli mar kalaan doonan doonaa.
english: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”

kikuyu: Dad shar leh ha ka masayrin, Hana jeclaysan inaad iyaga la joogtid.
english: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

kikuyu: Waayo, qalbigoodu wuxuu ka fikiraa kharribaad, Oo bushimahooduna waxay ku hadlaan belaayo.
english: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.

kikuyu: Guri wuxuu ku dhismaa xigmad, Wuxuuna ku taagnaadaa waxgarasho,
english: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;

kikuyu: Qawladuhuna aqoontay kaga buuxsamaan Maal kasta oo qaali ah oo qurux badan.
english: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.

kikuyu: Ninkii caqli lahu xoog buu leeyahay, Oo ninkii aqoon lahuna itaal buu sii korodhsadaa.
english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

kikuyu: Waayo, waa inaad talo wanaagsan ku dagaallantaa, Oo waxaa taliyayaal badan la jirta nabadgelyo.
english: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

kikuyu: Xigmaddu nacaska way ka dheer tahay, Isagu xagga iridda afkiisa kuma kala qaado.
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.

kikuyu: Kii ku fikira inuu xumaan sameeyo, Waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa belaayo-sameeye.
english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

kikuyu: Fikirka nacasnimadu waa dembi, Kii wax quudhsadaana waa u karaahiyo dadka.
english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

kikuyu: Maalinta dhibaatada haddaad liicdid, Itaalkaagu waa yar yahay.
english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

kikuyu: Samatabbixi kuwa dhimashada loo wadayo, Kuwa ku dhow in la gowracona dib uga qabo.
english: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

kikuyu: Haddaad tidhaahdid, Bal eeg, waxan ma aannu garanayn, Kan qalbiyada miisaamaa miyaanu ka fiirsanayn? Oo kan naftaada dhawraa miyaanu ogayn? Oo miyaanu isagu nin walba ugu abaalgudayn sida shuqulkiisu yahay?
english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, malab cun, waayo, wuu wanaagsan yahay, Oo waxaad cuntaa awlallada malabka, taas oo kuu dhadhan macaan.
english: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

kikuyu: Oo xigmadda aqoonteeduna sidaasoo kalay naftaada u ahaan doontaa, Oo haddaad iyada heshid waxaa jiri doona abaalgud, Oo rajadaaduna ma go'i doonto.
english: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

kikuyu: Sida nin shar leh, ha u gabban kan xaqa ah gurigiisa, Oo rugtiisa nasashadana ha kharribin.
english: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;

kikuyu: Waayo, nin xaq ahu toddoba goor buu dhacaa, wuuna soo sara kacaa haddana, Laakiinse kuwa sharka leh waxaa lagu afgembiyaa belaayo.
english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

kikuyu: Ha rayrayn markuu cadowgaagu dhaco, Oo qalbigaaguna yaanu farxin markuu turunturoodo,
english: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

kikuyu: Waayo, waaba intaas oo Rabbigu taas arkaa, oo ay shar la ahaato indhihiisa, Oo uu dabadeedna cadhadiisa ka soo celiyaa isaga.
english: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

kikuyu: Xumaanfalayaasha aawadood ha isku dhibin, Kuwa sharka lehna ha ka masayrin,
english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

kikuyu: Waayo, kii shar leh abaalgud ma heli doono, Oo laambadda xumaanfalayaashana waa la bakhtiin doonaa.
english: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, Rabbiga iyo boqorkaba ka cabso, Oo ha ku darsamin kuwa isrogrog badan,
english: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

kikuyu: Waayo, belaayadoodu si degdeg ah ayay u soo kici doontaa, Oo bal yaa yaqaan baabbi'inta labadoodaba?
english: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxyaalahanuna waa wixii ay kuwa caqliga lahaa yidhaahdeen. In dadka garsooridda loogu kala eexdaa ma wanaagsana.
english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.

kikuyu: Kii kan shar leh ku yidhaahda, Xaq baad tahay, Dadyowga ayaa habaari doona, oo quruumuhuna way karhi doonaan isaga,
english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwii isaga canaantaa farxad bay yeelan doonaan, Oo dushoodana waxaa ku soo degi doonta barako wanaagsan.
english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.

kikuyu: Kii jawaab qumman ku jawaabaa Bushimuhuu dhunkadaa.
english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

kikuyu: Shuqulkaaga dibadda ku hagaajiso, Oo beerta ku diyaarso, Oo dabadeedna gurigaaga dhiso.
english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

kikuyu: Deriskaaga sababla'aan markhaati ha ku furin, Oo bushimahaagana ha ku khiyaanayn.
english: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.

kikuyu: Hana odhan, Wixii uu igu sameeyey oo kale ayaan ku samayn doonaa, Oo ninkii sidii shuqulkiisu ahaa ayaan u abaalmarin doonaa.
english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

kikuyu: Waxaan ag maray ninka caajiska ah beertiisa, Iyo ninka garaadka daran beercanabkiisa,
english: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, kulligood waxaa ka baxay qodxan, Oo dhammaantoodna waxaa qariyey maraboob, Oo derbigoodii dhagaxa ahaana waa dumay.
english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

kikuyu: Markaasaan eegay oo aad uga fiirsaday, Waan fiiriyey oo wax ka bartay.
english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:

kikuyu: Weliba in yar baad seexanaysaa, oo in yar baad gam'aysaa, Oo in yar baad gacmaha hurdo u laabaysaa,
english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,

kikuyu: Haddaba caydhnimo waa kuu iman doontaa sida tuug oo kale, Oo baahina sida nin hub sita oo kale.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.

kikuyu: Oo weliba kuwanuna waa maahmaahyadii Sulaymaan, Oo boqorkii Yahuudah oo Xisqiyaah ahaa raggiisii ay soo guuriyeen.
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

kikuyu: Waa u ammaan Ilaah inuu xaal qariyo, Laakiinse waa u ammaan boqorrada inay xaal baadhaan.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

kikuyu: Sida samadu u sarrayso, oo dhulkuna u gun dheer yahay, Ayaan qalbiga boqorrada loo baadhi karin.
english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

kikuyu: Lacagta wasakhda ka qaad, Oo dabadeedna waxaa lacagshubaha uga soo bixi doona weel.
english: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

kikuyu: Boqorka hortiisa kuwa sharka leh ka fogee, Oo carshigiisuna xaqnimuu ku taagnaan doonaa.
english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

kikuyu: Ha isweynweynayn boqorka hortiisa, Oo kuwa waaweyn meeshoodana ha istaagin.
english: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

kikuyu: Amiirkii aad indhahaaga ku aragtay Intii hortiisa lagu hoosaysiin lahaa, Waxaa kuu wanaagsan iyadoo lagu yidhaahdo, Halkan sare kaalay.
english: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

kikuyu: Dirir degdeg ha ugu bixin, Waaba intaasoo aad ugu dambaysta garan weydaa waxaad samayn lahayd, Markii uu deriskaagu ku ceebeeyey dabadeed.
english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

kikuyu: Dacwadaada deriskaaga kala dood, Laakiinse mid kale xaalkiisa qarsoon ha sheegin,
english: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

kikuyu: Waaba intaas oo uu ku caayaa kii maqlaa, Oo aanay ceebtaadu kaa hadhin.
english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

kikuyu: Hadalkii si hagaagsan loogu hadlaa Wuxuu la mid yahay tufaaxyo dahab ah oo lagu dhex sameeyey taswiiro lacag ah.
english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

kikuyu: Kii caqli leh oo wax canaantaa wuxuu dhegta wax maqasha oo addeecda ula mid yahay Hilqado dahab ah iyo wax laysku sharraxo oo dahab saafiya ah.
english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

kikuyu: Wargeeyihii aamin ahu wuxuu kuwii isaga soo diray ula mid yahay Qabowga barafka cad oo wakhtiga beergooyska, Waayo, isagu wuxuu qabowjiyaa nafta sayidyadiisa.
english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii hadiyad been ah isku faaniyaa Wuxuu la mid yahay daruuro iyo dabayl aan roob lahayn.
english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

kikuyu: Waxaa xaakin wax lagu oggolaysiiyaa dulqaadasho badan, Carrab macaanuna laftuu jebiyaa.
english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

kikuyu: Malab ma heshay? In kugu filan oo keliya ka cun, Waaba intaas oo intaad ka dheregto aad soo hunqaacdaaye.
english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

kikuyu: Cagtaadu ha ku yaraato guriga deriskaaga, Waaba intaasoo uu kaa daalaa oo uu ku necbaadaaye.
english: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

kikuyu: Ninkii deriskiisa marag been ah ku furaa Waa sida budh iyo seef iyo fallaadh af badan oo kale.
english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

kikuyu: In wakhtiga dhibaatada nin aaminlaawe ah laysku halleeyo Waa sida ilig jaban iyo cag murkacatay oo kale.
english: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

kikuyu: Kii qalbi murugaysan u gabyaa Waa sida mid maalin qabow huwiska iska qaada iyo sida khal soodhe lagu shubo oo kale.
english: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

kikuyu: Cadowgaagu hadduu gaajaysan yahay, wax uu cuno sii, Hadduu harraadsan yahayna waraabi,
english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

kikuyu: Waayo, dhuxulo dab ah ayaad madaxiisa ku tuuli doontaa, Oo Rabbiguna waa kuu abaalgudi doonaa.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

kikuyu: Dabaysha woqooyi roob bay keentaa, Sidaas oo kale carrabkii xan badanna weji cadhaysan buu keenaa.
english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

kikuyu: In guriga dushiisa dhinac laga joogo ayaa ka roon In guri weyn naag muran badan lala joogo.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

kikuyu: Warkii wanaagsan oo dal fog ka yimaadaa Waa sida biyo qabow ay naf harraadsan u yihiin oo kale.
english: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

kikuyu: Ninkii xaq ah ee kii shar leh isu dhiibaa Waa sida durdur qasmay iyo sida il biyood oo wasakhowday oo kale.
english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

kikuyu: In malab badan la cunaa ma wanaagsana, Sidaas oo kalena in ammaan la doondoontaa ammaan ma aha.
english: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

kikuyu: Kii aan ruuxiisa u talin karinu Waa sida magaalo duntay oo aan derbi lahayn oo kale.
english: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

kikuyu: Sida wakhtiga kulul aan baraf cad ugu habboonayn, oo wakhtiga beergooyska aan roob ugu habboonayn, Ayaan sharaf nacas ugu habboonayn.
english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

kikuyu: Sida shimbir iska wareegaysa iyo sida dabafallaadh iska duulaysa, Ayaan habaarkii sababla'aan ahu cidna ugu dhacayn.
english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

kikuyu: Jeedal faras buu ku habboon yahay, dacayna dameer, Ulina dhabarka nacaska.
english: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

kikuyu: Nacas ha ugu jawaabin sida nacasnimadiisu tahay, Waaba intaasoo aad sidiisa oo kale noqotaaye.
english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

kikuyu: Nacas ugu jawaab sida nacasnimadiisu tahay, Waaba intaasoo uu isla caqli weynaadaaye.
english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

kikuyu: Kii nacas gacantiis farriin u sii dhiibaa Cagahuu iska gooyaa oo khasaaruu cabbaa.
english: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

kikuyu: Sida lugaha curyaanku u laalaadaan Ayuu masaalkuna u yahay afka nacasyada.
english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: Kii nacas sharaf siiyaa Wuxuu la mid yahay mid wadhaf dhagax ku xidha oo kale.
english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

kikuyu: Sida qodaxdu u dhex gasho sakhraan gacantiis, Ayuu masaalkuna u yahay afka nacasyada.
english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: Kii nacaska ama kuwa jidka maraya kiraystaa Waa sida qaansoole dadka oo dhan dhaawaca oo kale.
english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

kikuyu: Nacas nacasnimadiisa ku noqnoqdaa Waa sida eey mantaggiisa ku noqnoqda oo kale.
english: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

kikuyu: Nin isla caqli weyn ma aragtay? Waxaa isaga ka rajo roon nacas.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Ninkii caajis ahu wuxuu yidhaahdaa, Libaax baa waddada jooga; Libaax baa jidka taagan.
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

kikuyu: Sida albaabku birihiisa ugu noqnoqdo, Ayaa kii caajis ahuna sariirtiisa isugu rogrogaa.
english: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

kikuyu: Kii caajis ahu wuxuu gacantiisa geliyaa xeedhadiisa, Oo inuu afkiisa ku soo celiyona waa ku dhib isaga.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

kikuyu: Kii caajis ahu waa iskala caqli badan yahay Toddoba nin oo xigmad ku jawaabi karta.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

kikuyu: Kii isagoo jidka iska maraya isku dhex dara dirir aanu waxba ku lahayn, Wuxuu la mid yahay mid eey dhegaha qabta oo kale.
english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

kikuyu: Sida nin waalan oo rida dab, Iyo fallaadho, iyo dhimasho,
english: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

kikuyu: Ayuu yahay kii intuu deriskiisa khiyaaneeyo, Haddana yidhaahda, Miyaanan cayaarayn?
english: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

kikuyu: Xaabola'aanta dabku waa bakhtiyaa, Oo meeshii aan mid xan badanu jooginna muranku waa ka joogsadaa.
english: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

kikuyu: Sida dhuxuli raran u sii shiddo, qoryona dab u sii belbeliyaan, Ayuu ninkii muran badanuna dirir u sii kiciyaa.
english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

kikuyu: Kii xan badan erayadiisu waa sida cunto macaan, Oo waxay ku degaan meelaha caloosha ugu hooseeya.
english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Bushimihii macaan iyo qalbigii shar lehba Waxay la mid yihiin weel dhoobo ah oo lagu dahaadhay lacag wasakhdeed.
english: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

kikuyu: Kii wax necebu bushimihiisuu isku yeelyeelaa, Laakiinse uurkiisuu khiyaano ku kaydsadaa.
english: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

kikuyu: Markuu si wacan u hadlo ha rumaysan, Waayo, waxaa qalbigiisa ku jira toddoba karaahiyo.
english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

kikuyu: In kastoo nacaybkiisu khiyaano isku daboolo, Xumaantiisa ayaa shirka lagu hor muujin doonaa.
english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii bohol qodaaba isagaa ku dhex dhici doona, Oo kii dhagax giringiriyana, isaguu ku soo rogman doonaa.
english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

kikuyu: Carrabkii been sheega wuxuu neceb yahay kuwuu dhaawacay, Oo afkii wax faaniyaana wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa baabba'.
english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

kikuyu: Berrito ha ku faanin, Waayo, ma ogid waxay maalinu keeni doonto.
english: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.

kikuyu: Mid kale ha ku faaniyo oo yaanu afkaagu ku faanin, Shisheeye ha ku ammaano, oo yaanay bushimahaagu ku ammaanin.
english: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

kikuyu: Dhagax waa culus yahay, oo cammuuduna way miisaan weyn tahay, Laakiinse waxaa labadoodaba ka sii culus nacas cadhadiis.
english: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

kikuyu: Cadho waa naxariisdarro, xanaaqna waa daad, Laakiinse bal yaa hinaaso is-hor taagi kara?
english: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

kikuyu: Canaantii bayaan ahu Waa ka wanaagsan tahay jacaylkii qarsoon.
english: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

kikuyu: Saaxiib nabrihiisu waa daacadnimo, Laakiinse cadow dhunkashooyinkiisu waa khiyaano miidhan.
english: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

kikuyu: Naftii dheregsanu xataa awlallada malabka waa ka yaqyaqsataa, Laakiinse naftii gaajaysan wax kasta oo qadhaadhuba way u macaan yihiin.
english: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

kikuyu: Ninkii hoygiisa ka warwareegaa Waa sida shimbir buulkeeda ka warwareegta oo kale.
english: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.

kikuyu: Saliidda iyo cadarku qalbigay ka farxiyaan, Sidaas oo kalena waxaa nin ka farxiya macaanka saaxiibkiis oo ka yimaada talada qalbiga.
english: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

kikuyu: Ha ka tegin saaxiibkaa iyo aabbahaa saaxiibkiis toona, Oo maalintii masiibadaadana guriga walaalkaa ha tegin, Deris kuu dhowu waa ka wanaagsan yahay walaal kaa fog.
english: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygiiyow, caqli yeelo, oo qalbigayga ka farxi, Si aan ugu jawaabo kii i caayaba.
english: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

kikuyu: Ninkii miyir lahu sharkuu arkaa, wuuna dhuuntaa, Laakiinse garaadlaawayaashu way iska sii maraan, oo waana la taqsiiraa.
english: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

kikuyu: Kii qof qalaad dammiinta dharkiisa ka qaad, Oo kii naag qalaad dammiintana isaga rahmad ahaan u hay.
english: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

kikuyu: Kii intuu aroor hore kaco saaxiibkiis cod dheer ugu duceeya, Waxaa loo qaadan doonaa habaar.
english: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

kikuyu: Maalin roobaabeed dhibicyadeeda aan kala go'in Iyo naag muran badanu waa isku mid.
english: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

kikuyu: Ku alla kii iyada celiyaa, dabayshuu celiyaa. Gacantiisa midigna saliid bay qabataa.
english: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.

kikuyu: Bir baa bir afaysa, Oo sidaas oo kale nin baa saaxiibkiis afeeya.
english: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii berde xannaanaystaa midhihiisuu cuni doonaa. Oo kii sayidkiisa dhawrana waa la murwayn doonaa.
english: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.

kikuyu: Sida fool biyaha dhexdooda fool uga muuqdo, Ayaa nin qalbigiisu nin kale ugu muuqdaa.
english: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.

kikuyu: She'ool iyo halligaadu weligood ma dhergaan, Dadka indhihiisu weligood ma dhergaan.
english: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

kikuyu: Weelka lacagta lagu safeeyo lacagtaa iska leh, oo foornadana dahabkaa iska leh, Sidaas oo kalena nin waxaa lagu tijaabiyaa ammaantiisa.
english: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

kikuyu: In kastoo aad nacas tib iyo mooye hadhuudh kula tuntid, Weliba nacasnimadiisu ka tegi mayso isaga.
english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

kikuyu: Aad ugu dadaal inaad ogaatid xaalka adhigaaga, Oo lo'daadana si wanaagsan u ilaali.
english: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

kikuyu: Waayo, maalku weligiis siima raago, Taajkuna ab ka ab miyuu waaraa?
english: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.

kikuyu: Cawska qallalan markii la gooyo mid cagaar ah oo jilicsan baa soo muuqda, Oo dhalatada buurahana waa la soo urursadaa.
english: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

kikuyu: Baraarku waa kuu dhar, Oo adhiguna waa kuu qiimihii beerta.
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

kikuyu: Waxaa jiri doona caano riyaad oo cunto ugu filan adiga iyo reerkaagaba, Iyo weliba masruufka gabdhaha kuu shaqeeya.
english: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharka lahu waxay cararaan iyadoo aan ciduna eryanayn, Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ahu waxay u dhiirran yihiin sida libaax oo kale.
english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

kikuyu: Waddan xadgudubkiisa aawadiis amiirradu way badan yihiin, Laakiinse ninkii waxgarasho iyo aqoon leh dowladdiisu way sii raagtaa.
english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

kikuyu: Miskiin masaakiinta dulmaa Waa sida roob dhulka xaadha oo aan cunto ka tegin.
english: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

kikuyu: Kuwa sharciga ka tagaa waxay ammaanaan kuwa sharka leh, Laakiinse kuwa sharciga dhawra ayaa iyaga la dirira.
english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

kikuyu: Nimanka sharka lahu garsooridda ma gartaan, Laakiinse kuwa Rabbiga doondoonaa wax walbay gartaan.
english: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.

kikuyu: Kii jidad qalloocan ku socda, in kastoo uu taajir yahay, Waxaa ka roon miskiinka daacadnimadiisa ku socda.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii sharciga dhawraa waa wiil caqli leh, Laakiinse kii raaca kuwa cirta weyn, aabbihiisuu ceebeeyaa.
english: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

kikuyu: Kii korsaar iyo ribo maalkiisa ku korodhsadaa, Wuxuu u ururin doonaa mid masaakiinta u naxariista.
english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

kikuyu: Kii dhegtiisa ka leexiya inuu sharciga maqlo, Xataa baryootankiisu waa karaahiyo.
english: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii kuwa xaqa ah jid shar ah ku ambiyaa, Isagaa ku dhici doona godkiisa, Laakiinse kuwa qummanu wax wanaagsan bay dhaxli doonaan.
english: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

kikuyu: Taajirku waa isla caqli weyn yahay, Laakiinse miskiinka waxgarashada leh ayaa isaga kashifa.
english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

kikuyu: Kuwa xaqa ahu markay guulaystaan, waxaa jirta ammaan weyn, Laakiinse markii kuwa sharka lahu sara kacaan dadku waa dhuuntaa.
english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

kikuyu: Kii xadgudubyadiisa qariyaa ma liibaani doono, Laakiinse kii qirta oo haddana ka tagaa, naxariis buu heli doonaa.
english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

kikuyu: Ninkii mar kasta cabsadaa waa barakaysan yahay, Laakiinse kii qalbigiisa sii adkeeyaa masiibuu ku dhici doonaa.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

kikuyu: Taliyihii shar lahu wuxuu dadka masaakiintaa ku yahay Sida libaax ciyaya iyo sida orso weerar ah oo kale.
english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

kikuyu: Amiirkii garaaddaranu waa nin dulun weyn, Laakiinse kii neceb faa'iidada xaqdarrada ah cimrigiisuu dheerayn doonaa.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

kikuyu: Ninkii nin dhiiggiis qabaa Wuxuu u carari doonaa godka, oo ninna yaanu ka joojin.
english: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii si qumman u socda waa la samatabbixin doonaa, Laakiinse kii si qalloocan laba jid ugu socdaa haddiiba wuu dhici doonaa.
english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

kikuyu: Kii dhulkiisa beertaa, cunto badan buu ka dhergi doonaa, Laakiinse kii waxmatarayaal raacaa wuxuu ka dhergi doonaa caydhnimo.
english: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

kikuyu: Ninkii aamin ahu aad buu u barakoobi doonaa, Laakiinse kii taajirnimo ku degdegaa ma taqsiir la'aan doono.
english: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

kikuyu: Ma wanaagsana in dadka loo kala eexdo, Iyo inuu nin xabbad kibis ah u xadgudbo toona.
english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

kikuyu: Kii taajirnimo ku degdegaa waa qumay, Mana oga inuu caydhoobi doono.
english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

kikuyu: Kii nin canaantaa wuxuu marka dambe heli doonaa Raallinimo ka badan kan carrabka ku faaniya.
english: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

kikuyu: Kii aabbihiis ama hooyadiis wax ka dhaca oo haddana yidhaahda, Taasu xadgudub ma aha, Wuxuu saaxiib la yahay kii wax dumiya.
english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

kikuyu: Kii hunguri weynu muran buu kiciyaa, Laakiinse kii Rabbiga isku halleeya waa la barwaaqaysiin doonaa.
english: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.

kikuyu: Kii qalbigiisa isku halleeyaa waa nacas, Laakiinse ku alla kii si caqli ah u socda waa la samatabbixin doonaa.
english: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

kikuyu: Kii miskiinka wax siiyaa ma baahan doono, Laakiinse kii indhaha ka qarsada aad baa loo habaari doonaa.
english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

kikuyu: Markii kuwa sharka lahu kacaan dadku waa dhuuntaa, Laakiinse markay halligmaan, kuwa xaqa ahu way sii kordhaan.
english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.

kikuyu: Kii inta wax badan la canaanto ka madax adkaadaa, Dhaqso buu u jabi doonaa, dawona ma leh.
english: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

kikuyu: Markii kuwa xaqa ahu amarka haystaan, dadku wuu reyreeyaa, Laakiinse markii kuwa sharka lahu xukunka wataan, dadku wuu taahaa.
english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

kikuyu: Kii xigmad jecelu aabbihiisuu ka farxiyaa, Laakiinse kii dhillooyin raacaa maalkiisuu khasaariyaa.
english: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

kikuyu: Boqorku gar buu dalka ku dhisaa, Laakiinse kii laaluush jecelu wuu dumiyaa.
english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

kikuyu: Ninkii deriskiisa faaniyaa Shabag dabin ah ayuu cagihiisa hor dhigaa.
english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

kikuyu: Ninkii shar ah xadgudubkiisa waxaa ku jira dabin, Laakiinse kii xaq ahu waa iska heesaa oo reyreeyaa.
english: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

kikuyu: Kii xaq ahu wuxuu ka war hayaa dacwadda masaakiinta, Laakiinse kii shar ahu ma yaqaan aqoontaas.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

kikuyu: Kuwa wax quudhsadaa magaalay dab qabadsiiyaan, Laakiinse kuwa caqliga lahu cadhay qabowjiyaan.
english: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

kikuyu: Haddii nin caqli leh nin nacas ah la doodo, Nasasho ma jirto hadduu cadhoodo iyo hadduu qosloba.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

kikuyu: Dhiigyocabyadu kii kaamil ah way neceb yihiin, Laakiinse kuwa qumman waxay doondoonaan inay naftiisa badbaadshaan.
english: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

kikuyu: Nacasku cadhadiisa oo dhan buu soo saaraa, Laakiinse kii caqli lahu dib buu u ceshadaa, wuuna aamusnaadaa.
english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

kikuyu: Haddii taliye been dhegaysto, Midiidinyadiisa oo dhammu waa wada shar miidhan.
english: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

kikuyu: Miskiinka iyo khaayinku way wada kulmaan, Oo labadoodaba Rabbigu indhahooduu iftiimiyaa.
english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.

kikuyu: Boqorkii daacadnimo masaakiinta ugu xukuma, Carshigiisu wuu dhisnaan doonaa weligiisba.
english: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

kikuyu: Usha iyo canaantu caqli bay keenaan, Laakiinse ilmihii layska daayaa ceeb buu hooyadiis u soo jiidaa.
english: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

kikuyu: Markii kuwa sharka lahu bataan, xadgudub baa sii kordha, Laakiinse kuwa xaqa ah ayaa dhiciddooda arki doona.
english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

kikuyu: Wiilkaaga edbi, oo isna wuu ku nasin doonaa, Haah, naftaada wuu ka farxin doonaa.
english: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

kikuyu: Markii aan muujinu jirin dadku waa halligmaa, Laakiinse kii sharciga dhawraa waa barakaysan yahay.
english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

kikuyu: Addoon hadal kuma edeb yeesho, Waayo, in kastoo uu garanayo ka jawaabi maayo.
english: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

kikuyu: Ma aragtay nin hadalkiisa ku degdega? Kaas waxaa ka rajo roon nacas.
english: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Kii addoonkiisa si wanaagsan u soo koriya tan iyo yaraantiisa, Ugu dambaysta wiil buu u noqon doonaa.
english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

kikuyu: Ninkii xanaaq badanu muran buu kiciyaa. Ninkii cadho kululuna xadgudub buu badsadaa.
english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

kikuyu: Nin kibirkiisu hoos buu u dejin doonaa, Laakiinse kii is-hoosaysiiyaa sharaf buu heli doonaa.
english: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii tuug la shirkoobaa naftiisuu nacaa, Habaarkuu maqlaa, laakiinse waxba kama sheego.
english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

kikuyu: Dadka ka cabsashadiisu wax bay dabtaa, Laakiinse kii Rabbiga isku halleeyaa wuu nabad geli doonaa.
english: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

kikuyu: Kuwo badan baa taliyaha raallinimo ka doona, Laakiinse dadka garsooriddiisu waxay ka timaadaa xagga Rabbiga.
english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.

kikuyu: Ninkii xaqdaranu waa u karaahiyo kuwa xaqa ah, Oo kii jidka ku qummanuna waa u karaahiyo kii shar ah.
english: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa erayadii Aaguur ina Yaaqeh, oo ahaa reer Masaa. Ninku wuxuu la hadlay Iitii'eel, iyo xataa Iitii'eel iyo Ukaal, oo ku yidhi,
english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

kikuyu: Hubaal anigu waan ka doqonnimo weynahay nin kastaba, Oo dad waxgarashadiisana ma lihi.
english: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

kikuyu: Xigmad ma aan baran, Aqoonta Kan quduuska ahna ma aqaan.
english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

kikuyu: Yaa samada u baxay, oo ka soo degay? Yaa dabaysha gacmihiisa ku soo ururshay? Yaa biyaha dharkiisa ku guntay? Yaa dhulka darafyadiisa oo dhan dhisay? Magicii, wiilkiisana magicii, haddaad taqaan?
english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

kikuyu: Eray kasta oo Ilaah waa daahir; Oo isagu wuxuu gaashaan u yahay kuwa isaga aaminsan.
english: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Erayadiisa waxba ha ku darin, Waaba intaas oo uu ku canaantaa, oo lagu ogaadaa inaad beenaaleh tahay.
english: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

kikuyu: Laba waxyaalood ayaan ku weyddiistay, Iyaga ha ii diidin intaanan dhiman.
english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

kikuyu: Wax aan waxtar lahayn iyo been iga fogee, Oo caydhnimo iyo taajirnimo midna ha i siin. Igu quudi cunto aanan ka maarmin,
english: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

kikuyu: Waaba intaasoo intaan dhergo, aan adiga ku inkiraaye, oo aan idhaahdaa, Waa ayo Rabbigu? Amase waaba intaasoo aan miskiin noqdaa, oo intaan wax xado, Aan magaca Ilaahayga si been ah ugu hadal qaadaaye.
english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

kikuyu: Addoon sayidkiisa xan ha uga sheegin, Waaba intaas oo uu ku habaaraa, oo eed lagugu helaaye.
english: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira farcan aabbahood inkaara, Oo aan hooyadoodna u ducayn.
english: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira farcan isla daahirsan, Oo weliba aan nijaastoodii ka maydhmin.
english: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira farcan indhahoodu aad u sarreeyaan! Oo daboolka indhahoodana kor bay u qaadaan.
english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira farcan ilkahoodu sida seefo oo kale yihiin, oo gowsahooduna sida mindiyo oo kale yihiin, Si ay masaakiinta dhulka uga baabbi'iyaan, oo ay kuwa baahanna dadka dhexdiisa uga dhammeeyaan.
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

kikuyu: Culaacushu waxay leedahay laba gabdhood, oo leh, Na sii, Na sii. Waxaa jira saddex waxyaalood oo aan weligood dhergin, Haah, oo afar aan odhan, Bes, nagu filan;
english: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

kikuyu: Waxaana weeye qabriga, iyo maxalka aan wax dhalayn, Iyo dhulka aan biyo ka dhergayn, Iyo dabka aan odhan, Bes, igu filan.
english: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

kikuyu: Isha aabbaheed ku majaajiloota, Oo quudhsata inay hooyadeed addeecdo, Waxaa la soo bixi doona tukayaasha dooxada, Oo waxaa cuni doona gorgorrada.
english: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira saddex waxyaalood oo anigu aan aad ula yaabo, Haah, afar baan garan waayay,
english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxaa weeye siduu gorgor hawada u duulo, Siduu masna dhagax ugu socdo, Siday doonnina badda u maaxdo, Iyo siduu nin gabadh ula macaamiloodo.
english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale waxaa ah naag dhillo ah sideeda, Taasoo intay wax cunto afka tirtirta, Oo haddana tidhaahda, Anigu waxba xumaan ma aan samayn.
english: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

kikuyu: Saddex waxyaalood ayaa dhulku la gariiraa, Oo afar baanu qaadan karin,
english: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

kikuyu: Waxaana weeye addoon markuu boqor noqdo, Iyo nacas markuu cunto ka dhergo,
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

kikuyu: Iyo naag la nacay markay guursato, Iyo gabadh addoon ahu markay sayidaddeedii meesheeda gasho.
english: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira afar waxyaalood oo dhulka ku yaryar, Laakiinse aad iyo aad u caqli badan.
english: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

kikuyu: Qudhaanjadu waa sida dad aan xoog badnayn, Laakiinse waxay cuntadooda soo diyaarsadaan guga.
english: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

kikuyu: Walooyinku waa qoon taagdaran, Oo haddana waxay guryahooda ka samaystaan dhagaxyada dhexdooda;
english: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

kikuyu: Ayaxu boqor ma leh, Weliba dhammaantood guuto guuto ayay u socdaan.
english: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

kikuyu: Qorratadu waa wax gacanta lagu qaban karo, Weliba waxay joogtaa guryaha boqorrada.
english: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira saddex waxyaalood oo si fiican u socda, Haah, oo afar waa socod wanaagsan yihiin.
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

kikuyu: Aar libaax oo ah kan xayawaanka ugu xoogga badan, Oo aan weliba midna dib uga noqon,
english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

kikuyu: Diiqa xarragoonaya, iyo orgiga; Iyo boqorka aanay dadku gees ka ahayn.
english: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

kikuyu: Haddaad nacasnimo samaysay adoo isa sarraysiinaya, Ama aad wax shar ah ka fikirtay, Gacanta afka saar.
english: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

kikuyu: Waayo, caanihii la lulaa subag bay soo saaraan, Sankii la maroojiyaana dhiig buu keenaa, Sidaas oo kalena cadhadii la qasbaa dirir bay keentaa.
english: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa erayadii Lemuu'eel oo ahaa boqorkii Masaa ay hooyadiis bartay isaga.
english: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

kikuyu: Waa maxay, wiilkaygiiyow? Waa maxay, wiilkii uurkaygow? Waa maxay, wiilkii nidarradaydow?
english: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

kikuyu: Xooggaaga naago ha siinin, Dawyadaadana ha siinin kuwa boqorrada dumiya.
english: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

kikuyu: Lemuu'eelow, uma eka boqorrada, uma eka boqorradu inay khamri cabbaan, Oo amiirradana uma eka inay waxa lagu sakhraamo damcaan,
english: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

kikuyu: Waaba intaasoo ay cabbaan, oo ay sharciga illoobaan, Oo ay kuwa dhibaataysan midkood gartiisa qalloociyaan.
english: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

kikuyu: Waxa lagu sakhraamo siiya ka dhimashada ku dhow, Oo khamrigana waxaad siisaan kuwa naftoodu la qadhaadhaatay.
english: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

kikuyu: Ha cabbo, oo caydhnimadiisa ha illoobo, Oo dhibaatadiisana yaanu mar dambe soo xusuusan innaba.
english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

kikuyu: Afka u fur carrablaawaha aawadiis, Si aad kuwa baabba'aya oo dhan u xaq mariso.
english: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

kikuyu: Afka fur, oo si xaq ah u garsoor, Oo miskiinka iyo saboolka baahanba gartooda u qaad.
english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

kikuyu: Bal yaa heli kara naag wanaagsan? Waayo, qiimaheedu waa ka sii badan yahay xataa luul.
english: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

kikuyu: Waayo, qalbiga ninkeedu iyaduu isku halleeyaa, Oo isagu innaba uma baahnaan doono wax booli ah.
english: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

kikuyu: Cimrigeeda oo dhan isaga wanaag bay u samayn doontaa, Oo innaba xumaan kuma samayn doonto.
english: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

kikuyu: Waxay doondoontaa dhogor idaad iyo geed linen la yidhaahdo. Oo iyadoo raalli ku ah ayay gacmaheeda ku shaqaysaa.
english: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

kikuyu: Iyadu waa sida doonniyaha baayacmushtariga, Oo cuntadeeda waxay ka keentaa meel fog.
english: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

kikuyu: Waxay kacdaa iyadoo weli ay habeennimo tahay, Oo dadka reerkeeda ayay cunto siisaa, Oo gabdhaheedana hawshooday siisaa,
english: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

kikuyu: Iyadu waxay ka fikirtaa beer, wayna soo iibsataa, Oo midhaha gacmaheeda ayay beercanab ku beerataa.
english: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

kikuyu: Waxay dhexda ku xidhataa xoog, Oo gacmaheedana way xoogaysaa.
english: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

kikuyu: Waxay eegtaa in baayacmushtarigeedu wanaagsan yahay; Laambaddeeduna habeenkii ma bakhtido.
english: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

kikuyu: Waxay gacmaheeda ku fidisaa dunmiiqa, Oo sacabbadeeduna waxay qabtaan usha wareegta.
english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

kikuyu: Waxay sacabkeeda u furtaa miskiinka, Oo gacmaheedana waxay u fidisaa saboolka baahan.
english: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

kikuyu: Dadka reerkeeda ugama cabsato dhaxanta barafka cad, Waayo, xaaskeeda oo dhammu waxay wada qabaan dhar labanlaab ah.
english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

kikuyu: Waxay samaysataa durraaxado daabac leh, Oo dharkeeduna waxaa weeye dhar aad u wanaagsan oo guduudan.
english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

kikuyu: Ninkeedana waxaa laga yaqaan irdaha magaalada, Markuu dhex fadhiisto waayeellada waddanka.
english: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

kikuyu: Waxay samaysaa dhar wanaagsan, wayna iibisaa, Oo baayacmushtarigana waxay ka iibisaa boqorro dhexda lagu xidho.
english: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

kikuyu: Xoog iyo sharaf ayaa iyada dhar u ah; Oo wakhtiga soo socda way ku qososhaa.
english: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

kikuyu: Afkeeda waxay u kala qaaddaa xigmad; Oo carrabkeedana waxaa saaran sharciga raxmadda.
english: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

kikuyu: Waxay aad u xannaanaysaa reerkeeda, Oo kibista caajisnimadana ma cunto.
english: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

kikuyu: Carruurteedu way kacaan oo waxay ugu yeedhaan tan barakaysan, Oo weliba ninkeeduna wuu ammaanaa, isagoo leh;
english: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

kikuyu: Dumar badan baa wanaag sameeyey, Laakiinse adigu waad ka sii wanaagsan tahay dhammaantood.
english: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

kikuyu: Suuradwacnaantu waa khiyaano miidhan, oo quruxduna waa ceeryaamo oo kale, Laakiinse naagtii Rabbiga ka cabsata waa la ammaani doonaa.
english: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

kikuyu: Midhihii gacmaheeda wax ka siiya, Oo shuqulladeeduna iyada ha ku ammaaneen irdaha magaalada.
english: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa erayadii wacdiyihii ahaa ina Daa'uud oo Yeruusaalem boqorka ku ahaa.
english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

kikuyu: Wacdiyuhu wuxuu leeyahay, Waa wax aan waxba tarayn, waa wax aan waxba tarayn, wax waluba waa wax aan waxba tarayn.
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

kikuyu: Bal maxaa faa'iido ah oo nin ka hela hawshiisa uu qorraxda hoosteeda ku hawshoodo oo dhan?
english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

kikuyu: Qarni baa taga, oo qarni kalena wuu yimaadaa, laakiinse dhulku weligiisba wuu waaraa.
english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

kikuyu: Oo qorraxduna way soo baxdaa, oo haddana way dhacdaa, oo waxay ku degdegtaa meeshii ay ka soo baxdo.
english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

kikuyu: Dabayshu waxay tagtaa xagga koonfureed, oo haddana waxay u soo rogmataa xagga woqooyi, oo had iyo goorba way wareegtaa, oo dabayshu waxay ku soo noqotaa wareeggeedii.
english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

kikuyu: Webiyaasha oo dhammu waxay ku shubmaan badda, oo weli badduna ma buuxsanto, oo webiyaashu meeshii ay ku socdaan ayay haddana ku sii socdaan.
english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.
