english: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but I didn’t find him. I called him, but he didn’t answer.

kikuyu: Oo waardiyayaashii magaalada dhex warwareegayay ayaa i helay Wayna i garaaceen oo i dhaawaceen. Oo kuwii derbiyada dhawrayay ayaa garbasaartaydii iga qaaday.
english: The watchmen who go about the city found me. They beat me. They bruised me. The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me.

kikuyu: Gabdhaha reer Yeruusaalemow, Waxaan idinku dhaarinayaa, haddaad gacaliyahaygii aragtaan, U sheega inaan caashaq la buko.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.

kikuyu: Gacaliyahaagu muxuu gacaliye kale dheer yahay, Taada naagaha ugu qurxoonay? Bal gacaliyahaagu muxuu gacaliye kale dheer yahay, Waadigaa sidan noo dhaarinayee?
english: How is your beloved better than another beloved, you fairest among women? How is your beloved better than another beloved, that you do so adjure us?

kikuyu: Gacaliyahaygu waa cad yahay oo waa casaan. Waana kan toban kun ugu wanaagsan.
english: My beloved is white and ruddy. The best among ten thousand.

kikuyu: Madaxiisu waa sida dahab saafi ah, Oo timihiisuna waa sida cawbaar, oo waxay u madow yihiin sida tuke oo kale.
english: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.

kikuyu: Indhihiisu waa sida indho qoolley oo durdur biya ah ag joogta, Oo caano lagu maydhay oo si qumman loo dhigay.
english: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.

kikuyu: Dhabannadiisu waa sida beer dhir udgoon ah iyo sida ubaxyo carfa. Oo bushimihiisuna waa sida ubaxshooshanno uu malmal ka tiftifqayo.
english: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes. His lips are like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.

kikuyu: Gacmihiisu waa sida kaatummo dahab ah oo berullos lagu dhejiyey, Oo jidhkiisuna waa sida foolmaroodi oo dhalaalaya oo safayr lagu sharraxay.
english: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.

kikuyu: Lugihiisu waa sida tiirar marmar ah, oo lagu qotomiyey saldhigyo dahab saafiya ah, Oo muuqashadiisuna waa sida Buur Lubnaan oo kale, oo wuxuu u qurxoon yahay sida geedaha kedarka oo kale.
english: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

kikuyu: Afkiisu aad iyo aad buu u macaan yahay, oo isaga dhammaantiis waa mid aad loo jecel yahay. Gabdhaha reer Yeruusaalemow, Kaasu waa gacaliyahayga, waana saaxiibkayga.
english: His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Taada naagaha u qurxoonay, Xaggee gacaliyahaagii tegey? Aannu kula goobnee, Xaggee buu gacaliyahaagii u leexday?
english: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?

kikuyu: Gacaliyahaygii wuxuu u dhaadhacay beertiisa, iyo beer qaybaheed oo dhir udgoon ah Inuu adhigiisa soo daajiyo beeraha dhexdooda, oo uu soo urursado ubaxshooshanno.
english: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay tii gacaliyahayga, oo gacaliyahayguna waa kaygii, Oo wuxuu adhigiisa daajiyaa ubaxshooshannada dhexdooda.
english: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.

kikuyu: Taan jeclahayay, waxaad u qurux badan tahay sida Tirsaah oo kale, Oo waxaad u suurad wacan tahay sida Yeruusaalem oo kale, Waxaana lagaaga cabsadaa sida ciidan calammo sita oo kale.
english: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.

kikuyu: Indhahaaga iga sii jeedi, Waayo, way iga adkaadeen. Timahaagu waa sida riyo Buur Gilecaad ka muuqda.
english: Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead.

kikuyu: Ilkahaaguna waa sida laxo Ka soo baxay meeshii lagu soo maydhay, Oo middood kastaaba mataano dhashay, Oo aan dhexdooda lagu arag mid dhicisay.
english: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.

kikuyu: Oo dhafoorradaada indhashareertaada ku qarsoonuna waa sida xabbad rummaan ah jeexeed.
english: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira lixdan boqoradood, iyo siddeetan naagood oo addoommo ah, Iyo gabdho aan tiro lahayn.
english: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.

kikuyu: Laakiinse qoolleydayda, iyo tayda sanu waa mid qudha. Iyadu waa tan keliya ee hooyadeed, Oo waa tan daahirsan ee tii iyada dhashay. Gabdhuhu iyaday arkeen oo waxay ku sheegeen mid barakaysan, Oo xataa boqoradihii iyo naagihii addoommaha ahaaba way ammaaneen.
english: My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother’s only daughter. She is the favorite one of her who bore her. The daughters saw her, and called her blessed. The queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.

kikuyu: Waa tuma tan u soo muuqata sida kaaha waaberiga, Oo sida dayaxa u qurxoon, Ee sida qorraxda u daahirsan, Oo haddana looga cabsado sida ciidan calammo sita oo kale?
english: Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?

kikuyu: Waxaan ku dhaadhacay beertii yicibta Inaan soo arko geedaha cagaarka ah ee dooxada, Iyo inaan soo arko bal in canabkii magoolay, Oo uu rummaankii ubxiyey iyo in kale.
english: I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.

kikuyu: Anigoo aan garanayn ayaa nafsaddaydu iga dhigtay sida gaadhifardoodkii Cammiinaadiib oo kale.
english: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.

kikuyu: Tan reer Shuuleemay, soo noqo, soo noqo, Aan ku daawannee soo noqo, soo noqo. Gacaliyaha Hadlayaa Bal maxaad u daawanaysaan tan reer Shuuleem Sida cayaarta Maxanayim?
english: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Lover Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?

kikuyu: Gabadha amiirku dhalayay, cagahaagu qurux badanaa markay kabo illan yihiin, Bowdooyinkaagu waa sida dahab Nin saanac ahu gacantiisa ku sameeyey.
english: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Xudduntaadu waa sida fijaan goobaaban Oo aan innaba khamri ka dhinnanayn, Oo xaluskaaguna waa sida sarreen meel tuunsan Oo ubaxshooshanno lagu wareejiyey.
english: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.

kikuyu: Labadaada naasna waa sida laba gibin Oo mataano ah oo cawl dhashay.
english: Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.

kikuyu: Qoortaaduna waa sida munaarad foolmaroodi ah, Oo indhahaaguna waa sida ballidii Xeshboon oo ku ag yaal iridda Batrabbiim. Oo sankaaguna waa sida munaaradda Lubnaan Oo xagga Dimishaq u jeeda.
english: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.

kikuyu: Madaxaagu sida Buur Karmel oo kale wuu dheer yahay, Oo timaha madaxaaguna waa sida guduud oo kale, Oo boqorkuna wuu ku xidhan yahay.
english: Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.

kikuyu: Taan jeclahayay, qurux badnidaa! Fiicnaan badnidaa! Aad baad iiga farxisaa!
english: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!

kikuyu: Sarajooggaagu waa sida geed baar ah, Oo naasahaaguna waa sida rucubyo canab ah.
english: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.

kikuyu: Waxaan is-idhi, Geedka baarka waan fuuli doonaa, Oo waxaan qabsan doonaa laamihiisa. Naasahaagu ha ahaadeen sida rucubyo canab ah, Oo sankaaga neeftiisuna ha u carafto sida midho tufaax ah.
english: I said, “I will climb up into the palm tree. I will take hold of its fruit.” Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the smell of your breath like apples.

kikuyu: Oo afkaaguna ha ahaado sida khamri wanaagsan. Gacalisada Hadlaysaa Si qumman oo macaan ha ugu socda gacaliyahayga, Oo kuwa hurda bushimahooda ka hadliya.
english: Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay tii gacaliyahayga, Oo damaciisuna xaggayguu soo jiraa.
english: I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.

kikuyu: Gacaliyahaygow, kaalay, aynu duurka isla tagnee, Oo aynu tuulooyinka ku soo dhaxnee.
english: Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field. Let’s lodge in the villages.

kikuyu: Aynu aroor hore beercanabyada tagnee, Oo aynu soo aragno bal in canabkii magoolay, oo ay ubixiisii soo muuqdeen, Oo uu rummaankii ubxiyey iyo in kale; Oo halkaasaan jacaylkayga kugu siin doonaa.
english: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.

kikuyu: Ubixii duudaygu way soo carfayaan, Oo albaabbadayada agtooda waxaa yaal midho cayn kasta ah oo cusayb iyo duugba leh, Oo adigaan kuu kaydiyey, gacaliyahaygiiyow.
english: The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.

kikuyu: Haddaad ahaan lahayd walaalkay Oo naasihii hooyaday nuugay, Markaan dibadda kaa helaba waan ku dhunkan lahaa. Oo innaba layma quudhsadeen.
english: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.

kikuyu: Waan ku soo kaxayn lahaa oo waxaan ku gelin lahaa guriga hooyaday, Wax baadna i bari lahayd. Oo waxaan ku cabsiin lahaa khamriga xawaashka leh Ee biyaha rummaankayga laga sameeyey.
english: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.

kikuyu: Gacantiisa bidix madaxaygay ka hoosayn lahayd, Oo gacantiisa midigna way isku kay duubi lahayd.
english: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.

kikuyu: Gabdhaha reer Yeruusaalemow, waxaan idinku dhaarinayaa Inaydaan jacayl kicin, ama aydaan toosin, Ilaa uu doono.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

kikuyu: Waa tuma tan cidlada ka soo baxaysa, Ee gacaliyeheeda ku tiirsanu? Gacalisada Hadlaysaa Waxaan kaa soo kiciyey geed tufaax ah hoostiis. Halkaasaa hooyadaa kugu foolatay, Oo halkaasay tii ku dhashay kugu foolatay.
english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.

kikuyu: Qalbigaaga korkiisa ii dhig sida shaabad oo kale, oo gacantaada korkeeda ii dhig sida shaabad oo kale, Waayo, jacaylku wuxuu u xoog badan yahay sida geeri oo kale, Oo masayrkuna wuxuu u nac weyn yahay sidii She'ool oo kale. Belbelkiisu waa sida belbel dab ah, Oo waa ololka ugu wada kulul ee Rabbiga.
english: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.

kikuyu: Biyo badanu jacayl ma demin karaan, Oo daadadkuna innaba ma qarqin karaan. Haddii nin damco inuu jacayl soo siisto maalka gurigiisa oo dhan, Haddana dhammaan waa la quudhsan lahaa.
english: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.

kikuyu: Annagu waxaannu leennahay walaal yar, Oo aan innaba naaso lahayn. Haddaba bal maxaannu walaashayo u samayn doonnaa Maalintii iyada guur loo soo doonto?
english: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?

kikuyu: Hadday derbi tahay waxaannu korkeeda ka dhisi doonnaa munaarad lacag ah, Oo hadday albaab tahayna waxaannu iyada ku hareerayn doonnaa alwaaxyo kedar ah.
english: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay derbi, oo naasahayguna waa sida munaaradaha oo kale. Oo markaas waxaan hortiisa ku ahaa sidii mid nabad heshay.
english: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.

kikuyu: Sulaymaan beercanab buu Bacal Hamoon ku lahaa; Oo beercanabkii wuxuu ka kireeyey kuwa dhawra, Oo midkood kastaaba wuxuu midhaheeda uga keeni jiray kun xabbadood oo lacag ah.
english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.

kikuyu: Beercanabkayga ah kan aan iska leeyahay, hortayduu ku yaal, Haddaba Sulaymaanow, adigu waxaad heli doontaa kun, Kuwa midhihiisa dhawraana laba boqol.
english: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.

kikuyu: Taada beeraha dhexdooda degganay, Rafiiqyadaadu waxay dhegaystaan codkaaga, Haddaba, bal i maqashii.
english: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!

kikuyu: Gacaliyahaygow, dhaqso, Oo waxaad ahaataa sida cawl ama deer qayrab ah Oo buuraha dhirta udgoon kor jooga.
english: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!

kikuyu: Kanu waa wixii Ishacyaah ina Aamoos la tusay ee uu ku arkay wax ku saabsan dalka Yahuudah iyo Yeruusaalem waagii ay Cusiyaah, iyo Yootam, iyo Aaxaas, iyo Xisqiyaah boqorrada ka ahaayeen dalka Yahuudah.
english: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

kikuyu: Samooyinkow maqla, dhulkow bal wax dhegayso, waayo, Rabbigu wuu hadlay oo yidhi: Carruur baan quudiyey oo koriyey, oo iyana way igu caasiyoobeen.
english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for the LORD has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.

kikuyu: Dibigu kan isaga leh wuu yaqaan, oo dameerkuna waa yaqaan meeshuu wax ka cuno ee sayidkiisa, laakiinse reer binu Israa'iil waxba ma yaqaaniin, oo dadkayguna waxba garan maayaan.
english: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh quruuntan dembiga badan, iyo dadkan xumaanta ku raran, iyo dhashan xumaanfalayaasha, iyo wiilashan si xun u macaamilooda. Iyagu Rabbiga way ka tageen, oo waxay quudhsadeen Ka Quduuska ah ee reer binu Israa'iil dib bayna uga noqdeen.
english: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

kikuyu: Bal maxaa mar dambe wax laydiinku dhufan doonaa, oo aad u sii fallaagoobi doontaan? Madaxa oo dhammu waa bukaa, oo qalbiga oo dhammuna waa taag daranyahay.
english: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

kikuyu: Madaxa iyo minjaha inta ka dhex leh innaba caafimaad ma leh, laakiinse waxaa ku yaal nabro, iyo burbur, iyo boogo cusub, lama awdin, lamana duubin, oo saliidna laguma dhayin.
english: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.

kikuyu: Dalkiinnii waa cidla, magaalooyinkiinniina waa la gubay, oo waddankiinniina shisheeyayaal baa hortiinna ku cunay, waana cidla, sidii wax ay shisheeyayaal afgembiyeen.
english: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

kikuyu: Oo magaalada Siyoonna waxaa looga tegey sidii waab beercanab ku dhex yaal, iyo sidii buul beer khijaar ah ku dhex yaal, iyo sidii magaalo cadow hareereeyey.
english: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

kikuyu: Haddaan Rabbiga ciidammadu dad aad u yar inoo reebin, sida Sodom baan noqon lahayn, oo sida Gomorana baan noqon lahayn.
english: Unless the LORD of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.

kikuyu: Taliyayaasha Sodomow, Rabbiga eraygiisa maqla, dadka Gomorow, sharciga Ilaahayaga dhegta u dhiga.
english: Hear the LORD’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Allabaryadiinna tirada badanu bal maxay ii yihiin? Waan ka dhergay qurbaanno guban oo wanan ah iyo xoolo buurbuuran baruurtood, kuma farxo dhiigga dibida, iyo ka baraarka iyo ka orgida toona.
english: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says the LORD. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

kikuyu: Markaad u timaadaan inaad i hor istaagtaan, bal yaa weyddiista inaad barxadahayga ku joogjoogsataan?
english: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

kikuyu: Mar dambe ha ii keenina qurbaanno aan waxtar lahayn, fooxu waa ii karaahiyo, bilaha cusub, iyo maalmaha sabtida, iyo isuyeedhidda shirarkaba uma aan adkaysan karo, oo xataa shirka weyn waa dembi.
english: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.

kikuyu: Bilihiinna cusub iyo ciidihiinnaba naftaydu way neceb tahay, waa ii culays, inaan u adkaysto waan ka daalay.
english: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.

kikuyu: Oo markaad gacmihiinna ii soo hoorsataanna indhahayga waan idinka qarinayaa, oo markaad tukasho ku noqnoqataanna idin maqli maayo, waayo, gacmihiinnu waa dhiig miidhan.
english: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

kikuyu: Maydha, oo isnadiifiya, oo falimihiinna sharkooda, indhahayga hortooda ka fogeeya, oo sharka aad samaysaan daaya.
english: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.

kikuyu: Inaad wax wanaagsan samaysaan barta, oo caddaalad doondoona, oo kuwa la dulmay u gargaara, agoonta gartooda u qaada, oo carmallada u muddaca.
english: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Haatan kaalaya oo aynu u wada fiirsannee. In kastoo ay dembiyadiinnu guduudan yihiin, sida baraf cad oo kalay u caddaan doonaan, oo in kastoo ay cascas yihiin, sida suuf oo kalay ahaan doonaan.
english: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

kikuyu: Haddaad raalli tihiin oo aad dhega nugushihiin, waxaad cuni doontaan dalka barwaaqadiisa,
english: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;

kikuyu: haddiise aad diiddaan oo aad caasiyowdaan, waxaa idin wada baabbi'in doonta seef, waayo, afkii Rabbiga ayaa saas ku hadlay.
english: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.”

kikuyu: Magaaladii aaminka ahayd oo caddaaladdu ka buuxday, sidee bay dhillo u noqotay! Waxaa ku jiri jirtay xaqnimo, haatanse waxaa jooga gacankudhiiglayaal!
english: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.

kikuyu: Lacagtaadii wasakh bay noqotay, khamrigaagiina waxaa ku qasmay biyo.
english: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.

kikuyu: Amiirradaadii way caasiyoobeen, oo waxay u wehel yeeleen tuugag, oo mid walubana wuxuu jecel yahay laaluush, oo wuxuu daba ordaa abaalgudyo. Agoonta gartooda uma qaadaan, oo dacwada carmalkuna hortooda ma timaado.
english: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t defend the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammada, oo ah Ka xoogga badan ee reer binu Israa'iil wuxuu leeyahay, Way, anigu nacabyadayda waan ka nasan doonaa, oo cadaawayaashaydana waan ka aar gudan doonaa.
english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies.

kikuyu: Oo haddana gacantayda waan ku saari doonaa, oo wasakhdaadana aad baan kaaga nadiifin doonaa, waxaaga aan saafi ahayn oo dhanna waan kaa bixin doonaa.
english: I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan kuu soo celin doonaa xaakinnadaadii sidii markii hore oo kale, oo lataliyayaashaadana waxaan ka dhigi doonaa sidii bilowgii oo kale, oo dabadeedna waxaa laguugu yeedhi doonaa Magaalada xaqnimada, iyo magaalada aaminka ah.
english: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’

kikuyu: Siyoon waxaa lagu soo furan doonaa caddaalad, oo kuweeda soo noqdayna waxaa lagu soo furan doonaa xaqnimo.
english: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwa xadgudba iyo dembilayaasha isku mar baa la burburin doonaa, oo kuwa Rabbiga ka tagana waa la wada baabbi'in doonaa.
english: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed.

kikuyu: Waayo, way ku ceeboobi doonaan geedihii aad jeclaateen, oo beerihii aad doorateenna waad ku qasmi doontaan.
english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

kikuyu: Waayo, idinku waxaad ahaan doontaan sida geed caleentiisu dhado iyo sida beer aan biyo lahayn.
english: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.

kikuyu: Kan xoogga badanu wuxuu noqon doonaa sida shootali oo kale, oo shuqulkiisuna wuxuu noqon doonaa sida dhimbiil oo kale, oo labadooduba way isla guban doonaan, oo lama demin doono iyaga.
english: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”

kikuyu: Kanu waa eraygii uu Ishacyaah ina Aamoos ku arkay wax ku saabsan dalka Yahuudah iyo Yeruusaalem.
english: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ugu dambaysta buurta guriga Rabbigu waxay ka taagnaan doontaa buuraha korkooda, oo kurahana way ka wada sara mari doontaa, oo quruumaha oo dhammuna iyaday ku qulquli doonaan.
english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

kikuyu: Oo dad badan baa halkaas tegi doona oo waxay odhan doonaan, Ina keena, buurta Rabbiga aynu u kacnee, oo guriga Ilaaha reer Yacquub aynu tagnee, oo isna wuxuu ina bari doonaa jidadkiisa, oo innana waxaynu mari doonnaa waddooyinkiisa, waayo, sharcigu wuxuu ka soo bixi doonaa Siyoon, erayga Rabbiguna Yeruusaalem.
english: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo isaguna quruumuhuu u kala garsoori doonaa, oo dad badan ayuu canaanan doonaa, oo iyana waxay seefahooda ka tuman doonaan marashiyo, warmahoodana manjooyin, oo quruunina quruun kale seef uma qaadan doonto, oo innaba mar dambe dagaal ma ay baran doonaan.
english: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

kikuyu: Reer Yacquubow, kaalaya, oo aynu iftiinka Rabbiga ku dhex soconnee.
english: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of the LORD.

kikuyu: Waad ka tagtay dadkaagii reer Yacquub, maxaa yeelay, waxay ka buuxsameen waxyaalihii bariga, oo waa faaliyayaal sida reer Falastiin, oo waxay la heshiiyaan dad shisheeyayaal ah.
english: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

kikuyu: Oo weliba dalkooda waxaa ka buuxa lacag iyo dahab, oo khasnadahooduna dhammaad ma leh, oo weliba dalkooda waxaa ka buuxa fardo, oo gaadhifardoodyadooduna innaba dhammaad ma leh.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

kikuyu: Oo weliba dalkooda waxaa ka buuxa sanamyo, oo waxay caabudaan shuqulkii gacmahooda, iyo wixii ay farahoodu sameeyeen.
english: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

kikuyu: Oo ninka hoose waa u foororsadaa, oo ninka weynuna waa isu hoosaysiiyaa, haddaba dembigooda ha ka cafiyin.
english: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

kikuyu: Cabsida Rabbiga, iyo sharafta haybaddiisa dhagaxa ka gal, oo ciidda kaga dhuumo.
english: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty.

kikuyu: Binu-aadmiga indhihiisa kibray waa la hoosaysiin doonaa, oo dadka madaxweynaantiisana hoos baa loo soo dejin doonaa, oo Rabbiga keliya ayaa maalintaas la sarraysiin doonaa.
english: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu maalin u haystaa ku kasta oo kibra oo madax weynaada, iyo ku kasta oo kor isu qaada, waana la hoosaysiin doonaa,
english: For there will be a day of the LORD of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—

kikuyu: iyo weliba geedaha kedar la yidhaahdo ee Lubnaan ee dhaadheer ee sare u baxa oo dhan, iyo geedaha eelaah la yidhaahdo ee Baashaan oo dhan,
english: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

kikuyu: iyo buuraha dhaadheer oo dhan, iyo kuraha sare u jooga oo dhan,
english: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

kikuyu: iyo munaarad kasta oo dheer, iyo derbi kasta oo deyr leh,
english: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

kikuyu: iyo doonniyaha Tarshiish oo dhan, iyo taswiiro la jecel yahay oo dhan.
english: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

kikuyu: Oo kibirka binu-aadmiga hoos baa loo soo dejin doonaa, oo dadka madaxweynaantiisana waa la hoosaysiin doonaa, oo Rabbiga keliya ayaa maalintaas la sarraysiin doonaa.
english: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

kikuyu: Oo sanamyaduna dhammaantood way wada baabbi'i doonaan.
english: The idols shall utterly pass away.

kikuyu: Markii Rabbigu u soo sara joogsado inuu dhulka si xun u gariiriyo ayay dadku cabsida Rabbiga iyo sharafta haybaddiisa ka geli doonaan qorrofyada dhagaxyada, iyo godadka dhulka.
english: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas dadku sanamyadooda lacagta ah iyo sanamyadooda dahabka ah oo ay u samaysteen inay caabudaan waxay u tuuri doonaan jiirarka iyo fiidmeeraha,
english: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,

kikuyu: si ay cabsida Rabbiga iyo sharafta haybaddiisa uga galaan qorrofyada dhagaxyada iyo qararka meelahooda dildillaacsan markii Rabbigu uu soo sara joogsado inuu dhulka si xun u gariiriyo.
english: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

kikuyu: Ka joogsada binu-aadmiga ay neeftiisu ku jirto dulalka sankiisa, waayo, bal maxaa isaga lagu tiriyaa?
english: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eega, Sayidka ciidammada ahu wuxuu Yeruusaalem iyo dalka Yahuudah ka qaadayaa tiirka iyo waxa la cuskado, xataa tiirka cuntada oo dhan, iyo tiirka biyaha oo dhan,
english: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

kikuyu: iyo ninka xoogga badan, iyo ninka dagaalyahanka ah, iyo xaakinka, iyo nebiga, iyo waxsheegaha, iyo odayga,
english: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

kikuyu: iyo sirkaalka konton u taliya, iyo ninka sharafta leh, iyo lataliyaha, iyo saanaca, iyo saaxirka.
english: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan amiirro uga dhigi doonaa carruur, oo dhallaan baa iyaga u talin doona.
english: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

kikuyu: Oo dadkana midkood kastaba waxaa dulmi doona mid kale, oo mid kastaba waxaa dulmi doona deriskiisa, yarku wuxuu ku kibri doonaa odayga, oo kan hoosena kan sharafta leh.
english: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

kikuyu: Oo markaas nin wuxuu soo qaban doonaa walaalkiis oo jooga gurigii aabbihiis, oo wuxuu ku odhan doonaa, Adigu waxaad leedahay dhar, haddaba taliye noo noqo oo waxan burburka ahuna ha kaa hooseeyo.
english: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

kikuyu: Maalintaasba wuu dhawaaqi doonaa, oo wuxuu odhan doonaa, Anigu bogsiiye noqon maayo, maxaa yeelay, gurigayga dhar iyo dhuuni midna laguma arko, haddaba dadka taliye ha iiga dhigina.
english: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Yeruusaalem waa duntay, oo dadka Yahuudahna waa dheceen, maxaa yeelay, hadalkooda iyo falimahooduba waxay col ku yihiin Rabbiga, oo indhihiisa ammaanta leh ayay ka cadhaysiiyaan.
english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

kikuyu: Muuqashada wejigooda ayaa iyaga ku marag furta oo dembigoodana way u sheegaan sidii dadkii Sodom oo kale, oo innaba ma ay qarsadaan. Naftoodaa hoogtay! Waayo, xumaan bay isu keeneen.
english: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

kikuyu: Waxaad sheegtaan inuu kan xaqa ah barwaaqaysnaan doono, waayo, iyagu waxay cuni doonaan midhihii falimahooda.
english: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.

kikuyu: Waxaa hoogay kan sharka ah, waayo, belaayaa ku dhici doonta, oo waxaa loo samayn doonaa wixii gacmihiisu sameeyeen oo kale.
english: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaa dulma dadkayga carruur, oo dumar baa iyaga u taliya. Dadkaygow, hoggaamiyayaashaadu way ku qaldaan, oo waxay kharribaan jidkaaga aad ku socoto.
english: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu u sara joogaa inuu doodo, oo wuxuu u taagan yahay inuu dadka xukumo.
english: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu dacwad la geli doonaa odayaasha iyo amiirrada dadkiisa. Waa idinka kuwa dhammaystay beercanabka, wixii aad masaakiinta ka soo dhacdeenna guryihiinnay ku dhex jiraan.
english: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

kikuyu: Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, War maxaad ula jeeddaan dadkayga aad burburinaysaan iyo masaakiinta aad wejigooda duqaynaysaan?
english: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi, Gabdhaha Siyoon waa kibirsan yihiin, oo waxay socdaan iyagoo madax taagan oo indhaha ku baaqaya, oo qaadaya tallaabooyin yaryar oo degdeg ah, dugaagadaha cagahana way ka shanqadhiyaan,
english: Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

kikuyu: haddaba sidaas daraaddeed gabdhaha Siyoon madaxooda dhaladiisa Sayidku wuxuu u yeeli doonaa canbaar, oo wuxuu muujin doonaa cawradooda.
english: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas Sayidku wuxuu iyaga ka qaadi doonaa quruxda dugaagadaha cagahooda, iyo shabagyada timaha, iyo bilaha,
english: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

kikuyu: iyo waxa dhegaha la sudho, iyo sindiyada, iyo indhashareeryada,
english: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

kikuyu: iyo waxa madaxa lagu sharraxo, iyo silsiladaha lugaha, iyo waxa madaxa lagu xidho, iyo weelasha cadarka, iyo qardhaasaha,
english: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,

kikuyu: iyo kaatummada, iyo sangelisyada,
english: the signet rings, the nose rings,

kikuyu: iyo dharka lagu iido, iyo shaadirrada, iyo go'yaasha, iyo boorsooyinka,
english: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

kikuyu: iyo muraayadaha, iyo dharka wanaagsan, iyo garbasaarrada, iyo gambooyinka.
english: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqon doontaa in meeshii ay ka carfi jireen ay ka qudhmuunaan doonaan, oo meeshii ay dhex-xidh ka xidhan jireenna xadhig bay dhexda ku xidhan doonaan, oo meeshii ay timo wanaagsan ka lahaayeenna waa looga xiiri doonaa, oo meeshii ay maro wanaagsan ka guntan jireenna, joonyad bay ka guntan doonaan, oo meeshii ay quruxda ka lahaayeenna waa laga sunti doonaa.
english: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

kikuyu: Raggaagu wuxuu ku le'an doonaa seefta, oo kuwaaga xoogga badanuna waxay ku le'an doonaan dagaalka.
english: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

kikuyu: Oo Siyoon irdaheeduna way ooyi doonaan oo ay barooran doonaan, oo iyadoo cidla ah ayay dhulka fadhiisan doontaa.
english: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas toddoba naagood ayaa isku nin qabsan doona, oo waxay ku odhan doonaan, Annagaa ismasruufayna oo annagaa is-arrad tirayna, ee magacaaga keliya ha lanoogu yeedho, oo ceebtayada naga fogee.
english: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas ayaa biqilka Rabbigu noqon doonaa wax qurux iyo ammaan badan, oo midhaha dhulkuna waxay kuwa reer binu Israa'iil oo baxsaday u noqon doonaan wax lagu faano oo quruxsan.
english: In that day, the LORD’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqon doontaa in kii Siyoon ku hadhay iyo kii Yeruusaalem sii joogay loogu yeedho quduus, xataa mid kasta oo ku qoran kuwa Yeruusaalem ku nool dhexdooda
english: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: markii Sayidku maydho wasakhda dadka Siyoon, oo uu Yeruusaalem dhiiggeeda dhexdeeda kaga nadiifiyo ruuxa caddaaladda, iyo ruuxa wax guba.
english: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.

kikuyu: Oo meel kasta oo la deggan yahay oo Buur Siyoon ku taal, iyo shirarkeeda oo dhanba Rabbigu wuxuu ku kor abuuri doonaa maalintii daruur iyo qiiq, habeenkiina dab ololaya iftiinkiis, oo ammaanta oo dhanna waxaa ka sarrayn doona dabool.
english: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.

kikuyu: Oo maalinnimada waxaa jiri doona meel kulaylka laga hadhsado, iyo meel la galo, iyo meel laga dugsado duufaanka iyo roobka.
english: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.

kikuyu: Aan gacaliyahayga ugu gabyo gacaliyahayga gabaygiisa oo ku saabsan beertiisa canabka ah. Gacaliyahaygu wuxuu beer canab ah ku lahaa kur barwaaqaysan.
english: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu hareereheeda ka qoday god, oo dagaxyadii ku jirayna wuu ka saaray, markaasuu ku dhex beeray geedcanabka ugu wanaagsan, oo dhexdeedana wuxuu ka dhisay munaarad, oo weliba wuxuu dhexdeeda ka sameeyey god macsareed, oo wuxuu ka sugayay in midho canab ka soo baxaan, laakiinse waxaa ka soo baxay kuwa xunxun.
english: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

kikuyu: Haddaba, dadka Yeruusaalem deggan iyo dadka Yahuudahow, waxaan idinka baryayaa inaad aniga iyo beertayda canabka ah noo kala gar qaybisaan.
english: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

kikuyu: Bal maxaa kaloo beertayda loo samayn karay oo aanan u samayn? Maxayse markaan ka sugayay inay midho canab ka soo baxaan kuwa xunxun uga soo baxeen?
english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan idiin sheegayaa waxaan beertayda canabka ah ku samayn doono: heeraarkeeda waan ka qaadi doonaa, oo dhammaanteed way baabbi'i doontaa, oo deyrkeedana waan dumin doonaa, oo waa lagu joogjoogsan doonaa,
english: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

kikuyu: oo iyada waxaan ka dhigi doonaa baabba' oo lama gooyn doono, lamana xagaafi doono, laakiinse waxaa ka soo bixi doona yamaarug iyo qodxan, oo weliba daruurahana waan ku amri doonaa inayan roob ku soo dayn.
english: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga ciidammada beercanabkiisu waa dadka Israa'iil, oo dadka Yahuudahna waa geedkuu ku farxo, oo wuxuu ka sugayay caddaalad, laakiinse bal eega, waxaa ka soo baxay dhiigdaadasho oo wuxuu ka sugayay xaqnimo, laakiinse bal eega, waxaa ka soo baxay qaylo.
english: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh kuwa guriba guri ku dhejiya oo beerna beer kale ku dara ilaa meel la waayo oo ay keli ahaantood dhulka dhexdiisa degaan.
english: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, oo aan anigu dhegahayga ku maqlay, Sida runta ah guryo badan baa cidloobi doona, oo xataa kuwa waaweyn oo quruxda badanina waxay ahaan doonaan cidla aan qofna degganayn.
english: In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

kikuyu: Oo weliba toban tacab oo beer canab ahu waxay dhali doonaan qiyaas bad la yidhaahdo oo keliya, oo xomeer muggiis oo iniino ahuna wuxuu dhali doonaa in eefaah qaadi karo.
english: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh kuwa aroor hore u kaca si ay wax lagu sakhraamo u daba galaan, oo haddana ilaa habeenkii ku sii raaga ilaa uu khamrigu ololiyo!
english: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

kikuyu: Diyaafadahooda waxaa yaal kataarad iyo shareerad, iyo daf iyo biibiile, iyo khamri, laakiinse iyagu kama fiirsadaan shuqulka Rabbiga, kamana fikiraan waxyaalihii ay gacmihiisu sameeyeen.
english: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed dadkaygii waxaa loo kaxaystay maxaabbiis ahaan, maxaa yeelay, aqoon ma laha, oo raggoodii sharafta lahaa way gaajoodeen, dadkoodii badnaana oon bay la gubteen.
english: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed She'ool calooshiisii buu isballaadhiyey, oo afkiisiina qiyaasla'aan buu u kala qaaday, oo kuwooda haybadda leh, iyo dadkooda badan, iyo kuwooda buuqa, iyo ku alla koodii reyreeyaba isagay hoos ugu dhaadhacaan.
english: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

kikuyu: Oo ninka hoose baa la soo dejin doonaa, oo ninka weynna waa la hoosaysiin doonaa, oo kuwa isla weyn indhahooda waa la hoosaysiin doonaa,
english: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

kikuyu: laakiinse Rabbiga ciidammada caddaalad baa lagu sarraysiin doonaa, oo Ilaaha quduuska ahna waxaa quduus loogu tirin doonaa xaqnimo.
english: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

kikuyu: Oo markaasay baraarku daaqsintooda ikhtiyaar u daaqi doonaan, oo kuwii barwaaqaysnaana meelahooda baabba'ay waxaa cuni doona shisheeyayaal.
english: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh kuwa xumaanta ku soo jiita xadhkaha aan waxba tarayn, oo dembigana ku soo jiita jaraha gaadhiga oo kale,
english: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

kikuyu: kuwaasoo yidhaahda, Isagu ha soo dhaqsado, oo shuqulkiisana ha soo deddejiyo, si aannu u aragno aawadeed, oo Kan Quduuska ah oo reer binu Israa'iil taladiisuna ha soo dhowaato oo ha timaado, si aannu iyada u aqoonsanno aawadeed!
english: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh kuwa sharka yidhaahda waa wanaag, wanaagna yidhaahda waa shar, oo gudcurkana iftiin ku beddela, iftiinkana gudcur ku beddela, oo qadhaadhkana macaan ku beddela, macaankana qadhaadh ku beddela.
english: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh kuwa isla caqliga badan ee isla miyirka badan!
english: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh kuwa u xoogga badan inay khamri cabbaan, iyo dadka u itaalka weyn inay qasaan wax lagu sakhraamo,
english: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

kikuyu: kuwaasoo kan sharka leh xaq ka dhiga laaluush aawadiis, oo ka xaqa ahna xaqiisa ka qaada!
english: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed sida carrabka dabku xaabka u gubo, oo uu cawskuna ololka ugu dhammaado ayaa xididkoodu u xumaan doonaa, oo ubaxooduna wuxuu u duuli doonaa sida boodh oo kale, maxaa yeelay, waxay diideen sharcigii Rabbiga ciidammada, oo waxay quudhsadeen Kan Quduuska ah oo reer binu Israa'iil eraygiisii.
english: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of the LORD of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed ayaa cadhadii Rabbigu dadkiisa ugu oloshay, oo wuxuu iyaga ku soo fidiyey gacantiisii, wax buuna ku dhuftay, oo buurihiina way wada gariireen, oo meydadkoodiina jidadkay dhex daadsanaayeen sida qashin oo kale, hase ahaatee cadhadiisa kama uu sii jeedin, laakiinse gacantiisu weli way sii fidsan tahay.
english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.

kikuyu: Oo isna meel fog ayuu calan uga taagi doonaa quruumaha, oo wuxuu iyaga uga foodhyi doonaa dhulka dhammaadkiisa, oo bal eega, dhaqsay u iman doonaan.
english: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

kikuyu: Midkoodna ma daali doono, mana kufi doono, oo midkoodna ma gam'i doono, mana seexan doono, dhex-xidhkuna ma furmi doono, yeelmaha kabahooduna ma go'i doono.
english: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,

kikuyu: Fallaadhahoodu waa af miidhan, oo qaansooyinkooda oo dhammuna waa wada xodan yihiin, oo qoobabka fardahoodana waxaa la moodaa sida dhagaxmadow oo kale, oo giraangirahooduna waa sida cirwareenta oo kale,
english: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

kikuyu: oo cidoodu waxay ahaan doontaa sida gool cideed, oo waxay u ciyi doonaan sida libaaxyo yaryar oo kale; hubaal way ciyi doonaan, wayna qabsan doonaan waxay ugaadhsanayaan, oo si ammaan ah ayay u qaadan doonaan, oo ciduna kama samatabbixin doonto.
english: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas waxay iyaga ugu gurxami doonaan sida gurxanka badda; oo haddii dalka la eegana waxaa ka muuqda gudcur iyo cidhiidhi, oo iftiinkuna waa ku dhex madoobaaday daruurihii.
english: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.

kikuyu: Sannaddii Boqor Cusiyaah dhintay ayaan arkay Rabbiga oo ku fadhiya carshi sare oo dheer, oo faraqii dharkiisa ayaa macbudkii buuxiyey.
english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

kikuyu: Oo meel isaga ka sarraysayna waxaa taagnaa seraafiim, oo midkood kastaaba wuxuu lahaa lix baal, laba wejigiisuu ku deday, labana cagihiisuu ku deday, labana wuu ku duulay.
english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

kikuyu: Oo midba wuxuu u qaylinayay midka kale, oo waxay lahaayeen, Quduus, quduus, quduus waxaa ah Rabbiga ciidammada, oo dhulka oo dhanna waxaa ka buuxda ammaantiisa.
english: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

kikuyu: Oo aasaaska iridda ayaa la gariiray kii qayliyey codkiisii, oo gurigiina waxaa ka buuxsamay qiiq.
english: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

kikuyu: Markaasaan idhi, Anaa hoogay! Waayo, waan lumay, maxaa yeelay, waxaan ahay nin aan bushimihiisu daahirsanayn, oo weliba waxaan dhex degganahay dad aan bushimahoodu daahirsanayn, waayo, indhahaygu waxay arkeen Boqorka ah Rabbiga ciidammada.
english: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa seraafiimtii midkood xaggayga u soo duulay isagoo gacanta ku sida dhuxul nool, oo uu birqaab kaga soo qaaday meeshii allabariga,
english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

kikuyu: oo intuu dhuxushii afkayga taabsiiyey ayuu igu yidhi, Bal eeg, tanu waxay taabatay bushimahaaga, oo xumaantaadii waa lagaa qaaday, oo dembigaagiina waa lagaa kafaaragguday.
english: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaan maqlay codkii Rabbiga oo leh, Yaan diraa? Yaase noo tegaya? Markaasaan idhi, Waa i kane aniga i dir.
english: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Tag, oo dadkan waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Wax sii maqla, mana garan doontaan, oo wax sii arka, idiinmana dhaadhici doonto.
english: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

kikuyu: Dadkan qalbigooda ka dhig mid qallafsan, dhegahoodana kuwa dhib wax ku maqla, indhahoodana kuwa xidhan, si aanay indhaha wax ugu arkin, oo aanay dhegaha wax ugu maqlin, oo aanay qalbiga wax ugu garan, oo aanay u soo noqon, oo aanay u bogsan.
english: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

kikuyu: Markaasaan idhi, Sayidow, waa ilaa goorma? Oo isna wuxuu iigu jawaabay, Waa ilaa magaalooyinku baabba'aan oo wax deggan laga waayo, oo guryuhuna ay noqdaan cidla, oo dalkuna uu dhammaantiis wada baabba'o,
english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,

kikuyu: oo Rabbigu dadka ka fogeeyo, oo ay dhulka ku bataan meelo badan oo laga tegey.
english: and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

kikuyu: Oo haddii dhexdiisa toban meelood meel ku hadho way baabbi'i doontaa, oo sida geedo marka la gooyo jiridu u hadho ayaa farcanka quduuska ahu dadka jirid u yahay.
english: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”

kikuyu: Oo Aaxaas ina Yootan, ina Cusiyaah, oo ahaa boqorkii dalka Yahuudah wakhtigiisii waxaa Yeruusaalem ku soo kacay Resiin oo ahaa boqorkii Suuriya iyo Feqax ina Remalyaah oo ahaa boqorkii dalka Israa'iil inay la diriraan, laakiinse way ka adkaan kari waayeen.
english: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa reer Daa'uud loo soo sheegay war leh, Suuriya waxay xidhiidh la yeelatay reer Efrayim. Markaasaa qalbigiisii iyo qalbigii dadkiisuba waxay u ruxmadeen sida geedaha duurka dabayshu u ruxdo oo kale.
english: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu Ishacyaah ku yidhi, Adiga iyo wiilkaaga She'aar Yaashuubba taga oo waxaad Aaxaas uga hor tagtaan meeshuu biyomareenka balliga sare ku dhammaado kaasoo ku dhex yaal waddada berrinka dharmaydhaha,
english: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

kikuyu: oo waxaad isaga ku tidhaahdaa, Digtoonow oo xasilloonow, ha cabsan, hana qalbi jabin labadan qori ee dabka ah ee qiiqaya aawadood, ha ka welwelin cadhada kulul oo Resiin iyo Suuriya, iyo tan ina Remalyaah toona.
english: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

kikuyu: Suuriya, iyo Efrayim, iyo ina Remalyaah waxay kuugu tashadeen talo xun, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen,
english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

kikuyu: Ina keena aynu dalka Yahuudah ku kacnee oo dhibnee, aynuna jabsanno, oo dhexdiisa boqor fadhiisinno, kaasoo ah ina Taabeel,
english: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”

kikuyu: taas daraaddeed Sayidka Rabbiga ahu wuxuu leeyahay, Taladaasu hagaagi mayso, mana ahaan doonto.
english: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Suuriya madaxeedu waa Dimishaq, oo Dimishaq madaxeeduna waa Resiin, oo reer Efrayimna waxay ku kala jajabi doonaan muddo ah shan iyo lixdan sannadood si aanay innaba dad u sii ahaan,
english: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.

kikuyu: oo reer Efrayim madaxoodu waa Samaariya, oo Samaariya madaxeeduna waa ina Remalyaah. Haddaad rumaysan weydaan, sida xaqiiqada ah sinaba ma xoogaysan doontaan.
english: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

kikuyu: Oo weliba Rabbigu mar kaluu Aaxaas la sii hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah calaamad weyddiiso, oo waxaad ka weyddiisataa meelaha hoose ama meelaha sare.
english: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

kikuyu: Oo Aaxaasna wuxuu yidhi, Anigu waxba weyddiisan maayo, oo Rabbigana innaba jirrabi maayo.
english: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu yidhi, Reer Daa'uudow, bal haatan i maqla, ma wax yar bay idinku tahay inaad dadka daalisaan? Oo weliba Ilaahaygana miyaad daalinaysaan?
english: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbiga qudhiisa ayaa calaamad idin siin doona. Bal ogaada, gabadh bikrad ah baa uuraysan doonta, oo waxay dhali doontaa wiil, oo magiciisana waxay u bixin doontaa Cimmaanuu'eel.
english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

kikuyu: Wuxuu cuni doonaa subag iyo malab, ilaa uu aqoonsado inuu sharka diido oo wanaagga doorto.
english: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

kikuyu: Waayo, intaan yarku aqoonsan inuu diido sharka oo uu wanaagga doorto ayaa dalka aad labadiisa boqor karaahiyaysatoba laga tegi doonaa.
english: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

kikuyu: Adiga, iyo dadkaaga iyo reerka aabbahaaba waxaa Rabbigu ku soo dejin doonaa wakhti aan idiin iman tan iyo waa reer Efrayim ay dalka Yahuudah ka tageen, oo kaasuna waa kii boqorka Ashuur.
english: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.

kikuyu: Oo weliba maalintaas Rabbigu wuxuu u soo foodhyi doonaa diqsiyada jooga webiyada Masar darafka ugu shisheeya, iyo shinnida joogta dalka Ashuur.
english: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

kikuyu: Oo iyana way iman doonaan, oo kulligood waxay ku degi doonaan dooxooyinka cidlada, iyo godadka dhagaxyada, iyo geedaha qodxanta leh oo dhan, iyo meelaha daaqsinta ah oo dhan.
english: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

kikuyu: Oo isla maalintaas ayaa Rabbigu madaxa iyo xataa lugahaba ku xiiri doona mandiil laga soo kiraystay webiga shishadiisa, taasoo ah boqorka Ashuur, waxayna baabba' ka dhigi doontaa gadhka.
english: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

kikuyu: Oo waxay maalintaas noqon doontaa in nin dhaqaalaysto sac iyo laba laxaad,
english: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.

kikuyu: oo caanaha tirada badan oo uu ka heli doono aawadood ayuu subag cuni doonaa, waayo, mid kasta oo dalka ku hadhayba wuxuu quudan doonaa subag iyo malab.
english: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

kikuyu: Oo waxay maalintaas noqon doontaa in meel kasta oo ay ku yiilleen kun geed oo canab ah oo kun xabbadood oo lacag ah lagu qiimeeyo, ay noqoto meel ay ka soo baxaan yamaarug iyo qodxan.
english: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa halkaas lala iman doonaa fallaadho iyo qaansooyin, maxaa yeelay, dalka oo dhammu wuxuu noqon doonaa yamaarug iyo qodxan miidhan.
english: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

kikuyu: Oo kurihii sabaradda lagu qodi jiray oo dhan innaba ma aad iman doontaan xaggooda, waana cabsi aad ka qabtaan yamaarugga iyo qodxanta, laakiinse waxay noqon doonaan meel dibida lagu sii daayo daaqaan iyo meel iduhu ku tuntaan.
english: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu igu yidhi, Waxaad soo qaadataa loox weyn, oo waxaad farta dadka ku qortaa. Maheer-shaalaal-haash-bas,
english: The LORD said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;

kikuyu: oo anna waxaan markhaatiyaal aamin ah u soo wadi doonaa wadaadkii Uuriyaah iyo Sekaryaah ina Yeberekyaah.
english: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”

kikuyu: Markaasaan u tegey nebiyaddii oo iyana way uuraysatay, oo waxay dhashay wiil. Kolkaasaa Rabbigu igu yidhi, Waxaad magiciisa u bixisaa, Maheer-shaalaal-haash-bas.
english: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’

kikuyu: Waayo, intaan yarku baran inuu yidhaahdo, Aabbe iyo Hooyo ka hor ayaa boqorka Ashuur maalka Dimishaq iyo xoolaha boolida ah oo Samaariyaba wada qaadan doonaa.
english: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana Rabbigu waa ila hadlay, oo wuxuu igu yidhi,
english: The LORD spoke to me yet again, saying,

kikuyu: Dadkanu way diideen biyaha Shilo'ax oo qunyar socda, oo waxay ku reyreeyaan Resiin iyo ina Remalyaah,
english: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

kikuyu: haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Sayidku wuxuu ku soo dayn doonaa biyaha Webiga ee xoogga iyo badnaanta leh, kuwaasoo ah boqorka Ashuur iyo sharaftiisa oo dhan, oo isna faraqyadiisa oo dhan wuu soo buuxin doonaa, oo qararkiisa oo dhanna wuu buuxdhaafin doonaa,
english: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

kikuyu: oo aad buu u socon doonaa ilaa uu galo dalka Yahuudah, oo intuu wada buuxdhaafo ayuu dhex mari doonaa, oo wuxuu gaadhi doonaa ilaa luqunta, kalafidinta baadadkiisu waxay buuxin doontaa ballaadhka dalkaaga oo dhan Cimmaanuu'eelow.
english: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.

kikuyu: Dadyowgow, qayliya, waadna jajabi doontaan, kuwiinna dalalka fogow, dhegaysta, guntiga isku dhuujiya, waadna jajabi doontaan, guntiga isku dhuujiya, waadna jajabi doontaan.
english: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!

kikuyu: Kulligiin isla tashada, taladiinnuna way buri doontaa, erayga ku hadla, mana hagaagi doono, waayo, Ilaah baa nala jira.
english: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu sidaasuu igula hadlay, isagoo gacan xoog badan leh, oo wuxuu iiga digay inaanan ku socon jidka dadkanu ay ku socdaan, wuxuuna igu yidhi,
english: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

kikuyu: Ha odhanina, Waa fallaagow waxa dadkanu fallaagow yidhaahdaan oo dhan, hana ka cabsanina wixii ay ka cabsadaan, oo innaba ha argaggixina.
english: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.

kikuyu: Quduus ka dhiga Rabbiga ciidammada, oo isagu ha ahaado kan aad ka cabsataan oo aad ka argaggaxdaanba.
english: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ahaan doonaa meel quduus ah, laakiinse labada qoys oo reer binu Israa'iilba wuxuu u noqon doonaa dhagax lagu turunturoodo iyo sallax lagu xumaado, oo dadka Yeruusaalem degganna wuxuu u noqon doonaa dabin iyo siriq.
english: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa badan ayaa turunturoon doona, oo kufi doona, oo jebi doona, waana la dabi doonaa, oo la qabsan doonaa.
english: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

kikuyu: Markhaatifurka xidh, oo sharcigana xertayda dhexdeeda ku shaabadee.
english: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan sugi doonaa Rabbiga wejigiisa dadka Yacquub ka qariya, oo isagaan filan doonaa.
english: I will wait for the LORD, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

kikuyu: Bal eega, aniga iyo carruurta Rabbigu i siiyeyba waxaannu reer binu Israa'iil u nahay calaamado iyo yaabab ka yimid xagga Rabbiga ciidammada oo deggan Buur Siyoon.
english: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.

kikuyu: Oo markay idinku leeyihiin, Talo weyddiista kuwa ruuxaanta leh, iyo saaxiriinta hadaaqda oo guryanta, miyaanay dadka waajib ku ahayn inay Ilaahooda talo weyddiistaan? Miyayse iyaga ku habboon tahay inay kuwa dhintay wax u weyddiiyaan kuwa nool aawadood?
english: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?

kikuyu: Sharciga iyo markhaatifurka ka fiirsada, oo eraygan hadal waafaqsan haddaanay ku hadlinna hubaal iyaga waaberi uma jiri doono.
english: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

kikuyu: Oo iyagoo dhibaataysan oo gaajaysan ayay dalka dhex mari doonaan, oo markay gaajoodaan ayay isku xanaaqi doonaan, oo waxay habaari doonaan boqorkooda oo wax xun Ilaahooda ka sheegi doonaan, xagga sarena way u jeedsan doonaan,
english: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,

kikuyu: dhulkana way fiirin doonaan, oo bal eega, waxay ku arki doonaan dhib iyo gudcur, iyo cidhiidhiga madowgiisa, oo waxaa iyaga lagu eryi doonaa gudcur dam ah.
english: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

kikuyu: Habase ahaatee madow uma ahaan doono tii cidhiidhiga ku jirtay. Waagii hore wuxuu ka dhigay in la quudhsado dhulka Sebulun iyo dhulka Naftaali, laakiinse waagii dambe wuxuu ka dhigay in la sharafo dhulka ah xagga jidka badda, iyo Webi Urdun shishadiisa, iyo Galili quruumaha ka mid ah.
english: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

kikuyu: Dadkii ku socon jiray gudcurka ayaa iftiin weyn arkay, kuwii fadhiyi jiray dalka hooska dhimashada ahna iftiin baa u baxay.
english: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Adigu quruunta waad badisay, oo farxaddoodiina waad sii kordhisay, oo waxay hortaada ugu farxaan sida farxadda wakhtiga beeraha la goosto, iyo sida niman booli qaybsanayaa ay u reyreeyaan oo kale.
english: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

kikuyu: Waayo, harqoodkii ku cuslaa, iyo hangoolkii garbaha lagaga dhufan jiray, iyo ushii kii dulmi jiray, ayaad jebisay sidii waagii reer Midyaan.
english: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

kikuyu: Waayo, ninka hubka leh ee buuqa ku dhex jira hubkiisa oo dhan iyo dharka dhiigga miidhanna waa la gubi doonaa oo waxaa laga dhigi doonaa wax dabka lagu shido.
english: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa inoo dhashay ilmo, waxaa layna siiyey wiil, oo boqornimadu garbihiisay saarmi doontaa, oo magiciisana waxaa loo bixin doonaa Ka Yaabkaleh, iyo Lataliye, iyo Ilaaha Xoogga leh, iyo Aabbaha Daa'imka ah, iyo Amiirka Nabadda.
english: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

kikuyu: Oo boqornimadiisa iyo nabaddu way badnaan doonaan, dhammaadna uma lahaan doonaan carshiga Daa'uud iyo boqortooyadiisa, in la sii adkeeyo, oo caddaalad iyo xaqnimo lagu sii hayo haatan iyo tan iyo weligeedba. Oo tan waxaa samayn doona qiirada Rabbiga ciidammada.
english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.

kikuyu: Sayidku wuxuu eray u soo diray dadka Yacquub wuxuuna ku kor dhacay dadka Israa'iil.
english: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa garan doona dadka oo dhan, xataa reer Efrayim iyo kuwa Samaariya deggan oo kibirka iyo islaweynaanta qalbiga ku hadla, iyagoo leh,
english: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,

kikuyu: Lebennadii way soo dheceen, laakiinse annagu waxaannu ku dhisi doonnaa dhagaxyo la qoray, geedihii darayga ahaa waa la jaray, laakiinse waxaannu ku beddeli doonnaa geedo kedar ah.
english: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Rabbigu wuxuu ku soo kicin doonaa kuwa Resiin la col ah, oo cadaawayaashiisana wuu isku soo wada ururin doonaa dhammaantood,
english: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

kikuyu: wuxuu reer Suuriya ka soo kicin doonaa xagga bari, reer Falastiinna xagga galbeed, oo waxay dadka Israa'iil ku cuni doonaan af furan. Hase ahaatee cadhadiisa kama uu sii jeedin, laakiinse gacantiisii weli way fidsan tahay.
english: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: Laakiinse dadku uma ay soo noqon kii iyaga wax ku dhuftay, mana ay doondoonin Rabbiga ciidammada.
english: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Rabbigu maalin keliya ayuu dadka Israa'iil ka jari doonaa madaxa iyo dabadaba, iyo laanta iyo cawsduurkaba.
english: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.

kikuyu: Odayga iyo kan sharafta lahu waa madaxa, oo nebiga dadka beenta baraana waa dabada.
english: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

kikuyu: Waayo, dadkan hoggaamiyayaashoodu way qaldaan, oo kuwa la hoggaamiyaana way wada baabba'aan.
english: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Sayidku ku farxi maayo barbaarradooda, oo agoontooda iyo carmalladoodana u naxariisan maayo, waayo, midkood kastaaba waa cibaadalaawe iyo xumaanfale, oo af kastaana wuxuu ku hadlaa wax nacasnimo ah. Hase ahaatee cadhadiisa kama uu sii jeedin, laakiinse gacantiisii weli way fidsan tahay.
english: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: Waayo, xumaantu waxay wax u gubtaa sida dabka oo kale, oo waxay dam ka dhigtaa yamaarugga iyo qodxanta, oo jiqda duuddana way ololisaa, oo waxaa kor uga baxa daruur qiiq ah.
english: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

kikuyu: Dhulku wuxuu la gubtay Rabbiga ciidammada cadhadiisa, oo dadkuna waxay yihiin sida wax dabka lagu shido, oo ninna walaalkiis ma caymiyo.
english: Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

kikuyu: Xagga gacanta midig ayaa wax laga dhufsan doonaa, waana la sii gaajoon doonaa, xagga gacanta bidixna wax baa lagu cuni doonaa, lamana dhergi doono, oo midkood kastaaba wuxuu cuni doonaa hilibka gacantiisa.
english: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

kikuyu: Reer Manaseh waxay cuni doonaan reer Efrayim, oo reer Efrayimna waxay cuni doonaan reer Manaseh, oo iyana dhammaantood waxay col ku ahaan doonaan reer Yahuudah. Hase ahaatee cadhadiisa kama uu sii jeedin, laakiinse gacantiisii weli way fidsan tahay.
english: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh kuwa amarro aan xaq ahayn soo saara, iyo kuwa wax qalloocan qora,
english: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees

kikuyu: inay kuwa baahan garta ka qalloociyaan oo ay masaakiinta dadkaygana xaqooda ka qaadaan, oo ay carmallada ka dhigaan waxa ay dhacaan agoontana waxa ay ugaadhsadaan.
english: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

kikuyu: Oo bal maxaad samayn doontaan maalinta ciqaabta, iyo wakhtiga baabbi'intu meesha fog ka iman doonto? Bal yaad u magangeli doontaan? Sharaftiinnana xaggee baad kaga tegi doontaan?
english: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

kikuyu: Waxay ku dhex foororsan doonaan maxaabiista, oo waxay ku dhex dhici doonaan kuwa la layn doono. Hase ahaatee cadhadiisa kama uu sii jeedin, laakiinse gacantiisii weli way fidsan tahay.
english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh ka reer Ashuur oo ah ushii cadhadayda iyo hangoolka dhirifkaygu gacanta ugu jiro.
english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

kikuyu: Isagaan u diri doonaa inuu quruun cibaadalaawayaal ah ku kaco, oo waxaan ku amri doonaa amar ka gees ah dadka aan u cadhooday, inuu maalkooda dhaco, oo uu maxaabiis kexeeyo, oo uu iyaga ugu tunto sida dhoobada jidadka dhex taal.
english: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

kikuyu: Habase ahaatee isagu saas kuma talo jiro, oo qalbigiisuna saas kuma fikiro, laakiinse waxaa qalbigiisa ku jira inuu baabbi'iyo oo jaro quruumo aan yarayn.
english: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu leeyahay, Amiirradaydu dhammaantood sow boqorro ma aha?
english: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

kikuyu: Kalnoo sow ma aha sida Karkemiish? Xamadna sow ma aha sida Arfaad? Samaariyana sow ma aha sida Dimishaq oo kale?
english: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

kikuyu: Sidii ay gacantaydu u gaadhay boqortooyooyinkii sanamyada, oo ay taswiirahoodii la xardhay ka sii badnayeen kuwa Yeruusaalem iyo Samaariya,
english: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,

kikuyu: iyo sidii aan Samaariya iyo sanamyadeedii ku sameeyey oo kale, miyaanan Yeruusaalem iyo sanamyadeedaba ku samayn doonin?
english: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed markii Sayidku shuqulkiisa oo dhan ku dhammaystiro Buur Siyoon iyo Yeruusaalem, wuxuu odhan doonaa, Boqorka Ashuur ayaan u ciqaabi doonaa midhaha qalbigiisa isla weyn iyo faanka indhihiisa kibrayba.
english: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu yidhi, Tan waxaan ku sameeyey xoogga gacantayda iyo xigmaddayda, maxaa yeelay, miyir baan leeyahay, oo waxaan durkiyey dadyowga soohdintooda, khasnadahoodiina waan dhacay, oo sidii nin geesi ah oo kale ayaan kuwii carshiyada ku fadhiyey u soo dejiyey.
english: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

kikuyu: Oo gacantayduna waxay maalkii dadka u heshay sidii buul shimbireed oo kale, oo sida loo soo ururiyo ukumo laga tegey ayaan u soo ururiyey dhulka oo dhan, oo lamana arag mid baal dhaqaajiyey, ama afka kala qaaday, amase ciyey.
english: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

kikuyu: Miyuu faasku ka faanaa kan isaga wax ku gooya? Minshaartuna miyey iska sii weynaysaa kan iyada ku shaqeeya? Waa sida haddii ulu iska gilgisho kuwa iyada kor u qaada, amase sida hangool kor u qaada kan aan qori ahayn?
english: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Sayidka ah Sayidka ciidammadu wuxuu kuwiisa cayilay ku soo diri doonaa macaluul, oo sharaftiisa meesheedana waxaa lagu shidi doonaa olol ah sida olol dabeed.
english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

kikuyu: Iftiinka Israa'iilna wuxuu noqon doonaa dab, oo kiisa Quduuska ahuna olol, oo maalin qudha ayuu gubi doonaa oo baabbi'in doonaa qodxantiisa iyo yamaaruggiisba,
english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
