kikuyu: oo wuxuu dhammayn doonaa ammaanta duuddiisa iyo beertiisa midhaha badanba, iyo naf iyo jidhba, oo waxay noqon doontaa sidii markii calanqaade taag darnaado.
english: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

kikuyu: Oo geedaha duuddiisa ku hadhayna waxay noqon doonaan in yar oo ilma yaru tiradooda qori karo.
english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

kikuyu: Oo waxay maalintaas noqon doontaa in kuwa dadka Israa'iil ka hadhay iyo intii dadka Yacquub ka baxsatayba ayan mar dambe ku tiirsan kii iyaga wax ku dhuftay, laakiinse waxay si run ah ugu tiirsan doonaan Rabbiga ah Kan Quduuska ah oo dadka Israa'iil.
english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

kikuyu: Qaar hadhay baa soo noqon doona, xataa qaar hadhay oo dadka Yacquub waxay u soo noqon doonaan Ilaaha xoogga badan.
english: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

kikuyu: Israa'iilow, in kastoo dadkaagu u badan yahay sida cammuudda badda, qaar yar oo qudha ayaa soo noqon doona, oo baabba' la soo amray ayaa caddaalad la qarqi doona.
english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

kikuyu: Waayo, Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu baabbi'id la amray ku samayn doonaa dhulka dhexdiisa oo dhan.
english: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaa daraaddeed Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Dadkayga Siyoon degganow, kan reer Ashuur ha ka baqin. Ushiisuu kugu dhufan doonaa, oo hangoolkiisuu kuu qaadan doonaa sida Masriyiintu sameeyeen oo kale,
english: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

kikuyu: laakiin, weli wakhti yar baa hadhay, dabadeedna dhirifkaygu wuu idlaan doonaa, oo cadhadayduna way ku dhammaan doontaa baabba'ooda.
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga ciidammaduna wuxuu iyaga ku ciqaabi doonaa karbaash u gala sida layntii reer Midyaan oo ka dhacday dhagixii weynaa ee Xoreeb agtiisa, oo sida ushiisu u kor ahayd badda ayuu kor ugu qaadi doonaa sidii Masar loogu qaaday oo kale.
english: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas rarkiisa ayaa garbahaaga laga qaadi doonaa, oo harqoodkiisana surkaagaa laga dejin doonaa, oo harqoodkuna wuxuu u baabbi'i doonaa saliidda aawadeed.
english: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

kikuyu: Cayaad buu yimid, oo Migroon buu dhex maray, oo wuxuu alaabtiisii dhigtay Mikmaash.
english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

kikuyu: Way gudbeen meeshii laga gudbi jiray, oo waxay ku dhaxeen Gebac. Raamaah way gariirtay, Gibecaahdii Saa'uulna way carartay.
english: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

kikuyu: Magaalada Galliimay, codkaaga kor u qaad! Layishay, maqal! Adaa hoogay, Canaatooday!
english: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

kikuyu: Madmeenaah way carartay, oo dadkii Gebiim degganaana waxay isu soo urursadeen inay baxsadaan.
english: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

kikuyu: Maantadan wuxuu soo joogsan doonaa Nob, oo wuxuu gacantiisa ku ruxayaa buurta magaalada Siyoon oo ah kurta Yeruusaalem.
english: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Bal eega, Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu laamaha u gooyn doonaa si aad loogaga cabsado, oo kuwa waaweynna waa la jari doonaa, oo kuwa dhaadheerna waa la ridi doonaa.
english: Behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

kikuyu: Oo jiqda duuddana bir buu ku jari doonaa, oo Lubnaanna waxay ku dhici doontaa mid xoog badan gacantiis.
english: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.

kikuyu: Oo jiridda Yesay biqil baa ka soo biqli doona, oo xididdadiisana laan baa ka soo dhalan doonta,
english: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.

kikuyu: oo waxaa ku dul joogi doona Ruuxa Rabbiga oo ah ruuxa xigmadda iyo waxgarashada, iyo ruuxa talada iyo xoogga, iyo ruuxa aqoonta iyo ka cabsashada Rabbiga.
english: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku farxi doonaa Rabbiga ka cabsashadiisa, oo isagu wax uma xukumi doono siduu wax u arko, oo siduu wax u maqlana innaba uma gar gooyn doono,
english: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

kikuyu: laakiin masaakiinta wuxuu ugu gar qaybin doonaa xaqnimo, oo dhulka kuwiisa hooseeyana wuxuu ugu gar gooyn doonaa caddaalad, oo wuxuu dhulka ku dhufan doonaa usha afkiisa, oo kan sharka lehna wuu ku dili doonaa neefta bushimihiisa.
english: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

kikuyu: Wuxuu dhexda ku xidhan doonaa xaqnimo, miskihiisana wuxuu ku xidhan doonaa aaminnimo.
english: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

kikuyu: Oo yeydu waxay la joogi doontaa baraarka, shabeelkuna wuxuu la jiifsan doonaa waxarta, oo weysha iyo dhasha libaaxa iyo neefka buuranu way wada joogi doonaan, oo waxaa iyaga hor kici doona ilma yar.
english: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa wada daaqi doona saca iyo orsada, oo ubadkooduna way isla wada jiifsan doonaan, oo libaaxuna sida dibiga oo kale caws buu u cuni doonaa.
english: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

kikuyu: Oo caanonuuggu wuxuu ku dul cayaari doonaa godka jilbiska, ilmaha naaska laga gudhiyeyna wuxuu gacantiisa saari doonaa hogga abeesada.
english: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.

kikuyu: Oo buurtayda quduuska ah oo dhan, waxba kuma yeeli doonaan, waxna kuma baabbi'in doonaan, waayo, dhulka waxaa ka buuxsami doona aqoonta Rabbiga, siday biyuhu badda uga buuxaan.
english: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas xididka Yesay ayaa dadyowga calan u ahaan doona. Isagay quruumuhu doondooni doonaan, oo rugtiisuna ammaan bay ahaan doontaa.
english: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas ayuu Sayidku gacantiisa mar labaad u soo fidin doonaa inuu dadkiisa hadhay ka soo celiyo Ashuur iyo Masar, iyo Fatroos, iyo Kuush, iyo Ceelaam, iyo Shincaar, iyo Xamaad, iyo gasiiradaha baddaba.
english: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

kikuyu: Oo calan ayuu quruumaha u taagi doonaa, wuxuuna soo shirin doonaa masaafurisyadii dadka Israa'iil, oo wuxuu isu soo ururin doonaa oo dhulka afartiisa daraf ka soo kaxayn doonaa kuwa kala firdhay oo dadka Yahuudah.
english: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

kikuyu: Oo weliba hinaasada reer Efrayim wuu idlaan doonaa, oo kuwa dadka Yahuudah dhibana waa la jari doonaa, reer Efrayim kuma hinaasi doonaan dadka Yahuudah, oo dadka Yahuudahna reer Efrayim ma dhibi doonaan.
english: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.

kikuyu: Way duuli doonaan oo ku degi doonaan garbaha reer Falastiin xagga galbeed jooga, oo waxay wadajir u dhici doonaan dadka reer bari, gacantooday saari doonaan reer Edom iyo reer Moo'aab, oo reer Cammoonna iyagay addeeci doonaan.
english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu dhammaantiis wada baabbi'in doonaa carrabka badda Masar, oo gacantiisa oo dabayl xoog leh wadata ayuu ku kor ruxi doonaa Webiga, oo intuu wax ku dhufto ayuu toddoba faraq u kala qaybin doonaa, oo wuxuu ka dhigi doonaa in dadku kabo kaga gudbaan.
english: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

kikuyu: Oo dadkiisa hadhay waxaa u jiri doona jid weyn oo ka yimaada xagga Ashuur, sidii uu reer binu Israa'iilba ugu jiray waagii ay dalkii Masar ka soo baxeen.
english: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas waxaad odhan doontaa, Rabbiyow, waan kuu mahadnaqayaa, waayo, in kastoo aad ii cadhaysnayd, cadhadaadii way iga rogmatay oo waad i qalbi qaboojisay.
english: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

kikuyu: Bal eega, Ilaah waa badbaadadayda! Waan isku hallayn doonaa, mana baqi doono, waayo, Rabbiga Ilaaha ahu waa xooggayga iyo gabaygayga, oo weliba wuxuu ii noqday badbaadadayda.
english: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

kikuyu: Haddaba farxad baad biyo kaga dhaansan doontaan ceelasha badbaadada.
english: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas waxaad odhan doontaan, Rabbiga u mahadnaqa, oo magiciisa ku barya, falimihiisana ka caddeeya dadyowga dhexdooda, oo xusuusiya inuu magiciisu weyn yahay.
english: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!

kikuyu: Rabbiga u gabya, waayo, waxyaalo waaweyn ayuu sameeyey, dunida oo dhanna taas ogeysiiya.
english: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

kikuyu: Kuwiinna Siyoon degganow, aad u qayliya oo dhawaaqa, waayo, Kan Quduuska ah oo reer binu Israa'iil ee dhexdiinna joogaa wuu weyn yahay.
english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

kikuyu: Kanu waa warka culus ee Baabuloon ku saabsan oo uu Ishacyaah ina Aamoos arkay.
english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

kikuyu: Buurta dheer calan ka taaga, codkana iyaga kor ugu qaada, oo u gacanhaadiya inay irdaha kuwa gobta ah galaan.
english: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

kikuyu: Waxaan amray kuwaygii gooni la iigu dhigay, oo weliba waxaan cadhadayda aawadeed ugu yeedhay kuwayga xoogga badan, waxaana weeye kuwa sarrayntayda ku reyreeya.
english: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

kikuyu: Waxaa la maqlayaa bulxanka dadka badan oo buuraha ka yeedhaya sida dad fara badan! Waxaana la maqlayaa buuqa boqortooyooyinkii quruumaha isa soo wada urursaday! Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu soo ururinayaa ciidanka dagaalka.
english: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.

kikuyu: Waxay ka imanayaan waddan fog iyo samada darafka ugu shisheeya inay dalka oo dhan baabbi'iyaan, waana Rabbiga iyo hubkii dhirifkiisaba.
english: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

kikuyu: Baroorta, waayo, maalintii Rabbigu way dhow dahay, oo waxay u iman doontaa sida baabbi'in xagga Ilaaha Qaadirka ah ka timid.
english: Wail, for the LORD’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed gacmo oo dhammu way taag gabi doonaan, oo nin kastaba qalbigiisu wuu dhalaali doonaa.
english: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.

kikuyu: Wayna nixi doonaan, oo waxaa qaban doona xanuun iyo murug, oo waxay u xanuunsan doonaan sida naag foolanaysa. Oo midkoodba kan kaluu la yaabi doonaa, oo wejigooduna wuxuu noqon doonaa sida olol oo kale.
english: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.

kikuyu: Bal eega, maalinta Rabbigu way imanaysaa iyadoo nac weyn oo ka buuxda cadho iyo xanaaq kulul si dhulka cidla looga dhigo oo dembilayaasha oo dhan dhexdiisa looga baabbi'iyo.
english: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.

kikuyu: Waayo, xiddigaha samada iyo ururkooduba ma iftiimi doonaan. Qorraxduna way madoobaan doontaa markii ay soo baxdo, oo dayaxuna ma iftiimi doono.
english: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

kikuyu: Oo dunida sharkeeda aawadiis ayaan u ciqaabi doonaa, oo kuwa sharka lehna xumaantooda aawadeed ayaan u ciqaabi doonaa, oo kuwa kibrana kibirkooda waan joojin doonaa, oo kuwa laga cabsadona madaxweynaantooda hoos baan u soo dejin doonaa.
english: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.

kikuyu: Waxaan dadka ka dhigi doonaa wax dhif ah oo ka qaalisan dahabka wanaagsan, oo binu-aadmigana waxaan ka dhigi doonaa wax aan badnayn sida dahabka saafiga ah ee Oofir.
english: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed maalinta Rabbiga xanaaqiisa kululu iman doono ayaan samooyinka gariirin doonaa, dhulkuna meeshiisuu kaga dhaqaaqi doonaa cadhada Rabbiga ciidammada.
english: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.

kikuyu: Oo sida deero la eryay iyo sida ido aan ciduna soo ururin ayaa midkood kastaaba dadkiisa ku noqon doonaa, oo mid kastaaba dalkiisa u carari doonaa.
english: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.

kikuyu: Mid kasta oo la helo waa la dooxi doonaa, oo mid kasta oo la qabto seef baa lagu dili doonaa.
english: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

kikuyu: Oo dhallaankoodana dhulkaa lagu tuuri doonaa iyagoo arkaya, guryahoodana waa la dhici doonaa, naagahoodana waa la kufsan doonaa.
english: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

kikuyu: Bal eega, waxaan iyaga ku soo kicin doonaa reer Maaday oo aan innaba lacag ka fikirayn oo aan dahabkana ku farxin.
english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.

kikuyu: Qaansooyinkoodu waxay baabbi'in doonaan barbaarrada, oo midhaha maxalkana innaba uma ay naxariisan doonaan, oo carruurtana uma ay tudhi doonaan.
english: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.

kikuyu: Oo Baabuloon oo ah sharaftii boqortooyooyinka iyo quruxdii kibirka reer Kaldayiin waxay noqon doontaa sidii markii Ilaah Sodom iyo Gomora afgembiyey.
english: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

kikuyu: Oo weligeed innaba lama degi doono oo tan iyo ab ka ab laguma dhex hoyan doono, oo Carabkuna halkaas teendho kama dhisan doono, oo adhijirraduna halkaas adhigooda ma daajin doonaan.
english: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

kikuyu: Laakiinse halkaas waxaa jiifsan doona dugaagga lamadegaanka, oo guryahoodana waxaa ka buuxsami doona guumeyso, oo waxaa ku hoyan doona gorayo, waxaana ku dhex cayaari doona xayawaan dhogor dheer leh.
english: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.

kikuyu: Oo yeey baana guryahooda cidloobay qaylo isugu jawaabi doona, oo daarahooda qurqurxoonna dawacooyin baa ka dhex qaylin doona, oo wakhtigeediina kol dhow buu iman doonaa, oo cimrigeedana lama sii dheerayn doono.
english: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu reer Yacquub wuu u naxariisan doonaa, oo haddana reer binu Israa'iil ayuu dooran doonaa, dalkoodiina wuu fadhiisin doonaa, oo waxaa iyaga ku darman doona shisheeyayaal, wayna la degi doonaan reerka Yacquub.
english: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

kikuyu: Oo dadyowga ayaa soo kaxayn doona, oo waxay iyaga keeni doonaan meeshoodii, oo reer binu Israa'iil ayaa iyaga dalka Rabbiga ugu haysan doona addoommo rag iyo gabdho ah, oo maxaabiis ahaan bay u haysan doonaan kuwii ay iyagu maxaabiista u ahaan jireen, oo waxay u talin doonaan kuwii iyaga dulmi jiray.
english: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta Rabbigu kaa nasiyo murugtaadii, iyo dhibkaagii, iyo addoonsigii adkaa oo lagugu addoonsanayay,
english: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

kikuyu: ayaad boqorka Baabuloon ku soo maadsan doontaa, oo waxaad ka odhan doontaa, Kii wax dulmi jiray sidee buu u dhammaaday! Magaalada gabbaro qaadan jirtay sidee bay u idlaatay!
english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu jebiyey hangoolkii kuwa sharka leh, iyo ushii taliyayaasha.
english: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

kikuyu: Kii isagoo cadhaysan dadka ku dhufan jiray darbado joogta ah, oo quruumaha u talin jiray isagoo xanaaqsan waa la silciyaa iyadoo aan ciduna ka hor joogsan.
english: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.

kikuyu: Dunida oo dhammu way nasan tahay oo way xasilloon tahay, farxad baana lala gabyayaa.
english: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.

kikuyu: Dhirta berooshka ah iyo geedaha kedarka ah ee Lubnaanba way kugu reyreeyaan, oo waxay yidhaahdaan, Tan iyo waagii aad dhacday ninna nooma soo kicin inuu na jarto.
english: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

kikuyu: She'oolka hoose wuu soo kacay oo u dhaqdhaqaaqay inuu ku qaabbilo markaad timaado, oo wuxuu kuu soo kiciyey kuwii dhintay oo ahaa xataa kuwii dhulka ugu waaweynaa oo dhan, oo boqorradii quruumaha oo dhan wuxuu ka soo kiciyey carshiyadoodii.
english: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

kikuyu: Oo iyana dhammaantood waxay kugu odhan doonaan, War adiguna ma sidayadoo kalaad u taag gabtay? Oo ma annagoo kalaad noqotay?
english: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

kikuyu: Sarrayntaadii iyo dhawaaqii shareeradahaagaba waxaa hoos loogu soo dejiyey She'ool, waxaa hoos lagaaga goglay dixiri, korkana waxaa lagaa huwiyey dixiri.
english: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.

kikuyu: Xiddigta waaberiyow, Inanka arooryadow, sidee baad samada uga soo dhacday! Kaagan quruumaha taag yareeyeyow, sidee baa dhulka laguugu riday!
english: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

kikuyu: Waxaad qalbigaaga iska tidhi, Anigu waxaan kori doonaa samada, oo carshigaygana xiddigaha Ilaah waan ka sara marin doonaa, oo weliba waxaan ku fadhiisan doonaa buurta shirka ee darafka woqooyi ku taal.
english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

kikuyu: Waxaan kori doonaa daruuraha sare korkooda, oo waxaan noqon doonaa sida Ilaaha ugu sarreeya oo kale.
english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaa lagu dejin doonaa She'ool, iyo meelaha ugu hooseeya ee yamayska.
english: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa ku arkaa way kugu dhaygagi doonaan, wayna ku fiirsan doonaan, oo waxay odhan doonaan, War kanu ma ninkii dhulka gariiriyey, oo boqortooyooyinka ruxruxay,
english: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,

kikuyu: oo dunida sidii lamadegaan oo kale ka dhigay, oo magaalooyinkeedii dumiyey, oo aan maxaabiistiisa u dayn inay gurigoodii ku noqdaan baa?
english: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”

kikuyu: Boqorradii quruumaha oo dhammu dhammaantood sharaf bay ku jiifaan iyagoo mid kastaaba qabrigiisa ku jiro.
english: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adiga waa lagu xooray, oo qabrigaagii waa lagaa fogeeyey sidii laan la karhay, oo sidii dharka kuwa la laayay oo seefta lagu mudhbixiyey oo hoos ugu dhaca dhagaxyada yamayska, ayaa sidii meyd oo kale lagugu tuntay.
english: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga kuma darsami doontid, lagumana aasi doono, maxaa yeelay, dalkaagii waad baabbi'isay, dadkaagiina waad laysay. Farcanka xumaanfalayaasha weligood mar dambe lama magacaabi doono.
english: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.

kikuyu: Meel lagu laayo u diyaarsha carruurtiisa xumaantii aabbayaashood aawadeed, si ayan u sara kicin, oo ayan dhulka u hantiyin, oo ayan dunida korkeedana magaalooyin uga buuxin.
english: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ah Ilaaha ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigaa ku soo kici doona iyaga, oo Baabuloon ayaan ka baabbi'in doonaa magac iyo dad hadhay, iyo wiil iyo wiil wiilkii.
english: “I will rise up against them,” says the LORD of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo weliba Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Waxaan ka dhigi doonaa hantida caanaqubta iyo balliyo biyo ah, oo waxaan ku xaaqi doonaa xaaqinka baabbi'inta.
english: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu ku dhaartay oo yidhi, Sida xaqiiqada ah waxay noqon doontaa sidii aan ku fikiray, oo taladanuna waxay u hagaagi doontaa sidii aan u qasdiyey,
english: The LORD of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

kikuyu: taasoo ah inaan kan reer Ashuur dalkayga ku jebin doono, buurahayga korkoodana isaga ku tuman doono, markaasaa harqoodkiisu iyaga ka fogaan doonaa, culayskiisuna garbahooda ka degi doonaa.
english: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.

kikuyu: Kanu waa qasdigii loola qasdiyey dhulka oo dhan, oo tanuna waa gacantii lagu kor fidiyey quruumaha oo dhan.
english: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadu waxan wuu u qasdiyey, haddaba bal yaa burin doona? Oo gacantiisiina way soo fidsan tahay, yaa dib u celin doona?
english: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”

kikuyu: Sannaddii Boqor Aaxaas dhintay ayaa warkan culus la yidhi.
english: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.

kikuyu: Reer Falastiin oo dhammow, ha ku farxin in ushii lagugu garaacay jabtay, maxaa yeelay, abeesada xididkeeda waxaa ka soo bixi doona jilbis, oo farcankiisuna wuxuu noqon doonaa masduulaa dab leh.
english: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.

kikuyu: Oo curadka masaakiinta ayaa wax cuni doona, kuwa baahanna ammaan bay ku jiifsan doonaan, oo xididkaagana waxaan ku dili doonaa abaar, kuwa kaa hadhayna waa la layn doonaa.
english: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.

kikuyu: Iriddow, barooro. Magaaladaay, ooy! Reer Falastiin oo dhammow, kulligaa cabsi la dhalaal, waayo, waxaa woqooyi ka iman doona qiiq, oo midna saaxiibbadiis kama hadhi doono.
english: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

kikuyu: Haddaba bal maxaa loogu jawaabi doonaa wargeeyayaasha quruunta? Waxaa loogu jawaabi doonaa in Rabbigu Siyoon aasaasay oo kuwa dhibaataysan ee dadkiisuna ay dhexdeeda magangeli doonaan.
english: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

kikuyu: Kanu waa warka culus ee Moo'aab ku saabsan. Caartii Moo'aab habeen qudha baa lagu dumiyey oo baabba'shay; Qiirtii Moo'aab habeen qudha baa lagu dumiyey oo baabba'shay.
english: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.

kikuyu: Waxaa kor loogu baxay Bayid iyo Diboon oo meelaha sare ku yaal in lagu ooyo, reer Moo'aab waxay u baroortaan Neboo iyo Meedebaa, madaxyadooda oo dhan waa la xiiray oo gadh kastana waa la jaray.
english: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

kikuyu: Jidadkooda waxaa lagu guntadaa dhar joonyad ah, oo guryahooda dushooda iyo jidadkooda ayaa mid kastaaba ka baroortaa isagoo aad u ooyaya.
english: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.

kikuyu: Oo Xeshboon iyo Elecaaleehba way qayliyaan, oo codkoodana waxaa laga maqlaa tan iyo Yahas, sidaas daraaddeed ragga hubka leh ee Moo'aab aad bay u qayliyaan, oo cabsi bay la gariiraan.
english: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.

kikuyu: Qalbigaygu wuxuu u ooyaa reer Moo'aab, kuwoodii qaxay waxay u cararaan tan iyo Socar iyo ilaa Ceglad Shelishiyaah, waayo, oohin bay la fuulaan jiirta Luxiid, oo jidka Xororayimna waxay kor ugu qaadaan qaylo baabba'eed.
english: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

kikuyu: Waayo, biyaha Nimriim baabba' bay noqon doonaan, cawskiina wuu engegay, biqilkiina wuu qallalay, oo wax cagaar ahna innaba lama arko.
english: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed maalkii badnaa ee ay urursadeen iyo wixii ay kaydsadeenba waxay u qaadan doonaan durdurka geedaha safsaafka ah.
english: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.

kikuyu: Waayo, qayladii waxay gaadhay soohdimaha Moo'aab ku wareegsan, baroortoodii waxay gaadhay tan iyo Eglayim, oo baroortoodiina waxay gaadhay tan iyo Bi'ir Eelim.
english: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.

kikuyu: Biyaha Diimoon dhiig baa ka buuxa, weliba waxaan Diimoon ku keeni doonaa belaayo kale, kan Moo'aab ka baxsaday iyo kuwa dalka ku hadhayba libaax baan ku diri doonaa.
english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.

kikuyu: Taliyaha dalka baraarka uga soo dira Selac oo cidlada ag taal, oo waxaad ugu keentaan buurta magaalada Siyoon.
english: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: Waayo, sidii shimbir wareegaysa oo buulkeedii laga tuuray ayaa gabdhaha Moo'aab ku ahaan doonaan meelaha Webi Arnoon laga gudbo.
english: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

kikuyu: Talo ku tali, oo caddaalad ku garsoor, maalin hadh cad ah hooskaaga ka dhig habeen madow oo kale, masaafurisyada qari, oo magantana ha gacangelin.
english: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

kikuyu: Kuwa Moo'aab ee masaafurisyada ah ha kula joogeen, oo waxaad gabbaad uga noqotaa kan iyaga dhacaya, waayo, kii wax dulmi jiray wuu dhammaaday, dhiciddiina way joogsatay, kuwii dadka cadaadin jirayna dalkaa laga baabbi'iyey.
english: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

kikuyu: Oo carshigu naxariis buu ku dhismi doonaa, oo run ahaan waxaa carshiga taambuugga Daa'uud dhexdiisa ah ku fadhiisan doona mid caddaalad ku garsoora, caddaaladna doondoona, oo xaqnimada ku dhaqsada.
english: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

kikuyu: Waxaannu maqalnay kibirkii Moo'aab oo uu aad u kibray, iyo xataa madaxweynaantiisa, iyo kibirkiisa, iyo cadhadiisa, faankiisuna waa wax aan waxba tarayn.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed reer Moo'aab waxay u ooyi doonaan dalka Moo'aab, oo mid kastaaba waa ooyi doonaa. Oo waxaad aad ugu barooran doontaan aasaaska Qiir Xaresed oo aad wax loogu dhuftay.
english: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

kikuyu: Waayo, beerihii Xeshboon way qallalan yihiin, quruumaha madaxdoodii ayaa jejebisay geedihii canabka ee Sibmaah oo soo gaadhay xataa tan iyo Yacser oo xagga cidlada u soo baxay. Laamihiisii way fidsanaayeen oo badday dhaafeen.
english: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaan canabka Sibmaah ugu ooyi doonaa oohintii aan Yacser ugu ooyay oo kale. Xeshboon iyo Elecaaleehow, waxaan idinku waraabin doonaa ilmadayda, waayo, midhahaagii la hor guray iyo beergoosadkaagiiba waxaa ku dhacday qayladii dagaalka.
english: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

kikuyu: Farxaddii waa la qaaday, oo beertii midhaha badnaydna farxaddii waa laga bixiyey, oo beeraha canabka ahna hees iyo rayrayn ma jiri doonaan, mana jiri doono mid canabka macsarooyin ku tunta, oo qaylada tumidda canabkana waan joojiyey.
english: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed qalbigaygu wuxuu sida kiraar oo kale ugu barooranayaa Moo'aab aawadeed, oo calooshayduna Qiir Xaresed aawadeed.
english: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

kikuyu: Oo markii Moo'aab iskeeno oo uu meesha sare ku daalo, oo uu meeshiisa quduuska ah u yimaado si uu ugu tukado, innaba ma guulaysan doono.
english: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

kikuyu: Kanu waa eraygii uu Rabbigu waagii hore reer Moo'aab kaga hadlay.
english: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan Rabbigu wuu hadlay oo wuxuu yidhi, Muddo saddex sannadood ah sida shaqaale sannaddiis ayaa sharafta reer Moo'aab lagu quudhsan doonaa, isaga iyo dadkiisa faraha badan, oo kuwa hadhi doonaana waxay ahaan doonaan in yar oo aan tabar lahayn.
english: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

kikuyu: Kanu waa warka culus ee Dimishaq ku saabsan. Bal eega, Dimishaq inay magaalo sii ahaato waa laga joojiyey, oo waxay ahaan doontaa tuulmooyin burbur ah.
english: The burden of Damascus. “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.

kikuyu: Magaalooyinkii Carooceer waa laga wada tegey. Waxay noqon doonaan meelo adhyuhu daaqaan oo ay iska fadhiistaan, oo ciduna ma didin doonto.
english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Qalcaddu reer Efrayim way ka baabbi'i doontaa, oo boqortooyaduna Dimishaq way ka dhammaan doontaa, oo kuwa Suuriya ka hadhi doonaana waxay noqon doonaan sida sharaftii dadkii Israa'iil.
english: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas sharafta reer Yacquub way daciifi doontaa, oo baruurta jidhkiisuna way macaluuli doontaa.
english: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqon doontaa sida marka beeragooyuhu balka soo urursho oo gacantiisuna ay sabuullada soo gurato, oo waxay noqon doontaa sida mid sabuullo laga tegey ka guranaya dooxada Refaa'iim.
english: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil wuxuu leeyahay, Weli canab xaabxaab ah ayaa ku hadhi doona, oo sida geed saytuun ah oo la ruxay ayaa laba ama saddex xabbadood ku hadhi doonaan laanta geedka ugu korraysa dhaladeeda, laamaha ugu shisheeya oo midhaha badanna waxaa ku hadhi doona afar ama shan xabbadood.
english: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas nin baa wuxuu fiirin doonaa Abuurihiisii, oo indhihiisuna waxay u jeedsan doonaan Kan Quduuska ah oo reer binu Israa'iil.
english: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo isagu ma uu fiirin doono meelaha allabariga ee uu gacmihiisa ku sameeyey, umana uu jeedsan doono wixii ay farihiisu sameeyeen, kuwaasoo ah geedaha Asheeraah, iyo sanamyada qorraxda.
english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.

kikuyu: Oo maalintaas magaalooyinkiisa xoogga badanu waxay noqon doonaan sida meelaha ay reer Xiwi iyo reer Amor kaga tageen reer binu Israa'iil hortood, oo waxaa jiri doona baabba'.
english: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, waxaad illowday Ilaaha badbaadadaada, oo kamana aad fikirin Dhagaxa xoogga kuu ah, sidaas daraaddeed waxaad beertaa geedo wacan, waxaadna tallaashaa geedo qalaad oo canab ah.
english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.

kikuyu: Maalintii aad beerto ayaad xeraysaa, subaxdiina waxaad ubax ka keentaa abuurkaaga, laakiinse beergoosadku wuxuu carari doonaa maalin murug iyo caloolxumo badan.
english: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

kikuyu: Dadka faraha badanu aad bay u buuqayaan, oo waxay u hugmaan sida hugunka badda! Quruumuhu aad bay u bulxamayaan, oo waxay u guuxaan sidii guuxa biyo xoog badan!
english: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

kikuyu: Quruumuhu waxay u guuxi doonaan sida guuxa biyo faro badan, laakiinse wuu canaanan doonaa, oo meel fog bay u carari doonaan, oo waxaa loo eryi doonaa sida xaabka buuraha ee dabayshu kaxayso iyo sida boodh cirwareen ah.
english: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

kikuyu: Bal eega, makhribkii cabsi baa jirta, oo aroortii ka horna ma jiraan. Taasu waa waxa ku dhaca kuwa na booba iyo qaybtii kuwa na dhaca.
english: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.

kikuyu: Dalka baalasha hadhsanaya wuxuu ka sii shisheeyaa webiyaasha Kuush!
english: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

kikuyu: Ergooyin ayuu badda ku diraa, oo xataa doonniyo caw ah ayuu biyaha korkooda ku diraa oo yidhaahdaa, Wargeeyayaasha dheereeyow, waxaad u tagtaan quruun dheer oo sulubsan, oo ah dad tan iyo bilowgoodii aad looga cabsado, oo ah quruun xoog badan oo wax ku tumata, oo dalkeeda webiyadu kala qaybiyaan!
english: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”

kikuyu: Kuwiinna dunida deggan oo dhammow, kuwiinna dhulka joogow, markii buuraha korkooda calan laga taago fiiriya, oo markii buunka la yeedhiyana maqla.
english: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu igu yidhi, Anigoo aamusan, ayaan hoygayga wax ka soo fiirin doonaa sida kulaylka widhwidhaya ee qorraxda, iyo sida daruur darab ah oo xilliga beergoosadka hooraysa.
english: For the LORD said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

kikuyu: Waayo, beergoosadka ka hor markuu ubaxu dhammaado, oo uu ubaxu canab bislaanaya noqdo ayuu manjo laamaha yaryar ku gooyn doonaa, oo laamaha waaweyn ee sii faafayana wuu gooyn doonaa oo fogayn doonaa.
english: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga waxaa dhammaantood looga wada tegi doonaa haadka buuraha iyo dugaagga dhulka, oo haadka ayaa iyaga kulaylka ka hadhsan doonaa, oo dugaagga dhulka oo dhammuna iyagay qabowga ka dugsan doonaan.
english: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas waxaa Rabbiga ciidammada loo keeni doonaa hadiyad laga keenay dadka dheer oo sulubsan oo ah dad tan iyo bilowgoodii aad looga cabsado, oo ah quruun xoog badan oo wax ku tumata, oo dalkeeda webiyadu kala qaybiyaan, oo waxaa la keeni doonaa Buur Siyoon oo ah meesha magaca Rabbiga ciidammada.
english: In that time, a present will be brought to the LORD of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of the LORD of Armies, Mount Zion.

kikuyu: Kanu waa warka culus ee Masar ku saabsan. Bal eega, Rabbigu wuxuu fuushan yahay daruur dheeraysa oo wuxuu u socdaa Masar, oo sanamyada Masarna waxay ku gariiri doonaan hortiisa, oo Masriyiinta qalbigooduna cabsi buu kula dhex dhalaali doonaa.
english: The burden of Egypt. “Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.

kikuyu: Oo Masriyiinta waxaan ku kicin doonaa Masriyiin kale, oo midkood kastaaba wuxuu la diriri doonaa walaalkiis iyo deriskiisa, magaalaba magaalay la diriri doontaa, boqortooyana boqortooyo kale.
english: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

kikuyu: Oo Masriyiinta ruuxooduna wuu ka dhammaan doonaa, oo taladooda waan baabbi'in doonaa, oo waxay talo u doonan doonaan sanamyada, iyo falanfallowyada, iyo kuwa ruuxaanta leh, iyo saaxiriinta.
english: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.

kikuyu: Oo Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu waxaan Masriyiinta gacanta u gelin doonaa sayid nac weyn, oo waxaa u talin doona boqor xoog badan.
english: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

kikuyu: Oo biyuhuna badda way ka madhan doonaan, oo webiguna wuu gudhi doonaa oo engegi doonaa.
english: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.

kikuyu: Oo webiyaashuna way qudhmi doonaan oo durdurrada Masarna way madhan doonaan oo engegi doonaan, oo cawsduurka iyo dareemaduna way wada qallali doonaan.
english: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.

kikuyu: Oo seeraha Webi Niil oo qarkiisa ku yaal, iyo wax kasta oo lagu beeray Webi Niil agtiisuba way wada engegi doonaan, oo dabayshaa la tegi doonta, oo mar dambena lama arki doono.
english: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

kikuyu: Oo kalluumaystayaashuna way ooyi doonaan, kuwa jillaabka Webi Niil ku rida oo dhammuna way wada barooran doonaan, oo kuwa biyaha korkooda shabagga ku kala bixiyaana way macaluuli doonaan.
english: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa geed linenka dharka ka sameeya iyo kuwa cudbiga dharka ka sameeyaaba way quusan doonaan.
english: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa waddanka tiirarka u ah oo dhammuna way wada jabi doonaan, kuwa kiro u shaqeeyaana way murugoon doonaan.
english: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

kikuyu: Amiirrada Socan waa nacasyo, oo taladii taliyayaasha ugu xigmad badnaa ee Fircoon waxay noqotay doqonnimo. Sidee baad Fircoon ugu tidhaahdaan, Anigu waxaan ahay nin xigmad leh wiilkiis, oo waxaan ahay farcankii boqorradii hore?
english: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?

kikuyu: Haddaba meeye raggaaga xigmadda lahu? Oo bal haatan ha kuu sheegeen, oo ha ogaadeen waxa Rabbiga ciidammadu Masar ugu talaggalay.
english: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what the LORD of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

kikuyu: Amiirradii Socan waxay noqdeen nacasyo, oo amiirradii Nofna waa la khiyaaneeyey Masarna waxaa qalday kuwa qabiilooyinkeeda tiirarka u ah.
english: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu ku dhex qasay wareer, oo iyana waxay Masar shuqulladeedii oo dhan ugu qaldeen sida nin sakhraanu mantaggiisa ugu dhacdhaco oo kale.
english: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

kikuyu: Oo Masarna laguma arki doono shuqul ay samayn karaan madaxa ama dabadu, laanta ama cawsduurku toona.
english: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas Masriyiintu waxay noqon doonaan sida naago oo kale, oo waxay la gariiri doonaan oo la cabsan doonaan ruxruxidda gacanta Rabbiga ciidammada, oo uu Masar korkeeda ku ruxruxi doono.
english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the LORD of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.

kikuyu: Oo dalka Yahuudahna cabsi buu Masar u noqon doonaa, oo mid kasta oo la xusuusiyaaba wuu ka cabsan doonaa, waana talada Rabbiga ciidammadu uu iyaga u goostay aawadeed.
english: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of the LORD of Armies, which he determines against it.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas waxaa dalka Masar jiri doona shan magaalo oo afka Kancaan ku hadasha oo Rabbiga ciidammada ku dhaarata, oo middoodna waxaa lagu magacaabi doonaa Magaalada baabba'a.
english: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas dalka Masar dhexdiisa meel allabari baa Rabbiga ugu oolli doonta, oo soohdinteedana waxaa Rabbiga u jiri doona tiir.
english: In that day, there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.

kikuyu: Oo taasu waxay calaamad iyo markhaati dalka Masar dhexdiisa ugu noqon doontaa Rabbiga ciidammada, waayo, kuwa dulma aawadood ayay Rabbiga ugu qayshan doonaan, oo isna wuxuu u soo diri doonaa badbaadiye iyo mid xoog badan, wuuna samatabbixin doonaa.
english: It will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas ayaa Rabbigu Masriyiinta is-ogeysiin doonaa, oo ay Masriyiintuna Rabbiga aqoon doonaan, oo waxay ku caabudi doonaan allabari iyo qurbaan, oo Rabbiga ayay nidar u nidri doonaan, wayna oofin doonaan.
english: The LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to the LORD, and will perform it.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wax buu Masar ku dhufan doonaa, wax buu ku dhufan doonaa, wuuna dawayn doonaa, oo iyana Rabbigay u soo noqon doonaan, oo isna baryootankooda ayuu aqbali doonaa, wuuna bogsiin doonaa.
english: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas waxaa jiri doona jid weyn oo Masar ka baxa oo tan iyo Ashuur gaadha, oo kuwa reer Ashuur ah ayaa Masar geli doona, oo Masriyiintuna reer Ashuur bay Ilaah la caabudi doonaan.
english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas dalka Israa'iil wuxuu saddex ku noqon doonaa Masar iyo Ashuur, oo dhulka dhexdiisana barako buu ku ahaan doonaa,
english: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;

kikuyu: waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuu barakeeyey, isagoo leh, Barako waxaa leh Masar oo ah dadkayga, iyo Ashuur oo ah shuqulkii gacmahayga, iyo Israa'iil oo ah dhaxalkayga.
english: because the LORD of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”

kikuyu: Sannaddii Sargoon oo ahaa boqorkii Ashuur uu Tartaan Ashdood u diray, oo uu tegey, oo la diriray oo qabsaday Ashdood,
english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

kikuyu: ayaa Rabbigu Ishacyaah ina Aamoos la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Tag, oo dharka joonyadda ah dhexdaada ka fur, oo kabahaagana iska siib. Oo isna saasuu yeelay, oo wuxuu socday isagoo qaawan oo caga cad.
english: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi, Sidii addoonkaygii Ishacyaah saddex sannadood qaawanaan iyo cago caddaan uu ugu socday inuu calaamad iyo yaab Masar iyo Itoobiyaba u ahaado
english: The LORD said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

kikuyu: ayaa boqorka Ashuur kaxaysan doonaa maxaabiista Masar iyo masaafurisyada Itoobiya, yar iyo weynba, iyagoo qaaqaawan oo wada cagacad, oo badhidoodu muuqato, si uu Masriyiinta u ceebeeyo aawadeed.
english: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

kikuyu: Markaasaa la nixi doonaa oo la ceeboobi doonaa Itoobiya oo rajadoodii ahayd aawadeed iyo Masar oo sharaftoodii ahayd aawadeed.
english: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa xeebta degganu waxay wakhtigaas odhan doonaan, Bal eega wixii ku dhacay kuwii aan isku hallaynaynay oo aan caawimaad ugu cararaynay inay boqorka Ashuur naga samatabbixiyaan Oo bal annagu sidee baannu u baxsanaynaa?
english: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”

kikuyu: Kanu waa warka culus ee ku saabsan cidlada badda ku ag taal. Sida cirwareentu koonfur uga timaado oo kale ayuu cidlada oo ah dal cabsi badan uga yimaadaa.
english: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

kikuyu: Waxaa lay tusay muujin culus. Khaa'inkii khiyaanuu sameeyaa, oo kan wax dhacaana wax buu dhacaa. Reer Ceelaamow, ku kac, reer Maadayow, hareeree. Taahiddii oo dhan anigu waan joojiyey.
english: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed naxdin baa cidhiidhi i gelisay, oo waxaa i qabtay xanuun badan sida naag foosheed oo kale, oo xanuun aawadiis waxba waan maqli kari waayay, oo naxdin aawadeed waxba waan arki kari waayay.
english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.

kikuyu: Waan qalbitakhtakhay, oo cabsi baa i argaggixisay. Fiidkii aan istareexa ka filanayay gariir buu iigu rogmaday.
english: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

kikuyu: Miis bay diyaarsadaan, oo gogol bay gogladaan, wax bayna cunaan oo cabbaan. Amiirradow, sara joogsada, oo gaashaanka subka.
english: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

kikuyu: Waayo, Sayidku wuxuu igu yidhi, Tag, oo waardiye meel dhig, oo isna wuxuu arko ha sheego.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

kikuyu: Oo markaasuu arkay ciidan fardo fuushan oo laba laba u socda, iyo ciidan dameerro fuushan, iyo ciidan rakuubbo fuushan, aad buuna u dhegaystay oo aad iyo aad buu uga fikiray.
english: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu u qayliyey sidii libaax oo kale oo yidhi, Sayidow, maalintii oo dhan waxaan had iyo goorba ku kor taagnahay munaaradda waardiyaha, oo habeen walbana waxaan joogaa meeshayda waardiyaha.
english: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa soo socda ciidan fardo fuushan oo laba laba u socda. Oo isna waa u jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi, Baabuloon waa dhacday, waa dhacday, oo sanamyadeedii xardhanaa oo ilaahyadeedu way wada jajabeen oo dhulkay daadsan yihiin.
english: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

kikuyu: Dadkayga sida hadhuudh la tumayow, wixii aan Rabbiga ciidammada oo ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil ka maqlay waan idin ogeysiiyey.
english: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

kikuyu: Kanu waa warka culus ee Duumah ku saabsan. Mid baa aniga Seciir iiga yeedhay, isagoo leh, Waardiyow, habeenka ka warran?
english: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

kikuyu: Oo waardiyihiina wuxuu yidhi, Waagu waa beryayaa, habeenkuna waa soo socdaa, haddii aad wax weyddiinaysaan, weyddiiya, soo noqda oo kaalaya.
english: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

kikuyu: Kanu waa warka culus ee dalka Carabta ku saabsan. Kuwiinna safarka ah oo reer Dedaanow, waxaad ku hoyan doontaan kaynta dalka Carabta.
english: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.

kikuyu: Kuwa oomman biyo u keena, kuwa dalka Teemaa degganow, kuwa qaxay cunto kala hor taga.
english: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu seef bay ka carareen, taas oo ahayd seef gal la', iyo qaanso xodan iyo dagaal aad u kulul.
english: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

kikuyu: Waayo, Sayidku wuxuu igu yidhi, Muddo sannad ah oo ah sida sannadaha shaqaalaha ayaa sharafta Qedaar oo dhammu ku baabbi'i doontaa.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

kikuyu: Oo intii ka hadhay tirada ragga qaansaleyda ah oo ah ragga xoogga badan oo reer Qedaarna way yaraan doontaa, waayo, Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil ayaa saas ku hadlay.
english: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”

kikuyu: Kanu waa war culus ee dooxada muujinta ku saabsan. War maxaa idinku dhacay, oo aad dhammaantiin guryaha dushooda la korteen?
english: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

kikuyu: Magaalada qaylada iyo bulxanku ka buuxaanay, magaalada farxadda badanay, kuwa dhexdaada lagu laayay seef laguma layn, dagaalna kuma ay dhiman.
english: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

kikuyu: Taliyayaashaadii oo dhammu way wada carareen, oo qaansola'aan iyagoo ah ayaa la xidhay. Inta lagaa helay oo dhan waa la wada xidhay in kastoo ay meel fog u carareen.
english: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ayaan idhi, Aniga iga sii jeesta. Si qadhaadh baan u ooyi doonaa, ha isku daalinnina inaad dadkayga iiga qalbi qabowjisaan.
english: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

kikuyu: Waayo, waa maalin ay naxdin iyo kutumasho iyo isku qasnaanu Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammada ka iman doonaan oo ay dooxada muujinta ku dhici doonaan, waana wakhti derbiyada la dumin doono oo buuraha lagu qaylin doono.
english: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, GOD of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”

kikuyu: Oo reer Ceelaam wuxuu qaatay gabooyihii, oo gaadhifardoodyo iyo rag fardo fuushan baa la socday, oo reer Qiirna gaashaankii buu daaha ka qaaday.
english: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in dooxooyinkaagii ugu wacanaa gaadhifardoodyo ka buuxsameen, ragga fardooleyda ahuna waxay isku diyaariyeen iridda horteeda.
english: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu banneeyey daahii dadka Yahuudah, oo adna maalintaas waxaad aad u fiirisay hubkii guriga kaynta yiil.
english: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaad aragteen in daldaloolka magaalada Daa'uud ay badan yihiin, oo waxaad isku soo wada ururiseen biyihii balliga hoose.
english: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad tiriseen guryihii Yeruusaalem, oo waxaad guryihii u dumiseen inaad derbiga adkaysaan.
english: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

kikuyu: Oo weliba biyihii balligii hore waxaad biyoxidheen uga samayseen labada derbi dhexdooda laakiinse ma aydaan fiirin kii waxan sameeyey, mana aydaan u jeedsan kii waa hore sameeyey.
english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.

kikuyu: Oo Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu maalintaas dadka ugu yeedhay oohin, iyo madax-xiirnaan, iyo dhar joonyad ah guntashadiisa.
english: In that day, the Lord, GOD of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;

kikuyu: Oo bal eega, waxaa jira farxad iyo rayrayn, dibi la qalo iyo ido la gowraco, hilib la cuno iyo khamri la cabbo, oo waxaa la yidhaahdaa, Aynu wax cunno oo cabno, waayo, berrito waynu dhiman doonaaye.
english: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga ciidammada ayaa waxan dhegaha ii saaray. Sida xaqiiqada ah xumaantan laydinkama maydhi doono jeeraad dhimataan, ayaa Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammadu leeyahay.
english: The LORD of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

kikuyu: Sayidka ah Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Kac, oo waxaad u tagtaa Shebnaa oo ah khasnajiga guriga u sarreeya, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa,
english: The Lord, GOD of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

kikuyu: Waadiga qabrigaagii halkan ka qotay, oo xabaashaadiina meel sare ka qotay, oo dhagaxana hoy ka samaystay, bal maxaad halkan ku samaynaysaa? Oo yaad halkan ku haysataa?
english: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”

kikuyu: Bal eeg, ninka xoogga badanow, Rabbigu xoog buu kuu tuuri doonaa. Aad buu kuu qaban doonaa.
english: Behold, the LORD will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

kikuyu: Oo hubaal sida kubbad oo kale ayuu kugu wadhfin doonaa dhul weyn oo ballaadhan, oo halkaasaad ku dhiman doontaa, oo gaadhifardoodyadii sharaftaaduna halkaasay joogi doonaan, adigoo ah ceebta gurigii sayidkaaga.
english: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan kaa eryi doonaa derejadaada, oo jagada aad joogtona isagaa kaa soo dejin doona.
english: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan maalintaas u yeedhi doonaa addoonkayga Elyaaqiim ina Xilqiyaah.
english: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

kikuyu: Oo waxaan isaga huwin doonaa shuluggaaga, oo waxaan ku adkayn doonaa dhex-xidhkaaga, oo dowladnimadaada isagaan u dhiibi doonaa, oo isna aabbe buu dadka Yeruusaalem deggan iyo reer Yahuudah u noqon doonaa.
english: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

kikuyu: Oo furihii guriga Daa'uudna garbihiisaan saari doonaa, oo wuu furi doonaa, oo ninna ma xidhi doono, wuu xidhi doonaa, oo ninna ma furi doono.
english: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan isaga u dhuujin doonaa sida dhidib meel adag haysta, oo isna wuxuu reerka aabbihiis u noqon doonaa carshi sharaf badan.
english: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa korkiisa laga lalmin doonaa sharaftii reerka aabbiihiis oo dhan, dhasha iyo farcanka, iyo weelasha yaryar oo dhan, koobabka iyo xataa sibraarrada waaweyn oo dhanba.
english: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Maalintaas dhidibkii meesha adag ku dhuuqsanaa wuu ka siibmi doonaa, oo intuu jabo ayuu dhici doonaa, oo culayskii saarnaana waa la baabbi'in doonaa, waayo, Rabbiga ayaa saas ku hadlay.
english: “In that day,” says the LORD of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for the LORD has spoken it.”

kikuyu: Kanu waa warka culus ee Turos ku saabsan. Doonniyaha Tarshiishow, baroorta, waayo, way baabba'day, guri iyo irid la galo midna ma leh, waxaana iyaga looga muujiyey dalka Kitiim.
english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

kikuyu: Kuwiinnan gasiiradda deggan ee baayacmushtariyaasha Siidoon oo badda gudbayaa ay alaab ka buuxiyeenow, aamusa.
english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.

kikuyu: Biyaha badan waxaa laga keenay sarreenkii Shiixoor iyo waxa beerihii Webi Niil laga goostay oo faa'iidadeedii ahaa, oo iyadu waxay noqotay suuqii quruumaha.
english: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

kikuyu: Siidoonay, ceebow, waayo, baddii way hadashay, oo qalcaddii baddu waxay tidhi, Anigu ma foolan, carruurna ma dhalin, barbaarrona ma korin, gabdhona ma korin.
english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

kikuyu: Markii warku Masar soo gaadho aad bay warka Turos uga xanuunsan doonaan.
english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

kikuyu: Tarshiish xaggeeda u gudba. Kuwiinna gasiiradda degganow, baroorta.
english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

kikuyu: Tanu ma magaaladiinnii waa hore jirtay oo faraxsanayd baa oo cagaheeda meel fog u waday inay dal shisheeye degto aawadeed?
english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

kikuyu: Yaa taladan u goostay Turos oo ahayd magaaladii taajajka bixisay, oo baayacmushtariyaasheedu amiirro ahaayeen, oo geddisleydeeduna ay ahaayeen kuwii dhulka sharafta ku lahaa?
english: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammada ayaa waxaas u qasdiyey inuu jebiyo kibirka faanka oo dhan, iyo inuu ka dhigo in kuwa dhulka sharafta ku leh oo dhan la quudhsado.
english: The LORD of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

kikuyu: Reer Tarshiishow, bal dalkaaga dhex mar sida Webi Niil oo kale. Innaba wax ku celiya oo dambe ma jiraan.
english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu gacantiisa ku fidiyey badda korkeeda, oo boqortooyooyinkiina wuu gariiriyey. Rabbigu wuxuu amar ku bixiyey in la dumiyo qalcadaha Kancaan.
english: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. The LORD has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

kikuyu: Oo isagu wuxuu yidhi, Dadka Siidoon oo ah sida bikrad la nijaaseeyeyow, mar dambe ma farxi doontid. Kac, oo xagga Kitiim u gudub, oo xataa halkaasna nasasho kama heli doontid.
english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

kikuyu: Bal dalka reer Kaldayiin fiiriya, dadkaasu ma jirin. Kii reer Ashuur kuwii cidlada degganaa ayuu u aasaasay, munaaradaa la dhisay, daaraheedii waaweynaana waa la dumiyey, oo baabba' buu ka dhigay.
english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

kikuyu: Doonniyaha Tarshiishow, baroorta, waayo, qalcaddiinnii waa la baabbi'iyey.
english: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

kikuyu: Oo waxay wakhtigaas noqon doontaa in Turos la illoobi doono toddobaatan sannadood, oo ah sida boqor wakhtigiis. Oo toddobaatankaas sannadood markay dhammaadaan ayaa Turos waxaa laga heesi doonaa sida dhillada oo kale.
english: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

kikuyu: Dhilladii la illoobayay, kataarad qaado, oo magaalada ku dhex wareeg, oo luuq macaan luuqee, oo heeso badan hees, si lagugu soo xusuusto aawadeed.
english: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

kikuyu: Oo toddobaatanka sannadood markay dhammaadaan ayaa Rabbigu Turos soo booqan doonaa, oo waxay ku soo noqon doontaa kiradeedii, oo waxay dhulka kaga dhillaysan doontaa boqortooyooyinka dunida oo dhan.
english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

kikuyu: Laakiinse baayacmushtarigeeda iyo kiradeedaba quduus baa Rabbiga looga dhigi doonaa, lama urursan doono, lamana kaydsan doono, waayo, baayacmushtarigeedu wuxuu u ahaan doonaa kuwa Rabbiga hortiisa jooga inay wax ku filan cunaan oo ay dhar raagaya xidhaan.
english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to the LORD. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

kikuyu: Bal eega, Rabbigu dalkuu madhinayaa, oo baabba' buu ka dhigayaa, wuuna afgembiyayaa, oo kuwa degganna wuu kala firdhinayaa.
english: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqon doontaa in wixii dadka ku dhaca ay wadaadkana ku dhacaan, oo wixii addoonka hela, sayidkana way heli doonaan, oo wixii iibiyaha helana, iibsadahana way heli doonaan, oo wixii amaahiyaha helana amaahsadahana way heli doonaan, oo wixii korsaarqaataha helana, korsaarbixiyahana way heli doonaan.
english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

kikuyu: Oo dalkana dhammaantiis waa la madhin doonaa oo la kharribi doonaa, waayo, Rabbiga ayaa eraygaas ku hadlay.
english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.

kikuyu: Dhulku wuu baroortaa, wuuna qallalaa, dunidu way daashaa, wayna qallashaa, oo dadka sarena way daalaan.
english: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

kikuyu: Oo dhulkiina waxaa nijaaseeyey kuwa deggan, maxaa yeelay, iyagu qaynuunnadii bay ku xadgudbeen, oo amarkiina way beddeleen, oo axdigii daa'imka ahaana way jebiyeen.
english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed dhulkii waxaa baabbi'iyey habaar, oo kuwii dhex degganaana eed baa laga helay, sidaas daraaddeed kuwii dhulka degganaa way gubteen oo wax yar baa ka hadhay.
english: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.

kikuyu: Khamriga cusubu wuu baroortaa, dhirta canabkuna way dhadaa, oo kuwii qalbigoodu faraxsanaa oo dhammuna way taahaan.
english: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

kikuyu: Farxaddii dafku way joogsatay, oo kuwii rayraynayay buuqoodiina waa dhammaaday, farxaddii kataaradduna way joogsatay.
english: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

kikuyu: Mar dambe khamri hees kuma ay cabbi doonaan, oo wax lagu sakhraamona wuu u qadhaadhaan doonaa kuwa cabba.
english: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

kikuyu: Magaalada cidlada ah waa la dumiyey, oo guri kastana waa la xidhay si aan ninna u soo gelin.
english: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

kikuyu: Jidadka waxaa looga ooyayaa khamri la waayay aawadeed, farxaddii oo dhammuna way madoobaatay, oo rayrayntiina dalkay ka dhammaatay.
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

kikuyu: Magaaladii waxaa lagaga dhex tegey baabba', oo albaabkiina intii la jebiyey, ayaa la baabbi'iyey.
english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

kikuyu: Waayo, sidaasay ahaan doontaa dalka iyo dadyowga dhexdoodaba, oo waxay noqon doontaa sida ruxruxidda geedka saytuunka ah iyo sida xaaxaabka canabka marka midhaha laga gurto dabadeed.
english: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

kikuyu: Codkooday kor u qaadi doonaan, wayna dhawaaqi doonaan, oo haybadda Rabbiga ayay badda aad ugaga qaylin doonaan.
english: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed xagga bari Rabbiga ka ammaana, oo Rabbiga ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil magiciisana waxaad ka ammaantaan gasiiradaha badda.
english: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

kikuyu: Darafka dhulka ugu shisheeya ayaan ka maqalnay gabayo lahaa, Ammaanu ha u ahaato kan xaqa ah. Laakiinse anigu waxaan idhi, Caatoobay oo caatoobay, anaa iska hoogay! Khaa'innadii khiyaanay sameeyeen, hubaal khaa'innadii aad iyo aad bay khiyaano xun u sameeyeen.
english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

kikuyu: Kan dhulka degganow, waxaa ku hor yaal cabsi iyo yamays iyo dabin.
english: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.

kikuyu: Oo kii qaylada cabsida ka cararaa yamayskuu ku dhici doonaa, oo kii yamayska ka soo baxana waxaa qaban doona dabinka, waayo, waxaa la furay daaqadihii xagga sare, oo aasaaskii dhulkuna wuu gariirayaa.
english: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

kikuyu: Dhulkii dhammaantiis wuu dumay, oo dhulkii kulligiis wuu burburay, oo dhulkii aad iyo aad buu u dhaqdhaqaaqay.
english: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

kikuyu: Dhulku wuxuu u dhicdhici doonaa sida nin sakhraansan, oo waxaa loo dhaqdhaqaajin doonaa sida buul oo kale. Xadgudubkiisuna wuu ku cuslaan doonaa, oo wuu dhici doonaa, oo mar dambena sooma kici doono.
english: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

kikuyu: Oo waxay maalintaas noqon doontaa in Rabbigu ciidanka kuwa sare kor ku ciqaabi doono, oo boqorrada dunidana dhulkuu ku ciqaabi doonaa.
english: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

kikuyu: Oo iyaga waxaa laysugu soo ururin doonaa sida maxaabiista godxabsiga loogu urursho, oo waa la xabbisi doonaa oo maalmo badan dabadeed ayaa la ciqaabi doonaa.
english: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaa dayaxu isku qasmi doonaa, oo qorraxduna way ceeboobi doontaa, waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadu boqor buu ku ahaan doonaa Buur Siyoon iyo Yeruusaalem, isagoo odayaashiisa hortooda sharaftiisa ka muujinaya.
english: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waxaad tahay Ilaahay. Waan ku sarraysiin doonaa, oo magacaagana waan ammaani doonaa, waayo, waxaad samaysay waxyaalo yaab badan oo ah talooyin aad waa hore aaminnimo iyo run ku talaggashay.
english: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad magaalo ka dhigtay meel tuulan, oo magaalo deyr lehna burbur, oo daartii weynayd ee shisheeyahana waxaad ka dhigtay wax aan magaalo ahayn, oo mar dambena lama dhisi doono.
