kikuyu: Rabbigii ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Bal eega, anigu col baan idinla ahay, oo gaadhifardoodyadana qiiq baan ku gubi doonaa, oo libaaxyada qayrabyada ahna seef baa baabbi'in doonta, oo waxa aad ugaadhsataanna dhulkaan ka dhammayn doonaa, oo codkii wargeysyadiinnana mar dambe lama maqli doono.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

kikuyu: Waxaa iska hoogtay magaalada dhiigga! Waayo, dhammaanteed waxaa ka buuxa been iyo dhac, oo boobkuna iyada kama dhammaado.
english: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa ka buuxa dhawaaqa karbaashka, iyo dhawaaqa giraangiraha qablamaya, iyo fardo qoobqaadaya, iyo gaadhifardoodyo boodboodaya,
english: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,

kikuyu: iyo fardooley hor u socda, iyo seef dhalaalaysa, iyo waran birbirqaya, iyo dad badan oo la laayay, iyo bakhti faro badan oo iskor tuulsan, oo meydadkuna innaba dhammaad ma leh, oo waa lagu turunturoodaan meydadkooda,
english: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, waa dhillanimadii faraha badnayd oo ay fashay dhilladii aad loo jeclaa oo ah sayidaddii sixirrada, oo quruumo ku iibisa dhillanimadeeda, oo reerona ku iibisa sixirradeeda.
english: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.

kikuyu: Rabbigii ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Bal eeg, col baan kula ahay, oo gogaradahaagana waan kaa feydi doonaa oo wejigaan kuu saari doonaa, oo waxaan quruumaha tusi doonaa cawradaada, boqortooyooyinkana ceebtaada.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

kikuyu: Oo wasakh baan korkaaga ku tuuri doonaa, oo ceeb baan ku saari doonaa, oo waxaan kaa dhigi doonaa wax lagu dhaygago.
english: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqon doontaa in kuwa ku fiiriya oo dhammu ay kaa cararaan oo ay yidhaahdaan, Nineweh waa la baabbi'iyey, bal yaa iyada u barooran doona? Xaggee baanse kuwa u tacsiyeeya uga doonaa?
english: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”

kikuyu: Bal adigu miyaad ka wanaagsan tahay Noo Aamoon, taasoo webiyada dhexdooda ku jirtay, oo ay biyuhu ku hareeraysnaayeen, oo dhufayskeedu u badda ahaa, derbigeeduna u badda ahaa?
english: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?

kikuyu: Itoobiya iyo Masar waxay ahaayeen xooggeeda aan dhammaadka lahayn, oo reer Fuud iyo reer Luubiimna waxay ahaayeen kuwii u hiilin jiray.
english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee iyadii waa la kaxaystay oo maxaabiis ahaan baa loo watay, oo dhallaankeediina dhulkaa lagaga tuuray jidadka rukummadooda oo dhan, oo nimankeedii sharafta lahaa saami baa loo ritay, oo raggeedii waaweynaa oo dhanna silsilado baa lagu xidhay.
english: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

kikuyu: Oo weliba adigu waad sakhraami doontaa oo waad qarsoonaan doontaa, adiguna cadowga aawadiis dufays baad doondooni doontaa.
english: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.

kikuyu: Qalcadahaaga oo dhammu waxay noqon doonaan sida geedo berde ah oo midho hore u bislaaday ku yaalliin, oo haddii la ruxruxo waxay ku soo daatan kan wax cuna afkiisa.
english: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, dadkaaga ku dhex jooga waa dumar, oo irdaha dalkaaguna waa u bannaan yihiin cadaawayaashaada, oo qataaradaadiina dab baa baabbi'iyey.
english: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.

kikuyu: Biyo u soo dhaanso hareeraynta aawadeed, oo qalcadahaagana adkee. Dhoobada dhex gal, oo dhigada ku joogjoogso, oo xoog u yeel meesha lebenka lagu dubo.
english: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.

kikuyu: Halkaasaa dab kugu laasan doona, oo seef baa ku baabbi'in doonta, oo waxay kuu dhammayn doontaa sida koronkorro, bal isu badi sidii koronkorro oo kale, oo sidii ayax oo kale isu badi.
english: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.

kikuyu: Baayacmushtariyaashaadii waxaad ka sii badisay xiddigaha samada, koronkorraduse intay wax cunto bay iska duushaa.
english: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.

kikuyu: Kuwaaga taajka lahu waa sidii ayax oo kale, oo karraaniyaashaaduna waa sidii kobojaan raxan ah, kaasoo maalintii qabow xaydaanka dhex dega, laakiinse kolkii qorraxdu soo baxdo way iska cararaan, oo meeshay joogaan lama yaqaan.
english: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

kikuyu: Boqorkii Ashuurow, adhijirradaadii lulo baa haysa, geesiyaashaadii way nasanayaan, dadkaagii wuxuu ku kala firidhsan yahay buuraha dushooda, oo wax iyaga soo ururiyana lama arko.
english: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.

kikuyu: Nabarkaagu bogsan maayo, dhaawacaaguna aad buu u xun yahay, oo kuwa warkaaga maqla oo dhammuba way kugu sacab tumaan, waayo, bal waa kuma kan aanay xumaantaadu had iyo goorba gaadhin?
english: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?

kikuyu: Kanu waa waxa culus ee uu Nebi Xabaquuq arkay.
english: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, ilaa goormaan kuu qayshadaa, oo adna aadan i maqlayn? Dulmi baan kaaga qayshadaa, oo namana aad badbaadisid.
english: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

kikuyu: Bal maxaad xumaan ii tustaa oo aad qallooc iigu jeedisaa? Waayo, waxaa hortayda yaal halligaad iyo dulmi, oo waxaa kor u kaca dirir iyo dagaal.
english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed sharcigii waa dabcay oo caddaaladduna hore uma socoto, waayo, kii sharrow ah ayaa hareereeya kii xaq ah, oo sidaas daraaddeed garsooridda waa la qalloociyaa.
english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

kikuyu: Bal eega quruumaha dhexdooda, ka fiirsada oo aad u yaaba, waayo, maalmihiinnii waxaan samaynayaa shuqul aydaan rumaysan doonin in kastoo laydiin sheego.
english: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eega, waxaan soo kicinayaa reer Kaldayiin oo ah quruuntaas qadhaadh oo degdegga badan oo dhulka ballaadhkiisa mara inay hantiyaan meelo la dego oo ayan iyagu lahayn.
english: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

kikuyu: Iyagu waa kuwa laga cabsado oo aad looga baqo; xukunkooda iyo sharaftoodu iyagay ka soo baxaan.
english: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

kikuyu: Fardahoodu way ka sii dheereeyaan shabeelka, oo way ka sii cabsi badan yihiin yeyda fiidka, oo fardooleydooduna way iskala bixiyaan, haah, oo fardooleydooduna meel fog bay ka yimaadaan, oo waxay u soo duulaan sida gorgor u soo degdegaya inuu wax dhufsado oo cuno.
english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

kikuyu: Dhammaantood waxay u yimaadaan inay wax xoogaan, oo damaca wejigooduna waa sida dabaysha bari, oo waxay urursadaan maxaabiis sida cammuudda u badan.
english: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

kikuyu: Cadowgu boqorro wuu quudhsadaa, oo amiirrona wuu fududaystaa, oo qalcad kastana wuu ku qoslaa, waayo, intuu ciid tuulaa ayuu iska qabsadaa.
english: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

kikuyu: Markaas sida dabayl buu u dhaafi doonaa, oo wuu sii gudbi doonaa, oo dembi buu lahaan doonaa kan xooggiisu ilaah u yahay.
english: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, Ilaahaygiiyow, kayga Quduuska ahow, sow adigu weligaaba ma aad jiri jirin? Annagu dhiman mayno. Rabbiyow, isaga waxaad u diyaarisay xukun, oo waxaad u xoogaysay edbin, kaaga Dhagaxa weyn ahow.
english: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

kikuyu: Waxaad tahay mid indhihiisu ka sii daahirsan yihiin inay wax shar ah eegaan, oo qalloocna ma fiirin kartid, haddaba bal maxaad u fiirisaa kuwa khiyaanada sameeya? Oo maxaad u aamusan tahay marka sharrowgu liqo ninka isaga ka sii xaq yahay?
english: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

kikuyu: Oo maxaad dadka uga dhigtaa sida kalluunka badda, iyo sida waxa gurguurta oo aan lahayn mid iyaga u taliya?
english: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

kikuyu: Isagu dhammaantood ayuu jillaab ku soo qaataa, oo shabaggiisuu ku soo qabsadaa, oo intuu shabaggiisa ku soo wada urursado ayuu soo jiitaa, haddaba sidaas daraaddeed wuu reyreeyaa oo farxaa.
english: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed allabari buu u bixiyaa shabaggiisa, oo fooxna wuu u shidaa shabagguu jiita, maxaa yeelay, iyaga ayaa qaybtiisii ku barwaaqowday, oo quudkiisiina aad iyo aad batay.
english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

kikuyu: Haddaba miyuu shabaggiisa madhin doonaa, oo miyuu quruumaha had iyo goorba layn doonaa, isagoo aan u tudhin?
english: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

kikuyu: Meeshayda aan wax ka dhawro ayaan istaagi doonaa, qalcaddana waan isa saari doonaa, waanan u fiirin doonaa bal waxa uu igula hadli doono, iyo waxa aan uga jawaabi doono cabashadayda.
english: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuu ii jawaabay, oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Waxa lagu tusay qor, oo looxyo ku caddee, si kii akhristaaba u ordo.
english: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

kikuyu: Waayo, wixii lagu tusay waa weli, oo waxay iman doonaan wakhtigii la yidhi, wayna u degdegaan ugudambaysta, oo innaba been ma sheegi doonaan. In kastoo ay raagaan waa inaad sugtaa, maxaa yeelay, sida xaqiiqada ah way noqon doonaan, oo innaba ma raagi doonaan.
english: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

kikuyu: Bal eega, kan madaxa weynaaday naftiisii way kibirtay, oo ma toosna, laakiinse kii xaq ahu rumaysadkiisa buu ku noolaan doonaa.
english: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

kikuyu: Haah, oo weliba khamrigu wax buu khiyaanaa, oo nin isla weynu gurigiisa kuma xasillo. Wuxuu xiisihiisa u ballaadhiyaa sida She'ool oo kale, oo isagu waa sida geerida oo kale oo innaba lama dherjin karo, laakiinse wuxuu soo urursadaa quruumaha oo dhan, oo wuxuu isu geeystaa dadyowga oo dhan.
english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.

kikuyu: Kuwan oo dhammu sow isaga kuma halqabsan doonaan? Oo sow maahmaahyo kuma quudhsan doonaan? Waxay odhan doonaan, Waxaa iska hoogay kan urursada wax uusan isagu lahayn! Bal ilaa goorma? Waxaa iska hoogay kan rahaamado isku rara!
english: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

kikuyu: Kuwii ku qaniini lahaa sow haddiiba ma kici doonaan? Oo kuwii ku dhibi lahaa sow ma toosi doonaan? Oo adna booli baad iyaga u noqon doontaa.
english: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

kikuyu: Quruumo badan baad dhacday, haddaba sidaas daraaddeed dadyowga intooda hadhay oo dhammu aday ku dhici doonaan, taasuna waa dhiiggii dadka daraaddiis, iyo dulmigii lagu sameeyey dalka iyo magaalada iyo inta dhex deggan oo dhanba.
english: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Waxaa iska hoogay kii faa'iido shar ah reerkiisa u soo urursada si uu buulkiisa uga dhisto meel sare oo uu gacanta sharka uga samatabbaxo!
english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

kikuyu: Dadyowga badan oo aad baabbi'isay daraaddood waxaad reerkaagii ugu arrimisay ceeb, oo waxaad ku dembaabtay naftaadii.
english: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhagax baa ka qaylin doona derbiga dhexdiisa, oo loox alwaaxda ku dhex jira ayaa u jawaabi doona.
english: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

kikuyu: Waxaa iska hoogay kii magaalo dhiig ku dhisa, oo magaalo xumaan ku adkeeya!
english: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

kikuyu: Bal eeg in dadku ay dabka aawadiis u hawshoodaan, oo quruumuhuna ay waxtarla'aan isu daaliyaan sow ma aha mid Rabbiga ciidammada xaggiisa ka timid?
english: Behold, isn’t it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

kikuyu: Waayo, sida biyuhu badda u daboolaan oo kale ayaa dhulka waxaa ka buuxsami doona aqoonta sharafta Rabbiga.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

kikuyu: Waxaa iska hoogay kaaga deriskiisa khamri cabsiiya, oo cadho ugu shuba, oo weliba u sakhraamiya si uu cawradooda u fiirsada aawadeed!
english: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

kikuyu: Adigu intaad sharaf heli lahayd waxaa ka buuxsantay ceeb, oo weliba adiguna khamri cab, oo waxaad noqotaa sida mid buuryaqab ah. Rabbiga gacantiisa midig koobka ku jira adiguu kugu soo rogman doonaa, oo sharaftaadana waxaa ku dhici doonta ceeb xun.
english: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa ku dabooli doona dulmigii Lubnaan lagu sameeyey, iyo halligaaddii ku dhacday xayawaankii iyaga ka cabsiiyey, taasuna waa dhiiggii dadka daraaddiis, iyo dulmigii lagu sameeyey dalka iyo magaalada iyo inta dhex deggan oo dhanba.
english: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

kikuyu: Bal muxuu taraa sanamka xardhan, oo muxuu kii sameeyey u xardhay? Oo muxuu taraa sanamka la shubay oo ah macallinka beenta bara, oo kii sameeyey muxuu haddana isugu halleeyaa, waayo, waa sanamyo carrab la'.
english: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

kikuyu: Waxaa iska hoogay kii qoriga ku yidhaahda, Toos! oo dhagax carrab la' ku yidhaahda, Sara joogso! Kanu miyuu wax bari doonaa? Bal eega, waxaa lagu dahaadhay dahab iyo lacag, laakiinse innaba neefu kuma jirto.
english: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbigu waa ku jiraa macbudkiisa quduuska ah, haddaba inta dhulka joogta oo dhammu ha ku hor aamuseen.
english: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

kikuyu: Tanu waa salaaddii Xabaquuq, oo lagu luuqeeyo Shigyonood.
english: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, waxaan maqlay warkaagii, waanan cabsanayaa. Rabbiyow, shuqulkaaga soo noolee sannadaha dhexdooda, Sannadaha dhexdooda ogeysii, Oo markii aad cadhootid naxariis soo xusuuso.
english: LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu ka yimid Teemaan, Kii Quduuska ahaana wuxuu ka yimid Buur Faaraan. (Selaah) Sharaftiisii waxay ku fidday samooyinka, Oo dhulkiina waxaa ka buuxsamay ammaantiisii.
english: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

kikuyu: Oo dhalaalkiisiina wuxuu ahaa sida nuurka, Wuxuuna lahaa iftiin gacantiisa ka soo baxaya. Oo waxaa halkaas ku qarsoonaa xooggiisa.
english: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

kikuyu: Waxaa hortiisa socday belaayo, Oo waxaa daba socday xummad.
english: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

kikuyu: Wuu istaagay, oo dhulkuu qiyaasay, Wax buu fiiriyey, oo quruumihii buu kala eryay. Kolkaasaa buurihii weligood ahaa kala firdheen, Oo kurihii daa'imiska ahaana way wada foororsadeen. Socodkiisuna wuxuu ahaa sidii waagii hore.
english: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

kikuyu: Waxaan arkay teendhooyinkii reer Kushan oo dhib ku dhex jira. Daahyadii dalka reer Midyaanna way gariireen.
english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

kikuyu: Rabbigu ma wuxuu u cadhooday webiyaasha? Ma waxaad u xanaaqday webiyaasha Mase waxaad u cadhootay badda? Ma saas aawadeed baad u soo fuushay fardahaaga, Iyo gaadhifardoodyadaadii badbaadinta?
english: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?

kikuyu: Qaansadaadii daaha baad ka qaadday, Dhaartii aad qabiilooyinka ugu dhaaratayna waxay ahayd eray run ah. (Selaah) Dhulka waxaad ka dillaacisay webiyaal.
english: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

kikuyu: Buurihii way ku arkeen, oo way cabsadeen. Biyaha xoogga lahuna way iska gudbeen, Moolkii codkiisuu ku hadlay, Gacmihiisiina kor buu u taagay.
english: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

kikuyu: Qorraxdii iyo dayaxiiba waxay istaageen rugtoodii, Markay fallaadhahaaga nuuraya lalayeen, Iyo markuu warankaaga dhalaalaya birbirqay.
english: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

kikuyu: Dalkii xanaaq baad kula dhex socotay, Quruumihiina cadho baad ku tuntay.
english: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.

kikuyu: Waad u soo baxday inaad dadkaaga badbaadiso daraaddeed, Iyo inaad badbaadiso kaaga subkan. Reerka sharrowga madaxiisa waad dhaawacday. Aasaaskiina waad soo bandhigtay. (Selaah)
english: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.

kikuyu: Madaxii dagaalyahanyadiisa waxaad ku mudday ulihiisii, Waxay u yimaadeen sidii dabayl cirwareen ah inay i kala firdhiyaan daraaddeed. Rayrayntoodu waxay ahayd inay masaakiinta qarsoodi u dhammeeyaan.
english: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

kikuyu: Fardahaagii waad kula tumatay baddii, Taasoo ahayd biyaha aad u badan oo iskor taallaysan.
english: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

kikuyu: Anigu waan maqlay, kolkaasaan caloosha ka naxay, Oo codkii aawadiis ayaa bushimahaygu la qadhqadheen, Lafahaygiina way qudhmeen, oo meeshaydaan ku gariiray, Inaan iska nasto intaan sugayo maalinta dhibka Oo ay ciidammadu ku soo kici doonaan dadka.
english: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.

kikuyu: Waayo, in kastoo berduhu uusan ubxin, Ama aan midho ku oollin geedaha canabka ah, Oo hawsha saytuunka lagu khasaaro, Ama aan beeraha quud ka bixin, Oo adhigu xerada ka baabbo'o, Oo golahana aan xoolo lagu arag,
english: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,

kikuyu: Haddana Rabbiga waan ku rayrayn doonaa, Oo Ilaaha badbaadadayda ah waan ku farxi doonaa.
english: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

kikuyu: Rabbiga Sayidka ah ayaa xoog ii ah, Cagahaygana wuxuu ka dhigaa sida cagaha deerada, Oo wuxuu igu socodsiin doonaa meelahayga sarsare. Tan waxaa lagu tiriyey madaxdii muusikaystayaasha, oo waxaa lagu qaadaa alaabtayda xadhkaha leh.
english: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

kikuyu: Kanu waa Eraygii Rabbiga oo u yimid Sefanyaah ina Kuushii, ina Gedalyaah, ina Amaryaah, ina Xisqiyaah, wakhtigii Yoosiyaah ina Aamoon uu boqorka ka ahaa dalka Yahuudah.
english: The LORD’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu wax kasta waan ka baabbi'in doonaa dhulka korkiisa.
english: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Dad iyo duunyoba waan wada baabbi'in doonaa, haadda samada iyo kalluunka baddaba waan wada baabbi'in doonaa, oo waxa lagu turunturoodo iyo sharrowyadaba waan wada baabbi'in doonaa, oo binu-aadmigana waan ka gooyn doonaa dhulka korkiisa.
english: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo gacantaydaan ku soo kor fidin doonaa dalka Yahuudah iyo inta Yeruusaalem deggan oo dhan, oo intii Bacal ka hadhayna meeshan waan ka gooyn doonaa, iyo magaca Kemaariim iyo wadaaddada,
english: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,

kikuyu: iyo kuwa ciidanka samada ku caabuda guryaha dhaladooda, iyo kuwa Rabbiga caabuda oo ku dhaarta oo haddana ku dhaarta Malkaam,
english: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by the LORD and also swear by Malcam,

kikuyu: iyo kuwa dib uga noqday Rabbiga lasocodkiisii, iyo kuwa aan Rabbiga doondoonin ama aan isaga innaba wax ka baryin.
english: those who have turned back from following the LORD, and those who haven’t sought the LORD nor inquired after him.

kikuyu: Sayidka Rabbiga ah hortiisa ku aamus, maxaa yeelay, maalintii Rabbigu waa soo dhow dahay, waayo, Rabbigu waa diyaariyey allabari, oo martidiisiina quduus buu ka dhigay.
english: Be silent at the presence of the Lord GOD, for the day of the LORD is at hand. For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta Rabbiga allabarigiisa ayaan ciqaabi doonaa amiirrada iyo wiilasha boqorka, iyo inta dharka qalaad xidhan oo dhanba.
english: It will happen in the day of the LORD’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.

kikuyu: Maalintaas waxaan wada ciqaabi doonaa kuwa marinka ka booda, oo guriga sayidkooda ka buuxiya dulmi iyo khiyaano.
english: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Isla maalintaas qaylo dhawaaqeed ayaa ka yeedhi doona Iridda Kalluunka, oo magaalada inteeda labaadna waxaa ka yeedhi doonta baroor, kurahana waxaa ka yeedhi doona daryaan weyn.
english: In that day, says the LORD, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna Makteesh degganow, qayliya, waayo, dadkii reer Kancaan oo dhammu waa dhammaaday, oo kuwii lacagta ku rarnaa oo dhammu waa baabba'.
english: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas ayaan Yeruusaalem laambado ku baadhi doonaa, waanan ciqaabi doonaa dadka gufarkooda isaga fadhiyey sida khamri deggan oo kale, oo qalbigooda iska yidhaahda, Rabbigu wax wanaagsan samayn maayo, wax shar ahna samayn maayo.
english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.”

kikuyu: Maalkoodu wuxuu noqon doonaa wax la boobo, guryahooduna waxay noqon doonaan meel baabba' ah, haah, oo waxay dhisan doonaan guryo, laakiinse ma ay degi doonaan, oo waxay beeran doonaan beero canab ah, laakiinse khamrigooda ma ay cabbi doonaan.
english: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.

kikuyu: Maalintii weynayd oo Rabbigu way soo dhow dahay, way soo dhow dahay, oo aad bay u soo degdegaysaa. Dhawaaqi maalinta Rabbigu mar dhow buu yeedhi doonaa, dadka xoogga badanuna halkaasay si qadhaadh ah uga qaylin doonaan.
english: The great day of the LORD is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of the LORD. The mighty man cries there bitterly.

kikuyu: Maalintaasu waa maalin ay cadho jirto, oo waa maalin ay jiraan dhibaato iyo cidhiidhi, oo waa maalin ay jiraan dumin iyo baabbi'in, oo waa maalin ay jiraan gudcur iyo mugdi madow, oo waa maalin ay jiraan daruuro iyo gudcur dam ah,
english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

kikuyu: oo waa maalin ay jiraan buun iyo qaylo dagaaleed oo ka gees ah magaalooyinka deyrka leh, iyo munaaradaha dhaadheer.
english: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.

kikuyu: Dadka waxaan ku soo dejin doonaa cidhiidhi inay u socdaan sidii dad indha la', maxaa yeelay, Rabbigay ku dembaabeen, oo dhiiggoodu wuxuu u daadan doonaa sida boodh oo kale, hilibkooduna sida digo oo kale.
english: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

kikuyu: Oo maalinta cadhada Rabbiga lacagtooda iyo dahabkooda midna kama samatabbixin doono iyaga, laakiinse dalka oo dhan waxaa baabbi'in doona dabka qiiradiisa, oo dhulka waxa deggan oo dhanna haddiiba dhaqsiyuu u wada dhammayn doonaa.
english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.

kikuyu: Isa soo urursada, quruuntan aan xishoodka lahaynay, isa soo urursada,
english: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

kikuyu: intaan amarku soo bixin, oo aan maalintu u dhaafin sida xaab oo kale, intaan Rabbiga xanaaqiisa kululu idinku soo degin, intaan maalinta cadhada Rabbigu idinku soo degin.
english: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD comes on you, before the day of the LORD’s anger comes on you.

kikuyu: Rabbiga doondoona, dhammaantiin kuwiinna camalka qabow ee dhulkow, oo xukunkiisa yeelayow, xaqnimo doondoona, oo qabownaan doondoona. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad maalinta cadhada Rabbiga qarsoonaan doontaan.
english: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of the LORD’s anger.

kikuyu: Waayo, Gaasa waa la dayrin doonaa, oo Ashqeloonna waxay noqon doontaa meel cidla ah, oo dadka Ashdoodna waxaa la eryi doonaa hadh cad, Ceqroonna waa la rujin doonaa.
english: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.

kikuyu: Waxaa iska hoogay dadka deggan badda xeebteeda, waana quruunta reer Kereetiim! Kancaan oo ah dalka reer Falastiinow, Rabbiga eraygiisu waa kaa gees. Waan ku baabbi'in doonaa si aan qof keliyuhuna kuu sii degganaan.
english: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The LORD’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.

kikuyu: Badda xeebteedu waxay noqon doontaa berrimmo daaqsiin ah, oo leh rug adhijirro iyo xeryo adhi.
english: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

kikuyu: Oo xeebta waxaa yeelan doona kuwa dadka Yahuudah ka hadhay. Iyana adhyahooda ayay halkaas daaqsan doonaan, oo fiidkiina waxay jiifsan doonaan guryihii reer Ashqeloon, waayo, Ilaaha Rabbigooda ah ayaa iyaga soo booqan doona, oo maxaabiistoodiina wuu soo celin doonaa.
english: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for the LORD, their God, will visit them and restore them.

kikuyu: Anigu waan maqlay caydii reer Moo'aab iyo canaantii reer Cammoon oo ay dadkayga ku caayeen, iyo inay iska sii weyneeyeen soohdintooda.
english: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Rabbiga ciidammada oo ah Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil wuxuu leeyahay, Noloshaydaan ku dhaartay oo sida xaqiiqada ah Moo'aab waxay noqon doontaa sida Sodom oo kale, oo reer Cammoonna waxay noqon doonaan sida Gomora oo kale, oo waxay ahaan doonaan meel maraboob ka baxo, iyo godad cusbo, iyo meel had iyo goor cidla ah. Kuwa dadkayga ka hadhay ayaa dhici doona oo inta quruuntayda ka hadhay ayaa dhaxli doonta.
english: Therefore, as I live, says the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.

kikuyu: Kibirkoodii aawadiis ayay waxan u heli doonaan, maxaa yeelay, waxay caayeen oo iska weynaysiiyeen dadkii Rabbiga ciidammada.
english: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu iyaga u noqon doonaa mid aad looga cabsado, waayo, wuu wada macaluulin doonaa ilaahyada dhulka oo dhan, kolkaasay dadku isaga caabudi doonaan, oo mid kastaaba wuxuu isaga ka caabudi doonaa meeshiisa, oo xataa quruumaha gasiiraduhu way wada caabudi doonaan isaga.
english: The LORD will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.

kikuyu: Oo weliba reer Itoobiyow, idinkana waxaa laydinku layn doonaa seeftayda.
english: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.

kikuyu: Oo isagu gacantiisuu u fidin doonaa xagga woqooyi, oo dalka Ashuur wuu wada baabbi'in doonaa, oo Ninewehna cidla buu ka dhigi doonaa iyo lamadegaan engegan.
english: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhexdeeda jiifsan doona xoolo iyo xayawaanka quruumaha oo dhan, oo cantalyaaga iyo caanaqubtuba waxay ku dhex hoyan doonaan tiirarkeeda. Cod baa ka gabyi doona daaqadaheeda, oo waxaa marinnada joogi doona abaar, waayo, isagu wuu soo bandhigay shuqulkii qoriga kedarka ah laga qabtay.
english: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.

kikuyu: Tanu waa magaaladii faraxa badnayd oo feyigla'aanta ku degganayd, oo qalbiga iska tidhi, Anigaa ah, oo aniga mooyaane mid kale ma jirto. Waxay noqotay cidla iyo meel dugaag ku hoydo! Mid kasta oo agteeda soo maraaba wuu ku foodhyi doonaa oo gacanta quudhsasho la ruxi doonaa.
english: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.

kikuyu: Waxaa iska hoogtay magaalada caasiyowday oo nijaasowday oo wax dulunta!
english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

kikuyu: Iyadu codkii ma ay addeecin, oo edbintiina ma ay aqbalin, oo Rabbiga iskuma ay hallayn, oo Ilaahna kuma ay soo dhowaan.
english: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in the LORD. She didn’t draw near to her God.

kikuyu: Amiirradeeda iyada dhex jooga waa sida libaaxyo ciyaya, xaakinnadeeduna waa sida yeey habeennimo oo aan waxba tan iyo aroortii reebin.
english: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

kikuyu: Nebiyadeedu waa kuwo fudud oo khiyaano badan, oo wadaaddadeediina meeshii quduuska ahayd ayay nijaaseeyeen, oo sharcigiina si xun bay u dhaafeen.
english: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

kikuyu: Rabbiga dhexdeeda jooga waa xaq, oo innaba xumaan ma samayn doono, oo caddaaladdiisana aroor kastaba wuu soo saaraa, oo marnaba kama baaqdo, laakiinse caddaaladlaawuhu isma ceebsan yaqaan.
english: The LORD, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

kikuyu: Anigu quruumo ayaan baabbi'iyey, oo qalcadahoodiina waa baabba', oo jidadkoodiina cidla baan ka dhigay si aan ciduna u marin, oo magaalooyinkoodiina waa la dumiyey, si aan qofna u joogin oo aan cid keliyuhuna u degganaan.
english: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

kikuyu: Waxaan idhi, Sida xaqiiqada ah waad iga cabsan doontaa, oo edbin baad aqbali doontaa. Markaas hoygeedu uma uu baabbe'een sidii aan iyada u goostay. Laakiinse aroor horay keceen oo falimahoodii oo dhan way xumeeyeen.
english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

kikuyu: Haddaba i suga, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay, ilaa maalinta aan ugaadhsade u soo kici doono, waayo, waxaan ku talajiraa inaan quruumaha isu soo ururiyo oo aan boqortooyooyinka isu soo shiriyo, si aan korkooda ugu shubo dhirifkayga iyo xataa xanaaqayga kulul oo dhan, waayo, dhulka oo dhan waxaa baabbi'in doona dabka qiiradayda.
english: “Therefore wait for me”, says the LORD, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

kikuyu: Waayo, markaas ayaan dadyowga siin doonaa af daahir ah, si ay kulligood magaca Rabbiga ugu yeedhaan, oo ay isaga ugu adeegaan isku niyad keliya.
english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

kikuyu: Kuwa i barya oo ah dadkayga firidhsan waxay webiyaasha Itoobiya shishadooda ka keeni doonaan qurbaankayga.
english: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas uma aad ceeboobi doontid falimahaaga oo dhan, kuwaas oo aad igaga xadgudubtay, waayo, markaas waxaan dhexdaada ka bixin doonaa kuwaaga kibray oo isfaaninaya, oo adna mar dambe ku madax weynaan maysid buurtayda quduuska ah.
english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

kikuyu: Laakiinse dhexdaada waxaan uga tegi doonaa dad dhibaataysan oo masaakiin ah, oo iyana magaca Rabbiga ayay isku hallayn doonaan.
english: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Kuwa reer binu Israa'iil ka hadhay xumaan ma samayn doonaan, beenna ma sheegi doonaan, oo afkoodana innaba carrab khiyaano badan lagama heli doono, waayo, iyagu wax bay quudan doonaan oo way iska jiifsan doonaan, oo waxba iyaga ma cabsiin doonaan.
english: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

kikuyu: Magaalada Siyoonay, gabay, reer binu Israa'iilow, qayliya, Magaalada Yeruusaalemay, farax oo qalbiga oo dhan ku reyree.
english: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu qaaday xukummadaadii, oo cadowgaagiina wuu tuuray. Boqorkii reer binu Israa'iil oo Rabbiga ah ayaa dhexdaada jooga, oo mar dambe shar ka baqi maysid.
english: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas waxaa Yeruusaalem lagu odhan doonaa, Ha cabsan, Siyoonay, yaan gacmahaagu debcin.
english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah ayaa dhexdaada jooga, isagu waa mid xoog badan oo ku badbaadin doona. Farxad buu kuugu rayrayn doonaa, oo wuxuu ku nasan doonaa jacaylkiisa, oo gabay buu kuugu farxi doonaa.
english: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

kikuyu: Waxaan soo ururin doonaa kuwaagii laga masaafuriyey oo haatan u murugaysan shirka quduuska ah, kuwaasoo culaabta kor saaranu ay cay ahayd.
english: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, wakhtigaas anigaa la macaamiloon doona kuwa ku dhiba oo dhan, oo waan badbaadin doonaa kuwa dhutiya, oo kuwii la eryayna waan soo ururin doonaa, oo kuwii ceebtoodu ay wada gaadhay dhulka oo dhan ayaan u yeeli doonaa ammaan iyo magac.
english: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas waan idin soo gelin doonaa gudaha, oo wakhtigaas waan idin soo ururin doonaa, waayo, dadyowga dunida jooga oo dhan waxaan idiinku dhex yeeli doonaa magac iyo ammaan, markaan maxaabiistiinnii oo dhan hortiinna ku soo celiyo, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay.
english: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Boqor Daariyus sannaddiisii labaad, bisheedii lixaad, maalinteedii kowaad ayaa eraygii Rabbigu u yimid Nebi Xaggay, oo waxaa loogu soo dhiibay Serubaabel ina Salaatii'eel oo ahaa taliyihii dalka Yahuudah, iyo Yashuuca ina Yehoosaadaaq oo ahaa wadaadka sare, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu sidanuu u hadlaa oo wuxuu leeyahay, Dadkanu waxay yidhaahdaan, Wakhtigii weli lama gaadhin, wakhtigii guriga Rabbiga la dhisi lahaa weli lama gaadhin.
english: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa eraygii Rabbigu u yimid Nebi Xaggay oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Ma idiin tahay wakhti aad ku hoyataan guryihiinna saqafka loo yeelay, iyadoo guriganu uu dunsan yahay?
english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Jidadkiinna ka fiirsada.
english: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

kikuyu: Wax badan baad beerateen, laakiinse in yar baad soo gurateen, wax baad cuntaan, laakiinse innaba kama dheregtaan, wax baad cabtaan, laakiinse innaba kama wabaxdaan, dhar baad xidhataan, laakiinse innaba ma diirsataan, oo kii mushahaaro soo qaataana wuxuu mushahaarada u soo qaata inuu kiish daloolan ku rito.
english: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Jidadkiinna ka fiirsada.
english: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Buurta fuula, oo alwaax ka keena, oo guriga dhisa, oo anna waan ku farxi doonaa, oo kolkaasaan ammaanmi doonaa.
english: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Waxaad filanayseen wax badan, laakiinse waxay noqdeen in yar, oo markaad intaas gurigii keenteenna anigu waan afuufay. Waa maxay sababtu? Maxaa yeelay, gurigaygii baa dunsan oo idinkana midkiin kastaaba wuxuu u ordaa gurigiisa.
english: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

kikuyu: Haddaba idinka daraaddiin ayaa samadii u diidday sayaxeedii oo dhulkiina wuu diiday midhihiisii.
english: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

kikuyu: Oo anigu abaar baan u yeedhay, oo waxaan ku soo dejiyey dhulka, iyo buuraha, iyo hadhuudhka, iyo khamriga, iyo saliidda, iyo waxaa dhulka ka soo baxa, iyo dadka, iyo duunyada, iyo hawsha gacmaha oo dhan.
english: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Serubaabel ina Salaatii'eel, iyo wadaadkii sare oo ahaa Yashuuca ina Yehoosaadaaq, iyo dadka intiisii hadhay oo dhammu waxay addeeceen codkii Rabbiga Ilaahooda ah, iyo erayadii Nebi Xaggay, waayo, Rabbiga Ilaahooda ah ayaa isaga soo diray, oo dadkiina Rabbiga hortiisa ayaa cabsi ku gashay.
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Xaggay oo ahaa wargeeyihii Rabbiga dadkii u sheegay farriintii Rabbiga, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu waan idinla joogaa.
english: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Rabbigu kiciyey ruuxii Serubaabel ina Salaatii'eel oo ahaa taliyihii dalka Yahuudah, iyo ruuxii Yashuuca ina Yehoosaadaaq oo ahaa wadaadka sare, iyo ruuxii dadka intiisa hadhay oo dhanba, oo intay yimaadeen ayay ka shaqeeyeen gurigii Rabbiga ciidammada oo Ilaahooda ah,
english: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,

kikuyu: oo taasuna waxay dhacday Boqor Daariyus sannaddiisii labaad, bishii lixaad, maalinteedii afar iyo labaatanaad.
english: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

kikuyu: Oo haddana bishii toddobaad maalinteedii kow iyo labaatanaad ayaa eraygii Rabbigu u yimid Nebi Xaggay, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Hadda waxaad la hadashaa Serubaabel ina Salaatii'eel oo ah taliyaha dalka Yahuudah, iyo Yashuuca ina Yehoosaadaaq oo ah wadaadka sare, iyo dadka intiisa hadhayba, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa,
english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

kikuyu: Yaa hadhay oo idin dhex jooga oo gurigan ammaantiisii hore arkay? Haatanse sidee buu idiinla eg yahay? Sow meel aan waxba ahayn idiinlama eka?
english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Serubaabelow, xoog yeelo. Yashuuca ina Yehoosaadaaq oo wadaadka sare ahow, xoog yeelo. Dadkiinna dalka jooga oo dhammow, xoog yeesha oo shaqeeya, waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu waan idinla joogaa,
english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: sidaan idiin ballanqaaday waagii aad Masar ka soo baxdeen, oo ruuxaygiina wuu idin dhex joogaa, haddaba ha cabsanina.
english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Weli wakhti yar oo gaaban baa ii hadhay, oo dabadeedna waxaan gariirin doonaa samooyinka, iyo dhulka, iyo badda, iyo berrigaba.
english: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

kikuyu: Oo quruumaha oo dhanna waan gariirin doonaa, oo waxa ay quruumaha oo dhammu jeclaystaan way iman doonaan, oo anna gurigan waxaan ka buuxin doonaa ammaan, ayaa Rabbiga ciidammadu leeyahay.
english: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Lacagta anigaa leh, oo dahabkana anigaa leh.
english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Ammaanta gurigan dambe waa ka sii weynaan doontaa tan kii hore. Oo Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Meeshan dhexdeeda ayaan nabad ku siin doonaa.
english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

kikuyu: Boqor Daariyus sannaddiisii labaad, bisheedii sagaalaad, maalinteedii afar iyo labaatanaad ayaa eraygii Rabbigu u yimid Nebi Xaggay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Haddaba wadaaddada waxaad weyddiisaan wax sharciga ku saabsan, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaan,
english: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

kikuyu: Haddii mid darafka maradiisa ku qaato hilib quduusan, oo uu darafkiisu taabto kibis, ama fuud, ama khamri, ama saliid, ama wax kale oo cunta ah, miyey waxaasu quduus noqonayaan? Kolkaasaa wadaaddadii waxay ugu jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen. Maya.
english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Xaggay yidhi, Haddii mid ku nijaasoobo meyd oo uu taabto wax kuwan ka mid ah, miyaa kaasuu nijaasoobayaa? Oo wadaaddadiina waxay ugu jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Wuu nijaasoobayaa.
english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Xaggay jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Dadkanu waa saasoo kale, oo quruuntanuna saasoo kalay hortayda ku tahay, oo shuqul kasta oo ay gacmahooda ku qabtaanna waa saasoo kale, oo wixii ay halkaas ku bixiyaanna waa nijaas.
english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says the LORD; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

kikuyu: Haddaba waan idin baryayaaye, maanta intii ka bilaabata iyo wixii ka dambeeyaba ka fiirsada intaan dhagaxna dhagax la dul saarin macbudka Rabbiga,
english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in the LORD’s temple.

kikuyu: iyo tan iyo wakhtigaas oo dhan markii la doonto tulmo ah labaatan, waxaa laga helay toban keliya, oo markii loo yimaado in macsarada khamriga laga soo dhaansado konton weel, waxaa ku jiray labaatan weel oo keliya.
english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

kikuyu: Anigu shuqulka gacmihiinna oo dhan waxaan ku dhuftay beera-engeeg iyo cariyaysi iyo roobdhagaxyaale, laakiinse iima aydaan soo noqon ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay.
english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Haddaba waan idin baryayaaye maanta intii ka bilaabata iyo wixii ka dambeeyaba ka fiirsada, oo bishii sagaalaad maalinteedii afar iyo labaatanaad oo ahayd maalintii la dhigay aasaaska macbudka Rabbiga, aad uga fiirsada.
english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid, consider it.

kikuyu: Maqsinka iniino ma ku jiraan? Hubaal canabka iyo berdaha iyo rummaanka iyo saytuunka midkoodna midho ma dhalin, laakiinse maanta inta ka bilaabata waan idin barakayn doonaa.
english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa mar labaad eraygii Rabbigu u yimid Nebi Xaggay, taasuna waxay ahayd bisha maalinteedii afar iyo labaatanaad, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

kikuyu: La hadal Serubaabel oo ah taliyaha dalka Yahuudah, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Waxaan gariirin doonaa samooyinka iyo dhulkaba,
english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

kikuyu: waanan afgembiyi doonaa carshiga boqortooyooyinka, oo waan baabbi'in doonaa xoogga boqortooyooyinka quruumaha, waanan afgembiyi doonaa gaadhifardoodyada iyo kuwa fuushanba, oo fardaha iyo kuwa ku joogaaba way dhici doonaan, oo mid kastaaba wuxuu ku dhiman doonaa seefta walaalkiis.
english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Serubaabelow, Addoonkaygiiyow, ina Salaatii'eelow, maalintaas waan ku qaadan doonaa, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay, oo waxaan kaa dhigi doonaa sidii shaabad oo kale, waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu waan ku doortay.
english: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the LORD, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

kikuyu: Boqor Daariyus sannaddiisii labaad, bishii siddeedaad ayaa eraygii Rabbigu u yimid Sekaryaah oo ahaa ina Berekyaah ina Iddo oo nebigii ahaa, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbigu aad buu awowayaashiin ugu cadhooday.
english: “The LORD was very displeased with your fathers.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waxaad iyaga ku tidhaahdaa, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Ii soo noqda, ayuu Rabbiga ciidammadu leeyahay, oo anna waan idiin soo noqonayaa, ayuu Rabbiga ciidammadu leeyahay.
english: Therefore tell them, the LORD of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Ha ahaanina sidii awowayaashiin oo kale, kuwaasoo ahaa kuwii ay nebiyadii hore ku qayliyeen oo ay ku yidhaahdeen, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Hadda ka soo noqda jidadkiinna sharka ah iyo falimihiinna sharka ahba, laakiinse Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Iyagu ima ay maqlin, oo innaba ima ay dhegaysan.
english: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: The LORD of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bal meeye awowayaashiin? Nebiyaduse miyey weligood iska noolaadaan?
english: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

kikuyu: Laakiinse erayadaydii iyo qaynuunnadaydii aan nebiyadii addoommadayda ahaa ku soo amray, sow ma gaadhin awowayaashiin? Oo iyana intay soo noqdeen ayay yidhaahdeen, Rabbiga ciidammadu siduu ku fikiray inuu nagu sameeyo, siday jidadkayagu ahaayeen, iyo siday falimahayagu ahaayeen ayuu nagu sameeyey.
english: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”

kikuyu: Boqor Daariyus sannaddiisii labaad, bisheedii kow iyo tobnaad, taasoo ah bisha Shebaad maalinteedii afar iyo labaatanaad ayaa eraygii Rabbigu u yimid Sekaryaah oo ahaa ina Berekyaah ina Iddo oo nebigii ahaa, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

kikuyu: Habeenkii waxaan arkay oo ii muuqday nin faras xamar ah fuushan, oo wuxuu dhex istaagay geedaha hadaaska la yidhaahdo oo meel hoos leh ku yiil, oo gadaashiisana waxaa joogay fardo kale oo midabkoodu yahay xamar iyo midab dibicyo leh iyo caddaan.
english: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.

kikuyu: Markaasaan idhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, waa maxay kuwanu? Markaasaa malaggii ila hadlay igu yidhi, Anigaa ku tusi doona waxa kuwanu yihiin.
english: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The angel who talked with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”

kikuyu: Oo ninkii geedaha hadaaska ah dhex taagnaa ayaa jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi, Kuwanu waa kuwii Rabbigu u diray inay dhulka hore iyo dib u dhex maraan.
english: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay u jawaabeen malaggii Rabbiga oo geedaha hadaaska ah dhex taagnaa oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Dhulkii hore iyo dibba waannu u dhex marnay, oo bal eeg, dhulkii oo dhammu wuu deggan yahay oo wuu xasilloon yahay.
english: They reported to the LORD’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaggii Rabbigu jawaabay oo wuxuu yidhi, Rabbiga ciidammadow, ilaa goormaadan u naxariisanayn Yeruusaalem iyo magaalooyinka dalka Yahuudah, kuwaasoo aad toddobaatan sannadood u cadhaysnayd?
english: Then the LORD’s angel replied, “O LORD of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu malaggii ila hadlay ugu jawaabay erayo wanaagsan oo qabow.
english: The LORD answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa malaggii ila hadlay igu yidhi, War qayli, oo waxaad tidhaahdaa, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu Yeruusaalem iyo Siyoonba waxaan ugu masayrsanahay masayr weyn.
english: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

kikuyu: Oo aad iyo aad baan ugu cadhooday quruumaha iska istareexsan! Waayo, anigoo in yar u cadhaysan ayay sii badiyeen dhibaatadii.
english: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Yeruusaalem ayaan naxariis kula soo noqday. Oo Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Gurigayga waa laga dhisi doonaa dhexdeeda, oo Yeruusaalem korkeeda waxaa lagu fidin doonaa xadhig qiyaaseed.
english: Therefore the LORD says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says the LORD of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’

kikuyu: Oo haddana qayli oo waxaad tidhaahdaa, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Magaalooyinkaygu mar kalay barwaaqo la faafi doonaan, oo Rabbigu mar kaluu Siyoon u qalbi qaboojin doonaa, oo mar kaluu Yeruusaalem dooran doonaa.
english: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

kikuyu: Oo indhahaygii baan kor u qaaday, oo wax baan fiiriyey, oo waxaan arkay afar gees.
english: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.

kikuyu: Oo anna waxaan malaggii ila hadlay ku idhi, Waa maxay kuwanu? Oo isna wuxuu iigu jawaabay, Kuwanu waa geesihii kala firdhiyey dadkii dalka Yahuudah iyo dadkii dalka Israa'iil iyo Yeruusaalemba.
english: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu i tusay afar tumaal.
english: The LORD showed me four craftsmen.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaan idhi, Kuwanu maxay u yimaadeen inay sameeyaan? Oo isna wuu hadlay oo wuxuu yidhi, Kuwanu waa geesihii kala firdhiyey dadkii dalka Yahuudah si aan ninna madaxiisa ugu qaadin aawadeed. Laakiinse kuwanu waxay haatan u yimaadeen inay ka argaggixiyaan, oo ay hoos u tuuraan quruumaha geesahooda kor ugu qaaday dalka Yahuudah inay kala firdhiyaan.
english: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”

kikuyu: Oo anna indhahaygii baan kor u qaaday, oo wax baan fiiriyey, oo waxaan arkay nin gacanta ku haysta xadhig qiyaaseed.
english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaan idhi, War xaggee baad u socotaa? Oo isna wuxuu igu yidhi, Waxaan u socdaa inaan Yeruusaalem soo qiyaaso oo aan soo ogaado intuu ballaadhkeedu yahay, iyo intuu dhererkeedu yahayba.
english: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, malaggii ila hadlay ayaa baxay, oo malag kale ayaa u baxay inuu isaga ka hor tago.
english: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi isagii, Orod, oo la hadal ninkaas dhallinyarada ah, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Yeruusaalem waxaa loo degi doonaa sidii tuulooyin aan deyr lahayn, sababtuna waa dadka tirobadnaantiisa iyo xoolaha iyada dhex jooga daraaddood.
english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu waxaan iyada u noqon doonaa deyr dab ah oo iyada ku wareegsan, oo waxaan iyada u noqon doonaa ammaanta dhexdeeda joogta.
english: For I,’ says the LORD, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Warroy dalka woqooyi ka carara, waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu waxaan idiin kala firdhiyey sida afarta dabaylood oo samada.
english: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says the LORD; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Siyoonay, tan dadka Baabuloon la joogtoy, baxso.
english: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Ammaan dabadeed wuxuu ii soo diray quruumihii adiga ku dhacay, waayo, kii ku taabto wuxuu taabtaa ishiisa inankeeda.
english: For the LORD of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eega, Gacantayda ayaan iyaga ku kor ruxruxi doonaa, oo iyana waxay booli u noqon doonaan kuwii iyaga u adeegi jiray, oo idinna waxaad ogaan doontaan in Rabbiga ciidammadu i soo diray.
english: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.

kikuyu: Magaalada Siyoonay, gabay oo reyree, waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Bal eeg, anigu waan imanayaa oo dhexdaadaan degganaan doonaa.
english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says the LORD.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas quruumo badan ayaa Rabbiga isugu darmi doona, oo dadkaygay noqon doonaan, oo dhexdaadaan degganaan doonaa, oo adna waxaad ogaan doontaa in Rabbiga ciidammadii ii soo kaa diray.
english: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiguna dadka dalka Yahuudah wuu dhaxli doonaa iyagoo qaybtiisa ku ah dalka quduuska ah, oo weliba Yeruusaalem buu dooran doonaa.
english: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Binu-aadmiga oo dhammow, Rabbiga hortiisa ku aamusa, waayo, isagu waa ka soo kacay hoygiisii quduuska ahaa.
english: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu i tusay Yashuuca oo ah wadaadka sare oo hor taagan malaggii Rabbiga, iyo Shayddaan oo taagan gacantiisa midig si uu u ashtakeeyo.
english: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

kikuyu: Markaas Rabbigu wuxuu Shayddaan ku yidhi, Shayddaanow, Rabbigu ha ku canaanto, Rabbiga Yeruusaalem doortay ha ku canaanto. Sow kanu ma aha qori dab laga dhiftay?
english: The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! Yes, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

kikuyu: Haddaba Yashuuca dhar wasakhaysan buu qabay, oo wuxuu istaagay malagga hortiisii.
english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

kikuyu: Isagu wuu jawaabay oo la hadlay kuwii isaga hor taagnaa, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Dharka wasakhaysan isaga ka fura. Kolkaasuu isagiina ku yidhi, Bal eeg, xumaantaadii waan kaa qaaday oo waxaan kuu xidhi doonaa dhar aad u wanaagsan.
english: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

kikuyu: Oo anna markaasaan idhi, Duub daahirsan madaxa ha loo saaro. Markaasaa duub daahirsan madaxa loo saaray, oo dhar baa loo xidhay, oo malaggii Rabbiga ayaa ag istaagay.
english: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and the LORD’s angel was standing by.

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaggii Rabbigu u caddeeyey Yashuuca, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Haddaad jidadkayga ku socotid, oo aad amarkayga xajisid, markaas waxaad xukumi doontaa gurigayga, oo weliba waxaad dhawri doontaa barxadahayga, oo anna kuwa halkan taagan dhexdooda ayaan kaa siin doonaa meel aad soo gashid.
english: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

kikuyu: Haddaba Yashuuca oo wadaadka sare ahow, maqal, adiga iyo saaxiibbadaada ku hor fadhiya, maxaa yeelay, iyagu waa niman calaamad ah, waayo, bal eeg, anigu waxaan bixin doonaa addoonkayga Biqilka ah.
english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal eeg dhagaxa aan Yashuuca hortiisa dhigay, isku dhagax ayaa waxaa ku yaal toddoba indhood. Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Bal eeg, anigu waan xardhi doonaa xaradhkiisa, oo dalkaas xumaantiisana maalin qudha baan ku qaadi doonaa.
english: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Wakhtigaas ninkiin kastaaba wuxuu deriskiisa ugu yeedhi doonaa canabka iyo berdaha hoostooda.
english: In that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”

kikuyu: Oo haddana malaggii ila hadlay ayaa i toosiyey, sidii nin hurdo laga soo toosiyey.
english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu igu yidhi, War maxaad aragtaa? Oo aniguna waxaan idhi, Waxaan arkaa oo u jeedaa laambad wada dahab ah, oo maddiibaddeedana iyaday kor sarantahay, oo toddobadeeda laambadood ee yaryarna way kor yaalliin, oo waxaa jira toddobada tuubbo oo ku socota laambad yar oo kasta oo ku kor taal.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;

kikuyu: Oo agteedana waxaa ku yaal laba geed oo saytuun ah, oo mid wuxuu ku yaal maddiibadda dhankeeda midig, oo kan kalena wuxuu ku yaal maddiibadda dhankeeda bidix.
english: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

kikuyu: Oo anna waan jawaabay oo la hadlay malaggii ila hadlay oo waxaan ku idhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, waa maxay kuwanu?
english: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaggii ila hadlay jawaabay oo wuxuu igu yidhi, War miyaadan aqoon waxa kuwanu yihiin? Oo anna waxaan ku idhi, Maya, sayidkaygiiyow.
english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu jawaabay oo ila hadlay, oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Kanu waa eraygii Rabbigu u soo diray Serubaabel, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Rabbigii ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Itaal kuma aha, xoogna kuma aha, laakiinse waxay ku tahay ruuxayga.
english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Buurtan weynay, kumaad tahay? Serubaabel hortiisa waxaad ku noqon doontaa bannaan. Oo isna wuxuu soo bixin doonaa dhagaxa madaxa ah isagoo dhawaaqaya oo leh, Ammaan ha u ahaato, ammaan ha u ahaato.
english: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaa ii yimid Eraygii Rabbiga, oo wuxuu igu yidhi,
english: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Serubaabel gacmihiisa ayaa dhigay gurigan aasaaskiisa, oo weliba gacmihiisaa dhammayn doona, oo waxaad ogaan doontaa in Rabbiga ciidammadu ii soo kaa diray.
english: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

kikuyu: Waayo, bal yaa quudhsaday maalinta waxyaalaha yaryar? Waayo, iyagu way rayrayn doonaan, oo waxay arki doonaan xadhigga miisaanka oo ku jira gacanta Serubaabel, waana toddobadan oo ah indhihii Rabbiga. Iyagu dhulka oo dhan ayay hore iyo dibba u fiiriyaan.
english: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are the LORD’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

kikuyu: Markaasaan jawaabay, oo waxaan isagii ku idhi, Waa maxay labadan geed oo saytuunka ah oo ku yaal laambadda dhankeeda midig iyo dhankeeda bidixba?
english: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

kikuyu: Oo haddana mar labaad baan jawaabay oo waxaan ku idhi, Waa maxay labadan laamood oo saytuunka ah oo ku ag yaal labada tuubbo oo dahabka ah oo saliidda dahabka ah iska madhiya?
english: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

kikuyu: Oo isna wuu ii jawaabay oo wuxuu igu yidhi, War miyaadan aqoon waxa kuwanu yihiin? Oo anna waxaan ku idhi, Maya, sayidkaygiiyow.
english: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

kikuyu: Oo isna kolkaasuu igu yidhi, Kuwanu waa labada la subkay oo ag istaaga Sayidka dhulka oo dhan.
english: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana indhaha baan kor u taagay oo wax fiiriyey, oo waxaan arkay qorniin la duubo oo duulaya.
english: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

kikuyu: Oo isna wuxuu igu yidhi, War maxaad aragtaa? Oo anna waxaan ugu jawaabay, Waxaan arkaa qorniin la duubo oo duulaya, oo dhererkiisu waa labaatan dhudhun, ballaadhkiisuna waa labaatan dhudhun.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu igu yidhi, Kanu waa habaarka soo baxay oo dhulka oo dhan kor maraya, waayo, ku alla kii wax xada waxaa lagu baabbi'in doonaa sida dhankiisan ku qoran, oo ku alla kii been ku dhaartana waxaa lagu baabbi'in doonaa sida dhankiisa kale ku qoran.
english: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu waan soo bixin doonaa, oo wuxuu soo geli doonaa guriga tuugga, iyo guriga kan magacayga beenta ugu dhaarta, oo wuxuu iska joogi doonaa gurigiisa dhexdiisa, oo alwaaxdiisa iyo dhagaxyadiisaba wuu wada baabbi'in doonaa.
english: I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaggii ila hadlay soo baxay, oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Bal hadda indhaha kor u taag, oo bal arag waxa uu yahay waxan soo baxaya.
english: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

kikuyu: Oo waxaan ku idhi, Waa maxay? Kolkaasuu igu yidhi, Kanu waa weel eefaah ah oo soo baxaya. Oo weliba wuxuu igu yidhi, Kanu waa muuqashadii dembigooda oo dhulka oo dhan gaadhay.
english: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa kor loo qaaday wax culus oo laxaamad ah, oo waxaa jirtay naag eefaahda dhexdeeda fadhida.
english: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana wuxuu igu yidhi, Tanu waa xumaan. Kolkaasuu iyadii hoos ugu riday eefaahda dhexdeeda, oo wuxuu ku daboolay wixii cuslaa oo laxaamadda ahaa.
english: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaan indhaha kor u taagay, oo intaan wax fiiriyey ayaan arkay laba naagood oo soo baxay, oo dabayshuna waa ku jirtay baalashooda. Iyagu waxay lahaayeen baalal u eg baalasha xuurta oo kale, oo iyana intay eefaahdii kor u qaadeen ayay meel dhulka iyo samada u dhaxaysa geeyeen.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

kikuyu: Markaasaan malaggii ila hadlay ku idhi, Kuwanu xaggee bay eefaahda u qaadayaan?
english: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

kikuyu: Oo isaguna wuxuu igu yidhi, Waxay u qaadayaan inay guri iyada uga dhisaan dalka Shincaar, oo markii la diyaariyo ayaa iyada lagu dejin doonaa halkaas oo meesheeda ah.
english: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana indhaha baan kor u taagay oo wax fiiriyey, oo waxaan arkay afar gaadhifaras oo ka soo baxay laba buurood dhexdood, buuruhuna waxay ahaayeen buuro naxaas ah.
english: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

kikuyu: Gaadhifaraska kowaad waxaa waday fardo xamar ah, gaadhifaraska labaadna waxaa waday fardo madmadow.
english: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

kikuyu: Gaadhifaraska saddexaadna waxaa waday fardo cadcad, gaadhifaraska afraadna waxaa waday fardo barbaro leh oo xoog badan.
english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

kikuyu: Markaasaan jawaabay oo waxaan malaggii ila hadlay ku idhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, waa maxay kuwanu?
english: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa malaggii jawaabay oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Kuwanu waa samada afarteeda dabaylood, oo ka soo baxa meeshay Sayidka dhulka oo dhan ku hor taagnaayeen.
english: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

kikuyu: Gaadhifaraskii fardaha madmadow lahaa wuxuu tegayaa xagga dalka woqooyi, oo kuwa cadcaduna iyagay daba gelayaan, oo gaadhifaraskii fardaha barbaraha leh lahaana wuxuu tegayaa xagga dalka koonfureed.
english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

kikuyu: Oo kuwii xoogga badnaana way soo bexeen, oo waxay doonayeen inay dhulka hore iyo dibba u dhex maraan, oo isna wuxuu ku yidhi, Taga oo dhulka hore iyo dibba u dhex mara. Oo iyana markaasay dhulkii hore iyo dibba u dhex mareen.
