kikuyu: Goortuu Herodos arkay inay nimankii xigmadda lahaa ku cayaareen isagii, ayuu aad u cadhooday, oo cid buu u diray oo laayay wiilashii yaryaraa oo dhan, kuwii laba sannadood jiray iyo kuwii ka yaraa oo joogay Beytlaxam iyo meelaha u dhow oo dhan, sida wakhtigii uu nimankii xigmadda lahaa ka hubsaday.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa noqotay wixii nebi Yeremyaah lagaga dhex hadlay, isagoo leh,
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

kikuyu: Cod baa Raamaah laga maqlay, Oohin iyo baroor weyn, Raaxeel oo u ooyaysa carruurteeda, Oo aan doonaynin in la qalbi qabowjiyo, waayo, ma ay joogin.
english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

kikuyu: Laakiin goortuu Herodos dhintay, malaa'igtii Rabbiga ayaa riyo ugu muuqatay Yuusuf oo Masar jooga, iyadoo leh,
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: Kac oo kaxee ilmaha iyo hooyadiis, oo dhulka Israa'iil tag, waayo, kuwii ilmaha naftiisa doonayay waa dhinteen.
english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu kacay oo kaxeeyey ilmihii iyo hooyadiis, oo dalkii Israa'iil tegey.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortuu maqlay in Arkhela'os meeshii aabbihiis Herodos Yahuudiya xukumayo, wuu ka baqay inuu halkaas tago. Markaase Ilaah baa riyo ugu digay, oo uu dhinacyada Galili ku leexday.
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

kikuyu: Wuxuuna yimid oo degay magaalada Naasared la odhan jiray si ay u noqoto wixii nebiyada lagaga hadlay, Waxaa loogu yeedhayaa Naasaraani.
english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

kikuyu: Maalmahaas waxaa yimid Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha isagoo cidlada Yahuudiya wax ku wacdiyaya, oo leh,
english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

kikuyu: Toobadkeena, waayo, boqortooyadii jannadu waa dhow dahay.
english: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

kikuyu: Waayo, kan waa kii nebi Isayos ka hadlay kolkuu yidhi, Waa codka kan cidlada kaga qaylinaya, Jidka Rabbiga hagaajiya, Waddooyinkiisa toosiya.
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”

kikuyu: Yooxanaa qudhiisu wuxuu guntanaa dharkiisii dhogorta geel ahaa, oo suun meged ahna dhexduu ku xidhnaa, cuntadiisuna waxay ahayd ayax iyo malab dibadeed.
english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa u soo baxay dadka Yeruusaalem, iyo kuwa Yahuudiya oo dhan iyo kuwa dalka Urdun ku wareegsan oo dhan,
english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

kikuyu: markaasuu Webi Urdun ku baabtiisay iyagoo dembiyadooda qiranaya.
english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortuu arkay qaar badan oo Farrisiin iyo Sadukiin ah oo baabtiiskiisa yimid wuxuu ku yidhi, Dhal jilbisay, yaa idiinka digay inaad ka carartaan cadhada imanaysa?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

kikuyu: Haddaba midho toobad istaahila soo bixiya,
english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

kikuyu: hana ku fikirina inaad tidhaahdaan, Waxaannu leennahay Ibraahim oo aabbe noo ah. Waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ilaah waa karaa inuu dhagaxyadan carruur uga kiciyo Ibraahim.
english: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

kikuyu: Haddeer weliba faaska waxaa la dhigay geedaha guntooda. Sidaa darteed geed walba oo aan midho wanaagsan soo bixin waa la gooyaa oo dabkaa lagu tuuraa.
english: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

kikuyu: Anigu biyo ayaan idinku baabtiisaa ilaa toobadda, laakiin kan iga daba imanayaa waa iga itaal weyn yahay, kan aanan istaahilin inaan kabihiisa u qaado. Isagu wuxuu idinku baabtiisi doonaa Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo dab.
english: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Masaftiisu gacantiisay ku jirtaa, goobta wax lagu tumona aad buu u safayn doonaa, oo sarreenkiisa ayuu maqsinka ku soo ururin doonaa, laakiin buunshaha ayuu dab aan damayn ku gubi doonaa.
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise Galili ka yimid oo Webi Urdun ugu tegey Yooxanaa inuu baabtiiso.
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

kikuyu: Yooxanaase waa diiday, isagoo leh, Anaa u baahan inaad i baabtiisto, adiguna miyaad ii timid?
english: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise waa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Haddeer oggolow, waayo, sidaas waa inoo eg tahay inaynu xaqnimada oo dhan wada yeelno; markaasuu u oggolaaday.
english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

kikuyu: Ciise goortii la baabtiisay, ayuu markiiba biyaha kor uga baxay, kolkaasaa samooyinku furmeen, oo wuxuu arkay Ruuxa Ilaah oo sida qoolley oo kale u soo degaya oo dushiisa imanaya,
english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

kikuyu: oo cod baa samooyinka ka lahaa, Kanu waa Wiilkayga aan jeclahay, oo aan ku faraxsanahay.
english: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Goortaasaa Ruuxu Ciise cidlada u kaxeeyey in Ibliisku jirrabo.
english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

kikuyu: Oo goortuu afartan maalmood iyo afartan habeen soomanaa, ayuu dabadeed gaajooday.
english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

kikuyu: Markaasaa duufiyihii u yimid oo ku yidhi, Haddaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah, dhagaxyadan ku dheh, Kibis noqda.
english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa qoran tahay, Dadku waa inaanu kibis oo keliya ku noolaan, laakiin waa inuu eray walba oo afka Ilaah ka soo baxa ku noolaado.
english: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ibliisku magaaladii quduuska ahayd geeyey, wuxuuna saaray munaaraddii macbudka
english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

kikuyu: oo ku yidhi, Haddaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah, hoos isu tuur, waayo, waa qoran tahay, Malaa'igihiisa ayuu amri doonaa, Oo gacmahooda ayay sare kuugu qaban doonaan, Inaanay cagtaadu dhagax ku dhicin.
english: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddana waa qoran tahay, Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah waa inaanad jirrabin.
english: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

kikuyu: Haddana Ibliiskii ayaa buur aad u dheer geeyey, wuxuuna tusay boqortooyooyinka dunida oo dhan iyo ammaantooda.
english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waxyaalahan oo dhan waan ku siinayaa haddaad sujuuddid oo i caabuddid.
english: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Shayddaan yahow, bax, waayo, waa qoran tahay, Waa inaad caabuddo Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah oo waa inaad isaga keliya u adeegto.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ibliiskii ka tegey, oo waxaa u yimid malaa'igo, wayna u adeegeen.
english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

kikuyu: Maarkuu maqlay in Yooxanaa la qabtay, ayuu Galili ku leexday,
english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

kikuyu: oo intuu Naasared ka tegey, wuxuu yimid oo degay Kafarna'um, tan badda agteeda ahayd oo ku jirtay soohdimaha Sebulun iyo Naftaali,
english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

kikuyu: inay noqoto wixii nebi Isayos lagaga dhex hadlay, isagoo leh,
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Dhulka Sebulun iyo dhulka Naftaali, Xagga jidka badda, Webi Urdun shishadiisa, Galili quruumaha ka mid ah,
english: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

kikuyu: Dadkii fadhiyi jiray gudcurka Ayaa iftiin weyn arkay, Kuwii fadhiyi jiray dalka iyo hooska dhimashadana, Iftiin baa u baxay.
english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

kikuyu: Markaas dabadeed Ciise wuxuu bilaabay inuu wax ku wacdiyo oo yidhaahdo, Toobadkeena, waayo, boqortooyadii jannadu waa dhow dahay.
english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

kikuyu: Markuu badda Galili ag marayay wuxuu arkay laba walaalo ah, Simoon kii Butros la odhan jiray iyo Andaros oo ahaa walaalkiis, iyagoo shabag badda ku tuuraya, waayo, waxay ahaayeen kalluumaystayaal.
english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, I soo raaca, waxaan idinka dhigayaa kuwa dadka jillaabta.
english: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

kikuyu: Markiiba intay shabagyadii ka tageen, ayay raaceen isagii.
english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

kikuyu: Markuu meeshaas hore uga socday wuxuu arkay laba kale oo walaalo ah, Yacquub ina Sebedi iyo walaalkiis Yooxanaa, iyagoo aabbahood doonnida kula jira oo shabagyadoodii hagaajinaya, wuuna u yeedhay.
english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

kikuyu: Markiiba doonnidii iyo aabbahood way ka soo tageen oo way raaceen.
english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa Galili oo dhan ku wareegay, isagoo sunagogyadooda wax ku baraya oo injiilka boqortooyadii ku wacdiyaya oo bukaan oo dhan iyo cudur oo dhan bogsiinaya dadka dhexdiisa.
english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

kikuyu: Warkiisuna waa gaadhay Suuriya oo dhan, oo waxay u keeneen kuwii bukay oo dhan, oo cudurro kala cayncayn ah iyo silic qabay, iyo kuwo jinni qaba, iyo kuwo suuxdin qaba, iyo kuwa curyaan ah, wuuna bogsiiyey.
english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

kikuyu: Waxaana raacay dad badan oo ka yimid Galili iyo Dekabolis iyo Yeruusaalem iyo Yahuudiya iyo Webi Urdun shishadiisa.
english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

kikuyu: Markuu dadkii badnaa arkay ayuu buur fuulay, markaasuu fadhiistay oo xertiisa ayaa u timid.
english: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu afkiisa kala qaaday oo wax baray, isagoo leh.
english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa xagga ruuxa ka masaakiin ah, waayo, boqortooyada jannada iyagaa leh.
english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa baroorta, waayo, waa la qalbiqabowjin doonaa.
english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa camal qabow, waayo, dhulkay dhaxli doonaan.
english: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa xaqnimada u gaajaysan oo u harraadsan, waayo, way dhergi doonaan.
english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa naxariista leh, waayo, waa loo naxariisan doonaa.
english: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa qalbiga ka daahirsan, waayo, Ilaah bay arki doonaan.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa nabadda ka shaqeeyaa, waayo, waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa wiilashii Ilaah.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa xaqnimada aawadeed loo silciyo, waayo, boqortooyada jannada iyagaa leh.
english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Waad barakaysan tihiin goortii laydin caayo, oo laydin silciyo, oo wax walba oo xun oo been ah laydinka sheego aawaday.
english: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

kikuyu: Farxa oo reyreeya, waayo, jannada abaalgudkiinnu waa ku weyn yahay, waayo, sidaasay u silcin jireen nebiyadii idinka horreeyey.
english: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad tihiin cusbadii dhulka, laakiin haddii cusbadu dhadhan beesho, maxaa lagu cusbaynayaa? Dabadeed waxba tari mayso in dibadda loo tuuro oo dadku ku tunto maahee.
english: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad tihiin iftiinkii dunida. Magaalo buur ku taallu ma qarsoomi karto.
english: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

kikuyu: Ilays looma shido in la hoos geliyo weel, laakiin waxaa la saaraa meeshii ilayska, oo wuu u iftiimaa kuwa guriga ku jira oo dhan.
english: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale iftiinkiinnu dadka hortiisa ha iftiimo, si ay shuqulladiinna wanaagsan u arkaan, oo ay Aabbihiinna jannada ku jira u ammaanaan.
english: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Ha u malaynina inaan u imid inaan sharciga ama qorniintii nebiyada baabbi'iyo; uma aan iman inaan baabbi'iyo, laakiin waxaan u imid inaan wada oofiyo
english: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Intaan cirka iyo dhulku idlaan, xaraf ama dhibic keliya ka idlaan mayso sharciga ilaa ay wada noqdaan.
english: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed kii jebiya qaynuunnadan kuwa ugu yar midkood, oo sidaas dadka u bara, waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa kan uga yar boqortooyadii jannada, laakiin kii yeela oo bara, waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa kan weyn boqortooyadii jannada.
english: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Xaqnimadiinnu haddaanay ka badnaan tan culimmada iyo Farrisiinta, geliba maysaan boqortooyadii jannada.
english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Waad maqasheen in kuwii hore lagu yidhi, Waa inaanad dhiig qabin; kii dhiig qabaa wuxuu galabsadaa xukunka.
english: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mid walba oo walaalkiis u cadhoodaa wuxuu galabsadaa xukunka, oo kii walaalkiis ku yidhaahda, Nacas yahow, wuxuu galabsadaa in shirka la geeyo, oo kii yidhaahda, Doqon yahow, wuxuu galabsadaa jahannamada dabka ah.
english: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaad hadiyaddaada meesha allabariga keento, oo meeshaas aad ku xusuusatid in walaalkaa wax kuu haysto,
english: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

kikuyu: hadiyaddaada ku dhaaf meeshii allabariga horteeda, tag, oo horta walaalkaa la soo heshii, dabadeed kaalay oo hadiyaddaada bixi.
english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

kikuyu: Dhaqso cadowgaaga ula heshii intaad jidka kula socoto, si aan cadowgu xaakinka kuugu dhiibin, xaakinkuna askariga kuugu dhiibin, oo xabsi lagugu tuurin.
english: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan kugu leeyahay, Halkaas ka soo bixi maysid ilaa aad siisid beesadda ugu dambaysa.
english: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.

kikuyu: Waad maqasheen in la yidhi, Waa inaanad sinaysan.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nin walba oo qof dumar ah damac u eegaa, durba qalbigiisuu kaga sinaystay.
english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

kikuyu: Haddii ishaada midig ku xumayso, iska bixi oo iska tuur, waayo, waxaa kuu wanaagsan in xubnahaaga mid kaa lunto intii jidhkaaga oo dhan jahannamada lagu tuuri lahaa.
english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

kikuyu: Gacantaada midig hadday ku xumayso, iska jar oo iska tuur, waayo, waxaa kuu wanaagsan in xubnahaaga mid kaa lunto intii jidhkaaga oo dhan jahannamada geli lahaa.
english: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

kikuyu: Waxaana la yidhi, Ku alla kii naagtiisa furaa, warqaddii furniinka ha siiyo.
english: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mid walba oo naagtiisa furaa sababta sinada aawadeed maahee, wuxuu ka dhigayaa inay sinaysato, oo kii guursadaa tii la furayna waa sinaystaa.
english: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

kikuyu: Weliba waad maqasheen in kuwii hore lagu yidhi, Waa inaanad nidarradaada jebin, laakiin waa inaad Rabbiga u yeeshaa nidarradaada.
english: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ha dhaaraninaba; jannada ha ku dhaaranina, waayo, waa carshigii Ilaah.
english: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

kikuyu: Dhulkana ha ku dhaaranina, waayo, waa meeshuu cagihiisa dhigo; Yeruusaalemna ha ku dhaaranina, waayo, waa magaaladii Boqorkii weynaa.
english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Madaxaagana ha ku dhaaran, waayo, tin keliya kama dhigi kartid caddaan ama madow.
english: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadalkiinnu ha ahaado, Haah, haah, maya, maya; wixii intaas ka badan sharkuu ka yimaadaa.
english: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

kikuyu: Waad maqasheen in la yidhi, Il il ha loo rido, iligna ilig ha loo rido.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Sharka ha hor istaagina, laakiin ku alla kii dhabanka midig kaa dharbaaxa, kan kalena u jeedi,
english: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

kikuyu: oo kii doonaya inuu ku ashtakeeyo oo khamiiskaaga kaa qaato, maradaadana u daa,
english: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

kikuyu: oo ku alla kii kugu qasba inaad mayl la socotid, laba la soco.
english: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

kikuyu: Kii wax kaa barya, sii, oo kii doonaya inuu wax kaa amaahdo ha ka sii jeesan.
english: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

kikuyu: Waad maqasheen in la yidhi, Waa inaad deriskaaga jeclaatid oo cadowgaaga necbaatid,
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

kikuyu: laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Cadowyadiinna jeclaada, u duceeya kuwa idin habaara, wax wanaagsan u sameeya kuwa idin neceb, oo Ilaah u barya kuwa idin caaya oo idin silciya,
english: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

kikuyu: si aad u ahaataan wiilashii Aabbihiinna jannada ku jira, waayo, qorraxdiisa wuxuu u soo bixiya kuwa xun iyo kuwa wanaagsan, roobna wuu u di'iyaa kuwa xaqa ah iyo kuwa aan xaqa ahaynba.
english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaad jeceshihiin kuwa idin jecel, abaalkee baad leedihiin? Cashuurqaadayaashu miyaanay sidaas oo kale samayn?
english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

kikuyu: Haddaad salaantaan walaalihiin oo keliya, maxaa dheeraad ah oo aad samaysaan? Dadka kale miyaanay sidaas oo kale samayn?
english: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

kikuyu: Saas aawadeed u samaada sida Aabbihiinna jannadu u san yahay.
english: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

kikuyu: Iska jira inaydnaan xaqnimadiinna dadka ku hor samayn inay idin arkaan, haddii kale abaal kuma lihidin Aabbihiinna jannada ku jira.
english: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Haddaba markaad sadaqad bixinayso, buun ha ugu dhufan hortaada sida labawejiilayaashu sunagogyada iyo jidadka ku sameeyaan si dadku u ammaanaan. Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Abaalgudkoodii way heleen.
english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: Laakiin adigu goortaad sadaqad bixinayso, bidixdaadu yaanay ogaan waxa midigtaadu samaynayso,
english: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

kikuyu: si ay sadaqaddaadu u qarsoonaato, oo Aabbahaaga waxa qarsoon arka ayaa kuu abaalgudi doona.
english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

kikuyu: Oo goortaad tukanaysaan, ha ahaanina sida labawejiilayaasha, waayo, waxay jecel yihiin inay tukadaan iyagoo taagan sunagogyada iyo meesha jidadku isku gooyaan si ay dadka ugu muuqdaan. Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Abaalgudkoodii way heleen.
english: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: Laakiin adigu goortaad tukanaysid, qolkaaga qarsoon gal, oo goortaad albaabkaaga xidhid, Aabbahaaga meesha qarsoon ku jira bari, oo Aabbahaaga waxa qarsoon arka ayaa kuu abaalgudi doona.
english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

kikuyu: Goortaad tukanaysaan hadalka ha ku celcelinina sida dadka aan Ilaah aaminin yeelaan, waayo, waxay u malaynayaan in loo maqlayo hadalkooda badan aawadiis.
english: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed ha ahaanina sidooda oo kale, waayo, Aabbihiin waa og yahay waxaad u baahan tihiin intaanad weyddiin.
english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidatan u tukada, Aabbahayaga jannada ku jirow, magacaagu quduus ha ahaado.
english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

kikuyu: Boqortooyadaadu ha timaado, doonistaada dhulka ha lagu yeelo sida jannada loogu yeelo.
english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

kikuyu: Kibis maalin nagu filan, maanta na sii.
english: Give us today our daily bread.

kikuyu: Oo naga cafi qaamahayaga sidaannu u cafinnay kuwa noo qaamaysan.
english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

kikuyu: Oo jirrabaadda ha noo kaxayn, laakiin sharka naga du. Waayo, boqortooyada iyo xoogga iyo ammaanta adigaa leh weligaa. Aamiin.
english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaad dadka u cafidaan xumaantooda, Aabbihiinna jannada ku jira ayaa idin cafiyi doona.
english: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaanad dadka cafiyin, Aabbihiinnu xumaantiinna idiin cafiyi maayo.
english: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

kikuyu: Kolkaad soontaan ha ahaanina sida labawejiilayaashu u fool qulubsan yihiin, waayo, way isfoolxumeeyaan si ay dadka ugu muuqdaan inay sooman yihiin. Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Abaalgudkoodii way heleen.
english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: Laakiin adigu goortaad soontid, madaxaaga saliid marso oo fool dhaqo,
english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

kikuyu: si aadan dadka ugu muuqan inaad sooman tahay, laakiin aad ugu muuqatid Aabbahaaga meel qarsoon ku jira, oo Aabbahaaga waxa qarsoon arkaa waa kuu abaalgudi doonaa.
english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

kikuyu: Maal ha ku urursanina dhulka, meesha aboorka iyo miridhku ku baabbi'iyaan, iyo meesha tuugaggu jebiyaan oo ka xadaan,
english: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

kikuyu: laakiin maal jannada ku urursada, meesha aboorka iyo miridhku ayan ku baabbi'in iyo meesha tuugaggu ayan jebin oo ayan ka xadin.
english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

kikuyu: Waayo, meesha maalkaagu ku jiro, meeshaasaa qalbigaaguna ku jiri doonaa.
english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

kikuyu: Ilayska jidhku waa isha; haddaba haddii ishaadu hagaagsan tahay, jidhkaaga oo dhammi waa iftiimi doonaa.
english: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

kikuyu: Laakiin ishaadu hadday xun tahay, jidhkaaga oo dhammi gudcur buu ahaan doonaa. Haddaba iftiinka kugu jira hadduu gudcur yahay, gudcurkaasu sidee buu u weyn yahay!
english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

kikuyu: Ninna laba sayid uma shaqayn karo, waayo, mid buu nacayaa, kan kalena wuu jeclaanayaa, ama mid buu la jirayaa, kan kalena wuu quudhsanayaa. Uma wada shaqayn kartaan Ilaah iyo maal.
english: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ha ugu welwelina naftiinna waxaad cuni doontaan, iyo waxaad cabbi doontaan, jidhkiinnana ha ugu welwelina waxaad u huwan doontaan. Naftu miyaanay ka roonayn cuntada, jidhkuna miyaanu ka roonayn dharka?
english: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

kikuyu: Shimbirraha cirka eega, waayo, waxba ma beeraan, waxna ma gurtaan, maqsinnona waxba kuma urursadaan, oo Aabbihiinna jannada ku jira ayaa cunto siiya. Idinku miyaydnaan ka roonayn?
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

kikuyu: Midkiinnee intuu welwelo dhererkiisa dhudhun ku dari kara?
english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

kikuyu: Maxaad dharka ugu welweshaan? Fiiriya ubaxyada duurka siday u baxaan, ma ay shaqeeyaan, ma ayna miiqdaan.
english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

kikuyu: Weliba waxaan idinku leeyahay, Xataa Sulaymaan wakhtigii ammaantiisa oo dhan dhar uma uu gashan jirin sida kuwan midkood.
english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii Ilaah sidaa u huwiyo cawska maanta duurka ku yaal oo berrito moofada lagu ridayo, sidee ka badan ayuu idiin huwinayaa, rumaysadyarayaalow?
english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed ha ku welwelina, idinkoo leh, Maxaannu cunaynaa? ama, Maxaannu cabbaynaa? ama, Maxaannu huwanaynaa?
english: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

kikuyu: Waayo, quruumuhu waxaas oo dhan ayay doondoonaan. Aabbihiinna jannada ku jiraa waa og yahay inaad waxaas oo dhan u baahan tihiin.
english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

kikuyu: Laakiin horta doondoona boqortooyadii Ilaah iyo xaqnimadiisa, oo waxaas oo dhan waa laydinku dari doonaa.
english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed berrito ha ka welwelina, waayo, berrito iyadaa isu welwelaysa. Maalinta sharkeedu waa ku filan yahay.
english: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

kikuyu: Ninna ha xukumina inaan laydin xukumin.
english: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

kikuyu: Waayo, xukunkii aad ku xukuntaan ayaa laydinku xukumi doonaa, oo qiyaastii aad ku qiyaastaan ayaa laydinku qiyaasi doonaa.
english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

kikuyu: Saxarka isha walaalkaa ku jira maxaad u aragtaa, dogobka ishaada ku jirase aad u fiirsan weydaa?
english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Sidee baad walaalkaa ugu odhan doontaa, I daa, saxarka ishaada ku jira aan kaa saaree; oo dogob baa ishaada ku jiree?
english: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Labawejiile yahow, horta dogobka ishaada ku jira iska saar, goortaasaad bayaan u arkaysaa inaad saxarka isha walaalkaa ku jira ka saarto.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

kikuyu: Waxa quduuska ah eeyaha ha siinina, luulkiinnana doofaarrada hortooda ha ku tuurina, si ayan ugu tuman oo ayan idinku soo jeesan oo ayan idiinkala jeexjeexin.
english: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

kikuyu: Weyddiista oo waa laydin siin doonaa; doona oo waad heli doontaan: garaaca oo waa laydinka furi doonaa;
english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

kikuyu: waayo, mid kasto oo weyddiista waa la siiyaa, kii doonaana waa helaa, kii garaacana waa laga furi doonaa.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

kikuyu: Ninkiinnee baa haddii wiilkiisu kibis weyddiisto, dhagax siinaya?
english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

kikuyu: Ama hadduu kalluun weyddiisto, abeeso siinaya?
english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

kikuyu: Haddaba idinka oo shar leh haddaad garanaysaan inaad hadiyado wanaagsan carruurtiinna siisaan, intee ka badan ayaa Aabbihiinna jannada ku jiraa wax wanaagsan uu siin doonaa kuwa isaga weyddiista?
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

kikuyu: Haddaba wax kasta oo aad doonaysaan in laydinku sameeyo, idinkuna sidaas oo kale u sameeya; waayo, kanu waa sharcigii iyo nebiyadii.
english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

kikuyu: Iridda cidhiidhsan ka gala, waayo, iriddu waa weyn tahay, jidkuna waa ballaadhan yahay kan xagga baabbi'idda u kaca, oo kuwa ka galaa waa badan yihiin.
english: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

kikuyu: Waayo, iriddu waa cidhiidhsan tahay, jidkuna waa yar yahay kan xagga nolosha u kaca, kuwa helaana waa yar yihiin.
english: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

kikuyu: Iska jira nebiyada beenta ah, kuwa idiinku imanaya iyagoo qaba dharka idaad, laakiin hoosta ka ah yeey wax boobaysa.
english: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

kikuyu: Midhahooda ayaad ku garan doontaan. Canab ma laga guraa geed qodxan leh? Berdena ma laga guraa yamaarugga?
english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

kikuyu: Sidaasaa geed kasta oo wanaagsanu midho wanaagsan u dhalaa, geedkii xumina midho xun u dhalaa.
english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

kikuyu: Geed wanaagsanu midho xun ma dhali karo, geed xumina midho wanaagsan ma dhali karo.
english: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

kikuyu: Geed kasta oo aan midho wanaagsan dhalin waa la jaraa oo dabka lagu tuuraa.
english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed waxaad iyaga ku garanaysaan midhahooda.
english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

kikuyu: Ma aha qof kasta oo igu yidhaahda, Rabbow, Rabbow, kuwa boqortooyadii jannada gelayaa, laakiin kii sameeya doonista Aabbahayga jannada ku jira, kaasaa gelaya.
english: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Maalintaas qaar badan baa igu odhan doona, Rabbow, Rabbow, miyaannan magacaaga wax ku sii sheegin, oo miyaannan magacaaga jinniyo ku saarin, oo miyaannan magacaaga wax badan oo xoog leh ku samayn?
english: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

kikuyu: Markaasaan ku odhan doonaa, Weligay idinma aqoon, iga taga, dembifalayaalow.
english: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

kikuyu: Haddaba qof kasta oo ereyadaydan maqla oo yeela, waxaa loo ekaysiinayaa nin caqli leh oo gurigiisa ka dul dhisay dhagaxa.
english: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

kikuyu: Roobkii ayaa da'ay, daadkiina waa yimid, dabayshiina waa dhacday, wayna ku dhaceen gurigaas, ma uuna dumin, waayo, waxaa laga dul dhisay dhagaxa.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

kikuyu: Qof kasta oo ereyadaydan maqla oo aan yeelin, waxaa loo ekaysiinayaa nin doqon ah oo gurigiisa carrada ka dul dhisay.
english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

kikuyu: Roobkii waa da'ay, daadkiina waa yimid, dabayshiina waa dhacday, wayna ku dhaceen gurigaas, wuuna dumay, dumiddiisuna waa weynayd.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay goortii Ciise hadalladan dhammeeyey, in dadkii oo dhammu waxbariddiisa la yaabeen,
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

kikuyu: waayo, wuxuu wax u barayay sida mid amar leh oo uma uu baraynin sida culimmada.
english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

kikuyu: Goortuu buurta ka soo degay, dad badan baa soo raacay.
english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa u yimid nin baras leh oo caabuday, oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, haddaad doonaysid, waad i daahirin kartaa.
english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Ciise intuu gacantiisa soo taagay, ayuu taabtay, oo ku yidhi, Waan doonayaa ee daahirsanow. Kolkiiba baraskiisa wuu ka daahirsanaaday,
english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

kikuyu: oo Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Iska eeg, oo ninna ha u sheegin, laakiin jidkaaga iska mar, oo wadaadka istus, oo bixi hadiyaddii Muuse amray, marag iyaga ha u ahaatee.
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Goortuu Kafarna'um galay, waxaa u yimid boqol-u-taliye, isagoo baryaya
english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

kikuyu: oo leh, Sayidow, midiidinkaygii guriguu jiifaa, isagoo curyaannimo u buka oo aad u xanuunsanaya.
english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Waan imanayaa oo bogsiinayaa.
english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqol-u-taliyihii u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, anigu ma istaahilo inaad saqafka gurigayga hoostiisa soo gashid, laakiin hadal keliya dheh, midiidinkayguna waa bogsan doonaa.
english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu waxaan ahay nin laga sarreeyo oo askar baa iga hoosaysa. Kan waxaan ku idhaahdaa, Tag, wuuna tagaa; mid kalena, Kaalay, wuuna yimaadaa; midiidinkaygana, Waxan samee, wuuna sameeyaa.
english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

kikuyu: Goortuu Ciise taas maqlay, wuu ka yaabay, wuxuuna ku yidhi kuwii la socday, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Rumaysad sidan u weyn oo kale reer binu Israa'iil kama dhex helin.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Qaar badan ayaa bari iyo galbeed ka iman doona oo la fadhiisan doona Ibraahim iyo Isxaaq iyo Yacquub boqortooyadii jannada gudaheeda,
english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

kikuyu: laakiin wiilashii boqortooyada waxaa lagu tuuri doonaa gudcurka dibadda ah. Meeshaas waxaa jiri doonta baroor iyo ilkojirriqsi.
english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu boqol-u-taliyihii ku yidhi, Tag. Sidaad u ramaysatay ha kuu noqoto e. Oo saacaddaas ayaa midiidinkii bogsaday.
english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu guriga Butros galay, wuxuu arkay Butros soddohdiis oo jiifta oo qandhaysan.
english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

kikuyu: Markaasuu gacanteeda taabtay, qandhadiina waa ka baxday. Wayna kacday oo u adeegtay isaga.
english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

kikuyu: Goortii makhribkii la gaadhay waxay u keeneen qaar badan oo jinniyo qaba. Eray ayuu jinniyadii ku saaray, kuwii bukay oo dhanna wuu bogsiiyey,
english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

kikuyu: si ay u noqoto wixii nebi Isayos lagaga dhex hadlay isagoo leh, Isagaa qaatay bukaankeennii, cudurradeenniina wuu isku raray.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

kikuyu: Goortuu Ciise dad badan oo ku wareegsan arkay, ayuu amray inay dhinaca kale tagaan.
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa culimmada midkood u yimid oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, waan ku raacayaa meeshaad tagtidba.
english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Dawacooyinku godad bay leeyihiin, shimbirraha cirkuna buulal bay leeyihiin, laakiin Wiilka Aadanahu meel uu madaxiisa dhigo ma leh.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

kikuyu: Mid kale oo xertiisa ah ayaa ku yidhi, Sayidow, horta ii oggolow inaan tago oo aabbahay soo aaso.
english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, I soo raac; oo iska daa meydadku ha aaseen meydadkooda.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

kikuyu: Goortuu doonnida fuulay, xertiisii ayaa raacday.
english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa badda ka kacay duufaan weyn, ilaa ay hirarku qariyeen doonnida, laakiin isagu waa hurday.
english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertiisii u timid oo toosisay, iyagoo leh, Sayidow, na badbaadi, waannu lumaynaaye.
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad u baqaysaan, rumaysadyarayaalow? Markaasuu kacay, oo canaantay dabaysha iyo badda, oo xawaal weyn baa dhacday.
english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

kikuyu: Haddaba nimankii waa yaabeen, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Waa nin caynkee ah kan xataa dabaysha iyo badduba yeelaan?
english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

kikuyu: Goortuu yimid dhinaca kale oo dalka Gadareni, waxaa la kulmay laba qof oo jinni qaba oo xabaalaha ka soo baxaya, iyagoo aad khatar u ah, si aan ninna jidkaas u mari karin.
english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

kikuyu: Way qayliyeen iyagoo leh, Maxaa inoo dhexeeya, Wiilka Ilaahow? Ma waxaad halkan u timid inaad wakhtiga hortiis na silciso?
english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

kikuyu: Waxaa iyaga ka fogaa daaqsin doofaarro badan ah oo daaqaysa.
english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

kikuyu: Jinniyadii ayaa baryay iyagoo leh, Haddaad na saaraysid, noo dir daaqsinta doofaarrada ah,
english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Baxa. Markaasay baxeen oo galeen doofaarradii, oo daaqsinta oo dhammu jarka hoos bay uga yaacday ilaa badda, oo biyaha ku bakhtiday.
english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay kuwii daajin jiray carareen oo magaalada galeen, wax walbana way u sheegeen iyo wixii ku dhacay kuwii jinniyada qabi jiray.
english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

kikuyu: Markaasaa magaaladii oo dhan lagaga soo baxay inay Ciise ka hor tagaan. Goortay arkeen, waxay ka baryeen inuu soohdintooda ka noqdo.
english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

kikuyu: Markaasuu doonni fuulay oo dhanka kale u tallaabay oo magaaladiisii yimid.
english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay waxay u keeneen nin curyaan ah oo sariir ku jiifa. Ciise oo rumaysadkooda arka ayaa ninkii curyaanka ahaa ku yidhi, Wiilkow, kalsoonow, dembiyadaadu waa kaa cafiyan yihiin.
english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa qaar culimmada ah waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Ninkan waa caytamayaa.
english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

kikuyu: Ciise oo fikirradooda garanaya ayaa ku yidhi, Maxaad haddaba shar ugu fikiraysaan qalbiyadiinna?
english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

kikuyu: Iyamaa hawl yar, in la yidhaahdo, Dembiyadaadu waa cafiyan yihiin, ama in la yidhaahdo, Kac oo soco?
english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

kikuyu: Laakiin si aad ku garataan in Wiilka Aadanahu dhulka ku leeyahay amar uu dembiyada ku cafiyo (markaasuu kii curyaanka ahaa ku yidhi), Kac oo sariirtaada qaado oo gurigaaga tag.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu kacay oo gurigiisii tegey.
english: He arose and departed to his house.

kikuyu: Laakiin dadkii badnaa goortay arkeen, way baqeen, oo Ilaah ammaaneen, kan amar caynkan oo kale ah dadka siiyey.
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

kikuyu: Ciise kolkuu meeshaas ka tegey intuu socday ayuu wuxuu arkay nin la odhan jiray Matayos oo fadhiya meeshii cashuurta lagu qaado, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, I soo raac. Markaasuu kacay oo raacay.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay, goortii Ciise guriga cunto u fadhiistay, in cashuurqaadayaal iyo dembilayaal badanu yimaadeen, oo ay la fadhiisteen Ciise iyo xertiisa.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

kikuyu: Goortii Farrisiintu arkeen ayay xertiisii ku yidhaahdeen, Macallinkiinnu muxuu cashuurqaadayaasha iyo dembilayaasha ula cunaa?
english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Laakiin goortuu maqlay, wuxuu yidhi, Kuwa ladan dhakhtar uma baahna, laakiin kuwa buka ayaa u baahan.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: Laakiin taga oo barta hadalkan micnihiisa, Waxaan doonayaa naxariis ee ma aha allabari, waayo uma aan imanin inaan kuwa xaqa ah u yeedho, laakiin inaan dembilayaasha u yeedho ayaan u imid.
english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa u timid xertii Yooxanaa iyagoo leh, Annaga iyo Farrisiintu maxaannu dhaaxa u soonnaa, laakiin xertaadu ay u soomi weydaa?
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Dadka aroosku ma barooran karaan intuu aroosku la joogo? Laakiin waxaa iman doona maalmaha arooska laga qaadi doono, markaasay soomi doonaan.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

kikuyu: Ninna karriin cusub kuma tolo dhar duug ah, waayo, tan lagu buuxin lahaa ayaa dharka ka go'da, oo jeexdintu waa ka sii xumaataa.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

kikuyu: Khamri cusubna laguma shubo qarbeddo duug ah, haddii kale qarbeddada ayaa qarxaya, khamriguna waa daadanayaa, qarbeddaduna waa hallaabayaan, laakiin khamri cusubse waxaa lagu shubaa qarbeddo cuscusub, labaduba waa sii raagayaan.
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

kikuyu: Intuu waxan kula hadlayay, waxaa u yimid taliye oo u sujuuday oo ku yidhi, Gabadhaydu haddeer bay dhimatay, laakiin kaalay oo gacantaada saar oo way noolaanaysaa.
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise kacay oo raacay, isaga iyo xertiisiiba.
english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

kikuyu: Kolkaas naag laba iyo toban sannadood dhiigbixid qabtay ayaa dhabarkiisa timid oo taabatay maradiisa darafteeda.
english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay isku tidhi, Haddaan maradiisa iska taabto uun, waan bogsanayaa.
english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise intuu ku soo jeestay oo arkay, ayuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Gabadhay, kalsoonow; rumaysadkaaga ayaa ku bogsiiyey. Oo naagtii baa saacaddaas bogsatay.
english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu guriga taliyaha galay oo arkay kuwa biibiilayaasha yeedhinaya iyo dadka buuqaya,
english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

kikuyu: wuxuu ku yidhi, Ka leexda, yartu ma dhiman, waase huruddaa. Wayna ku qosleen.
english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

kikuyu: Laakiin markii dadkii badnaa la saaray, ayuu galay oo gacanteeda qabtay, yartiina waa kacday.
english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

kikuyu: Markaasaa warkaasu dalkaas oo dhan gaadhay.
english: The report of this went out into all that land.

kikuyu: Ciise intuu meeshaas ka tegayay, waxaa daba socday laba nin oo Indhala', iyagoo qaylinaya oo leh, Ina Daa'uudow, noo naxariiso.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

kikuyu: Goortuu guriga galay ayay nimankii indhaha la'aa u yimaadeen. Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma rumaysan tihiin inaan waxan yeeli karo? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haah, Sayidow.
english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu indhahooda taabtay isagoo leh, Sida rumaysadkiinnu yahay ha idiin noqoto.
english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa indhahoodii furmeen. Ciise aad buu u amray, oo ku yidhi, Iska jira; ninna yaanu ogaan.
english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

kikuyu: Laakiin iyagu way baxeen oo warkiisa ku fidiyeen dhulkaas oo dhan.
english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

kikuyu: Kolkay baxeen, bal eeg, waxaa loo keenay nin Carrabla' oo jinni qaba.
english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

kikuyu: Oo goortii jinnigii la saaray, ninkii carrabka la'aa waa hadlay, dadkii badnaana way yaabeen oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Sidaas oo kale Israa'iil weligeed laguma arag.
english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

kikuyu: Laakiin Farrisiintii waxay yidhaahdeen, Wuxuu jinniyada ku eryaa madaxda jinniyada.
english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku wareegay magaalooyinka iyo tuulooyinka oo dhan, oo sunagogyadooda ayuu wax ku barayay, oo injiilka boqortooyadii ku wacdiyeyey, oo bugto walba iyo cudur walba ayuu bogsiinayay:
english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortuu dadkii badnaa arkay ayuu u naxariistay, waayo, way dhibaataysnaayeen oo kala firidhsanaayeen sidii ido aan adhijir lahayn.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

kikuyu: Markaasuu xertiisii ku yidhi, Waxa beerta laga gooynayaa way badan yihiin, shaqaalayaashuse waa yar yihiin.
english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed Sayidka beergooyska barya inuu shaqaalayaal beertiisa u soo diro.
english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu u yeedhay laba-iyo-tobankii xertiisa ahaa oo wuxuu siiyey amar ay jinniyo wasakh leh ku saaraan oo ay bugto walba iyo cudur walba ku bogsiiyaan.
english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

kikuyu: Laba-iyo-tobanka rasuul magacyadoodu waa kuwan, Kan ugu horreeyaa waa Simoon, kan Butros la odhan jiray, iyo walaalkiis Andaros, iyo Yacquub ina Sebedi, iyo walaalkiis Yooxanaa,
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

kikuyu: iyo Filibos, iyo Bartolomayos, iyo Toomas, iyo Matayos oo cashuurqaadaha ahaa, iyo Yacquub ina Alfayos, iyo Tadayos,
english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

kikuyu: iyo Simoon reer Kaana, iyo Yuudas Iskariyod, kii gacangeliyey.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

kikuyu: Laba-iyo-tobankan Ciise ayaa diray oo amray isagoo leh, Jid ka mid ah jidadka dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ha marina, magaalo ka mid ah magaalooyinka reer Samaariyana ha gelina,
english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

kikuyu: laakiin waxaad u tagtaan idaha lunsan oo guriga Israa'iil ah.
english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo intaad socotaan wacdiya, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Boqortooyadii jannadu waa dhow dahay.
english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

kikuyu: Kuwa bukana bogsiiya, kuwii dhintayna sara kiciya, kuwa baraska lehna nadiifiya, jinniyadana saara, hadiyad ahaan baad ku hesheen ee hadiyad ahaanna ku siiya.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

kikuyu: Dahab ama lacag ama naxaas kiishadihiinna ha ku haysanina,
english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

kikuyu: qandina jidka ha u qaadanina, ama laba khamiis, ama kabo, ama ul, waayo, shaqaaluhu cuntadiisa ayuu istaahilaa.
english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

kikuyu: Magaalo alla magaaladaad gashaan iyo tuuloba, ka doona mid istaahila, oo halkaas jooga ilaa aad ka tegaysaan.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

kikuyu: Goortaad guriga gelaysaan, nabdaadiya,
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

kikuyu: oo hadduu gurigu istaahilo, nabaddiinnu ha ku soo degto, laakiin haddaanu istaahilin, nabaddiinnu ha idinku soo noqoto.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii aan idin soo dhowayn, oo aan hadalladiinna maqlin, goortaad gurigaas ama magaaladaas ka baxaysaan, siigada cagihiinna ka dhabaandhaba.
english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Maalinta xisaabta, Sodom iyo Gomora waa ka xisaab fududaan doonaan magaaladaas.
english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

kikuyu: Waxaan idiin dirayaa sidii ido yeey ku dhex jira, sidaa darteed caqli u lahaada sida abeesooyin, oo u sir la'aada sida qoolleyo.
english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

kikuyu: Laakiin dad iska jira, waayo, waxay idiin dhiibi doonaan shirar, oo sunagogyadooda ayay idinku karbaashi doonaan.
english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa aawaday laydiin hor geeyn doonaa taliyayaal iyo boqorro inay marag ku noqoto iyaga iyo dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn.
english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortay idin gacangeliyaan, ha ka welwelina sidaad u hadli doontaan ama waxaad ku hadli doontaan, waayo, waxaad ku hadli doontaan ayaa saacaddaas laydin siin doonaa.
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

kikuyu: Waayo, ma aha idinka kuwa hadlayaa laakiin waa Ruuxa Aabbihiin kan idinka dhex hadlayaa.
english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

kikuyu: Walaalba walaalkiis wuxuu u dhiibi doonaa in la dilo, aabbena wiilkiisa, carruurna waalidkood ayay ku kici doonaan oo dhimashay gaadhsiin doonaan.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

kikuyu: Dadka oo dhan ayaa magacayga aawadiis idiin necbaan doona, laakiin kan ilaa ugu dambaysta adkaysta, kaasaa badbaadi doona.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortay magaaladan idinku silciyaan, tan kale u carara, waayo, runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Magaalooyinka Israa'iil ma wada gaadhi doontaan ilaa Wiilka Aadanahu yimaado.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

kikuyu: Qof xer ahu macallinkiisa kama sarreeyo, addoonkuna sayidkiisa kama sarreeyo.
english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

kikuyu: Waa ku filan tahay qof xer ah inuu noqdo sida macallinkiisa, addoonkuna sida sayidkiisa. Hadday odayga reerka Be'elsebul ugu yeedhaan, intee ka badan ayay ugu yeedhi doonaan kuwa gurigiisa jooga.
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed ha ka baqina, waayo, wax daboolan ma jiro oo aan soo muuqan doonin, wax qarsoonna ma jiro oo aan la garan doonin.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

kikuyu: Waxaan gudcurka idiinku sheego, iftiinka ku dhaha, oo waxaad dhegta ka maqashaanna, guryaha dushooda kaga dhawaaqa.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

kikuyu: Ha ka baqina kuwa jidhka dila, laakiin aan karin inay nafta dilaan, waxaadse ka baqdaan kan jahannamada ku hallayn kara nafta iyo jidhkaba.
english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

kikuyu: Laba shimbirrood miyaan beesad lagu iibin? Middoodna dhulka ku dhici mayso amarka Aabbihiin la'aantiis.
english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

kikuyu: Timaha madaxiinna oo dhan waa tirsan yihiin.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed ha baqina, waad ka qiima badan tihiin shimbirro badan.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed mid walba oo igu qirta dadka hortiisa, anna waan ku qiran doonaa Aabbahayga jannada ku jira hortiisa.
english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Laakiin ku alla kii igu diida dadka hortiisa, anna waan ku diidi doonaa Aabbahayga jannada ku jira hortiisa.
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Ha u malaynina inaan u imid inaan nabad dhulka u keeno; uma aan iman inaan nabad keeno, laakiin inaan seef keeno.
english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

kikuyu: Waxaanse u imid inaan nin cadow kaga dhigo aabbihiis, gabadhna hooyadeed, naagna soddohdeed.
english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

kikuyu: Nin cadowgiisu waa dadka gurigiisa.
english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

kikuyu: Kan aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis iga jecel, ima istaahilo, oo kan wiilkiisa iyo gabadhdiisa iga jecel, ima istaahilo.
english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Kan aan iskutallaabtiisa soo qaadan oo aan i soo raacin, ima istaahilo.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Kan naftiisa helaa waa lumin doonaa, oo kan naftiisa u lumiya aawaday waa heli doonaa.
english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

kikuyu: Kan idin aqbalaa wuu i aqbalaa, kan i aqbalaana, wuxuu aqbalaa kan i soo diray.
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

kikuyu: Kan nebi ku aqbala nebi magiciis, wuxuu heli doonaa nebi abaalkiis, kan qof xaq ah ku aqbala qof xaq ah magiciis, wuxuu heli doonaa qof xaq ah abaalkiis.
english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii kuwan yaryar koob biyo qabow oo keliya ku siiya qof xer ah magiciis, runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, abaalkiisu ka lumi maayoba.
english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

kikuyu: Goortii Ciise amarkiisa u dhammeeyey laba iyo tobankii xertiisa ahaa, waxaa dhacay inuu meeshaas ka noqday inuu magaalooyinkooda wax ku baro oo ku wacdiyo.
english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

kikuyu: Goortii Yooxanaa xabsiga ka maqlay shuqulladii Masiixa, laba xertiisii ah ayuu u soo diray
english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

kikuyu: oo ku yidhi, Miyaad tahay kan imanaya mise mid kale aannu dhawrnaa?
english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Taga oo Yooxanaa uga warrama waxaad aragteen iyo waxaad maqasheen.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

kikuyu: Kuwii indhaha la'aa wax bay arkaan, kuwii lugahala'aana way socdaan, kuwii baraska qabayna waa la nadiifiyey, kuwii dhegahala'aana wax bay maqlaan, kuwii dhintayna waa la kiciyey, masaakiintana injiilka waa lagu wacdiyaa,
english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: oo waxaana barakaysan kan aan iga xumaanin.
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

kikuyu: Markay tageen, Ciise wuxuu bilaabay inuu dadkii badnaa wax uga sheego Yooxanaa oo wuxuu yidhi, Maxaad cidlada ugu baxdeen? Ma waxay ahayd inaad soo aragtaan cawsduur dabaylu ruxayso?
english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

kikuyu: Laakiin maxaad u baxdeen? Ma waxay ahayd inaad soo aragtaan nin dhar jilicsan qaba? Kuwa dharka jilicsan qaba waxay joogaan guryaha boqorrada.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

kikuyu: Laakiin maxaad u baxdeen? Ma waxay ahayd inaad nebi soo aragtaan? Haah, waxaan idinku leeyahay, mid nebi ka sarreeya.
english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

kikuyu: Kanu waa kii laga qoray, Eeg, waxaan hortaada soo dirayaa wargeeyahayga, Kan jidkaaga kuu sii diyaargarayn doona hortaada.
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Intii dumar ka dhalatay, mid Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha ka weyn kama dhex kicin, laakiin kan boqortooyadii jannada ugu yar ayaa ka weyn.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

kikuyu: Tan iyo wakhtigii Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha boqortooyada jannada waa la xoogay, oo kuwii xoogayna ayaa qaatay.
english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

kikuyu: Waayo, nebiyadii iyo sharcigu waxay wax sii sheegeen ilaa Yooxanaa.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

kikuyu: Haddii aad doonaysaan inaad tan aqbashaan, Kanu waa Eliyaas kan iman lahaa.
english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

kikuyu: Kan dhego wax lagu maqlo lahu ha maqlo.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

kikuyu: Maxaan qarnigan u ekaysiiyaa? Wuxuu u eg yahay carruur suuqa fadhida oo kuwa kale u yeedhaysa,
english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

kikuyu: iyagoo leh, Biibiile baannu idiin yeedhinnay, oo waad cayaari weydeen, waannu baroorannay oo waad calaacali weydeen.
english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

kikuyu: Waayo, Yooxanaa waa yimid isagoo aan waxba cunaynin oo cabbaynin, oo waxay yidhaahdaan, Jinni buu qabaa.
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

kikuyu: Wiilka Aadanahuse waa yimid isagoo wax cunaya oo cabbaya, oo waxay yidhaahdaan, Eeg, waa nin cir weyn oo khamriyacab ah oo saaxiib la ah cashuurqaadayaal iyo dembilayaal. Xigmaddu inay xaq tahay waa lagu caddeeyaa shuqulladeeda.
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

kikuyu: Dabadeed wuxuu bilaabay inuu canaanto magaalooyinkii uu shuqulladiisa xoogga leh badidooda ku dhex sameeyey, waayo, ma ay toobadkeenin.
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

kikuyu: Waa kuu hoog, Khorasinay; waa kuu hoog, Beytsayday; waayo, shuqulladii xoogga lahaa oo laydinku dhex sameeyey, haddii Turos iyo Siidoon lagu samayn lahaa, goor horay toobadkeeni lahaayeen, iyagoo dhar joonyad ah gashan oo dambas ku fadhiya.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Maalinta xisaabta Turos iyo Siidoon waa idinka xisaab fududaan doonaan.
english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

kikuyu: Adiguna Kafarna'umay, samada ma laguu sarraysiin doonaa? Waxaad ku degi doontaa Haadees, waayo, haddii shuqulladii xoogga lahaa oo lagugu dhex sameeyey, Sodom lagu samayn lahaa, ilaa maanta way joogi lahayd.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Maalinta xisaabta, dalka Sodom ayaa kaa xisaab fududaan doona.
english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas Ciise ayaa hadalkan yidhi, Aabbow, Rabbiga samada iyo dhulkow, waan kugu mahadnaqayaa, waayo, waxyaalahan ayaad kuwa caqliga iyo garashada leh ka qarisay, oo waxaad u muujisay ilma yaryar.
english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

kikuyu: Haah, Aabbow, waayo, sidaas ayaa kaa farxisay.
english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

kikuyu: Aabbahay wax walbaba waa ii dhiibay; oo ninna Wiilka garan maayo Aabbaha maahee, oo ninna Aabbaha garan maayo Wiilka maahee iyo kii Wiilku doonayo inuu u muujiyo.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

kikuyu: Ii kaalaya kulligiin kuwiinna hawshaysan oo culaabaysanow, oo anigu waan idin nasin doonaa.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

kikuyu: Harqoodkayga dushiinna ku qaata oo wax iga barta; waayo, waan qaboobahay, qalbigayguna waa hooseeyaa, oo naftiinna nasashaad u heli doontaan.
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

kikuyu: Waayo, harqoodkaygu waa dhib yar yahay, oo rarkayguna waa fudud yahay.
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas Ciise wuxuu sabtidii dhex maray beeraha, xertiisuna waa gaajaysnayd, oo waxay bilaabeen inay sabuulladii jartaan oo cunaan.
english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

kikuyu: Laakiin Farrisiintii goortay arkeen, waxay isaga ku yidhaahdeen, Eeg, xertaadu waxay samaynayaan wixii aan xalaal ahayn in sabtida la sameeyo.
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Miyaydnaan akhriyin wixii Daa'uud sameeyey goortuu gaajooday, isaga iyo kuwii la jiray,
english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

kikuyu: siduu gurigii Ilaah u galay oo uu u cunay kibistii tusniinta, tan aan xalaal u ahayn inuu cuno ama in kuwii la jiray cunaan, wadaaddada keliya maahee?
english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

kikuyu: Ama miyaydnaan sharciga ka akhriyin in wadaaddadii macbudka ku jira sabtida, ay sabtida ka dhigaan wax aan quduus ahayn oo ay ka eed la' yihiin?
english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mid macbudka ka sarreeya ayaa halkan jooga.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

kikuyu: Haddaad aqoon lahaydeen hadalkan micnihiisa, Waxaan doonayaa naxariis ee ma aha allabari, kuwa aan eed lahayn ma aad xukunteen.
english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

kikuyu: Waayo, Wiilka Aadanahu waa sayidkii sabtida.
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu halkaas ka tegey oo wuxuu galay sunagoggooda.
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa joogay nin gacan engegan. Goortaasay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Ma xalaal baa in sabtida wax la bogsiiyo? si ay ugu ashtakeeyaan.
english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Ninkiinnee baa lax leh oo hadday sabtida god ku dhacdo, aan soo qabanaynin oo aan soo bixinaynin?
english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

kikuyu: Haddaba nin intee buu ka qiima badan yahay lax! Sidaa darteed waa xalaal in sabtida wanaag la sameeyo.
english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ninkii ku yidhi, Gacantaada soo taag. Wuuna soo taagay, oo way bogsatay sida tan kale.
english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

kikuyu: Laakiin Farrisiintu waa baxeen, oo waxay ka wada hadleen si ay u dilaan.
english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu ogaaday ayuu halkaas ka tegey, oo waxaa raacay dad badan, dhammaantoodna wuu wada bogsiiyey.
english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
