kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku amray inaanay cidna u sheegin,
english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

kikuyu: si ay u noqoto wixii lagaga dhex hadlay nebi Isayos isagoo leh,
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Eeg midiidinkaygii aan doortay, Kan aan jeclahay oo ay naftaydu ku faraxsan tahay. Ruuxayga ayaan dul saari doonaa, Wuxuuna quruumaha u sheegi doonaa xukunka.
english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

kikuyu: Ma uu ilaaqtami doono, mana qaylin doono, Ninnana codkiisa jidadka kama maqli doono.
english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

kikuyu: Cawsduur nabar leh ma jebin doono, Dubaalad qiiqaysana ma demin doono, Ilaa uu xukunka u soo bixiyo libta.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

kikuyu: Oo quruumuhu waxay ku rajayn doonaan magiciisa.
english: In his name, the nations will hope.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa loo keenay jinnoole indha la' oo carrab la', wuuna bogsiiyey, sidaa darteed ninkii carrabka la'aa waa hadlay oo wax arkay.
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa dadkii badnaa oo dhammu yaabeen oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Kanu miyaanu ahayn ina Daa'uud?
english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

kikuyu: Laakiin Farrisiintu goortay maqleen, waxay yidhaahdeen, Kanu jinniyada wax kale kuma saaro Be'elsebul oo ah madaxda jinniyada maahee.
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

kikuyu: Laakiin isagoo garanaya fikirradooda ayuu ku yidhi, Boqortooyo walba oo kala qaybsantaa, cid la' bay noqotaa, oo magaalo walba iyo guri walba oo kala qaysamaa, ma taagnaan doonaan.
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

kikuyu: Haddii Shayddaan Shayddaan saaro, waa kala qaybsamaa. Haddaba boqortooyadiisu sidee bay u taagnaan doontaa?
english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

kikuyu: Oo anigu haddii aan jinniyada ku saaro Be'elsebul, wiilashiinnu yay ku saaraan? Sidaa darteed iyagu waxay ahaanayaan xaakinnadiinna.
english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaan jinniyada ku saaro Ruuxa Ilaah, waxaa idiin timid boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

kikuyu: Ama qof sidee buu kan xoog leh gurigiisa u geli karaa oo alaabtiisa u dhici karaa, haddaanu kolkii hore kan xoogga leh xidhin? Markaasuu gurigiisa dhici doonaa.
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: Kan aan ila jirin waa iga gees, oo kan aan ila ururin waa firdhiyaa.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed waxaan idinku leeyahay, Dembi walba iyo cay walba waa loo cafiyi doonaa dadka, laakiin cayda Ruuxa Quduuska ah ka gees ah looma cafiyi doono.
english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii ku hadla hadal Wiilka Aadanaha ka gees ah waa loo cafiyi doonaa, laakiin ku alla kii ku hadla hadal Ruuxa Quduuska ah ka gees ah looma cafiyi doono wakhtigan iyo wakhtiga iman doona.
english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

kikuyu: Ama geedka wanaajiya iyo midhihiisaba, ama geedka xumeeya iyo midhihiisaba, waayo, geedka waxaa lagu gartaa midhihiisa.
english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

kikuyu: Dhal jilbisay, sidee baad wax wanaagsan ugu hadli karaysaan idinkoo shar leh? Waayo, afku wuxuu ku hadlaa waxa qalbiga ku badan.
english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

kikuyu: Ninka wanaagsani wuxuu maalka wanaagsan ka soo saaraa wax wanaagsan, kan sharka lihina wuxuu maalka sharka leh ka soo saaraa wax shar ah.
english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Eray kasta oo aan waxtar lahayn oo dadku ku hadlo, maalinta xisaabta xisaab bay ka bixin doonaan.
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

kikuyu: Waayo, hadalladaada ayaa lagugu caddayn doonaa inaad xaq tahay, oo hadalladaada ayaa lagugu xukumi doonaa.
english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

kikuyu: Markaas qaar culimmada iyo Farrisiinta ah ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, waxaannu doonaynaa inaannu calaamo kaa aragno.
english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Qarni shareed oo sina leh ayaa calaamo doonaya, calaamona lama siin doono calaamada nebi Yoonis maahee.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida Yoonis saddex maalmood iyo saddex habeen caloosha nibiriga ugu jiray, sidaasuu Wiilka Aadanahuna saddex maalmood iyo saddex habeen caloosha dhulka uga jiri doonaa.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

kikuyu: Nimanka Nineweh waxay xisaabta isla taagi doonaan dadka qarnigan, wayna xukumi doonaan, waayo, waxay ku toobadkeeneen wacdigii Yoonis, oo bal eeg, mid Yoonis ka weyn ayaa halkan jooga.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

kikuyu: Boqoradda koonfureed waxay xisaabta la kici doontaa dadka qarnigan, wayna xukumi doontaa, waayo, waxay ka timid meesha dhulka ugu shishaysa inay xigmadda Sulaymaan maqasho, oo bal eeg, mid Sulaymaan ka weyn ayaa halkan jooga.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

kikuyu: Jinniga wasakhda leh goortuu ninka ka baxo, wuxuu maraa meelo aan biyo lahayn isagoo nasasho doonaya, mana helo.
english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhaahdaa, Waxaan ku noqonayaa gurigaygii aan ka baxay, oo goortuu yimaado wuxuu helaa isagoo madhan oo xaaqan oo hagaagsan.
english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

kikuyu: Markaasuu tagaa oo wuxuu wataa toddoba jinni oo kale oo ka xunxun isaga, wayna galaan oo halkaas joogaan. Ninkaas wakhtigiisa dambe ayaa ka darnaada wakhtiga hore. Sidaasay u noqon doontaa qarnigan sharka leh.
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

kikuyu: Intuu weli dadkii badnaa la hadlayay, ayaa hooyadiis iyo walaalihiis dibadda taagnaayeen oo doonayeen inay la hadlaan isaga.
english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

kikuyu: Mid baa ku yidhi, Bal eeg, hooyadaa iyo walaalahaa ayaa dibadda taagan oo doonaya inay kula hadlaan.
english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi kii u sheegay, Yaa hooyaday ah oo yaa walaalahay ah?
english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

kikuyu: Gacantiisa ayuu xertiisa ku taagay oo yidhi, Waa kuwan hooyaday iyo walaalahay!
english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

kikuyu: Waayo, ku alla kii yeela doonista Aabbahayga jannada ku jira, kaasaa walaalkay iyo walaashay iyo hooyaday ah.
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

kikuyu: Maalintaas Ciise ayaa guriga ka baxay oo fadhiistay badda agteeda,
english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

kikuyu: oo waxaa u soo ururay dad faro badan, sidaa darteed doonni ayuu fuulay oo fadhiistay, dadkii badnaa oo dhammuna xeebtay taagnaayeen.
english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wax badan masaallo ugu sheegay isagoo leh, Beerrey baa baxay inuu wax beero,
english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

kikuyu: oo intuu beerayay qaar baa jidka geestiisa ku dhacay. Kolkaasaa shimbirro yimaadeen oo cuneen.
english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waxay ku dhaceen dhul dhagax ah oo aan carro badan lahayn; kolkiiba way soo baxeen, waayo, carradu hoos uma dheerayn,
english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

kikuyu: laakiin qorraxdu goortay soo baxday way gubteen, waana engegeen, waayo, xidid ma lahayn.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waxay ku dhaceen qodxan, qodxantiina waa soo baxday oo ceejisay.
english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena dhul wanaagsan bay ku dhaceen oo ay midho dhaleen, mid boqol, midna lixdan, midna soddon.
english: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

kikuyu: Kan dhego wax lagu maqlo lahu ha maqlo.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertii u timid oo ku tidhi, Maxaad masaallo ugula hadashaa?
english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Idinka waa laydin siiyaa inaad waxa qarsoon ee boqortooyada jannada garataan, kuwaase lama siiyo.
english: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

kikuyu: Waayo, ku alla kii wax haysta waa la siin doonaa, waana loo badin doonaa, kii aan waxba haysanse, waa laga qaadi doonaa wuxuu haysto.
english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed ayaan masaallo ugula hadlaa, waayo, iyagoo arkaya ma arkaan, oo iyagoo maqlaya ma maqlaan, mana gartaan.
english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

kikuyu: Iyagay u noqotay waxsheegidda Isayos iyadoo leh, Maqal baad ku maqli doontaan mana garan doontaan, Idinkoo arkaya wax baad arki doontaan, idiinmana dhaadhici doonto.
english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

kikuyu: Waayo, dadkan qalbigoodu waa qallafsanaaday, Oo dhib bay dhegahooda wax ugu maqlaan, Indhahoodana way isku qabteen; Si aanay indhaha wax ugu arkin, Oo dhegaha wax ugu maqlin, Oo qalbiga wax ugu garan, Si aanay u soo noqon, Oo aanan u bogsiin.
english: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa barakaysan indhihiinna, waayo, wax bay arkaan, iyo dhegihiinna, waayo, wax bay maqlaan.
english: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nebiyo badan iyo niman xaq ah ayaa doonay inay arkaan waxaad aragtaan, mana arkin, iyo inay maqlaan waxaad maqashaan, mana ay maqlin.
english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

kikuyu: Haddaba maqla masaalkii beerreyga.
english: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

kikuyu: Mid kasta oo hadalka boqortooyada maqla oo aan garan, waxaa u yimaada kan sharka leh oo ka dhifta wixii qalbigiisa lagu beeray. Waa kan kii jidka geestiisa lagu beeray.
english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

kikuyu: Oo kii meelaha dhagaxa ah lagu beeray waa kan hadalka maqla oo kolkiiba farxad ku qaata.
english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

kikuyu: Xididse isagu ma leh, laakiin wakhti yar buu sii jiraa, oo goortii dhib ama silec ugu dhaco erayga aawadiis, markiiba waa ka xumaadaa.
english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

kikuyu: Kii qodxanta lagu dhex beerayna waa kan hadalka maqla oo kawelwelidda dunidan iyo sasabidda maalka ayaa hadalka ceejiya, oo wuxuu noqdaa midhola'aan.
english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

kikuyu: Kii dhulka wanaagsan lagu beeray waa kan erayga maqla oo garta, oo isagu waa kan midho dhala, mid boqol, midna lixdan, midna soddon.
english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

kikuyu: Masaal kale ayuu u saaray, oo wuxuu yidhi, Boqortooyada jannada waxaa loo ekaysiiyaa nin beertiisa abuur wanaagsan ku abuuray.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa yimid cadowgiisa intii dadku hurday, oo wuxuu sarreenka kaga dhex abuuray gocondho, markaasuu tegey.
english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

kikuyu: Laakiin markii geedku soo baxay oo uu midho dhalay, markaasaa gocondhadii soo muuqatay.
english: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa odayga reerka addoommadiisu u yimaadeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, miyaanad abuur wanaagsan beertaada ku abuurin? Xaggee haddaba gocondhadu uga timid?
english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Nin cadow ah ayaa waxan sameeyey. Addoommadii waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Ma waxaad doonaysaa haddaba inaannu tagno oo ururinno?
english: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

kikuyu: Wuxuuse ku yidhi, Maya, waaba intaas oo goortaad gocondhada ururinaysaan aad sarreenka la rurujisaan.
english: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

kikuyu: Labadoodu ha isla baxaan ilaa beergooyska, oo wakhtiga beergooyska waxaan kuwa gooya ku odhanayaa, Horta waxaad ururisaan gocondhadii, oo xidhmo xidhmo isugu xidha in la gubo, laakiin sarreenka ku soo ururiya maqsinkayga.
english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

kikuyu: Masaal kale ayuu u saaray oo wuxuu yidhi, Boqortooyada jannada waxay u eg tahay iniin khardal, tan uu nin qaaday oo beertiisa ku beeray.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

kikuyu: Taas waa ka wada yar tahay iniinaha oo dhan, laakiin goortay weynaato, way ka weyn tahay dhalatada oo dhan, oo waxay noqotaa geed dheer si ay shimbirraha cirku u yimaadaan oo laamaheeda ugu degaan.
english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

kikuyu: Masaal kale ayuu kula hadlay, Boqortooyada jannada waxay u eg tahay khamiir, kan naagi intay qaadday ay saddex qiyaasood oo bur ah ku dhex qooshtay ilaa ay wada khamiireen.
english: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

kikuyu: Waxan oo dhan ayaa Ciise masaallo kula hadlay dadkii badnaa, oo masaalla'aan kulama uu hadlin iyaga.
english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

kikuyu: Si ay u noqoto wixii nebiga lagaga dhex hadlay isagoo leh, Afkayga waxaan ku furayaa masaallo, Oo wax qarsoonna tan iyo aasaaskii dunida ayaan ku dhawaaqayaa.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu dadkii badnaa ka tegey oo guriga galay. Xertiisii ayaa u timid oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Noo caddee masaalkii gocondhadii beerta.
english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Kii abuur wanaagsan abuuray waa Wiilka Aadanaha,
english: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

kikuyu: beertuna waa dunida. Abuurka wanaagsanna waa wiilasha boqortooyada, gocondhadiina waa wiilasha kan sharka leh.
english: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

kikuyu: Oo cadowga abuurayna waa Ibliiska, beergooyskuna waa dhammaadka wakhtigii dunida, kuwa gooyaana waa malaa'igo.
english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidii gocondhadii loo ururiyey oo dab loogu gubay, sidaasay ahaan doontaa dhammaadka wakhtiga dunidu.
english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

kikuyu: Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa malaa'igihiisa diri doona, oo waxay boqortooyadiisa ka ururin doonaan wax kasta oo xumeeya iyo kuwa dembiga fala.
english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku tuuri doonaan foornada dabka, halkaas waxaa jiri doonta baroor iyo ilko jirriqsi.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

kikuyu: Markaasaa kuwa xaqa ah ku dhalaali doonaan boqortooyada Aabbahood sida qorraxdu u dhalaalayso. Kan dhego lahu ha maqlo.
english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

kikuyu: Boqortooyada jannadu waxay u eg tahay maal beer ku qarsoon, kan nin intuu helay qarsaday, oo farxad aawadeed ayuu baxay, oo wuxuu lahaa oo dhan iibiyey, oo beertaas iibsaday.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

kikuyu: Haddana boqortooyada jannadu waxay u eg tahay baayacmushtari luul wanaagsan doonaya.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

kikuyu: Goortuu xabbad luul ah oo ganac weyn helay, ayuu baxay, oo wuxuu lahaa oo dhan ayuu iibiyey oo iibsaday.
english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

kikuyu: Haddana boqortooyada jannadu waxay u eg tahay shabag badda lagu tuuray oo cayn walba lagu ururiyey.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

kikuyu: Kan markuu buuxsamay ay nimanku xeebta ku soo jiideen, wayna fadhiisteen oo kuwii wanaagsanaa weelal bay ku ururiyeen, kuwii xumaana way tuureen.
english: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

kikuyu: Sidaasay ahaan doontaa dhammaadka wakhtiga dunidu. Malaa'igahu way soo bixi doonaan oo waxay kuwa sharka leh ka dhex sooci doonaan kuwa xaqa ah,
english: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku tuuri doonaan foornada dabka. Halkaa waxaa jiri doonta baroor iyo ilko jirriqsi.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan oo dhan ma garateen? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haah.
english: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Sidaa darteed mid kasta oo culimmada ka mid ah oo xer looga dhigay boqortooyada jannada, wuxuu u eg yahay nin reer odaygiis ah oo maalkiisa ka soo saara wax cusub iyo wax duug ah.
english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

kikuyu: Kolkii Ciise masaalladan dhammeeyey, ayuu halkaas ka tegey.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

kikuyu: Oo markuu waddankiisa yimid, ayuu sunagoggooda wax ku baray, sidaa darteed way yaabeen oo yidhaahdeen, Ninkanu xaggee buu ka helay xigmaddan iyo shuqulladan xoogga leh?
english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

kikuyu: Kanu miyaanu ahayn wiilkii nijaarka? Miyaan hooyadiis la odhan Maryan? Walaalihiisna Yacquub iyo Yoosee iyo Simoon iyo Yuudas?
english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

kikuyu: Gabdhihii walaalihiis ahaana miyaanay inala wada joogin? Haddaba kanu xaggee buu waxyaalahan oo dhan ka helay?
english: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

kikuyu: Wayna ka xumaadeen, laakiin Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Nebi murwad la' ma jiro, waddankiisa iyo gurigiisa dhexdooda maahee.
english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

kikuyu: Halkaas shuqullo badan oo xoog leh kuma samayn rumaysadla'aantooda aawadeed.
english: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

kikuyu: Waagaas taliye Herodos ayaa warkii Ciise maqlay,
english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu midiidinyadiisii ku yidhi, Kanu waa Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha. Kuwii dhintay ayuu ka soo sara kacay, sidaa darteed shuqulladan xoogga leh waa ku dhex jiraan oo shaqaynayaan.
english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Herodos baa Yooxanaa qabtay oo intuu xidhay ayuu u xabbisay, walaalkiis Filibos naagtiisii Herodiya aawadeed.
english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

kikuyu: Waayo, Yooxanaa wuxuu ku yidhi, Xalaal kuuma aha inaad haysatid,
english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

kikuyu: oo goortuu doonay inuu dilo, dadkii badnaa ayuu ka baqay, maxaa yeelay, waxay u haysteen sidii nebi oo kale.
english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

kikuyu: Goortii maalintii la xusuustay dhalashadii Herodos timid, gabadhii Herodiya ayaa dadkii dhexdiisa ku cayaartay, oo Herodos ayay ka farxisay.
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu dhaar ku ballanqaaday inuu siiyo wixii ay weyddiisatoba.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

kikuyu: Iyadoo hooyadeed hore ula soo talisay ayay tidhi, Halkan xeedho igu soo sii madaxa Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha.
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

kikuyu: Boqorkii waa calool xumaaday, laakiin dhaarihiisii iyo kuwii la fadhiyey aawadood ayuu ku amray in la siiyo.
english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

kikuyu: Markaasuu cid diray oo Yooxanaa xabsigaa madaxa lagaga gooyay.
english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

kikuyu: Madaxiisiina waxaa lagu keenay xeedho, oo gabadhii la siiyey, iyaduna hooyadeed bay u keentay.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertiisii timid, oo meydkiisay qaadeen oo aaseen, kolkaasay tageen oo Ciise u warrameen.
english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu taas maqlay, ayuu halkaas doonni kaga soo noqday, oo meel cidla ah ayuu keligiis tegey. Dadkii badnaana goortay warkaas maqleen, ayay magaalooyinka lug kaga soo raaceen.
english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

kikuyu: Goortuu degay ayuu dad badan arkay, wuuna u naxariistay, oo kuwoodii bukay ayuu bogsiiyey.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

kikuyu: Goortii makhribkii la gaadhay ayaa xertiisii u timid oo ku tidhi, Meeshu waa cidlo, wakhtigiina waa dhammaaday, haddaba dadka dir si ay tuulooyinka u tagaan oo cunto u soo iibsadaan.
english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Uma ay baahna inay tagaan, idinku siiya waxay cunaan.
english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Halkan waxba kuma hayno shan kibsood iyo laba kalluun maahee.
english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Halkan iigu keena.
english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu dadkii badnaa ku amray inay cawska ku fadhiistaan. Isaguna wuxuu qaaday shantii kibsood iyo labadii kalluun, oo intuu cirka eegay ayuu barakeeyey oo kibistii kala jejebiyey oo xertiisii siiyey, xertiina dadkii badnaa bay siiyeen.
english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

kikuyu: Dhammaantood way wada cuneen oo ka dhergeen, oo waxay soo gureen jajabkii hadhay oo laba iyo toban dambiilood ka buuxa.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

kikuyu: Kuwii cunayna waxay ku dhowaayeen shan kun oo nin oo aan naagaha iyo carruurtu ku jirin.
english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

kikuyu: Kolkiiba wuxuu xertiisii ku amray inay doonnida fuulaan oo ay hortiis tagaan dhanka kale, intuu dadkii badnaa dirayo.
english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

kikuyu: Goortuu dadkii badnaa diray ayuu keligiis buurta fuulay inuu ku tukado, oo goortii makhribka la gaadhay keli ahaantiis ayuu halkaas joogay.
english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

kikuyu: Doonniduse durba wax badan ayay dhulka ka fogaatay oo hirarku waa dhibeen, waayo, dabaysha ayaa ka gees ahayd.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

kikuyu: Wakhtiga gaadhkii afraad oo habeenka ayuu u yimid isagoo badda ku dul socda.
english: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

kikuyu: Oo xertiisii goortay arkeen isagoo badda ku dul socda, way nexeen oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Waa muuqasho, oo baqdin bay la qayliyeen.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

kikuyu: Markiiba Ciise waa la hadlay oo ku yidhi, Kalsoonaada, waa aniga ee ha baqina.
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, haddaad tahay adiga, igu amar inaan biyaha kuugu dul imaado.
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Kaalay. Oo Butros markuu doonnida ka degay ayuu biyaha ku dul socday inuu Ciise u tago.
english: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortuu dabayshii arkay ayuu baqay, oo markuu bilaabay inuu dego ayuu qayliyey oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, i badbaadi,
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

kikuyu: oo markiiba Ciise gacantiisuu u taagay oo qabtay oo ku yidhi, Rumaysadyare yahow, maxaad u shakiday?
english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

kikuyu: Oo markay doonnida fuuleen, dabayshu waa joogsatay.
english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

kikuyu: Kuwii doonnida ku jirayna way caabudeen isaga, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Runtii, waxaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah.
english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Oo markay gudbeen waxay yimaadeen dalka Gennesared.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

kikuyu: Oo nimankii halkaas degganaa goortay garteen isaga, waxay cid u direen dalkaas ku wareegsan oo dhan, oo waxay u keeneen kuwa buka oo dhan,
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

kikuyu: oo waxay ka baryeen inay faraqa maradiisa keliya taabtaan, oo kuwii taabtayna way bogsadeen.
english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa Yeruusaalem Ciise uga yimid niman Farrisiin iyo culimmo ah, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen,
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

kikuyu: Xertaadu maxay xeerka waayeellada uga gudbaan? Waayo, ma faro xashaan goortay kibis cunayaan.
english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

kikuyu: Wuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Idinkuba maxaad amarkii Ilaah uga gudubtaan xeerkiinna aawadiis?
english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah wuxuu amray, Aabbahaa iyo hooyadaa maamuus, oo Kan aabbihii ama hooyadii caayaa, dhimasho ha ku dhammaado.
english: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaad leedihiin, Kan aabbihii ama hooyadii ku yidhaahda, Wixii aan idiin tari lahaa, hadiyad baan Ilaah ugu bixiyey,
english: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

kikuyu: aabbihii ama hooyadii maamuusi maayo. Xeerkiinna ayaad erayga Ilaah ku buriseen.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

kikuyu: Labawejiilayaalow, Isayos aad buu wax idiinka sii sheegay markuu yidhi,
english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

kikuyu: Dadkanu bushimahooda ayay igu maamuusaan, Laakiin qalbigoodu waa iga fog yahay.
english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

kikuyu: Si aan micne lahayn ayay ii caabudaan, Iyagoo dadka wax ku baraya amarrada dadka.
english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

kikuyu: Markaasuu dadkii badnaa u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Maqla oo garta.
english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

kikuyu: Ma aha waxa afka gala waxa ninka nijaaseeyaa, laakiin waxa afka ka soo baxa, kaas ayaa ninka nijaaseeya.
english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertii u timid oo ku tidhi, Ma og tahay Farrisiintii inay ka xumaadeen markay hadalkii maqleen?
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Geed walba oo aan Aabbahayga jannada ku jiraa abuurin waa la rujin doonaa.
english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

kikuyu: Iska daaya. Iyagu waa indhoolayaal indhoolayaal hagayaye. Laakiin nin indha la' hadduu nin indha la' hago, labadooduba god bay ku dhici doonaan.
english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Masaalkaa noo caddee.
english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu yidhi, Idinku weli ma garashola'aan baad tihiin?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

kikuyu: Miyaydnaan garanaynin, Wax kasta oo afka galaa calooshay tagaan, oo waxaa lagu tuuraa meesha lagu saxaroodo?
english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

kikuyu: Laakiin waxa afka ka soo baxaa, qalbigay ka yimaadaan; oo kuwaas weeye waxa ninka nijaaseeyaa.
english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa qalbiga ka soo baxaa fikirrada sharka leh iyo dilidda iyo sinada iyo galmada xaaraanta ah iyo tuuganimada iyo maragga beenta ah iyo cayda.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

kikuyu: Kuwan weeye waxa ninka nijaaseeyaa. Laakiin in lagu cuno faro aan la maydhin, ninka ma nijaasayso.
english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa meeshaas ka baxay, oo dhinacyada Turos iyo Siidoon ayuu u leexday.
english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

kikuyu: Oo naag reer Kancaan ah ayaa soohdimahaas ka soo baxday oo qaylisay iyadoo leh, Ii naxariiso, Sayidow, ina Daa'uudow. Gabadhayda jinni baa si xun u waalaya.
english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

kikuyu: Laakiin hadal uguma uu jawaabin. Markaasaa xertiisii u timid oo ka bariday iyagoo leh, Eri, waayo, way inaga daba qaylinaysaa.
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, La iima soo dirin, idaha lunsan oo reer binu Israa'iil maahee.
english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Laakiin iyadu way u timid oo sujuudday, oo waxay tidhi, Sayidow, i caawi.
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ma wanaagsana in carruurta kibistooda la qaado oo eeyaha loo tuuro.
english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

kikuyu: Waxay tidhi, Waa run, Sayidow, laakiin weliba eeyahu waxay cunaan jajabka ka dhaca miiska sayidkooda.
english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Naagtay, rumaysadkaagu waa weyn yahay ee ha kuu noqoto sidaad doonaysid. Oo saacaddaasba gabadheedii waa bogsatay.
english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise halkaas ka tegey, oo wuxuu u soo dhowaaday badda Galili, oo buurtuu fuulay oo halkaasuu fadhiistay.
english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa waxaa u yimid dad fara badan oo wada kuwa curyaan ah iyo kuwa indha la' iyo kuwa carrab la' iyo kuwa addimmo la' iyo qaar badan oo kale, oo waxay iyaga dhigeen cagihiisa agtooda, wuuna bogsiiyey.
english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed baa dadkii yaabay goortay arkeen kuwii carrabka la'aa oo hadlaya iyo kuwii lugaha la'aa oo bogsaday iyo kuwii curyaanka ahaa oo socda iyo kuwii indhaha la'aa oo wax arkaya, waxayna ammaaneen Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil.
english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise xertiisii u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Dadka badan ayaan u naxariisanayaa, waayo, durba saddex maalmood ayay ila joogeen, oo waxay cunaanna ma haystaan. Dooni maayo inaan diro iyagoo sooman waaba intaas oo ay jidka ku itaal beelaane.
english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

kikuyu: Xertiisii waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Innagoo meel cidla ah joogna, xaggee baynu ka helaynaa kibis intaa le'eg in dad sida u badanu ka dhergaan?
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi Immisa kibsood baad haysaan? Waxay yidhaahdeen, Toddoba iyo waxoogaa kalluun yaryar ah.
english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dadkii badnaa ku amray inay dhulka fadhiistaan.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

kikuyu: Markaasuu toddobadii kibsood iyo kalluunkii soo qaaday, oo goortuu ku mahadnaqay ayuu kala jejebiyey oo xertii siiyey, xertiina dadkii badnaa ayay siiyeen.
english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

kikuyu: Dhammaantood way wada cuneen oo dhergeen, oo waxay soo ururiyeen toddoba dambiilood oo ka buuxa jajabkii hadhay.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Dadkii cunayna waxay ahaayeen afar kun oo rag ah oo aan naagaha iyo carruurtu ku jirin.
english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

kikuyu: Kolkuu dadkii badnaa diray dabadeed ayuu doonni fuulay, oo wuxuu galay soohdimaha Magadan.
english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

kikuyu: Waxaa u yimid Farrisiintii iyo Sadukiintii iyagoo jirrabaya, oo waxay ka baryeen inuu calaamo cirka ka tuso.
english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Goortii ay makhrib tahay waxaad tidhaahdaan, Waxay noqonaysaa maalin wanaagsan, waayo, cirku waa guduudan yahay.
english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

kikuyu: Aroortiina waxaad tidhaahdaan, Maanta roob baa da'aya, waayo, cirku waa guduudan yahay, waana kicinsan yahay. Waxaad taqaaniin sida loo garto muuqashada cirka, laakiin ma kala garan kartaan calaamooyinka wakhtiyada.
english: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

kikuyu: Waxaa calaamo doonaya qarni shareed oo sina leh, calaamose lama siin doono calaamadii Yoonis maahee. Markaasuu iska daayay iyaga oo ka tegey.
english: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

kikuyu: Markii xertii dhanka kale timid, waxay illoobeen inay kibis sii qaataan.
english: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Iska eega oo iska jira khamiirka Farrisiinta iyo Sadukiinta.
english: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

kikuyu: Markaasay isla wada hadleen oo isku yidhaahdeen, Sababtaasu waa kibistii aannan soo qaadan aawadeed.
english: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

kikuyu: Ciise oo gartay ayaa ku yidhi, Maxaad isula hadlaysaan, rumaysadyarayaalow? Ma kibista aydnan haysan aawadeed baa?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

kikuyu: Miyaydnaan weli garan ama miyaydnaan xusuusnayn shantii kibsood oo shantii kun cuntay, iyo intii dambiilood oo aad ka soo ururiseen?
english: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

kikuyu: Ama toddobadii kibsood oo afartii kun cuntay iyo intii dambiilood oo aad ka soo ururiseen?
english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

kikuyu: Sidee baad u garan weydeen inaanan kibis idinkala hadlayn? Iska jira khamiirka Farrisiinta iyo Sadukiinta.
english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

kikuyu: Markaasay garteen inaanu ku lahayn, Iska jira khamiirka kibista, laakiin waxbaridda Farrisiinta iyo Sadukiinta.
english: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu dhinacyada Kaysariya Filibos yimid ayuu xertiisii weyddiiyey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Dadku yay ku sheegaan Wiilka Aadanaha?
english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

kikuyu: Waxay yidhaahdeen, Qaar waxay yidhaahdaan, Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha, qaarna Eliyaas, qaar kalena waxay yidhaahdaan, Yeremyaah, ama nebiyada midkood.
english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinkuse yaad igu sheegtaan?
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

kikuyu: Simoon Butros ayaa u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaad tahay Masiixa ah Wiilka Ilaaha nool.
english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waad barakaysan tahay Simoon ina Yoonis, waayo, bini-aadmi tan kuuma muujin, laakiin Aabbahayga jannada ku jira ayaa kuu muujiyey.
english: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan kugu leeyahay, Butros baad tahay, oo dhagaxan ayaan ka dul dhisan doonaa kiniisaddayda, oo albaabbadii Haadees kama adkaan doonaan.
english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku siin doonaa furayaasha boqortooyada jannada, oo wax alla wixii aad dhulka ku xidho ayaa jannada ku xidhnaan doona, oo wax alla wixii aad dhulka ku furto ayaa jannada ku furnaan doona.
english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu xertii ku amray inaanay cidna u sheegin inuu Masiixa yahay.
english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

kikuyu: Kolkaa dabadeed Ciise Masiix ayaa bilaabay inuu xertiisii u sheego inay waajib ugu tahay inuu Yeruusaalem tago, oo xanuun badan ka helo waayeellada iyo wadaaddada sare iyo culimmada, oo la dilo, oo maalinta saddexaad la sara kiciyo.
english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros gees u waday oo bilaabay inuu canaanto, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ilaah ha kaa hayo, Sayidow, taasu weligaa kuuma noqon doonto.
english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros ayuu u soo jeestay oo ku yidhi, Gadaal iga mar, Shayddaan yahow. Waad i xumaynaysaaye, waayo, waxyaalaha Ilaah kama fikirtid, waxaadse ka fikirtaa waxyaalaha dadka.
english: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi, Mid uun hadduu doonayo inuu iga daba yimaado, ha dayriyo doonistiisa, iskutallaabtiisana ha soo qaato oo ha i soo raaco.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: Kan doonaya inuu naftiisa badbaadiyo, waa lumin doonaa, oo kan naftiisa u lumiya aawaday wuu heli doonaa.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

kikuyu: Waayo, nin maxay u taraysaa hadduu dunida oo dhan helo oo uu naftiisa lumiyo? Ama nin muxuu u bixiyaa naftiisa beddelkeeda?
english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

kikuyu: Waayo, Wiilka Aadanahu wuxuu ammaanta Aabbihiis kula iman doonaa malaa'igihiisa, markaasuu nin kasta ugu abaalgudi doonaa siduu falay.
english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kuwa halkan taagan qaarkood sinaba dhimasho uma dhadhamin doonaan ilaa ay arkaan Wiilka Aadanaha oo boqortooyadiisa ku imanaya.
english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Lix maalmood dabadeed Ciise wuxuu waday Butros iyo Yacquub iyo walaalkiis Yooxanaa, oo wuxuu keligood geeyey buur dheer.
english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

kikuyu: Hortoodana ayuu ku beddelmay, wejigiisuna sida qorraxda oo kale ayuu u dhalaalay, dharkiisuna sida nuurka oo kale ayuu u caddaaday.
english: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa iyaga u muuqday Muuse iyo Eliyaas oo la hadlaya isaga.
english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros u jawaabay oo wuxuu Ciise ku yidhi, Sayidow, waxaa inoo wanaagsan inaynu halkan joogno. Haddaad doonayso saddex waab ayaan halkan ka dhisayaa, mid adaan kuu dhisayaa, midna Muuse, midna Eliyaas.
english: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

kikuyu: Intuu weli hadlayay, daruur dhalaalaysa ayaa hadhaysay, oo cod baa daruurtii ka soo baxay oo yidhi, Kanu waa Wiilkayga aan jeclahay oo aan ku faraxsanahay. Maqla isaga.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

kikuyu: Xertiina goortay maqleen, ayay wejigooda u dhaceen, aad bayna u baqeen.
english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u yimid oo taabtay oo ku yidhi, Kaca, hana baqina.
english: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Goortay indhahooda kor u qaadeen, cidna ma ay arkin Ciise keliya maahee.
english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

kikuyu: Markay buurta ka soo degayeen, Ciise ayaa amray oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ninna ha u sheegina wixii aad aragteen intaanu Wiilka Aadanahu kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kicin.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

kikuyu: Xertiisii waxay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba culimmadu maxay u yidhaahdaan, Eliyaas waa inuu horta yimaado?
english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa run, Eliyaas waa imanayaa, oo wax walba ayuu soo celin doonaa.
english: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Eliyaas horuu u yimid, wayna garan waayeen, laakiin wax kasta oo ay doonayeen ayay ku sameeyeen isaga. Sidaas oo kalena Wiilka Aadanahu xanuun buu ka heli doonaa iyaga.
english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertiisii garatay inuu kala hadlay Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha.
english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

kikuyu: Goortay dadkii badnaa u yimaadeen, ayaa nin u yimid isaga, oo intuu u jilba joogsaday ayuu ku yidhi,
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

kikuyu: Sayidow, wiilkayga u naxariiso, waayo, suuxdin buu qabaa oo aad buu u xanuunsadaa, oo marar badan wuxuu ku dhacaa dabka, marar badanna biyo,
english: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

kikuyu: oo waxaan u keenay xertaada, wayna bogsiin kari waayeen.
english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Qarni yahow rumaysadka daranu oo madaxa adagu, ilaa goormaan idinla jiri doonaa, oo ilaa goormaan idiin dulqaadan doonaa? Halkan iigu keena isaga.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise canaantay, oo jinnigii waa ka baxay, saacaddaasna wiilkii waa bogsaday.
english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

kikuyu: Markaas xertii ayaa keli ahaan Ciise ugu timid oo ku tidhi, Annagu maxaannu u saari kari waynay?
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa rumaysadyaraantiinna aawadeed. Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Haddaad leedihiin rumaysad iniin khardal le'eg, waxaad buurtan ku odhan doontaan, Halkan ka dhaqaaq oo halkaas tag, wayna dhaqaaqi doontaa, oo waxba ma kari waayi doontaan.
english: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

kikuyu: Laakiin caynkan waxba kuma soo baxo tukasho iyo soon maahee.
english: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

kikuyu: Intay Galili ku warwareegayeen, Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa dadka loo gacangelin doonaa.
english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

kikuyu: Wayna dili doonaan, maalinta saddexaadna waa la sara kicin doonaa. Markaasay aad u calool xumaadeen.
english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

kikuyu: Goortay Kafarna'um yimaadeen, waxaa Butros u yimid kuwii labada daraakmo qaadi jiray, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallinkiinnu labadii daraakmo oo cashuurta ahayd sow ma bixiyo?
english: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu yidhi, Haah, wuu bixiyaa. Oo goortuu guriga galay Ciise ayaa hadal hor mariyey oo ku yidhi, Maxay kula tahay, Simoonow? Boqorrada dhulku yay ka qaadaan cashuurta iyo baadda? Wiilashooda ama shisheeyaha?
english: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

kikuyu: Goortuu yidhi, Shisheeyaha, Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Haddaba wiilashu waa ka reebban yihiin.
english: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

kikuyu: Laakiin si aynan u xumayn iyaga, badda tag, oo jillaab ku tuur, oo kalluunka kolka hore soo baxa soo qaad, oo goortaad afkiisa furtid waxaad ka heli doontaa istater. Kaas qaad oo inooga bixi aniga iyo adigaba.
english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

kikuyu: Saacaddaas ayaa xertii u timid Ciise oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Yaa haddaba boqortooyada jannada ugu weyn?
english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu u yeedhay ilmo yar, oo dhexdooda ayuu joojiyey oo yidhi,
english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Haddaydnan soo jeesan oo aydnaan noqon sida carruur oo kale, boqortooyada jannada ma geli doontaan.
english: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii haddaba isu hoosaysiiya sida ilmahan oo kale, kaas ayaa ugu weyn boqortooyada jannada,
english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: oo ku alla kii magacayga ilmahan oo kale ku aqbalaa, wuu i aqbalaa.
english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

kikuyu: Laakiin ku alla kii xumeeya yaryarkan i rumaystay midkood, waxaa u roon in dhagaxshiid luqunta looga lalmiyo oo badda moolkeeda lagu hafiyo.
english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

kikuyu: Waa u hoog dunida xumaanta aawadeed! Xumaantu waa inay timaado, laakiin waa u hoog ninka ay xumaantu ka timaado.
english: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

kikuyu: Haddii gacantaadu ama cagtaadu ku xumayso, iska jar, oo iska tuur. Waxaa kuu wanaagsan inaad gacanla'aan iyo lugla'aan nolosha ku gashid intii adigoo laba gacmood iyo laba cagood leh lagugu tuuri lahaa dabka weligiis ah.
english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

kikuyu: Haddii ishaaduna ku xumayso iska bixi oo iska tuur. Waxaa kuu wanaagsan inaad il keliya nolosha ku gashid intii adigoo laba indhood leh lagugu tuuri lahaa jahannamada dabka ah.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

kikuyu: Iska jira inaydnaan yaryarkan midkood quudhsan, waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mar walba malaa'igahooda jannada ku jira ayaa wejiga Aabbahayga jannada ku jira eegaya.
english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Waayo, Wiilka Aadanahu wuxuu u yimid inuu badbaadsho kii lumay.
english: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

kikuyu: Maxay idinla tahay, Nin hadduu tiro ido ah leeyahay oo middood ay ka hallowdo, miyaanu sagaal iyo sagaashanka buuraha dushooda kaga tegin oo doonin tii hallowday?
english: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

kikuyu: Oo hadday noqoto inuu helo, runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, taas aad buu ugu farxaa si uusan ugu farxin sagaal iyo sagaashankii aan hallaabin.
english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale, ma aha doonista Aabbihiinna jannada ku jira in yaryarkan midkood lumo.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

kikuyu: Oo haddii walaalkaa kugu dembaabo, u tag oo canaano, adiga iyo isaga keli ahaantiinna. Hadduu ku maqlo, walaalkaa waad soo ceshatay.
english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadduu ku maqli waayo, mid ama laba kale wado, si hadal walba loogu adkeeyo afka laba ama saddex markhaati.
english: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu iyaga maqli waayo, dadka kiniisadda u sheeg, oo hadduu dadka kiniisadda maqli waayona, ha kuu ahaado sida qof aan Ilaah aaminin iyo cashuurqaade.
english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Wax alla wixii aad dhulka ku xidhaan ayaa jannada ku xidhnaan doona, oo wax alla wixii aad dhulka ku furtaan ayaa jannada ku furnaan doona.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

kikuyu: Weliba waxaan idinku leeyahay, Haddii laba idinka mid ahu dhulka ku heshiiyaan wax kastoo ay baryaan, way uga noqon doontaa xagga Aabbahayga jannada ku jira.
english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Waayo, meeshii laba ama saddex qof ay magacayga isugu soo ururaan, halkaas anigu dhexdoodaan joogaa.
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

kikuyu: Markaas Butros ayaa u yimid oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, immisa goor baan cafiyaa walaalkay hadduu igu dembaabo? Ma ilaa toddoba goor baa?
english: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Kugu odhan maayo, Ilaa toddoba goor, laakiin, Ilaa toddobaatan goor oo toddoba ah.
english: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed boqortooyada jannada waxaa loo ekaysiiyaa nin boqor ah oo doonayay inuu addoommadiisa ka xisaab qaato.
english: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

kikuyu: Goortuu bilaabay inuu xisaab qaato waxaa loo keenay nin toban kun oo talanti uu ku lahaa.
english: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu ku bixiyo ma uu haysan. Markaasaa sayidkii wuxuu ku amray in la iibiyo isaga iyo naagtiisa iyo carruurtiisa iyo wuxuu lahaa oo dhan, oo lagu bixiyo.
english: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

kikuyu: Addoonkii haddaba wuu dhacay, oo intuu sujuuday, ayuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Ii dulqaado, anna waan wada bixin doonaaye.
english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

kikuyu: Markaasaa addoonkaas sayidkiisii u naxariistay, wuuna sii daayay, oo amaahdii wuu u dhaafay.
english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

kikuyu: Laakiin addoonkaas ayaa baxay oo helay mid ka mid ah addoommadii uu la shaqayn jiray, kii uu ku lahaa boqol dinaar. Wuu qabtay oo intuu ceejiyey ayuu ku yidhi, Bixi waxa lagugu leeyahay.
english: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

kikuyu: Addoonkii uu la shaqayn jiray ayaa haddaba cagihiisii isku riday oo baryay, oo ku yidhi, Ii dulqaado, anna waan bixin doonaaye.
english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

kikuyu: Isaguse ma uu doonaynin, laakiin wuu baxay oo xabsiga ku tuuray ilaa uu bixiyo wixii lagu lahaa.
english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwii la shaqayn jiray, goortay arkeen wixii dhacay, aad bay u calool xumaadeen, oo intay sayidkooda u yimaadeen, ayay u sheegeen wixii dhacay oo dhan.
english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

kikuyu: Markaasaa sayidkiisii u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Addoon yahow sharkaluhu! Waxaan kugu lahaa oo dhan waan kuu dhaafay, waayo, waad i bariday.
english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

kikuyu: Miyaanad lahayn inaad kii kula shaqayn jiray u naxariisatid sidaan anigu kuugu naxariistay?
english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

kikuyu: Markaasaa sayidkiisu cadhooday oo u dhiibay kuwa dadka silciya ilaa uu bixiyo wixii lagu lahaa oo dhan.
english: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena ayaa Aabbahayga jannada ku jiraa idinku samayn doonaa, haddaan midkiin waliba qalbiga ka cafiyin walaalkiis.
english: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay in, goortuu Ciise hadalladan dhammeeyey, uu Galili ka tegey, oo wuxuu yimid soohdimaha Yahuudiya, oo Webi Urdun ka shisheeya.
english: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

kikuyu: Waxaana soo raacay dad aad u badan, oo halkaas ayuu ku bogsiiyey iyaga.
english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Farrisiintii u timid, iyagoo jirrabaya, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Ma xalaal baa in nin sabab kasta naagtiisa ku furo?
english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Miyaydnaan akhriyin, Kii bilowgii uumay iyaga wuxuu ka dhigay lab iyo dhaddig,
english: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu yidhi, Sababtaas aawadeed nin wuxuu ka tegayaa aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis, wuxuuna la joogayaa naagtiisa, oo labaduba waxay noqonayaan isku jidh?
english: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed haatan iyagu laba ma aha, laakiin waa isku jidh. Haddaba wixii Ilaah isku xidhay, ninna yaanu kala furin.
english: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba Muuse muxuu u amray in warqaddii furniinta iyada la siiyo oo la furo?
english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaa yeelay, Muuse wuxuu idiinku fasaxay inaad naagihiinna furtaan qalbi engegnaantiinna aawadeed, laakiin bilowgii sidaas ma ay ahayn.
english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ku alla kii naagtiisa ku fura wax aan sino ahayn, oo mid kale guursadaa, wuu sinaystaa. Oo kii guursada tii la furay wuu sinaystaa.
english: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

kikuyu: Xertiisii waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haddii nin xaalkiisu sidan yahay xagga naagtiisa, in la guursadaaba ma wanaagsana.
english: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Dadka oo dhammu ereygan ma wada aqbali karaan, kuwii la siiyey mooyaane.
english: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa jira bohommo sidaas kaga dhashay uurkii hooyadood, oo waxaa jira bohommo dadku dhufaanay, oo waxaa jira bohommo isaga dhigay bohommo boqortooyada jannada aawadeed. Kii hadalkan aqbali karaa, ha aqbalo.
english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa ilmo yaryar loo keenay inuu gacmiihiisa saaro oo uu u duceeyo, laakiin xertii ayaa canaanatay.
english: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Ilmaha daaya oo ha u diidina inay ii yimaadaan, waayo, kuwan oo kale ayaa ka mid ah boqortooyada jannada.
english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

kikuyu: Gacmihiisa ayuu saaray iyaga, markaasuu meeshaas ka tegey.
english: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

kikuyu: Oo mid baa intuu yimid ku yidhi, Macallin wanaagsanow, maxaa wanaagsan oo aan sameeyaa inaan nolosha weligeed ah helo?
english: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad wax iiga weyddiinaysaa wanaagga? Waxaa jira mid wanaagsan. Haddaad doonaysid inaad nolosha gashid, qaynuunnada dhawr.
english: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Kuwee? Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Waa inaanad qudh gooyn, Waa inaanad sinaysan, Wan inaanad wax xadin, Waa inaanad marag been ah furin.
english: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

kikuyu: Aabbahaa iyo hooyadaa maamuus, oo Waa inaad deriskaaga u jeclaataa sidaad naftaada u jeceshahay.
english: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

kikuyu: Ninkii dhallinyarada ahaa ayaa ku yidhi, Kuwaas oo dhan ayaan dhawray. Maxaa weli ii dhiman?
english: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Haddaad doonaysid inaad samaatid, tag oo iibi waxaad haysatid, oo masaakiinta sii, oo waxaad jannada ku lahaan doontaa maal; ee kaalay oo i soo raac.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

kikuyu: Ninkii dhallinyarada ahaa goortuu hadalkaas maqlay ayuu baxay isagoo calool xun, waayo, wuxuu ahaa mid waxyaalo badan leh.
english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nin hodan ah inuu boqortooyada jannada galo waa ku adag tahay.
english: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

kikuyu: Haddana waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nin hodan ah inuu boqortooyada Ilaah galo waxaa ka hawl yar in awr irbad daloolkeed ka duso.
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Xertii goortay maqleen aad bay u yaabeen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba yaa badbaadi kara?
english: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

kikuyu: Ciise intuu eegay ayuu ku yidhi, Waxanu uma suurtoobaan dadka, laakiin wax waluba waa u suurtoobaan Ilaah.
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

kikuyu: Markaas Butros ayaa u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Annagu wax walba waannu ka soo wada tagnay, waana ku raacnay. Maxaannu haddaba heli doonnaa?
english: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kuwiinna i soo raacay, wakhtiga cusboonaysiinta, goortii Wiilka Aadanahu carshiga ammaantiisa ku fadhiisto, idinkuna waxaad ku fadhiisan doontaan laba iyo toban carshi, idinkoo xukumaya laba-iyo-tobanka qolo oo Israa'iil.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo mid walba oo ka tegey guryo, ama walaalo, ama aabbe, ama hooyo, ama carruur, ama beero, magacayga aawadiis, wuxuu heli doonaa boqol laab, oo wuxuu dhaxli doonaa nolosha weligeed ah.
english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

kikuyu: Kuwa badan oo hore waa dambayn doonaan, kuwa dambena waa horrayn doonaan.
english: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.

kikuyu: Boqortooyada jannada waxay u eg tahay nin oday reer u ah oo aroortii hore baxay inuu shaqaalayaal u kireeyo beertiisa canabka ah.
english: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

kikuyu: Oo goortuu shaqaalayaal maalintii kula heshiiyey dinaar, ayuu beertiisii canabka ahayd u diray iyagii.
english: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

kikuyu: Oo saacaddii saddexaad ayuu baxay, oo wuxuu arkay qaar kale oo suuqa shuqulla'aan la taagtaagan,
english: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu kuwaas ku yidhi, Idinkuna beerta canabka ah taga oo wixii xaq ah ayaan idin siin doonaa. Wayna tageen.
english: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

kikuyu: Haddana saacaddii lixaad iyo saacaddii sagaalaad wuu baxay oo sidaas oo kale ayuu sameeyey.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

kikuyu: Saacaddii koob iyo tobnaad intuu baxay wuxuu arkay qaar kale oo taagtaagan, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad maalintii oo dhan halkan shuqulla'aan ula taagtaagan tihiin?
english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen Maxaa yeelay, cidna nama kiraysan. Wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinkuna beerta canabka ah taga.
english: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

kikuyu: Goortii makhribkii la gaadhay, sayidkii beertii canabka ahayd ayaa wakiilkiisii ku yidhi, Shaqaalayaasha u yeedh oo mushahaaradooda sii, oo waxaad ka bilowdaa kuwii ugu dambeeyey ilaa kuwii ugu horreeyey.
english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

kikuyu: Goortay yimaadeen, kuwii saacaddii koob iyo tobnaad baxay, waxay wada heleen dinaar dinaar.
english: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

kikuyu: Kuwii hore goortay yimaadeen waxay u malaynayeen inay wax ka badan helayaan, iyaguna sidaas oo kale dinaar dinaar bay heleen.
english: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

kikuyu: Oo intay qaadanayeen ayay odaygii reerka ku gunuunaceen,
english: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Kuwan dambeeyey waxay shaqeeyeen saacad keliya, oo waad nagala mid dhigtay annagoo sidnay shaqadii cuslayd ee maalinta iyo kulaylkii.
english: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu u jawaabay oo midkood ku yidhi, Saaxiibow, xumaan kuguma aan samayn. Sow dinaar igulama heshiin?
english: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

kikuyu: Waxaaga qaado oo tag. Waxaan doonayaa inaan kan ugu dambeeya siiyo intaan ku siiyey oo kale.
english: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

kikuyu: Miyaynan igu hagaagsanayn inaan waxayga ku sameeyo wixii aan doonayo? Ma waxaase ishaadu u xun tahay wanaagsanaantayda aawadeed?
english: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

kikuyu: Sidaasay kuwa dambe u horrayn doonaan, kuwa horena u dambayn doonaan. Waayo, kuwo badan baa loo yeedhay, laakiin kuwo yar baa la doortay.
english: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

kikuyu: Intuu Ciise Yeruusaalem ku socday, laba-iyo-tobankii ayuu keli ahaantood waday, oo intay jidka ku socdeen ayuu ku yidhi,
english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

kikuyu: Waxaynu ku soconnaa Yeruusaalem. Wiilka Aadanahana waxaa loo dhiibi doonaa wadaaddada sare iyo culimmada; oo waxay ku xukumi doonaan dhimasho.
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

kikuyu: Waxayna u dhiibi doonaan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn inay ku kajamaan oo karbaashaan oo iskutallaabta ku qodbaan. Maalinta saddexaadna waa la sara kicin doonaa.
english: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa u timid wiilashii Sebedi hooyadood iyadoo wadata wiilasheedii, wayna u sujuudday oo wax ka bariday.
english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad doonaysaa? Waxay ku tidhi, Amar in labadaydan wiil mid midigtaada, midna bidixdaada, boqortooyadaada ka fadhiistaan.
english: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Garan maysaan waxaad weyddiisanaysaan. Ma karaysaan inaad ka cabtaan koobka aan ku dhowahay inaan ka cabbo, iyo in laydinku baabtiiso baabtiiska laygu baabtiisay? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Waannu karaynaa.
english: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtii koobkayga waad ka cabbi doontaan, oo baabtiiska laygu baabtiisay waa laydinku baabtiisi doonaa, laakiin inaad midigtayda iyo bidixdayda fadhiisataan anigu malihi inaan idin siiyo, laakiin waxaa la siin doonaa kuwa Aabbahay u diyaargareeyey.
