english: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

kikuyu: Tobankii goortay taas maqleen ayay labadii walaalaha ahayd u cadhoodeen.
english: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise ayaa u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Idinku waad garanaysaan in quruumaha madaxdoodu ay u taliyaan, oo kuwooda u waaweynna ay xukun ku leeyihiin.
english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

kikuyu: Laakiin sidaasu dhexdiinna ahaan mayso, laakiin ku alla kii doonaya inuu dhexdiinna u weynaado, midiidinkiinna waa inuu ahaado,
english: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

kikuyu: oo ku alla kii doonaya inuu idiin horreeyo, addoonkiinna waa inuu ahaado,
english: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

kikuyu: sida Wiilka Aadanahu uusan ugu iman in loo adeego laakiin inuu adeego iyo inuu naftiisa dad badan furashadooda u bixiyo.
english: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

kikuyu: Kolkay Yerixoo ka tegayeen waxaa raacay dad aad u badan.
english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

kikuyu: Oo laba nin oo indha la' ayaa jidka ag fadhiyey, oo goortay maqleen in Ciise ag marayo ayay qayliyeen iyagoo leh, Sayidow, ina Daa'uudow, noo naxariiso.
english: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa ayaa canaantay si ay u aamusaan, laakiin si ka badan ayay u qayliyeen iyagoo leh, Sayidow, ina Daa'uudow, noo naxariiso.
english: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise joogsaday, oo intuu u yeedhay ayuu ku yidhi, Maxaad doonaysaan inaan idiin sameeyo?
english: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, in indhuhu noo furmaan ayaannu doonaynaa.
english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

kikuyu: Ciise intuu u naxariistay ayuu indhahooda taabtay oo kolkiiba wax bay arkeen, wayna raaceen.
english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

kikuyu: Goortay Yeruusaalem ku soo dhowaadeen oo ay Beytfaage galeen ilaa Buur Saytuun, markaasaa Ciise laba xer ah diray,
english: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Tuulada idinka soo hor jeedda taga, oo kolkiiba waxaad ka helaysaan dameer xidhan iyo qayl la jooga. Soo fura oo ii keena,
english: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

kikuyu: oo haddii nin wax idinku yidhaahdo, waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Sayidkaa u baahan, oo kolkiiba wuu soo diri doonaa.
english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

kikuyu: Waxanu waa dhaceen in la arko wixii nebiga lagaga dhex hadlay markuu yidhi,
english: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Gabadha Siyoon u sheega, Bal eeg, boqorkaagu waa kuu imanayaa, Isagoo qalbi qabow, oo dameer fuushan Iyo qayl dameereed.
english: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertii tagtay, oo sida Ciise ku amray ayay yeeleen.
english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

kikuyu: Dameertii iyo qaylkii ayay keeneen, oo dharkoodii bay dusha ka saareen, wuuna ku fadhiistay.
english: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

kikuyu: Dadka badidooda ayaa dharkoodii jidka ku goglay, qaar kalena laamo ayay geedaha ka soo jareen oo jidka ku gogleen.
english: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa oo hor socday iyo kuwii daba socday waxay ku qayliyeen, Hoosanna ha u jirto ina Daa'uud. Waxaa barakaysan kan Rabbiga magiciisa ku imanaya, Hoosanna ha ku jirto meelaha ugu sarreeya.
english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

kikuyu: Oo goortuu Yeruusaalem galay, magaalada oo dhan waa kacsanayd, iyagoo leh, Kanu yuu yahay?
english: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa ayaa yidhi, Kanu waa nebiga Ciise la yidhaahdo oo ka yimid Naasared tii Galili.
english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu galay macbudka Ilaah oo ka eryay kulli kuwii macbudka wax ku iibinayay iyo kuwii wax ka iibsanayay, oo wuxuuna rogay miisaskii kuwii lacagta bedbeddelayay iyo kursiyadii kuwii qoolleyaha iibinayay.
english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waa qoran tahay, Gurigayga waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa guriga tukashada, laakiin waxaad ka dhigaysaan god tuugo.
english: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

kikuyu: Waxaana macbudka ugu yimid kuwa indha la' iyo kuwa luga la'; wuuna bogsiiyey.
english: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

kikuyu: Laakiin wadaaddada sare iyo culimmadu goortay arkeen waxyaalaha yaabka leh oo uu suubbiyey iyo carruurta macbudka ka qaylinaysa, iyagoo leh, Hoosanna ha u jirto ina Daa'uud, way cadhoodeen
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

kikuyu: oo ku yidhaahdeen, Ma maqlaysaa kuwanu waxay leeyihiin? Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Haah, miyaydnaan weligiin akhriyin, Ammaanta waxaad ku hagaajisay afka ilmaha yaryar iyo caanonuugga?
english: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ka tegey iyaga oo magaaladii ka baxay ilaa Beytaniya, oo halkaasuu ku hoyday.
english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

kikuyu: Aroortii goortuu magaaladii ku soo noqonayay, wuu gaajaysnaa.
english: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu arkay geed berde ah oo jidka ku ag yaal, kolkaasuu u yimid, waxbana kama uu helin, caleemo keliya maahee. Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Hadda dabadeed weligaa midho yaanay kaa bixin, oo kolkiiba geedkii berdaha ahaa waa engegay.
english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

kikuyu: Xertii goortay arkeen way yaabeen oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Geedkii berdaha ahaa sidee buu kolkiiba u engegay?
english: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Haddaad rumaysan tihiin oo aydnaan shakiyin, wixii geedkii berdaha ahaa ku dhacay oo keliya ma aad samayn doontaan, laakiin weliba haddaad buurtan ku tidhaahdaan, Ruq, baddana isku tuur, way noqonaysaa.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

kikuyu: Oo wax kasta oo aad tukasho ku baridaan idinkoo rumaysan waad heli doontaan.
english: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

kikuyu: Oo goortuu macbudkii galay, intuu wax barayay waxaa u yimid wadaaddadii sare iyo waayeelladii dadka, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Amarkee baad waxan ku samaysaa? Oo yaa amarkan ku siiyey?
english: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Aniguna hal baan idin weyddiinayaa. Haddaad taas ii sheegtaan, aniguna waan idiin sheegi doonaa amarka aan waxan ku sameeyo.
english: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Baabtiiskii Yooxanaa xaggee buu ka yimid? Ma wuxuu ka yimid xagga jannada mise dadka? Dhexdooda ayay iskala hadleen iyagoo leh, Haddaynu nidhaahno, Xagga jannada, wuxuu inagu odhanayaa, Haddaba maxaad u rumaysan weydeen?
english: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii aynu nidhaahno, Xagga dadka, dadka badan ayaynu ka baqaynaa, waayo, Yooxanaa sida nebi oo kale ayay kulli u haystaan.
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

kikuyu: Markaasay Ciise u jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Garan mayno. Isaguna wuxuu ku yidhi, Aniguna idiin sheegi maayo amarka aan waxan ku sameeyo.
english: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Maxay idinla tahay? Nin baa laba wiil lahaa. Wuxuu u yimid kii hore oo ku yidhi, Wiilkaygiiyow, aad beerta canabka ah oo maanta ka shaqee.
english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

kikuyu: Wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Dooni maayo, laakiin kolkaas dabadeed ayuu isqoomameeyey oo aaday.
english: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu u yimid kii labaad, oo sidii oo kale ku yidhi. Isaguna wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa yahay, waan tegayaa, sayidow, laakiin ma uu tegin.
english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

kikuyu: Kee baa labadoodii doonistii aabbihiis yeelay? Waxay yidhaahdeen, Kii hore. Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Cashuurqaadayaasha iyo dhillooyinka ayaa idinka hor geli doona boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

kikuyu: Waayo, Yooxanaa wuxuu idiinku yimid jidka xaqnimada ah, oo waad rumaysan weydeen isaga, laakiin cashuurqaadayaashii iyo dhillooyinkii ayaa rumaystay isaga. Idinkuna goortaad aragteen dabadeed iskama aydnaan qoomamayn si aad u rumaysataan.
english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

kikuyu: Maqla masaal kale. Waxaa jiri jiray nin oday reer u ah, oo beer canab ah beertay, oo ood ku heeraaray, dabadeedna god macsareed ka dhex qoday, oo munaarad ka dhisay, oo niman beerrey ah u kiraystay, oo dal kale tegey.
english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

kikuyu: Oo goortii xilligii midhahu soo dhowaaday ayuu addoommadiisii u soo diray beerreydii inay midhihiisii u soo qaadaan.
english: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

kikuyu: Markaasaa beerreydu addoommadiisii qabatay, mid way garaaceen, mid kalena way dileen, mid kalena way dhagxiyeen.
english: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

kikuyu: Haddana wuxuu diray addoommo kale oo kuwii hore ka badan, iyagiina sidaas oo kalay ku sameeyeen.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

kikuyu: Laakiin dabadeed wuxuu u soo diray wiilkiisii isagoo leh, Wiilkayga way maamuusi doonaan.
english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

kikuyu: Laakiin beerreydii goortay wiilkii arkeen, waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Kanu waa kii dhaxalka lahaa, kaalaya aan dilnee oo dhaxalkiisa aynu qaadannee.
english: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

kikuyu: Way qabteen oo beertii canabka ahayd dibaddeeda ku tuureen, wayna dileen.
english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

kikuyu: Haddaba sayidkii beerta canabka ah goortuu yimaado, muxuu beerreydaas ku samayn doonaa?
english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Nimankaas belaayada ah si baas buu u baabbi'in doonaa; beerta canabka ahna wuxuu u kiraysan doonaa beerrey kale, kuwa isaga siin doona midhihiisa xilligooda.
english: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi iyaga, Miyaanaydin weligiin Qorniinka ka akhriyin, Dhagaxii kuwa wax dhisaa ay diideen, Wuxuu noqday madaxa rukunka. Tanu xagga Rabbiga bay ka timid, Oo waa ku yaab indhahayaga?
english: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed waxaan idinku leeyahay, Boqortooyada Ilaah waa laydinka qaadi doonaa, oo waxaa la siin doonaa dad midhihii boqortooyada bixiya.
english: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

kikuyu: Oo kan dhagaxan ku dhacaa, wuu jejebi doonaa, oo kan uu ku dhaco, wuu burburin doonaa.
english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

kikuyu: Wadaaddadii sare iyo Farrisiintii goortay masaalladiisii maqleen waxay garteen inuu iyagu ka hadlay.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

kikuyu: Goortay dooneen inay qabtaan ayay dadkii badnaa ka baqeen, waayo, waxay u haysteen nebi.
english: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo mar kale masaallo kula hadlay, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

kikuyu: Boqortooyada jannada waxay la mid tahay sidii boqor wiilkiisa aroos u dhigay.
english: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

kikuyu: Addoommadiisii ayuu u diray inay u yeedhaan kuwa arooska loogu yeedhay, mana ay doonaynin inay yimaadaan.
english: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

kikuyu: Haddana addoommo kale ayuu diray oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Kuwii loo yeedhay waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Bal eega, cuntadaydii waan diyaargareeyey, dibiyadaydii iyo neefafkaygii buurbuurnaana waa la qalay, wax walubana waa diyar, ee arooska kaalaya.
english: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

kikuyu: Laakiin way fududaysteen, oo iska tageen, mid beertiisuu aaday, mid kalena wuxuu aaday baayacmushtarigiisii.
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

kikuyu: Kuwii kalena addoommadiisii ayay qabteen, wayna caayeen oo dileen.
english: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

kikuyu: Laakiin boqorkii markuu maqlay wuu cadhooday, oo askartiisii buu u diray oo baabbi'iyey kuwaasoo dhiig qabay, magaaladoodiina wuu gubay.
english: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

kikuyu: Markaasuu addoommadiisii ku yidhi, Arooskii waa diyaar, kuwii loo yeedhayse ma ay istaahilin.
english: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

kikuyu: Haddaba taga meesha jidadka ku kala leexdaan, oo in alla intaad heshaan arooska ugu yeedha.
english: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa addoommadaas jidadkay u baxeen, oo ay soo ururiyeen kuwii ay heleen oo dhan, kuwii sharka lahaa iyo kuwii wanaagsanaaba; gurigii arooskana waxaa laga buuxiyey marti.
english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

kikuyu: Laakiin boqorkii kolkuu soo galay inuu martida eego, wuxuu meesha ku arkay nin aan dharkii arooska qabin,
english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Saaxiibow, sidee baad halkan u soo gashay adigoo aan dharkii arooska qabin? Wuuna iska aamusay.
english: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii wuxuu midiidinyadii ku yidhi, Lugaha iyo gacmaha ka xidha, oo gudcurka dibadda ah ku tuura; halkaas waxaa jiri doonta baroor iyo ilko jirriqsi.
english: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwo badan baa loo yeedhay, laakiin kuwo yar baa la doortay.
english: For many are called, but few chosen.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Farrisiintii baxeen, oo waxay ka wada hadleen si ay hadalkiisa ugu qabtaan.
english: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

kikuyu: Waxay xertoodii ula soo direen Herodosiinta, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, waannu og nahay inaad run tahay, oo aad dadka jidka Ilaah run ku bartid, oo aanad ninna u eexan, waayo, dadka wejigooda ma eegtid.
english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

kikuyu: Haddaba noo sheeg waxay kula tahay, Ma xalaal baa in cashuur Kaysar la siiyo ama inaan la siin?
english: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise ayaa sharkoodii gartay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad ii jirrabaysaan, labawejiilayaal yahow?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

kikuyu: I tusa lacagta cashuurta. Kolkaasay u keeneen dinaar.
english: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Yaa leh masawirkan iyo qorniinkan?
english: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Kaysar baa leh. Markaasuu ku yidhi, Haddaba Kaysar siiya wixii Kaysar leeyahay, Ilaahna siiya wixii Ilaah leeyahay.
english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

kikuyu: Oo goortay taas maqleen, way yaabeen, wayna iska daayeen oo ka tageen.
english: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

kikuyu: Maalintaas waxaa u yimid Sadukiin kuwii odhan jiray, Sarakicidda kuwii dhintay ma jirto. Oo waxay weyddiiyeen,
english: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

kikuyu: oo ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, Muuse wuxuu yidhi, Haddii nin dhinto isagoo aan carruur lahayn, walaalkiis waa inuu naagtiisa dumaalo oo uu carruur walaalkiis u dhalo.
english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

kikuyu: Waxaa nala jiray toddoba walaalo ah. Kii ugu horreeyey ayaa guursaday, wuuna dhintay, dhalna ma lahayn, wuxuuna naagtiisii uga tegey walaalkiis.
english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalaa ku dhacday kii labaad, iyo kii saddexaad ilaa kii toddobaad.
english: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

kikuyu: Markay wada dhinteen dabadeed naagtiina waa dhimatay.
english: After them all, the woman died.

kikuyu: Haddaba wakhtiga sarakicidda kuwii dhintay toddobadoodii kee bay naagtiisii ahaan doontaa? Waayo, kulligood way wada guursadeen iyada.
english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waad qaldan tihiin oo garan maysaan Qorniinka iyo xoogga Ilaah.
english: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, wakhtiga sarakicidda kuwii dhintay dabadeed, layskuma guursado, guurna layskuma siiyo, laakiin waxay yihiin sida malaa'igaha Ilaah oo jannada ku jira.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

kikuyu: Laakiin xagga sarakicidda kuwii dhintay miyaydnaan akhriyin wixii Ilaah idinkula hadlay, markuu yidhi,
english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay Ilaaha Ibraahim iyo Ilaaha Isxaaq iyo Ilaaha Yacquub? Isagu ma aha Ilaaha kuwa dhintay, laakiin waa Ilaaha kuwa nool.
english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa goortay taas maqleen ayay waxbariddiisii ka yaabeen.
english: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

kikuyu: Laakiin Farrisiintii goortay maqleen inuu Sadukiintii aamusiiyey ayay isu yimaadeen.
english: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

kikuyu: Oo midkood oo sharciga yaqaan ayaa wax weyddiiyey, isagoo jirrabaya, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

kikuyu: Macallimow, qaynuunkee baa sharciga uga weyn?
english: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ku yidhi isaga, Waa inaad Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah ka jeclaataa qalbigaaga oo dhan iyo naftaada oo dhan iyo caqligaaga oo dhan.
english: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

kikuyu: Kanu waa qaynuunka ugu weyn oo ugu horreeya.
english: This is the first and great commandment.

kikuyu: Ku labaad oo u ekina waa kan. Waa inaad deriskaaga u jeclaataa sida naftaada.
english: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

kikuyu: Sharcigii oo dhan iyo nebiyadiiba waxay sudhan yihiin labadan qaynuun.
english: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

kikuyu: Kolkii Farrisiintii isu yimaadeen ayaa Ciise wax weyddiiyey,
english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Yuu idinla yahay Masiixu? Waa ina ayo? Kolkaasay ku yidhaahdeen, Waa ina Daa'uud.
english: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaba Daa'uud sidee buu Ruuxa ugaga yeedhay Rabbi? isagoo leh,
english: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbigu wuxuu Sayidkayga ku yidhi, Midigtayda fadhiiso, Ilaa aan cadaawayaashaada cagahaaga hoostooda geliyo.
english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

kikuyu: Haddaba Daa'uud hadduu ugu yeedhay isaga Sayid, sidee buu wiilkiisa u yahay?
english: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

kikuyu: Ninna hadal uguma jawaabi karin, oo maalintaas dabadeed ninna kuma dhicin inuu mar dambe wax weyddiiyo.
english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

kikuyu: Dabadeed Ciise ayaa dadkii badnaa iyo xertiisii la hadlay,
english: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Culimmada iyo Farrisiinta waxay ku fadhiistaan kursiga Muuse.
english: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

kikuyu: Haddaba wax walba oo ay idiin sheegaan inaad dhawrtaan, dhawra oo yeela, laakiin siday sameeyaan ha samaynina, waayo, wax bay yidhaahdaan, mana sameeyaan.
english: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

kikuyu: Waxay isku xidhxidhaan culaabo culculus oo waxay saaraan dadka garbihiisa, laakiin iyagu dooni maayaan inay fartooda ku dhaqaajiyaan.
english: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

kikuyu: Laakiin shuqulkooda oo dhan waxay u sameeyaan in dadku arko, waayo, xirsiyadooda way ballaadhiyaan, oo faraqa dharkoodana way weyneeyaan;
english: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

kikuyu: waxay jecel yihiin meelaha hore oo diyaafadaha, iyo kursiyada hore oo sunagogyada,
english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

kikuyu: iyo salaanta suuqa, iyo in dadku ugu yeedhaan, Macallin.
english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

kikuyu: Laakiin yaan laydiinku yeedhin, Macallin, waayo, mid baa macallinkiinna ah, idinkuna kulli walaalo baad tihiin.
english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

kikuyu: Ninna dhulka ha ugu yeedhina aabbe, waayo, mid baa Aabbihiin ah, kaasu waa kan jannada ku jira.
english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Yaan laydiinku yeedhin sayiddo, waayo, mid baa sayidkiinna ah, kaasu waa Masiixa.
english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiin kan idiinku weyn waa inuu ahaado midiidinkinna.
english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

kikuyu: Oo ku alla kii isa sarraysiiya waa la hoosaysiin doonaa, oo ku alla kii is-hoosaysiiyana waa la sarraysiin doonaa.
english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa idiin hoog, culimmo iyo Farrisiin yahay oo labawejiilayaasha ahu, waayo, boqortooyada jannada ayaad dadka ka xidhaan, maxaa yeelay, idinku ma gashaan, oo kuwa gelayana uma deysaan inay galaan.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, culimmo iyo Farrisiin yahay, labawejiilayaasha ahu, waayo, waxaad laasataan guryaha carmallada, oo tukashooyin dhaadheer ayaad istusid u tukataan, sidaa darteed waxaad heli doontaan xisaab aad u daran.
english: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, culimmo iyo Farrisiin yahay, labawejiilayaasha ahu, waayo, badda iyo dhulka waxaad u wareegtaan inaad mid soo hadaysaan, oo kolkuu sidaas noqdo, waxaad ka dhigtaan wiilka jahannamada laba kol in idinka badan idinka.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, hoggaamiyayaal yahow indhaha la'u oo leh, Ku alla kii macbudka ku dhaarta, waxba ma aha, laakiin ku alla kii dahabkii macbudka ku dhaarta, wuxuu ku dhaartay waa lagu leeyahay.
english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

kikuyu: Doqonno yahow indhaha la'u, kee baa weyn, dahabka iyo macbudka dahabka quduus ka dhiga?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaad leedihiin, Ku alla kii meesha allabariga ku dhaarta waxba ma aha, laakiin ku alla kii ku dhaarta hadiyadda dul saaran, wuxuu ku dhaartay waa lagu leeyahay.
english: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

kikuyu: Indhoolayaal yahow, haddaba kee baa weyn, hadiyadda iyo meesha allabariga oo hadiyadda quduus ka dhigta?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

kikuyu: Haddaba kan meesha allabariga ku dhaartaa, wuxuu ku dhaartaa iyada iyo wixii dul saaran oo dhanba.
english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

kikuyu: Oo kii macbudka ku dhaartaa, wuxuu ku dhaartaa isaga iyo kan dhex degganba.
english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

kikuyu: Oo kii jannada ku dhaartaana, wuxuu ku dhaartaa carshiga Ilaah iyo kan ku dul fadhiyaba.
english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, culimmo iyo Farrisiin yahay, labawejiilayaasha ahu, waayo, reexaanta iyo kabsarta iyo kamuunta toban meelood ayaad meel ka bixisaan, oo waxaad dhaafteen wixii sharciga ugu cuslaa, waxaa weeye xukunka iyo naxariista iyo iimaanka. Waxaad lahaydeen inaad waxan samaysaan oo aydnaan kuwa kale dhaafin.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

kikuyu: Hoggaamiyayaal yahow indhaha la'u oo kaneecada iska miira oo awrka liqa.
english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, culimmo iyo Farrisiin yahay, labawejiilayaasha ahu, waayo, koobka iyo saxanka dushaad ka nadiifisaan, laakiin gudaha waxaa ka buuxa dulun iyo damacbadnaan.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Farrisi yahow indhaha la'u, horta koobka gudaha ka nadiifi in dushiisuna nadiifsanaato.
english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, culimmo iyo Farrisiin yahay, labawejiilayaasha ahu, waayo, waxaad u eg tihiin xabaalo la caddeeyey, kuwa dushoodu u eg tahay wax qurxoon, laakiin hoosta waxaa ka buuxa lafo dad dhintay iyo wasakh oo dhan.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena idinku dusha waxaad dadka ugu eg tihiin dad xaq ah, laakiin gudaha waxaa idinka buuxa labawejiilenimo iyo dembi.
english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, culimmo iyo Farrisiin yahay, labawejiilayaasha ahu, waayo, waxaad dhistaan xabaalaha nebiyada, oo waxaad qurxisaan qabriyada kuwii xaqa ahaa;
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

kikuyu: oo waxaad tidhaahdaan, Haddii aannu waagii awowayaashayo joogi lahayn, annagu kala ma aannan qayb galneen kuwii dhiigga nebiyada qabay.
english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

kikuyu: Sidaasaad isugu marag furaysaan inaad tihiin wiilasha kuwii nebiyada dilay.
english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

kikuyu: Idinku haddaba dhammaystira qiyaastii awowayaashiin.
english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

kikuyu: Abeesooyin yahow, dhal jilbisay, sidee baad uga baxsan doontaan xisaabta jahannamada?
english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed, waxaan idiin soo dirayaa nebiyo iyo kuwa xigmadda leh iyo culimmo. Qaarkood waad dili doontaan oo iskutallaabta ku qodbi doontaan, qaarkoodna sunagogyadiinna ayaad ku karbaashi doontaan, oo magaalo ilaa magaalo ayaad ku silcin doontaan,
english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

kikuyu: inuu dushiinna ku soo dego dhiiggii xaqa ahaa oo dhulka ku daatay oo dhan oo laga bilaabo dhiigga Haabiil kii xaqa ahaa ilaa dhiigga Sakariyas ina Barakiyas kan aad ku disheen meesha quduuska ah iyo meeshii allabariga dhexdooda.
english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Waxyaalahan oo dhan ayaa qarnigan ku dul degi doona.
english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

kikuyu: Yeruusaalemay, Yeruusaalemay, tan nebiyada dishoy oo kuwa loo soo diray dhagxisoy! Intee baan marar badan jeclaaday inaan carruurtaada u soo ururiyo xataa sida dooradu carruurteeda baalasheeda hoostooda ugu ururiso, laakiin idinku ma aydnaan jeclayn.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

kikuyu: Bal eega, gurigiinnii waa laydiin daayay isagoo cidla ah.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ima arki doontaan hadda dabadeed ilaa aad tidhaahdaan, Waxaa barakaysan kan Rabbiga magiciisa ku imanaya.
english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa macbudka ka baxay, oo intuu tegayay ayaa xertiisii u timid inay tusaan dhismaha macbudka.
english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Miyaydnaan waxyaalahan oo dhan arkaynin? Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Halkan lagu dul dayn maayo dhagax dhagax kale dushiisa oo aan la dumin doonin.
english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Oo goortuu Buur Saytuun fadhiistay, xertii ayaa keli ahaan ugu timid oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Noo sheeg, Goormay waxyaalahanu ahaan doonaan, oo calaamada imaatinkaaga iyo dhammaadka wakhtiga dunidu maxay ahaan doontaa?
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Iska eega yaan laydin khiyaanayn.
english: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

kikuyu: Waayo, qaar badan ayaa magacayga ku iman doona, oo waxay odhan doonaan, Anigu waxaan ahay Masiixa, oo qaar badan ayay khiyaanayn doonaan.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad maqli doontaan dagaallo iyo dagaallo hadalhayntood. Iska jira, hana baqanina, waayo, waxaasu waa inay dhacaan, laakiin dhammaadku weli weeye.
english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

kikuyu: Waayo, quruunba quruun bay ku kici doontaa, boqortooyona boqortooyo, oo waxaa meelo kala duwan ka dhici doona abaaro iyo dhulgariir.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

kikuyu: Waxan oo dhammu waa bilowga hoogagga.
english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dhib laydiin gaysan doonaa, waana laydin dili doonaa, oo magacayga aawadiis ayaa quruumaha oo dhammi idiin nebcaan doonaan.
english: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Maarkaas qaar badan ayaa xumaan doona, midba mid buu gacangelin doonaa, wayna isnebcaan doonaan.
english: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

kikuyu: Waxaa kici doona nebiyo badan oo been ah, oo qaar badan ayay khiyaanayn doonaan.
english: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Dembigu waa badnaan doonaa, taa aawadeed qaar badan jacaylkoodu waa yaraan doonaa.
english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

kikuyu: Laakiin kii adkaysta ilaa ugu dambaysta, kaasaa badbaadi doona.
english: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: Oo injiilkan boqortooyada ayaa dunida oo dhan lagu wacdiyi doonaa inuu marag u noqdo Quruumaha oo dhan, dabadeedna ugudambaysta ayaa iman doonta.
english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

kikuyu: Haddaba goortaad aragtaan waxa baas oo hallaynta ah ee lagaga hadlay nebi Daanyeel, oo taagan meesha quduuska ah (kii akhriyaa ha garto),
english: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

kikuyu: markaas kuwa Yahuudiya joogaa, buuraha ha u carareen.
english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

kikuyu: Kii guri fuushanuna yaanu u soo degin inuu wixii gurigiisa ku jira soo qaato.
english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

kikuyu: Kii beerta joogaana yaanu dib ugu noqon inuu dharkiisa soo qaato.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa u hoog kuwa uurka leh iyo kuwa wakhtigaas ilmo nuujinaya.
english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

kikuyu: Barya inaan cararkiinnu noqon wakhtiga qabowga ama sabtida.
english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

kikuyu: Waayo, markaas waxaa jiri doona dhib weyn sida mid aan jirin tan iyo dunida bilowgeedii ilaa hadda, mana jiri doonto weligeed.
english: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

kikuyu: Oo haddaan wakhtigaas la gaabin ninna ma uu badbaadeen, laakiin kuwa la doortay aawadood ayaa wakhtigaas loo gaabin doonaa.
english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

kikuyu: Maarkaas haddii laydinku yidhaahdo, Waa kan Masiixa ama waa kaas, ha rumaysanina.
english: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa kici doona Masiixyo been ah iyo nebiyo been ah, oo waxay samayn doonaan calaamooyin waaweyn iyo yaabab, si ay xataa kuwa la doortay u khiyaaneeyaan hadday u suurtowdo.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

kikuyu: Bal eega, horaan idiinku sheegaye.
english: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

kikuyu: Haddaba hadday idinku yidhaahdaan, Bal eega, wuxuu joogaa cidlada, ha u bixina. Bal eega, wuxuu joogaa qolalka qarsoon, ha rumaysanina.
english: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida hillaacu bari uga yimaado oo u ifiyo galbeed, sidaas oo kale ayaa imaatinka Wiilka Aadanahu ahaan doonaa.
english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Meel alla meeshii bakhtigu yaal, halkaas ayaa gorgorraduna isugu ururi doonaan.
english: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

kikuyu: Laakiin dhibta wakhtigaas dabadeed, kolkiiba qorraxdu waa madoobaan doontaa, dayuxuna ma nuuri doono, xiddiguhuna cirka waa ka soo dhici doonaan, xoogagga cirkana waa la gariirin doonaa.
english: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa cirka ka soo muuqan doona calaamada Wiilka Aadanaha, markaas ayaa qolooyinka dhulka oo dhammu barooran doonaan, oo waxay arki doonaan Wiilka Aadanaha oo daruuraha cirka ku imanaya isagoo leh xoog iyo ammaan weyn.
english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu soo diri doonaa malaa'igihiisa oo wata buun weyn, oo kuwuu doortay ayay ka soo ururin doonaan afarta jahood cirka meesha ugu fog ilaa meesheeda kale.
english: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

kikuyu: Haddeer geedka berdaha ah masaal ka garta. Intii laantiisu curdan tahay oo caleemo bixinayso, waxaad garanaysaan inuu roobku dhow yahay.
english: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

kikuyu: Idinkuna sidaas oo kale goortaad waxan oo dhan aragtaan, garta inuu dhow yahay oo albaabbada ag joogo.
english: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Qarniganu ma idlaan doono intaanay waxan oo dhammi dhicin.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Cirka iyo dhulku waa idlaan doonaan, laakiinse ereyadaydu ma idlaan doonaan.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

kikuyu: Laakiin maalintaas iyo saacaddaas ninna waxba kama oga, malaa'igaha jannada iyo Wiilka toona, midna ma oga, Aabbahay keliya maahee.
english: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

kikuyu: Sida wakhtigii Nuux ahaa, sidaas oo kale ayaa imaatinka Wiilka Aadanahu ahaan doonaa.
english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Waayo, siday wax u cunayeen oo wax u cabbayeen, oo u guursanayeen oo loogu guurinayay maalmihii daadka hortiisa ilaa maalintii Nuux doonnida galay,
english: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

kikuyu: wayna garan waayeen ilaa daadkii yimid oo kulligood wada qaaday, sidaas oo kale ayaa imaatinka Wiilka Aadanahu ahaan doonaa.
english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Markaas laba nin ayaa beerta ku jiri doona, mid waa la qaadi doonaa, midna waa laga tegi doonaa.
english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

kikuyu: Laba naagood ayaa dhagax wax ku shiidi doona, mid waa la qaadi doonaa, midna waa laga tegi doonaa.
english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

kikuyu: Haddaba soo jeeda, waayo, ma aad ogidin maalinta Rabbigiinnu imanayo.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

kikuyu: Laakiin tan ogaada, odayga reerku hadduu ogaan lahaa wakhtiga tuuggu imanayo, wuu soo jeedi lahaa, oo ma uu daayeen in gurigiisa la jebiyo.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed idinkuna diyaar ahaada, waayo, saacad aydnaan u malaynaynin ayaa Wiilka Aadanahu imanayaa.
english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

kikuyu: Haddaba yuu yahay addoonka aaminka ah oo caqliga leh, kan sayidkiisu dadka gurigiisa u sarreeysiiyey inuu cuntada siiyo wakhtigeeda?
english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan addoonkaas kan sayidkiisu goortuu yimaado uu helayo isagoo sidaas samaynaya.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Wuxuu leeyahay oo dhan ayuu ka sarreeysiin doonaa isaga.
english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii addoonkaas sharka leh qalbigiisa ka yidhaahdo, Sayidkaygu waa raagay,
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

kikuyu: oo uu bilaabo inuu garaaco kuwii la shaqayn jiray, oo uu wax la cuno oo wax la cabbo kuwa sakhraanka ah,
english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

kikuyu: addoonkaas sayidkiisu wuxuu iman doonaa maalin aanu filayn iyo saacad aanu ogayn,
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

kikuyu: oo waa kala jeexi doonaa oo wuxuu ka dhigi doonaa mid qayb la hela labawejiilayaasha. Halkaa waxaa jiri doonta baroor iyo ilko jirriqsi.
english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

kikuyu: Haddaba boqortooyada jannada waxaa loo ekaysiin doonaa toban gabdhood oo bikrado ah, kuwa intay laambadahooda qaateen, u baxay inay ninka arooska ah ka hor tagaan.
english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

kikuyu: Shantood waxay ahaayeen doqonno, shanna caqli bay lahaayeen.
english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

kikuyu: Kuwii doqonnada ahaa laambadahoodii bay qaateen, laakiin saliid ma ay qaadan.
english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

kikuyu: Kuwa caqliga lahaase laambadahoodii bay qaateen iyo weelal saliidu ku jirto.
english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

kikuyu: Laakiin ninkii arooska ahaa waa raagay, taas daraaddeed ayay wada lulmoodeen oo seexdeen.
english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

kikuyu: Habeenbadhkiise qaylo ayaa yeedhay, Arooskii waa soo socdaaye, soo baxa oo ka hor taga.
english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

kikuyu: Markaasaa bikradihii oo dhammu wada kaceen oo laambadahoodii hagaajiyeen.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

kikuyu: Kuwii doqonnada ahaa waxay kuwii caqliga lahaa ku yidhaahdeen, Saliiddiinna wax naga siiya, waayo, laambadahayagii waa demayaan.
english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

kikuyu: Laakiin kuwii caqliga lahaa ayaa u jawaabay oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Maya, waaba intaas oo ay nagu filnaan waydaa annaga iyo idinka; bal u taga kuwa iibiya oo ka soo iibsada.
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

kikuyu: Markay tageen inay soo iibsadaan, ninkii arooska ahaa ayaa yimid, oo kuwii diyaarka ahaa ayaa la galay guriga arooska, albaabkiina waa la xidhay.
english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

kikuyu: Dabadeedna waxaa yimid bikradihii kale, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, Sayidow, naga fur.
english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Anigu idin garan maayo.
english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

kikuyu: Haddaba soo jeeda, waayo, garan maysaan maalinta ama saacadda.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, waa sidii nin dal kale tegaya, oo addoommadiisii u yeedhay oo xoolihiisii u dhiibay.
english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

kikuyu: Mid wuxuu siiyey shan talanti, midna wuxuu siiyey laba, midna wuxuu siiyey mid; mid kasta sidii tabartiisu ahayd, markaasuu dhoofay.
english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

kikuyu: Isla markiiba kii shantii talanti helay ayaa tegey oo ku baayacmushtaray, oo wuxuu faa'iiday shan talanti oo kale.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale kii labada helayna, laba kale ayuu faa'iiday.
english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

kikuyu: Kii midka helayse, wuu baxay oo dhulka qoday oo lacagtii sayidkiisii ayuu ku qariyey.
english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

kikuyu: Wakhti dheer dabadeed sayidkii addoommadaas ayaa yimid oo ka xisaab qaatay.
english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

kikuyu: Kii shantii talanti helay ayaa yimid oo keenay shan talanti oo kale, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, waxaad ii dhiibtay shan talanti; eeg, shan talanti oo kale ayaan ka faa'iiday.
english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: Sayidkiisii ayaa ku yidhi, Si wanaagsan baad yeeshay, addoon yahow wanaagsan oo aaminka ahu. Wax yar ayaad aamin ku ahayd, wax badan baan madax kaaga dhigayaa. Farxadda sayidkaaga gal.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

kikuyu: Kii labadii talanti helayna waa yimid oo yidhi, Sayidow, waxaad ii dhiibtay laba talanti; eeg, laba talanti oo kale ayaan ka faa'iiday.
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: Sayidkiisii ayaa ku yidhi, Si wanaagsan baad yeeshay, addoon yahow wanaagsan oo aaminka ahu. Wax yar ayaad aamin ku ahayd, wax badan baan madax kaaga dhigayaa. Farxadda sayidkaaga gal.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

kikuyu: Kii talantigii keliya helayna waa u yimid oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, waan ku garanayay inaad tahay nin qalbi engegan, oo aad wax ka guratid meel aanad wax ku beeran oo aad wax ka urursatid meel aanad wax ku firdhin.
english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

kikuyu: Waana baqay, oo intaan tegey ayaan talantigaagii dhulka ku qariyey. Bal eeg, waa kan kaagii.
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa sayidkiisii u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Addoon yahow sharka leh oo caajiska ahu, waad ogayd inaan wax ka gurto meel aanan wax ku beeran, oo aan wax ka urursado meel aanan wax ku firdhin.
english: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaad lahayd inaad lacagtayda u dhiibto kuwa baangiga jooga, oo goortaan soo noqdo, waxayga iyo faa'iido ayaan qaadan lahaa.
english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

kikuyu: Haddaba talantigii ka qaada oo u dhiiba kan tobanka talanti haya.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

kikuyu: Waayo, mid walba oo wax haysta waa la siin doonaa, waana loo badin doonaa, kii aan waxba haysanse waa laga qaadi doonaa xataa wuxuu haysto.
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

kikuyu: Oo addoonka aan waxtarka lahayn ku tuura gudcurka dibadda ah. Halkaas waxaa jiri doonta baroor iyo ilko jirriqsi.
english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

kikuyu: Goortii Wiilka Aadanahu ammaantiisa ku yimaado, isaga iyo malaa'igaha oo dhan, markaasuu carshiga ammaantiisa ku fadhiisan doonaa.
english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

kikuyu: Quruumaha oo dhan ayaa hortiisa lagu soo ururin doonaa oo wuxuu u kala sooci doonaa mid mid sida adhijirku u kala sooco idaha iyo riyaha.
english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

kikuyu: Idaha wuxuu joojin doonaa midigtiisa, riyahana bidixdiisa.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqorku kuwa midigtiisa jooga ku odhan doonaa, Kaalaya, kuwa Aabbahay barakeeyeyow, oo dhaxla boqortooyada tan iyo aasaaskii dunida laydiin diyaargareeyey.
english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

kikuyu: Waayo, waan gaajooday oo cuntaad i siiseen, waan harraadsanaa oo waad i waraabiseen, qariib baan ahaa oo waad i soo dhoweeyseen,
english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

kikuyu: waan qaawanaa oo dhar baad i huwiseen, waan bukay oo waad i soo booqateen, xabsi baan ku jiray oo waad ii timaadeen.
english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa kuwa xaqa ahu u jawaabi doonaan iyagoo leh, Sayidow, goormaannu ku aragnay adigoo gaajaysan oo aannu cunto ku siinnay, ama adigoo harraadsan oo aannu ku waraabinnay?
english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

kikuyu: Goormaannu ku aragnay adigoo qariib ah oo aannu ku soo dhowaynay ama adigoo qaawan oo aannu wax ku huwinnay?
english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

kikuyu: Goormaannu ku aragnay adigoo buka ama adigoo xabsi ku jira oo aannu kuu nimid?
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

kikuyu: Markaasaa Boqorkii u jawaabi doonaa oo ku odhan doonaa, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, In alla intaad u samayseen mid ka mid ah walaalahaygan u yaryar, waad ii samayseen.
english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu kuwa bidixdiisa jooga ku odhan doonaa, Kuwa yahow inkaaranu, iga taga oo gala dabka weligiis ah kan Ibliiska iyo malaa'igihiisa loo diyaargareeyey.
english: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

kikuyu: Waayo, waan gaajooday, cuntona ima aydnaan siin, waan harraadsanaa, imana aydnaan waraabin.
english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

kikuyu: Qariib baan ahaa, imana aydnaan soo dhowayn, waan qaawanaa, dharna ima aydnaan huwin, waanan bukay oo xabsi ku jiray oo ima aydnaan soo booqan.
english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

kikuyu: Iyaguna markaasay u jawaabi doonaan oo ku odhan doonaan, Sayidow, goormaannu ku aragnay adigoo gaajaysan ama harraadsan ama qariib ah ama qaawan ama buka ama xabsi ku jira oo aannu ku kalmayn waynay?
english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabi doonaa oo ku odhan doonaa, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, In alla intaad u samayn weydeen mid ka mid ah kuwan u yaryar, anigana waad ii samayn weydeen.
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

kikuyu: Kuwanuna waxay geli doonaan taqsiirta weligeed ah, kuwa xaqa ahuse waxay geli doonaan nolosha weligeed ah.
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay goortii Ciise hadalladan oo dhan dhammeeyey, inuu xertiisii ku yidhi,
english: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: Waxaad og tihiin laba maalmood dabadeed inay tahay Iiddii Kormaridda, oo Wiilka Aadanaha waxaa loo gacangelinayaa in iskutallaabta lagu qodbo.
english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaaddadii sare iyo waayeelladii dadka waxay isku urursadeen barxadda wadaadkii sare oo Kayafas la odhan jiray.
english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ka wada hadleen si ay Ciise khiyaano ugu qabtaan oo ay u dilaan.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxay yidhaahdeen, Yaanay noqon wakhtiga iidda si aan rabshad dadka uga dhex kicin.
english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu Beytaniya joogay oo ku jiray guriga Simoon kii baraska qabi jiray,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

kikuyu: waxaa u timid naag haysa weel alabastar ah oo cadar qaali ah ku jiro, oo waxay ku shubtay madaxiisa intuu cuntada u fadhiyey.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

kikuyu: Laakiin xertu goortay arkeen, way cadhoodeen oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Khasaaradanu maxay ku noqotay?
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

kikuyu: Waayo, kan waxaa lagu iibin kari lahaa wax badan oo masaakiinta la siin lahaa.
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu gartay ayuu ku yidhi, Maxaad naagta u dhibaysaan? Shuqul wanaagsan ayay igu samaysaye.
english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

kikuyu: Waayo, masaakiintu mar walba way idinla jiraan, aniguse mar walba idinlama joogo.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

kikuyu: Waxay cadarkan jidhkayga ugu shubtay inay aasniintayda ii diyaargarayso.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Dunida oo dhan meel alla meeshii injiilkan lagu wacdiyo, waxay samaysay ayaa xusuusteeda lagaga hadli doonaa.
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

kikuyu: Markaas mid laba-iyo-tobankii ka mid ahaa oo Yuudas Iskariyod la odhan jiray ayaa u tegey wadaaddada sare
english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

kikuyu: oo ku yidhi, Maxaad doonaysaan inaad i siisaan? Anna waan idiin soo gacangelin doonaaye. Oo waxay bixiyeen soddon gogo' oo lacag ah.
english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

kikuyu: Markaas dabadeed wuxuu doonayay goor wanaagsan oo uu u soo gacangeliyo.
english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

kikuyu: Maalintii ugu horraysay oo Iiddii Kibistii aan khamiirka lahayn xertii ayaa Ciise u timid oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Xaggee baad doonaysaa inaannu kuu diyaargarayno inaad cuntid cashada Iidda Kormaridda?
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu yidhi, Magaalada gala oo hebel u taga oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Macallinkii wuxuu leeyahay, Wakhtigaygii waa dhow yahay, gurigaaga ayaan cashada Iidda Kormaridda kula samaysanayaa xertayda.
english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

kikuyu: Xertii waa samaysay sida Ciise ku amray oo cashada Iidda Kormariddii ayay diyaargareeyeen.
english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Goortii makhribkii la gaadhay, laba-iyo-tobankii xerta ahaa ayuu cunto ula fadhiistay,
english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

kikuyu: oo intay wax cunayeen ayuu ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Midkiin ayaa i gacangelin doona.
english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

kikuyu: Markaasay aad iyo aad u caloolxumaadeen, oo waxay bilaabeen in mid kastaa ku yidhaahdo, Ma aniga baa, Sayidow?
english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

kikuyu: Wuu u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Kii saxanka gacanta ila gesha kaasaa i gacangelin doona.
english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

kikuyu: Wiilka Aadanahu waa baxayaa, siday u qoran tahay, laakiin hoog waxaa leh ninkaas Wiilka Aadanaha gacangelinaya. Waxaa ninkaas u wanaagsanaan lahayd inaanu dhalan.
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: Yuudas oo ah kii gacangeliyey ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ma aniga baa, Sayidow? Wuxuu ku yidhi, Waad tidhi.
english: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

kikuyu: Oo intay wax cunayeen, Ciise ayaa kibis qaaday oo barakeeyey, wuuna jejebiyey oo xertii siiyey oo yidhi, Qaata oo cuna. Tanu waa jidhkaygiiye.
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu koobkii qaaday oo mahadnaqay oo siiyey iyaga, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Kulligiin ka cabba.
english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

kikuyu: Waayo, kanu waa dhiiggayga axdiga cusub kan kuwo badan loo daadshay dembidhaafkooda aawadiis.
english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Hadda dabadeed anigu kama cabbi doono midhahan geedka canabka ah ilaa maalinta aan iyadoo cusub idinkula cabbayo boqortooyada Aabbahay dhexdeed.
english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Goortay gabay ammaan ah ku gabyeen waxay u baxeen Buur Saytuun.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Caawa kulligiin waa iga xumaan doontaan, waayo, waxaa qoran, Adhijirkaan dili doonaa oo idaha foofka ahu waa kala firdhi doonaan.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

kikuyu: Laakiin markii kuwii dhintay layga sara kiciyo, dabadeed ayaan Galili hortiin tegi doonaa.
english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Hadday kulli kaa xumaadaan, anigu weligay kaa xumaan maayo.
english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan kugu leeyahay, Caawa qudheeda intaan diiqu ciyin, saddex kol ayaad i dafiri doontaa.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Butros wuxuu ku yidhi, In kastoo aan leeyahay inaan kula dhinto, kolleyba ku dafiri maayo. Xertii oo dhammuna sidaasay wada yidhaahdeen.
english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise la yimid iyaga meel Getsemane la odhan jiray, oo wuxuu xertii ku yidhi, Halkan fadhiista intii aan halkaas tegayo oo ku soo tukanayo.
english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu watay Butros iyo labada wiil oo Sebedi, oo wuxuu bilaabay inuu calool xumaado oo tiiraanyoodo.
english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Naftaydu aad bay u calool xun tahay tan iyo dhimasho; halkan jooga oo ila soo jeeda.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

kikuyu: Waxoogaa ayuu hore u socday, oo wejigiisuu u dhacay oo tukaday isagoo leh, Aabbow, hadday suurtowdo, koobkanu ha i dhaafo, hase ahaatee, yaanay noqon sidaan doonayo laakiin sidaad doonaysid ha noqoto.
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

kikuyu: Xertii ayuu u yimid, oo wuxuu arkay iyagoo hurda, oo wuxuu Butros ku yidhi, Waa sidee? Miyaad kari weydeen inaad saacad keliya ila soo jeeddaan?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

kikuyu: Soo jeeda oo tukada inaydnaan jirrabaadda gelin. Ruuxu waa diyaar, laakiin jidhku waa itaal daranyahay.
english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: Haddana mar labaad ayuu tegey oo tukaday isagoo leh, Aabbow, haddii aanay suurtoobin in koobkanu i dhaafo anigoo cabba maahee, sidaad doonaysid ha noqoto.
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

kikuyu: Mar kale ayuu yimid oo arkay iyagoo hurda, waayo, indhahoodu lulmay la cuslaayeen.
english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

kikuyu: Wuu iska daayay oo haddana ka tegey, oo mar saddexaad ayuu tukaday isagoo haddana hadalkii oo kale ku hadlaya.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Markaasuu xertii u yimid oo ku yidhi, Hadda seexda oo nasta. Bal eega, saacaddii waa dhow dahay, oo Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa dembilayaal loo gacangelinayaa.
english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

kikuyu: Kaca aan tagnee. Eega, kii i gacangelin lahaa waa soo dhow yahay.
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Oo intuu weli hadlayay ayaa Yuudas oo laba-iyo-tobankii ka mid ahaa yimid, isaga iyo dad aad u badan oo seefo iyo ulo sita. Waxay ka yimaadeen wadaaddada sare iyo waayeellada dadka.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

kikuyu: Kii gacangeliyey ayaa calaamo kula ballamay oo ku yidhi, Mid alla midkaan dhunkado waa isagii ee qabta.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba Ciise buu u yimid oo ku yidhi, Nabad, Macallimow; wuuna dhunkaday.
english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Saaxiibow, maxaad u timid? Markaasay yimaadeen, oo gacmahooda ayay Ciise saareen oo qabteen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, mid ka mid ah kuwii Ciise la jiray ayaa gacanta fidiyey, oo seeftiisa soo bixiyey, oo wuxuu ku dhuftay wadaadka sare addoonkiisii, oo dheg buu ka gooyay.
english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Seeftaada meesheedii ku celi, waayo, kuwa seefo qaada oo dhammu seef bay ku halligmi doonaan.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

kikuyu: Ma waxaad u malaynaysaa inaanan Aabbahay baryi karin oo uusan haddeer ii soo diri karin malaa'igo laba iyo toban guuto ka badan?
english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

kikuyu: Haddaba sidee buu u noqon doonaa Qorniinku kan leh, Waa in sidaasu noqotaa?
english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

kikuyu: Saacaddaas qudheeda ayaa Ciise dadkii badnaa ku yidhi, Ma waxaad iila soo baxdeen seefo iyo ulo inaad i qabataan sidaan tuug ahay? Maalin walbaba macbudka ayaan fadhiyi jiray oo wax bari jiray, imana aydnaan qabsan.
english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxan oo dhan ayaa noqday in qorniinka nebiyadu rumoobo. Markaasaa xertii oo dhammu ka wada tageen oo carareen.
english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

kikuyu: Kuwii Ciise qabtay waxay u geeyeen Kayafas oo ahaa wadaadkii sare, ilaa meeshii culimmada iyo waayeelladu ku urursanaayeen.
english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros baa meel fog ka soo daba socday ilaa barxadda wadaadkii sare, wuuna galay oo askartii la fadhiistay inuu ugudambaysta arko.
english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

kikuyu: Wadaaddadii sare iyo shirkii oo dhan ayaa waxay dooneen markhaati been ah oo Ciise ka gees ah si ay u dilaan.
english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

kikuyu: Waase heli waayeen, in kastoo markhaatiyaal badan oo been ahu yimaadeen. Laakiinse dabadeed waxaa yimid laba,
english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

kikuyu: oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Kanu wuxuu yidhi, Waan karayaa inan macbudka Ilaah dudumiyo oo saddex maalmood ku dhiso.
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii sare istaagay oo ku yidhi, Miyaanad waxba ka jawaabayn? Kuwanu waxay kugu marag furayaan waa maxay?
english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise waa iska aamusay. Kolkaasaa wadaadkii sare wuxuu ku yidhi, Ilaaha nool ayaan kugu dhaarinayaa ee noo sheeg inaad tahay Masiixa oo ah Wiilka Ilaah, iyo in kale.
english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Waad tidhi. Hase ahaatee waxaan idinku leeyahay, Hadda dabadeed waxaad arki doontaan Wiilka Aadanaha oo fadhiya midigta xoogga Ilaah oo ku imanaya daruuraha cirka.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii sare dharkiisii jeexjeexay isagoo leh, Wuu caytamay. Maxaynu markhaatiyaal weli ugu baahan nahay? Bal eega, haddeer waad maqasheen caytanka.
english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

kikuyu: Maxay idinla tahay? Way u jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Wuxuu istaahilaa dhimasho.
english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

kikuyu: Markaasay wejiga kaga candhuufeen oo garaaceen. Qaarna waa dharbaaxeen,
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Noo sheeg, Masiixow. Yuu yahay kan kugu dhuftay?
english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

kikuyu: Butros wuxuu fadhiyey barxadda dibadda ah, markaasaa gabadh u timid oo waxay ku tidhi, Adiguna waxaad la jirtay Ciisihii reer Galili.
english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

kikuyu: Laakiin dhammaantood ayuu ku hor dafiray oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Anigu garan maayo waxaad leedahay.
english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

kikuyu: Goortuu iridda tegey mid kale ayaa aragtay, oo waxay kuwii halkaas joogay ku tidhi, Kanu wuxuu la jiray Ciisihii reer Naasared.
english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

kikuyu: Haddana dhaar ayuu ku dafiray oo yidhi, Anigu garan maayo ninka.
english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

kikuyu: Waxoogaa yar dabadeed kuwii ag taagnaa ayaa u yimid oo Butros ku yidhi, Run weeye, adiguna midkood baad tahay, waayo, hadalkaaga ayaa ku muujinaya.
english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu bilaabay inuu caytamo oo ku dhaarto inaanu ninka garanayn. Kolkiiba diiqii baa ciyey.
english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros wuxuu xusuustay hadalkii Ciise ku hadlay, Diiqu intaanu ciyin saddex goor ayaad i dafiri doontaa. Markaasuu baxay oo aad u ooyay.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Goortii aroortii la gaadhay wadaaddadii sare iyo waayeelladii dadka oo dhan ayaa Ciise wax ka gees ah ka wada hadlay si ay u dilaan.
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

kikuyu: Markaasay xidheen oo kaxeeyeen, oo waxay u dhiibeen taliyihii Bilaatos ahaa.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

kikuyu: Markaas Yuudas, oo ahaa kii gacangeliyey, goortuu arkay in la xukumay, ayuu isqoomameeyey, oo soddonkii gogo' oo lacagta ahaa ayuu wadaaddadii sare iyo waayeelladii ku celiyey,
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waan dembaabay markaan gacangeliyey dhiig eed la'. Laakiin waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaa noogu jira? Yeelkaa.
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu lacagtii macbudka gudihiisa ku daadshay oo ka tegey, wuuna baxay oo isdeldelay.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa wadaaddadii sare lacagtii qaadeen oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Xalaal ma aha in khasnadda quduuska ah lagu rido, waayo, waa dhiig iibkiis.
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

kikuyu: Markaasay ka wada hadleen oo waxay ku iibsadeen dhulka dheriyasameeyaha in shisheeyaha lagu aaso.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed ilaa maanta dhulkaas waxaa loogu yeedhaa dhulkii dhiigga.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa noqotay wixii nebi Yeremyaah lagaga hadlay markuu yidhi, Waxay qaateen soddonkii gogo' oo lacagta ahaa oo ah iibkii lagu qiimeeyey isaga, kii bini Israa'iil ku qiimeeyeen.
