english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

kikuyu: Waxayna ka bixiyeen dhulka dheriyasameeyaha sida Rabbigu iigu amray.
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu hor istaagay taliyaha, oo taliyihiina waa weyddiiyey oo ku yidhi, Ma Boqorkii Yuhuudda baad tahay? Ciisena wuxuu ku yidhi, Waad tidhi.
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Goortii wadaaddadii sare iyo waayeelladii ay ashtakeeyeen, waxba uma uu jawaabin.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bilaatos ku yidhi, Miyaanad maqlaynin waxa badan oo ay kugu marag furayaan?
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

kikuyu: Laakiin uguma uu jawaabin xataa eray keliya, sidaa darteed taliyihii ayaa aad ula yaabay.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

kikuyu: Taliyihii waxaa caadadiisu ahayd inuu iidda dadka u sii daayo maxbuuskay doonayaan.
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay lahaayeen maxbuus caan ah oo la odhan jiray Baraabbas.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

kikuyu: Haddaba goortay isu urureen, Bilaatos ayaa ku yidhi, Iyamaad doonaysaan inaan idiin sii daayo? Baraabbas ama Ciise kan Masiixa la yidhaahdo?
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu ogaa inay hinaaso ugu soo dhiibeen.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

kikuyu: Kolkuu kursiga xukumaadda ku fadhiistay ayaa naagtiisii farriin u soo dirtay oo waxay ku tidhi, Ha dhex gelin xaajada ninkaas xaqa ah, waayo, maanta anigoo ku riyoonaya isaga, ayaan aad iyo aad u xanuunsaday.
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wadaaddadii sare iyo waayeelladii waxay dadkii badnaa oggolaysiiyeen inay Baraabbas weyddiistaan, Ciisena la dilo.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

kikuyu: Laakiin taliyihii ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Labadooda kee baad doonaysaan inaan idiin sii daayo? Waxay yidhaahdeen, Baraabbas.
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bilaatos wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaba maxaan ku sameeyaa Ciise kan Masiixa la yidhaahdo? Kulligood waxay wada yidhaahdeen, Iskutallaabta ha lagu qodbo.
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu yidhi, Waayo, waa maxay sharkuu falay? Laakiin aad bay u sii qayliyeen oo yidhaahdeen, Iskutallaabta ha lagu qodbo.
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

kikuyu: Bilaatos goortuu arkay inuusan waxba ka tari karin in rabshad kacdo maahee, ayuu biyo qaatay oo dadka hortooda ku gacmo dhaqday oo wuxuu yidhi, Anigu waan ka eedla'ahay ninkan xaqa ah dhiiggiisa. Idinku yeelkiinna.
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

kikuyu: Dadkii oo dhammu waa wada jawaabeen oo yidhaahdeen, Dhiiggiisu annaga iyo carruurtayadaba ha dul saarnaado.
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Baraabbas u sii daayay, oo goortuu Ciise karbaashay ayuu u dhiibay in iskutallaabta lagu qodbo.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

kikuyu: Markaasaa taliyaha askartiisii waxay Ciise geeyeen guriga taliyaha, oo waxay isaga ku soo ururiyeen askartii oo dhan.
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

kikuyu: Dharkiisii ayay ka qaadeen oo waxay u geliyeen dhar guduudan.
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

kikuyu: Markaasay taaj qodxan uga taxeen oo madaxiisay saareen, cawsduurna gacantiisa midigtaa ayay u geliyeen, oo intay hortiisa jilba joogsadeen oo ku majaajiloodeen ayay waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Nabad, Boqorka Yuhuuddow.
english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

kikuyu: Wayna ku candhuufeen, markaasay cawsduurkii ka qaadeen oo madaxay kaga dhufteen.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

kikuyu: Oo goortay ku majaajiloodeen dabadeed ayay dharkii ka qaadeen oo dharkiisii bay u geliyeen, markaasay wadeen in iskutallaabta lagu qodbo.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

kikuyu: Goortay soo baxeen, waxay arkeen nin reer Kuranaya ah oo Simoon la odhan jiray, kan ay ku qasbeen inuu iskutallaabtiisa u qaado.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

kikuyu: Oo goortay yimaadeen meel Golgota la odhan jiray, tan la yidhaahdo meeshii dhakada,
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

kikuyu: waxay siiyeen inuu cabbo khamri xammeeti lagu daray, goortuu dhadhamiyeyse wuu diiday inuu cabbo.
english: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

kikuyu: Oo goortay iskutallaabta ku qodbeen, dharkiisay qaybsadeen, wayna saami riteen si wixii nebigu ku hadlay u noqdaan, Dharkaygii bay qaybsadeen oo maradaydii bay saami u riteen.
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

kikuyu: Meeshaasna ayay fadhiisteen oo dhawreen.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

kikuyu: Waxay meel madaxiisa ka korraysa ku qoreen ashtakadii lagu ashtakeeyey oo leh, KANU WAA CIISE BOQORKA YUHUUDDA.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa iskutallaabo lagu la qodbay laba tuug, mid midigta, midna bidixda.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

kikuyu: Kuwii ag marayayna waa caayeen, oo intay madaxooda luleen,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

kikuyu: waxay yidhaahdeen, Kaaga macbudka duminayow oo saddex maalmood ku dhisayow, isbadbaadi, haddii aad tahay Wiilka Ilaah, oo iskutallaabta ka soo deg.
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale ayaa wadaaddada sare ugu majaajiloodeen, iyaga iyo culimmada iyo waayeelladaba, oo waxay yidhaahdeen,
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

kikuyu: Kuwa kale ayuu badbaadiyey, qudhiisa isma badbaadin karo. Waa Boqorka Israa'iil; haddeer iskutallaabta ha ka soo dego, annaguna waannu rumaysan doonnaaye.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

kikuyu: Ilaah buu isku halleeyey, haddeer ha bixiyo hadduu isaga ku faraxsan yahay, waayo, wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan ahay Wiilka Ilaah.
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

kikuyu: Tuugaggii iskutallaabaha lagu la qodbayna sidaas oo kale ayay u caayeen.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

kikuyu: Hadda saacaddii lixaad ilaa saacaddii sagaalaad dhulka oo dhammu gudcur buu ahaa.
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Abbaaraha saacaddii sagaalaad Ciise ayaa cod weyn ku dhawaaqay oo yidhi, Eloy, Eloy, lama sabakhtani, waxaa weeye, Ilaahayow, Ilaahayow, maxaad ii dayrisay?
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

kikuyu: Kuwa halkaas taagnaa qaarkood ayaa goortay maqleen, yidhi, Kanu wuxuu u yeedhayaa Eliyaas.
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba midkood baa orday oo qaaday geed isbonji la yidhaahdo, oo khal uga soo buuxshay, oo intuu cawsduur saaray ayuu siiyey inuu cabbo.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

kikuyu: Kuwa kale ayaa yidhi, Daaya aynu aragnee inuu Eliyaas yimaado oo badbaadiyo.
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise goortuu mar kale cod weyn ku dhawaaqay, ruuxii bixiyey.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, daahi macbudka ayaa kor ilaa hoos laba u kala dillaacay, dhulkiina waa gariiray, dhagaxyadiina waa kala dildillaaceen.
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

kikuyu: Xabaalihiina waa furmeen, oo quduusiin badan oo hurdayna meydadkoodii waa la kiciyey.
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

kikuyu: Sarakiciddiisa dabadeed ayay xabaalaha ka soo baxeen, oo waxay galeen magaalada quduuska ah, oo waxay u muuqdeen dad badan.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

kikuyu: Boqol-u-taliyihii iyo kuwii la jiray oo Ciise dhawrayay, goortay arkeen dhulgariirkii iyo wixii dhacay, aad bay u baqeen oo yidhaahdeen, Runtii, kanu wuxuu ahaa Wiilkii Ilaah.
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Waxaana halkaas joogay dumar badan oo meel fog ka eegayay, kuwii Ciise ka soo raacay Galili oo u adeegi jiray isaga,
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

kikuyu: oo waxaa ku dhex jirtay Maryantii reer Magdala, iyo Maryan oo ahayd Yacquub iyo Yoosee hooyadood, iyo wiilashii Sebedi hooyadood.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

kikuyu: Goortay casarkii ahayd waxaa yimid nin reer Arimataya oo hodan ah oo Yuusuf la odhan jiray, oo isaguna Ciise xertiisa ahaa.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

kikuyu: Kaasu wuxuu u tegey Bilaatos oo ka baryay Ciise meydkiisii. Markaasaa Bilaatos amray in loo dhiibo.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

kikuyu: Yuusuf goortuu meydkii qaaday ayuu kafan nadiif ah ku duudduubay,
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

kikuyu: oo wuxuu geliyey xabaashiisii cusbayd, tan uu dhagax ka qoday, oo xabaashii afkeedii wuxuu ku soo giringiriyey dhagax weyn, wuuna ka tegey.
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

kikuyu: Oo halkaas waxaa joogay Maryantii reer Magdala iyo Maryantii kale, oo waxay fadhiyeen meel xabaashii ka soo hor jeedda.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

kikuyu: Maalintii dambe oo ku xigtay Maalintii Diyaargarayska, wadaaddadii sare iyo Farrisiintii waxay u wada yimaadeen Bilaatos,
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, waxaannu xusuusan nahay in khaa'inkaasu yidhi, intuu weli noolaa, Saddex maalmood dabadeed waan soo sara kacayaa.
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

kikuyu: Haddaba amar in xabaashii aad loo dhawro ilaa maalinta saddexaad inaan xertiisu iman oo xadin oo aanay dadka ku odhan, Kuwii dhintay wuu ka soo sara kacay, oo aanay khiyaanada dambe ka sii xumaan tii hore.
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

kikuyu: Bilaatos wuxuu ku yidhi, Waardiyayaal baad leedihiin. Taga oo adkeeya in alla intaad adkayn taqaaniin.
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

kikuyu: Markaasay tageen, iyaga iyo waardiyayaashii, oo xabaashay soo adkeeyeen, dhagixiina way shaabadeeyeen.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

kikuyu: Sabtidii dabadeed goortii waagii beryayay maalintii ugu horraysay ee toddobaadka, Maryantii reer Magdala iyo Maryantii kale waxay u yimaadeen inay xabaashii arkaan.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa jiray dhulgariir weyn, waayo, malaa'igta Rabbiga ayaa intay samada ka soo degtay timid oo dhagixii ka giringirisay oo ku dul fadhiisatay.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

kikuyu: Midabkeedu wuxuu u ekaa hillaac, dharkeeduna wuxuu u caddaa sida baraf cad.
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

kikuyu: Oo cabsi aawadeed kuwii ilaalinayay waa gariireen, oo waxay noqdeen sida meydad.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

kikuyu: Malaa'igtii ayaa u jawaabtay oo naagihii ku tidhi, Ha baqina, waayo, waxaan ogahay inaad doonaysaan Ciise, kan iskutallaabta lagu qodbay.
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

kikuyu: Halkan ma joogo, waayo, wuu sara kacay siduu yidhi. Bal kaalaya oo arka meeshii Rabbigu jiifay.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

kikuyu: Dhaqso u taga, oo waxaad xertiisii ku tidhaahdaan, Kuwii dhintay ayuu ka soo sara kacay, oo wuu idin hor marayaa ilaa Galili. Halkaasna waad ku arki doontaan. Bal eega, waan idiin sheegaye.
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

kikuyu: Dhaqsoba waxay xabaashii kala tageen baqdin iyo farxad weyn, oo waxay u ordeen inay xertiisa u warramaan.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ciise ka hor yimid oo ku yidhi, Nabad. Markaasay u dhowaadeen oo intay cagihiisa qabteen ayay caabudeen.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Ha baqina. Taga oo walaalahay u sheega inay Galili tagaan, oo halkaasay igu arki doonaan.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

kikuyu: Intay sii socdeen ayaa waardiyayaashii qaarkood magaaladii yimid, oo waxay wadaaddadii sare uga warrameen wixii dhacay oo dhan.
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

kikuyu: Iyaguna goortay waayeelladii la shireen oo ay wada hadleen, ayay askartii lacag badan siiyeen,
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Waxaad tidhaahdaan, Xertiisii ayaa habeennimo timid oo xadday isaga intii aannu hurudnay.
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

kikuyu: Oo haddii taliyihii waxan maqlo, waannu rumaysiinaynaa oo waannu idiin welwel tiraynaa.
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

kikuyu: Markaasay lacagtii qaateen oo yeeleen sidii lagu yidhi. Hadalkanu maalintaas ilaa maanta waa ku dhex firdhisanaa Yuhuudda.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

kikuyu: Markaasaa koob-iyo-tobankii xerta ahaa Galili tageen ilaa buurtii Ciise kula ballamay.
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

kikuyu: Oo goortay arkeen isagii, way caabudeen, laakiin qaar baa shakiyey.
english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

kikuyu: Oo Ciise ayaa u yimid oo la hadlay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Amar oo dhan ayaa samada iyo dhulka laygu siiyey.
english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

kikuyu: Haddaba taga, oo quruumaha oo dhan xer ka dhiga, oo ku baabtiisa magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuskaa,
english: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: oo bara inay dhawraan wax walba oo aan idinku amray, oo bal eega had iyo goor ayaan idinla joogaa xataa ilaa wakhtigu dhammaado.
english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

kikuyu: Bilowgii injiilkii Ciise Masiix, oo ah Wiilka Ilaah.
english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

kikuyu: Sidii Nebi Isayos u qoray, Eeg, waxaan hortaada soo dirayaa wargeeyahayga, Kan jidkaaga diyaargarayn doona;
english: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

kikuyu: Waa codka kan cidlada kaga qaylinaya, Jidka Rabbiga hagaajiya, Waddooyinkiisa toosiya.
english: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

kikuyu: Waxaa yimid Yooxanaa kan cidlada dadka ku baabtiisayay oo ku wacdiyeyey baabtiiskii toobadda dembidhaafka aawadiis.
english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa u soo baxay dadkii Yahuudiya oo dhan iyo kuwii Yeruusaalem oo dhan, oo kulligoodna Webi Urdun ayuu ku baabtiisay, iyagoo dembiyadooda qiranaya.
english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

kikuyu: Yooxanaa wuxuu guntanaa dharkiisii dhogorta geel ahaa, oo suun meged ahna dhexduu ku xidhnaa, oo wuxuu cunay ayax iyo malab dibadeed.
english: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

kikuyu: Oo wax buu wacdiyey oo yidhi, Waxaa iga daba imanaya ku iga itaal weyn, kan aanan istaahilin inaan foororsado oo aan yeelmihii kabihiisa furo.
english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan idinku baabtiisay biyo, isaguse wuxuu idinku baabtiisi doonaa Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas waxay noqotay in Ciise ka yimid Naasared tii Galili, oo Yooxanaa baa Webi Urdun ku baabtiisay isagii.
english: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

kikuyu: Markiiba intuu biyihii ka soo baxay wuxuu arkay samooyinkii oo kala dillaacay iyo Ruuxii oo sidii qoolley oo kale dushiisa ugu soo degaya.
english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

kikuyu: Waxaa samooyinka ka yimid cod leh, Adigu waxaad tahay Wiilkayga aan jeclahay oo aan ku faraxsanahay.
english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Oo markiiba Ruuxii baa xaggii cidlada u eryay.
english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

kikuyu: Afartan maalmood buu cidlada joogay, Shayddaan baana jirrabay oo wuxuu la jiray dugaagga, malaa'igahuna waa u adeegeen.
english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

kikuyu: Kolkii Yooxanaa la qabtay dabadeed, Ciise wuxuu yimid Galili, oo wuxuu dadka ku wacdiyey injiilka Ilaah,
english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

kikuyu: wuxuuna yidhi, Wakhtigii waa buuxsamay, oo boqortooyadii Ilaah waa soo dhowaatay; toobadkeena oo injiilka rumaysta.
english: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

kikuyu: Markuu badda Galili ag marayay, wuxuu arkay Simoon iyo walaalkiis Andaros, iyagoo shabag badda ku tuuraya, waayo, waxay ahaayeen kuwa kalluun jillaabta.
english: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, I soo raaca. Waxaan idinka dhigayaa kuwa dadka jillaabta.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

kikuyu: Markiiba shabagyadoodii way ka tageen, wayna raaceen.
english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

kikuyu: Markuu cabbaar socday, wuxuu arkay Yacquub ina Sebedi iyo walaalkiis Yooxanaa, iyagoo doonnida dhexdeeda shabagyadoodii ku hagaajinaya.
english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

kikuyu: Markiiba wuu u yeedhay. Kolkaasay aabbahood Sebedi iyo shaqaalayaasha kaga soo tageen doonnida, oo isagay raaceen.
english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

kikuyu: Markaasay Kafarna'um galeen, oo markiiba sabtida wuxuu galay sunagogga oo dadka wax baray.
english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

kikuyu: Waxayna la yaabeen wax bariddiisa, waayo, wuxuu wax u barayay sida mid amar leh, oo uma uu baraynin sida culimmada.
english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa sunagoggoodii ku jiray nin jinni wasakh leh qaba, wuuna qayliyey, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

kikuyu: Maxaa inoo dhexaya, Ciise reer Naasaredow? Ma waxaad u timid inaad na baabbi'iso? Anigu waa ku garanayaa kii aad tahay Kan Quduuska ah ee Ilaah.
english: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

kikuyu: Ciise baa canaantay oo ku yidhi, Aamus oo ka soo bax.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

kikuyu: Goortii jinnigii wasakhda lahaa gilgilay oo cod weyn ku qayliyey, ayuu ka soo baxay.
english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

kikuyu: Kulligoodba ayay la wada yaabeen, sidaa aawadeed iyaga dhexdooda way isweyddiiyeen oo yidhaahdeen, Waa maxay waxani? Ma wax barid cusub baa? Xataa jinniyadii wasakhda lahayd amar buu ku amraa, wayna yeelaan.
english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

kikuyu: Markiiba warkiisii waa gaadhay dhulkii Galili ku wareegsanaa oo dhan.
english: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

kikuyu: Oo markiiba kolkay sunagoggii ka soo baxeen, waxay galeen guriga Simoon iyo Andaros, iyaga iyo Yacquub iyo Yooxanaaba.
english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

kikuyu: Simoon soddohdiis baa qandho la jiiftay, oo kolkiiba waxay isaga u sheegeen wax iyada ku saabsan.
english: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

kikuyu: Markaasuu u soo dhowaaday oo gacanteeda qabtay oo uu kiciyey. Kolkiiba qandhadii waa ka baxday oo ay u adeegtay iyaga.
english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

kikuyu: Makhribkii goortay qorraxdii dhacday, waxay u keeneen kuwa buka oo dhan iyo kuwa jinniyo qaba.
english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii magaalada oo dhan albaabka ku soo ururay.
english: All the city was gathered together at the door.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu bogsiiyey dad badan oo cudurro kala cayncayn ah qabay, dadkana jinniyo badan buu ka saaray, oo uma oggolaanin jinniyadu inay hadlaan, waayo, isagay garanayeen.
english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

kikuyu: Aroortii hore intaan weli waagii beryin ayuu kacay oo wuxuu tegey meel cidla ah, halkaasuuna ku soo tukanayay.
english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Simoon iyo kuwii la jiray ka daba tageen.
english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

kikuyu: Goortay heleen waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Dadka oo dhan baa ku doondoonaya.
english: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Aan tagno magaalooyinka inoo dhow, inaan halkaasna wax ku wacdiyo; waayo, taas aawadeed ayaan u imid.
english: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu galay sunagogyadoodii Galili ku yiil oo dhan; dadkana ayuu ka wacdiyey, jinniyadiina ayuu dadka ka saaray.
english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa u yimid nin baras leh, wuuna jilba joogsaday oo baryay, oo ku yidhi, Haddaad doonaysid waad i daahirin kartaa.
english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ciise u naxariistay, oo intuu gacantiisa soo taagay, ayuu taabtay oo ku yidhi, Waa doonayaa ee daahirsanow.
english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba baraskii waa ka baxay, oo wuu daahirsanaaday.
english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

kikuyu: Ciisena aad buu u xukumay, oo markiiba ayuu iska diray,
english: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

kikuyu: oo ku yidhi, Ninna waxba ha kala hadlin, laakiin tag oo wadaadka istus. Waxaad daahirsanaantaada u bixisaa wixii uu Muuse amray, marag iyaga ha u ahaatee.
english: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu baxay oo bilaabay inuu aad u naadiyo oo warka faafiyo, taas aawadeed kol dambe Ciise magaaladuu bayaan u geli kari waayay, laakiin wuxuu joogay dibadda ee meelo cidla ah, meel kastana waa looga yimid.
english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

kikuyu: Dhawr maalmood dabadeed goortuu haddana Kafarna'um galay, waxaa la maqlay inuu guriga joogo.
english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa is-urursaday dad badan, sidaa daraaddeed meel ay joogsadaan ayay ka waayeen xataa albaabka hortiisii, oo iyaga ayuu ereygii kula hadlay.
english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay u yimaadeen oo nin curyaan ah u keeneen, waxaana siday afar qof.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

kikuyu: Goortay u soo dhowaan kari waayeen dadkii badnaa daraaddiis ayay saqafka dusha ka fureen meeshuu joogay. Goortii ay jebsheen, waxay ka soo dejiyeen sariirtii ninkii curyaanka ahaa ku jiifay.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

kikuyu: Ciise kolkuu rumaysadkoodii arkay, ayuu ninkii curyaanka ahaa ku yidhi, Wiilkow, dembiyadaadu waa cafiyan yihiin.
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Laakiin halkaa waxaa joogay qaar culimmada ah oo iska fadhiyey oo qalbiyadooda ka fikirayay, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen,
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

kikuyu: Ninkanu muxuu sidan ugu hadlayaa? Wuu caytamayaa. Ayaa dembiyo cafiyi kara Ilaah keliya maahee?
english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba Ciise ruuxiisuu ka ogaaday inay sidaas qalbiyadooda ka fikirayaan, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad waxan qalbiyadiinna ugaga fikiraysaan?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

kikuyu: Iyamaa hawl yar, in curyaanka lagu yidhaahdo, Dembiyadaadu waa cafiyan yihiin, ama in lagu yidhaahdo, Kac oo sariirtaada qaado oo soco?
english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

kikuyu: Laakiin si aad ku garataan in Wiilka Aadanahu dhulka ku leeyahay amar uu dembiyada ku cafiyo (ayuu ninkii curyaanka ahaa ku yidhi),
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

kikuyu: Waxaan ku leeyahay, Kac oo sariirtaada qaado oo gurigaaga tag.
english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba wuu kacay oo sariirtiisii qaatay; wuuna baxay dadkii oo dhan hortooda, sidaa darteed ayay la wada yaabeen, wayna ammaaneen Ilaah, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Weligayo sidan oo kale ma aannu arag.
english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

kikuyu: Haddana wuu u baxay badda xeebteeda, oo dadkii oo dhan baa u yimid, wuuna wax baray.
english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

kikuyu: Goortuu ag marayay, wuxuu arkay Laawi ina Alfayos, isagoo fadhiya meesha cashuurta lagu qaado, oo uu ku yidhi isaga, I soo raac. Wuuna kacay oo raacay.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay markii Ciise gurigiisa cunto u fadhiistay in kuwa badan oo cashuurqaadayaal iyo dembilayaal ah Ciise iyo xertiisii la fadhiistay; waayo, way badnaayeen, wayna raaceen.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

kikuyu: Culimmadii iyo Farrisiintii markay arkeen isagoo dembilayaal iyo cashuurqaadayaal wax la cunaya, waxay xertiisii ku yidhaahdeen, Waa sidee? Wuxuu wax la cunaa oo la cabbaa cashuurqaadayaal iyo dembilayaal.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu maqlay ayuu ku yidhi, Kuwa ladan dhakhtar uma baahna, laakiin kuwa buka ayaa u baahan. Uma aan imanin inaan kuwa xaqa ah u yeedho, laakiin inaan dembilayaasha u yeedho ayaan u imid.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

kikuyu: Xertii Yooxanaa iyo Farrisiintii ayaa soomi jiray. Isagay u yimaadeen oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Xertii Yooxanaa iyo xertii Farrisiintu maxay u soomaan oo ay xertaadu u soomi weydaa?
english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Dadka aroosku miyay soomi karaan intuu aroosku la joogo? In alla intii aroosku la joogo ma ay soomi karaan.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa iman doona maalmaha arooska laga qaadi doono, markaasay soomi doonaan maalintaas.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

kikuyu: Ninna karriin cusub kuma tolo dhar duug ah, haddii kale tan cusub ee lagu buuxin lahaa ayaa ka go'da kan duug ah, oo jeexdintu waa ka sii xumaataa.
english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

kikuyu: Khamri cusubna qarbeddo duug ah laguma shubo, haddii kale khamrigii cusbaa ayaa qarbeddada kala dildillaacinaya, khamriguna waa daadanayaa, qarbeddaduna waa hallaabayaan, laakiin khamriga cusubse waxaa lagu shubaa qarbeddo cuscusub.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay inuu sabtidii beeraha dhex marayay, oo xertiisii intay soconayeen ayay bilaabeen inay sabuullada jartaan.
english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Farrisiintii waxay isaga ku yidhaahdeen, Bal eeg, maxay sabtida u samaynayaan wixii aan xalaal ahayn?
english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Miyaydnaan weligiin akhriyin wixii Daa'uud sameeyey markuu wax u baahnaa oo uu gaajaysnaa, isaga iyo kuwii la jiray?
english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

kikuyu: Siduu guriga Ilaah u galay waagii wadaadkii sare ee Aabyaataar, oo uu u cunay kibistii tusniinta oo aan xalaal uu ahayn dad kale wadaaddada maahee, oo uu siiyey kuwii la jirayna.
english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wuxuu ku yidhi iyaga, Sabtida waxaa loo sameeyey dadka aawadiis ee dadka looma samayn sabtida aawadeed.
english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed Wiilka Aadanahu waa sayidka sabtida.
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Kol dambe wuxuu galay sunagogga; halkaasna waxaa joogay nin gacan engegan.
english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

kikuyu: Markaasay fiirinayeen inuu sabtida bogsiinayo iyo in kale, si ay u ashtakeeyaan.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ninkii gacanta engegnaa ku yidhi, Dhexda isa soo taag.
english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Sabtida ma xalaal baa in wanaag la falo ama shar; in naf la badbaadiyo ama la dilo? Laakiin way iska aamuseen.
english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

kikuyu: Goortuu iyaga isha mariyey isagoo cadhaysan oo qalbigiisii ka tiiraanyooday qalbi engegnaantooda aawadeed, wuxuu ninkii ku yidhi, Gacanta soo taag. Kolkaasuu soo taagay, oo gacantiisu way bogsatay.
english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Farrisiintu baxeen, oo markiiba waxay kala tashadeen Herodosiintii si ay u dilaan isaga.
english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise xertiisii ayuu badda kula noqday; waxaana raacay dad badan oo ka yimid Galili, iyo Yahuudiya,
english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

kikuyu: iyo Yeruusaalem, iyo Idumiya, iyo Webi Urdun shishadiisa, iyo kuwa ag joogay Turos iyo Siidoon; dad tiro badan goortii ay maqleen waxa weyn ee uu samaynayay ayay u yimaadeen.
english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

kikuyu: Xertiisii wuu la hadlay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Doonni yar ha i sugto dadkii badnaa aawadiis si ayan ii cidhiidhiyin.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

kikuyu: Waayo, dad badan ayuu bogsiiyey, sidaa daraaddeed ayay waxay ugu kufeen si ay kuwii cudur qabay oo dhan u taabtaan isaga.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

kikuyu: Oo jinniyada wasakhda lehna goortay arkeen, hortiisii ayay isku tuureen oo qayliyeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Adigu waxaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah.
english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Aad buu u amray inaanay dadka ogeysiinin isaga.
english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

kikuyu: Goortaasuu buurta fuulay; wuu u yeedhayna kuwii uu doonayay; wayna u yimaadeen.
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

kikuyu: Laba iyo toban ayuu soo saaray inay isaga la joogaan, iyo inuu u diro inay wax wacdiyaan,
english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

kikuyu: iyo inay u leeyihiin amar ay cudurro ku bogsiiyaan oo ay jinniyo ku saaraan.
english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

kikuyu: Waxay ahaayeen Simoon, kan uu Butros u bixiyey,
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

kikuyu: iyo Yacquub ina Sebedi, iyo Yooxanaa, Yacquub walaalkiis, iyaga wuxuu u bixiyey Bo'anerges, waxaa weeye wiilashii onkodka,
english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

kikuyu: iyo Andaros, iyo Filibos, iyo Bartolomayos, iyo Matayos, iyo Toomas, iyo Yacquub ina Alfayos, iyo Tadayos, iyo Simoon reer Kaana,
english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

kikuyu: iyo Yuudas Iskariyod, kii gacangeliyey.
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu guri galay; oo dad badan ayaa haddana ku soo ururay si aanay karin inay kibis cunaan.
english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

kikuyu: Xigtadiisii goortay maqleen, ayay u soo baxeen inay qabtaan, waayo, waxay yidhaahdeen, Isagu waa waalan yahay.
english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

kikuyu: Culimmadii Yeruusaalem ka soo degeenna waxay yidhaahdeen, Wuxuu qabaa Be'elsebul, oo madaxda jinniyada ayuu jinniyada ku saaraa.
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu iyagii u yeedhay oo masaallo kugu yidhi, Sidee baa Shayddaan Shayddaan u saari karaa?
english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

kikuyu: Haddii boqortooyo kala qaybsanto, boqortooyadaasu ma taagnaan karto.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

kikuyu: Haddii gurina kala qaybsamo, gurigaasu ma taagnaan kari doono.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

kikuyu: Haddii Shayddaanna isku kaco oo qaybsamo, ma taagnaan karo. Laakiin wuxuu leeyahay dhammaansho.
english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

kikuyu: Ninna nin xoog leh gurigiisa ma geli karo inuu alaabtiisa dhaco hadduusan kolkii hore ninka xoogga leh xidhin, goortaasuu gurigiisa dhici doonaa.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Bini-aadmiga waa loo cafiyi doonaa dembiyadii oo dhan iyo caydii ay ku caytamaan;
english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

kikuyu: laakiin ku alla kii caaya Ruuxa Quduuska ah, weligiis cafiga heli maayo, laakiin wuxuu eed u leeyahay dembi weligiis ah;
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

kikuyu: waayo, waxay yidhaahdeen, Jinni wasakh leh ayuu qabaa.
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa yimid walaalihiis iyo hooyadiis, oo dibadday istaageen, waxayna u direen cid ugu yeedha.
english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

kikuyu: Dad badan baa agtiisa fadhiyey oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Bal eeg, hooyadaa iyo walaalahaa dibadday joogaan oo waa ku doonayaan.
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Yaa ah hooyaday iyo walaalahay?
english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu isha mariyey kuwii agtiisa fadhiyey oo ku yidhi, Waa kuwan hooyaday iyo walaalahay!
english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

kikuyu: Ku alla kii yeela doonistii Ilaah kaasaa walaalkay iyo walaashay iyo hooyaday.
english: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

kikuyu: Haddana wuxuu bilaabay inuu badda agteeda wax ku baro, oo waxaa u soo ururay dad badan, sidaa darteed doonni ayuu fuulay, wuxuuna fadhiistay badda, dadkii badnaana waxay joogeen badda xeebteeda.
english: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wax badan masaallo ku baray, oo intuu wax barayay ayuu iyaga ku yidhi,
english: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

kikuyu: Dhegaysta, waxaa baxay beerrey inuu wax beero.
english: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

kikuyu: Intuu beerayay qaar baa jidka geestiisa ku dhacay, kolkaasaa shimbirro yimaadeen oo cuneen.
english: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waxay ku dhaceen dhul dhagax ah oo aan carro badan lahayn; kolkiiba way soo baxeen, waayo, carradu hoos uma dheerayn,
english: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

kikuyu: laakiin qorraxdu goortay soo baxday way gubteen, waana engegeen, waayo, xidid ma lahayn.
english: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waxay ku dhex dhaceen qodxan, qodxantiina waa soo baxday oo ceejisay, oo midho ma ay dhalin.
english: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena dhul wanaagsan bay ku dhaceen, oo intay baxeen ayay koreen oo midho dhaleen. Mid wuxuu dhalay soddon, midna lixdan, midna boqol.
english: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Kan dhego wax lagu maqlo lahu ha maqlo.
english: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Goortuu keligiis ahaa kuwii la joogay iyo laba-iyo-tobankii wax bay masaalladii ka weyddiiyeen.
english: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ku yidhi, Idinka waa laydin siiyaa inaad waxa qarsoon ee boqortooyada Ilaah garataan, laakiin kuwa dibadda jooga wax walba waxaa loogu sheegaa masaallo,
english: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

kikuyu: si ay goortay arkayaan ayan u arkin, oo si ay goortay maqlayaan ayan u garan, si ayan u soo noqon oo aan loo cafiyin.
english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna iyaga ku yidhi, Miyaydnaan masaalkan garanaynin? Sidee baad masaalladii oo dhan u garan doontaan?
english: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

kikuyu: Beerreygu wuxuu beeraa hadalka.
english: The farmer sows the word.

kikuyu: Waa kuwan kuwii jidka yiil meeshii hadalka lagu beeray, oo goortay maqlaan, Shayddaan baa kolkiiba yimaada oo ka qaada hadalkii lagu beeray iyaga.
english: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

kikuyu: Si la mid ahna kuwan waa kuwii dhul dhagax ah lagu beeray, kuwii goortay hadalkii maqlaanba kolkiiba farxad bay ku qaataan;
english: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

kikuyu: xididse isagu ma leh, laakiin wakhti yar bay sii jiraan, markii dambe goortii dhib ama silac u dhoco hadalka aawadiis, markiiba way ka xumaadaan.
english: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

kikuyu: Kuwanna waa kuwii qodxanta lagu dhex beeray, kuwa hadalka maqla,
english: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

kikuyu: laakiin kawelwelidda dunidan, iyo sasabidda maalka, iyo damacyada wax kale ayaa gala oo hadalkii ceejiya, oo wuxuu noqdaa midhola'aan.
english: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

kikuyu: Kuwanna waa kuwii dhulka wanaagsan lagu beeray, kuwa hadalka maqla, oo aqbala, oo midho soo dhala, mid soddon, midna lixdan, midna boqol.
english: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna iyaga ku yidhi, Ilays ma waxaa loo keenaa in la hoos geliyo weel ama sariir? Sow lama saaro meeshii ilayska?
english: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

kikuyu: Wax qarsoon ma jiro oo aan soo muuqan doonin, oo wax daboolanna ma jiro oo aan bannaan soo bixi doonin.
english: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

kikuyu: Haddii nin leeyahay dhego uu wax ku maqlo ha maqlo.
english: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ku yidhi, U fiirsada waxaad maqlaysaan; qiyaastii aad ku qiyaastaan ayaa laydiinku qiyaasi doona oo ayaa laydiin kordhin doonaa.
english: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

kikuyu: Kii wax haysta waa la siin doonaa. Kii aan waxba haysanse waa laga qaadi doonaa wuxuu haysto.
english: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna yidhi, Sidaa weeye boqortooyadii Ilaah, sida nin abuur dhulka ku daadsha.
english: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

kikuyu: Isagu waa hurdaa, waana kacaa maalin iyo habeenba, oo abuurku waa baxaa oo weynaadaa, laakiin si ay tahay isagu garan maayo.
english: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

kikuyu: Dhulka keligiis ayaa midhaha bixiya, horta jirridda, dabadeed sabuulka, dabadeedna sabuulka midho ka buuxsama.
english: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortii midhuhu soo bislaadaan, kolkiiba ayuu mindi la galaa, waayo, wakhtigii beergooyska ayaa yimid.
english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna yidhi, Maxaynu boqortooyadii Ilaah la masaysiinnaa, oo masaalkee baynu u ekaysiinnaa?
english: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

kikuyu: Wuxuu yahay sida iniin khardal oo kale, tan goortii dhulka lagu beero waa ka wada yar tahay iniinaha dhulka ku jira oo dhan.
english: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

kikuyu: Laakiin goortii la beero way baxdaa oo ka weynaataa dhalatada oo dhan, oo ay laamo waaweyn bixisaa si ay shimbirraha cirku hooskeeda ugu degaan.
english: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

kikuyu: Masaallo badan oo tan oo kale ah ayuu ereyga kula hadlay intii ay maqli karayeen.
english: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

kikuyu: Laakiin masaalla'aan kulama uu hadlin, oo markay keligood ahaayeen ayuu wax walba xertiisii u fasiray.
english: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

kikuyu: Maalintii qudheedii, goortii makhribkii la gaadhay, wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Dhanka kale aan u gudubnee.
english: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

kikuyu: Goortay dadkii badnaa direen, isagay wadeen intuu doonnidii ku jiray, oo doonniyo yaryar oo kalena way la jireen.
english: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

kikuyu: Waxaa kacay duufaan weyn oo dabayl ah, hirarkiina doonniday ku dhaceen ilaa ay doonnidii buuxsamaysay.
english: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

kikuyu: Isaguna wuxuu joogay xaggii dambe ee doonnida isagoo barkin ku hurda. Markaasay toosiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, miyaanay waxba kula ahayn inaynu lunno?
english: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu kacay oo dabayshii canaantay, oo badduu ku yidhi, Aamus oo xasil. Markaasaa dabayshii degtay oo xawaal weyn baa dhacday.
english: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

kikuyu: Goortaasuu wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Maxaad sidaa ugu baqaysaan? Sidee baydnaan weli rumaysad u lahayn?
english: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

kikuyu: Aad bay u baqeen, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba yuu yahay kan xataa dabaysha iyo badduba yeelaan?
english: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

kikuyu: Waxay yimaadeen dhanka kale oo badda ilaa dalkii Gadareni.
english: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

kikuyu: Goortuu doonnidii ka degay, kolkiiba waxaa la kulmay nin xabaalaha ka soo baxay oo jinni wasakh leh qaba.
english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

kikuyu: Isagu xabaalaha ayuu dhex fadhiyi jiray, oo ninna xataa silsilad kuma xidhi kari jirin.
english: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, marar badan bir cagaha iyo silsilado waa lagu xidhi jiray, silsiladihiina ayuu iska gooyn jiray, bir cagahana wuu kala jejebin jiray. Ninna ka adkaan kari waayay.
english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

kikuyu: Weligiiba, habeen iyo maalin, ayuu buuraha iyo xabaalaha joogi jiray isagoo qaylinaya oo dhagaxyona isku jarjaraya.
english: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortuu Ciise meel fog ka arkay, ayuu ku soo orday oo u sujuuday.
english: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

kikuyu: Markaasuu cod weyn ku qayliyey oo ku yidhi, Maxaa inoo dhexeeya, Ciisow adigoo ah Wiilka Ilaaha sarow? Ilaah baan kugu dhaarinayaa, Ha i silcin.
english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu ku yidhi, Ka soo bax ninka, jinni wasakh lahow.
english: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu weyddiiyey, Magacaa? Wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Waxaa lay yidhaahdaa, Liijon, waayo, annagu waa badan nahay.
english: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

kikuyu: Aad buuna uga baryay inaanu dalka ka eryin.
english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

kikuyu: Buurta sinteedana waxaa joogay daaqsin weyn oo doofaarro ah oo daaqaysa.
english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

kikuyu: Jinniyadii oo dhan baa baryeen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Noo dir doofaarrada inaannu galno.
english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba Ciise baa u fasaxay. Markaasaa jinniyadii wasakhda lahayd baxeen, oo waxay galeen doofaarrada, daaqsintiina jarka hoos bay uga yacday ilaa badda, baddayna ku bakhtiyeen, waxayna ahaayeen abbaaraha laba kun.
english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

kikuyu: Markaasaa kuwii daajin jiray carareen, oo dadkii magaalada iyo beerahaba ayay u warrameen. Kolkaasaa dadkii u soo baxay inay arkaan wixii dhacay.
english: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

kikuyu: Markaasay u yimaadeen Ciise, oo waxay arkeen jinnoolihii isagoo fadhiya oo dhar sita oo miyir qaba, wayna baqeen.
english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa kuwii arkay waxay u sheegeen sidii ay u dhacday jinnoolihii iyo warkii doofaarrada.
english: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

kikuyu: Markaasay bilaabeen inay baryaan inuu soohdintooda ka noqdo.
english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

kikuyu: Intuu doonnida fuulayay, kii jinniyada qabi jiray ayaa baryay inuu raaco.
english: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

kikuyu: Ciisese uma fasaxin, laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Gurigaaga iyo dadkaaga u tag oo u sheeg waxa weyn oo Rabbigu kuu sameeyey iyo siduu kuugu naxariistay.
english: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu tegey oo bilaabay inuu Dekabolis ku naadiyo waxa weyn oo Ciise u sameeyey, oo dhammaan bay la wada yaabeen.
english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

kikuyu: Markii Ciise haddana dhanka kale doonnida ugu gudbay ayaa dad faro badan u soo ururay, isaguna badda agteeda ayuu joogay.
english: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

kikuyu: Waxaa u yimid taliyayaasha sunagogga midkood ee Yayros la odhan jiray, oo markuu arkay, cagihiisa ayuu isku riday,
english: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

kikuyu: oo aad buu u baryay oo ku yidhi, Gabadhaydii yarayd waa sakaraad. Waan ku baryayaa, kaalay oo gacmahaaga saar inay bogsato oo noolaato.
english: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise raacay, dad faro badanna waa la socday, wayna cidhiidhiyeen.
english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

kikuyu: Waxaa jirtay naag laba iyo toban sannadood dhiigbixid qabtay.
english: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

kikuyu: Silec badanna ayay dhakhtarro badan ka heshay, oo wixii ay lahayd oo dhanna ayay ku bixisay, mana roonaanin laakiinse way ka sii dartay.
english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

kikuyu: Markay Ciise warkiisa maqashay ayay dadkii soo dhex martay oo dhabarkiisa timid, markaasay maradiisa taabatay.
english: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay tidhi, Haddaan dharkiisa iska taabto uun, waan bogsanayaa.
english: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba bixiddii dhiiggeeda ayaa joogsatay oo waxay jidhkeedii ka garatay inay cudurkii ka bogsatay.
english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

kikuyu: Ciise kolkiiba wuxuu iska gartay in xoog ka baxay isagii, oo intuu cidhiidhiga ku soo jeestay ayuu yidhi, Yaa dharkayga taabtay?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

kikuyu: Xertiisii ayaa ku tidhi, Adigu waad aragtaa dadka badan oo ku cidhiidhinaya. Ma waxaad na leedahay, Yaa i taabtay?
english: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu hareerihiisii ka fiirfiiriyey inuu arko tan waxan samaysay.
english: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

kikuyu: Naagtiise waa baqday oo gariirtay iyadoo garanaysa wixii loogu sameeyey. Markaasay timid oo hortiisa ku dhacday oo runtii oo dhan u sheegtay.
english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu iyada ku yidhi, Gabadhay, rumaysadkaaga ayaa ku bogsiiyey. Nabad ku tag, cudurkaagiina ka bogso.
english: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

kikuyu: Goortuu weli hadlayay waxaa gurigii taliyaha sunagogga ka yimid kuwii yidhi, Gabadhaadii waa dhimatay. Maxaad Macallinka u sii dhibaysaa?
english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

kikuyu: Mar alla markuu Ciise maqlay hadalka lagu hadlay, wuxuu taliyaha sunagogga ku yidhi, Ha baqin ee iska rumayso.
english: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

kikuyu: Ninnana uma oggolaanin inuu raaco, Butros, iyo Yacquub, iyo Yooxanaa oo ahaa Yacquub walaalkiis, maahee.
english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu yimid gurigii taliyaha sunagogga, oo wuxuu arkay buuqa iyo kuwa ooyaya oo aad u barooranaya.
english: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

kikuyu: Goortuu galay wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad sidaas ugu buuqaysaan oo u ooyaysaan? Gabadhu ma dhiman, waase huruddaa.
english: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

kikuyu: Iyaguse aad bay ugu qosleen, laakiin goortuu kulligood dibadda u saaray, wuxuu waday gabadhii aabbeheed iyo hooyadeed iyo kuwii isaga la jiray, wuxuuna galay meeshii gabadhu jiiftay.
english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu gabadhii gacanteeda qabtay oo ku yidhi, Talita qumi, taasoo micneheedu yahay, Gabadhay, waxaan ku leeyahay, Kac.
english: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba gabadhii waa kacday oo socotay; waxay jirtay laba iyo toban sannadood. Dadkuna aad bay ula wada yaabeen.
english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

kikuyu: Aad buu ugu adkeeyey inaan ninna ogaan, wuxuuna u sheegay in cunto la siiyo iyada.
english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

kikuyu: Meeshaas ayuu ka tegey oo waddankiisii yimid, xertiisiina way soo raaceen.
english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

kikuyu: Goortii sabtida la gaadhay ayuu bilaabay inuu sunagogga wax ku baro; dad badan oo maqlayaana way la yaabeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Ninkanu xaggee buu waxyaalahan ka helay? Oo xigmaddan la siiyeyna maxay tahay in xataa shuqulladan oo xoogga leh gacmihiisu sameeyaan?
english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

kikuyu: Kanu miyaanu ahayn nijaarkii, ina Maryan, kii walaal u yahay Yacquub, iyo Yoosee, iyo Yuudas, iyo Simoon; gabdhihii walaalihiis ahaana miyaanay inala wada joogin? Wayna ka xumaadeen.
english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Nebi murwad la' ma jiro, waddankiisa, iyo dadkiisa, iyo gurigiisa dhexdooda maahee.
english: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

kikuyu: Meeshaas shuqul xoog leh kuma samayn karin inuu dhawr buka gacmihiisii saaro oo bogsiiyo mooyaane.
english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

kikuyu: Wuuna ka yaabay rumaysadla'aantooda aawadeed. Kolkaasuu tuulooyinka ku wareegay isagoo wax baraya.
english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu laba-iyo-tobankii u yeedhay, wuxuuna bilaabay inuu laba laba u diro. Wuuna siiyey amar ay jinniyo wasakh leh ku saaraan.
english: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku amray, Waxba safarka ha u qaadanina ul maahee. Kibis iyo qandi iyo lacag kiishad ku jirta ha qaadanina.
english: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

kikuyu: Kabo gashada, laakiin laba khamiis ha gashanina.
english: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Meel walba oo aad guri ka gashaan, halkaas jooga ilaa aad ka tegaysaan.
english: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

kikuyu: Meel alla meeshaan idin soo dhowayn oo aan idin maqlin, goortaad halkaas ka tegaysaan, siigada cagihiinna ka dhabaandhaba inay marag ka gees ah ku ahaato.
english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

kikuyu: Markaasay baxeen oo waxay wacdiyeen dadkii si ay u toobadkeenaan.
english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

kikuyu: Jinniyo badan ayay saareen, dad badan oo bukayna saliid bay mariyeen, wayna bogsiiyeen.
english: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

kikuyu: Boqor Herodos ayaa warkii Ciise maqlay, waayo, magiciisa ayaa meel walba laga wada ogaaday. Kolkaasuu yidhi, Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha ayaa kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kacay, sidaa darteeda shuqulladan xoogga leh waa ku dhex jiraan oo shaqaynayaan.
english: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

kikuyu: Laakiin qaar kale waxay yidhaahdeen, Waa Eliyaas; qaar kalena waxay yidhaahdeen, Waa nebi, nebiyada kale la mid ah.
english: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Herodos goortuu maqlay wuxuu yidhi, Kanu waa Yooxanaa, kii aan madaxa ka gooyay. Kuwii dhintay ayuu ka soo sara kacay.
english: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Herodos qudhiisa ayaa cid diray oo Yooxanaa qabtay oo u xabbisay walaalkiis Filibos naagtiisii Herodiya aawadeed, waayo, wuu guursaday,
english: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

kikuyu: oo Yooxanaa wuxuu Herodos ku yidhi, Xalaal kuu ma aha inaad naagtii walaalkaa haysatid.
english: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed ayaa Herodiya ka dhiriftay oo doonaysay inay disho, mase karin,
english: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

kikuyu: waayo, Herodos baa Yooxanaa ka baqay. Wuxuu ogaa inuu yahay nin qumman oo quduus ah, wuuna ilaaliyey. Oo goortuu maqlay waa wareeray, farxadna wuu ku maqlay.
english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

kikuyu: Goortii maalin wanaagsan timid, markii la xusuustay dhalashadii Herodos, ayuu diyaafad ugu yeedhay raggiisii waaweynaa iyo saraakiishiisii iyo cuqaashii Galili.
english: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa gabadhii Herodiya qudheedu soo gashay oo cayaartay, oo waxay ka farxisay Herodos iyo kuwii la fadhiyey, kolkaasaa boqorkii baa wuxuu gabadhii ku yidhi, Wax alla wixii aad doonaysidba i weyddiiso, waanan ku siinayaa.
english: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu ugu dhaartay, Wax alla wixii aad i weyddiisatidba, waan ku siinayaa ilaa boqortooyadayda badhkeed.
english: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

kikuyu: Markaasay baxday oo hooyadeed ku tidhi, Maxaan weyddiistaa? Oo waxay tidhi, Madaxa Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha.
english: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba boqorkii ayay dhaqso ugu timid oo weyddiisatay iyadoo leh, Waxaan doonayaa haddaba madaxii Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha inaad xeedho igu siiso.
english: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa boqorkii aad u calool xumaaday, laakiin dhaarihiisii iyo kuwii la fadhiyey aawadood ayuusan doonaynin inuu diido.
english: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

kikuyu: Kolkiiba boqorkii wuxuu diray askari oo ku amray inuu madaxiisa soo qaado. Markaasuu tegay oo xabsiga madaxa kaga gooyay.
english: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

kikuyu: Madaxiisiina ayuu xeedho ku soo qaaday oo gabadhii siiyey, gabadhiina waxay siisay hooyadeed.
english: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

kikuyu: Tan goortii xertiisii maqashay, ayay yimaadeen oo meydkiisii qaadeen oo aaseen.
english: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

kikuyu: Rasuulladii ayaa Ciise u soo ururay, oo waxay u sheegeen wixii ay sameeyeen oo dhan iyo wixii ay bareenba.
english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

kikuyu: Markaasuu iyaga ku yidhi, Keligiin kaalaya cidlada, waxoogaana ku nasta. Waayo, kuwii imanayay iyo kuwii tegayay way badnaayeen, nefis ay wax ku cunaanna ma lahayn.
english: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay keli ahaantooda doonni raaceen oo meel cidla' ah tageen.
english: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

kikuyu: Dadkii baase arkay iyagoo tegaya, qaar badanna way garteen, oo magaalooyinka oo dhan ayay ka soo ordeen, wayna ka dheereeyeen.
english: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu soo degay ayuu dad badan arkay, wuuna u naxariistay, maxaa yeelay, waxay ahaayeen sidii ido aan adhijir lahayn, wuxuuna bilaabay inuu wax badan baro.
english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

kikuyu: Goortii maalintii hore u badatay ayaa xertiisii u timid oo ku tidhi, Meeshu waa cidlo, haddana maalintii horay u badatay.
english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

kikuyu: Dadka dir, si ay u tagaan beeraha iyo tuulooyinka ku wareegsan, oo ay wax la cuno u soo iibsadaan.
english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Idinku siiya waxay cunaan. Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Miyaannu tagnaa inaannu soo iibinno laba boqol oo dinaar oo kibis ah oo aannu siinno inay cunaan?
english: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Immisa kibsood baad haysaan? Soo eega. Oo markay ogaadeen, waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Shan kibsood iyo laba kalluun.
english: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ku amray inay cawska koox koox ugu fadhiisiyaan.
english: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

kikuyu: Waxay u fadhiisteen safaf boqol boqol iyo konton konton ah.
english: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

kikuyu: Isaguna wuxuu qaaday shantii kibsood iyo labadii kalluun, oo intuu cirka eegay ayuu barakeeyey, kibistiina ayuu kala jejebiyey oo xertiisii siiyey inay hortooda dhigaan, labadii kalluunna wuu u qaybiyey giddigood.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

kikuyu: Dhammaantood way wada cuneen, oo ka dhergeen.
english: They all ate and were filled.

kikuyu: Oo waxay soo gureen laba iyo toban dambiilood oo ka buuxa jajabkii iyo kalluunka.
english: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

kikuyu: Kuwii kibistii cunayna waxay ahaayeen shan kun oo nin.
english: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

kikuyu: Kolkiiba wuxuu xertiisii ku amray inay doonnida fuulaan oo ay hortiis tagaan dhanka kale oo Beytsayda intuu dadkii badnaa dirayo.
english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

kikuyu: Goortuu kala diray, ayuu buurta tegey inuu ku tukado.
english: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

kikuyu: Goortii makhribkii la gaadhay, doonnidii waxay joogtay badda dhexdeeda, isaguna keligiis ayuu dhulka joogay.
english: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

kikuyu: Wuxuu arkay iyagoo wadidda ku dhibtoonaya, waayo, dabaysha ayaa ka gees ahayd. Wakhtigii gaadhka afraad oo habeenka ayuu u yimid isagoo badda ku dul socda, wuuna iska dhaafi lahaa.
english: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

kikuyu: Laakiin goortay arkeen isagoo badda ku dul socda, waxay moodeen inuu muuqasho yahay, markaasay qayliyeen.
english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

kikuyu: Waayo, way wada arkeen, wayna nexeen. Markiiba wuu la hadlay oo ku yidhi, Kalsoonaada, waa aniga ee ha baqina.
english: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu doonnidii iyaga ugu tegey, dabayshuna waa joogsatay. Aad iyo aad bay u nexeen oo ula yaabeen.
english: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

kikuyu: Waayo, iyaga kibistii waxba kama ay garanin, maxaa yeelay, qalbigoodu waa engegnaa.
english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

kikuyu: Oo markay gudbeen waxay yimaadeen dalka Gennesared, oo doonnidiina xeebtay ku xidheen.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

kikuyu: Goortay doonnida ka soo degeen, kolkiiba dadku way garteen isaga.
english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

kikuyu: Oo waxay orod ku wareegeen dalka u dhow oo dhan oo bilaabeen inay kuwa buka sariiro ugu soo qaadaan meeshii ay ku maqleen inuu joogo.
english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

kikuyu: Meel alla meeshuu galayba, tuulooyinka ama magaalooyinka ama beeraha, waxay suuqyada dhigeen kuwa buka, oo ay ka baryeen inay faraqa maradiisa oo keliya taabtaan, oo kuwii taabtay oo dhammuna way bogsadeen.
english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa waxaa u soo urureen Farrisiintii iyo qaar culimmo ah oo Yeruusaalem ka yimid.
english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Goortaasay arkeen xertiisii qaarkooda oo kibis ku cunaya gacmo nijaasaysan, waxa weeye gacmo aan dhaqnayn.
english: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

kikuyu: Waayo, Farrisiinta iyo Yuhuudda oo dhammu waxba ma cunaan haddayan gacmahooda aad u dhaqin, si ay u xajiyaan xeerkii waayeellada.
english: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

kikuyu: Oo goortay suuqa ka yimaadaan waxba ma cunaan, inay maydhaan maahee. Waxyaalo badan oo kale ayaa jira oo ay heleen inay xajiyaan sida dhaqidda koobab, iyo dheriyo, iyo weelal naxaas ah, iyo miisas.
english: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

kikuyu: Markaasaa Farrisiintii iyo culimmadii weyddiiyeen oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Xertaadii maxay ugu socon waayeen xeerkii waayeellada, waxayse wax ku cunaan gacmo nijaasaysan?
english: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
