kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Isayos aad buu wax idiinka sii sheegay, labawejiilayaalow, siday u qoran tahay, Dadkanu bushimahooda ayay igu maamuusaan, Laakiin qalbigoodu waa iga fog yahay.
english: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

kikuyu: Si aan micne lahayn ayay ii caabudaan, Iyagoo dadka wax ku baraya amarrada dadka.
english: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

kikuyu: Idinku qaynuunkii Ilaah waad ka tagtaan, oo waxaad xajisaan xeerka dadka, sida dhaqidda dheriyada iyo koobabka, oo wax kale oo badan oo kuwaas la mid ah ayaad samaysaan.
english: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Qaynuunkii Ilaah aad baad u diiddaan inaad xeerkiinna xajisaan.
english: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

kikuyu: Waayo, Muuse wuxuu yidhi, Aabbahaa iyo hooyadaa maamuus; oo kan aabbihii iyo hooyadii caayaa, dhimasho ha ku dhammaado.
english: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaad leedihiin, Haddii nin aabbihii iyo hooyadii ku yidhaahdo, Wixii aan idiin tari lahaa oo dhan waa Qurbaan, waxa weeye, Waa sadaqad aan Ilaah siiyey;
english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

kikuyu: idinku uma daysaan mar dambe inuu aabbihii iyo hooyadii wax u sameeyo.
english: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

kikuyu: Ereygii Ilaah ayaad ku buriseen xeerkiinna aad bixiseen, oo wax badan oo kuwan oo kale ah ayaad samaysaan.
english: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu dadkii badnaa haddana u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, I maqla kulligiin oo garta.
english: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

kikuyu: Ma jiraan wax dibadda jooga oo intay ninka galaan nijaasayn karaa, laakiin waxa isaga ka soo baxa kuwaasaa waxa ninka nijaaseeya.
english: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

kikuyu: Haddii nin dhego wax lagu maqlo leeyahay ha maqlo.
english: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

kikuyu: Markuu dadka ka tegey oo guri galay ayaa xertiisii masaalladii wax ka weyddiisay.
english: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

kikuyu: Wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Idinkuna ma sidaasaad garashola'aan u tihiin? Miyaydnaan garanaynin in waxa dibadda joogaa oo dadka galaa ayan nijaasayn karin?
english: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

kikuyu: Waayo, qalbigiisa ma galaan, laakiin calooshiisay galaan, oo waxay ku dhacaan meesha lagu saxaroodo. Sidaasuu cuntada oo dhan ku nadiifiyey.
english: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waxa ninka ka soo baxa, kuwaas weeye waxa ninka nijaaseeyaa.
english: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxan weeye waxa qalbiga dadka gudihiisa ka soo baxa fikirrada shar leh, iyo galmada xaaraanta ah, iyo tuuganimada, iyo dilidda,
english: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

kikuyu: iyo damacnimada, iyo sharka, iyo khiyaanada, iyo camal xumaanta, iyo il xun, iyo cayda, iyo kibirka, iyo nacasnimada.
english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan shar leh oo dhammu gudahay ka soo baxaan oo ninka nijaaseeyaan.
english: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

kikuyu: Meeshaas ayuu ka kacay oo wuxuu tegey soohdimaha Turos iyo Siidoon. Markaasuu guri galay. Ma uu doonaynin in la ogaado, laakiin wuu qarsoomi kari waayay.
english: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa naag gabadheedu jinni wasakh leh qabtay ayaa warkiisa maqashay, oo intay timid ayay lugihiisa isku tuurtay.
english: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

kikuyu: Naagtii waxay ahayd Gariig, qolo ahaanna Surofoynike. Oo waxay ka bariday inuu jinniga gabadheeda ka saaro.
english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ku yidhi, Kolka hore carruurtu ha dheergaan, waayo, ma wanaagsana in carruurta kibistooda la qaado oo eeyaha loo tuuro.
english: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

kikuyu: Laakiin way u jawaabtay oo ku tidhi, Waa run, Sayidow, laakiin weliba eeyaha miiska hoostiisa ku jiraa waxay cunaan jajabka carruurta ka dhaca.
english: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu iyada ku yidhi, Hadalkaas aawadiis tag; jinnigii ayaa gabadhaada ka baxay.
english: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

kikuyu: Goortay gurigeeda timid waxay aragtay gabadhii oo sariirta jiifta oo jinnigii ka baxay.
english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

kikuyu: Mar kale ayuu soohdimaha Turos ka soo tegey oo Siidoon maray oo badda Galili yimid, soohdimaha Dekabolisna ayuu soo dhex maray.
english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay u keeneen mid dhego iyo carrab la', waxayna ka baryeen inuu gacantiisa saaro.
english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu dadkii badnaa dhinaca uga bixiyey, oo farihiisa ayuu dhegihiisa ka geliyey, wuuna tufay oo carrabkiisa taabtay.
english: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

kikuyu: Markaasuu cirka kor u eegay, wuuna taahay oo ku yidhi, Efata, waxa weeye, Furan.
english: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

kikuyu: Markiiba dhegihiisa waa furmeen oo carrabkiisii xidhnaa waa debcay, oo si bayaan ah ayuu u hadlay.
english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

kikuyu: Wuuna ku amray inaanay ninna u sheegin; laakiin in alla intuu amray, ayay in ka badan sii naadiyeen.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

kikuyu: Aad iyo aad bay ula yaabsanaayeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Wax walba si wanaagsan ayuu u sameeyey. Kuwa dhegaha la' wax buu maqashiiyaa, kuwa carrabka la'na wax buu ka hadliyaa.
english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

kikuyu: Maalmahaas dadkii aad buu u badnaa oo waxay cunaanna ma haysan, markaasaa Ciise xertiisii u yeedhay oo ku yidhi,
english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

kikuyu: Dadka badan ayaan u naxariisanayaa, waayo, durba saddex maalmood ayay ila joogeen, oo waxay cunaanna ma haystaan.
english: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

kikuyu: Haddii aan guryahooda u diro, iyagoo sooman, jidkay ku itaalbeeli doonaan, waayo, qaarkood waxay ka yimaadeen meel fog.
english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa xertiisii u jawaabtay, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Meeshan cidlada ah xaggee looga heli karaa kibis dadkanu ka dhergaan?
english: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

kikuyu: Goortaasuu weyddiiyey, Immisa kibsood baad haysaan? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Toddoba.
english: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu dadkii badnaa ku amray inay dhulka fadhiistaan. Markaasuu toddobadii kibsood soo qaaday, oo goortuu ku mahadnaqay ayuu kala jejebiyey oo xertiisii siiyey inay hortooda dhigaan. Markaasay dadkii badnaa hor dhigeen.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

kikuyu: Waxay haysteen in yar oo kalluun yaryar ah. Oo intuu barakeeyey, wuxuu ku amray inay kuwaasna hortooda dhigaan.
english: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

kikuyu: Markaasay cuneen oo dhergeen; kolkaasay soo ururiyeen toddoba dambiilood oo ka buuxa jajabkii hadhay.
english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Kuwii cunayna waxay ku dhowaayeen afar kun, markaasuu diray.
english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

kikuyu: Kolkiiba xertiisii ayuu doonni la fuulay, oo wuxuu yimid dhinacyada Dalmanuuta.
english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Farrisiintu u soo baxday, oo waxay bilaabeen inay wax weyddiiyaan, oo waxay ka doonayeen inuu calaamo cirka ka tuso, si ay u jirrabaan.
english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

kikuyu: Intuu ruuxiisa ka taahay ayuu yidhi, Qarnigan muxuu calaamo u doondoonayaa? Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Qarnigan calaamo lama siin doono.
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ka tegey oo haddana doonniduu fuulay oo dhanka kale u kacay.
english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

kikuyu: Xertii waxay illoobeen inay kibis soo qaataan, oo doonnida kibis kuma ay haysan mid keliya maahane.
english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku amray, oo ku yidhi, Iska eega oo iska jira khamiirka Farrisiinta iyo khamiirka Herodos.
english: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

kikuyu: Markaasay isla wada hadleen, oo isku yidhaahdeen, Sababtaasu waa kibistii aannan haysan aawadeed.
english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

kikuyu: Ciise oo gartay ayaa ku yidhi, Maxaad isu la hadlaysaan? Ma kibistii aydnaan haysan aawadeed ba? Miyaydnaan weli arkin oo aydnaan garanaynin? Qalbigiinnu weli ma engegan yahay?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

kikuyu: Indho baad leedihiin, miyaydnaan waxba arkaynin? Dhegona waad leedihiin, miyaydnaan waxba maqlaynin oo aydnaan xusuusnayn?
english: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

kikuyu: Goortii aan shantii kibsood shantii kun u kala jejebiyey, immisa dambiilood oo jajab ka buuxa ayaad soo ururiseen? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Laba iyo toban.
english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

kikuyu: Oo goortii aan toddobadii kibsood afartii kun u kala jejebiyey, immisa dambiilood oo jajab ka buuxa ayaad soo ururiseen? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Toddoba.
english: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Miyaydnaan weli garanaynin?
english: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

kikuyu: Markaasay yimaadeen Beytsayda. Oo waxay u keeneen nin indha la' oo ay ka baryeen inuu taabto.
english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ninkii indhaha la'aa gacanta qabtay, oo tuulada dibadda uga saaray, oo goortuu indhaha kaga tufay oo gacmihiisii saaray, wuxuu weyddiiyey, Wax ma arkaysaa?
english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

kikuyu: Kor buu u eegay oo yidhi, Waxaan arkayaa niman, oo waxay ii le'eg yihiin sida geedo socda.
english: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu mar kale gacmihiisii indhaha ka saaray. Markaasuu aad iyo aad wax u eegay, wuuna bogsaday, oo wax walba bayaan buu u arkay.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu gurigiisii u diray, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Tuulada ha gelin.
english: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise iyo xertiisii waxay tageen oo galeen tuulooyinka Kaysariya Filibos. Xertiisii ayuu jidka ku weyddiiyey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Dadku yay igu sheegaan?
english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

kikuyu: Waxay yidhaahdeen, Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha, qaarna, Eliyaas, qaar kalena, Nebiyada midkood.
english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu weyddiiyey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinkuse yaad igu sheegtaan? Butros ayaa u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaad tahay Masiixa.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku amray inayan ninna isaga u sheegin.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu bilaabay inuu baro inay waajib ugu tahay Wiilka Aadanahu inuu wax badan ku xanuunsado, oo ay waayeellada iyo wadaaddada sare iyo culimmadu diidaan, oo la dilo, oo saddex maalmood dabadeed uu soo sara kaco.
english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

kikuyu: Hadalkaas bayaan buu ugu hadlay. Markaasaa Butros gees u waday oo bilaabay inuu canaanto.
english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise markuu soo jeestay oo xertiisii eegay, ayuu Butros canaantay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Gadaal iga mar, Shayddaan yahow, waayo, waxyaalaha Ilaah kama fikirtid, waxaadse ka fikirtaa waxyaalaha dadka.
english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

kikuyu: Goortaasuu dadkii badnaa u yeedhay iyo xertiisiiba oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Mid uun hadduu doonayo inuu iga daba yimaado, ha dayriyo doonistiisa, iskutallaabtiisana ha soo qaato oo ha i soo raaco.
english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: Kan doonaya inuu naftiisa badbaadiyo, waa lumin doonaa, laakiin kan naftiisa u lumiya aawaday iyo injiilka aawadii, kaasaa badbaadin doona.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

kikuyu: Waayo, nin maxay u taraysaa hadduu dunida oo dhan helo oo uu naftiisa lumiyo?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

kikuyu: Nin muxuu u bixiyaa naftiisa beddelkeeda?
english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

kikuyu: Haddaba ku alla kii qarnigan dembiga iyo sinada leh kaga xishooda aniga iyo hadalkaygaba, Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa ka xishoon doona isaga markuu ammaantii Aabbihiis kula yimaado malaa'igaha quduuska ah.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kuwa halkan taagan qaarkood sinaba dhimasho uma dhadhamin doonaan ilaa ay arkaan boqortooyada Ilaah oo xoog ku imanaysa.
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

kikuyu: Lix maalmood dabadeed Ciise wuxuu waday Butros iyo Yacquub iyo Yooxanaa; oo wuxuu keligood geeyey buur dheer, hortoodana ayuu ku beddelmay.
english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

kikuyu: Dharkiisu aad buu caddaan ula dhalaalay sidii midka dhulka wax ku caddeeya aanu u caddayn karin.
english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa iyaga u muuqday Eliyaas iyo Muuseba, waxayna la hadlayeen Ciise.
english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros la hadlay oo Ciise ku yidhi, Macallimow, waxaa inoo wanaagsan inaynu halkan joogno. Saddex waab aannu ka dhisno, mid adaan kuu dhisaynaa, midna Muuse, midna Eliyaas.
english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

kikuyu: Waayo, ma uu garanaynin wuxuu ku jawaabo, maxaa yeelay, aad bay u baqeen.
english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa waxaa timid daruur oo iyaga hadhaynaysa, daruurtiina waxaa ka yimid cod leh, Kanu waa Wiilkayga aan jeclahay ee maqla isaga.
english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

kikuyu: Dhaqsiba goortii ay hareerahooda fiiriyeen, mar dambe ma ay arkin cid kale oo iyaga la joogta Ciise keliya maahee.
english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

kikuyu: Markay buurta ka soo degayeen, wuxuu ku amray inaanay ninna u sheegin waxay arkeen intaanu Wiilkii Aadanahu kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kicin.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

kikuyu: Dhexdoodii ayay hadalkii haysteen oo iska weyddiinayeen, Waa maxay ka soo sara kiciddii kuwii dhintay?
english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Culimmadu maxay u yidhaahdaan, Eliyaas waa inuu horta yimaado?
english: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa run in Eliyaas horta imanayo oo wax walba soo celinayo. Oo sidee uga qoran tahay xagga Wiilka Aadanaha inuu wax badan ku xanuunsan doono oo la nici doono?
english: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay, Eliyaas waa yimid, oo wax kasta oo ay doonayeen ayay ku sameeyeen siday uga qoran tahay.
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

kikuyu: Markay xertii u yimaadeen, waxay arkeen dad faro badan oo la jooga. Culimmaduna wax bay weyddiinayeen.
english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

kikuyu: Kolkiiba dadkii badnaa markay isaga arkeen aad bay u yaabeen oo ku soo ordeen oo nabdaadiyeen.
english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu weyddiiyey, Maxaad isweyddiinaysaan?
english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii badnaa midkood wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Macallimow, waxaan kuu keenay wiilkayga jinni carrab la' qaba.
english: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

kikuyu: Meel alla meeshuu ku qabtoba, wuu ridaa; markaasuu afka ka xumbeeyaa, wuuna ilka jirriqsadaa oo qallalaa. Waxaan xertaada ka baryay inay ka saaraan, wayna kari waayeen.
english: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Qarni yahow rumaysadka daranu! Ilaa goormaan idinla jiri doonaa? Ilaa goormaan idiin dulqaadan doonaa? Ii keena isaga.
english: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

kikuyu: Markaasay u keeneen. Goortuu arkay, kolkiiba jinnigii waa gilgilay; dhulkuuna ku dhacay oo laballegdeeyey isagoo afka ka xumbaynaya.
english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

kikuyu: Markaasuu aabbihiis weyddiiyey, Intee buu waxan qabay? Kolkaasuu yidhi, Tan iyo yaraantiisii.
english: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

kikuyu: Marar badan wuxuu ku tuuray dab iyo biyo inuu dumiyo, laakiin haddaad wax samayn kartid, noo naxariiso oo na caawi.
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaad rumaysan karaysid, wax waluba waa u suurtoobaan ka rumaysan.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba wiilka aabbihiis ayaa qayliyey oo oohin ku yidhi, Sayidow, waan rumaysanahay, iga caawi rumaysaddarradayda.
english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu arkay dadkii oo u soo ordaya, ayuu jinnigii wasakhda lahaa canaantay oo ku yidhi, Jinni yahow carrabka iyo dhegaha la'u, waxaan kugu amrayaa, Ka soo bax oo kol dambena ha ku noqon.
english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

kikuyu: Jinnigii intuu qayliyey, aad buu u gilgilay, kolkaasuu ka soo baxay. Markaasuu wiilku noqday sidii mid dhintay oo kale, sidaa darteeda dad badan baa yidhi, Waa dhintay.
english: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise ayaa gacanta qabtay oo kiciyey; markaasuu kacay.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu guriga galay, xertiisii waxay gooni ahaan u weyddiiyeen, Annagu maxaannu u saari kari waynay?
english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Caynkanu wax kale kuma soo bixi karo tukasho iyo soon maahee.
english: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

kikuyu: Markaasay halkaas ka tageen oo Galili dhex mareen, mana uu doonaynin in la ogaado.
english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

kikuyu: Waayo, xertiisii ayuu wax barayay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa dadka loo gacangelinayaa, wayna dili doonaan oo markii la dilo, saddex maalmood dabadeed, ayuu sara kici doonaa.
english: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Laakiin hadalkaas ayay garan waayeen, wayna ka cabsadeen inay weyddiiyaan.
english: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu yimid Kafarna'um, oo intuu gurigii joogay ayuu weyddiiyey, Maxaad ka wada hadlayseen intaad jidka ku soo socoteen?
english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

kikuyu: Laakiin way aamuseen, waayo, intay jidka ku socdeen waxay ka wada hadlayeen kan ugu weyn.
english: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

kikuyu: Intuu fadhiistay laba-iyo-tobankii ayuu u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Haddii qof doonayo inuu dadka u horreeyo, isagaa ugu wada dambayn doona, midiidin buuna u wada noqon doonaa.
english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

kikuyu: Ilmo yar ayuu qaaday oo dhexdooda joojiyey, oo goortuu gacmihiisii ku soo qaaday ayuu iyaga ku yidhi,
english: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

kikuyu: Ku alla kii carruurta kan la mid ah midkood magacayga ku aqbalaa, wuu i aqbalaa, oo ku alla kii i aqbalaa, ima aqbalo, wuxuuse aqbalaa kan i soo diray.
english: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

kikuyu: Yooxanaa baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, waxaannu aragnay qof magacaaga jinniyo ku saaraya. Nama uu soo raaco. Waannu u diidnay, waayo, isagu nama uu soo raaco.
english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise baa yidhi, Ha u diidina, waayo, ninna ma jiro oo yaab xoog leh magacayga ku sameeyaa oo dhaqso hadal xun iga odhan karaa.
english: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

kikuyu: Waayo, kan aan inaga gees ahayn waa inala gees.
english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii koob biyo ah magacayga idinku siiyaa, maxaa yeelay, waxaad tihiin kuwa Masiix, runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Abaalkiisuu ka lumi maayoba.
english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii xumeeya yaryarkan i rumaystay midkood, waxaa u roon in dhagaxshiid luqunta looga lalmiyo oo badda lagu tuuro.
english: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

kikuyu: Haddii gacantaadu ku xumayso, iska jar; waxaa kuu wanaagsan inaad gacanla'aan nolosha ku gashid intii aad adigoo laba gacmood leh ula tegi lahayd jahannamada ee ah dabkii aan la demin karayn
english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

kikuyu: oo ah meeshii dixirigoodu uusan dhimanayn, dabkuna uusan ka demayn.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

kikuyu: Cagtaaduna hadday ku xumayso, iska jar. Waxaa kuu wanaagsan inaad lugla'aan nolosha ku gashid intii adigoo laba cagood leh lagugu tuuri lahaa jahannamada
english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

kikuyu: oo ah meeshii dixirigoodu uusan dhimanayn, dabkuna uusan ka demayn.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

kikuyu: Haddii ishaadu ku xumayso, iska bixi. Waxaa kuu wanaagsan inaad boqortooyada Ilaah gashid adigoo il keliya leh intii adigoo laba indhood leh lagugu tuuri lahaa jahannamada
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

kikuyu: oo ah meeshii dixirigoodu uusan dhimanayn, dabkuna uusan ka demayn.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

kikuyu: Waayo, mid walba dab baa lagu cusbayn doonaa.
english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

kikuyu: Cusbadu waa wanaagsan tahay, laakiin cusbadu hadday dhadhan beesho, maxaad wax ku cusbaynaysaan? Cusbo isku lahaada, nabadna isu ahaada.
english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

kikuyu: Meeshaasuu ka soo kacay oo wuxuu galay soohdimaha Yahuudiya oo Webi Urdun ka shisheeya. Mar kale dadkii badnaa baa u soo ururay, oo sida caadadiisu ahaan jirtay, ayuu haddana wax baray.
english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Farrisiintu u timid oo weyddiisay, Ma xalaal baa in nin naagtiisa furo? Wayna jirrabayeen.
english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Muuse muxuu idinku amray?
english: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

kikuyu: Waxay yidhaahdeen, Muuse waa fasaxay in warqaddii furniinta la dhigo oo la furo.
english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

kikuyu: Ciisena wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Qalbi engegnaantiinna aawadeed ayuu amarkaas idiinku dhigay.
english: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

kikuyu: Laakiin tan iyo bilowgii abuurniinta, Ilaah wuxuu sameeyey lab iyo dhaddig.
english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

kikuyu: Sababtaas aawadeed nin wuxuu ka tegayaa aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis, wuxuuna la joogayaa naagtiisa.
english: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

kikuyu: Labaduba waxay noqonayaan isku jidh. Sidaa darteed haatan iyagu laba ma aha, laakiin waa isku jidh.
english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

kikuyu: Haddaba wixii Ilaah isku xidhay ninna yaanu kala furin.
english: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

kikuyu: Goortay guriga ku jireen, xertiisii ayaa haddana waxaas wax ka weyddiiyeen.
english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Ku alla kii naagtiisa furaa oo mid kale guursadaa ayaa ka sinaysta.
english: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

kikuyu: Naagna haddii ay ninkeeda furto oo mid kale guursato ayay sinaysataa.
english: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

kikuyu: Ilmo yaryar ayay u keeneen inuu taabto, xertuna way canaanatay.
english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise goortuu arkay, wuu cadhooday, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ilmaha yaryar daaya, ha ii yimaadeene, hana diidina, waayo, kuwan oo kale ayaa ka mid ah boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ku alla kii aan boqortooyada Ilaah u aqbalin sida ilmo yar oo kale, meeshaas ma uu geli doono.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

kikuyu: Gacmihiisuu ku qaaday oo intuu calaacalihiisa saaray, ayuu barakeeyey.
english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

kikuyu: Goortuu jidka u soo baxay, mid baa ku soo orday oo intuu u jilba joogsaday ayuu weyddiiyey oo ku yidhi, Macallin wanaagsanow, maxaan sameeyaa inaan nolosha weligeed ah dhaxlo?
english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad iigu yeedhaysaa, Wanaagsanow? Mid wanaagsan ma jiro mid maahee, kaasuna waa Ilaah.
english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

kikuyu: Qaynuunnada waad taqaan. Waa inaanad sinaysan, Waa inaanad qudh gooyn, Waa inaanad waxba xadin, Waa inaanad marag been ah furin, Waa inaanad waxba dulmin, Aabbahaa iyo hooyadaana maamuus.
english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

kikuyu: Wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, kuwaas oo dhan tan iyo yaraantaydii ayaan dhawrayay.
english: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise intuu eegay jeclaaday oo ku yidhi, Wax keliya ayaa kuu dhiman. Tag oo iibi waxaad haysatid oo dhan, oo masaakiintana sii, oo waxaad jannada ku lahaan doontaa maal; ee kaalay oo i soo raac.
english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

kikuyu: Hadalkaas ayuu ka qulbay, wuuna baxay isagoo calool xun, waayo, wuxuu ahaa mid waxyaalo badan leh.
english: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

kikuyu: Ciise ishuu wada mariyey oo xertiisuu ku yidhi, Kuwa hodanka ah waa ku adag tahay inay boqortooyada Ilaah galaan!
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

kikuyu: Xertiisii hadalladiisii bay ka yaabeen. Laakiin Ciise mar kaluu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ilma yahow, siday ugu adag tahay kuwa maalka isku halleeya inay boqortooyada Ilaah galaan!
english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

kikuyu: Nin hodan ah inuu boqortooyada Ilaah galo waxaa ka hawl yar in awr irbad daloolkeed ka duso.
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Aad bay u yaabeen, waxayna isku lahaayeen, Haddaba yaa badbaadi kara?
english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise eegay oo ku yidhi, Waxanu uma suurtoobaan dadka, waxbase uma aha Ilaah, waayo, wax waluba waa u suurtoobaan Ilaah.
english: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Butros bilaabay inuu ku yidhaahdo, Annagu wax walba waannu ka wada tagnay, waana ku raacnay.
english: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ma jiro nin aawaday iyo injiilka aawadiis uga tegey guri, ama walaalo, ama hooyo, ama aabbe, ama carruur, ama beero,
english: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

kikuyu: oo aan haatan oo la joogo helayn boqol laab guryo ah, iyo walaalo, iyo hooyooyin, iyo carruur, iyo beero, wuxuuna la heli doonaa silec, wakhtiga imanayana nolosha weligeed ah.
english: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

kikuyu: Laakiin kuwa badan oo hore waa dambayn doonaan, kuwa dambena waa horrayn doonaan.
english: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

kikuyu: Waxay ku socdeen jidka xaggii Yeruusaalem, Ciisena waa hor marayay. Wayna yaabeen oo intay daba socdeen way baqeen. Kolkaasuu laba-iyo-tobankii haddana waday oo bilaabay inuu u sheego waxa isaga ku dhici doona,
english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaynu ku soconnaa Yeruusaalem. Wiilka Aadanaha waxaa loo dhiibi doonaa wadaaddada sare iyo culimmada; oo waxay ku xukumi doonaan dhimasho. Waxayna u dhiibi doonaan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn.
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Wayna ku kajami doonaan, oo ku tufi doonaan, oo karbaashi doonaan, wayna dili doonaan, saddex maalmood dabadeedna wuu soo sara kici doonaa.
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Waxaa u yimid Yooxanaa iyo Yacquub oo ahaa wiilashii Sebedi, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, waxaannu doonaynaa inaad noo yeeshid wixii aannu weyddiisanno.
english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad doonaysaan inaan idiin sameeyo?
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Na sii inaannu fadhiisanno mid midigtaada, kii kalena bidixdaada xaggii ammaantaada.
english: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Garan maysaan waxaad weyddiisanaysaan. Ma karaysaan inaad ka cabtaan koobka aan ku dhowahay inaan ka cabbo, iyo in laydinku baabtiiso baabtiiska laygu baabtiisay?
english: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Waannu karaynaa. Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Koobka aan ka cabbayo waad ka cabbi doontaan, oo baabtiiska laygu baabtiisay waa laydinku baabtiisi doonaa,
english: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

kikuyu: laakiin inaad midigtayda iyo bidixdayda fadhiisataan anigu ma lihi inaan idin siiyo, laakiin waxaa la siin doonaa kuwa loo diyaargareeyey.
english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

kikuyu: Tobankii goortay taas maqleen waxay bilaabeen inay Yacquub iyo Yooxanaa u cadhoodaan.
english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise baa u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Idinku waad garanaysaan in kuwa loo malaynayo inay quruumaha madaxdooda yihiin ay u taliyaan, oo kuwooda u waaweynna ay xukun ku leeyihiin.
english: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

kikuyu: Laakiin sidaasu dhexdiinna ma aha, laakiin ku alla kii doonaya inuu dhexdiinna u weynaado, midiidinkiinna waa inuu ahaado,
english: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

kikuyu: oo ku alla kii doonaya inuu idiin horreeyo, kulli waa inuu addoon u ahaado.
english: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

kikuyu: Waayo, Wiilka Aadanahu uma iman in loo adeego laakiin inuu adeego iyo inuu naftiisa dad badan furashadooda u bixiyo.
english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay yimaadeen Yerixoo, oo goortuu Yerixoo ka soo baxayay, isaga iyo xertiisii iyo dad faro badanba, nin indha la' oo Bartimayos la odhan jiray, oo ina Timayos ahaa, ayaa jidka ag fadhiyey oo dawarsanayay.
english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

kikuyu: Goortuu maqlay inuu yahay Ciisihii reer Naasared, wuxuu bilaabay inuu aad u qayliyo oo yidhaahdo, Ciise, ina Daa'uudow, ii naxariiso.
english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Qaar badan baa canaantay si uu u aamuso, laakiin si ka badan ayuu ugu qayliyey, Ina Daa'uudow, ii naxariiso.
english: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ciise joogsaday oo yidhi, U yeedha. Markaasay ninkii indhaha la'aa u yeedheen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Kalsoonow, kac, waa kuu yeedhayaaye.
english: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

kikuyu: Intuu maradiisa iska tuuray ayuu booday oo Ciise u yimid.
english: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Maxaad doonaysaa inaan kuu sameeyo? Indhoolihii baa ku yidhi, Sayidow, inaan wax arko.
english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Soco. Rumaysadkaaga ayaa ku bogsiiyey. Kolkiiba ayuu wax arkay, oo jidka buu la qaaday isaga.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

kikuyu: Goortay Yeruusaalem ku soo dhowaadeen, halka Beytfaage iyo Beytaniya, xaggii Buur Saytuun, xertiisii ayuu laba ka diray.
english: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Tuulada idinka soo hor jeedda taga, oo kolkiiba markaad gashaan waxaad ka helaysaan qayl xidhan oo aan ninna weligii fuulin. Soo fura oo keena.
english: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

kikuyu: Haddii nin idinku yidhaahdo, Maxaad waxan u samaynaysaan? waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Sayidkaa u baahan, oo kolkiiba wuu u soo diri doonaa halkan.
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

kikuyu: Markaasay tageen oo heleen qayl ku xidhan irid agteed meel dibadda ah oo jidka dhexdiisaa, wayna soo fureen.
english: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

kikuyu: Kuwa halkaa taagnaa qaarkood waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaad samaynaysaan oo u furaysaan qaylka?
english: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay waxay ku yidhaahdeen sida Ciise u amray, markaasay oggolaadeen.
english: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

kikuyu: Waxay qaylkii u keeneen Ciise, dharkoodana ayay dusha ka saareen, wuuna ku fadhiistay.
english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

kikuyu: Dad badan baa dharkoodii jidka ku goglay, kuwa kalena laamo ayay beeraha ka soo jareen oo jidka ku gogleen.
english: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

kikuyu: Kuwii hor socday iyo kuwii daba socdayba way qayliyeen oo yidhaahdeen, Hoosanna, waxaa barakaysan kan Rabbiga magiciisa ku imanayo.
english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan boqortooyada imanaysa oo aabbeheen Daa'uud. Hoosanna ha ku jirto meelaha ugu sarreeya.
english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise Yeruusaalem yimid oo galay macbudka. Goortuu hareeraha iyo wax walbaba eegay, oo gabbalkiina dhacay, ayuu Beytaniya laba-iyo-tobankii ula baxay.
english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

kikuyu: Maalintii dambe, markay Beytaniya ka yimaadeen, wuu gaajaysnaa.
english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Meel fog wuxuu ka arkay geed berde ah oo caleen leh. Wuu u yimid inuu haddana wax ka helo. Goortuu u yimid waxba kama uu helin caleemo keliya maahee, waayo, wakhtigii berdaha ma ahayn.
english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo geedkii ku yidhi, Hadda dabadeed weligaa ninna yuu midho kaa cunin. Xertiisiina waa maqashay.
english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

kikuyu: Waxay yimaadeen Yeruusaalem. Ciisena macbudka ayuu galay oo bilaabay inuu ka eryo kuwii macbudkii wax ku iibinayay iyo kuwii wax ka iibsanayay. Wuxuuna rogay miisaskii kuwii lacagta bedbeddelayay iyo kursiyadii kuwii qoolleyaha iibinayay.
english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

kikuyu: Umana oggolayn in ninna alaab macbudka la soo dhex maro.
english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wax baray oo ku yidhi, Miyaanay qornayn, Gurigayga waxaa quruumaha oo dhan loogu yeedhi doonaa guriga tukashada? Idinkuse waxaad ka dhigteen god tuugo.
english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

kikuyu: Markii wadaaddadii sare iyo culimmadii maqleen, waxay doonayeen si ay u dilaan, waayo, way ka baqeen, maxaa yeelay, dadka oo dhan waxay ka yaabeen waxbariddiisa.
english: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

kikuyu: Mar alla markii qorraxdu dhacday ayay magaalada ka baxeen.
english: When evening came, he went out of the city.

kikuyu: Subaxdii goortay ag marayeen, waxay arkeen geedkii berdaha ahaa oo xididdada ka engegay.
english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros soo xusuustay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Macallinkaygiiyow, eeg, geedkii berdaha ahaa oo aad habaartay waa engegay.
english: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ilaah rumaysta.
english: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ku alla kii buurtan ku yidhaahda, Ruq, baddana isku tuur, oo aan qalbigiisana ka shakiyin laakiin rumaysta in wuxuu yidhi ay noqonayso, waa u ahaan doontaa.
english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed, waxaan idinku leeyahay, wax kasta oo aad tukasho ku baridaan, rumaysta inaad hesheen oo way idiin ahaan doontaa.
english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

kikuyu: Oo kolkaad tukasho u taagan tihiin, cafiya haddii aad dad wax ku leedihiin, si Aabbihiinna jannada ku jiraa xumaantiinna idiin cafiyo.
english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

kikuyu: Haddii aanad cafiyin, Aabbihiinna jannada ku jira xumaantiinna idiin cafiyi maayo.
english: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

kikuyu: Mar kale ayay Yeruusaalem yimaadeen. Oo goortuu macbudkii dhex marayay waxaa u yimid wadaaddadii sare iyo culimmadii iyo waayeelladii.
english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Amarkee baad waxan ku samaysaa? Yaa amarkan ku siiyey inaad waxan ku samayso?
english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Aniguna hal baan idin weyddiinayaa, ii jawaaba, waanan idiin sheegi doonaa amarka aan waxan ku sameeyo.
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Baabtiiskii Yooxanaa ma wuxuu ka yimid xagga jannada mise dadka? Ii jawaaba.
english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

kikuyu: Dhexdooda ayay iskala hadleen iyagoo leh, Maxaynu nidhaahnaa? Haddaynu nidhaahno, Xagga jannada, wuxuu inagu odhanayaa, Haddaba maxaad u rumaysan weydeen?
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii aynu nidhaahno, Xagga dadka ayuu ka yimid, dadkay ka baqeen. Waayo, kulli waxay u haysteen Yooxanaa inuu nebi yahay.
english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

kikuyu: Markaasay Ciise u jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Garan mayno. Ciisena wuxuu ku yidhi, Aniguna idiin sheegi maayo amarka aan waxan ku sameeyo.
english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu bilaabay inuu masaallo kula hadlo iyaga. Nin baa wuxuu beertay beer canab ah, oo ood ku heraaray, dabadeedna god macsareed ka dhex qoday, oo munaarad ka dhisay, oo niman beerrey ah u kiraystay, oo dal kale tegey.
english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

kikuyu: Goortii xilligii yimid, ayuu addoon u soo diray beerreydii inuu beerreydii midhihii beerta ka soo qaado.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

kikuyu: Markaasay qabteen oo garaaceen oo waxla'aan ku direen.
english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Haddana addoon kale ayuu u soo diray. Kaasay dakhreen oo ceebeeyeen.
english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

kikuyu: Haddana mid kale ayuu u soo diray, wayna dileen; oo qaar kale oo badan ayuu diray. Qaar waa la garaacay; qaarna waa la dilay.
english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

kikuyu: Weliba wuxuu lahaa wiil keliya oo uu jeclaa. Kolkii ugu dambaysay ayuu u soo diray isagii, oo wuxuu yidhi, Wiilkayga way maamuusi doonaan.
english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

kikuyu: Laakiin beerreydii waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Kanu waa kii dhaxalka lahaa, kaalaya aan dilnee, dhaxalkiina innagaa lahaan doonna.
english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

kikuyu: Way qabteen, wayna dileen, oo beertii canabka ahayd dibaddeeda ku tuureen.
english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

kikuyu: Haddaba sayidkii beerta canabka ah muxuu samayn doonaa? Wuu iman doonaa oo beerreyda dili doonaa, dad kalena ayuu beerta canabka ah u dhiibi doonaa.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

kikuyu: Miyaanaydin weligiin Qorniinka ka akhriyin Dhagixii kuwa wax dhisaa ay diideen, Kaasu wuxuu noqday madaxa rukunka.
english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

kikuyu: Tanu xagga Rabbiga bay ka timid; Oo waa ku yaab indhahayaga?
english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay dooneen inay qabtaan, laakiin dadkay ka baqeen; waayo, way garteen inuu masaalka iyaga kaga hadlay, markaasay iska daayeen oo ka tageen.
english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

kikuyu: Waxay u soo direen Farrisiinta iyo Herodosiinta qaarkood si ay hadalkiisa ugu qabtaan.
english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

kikuyu: Goortay yimaadeen waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, waannu og nahay inaad run tahay oo aanad ninna u eexan, waayo, dadka wejigooda ma eegtid, jidka Ilaahse aad run ku bartid. Ma xalaal baa in cashuur Kaysar la siiyo ama inaan la siin?
english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

kikuyu: Ma siinna mise ma siinno? Isaguse labawejiilenimadooda ayuu gartay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad ii jirrabaysaan? Dinaar ii keena aan arko e.
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

kikuyu: Wayna u keeneen, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Yaa leh masawirkan iyo qorniinkan? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Kaysar baa leh.
english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Kaysar siiya wixii Kaysar leeyahay, Ilaahna siiya wixii Ilaah leeyahay. Wayna ka yaabeen.
english: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa u yimid Sadukiin kuwii odhan jiray, Sarakicidda kuwii dhintay ma jirto. Oo waxay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen,
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

kikuyu: Macallimow, Muuse wuxuu noo qoray, Nin walaalkiis hadduu dhinto oo naag ka tago isagoo aan ilmo lahayn, walaalkiis naagtiisa waa inuu dumaalo oo uu carruur walaalkiis u dhalo.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

kikuyu: Waxaa jiray toddoba walaalo ah. Kii ugu horreeyey naag buu qabay, wuuna dhintay, dhalna kama tegin.
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

kikuyu: Kii labaad baa dumaalay, wuuna dhintay, isaguna dhal kama tegin, oo sidaas oo kalaa ku dhacday kii saddexaad.
english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

kikuyu: Toddobadii way wada guursadeen, dhalna kama tegin. Kulligood dabadood naagtiina waa dhimatay.
english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

kikuyu: Wakhtiga sarakicidda kuwii dhintay iyaga kee bay naagtiisii ahaan doontaa? Waayo, toddobadu way wada guursadeen.
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Sidaa darteed miyaydnaan qaldamin? Waayo, Qorniinka iyo xoogga Ilaah midna garan maysaan.
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

kikuyu: Waayo, goortay kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kacaan layskuma guursado, guurna layskuma siiyo, laakiin waxay yihiin sida malaa'igaha jannada ku jira.
english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

kikuyu: Oo xagga kuwii dhintay in la sara kiciyo miyaydnaan kitaabkii Muuse ka akhriyin sidii Ilaah geedkii ugala soo hadlay oo yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay Ilaaha Ibraahim iyo Ilaaha Isxaaq iyo Ilaaha Yacquub?
english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

kikuyu: Isagu ma aha Ilaaha kuwa dhintay, laakiin waa Ilaaha kuwa nool. Idinku aad baad u qaldan tihiin.
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa culimmada midkood u yimid, oo markuu maqlay iyagoo wada hadlaya, oo markuu gartay inuu si wanaagsan u jawaabay, ayuu wax weyddiiyey oo ku yidhi, Qaynuunkee baa ka horreeya kuwa kale oo dhan?
english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Kan ugu horreeyaa waxaa weeye, Maqal, Israa'iilow, Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah waa Rabbi keliya.
english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

kikuyu: Waa inaad Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah ka jeclaataa qalbigaaga oo dhan, iyo naftaada oo dhan, iyo caqligaaga oo dhan, iyo xooggaaga oo dhan.
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

kikuyu: Ku labaad waa kan, Waa inaad deriskaaga u jeclaataa sida naftaada. Qaynuun kale oo kuwan ka weyn ma jiro.
english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

kikuyu: Waxaa culimmada mid ka mid ahu ku yidhi, Sida runta ah, Macallimow, si wanaagsan baad u hadashay markaad tidhi, Isagu waa mid keliya, oo mid kalena ma jiro isaga ma ahaane.
english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

kikuyu: In laga jeclaado qalbiga oo dhan, iyo caqliga oo dhan, iyo nafta oo dhan, iyo xoogga oo dhan, iyo in deriska loo jeclaado sida nafta, taasaa ka sii wanaagsan allabaryo la wada gubo iyo allabaryo kale oo dhanba.
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

kikuyu: Markii Ciise arkay inuu miyir ku jawaabay, wuxuu ku yidhi, Boqortooyada Ilaah kama aad fogid. Markaas dabadeed ninna kuma dhicin inuu wax weyddiiyo.
english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, intuu macbudka wax ku barayay, Culimmadu sidee bay u yidhaahdaan, Masiixu waa ina Daa'uud?
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

kikuyu: Daa'uud qudhiisuna, isagoo Ruuxa Quduuskaa ku hadlaya, ayuu wuxuu yidhi, Rabbigu wuxuu Sayidkayga ku yidhi, Midigtayda fadhiiso, Ilaa aan cadaawayaashaada cagahaaga hoostooda geliyo.
english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

kikuyu: Daa'uud qudhiisa ayaa ugu yeedhay Sayid, sidee buu wiilkiisa u yahay? Dadkii badnaana farxad bay ku maqleen.
english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

kikuyu: Markuu wax barayay wuxuu ku yidhi, Iska jira culimmada oo doonaya inay khamiisyo dhaadheer ku socdaan, oo jecel salaanta suuqa,
english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

kikuyu: iyo kursiyada hore oo sunagogyada, iyo meelaha hore oo diyaafadaha.
english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

kikuyu: Waxay yihiin kuwa wada laasta guryaha carmallada, oo tukashooyin dhaadheer ayay istusid u tukadaan. Kuwaas waxay heli doonaan xisaab aad u daran.
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu fadhiistay meel ka hor jeedda khasnaddii, oo wuxuu eegayay sida dadku lacagta ugu ridayo khasnaddii. Qaar badan oo hodon ah ayaa wax badan ku riday.
english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa yimid carmal miskiin ah. Iyadu waxay ku ridday laba lacag ah oo yaryar oo qiimadood beesad tahay.
english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

kikuyu: Markaasuu xertiisii u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Carmalkan miskiinta ah waxay ku ridday wax ka badan wixii ay dhammaan ku ridayaan khasnaddii.
english: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

kikuyu: Waayo, kulligood waxay kaga rideen waxoodii badnaa, iyaduse miskiinnimadeeday kaga ridday wixii ay lahayd oo dhan, xataa wixii ay ku noolaan lahayd oo dhan.
english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

kikuyu: Goortuu macbudka ka baxay, xertiisa midkood ayaa ku yidhi, Eeg, Macallimow, dhagaxyada iyo dhismaha siday u weyn yihiin!
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Guryahan waaweyn ma arkaysaa? Halkan lagu dul dayn maayo dhagax dhagax kale dushiisa oo aan la dumin doonin.
english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Oo intuu Buur Saytuun fadhiistay, meel macbudka ku toosan, Butros iyo Yacquub iyo Yooxanaa iyo Andaros waxay keli ahaan u weyddiiyeen, oo ku yidhaahdeen,
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

kikuyu: Noo sheeg, Goormay waxyaalahanu ahaan doonaan? Calaamadu maxay ahaan doontaa, goortii waxyaalahan oo dhan dhammaan u dhowaan doonaan?
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo bilaabay inuu ku yidhaahdo, Iska eega yaan laydin khiyaanayn.
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

kikuyu: Qaar badan ayaa magacayga ku iman doona, oo waxay odhan doonaan, Anigu waxaan ahay isaga, oo qaar badan ayay khiyaanayn doonaan.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Goortaad dagaallo maqashaan iyo dagaallo hadalhayntood ha baqanina. Waxaasu waa inay dhacaan, laakiin dhammaadku weli weeye.
english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

kikuyu: Waayo, quruunba quruun bay ku kici doontaa, boqortooyona boqortooyo, oo waxaa meelo kala duwan ka dhici doona dhulgariir iyo abaaro. Waxanu waa bilowga hoogagga.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

kikuyu: Laakiin iska jira. Waxaa laydiin dhiibi doonaa shirar, oo sunagogyo waa laydinku karbaashi doonaa; taliyayaal iyo boqorro hortooda ayaad daraadday u istaagi doontaan inaad markhaati u ahaataan.
english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

kikuyu: Horta injiilka waa in lagu wacdiyo quruumaha oo dhan.
english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

kikuyu: Oo goortii laydin wado oo laydin gacangeliyo, horta ha ka welwelina wixii aad ku hadli doontaan; laakiin wixii saacaddaas laydin siiyo, waxaas ku hadla, waayo, ma aha idinka kuwa hadlayaa laakiin waa Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Walaalba walaalkiis wuxuu u dhiibi doonaa in la dilo, aabbena wiilkiis, carruurna waalidkood ayay ku kici doonaan, oo dhimasho ay gaadhsiin doonaan.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

kikuyu: Dadka oo dhan ayaa magacayga aawadiis idiin necbaan doona, laakiin kan ilaa ugu dambaysta adkaysta kaasaa badbaadi doona.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortaad aragtaan waxa baas oo hallaynta ah oo taagan meeshii uusan lahayn inuu taagnaado (kii akhriyaa ha garto), markaas kuwa Yahuudiya joogaa buuraha ha u carareen.
english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

kikuyu: Kii guri fuushanuna yaanu guriga u soo degin oo gelin inuu wax ka soo qaato.
english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

kikuyu: Kii beer joogaana yaanu dib ugu noqon inuu dharkiisa soo qaato.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa u hoog kuwa uurka leh iyo kuwa wakhtigaas ilmo nuujinaya.
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

kikuyu: Barya inaan waxaasu noqon wakhtiga qabowga.
english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

kikuyu: Waayo, maalmahaas waxay ahaan doonaan dhib sida mid aan jirin tan iyo bilowgii abuurniinta oo Ilaah abuuray, mana jiri doonto weligeed.
english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

kikuyu: Oo haddaan Rabbigu wakhtigaas gaabin, ninna ma uu badbaadeen, laakiin kuwuu doortay aawadood ayuu wakhtigaas u gaabshay.
english: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

kikuyu: Markaas haddii nin idinku yidhaahdo, Waa kan Masiixii, ama, Waa kaas, ha rumaysanina.
english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa kici doona Masiixyo been ah iyo nebiyo been ah, oo waxay samayn doonaan calaamooyin iyo yaabab si ay xataa kuwa la doortay u khiyaaneeyaan hadday u suurtowdo.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

kikuyu: Laakiin idinku iska jira, wax walbaba horaan idiinku sheegaye.
english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

kikuyu: Laakiin wakhtigaas, dhibtaas dabadeed, qorraxdu waa madoobaan doontaa, dayaxuna ma nuuri doono,
english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

kikuyu: xiddiguhuna cirka waa ka soo dhici doonaan, xoogagga cirka ku jirana waa la gariirin doonaa.
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay arki doonaan Wiilka Aadanaha oo daruuraha ku imanaya isagoo leh xoog badan iyo ammaan.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu soo diri doonaa malaa'igihiisa, oo kuwuu doortay ayuu ka soo ururin doonaa afarta jahood ee meesha dhulka ugu fog ilaa meesha cirka ugu fog.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

kikuyu: Haddeer geedka berdaha ah masaal ka garta. Intii laantiisu curdan tahay oo caleemo bixinayso, waxaad garanaysaan inuu roobku dhow yahay.
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

kikuyu: Idinkuna sidaas oo kale goortaad aragtaan waxaas oo dhacaya, garta inuu Wiilka Aadanahu dhow yahay oo albaabbada ag joogo.
english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Qarniganu ma idlaan doono intaanay waxan oo dhammi dhicin.
english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

kikuyu: Cirka iyo dhulku waa idlaan doonaan, laakiinse hadalladaydu ma idlaan doonaan.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

kikuyu: Laakiin maalintaas iyo saacaddaas ninna waxba kama oga, malaa'igaha jannada ku jira iyo Wiilka toona, midna ma oga, Aabbaha keliya maahee.
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

kikuyu: Iska jira oo soo jeeda, waayo, ma ogidin wakhtigu goortuu yahay.
english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

kikuyu: Waa sidii nin dal kale tegey oo gurigiisii kaga tegey. Addoommadiisa ayuu amar siiyey, nin walbana shuqulkiisa; wuxuuna amray albaabjoogahu inuu soo jeedo.
english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

kikuyu: Soo jeeda haddaba, waayo, idinku ma ogidin sayidkii guriga lahaa goortuu imanayo, inay tahay makhrib, ama habeenbadhkii, ama goortii diiqu ciyo, ama aroortiiba,
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

kikuyu: waayo, waaba intaasuu idinku soo kediyaa oo uu idin helaa idinkoo hurda.
english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay ayaan dadkii oo dhan ku leeyahay, Soo jeeda.
english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

kikuyu: Laba maalmood dabadeed waxaa jiray Iiddii Kormaridda iyo Iiddii Kibistii-aan-khamiirka-lahayn. Wadaaddadii sare iyo culimmadii waxay doonayeen si ay khiyaano ugu qabtaan oo ay u dilaan.
english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay yidhaahdeen, Yaanay noqon wakhtiga iidda si aan rabshad dadka uga dhex kicin.
english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu Beytaniya joogay oo ku jiray guriga Simoon kii baraska qabi jiray, intuu cuntada u fadhiyey, waxaa u timid naag haysa weel alabastar ah oo cadar naaradiin oo qaali ah ku jiro. Weelkii bay jebisay, oo cadarkii madaxiisay ku shubtay.
english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

kikuyu: Waxaa joogay kuwa qalbiga ka cadhooday, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Cadarkii maxaa sidan loogu khasaariyey?
english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

kikuyu: Waayo, cadarkan waxaa lagu iibin kari lahaa wax saddex boqol oo dinaar ka badan oo masaakiinta la siin lahaa, wayna ku gunuunaceen iyadii.
english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise baa ku yidhi, Daaya. Maxaad iyada u dhibaysaan? Shuqul wanaagsan ayay igu samaysaye.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

kikuyu: Waayo, masaakiintu mar walba way idinla jiraan. Markaad doonaysaan wax wanaagsan waad u samayn kartaan. Aniguse mar walba idinlama joogo.
english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

kikuyu: Way samaysay waxay kartay. Waxay hore ugu soo baxday inay jidhkayga udgoonayso aasniintayda aawadeed.
english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Dunida oo dhan meel alla meeshii injiilkan lagu wacdiyo, waxay samaysay ayaa xusuusteeda lagaga hadli doonaa.
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

kikuyu: Yuudas Iskariyod oo ahaa mid laba-iyo-tobanka ka mid ah ayaa u tegey wadaaddada sare inuu u gacangeliyo.
english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: Iyagu markay maqleen ayay farxeen oo waxay ka ballanqaadeen inay lacag siiyaan. Markaasuu doonayay goor wanaagsan oo uu u soo gacangeliyo.
english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

kikuyu: Maalinta ugu horraysay oo Iiddii Kibistii-aan-khamiirka-lahayn, goortii neefka Kormaridda la gowraco ayaa xertiisii ku tidhi, Xaggee baad doonaysaa inaannu tagno oo ku diyaargarayno inaad cuntid cashada Iidda Kormaridda?
english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu diray laba xertiisii ah oo ku yidhi, Magaalada gala, oo waxaa idinla kulmi doona nin ashuun biyah sita; isaga raaca.
english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

kikuyu: Meeshuu galo waxaad ninkii guriga lahaa ku tidhaahdaan, Macallinkii wuxuu leeyahay, Meeday qolladdaydii martidu oo aan xertayda kula cuni doono cashada Iidda Kormaridda?
english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

kikuyu: Wuxuu idin tusayaa qollad weyn oo sare oo goglan oo diyaar ah; halkaa inoogu diyaargareeya.
english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

kikuyu: Xertiisii ayaa baxday oo magaalada gashay, wayna heleen siduu u sheegay, oo cashada Iidda Kormaridda ayay diyaargareeyeen.
english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Goortii makhribkii la gaadhay ayuu laba-iyo-tobankii la yimid.
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

kikuyu: Oo intay fadhiisteen oo wax cunayeen, Ciise baa yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Midkiin oo wax ila cunaya ayaa i gacangelin doona.
english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

kikuyu: Markaasay calool xumaadeen, oo mid baa mid ku yidhi, Ma aniga baa?
english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

kikuyu: Wuu u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa mid ka mid ah laba-iyo-tobankii oo saxanka gacanta ila gesha.
english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

kikuyu: Wiilka Aadanahu waa baxayaa siday u qoran tahay, laakiin hoog waxaa leh ninkaas Wiilka Aadanaha gacangelinaya. Waxaa ninkaas u wanaagsanaan lahayd inaanu dhalan.
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: Oo intay wax cunayeen, Ciise ayaa kibis qaaday oo barakeeyey, wuuna jejebiyey oo iyaga siiyey oo yidhi, Qaata, tanu waa jidhkaygiiye.
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu koobkii qaaday oo mahadnaqay oo siiyey iyaga, oo kulli way ka wada cabbeen.
english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Kanu waa dhiiggayga axdiga cusub kan kuwo badan loo daadshay.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mar dambe midhaha geedka canabka ah kama cabbi doono ilaa maalinta aan boqortooyada Ilaah ka cabbi doono kan cusub.
english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Goortay gabay ammaan ah ku gabyeen waxay u baxeen Buur Saytuun.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Kulligiin waad iga xumaan doontaan, waayo, waxaa qoran, Adhijirkaan dili doonaa, idahuna waa kala firdhi doonaan.
english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

kikuyu: Laakiin markii kuwii dhintay layga sara kiciyo dabadeed ayaan Galili hortiin tegi doonaa.
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
