kikuyu: Laakiin Butros ayaa ku yidhi, In kastoo kulligood kaa xumaadaan, aniguse kaa xumaan maayo.
english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan kugu leeyahay, Maalintan, xataa caawa, intaan diiqu laba goor ciyin, saddex kol ayaad i dafiri doontaa.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Laakiin aad buu ugu celceliyey, Haddaan leeyahay inaan kula dhinto, kolleyba ku dafiri maayo. Kulligoodba sidaas oo kale ayay yidhaahdeen.
english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

kikuyu: Markaasay yimaadeen meel Getsemane la odhan jiray, wuxuuna xertiisii ku yidhi, Halkan fadhiista intii aan soo tukanayo.
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu watay Butros iyo Yacquub iyo Yooxanaa, oo wuxuu bilaabay inuu calool xumaado oo tiraanyoodo.
english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Naftaydu aad bay u calool xun tahay tan iyo dhimasho; halkan jooga oo soo jeeda.
english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

kikuyu: Waxoogaa ayuu hore u socday oo dhulkuu ku dhacay, wuxuuna tukaday in hadday suurtowdo saacaddu ay dhaafto.
english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna yidhi, Aabbow, Aabbe, wax walbaba waad karaysaa. Koobkan iga qaad, laakiin yaanay noqon waxaan doonayo, ee waxaad doonaysid ha noqoto.
english: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yimid oo wuxuu arkay iyagoo hurda, oo wuxuu Butros ku yidhi, Simoonow, ma huruddaa? Miyaad kari wayday inaad saacad keliya soo jeeddo?
english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

kikuyu: Soo jeeda oo tukada inaydnaan jirrabaadda gelin. Ruuxu waa diyaar, laakiin jidhku waa itaal daranyahay.
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: Mar kale ayuu tegey oo tukaday isagoo hadalkii oo kale ku hadlaya.
english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Mar kale ayuu yimid oo arkay iyagoo hurda, waayo, indhahoodu lulmay la cuslaayeen, ma ayna garan waxay ugu jawaabaan.
english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

kikuyu: Kolkii saddexaad ayuu yimid oo ku yidhi, Hadda seexda oo nasta, waa ku filan tahay. Saacaddii waa timid. Bal eega, Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa dembilayaal loo gacangelinayaa.
english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

kikuyu: Kaca aan tagnee. Eega, kii i gacangelin lahaa waa soo dhow yahay.
english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba intuu weli hadlayay ayaa Yuudas oo laba-iyo-tobankii ka mid ahaa yimid, isaga iyo dad aad u badan oo seefo iyo ulo sita. Waxay ka yimaadeen wadaaddada sare iyo culimmada iyo waayeellada.
english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

kikuyu: Kii gacangeliyey ayaa calaamo kula ballamay oo ku yidhi, Mid alla midkaan dhunkado waa isagii. Qabta oo kaxeeya oo dhawra.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

kikuyu: Kolkuu yimidba, kolkiiba ayuu u tegey oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, wuuna dhunkaday.
english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

kikuyu: Markaasay gacmaha saareen, wayna qabteen.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

kikuyu: Midkooda oo ag taagnaa ayaa seeftiisa soo bixiyey, oo wuxuu ku dhuftay wadaadkii sare addoonkiisii, oo dheg buu ka gooyay.
english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ma waxaad iila soo baxdeen seefo iyo ulo inaad i qabataan sidaan tuug ahay?
english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

kikuyu: Maalin walbaba macbudka ayaan idinkula jiri jiray oo wax bari jiray, imana aydnaan qabsan, laakiin Qorniinku waa inuu rumoobo.
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Markaasay xertii ka wada tageen oo carareen.
english: They all left him, and fled.

kikuyu: Waxaa daba socday nin dhallinyaro ah oo qaawanaantiisa maro jilicsan ka huwaday; wayna qabteen.
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

kikuyu: Laakiin maradii jilicsanayd ayuu ka tegey oo ka cararay isagoo qaawan.
english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

kikuyu: Ciisena waxay u geeyeen wadaadkii sare, waxaana u soo ururay wadaaddadii sare iyo waayeelladii iyo culimmadii.
english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

kikuyu: Butros baa meel fog ka soo daba socday, oo wuxuu galay barxadda wadaadkii sare oo la fadhiistay askartii, dabkana ayuu kulaalay.
english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

kikuyu: Wadaaddadii sare iyo shirkii oo dhan ayaa waxay dooneen markhaati Ciise ka gees ah si ay u dilaan, waase heli waayeen.
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

kikuyu: Waayo, qaar badan baa marag been ah ku fureen, laakiin maraggoodii isku mid ma ahayn.
english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa kacay qaar marag been ah ku furay oo yidhaahdeen,
english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

kikuyu: Waxaannu maqalnay isagoo leh, Macbudkan gacmo lagu sameeyey ayaan dudumin doonaa, saddex maalmood dabadeed waxaan dhisi doonaa mid kale oo aan gacmo lagu samayn.
english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

kikuyu: Laakiin sidaasuuna maraggoodii isku mid u ahayn.
english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii sare dhexda istaagay oo Ciise weyddiiyey isagoo leh, Miyaanad waxba ka jawaabayn? Kuwanu waxay kugu marag furayaan waa maxay?
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Isaguse waa iska aamusay oo waxba uma jawaabin. Mar kale wadaadkii sare ayaa weyddiiyey oo ku yidhi, Miyaad tahay Masiixa oo ah Wiilka Kan la ammaano?
english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

kikuyu: Ciise baa yidhi, Waan ahay, oo waxaad arki doontaan Wiilka Aadanaha oo fadhiya midigta xoogga Ilaah, oo ku imanaya daruuraha cirka.
english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii sare dharkiisii jeexjeexay oo yidhi, Maxaannu markhaatiyaal weli ugu baahan nahay?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

kikuyu: Waad maqasheen caytanka. Maxay idinla tahay? Kulligood waxay xukumeen inuu dhimasho istaahilo.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

kikuyu: Qaar waxay bilaabeen inay candhuuf ku tufaan oo wejigiisa daboolaan oo garaacaan, waxayna ku yidhaahdeen, Wax sheeg. Askartiina way dharbaaxeen.
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

kikuyu: Butros intuu hoosta joogay xaggii barxadda, waxaa u timid mid ka mid ah hablihii wadaadkii sare u shaqaynayay,
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

kikuyu: oo markay aragtay Butros oo dabka kulaalaya, ayay dayday oo tidhi, Adiguna waxaad la jirtay Ciisihii reer Naasared.
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu dafiray oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Anigu ma aqaan, garanba maayo waxaad leedahay. Markaasuu albaabka agtiisa tegey, diiqiina waa ciyey.
english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Gabadhii baa aragtay oo bilowday haddana inay kuwii ag taagnaa ku tidhaahdo, Kanu waa midkood.
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

kikuyu: Laakiin mar kale ayuu dafiray. Waxoogaa yar dabadeed kuwii ag taagnaa ayaa mar kale Butros ku yidhi, Run weeye, adiguna midkood baad tahay, waayo, waxaad tahay reer Galili, afkaaguna waa la mid afkooda.
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu bilaabay inuu habaaro oo dhaarto isagoo leh, Anigu garan maayo ninkaas aad ka hadlaysaan.
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

kikuyu: Kolkii labaad ayaa diiqii ciyey; oo Butros wuxuu xusuustay hadalkii Ciise ku hadlay, Diiqu intaanu laba goor ciyin, saddex kol ayaad i dafiri doontaa, oo intuu ka fikirayay ayuu ooyay.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

kikuyu: Aroortii kolkiiba wadaaddadii sare waxay la wada hadleen waayeelladii iyo culimmadii iyo shirkii oo dhan. Ciisena way xidheen oo kaxeeyeen oo waxay u dhiibeen Bilaatos.
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

kikuyu: Bilaatos wuxuu weyddiiyey, Ma Boqorka Yuhuudda baad tahay? Wuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waad tidhi.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaaddadii sare wax badan ku ashtakeeyeen.
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

kikuyu: Bilaatos baa kol dambe wax weyddiiyey isagoo leh, Miyaanad waxba ka jawaabayn? Bal eeg intii ay kugu ashtakaynayaan.
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise weli waxba ugama jawaabin, sidaa darteed Bilaatos waa la yaabay.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

kikuyu: Iiddaas wuxuu iyaga u sii dayn jiray maxbuuskay doonayeen.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa jiray nin Baraabbas la odhan jiray oo ahaa mid lala xidhay kuwii kula kacay oo wax dilay markii fidmaddu dhacday.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa ayaa Bilaatos u kacay oo bilaabay inay doonaan inuu u sameeyo siduu u samayn jiray.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

kikuyu: Bilaatos baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ma waxaad doonaysaan inaan idiin sii daayo Boqorka Yuhuudda?
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu ogaa wadaaddadii sare inay hinaaso ugu soo dhiibeen.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

kikuyu: Laakiin wadaaddadii sare ayaa dadka kiciyey, oo waxay yidhaahdeen inay u roon tahay inuu Baraabbas u sii daayo iyaga.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

kikuyu: Bilaatos baa mar kale u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Haddaba maxaad doonaysaan inaan ku sameeyo kan aad ugu yeedhaan Boqorka Yuhuudda?
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Iyaguna mar kale ayay ku qayliyeen, Iskutallaabta ku qodob.
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bilaatos ku yidhi, Waa maxay sharkuu falay? Laakiin aad bay u sii qayliyeen oo yidhaahdeen, Iskutallaabta ku qodob.
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Bilaatos wuxuu doonayay inuu sameeyo waxa dadku raalli ka yahay, sidaa darteed ayuu Baraabbas u sii daayay, oo goortuu Ciise karbaashay ayuu u dhiibay in iskutallaabta lagu qodbo.
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

kikuyu: Markaasaa askartii isaga geeyeen barxaddii dhexdeeda, taasoo la odhan jiray Baraytoriyon, waxayna isugu yeedheen askartii oo dhan.
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

kikuyu: Waxay u geliyeen dhar guduudan, oo taaj ayay qodxan uga texeen, oo madaxiisay saareen.
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

kikuyu: Markaasay salaameen oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Nabad, Boqorka Yuhuuddow.
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

kikuyu: Madaxana ayay cawsduur kaga dhufteen, oo wayna ku candhuufeen, oo u jilba joogsadeen, oo u sujuudeen.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

kikuyu: Goortay ku majaajiloodeen dabadeed ayay dharkii guduudnaa ka qaadeen oo dharkiisii bay u geliyeen, markaasay wadeen in iskutallaabta lagu qodbo.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

kikuyu: Waxaa ag marayay nin beeraha ka yimid, oo reer Kuranaya ah, oo Simoon la odhan jiray, oo ahaa aabbihii Aleksanderos iyo Rufus, kan ay ku qasbeen inuu iskutallaabtiisa u qaado.
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

kikuyu: Oo waxay u soo wadeen meel Golgota la odhan jiray, taasoo micneheedu yahay meeshii dhakada.
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

kikuyu: Waxay siiyeen inuu cabbo khamri xammeeti lagu daray, laakiin ma uu qaadan.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

kikuyu: Oo goortay iskutallaabta ku qodbeen, dharkiisay qaybsadeen, wayna saami ku riteen mid kasta wuxuu qaadan lahaa.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

kikuyu: Waxayna ahayd saacaddii saddexaad oo iskutallaabta ay ku qodbeen.
english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

kikuyu: Waxaa lagu qoray meel ka korraysa isaga qorniinkii ashtakadiisii oo leh, BOQORKA YUHUUDDA.
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa iskutallaabo lagula qodbay laba tuug, mid midigtiisa, midna bidixdiisa.
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa rumoobay Qorniinkii yidhi, Waxaa isaga lagu tiriyey sharcilaawayaasha.
english: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

kikuyu: Oo kuwii ag marayayna waa caayeen, oo intay madaxooda luleen, waxay yidhaahdeen, Kaaga macbudka duminayow oo saddex maalmood ku dhisayow,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

kikuyu: isbadbaadi oo iskutallaabta ka soo deg.
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena ayaa wadaaddada sare dhexdooda ugu majaajiloodeen, iyaga iyo culimmadaba, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Kuwa kale ayuu badbaadiyey, qudhiisa isma badbaadin karo.
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

kikuyu: Masiixa oo ah Boqorka Israa'iil haddeer iskutallaabta ha ka soo dego si aannu u aragno oo u rumaysanno. Kuwii iskutallaabaha lagula qodbayna ayaa caayay.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

kikuyu: Goortii saacaddii lixaad la gaadhay, dhulka oo dhammu gudcur buu ahaa ilaa saacaddii sagaalaad.
english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Saacaddii sagaalaad Ciise ayaa cod weyn ku dhawaaqay oo yidhi, Eloy, Eloy, lama sabakhtani? taasoo micneheedu yahay, Ilaahayow, Ilaahayow, maxaad ii dayrisay?
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

kikuyu: Kuwa ag taagnaa qaarkood ayaa goortay maqleen yidhi, Eeg, wuxuu u yeedhayaa Eliyaas.
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

kikuyu: Mid baa orday, oo geed isbonji la yidhaahdo khal uga soo buuxshay, oo intuu cawsduur saaray ayuu siiyey inuu cabbo, wuxuuna yidhi, Daaya aannu aragnee inuu Eliyaas yimaado oo soo dejiyo.
english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise cod weyn ku dhawaaqay oo ruuxii bixiyey.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

kikuyu: Markaasaa daahii macbudka kor ilaa hoos laba u kala dillaacay.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa boqol-u-taliyihii oo meel ku toosan taagnaa markuu arkay inuu sidaas ruuxiisii u baxshay, wuxuu yidhi, Runtii, ninkanu wuxuu ahaa Wiilkii Ilaah.
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Waxaana joogay dumar meel fog ka eegayay, oo waxaa ku dhex jirtay Maryan tii reer Magdala, iyo Maryan oo ahayd Yacquub Yare iyo Yoosee hooyadood, iyo Saloome,
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

kikuyu: oo ah kuwa xataa intuu Galili joogay raaci jiray oo u adeegi jiray, iyo qaar kale oo badan oo Yeruusaalem u sii raacay.
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxay ahayd Maalintii Diyaargarayska, taas oo ah maalinta sabtida ka horraysa, oo markii makhribkii la gaadhay,
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

kikuyu: waxaa yimid Yuusuf kii reer Arimataya oo ahaa taliye murwad leh, oo isna boqortooyadii Ilaah ayuu sugayay. Isagu wuxuu dhiranaan ugu galay Bilaatos oo ka baryay Ciise meydkiisii.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Bilaatos waa yaabay inuu hadda dhintay. Markaasuu wuxuu u yeedhay boqol-u-taliyihii oo weyddiiyey, Durba miyuu dhintay?
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

kikuyu: Goortuu ka gartay boqol-u-taliyihii, ayuu meydkii Yuusuf siiyey.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf wuxuu soo iibsaday kafan, wuuna soo dejiyey isaga, oo kafantii ku duudduubay, oo wuxuu geliyey xabaal dhagax ka qodnayd, oo xabaashii afkeedii wuxuu ku soo giringiriyey dhagax weyn.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

kikuyu: Maryan tii reer Magdala iyo Maryan oo ahayd hooyadii Yoosee waxay arkeen meeshii la dhigay.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

kikuyu: Goortii sabtidii dhammaatay Maryan tii reer Magdala, iyo Maryan oo ahayd Yacquub hooyadiis, iyo Saloome, waxay iibsadeen dhir udgoon inay u yimaadaan oo mariyaan isaga.
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

kikuyu: Waaberigii maalintii ugu horraysay ee toddobaadka waxay yimaadeen xabaasha goortii qorraxdu soo baxday.
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

kikuyu: Waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Ayaa dhagaxa xabaashii afkeeda inooga giringirinaya?
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

kikuyu: Goortay eegeen waxay arkeen dhagixii oo la giringiriyey; oo aad buu u weynaa.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

kikuyu: Goortay xabaashii galeen waxay arkeen nin dhallinyar oo midigta fadhiya oo khamiis cad gashan, markaasay aad u nexeen.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Ha nexina. Waxaad doonaysaan Ciisihii reer Naasared, kan iskutallaabta lagu qodbay. Wuu sara kacay, oo halkan ma joogo. Waa taa meeshii la dhigay.
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

kikuyu: Laakiin taga, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaan xertiisii iyo Butros, Wuu idin hor marayaa ilaa Galili. Halkaasna waad ku arki doontaan, siduu idinku yidhi.
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

kikuyu: Markaasay dhaqso u soo baxeen oo xabaasha ka soo carareen, waayo, way gariireen oo yaabeen. Ninnana waxba kuma ay odhan, maxaa yeelay, way baqeen.
english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

kikuyu: Waaberigii maalintii ugu horraysay ee toddobaadka ayaa Ciise sara kacay, oo markii hore wuxuu u muuqday Maryan tii reer Magdala, tii uu toddoba jinni ka saaray.
english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

kikuyu: Iyadu waa tagtay oo waxay u sheegtay kuwii la joogi jiray, iyagoo barooranaya oo ooyaya.
english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

kikuyu: Iyaguna goortay maqleen inuu nool yahay oo ay aragtay, way rumaysan waayeen.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

kikuyu: Waxan dabadeed isagoo suurad kale ah ayuu u muuqday laba iyaga ah iyagoo sii socda oo beeraha tegaya.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

kikuyu: Markaasay baxeen oo kuwii kale u sheegeen, kuwaasina ma ay rumaysan.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

kikuyu: Dabadeed wuxuu u muuqday koob-iyo-tobankii goortay cunto u fadhiyeen. Wuuna u canaantay rumaysaddarradooda iyo qalbi engegnaantooda, waayo, ma ayna rumaysan kuwii isaga arkay goortuu sara kacay dabadeed.
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Dunida oo dhan taga, oo uunka oo dhan injiilka ku wacdiya.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

kikuyu: Kii rumaysta oo la baabtiiso waa badbaadi doonaa, laakiin kii aan rumaysanin waa la xukumi doonaa.
english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

kikuyu: Calaamooyinkanna ayaa la socon doona kuwa rumaysta. Magacayga ayay jinniyo ku saari doonaan, afaf cuscusubna ayay ku hadli doonaan,
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

kikuyu: abeesooyin ayay qaadi doonaan, oo hadday cabbaan wax lagu dhimanayo waxba ma yeeli doono, gacmo ayay kuwii buka dul saari doonaan, wayna bogsan doonaan.
english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbi Ciise goortuu la hadlay dabadeed ayaa samada loo qaaday, wuxuuna fadhiistay Ilaah midigtiisa.
english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

kikuyu: Iyaguna way baxeen oo meel kasta oo ay tageen dadkii bay wacdiyeen, Rabbiguna waa la shaqaynayay iyaga, isagoo hadalka ku xaqiijinaya calaamooyinkii la socday. Aamiin.
english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

kikuyu: Dad badan waxay ku dadaaleen inay soo hagaajiyaan sheeko ku saabsan wixii dhexdayada lagu sameeyey oo la hubsaday,
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

kikuyu: siday noo ogeysiiyeen kuwii tan iyo bilowgii arkay oo Ereygii u shaqeeyey.
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed anigana waxaa ila wanaagsanayd inaan, anigoo tan iyo bilowgii wax walba oo dhacay aad u gartay, si hagaagsan kuugu qoro, Te'ofilosow sharaf weyn lahow,
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

kikuyu: inaad garatid hubniintii hadalkii lagu baray.
english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Herodos ahaa boqorkii Yahuudiya, waxaa jiray wadaad la odhan jiray Sakariyas, oo ka mid ahaa safkii Abiya; haweenaydiisuna waxay ka mid ahayd hablihii reer Haaruun, magaceedana waxaa la odhan jiray Elisabed.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

kikuyu: Labadooduba xaq bay ku ahaayeen Ilaah hortiisa, oo qaynuunnadii iyo xukummadii Rabbiga ayay eedla'aan ku socon jireen.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

kikuyu: Ilmo ma ay lahayn, waayo, Elisabed madhalays bay ahayd, oo labadooduba way da'weynaayeen.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay, intuu shuqulkii wadaadnimadii safkiisa dartiis samaynayay Ilaah hortiisa,
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

kikuyu: sida caadadii wadaadnimadu u ahayd, in shuqulkiisu ahaa inuu foox shido goortuu macbudka Rabbiga galay.
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

kikuyu: Saacaddii fooxa ayaa dadkii badnaa oo dhammu dibadda ku tukanayeen.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa isaga u soo muuqatay malaa'igtii Rabbiga oo taagnayd meeshii fooxa lagu shido midigteeda.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

kikuyu: Goortuu Sakariyas arkay ayuu naxay, wuuna cabsaday.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

kikuyu: Laakiin malaa'igtii baa ku tidhi, Ha baqin, Sakariyasow, waayo, baryadaadii waa la maqlay; afadaada Elisabedna wiil bay kuu dhali doontaa, magiciisana waxaad u bixin doontaa Yooxanaa.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

kikuyu: Waxaad heli doontaa farxad iyo rayrayn; dad badanna dhalashadiisa ayay ku farxi doonaan,
english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

kikuyu: waayo, Rabbiga hortiisa nin weyn buu ku ahaan doonaa, mana cabbi doono khamri ama wax lagu sakhraamo. Waxaana xataa uurka hooyadiis kaga buuxsami doona Ruuxa Quduuskaa.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil badidoodana ayuu Rabbiga Ilaahooda ah ku soo jeedin doonaa.
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

kikuyu: Isaguna wuxuu ku hor mari doonaa ruuxii iyo xooggii Eliyaas inuu aabbayaasha qalbiyadooda ku soo jeediyo carruurta, iyo inuu caasiyiinta ku soo celiyo xigmadda kuwa xaqa ah, inuu Rabbiga u diyaargareeyo dad hagaagsan.
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

kikuyu: Sakariyas wuxuu malaa'igtii ku yidhi, Sidee baan waxan u garan doonaa? Waayo, anigu oday baan ahay, afadayduna waa da'weynaatay.
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

kikuyu: Malaa'igtii baa u jawaabtay oo ku tidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay Jibriil oo Ilaah hortiisa istaaga. Waxaa la ii soo diray inaan kula hadlo oo aan warkan wanaagsan kuu keeno.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waad aamusnaan doontaa, mana hadli kari doonto, ilaa maalinta waxyaalahan dhici doonaan, waayo, waad rumaysan weyday hadalladayda wakhtigooda la oofin doono.
english: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

kikuyu: Dadkuna waxay sugayeen Sakariyas, oo waxay la yaabeen siduu macbudka ugu raagay.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

kikuyu: Markuu soo baxay ayuu la hadli kari waayay, markaasay garteen inuu macbudka wax ku arkay. Kolkaasuu gacanta ugu sii tilmaamayay iyaga, isagoo sii carrab la'.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

kikuyu: Kolkii maalmihii shuqulkiisii wadaadnimadu dhammaadeen ayuu wuxuu tegey gurigiisii.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

kikuyu: Maalmahaas dabadeed afadiisa Elisabed ayaa uuraysatay, oo shan bilood ayay isqarisay iyadoo leh.
english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

kikuyu: Sidaasaa Rabbigu iigu sameeyey maalmihii uu i eegay inuu ceebtayda dadka dhexdooda iiga qaado.
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

kikuyu: Bishii lixaad Ilaah baa malaa'ig Jibriil u soo diray magaalada Galili oo Naasared la odhan jiray
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

kikuyu: ilaa gabadh bikrad ah oo u doonanayd nin la odhan jiray Yuusuf oo dhashii Daa'uud ahaa; gabadhana waxaa la odhan jiray Maryan.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

kikuyu: Malaa'igtii baa u soo gashay, oo waxay ku tidhi, Nabad, adigoo nimcaysan, Rabbiga ayaa kula jira.
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

kikuyu: Markaasay hadalkii ka naxday, oo waxay isku tidhi, Maxay tahay salaantan?
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

kikuyu: Malaa'igtii baa ku tidhi, Ha baqin, Maryamay, waayo, nimco ayaad Ilaah ka heshay.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waad uuraysan doontaa, oo wiil baad umuli doontaa, magiciisana waxaad u bixin doontaa Ciise.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

kikuyu: Nin weyn buu ahaan doonaa, waxaana loogu yeedhi doonaa Wiilka Kan ugu sarreeya, Rabbiga Ilaaha ahuna wuxuu siin doonaa carshigii awowgiis Daa'uud.
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

kikuyu: Weligiiba wuxuu boqor u ahaan doonaa dadkii Yacquub, boqornimadiisuna ma idlaan doonto.
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Maryan waxay malaa'igtii ku tidhi, Sidee baa waxanu ku noqon doonaan? Anigu ninna garan maayo.
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

kikuyu: Malaa'igtii waa u jawaabtay oo ku tidhi, Ruuxa Quduuska ah ayaa kugu soo degi doona, oo xooggii Kan ugu sarreeya ayaa hoosiis kuu noqon doona, sidaa darteed kan quduuska ah oo kaa dhalan doona waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa Wiilka Ilaah.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, ina-adeertaa Elisabedna wiil bay uuraysatay iyadoo da'weyn; oo tanuna waxay tii madhalays loogu yeedhi jiray u tahay bisheedii lixaad.
english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

kikuyu: Waayo, wax aan Ilaah kari doonin ma jiro.
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

kikuyu: Maryan ayaa tidhi, Waa i kan, waxaan ahay addoontii Rabbiga. Sidaad u hadashay ha ii noqoto. Markaasaa malaa'igtii ka tagtay.
english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

kikuyu: Maalmahaas Maryan baa kacday, oo waxay dhaqso u tagtay dhulkii buuraha lahaa ilaa magaalo ka mid ah reer Yahuudah,
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

kikuyu: oo waxay gashay gurigii Sakariyas, oo salaantay Elisabed.
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacay goortii Elisabed salaantii Maryan maqashay in ilmihii uurkeeda ku boodbooday; Elisabedna waxaa ka buuxsamay Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Markaasay cod dheer ku qaylisay oo tidhi, Dumarka dhexdooda waad ku barakaysan tahay, oo midhaha uurkaaga waa barakaysan yahay.
english: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

kikuyu: Xaggee waxanu iiga yimaadeen in Sayidkayga hooyadiis iigu timaado?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

kikuyu: Bal eeg, markii codkii salaantaadu dhegahayga ku dhacay, ilmaha uurkayga ku jira ayaa farxad la boodbooday.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan tii rumaysatay; waayo, waxyaalihii xagga Rabbiga looga sheegay ayay dhici doonaan.
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

kikuyu: Maryanna waxay tidhi, Naftaydu Rabbigay weynaynaysaa,
english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

kikuyu: Ruuxayguna wuxuu ku reyreeyey Ilaaha Badbaadiyahayga ah.
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu eegay hoosaysnimada addoontiisa, Bal eeg, tan iyo hadhow qarniyada oo dhammu waxay iigu yeedhi doonaan tan barakaysan.
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

kikuyu: Waayo, kan xoogga leh ayaa waxyaalo waaweyn ii sameeyey; Magiciisuna waa Quduus,
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

kikuyu: Tan iyo ab ka ab naxariistiisu waxay gaadhaa Kuwa isaga ka cabsada.
english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

kikuyu: Wuxuu xoog ku sameeyey gacantiisa, Oo kuwii fikirradii qalbigoodii ku kibray ayuu kala firdhiyey.
english: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

kikuyu: Kuwii xoogga lahaa ayuu carshiyadoodii ka soo dejiyey Oo kuwii hooseeyey ayuu sarraysiiyey.
english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

kikuyu: Kuwii gaajaysnaa ayuu wax wanaagsan ka dhergiyey, Kuwii hodanka ahaana iyagoo madhan ayuu diray.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

kikuyu: Midiidinkiisii Israa'iil ayuu caawiyey Inuu xusuusto inuu u naxariisto
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

kikuyu: Ibraahim iyo farcankiisii weligoodba (Siduu awowayaasheennii ula hadlay).
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

kikuyu: Maryan waxay iyada la joogtay abbaaraha saddex bilood, markaasay gurigeeda ku noqotay.
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

kikuyu: Hadda Elisabed wakhtigii ay umuli lahayd ayaa la joogay, oo wiil bay dhashay.
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

kikuyu: Derisyadeedii iyo xigaalkeedii ayay maqleen siduu Rabbigu naxariistiisii ugu weyneeyey iyada, wayna la farxeen.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay inay maalintii siddeedaad u yimaadeen inay wiilkii gudaan, oo waxayna u bixiyeen magicii aabbihiis Sakariyas.
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa hooyadiis u jawaabtay oo ku tidhi, Sidaas ma aha; waxaase loogu yeedhi doonaa Yooxanaa.
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Xigaalkaaga kuma jiro qof magacaas loo bixiyey.
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

kikuyu: Waxay aabbihiis gacan ugu tilmaameen oo weyddiiyeen wuxuu doonayay in loogu yeedho.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu weyddiistay loox oo ku qoray, isagoo leh, Magiciisu waa Yooxanaa. Wayna wada yaabeen.
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

kikuyu: Kolkiiba afkiisii ayaa furmay, oo carrabkiisiina waa debcay, markaasuu hadlay oo Ilaah ammaanay.
english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

kikuyu: Dadkii agtooda joogay oo dhammu way wada cabsadeen, oo hadalladan oo dhan waa lagaga hadlayay dalkii buuraha lahaa oo Yahuudiya oo dhan.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

kikuyu: Kuwa waxyaalahaas maqlay oo dhan ayaa qalbigooda geliyey oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Haddaba ilmahanu muxuu noqon doonaa? Waayo, gacantii Rabbiga ayaa la jirtay isaga.
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa aabbihiis Sakariyas waxaa ka buuxsamay Ruuxa Quduuska ah, waxna wuu sii sheegay isagoo leh,
english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

kikuyu: Ha ammaanmo Rabbiga ah Ilaaha Israa'iil, Waayo, dadkiisii ayuu soo booqday oo furtay.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

kikuyu: Badbaadiye xoog leh ayuu inoogu kiciyey Gurigii midiidinkiisa Daa'uud,
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

kikuyu: (Siduu afkii nebiyadiisii quduuska ahaa tan iyo bilowgii uga hadli jiray),
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

kikuyu: Inuu inaga badbaadiyo cadaawayaasheenna iyo gacanta kuwa ina neceb oo dhan,
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

kikuyu: Iyo inuu u naxariisto awowayaasheen, Iyo inuu axdigiisii quduuska ahaa xusuusto,
english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

kikuyu: Oo ahaa dhaartii uu awoweheennii Ibraahim ugu dhaartay,
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

kikuyu: Inuu ina siiyo innagoo cadaawayaasheenna gacmahooda laynaga bixiyey Inaynu baqdinla'aan isaga ugu hawshoonno
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

kikuyu: Quduusnimada iyo xaqnimada isaga hortiisa cimrigeenna oo dhan.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

kikuyu: Adiguna, ilma yahow, waxaa laguugu yeedhi doonaa nebigii Kan ugu sarreeya, Waayo, waxaad hor mari doontaa Rabbiga hortiisa inaad jidadkiisa diyaargaraysid;
english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

kikuyu: Oo aad dadkiisa ogeysiisid badbaadada Ee dembidhaafkooda ah,
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

kikuyu: Ee laga hela naxariista weyn ee Ilaaheenna, Tan qorraxda soo baxda xagga sare inaga soo booqan doonta,
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

kikuyu: Inay iftiimiso kuwa fadhiya gudcurka iyo hooskii dhimashada, Iyo inay cagaheenna jidkii nabadda ku kaxayso,
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

kikuyu: Wiilkuna waa koray oo ruuxuu ka xoogoobay, wuxuuna joogay cidlada ilaa maalintii uu Israa'iil istusi lahaa.
english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas waxaa dhacay in amar ka soo baxay Kaysar Awgustus in dadka dunida jooga oo dhan la qoro.
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

kikuyu: Qorniinkaas kolkii ugu horreeyey waxaa la sameeyey markii Kuranayos xukumi jiray Suuriya.
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

kikuyu: Dhammaan waxay u wada tageen in la qoro, mid kastaba magaaladiisii.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

kikuyu: Yuusufna Galili ayuu ka kacay, oo magaaladii Naasared ka tegey, oo wuxuu aaday Yahuudiya ilaa magaaladii Daa'uud oo Beytlaxam la odhan jiray, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu ahaa dadkii iyo dhashii Daa'uud,
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

kikuyu: in lala qoro Maryan oo ahayd tii u doonanayd oo uurka lahayd.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay kolkay halkaas joogeen in maalmihii ay umuli lahayd dhammaadeen,
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

kikuyu: waxayna umushay wiilkeedii curadka ahaa, markaasay maro ku duudduubtay oo qabaal ku jiifisay, waayo, meel ay ku hoydaan ayay hudheelkii ka waayeen.
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

kikuyu: Dalkaas waxaa jiray adhijirro bannaanka jooga oo habeenkii idahooda ilaalinaya.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

kikuyu: Malaa'igtii Rabbiga ayaa ag istaagtay, oo ammaanta Rabbiga ayaa iftiimisay hareerahooda, aad bayna u baqeen.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaa'igtii ku tidhi, Ha baqina, waayo, ogaada, waxaan idiin keenay war wanaagsan oo leh farxad weyn oo u ahaan dadka oo dhan.
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

kikuyu: Waayo, maanta waxaa magaalada Daa'uud idiinku dhashay Badbaadiye oo ah Masiixa Rabbiga ah.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa calaamo idiin ahaan tan, waxaad heli doontaan ilmo maro ku duudduuban oo ku jiifa qabaal.
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

kikuyu: Dhaqsoba waxaa malaa'igtii la jirtay guuto fara badan oo jannada ka timid, wayna ammaanayeen Ilaah oo lahaayeen,
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

kikuyu: Ilaah ha ku ammaanmo meelaha ugu sarreeya, Xagga dhulkana nabad ha ahaato dadka ka farxiya Ilaah dhexdooda.
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay markii malaa'igihii ka tageen oo jannada ku noqdeen in adhijirradii isku yidhaahdeen, Haddana aan tagno xataa ilaa Beytlaxam, aan aragnee waxaas dhacay oo Rabbiga ina ogeysiiyey.
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

kikuyu: Markaasay dhaqso u yimaadeen oo waxay heleen Maryan iyo Yuusufba iyo ilmihii oo qabaal ku jiifa.
english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

kikuyu: Oo goortay arkeen, waxay ogeysiiyeen hadalka ilmahan looga sheegay iyaga.
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

kikuyu: Dadkii maqlay oo dhanna ayaa ka yaabay waxyaalihii adhijirradu u sheegeen.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

kikuyu: Maryanse hadalkaas oo dhan ayay haysatay oo qalbigeeda kaga fikirtay.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

kikuyu: Adhijirraduna way noqdeen iyagoo Ilaah ku ammaanaya oo ku weynaynaya waxyaalihii ay maqleen oo ay arkeen oo dhan, sidii iyaga loogu sheegay.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

kikuyu: Goortii siddeed maalmood dhammaatay oo wiilkii la gudi lahaa, magiciisii waxaa loo baxshay Ciise, sida malaa'igtii ugu bixisay intaan uurka lagu uuraysan.
english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

kikuyu: Kolkii maalmihii nadiifiskeeda u dhammaadeen sidii sharciga Muuse lahaa, waxay geeyeen Yeruusaalem inay Rabbiga u dhiibaan
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

kikuyu: (siday ugu qoran tahay sharciga Rabbiga, Curad walba oo lab ah waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa quduus xagga Rabbiga),
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

kikuyu: iyo inay allabari u bixiyaan siday ugu qoran tahay sharciga Rabbiga, Laba qoolley ama laba xamaam oo yaryar.
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

kikuyu: Bal eeg, waxaa Yeruusaalem joogay nin magiciisii ahaa Simecoon. Ninkaasu wuxuu ahaa nin xaq ah oo cibaado leh; wuxuuna sugayay gargaaridda Israa'iil. Ruuxii Quduuska ahaana waa dul joogay.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

kikuyu: Waxaana Ruuxii Quduuska ahaa u muujiyey inaanu dhimasho arag intaanu Rabbiga Masiixiisa arkin.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu Ruuxii ku galay macbudka, oo goortii waalidkii keeneen wiilkii Ciise ahaa inay caadadii sharciga ku sameeyaan,
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

kikuyu: markaasuu gacmihiisa ku qaaday, oo Ilaah ammaanay, oo yidhi,
english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

kikuyu: Rabbiyow, imminka addoonkaagu nabad ha ku tago, Sida hadalkaagu ahaa,
english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

kikuyu: Waayo, indhahaygu waxay arkeen badbaadintaada,
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

kikuyu: Tan aad dadka oo dhan hortiis hagaajisay,
english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

kikuyu: Oo ah iftiin quruumaha lagu muujiyo, Iyo ammaanta dadkaaga Israa'iil.
english: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis ka yaabeen waxyaalihii lagaga hadlay isaga.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

kikuyu: Simecoon ayaa iyaga u duceeyey, wuxuuna hooyadiis Maryan ku yidhi, Ogow, wiilkan waxaa loo dhigay dhicidda iyo kicidda kuwa badan oo Israa'iil ku jira, iyo calaamo ka gees ahaan lagaga hadlo,
english: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

kikuyu: si ay qalbiyo badan fikirradoodu u muuqan doonaan. Adigana seef baa naftaada ka mudhbixi doonta.
english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

kikuyu: Waxaa jirtay nebiyad Anna la odhan jiray, ina Fanuu'eel, oo ahayd qoladii Aasheer, wayna da'weynayd; nin bayna la jirtay toddoba sannadood bikradnimadeeda dabadeed.
english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

kikuyu: Waxayna ahayd carmal xataa afar iyo siddeetan sannadood, macbudkana kama ay tegin, laakiin Ilaah ayay soon iyo salaad habeen iyo maalinba ku caabudaysay.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

kikuyu: Saacaddaas qudheeda ayay soo gashay oo Ilaah u mahadnaqday, oo kuwa furashada Yeruusaalem sugayay oo dhan ayay xaggiisa kala hadashay.
english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Goortay wax walba dhammeeyeen sida sharciga Rabbigu leeyahay, waxay ku noqdeen Galili ilaa magaaladoodii Naasared.
english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

kikuyu: Wiilkii ayaa koray oo itaal weynaaday, waxaana ka buuxsantay xigmad; Ilaah nimcadiisuna way dul joogtay.
english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

kikuyu: Sannad walba waalidkiisii waxay Yeruusaalem u tegi jireen Iiddii Kormaridda.
english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

kikuyu: Goortuu laba iyo toban sannadood jiray ayay aadeen sidii caadadii iiddu u ahayd.
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

kikuyu: Oo goortay maalmihii dhammaysteen, oo ay noqonayeen, ayaa Ciise wiilkii ahaa ku hadhay Yeruusaalem, waalidkiisuna ma ogayn,
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

kikuyu: laakiin iyagoo u malaynaya inuu dadka la socdo, ayay maalin sii socdeen, markaasay ka dhex doondooneen xigaalkooda iyo kuway isbarteen.
english: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

kikuyu: Oo markay heli waayeen ayay Yeruusaalem ku noqdeen oo ka doondooneen.
english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

kikuyu: Waxaa noqotay, saddex maalmood dabadeed, inay macbudka ka heleen isagoo macallimiinta dhex fadhiya oo dhegaysanaya oo wax weyddiinaya.
english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

kikuyu: Dadkii maqlay oo dhan ayaa la yaabay garashadiisii iyo jawaabihiisii.
english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

kikuyu: Goortay arkeen isagii way la yaabeen, oo hooyadiis ayaa ku tidhi, Wiilkaygiiyow, maxaad sidaas noo yeeshay? Bal eeg, aniga iyo aabbahaa caloolxumo waannu kugu doondoonnay.
english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaad ii doondoonayseen? Miyaanad ogayn inay igu waajib tahay inaan danta Aabbahay ku jeedo?
english: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

kikuyu: Laakiin way garan waayeen hadalkii uu kula hadlay.
english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu raacay oo Naasared tegey, wuuna ka dambeeyey iyaga; laakiinse hooyadiis hadalkaas oo dhan qalbigeeda ayay ku haysatay.
english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

kikuyu: Ciisena wuxuu ku koray xigmad iyo dherer iyo nimco, Ilaah iyo dadka hortooda.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

kikuyu: Waxay ahayd sannaddii shan iyo tobnaad oo Tiberiyas Kaysar boqranaa, markii Bontiyos Bilaatos xukumi jiray Yahuudiya, oo Herodos taliye u ahaa Galili, walaalkiis Filibosna taliye u ahaa Ituraya iyo dalkii Tarakhoonitis, oo Lusaniyas taliye u ahaa Abilene,
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

kikuyu: oo Annas iyo Kayafas wadaaddadii sare ahaan jireen, markaasaa ereygii Ilaah cidlada ugu yimid Yooxanaa ina Sakariyas.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Wuxuu yimid Webi Urdun hareerihiis oo dhan isagoo dadka ku wacdiyeya baabtiiskii toobadda dembidhaafka aawadiis,
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

kikuyu: siday ugu qoran tahay kitaabkii hadallada Nebi Isayos, Waa codka kan cidlada kaga qaylinaya, Jidka Rabbiga hagaajiya, Waddooyinkiisa toosiya.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

kikuyu: Dooxo walba waa la buuxin doonaa, Qar iyo buur walbana waa la gaabin doonaa, Wixii qalloocanna waa la toosin doonaa, Jidadka xunxunna waa la simi doonaa,
english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

kikuyu: Uunka oo dhammuna badbaadinta Ilaah ayay arki doonaan.
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

kikuyu: Haddaba wuxuu ku yidhi dadkii badnaa oo u soo baxay inuu baabtiiso iyaga, Dhal jilbisay, yaa idiinka digay inaad ka carartaan cadhada imanaysa?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

kikuyu: Haddaba midho toobad istaahila soo bixiya, hana bilaabina inaad isku tidhaahdaan, Waxaannu leennahay Ibraahim oo aabbe noo ah. Waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ilaah waa karaa inuu dhagaxyadan carruur uga kiciyo Ibraahim.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

kikuyu: Haddeer weliba faaska waxaa la dhigay geedaha guntooda. Sidaa darteed geed walba oo aan midho wanaagsan soo bixin waa la gooyaa oo dabka lagu tuuraa.
english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii badnaa weyddiiyeen, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba maxaannu samaynaa?
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu u jawaabay oo iyagii ku yidhi, Kii laba khamiis qabaa, ha siiyo kii aan waxba qabin; kii cunto qabaana, sidaas oo kale ha yeelo.
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa u yimid cashuurqaadayaal in la baabtiiso, waxayna ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, annaguna maxaannu samaynaa?
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

kikuyu: Isaguna wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaa laydiin amray wax ka badan ha qaadanina.
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa askarna weyddiisay oo ku tidhi, Annaguna maxaannu samaynaa? Wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Ninna ha dulmina, oo ninna ha masabidina; mushahaaradiinnana raalli ku ahaada.
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

kikuyu: Intii dadku filanayeen oo kulligoodna qalbiyadooda kaga fikirayeen Yooxanaa inuu yahay Masiixii iyo in kale,
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

kikuyu: ayaa Yooxanaa kulligood u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan idinku baabtiisaa biyo, laakiin waxaa imanaya ku iga itaal weyn, kan aanan istaahilin inaan yeelmihii kabihiisa furo. Isagu wuxuu idinku baabtiisi doonaa Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo dab.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

kikuyu: Masaftiisu gacantiisay ku jirtaa inuu goobtiisa wax lagu tumo aad u safeeyo oo sarreenkana maqsinkiisa ku soo ururiyo, laakiin buunshaha ayuu dab aan demeyn ku gubi doonaa.
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

kikuyu: Digniin badan oo kale ayuu dadka ku wacdiyey.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

kikuyu: Laakiin kolkuu taliye Herodos u canaantay walaalkiis Filibos naagtiisii Herodiya aawadeed, iyo waxyaalaha xunxun oo Herodos sameeyey oo dhan aawadood,
english: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

kikuyu: ayaa Herodos waxan oo dhan weliba ku daray inuu Yooxanaa ku xidho xabsigii.
english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

kikuyu: Markii dadkii oo dhan la baabtiisay, waxaa dhacay in Ciisena la baabtiisay, oo intuu tukanayay ayaa samadu furantay,
english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

kikuyu: oo Ruuxa Quduuska ah ayaa dushiisa ku soo degay isagoo muuqasho jidh leh oo qoolley u eg, waxaana samada ka yimid cod leh, Adigu waxaad tahay Wiilkayga aan jeclahay; ee waan kugu faraxsanahay.
english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Oo Ciise markuu bilaabay inuu wax baro, wuxuu ahaa qiyaas soddon jir, isagoo ahaa (sida loo moodayay) ina Yuusuf, kan ahaa ina Heli,
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Matad, kan ahaa ina Laawi, kan ahaa ina Malki, kan ahaa ina Yanna,
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Yuusuf, kan ahaa ina Matatiyas, kan ahaa ina Caamoos, kan ahaa ina Na'uum, kan ahaa ina Esli, kan ahaa ina Naggay,
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Ma'ad, kan ahaa ina Matatiyas, kan ahaa ina Semey, kan ahaa ina Yuusuf, kan ahaa ina Yuuda,
english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Yo'anna, kan ahaa ina Reesa, kan ahaa ina Serubaabel, kan ahaa ina Salaatii'eel, kan ahaa ina Neeri,
english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Malki, kan ahaa ina Addi, kan ahaa ina Koosam, kan ahaa ina Elmoodam, kan ahaa ina Ceer,
english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Yooses, kan ahaa ina Eliiceser, kan ahaa ina Yoorim, kan ahaa ina Matad, kan ahaa ina Laawi,
english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Simecoon, kan ahaa ina Yuuda, kan ahaa ina Yuusuf, kan ahaa ina Yoonam, kan ahaa ina Eliyaqiim,
english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Mele'as, kan ahaa ina Menna, kan ahaa ina Matata, kan ahaa ina Naataan, kan ahaa ina Daa'uud,
english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Yesay, kan ahaa ina Coobeed, kan ahaa ina Bocas, kan ahaa ina Salmoon, kan ahaa ina Naasoon,
english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Caminadaab, kan ahaa ina Araam, kan ahaa ina Esroom, kan ahaa ina Feres, kan ahaa ina Yahuudah,
english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Yacquub, kan ahaa ina Isxaaq, kan ahaa ina Ibraahim, kan ahaa ina Tara, kan ahaa ina Naakoor,
english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Seruukh, kan ahaa ina Ragaw, kan ahaa ina Faleg, kan ahaa ina Xeber, kan ahaa ina Salah,
english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Qaynaan, kan ahaa ina Arfaksad, kan ahaa ina Sheem, kan ahaa ina Nuux, kan ahaa ina Lameg,
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Metushelax, kan ahaa ina Enoog, kan ahaa ina Yaared, kan ahaa ina Mahalaleel, kan ahaa ina Qaynaan,
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

kikuyu: kan ahaa ina Enoos, kan ahaa ina Seed, kan ahaa ina Aadan, kan ahaa ina Ilaah.
english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

kikuyu: Ciise waxaa ka buuxsamay Ruuxa Quduuska ah, oo Webi Urdun ayuu ka noqday, oo Ruuxii baa cidlada u kaxeeyey.
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

kikuyu: Afartan maalmood ayaa Ibliisku jirrabayay. Maalmahaasna waxba ma cunin. Goortay maalmihii dhammaadeen ayuu gaajooday.
english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ibliisku wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah ku dheh dhagaxan, Kibis noqo.
english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa qoran tahay, Dadku waa inaanu kibis oo keliya ku noolaan.
english: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

kikuyu: Oo markuu kor u kaxeeyey wuxuu wakhti yar ku tusay quruumaha dunida oo dhan.
english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ibliisku wuxuu ku yidhi, Amarkan oo dhan waan ku siinayaa iyo ammaantoodaba, waayo, waa lay siiyey; oo kii aan doonayo ayaan siiyaa.
english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaad hortayda i caabuddid, kulli adaa lahaan doona.
english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa qoran tahay, Waa inaad caabuddo Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah oo waa inaad isagoo keliya u adeegto.
english: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Yeruusaalem geeyey, wuxuuna saaray munaaraddii macbudka oo ku yidhi, Haddaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah, halkan hoos iskaga tuur;
english: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

kikuyu: waayo, waa qoran tahay, Malaa'igihiisa ayuu ku amri doonaa inay ku ilaaliyaan,
english: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

kikuyu: iyo, Inay gacmahooda sare kuugu qabtaan inaanay cagtaadu dhagax ku dhicin.
english: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa la yidhi, Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah waa inaanad jirrabin.
english: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

kikuyu: Ibliiskiina markuu jirrabaad walba dhammeeyey ayuu ka tegey intii wakhti ah.
english: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu xooggii Ruuxa kula noqday Galili, warkiisuna wuxuu gaadhay dhulka ku wareegsan oo dhan.
english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

kikuyu: Sunagogyadoodana ayuu wax ku baray, dhammaanna waa la wada ammaanay isaga.
english: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu yimid Naasared oo ahayd meeshuu ku koray, oo maalintii sabtida sida caadadiisu ahayd ayuu sunagogga galay, wuuna istaagay inuu wax akhriyo.
english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

kikuyu: Waxaa loo dhiibay kitaabkii Nebi Isayos, oo goortuu kitaabkii furay ayuu helay meeshii lagu qoray,
english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

kikuyu: Ruuxii Rabbiga ayaa i dul jooga, Waayo, wuxuu ii subkay inaan war wanaagsan masaakiinta ku wacdiyo, Wuxuuna ii soo diray inaan kuwa xidhan furriinnimada ogeysiiyo Iyo kuwa indhaha la' soo celinta araggooda Iyo inaan kuwa nabaraysan soo furfuro,
english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

kikuyu: Iyo inaan dadka ogeysiiyo sannadda qaabbilaadda ah ee Rabbiga.
english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

kikuyu: Intuu kitaabkii duudduubay ayuu midiidinka u dhiibay oo fadhiistay; oo dadkii sunagoggii ku jiray oo dhan ayaa indhaha ku taagay.
english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu bilaabay inuu ku yidhaahdo, Maanta Qorniinkan dhegihiinnu maqlay waa rumoobay.
english: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

kikuyu: Kulligood markhaati bay ahaayeen, wayna ka yaabeen hadallada nimcada leh oo afkiisa ka soo baxay, markaasay yidhaahdeen, Kanu miyaanu ahayn wiilkii Yuusuf?
english: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu ku yidhi, Shakila'aan waxaad masaalkan igu odhan doontaan, Dhakhtarow, isbogsii. Wax kastoo aannu maqalnay oo Kafarna'um lagu sameeyey, halkan dhulkaagana ku samee.
english: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nebina dalkiisa laguma aqbalo.
english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

kikuyu: Laakiin runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Wakhtigii Eliyaas waxaa Israa'iil ku jiray carmallo badan oo nimankoodii ka dhinteen markii cirku saddex sannadood iyo lix bilood xidhmay oo abaar weyni dhulka oo dhan ka dhacday.
english: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

kikuyu: Laakiin middoodna Eliyaas looma dirin, naag carmal ah oo magaalada Sarefta oo dalka Siidoon ku jirtay maahee.
english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii Nebi Eliishaana waxaa Israa'iil ku jiray dad badan oo baras leh, midkoodna lama daahirin Nacamaan reer Suuriya maahee.
english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

kikuyu: Markii kuwii sunagogga ku jiray oo dhan waxaas maqleen ayay aad u cadhoodeen.
english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

kikuyu: Markaasay kaceen oo magaaladii ka saareen, waxayna u kaxeeyeen buurtii magaaladoodii ka dhisnayd qarkeedii inay ka tuuraan.
english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

kikuyu: Laakiin isagu intuu dhex maray ayuu iska tegey.
english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna u degay Kafarna'um oo magaalada Galili ah. Oo maalmihii sabtida ayuu dadka wax barayay.
english: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

kikuyu: Waxbariddiisiina way la yaabeen, waayo, hadalkiisu amar buu lahaa.
english: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

kikuyu: Waxaana sunagogga joogay nin jinni wasakh leh qaba. Cod weyn ayuu ku qayliyey, oo wuxuu yidhi,
english: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

kikuyu: Na daa! Maxaa inoo dhexaya, Ciise reer Naasaredow? Ma waxaad u timid inaad na baabbi'iso? Anigu waa ku garanayaa kii aad tahay, Kan Quduuska ah ee Ilaah.
english: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

kikuyu: Ciise baa canaantay oo ku yidhi, Aamus oo ka soo bax. Jinniguna goortuu ninkii dhexda ku tuuray ayuu ka soo baxay, waxbana ma uu yeelin.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

kikuyu: Yaab weyn ayaa ku wada dhacay; wayna isla wada hadleen oo yidhaahdeen, Waa maxay hadalkan? waayo, jinniyada wasakhda leh ayuu amar iyo xoog ku xukumaa, wayna ka baxaan.
english: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

kikuyu: Meel kasta oo dalka ku wareegsan ayaa warka isaga ku saabsan gaadhay.
english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

kikuyu: Markaasuu sunagoggi ka soo kacay, oo wuxuu galay gurigii Simoon. Simoon soddohdiisna qandho weyn ayay qabtay, markaasay isaga u baryeen aawadeed,
english: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

kikuyu: oo intuu isa soo dul taagay ayuu qandhadii canaantay, wayna daysay. Kolkiiba way kacday oo u adeegtay iyagii.
english: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

kikuyu: Markii qorraxdu sii dhacaysay, dadkii oo dhan oo lahaa dad cudurro kala cayncayn ah qabay ayay isaga u keeneen; mid kastaba gacmihiisuu saaray oo bogsiiyey.
english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

kikuyu: Jinniyona dad badan ayay ka soo baxeen, iyagoo qaylinaya oo leh, Adigu waxaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah. Isaguse waa canaantay oo uma oggolaanin inay hadlaan, waayo, waxay garanayeen inuu Masiixa yahay.
english: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

kikuyu: Goortii ay maalintii noqotay, ayuu baxay oo meel cidla ah tegey; dadkii badnaana way doondooneen oo u yimaadeen. Wayna qabteen si aanu uga tegin.
english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Waa inaan magaalooyinka kalena injiilka boqortooyada Ilaah ku wacdiyo, waayo, sidaa darteeda waa la ii soo diray.
english: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

kikuyu: Sunagogyada Galilina ayuu dadka ka dhex wacdiyi jiray.
english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

kikuyu: Intii dadkii oo dhan isku soo cidhiidhiyeen inay ereygii Ilaah maqlaan, ayuu is-ag taagay badda Gennesared;
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu arkay laba doonniyood oo badda ag taal; laakiin kalluumaystayaashii waa ka degeen, oo shabagyadoodii ayay maydhayeen.
english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

kikuyu: Markaasuu fuulay doonniyihii middood oo Simoon lahaa, wuxuuna ka baryay inuu in yar dhulka ka durkiyo. Markaasuu fadhiistay oo dadkii wax ka dhex baray doonnidii.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

kikuyu: Goortuu hadalkii dhammeeyey ayuu Simoon ku yidhi, Meesha biyaha u dheer gee, oo shabagyadiinna ku dejiya si aad kalluun u heshaan.
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

kikuyu: Simoon baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, xalay oo dhan ayaannu hawshoonnay, waxbana ma aannu qaban, laakiin hadalkaaga dartii shabagyada waan dejinayaa.
english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

kikuyu: Goortay waxaas yeeleen waxay ku qabteen kalluun tiro badan, shabagyadooduna way kala dillaaci gaadheen.
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

kikuyu: Markaasay u gacan haadiyeen wehelladoodii doonnida kale ku jiray inay yimaadaan oo caawiyaan. Wayna yimaadeen, oo waxay buuxiyeen labadii doonniyood, sidaa darteed ayay u dhowaadeen inay degaan.
english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

kikuyu: Laakiin Simoon Butros goortuu waxaas arkay, ayuu Ciise jilbihiisa isku tuuray, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, waxaan ahay nin dembi leh, ee iga tag.
english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, isaga iyo kuwii la jirayba, waxay la yaabeen kalluunkii badnaa oo ay qabteen.
english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

kikuyu: Sidoo kalena waxaa la yaabay Yacquub iyo Yooxanaa oo wiilashii Sebedi ahaa, kuwii wehello Simoon la ahaa. Ciisena wuxuu Simoon ku yidhi, Ha baqin, hadda iyo hadhowba dad baad jillaabi doontaa.
english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
