kikuyu: Markay doonniyahoodii dhulkii geeyeen, ayay wax walba ka tageen, markaasay raaceen isaga.
english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

kikuyu: Goortuu magaalooyinka middood ku jiray, waxaa la arkay nin baras miidhan ah. Isaguna markuu Ciise arkay, wejigiisuu dhulka dhigay oo ka baryay isagoo leh, Sayidow, haddaad doonaysid waad i daahirin kartaa.
english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Oo intuu gacantiisa soo taagay, ayuu taabtay, oo ku yidhi, Waan doonayaa ee daahirsanow. Oo kolkiiba baraskii waa ka baxay.
english: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku amray, Ninna ha u sheegin, laakiin jidkaaga mar oo wadaadka istus. Waxaad daahirsanaantaada u bixisaa wixii Muuse amray, marag iyaga ha u ahaatee.
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Laakiin weliba warkii isaga ku saabsanaa ayaa sii fiday; o dad aad u badan ayaa u yimid inay maqlaan, iyo in bukaankooda laga bogsiiyo.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

kikuyu: Markaasuu, intuu ku noqday meelo cidla ah, ku tukaday.
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

kikuyu: Maalmahaas middood waxaa dhacay inuu wax barayay, oo halkaasna waxaa ag fadhiyey qaar Farrisiinta iyo macallimiintii sharciga ah oo ka yimid magaalo walba oo Galili iyo Yahuudiya iyo Yeruusaalem; xoogga Rabbiguna waa la jiray isaga si uu u bogsiiyo kuwa buka.
english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa niman waxay sariir ku soo qaadeen nin curyaan ah, waxayna doonayeen inay gudaha geliyaan oo hortiisa dhigaan.
english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

kikuyu: Markay heli waayeen meel ay ka geliyaan dadkii badnaa aawadiis, ayay guriga dushiisa fuuleen, oo saqafka ayay ka dusiyeen isaga iyo sariirtiisii, oo ay dhex dhigeen Ciise hortiisa.
english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

kikuyu: Goortuu rumaysadkoodii arkay ayuu ku yidhi, Nin yahow, dembiyadaadu waa kaa cafiyan yihiin.
english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa culimmadii iyo Farrisiintii waxay bilaabeen inay fikiraan iyagoo leh, Ayuu yahay kan caytamayaa? Ayaa dembiyo cafiyi kara Ilaah keliya maahee?
english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise goortuu fikirradoodii gartay ayuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Maxaad qalbiyadiinna uga fikiraysaan?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

kikuyu: Iyamaa hawl yar, in la yidhaahdo, Dembiyadaadu waa kaa cafiyan yihiin, ama in la yidhaahdo, Kac oo soco?
english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

kikuyu: Laakiin si aad ku garataan in Wiilka Aadanahu dhulka ku leeyahay amar uu dembiyada ku cafiyo (ayuu ninkii curyaanka ahaa ku yidhi), Waxaan kugu leeyahay, Kac oo sariirtaada qaado oo gurigaaga tag.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba hortood ayuu kacay, oo qaatay wixii uu ku jiifay, oo gurigiisa tegey, isagoo Ilaah ammaanaya.
english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

kikuyu: Markaasay wada yaabeen oo Ilaah ammaaneen, aad bayna u baqeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Maanta waxaannu aragnay waxyaalo yaab leh.
english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas dabadood ayuu baxay, oo wuxuu arkay cashuurqaade Laawi la odhan jiray oo fadhiya meeshii cashuurta lagu qaado, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, I soo raac.
english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wax walba ka tegey, wuuna kacay oo raacay.
english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

kikuyu: Laawi wuxuu gurigiisa ugu sameeyey diyaafad weyn. Waxaana joogay qaar badan oo cashuurqaadayaal ah iyo qaar kale oo cunto ula fadhiya iyaga.
english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Farrisiintii iyo culimmadoodii, intay xertiisii ka gunuunaceen, waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaad cashuurqaadayaasha iyo dembilayaasha wax ula cuntaan oo ula cabtaan?
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Kuwa ladan dhakhtar uma baahna, laakiin kuwa buka ayaa u baahan.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: Anigu uma aan imanin inaan kuwa xaqa ah u yeedho, laakiin inaan dembilayaashase toobadda ugu yeedho ayaan u imid.
english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Xerta Yooxanaa marar badan bay soomaan oo tukadaan, kuwa Farrisiintuna sidaas oo kale ayay yeelaan, laakiin kuwaagu wax bay cunaan oo cabbaan.
english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma ku dirqi karaysaan saaxiibbadii arooska inay soomaan kolkuu aroosku la joogo?
english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

kikuyu: Laakiin maalmaha ayaa iman doona; oo kolkii arooska laga qaadi doono, kolkaasay maalmahaas soomi doonaan.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

kikuyu: Weliba wuxuu kula hadlay masaal isagoo leh, Ninna karriin kama jeexo dhar cusub inuu dhar duug ah ku tolo, haddii kale tan cusub ayuu jeexayaa, oo karriintii laga soo gooyay dharkii cusbaa la heshiin mayso kan duugga ah.
english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

kikuyu: Ninna khamri cusub kuma shubo qarbeddo duug ah, haddii kale khamrigii cusbaa ayaa qarbeddada kala dildillaacinaya, oo waa daadanayaa; qarbeddaduna waa hallaabayaan.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

kikuyu: Laakiin khamri cusub waa in lagu shubaa qarbeddo cuscusub.
english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

kikuyu: Ma jiro nin, hadduu khamri duug ah cabbay, doonaya kan cusub, waayo, wuxuu leeyahay, Kan duugga ah ayaa wanaagsan.
english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

kikuyu: Maalin sabti ah waxaa dhacay inuu beeraha dhex marayay, xertiisuna waxay jarteen sabuulladii, oo intay gacmahooda ku xoqeen ayay cuneen.
english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

kikuyu: Laakiin Farrisiintii qaarkood waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaad u samaynaysaan wixii aan xalaal ahayn in sabtida la sameeyo?
english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Miyaydnaan akhriyin wixii Daa'uud sameeyey goortuu gaajooday, isaga iyo kuwii la jiray,
english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

kikuyu: siduu gurigii Ilaah u galay oo uu u qaaday kibistii tusniinta oo u cunay oo u siiyey kuwii la jiray, tan aan xalaal u ahayn in la cuno wadaaddada maahee?
english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu iyagii ku yidhi, Wiilka Aadanahu waa sayidka sabtida.
english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Waxaa sabti kale dhacay inuu sunagogga galay oo wax ku baray; halkaasna waxaa joogay nin gacantiisa midigeed engegnayd.
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

kikuyu: Culimmadii iyo Farrisiintii ayaa fiirinayay inuu sabtida wax bogsiinayo iyo in kale, si ay ugu helaan wax ay ku ashtakeeyaan.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

kikuyu: Isaguse wuxuu gartay fikirradoodii; goortaasuu ninkii gacanta engegnaa ku yidhi, Kac oo dhexda isa soo taag. Wuuna kacay oo istaagay.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Wax baan idin weyddiinayaa, Sabtida ma xalaal baa in wanaag la falo ama shar, in naf la badbaadiyo ama in la dilo?
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu isha wada mariyey, wuxuuna ninkii ku yidhi, Gacantaada soo taag. Markaasuu yeelay sidaas, gacantiisuna waa bogsatay.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

kikuyu: Markaasay aad u cadhoodeen, oo waxay ka wada hadleen waxay Ciise ku samayn lahaayeen.
english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

kikuyu: Maalmahaas waxaa dhacay inuu buurta u baxay inuu tukado. Habeenkii oo dhan wuxuu waday inuu Ilaah u tukado.
english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

kikuyu: Oo goortay maalin noqotay ayuu xertiisii u yeedhay. Markaasuu laba iyo toban ka soo saaray, wuxuuna u bixiyey rasuullo;
english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

kikuyu: oo waxay ahayeen Simoon, kan uu Butros u bixiyey, iyo walaalkiis Andaros, iyo Yacquub iyo Yooxanaa, iyo Filibos iyo Bartolomayos, iyo
english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

kikuyu: Matayos iyo Toomas, iyo Yacquub ina Alfayos, iyo Simoon oo la odhan jiray Qiiroleh,
english: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

kikuyu: iyo Yuudas ina Yacquub, iyo Yuudas Iskariyod, kii gacangeliyey.
english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

kikuyu: Markaasuu hoos ula degay, oo bannaan ayuu istaagay, isaga iyo qaar badan oo xertiisa ah, iyo dad badan oo Yahuudiya iyo Yeruusaalem iyo xeebaha Turos iyo Siidoon uga yimaadeen inay maqlaan iyo in cudurradooda laga bogsiiyo.
english: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

kikuyu: Oo kuwo jinniyo wasakh leh derdereenna waa la bogsiiyey.
english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa oo dhan waxay doonayeen inay taabtaan isaga, waayo, xoog baa ka soo baxay oo wada bogsiiyey.
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

kikuyu: Markaasuu kor u fiiriyey oo xertiisii eegay oo ku yidhi, Waxaa barakaysan kuwiinna masaakiinta ah, waayo, boqortooyadii Ilaah idinkaa leh.
english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

kikuyu: Waxaana barakaysan kuwiinna haddeer gaajaysan, waayo, waad dhergi doontaan. Waxaana barakaysan kuwiinna haddeer ooyaya, waayo, waad qosli doontaan.
english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

kikuyu: Waad barakaysan tihiin goortii dadku idin necbaado, oo goortay dhexdooda idinka saaraan, oo idin caayaan, oo magacyadiinna sida wax shar leh u tuuraan Wiilkii Aadanaha aawadiis.
english: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

kikuyu: Maalintaas reyreeya oo farxad ku boodbooda, waayo, bal ogaada, abaalgudkiinnu waa ku weyn yahay jannada, waayo, awowayaashood sidaasay nebiyadii ku samayn jireen.
english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

kikuyu: Hoog waxaa leh kuwiinna hodanka ah, waayo, gargaarkiinna waad hesheen.
english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

kikuyu: Hoogna waxaa leh kuwiinna haddeer dheregsan, waayo, waad gaajoon doontaan; hoogna waxaa leh kuwiinna haddeer qoslaya, waayo, waad barooran doontaan oo ooyi doontaan.
english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog markii dadka oo dhammu wanaag idinka sheego, waayo, awowayaashood sidaasay nebiyadii beenta ahaa ku samayn jireen.
english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinku leeyahay kuwiinna maqlaya, Cadowyadiinna jeclaada, kuwa idin necebna wax wanaagsan u sameeya.
english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

kikuyu: Kuwa idin habaara u duceeya, kuwa idin caayana Ilaah u barya.
english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

kikuyu: Kii dhabanka kaa dhirbaaxa, kan kalena u du; oo kii maradaada kaa qaata, khamiiskaagana ha ka celin.
english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

kikuyu: Mid walba oo wax kaa barya, sii; kii waxaaga qaatana, ha ka baryin.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

kikuyu: Oo sidaad doonaysaan in dadku idiin sameeyo, idinkuna sidaas oo kale u sameeya iyaga.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

kikuyu: Haddaad jeceshihiin kuwa idin jecel, mahadmaad heshaan? Waayo, xataa dembilayaashuba way jecel yihiin kuwa jecel iyaga.
english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

kikuyu: Haddaad wanaag u fashaan kuwa wanaag idiin fala, mahadmaad heshaan? Waayo, xataa dembilayaashuba sidaasay yeelaan.
english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

kikuyu: Haddaad wax amaahisaan kuwa aad ka rajaynaysaan inaad ka heshaan, mahadmaad heshaan? Waayo, xataa dembilayaashuba way amaahiyaan dembilayaasha inay ka helaan intii oo kale.
english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

kikuyu: Laakiin cadowyadiinna jeclaada, oo wanaag u sameeya, oo amaahiya, idinkoo aan waxba ka rajaynaynin, abaalgudkiinnuna waa badan doonaa, oo waxaadna noqon doontaan wiilashii Kan ugu sarreeya, waayo, isagu waa u roon yahay kuwa aan mahadnaqin iyo kuwa sharka leh.
english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

kikuyu: Naxariis lahaada sida Aabbihiin naxariis u leeyahay.
english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

kikuyu: Cidna ha xukumina, idinkana laydinma xukumi doono. Ninnana wax ha ku garaynina, idinkana wax laydinkuma garayn doono e; dhaafa oo waa laydin dhaafi doonaa.
english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

kikuyu: Siiya oo waa laydin siin doonaa; qiyaas wanaagsan oo hoos u riixriixan oo ruxan oo buuxdhaafaya ayaa laydinku siin doonaa faraqiinna, waayo, qiyaastii aad ku qiyaastaan ayaa laydiinku qiyaasi doonaa.
english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu masaal kula hadlay. Indhoole indhoole ma hagi karaa? Labadoodu miyaanay god ku dhici doonin?
english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

kikuyu: Qof xer ah macallinkiisa kama sarreeyo, laakiin mid walba markuu wanaag u dhan yahay wuxuu noqon doonaa sida macallinkiisa oo kale.
english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

kikuyu: Saxarka isha walaalkaa ku jira maxaad u aragtaa, dogobka ishaada ku jirase aad u fiirsan weydaa?
english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Sidee baad walaalkaa ugu odhan kartaa, Walaalow i daa, saxarka ishaada ku jira aan kaa saaree, adiga oo aan arkaynin dogobka ishaada ku jira? Labawejiile yahow, horta dogobka ishaada ku jira iska saar, goortaasaad bayaan u arkaysaa inaad saxarka isha walaalkaa ku jira ka saarto.
english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

kikuyu: Waayo, ma jiro geed wanaagsan oo midho xun dhalaa, welibana ma jiro geed xun oo midho wanaagsan dhalaa.
english: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, geed kasta waxaa laga garanayaa midhihiisa. Waayo, berde lagama guro qudhac, canabkana lagama guro geed qodxan leh.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

kikuyu: Ninka wanaagsan wuxuu maalka wanaagsan oo qalbiga ku jira ka soo saaraa wax wanaagsan; kan sharka lehna wuxuu sharka ka soo saaraa wax shar ah; waayo, afkiisu wuxuu ku hadlaa waxa qalbiga ku badan.
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

kikuyu: Maxaad iigu yeedhaan, Rabbow, Rabbow, oo aad u yeeli weydaan wixii aan leeyahay?
english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

kikuyu: Kii kasta oo ii yimaada, oo ereyadayda maqla, oo yeela, waxaan idin tusayaa kuu u eg yahay.
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu u eg yahay nin guri dhisay, oo qoday oo hoos u dheereeyey; aasaaskiina ayuu dhagax weyn ka dul dhisay. Goortii daadku yimid ayaa webigu ku soo jabay gurigaas, xoog uu ku gilgilose ma lahayn, waayo, si wanaagsan ayaa loo dhisay.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

kikuyu: Laakiin kii maqla oo aan yeelin, wuxuu u eg yahay nin dhulka ka dhisay guri aan aasaas lahayn. Kan webigu ku soo jabay, oo kolkiiba ayuu dumay, oo dumiddii gurigaasu waa weynayd.
english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

kikuyu: Goortuu hadalladiisa ku dhammeeyey dadka dhegaysadkooda ayuu Kafarna'um galay.
english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

kikuyu: Boqol-u-taliye addoonkiisii uu jeclaa ayaa bukay oo dhimashuu u dhowaa.
english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

kikuyu: Goortuu maqlay wax Ciise ku saabsan, ayuu waayeelladii Yuhuudda u diray isaga, oo ka baryay inuu yimaado oo addoonkiisa bogsiiyo.
english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

kikuyu: Goortay Ciise u yimaadeen, aad bay u baryeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Isagu waa istaahilaa inaad waxaas u yeeshid,
english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

kikuyu: waayo, quruunteenna ayuu jecel yahay, oo sunagog ayuu noo dhisay.
english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise raacay, oo isagoo aan guriga ka fogayn, ayaa boqol-u-taliyihii saaxiibbo u soo diray oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, ha isdhibin, waayo, anigu ma istaahilo inaad saqafka gurigayga hoostiisa soo gashid.
english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

kikuyu: Saas aawadeed uma aan malaynaynin inaan istaahilo inaan kuu imaado; laakiin hadal dheh, midiidinkayguna waa bogsan doonaa.
english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu waxaan ahay nin laga sarreeyo, oo askar baa iga hoosaysa. Kan waxaan ku idhaahdaa, Tag, wuuna tagaa; mid kalena, Kaalay, wuuna yimaadaa; midiidinkaygana, Waxan samee, wuuna sameeyaa.
english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

kikuyu: Goortuu Ciise taas maqlay, wuu ka yaabay, oo intuu dadkii la socday ku jeestay ayuu ku yidhi, Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Rumaysad sidaas u weyn oo kale reer binu Israa'iil kama dhex helin.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

kikuyu: Kuwii la soo dirayna kolkay gurigii ku noqdeen, waxay heleen addoonkii oo ladan.
english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

kikuyu: Markii dambe waxaa noqotay inuu galay magaalada Na'in la odhan jiray; waxaana raacay xertiisii, iyo dad badanba.
english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

kikuyu: Oo goortuu iriddii magaalada ku soo dhowaaday, waxaa dibadda loo waday nin meyd ah oo madi u ahaa hooyadiis; iyaduna waxay ahayd carmal. Oo waxaa iyada la jiray dad badan oo magaalada.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

kikuyu: Rabbigu goortuu arkay iyada, ayuu u naxariistay oo ku yidhi, Ha ooyin.
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

kikuyu: Oo intuu ku soo dhowaaday, ayuu taabtay rabrabtii. Kuwii sidayna way joogsadeen. Markaasuu yidhi, Dhallinyarow, waxaan kugu leeyahay, Kac.
english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa kii dhintay sara fadhiistay oo bilaabay inuu hadlo, oo markaasaa Ciise isagii u dhiibay hooyadiis.
english: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

kikuyu: Kulligood baqdin baa ku wada dhacday, oo Ilaah bay ammaaneen iyagoo leh, Nebi weyn ayaa dhexdeenna ka kacay. Ilaahna waa soo booqday dadkiisa.
english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

kikuyu: Warkaas isaga ku saabsan ayaa gaadhay Yahuudiya oo dhan iyo dhulka ku wareegsan oo dhan.
english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

kikuyu: Yooxanaa xertiisa ayaa waxaas oo dhan uga warrantay.
english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yooxanaa wuxuu u yeedhay laba xertiisii ah oo Ciise u soo diray, oo ku yidhi, Miyaad tahay kan imanaya mise mid kalaannu dhawrnaa?
english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

kikuyu: Nimankii goortay u yimaadeen, waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha ayaa noo soo kaa diray isagoo leh, Miyaad tahay kan imanaya mise mid kalaannu dhawrnaa?
english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

kikuyu: Saacaddaas qudheeda ayuu dad badan ka bogsiiyey bukaankooda iyo cudurradooda iyo jinniyadooda sharka leh. Indhoolayaal badanna wuxuu ugu roonaaday inay wax arkaan.
english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Taga oo Yooxanaa uga warrama waxaad aragteen iyo waxaad maqasheen. Kuwii indhaha la'aa wax bay arkaan, kuwii lugahala'aana way socdaan, kuwii baraska qabayna waa la nadiifiyey, kuwii dhegahala'aana wax bay maqlaan, kuwii dhintayna waa la kiciyey, masaakiintana injiilka waa lagu wacdiyaa,
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: oo waxaana barakaysan kan aan iga xumaanin.
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

kikuyu: Kuwii Yooxanaa diray goortay tageen, wuxuu bilaabay inuu dadkii badnaa wax uga sheego Yooxanaa. Maxaad cidlada ugu baxdeen? Ma waxay ahayd inaad soo aragtaan cawsduur dabaylu ruxayso?
english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

kikuyu: Laakiin maxaad u baxdeen? Ma waxay ahayd inaad soo aragtaan nin dhar jilicsan qaba? Kuwa dharka wanaagsan qaba oo hodan ku nool waxay joogaan guryaha boqorrada.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

kikuyu: Laakiin maxaad u baxdeen? Ma waxay ahayd inaad nebi soo aragtaan? Haah, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mid nebi ka sarreeya.
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

kikuyu: Kanu waa kii laga qoray, Eeg, waxaan hortaada soo dirayaa wargeeyahayga, Kan jidkaaga ku sii diyaargarayn doona hortaada.
english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Intii dumar ka dhalatay, mid Yooxanaa ka weyn ma jiro, laakiin kan boqortooyada Ilaah ugu yar ayaa ka weyn.
english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

kikuyu: Dadkii maqlay oo dhan iyo cashuurqaadayaashiiba waxay caddeeyeen inuu Ilaah yahay xaq, iyagoo ah kuwii lagu baabtiisay baabtiiskii Yooxanaa.
english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

kikuyu: Laakiin Farrisiintii iyo kuwii sharciga yiqiin ayaa waanadii Ilaah naftooda darteed u diiday iyagoo aan Yooxanaa baabtiisin.
english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

kikuyu: Haddaba maxaan nimanka qarnigan u ekaysiiyaa? Maxay u eg yihiin?
english: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

kikuyu: Waxay u eg yihiin carruur suuqa fadhida oo isu yeedhyeedhaysa iyagoo leh, Biibiile baannu idiin yeedhinnay, oo waad cayaari weydeen, waannu baroorannay oo waad ooyi weydeen.
english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

kikuyu: Waayo, Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha waa yimid isagoo aan kibis cunaynin oo aan khamri cabbaynin; waxaadna tidhaahdaan, Jinni buu qabaa.
english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

kikuyu: Wiilka Aadanahu waa yimid isagoo wax cunaya oo cabbaya, waxaadna tidhaahdaan, Eeg, waa nin cir weyn oo khamriyacab ah oo saaxiib la ah cashuurqaadayaal iyo dembilayaal.
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

kikuyu: Xigmaddu inay xaq tahay waa laga caddeeyey xaggii carruurteeda oo dhan.
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

kikuyu: Farrisiinta midkood ayaa weyddiistay inuu wax la cuno, wuuna galay gurigii Farrisiga oo cunto u fadhiistay.
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, naag magaalada joogtay oo dembi lahayd goortay ogaatay inuu gurigii Farrisiga cunto u fadhiyo, waxay soo qaadatay weel alabastar ah oo cadar ku jiro.
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

kikuyu: Way isdaba taagtay cagihiisa agtooda iyadoo ooyaysa, waxayna bilaabtay inay ilmada cagihiisa ku qoyso, oo ay timaha madaxeeda ku tirtirto, oo cagihiisay dhunkatay, oo cadarkii marisay.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

kikuyu: Farrisigii u yeedhay isaga, goortuu arkay, ayuu isla hadlay isagoo leh, Ninkan hadduu nebi yahay, wuu ogaan lahaa naagtan taataabatay cid ay tahay iyo waxay tahay inay tahay dembile.
english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Simoonow, hal baan ku leeyahay. Wuxuu yidhi, Dheh, Macallimow.
english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

kikuyu: Waxaa jiray amaahiye laba nin amaah ku lahaa, mid wuxuu ku lahaa shan boqol oo dinaar, midka kalena konton.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

kikuyu: Goortii ay waayeen waxay bixiyaan, ayuu labadoodiiba u dhaafay. Haddaba iyamaa ahaan doona kan jacayl badan?
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

kikuyu: Simoon baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waxaan u malaynayaa, kan uu wax badan u dhaafay. Wuxuu ku yidhi, Si hagaagsan baad u qiyaastay.
english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu naagtii u jeestay, oo wuxuu Simoon ku yidhi, Naagtan ma aragtaa? Anigu gurigaagaan galay; biyo cagahayga iima aad siin, laakiin iyadu cagahayga ayay ilmadeeda ku qoysay oo ay timaheeda ku tirtirtay.
english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

kikuyu: Dhunkasho ima aad dhunkan, iyaduse tan iyo wakhtigaan soo galay kama dayn inay cagahayga dhunkato.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

kikuyu: Madaxaygana saliid ma aad marin, iyaduse cagahayga ayay cadar marisay.
english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed waxaan kugu leeyahay, Dembiyadeedii badnaa waa cafiyan yihiin, waayo, aad bay u jeclayd. Kii wax yar loo dhaafay, ayaa wax yar jecel.
english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu iyada ku yidhi, Dembiyadaadii waa cafiyan yihiin.
english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

kikuyu: Kuwii cunto ula fadhiyey waxay bilaabeen inay isku yidhaahdaan, Yuu yahay kan dembiyo cafiya haddana?
english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu naagtii ku yidhi, Rumaysadkaaga ayaa ku badbaadiyey ee nabad ku tag.
english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

kikuyu: Markii dambe waxaa dhacay inuu magaalooyinka iyo tuulooyinka dhex marayay isagoo dadka ku wacdiyaya oo u sheegaya injiilka boqortooyadii Ilaah; waxaana la jiray laba-iyo-tobankii,
english: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

kikuyu: iyo naago laga bogsiiyey jinniyo shar leh iyo cudurro. Waxay ahaayeen Maryantii la odhan jiray tii reer Magdala, ee toddoba jinni ka baxeen,
english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

kikuyu: iyo Yo'anna afadii Khusas ee wakiilkii Herodos ahaa, iyo Susanna, iyo qaar badan oo kale oo waxooda ugu adeegi jiray.
english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

kikuyu: Goortii dad badan isu soo urureen, iyo kuwa magaalo walba uga yimid, wuxuu ku hadlay masaal.
english: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:

kikuyu: Beerrey baa baxay inuu abuurkiisa beero, oo intuu beerayay, qaar baa jidka geestiisa ku dhacay, oo waa lagu tuntay, oo shimbirrihii cirka ayaa cunay.
english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waxay ku dhaceen dhagax; kol alla kolkii ay soo baxeen way engegeen, waayo, qoyaan ma lahayn.
english: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waxay ku dhex dhaceen qodxan, qodxantiina waa la soo baxday oo ceejisay.
english: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena dhul wanaagsan bay ku dhaceen oo soo baxeen, waxayna midho dhaleen boqol jibbaar. Goortuu waxan yidhi, ayuu qayliyey oo yidhi, Kan dhego wax lagu maqlo lahu ha maqlo.
english: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertiisii weyddiisay oo ku tidhi, Muxuu yahay masaalkan?
english: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinka waa laydin siiyaa inaad waxa qarsoon ee boqortooyadii Ilaah garataan, kuwa kalese masaallo ayaa loogu sheegaa, si ay goortay arkayaan ayan u arkin, oo si ay goortay maqlayaan ayan u garan.
english: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

kikuyu: Masaalku waa kan: Abuurku waa ereygii Ilaah.
english: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

kikuyu: Kuwii jidka yiil waa kuwa maqla, markaasaa Ibliisku yimaadaa, oo hadalka ayuu qalbigooda ka qaadaa, si aanay u rumaysan oo aanay u badbaadin.
english: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

kikuyu: Kuwii dhagaxa yiilna waa kuwa goortay maqlaan, hadalka farxad ku qaata, kuwanna xidid ma leh; laakiin wakhti yar ayay rumaystaan, wakhtiga duufsashadana way iska noqdaan.
english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

kikuyu: Kuwii qodxanta ku dhex dhacayna waa kuwan maqla oo intay socdaan waxaa ceejiya welwelidda iyo hodantinimada iyo farxadda ifkan, midho bisilna ma dhalaan.
english: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

kikuyu: Kuwa dhulka wanaagsanna waxay yihiin kuwa, intay maqlaan, qalbi wanaagsan oo fiican hadalka ku haysta, oo dulqaadasho ayay midho ku dhalaan.
english: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

kikuyu: Ma jiro nin, goortuu ilays shido, weel ku daboola, ama sariir hoos geliya, laakiin wuxuu saaraa meeshii ilayska si ay kuwa soo galaa iftiinka u arkaan.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

kikuyu: Waayo, wax qarsoon ma jiro oo aan soo muuqan doonin, wax daboolanna ma jiro oo aan la garan doonin oo aan bannaan soo bixi doonin.
english: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed u fiirsada sidaad u maqlaysaan, waayo, ku alla kii wax haysta waa la siin doonaa, ku alla kii aan waxba haysanse waa laga qaadi doonaa wixii loo maleeyo inuu haysto.
english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa isaga u yimid hooyadiis iyo walaalihiis, wayna soo gaadhi kari waayeen dadkii badnaa aawadood.
english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa lagu yidhi, Hooyadaa iyo walaalahaa ayaa dibadda taagan oo doonaya inay ku arkaan.
english: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Hooyaday iyo walaalahay waa kuwan ereyga Ilaah maqla oo yeela.
english: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

kikuyu: Maalmahaas middood waxaa dhacay inuu doonni fuulay isaga iyo xertiisiiba, wuxuuna iyaga ku yidhi, Dhanka kale oo badda aan u gudubno, goortaasay dhaqaaqeen.
english: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

kikuyu: Laakiin intay socdeen ayuu seexday, oo waxaa baddii ku soo dhacay duufaan weyn oo dabayl ah; doonnidiina ayaa buuxsamaysay, oo halis bay ku jireen.
english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

kikuyu: Markaasay isaga u yimaadeen oo intay toosiyeen ayay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, Macallimow, waa lumaynaaye. Kolkaasuu kacay oo canaantay dabayshii iyo hirarkii biyaha. Goortaasay degeen oo xawaal baa dhacday.
english: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Rumaysadkiinnii meeh? Iyagoo baqaya oo yaabban waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba yuu yahay kan amra xataa dabaysha iyo biyaha oo ay yeelaan?
english: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

kikuyu: Waxay gaadheen dalka Gadareni ee ka soo hor jeeday Galili.
english: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

kikuyu: Goortuu dhulka u degay waxaa la kulmay nin magaalada ka yimid oo jinniyo qaba. Wakhti dheer dhar ma sidan jirin, gurina ma joogi jirin, laakiin xabaalaha ayuu dhex joogi jiray.
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

kikuyu: Goortuu arkay Ciise, ayuu qayliyey, hortiisana ayuu isku tuuray oo cod weyn ayuu ku yidhi, Maxaa inoo dhexeeya, Ciisow, adigoo ah Wiilka Ilaaha sarow? Waxaan kaa baryayaa, Ha i silcin.
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu jinnigii wasakhda lahaa ku amray inuu ninka ka baxo, maxaa yeelay, marar badan ayuu qaban jiray, oo waxaa lagu xidhi jiray silsilado iyo bircago, oo waa la ilaalin jiray; silsiladihiina wuu iska gooyn jiray oo jinniguna cidlada ayuu u kaxayn jiray.
english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise weyddiiyey oo ku yidhi, Magacaa? Oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Liijon; waayo, jinniyo badan ayaa galay.
english: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

kikuyu: Markaasay ka baryeen inaanu amrin inay yamayska tagaan.
english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

kikuyu: Halkaa waxaa joogay daaqsin doofaarro badan ah oo buurta daaqaysa. Waxayna ka baryeen inuu u fasaxo inay kuwaas galaan. Kolkaasuu u fasaxay.
english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

kikuyu: Markaasay jinniyadii ninkii ka baxeen oo doofaarradii galeen. Daqsintiina jarka hoos bay uga yaacday ilaa badda, wayna ku bakhtiyeen.
english: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

kikuyu: Kuwii daajin jiray markay arkeen waxa dhacay, ayay carareen oo dadkii magaalada iyo beerahaba ayay u warrameen.
english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa dadkii u soo baxay inay arkaan wixii dhacay. Markaasay u yimaadeen Ciise, oo waxay arkeen ninkii jinniyadu ka baxeen, isagoo ag fadhiya Ciise cagihiisa oo dhar sita oo miyir qaba; wayna baqeen.
english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa kuwii arkay waxay iyaga u sheegeen sida jinnoolihii loo bogsiiyey.
english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

kikuyu: Dadkii oo dhan oo dalka Gadareni ku wareegsanaa ayaa baryay inuu ka noqdo iyaga, waayo, baqdin weyn ayay baqeen. Markaasuu doonni fuulay, waana noqday.
english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

kikuyu: Laakiin ninkii jinniyadii ka baxeen ayaa ka baryay isaga inuu raaco, laakiin wuu diray isagoo ku leh,
english: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

kikuyu: Gurigaaga ku noqo oo dadka ogeysii waxa weyn oo Ilaah kuu sameeyey. Markaasuu tegey oo wuxuu magaalada oo dhan ku naadiyey waxa weyn oo Ciise u sameeyey.
english: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

kikuyu: Markii Ciise noqday ayaa dadkii badnaa farxad ku qaatay, waayo, way wada sugayeen.
english: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa yimid nin Yayros la odhan jiray, oo taliyaha sunagogga ahaan jiray. Wuxuuna isku riday Ciise cagihiisa oo ka baryay inuu gurigiisa galo.
english: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

kikuyu: Waayo, gabadh keliya buu lahaa, iyadoo abbaaraha laba iyo toban sannadood jirtay, wayna sakaraadaysay. Laakiin intuu socday dadkii badnaa ayaa cidhiidhiyey.
english: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

kikuyu: Naag laba iyo toban sannadood dhiigbixid qabtay, oo wixii ay ku noolaan lahayd oo dhan dhakhtarro ku bixisay, oo ku bogsan kari weyday, midna xaggiisa,
english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

kikuyu: ayaa dhabarkiisa timid oo taabatay maradiisa darafteeda. Kolkiiba bixiddii dhiiggeeda ayaa joogsatay.
english: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise yidhi, Yuu yahay kan i taabtay? Markay wada dafireen, Butros iyo kuwa la jiray waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, dadkii badnaa ayaa ku jiidhaya oo ku cidhiidhinaya.
english: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise wuxuu yidhi, Qof baa i taabtay, waayo, waxaan gartay in xoog iga baxay.
english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

kikuyu: Naagtii goortay aragtay inaanay qarsoonaan karin ayay timid iyadoo gariiraysa, oo hortiisay isku ridday, oo u caddaysay dadkii oo dhan hortooda waxay u taabatay iyo siday markiiba u bogsatay.
english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu iyada ku yidhi, Gabadhoy, rumaysadkaaga ayaa ku bogsiiyey ee nabad ku tag.
english: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

kikuyu: Intuu weli hadlayay, waxaa gurigii taliyaha sunagogga ka yimid nin ku leh, Gabadhaadii waa dhimatay, ee Macallinka ha dhibin.
english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise goortuu maqlay, wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Ha baqin ee iska rumayso, wayna bogsan doontaa.
english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

kikuyu: Markuu guriga yimid, ninna uma oggolaanin inuu la galo, Butros, iyo Yooxanaa, iyo Yacquub, iyo gabadha aabbeheed, iyo hooyadeed maahee.
english: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

kikuyu: Kulligood waxay u ooyayeen oo u barooranayeen iyada, laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Ha ooyina, iyadu ma dhiman, waase huruddaa.
english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

kikuyu: Wayna ku qosleen, iyagoo og inay dhimatay.
english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

kikuyu: Markaasuu dadkii oo dhan dibadda u saaray, oo uu gacanteeda qabtay oo qayliyey isagoo leh, Yartoy, kac.
english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

kikuyu: Ruuxeedii ayaa ku soo noqday, oo markiiba way kacday, oo wuxuu amray in cunto la siiyo iyada.
english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

kikuyu: Waalidkeedii waa yaabeen, wuxuuse amray inaanay ninna u sheegin waxa dhacay.
english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

kikuyu: Laba-iyo-tobankii ayuu isugu yeedhay, wuxuuna siiyey xoog iyo amar ay jinniyada oo dhan ku saaraan oo ay cudurro ku bogsiiyaan.
english: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

kikuyu: Wuuna diray inay boqortooyadii Ilaah ku wacdiyaan dadka oo ay bogsiiyaan kuwa buka.
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waxba safarka ha u qaadanina, ama ul, ama qandi, ama kibis, ama lacag. Laba khamiisna ha qaadanina.
english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

kikuyu: Guri alla gurigaad gashaan jooga, meeshaasna ka baxa.
english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

kikuyu: Kuwa alla kuwii aan idin soo dhowayn, markaad magaaladaas ka baxdaan siigada cagihiinna ka dhabaandhaba inay marag ka gees ah ku ahaato.
english: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

kikuyu: Markaasay baxeen, oo tuulooyinka ayay dhex mareen, iyagoo injiilka ku wacdiyaya oo meel walbaba kuwa buka ku bogsiinaya.
english: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

kikuyu: Markaasaa taliye Herodos maqlay waxa dhacay oo dhan, wuuna shakiyey, waayo, qaar baa yidhi, Yooxanaa ayaa kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kacay,
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

kikuyu: qaarna waxay yidhaahdeen, Eliyaas ayaa soo muuqday, qaar kalena waxay yidhaahdeen, Nebi nebiyadii hore ah ayaa soo sara kacay.
english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Herodos wuxuu yidhi, Yooxanaa madaxaan ka gooyay, Yuu yahay kan aan waxan ka maqlayo? Oo wuxuu doonayay inuu arko.
english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

kikuyu: Rasuulladii markay soo noqdeen ayay isaga u sheegeen wixii ay sameeyeen. Wuuna waday oo keli ahaan u kaxeeyey magaalada Beytsayda la odhan jiray.
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

kikuyu: Laakiin dadkii badnaa, goortay ogaadeen, way soo raaceen. Markaasuuna iyaga soo dhoweeyey, oo wuxuu kala hadlay wax ku saabsan boqortooyadii. Ilaah, oo kuwii u baahnaa in la bogsiiyona wuu bogsiiyey.
english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

kikuyu: Goortii maalintii dhammaanaysay laba-iyo-tobankii ayaa yimid iyagoo ku leh, Dadka badan dir si ay u tagaan tuulooyinka iyo beeraha ku wareegsan, oo ay ugu hoydaan oo cunto uga helaan, waayo, meeshan cidlada ah ayaynu joognaa.
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuse ku yidhi, Idinku siiya waxay cunaan. Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Annagu wax ka badan shan kibsood iyo laba kalluun ma hayno, inaannu tagno oo dadkan oo dhan cunto u soo iibinno maahee.
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay ku dhowaayeen shan kun oo nin. Wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi, U fadhiisiya koox koox konton konton ah.
english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

kikuyu: Sidaasay yeeleen oo wada fadhiisiyeen.
english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu qaaday shantii kibsood iyo labadii kalluun, oo intuu cirka eegay, ayuu barakeeyey, oo kala jejebiyey, oo xertiisii siiyey, inay dadkii badnaa hortooda dhigaan.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

kikuyu: Markaasay cuneen oo ka wada dhergeen; waxaana la guray jajabkii ka hadhay oo laba iyo toban dambiilood ah.
english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Intuu keli ahaan u tukanayay, ayaa xertiisii la joogtay, markaasuu weyddiiyey isagoo leh, Dadkii badnaa yay igu sheegaan?
english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

kikuyu: Way u jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha; qaar kalena waxay yidhaahdeen, Eliyaas, qaarna waxay yidhaahdeen, Nebi nebiyadii hore ah oo soo sara kacay.
english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinkuse yaad igu sheegtaan? Butros ayaa u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Masiixii Ilaah.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu waaniyey oo wuxuu ku amray inaanay ninna waxaas u sheegin,
english: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Waxay waajib ugu tahay Wiilka Aadanahu inuu wax badan ku xanuunsado, oo ay waayeellada iyo wadaaddada sare iyo culimmadu diidaan, oo la dilo, oo maalinta saddexaad la sara kiciyo.
english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu kulligood ku yidhi, Mid uun hadduu doonayo inuu iga daba yimaado, ha dayriyo doonistiisa, iskutallaabtiisana maalin walba ha soo qaato oo ha i soo raaco.
english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: Waayo, kan doonaya inuu naftiisa badbaadiyo, waa lumin doonaa, laakiin kan naftiisa u lumiya aawaday, kaasaa badbaadin doona.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

kikuyu: Waayo, nin maxay u taraysaa hadduu dunida oo dhan helo oo uu islumiyo oo khasaaro?
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, ku alla kii ka xishooda aniga iyo ereygaygaba, Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa ka xishoon doona isaga, goortuu ku yimaado ammaantiisa iyo ammaanta Aabbihiis iyo tan malaa'igaha quduuska ah.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

kikuyu: Laakiin run baan idiin sheegayaa, Kuwa halkan taagan qaarkood sinaba dhimasho uma dhadhamin doonaan ilaa ay arkaan boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Abbaaraha siddeed maalmood hadalladan dabadood waxaa dhacay inuu waday Butros, iyo Yooxanaa, iyo Yacquub, oo buurtuu fuulay inuu ku tukado,
english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

kikuyu: oo intuu tukanayay, araggii wejigiisa ayaa si kale noqday, dharkiisuna caddaan ayuu la dhalaalayay.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, laba nin ayaa la hadlayay isaga, waxayna ahaayeen Muuse iyo Eliyaas,
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

kikuyu: oo ammaan ku soo muuqday, oo waxay kala hadlayeen dhimashadiisa uu Yeruusaalem dhowaan ku dhammayn lahaa.
english: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros iyo kuwii la jiray ayaa hurdo la cuslaaday; oo goortay tooseen ayay arkeen ammaantiisa iyo labadii nin oo la taagan.
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

kikuyu: Kolkay ka tegayeen waxaa dhacay in Butros ku yidhi Ciise, Macallimow, waxaa inoo wanaagsan inaynu halkan joogno, haddaba saddex waab aannu ka dhisno, mid adaan ku dhisaynaa, midna Muuse, midna Eliyaas, waayo, ma uu garanaynin wuxuu leeyahay.
english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

kikuyu: Intuu waxaas lahaa, waxaa timid daruur oo iyagay hadhaysay, wayna baqeen kolkay daruurtii galeen.
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

kikuyu: Daruurtiina waxaa ka yimid cod leh, Kanu waa Wiilkayga aan jeclahay ee maqla isaga.
english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

kikuyu: Goortii codkii ahaaday Ciise keliya ayaa la arkay; markaasay iska aamuseen, oo maalmahaas ninna uma ay sheegin wixii ay arkeen.
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

kikuyu: Maalintii xigtay, goortay buurta ka soo degeen, waxaa dhacay in dad badni la kulmay isaga.
english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, nin dadkii badnaa ka mid ah ayaa qayliyey isagoo leh, Macallimow, waxaan kaa baryayaa inaad wiilkayga eegto, waayo, waa madigayga,
english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

kikuyu: oo bal eeg, jinni baa qabsada, oo dhaqsiba wiilkaa qayliya, jinniguna waa gilgilaa, oo wiilku afkuu ka xumbeeyaa; dhib ayaa jinnigu kaga baxaa, isagoo aad u burburinaya.
english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

kikuyu: Waxaan xertaada ka baryay inay ka saaraan, wayna kari waayeen.
english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Qarni yahow rumaysadka daranu oo madaxa adagu, ilaa goormaan idinla jiri doonaa, oo ilaa goormaan idiin dulqaadan doonaa? Wiilkaaga halkan keen.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

kikuyu: Intuu weli soo socday, jinnigii ayaa jeexjeexay oo gilgilay. Markaasaa Ciise jinnigii wasakhda lahaa canaantay, wiilkiina ayuu bogsiiyey oo aabbihiis ku celiyey.
english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

kikuyu: Kulli way ka wada yaabeen Ilaah weynaantiisa. Laakiin intay kulligood la wada yaabsanaayeen wixii uu sameeyey oo dhan, wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi,
english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: Hadalladanu ha galeen dhegihiinna, waayo, Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa dadka loo gacangelin doonaa.
english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

kikuyu: Laakiin hadalkaas ayay garan waayeen, waana laga qariyey si ayna u garan, wayna ka cabsadeen inay hadalkas wax ka weyddiiyaan.
english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

kikuyu: Waxaa ka dhex kacday dood ay islahaayeen, Kee baa ahaan doonaa kan inoo weyn.
english: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise markuu gartay fikirrada qalbigooda ayuu ilmo qaaday oo is-ag joojiyey,
english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

kikuyu: markaasuu ku yidhi iyaga, Ku alla kii magacayga ku aqbala ilmahan, wuu i aqbalaa, oo ku alla kii i aqbalaa, wuxuu aqbalaa kii i soo diray, waayo, kii idiinku wada yar, kaas ayaa u weyn.
english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

kikuyu: Yooxanaa baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, waxaannu aragnay qof magacaaga jinniyo ku saaraya, oo waannu u diidnay, waayo, isagu nama uu soo raaco.
english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Ha u diidina, waayo, kan aan idinka gees ahayn waa idinla gees.
english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

kikuyu: Goortii wakhtigii isaga kor loo qaadi lahaa uu dhowaaday, wuxuu wejigiisa u jeediyey inuu Yeruusaalem tago.
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

kikuyu: Markaasuu hortiisa cid u diray, oo intay tageen ayay galeen tuulo reer Samaariya ah inay wax u diyaariyaan isaga.
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

kikuyu: Iyaguse ma ay dhowayn, waayo, wejigiisa ayaa u jeeday xagga Yeruusaalem.
english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertiisii Yacquub iyo Yooxanaa goortay arkeen, waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, ma doonaysaa inaannu dab amarno inuu cirka ka soo dego oo baabbi'iyo?
english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

kikuyu: Isaguse waa ku jeestay oo canaantay iyaga, oo ku yidhi, Garan maysaan caynkii ruuxa aad ka tihiin.
english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay aadeen tuulo kale.
english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

kikuyu: Oo intay jidka ku socdeen nin baa ku yidhi isaga, Waan ku raacayaa meel alla meeshaad tagtidba.
english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Dawacooyinku godad bay leeyihiin, shimbirraha cirkuna buulal bay leeyihiin, laakiin Wiilka Aadanahu meel uu madaxiisa dhigo ma leh.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

kikuyu: Mid kalena ayuu ku yidhi, I soo raac. Laakiin isagu wuxuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, horta ii oggolow inaan tago oo aabbahay soo aaso.
english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Iska daa, meydadku ha aaseen meydadkooda, laakiin adigu bax oo boqortooyadii Ilaah ku naadi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Mid kale ayaa yidhi, Sayidow, waan ku raacayaa, laakiin horta ii oggolow inaan kuwa gurigayga jooga ku soo idhaahdo, Nabadgelyo.
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Ma jiro nin gacantiisa mixaraatka saara oo dib u eega, oo u qalma boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Waxaa dabadeed Rabbigu wuxuu soo bixiyey toddobaatan kale, oo laba laba ayuu hortiisa u diray ilaa magaalo walba iyo meel walba oo uu tegi lahaa.
english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waxa beerta laga gooynayaa way badan yihiin, shaqaalayaashuse waa yar yihiin. Sidaa darteed Sayidka beergooyska barya inuu shaqaalayaal beertiisa u soo diro.
english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

kikuyu: Socda, oo ogaada, waxaan idiin dirayaa sida baraar oo yeey ku dhex jira.
english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

kikuyu: Ha qaadanina kiish, ama qandi, ama kabo, ninnaba jidka ha ku nabdaadinina.
english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

kikuyu: Guri alla gurigaad gashaan, horta waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Gurigan nabad ha u ahaato.
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

kikuyu: Ina nabdeed hadduu halkaas joogo, nabaddiinnu waxay ahaan doontaa dushiisa, haddii kalese way idinku soo noqon doontaa.
english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

kikuyu: Gurigaas qudhiisa jooga, idinkoo cunaya oo cabbaya waxay haystaan, waayo, shaqaaluhu waa istaahilaa abaalgudkiisa. Guriba guri ha u dhaafina.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

kikuyu: Magaalo alla magaaladaad gashaan oo laydinka soo dhoweeya, waxa laydin soo hor dhigo cuna.
english: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

kikuyu: Bogsiiya kuwa buka oo halkaas jooga, oo ku dhaha, Boqortooyada Ilaah waa idinku soo dhow dahay.
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

kikuyu: Laakiin magaalo alla magaaladaad gashaan, oo aan laydinka soo dhowayn, u soo baxa jidadkeeda, oo dhaha,
english: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

kikuyu: Xataa siigada magaaladiinna ee cagahayaga soo raacday, waannu idinku tirtiraynaa, laakiin kan ogaada, Boqortooyadii Ilaah waa dhow dahay.
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Maalintaas Sodom ayaa ka xisaab fududaan doonta magaaldaas.
english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

kikuyu: Waa kuu hoog, Khorasinay. Waa kuu hoog, Beytsayday, waayo, shuqulladii xoogga lahaa oo laydinku dhex sameeyey haddii Turos iyo Siidoon lagu samayn lahaa, goor horay toobadkeeni lahaayeen, iyagoo dhar joonyad ah gashan oo dambas ku fadhiya.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: Laakiin maalinta xisaabta Turos iyo Siidoon waa idinka xisaab fududaan doonaan.
english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

kikuyu: Adiguna Kafarna'umay, samada ma laguu sarraysiin doonaa? Waxaa lagu dejin doonaa Haadees.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

kikuyu: Kan idin maqlaa waa i maqlaa, kan idin diidaana, waa i diidaa, kan i diidaana, wuxuu diidaa kii i soo diray.
english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

kikuyu: Toddobaatankii farxad ayay la soo noqdeen, iyagoo leh, Sayidow, xataa jinniyadu magacaaga ayay nooga dambeeyaan.
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaan arkay Shayddaankoo sida hillaac samada uga soo dhacaya.
english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

kikuyu: Bal ogaada, waxaan idin siiyey amar aad kula tumataan abeesooyin iyo dabaqalloocyo iyo xoogga oo dhan ee cadowga; innaba waxba idinma yeeli doono.
english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

kikuyu: Laakiin tan ha ku farxina in jinniyadu ay idinka dambeeyaan, laakiin ku farxa in magacyadiinnu ay jannada ku qoran yihiin.
english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

kikuyu: Saacaddaas qudheeda ayuu Ruuxa Quduuska ah ku reyreeyey oo yidhi, Waan kugu mahadnaqayaa, Aabbow, Rabbiga samada iyo dhulkow, waayo, waxyaalahan ayaad kuwa caqliga iyo garashada leh ka qarisay, oo waxaad u muujisay ilmo yaryar. Haah, Aabbow, waayo, sidaas ayaa kaa farxisay.
english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

kikuyu: Aabbahay wax walbaba waa ii dhiibay; oo ninna Wiilka garan maayo cid uu yahay Aabbaha maahee, oo ninna Aabbaha garan maayo cid uu yahay, Wiilka maahee, iyo kii Wiilku doonayo inuu u muujiyo.
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna u jeestay xertiisa oo keli ahaan ugu yidhi, Waxaa barakaysan indhaha arka waxaad aragtaan;
english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

kikuyu: waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nebiyo iyo boqorro badan ayaa doonay inay arkaan waxaad aragtaan, mana arkin, iyo inay maqlaan waxaad maqashaan, mana ay maqlin.
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

kikuyu: Mid sharciga yaqaan ayaa istaagay oo jirrabay, isagoo leh, Macallimow, maxaan sameeyaa si aan ku dhaxlo nolosha weligeed ah?
english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Maxaa sharciga ku qoran? Sidee baad u akhridaa?
english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

kikuyu: Isagaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa inaad Rabbiga Ilaahaaga ah ka jeclaataa qalbigaaga oo dhan, iyo naftaada oo dhan, iyo xooggaaga oo dhan, iyo caqligaaga oo dhan, deriskaagana waa inaad u jeclaataa sida naftaada.
english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Si hagaagsan ayaad u jawaabtay. Sidaas yeel oo waad noolaan doontaa.
english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

kikuyu: Laakiin isagoo doonaya inuu iscaddeeyo inuu xaq yahay, ayuu Ciise ku yidhi, Yaa deriskayga ah?
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Nin baa Yeruusaalem ka soo degayay oo Yerixoo ku socday; wuxuuna ku dhex dhacay tuugag, oo intay dharka ka furteen oo garaaceen ayay ka tageen oo daayeen isagoo bestiis ah.
english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

kikuyu: Waxay noqotay in wadaad jidkaas ku soo degayay, oo markuu arkay ayuu dhinaca kale maray.
english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena nin reer Laawi ah goortuu meeshaas yimid oo arkay, ayuu dhinaca kale maray.
english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

kikuyu: Laakiin nin reer Samaariya ah intuu socday ayuu meeshiisa yimid, oo markuu arkay ayuu u naxariistay.
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

kikuyu: Wuuna u dhowaaday, oo nabrihiisii ka duudduubay, oo saliid iyo khamri ku shubay, markaasuu saaray neefkiisii, oo hudheel geeyey, waana u dadaalay.
english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

kikuyu: Maalintii dambe wuxuu soo bixiyey laba dinaar, oo siiyey ninkii hudheelkii lahaa, oo ku yidhi, U dadaal, oo wixii dambe oo kaaga baxa, soo noqodkayga ayaan kuu celin doonaa.
english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

kikuyu: Saddexdaas kee bay kula tahay inuu deris u ahaa kii tuugagga ku dhex dhacay?
english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Kii u naxariistay. Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Tag oo sidaas oo kale yeel.
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

kikuyu: Intay socdeen wuxuu galay tuulo. Markaasaa qof dumar ah oo Maarta la odhan jiray ayaa gurigeeda gelisay.
english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

kikuyu: Waxayna lahayd walaal Maryan la odhan jiray, oo iyaduna waxay ag fadhiisatay cagihii Sayidka oo ereygiisa maqashay.
english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

kikuyu: Laakiin Maarta waxaa jiidanaysay hawl badan, oo intay u timid ayay ku tidhi, Sayidow, miyaanay waxba kula ahayn in walaashay i daysay inaan keligay adeego? Haddaba la hadal inay ila qabato.
english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Sayidku waa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Maarta, Maartay, wax badan ayaad ka welwelaysaa oo isku dhibaysaa.
english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

kikuyu: Laakiin mid baa loo baahan yahay, Maryanna waxay dooratay intii roonayd oo aan laga qaadi doonin.
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

kikuyu: Meel buu ku tukanayay, oo goortuu dhammeeyey, mid xertiisa ka mid ah ayaa ku yidhi, Sayidow, na bar si loo tukado, sida Yooxanaa xertiisa u baray.
english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Goortaad tukanaysaan dhaha, Aabbahayaga jannada ku jirow, magacaagu quduus ha ahaado, boqortooyadaadu ha timaado.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

kikuyu: Maalinba maalin kibistayada nagu filan na sii.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

kikuyu: Oo naga cafi dembiyadayada, waayo, annaguba waa u cafinnaa mid walba oo aannu qaan ku leennahay, oo jirrabaaddana ha noo kaxayn.
english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Kiinnee baa saaxiib leh oo saqdadhexe u tegaya oo ku odhanaya, Saaxiibow, saddex kibsood i amaahi,
english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

kikuyu: waayo, saaxiibkay ayaa safar iiga yimid, oo waxaan hor dhigo ma hayo.
english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

kikuyu: Kaasaana gudaha ka jawaabaya oo odhanaya, Ha i dhibin. Albaabka waa la xidhay; carruurtayduna sariirtay ila jiiftaa; umana kici karo inaan wax ku siiyo.
english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, In kastoo aanu kici doonin oo aanu siin doonin saaxiibnimadiisa aawadeed, weliba baryo badnaantiisa aawadeed ayuu u kici doonaa oo u siin doonaa in alla intuu u baahan yahay.
english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Weyddiista oo waa laydin siin doonaa; doona oo waad heli doontaan; garaaca oo waa laydinka furi doonaa.
english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

kikuyu: Waayo, mid kasta oo weyddiista waa la siiyaa; kii doonaana waa helaa; kii garaacana waa laga furi doonaa.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

kikuyu: Midkiinnee baa oo aabbe ah haddii wiilkiisu kibis weyddiisto, dhagax siinaya? Ama hadduu kalluun weyddiisto, kalluunka meeshiis abeeso siinaya?
english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

kikuyu: Ama hadduu ukun weyddiisto, dabaqallooc siinaya?
english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
