kikuyu: Haddaba idinka oo shar leh haddaad garanaysaan inaad hadiyado wanaagsan carruurtiinna siisaan, intee ka badan ayaa Aabbihiinna jannada ku jiraa Ruuxa Quduuska ah uu siin doonaa kuwa isaga weyddiista?
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu saarayay jinni carrab la'. Waxaana dhacay goortuu jinnigii baxay inuu kii carrabka la'aa hadlay, dadkiina way yaabeen.
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

kikuyu: Laakiin qaarkood ayaa yidhi, wuxuu jinniyada ku saaraa Be'elsebul oo ah madaxda jinniyada.
english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa kuwa kale oo jirrabaya waxay ka doonayeen inuu calaamo cirka ka tuso.
english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

kikuyu: Laakiin isagoo garanaya fikirradooda ayuu ku yidhi, Boqortooyo walba oo kala qaybsantaa, cidla' bay noqotaa, guri guri ka qaybsamaana waa dumaa.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

kikuyu: Shayddaankuna hadduu kala qaybsamo, boqortooyadiisu sidee bay u taagnaan doontaa? Waayo, waxaad tidhaahdaan, Waxaad jinniyo ku saartaa Be'elsebul.
english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

kikuyu: Anigu haddii aan jinniyada ku saaro Be'elsebul, wiilashiinna yay ku saaraan? Sidaa darteed iyagu waxay ahaanayaan xaakinnadiinna.
english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaan jinniyada ku saaro farta Ilaah, waxaa idiin timid boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

kikuyu: Nin xoog leh oo hubaysan markuu ilaalinayo barxaddiisa, alaabtiisu waa nabad gelaysaa.
english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

kikuyu: Laakiin mid ka xoog badan goortuu ku soo baxo oo ka adkaado, wuxuu ka qaadaa hubkiisii uu isku halleeyey, oo wuu qaybiyaa wuxuu ka dhacay.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

kikuyu: Kan aan ila jirin waa iga gees, oo kan aan ila ururin waa firdhiyaa.
english: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

kikuyu: Jinniga wasakhda leh goortuu ninka ka baxo, wuxuu maraa meelo aan biyo lahayn, isagoo nasasho doonaya, oo markuu heli waayo, wuxuu yidhaahdaa, Waxaan ku noqonayaa gurigaygii aan ka baxay.
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

kikuyu: Oo goortuu yimaado wuxuu helaa isagoo xaaqan oo hagaagsan.
english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

kikuyu: Markaasuu tagaa oo wuxuu wataa toddoba jinni oo kale oo ka xunxun isaga, wayna galaan oo halkaas joogaan. Ninkaas wakhtigiisa dambe ayaa ka darnaada wakhtiga hore.
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay goortuu waxyaalahaas yidhi, in qof dumar ah oo dadka ka mid ah codkeeda kor u qaadday oo ku tidhi, Waxaa barakaysan uurka ku siday iyo naasihii aad nuugtay.
english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtaa, laakiin waxaa barakaysan kuwa ereyga Ilaah maqla oo xajiya.
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

kikuyu: Goortii dadkii badnaa isugu soo ururayeen, wuxuu bilaabay inuu yidhaahdo, Qarniganu waa qarni shareed; calaamo bay doonayaan, lamana siin doono, calaamada Yoonis maahee.
english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida Yoonis calaamo ugu noqday reer Nineweh, sidaas oo kale ayuu Wiilka Aadanahu calaamo ugu ahaan doonaa qarnigan.
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

kikuyu: Boqoradda koonfureed waxay xisaabta la kici doontaa dadka qarnigan, wayna xukumi doontaa, waayo, waxay ka timid meesha dhulka ugu shishaysa inay xigmadda Sulaymaan maqasho, oo bal eeg, mid Sulaymaan ka weyn ayaa halkan jooga.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

kikuyu: Nimanka Nineweh waxay xisaabta isla taagi doonaan dadka qarnigan, wayna xukumi doonaan, waayo, waxay ku toobadkeeneen wacdigii Yoonis, oo bal eeg, mid Yoonis ka weyn ayaa halkan jooga.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

kikuyu: Ma jiro nin, goortuu ilays shido, dhiga meel qarsoon ama weel hoostiisa, laakiin wuxuu saaraa meeshii ilayska si ay kuwa soo galaa iftiinka u arkaan.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

kikuyu: Ilayska jidhkaagu waa ishaada, ishaaduna markay hagaagsan tahay, jidhkaaga oo dhammu waa iftiimaa, laakiin goortay xun tahay, jidhkaaguna waa gudcur.
english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

kikuyu: Haddaba iska jir si iftiinka kugu jiraa aanu gudcur u ahaan.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii jidhkaaga oo dhammu iftiimo, aanuna lahayn meel gudcur ah, waa wada iftiimaa, sida goortii ilayska dhalaalayaa uu kuu iftiimiyo.
english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

kikuyu: Goortuu hadlayay, nin Farrisi ah ayaa weyddiistay inuu wax la cuno; wuuna galay gurigiisa, oo cunto u fadhiistay.
english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

kikuyu: Farrisigii markuu arkay waa yaabay, waayo, cuntada horteed ma uu faraxalan.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

kikuyu: Sayidka ayaa ku yidhi, Haddeer idinkoo Farrisiin ah waxaad dusha ka nadiifisaan koobka iyo xeedhada, laakiin xaggiinna hoose waxaa ka buuxa dulun iyo shar.
english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

kikuyu: Doqonno yahow, kii dusha sameeyey miyaanu gudahana samaynin?
english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

kikuyu: Laakiin waxa gudaha ah sadaqad u bixiya, oo bal eeg, wax walba waa idiin nadiifsan yihiin.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa idiin hoog, Farrisiin yahay, waayo, reexaanta iyo kabsarta iyo khodaarta oo dhan toban meelood ayaad meel ka bixisaan, oo waxaad dhaaftaan xukunka iyo jeclaanta Ilaah. Waxaad lahaydeen inaad waxan samaysaan oo aydnaan kuwa kale dhaafin.
english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, Farrisiin yahay, waayo, waxaad jeceshihiin kursiyada hore oo sunagogyada, iyo salaanta suuqa.
english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, waayo, waxaad tihiin sida xabaalo aan muuqanaynin; nimanka dul marayaana aanay garanaynin.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

kikuyu: Kuwa sharciga yaqaan midkood ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, markaad waxaas leedahay, annagana waad na caayaysaa.
english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Idinkana waa idiin hoog, sharciga sheegayaal yahow, waayo, waxaad nimanka ku rartaan wax culus oo qaadiddoodu dhib leedahay; idinkuse farihiinna middood kuma taabataan culaabta.
english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, waayo, waxaad dhistaan xabaalaha nebiyada, awowayaashiinse way dileen.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaad tihiin markhaatiyaal oo aad oggoshihiin shuqulkii awowayaashiin, waayo, iyagaa dilay, idinkuna waad dhistaan xabaalahooda.
english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed xigmadda Ilaah ayaa tidhi, Waxaan u diri doonaa nebiyo iyo rasuullo; qaarkood waa la dili doonaa oo la silcin doonaa,
english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

kikuyu: in qarnigan la weyddiiyo dhiiggii nebiyada oo dhan oo daatay tan iyo aasaaskii dunida,
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

kikuyu: oo laga bilaabo dhiiggii Haabiil ilaa dhiiggii Sakariyas kii ku dhintay meeshii allabariga iyo meesha quduuska ah dhexdooda. Runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Qarnigan ayaa la weyddiin doonaa.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

kikuyu: Waa idiin hoog, sharciga sheegayaal yahow, waayo, furihii garashada ayaad qaaddeen. Idinka qudhiinnu ma gelin, oo kuwii gelayayna ayaad ka hor joogsateen.
english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

kikuyu: Oo kolkuu meeshaas ka baxay, culimmada iyo Farrisiintu waxay bilaabeen inay aad ugu dhirfaan iyo inay wax badan kaga hadlisiiyaan,
english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

kikuyu: iyagoo gaadaya inay ku qabtaan wixii afkiisa ka soo baxa.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Markii dadkii badnaa oo tirola'aanta ahaa isa soo tubeen, ilaa ay qaarba qaar ku joogjoogsadeen, wuxuu bilaabay inuu kolkii hore xertiisa ku yidhaahdo, Iska jira khamiirka Farrisiinta kan ah labawejiilenimada.
english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Ma jiro wax daboolan oo aan soo muuqan doonin ama wax qarsoon oo aan la garan doonin.
english: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed wax kasta oo aad gudcurka ku dhex tidhaahdeen, iftiinka ayaa laga maqli doonaa, oo wixii aad dhegta iskagala hadasheen qoolal qarsoon ayaa guryaha dushooda lagaga dhawaaqi doonaa.
english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, saaxiibbadayow, Ha ka baqina kuwa jidhka dila, oo aan dabadeed wax kale samayn karin.
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinkaga digayaa kaad ka baqi lahaydeen. Ka baqa kan kolkuu dilo dabadeed amar u leh inuu jahannamada ku tuuro. Runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kaas ka baqa.
english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

kikuyu: Shan shimbirrood miyaan laba beesadood lagu iibin? Oo midna lagama illaawin Ilaah hortiisa.
english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

kikuyu: Laakiin timaha madaxiinna oo dhan waa tirsan yihiin. Ha baqina; waad ka qiima badan tihiin shimbirro badan.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

kikuyu: Weliba waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mid walba oo igu qirta dadka hortiisa, ayaa Wiilka Aadanahu ku qiran doonaa malaa'igaha Ilaah hortooda.
english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

kikuyu: Laakiin kii igu diida dadka hortiisa, malaa'igaha Ilaah hortooda ayaa lagu diidi doonaa,
english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

kikuyu: oo mid walba oo ku hadla hadal Wiilka Aadanaha ka gees ah, waa loo cafiyi doonaa, laakiin kii caaya Ruuxa Quduuska ah looma cafiyi doono.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

kikuyu: Goortay idin hor keenayaan sunagogyada, iyo taliyayaasha, iyo kuwa amarka leh, ha ka welwelina sidii iyo wixii aad ku jawaabi doontaan ama waxaad odhan doontaan,
english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

kikuyu: waayo, Ruuxa Quduuska ah ayaa saacaddaas idin bari doonaa wixii aad leedihiin inaad tidhaahdaan.
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

kikuyu: Oo mid dadka ka mid ah ayaa ku yidhi, Macallimow, walaalkay u sheeg inuu dhaxalka ila qaybsado.
english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Ninkow, yaa iiga kiin dhigay xukume ama qaybiye?
english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Fiiriya oo iska ilaaliya damacnimada oo dhan, waayo, qof goortuu maal badnaado, noloshiisu kama timaado maalkuu leeyahay.
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu masaal kula hadlay oo ku yidhi, Nin hodan ah dhulkiisa ayaa wax badan bixiyey.
english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu isla tashaday isagoo leh, Maxaan sameeyaa, waayo, ma haysto meel aan ku ururiyo wixii ii baxay?
english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Sidan ayaan samayn doonaa. Maqsinnadaydii ayaan dumin doonaa oo kuwa ka waaweyn ayaan dhisan doonaa; halkaasna ayaan ku urursan doonaa sarreenkayga iyo alaabtayda oo dhan,
english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

kikuyu: oo waxaan naftayda ku odhan doonaa, Nafay, waxaad leedahay alaab badan oo sannado badan loo dhigay. Naso oo wax cun oo cab oo farax.
english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah wuxuu ku yidhi, Kaaga doqonka ahow, caawa naftaada waa lagu weyddiisan doonaa, wixii aad diyaarsatayna yaa lahaan doonaa?
english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale weeye kan maal urursada oo aan Ilaah u hodan ahayn.
english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu xertiisii ku yidhi, Sidaa darteed waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ha ugu welwelina naftiinna waxaad cuni doontaan, jidhkiinnana waxaad huwin doontaan.
english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

kikuyu: Waayo, naftu waa ka roon tahay cuntada, jidhkuna waa ka roon yahay dharka.
english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

kikuyu: Tukayaasha fiiriya, waayo, waxba ma beeraan, waxna ma gurtaan, mana haystaan maqsin ama meel ay wax ku urursadaan, oo Ilaah baa cunto siiya. Intee baad ka roon tihiin shimbirraha!
english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

kikuyu: Midkiinee intuu welwelo, dhererkiisa dhudhun ku dari kara?
english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii aanad samayn karin xataa waxa u yar, maxaad ugu welweshaan intii kale?
english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

kikuyu: Fiiriya ubaxyada, siday u baxaan, ma ay shaqeeyaan, ma ayna miiqdaan. Weliba waxaan idinku leeyahay, Xataa Sulaymaan wakhtiga ammaantiisii oo dhan dhar uma uu gashan jirin sida kuwan midkood.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii Ilaah sidaa u huwiyo cawska maanta duurka ku yaal oo berrito moofada lagu ridayo, sidee ka badan ayuu idiin huwinayaa, rumaysad yarayaalow?
english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

kikuyu: Ha doondoonina waxaad cuntaan iyo waxaad cabtaan, oo ha shakiyina,
english: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

kikuyu: waayo, quruumaha dunidu waxaas oo dhan ayay doondoonaan; laakiin Aabbihiin waa og yahay inaad waxaas u baahan tihiin.
english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

kikuyu: Laakiin doondoona boqortooyadiisa, oo waxaas oo dhan waa laydiinku dari doonaa.
english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

kikuyu: Ha baqina, idoyahow yari, waayo, Aabbihiin waxaa ka farxiya inuu boqortooyada idin siiyo.
english: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

kikuyu: Iibiya waxaad leedihiin oo sadaqo bixiya. Samaysta kiishash aan duugoobaynin, oo maal aan dhammaanaynin ku urursada jannada, meesha aan tuug ku soo dhowaan oo aan aboor ku baabbi'in.
english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

kikuyu: Waayo, meesha maalkiinnu ku jiro, meeshaasaa qalbigiinnuna ku jiri doonaa.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

kikuyu: Dhexdiinnu ha xidhnaato, laambadihiinnuna ha baxaan.
english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

kikuyu: Idinkuna ahaada sida niman sayidkooda sugaya, goortuu arooska ka soo noqdo, inay markiiba ka furaan markuu yimaado oo garaaco.
english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan addoommadaas, kuwa sayidku goortuu yimaado, uu helo iyagoo soo jeeda. Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Isagu waa guntan doonaa, oo cunto ayuu u fadhiisan doonaa, oo intuu iyaga u dhowaado ayuu u adeegi doonaa.
english: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

kikuyu: Hadduu yimaado wakhtigii gaadhka labaad ama kan saddexaad oo uu helo iyagoo sidaas ah, kuwaas ayaa barakaysan.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

kikuyu: Laakiin tan ogaada, odayga reerku hadduu ogaan lahaa saacadda tuuggu imanayo, wuu soo jeedi lahaa, oo uma uu daayeen in gurigiisa la jebiyo.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

kikuyu: Idinkuna diyaar ahaada, waayo, saacad aydnaan u malaynaynin ayaa Wiilka Aadanahu imanayaa.
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

kikuyu: Butros ayaa ku yidhi, Sayidow, ma annaga ayaad masaalkan nagula hadlaysaa ama dadka oo dhan?
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

kikuyu: Sayidkuna wuxuu yidhi, Haddaba yuu yahay wakiilka aaminka ah oo caqliga leh, kan uu sayidkiisu u sarraysiin doona dadka gurigiisa, inuu qaybtooda oo cuntada ah siiyo wakhtigeeda?
english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan addoonkaas kan sayidkiisu goortuu yimaado uu helayo isagoo sidaas samaynaya.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay. Wuxuu leeyahay oo dhan ayuu ka sarraysiin doonaa isaga.
english: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii addoonkaas qalbigiisa ka yidhaahdo, Sayidkayga imaatinkiisii waa raagay, oo uu bilaabo inuu garaaco midiidinyada ragga iyo dumarka ahaa, iyo inuu wax cuno oo wax cabbo oo sakhraamo,
english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

kikuyu: addoonkaas sayidkiisu wuxuu iman doonaa maalin aanu filayn oo saacad aanu ogayn, oo waa kala jeexi doonaa, oo wuxuu ka dhigi doonaa mid qayb la hela kuwa aan aaminka ahayn.
english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

kikuyu: Addoonkaas ogaa doonista sayidkiisa, oo aan diyaargarayn, oo aan yeelin sidii doonistiisu ahayd, wax badan waa la garaaci doonaa.
english: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

kikuyu: Laakiin kii aan ogayn oo yeelayse wixii garaacid istaahila, wax yar baa la garaaci doonaa. Mid kasta oo wax badan la siiyey, wax badan ayaa laga dooni doonaa, oo kan wax badan loo sii dhiibtay, wax ka badan ayaa la weyddiisan doonaa.
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

kikuyu: Waxaan u imid inaan dab dhulka ku tuuro, oo maxaan doonayaa hadduu durba shidan yahay?
english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan leeyahay baabtiis in laygu baabtiisayo oo sidee lay cidhiidhiyey ilaa uu dhammaado!
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

kikuyu: Miyaad u malaynaysaan inaan u imid inaan nabad dhulka siiyo? Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Maya, laakiinse kalasoocid.
english: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

kikuyu: Waayo, intii haddeer ka dambaysa waxaa guri ku jiri doona shan kala soocan, saddex laba ka gees ah iyo laba saddex ka gees ah.
english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

kikuyu: Waa kala soocmayaan, aabbe wiil ka gees ah iyo wiil aabbe ka gees ah, hooyo gabadh ka gees ah iyo gabadh hooyadeed ka gees ah, soddoh afadii wiilkeeda ka gees ah iyo afadii wiilkii soddohdeed ka gees ah.
english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

kikuyu: Weliba wuxuu dadkii badnaa ku yidhi, Goortaad aragtaan daruur gabbaldhac ka soo baxaysa, kolkiiba waxaad tidhaahdaan, Roob baa soo socda, oo sidaasuu noqdaa.
english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

kikuyu: Oo goortaad aragtaan dabayl koonfureed oo dhacaysa waxaad tidhaahdaan, Kulaylku waa iman doonaa, waana noqda.
english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

kikuyu: Labawejiilayaal yahow, waxaad kala garanaysaan muuqashada dhulka iyo cirka, laakiin wakhtigan sidee baad u kala garan weydaan?
english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

kikuyu: Maxaad qudhiinnu waxa xaqa ah u xukumi weydaan?
english: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

kikuyu: Goortaad cadowgaaga u raacdo xaakinka, intaad jidka maraysaan ku dadaal si aad uga baxsato, inaanu xaakinka kuu jiidin, xaakinkuna askariga kuu dhiibin, askariguna xabsiga kugu tuurin.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

kikuyu: Waxaan kugu leeyahay, Halkaas ka soo bixi maysid ilaa aad siisid lacagta u yar oo ugu dambaysa.
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas qudhiisa waxaa joogay qaar wax uga sheegay dadka reer Galili oo Bilaatos dhiiggooda ku daray allabarigooda.
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma waxay idinla tahay in kuwii reer Galili ahaa ay ka dembi badnaayeen kuwii kale oo reer Galili oo dhan waxyaalahaas ay ku silceen aawadood?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Maya, laakiin haddaanad toobadkeenin, kulligiin sidaas oo kale ayaad u lumi doontaan.
english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

kikuyu: Ama siddeed iyo tobankii oo munaaradda Siloo'am ay ku soo dhacday oo ay dishay, ma waxay idinla tahay, inay ka gef badnaayeen dadka Yeruusaalem joogay oo dhan?
english: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Maya, laakiin haddaydnan toobadkeenin, kulligiin sidaas oo kale ayaad u lumi doontaan.
english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu masaalkan ku hadlay, Nin baa wuxuu lahaa geed berde ah oo beertiisii canabka ahayd lagu beeray. Waa u yimid isagoo midho ka doonaya, waxbana kama uu helin.
english: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

kikuyu: Wuxuu beer-ka-shaqeeyihii ku yidhi, Bal eeg, saddex sannadood ayaan imanayay oo berdahan midho ka doonayay, kamana helin. Jar, muxuu dhulka u khasaarinayaa?
english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, sannaddanna daa ilaa aan hareerihiisa qodqodo oo aan digeeyo.
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

kikuyu: Dabadeed hadduu midhaysto, wanaag; haddii kalese waad jari doontaa.
english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

kikuyu: Maalin sabti ah sunagogyada midkood ayuu wax ku barayay.
english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa joogtay naag siddeed iyo toban sannadood cudur qabtay, wayna isku soo jabnayd, mana ay kari karin inay istoosiso.
english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu arkay, ayuu u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Haweentoy, cudurkaaga waad ka furan tahay.
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu gacmihiisa saaray, oo kolkiiba way toosnaatay, oo Ilaah bay ammaantay.
english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

kikuyu: Kii sunagogga u sarreeyey ayaa cadho ku jawaabay, waayo, Ciise maalintii sabtida ahayd ayuu wax bogsiiyey, wuxuuna dadkii badnaa ku yidhi, Waxaa jira lix maalmood oo dadkii leeyihiin inay shaqeeyaan. Maalmahaas haddaba kaalaya, ha laydin bogsiiye, ee ha imanina maalinta sabtida ah.
english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

kikuyu: Laakiin Sayidka ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Labawejiilayaal yahow, mid kasta oo idinka mid ah miyaanu sabtida dibigiisa ama dameerkiisa ka soo furin golaha oo u wadin inuu soo waraabiyo?
english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

kikuyu: Oo naagtan oo ina Ibraahim ah oo Shayddaanku siddeed iyo toban sannadood xidhay, miyaanay lahayn in maalinta sabtida ah laga fura xidhmaddaas?
english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Goortuu waxaas yidhi cadaawayaashiisii oo dhan way wada ceeboobeen, dadkii oo dhanna ayaa ku reyreeyey wax walba oo ammaanta lahaa oo uu falay.
english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

kikuyu: Haddaba wuxuu yidhi, Boqortooyada Ilaah maxay u eg tahay oo maxaan u ekaysiiyaa?
english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

kikuyu: Waxay u eg tahay iniin khardal ah, oo nin qaaday oo beertiisii ku riday, oo ay baxday oo geed dheer noqotay, shimbirraha cirkuna laamaheeday ku degeen.
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

kikuyu: Haddana wuxuu yidhi, Maxaan boqortooyada Ilaah u ekaysiiyaa?
english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

kikuyu: Waxay u eg tahay khamiir naag intay qaadday ay saddex qiyaasood oo bur ah ku dhex qooshtay ilaa ay wada khamiireen.
english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dhex marayay magaalooyin iyo tuulooyin isagoo wax baraya, Yeruusaalemna ayuu ku socday.
english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Mid baa wuxuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, ma yar yihiin kuwa badbaadayaa?
english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Aad u dadaala inaad iridda cidhiidhsan ka gashaan, waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Qaar badan ayaa dooni doona inay galaan, mana kari doonaan.
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

kikuyu: Goortii ninkii guriga lahaa kaco oo albaabka xidho, oo aad bilowdaan inaad dibadda istaagtaan oo aad albaabka garaacdaan, idinkoo leh, Sayidow, naga fur; isaguna waa u jawaabi doonaa oo idinku odhan doonaa, Garan maayo meeshaad ka timaadeen.
english: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

kikuyu: Markaasaad bilaabi doontaan inaad tidhaahdaan, Hortaada ayaannu wax ku cuni jirnay oo ku cabbi jirnay, oo jidadkayaga ayaad wax ku bari jirtay.
english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu odhan doonaa, Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Garan maayo meeshaad ka timaadeen; iga taga kulligiin oo xaqdarrada ka shaqeeya.
english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

kikuyu: Halkaa waxaa jiri doonta baroor iyo ilko jirriqsi goortaad boqortooyada Ilaah ku aragtaan Ibraahim iyo Isxaaq iyo Yacquub iyo nebiyada oo dhan, oo idinkana dibadda laydiin tuuray.
english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

kikuyu: Waxay ka iman doonaan bari iyo galbeed iyo woqooyi iyo koonfur, waxayna dhex fadhiisan doonaan boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Ogaada, kuwa ugu dambeeya ayaa ugu horrayn doona, kuwa ugu horreeyaana way ugu dambayn doonaan.
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

kikuyu: Markaas qudhiisa ayaa waxaa yimid qaar Farrisiin ah iyagoo ku leh, Bax oo ka tag meeshan, waayo, Herodos ayaa doonaya inuu ku dilo.
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Idinku u taga oo dawacaas u sheega, Bal eeg, maanta iyo berriba ayaan jinniyo saarayaa oo dad bogsiinayaa, maalinta saddexaadna ayaan kaamilmayaa.
english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa inaan socdo maanta iyo berri iyo maalinta ku xigtaba, waayo, ma noqon karto nebi inuu ku dhinto Yeruusaalem dibaddeeda.
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

kikuyu: Yeruusaalemay, Yeruusaalemay, tan nebiyada dishoy, oo kuwa loo soo diray dhagxisoy! Intee baan marar badan jeclaaday inaan carruurtaada u soo ururiyo xataa sida dooradu carruurteeda baalasheeda hoostooda ugu ururiso, laakiin idinku ma aydnaan jeclayn.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

kikuyu: Ogaada, gurigiinnii waa laydiin daayay, isagoo cidla ah. Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ima arki doontaan ilaa aad tidhaahdaan, Waxaa barakaysan kan Rabbiga magiciisa ku imanaya.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

kikuyu: Maalin sabti ah markuu galay mid ka mid ah kuwa Farrisiinta u sarreeya gurigiisa inuu kibis cuno, waxaa dhacay inay fiirinayeen.
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa hortiisa joogay nin uurweynaad qaba.
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo kuwii sharciga yiqiin iyo Farrisiintii ku yidhi, isagoo leh, Ma xalaal baa in sabtida wax la bogsiiyo, mise maya?
english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

kikuyu: Laakiin way aamuseen. Isaguse, intuu ninkii qabtay, ayuu bogsiiyey, markaasuu sii daayay.
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

kikuyu: Wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Kiinnee baa leh dameer ama dibi ceel ku dhacay oo aan maalin sabti ah dhaqso uga soo bixinaynin?
english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Wayna uga jawaabi kari waayeen waxyaalahaas.
english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

kikuyu: Goortuu arkay kuwii loo yeedhay siday kursiyada hore u doorteen, ayuu masaal kula hadlay oo ku yidhi,
english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

kikuyu: Markii nin kuugu yeedho aroos, kursiga hore ha fadhiisan, waaba intaasoo isagu nin kaa murwad weyn ugu yeedho,
english: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

kikuyu: oo kii isaga iyo adiga idiin yeedhay uu yimaado oo kugu yidhaahdo, Kan meel sii, oo markaasaad bilaabaysaa inaad meesha dambe ceeb ku fadhiisato.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortii laguu yeedho, tag oo meesha u hoosaysa fadhiiso, si kii kuu yeedhay kolkuu yimaado uu kuugu yidhaahdo, Saaxiibow, sare u soco. Markaasaad ammaan ku lahaan doontaa kuwa cuntada kula fadhiya oo dhan hortooda.
english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

kikuyu: Waayo, mid kasta oo isa sarraysiiya waa la hoosaysiin doonaa; oo kii is-hoosaysiiyana waa la sarraysiin doonaa.
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi kii u yeedhay, Goortaad qado ama casho samayso, ha u yeedhin saaxiibbadaada ama walaalahaa ama xigaalkaa ama derisyadaada hodanka ah, waaba intaasoo iyaguna ay markooda kuu yeedhaan, oo ay abaalgud kugu noqotaa.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortaad diyaafad samayso waxaad u yeedhaa masaakiinta iyo kuwa laxaadka la' iyo curyaannada iyo indhoolayaasha,
english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

kikuyu: oo aad barakaysnaan doontaa, waayo, iyagu maleh waxa ay kuugu abaalgudaan, laakiin waxaa laguu abaalgudi doonaa wakhtiga sarakicidda kuwa xaqa ah.
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

kikuyu: Kuwa cuntada ula fadhiyey midkood, goortuu waxaas maqlay, wuxuu isaga ku yidhi, Waxaa barakaysan kan kibis ku cuni doona boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

kikuyu: Wuxuuse ku yidhi, Nin baa casho weyn sameeyey, oo dad badan u yeedhay,
english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

kikuyu: oo saacaddii cashada ayuu addoonkiisii u diray inuu kuwii loo yeedhay ku yidhaahdo, Kaalaya, waayo, haatan wax waluba waa diyaar.
english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

kikuyu: Markaasay kulligood waxay bilaabeen inay fikir keliya ku marmarsiiyoodaan. Kii u horreeyey ayaa ku yidhi, Beer baan iibsaday, oo waa inaan tago oo aan soo arko. Waxaan kaa baryayaa inaad iga raalli ahaato.
english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

kikuyu: Mid kale ayaa yidhi, Waxaan iibsaday shan qindi oo dibi ah, oo waan tegayaa inaan imtixaamo. Waxaan kaa baryayaa inaad iga raalli ahaato.
english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

kikuyu: Mid kale ayaa yidhi, Naag baan guursaday, sidaa darteed ma iman karo.
english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa addoonkii yimid, oo waxaas ayuu sayidkiisii u sheegay. Kolkaasaa sayidkii gurigu cadhooday, oo wuxuu addoonkiisii ku yidhi, Dhaqso jidadka iyo surimmada magaalada u bax oo soo kaxee masaakiinta iyo kuwa laxaadka la' iyo indhoolayaasha iyo curyaannada.
english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa addoonkii ku yidhi, Sayidow, waxaad amartay waa la yeelay, oo weli meel baa bannaan.
english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa sayidkii wuxuu addoonkii ku yidhi, Jidadka iyo wadiiqooyinka oodaha u bax, oo dadka ku qasab inay soo galaan, si uu gurigaygu u buuxsamo.
english: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nimankaas loo yeedhay midkoodna cashadayda dhadhamin maayo.
english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”

kikuyu: Waxaa isaga la socday dad badan. Markaasuu u jeestay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

kikuyu: Haddii qof ii yimaado oo aanu nicin aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis iyo afadiisa iyo carruurtiisa iyo walaalihiis, xataa naftiisana xer iima ahaan karo.
english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii aan iskutallaabtiisa soo qaadan oo aan iga daba iman, xer iima ahaan karo.
english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: Waayo, midkiinnee doonaya inuu noobiyad dhiso oo aan kolkii hore fadhiisan inuu xisaabo intay ku kacayso, inuu ogaado inuu haysto wax uu ku dhammeeyo iyo in kale?
english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

kikuyu: Waaba intaasoo markuu aasaaska dhigo oo uu dhammayn kari waayo, kuwa eegaya oo dhammu ay bilaabaan inay ku qoslaan,
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

kikuyu: iyagoo leh, Ninkanu wuxuu bilaabay inuu wax dhiso, waana dhammayn kari waayay.
english: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

kikuyu: Ama boqorkee u tegaya inuu boqor kale dagaal u baxo, isagoo aan kolkii hore fadhiisan oo tashan inuu toban kun kala hor tegi karo kan labaatan kun ula imanaya?
english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

kikuyu: Ama haddii kale intuu kan kale weli fog yahay, ayuu ergo soo diraa oo uu weyddiistaa wax lagu heshiiyo.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed midkiin walba oo aan ka tegin wuxuu leeyahay oo dhan, xer iima ahaan karo.
english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: Haddaba cusbadu waa wanaagsan tahay, laakiin haddii cusbadu dhadhan beesho, maxaa lagu cusbaynayaa?
english: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

kikuyu: Uma ay wanaagsana dhulka ama meeshii digada, waase la tuuraa. Kan dhego wax lagu maqlo lahu, ha maqlo.
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Waxaa Ciise u soo dhowaanayay cashuurqaadayaasha iyo dembilayaasha oo dhan inay maqlaan.
english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay Farrisiintii iyo culimmadiiba gunuunaceen, iyagoo leh, Ninkanu dembilayaashuu soo dhoweeyaa oo wax la cunaa.
english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu masaalkan kula hadlay, oo ku yidhi,
english: He told them this parable:

kikuyu: Ninkiinnee baa tiro ido ah leh, oo middood ka hallowday, aan sagaal iyo sagaashanka cidlada kaga tegin, oo aan tii hallowday ka daba tegin, ilaa uu soo helo?
english: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

kikuyu: Oo goortuu soo helo, aan garbihiisa saarin, isagoo faraxsan.
english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

kikuyu: Oo goortuu guriga yimaado, aan isugu yeedhin saaxiibbadiisa iyo derisyadiisa, isagoo ku leh, Ila farxa, waayo, waxaan helay laxdaydii iga hallowday?
english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Sidaas oo kale, farxad ayaa jannada kaga jiri doonta dembile toobadkeena in ka badan sagaal iyo sagaashan xaq ah oo aan toobadkeen u baahnayn.
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

kikuyu: Ama naagtee baa toban daraakmo oo lacag ah leh, oo hadday daraakmo lumiso, aan laambad shidin, oo aan guriga xaaqin, oo aan dadaal ku doonin ilaa ay hesho?
english: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

kikuyu: Oo markay hesho, aan saaxiibbadeeda iyo derisyadeeda isugu yeedhin iyadoo ku leh, Ila farxa, waayo, waxaan helay daraakmadii iga luntay.
english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Sidaas oo kale markii mid dembi leh toobadkeenoba, farxad ayaa kaga jirta malaa'igaha Ilaah hortooda.
english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna yidhi, Nin baa laba wiil lahaa.
english: He said, “A certain man had two sons.

kikuyu: Kii yaraa ayaa aabbihii ku yidhi, Aabbow, waxaaga qaybtii aan heli lahaa i sii. Markaasuu iyaga u qaybiyey wuxuu ku noolaa.
english: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

kikuyu: Maalmo aan badnayn dabadeed wiilkii yaraa waa wada urursaday wax walbaba, oo dhul fog ayuu u safray, halkaas ayuuna wixiisii ku khasaariyey, isagoo iska tumaya.
english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

kikuyu: Goortuu wada bixiyey dabadeed ayaa abaar daran dhulkaas ka dhacday, wuuna bilaabay inuu baahdo.
english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

kikuyu: Goortaasuu tegey oo isku daray nin dadka dhulkaas ah, kan u diray beerihiisa inuu doofaarro daajiyo.
english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

kikuyu: Wuxuu damcay inuu calooshiisa ka buuxiyo buunshihii doofaarradu ay cunayeen, ninnana waxba ma uu siin.
english: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

kikuyu: Goortuu isgartay ayuu yidhi, Intee baa kuwa aabbahay kiraystay haysata kibis ka badan in ku filan, aniguna macaluul baan halkan ugu bakhtiyayaa.
english: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

kikuyu: Waan kici oo aan aabbahay u tegi, oo waxaan ku odhan, Aabbow, waxaan ku dembaabay jannada iyo hortaadaba.
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

kikuyu: Kol dambe ma istaahilo in laygu yeedho wiilkaaga, ee iga dhig sida kuwa aad kiraysatay midkood oo kale.
english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’

kikuyu: Markaasuu kacay, oo wuxuu u yimid aabbihii, laakiin intuu weli ka fogaa ayaa aabbihiis arkay, waana u naxariistay, oo ku soo orday oo qoortuu iskaga duubay, oo dhunkaday.
english: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

kikuyu: Markaasaa wiilkii ku yidhi, Aabbow, waxaan ku dembaabay jannada iyo hortaadaba; kol dambe ma istaahilo in laygu yeedho wiilkaaga.
english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

kikuyu: Laakiin aabbihii ayaa addoommadiisii ku yidhi, Dhaqso u soo bixiya khamiiska ugu wanaagsan oo u geliya, kaatunna gacanta u geliya, kabona cagaha u geliya.
english: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

kikuyu: Dibigii yaraa ee la shishleeyey keena oo gowraca, aynu cunno oo faraxno,
english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

kikuyu: waayo, wiilkaygan wuu dhintay, wuuna soo noolaaday; wuu lumay, waana la helay. Markaasay bilaabeen inay farxaan.
english: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

kikuyu: Laakiin wiilkiisii weynaa beerta buu ku jiray, oo intuu soo socday oo guriga u soo dhowaanayay, wuxuu maqlay muusika iyo cayaar.
english: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

kikuyu: Markaasuu midiidinyada midkood u yeedhay oo weyddiiyey, Waa maxay waxaas?
english: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Walaalkaa ayaa yimid, aabbahaana dibigii yaraa ee la shishleeyey ayuu u gowracay, waayo, ladnaan buu ku helay.
english: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu cadhooday, oo inuu galo ma doonayn, markaasaa aabbihiis soo baxay oo baryay.
english: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu u jawaabay, oo wuxuu aabbihiis ku yidhi, Bal eeg, intaas oo sannadood ayaan kuu shaqaynayay, oo weligay amarkaaga kama aan xadgudbin, oo weligaa waxar iima aad siin inaan saaxiibbadayda la farxo,
english: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortii uu yimid wiilkaagani waxaagii aad ku noolayd dhillooyin la cunay, waxaad u gowracday dibigii yaraa ee la shishleeyey.
english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Wiilkaygiiyow, weligaa waad ila joogtaa, oo waxayga oo dhan adigaa leh,
english: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

kikuyu: laakiin waxaa inoo wanaagsanayd inaynu rayrayno oo faraxno, waayo, waalaalkaagani waa dhintay, wuuna soo noolaaday; wuu lumay, waana la helay.
english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

kikuyu: Haddana wuxuu xertii ku yidhi, Waxaa jiri jiray nin hodan ah oo wakiil lahaa, kan loogu ashtakeeyey inuu alaabtiisa khasaarinayay.
english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

kikuyu: Markaasuu u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Waa maxay waxan kugu saabsan ee aan maqlayo? I sii xisaabtii wakiilnimadaada, waayo, hadda ka dib wakiil sii ahaan kari maysid.
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa wakiilkii isku yidhi, Maxaan sameeyaa, waayo, sayidkayga ayaa wakiilnimadii iga qaadaya? Itaal aan wax ku qodo ma lihi, inaan dawarsadona waan ka xishoonayaa.
english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

kikuyu: Waan garanayaa waxaan samaynayo, in goortii wakiilnimada layga saaro ay dadku guryahooda iigu dhowayn doonaan.
english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu u yeedhay mid walba oo sayidkiisu dayn ku lahaa. Kii hore ayuu ku yidhi, Sayidkaygu immisuu kugu leeyahay?
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

kikuyu: Wuxuu yidhi, Boqol qiyaasood oo saliid ah. Markaasuu ku yidhi, Wixii laguu qoray soo qaad, oo dhaqso u fadhiiso oo qor, Konton.
english: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu mid kale ku yidhi, Immisuu kugu leeyahay? Isaguna wuxuu yidhi, Boqol qiyaasood oo sarreen ah. Markaasuu ku yidhi. Wixii laguu qoray soo qaad, oo qor, Siddeetan.
english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

kikuyu: Sayidkiisii ayaa wakiilkii xaqa darnaa faaniyey, waayo, si caqli leh ayuu u sameeyey, waayo, wiilashii wakhtigan waxay wiilasha iftiinka kaga caqli badan yihiin waxa qarnigooda ku saabsan.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan idinku leeyahay, Saaxiibbo ku samaysta maalka xaqdarrada in goortuu dhammaado ay idiinku dhoweeyaan degmooyinka weligood ah.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

kikuyu: Kan waxa u yar aamin ku ah, ayaa weliba wax badan aamin ku ah. Kan waxa u yar ku xaqdaran, ayaa waxa badanna ku xaqdaran.
english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

kikuyu: Haddii aydnaan maalka xaqdaran aamin ku ahayn, waxa run ah yaa idinku aaminaya?
english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

kikuyu: Haddii aydnaan wixii qof kale leeyahay aamin ku ahayn, yaa idin siinaya wixiinna?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

kikuyu: Midiidinna laba sayid uma shaqayn karo, waayo, mid buu nacayaa, kan kalena wuu jeclaanayaa, ama mid buu la jirayaa, kan kalena wuu quudhsanayaa. Uma wada shaqayn kartaan Ilaah iyo maal.
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

kikuyu: Farrisiintii lacagta jeclayd ayaa waxaas oo dhan maqashay, wayna ku qosleen.
english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinku waxaad tihiin kuwa dadka hortooda isku soo caddeeya inaad xaq tihiin, laakiin Ilaah waa garanayaa qalbiyadiinna, waayo, wixii dadka dhexdooda lagu sarraysiiyaa, Ilaah hortiisa waa ka karaahiyo.
english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Sharciga iyo nebiyadu waxay jireen ilaa Yooxanaa; tan iyo wakhtigaas injiilka boqortooyada Ilaah waa lagu wacdiyey, oo mid walbaba xoog buu ku galaa.
english: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

kikuyu: Laakiin in sharciga dhibic keliya ka dhacdo waxaa ka hawl yar in cirka iyo dhulku ay idlaadaan.
english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

kikuyu: Mid walba oo naagtiisa fura oo mid kale guursadaa wuu sinaystaa, oo kii guursadaa mid nin laga furay wuu sinaystaa.
english: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

kikuyu: Waxaa jiri jiray nin hodan ah oo dhar gududan oo jilicsan sidan jiray, maalin walbana barwaaqo aad buu ugu farxi jiray.
english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa albaabkiisa la dhigi jiray miskiin Laasaros la odhan jiray, isagoo boogo miidhan leh,
english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

kikuyu: oo doonaya in la siiyo jajabkii miiska ninkii hodanka ahaa ka dhacay. Eeyduna way iman jireen oo boogihiisa leefleefi jireen.
english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay inuu miskiinkii dhintay, oo malaa'igahu waxay u qaadeen laabtii Ibraahim. Ninkii hodanka ahaana waa dhintay, waana la aasay.
english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

kikuyu: Intuu Haadees ku jiray ayuu indhihiisa kor u qaaday isagoo aad u silcaya; wuxuuna meel fog ka arkay Ibraahim, iyo Laasaros oo laabtiisa ku tiirsan.
english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

kikuyu: Markaasuu qayliyey oo yidhi, Aabbe Ibraahimow, ii naxariiso, oo Laasaros ii soo dir inuu fartiisa caaraddeeda biyo ku tiinbiyo oo carrabkayga ku qabowjiyo, waayo, anigu ololkan ayaan ku silcayaa.
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

kikuyu: Laakiin Ibraahim wuxuu ku yidhi, Wiil yahow, xusuuso inaad waxaagii wanaagsanaa heshay intii aad noolayd, si la mid ah ayuu Laasaros waxa xun helay, laakiin haddeer isaga halkan ayaa lagu raaxaysiiyey, adiguse waad silcaysaa.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

kikuyu: Weliba annaga iyo idinka waxaa layna dhex dhigay bohol aad u weyn, si kuwa doonaya inay halkan ka sii tallaabaan inay idiin yimaadaan aanay u karin, oo kuwa xaggaasna ayna noogu soo tallaabin.
english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Aabbow, waxaan kaa baryayaa haddaba inaad guriga aabbahay isaga u dirtid,
english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

kikuyu: waayo, shan walaalo ah baan leeyahay, si uu ugu warramo inaanay iyaguna meeshan silaca leh iman.
english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

kikuyu: Laakiin Ibraahim wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxay leeyihiin Muuse iyo nebiyada ee ha maqleen.
english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Maya, Aabbe Ibraahimow, laakiin haddii qof kuwii dhintay uga tago, way toobadkeeni doonaan.
english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

kikuyu: Wuxuuse ku yidhi, Haddii ay maqli waayaan Muuse iyo nebiyada, in kastoo qof kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kaco, la oggolaysiin kari maayo inay rumaystaan.
english: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

kikuyu: Wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi, Ma suurtowdo inaan xumaantu iman, laakiin waa u hoog kan ay xumaantu ka timaado.
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

kikuyu: In qof yaryarkan midkood xumeeyo, waxaa uga roon in dhagaxshiid luqunta looga lalmiyo oo badda lagu tuuro.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

kikuyu: Iska dhawra. Walaalkaa hadduu dembaabo, canaano; hadduuna toobadkeeno, cafi.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

kikuyu: Hadduu toddoba goor maalintii kugu dembaabo, oo toddoba goor kuu soo jeesto, isagoo leh, Waa toobadkeenay, waa inaad cafido.
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

kikuyu: Markaasay rasuulladii waxay Rabbiga ku yidhaahdeen, Rumaysad noo kordhi.
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

kikuyu: Rabbiguna wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaad leedihiin rumaysad iniin khardal le'eg, waxaad ku odhan lahaydeen geedkan sukamin, Ruq, oo badda ku beeran, wuuna idin addeeci lahaa.
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

kikuyu: Laakiin kiinnee baa leh addoon dhulka jaraya ama adhi jiraya, oo ku odhan doona goortuu beerta ka yimaado, Dhaqso u kaalay oo cunto u fadhiiso?
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

kikuyu: Laakiin miyaanu ku odhan doonin, Diyaari waxaan ku casheeyo, oo gunto, oo ii adeeg intaan wax cunayo oo cabbayo, kolkaa dabadeed ayaad wax cuni oo cabbi?
english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

kikuyu: Miyuu addoonkii u mahadnaqayaa, waayo, wuxuu sameeyey wixii la amray?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale idinkuna goortaad samaysaan wixii laydinku amray oo dhan, waxaad tidhaahdaan, Addoommo aan waxtar lahayn baannu nahay; wixii aannu lahayn inaannu samayno ayaannu samaynay.
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay intay Yeruusaalem ku sii socdeen inuu Samaariya iyo Galili dhex marayay.
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

kikuyu: Oo goortuu tuulo galay, waxaa la kulmay toban nin oo baras leh oo meel fog ka istaagay.
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

kikuyu: Markaasay codka kor u qaadeen iyagoo leh, Ciisow, Macallimow, noo naxariiso.
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

kikuyu: Goortuu arkay, wuxuu ku yidhi, Taga oo istusa wadaaddada. Oo waxaa dhacay, intay sii socdeen, inay daahirsameen.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

kikuyu: Midkood goortuu arkay inuu bogsaday, ayuu soo jeestay oo cod weyn Ilaah ku ammaanay.
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

kikuyu: Oo wejigiisa ayuu cagihiisa ag dhigay oo u mahadnaqay. Wuxuuna ahaa reer Samaariya.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

kikuyu: Ciisena waa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Tobankii miyaanay daahirsamin? Laakiin meeye sagaalkii?
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

kikuyu: Miyaan la arag kuwa u soo noqday inay Ilaah ammaanaan, shisheeyahan maahee?
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Kac oo soco. Rumaysadkaaga ayaa ku bogsiiyey.
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

kikuyu: Farrisiintii goortay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Goormay boqortooyada Ilaah imanaysaa? wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Boqortooyada Ilaah dhawrid ku iman mayso.
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

kikuyu: Lamana odhan doono, Waa tan! ama, Waa taas! waayo, bal eega, boqortooyada Ilaah waa idinku dhex jirtaa.
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu xertii ku yidhi, Maalmuhu waa iman doonaan goortaad dooni doontaan inaad aragtaan maalmaha Wiilka Aadanaha middood, mana arki doontaan.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

kikuyu: Waxaana laydinku odhan doonaa, Waa taas! Waa tan! Ha bixina, hana raacina.
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

kikuyu: Waayo, sida hillaacu markuu dhinaca hoose oo cirka ka hillaaco oo ilaa dhinaca kale oo hoose oo cirka u ifiyo, sidaas oo kale ayuu Wiilka Aadanahuna ahaan doonaa maalintiisa.
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

kikuyu: Laakiin kolka hore waxay waajib ugu tahay inuu wax badan ku xanuunsado oo uu qarniganu diido isaga.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

kikuyu: Oo sidii wakhtigii Nuux ahaa, sidaas oo kale ayay noqon doontaa maalmaha Wiilka Aadanaha.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

kikuyu: Wax bay cuni jireen oo cabbi jireen, wayna guursan jireen oo guur baa la siin jiray, ilaa maalintii Nuux uu doonnida galay, oo daadkii yimid oo wada baabbi'iyey.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale ayay weliba ahayd maalmihii Luud. Wax bay cuni jireen oo cabbi jireen, wax bayna iibsan jireen oo iibin jireen, oo beeran jireen, oo dhisan jireen.
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

kikuyu: Laakiin maalintii Luud ka baxay Sodom ayay dab iyo baaruud cirka kaga soo daateen oo wada baabbi'iyeen.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

kikuyu: Si la mid ah ayay noqon doontaa maalinta Wiilka Aadanahu soo muuqdo.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

kikuyu: Maalintaas kii guriga fuushanu, oo alaabtiisu guriga ku jirto, yaanu u soo degin inuu soo qaato; kii beerta joogaana sidaas oo kale yaanu dib u noqon.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

kikuyu: Naagtii Luud xusuusta.
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

kikuyu: Kan doona inuu naftiisa badbaadiyo waa lumin doonaa, laakiin kan lumiya ayaa badbaadin doona.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Habeenkaas laba nin ayaa sariir wada joogi doona; mid waa la qaadi doonaa, kan kalena waa laga tegi doonaa.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

kikuyu: Waxaana jiri doona laba naagood oo wax isla shiidi doona, mid waa la qaadi doonaa, tan kalena waa laga tegi doonaa.
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

kikuyu: Markaasay u jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Xaggee, Sayidow? Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Meeshii bakhtigu yaal, halkaas ayaa gorgorraduna isugu ururi doonaan.
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

kikuyu: Si Ciise u tuso inay waajib ku tahay iyaga inay mar walba tukadaan oo aanay ka qalbi jabin, wuxuu iyaga kula hadlay masaal isagoo leh,
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

kikuyu: Waxaa magaalo joogay xaakin aan Ilaah ka baqi jirin, ninnana aan danayn jirin.
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

kikuyu: Waxaana magaaladaas joogtay carmal ninkeedii ka dhintay, marar badanna way u timid, iyadoo ku leh, Cadowgayga iga xaq sii.
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

kikuyu: Intii wakhti ah ayuu yeeli waayay, laakiin dabadeed wuxuu isku yidhi, In kastoo aanan Ilaah ka baqin, oo aanan ninna danayn,
english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

kikuyu: weliba dhibta ay carmalkan i dhibayso aawadeed, waan xaq siin doonaa, si aanay marar badan iigu soo noqnoqon oo ii daalin.
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu yidhi, Maqla wixii xaakinkii xaqa darnaa yidhi.
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

kikuyu: Ilaahna miyaanu xaq siin doonin kuwuu doortay oo habeen iyo maalinba u qayliya; oo miyaanu u dulqaadan doonin?
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Dhaqsoba wuu u xaq siin doonaa; hase ahaatee goortuu Wiilka Aadanahu yimaado, markaas rumaysad ma ka heli doonaa dhulka?
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

kikuyu: Masaalkan ayuu kula hadlay qaar ismoodayay inay xaq yihiin oo kuwa kale quudhsaday.
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

kikuyu: Laba nin ayaa tegey inay macbudka ku tukadaan; mid Farrisi buu ahaa, kan kalena cashuurqaade.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

kikuyu: Farrisigii intuu istaagay ayuu waxyaalahan isugu tukaday, Ilaahow, waxaan kuugu mahadnaqayaa inaanan ahayn sida nimanka kale oo wax dulma, iyo kuwa xaqa daran, iyo dhillayaasha, ama xataa sida cashuurqaadahan.
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

kikuyu: Toddobaadkiiba laba kol ayaan soomaa, waxaan haysta oo dhanna toban meelood ayaan meel ka bixiyaa.
english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

kikuyu: Laakiin cashuurqaadihii meel fog ayuu ka istaagay, ma uuna doonaynin inuu indhihiisa cirka u qaado, laakiin laabtiisa ayuu garaacay isagoo leh, Ilaahow, ii naxariiso anigoo dembi leh.
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kan iyo kii kale, kan baa gurigiisa tegey isagoo la caddeeyey inuu xaq yahay; waayo, mid kasta oo isa sarraysiiya waa la hoosaysiin doonaa, oo kii is-hoosaysiiyana waa la sarraysiin doonaa.
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

kikuyu: Ilmo yaryar ayay u keeneen inuu taabto, laakiin goortii xertii aragtay, ayay canaanteen.
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise ayaa u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Ilmaha yaryar daaya, ha ii yimaadeene, hana diidina, waayo, kuwan oo kale ayaa ka mid ah boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ku alla kii aan boqortooyada Ilaah u aqbalin sida ilmo yar oo kale, meeshaas ma uu geli doono.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

kikuyu: Taliye ayaa weyddiiyey isagoo leh, Macallin wanaagsanow, maxaan sameeyaa inaan nolosha weligeed ah dhaxlo?
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Maxaad iigu yeedhaysaa wanaagsanow? Mid wanaagsan ma jiro mid maahee, kaasuna waa Ilaah.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

kikuyu: Qaynuunnada waad taqaan, Waa inaanad sinaysan, Waa inaanad qudh gooyn, Waa inaanad wax xadin, Waa inaanad marag been ah furin, Aabbahaa iyo hooyadaana maamuus.
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Kuwaas oo dhan tan iyo yaraantaydii waan dhawray.
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu waxaas maqlay ayuu ku yidhi, Weli wax keliya ayaa kuu dhiman. Waxaad haysatid oo dhan iibi, oo masaakiinta u qaybi, oo waxaad jannada ku lahaan doontaa maal, ee kaalay oo i soo raac.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

kikuyu: Laakiin goortuu waxaas maqlay ayuu aad uga caloolxumaaday, waayo, aad buu hodan u ahaa.
english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu arkay, wuxuu yidhi, Kuwa hodanka ah waa ku adag tahay inay boqortooyada Ilaah galaan,
english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

kikuyu: waayo, nin hodan ah inuu boqortooyada Ilaah galo waxaa ka hawl yar in awr irbad daloolkeeda ka duso.
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa kuwa maqlay waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba yaa badbaadi kara?
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

kikuyu: Wuxuuse ku yidhi, Waxa aan dadka u suurtoobin, Ilaah waa u suurtoobaan.
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

kikuyu: Butros ayaa ku yidhi, Bal eeg, waxayagii ayaannu ka tagnay, waana ku raacnay.
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay. Ma jiro nin boqortooyada Ilaah aawadeed uga tegey guri, ama afo, ama walaalo, ama waalid, ama carruur,
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

kikuyu: oo aan haatan helayn labanlaab badan, wakhtiga imanayana nolosha weligeed ah.
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

kikuyu: Laba-iyo-tobankii ayuu watay oo ku yidhi, Waxaynu ku soconnaa Yeruusaalem, oo wax walba oo nebiyadu qoreen ayaa Wiilka Aadanaha u noqon doona.
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

kikuyu: Waayo, isaga waxaa loo dhiibi doonaa dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn, waana lagu kajami doonaa, oo la caayi doonaa, oo lagu tufi doonaa,
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

kikuyu: wayna karbaashi doonaan oo dili doonaan, maalinta saddexaadna wuu soo sara kici doonaa.
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Laakiin waxyaalahaas waxba kama ay garan, hadalkaasna waa ka qarsoonaa, mana ay garan wixii la yidhi.
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

kikuyu: Waxaa noqotay markuu Yerixoo ku soo dhowaaday, in nin indha la' jidka ag fadhiyey oo dawarsanayay,
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

kikuyu: oo goortuu maqlay dadka badan oo ag maraya ayuu weyddiiyey waxaas waxay ahaayeen.
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

kikuyu: Waxay u sheegeen in Ciisihii Reer Naasared ag marayo.
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

kikuyu: Markaasuu qayliyey isagoo leh, Ciise, ina Daa'uudow, ii naxariiso.
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Kuwa hor marayay ayaa canaantay si uu u aamuso, laakiin si ka badan ayuu ugu qayliyey, Ina Daa'uudow, ii naxariiso.
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise joogsaday oo wuxuu ku amray in loo keeno, oo goortuu u soo dhowaaday ayuu weyddiiyey, oo ku yidhi,
