english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

kikuyu: Maxaad doonaysaa inaan kuu sameeyo? Wuxuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, inaan wax arko.
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Wax arag; rumaysadkaaga ayaa ku bogsiiyey.
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

kikuyu: Kolkiiba ayuu wax arkay, wuuna raacay oo Ilaah ammaanay. Dadkii oo dhanna goortay arkeen, ayay Ilaah ammaaneen.
english: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu galay oo dhex marayay Yerixoo.
english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa jiray nin Sakhayos la odhan jiray; kan ahaa madaxda cashuurqaadayaasha, oo hodan buuna ahaa.
english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna doonayay inuu Ciise arko cid uu yahay, wuuna kari waayay dadkii badnaa aawadood, waayo, wuu gaabnaa.
english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

kikuyu: Hore buu u orday, oo wuxuu fuulay geed sukomoor inuu isaga arko, waayo, goor dhow jidkaas ayuu soo mari lahaa.
english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

kikuyu: Ciise goortuu meeshii yimid, ayuu kor u eegay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Sakhayosow, dhaqso u soo deg, waayo, maanta waa inaan gurigaaga joogo.
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

kikuyu: Dhaqso ayuu u soo degay, oo farxad ayuu ku soo dhoweeyey.
english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

kikuyu: Dadkii goortay arkeen, kulligood way wada gunuunaceen, iyagoo leh, Nin dembi leh ayuu u marti galay.
english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Sakhayos waa istaagay oo Rabbiga ku yidhi, Bal eeg, Sayidow, maalkayga badhkiisa ayaan masaakiinta siinayaa, oo haddii aan nin wax ka dulmay, waxaan u celinayaa afar laab.
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Maanta badbaadinta ayaa gurigan timid, waayo, isaguna waa ina Ibraahim.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

kikuyu: Waayo, Wiilka Aadanahu wuxuu u yimid inuu kii hallaabay doondoono oo badbaadiyo.
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

kikuyu: Goortay waxaas maqleen, masaal buu ku daray oo ku hadlay, waayo, wuxuu ku dhowaa Yeruusaalem, waxayna u maleeyeen boqortooyada Ilaah inay markiiba soo muuqan doonto.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed wuxuu yidhi, Nin sharaf leh ayaa dal fog tegey inuu boqortooyo soo helo oo soo noqdo.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u yeedhay tobankiisa addoon, oo wuxuu u dhiibay toban mina, oo ku yidhi, Ku baayacmushtara ilaa aan soo noqdo.
english: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

kikuyu: Laakiin dadkii magaaladiisa ayaa nacay, oo waxay ka daba direen ergo iyagoo leh, Dooni mayno ninkaas inuu boqor noo ahaado.
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

kikuyu: Goortuu soo noqday isagoo boqortooyadii qaatay, wuxuu ku amray in loo yeedho addoommadii uu lacagtii u dhiibay inuu ogaado mid kasta intuu ka faa'iiday baayacmushtarigii.
english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

kikuyu: Kii hore ayaa u yimid oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, minahaagii ayaa toban kale laga faa'iiday.
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Si wanaagsan baad yeeshay, addoon yahow wanaagsan. Wax yar ayaad aamin ku ahayd, ee toban magaalo u sarree.
english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

kikuyu: Markaasaa kii labaad yimid isagoo leh, Sayidow, minahaagii waxaa laga faa'iiday shan mina.
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

kikuyu: Kaasna wuxuu ku yidhi, Adna shan magaalo u sarree.
english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

kikuyu: Kii kalena waa yimid isagoo leh, Sayidow, waa kaa minahaagii aan maro yar ku guntay oo meel dhigay.
english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

kikuyu: Waayo, waan kaa baqay, maxaa yeelay, nin ba'an baad tahay; waxaad qaadataa waxaanad dhigan, oo waxaad gurataa waxaanad beeran.
english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaa afkaaga ka soo baxay ayaan kugu xukumayaa, addoon yahow sharka leh. Waad ogayd inaan ahay nin ba'an oo qaato wixii aanan dhigan oo gurto wixii aanan beeran.
english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

kikuyu: Maxaad haddaba lacagtaydii baangiga u dhigi weyday, si, markaan imaado, aan u soo qaato lacagtaydii iyo faa'iidadeediiba?
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi kuwii ag taagnaa, Minaha ka qaada oo u dhiiba kan tobanka mina haya.
english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, toban mina ayuu hayaa.
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mid walba oo wax haysta waa la siin doonaa, kii aan waxba haysanse waa laga qaadi doonaa xataa wuxuu haysto.
english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

kikuyu: Laakiin cadowyadaydan oo aan doonin inaan boqor u ahaado halkan keena oo hortayda ku laaya.
english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

kikuyu: Goortuu waxaas ku hadlay ayuu hore u socday oo Yeruusaalem tegey.
english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Goortuu Beytfaage iyo Beytaniya ku dhowaaday ilaa buurta Buur Saytuun la yidhaahdo ayuu laba xer ah diray,
english: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Tuulada idinka soo hor jeedda taga, tan goortaad gashaan aad ka helaysaan qayl xidhan oo aan ninna weligii fuulin; soo fura oo keena.
english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

kikuyu: Haddii laydin weyddiiyo oo laydinku yidhaahdo, Maxaad u furaysaan? waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Sayidkaa u baahan.
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

kikuyu: Markaasay kuwii la diray tageen oo heleen sidii lagu yidhi.
english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

kikuyu: Kolkay qaylka furayeen ayaa kuwii lahaa ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaad qaylka u furaysaan?
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidkaa u baahan.
english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

kikuyu: Markaasay Ciise u keeneen, oo dharkoodii bay qaylkii dusha ka saareen, oo Ciise ayay fuusheen.
english: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

kikuyu: Oo intuu socday, dharkoodii ayay jidka ku gogleen.
english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

kikuyu: Goortuu ku soo dhowaanayay xataa meeshii Buur Saytuun laga dego, dadkii oo dhan oo xertii ahaa ayaa bilaabay inay farxaan, oo cod weyn Ilaah ku ammaanaan waxa xoogga leh oo dhan oo ay arkeen aawadood,
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

kikuyu: iyagoo leh, Waxaa barakaysan Boqorka Rabbiga magiciisa ku imanaya. Nabadi jannada ha ku jirto, ammaantuna meelaha ugu sarreeya.
english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

kikuyu: Farrisiintii qaarkood oo dadkii badnaa ku dhex jiray ayaa ku yidhi, Macallimow, xertaada canaano.
english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kuwani hadday aamusaan, dhagaxyada ayaa qaylin doona.
english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

kikuyu: Oo markuu ku soo dhowaaday, ayuu magaalada arkay oo u ooyay,
english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Adigu haddii aad maalintan garan lahayd waxa nabad ah! Laakiin hadda waa laga qariyey indhahaaga.
english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

kikuyu: Waayo, maalmuhu way kuu iman doonaan markii cadowyadaadu ay xaggaaga dhufays u soo qodan doonaan, oo ay kugu wareegi doonaan oo ay dhinac walba kaa celin doonaan.
english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

kikuyu: Way ku dumin doonaan, adiga iyo carruurtaada kugu jirta, oo kuguma dayn doonaan dhagax dhagax dul saaran, waayo, waad garan weyday wakhtigii booqashadaada.
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu galay macbudka oo bilaabay inuu ka eryo kuwii wax ku iibinayay,
english: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

kikuyu: isagoo ku leh, Waa qoran tahay, Gurigaygu wuxuu ahaan doonaa guriga tukashada, laakiin idinku waxaad ka dhigteen god tuugo.
english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

kikuyu: Maalin walba ayuu macbudka ku jiri jiray isagoo wax baraya; laakiin wadaaddada sare iyo culimmada iyo madaxda dadku waxay dooneen inay dilaan,
english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

kikuyu: oo ay waayeen waxay ku sameeyaan, waayo, dadka oo dhan ayaa aad u dhegaysanayay.
english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

kikuyu: Maalmahaa middood intuu Ciise dadka macbudkii wax ku barayay oo injiilka kaga dhex wacdiyeyey, waxaa dhacay in wadaaddada sare iyo culimmada ula yimaadeen waayeellada
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

kikuyu: oo la hadleen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Noo sheeg, Amarkee baad waxan ku samaysaa? Oo yuu yahay kan amarkan ku siiyey?
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Aniguna hal baan idin weyddiinayaa, iina sheega.
english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

kikuyu: Baabtiiskii Yooxanaa ma wuxuu ka yimid xagga jannada mase dadka?
english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

kikuyu: Dhexdooda ayay iskala hadleen iyagoo leh, Haddaynu nidhaahno, Xagga jannada, wuxuu odhanayaa, Maxaad u rumaysan weydeen?
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii aynu nidhaahno, Xagga dadka, dadka oo dhan ayaa ina dhagxinaya, waayo, waa la aaminsiiyey inuu Yooxanaa nebi ahaa.
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay ugu jawaabeen inaanay garan meeshuu ka yimid.
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

kikuyu: Ciisena wuxuu ku yidhi, Aniguna idiin sheegi maayo amarka aan waxan ku sameeyo.
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu bilaabay inuu masaalkan dadka kula hadlo. Nin baa wuxuu beertay beer canab ah, oo niman beerrey ah u kiraystay, markaasuu dal kale tegey, oo wax badan ku maqnaa.
english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

kikuyu: Goortii xilligii yimid, ayuu addoon u soo diray beerreydii inay isaga siiyaan midhaha beerta, laakiin beerreydii ayaa garaacday oo waxla'aan ku dirtay.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Haddana wuxuu diray addoon kale, kaasna way garaaceen, oo ceebeeyeen, oo waxla'aan ku direen.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Haddana mid saddexaad ayuu diray, kaasna way dhaawaceen oo iska tuureen.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

kikuyu: Markaasaa sayidka beerta wuxuu yidhi, Maxaan sameeyaa? Waxaan dirayaa wiilkaygaan jeclahay, malaha way maamuusi doonaan.
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

kikuyu: Laakiin beerreydii goortay arkeen, waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Kanu waa kii dhaxalka lahaa; aan dilnee, si aynu dhaxalka u lahaanno.
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

kikuyu: Markaasay beertii canabka ahayd dibaddeeda ku tuureen, wayna dileen. Haddaba sayidkii beerta canabka ah muxuu iyaga ku samayn doonaa?
english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

kikuyu: Wuu iman doonaa oo beerreydaas dili doonaa, oo dad kale ayuu beerta canabka ah u dhiibi doonaa. Goortay taas maqleen waxay yidhaahdeen, Yaanay noqon.
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu eegay oo ku yidhi, Haddaba muxuu yahay waxan la qoray, Dhagaxii kuwa wax dhisaa ay diideen, Kaasu wuxuu noqday madaxa rukunka?
english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

kikuyu: Mid kasta oo dhagaxaas ku dhacaa, wuu jejebi doonaa, laakiin kan uu ku dhoco, wuu burburin doonaa.
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

kikuyu: Saacaddaas qudheeda ayaa culimmadii iyo wadaaddadii sare dooneen inay isagii qabtaan; laakiin dadkay ka baqeen; waayo, waxay garteen inuu masaalkan iyaga kaga hadlay.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

kikuyu: Wayna dayayeen, oo ay u soo direen jaajuusiin iska dhigaya dad xaq ah, si ay hadalkiisa ugu qabtaan, oo ay ugu gacangeliyaan talada iyo amarka taliyaha.
english: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

kikuyu: Markaasay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, waxaannu og nahay inaad si hagaagsan wax u tidhaahdo oo wax u bartid, oo aanad ninna u eexan, laakiin aad jidka Ilaah run ku bartid.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

kikuyu: Ma xalaal baa inaannu cashuur Kaysar siinno ama inaannan siin?
english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

kikuyu: Laakiin khiyaanadooda wuu gartay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

kikuyu: Dinaar i tusa. Yaa leh masawirkan iyo qorniinkan ku yaal? Waxay yidhaahdeen, Kaysar baa leh.
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Haddaba Kaysar siiya wixii Kaysar leeyahay, Ilaahna siiya wixii Ilaah leeyahay.
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

kikuyu: Hadalkiisa way ku qaban kari waayeen dadka hortiisa, wayna ka yaabeen jawaabtiisa, oo way aamuseen.
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

kikuyu: Waxaa u yimid qaar Sadukiin ah, kuwii odhan jiray, Sarakicidda kuwii dhintay ma jirto.
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

kikuyu: Oo waxay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, Muuse wuxuu noo qoray, Nin walaalkiis hadduu dhinto isagoo naag leh oo aan carruur lahayn, walaalkiis naagtiisa waa inuu dumaalo oo uu carruur walaalkiis u dhalo.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa jiray toddoba walaalo ah. Kii ugu horreeyey naag buu qabay, wuuna dhintay carruurla'aan.
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

kikuyu: Kii labaadna wuu guursaday,
english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

kikuyu: oo kii saddexaadna waa dumaalay. Sidaasay toddobadii u wada guursadeen, carruurna kama ay tegin, wayna dhinteen.
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

kikuyu: Kulligood dabadeed naagtiina waa dhimatay.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

kikuyu: Haddaba wakhtiga sarakicidda kuwii dhintay, iyaga kee bay naagtiisa ahaan doontaa? Waayo, toddobadu way wada guursadeen.
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Wiilashii wakhtigan waa guursadaan, guurna waa la siiyaa,
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

kikuyu: laakiin kuwa loo xisaabay inay istaahilaan inay gaadhaan wakhtigaas iyo ka soo sarakicidda kuwii dhintay ma guursadaan, guurna lama siiyo,
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

kikuyu: waayo, kol dambe ma dhiman karaan, maxaa yeelay, waxay yihiin sida malaa'igaha, oo waxay yihiin wiilashii Ilaah iyagoo ah wiilashii sarakicidda.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

kikuyu: Laakiin in kuwii dhintay la sara kiciyo Muuse ayaa tilmaamay xaggii geedka markuu Rabbiga ugu yeedhay Ilaaha Ibraahim iyo Ilaaha Isxaaq iyo Ilaaha Yacquub.
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

kikuyu: Laakiin isagu ma aha Ilaaha kuwa dhintay, laakiin waa Ilaaha kuwa nool, waayo, dhammaan isagay u nool yihiin.
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

kikuyu: Culimmada qaarkood ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, si wanaagsan ayaad u hadashay.
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

kikuyu: Kol dambe kuma ay dhicin inay wax weyddiiyaan.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Sidee bay u yidhaahdaan, Masiixu waa ina Daa'uud?
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

kikuyu: Daa'uud qudhiisa ayaa kitaabkii Sabuurrada ku leh, Rabbigu wuxuu Sayidkayga ku yidhi, Midigtayda fadhiiso,
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

kikuyu: Ilaa aan cadaawayaashaada cagahaaga hoostooda geliyo.
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

kikuyu: Haddaba Daa'uud ayaa ugu yeedhay Sayid, ee sidee buu wiilkiisa u yahay?
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

kikuyu: Dadkii oo dhan oo maqlaya, ayuu xertiisii ku yidhi,
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: Iska jira culimmada oo doonaya inay khamiisyo dhaadheer ku socdaan, oo jecel salaanta suuqa, iyo kursiyada hore oo sunagogyada, iyo meelaha hore oo diyaafadaha,
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

kikuyu: kuwa wada laasta guryaha carmallada, oo tukashooyin dhaadheer istusid u tukada. Kuwaas waxay heli doonaan xisaab aad u daran.
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: Kor buu u eegay, oo wuxuu arkay kuwa hodanka ah oo hadiyadahoodii khasnadda ku ridaya.
english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna arkay carmal miskiin ah oo meeshaas laba lacag ah oo yaryar ku ridaysa.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Carmalkan miskiinta ah waxay ku ridday wax ka badan wixii ay dhammaan ku rideen.
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwaas oo dhan waxoodii badnaa ayay wax kaga rideen hadiyadaha, iyaduse miskiinnimadeeda waxay kaga ridday wixii ay ku noolaan lahayd oo dhan.
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

kikuyu: Oo qaar kolkay macbudka ka hadlayeen in dhagaxyo wanaagsan iyo hadiyado lagu qurxiyey, wuxuu yidhi,
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

kikuyu: Waxaa imanaya maalmo goortii kuwaas aad arkaysaan aan dhagax dhagax kale dushiisa lagu dul dayn doonin oo aan la dumin doonin.
english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Markaasay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, goormay waxyaalahanu ahaan doonaan, oo calaamadu maxay ahaan doontaa goortii waxyaalahanu ay dhowaan doonaan?
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Iska eega yaan laydin khiyaanayn, waayo, qaar badan ayaa magacayga ku iman doona, oo waxay odhan doonaan, Anigu waxaan ahay isaga; iyo, Wakhtigu waa soo dhowaaday. Ha raacina.
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

kikuyu: Oo markaad dagaallo iyo rabshooyin maqashaan ha baqanina, waayo, kolka hore waxyaalahanu waa inay dhacaan, laakiin dhammaadku kolkiiba ma aha.
english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Quruunba quruun bay ku kici doontaa, boqortooyona boqortooyo.
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

kikuyu: Waxaa meelo kala duwan ka dhici doona dhulgariir iyo abaaro iyo cudurro, samadana waxaa laga arki doonaa waxyaalo cabsi leh iyo calaamooyin waaweyn.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan oo dhan hortood gacmahooday idin saari doonaan oo idin silcin doonaan oo idiin dhiibi doonaan sunagogyada iyo xabsiyada, oo waxaa magacayga aawadiis laydiin hor geeyn doonaa boqorro iyo taliyayaal.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Waxayna idinku noqon doontaa marag.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed qalbiyadiinna geliya inaydnaan hore ugu fikirin waxaad ku jawaabi doontaan.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idin siin doonaa af iyo xigmad aanay cadaawayaashiinna oo dhammu ka adkaan karin oo aanay ka gees hadli karin.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

kikuyu: Laakiin idinka waxaa idin gacangelin doona waalidkiinna, iyo walaalahiinna, iyo xigaalkiinna, iyo saaxiibbadiinna, qaarkiinnana waa la dili doonaa.
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

kikuyu: Dadka oo dhan ayaa magacayga aawadiis idiin necbaan doona.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Tinna madaxiinna kama lumi doono.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

kikuyu: Waa inaad naftiinna ku haysataan dulqaadashadiinna.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortaad aragtaan Yeruusaalem oo colal ku wareegsan yihiin, markaas ogaada in hallaynteedu dhow dahay.
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

kikuyu: Markaas kuwa Yahuudiya joogaa buuraha ha u carareen, kuwa gudaheeda ku jiraana ha ka baxeen, kuwa beeraha joogaana yaanay gelin.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwanu waa maalmo aargudasho in wixii la qoray oo dhammu ay noqdaan.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa u hoog kuwa uurka leh iyo kuwa wakhtigaas ilmo nuujinaya, waayo, dhulka dhib weyn ayaa ka dhici doonta, dadkanna cadho.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

kikuyu: Waxayna ku dhici doonaan seef afkeeda, oo waa la qabsan doonaa, oo quruumaha oo dhan la geeyn doonaa; quruumuhuna Yeruusaalem ayay ku tuman doonaan ilaa wakhtiga quruumuhu ka dhammaado.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

kikuyu: Calaamooyin ayaa laga arki doonaa qorraxda, iyo dayaxa, iyo xiddigaha; dhulkana waxaa ku jiri doona dhib quruumahu ka welwelaan guuxa badda iyo hirarka aawadood.
english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

kikuyu: Dadkuna waxay la suuxi doonaan baqdin iyo filasho waxa dunida iman doona, waayo, xoogagga cirka ayaa la gariirin doonaa.
english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

kikuyu: Markaasay arki doonaan Wiilka Aadanaha oo daruur ku imanaya, isagoo leh xoog iyo ammaan weyn.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortii ay waxaasu bilaabaan inay dhacaan, kor eega, madaxyadiinnana kor u qaada, waayo, madaxfurashadiinnu waa dhow dahay.
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu masaal kula hadlay, Bal eega berdaha iyo dhirta oo dhan;
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

kikuyu: goortay caleemo bixiyaan waad arkaysaan oo garanaysaan inuu roobku haddaba dhow yahay.
english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale idinkuna goortaad aragtaan waxaas oo dhacaya, garta in boqortooyadii Ilaah dhow dahay.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, Qarniganu ma idlaan doono intaanay wax walba dhicin.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Cirka iyo dhulku waa idlaan doonaan, laakiinse ereyadaydu ma idlaan doonaan.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

kikuyu: Laakiin iska jira, yaan qalbiyadiinnu la cuslaan dhereg badan iyo sakhraannimo iyo ka welwelidda ifkan, oo yaan maalintaasu idiin soo kedin sida dabin oo kale.
english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

kikuyu: Waayo, sidaas oo kale ayaa ku dhacaysa kulli kuwa dunida oo dhan jooga.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Laakiin wakhti walbaba soo jeeda, idinkoo Ilaah baryaya inaad xoog yeelataan si aad uga baxsataan waxaas dhici doonaa oo dhan, oo aad Wiilka Aadanaha isu hor taagtaan.
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

kikuyu: Maalin walba ayuu macbudka wax ku bari jiray, habeen walbana dibadda ayuu u bixi jiray, oo wuxuu baryi jiray buurta la odhan jiray Buur Saytuun.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

kikuyu: Dadka oo dhammuna aroortii ayay macbudka ugu iman jireen inay dhegaystaan.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

kikuyu: Waxaa soo dhowaatay Iiddii Kibistii-aan-khamiirka-lahayn oo la yidhaahdo Kormaridda.
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaaddadii sare iyo culimmadii waxay dooneen si ay u dilaan isaga, waayo, dadka ayay ka baqeen.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Shayddaanku wuxuu galay Yuudas, kan Iskariyod la odhan jiray, isagoo ka mid ah tirada laba-iyo-tobanka.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

kikuyu: Markaasuu tegey, oo wuxuu la hadlay wadaaddada sare iyo madaxdii askarta si uu ugu gacangeliyo.
english: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: Goortaasay farxeen oo kula heshiiyeen inay lacag siiyaan,
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

kikuyu: wuuna oggolaaday, oo wuxuu doonayay goor wanaagsan inuu u soo gacangeliyo intii dadka maqnaayeen.
english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

kikuyu: Waxaa timid maalintii Iidda Kibista-aan-khamiirka-lahayn, tan la leeyahay in neefka Kormaridda la gowraco.
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu diray Butros iyo Yooxanaa isagoo ku leh, Taga oo Kormaridda inoo soo diyaargareeya aan cunnee.
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

kikuyu: Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Xaggee baad doonaysaa inaannu ku diyaargarayno?
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eega, goortaad magaalada gashaan waxaa idinla kulmi doona nin ashuun biyah sita. Isaga raaca oo ka daba gala guriguu galo.
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

kikuyu: Waxaad ninka guriga leh ku tidhaahdaan, Macallinkii wuxuu kugu leeyahay, Meeday qooladdii martidu oo aan xertayda kula cuni doono cashada Iidda Kormaridda?
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

kikuyu: Wuxuu idin tusayaa qoolad weyn oo sare oo goglan, halkaa ku diyaargareeya.
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

kikuyu: Markaasay tageen, oo waxay heleen siduu u sheegay, oo cashada Iidda Kormaridda way diyaargareeyeen.
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Goortii saacaddii timid ayuu fadhiistay, isaga iyo rasuulladiiba.
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Aad baan u doonayay inaan cashadan Iidda Kormaridda idinla cuno intaanan xanuunsan.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mar dambe tan ma cuni doono ilaa ay ku dhammaystiranto boqortooyada Ilaah dhexdeeda.
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu koob qaaday, oo goortuu mahadnaqay ayuu yidhi, Kan qaata oo qaybsada,
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

kikuyu: waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Hadda dabadeed anigu midhaha geedka canabka ah kama cabbi doono ilaa ay boqortooyada Ilaah timaado.
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

kikuyu: Kibisna wuu qaaday, oo goortuu mahadnaqay, ayuu kala jejebiyey, oo iyaga siiyey, isagoo leh, Tanu waa jidhkaygii laydiin bixiyey. Waxan xusuustayda u sameeya.
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale cashada dabadeed koobkuu qaaday isagoo leh, Koobkanu waa axdiga cusub oo dhiiggayga aawadiin loo daadshay,
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

kikuyu: laakiin eega, gacanta kan i gacangelinaya miiskay ila saaran tahay,
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

kikuyu: waayo, Wiilka Aadanahu waa baxayaa sidii loo gooyay, laakiin hoog waxaa leh ninkaas gacangelinaya.
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay bilaabeen inay dhexdooda isweyddiiyaan midkood waxan yeeli doona.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

kikuyu: Dhexdoodana waxaa ku jirtay dood ku saabsanayd midkood lagu tirinaya inuu ugu weyn yahay.
english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Quruumaha boqorradoodu ay u taliyaan iyaga, kuwa xukun ku lehna waxaa la yidhaahdaa, Wanaagfalayaal.
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

kikuyu: Idinkuse sidaas ma ahaan doontaan, laakiin kan dhexdiinna ugu weyn, ha noqdo sida kan yar; kan u sarreeyaana, ha noqdo sida kan adeega.
english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

kikuyu: Waayo, kee baa weyn, ma kan cuntada u fadhiya baa mise waa kan adeega? Miyaanu ahayn kan cuntada u fadhiya? Aniguse sida kan adeega ayaan idiin dhex joogaa.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad tihiin kuwa ila sii joogay markii lay jirrabayay.
english: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

kikuyu: Waxaan idiin yeelayaa boqortooyo sida aabbahay iigu yeelay,
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

kikuyu: si aad wax uga cuntaan oo uga cabtaan miiskayga oo boqortooyadayda ku jira, oo waxaad ku fadhiisan doontaan carshiyo idinkoo xukumaya laba-iyo-tobanka qolo oo Israa'iil.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

kikuyu: Simoonow, Simoonow, ogow, Shayddaanka ayaa ku doonay inuu kuu haadiyo sida sarreen,
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

kikuyu: laakiin waan kuu baryootamay si aanu rumaysadkaagu u baabbi'in, adiguna goortaad hadaysantid walaalaha adkee.
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, diyaar baan u ahay inaan kuu raaco xabsiga iyo dhimashadaba.
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

kikuyu: Isaguse wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaan kuu sheegayaa, Butrosow, maanta diiqu ciyi maayo ilaa aad saddex kol dafirtid inaad i taqaan.
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Goortaan idin diray kiishadla'aan iyo qandila'aan iyo kabola'aan, wax ma u baahnaydeen? Waxay yidhaahdeen, Maya, waxba.
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Laakiin haddeer kii kiishad qabaa ha qaato, sidaas oo kalena qandi ha qaato. Kii aan midna qabinna, dharkiisa ha iibiyo, oo seef ha iibsado.
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Waa inuu igu dhammaado qorniinkan leh, Waxaa isaga lagu tiriyey sharcilaawayaasha. Waayo, waxa igu saabsani dhammaad bay leeyihiin.
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, bal eeg, laba seefood ayaa halkan yaale. Wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa ku filan tahay.
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu baxay oo Buur Saytuun tegey sidii caadadiisu ahayd, xertiina waa raacday.
english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

kikuyu: Markuu meeshii joogay ayuu ku yidhi, Tukada inaydnaan jirrabaadda gelin.
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu intii dhagax la tuuro ka durkay, wuuna jilba joogsaday oo tukaday,
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Aabbow, haddaad doonaysid, koobkan iga fogee, hase ahaatee, doonistaydu yaanay noqon, taaduse ha noqoto.
english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa samada kaga muuqatay malaa'ig isaga xoogaynaysa.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

kikuyu: Isagoo aad u xanuunsan ayuu dadaal ku tukaday, dhididkiisuna wuxuu noqday sida dhibicyo dhiig ah oo dhulka ku dhacaya.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

kikuyu: Goortuu tukashadiisii ka soo kacay, ayuu xertii u yimid oo wuxuu arkay iyagoo caloolxumo la hurda.
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Maxaad u huruddaan? Kaca oo tukada inaydnaan jirrabaadda gelin.
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

kikuyu: Intuu weli hadlayay, bal eeg, waxaa yimid dad badan, oo kii Yuudas la odhan jiray oo laba-iyo-tobanka ka mid ahaa ayaa hortooda socday. Wuxuuna u soo dhowaaday Ciise inuu dhunkado.
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Yuudasow, ma waxaad Wiilka Aadanaha ku gacangelinaysaa dhunkasho?
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

kikuyu: Kuwii ag joogay goortay garteen waxa dhici doona, waxay yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, seef miyaannu ku dhufannaa?
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa midkood wuxuu ku dhuftay wadaadka sare addoonkiisii, oo dhegta midigta ka gooyay.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Sii daaya. Markaasuu dhegtiisa taabtay oo bogsiiyey.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

kikuyu: Kuwa u yimid, waxa weeye, wadaaddadii sare, iyo madaxdii askarta oo macbudka, iyo waayeelladii, waxaa Ciise ku yidhi, Ma waxaad iila soo baxdeen seefo iyo ulo sidaan tuug ahay?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

kikuyu: Goortaan maalin walba macbudka idinkula jiri jiray, gacmo iguma aydaan soo taagi jirin, laakiin tanu waa saacaddiinna iyo xoogga gudcurka.
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

kikuyu: Markaasay isagii qabteen oo kaxeeyeen, oo wadaadkii sare gurigiisa ayay geliyeen. Laakiin Butros baa meel fog ka daba socday,
english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

kikuyu: oo goortay barxadda dhexdeeda dab ka shideen, oo ay wada fadhiisteen, ayaa Butros dhexdooda fadhiistay.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

kikuyu: Laakiin gabadh baa intay aragtay isagoo dabka iftiinkiisa fadhiya, aad bay u dayday oo tidhi, Kanuna waa la jiray isagii.
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

kikuyu: Isaguse waa dafiray oo ku yidhi, Naag yahay, anigu garanba maayo isagii.
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

kikuyu: Waxoogaa yar dabadeed qof kale ayaa arkay oo yidhi, Adiguna midkood baad tahay. Butros baase yidhi, Nin yahow, anigu ma ihi.
english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

kikuyu: Goortii saacad dhaaftay mid kale ayaa adkeeyey isagoo leh, Run weeye, kanuna waa la jiray, waayo, waa reer Galili.
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros wuxuu ku yidhi, Nin yahow, anigu garan maayo waxaad leedahay. Kolkiiba intuu weli hadlayay, diiqii baa ciyey.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu soo jeestay oo Butros eegay; Butrosna wuxuu xusuustay ereygii Rabbiga siduu ku yidhi, Maanta intaanu diiqu ciyin, saddex kol ayaad i dafiri doontaa.
english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu dibadda u baxay oo aad u ooyay.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Nimankii Ciise qabtay way ku kajameen oo garaaceen.
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

kikuyu: Oo intay indhaha ka xidheen ayay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Noo sheeg, yuu yahay kan kugu dhuftay?
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

kikuyu: Wax badan oo kalena ayay ku lahaayeen iyagoo caayaya.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

kikuyu: Kolkuu waagii beryay, waxaa ururay waayeelladii dadka oo ahaa wadaaddadii sare iyo culimmadiiba, oo waxay isagii geeyeen shirkoodii iyagoo leh,
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

kikuyu: Haddii aad Masiixa tahay, noo sheeg. Wuxuuse ku yidhi, Haddaan idiin sheego ma rumaysan doontaan.
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

kikuyu: Haddaan idin weyddiiyona, iima jawaabi doontaan.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadda dabadeed Wiilka Aadanahu wuxuu fadhiisan doonaa midigta xoogga Ilaah.
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay wada yidhaahdeen, Haddaba miyaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah? Wuxuu ku yidhi, Waad tidhaahdeen inaan ahay.
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

kikuyu: Markaasay yidhaahdeen, Maxaannu markhaati weli ugu baahan nahay? Waayo, qudheenna ayaa afkiisa ka maqalnay.
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkoodii oo dhan kacay, oo waxay isagii hor geeyeen Bilaatos.
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay bilaabeen inay ku ashtakeeyaan iyagoo leh, Waxaannu aragnay ninkan oo quruuntayada rogaya, oo diidaya in Kaysar cashuur la siiyo, oo odhanaya inuu qudhiisu yahay Masiix oo boqor ah.
english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

kikuyu: Bilaatos ayaa weyddiiyey, isagoo leh, Ma Boqorka Yuhuudda baad tahay? Wuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waad tidhi.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Dabadeed Bilaatos wuxuu wadaaddadii sare iyo dadkii ku yidhi, Anigu ninkan eed kuma aan helin.
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

kikuyu: Laakiin way ku sii adkeeyeen iyagoo leh, Dadkuu kiciyaa, oo dalka Yahuudiya oo dhan ayuu wax baraa; dalka Galili ayuu ka soo bilaabay ilaa halkan.
english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

kikuyu: Bilaatos goortuu maqlay, wuxuu weyddiiyey inuu ninku reer Galili yahay.
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

kikuyu: Goortuu ogaaday inuu ka mid ahaa kuwii Herodos xukumo, wuxuu u diray Herodos, kan qudhiisu Yeruusaalem joogay wakhtigaas.
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

kikuyu: Herodos goortuu Ciise arkay, aad buu u farxay, maxaa yeelay, ilaa wakhti dheer ayuu doonayay inuu arko, waayo, wax buu ka maqlay, oo wuxuu rajaynayay inuu calaamo ka arko.
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu su'aalo badan weyddiiyey, laakiin waxba uma uu jawaabin.
english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

kikuyu: Wadaaddadii sare iyo culimmadii ayaa istaagay, oo aad iyo aad bay u ashtakeeyeen.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

kikuyu: Herodos ayaa fududaystay oo ku majaajilooday, isaga iyo askartiisiiba, oo intuu dhar dhalaalaya u geliyey ayuu Bilaatos u celiyey.
english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

kikuyu: Maalintaas qudheeda Herodos iyo Bilaatos saaxiibbo bay noqdeen, intii ka horraysayse cadaawe bay isu ahaayeen.
english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

kikuyu: Bilaatos ayaa isugu yeedhay wadaaddadii sare iyo taliyayaashii iyo dadkii.
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Ninkan waxaad iigu keenteen sidii mid dadka rogaya. Bal ogaada, hortiinna ayaan wax ku weyddiiyey, oo ninkan kuma aan helin eed ku saabsan waxaad ku ashtakaynaysaan.
english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

kikuyu: Herodosna kuma uu helin, wuuna noo soo celiyey, oo ma jiro wax dhimasho istaahila oo uu sameeyey.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

kikuyu: Taas aawadeed waan edbinayaa oo sii daynayaa.
english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Waayo, waajib bay ahayd inuu iidda mid u sii daayo iyaga.
english: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

kikuyu: Markaasay wada qayliyeen, iyagoo leh, Wad kan, Baraabbas noo sii daa,
english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

kikuyu: kan xabsiga loogu riday fallaagaduu magaalada ka riday iyo dilid aawadeed.
english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

kikuyu: Mar kale Bilaatos ayaa iyaga la hadlay isagoo doonaya inuu Ciise sii daayo.
english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

kikuyu: Laakiin way qayliyeen, iyagoo leh, Iskutallaabta ku qodob, iskutallaabta ku qodob.
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu kolkii saddexaad ku yidhi, Waayo? Waa maxay sharka kanu sameeyey? Kuma aan helin sabab lagu dilo, taas aawadeed waan edbinayaa oo sii daynayaa.
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Laakiin cod weyn ayay ku adkaysteen iyagoo weyddiisanaya in iskutallaabta lagu qodbo, oo waxaa xoog batay codadkoodii iyo codadkii wadaaddada sare.
english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bilaatos wuxuu xukumay in loo yeelo waxay weyddiisteen.
english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

kikuyu: Wuuna sii daayay kii fallaagada iyo dilidda xabsiga loogu riday oo ay weyddiisteen, laakiin Ciise buu u dhiibay iyaga siday doonayeen.
english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

kikuyu: Kolkay wadeen, waxay qabteen Simoon reer Kuranaya ah isagoo beeraha ka soo socda, waxayna saareen iskutallaabtii inuu Ciise ka daba qaado.
english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

kikuyu: Waxaana la socday dad badan iyo dumar laabta garaacaya oo barooranaya.
english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise intuu u soo jeestay, wuxuu ku yidhi, Gabdhaha Yeruusaalemow, ha ii ooyina, laakiin u ooya qudhiinna iyo carruurtiinna,
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

kikuyu: waayo, bal eega, wakhtigu waa imanayaa goortay odhan doonaan, Waxaa barakaysan madhashada iyo uurarka aan weligood dhalin iyo naasaha aan weligood la nuugin.
english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

kikuyu: Markaasay bilaabi doonaan inay buuraha ku yidhaahdaan, Nagu soo dhaca, oo ay gumburahana ku yidhaahdaan, Na qariya.
english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

kikuyu: Waayo, hadday geedka qoyan waxaas ku sameeyaan, maxaa ku dhici doona kan engegan?
english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

kikuyu: Waxaana lala waday laba kale oo xumaanfalayaal ah in lala dilo.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

kikuyu: Markay yimaadeen meeshii la yidhaahda dhakada, halkaasay iskutallaabo ku qodbeen isaga iyo xumaanfalayaashii, mid midigta, kan kalena bidixda.
english: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu yidhi, Aabbow, iyaga cafi, waayo, garan maayaan waxay samaynayaan. Markaasay dharkiisii qaybsadeen, wayna saami riteen.
english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

kikuyu: Dadkuna way taagnaayeen iyagoo daawanaya. Taliyayaashuna way ku qosleen iyagoo leh, Kuwa kale ayuu badbaadiyey, kanu ha isbadbaadiyo, hadduu yahay Masiixa Ilaah, kan uu doortay.
english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

kikuyu: Askartiina waa ku majaajiloodeen, oo intay u yimaadeen, ayay khal siiyeen,
english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haddii aad tahay boqorka Yuhuudda, isbadbaadi.
english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

kikuyu: Meel ka korraysay isagana waxaa ku qorraa qorniin leh, KANU WAA BOQORKA YUHUUDDA.
english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Xumaanfalayaashii deldelnaa midkood ayaa caayay isagoo leh, Miyaanad ahayn Masiixa? Annaga iyo qudhaadaba badbaadi.
english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

kikuyu: Laakiin kii kale ayaa jawaabay oo canaantay isagoo leh, Miyaanad xataa Ilaah ka baqin, waayo, isku xukun baad tihiin?
english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

kikuyu: Waayo, innaga waa inoo xaq, maxaa yeelay, waxaynu helnay abaalkii wixii aynu falnay, ninkanuse wax aan jid ahayn ma uu falin.
english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Ciisow, i xusuuso goortaad boqortooyadaada ku timaado.
english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtii waxaan kugu leeyahay, Maanta Firdooska ayaad igula jiri doontaa.
english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxay ahayd abbaaraha saacaddii lixaad, dhulka oo dhammuna gudcur buu noqday ilaa saacaddii sagaalaad.
english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Qorraxdu way madoobaatay, daahii macbudkuna dhexda ayuu ka kala dillaacay.
english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise cod weyn ku dhawaaqay oo yidhi, Aabbow, gacmahaaga ayaan ruuxayga u dhiibayaa. Goortuu waxaas yidhi, ayuu ruuxii bixiyey.
english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

kikuyu: Boqol-u-taliyihii goortuu arkay wixii dhacay, ayuu Ilaah ammaanay oo yidhi, Hubaal ninkanu xaq buu ahaa.
english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

kikuyu: Dadkii oo dhan oo daawasho isugu yimid, goortay arkeen wixii dhacay, ayay noqdeen iyagoo laabta garaacaya.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

kikuyu: Waxaa meel fogna ka taagnaayeen kuwii Ciise yiqiin oo dhan iyo dumarkii Galili ka soo raacay, iyagoo waxaas dayaya.
english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaa jiray nin Yuusuf la odhan jiray oo taliye ahaa, wuxuuna ahaa nin wanaagsan oo xaq ah,
english: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

kikuyu: (isaguna raalli kama ahayn waanidoodii iyo falniinkoodii), wuxuuna ahaa reer Arimataya oo ahayd magaalo Yuhuudda, kan boqortooyada Ilaah sugayay.
english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Kanu wuxuu u tegey Bilaatos oo ka baryay Ciise meydkiisii.
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Markaasuu soo dejiyey oo kafan ku duudduubay, oo wuxuu geliyey xabaal dhagax ka qodnayd, meel aan weligeed ninna la dhigin.
english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

kikuyu: Waxay ahayd Maalintii Diyaargarayska, sabtidiina waa soo dhowaanaysay.
english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

kikuyu: Dumarkii kala yimid Galili ayaa daba socday oo arkay xabaashii iyo sida meydkiisii loo dhigay.
english: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

kikuyu: Markaasay noqdeen, oo dhir udgoon iyo cadar soo diyargareeyeen. Sabtidiina way nasteen sida qaynuunka u ahaa.
english: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

kikuyu: Maalintii ugu horraysay ee toddobaadka, goortii waagii beryayay, ayay xabaashii yimaadeen, iyagoo wada dhirtii udgoonayd oo ay diyaargareeyeen.
english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

kikuyu: Oo waxay arkeen dhagixii oo xabaashii laga giringiriyey.
english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

kikuyu: Markaasay galeen, laakiin kama ay helin meydkii Rabbi Ciise.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay, intay waxaas ka sii welwelsanaayeen, in laba nin oo dhar dhalaalaya sitaa ag taagnaayeen.
english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

kikuyu: Dumarkii iyagoo cabsanaya ayay wejigooda hoos ugu foororiyeen dhulka. Markaasay ku yidhaahdeen iyaga, Maxaad kan nool uga dhex doondoonaysaan kuwii dhintay?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

kikuyu: Isagu halkan ma joogo, laakiinse waa sara kacay. Xusuusta siduu idiinla hadlay intuu Galili weli joogay,
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Wiilka Aadanaha waa in loo gacangeliyo dembilayaasha, oo iskutallaabta lagu qodbo, oo maalinta saddexaad uu soo sara kaco.
english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

kikuyu: Markaasay hadalladiisii xusuusteen.
english: They remembered his words,

kikuyu: Wayna ka soo noqdeen xabaashii, oo waxaas oo dhan ayay u sheegeen koob-iyo-tobankii iyo kuwii kale oo dhan.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

kikuyu: Waxay ahaayeen Maryantii reer Magdala, iyo Yo'anna, iyo Maryan oo ahayd Yacquub hooyadii; dumarkii kalena oo la jiray ayaa waxaas rasuulladii u sheegay.
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

kikuyu: Hadalladaas waxay la noqdeen wax aan micne lahayn, wayna rumaysan waayeen.
english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros ayaa kacay oo xabaashii u orday, markaasuu foororsaday oo wuxuu arkay maryihii keligood oo meel yaal; markaasuu ka tegey oo gurigiis ku noqday isagoo ka yaabban wixii dhacay.
english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

kikuyu: Laba ka mid ah iyaga waxay maalintaas qudheeda ku socdeen tuulo la odhan jiray Emma'us, tan Yeruusaalem u jirtay lixdan istaadiyon.
english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Waxay ka wada hadlayeen wixii dhacay oo dhan,
english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

kikuyu: oo waxay noqotay intay wada hadlayeen oo wax isweyweyddiinayeen, in Ciise qudhiisa u soo dhowaaday oo la socday.
english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa la indhasaabay si aanay u garanayn.
english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Maxay yihiin hadalladan aad isku haysaan intaad socotaan? Wayna istaageen iyagoo fool qulubsan.
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

kikuyu: Midkood oo Kale'obas la odhan jiray, ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ma adigoo keliya oo Yeruusaalem deggan oo aan ogayn wixii ayaamahan meeshaas ka dhacay?
english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Wax maxay ah? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Wixii ku saabsanaa Ciisihii Reer Naasared, kii ahaa nin nebi ah oo xoog u lahaa wax falniin iyo hadal ah Ilaah iyo dadka oo dhan hortooda,
english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

kikuyu: iyo sidii wadaaddada sare iyo taliyayaasheennii ugu dhiibeen in dhimasho lagu xukumo, oo iskutallaabta ayay ku qodbeen.
english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaannu rajaynaynay inuu yahay kan Israa'iil soo furan lahaa, laakiin waxaas oo dhan weliba maanta waa u maalintii saddexaad markii ay waxaas oo dhammi dhaceen.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

kikuyu: Weliba dumar annaga naga mid ah ayaa naga yaabsiiyey, kuwii aroortii hore xabaashii tegey.
english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

kikuyu: Goortii ay meydkiisii waayeen ayay yimaadeen iyagoo leh, Waxaannu weliba aragnay muuqad malaa'igo kuwa yidhi, Wuu nool yahay.
english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

kikuyu: Qaarkood oo nala joogay ayaa xabaashii tegey, oo waxay arkeen sidii dumarku yidhi, laakiin isagase ma ay arkin.
english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Nacasyo yahow oo qalbigoodu ka raagay inuu rumaysto wixii nebiyada oo dhammi ay ka hadleen.
english: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

kikuyu: Masiixa miyaanay waajib ku ahayn inuu waxaas oo dhan ku silco oo uu ammaantiisa galo?
english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ka bilaabay Muuse iyo nebiyada oo dhan, Qorniinka oo dhanna ayuu uga micneeyey wixii isaga qudhiisa ku saabsanaa.
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

kikuyu: Goortaasay ku soo dhowaadeen tuuladay ku socdeen, isaguna wuxuu iska dhigay mid sii fogaanaya,
english: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

kikuyu: laakiin way oggolaysiiyeen iyagoo leh, Nala joog, waayo, makhribku waa dhow yahay, maalintiina durba waa dhammaatay. Markaasuu la galay inuu la joogo.
english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay kolkuu cunto ula fadhiistay inuu kibista qaaday, oo barakeeyey, oo intuu kala jejebiyey ayuu siiyey.
english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa indhahoodu furmeen, oo isagay garteen, wuuna ka libdhay.
english: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

kikuyu: Markaasay isku yidhaahdeen, Miyaan qalbigeennu gubanin intuu jidka inagula hadlayay iyo intuu Qorniinkii inoo furayay?
english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

kikuyu: Saacaddaas qudheeda ayay kaceen oo Yeruusaalem ku noqdeen, waxayna arkeen koob-iyo-tobankii iyo kuwii la jiray oo isu ururay,
english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

kikuyu: iyagoo leh, Hubaal Sayidku waa sara kacay, oo wuxuu u muuqday Simoon.
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

kikuyu: Iyaguna waxay ka warrameen wixii jidka ka dhacay iyo siday isaga ugu garteen kala jejebintii kibista.
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

kikuyu: Intay waxyaalahaas ku hadlayeen, isaga qudhiisa ayaa dhexdooda taagnaa, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Nabadi ha idinla jirto.
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Laakiin way argaggexeen oo cabsadeen, waxayna u maleeyeen inay ruuxaan arkeen.
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Maxaad u naxaysaan? Fikirro maxay qalbigiinna uga kacayaan?
english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

kikuyu: Gacmahayga iyo cagahayga arka inaan anigu isagii ahay, i taabta oo arka, waayo, ruuxaan jiidh iyo lafo ma leh sidaad igu arkaysaan inaan leeyahay.
english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

kikuyu: Goortuu waxaas yidhi, ayuu tusay gacmihiisa iyo cagihiisa.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

kikuyu: Intay yaabsanaayeen iyagoo aan weli rumaysan farxad aawadeed, wuxuu ku yidhi, Halkan wax la cuno ma ku haysaan?
english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay waxay siiyeen in kalluun duban ah.
english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

kikuyu: Markaasuu qaaday oo hortooda ku cunay.
english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Kuwani waa hadalladaydii aan idinkula hadlay intii aan weli idinla jiray. Waa inay noqdaan wax walba oo sharciga Muuse iyo nebiyadii iyo sabuurrada laygaga qoray oo igu saabsanaa.
english: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu garashadooda u furay si ay u gartaan Qorniinka.
english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Sidaasay u qoran tahay, Waa inuu Masiixu silco, oo uu maalinta saddexaad kuwa dhintay ka soo sara kaco,
english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

kikuyu: iyo in toobaddii iyo dembidhaafka magiciisa lagu wacdiyo quruumaha oo dhan oo laga bilaabo Yeruusaalem.
english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Idinkuna waxyaalahaas ayaad markhaati ka tihiin.
english: You are witnesses of these things.

kikuyu: Oo bal eega, waxaan idiin soo dirayaa ballankii Aabbahay, laakiin magaalada jooga ilaa xoog laydinka huwiyo xagga sare.
english: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu iyaga kaxeeyey ilaa meel ku dhow Beytaniya, oo intuu gacmihii kor u qaaday ayuu barakeeyey.
english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay intuu barakaynayay inuu ka tegey, oo waxaa kor loogu qaaday samada.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

kikuyu: Markaasay isaga caabudeen, oo waxay Yeruusaalem kula noqdeen farxad weyn;
english: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

kikuyu: oo goor walbaba macbudka ayay ku jireen iyagoo Ilaah ammaanaya.
english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

kikuyu: Bilowgii waxaa jiray Ereyga, Ereyguna wuxuu la jiray Ilaah, Ereyguna wuxuu ahaa Ilaah.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

kikuyu: Isagu Ilaah buu la jiray bilowgii.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

kikuyu: Wax walba waxaa laga sameeyey xaggiisa, oo wixii la sameeyey lama samayn isaga la'aantiis.
english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

kikuyu: Isaga waxaa ku jirtay nolol, noloshuna waxay ahayd nuurka dadka.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

kikuyu: Nuurkuna wuxuu ka ifayaa gudcurka, gudcurkuna kama badin.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

kikuyu: Waxaa jiray nin xagga Ilaah laga soo diray, magiciisuna wuxuu ahaa Yooxanaa.
english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu u yimid markhaati furid, inuu u marag furo nuurka, inay dhammaan xaggiisa ka wada rumaystaan.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

kikuyu: Isagu nuurka ma uu ahayn, laakiin wuxuu u yimid inuu nuurka u marag furo.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

kikuyu: Kaasu wuxuu ahaa nuurka runta ah oo iftiimiya nin walba oo dunida yimaada.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku jiray dunida, dunidana waxaa laga sameeyey xaggiisa, oo duniduna ma ay garanayn isaga.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

kikuyu: Wuxuu u yimid kuwiisii, kuwiisiina ma ay aqbalin isaga.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

kikuyu: Laakiin in alla intii aqbashay, wuxuu siiyey amar ay carruurtii Ilaah ku noqdaan, kuwaasu waa kuwii magiciisa rumaystay,
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

kikuyu: oo aan ka dhalan dhiigga, ama doonistii jidhka, ama dad doonistiis, laakiin waxay ka dhasheen Ilaah.
english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

kikuyu: Ereyguna jidh buu noqday, oo waa ina dhex joogay, oo waxaannu aragnay ammaantiisii, taas oo ahayd ammaantii u ekayd tan Wiilka keliya ee Aabbaha, ee nimco iyo run ka buuxa.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

kikuyu: Yooxanaa waa u marag furay isaga, wuxuuna ku qayliyey oo yidhi, Kanu waa kii aan idhi, Kan iga daba imanayaa waa iga horreeyey, waayo, hortay buu jiray.
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

kikuyu: Dhammaanteen waxaynu buuxnaantiisa ka helnay nimco ka nimco.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

kikuyu: Waayo, sharciga waxaa loo soo dhiibay Muuse, laakiinse nimcada iyo runtu waxay ku yimaadeen Ciise Masiix.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ninna ma arkin Ilaah marnaba, Wiilka keliya oo laabta Aabbaha ku jira kaasaa inoo sheegay.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

kikuyu: Kanu waa maraggii Yooxanaa furay, markii Yuhuuddu Yeruusaalem uga soo direen wadaaddo iyo kuwo reer Laawi ah inay weyddiiyaan oo ku yidhaahdaan, Yaad tahay?
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

kikuyu: Isagu waa qirtay, mana uu inkirin, oo wuxuu qirtay oo yidhi, Anigu ma ihi Masiixa.
english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

kikuyu: Markaasay weyddiiyeen, Haddaba yaad tahay? Ma Eliyaas baad tahay? Wuxuuna yidhi, Ma ihi. Ma nebigii baad tahay? Wuxuuna ku jawaabay, Maya.
english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

kikuyu: Waxay haddaba ku yidhaahdeen, Yaad tahay? si aannu jawaab ugu celinno kuwii na soo diray. Yaad isku sheegaysaa?
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan ahay codka kan cidlada kaga qaylinaya, Jidka Rabbiga toosiya, siduu nebi Isayos u yidhi.
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

kikuyu: Kuwa la soo diray waxay ka yimaadeen Farrisiinta.
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

kikuyu: Markaasay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba maxaad dadka u baabtiistaa haddaanad ahayn Masiixa ama Eliyaas ama nebigii?
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

kikuyu: Yooxanaa wuxuu ugu jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan dadka ku baabtiisaa biyo, laakiin dhexdiinna waxaa jooga mid aydnaan garanaynin
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: oo ah kan iga daba imanaya, kan aanan istaahilin inaan yeelmaha kabtiisa furo.
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaasu waxay ka dhaceen Beytaniya taas oo ku taal Webi Urdun shishadiisa, oo ahayd meeshii Yooxanaa dadka ku baabtiisayay.
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

kikuyu: Maalintii labaad Yooxanaa wuxuu arkay Ciise oo ku soo socda, oo wuxuu yidhi, Bal eega Wanka Ilaah ee dembiga dunida qaadaya.
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

kikuyu: Kanu waa kii aan idhi, Waxaa iga daba imanaya nin iga horreeyey, waayo, hortay buu jiray.
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

kikuyu: Anigu ma aan aqoonin isaga, laakiin inuu Israa'iil u soo muuqdo sidaa daraaddeed ayaan u imid anigoo dadka biyo ku baabtiisa.
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

kikuyu: Yooxanaa waa marag furay isagoo leh, Waxaan arkay Ruuxa oo samada uga soo degaya sidii qoolley oo kale, wuuna dul joogsaday isagii.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

kikuyu: Anigu ma aan aqoonin isaga, laakiin kii ii soo diray inaan dadka biyo ku baabtiiso, wuxuu igu yidhi, Kii aad ku aragtid Ruuxa oo ku soo degaya oo ku dul joogsanaya, kaasu waa kan dadka ku baabtiisa Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

kikuyu: Anigu waan arkay, waana u marag furay in kanu yahay Wiilka Ilaah.
english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Mar kale maalintii dambe Yooxanaa waa taagnaa isaga iyo laba xertiisa ahayd.
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu arkay Ciise oo socda, markaasuu yidhi, Bal eega Wanka Ilaah.
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

kikuyu: Labadii xerta ahaydna way maqleen isagoo hadlaya, wayna raaceen Ciise.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise soo jeestay, waana arkay iyagoo raacaya, kolkaasuu ku yidhi, Maxaad doonaysaan? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Rabbi (waxaa lagu fasiraa Macallin), Xaggee baad deggan tahay?
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
