kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi, Kaalaya oo arka, Markaasay yimaadeen oo arkeen meeshuu degganaa, wayna la joogeen maalintaas. Goortaas waxay ahayd abbaaraha saacaddii tobnaad.
english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

kikuyu: Mid ka mid ah labadii maqashay Yooxanaa oo raacday, wuxuu ahaa Andaros, Simoon Butros walaalkiis.
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu hortii doonay walaalkiis Simoon oo ku yidhi, Waannu helnay Masiixa (kan lagu fasiro Kiristooska).
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu u geeyey Ciise. Ciisena intuu eegay ayuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Adigu waxaad tahay Simoon ina Yoonis. Waxaa lagu odhan doonaa Keeyfas (oo fasirkiisu yahay Butros).
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

kikuyu: Maalintii labaad wuxuu doonayay inuu Galili tago, oo wuxuu helay Filibos. Ciisena wuxuu ku yidhi, I soo raac.
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

kikuyu: Filibos wuxuu ahaa reer Beytsayda taas oo ah magaaladii Andaros iyo Butros.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Filibos wuxuu doonay Nataana'el oo ku yidhi, Waxaannu helnay kii Muuse sharciga ku qoray wax isaga ku saabsan, oo nebiyadiina ay qoreen wax isaga ku saabsan, waana Ciisihii reer Naasared oo ah ina Yuusuf.
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

kikuyu: Nataana'el wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma wax wanaagsan baa ka iman kara Naasared? Markaasaa Filibos wuxuu ku yidhi, Kaalay oo arag.
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu arkay Nataana'el oo ku soo socda, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eeg, kanu waa mid reer Israa'iil oo run ah oo aan khiyaano lahayn.
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Nataana'el wuxuu ku yidhi, Xaggee baad igu tiqiin? Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Intaan Filibos kuu yeedhin, markaad geedkii berdaha hoostiisa joogtay, ayaan ku arkay.
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Nataana'el u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macallimow, waxaad tahay Wiilka Ilaah, oo waxaad tahay boqorkii Israa'iil.
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ma waxaad u rumaysatay odhaatinkii aan kugu idhi, Geedka berdaha hoostiisa ayaan kugu arkay? Waxaad arki doontaa wax waxyaalahaas ka waaweyn.
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Waxaad arki doontaan samadoo furan iyo malaa'igaha Ilaah oo kor u kacaya oo ku soo degaya Wiilka Aadanaha.
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

kikuyu: Maalintii saddexaad waxaa Kaana tii Galili jiray aroos, Ciise hooyadiisna halkaasay joogtay.
english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

kikuyu: Waxaana arooska loogu yeedhay Ciise iyo xertiisii.
english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

kikuyu: Markii khamrigu dhammaaday Ciise hooyadiis waxay isaga ku tidhi, Khamri ma ay qabaan.
english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu iyada ku yidhi, Islaan yahay, aniga iyo adiga maxaa inoo dhexeeya? Saacaddaydu weli ma iman.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa hooyadiis waxay midiidinyadii ku tidhi, Wax kastuu idinku yidhaahdo, yeela.
english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

kikuyu: Meeshaas waxaa yiil lix ashuun oo dhagax ah, oo loo dhigay caadada Yuhuudda oo daahirinta, mid kastaana wuxuu qaadi jiray qiyaas laba ama saddex metritas.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Ashuummada biyo ka buuxiya, goortaasay buuxiyeen ilaa girgirka.
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Ka soo dhura oo u geeya ka miiska arooska madaxda u ah, wayna u geeyeen.
english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

kikuyu: Kii madaxda ahaa markuu dhadhamiyey biyihii khamriga noqday ma uu ogayn meel ay ka yimaadeen, laakiin midiidinyadii oo soo dhuray way ogaayeen; markaasaa kii madaxda ahaa u yeedhay ninkii arooska ahaa,
english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

kikuyu: oo ku yidhi, Nin kastaa marka hore wuxuu soo saaraa khamriga wanaagsan, oo markay u cabbaan siday doonayaan dabadeedna ayuu keenaa kan liita; adiguse khamriga wanaagsan ilaa haddeer ayaad dib u dhigtay.
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

kikuyu: Calaamooyinka Ciise tii ugu horraysay waxay ahayd tan uu ku sameeyey Kaana tii Galili, oo wuxuu ku muujiyey ammaantiisii, xertiisiina way rumaysteen.
english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

kikuyu: Waxaas dabadeed wuxuu tegey Kafarna'um, waxaana la socday hooyadiis iyo walaalihiis iyo xertiisii, oo maalmo aan badnayn ayay meeshaas joogeen.
english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

kikuyu: Iiddii Kormaridda oo Yuhuudda waa dhowayd, oo Ciisena wuxuu u kacay Yeruusaalem.
english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Wuxuu macbudka ku arkay kuwa ku iibinaya dibiyo iyo ido iyo qoolleyo, iyo kuwa fadhiya oo lacagta bedbeddelaya.
english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

kikuyu: Markaasuu xadhko karbaash ka sameeyey, kulligoodna ayuu macbudka ka eryay, dibiyada iyo idaha labadaba, lacagtiina wuu ka daadiyey kuwii bedbeddelayay, miisaskoodiina wuu rogay.
english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

kikuyu: Kuwii qoolleyaha iibinayayna wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxyaalahan halkan ka qaada. Guriga Aabbahay ha ka dhigina guri baayacmushtari.
english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

kikuyu: Xertiisii waxay xusuusteen in la qoray. Qiiradaan gurigaaga u qabo ayaa i gubaysa.
english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Yuhuuddu waa u jawaabtay oo ku tidhi isaga, Calaamadee baad na tusaysaa waxaad waxyaalahaas u samaynayso?
english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

kikuyu: Ciisena waa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Macbudkan dumiya, oo saddex maalmood dabadeed ayaan kicin doonaa.
english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

kikuyu: Yuhuuddu haddaba waxay yidhaahdeen, Lix iyo afartan sannadood ayaa macbudkan la dhisayay, adiguna ma waxaad ku kicinaysaa saddex maalmood?
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

kikuyu: Isaguse wuxuu ka hadlayay macbudka jidhkiisa ah.
english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed markuu ka soo sara kacay kuwii dhintay, xertiisii way soo xusuusteen inuu taas ka hadlay, wayna rumaysteen Qorniinka iyo hadalkii Ciise yidhi.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

kikuyu: Markuu Yeruusaalem joogay wakhtigii Iiddii Kormaridda dad badan ayaa magiciisa rumaystay markay arkeen calaamooyinkuu sameeyey.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise qudhiisu iskuma hallayn iyaga, waayo dadka oo dhan ayuu yiqiin,
english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

kikuyu: oo uma baahnayn in laga marag furo dadka, waayo, isaga qudhiisu waa yiqiin waxa dadka ku jira.
english: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

kikuyu: Waxaa jiray nin ka mid ahaa Farrisiinta oo la odhan jiray Nikodemos oo Yuhuudda taliye u ahaa.
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

kikuyu: Isagu habeenkuu u yimid Ciise, wuxuuna ku yidhi, Macallimow, waannu og nahay inaad tahay macallin ka yimid Ilaah, waayo, ninna ma samayn karo calaamooyinkan aad samayso haddaan Ilaah la jirin.
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Runtii, runtii waxaan kugu leeyahay, Qof haddaanu mar kale dhalan, boqortooyadii Ilaah arki kari maayo.
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Nikodemos wuxuu ku yidhi, Sidee baa nin mar kale u dhalan karaa isagoo duq ah? Miyuu mar kale uurkii hooyadiis geli karaa oo ka dhalan karaa?
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

kikuyu: Ciise baa ugu jawaabay, Runtii, runtii, waxaan kugu leeyahay, Qof haddaanu ka dhalan biyo iyo Ruuxa, boqortooyadii Ilaah geli kari maayo.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Waxa jidhka ka dhashaa waa jidh, waxa Ruuxa ka dhashaana waa ruux.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

kikuyu: Ha la yaabin haddaan ku leeyahay, Waa inaad mar kale dhalataan.
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

kikuyu: Dabayshu way u dhacdaa meeshay doonto, waxaadna maqashaa xiinkeeda, laakiin ma ogid meeshay ka timaado iyo meeshay u kacdo; waa sidaas oo kale qof kasta oo Ruuxa ka dhasha.
english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

kikuyu: Nikodemos ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Sidee baa waxyaalahaas u noqon karaan?
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ma waxaad tahay macallinka Israa'iil, oo aadan weliba waxyaalahaasna garanayn?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan ku leeyahay, Waxaannu naqaan ayaannu ka hadalnaa, oo waxaannu aragnay ayaannu ka marag furnaa, idinkuna maraggayaga ma aqbashaan.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

kikuyu: Haddaan wixii dunida idiin sheegay oo aad rumaysan weydeen, sidee baad u rumaysanaysaan haddaan waxa jannada idiin sheego?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

kikuyu: Ninna jannada kor uma tegin, kii jannada ka soo degay maahee, waana Wiilka Aadanaha oo jannada jooga.
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Sidii Muuse abeesadii kor ugu qaaday cidlada, sidaasoo kale Wiilka Aadanaha waa in kor loo qaado,
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

kikuyu: in mid kastoo isaga rumaystaa uu lahaado nolosha weligeed ah.
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

kikuyu: Ilaah intuu dunida jacayl u qabay ayuu siiyey Wiilkiisa keliya oo dhashay in mid kastoo isaga rumaystaa uusan lumin laakiinse uu lahaado nolosha weligeed ah.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

kikuyu: Ilaah Wiilka uguma soo dirin dunida inuu xukumo dunida, laakiin wuxuu u soo diray inay dunidu ku badbaaddo isaga.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

kikuyu: Kii isaga rumaystaa ma xukumna, laakiinse kii aan isaga rumaysan, hore ayaa loo xukumay, maxaa yeelay, wuxuusan rumaysan magaca Wiilka Ilaah oo keliya oo dhashay.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

kikuyu: Kanu waa xukunka, nuurka ayaa dunida yimid, dadkiise waxay nuurkii ka jeclaadeen gudcurka, maxaa yeelay, shuqulladoodu shar bay ahaayeen.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

kikuyu: Nin kastoo shar falaa nuurkuu nebcaadaa, umana yimaado nuurka, si aan shuqulladiisa loogu canaanan.
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kii runta falaa, nuurkuu yimaadaa si shuqulladiisu u muuqdaan in Ilaah laga sameeyey.
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

kikuyu: Waxaas dabadeed Ciise iyo xertiisii waxay yimaadeen dalka Yahuudiya, oo meeshaas ayuu iyaga la joogay oo dad ku baabtiisay.
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

kikuyu: Yooxanaana wuxuu dad ku baabtiisayay Caynoon oo ku dhow Saalim, waayo, meeshaasu waxay lahayd biyo badan, iyaguna way yimaadeen, waana la baabtiisay.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

kikuyu: Waayo, Yooxanaa weli xabsiga laguma tuurin.
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed waxaa ka dhex kacay Yooxanaa xertiisii iyo nin Yuhuudi ahaa weyddiis oo daahirinta ku saabsan.
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

kikuyu: Markaasay u yimaadeen Yooxanaa oo ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, kii kula jiray Webi Urdun shishadiisa oo aad marag u furtay ayaa dad baabtiisaya, oo dadka oo dhan way u imanayaan.
english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

kikuyu: Yooxanaa waa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ninna waxba ma heli karo haddaan jannada laga siin.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

kikuyu: Idinka qudhiinnu markhaatiyaal baad tihiin inaan idhi, Anigu ma ihi Masiixa, laakiin hortiisa ayaa lay soo diray.
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

kikuyu: Kii aroosadda qabaa waa arooska, laakiin saaxiibka arooska oo ag taagan oo maqla isaga, aad buu ugu farxaa codkii arooska daraaddiis. Sidaa aawadeed farxaddaydu waa dhan tahay.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

kikuyu: Isagu waa inuu kordho, aniguse waa inaan yaraado.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

kikuyu: Kii xagga sare ka yimaadaa, dhammaan ayuu ka sarreeyaa; kii dunida ka yimaadaana waa kii dunida, oo wuxuu ka hadlaa dunida. Kii jannada ka yimaadaa, dhammaan ayuu ka sarreeyaa.
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

kikuyu: Wuxuu arkay oo maqlay waxaas ayuu ka marag furaa, ninnana maraggiisa ma aqbalo.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

kikuyu: Kii maraggiisa aqbalay wuxuu xaqiijiyey in Ilaah run yahay.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii Ilaah soo diray ayaa ereygii Ilaah ku hadla, maxaa yeelay, isagu qiyaas kuma siiyo Ruuxa.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

kikuyu: Aabbuhu wuu jecel yahay Wiilka, oo wax walba ayuu gacanta u geliyey.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

kikuyu: Kii Wiilka rumaystaa, wuxuu leeyahay nolosha weligeed ah, kii aan Wiilka rumaysanse, nolosha ma arki doono, laakiin cadhadii Ilaah ayaa ku taal isaga.
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

kikuyu: Kolkii Ciise ogaaday inay Farrisiintu maqleen inuu yeelanayay oo baabtiisayay xer ka badan intii Yooxanaa
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

kikuyu: (in kastoo Ciise qudhiisu uusan baabtiisin, laakiin xertiisu way baabtiisayeen),
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

kikuyu: ayuu Yuhuudiya ka tegey, wuxuuna mar kale u kacay Galili.
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu lahaa inuu Samaariya dhex maro.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

kikuyu: Haddaba wuxuu yimid magaalada Samaariya, oo Sukhar la odhan jiray, oo ku dhowayd dalkii Yacquub siiyey wiilkiisii Yuusuf.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

kikuyu: Waxaana meeshaas jiray ceelkii Yacquub. Haddaba Ciise oo sodcaal ku soo daalay, wuxuu fadhiistay ceelka agtiisa. Saacaddiina waxay ku qiyaasnayd lixda.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa timid naag reer Samaariya ah inay biyo dhaansato. Kolkaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi iyada, I waraabi.
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, xertiisii magaaladay ku maqnaayeen inay cunto soo iibsadaan.
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

kikuyu: Naagtii reer Samaariya ahayd waxay haddaba ku tidhi isaga, Sidee baad, adigoo Yuhuudi ah, biyo ii weyddiisanaysaa, anigoo naag reer Samaariya ah? (Waayo, dan iskuma leh Yuhuudda iyo reer Samaariya.)
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

kikuyu: Ciise waa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi iyada, Haddaad garanaysid hadiyaddii Ilaah iyo kuu yahay kan kugu leh, I waraabi, adigu waad weyddiisan lahayd isaga, oo wuxuu ku siin lahaa biyaha nool.
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

kikuyu: Naagtii waxay ku tidhi, Sayidow, waxaad biyo ku dhaansato ma haysatid, ceelkuna wuu dheer yahay. Haddaba xaggee baad ka helaysaa biyaha nool?
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

kikuyu: Miyaad ka weyn tahay awowahayagii Yacquub oo ceelka na siiyey oo isaga qudhiisu ka cabbay iyo wiilashiisii iyo xoolihiisuba?
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi iyada, Kii kasta oo biyahan ka cabbaa, mar kale wuu harraadi doonaa,
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

kikuyu: laakiin ku alla kii ka cabba biyahaan siin doono, weligiis ma harraadi doono, laakiin biyahaan siin doono waxay gudihiisa ku noqon doonaan il biyo ka duulayaan tan iyo nolosha weligeed ah.
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

kikuyu: Naagtii waxay ku tidhi, Sayidow, biyahan i sii inaanan haddana harraadin oo aanan halkan iman inaan ka dhaansado.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Tag oo ninkaagii u soo yeedh, oo halkan kaalay.
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

kikuyu: Naagtii ayaa u jawaabtay oo ku tidhi, Nin ma lihi. Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Run baad ku hadashay, Nin ma lihi.
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

kikuyu: Waayo, shan nin baad lahayd, kan aad haddeer haysatidna ninkaagii ma aha. Taas run baad ku sheegtay.
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

kikuyu: Naagtii waxay ku tidhi, Sayidow, waan gartay inaad nebi tahay.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

kikuyu: Awowayaashayo buurtan ayay ku caabudi jireen, idinkuse waxaad tidhaahdaan, Yeruusaalem waa meeshii la leeyahay in lagu caabudo.
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Naag yahay, i rumee, saacaddu waa imanaysaa markii aydnaan Aabbaha ku caabudi doonin ama buurtan ama Yeruusaalem midnaba.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad caabuddaan waxaydnaan oqoon, annaguse waxaannu caabudnaa waxaannu naqaan, waayo, badbaadintu waxay ka timaadaa Yuhuudda.
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

kikuyu: Laakiin saacaddii baa imanaysa, waana joogtaa imminkada, markii caabudayaasha runta ihi ay Aabbaha ku caabudi doonaan ruuxa iyo runta, waayo, Aabbuhu wuxuu doonayaa caabudayaashaas oo kale.
english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

kikuyu: Ilaah waa Ruux, kuwa caabudaa isagana waa inay ku caabudaan ruuxa iyo runta.
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

kikuyu: Naagtii waxay ku tidhi, Waa ogahay Masiixu inuu imanayo (kan Kiristoos la yidhaahdo); oo markuu yimaado, wax walba ayuu noo sheegi doonaa.
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Anigoo kula hadlaya ayaa ah isaga.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

kikuyu: Isla markii waxaa timid xertiisii, wayna la yaabeen markay arkeen inuu naag la hadlayo. Weliba ninna ma odhan, Maxaad doonaysaa? amase, Maxaad ula hadlaysaa iyada?
english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed naagtii ayaa ashuunkeedii ka tagtay, oo magaaladay u baxday, oo waxay ku tidhi dadkii,
english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

kikuyu: Kaalaya oo arka ninkii ii sheegay wax walba oo aan sameeyey. Miyaanu kani ahayn Masiixa?
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

kikuyu: Markaasay magaaladii ka soo baxeen, wayna u imanayeen isagii.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay xertiisii baryeen iyagoo leh, Macallimow, wax cun.
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan haystaa cunto aan cuno oo aydnaan ogayn.
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

kikuyu: Haddaba xertiisii waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Ma loo keenay wuxuu cuno?
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Cuntadaydu waa inaan sameeyo doonistii kii i soo diray oo aan shuqulkiisa dhammeeyo.
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

kikuyu: Miyaydnaan odhanin, Waxaa weli hadhay afar bilood oo markaas ayaa beerta la gooynayaa? Bal eega, waxaan idin leeyahay, Indhihiinna kor u qaada oo daya beeraha inay u cad yihiin beergooyska.
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

kikuyu: Kii gooyaa mushahaaruu helaa, wuxuuna midho u ururiyaa nolosha weligeed ah, inay kii beera iyo kii gooyaaba isla farxaan.
english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

kikuyu: Hadalku waa ku run kan, Mid baa beera, mid kalena waa gooyaa.
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

kikuyu: Waxaan idiin diray inaad gooysaan wixii aydnaan ku hawshoon. Kuwa kale baa hawshooday, hawshoodiina waad gasheen.
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

kikuyu: Waxaa magaaladaas ka rumaystay isaga dad badan oo reer Samaariya ah, hadalkii naagta aawadiis, markay marag furtay oo tidhi, Wuxuu ii sheegay wax walba oo aan sameeyey.
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed markii dadka reer Samaariya ah u yimaadeen isaga, way baryeen inuu la joogo, wuxuuna halkaas joogay laba maalmood.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

kikuyu: Markaasaa kuwo kale oo badani rumaysteen hadalkiisii aawadiis,
english: Many more believed because of his word.

kikuyu: oo waxay naagtii ku yidhaahdeen, Imminka waxaannu u rumaysanaynaa ma aha hadalkaaga aawadiis, maxaa yeelay, qudhayadu waannu maqalnay, waannuna naqaan kanu inuu runtii yahay Badbaadiyaha dunida.
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

kikuyu: Labadaas maalmood dabadeed meeshaas ayuu ka tegey oo Galili aaday.
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

kikuyu: Oo Ciise ayaa ka marag kacay inaan nebi waddankiis murwad ku lahayn.
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

kikuyu: Haddaba markuu Galili yimid, dadkii Galili way soo dhoweeyeen, iyagoo arkay wuxuu ku sameeyey Yeruusaalem oo dhan wakhtigii iidda, waayo, iyaguna iiddii way tageen.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

kikuyu: Haddaba mar kale ayuu yimid Kaana tii Galili oo ahayd meeshuu biyihii khamriga kaga dhigay. Meeshaasna waxaa joogay sirkaal wiilkiisii ku bukay Kafarna'um.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

kikuyu: Isagu markuu maqlay inuu Ciise Yahuudiya ka yimid oo Galili gaadhay, ayuu u tegey oo ka baryay inuu u yimaado oo wiilkiisa bogsiiyo, waayo, dhimashuu u dhowaa.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaanad calaamooyin iyo yaabab arkin, marnaba ma rumaysan doontaan.
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

kikuyu: Sirkaalkii wuxuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, kaalay intaan wiilkaygu dhiman.
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Soco, wiilkaagii waa nool yahay. Markaasaa ninkii rumaystay hadalkii Ciise ku yidhi, wuuna socday.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

kikuyu: Intuu socday ayaa addoommadiisii ka hor yimaadeen, iyagoo leh, Wiilkaagii waa nool yahay.
english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu iyagii weyddiiyey saacadduu ladnaaday. Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Shalayto saacaddii toddobaad ayaa qandhadii daysay.
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa aabbuhu gartay inay saacaddaas ahayd saacaddii Ciise ku yidhi, Wiilkaagii waa nool yahay. Markaasaa isagii qudhiisu rumaystay iyo kuwii gurigiisii joogay oo dhan.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

kikuyu: Haddaba tanu waa calaamadii labaad oo Ciise sameeyey markuu Yahuudiya ka tegey oo Galili yimid.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

kikuyu: Waxaas dabadeed waxaa jirtay iiddii Yuhuudda, oo Ciise ayaa Yeruusaalem u kacay.
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Waxaa Yeruusaalem jirtay, Albaabka Idaha agtiisa, war biyo ah oo af Cibraani lagu yidhaahda Beytesda oo leh shan balbaladood.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

kikuyu: Meelahaas waxaa jiifay dad badan oo buka oo indha la' oo laxaad la' oo curyaan ah. Waxay sugayeen biyuhu inay dhaqaaqaan.
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, malaa'igta Rabbiga ayaa marmar warta ku soo degi jirtay oo biyaha qasi jirtay; oo kii ugu hor galay biyihii markii la qasay dabadeed wuu ka bogsaday cudur kastuu qabay.
english: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa meeshaas joogay nin siddeed iyo soddon sannadood bukay.
english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

kikuyu: Markii Ciise arkay isagoo jiifa, oo gartay inuu wakhti dheer bukay, wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma doonaysaa inaad bogsato?
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

kikuyu: Ninkii bukay wuxuu u jawaabay, oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, nin ma lihi inuu warta igu rido markii biyaha la qaso, laakiin markaan imaado, mid kale ayaa iga hor gala.
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Kac oo sariirtaada qaado oo soco.
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

kikuyu: Markiiba ninkii waa bogsaday, wuuna qaatay sariirtiisii oo socday. Maalintaas waxay ahayd sabtidii.
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Yuhuuddu waxay kii la bogsiiyey ku yidhaahdeen, Waa sabti, oo xalaal kuuma aha inaad sariirtaada qaadatid.
english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

kikuyu: Laakiin wuu u jawaabay, oo ku yidhi, Kii i bogsiiyey ayaa igu yidhi, Sariirtaada qaado oo soco.
english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

kikuyu: Oo waxay weyddiiyeen, oo ku yidhaahdeen, Yuu yahay ninkii kugu yidhi, Sariirtaada qaado oo soco?
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

kikuyu: Kii la bogsiiyeyse ma uu oqoonin kuu ahaa, waayo, Ciise waa tegey, maxaa yeelay, dad badan ayaa meeshaas joogay.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

kikuyu: Waxaas dabadeed Ciise wuxuu isaga ka helay macbudka oo ku yidhi, Bal eeg, waad bogsatay, mar dambe ha dembaabin inaan wax ka sii xumi kugu dhicin.
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa ninkii tegey, wuuna u sheegay Yuhuuddii inuu ninkii bogsiiyey Ciise ahaa.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Yuhuuddu Ciise way silciyeen, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu waxyaalahaas sameeyey sabtidii.
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Aabbahay tan iyo imminka ayuu shaqeeyaa, aniguna waa shaqeeyaa.
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed ayaa Yuhuuddu aad u sii dooneen inay dilaan, sababtu ma ahayn sabtidii uu jebiyey keliya, laakiin waxay ahayd inuu Ilaah ugu yeedhay Aabbihiis, iyo inuu isagu Ilaah iskala mid dhigay.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Wiilku keli ahaantiis waxba ma samayn karo, wuxuu arko Aabbahoo samaynaya mooyaane. Wax kastoo isagu sameeyo ayaa Wiilkuna sidiisa u sameeyaa.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

kikuyu: Waayo, Aabbuhu Wiilkuu jecel yahay, oo wuxuu tusaa wuxuu isagu sameeyo oo dhan, oo wuxuuna tusi doonaa shuqullo kuwan ka waaweyn inaad la yaabtaan.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

kikuyu: Sida Aabbuhu kuwa dhintay u kiciyo oo u nooleeyo ayuu Wiilkuna sidaas oo kale u nooleeyaa kuwuu doonayo.
english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

kikuyu: Aabbuhu ninna ma xukumo, laakiin xukunka oo dhan wuxuu siiyey Wiilka,
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

kikuyu: in dadka oo dhammu Wiilka maamuuso siday Aabbaha u maamuusaan. Kii aan Wiilka maamuusi, ma maamuuso Aabbaha soo diray.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kii ereygayga maqla oo rumaysta kii i soo diray, wuxuu leeyahay nolosha weligeed ah, xukunna geli maayo, laakiin dhimashadii ayuu ka soo gudbay oo nolosha u soo gudbay.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Saacaddu waa imanaysaa, waana joogtaa, markii kuwii dhintay codkii Wiilka Ilaah ay maqli doonaan, oo kuwa maqlaana way noolaan doonaan.
english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

kikuyu: Sida Aabbuhu nolol isugu leeyahay, sidaasuu Wiilka u siiyey inuu nolol isugu lahaado.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna siiyey amar uu wax ku xukumo, maxaa yeelay, waa Wiilka Aadanaha.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

kikuyu: Taas ha la yaabina, waayo, saacaddu waa imanaysaa markii kuwa xabaalaha ku jiraa dhammaantood ay codkiisa maqli doonaan,
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

kikuyu: wayna ka soo bixi doonaan, kuwa wanaagga falay ilaa sarakicidda nolosha, kuwa sharka falayna ilaa sarakicidda xukunka.
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

kikuyu: Waxba keli ahaantayda ma samayn karo. Sidaan wax u maqlo ayaan u xukumaa, xukunkayguna waa xaq, waayo, doonistayda ma doono, waxaanse doonaa doonista kii i soo diray.
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

kikuyu: Haddaan isu marag furo, maraggaygu run ma aha.
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa jira mid kale oo ii marag fura, waanan ogahay maragguu ii furaa inuu run yahay.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

kikuyu: Waxaad cid u soo dirteen Yooxanaa, wuuna u marag furay runta.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

kikuyu: Aniguse xagga dadka marag kama aan qaato, laakiin waxyaalahan waxaan u idhaahdaa inaad badbaaddaan.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu ahaa laambad baxaysa oo ifaysa, idinkuna waxaad doonayseen inaad saacad ku faraxdaan nuurkiisa.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

kikuyu: Laakiin maraggaan leeyahay waa ka weyn yahay kii Yooxanaa, waayo, shuqullada Aabbuhu i siiyey inaan dhammeeyo waa kuwaan hadda samaynayo, wayna ii marag furayaan in Aabbuhu i soo diray.
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

kikuyu: Aabbihii i soo dirayna waa ii marag furay. Idinkuna codkiisa ma maqlin goornaba, mana aydnaan arkin muuqiisa.
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

kikuyu: Mana haysataan ereygiisa oo idinku sii jira, waayo, kii uu soo diray waad rumaysan weydeen.
english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

kikuyu: Qorniinka ayaad baadhaan, waayo, waxaad u malaynaysaan inaad nolosha weligeed ah ka helaysaan, waana iyaga kuwa ii marag furayaa.
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

kikuyu: Idinkuna dooni maysaan inaad ii timaadaan inaad nolol lahaataan.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

kikuyu: Anigu dadka ammaan kama qaato.
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

kikuyu: Laakiin waan idin aqaan inaan jacaylka Ilaah idinku jirin.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku imid Aabbahay magiciis, idinkuna waad i aqbali weydeen. Haddiise mid kale magiciisa ku yimaado, kaasaad aqbalaysaan.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

kikuyu: Sidee baad u rumaysan kartaan, idinkoo dhexdiinna ammaan iska aqbalaya, oo aydnaan doonayn ammaanta ka timaada Ilaaha keligiis ah?
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

kikuyu: Ha u malaynina inaan Aabbaha idinku ashtakaynayo: kan idin ashtakaynayaa waa Muuse, kii aad isku hallayseen.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaad Muuse rumaysateen, anigana waad i rumaysan lahaydeen, waayo, wax buu iga qoray.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaydnan rumaysan wuxuu qoray, sidee baad u rumaysan doontaan ereyadayda?
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

kikuyu: Waxaas dabadeed Ciise wuxuu u kacay dhinaca kale oo badda Galili oo ahayd baddii Tiberiyas.
english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

kikuyu: Dad badanna way raaceen, waayo, waxay arkeen calaamooyinkii uu ku sameeyey kuwii bukay.
english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ciise buurta u baxay, halkaasna ayuu xertiisii la fadhiistay.
english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Markaasna waxaa dhowayd Iiddii Kormaridda ee ahayd iiddii Yuhuudda.
english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise intuu indhihiisii kor u qaaday, ayuu wuxuu arkay dad badan oo soo socda, wuxuuna Filibos ku yidhi, Xaggee baynu kibis ka soo iibinnaa inay kuwanu cunaan?
english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu waxaas ugu yidhi inuu jirrabo isaga, waayo, isaga qudhiisu waa ogaa wuxuu samayn lahaa.
english: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

kikuyu: Filibos wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Laba boqol oo dinaar oo kibis ahi kuma filla in nin walba wax yar qaato.
english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa xertiisii midkood oo Andaros la odhan jiray oo Simoon Butros walaalkiis ahaa wuxuu ku yidhi,
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

kikuyu: Halkan waxaa jooga wiil qaba shan kibsood oo shaciir ah iyo laba kalluun, laakiin waxaasi maxay u tarayaan dad sidan u badan?
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise yidhi, Dadka fadhiisiya. Meeshaasina waxay lahayd doog badan. Haddaba nimankii waa fadhiisteen, tiradooduna qiyaastii waxay ahayd shan kun.
english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise kibistuu qaaday, oo goortuu mahadnaqay ayuu u qaybiyey kuwii fadhiyey, sidaas oo kalena kalluunkii intay doonayeen.
english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

kikuyu: Markay wada dhergeen, wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi, Ururiya jajabkii hadhay, waxba yaanay ka hallaabin.
english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed ayay ururiyeen, oo laba iyo toban dambiilood ayay ka buuxiyeen jajabkii ka hadhay kuwii shantii kibsood oo shaciirka ahayd cunay.
english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

kikuyu: Haddaba dadkii markay arkeen calaamadii uu sameeyey, waxay yidhaahdeen, Runtii, kanu waa nebigii dunida iman lahaa.
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu gartay inay imanayaan inay qabtaan oo boqor ka dhigaan, sidaas daraaddeed ayuu mar kale keligiis buurta u baxay.
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

kikuyu: Markii makhribkii la gaadhay ayaa xertiisii badda u baxday.
english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

kikuyu: Waxayna fuuleen doonni, oo badday ka tallaabayeen ilaa Kafarna'um. Oo markiiba gudcur bay ahayd, Ciisena weli uma uu iman.
english: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

kikuyu: Badduna way isku kacday, dabayl weyn oo dhacday aawadeed.
english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

kikuyu: Haddaba markay seeb ku wadeen qiyaas shan iyo labaatan ama soddon istaadiyon, waxay arkeen Ciise oo badda ku dul socda oo doonnida u soo dhowaanaya, wayna baqeen.
english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa aniga ee ha baqina.
english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed waxay doonayeen inay doonnida ku qaadaan, oo markiiba doonnidu waxay joogtay dhulkay u socdeen.
english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

kikuyu: Maalintii labaad dadkii badnaa oo badda dhankeeda kale taagnaa, waxay arkeen inaan doonni kale joogin mid maahee, oo aan Ciisena taas la fuulin xertiisii, laakiin in xertiisii keligood baxeen.
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa Tiberiyas ka yimid doonniyo, wayna u soo dhowaadeen meeshii kibistii lagu cunay markuu Rabbigu mahadnaqay dabadeed.
english: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

kikuyu: Markii dadkii badnaa arkeen inaan Ciise halkaas joogin iyo xertiisiiba, waxay fuuleen doonniyihii, wayna yimaadeen Kafarna'um, iyagoo Ciise doondoonaya.
english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

kikuyu: Oo markay isaga ka heleen badda dhinaceeda kale, waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, goormaad halkan timid?
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Iima doondoontaan calaamooyinkii aad aragteen aawadood ee waa kibistii aad cunteen oo aad ka dheregteen aawadeed.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

kikuyu: Ha u shaqaynina cuntada hallaabaysa, laakiin u shaqeeya cuntada sii jiraysa ilaa nolosha weligeed ah ee Wiilka Aadanahu idin siin doono, waayo, isaga Aabbaha Ilaaha ah ayaa caddeeyey.
english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaannu yeelnaa si aannu shuqullada Ilaah u samayno?
english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Kanu waa shuqulkii Ilaah inaad rumaysataan kii uu soo diray.
english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

kikuyu: Sidaa darteed waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba calaamadee baad samaynaysaa inaannu aragno oo ku rumaysanno? Maxaad, samaynaysaa?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

kikuyu: Awowayaasheen waxay cidlada ku cuneen maannada sidii loo qoray, Wuxuu samada ka siiyey kibis ay cunaan.
english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Muuse samada idinkama siin kibistii, laakiin Aabbahay baa samada idinka siiya kibista runta ah.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

kikuyu: Waayo, kibista Ilaah waa kan samada ka soo degay oo dunida nolosha siiya.
english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, kibistan mar walba na sii.
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay kibista nolosha. Kii ii yimaadaa ma gaajoon doono, kii i rumaystaana ma harraadi doono weligiis.
english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idiin sheegay inaad i aragteen, mase rumaysataan.
english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

kikuyu: Dhammaan wuxuu Aabbuhu i siiyo way ii iman doonaan, oo kii ii yimaadana ma eryi doono.
english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan samada uga soo degay ma aha inaan doonistayda yeelo, laakiinse inaan yeelo doonista kii i soo diray.
english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

kikuyu: Tanu waa doonistii kii i soo diray in kuwii uu dhammaan i siiyey aanan midna ka lumin, laakiin inaan maalinta u dambaysa soo sara kiciyo.
english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

kikuyu: Waayo, tanu waa doonistii Aabbahay in mid kasta oo Wiilka arka oo rumaysta uu nolosha weligeed ah lahaado, aniguna maalinta u dambaysa waan soo sara kicin doonaa.
english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed Yuhuuddu way gunuuneceen, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay kibista samada ka soo degtay.
english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

kikuyu: Waxayna yidhaahdeen, Kanu miyaanu ahayn Ciise, ina Yuusuf, kaannu aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis naqaan? Hadda sidee buu u leeyahay, Samada baan ka soo degay?
english: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Ha ka gunuunecina dhexdiinna.
english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

kikuyu: Ninna iima iman karo hadduusan Aabbihii i soo diray soo jiidin, aniguna maalinta u dambaysa waan soo sara kicin doonaa.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

kikuyu: Waxaa ku qoran kitaabbadii nebiyada, Kulligood Ilaah baa wax bari doona. Mid kasta oo Aabbaha wax ka maqlay oo ka bartay waa ii yimaadaa.
english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

kikuyu: Ma aha in nin arkay Aabbaha, kii Ilaah ka yimid mooyaane. Isagu waa arkay Aabbaha.
english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kii i rumaystaa, wuxuu leeyahay nolosha weligeed ah.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay kibista nolosha.
english: I am the bread of life.

kikuyu: Awowayaashiin waxay cidlada ku cuneen maannada, oo ay dhinteen.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

kikuyu: Tanu waa kibistii samada ka soo degtay, in qof kasta cuno oo uusan dhiman.
english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay kibista nool ee samada ka soo degtay. Haddii qof uun kibistan cuno, weligiis wuu noolaan doonaa. Oo kibistaan siin doonaa waa jidhkayga, nolosha dunida aawadeed.
english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Yuhuuddu way isla murmeen iyagoo leh, Kanu sidee buu jidhkiisa inoo siin karaa inaannu cunno?
english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

kikuyu: Ciise haddaba wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Haddaydnan jidhkii Wiilka Aadanaha cunin oo dhiiggiisa cabbin nolosha kuma lihidin gudihiinna.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

kikuyu: Oo kii jidhkayga cuna oo dhiiggayga cabba wuxuu leeyahay nolosha weligeed ah, oo maalinta u dambaysa waan soo sara kicin doonaa.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

kikuyu: Waayo, runtii jidhkaygu waa cunto, dhiiggayguna runtii waa wax la cabbo.
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

kikuyu: Kii jidhkayga cuna oo dhiiggayga cabba wuu igu jiraa, anna waan ku jiraa isaga.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

kikuyu: Sida Aabbaha nool ii soo diray, aniguna Aabbahaan u noolahay daraaddiis, sidaasaa kii i cunaa isaguna u nolaan doonaa daraadday.
english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

kikuyu: Tanu waa kibista samada ka soo degtay, ma aha sida tii awowayaashiin cuneen oo ay dhinteen. Kii kibistan cunaa, weligiis wuu noolaan doonaa.
english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas ayuu sunagogga kaga dhex hadlay intuu Kafarna'um wax ku barayay.
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed xertiisii badidood markay maqleen, waxay yidhaahdeen, Hadalkaasu waa adag yahay. Yaa maqli kara?
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise qudhiisu wuu ogaa in xertiisu taas ka gunuunacday, wuxuuna ku yidhi, Taas ma ka xun tihiin?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

kikuyu: Haddaba maxay noqon haddaad aragtaan Wiilka Aadanaha oo kor ugu baxaya meeshuu markii hore joogi jiray?
english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

kikuyu: Waa ruuxa kan wax nooleeyaa, jidhkuse waxba ma taro. Erayadii aan idinkula hadlayna waxay yihiin ruux iyo nololba.
english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa dhexdiina jira qaar idinka mid ah oo aan rumaysan. Waayo, tan iyo bilowgii Ciise waa garanayay kuway ahaayeen kuwa aan rumaysan iyo kuu ahaa kii gacangelin lahaa.
english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Taas aawadeed waxaan idinku idhi, Qofna iima iman karo haddaan Aabbuhu awood siin.
english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

kikuyu: Taas dabadeed xertiisii intii badnayd dib bay uga noqdeen, oo mar dambe lama ay socon.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise wuxuu laba-iyo-tobankii ku yidhi, Idinkuna ma doonaysaan inaad tagtaan?
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Simoon Butros wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Sayidow, yaannu u tagnaa? Adigaa haya erayadii nolosha weligeed ahe.
english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

kikuyu: Annaguna waa rumaysannay, waana og nahay inaad tahay Kan Quduuska ah ee Ilaah.
english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Miyaanan idin dooran idinkoo laba iyo toban ah? Mid idinka mid ahna waa cifriid.
english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ka hadlay Yuudas ina Simoon Iskariyod, waayo, isaguu ahaa kan gacangelin lahaa, isagoo laba-iyo-tobankii ka mid ahaa.
english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas dabadeed Ciise ayaa Galili ku dhex wareegay, waayo, ma u doonaynin inuu Yahuudiya ku wareego, maxaa yeelay, Yuhuuddu waxay doonayeen inay dilaan.
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

kikuyu: Iiddii Yuhuudda oo tii waababka ahayd way dhowayd.
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

kikuyu: Walaalihiis haddaba waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Halkan ka bax oo Yahuudiya tag in xertaadiina aragto shuqullada aad samaynaysid.
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

kikuyu: Ma jiro nin si qarsoon wax u sameeyaa markuu doonayo in bayaan loo ogaado. Haddaad waxyaalahan samayso, dunida isu muuji.
english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

kikuyu: Xataa walaalihiis ma ay rumaysan isaga.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi iyaga, Wakhtigaygu weli ma iman, laakiin wakhtigiinnu goor walba wuu joogaa.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

kikuyu: Dunidu idinma nebcaan karto, anigase way i neceb tahay, waayo, waxaan ka marag furaa in shuqulladeedu ay shar yihiin.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

kikuyu: Idinku iidda u kaca, anigu iiddan weli u kici maayo, waayo, wakhtigaygu weli ma dhammaan.
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Markuu waxyaalahaas iyagii ku yidhi, weli wuxuu sii joogay Galili.
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

kikuyu: Markii walaalihiis iiddii u kaceen, ayuu isaguna markaas xaggeeda u kacay, bayaan kuma tegin, laakiin sidii mid isqarinaya buu u tegey.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

kikuyu: Yuhuuddu haddaba iidday ka dooneen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Xaggee buu joogaa?
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa aad bay uga gunuuneceen isaga, qaarkood waxay yidhaahdeen, Waa nin wanaagsan; qaar kalena waxay yidhaahdeen, Sidaas ma aha, laakiin dadkii badnaa ayuu khiyaaneeyaa.
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

kikuyu: Haddaba ninna bayaan isaga ugama hadlin cabsiday ka cabsanayeen Yuhuudda aawadeed.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

kikuyu: Laakiin markay ahayd iidda dhexdeeda Ciise wuxuu u kacay macbudka, wax ayuuna ku baray.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Yuhuuddii ayaa la yaabtay iyagoo leh, Sidee baa kanu qorniinka u yaqaan isagoo aan weligiis baran?
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa haddaba u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waxbariddaydu tayda ma aha, laakiin waxaa leh kan i soo diray.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

kikuyu: Haddii nin doonayo inuu doonistii Ilaah sameeyo, wuu garan doonaa waxbaridda, inay tahay tii Ilaah amase aan qudhaydu iska hadlayo.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

kikuyu: Kan qudhiisu iska hadlaa, ammaantiisuu doonaa, laakiin kan doona ammaanta kan soo diray, kaasaa run ah, oo xaqdarro kuma jirto.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

kikuyu: Miyaan Muuse sharciga idin siin? Midkiinnana sharciga ma yeelo. Maxaad u doonaysaan inaad i dishaan?
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa waxay ugu jawaabeen, Jinni baad qabtaa. Yaa doonaya inuu ku dilo?
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Shuqul keliya ayaan sameeyey, kulligiinna waad la yaabteen.
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Muuse wuxuu idin siiyey gudniinta (kamana iman Muuse, waxayse ka timid awowayaashii); idinku sabtida ayaad nin guddaan.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

kikuyu: Haddii sabtida nin la gudo, si aan sharciga Muuse u jabin, ma waxaad iigu cadhoonaysaan nin aan dhammaantiis sabtidii bogsiiyey?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

kikuyu: Aragtida waxba ha ku xukumina, laakiin ku xukuma xukunka xaqa ah.
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed qaar ka mid ah kuwa Yeruusaalem waxay yidhaahdeen, Kanu miyaanu ahayn kay doonayaan inay dilaan?
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

kikuyu: Bal fiiriya, bayaan buu u hadlaa, waxbase kuma yidhaahdaan. Taliyayaashu runtii ma og yihiin inuu kanu yahay Masiixa?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

kikuyu: Laakiin kani meeshuu ka yimid waannu og nahay, markuuse Masiixu yimaado, ninna garan maayo meeshuu ka imanayo.
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Ciise haddaba macbudkuu ka dhex qayliyey isagoo wax baraya oo leh, Waad i taqaanniin, waana og tihiin meeshaan ka imid; anigu qudhayda kuma aan iman, laakiin kii i soo diray waa run, kan aydnaan garanaynin.
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: Anigu waa aqaan, waayo, isagaan ka imid, wuuna i soo diray.
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed waxay dooneen inay qabtaan, laakiin ninna faro ma uu saarin, waayo, saacaddiisii weli ma iman.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Laakiin qaar badan oo dadkii ahi way rumaysteen, waxayna yidhaahdeen, Masiixu markuu yimaado miyuu samayn doonaa calaamooyin ka badan kuwii kanu sameeyey?
english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

kikuyu: Farrisiintu way maqleen dadkii badnaa oo ka gunuunacayay waxaas ku saabsanaa isaga, wadaaddadii sarena iyo Farrisiintii waxay u direen saraakiil inay soo qabtaan isaga.
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

kikuyu: Ciise haddaba wuxuu ku yidhi, Weli in yar baan idinla joogayaa, markaasaan u tegayaa kii i soo diray.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

kikuyu: Waad i doondooni doontaan, imana heli doontaan, meeshaan joogona iman kari maysaan.
english: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Yuhuuddu waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Kanu xaggee buu tegi doonaa oo aynaan ka heli doonin? Ma wuxuu u tegi doonaa kuwa ku kala firidhsan dadka Gariigta ah, oo wax bari doonaa dadka Gariigta ah?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

kikuyu: Waa maxay hadalkan uu yidhi? Waad i doondooni doontaan, imana heli doontaan, meeshaan joogona ma iman kari doontaan.
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

kikuyu: Maalintii u dambaysay, oo ahayd maalintii weynayd ee iidda, Ciise ayaa istaagay oo qayliyey isagoo leh, Haddii qof uun harraado, ha ii yimaado, hana cabbo.
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

kikuyu: Kii i rumaysta, calooshiisa waxaa ka duuli doona webiyo biyaha nool ah, sida Qorniinku u yidhi.
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

kikuyu: Waxaas ayuu kaga hadlay Ruuxa oo ay kuwii isaga rumaystay heli doonaan, waayo, Ruuxa weli lama bixin, maxaa yeelay, Ciise weli ma ammaanmin.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed dadkii badnaa qaarkood, goortay hadalladaas maqleen, waxay yidhaahdeen, Runtii kanu waa nebigii.
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waxay yidhaahdeen, Kanu waa Masiixii. Qaarse waxay yidhaahdeen, Laakiin Masiixii ma wuxuu ka imanayaa Galili?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

kikuyu: Qorniinku miyaanu odhan, Masiixu wuxuu ka iman doonaa farcanka Daa'uud iyo tuuladii Beytlaxam oo Daa'uud joogay?
english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed dadkii badnaa waa kala qaybsamay aawadiis.
english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

kikuyu: Qaarkood baa doonay inay qabtaan, laakiinse ninna faro ma uu saarin.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

kikuyu: Saraakiishii haddaba waxay u yimaadeen wadaaddadii sare iyo Farrisiintii, iyaguna waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaad u keeni weydeen?
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

kikuyu: Saraakiishii waxay ugu jawaabeen, Ninna weligiis uma hadlin sida ninkaasi u hadlay.
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

kikuyu: Farrisiintii haddaba waxay iyaga ugu jawaabeen, Idinkana ma laydin khiyaaneeyey?
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

kikuyu: Miyaa taliyayaasha midkood ama Farrisiinta rumaystay isaga?
english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

kikuyu: Laakiin dadkan badan oo aan sharciga garanaynin waa inkaaran yihiin.
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

kikuyu: Nikodemos (kii markii hore Ciise u yimid, isagoo ah midkood) wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi,
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

kikuyu: Miyaa sharcigeennu xukumaa nin, iyadoo aan marka hore laga maqlin isaga oo aan la garanaynin wuxuu sameeyo?
english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay u jawaabeen oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Adiguna ma reer Galili baad tahay? Doondoon, oo arag inaan nebi ka kacayn Galili.
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa nin kastaa wuxuu u baxay gurigiisii.
english: Everyone went to his own house,

kikuyu: Ciisese wuxuu u baxay Buur Saytuun.
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Aroortii hore ayuu haddana macbudka yimid, dadkii oo dhammuna way u yimaadeen, oo intuu fadhiistay, ayuu wax baray.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

kikuyu: Culimmadii iyo Farrisiintii waxay u keeneen naag sino lagu qabtay. Markaasay dhexda joojiyeen,
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

kikuyu: oo waxay isagii ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, naagtan waxaa lagu qabtay sino.
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

kikuyu: Hadda Muuse wuxuu sharciga nagu amray in la dhagxiyo tan oo kale, adiguse maxaad ka leedahay iyada?
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

kikuyu: Waxay waxaas u yidhaahdeen, iyagoo jirrabaya, si ay u helaan wax ay ku ashtakeeyaan. Laakiin Ciise waa foororsaday, oo farta ayuu dhulka wax ku qoray.
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

kikuyu: Laakiin goortay sii wadeen inay weyddiiyaan, wuu istaagay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Kii idinka mid ah oo aan dembi lahayn, isagu horta dhagax ha ku tuuro.
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

kikuyu: Mar kale ayuu foororsaday, oo haddana dhulka wax ku qoray.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

kikuyu: Iyagu markay waxaas maqleen, ayay iska daba baxeen midba mid, waayeelladii ka bilaabato ilaa kii u dambeeyey. Ciisena keligiis ayuu hadhay iyo naagtii dhexda joogtay.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa istaagay oo ku yidhi iyadii, Naag yahay, xaggee bay joogaan? Ninna miyaanu ku xukumin?
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

kikuyu: Waxay ku tidhi, Ninna, Sayidow. Ciisena wuxuu ku yidhi, Anna ku xukumi maayo. Soco, oo hadda ka dib ha dembaabin.
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise ayaa mar kale la hadlay iyaga, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay nuurka dunida. Kii i soo raacaa, gudcurka kuma socon doono, wuxuuse lahaan doonaa nuurka nolosha.
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Farrisiintu waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Marag baad isu furaysaa, maraggaagguna run ma aha.
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

kikuyu: Ciise baa u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, In kastoo aan marag isu furo, maraggaygu waa run, waayo, waxaan garanayaa meeshaan ka imid iyo meeshaan tegayo, idinkuse garan maysaan meeshaan ka imid ama meeshaan tegayo.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad wax ka xukuntaan xagga jidhka, aniguse ninna ma xukumo.
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

kikuyu: Haddaan xukumo, xukunkaygu waa run, waayo, anigu keligay ma ihi, laakiin waa aniga iyo Aabbahaygii i soo diray.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

kikuyu: Sharcigiinna waxaa ku qoran, Laba nin maraggoodu waa run.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay kii isu marag fura, oo Aabbahaygii i soo dirayna ayaa ii marag fura.
english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Aabbahaa xaggee buu joogaa? Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, I garan maysaan, Aabbahayna garan maysaan. Haddaad i garanaysaan, Aabbahayna waad garan lahaydeen.
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

kikuyu: Hadalladaas ayuu kaga hadlay meeshii khasnaddu tiil intuu macbudka wax ku barayay. Oo ninna ma uu qaban isaga, waayo, saacaddiisii weli ma iman.
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed wuxuu haddana ku yidhi iyaga, Waan tegayaa, waadna i doondooni doontaan, waadna ku dhiman doontaan dembigiinna. Meeshaan tegayo iman kari maysaan.
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Yuhuuddu waxay yidhaahdeen, Miyuu isdilayaa? Waayo, isagaa yidhi, Meeshaan tegayo iman kari maysaan.
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku yidhi iyaga, Idinku waxaad tihiin kuwa hoosta, aniguse waxaan ka mid ahay kuwa sare. Idinku waxaad tihiin kuwa dunidan, aniguse mid kama ihi kuwa dunidan.
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan idinku idhi, Dembiyadiinna waad ku dhiman doontaan, waayo, haddaydnan rumaysan inaan isagii ahay, dembiyadiinna ayaad ku dhiman doontaan.
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Yaad tahay? Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Kii aan tan iyo bilowgii idinkala hadlay.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

kikuyu: Waxaan hayaa wax badan oo aan idinkala hadlo oo aan idinku xukumo, laakiin kii i soo diray waa run, aniguna waxaan ka maqlay isaga, waxaas ayaan dunida kula hadlayaa.
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

kikuyu: Ma ayna garan inuu iyaga kala hadlay Aabbaha.
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Markaad Wiilka Aadanaha kor u qaaddaan, markaasaad garan doontaan inaan isagii ahay iyo inaanan keligay waxba samaynaynin, laakiin sida Aabbuhu ii baray ayaan waxyaalahaas ugu hadlaa.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

kikuyu: Oo kii i soo diray ayaa ila jira, keligay igama uu tegin, waayo, mar kasta waxaan sameeyaa waxa ka farxiya isaga.
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

kikuyu: Intuu waxyaalahaas ku hadlayay, dad badan ayaa rumaystay isaga.
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi Yuhuuddii isaga rumaysatay, Haddaad ereygayga ku sii socotaan, runtii waxaad tihiin xertayda.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad garan doontaan runta; runtiina waa idin xorayn doontaa.
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

kikuyu: Waxay ugu jawaabeen, Farcankii Ibraahim baannu nahay, oo weligayo addoommo ninna uma ahayn. Maxaad u leedahay, Waa laydin xorayn doonaa?
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kii kasta oo dembi sameeyaa waa addoonkii dembiga.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

kikuyu: Oo addoonkuna guriga kuma sii jiro, wiilkuse waa ku sii jiraa weligiis.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed haddii Wiilku idin xoreeyo, runtii xor baad ahaan doontaan.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

kikuyu: Waan garanayaa inaad farcankii Ibraahim tihiin, laakiin waxaad doonaysaan inaad i dishaan, waayo, hadalkaygu meel idinkuma haysto.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
