kikuyu: Waxaan xaggii Aabbahay ku soo arkay ayaan ka hadlaa, idinkuna waxaad samaysaan wixii aydin aabbihiin ka maqasheen.
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

kikuyu: Markaasay u jawaabeen oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Aabbahayo waa Ibraahim. Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Haddaad carruurtii Ibraahim tihiin, shuqullada Ibraahim waad samayn lahaydeen.
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadda waxaad doonaysaan inaad i dishaan, anoo ah ninkii idiin sheegay runtii aan xaggii Ilaah ka maqlay. Waxaas Ibraahim ma uu samayn jirin.
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

kikuyu: Waxaad samaysaan shuqullada aabbihiin. Markaasay ku yidhaahdeen, Annagu kuma aannu dhalan sino. Aabbe keliya ayaannu leennahay oo waa Ilaah.
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddii Ilaah aabbihiin yahay, waad i jeclaan lahaydeen, maxaa yeelay, Ilaah baan ka soo baxay oo ka imid, aniguna iskama iman, ee isagaa i soo diray.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

kikuyu: Maxaad hadalkayga u garan weydeen? Waayo, hadalkayga ma maqli karaysaane.
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad tihiin kuwo aabbahood Ibliiska yahay, oo waxaad doonaysaan inaad samaysaan damacyada aabbihiin. Tan iyo bilowgii wuxuu ahaa mid dhiig qaba, runtana kuma uu joogsan, waayo, runtu kuma jirto isaga. Markuu been ku hadlo, tiisuu ku hadlaa, waayo, waa beenaaleh, waana beenta aabbaheed.
english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

kikuyu: Laakiin runta aan ku hadlo aawadeed waad i rumaysan weydeen.
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

kikuyu: Midkiinnee baa dembi igu caddaynaya? Haddaan runta sheego, maxaad ii rumaysan weydaan?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

kikuyu: Kii Ilaah kuwiisa ka mid ah, erayada Ilaah ayuu maqlaa, sidaas daraaddeed idinku maqli maysaan, waayo, Ilaah kuwiisii ma ihidin.
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

kikuyu: Yuhuuddu waxay ugu jawaabeen, Miyaannan run ku hadlin markaannu nidhi, Reer Samaariya baad tahay, oo jinni baad qabtaa?
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Jinni ma qabo, laakiin Aabbahay baan murweeyaa, idinkuna waad i murwad jebisaan.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

kikuyu: Anigu ammaantayda ma doono, waxaase jira mid doona oo xukuma.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Haddii qof uun ereygayga xajiyo, weligiis dhimasho ma arki doono.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

kikuyu: Yuhuuddu waxay ku yidhaahdeen isaga, Imminka waxaannu garanaynaa inaad jinni qabto. Ibraahim waa dhintay iyo nebiyadiiba, adiguna waxaad leedahay, Haddii qof uun hadalkayga xajiyo, weligiis dhimasho ma dhadhamin doono.
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

kikuyu: Miyaad ka sii weyn tahay aabbaheen Ibraahim oo dhintay, iyo nebiyadii dhintay? Yaad iska dhigaysaa?
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Haddaan is-ammaano, ammaantaydu waxba ma aha. Waa Aabbahay kan i ammaanaa, kaad ku sheegtaan Ilaahiinna.
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

kikuyu: Mana aydnaan garan isaga, laakiinse anigu waa garanayaa, oo haddaan idhaahdo, Garan maayo isaga, sidiinna oo kalaan beenaaleh noqonayaa, laakiinse waan aqaan isaga, ereygiisana waan xajiyaa.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

kikuyu: Aabbihiin Ibraahim waa ku reyreeyey inuu maalintayda arko, wuuna arkay oo ku farxay.
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Yuhuuddii waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Weli konton sannadood ma aadan gaadhin, oo Ibraahim ma aragtay?
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Intaan Ibraahim jirin anaa ah.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

kikuyu: Markaasay dhagaxyo u gurteen inay ku tuuraan, laakiin Ciise waa dhuuntay, wuuna ka baxay macbudka.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

kikuyu: Ciise intuu socday, wuxuu arkay nin indhala'aan ku dhashay.
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

kikuyu: Xertiisu waxay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, yaa dembaabay, ma kan baa mise waa waalidkiis, inuu indhala'aan ku dhasho?
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Ninkan iyo waalidkiis midna ma dembaabin, laakiin waa in shuqullada Ilaah lagu muujiyo isaga.
english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

kikuyu: Waa inaan samayno shuqullada kii i soo diray intay maalin tahay; habeen baa imanaya mar aan ninna shaqayn karin.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

kikuyu: Intaan dunida joogo, waxaan ahay nuurkii dunida.
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

kikuyu: Markuu sidaas yidhi, ayuu dhulka candhuuf ku tufay, oo candhuuftii dhoobo ka sameeyey, markaasuu dhoobadii wuxuu mariyey ninkii indhihiisii,
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

kikuyu: oo ku yidhi, Bax oo ku soo maydho balliga Siloo'am la yidhaahdo (oo fasirkiisii yahay, Waa la diray). Wuu tegey haddaba oo soo maydhay, markaasuu yimid isagoo wax arkaya.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed derisyadii iyo kuwii hortii arki jiray inuu miskiin yahay, waxay yidhaahdeen, Kanu miyaanu ahayn kii fadhiyi jiray oo dawarsan jiray?
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

kikuyu: Qaar baa yidhi, Waa isagii, Qaarna waxay yidhaahdeen, Maya, laakiin waa u eg yahay. Isagaa yidhi, Isagii baan ahay.
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haddaba sidee bay indhahaagu u furmeen?
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Ninka Ciise la yidhaahdo ayaa dhoobo sameeyey oo indhahayga mariyey, oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Siloo'am u kac, oo ku soo maydho, Sidaa aawadeed ayaan tegey, oo markaan soo maydhay ayaan arag helay.
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Xaggee buu joogaa? Isaguse wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma ogi.
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa kii markii hore indhaha la'aa waxaa loo geeyey Farrisiintii.
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

kikuyu: Waxayna ahayd sabti maalintii Ciise dhoobada sameeyey oo indhihiisii furay.
english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

kikuyu: Mar kale haddaba Farrisiintii waxay weyddiiyeen siduu araggiisa ku helay. Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Dhoobuu indhahayga mariyey, oo aan maydhay, oo wax baan arkayaa.
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Farrisiinta qaarkood waxay yidhaahdeen, Ninkan xaggii Ilaah kama iman, waayo, sabtida ma dhawro. Qaar kalese waxay yidhaahdeen, Sidee baa nin dembi leh calaamooyinkan oo kale u samayn karaa? Markaasay kala qaybsameen dhexdoodii.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

kikuyu: Waxay haddaba ninkii indhaha la'aa ku yidhaahdeen, Maxaad ka leedahay isaga, waayo, waa kan indhahaaga furaye? Wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa nebi.
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Yuhuuddu kama rumaysanin inuu indha la'aa, oo uu araggiisa helay, ilaa ay u yeedheen waalidkii kii araggiisa helay,
english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

kikuyu: oo weyddiiyeen, iyagoo leh, Kanu ma wiilkiinnii baa aad leedihiin, Wuxuu ku dhashay indhala'aan? Sidee buu hadda wax ku arkaa?
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

kikuyu: Waalidkiis waxay haddaba ugu jawaabeen, Waannu garanaynaa kani inuu wiilkayagii yahay oo uu indhala'aan ku dhashay,
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

kikuyu: laakiin siduu hadda wax ku arko garan mayno, kii indhihiisii furayna garan mayno. Isaga weyddiiya. Waa nin weyn. Waa isu hadli doonaaye.
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas waxay waalidkiis u yidhaahdeen, waayo, Yuhuudday ka baqeen. Maxaa yeelay, Yuhuuddu waxay mar hore ku heshiiyeen in qof uun hadduu u qirto inuu yahay Masiixa, sunagogga laga saaro.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed waalidkiis waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Waa nin weyn ee weyddiiya isaga.
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

kikuyu: Haddaba mar labaad ayay ninkii indhaha la'aa u yeedheen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Ilaah ammaan. Waxaannu garanaynaa inuu ninkanu dembi leeyahaye.
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu haddaba ugu jawaabay, Inuu dembi leeyahay garan maayo, waxa keli ahoo aanse garanayaa, inaan indha la'aa, oo aan haddana wax arkayo.
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

kikuyu: Waxay haddaba ku yidhaahdeen, Muxuu kugu sameeyey? Sidee buu indhahaaga u furay?
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Horaan idiinku sheegay, mana aydnaan maqlin. Maxaad u doonaysaan inaad mar kale maqashaan? Idinkuna ma waxaad doonaysaan inaad xertiisa noqotaan?
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

kikuyu: Markaasay caayeen oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Adigu xertiisa baad tahay, annaguse waxaannu nahay xertii Muuse.
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

kikuyu: Waxaannu garanaynaa inuu Ilaah la hadlay Muuse, laakiinse ninkanu meeshuu ka yimid garan mayno.
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Ninkii baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waxakanu waa yaab inaydnaan garanaynin meeshuu ka yimid, isaguna uu indhaha ii furay.
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

kikuyu: Waannu garanaynaa inaan Ilaah dembilayaashii maqlayn, laakiin wuxuu maqlaa kii Ilaah caabuda oo doonistiisa sameeya.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

kikuyu: Tan iyo dunida bilowgeedii lama maqlin nin indhaha u furay qof indhala'aan ku dhashay.
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

kikuyu: Ninkanu haddaanu xaggii Ilaah ka iman, waxba ma uu samayn kareen.
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

kikuyu: Markaasay u jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Dhammaantaaba dembiyo waad ku dhalatay ee ma wax baad na baraysaa? Kolkaasay dibadda ku tuureen.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa maqlay inay dibadda ku tuureen, wuuna helay oo ku yidhi, Wiilka Ilaah ma rumaysan tahay?
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Yuu yahay, Sayidow, aan rumaystee?
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Waad aragtay, waana isaga kan kula hadlayaa.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Waa rumaysnahay, Sayidow. Wuuna caabuday.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan dunidan u imid xukun, kuwa aan wax arkin inay wax arkaan, kuwa wax arkaana inay indho beelaan.
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

kikuyu: Kuwii Farrisiinta ahaa oo la joogay ayaa waxyaalahaas maqlay, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Annaguna ma indha la' nahay?
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Haddaad indhala'aan lahaydeen, dembi ma aydin lahaateen, laakiinse haatan waxaad tidhaahdaan, Wax baannu aragnaa. Dembigiinnu waa sii jiraa.
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kii aan xerada idaha illinka ka soo gelin ee meel kale ka soo fuulaa, kaasi waa tuug iyo waxdhace.
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

kikuyu: Laakiin kii illinka ka soo galaa waa adhijirka idaha.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

kikuyu: Illinjoogaha ayaa isaga illinka ka fura, iduhuna codkiisay maqlaan, idihiisana magacyadooda ayuu ugu yeedhaa, oo dibadduu u kaxeeyaa.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

kikuyu: Markuu kuwiisa wada saaro, wuu hor kacaa, iduhuna way raacaan, waayo, codkiisay garanayaan.
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

kikuyu: Nin qalaadna raaci maayaan, laakiin way ka cararayaan, waayo, codka kuwa qalaad garan maayaan.
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

kikuyu: Masaalkaas Ciise ayaa kula hadlay iyaga, laakiin ma ay garan waxyaaluhuu kala hadlayay xaggooda.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise ayaa mar kale ku yidhi, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Waxaan ahay illinka iduhu ka soo galaan.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

kikuyu: Kuwii hortay yimid oo dhammu waa tuugag iyo waxdhacayaal, iduhuse ma maqlin.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

kikuyu: Waxaan ahay illinka, haddii qof uun xaggayga ka soo galo, wuu badbaadi doonaa, wuuna soo geli doonaa oo bixi doonaa, daaq buuna heli doonaa.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

kikuyu: Tuuggu wax kale uma yimaado inuu wax xado oo dilo oo halleeyo mooyaane, aniguse waxaan u imid inay nolosha haystaan oo ay badnaan u haystaan.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

kikuyu: Waxaan ahay adhijirka wanaagsan. Adhijirka wanaagsanu wuxuu naftiisa u bixiyaa idaha daraaddood.
english: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

kikuyu: Kan ciidanka ah oo aan adhijirka ahayn, iduhuna aanay kuwiisa ahayn, kolkuu arko yeeyda oo soo socota, wuu ka tagaa idaha oo ka cararaa. Markaasay yeeydu qabsataa oo kala firdhisaa iyaga.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

kikuyu: Wuu cararaa, waayo, isagu waa ciidan uun, oo idaha waxba kama gelin.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

kikuyu: Waxaan ahay adhijirka wanaagsan; waan garanayaa kuwayga, kuwayguna waa i garanayaan,
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

kikuyu: sida Aabbuhu ii garanayo, anna aan Aabbaha u garanayo; oo naftaydana waan u bixiyaa idaha daraaddood.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

kikuyu: Ido kale ayaan leeyahay oo aan kuwa xeradan ahayn, kuwaasna waa inaan keenaa, waxayna maqli doonaan codkayga, oo waxaa jiri doona adhi keliya iyo adhijir keliya.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Aabbuhu waa i jecel yahay, waayo, naftaydaan bixiyaa inaan mar kale qaato.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

kikuyu: Ninna igama qaado, laakiin anaa iska bixiya. Waxaan leeyahay amar aan ku bixiyo, waanan leeyahay amar aan haddana ku soo qaato. Amarkan waxaan ka helay Aabbahay.
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

kikuyu: Yuhuuddu haddana way kala qaybsameen hadalladaas aawadood.
english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

kikuyu: Badidood waxay yidhaahdeen, Jinni buu qabaa, wuuna waalan yahay, ee maxaad u maqlaysaan?
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

kikuyu: Qaar kale waxay yidhaahdeen, Hadalladaasu ma aha kuwa nin jinni qaba. Jinni miyuu indhaha u furi karaa nin indha la'?
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

kikuyu: Waxay ahayd Iidda Daahirinta Macbudka xagga Yeruusaalem, waxayna ahayd wakhtiga qabowga.
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ciisena wuxuu dhex socday macbudka xagga Balbalada Sulaymaan.
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

kikuyu: Yuhuuddu haddaba waxay isugu soo urureen hareerihiisa oo ku yidhaahdeen, Tan iyo goormaad shaki nagu sii wadi doontaa? Haddii aad Masiixa tahay bayaan noogu sheeg.
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Waan idiin sheegay, idinkuse ma rumaysnidin. Shuqullada aan magaca Aabbahay ku sameeyo ayaa ii marag fura,
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

kikuyu: laakiin ma rumaysnidin, waayo, idahayga ka mid ma ihidin.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

kikuyu: Idahaygu codkaygay maqlaan, waanan garanayaa iyaga, wayna i raacaan.
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan iyaga siiyaa nolosha weligeed ah, weligoodna ma lumi doonaan, oo ninna kama dhufsan doono gacantayda.
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

kikuyu: Aabbahaygii i siiyey iyaga ayaa wax walba ka weyn, oo ninna kama dhufsan karo gacanta Aabbahay.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

kikuyu: Aniga iyo Aabbuhu mid baannu nahay.
english: I and the Father are one.”

kikuyu: Markaasay Yuhuuddu haddana dhagaxyo u gurteen inay dhagxiyaan.
english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Shuqullo badan oo wanaagsan ayaan idinka tusay xagga Aabbahay. Shuqulladaas kee baad igu dhagxinaysaan?
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

kikuyu: Yuhuuddu waxay ugu jawaabeen, Shuqul wanaagsan aawadiis kugu dhagxin mayno, laakiin caytanka aawadiis iyo inaad adigoo nin ah Ilaah iska dhigayso.
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Miyaanay ku qorrayn sharcigiinna, Waxaan idhi, Idinku waxaad tihiin ilaahyo?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

kikuyu: Hadduu Ilaah kuwii ereygiisu u yimid ku sheegay ilaahyo (oo Qorniinkana lama jebin karo),
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

kikuyu: ma waxaad ku leedihiin kii Aabbuhu quduus ka dhigay oo xagga dunida u soo diray, Waad caytantaa, waayo, waxaan idhi, Wiilka Ilaah baan ahay?
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

kikuyu: Haddaanan samayn shuqullada Aabbahay, ha i rumaysanina.
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaan sameeyo, in kastoo aydnaan i rumaysanayn, shuqullada rumaysta, inaad ogaataan oo garataan in Aabbuhu igu jiro, anna Aabbaha aan ku jiro.
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed mar kale ayay dooneen inay qabtaan, wuuna ka baxsaday gacantooda.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

kikuyu: Haddana wuxuu u baxay Webi Urdun shishadiisa ilaa meeshii Yooxanaa markii hore ku jiray, isagoo dad ku baabtiisaya, meeshaasuuna joogay,
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

kikuyu: oo qaar badan baa u yimid isaga, waxayna ku yidhaahdeen, Runtii Yooxanaa calaamo ma samayn, laakiin wax walba oo Yooxanaa ka yidhi ninkan run bay ahaayeen.
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

kikuyu: Kuwa badan baana halkaa ku rumaystay isaga.
english: Many believed in him there.

kikuyu: Waxaa jiray nin buka oo ah Laasaros reer Beytaniya ee joogay tuulada Maryan iyo walaasheed Maarta.
english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

kikuyu: Maryantaasu waxay ahayd tii Rabbiga cadar marisay oo cagihiisa timaheeda ku tirtirtay, oo walaalkeed Laasaros bukay.
english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed walaalihii farriin bay Rabbiga u direen iyagoo leh, Sayidow, ogow, kii aad jeclayd waa bukaaye.
english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ciise markuu taas maqlay wuxuu yidhi, Bukaankanu kan dhimashada ma ahaa, laakiin waa ammaanta Ilaah aawadeed in Wiilka Ilaah lagu ammaano.
english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa jeclaa Maarta iyo walaasheed iyo Laasaros.
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed markuu maqlay inuu buko, laba maalmood oo kale ayuu meeshuu joogay iska sii joogay.
english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

kikuyu: Markaas dabadeed ayuu xertii ku yidhi, Yahuudiya aan haddana tagno.
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

kikuyu: Xertii waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, Yuhuuddu waxay haddana doonayeen inay ku dhagxiyaan, ma waxaad mar kale u kacaysaa meeshaas?
english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Maalintu miyaanay laba iyo toban saacadood ahayn? Qof hadduu maalinta socdo ma turunturoodo, waayo, wuxuu arkaa iftiinka dunidan.
english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

kikuyu: Laakiin qof hadduu habeenka socdo, wuu turunturoodaa, waayo, iftiinku kuma jiro isaga.
english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas ayuu ku hadlay, oo dabadeedto wuxuu ku yidhi iyaga, Saaxiibkeen Laasaros waa hurdaa, laakiin waan u tegayaa inaan soo toosiyo.
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed xertii waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, hadduu hurdo wuu bogsanayaa.
english: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ka hadlayay dhimashadiisa, iyaguse waxay u maleeyeen inuu ka hadlayo nasashada hurdada.
english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

kikuyu: Ciise haddaba ayaa bayaan ugu yidhi, Laasaros waa dhintay.
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

kikuyu: Anigu waa ku faraxsanahay aawadiin inaanan halkaas joogin si aad u rumaysataan, laakiin aan u tagno.
english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed Toomas, kii Didumos la odhan jiray, wuxuu ku yidhi xertii la socotay, Innaguna aan tagno si aynu ula dhimanno.
english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

kikuyu: Haddaba markuu Ciise yimid wuxuu ogaaday inuu afar maalmood xabaasha ku jiray.
english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

kikuyu: Haddana Beytaniya waa u dhowayd Yeruusaalem, oo waxay u jirtay qiyaas shan iyo toban istaadiyon.
english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

kikuyu: Yuhuud badan waxay u yimaadeen Maarta iyo Maryan inay walaalkood uga tacsiyeeyaan.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

kikuyu: Maarta haddaba markay maqashay in Ciise imanayo, ayay ka hor tagtay, Maryanse gurigay iska fadhiday.
english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Maarta waxay Ciise ku tidhi, Sayidow, haddaad halkan joogtid, walaalkay ma uu dhinteen.
english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

kikuyu: Hadda waxaan garanayaa in wax alla waxaad Ilaah weyddiisatid uu ku siinayo.
english: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Walaalkaa waa sara kici doonaa.
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

kikuyu: Maartaa ku tidhi, Waan garanayaa inuu kici doono wakhtiga sarakicidda ee maalinta u dambaysa.
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay sarakicidda iyo nolosha. Kii i rumaystaa, in kastoo uu dhinto, wuu noolaan doonaa.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

kikuyu: Kii kasta oo nool oo i rumaystaa weligii ma dhiman doono. Waxan ma rumaysan tahay?
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

kikuyu: Waxay ku tidhi, Haah, Sayidow, waan rumaysnahay inaad tahay Masiixa oo ah Wiilka Ilaah ee dunida iman lahaa.
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Markay taas tidhi, way tagtay oo hoos ahaan ugu soo yeedhay walaasheed Maryan, oo waxay ku tidhi, Macallinkii halkan buu joogaa, waana kuu yeedhayaa.
english: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

kikuyu: Iyaduna kolkay maqashay, dhaqso bay u kacday oo u tagtay.
english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

kikuyu: Ciise weli ma iman tuulada, laakiin wuxuu weli joogay meeshii Maarta kaga hor tagtay.
english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

kikuyu: Haddaba Yuhuuddii iyada guriga la joogtay oo u tacsiyaynaysay, markay arkeen Maryan inay dhaqso u kacday oo baxday, ayay raaceen, iyagoo u malaynaya inay xabaashii tegayso inay meeshaas ku baroorato.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Maryan markay timid meeshii Ciise joogay oo ay aragtay isaga, waxay ku dhacday cagihiisa iyadoo ku leh, Sayidow, haddaad halkan joogtid, walaalkay ma uu dhinteen.
english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

kikuyu: Ciise haddaba markuu arkay iyadoo barooranaysa, iyo Yuhuuddii la socotay oo la barooranaysa, ayuu ka qalbi xumaaday, wuuna murugooday.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Xaggee baad dhigteen? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, kaalay oo arag.
english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

kikuyu: Ciise waa ooyay.
english: Jesus wept.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Yuhuuddu waxay yidhaahdeen, Bal eega, siduu u jeclaa.
english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

kikuyu: Qaarkoodse waxay yidhaahdeen, Ninkan oo indhaha u furay kii indha la'aa, miyuusan wax ka samayn karin inuusan ninkaasu dhiman?
english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Ciise oo mar kale qalbi xumaaday ayaa xabaashii yimid. Waxay ahayd god, dhagax baana saarnaa.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa yidhi, Dhagaxa ka qaada. Maarta oo ahayd kii dhintay walaashiis, waxay ku tidhi, Sayidow, hadda wuu urayaa, waayo, afar maalmood buu mootanaa.
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, miyaanan kugu odhan, Haddaad rumaysatid, waxaad arki lahayd ammaanta Ilaah?
english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

kikuyu: Markaasay dhagaxii ka qaadeen. Ciisena indhihiisuu kor u taagay oo yidhi, Aabbow, waan kuugu mahadnaqayaa inaad i maqashay.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

kikuyu: Waana ogaa inaad mar kasta i maqasho, laakiin dadkan badan oo hareerahayga taagan aawadood ayaan taas u idhi inay rumaystaan inaad adigu i soo dirtay.
english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

kikuyu: Markuu sidaas ku hadlay dabadeed wuxuu ku dhawaaqay cod weyn, Laasarosow, soo bax.
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa kii dhintay soo baxay, isagoo gacmaha iyo cagaha ay kafan kaga xidhan tahay, wejigana maro kaga xidhan tahay. Kolkaasuu Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi iyaga, Fura oo daaya, ha socdee.
english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed qaar badan oo Yuhuuddii ah oo Maryan u yimid oo arkay wuxuu sameeyey ayaa rumaystay.
english: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

kikuyu: Qaarkoodse way u tageen Farrisiintii, oo waxay u sheegeen wuxuu Ciise sameeyey.
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed wadaaddadii sare iyo Farrisiintii shir bay isugu yimaadeen oo yidhaahdeen, Maxaynu samaynaa? Waayo, ninkanu calaamooyin badan buu sameeyeye.
english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

kikuyu: Haddaynu sidaa u dayno, dhammaan way rumaysan doonaan isaga, oo dadka Roomana way iman doonaan, oo waxay qaadan doonaan meesheenna iyo quruunteenna.
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

kikuyu: Midkood Kayafas la odhan jiray, oo wadaadka sare ahaa sannaddaas, wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Waxba garan maysaan,
english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

kikuyu: oo ka fiirsan maysaan inay idiin roon tahay in nin keli ahu dadka u dhinto oo aan quruunta oo dhammu lumin.
english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

kikuyu: Waxaas iskama odhan, laakiin isagoo ah wadaadka sare sannaddaas, wuxuu sii sheegay in Ciise quruunta u dhiman doono,
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

kikuyu: quruuntii oo keliya uma aha, laakiin inuu mid keliya isugu soo ururiyo carruurtii Ilaah oo kala firidhsan.
english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Haddaba maalintaas wixii ka dambeeyey waxay ku tashadeen inay dilaan.
english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed mar dambe Ciise bayaan uma dhex marin Yuhuudda, wuuse ka tegey meeshaas, ilaa meel u dhowayd cidlada, ilaa magaalo la yidhaahdo Efrayim, halkaasuuna xertii la joogay.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Hadda Iidda Yuhuudda ee Kormaridda la yidhaahdaa waa dhowayd, kuwa badanna waxay u kaceen Yeruusaalem iyagoo dalka ka yimid Iiddii Kormaridda horteed inay isdaahiriyaan.
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed ayay Ciise doondooneen, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, iyagoo macbudka dhex taagan, Maxay idinla tahay? Ma inuusan iidda imanaynin baa?
english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

kikuyu: Wadaaddadii sare iyo Farrisiintii waxay amar ku bixiyeen, Hadduu qof ogaado meeshuu joogo waa inuu sheego, ha la qabtee.
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

kikuyu: Haddaba lix maalmood ka hor Iidda Kormaridda, Ciise wuxuu yimid Beytaniya, meeshuu joogay Laasaros, kii Ciise kuwa dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey.
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed halkaasaa casho loogu sameeyey, Maartana waa adeegaysay, oo Laasaros wuxuu ka mid ahaa kuwa cuntada ula fadhiistay.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

kikuyu: Maryan haddaba waxay qaadday rodol cadar ah oo naaradiin qaaliya ah, waxayna marisay cagaha Ciise, oo timaheedii ayay cagihiisa ku tirtirtay. Gurigiina waxaa ka buuxsamay udgoonkii cadarka.
english: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

kikuyu: Laakiin Yuudas Iskariyod, oo ahaa mid xertiisii ka mid ah, oo gacangelin lahaa, wuxuu yidhi,
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

kikuyu: Maxaa cadarkan loogu iibin waayay saddex boqol oo dinaar, oo loo siin waayay masaakiinta?
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

kikuyu: Sidaas uma uu odhan dan uu ka lahaa masaakiinta, laakiin wuxuu u yidhi wuxuu ahaa tuug, oo kiishadda lacagta ayuu hayn jiray, wuuna kala bixi jiray wixii lagu rido.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise ayaa yidhi, Daaya. Waxay u haysay maalinta aasniintayda.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

kikuyu: Waayo, masaakiintu mar walba way idinla jiraan, aniguse idinlama joogo mar walba.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

kikuyu: Haddaba dad badan oo Yuhuud ah baa waxay ogaadeen inuu halkaas joogo, wayna u yimaadeen, ma aha Ciise aawadii oo keliya laakiin inay arkaan Laasarosna, kii uu kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Wadaaddadii sare waxay ku tashadeen inay Laasarosna dilaan.
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

kikuyu: Waayo, aawadiis ayaa Yuhuud badani ku tagtay oo Ciise rumaysatay.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

kikuyu: Maalintii xigtay dad badan oo u yimid iiddii, markay maqleen inuu Ciise Yeruusaalem imanayo,
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

kikuyu: waxay qaateen laamihii geedaha timirta ah, oo ay baxeen inay ka hor tagaan, iyagoo ku dhawaaqaya Hoosanna, waxaa barakaysan kan Rabbiga magiciisa ku imanaya oo boqorka Israa'iil ah.
english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu helay dameer yar oo fuulay, siday ugu qoran tahay,
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

kikuyu: Ha biqin, gabadhii Siyoonay; bal eeg, Boqorkaagu waa imanayaa isagoo fuushan qayl dameereed.
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

kikuyu: Markii hore xertiisii waxyaalahaas ma ay garan, laakiin markii Ciise ammaanmay dabadeed ayay xusuusteen in waxyaalahaas xaggiisa laga qoray iyo in waxyaalahaas lagu sameeyey isaga.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa marag furay dadkii badnaa ee la joogay markuu Laasaros xabaasha uga yeedhay oo uu kuwa dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed dadkii badnaa waa u kaceen inay ka hor tagaan, waayo, waxay maqleen inuu calaamadaas sameeyey.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

kikuyu: Haddaba Farrisiintii waxay dhexdoodii isku yidhaahdeen, Waad arkaysaan sidaydnaan waxba u taraynin. Eega, dunidii oo dhan baa raacdaye.
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

kikuyu: Kuwa wakhtiga iidda u kacay inay Ilaah caabudaan, waxaa ku dhex jiray qaar Gariig ah.
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

kikuyu: Kuwaas haddaba waxay u yimaadeen Filibos oo ahaa reer Beytsayda ee Galili, wayna weyddiisteen oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, waxaannu doonaynaa inaannu Ciise aragno.
english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Filibos u yimid oo Andaros u sheegay, oo haddana Andaros iyo Filibos baa wada yimid, oo ay Ciise u sheegeen.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ciise u jawaabay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Saacaddii way timid uu Wiilka Aadanahu ammaanmi lahaa.
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Xabbad sarreen ah haddaanay dhulka ku dhicin oo dhiman, keligeed bay iska jiraysaa, laakiin hadday dhimato, midho badan bay dhashaa.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

kikuyu: Kan naftiisa jecel, waa lumiyaa, kan dunidan naftiisa ku nebcaadaase, wuu hayn doonaa tan iyo nolosha weligeed ah.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

kikuyu: Qof uun hadduu ii adeego, ha i soo raaco, meeshaan joogona, midiidinkayguna wuu joogi doonaa. Qof uun hadduu ii adeego, Aabbuhu waa murwayn doonaa isaga.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

kikuyu: Haatan naftaydu waa murugootay, oo maxaan idhaahdaa? Aabbow, saacaddan iga badbaadi. Laakiin taas aawadeed ayaan saacaddan u soo gaadhay.
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

kikuyu: Aabbow, magacaaga ammaan. Haddaba waxaa samada ka yimid cod leh, Waan ammaanay, waanan ammaani doonaa mar kale.
english: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

kikuyu: Haddaba dadkii badnaa oo ag taagnaa, way maqleen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Waa onkod. Qaar kale waxay yidhaahdeen, Malaa'ig baa la hadashay isaga.
english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Codkaasu aawaday uma imanin, laakiin wuxuu u yimid aawadiin.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

kikuyu: Imminka weeye markii dunidan la xukumi lahaa, imminka kan madaxda dunida ah dibaddaa lagu tuuri doonaa.
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

kikuyu: Aniguna haddii kor layga qaado dhulka, dhammaan xaggaygaan u soo jiidi doonaa.
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu waxaas u yidhi inuu tuso siduu u dhiman doono.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kikuyu: Haddaba dadkii badnaa waxay ugu jawaabeen, Waxaannu sharciga ka maqallay in Masiixu weligiis jiri doono. Sidee baad u leedahay, Wiilka Aadanaha waa in kor loo qaado? Waa ayo Wiilka Aadanahu?
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

kikuyu: Ciise haddaba ayaa ku yidhi, Weli in yar nuurka ayaa idinla jiraya. Socda intaad nuurka haysataan, si aan gudcurku idiin soo gaadhin. Kan gudcurka ku socdaana ma yaqaan meeshuu u socdo.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

kikuyu: Intaad nuurka haysataan, rumaysta nuurka, inaad noqotaan wiilasha nuurka. Waxyaalahaas Ciise ayaa ku hadlay, markaasuu ka tegey oo ka dhuuntay iyaga.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

kikuyu: Laakiin in kastuu calaamooyin badan ku sameeyey hortooda, weli ma ay rumaysan isaga;
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

kikuyu: inuu noqdo hadalka nebi Isayos oo uu ku hadlay, Rabbiyow, yaa warkayagii rumaystay, Oo yaa gacantii Rabbiga loo muujiyey?
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed ayay rumaysan kari waayeen, waayo, Isayos ayaa haddana yidhi,
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

kikuyu: Wuu indhatiray, qalbigoodana ayuu engejiyey, Si aanay indhahooda wax ugu arkin, oo aanay qalbigoodana wax ugu garan, Oo aanay u soo noqon, Oo aanan u bogsiin.
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas Isayos ayaa yidhi, maxaa yeelay, ammaantiisuu arkay, wuuna ka hadlay isaga.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

kikuyu: Hase ahaatee qaar badan oo taliyayaasha ka mid ahaa way rumaysteen, laakiin Farrisiintii aawadood ma ay qiran si aan sunagogga looga saarin,
english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

kikuyu: waayo, waxay ammaanta Ilaah ka jeclaayeen ammaanta dadka.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku dhawaaqay oo yidhi, Kii i rumaystaa, ima rumaysto, wuxuuse rumaystaa kan i soo diray.
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

kikuyu: Kii i arkaana, wuxuu arkaa kan i soo diray.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

kikuyu: Waxaan dunida u imid inaan nuur u ahaado, in mid kasta oo i rumaystaa uusan gudcurka ku sii jirin.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

kikuyu: Nin uun hadduu erayadayda maqlo oo uusan xajin, xukumi maayo, waayo, uma iman inaan dunida xukumo, waxaanse u imid inaan dunida badbaadiyo.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

kikuyu: Kii i diida oo aan erayadayda aqbalin, wuxuu haystaa mid xukuma; ereygaan ku hadlay baa xukumi doona isaga maalinta u dambaysa.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu amarkayga kuma hadlin, laakiinse Aabbihii i soo diray isagaa i amray waxaan idhaahdo iyo waxaan ku hadloba.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

kikuyu: Oo waanan garanayaa inuu amarkiisu yahay nolosha weligeed ah. Sidaa daraaddeed waxaan ku hadlayaa, sidii Aabbuhu igu yidhi, sidaasaan ku hadlayaa.
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

kikuyu: Iidda Kormaridda horteed Ciise wuxuu garanayay inay timid saacaddiisii uu dunidan ka tegi lahaa ilaa Aabbaha, oo siduu u jeclaa kuwiisii dunida joogay, ayuu u jeclaa tan iyo dhammaadka.
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

kikuyu: Ibliiska ayaa markii hore qalbiga Yuudas Iskariyod ina Simoon geliyey inuu Ciise gacangeliyo.
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

kikuyu: Oo wakhtiga cashada Ciise oo garanaya in Aabbuhu wax walba gacanta u geliyey iyo inuu Ilaah ka yimid oo Ilaah ku noqonayo,
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

kikuyu: ayuu cashadii ka kacay oo dharkii iska dhigay, tuwaalna wuu qaatay oo guntaday.
english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

kikuyu: Markaasuu biyo weel ku shubay oo bilaabay inuu xertiisa cagaha u maydho oo ku tirtiro tuwaalkii uu guntanaa.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

kikuyu: Wuxuu haddaba u yimid Simoon Butros. Kaasaa ku yidhi, Sayidow, ma adaa cagaha ii maydhaya?
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waxaan samaynaya, garan maysid imminka, laakiinse dabadeed waad garan doontaa.
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

kikuyu: Butros ayaa ku yidhi, Weligaa cagaha ii maydhi maysid. Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Haddaanan kuu maydhin, qayb iguma lihid.
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Simoon Butros ku yidhi, Sayidow, cagaha keliya ha ii maydhin, laakiin gacmaha iyo madaxana ii maydh.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Kii maydhni uma baahna inuu maydho cagihiisa mooyaane, laakiin waa wada nadiifsan yahay, idinkuna waa nadiifsan tihiin, laakiin dhammaantiin ma aha.
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

kikuyu: Waayo, wuu garanayay kii gacangelin lahaa. Sidaa daraaddeed ayuu u yidhi, Dhammaantiin ma wada nadiifsanidin.
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

kikuyu: Haddaba markuu cagihii u maydhay iyagii, oo dharkiisa qaatay, oo haddana fadhiistay, markaasuu ku yidhi, Ma garanaysaan waxaan idinku sameeyey?
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

kikuyu: Waxaad iigu yeedhaan, Macallin iyo Sayid, waadna ku hagaagsan tihiin, waayo, waan ahay.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaan cagaha idiin maydhay anigoo ah Sayidka iyo Macallinka, idinkuna waa inaad cagaha isu maydhaan.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

kikuyu: Waxaan idin siiyey masaal inaad samaysaan sidaan idinku sameeyey.
english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Addoon kama weyna sayidkiis, mid la soo dirayna kama weyna kii soo diray.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

kikuyu: Haddaad waxyaalahan garanaysaan, waad barakaysan tihiin haddaad yeeshaan.
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

kikuyu: Dhammaantiin ka hadli maayo; waan garanayaa kuwaan doortay. Laakiin Qorniinka leh, Kan kibistayda cuna ayaa cedhibtiisa ii qaaday, waa inuu ahaado.
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

kikuyu: Hadda dabadeed waxaas ayaan idiin sheegayaa intaanay dhicin, in markay dhacaan aad rumaysataan inaan ahay isagii.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kan aqbala ku alla kaan soo diro ayaa i aqbala, oo kan i aqbalaana wuxuu aqbalaa kii i soo diray.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

kikuyu: Ciise markuu sidaas yidhi, ayuu ka qalbi xumaaday, wuxuuna bayaan u sheegay oo yidhi, Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Midkiin ayaa i gacangelin doona.
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

kikuyu: Markaasay xertii is-eegeegeen iyagoo aan garanaynin kii uu ka hadlayay.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

kikuyu: Waxaa joogay oo laabta Ciise ku tiirsanaa xertiisa midkood oo uu Ciise jeclaa.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed ayaa Simoon Butros calaamo u sameeyey oo ku yidhi, Noo sheeg yuu yahay kan uu ka hadlayo.
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

kikuyu: Isagoo sidii ugu tiirsan laabta Ciise, ayuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, waa kuma?
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ugu jawaabay, Waa kii aan koosaarta u dari doono oo aan siin doono. Haddaba markuu koosaarta u daray ayuu qaaday oo siiyey Yuudas Iskariyod ina Simoon.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

kikuyu: Markuu koosaarta qaatay dabadeed, Shayddaan baa galay isagii. Sidaa daraaddeed Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Waxaad samaynayso dhaqso u samee.
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

kikuyu: Kuwa la fadhiyey midkoodna ma garanaynin sababta uu sidaas ugula hadlay isaga.
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

kikuyu: Yuudas baa kiishaddii lacagta hayay, taas aawadeed qaar waxay u maleeyeen in Ciise ku yidhi, Soo iibi waxaynu iidda u baahan nahay, ama, Masaakiinta wax sii.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

kikuyu: Isagu haddaba markuu koosaartii qaatay, markiiba ayuu baxay, oo waxayna ahayd habeennimo.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

kikuyu: Haddaba markuu baxay, Ciise ayaa yidhi, Hadda Wiilka Aadanahu waa ammaanmay, Ilaahna waa ku ammaanmay isaga.
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

kikuyu: Haddii Ilaahu ku ammaanmay isaga, Ilaahna waa ammaani doonaa isaga qudhiisa, oo markiiba wuu ammaani doonaa.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

kikuyu: Carruur yahay yaryari, weli in yar baan idinla joogayaa. Waad i dooni doontaan, oo sidaan Yuhuuddii ku idhi, Meeshaan tegayo iman kari maysaan, idinkana hadda sidaasaan idinku leeyahay.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

kikuyu: Waxaan idin siinayaa qaynuun cusub oo ah, Waa inaad isjeclaataan; sidaan idiin jeclaaday, idinkuna waa inaad isu jeclaataan.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

kikuyu: Sidaasay dadka oo dhammi idinku garan doonaan inaad xertaydii tihiin, haddaad jacayl isu qabtaan.
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

kikuyu: Simoon Butros ayaa ku yidhi, Sayidow, xaggee baad tegaysaa? Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, Meeshaan tegayo hadda ii raaci kari maysid, laakiin mar dambe waad i soo raaci doontaa.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

kikuyu: Butros ayaa ku yidhi, Sayidow, maxaan hadda kuu raaci kari waayay? Naftaydaan aawadaa u bixin doonaaye.
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Miyaad naftaada u bixin doontaa aawaday? Runtii, runtii, waxaan kugu leeyahay, Diiqu ciyi maayo ilaa aad saddex kol i dafirtid.
english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

kikuyu: Qalbigiinnu yuusan murugoon. Ilaah waad rumaysan tihiin, anigana i rumaysta.
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

kikuyu: Guriga Aabbahay wuxuu leeyahay hoyaal badan. Haddaanay sidaas ahayn waan idiin sheegi lahaa, maxaa yeelay, waxaan u tegayaa inaan meel idiin sii diyaariyo.
english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

kikuyu: Oo haddaan tago oo meel idiin diyaariyo, mar dambe waan soo noqon doonaa, oo xaggaygaan idiin qaadan doonaa, in meeshaan joogo, idinkuna aad joogtaan.
english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

kikuyu: Oo meeshaan tegayo iyo jidkaba waad taqaaniin.
english: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

kikuyu: Toomas ayaa ku yidhi, Sayidow, ma naqaan meeshaad tegaysid ee sidee baan ku naqaan jidka?
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu Toomas ku yidhi, Anigu waxaan ahay jidka iyo runta iyo nolosha. Ninna Aabbaha uma yimaado, xaggayguu ku yimaado maahee.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

kikuyu: Haddaad i garateen, Aabbahayna waad garan lahaydeen. Hadda ka dib waad garanaysaan, waadna aragteen.
english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

kikuyu: Filibos baa ku yidhi, Sayidow, Aabbaha na tus, waana nagu filan yahay.
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma intaas badan baan idinla joogay, oo aanad i garanaynin, Filibosow? Kii i arkay wuxuu arkay Aabbaha. Sidee baad u leedahay, Aabbaha na tus?
english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

kikuyu: Miyaadan rumaysan inaan Aabbaha ku jiro, Aabbuhuna uu igu jiro? Erayadaan idinkula hadlayo, anigu iskagama hadlayo, Aabbahase igu jira ayaa shuqulladiisa sameeya.
english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

kikuyu: I rumaysta inaan Aabbaha ku jiro, oo Aabbuhuna aniga igu jiro, haddii kale shuqullada aawadood ii rumaysta.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kii i rumaystaa, shuqullada aan sameeyo, isna wuu samayn doonaa, oo shuqullo kuwan ka waaweynna wuu samayn doonaa, maxaa yeelay, Aabbahaan u tegayaa.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

kikuyu: Oo wax alla waxaad magacayga ku weyddiisataan, waan samayn doonaa in Aabbuhu ku ammaanmo Wiilka.
english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

kikuyu: Haddii aad wax igu weyddiisataan magacayga, waan samayn doonaa.
english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

kikuyu: Haddii aad i jeceshihiin, qaynuunnadayda waad xajin doontaan.
english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

kikuyu: Aniguna Aabbahaan baryi doonaa, isna wuxuu idin siin doonaa Gargaare kale inuu idinla jiro weligiin,
english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

kikuyu: waxaa weeye, Ruuxa runta ah oo aanay dunidu qaadan karin, waayo, ma aragto, garanna mayso, idinkuse waad garanaysaan, waayo, wuu idinla jiraa, wuuna idinku jiri doonaa.
english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

kikuyu: Idiinkama tegi doono agoonnimo, ee waan idiin imanayaa.
english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

kikuyu: In yar dabadeed dunidu i arki mayso mar dambe, idinkuse waad i arkaysaan. Waan noolahay, taas aawadeed idinkuna waad noolaan doontaan.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

kikuyu: Maalintaas waxaad garan doontaan inaan Aabbahay ku jiro, idinna aad igu jirtaan, anna aan idinku jiro.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

kikuyu: Kii qaynuunnadayda haysta oo xajiya, waa kaas kan i jecel, kan i jecelna Aabbahay waa jeclaan doonaa, anna waan jeclaan doonaa, waana isu muujin doonaa isaga.
english: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

kikuyu: Yuudas (Yuudas Iskariyod ma aha) ayaa ku yidhi isaga, Sayidow, maxaa dhacay oo annaga aad isugu kaaya muujin doontaa, dunidana aadan isugu muujin doonin?
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Haddii nin i jecel yahay, ereygayguu xajin doonaa, Aabbahayna waa jeclaan doonaa, oo waannu u iman doonnaa, waanna la joogi doonnaa.
english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

kikuyu: Kii aan i jeclayn, ereygayga ma xajiyo: ereygaad maqlaysaanna kayga ma aha, laakiin waxaa leh Aabbaha i soo diray.
english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas ayaan idinkula hadlay intaan idinla joogay,
english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

kikuyu: laakiin Gargaaraha Ruuxa Quduuska ah oo Aabbuhu ku soo diri doono magacayga, wax kasta ayuu idin bari doonaa, wuxuuna idin xusuusin doonaa wax kasta oo aan idinku idhi.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

kikuyu: Nabad baan idiinka tegayaa, nabaddaydana waan idin siinayaa, sida dunidu u siiso anigu idiin siin maayo. Qalbigiinnu yuusan murugoon, yuusanna biqin.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

kikuyu: Waad maqasheen inaan idinku idhi, Waan tegayaa, waanan idiin imanayaa. Haddaad i jeclaateen, waad farxi lahaydeen, waayo, Aabbahaan u tegayaa, maxaa yeelay, Aabbuhu waa iga weyn yahay.
english: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

kikuyu: Haatan waxaan idiinku sheegay intaanay dhicin, in markay dhacaan aad rumaysataan.
english: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

kikuyu: Mar dambe wax badan idinlama sii hadli doono, maxaa yeelay, kan madaxda dunida ahu wuu imanayaa, isaguna waxba iguma laha.
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

kikuyu: Laakiin tani waa in dunidu ku garato inaan Aabbaha jeclahay iyo inaan sameeyo sida Aabbuhu igu amray. Kaca, aynu meeshan ka tagnee.
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay geedka canabka ah oo runta ah; Aabbahayna waa beerfalaha.
english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

kikuyu: Laan walba oo igu taal oo aan midho dhalin, wuu gooyaa, oo mid kasta oo midho dhasha ayuu nadiifiyaa si ay midho ka sii badan u dhasho.
english: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

kikuyu: Durba waad nadiifsan tihiin hadalkaan idinkula hadlay daraaddiis.
english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

kikuyu: Igu jira, anna aan idinku jiree. Sida laantu keligeed aanay midho u dhali karin haddaanay geedka canabka ah ku oollin, sidaas oo kale idinkuna ma dhali kartaan haddaydnan igu jirin.
english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

kikuyu: Anaa ah geedka canabka ah, idinna waxaad tihiin laamihii. Kii igu jira oo anna aan ku jiro, kaasaa midho badan dhala, maxaa yeelay, la'aantay waxba ma samayn kartaan.
english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

kikuyu: Qof uun hadduusan igu jirin waxaa loo tuuraa sida laan oo kale, waana qallalaa, markaasaa la ururiyaa, oo dabka lagu tuuraa, oo la gubaa.
english: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

kikuyu: Haddaad igu jirtaan, oo ay erayadayduna idinku jiraan, weyddiista waxaad doonaysaanba, waana laydiin yeeli doonaa.
english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

kikuyu: Waxaa Aabbahay ku ammaanmaa inaad midho badan dhashaan, waxaadna noqon doontaan xertayda.
english: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

kikuyu: Siduu Aabbuhu ii jeclaaday, ayaan anna idiin jeclaaday. Jacaylkayga ku sii jira.
english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

kikuyu: Haddaad qaynuunnadayda xajisaan, jacaylkaygaad ku jiri doontaan, sidaan qaynuunnada Aabbahay u xajiyey, oo aan jacaylkiisa ugu jiro.
english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

kikuyu: Waxaan waxyaalahaas idiinkula hadlay in farxaddaydu idinku jirto, iyo inay farxaddiinnu buuxsanto.
english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

kikuyu: Kanu waa qaynuunkayga inaad isjeclaataan sidaan idiin jeclaaday.
english: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

kikuyu: Ninna ma leh jacayl kan ka weyn inuu nin naftiisa u bixiyo saaxiibbadiis.
english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

kikuyu: Saaxiibbaday baad tihiin haddaad yeeshaan waxaan idinku amro.
english: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

kikuyu: Mar dambe addoommo idiinku yeedhi maayo, maxaa yeelay, addoonku garan maayo wuxuu sayidkiisu sameeyo, laakiin saaxiibbo waan idiinku yeedhay, maxaa yeelay, waxaan Aabbahay ka soo maqlay oo dhan ayaan idin ogeysiiyey.
english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

kikuyu: Idinku ima aydnaan dooran, laakiinse anaa idin doortay, waanan idiin diray inaad tagtaan oo midho soo dhashaan, iyo in midhihiinnu sii jiraan, in wax alla waxaad Aabbaha magacayga ku weyddiisataan uu idin siiyo.
english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas ayaan idiinku amray inaad isjeclaataan.
english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

kikuyu: Dunidu hadday idin nebcaato, waad garanaysaan inay hortiin i nebcaatay.
english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

kikuyu: Haddaad kuwa dunida ahaan lahaydeen, dunidu kuweeda way jeclaan lahayd, laakiin kuwa dunida ma ihidin, waanse idinka doortay dunida, taas aawadeed dunidu way idin neceb tahay.
english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

kikuyu: Xusuusta hadalkaan idinku idhi, Addoon kama weyna sayidkiisa. Hadday i silciyeen, idinkana way idin silcin doonaan. Hadday hadalkayga xajiyeen, kiinnana way xajin doonaan.
english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxyaalahaas oo dhan waxay idiinku samayn doonaan magacayga aawadii, maxaa yeelay, waxaanay garanayn kii i soo diray.
english: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

kikuyu: Haddaanan iman oo aanan la hadlin, dembi ma ay lahaadeen, laakiin hadda dembigooda marmarsiinyo uma haystaan.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

kikuyu: Kii i neceb, waxaa kaluu neceb yahay Aabbahay.
english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

kikuyu: Haddaanan dhexdooda ku samayn shuqullada aan nin kale samayn, dembi ma ay lahaadeen, haddase aniga iyo Aabbahayba way na arkeen oo na nebcaadeen.
english: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

kikuyu: Laakiin sidaas waxay u noqotay inuu dhammaado hadalka sharcigooda ku qorani, Way ii nebcaadeen sababla'aan.
english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

kikuyu: Laakiin markuu yimaado Gargaaraha oo aan xagga Aabbaha ka soo diri doono, isagoo ah Ruuxa runta oo xagga Aabbaha ka soo baxa, ayuu ii marag furi doonaa.
english: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

kikuyu: Idinkuna waad marag furi doontaan, waayo, tan iyo bilowgii waad ila jirteen.
english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

kikuyu: Waxaan waxyaalahaas idiinkula hadlay inaydnaan ka xumaanin.
english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

kikuyu: Waxay idinka saari doonaan sunagogyada, weliba saacaddaa imanaysa in mid walboo idin dilaa uu u malaynayo inuu Ilaah u adeegayo.
english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

kikuyu: Oo waxay waxyaalahaas u samayn doonaan, waayo, waxaanay garanayn Aabbaha iyo aniga toona.
english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan waxyaalahaas idiinkula hadlay in markii saacaddoodu timaado aad xusuusataan inaan idiin sheegay. Tan iyo bilowgii waxyaalahaas idinkulama hadlin, maxaa yeelay, waan idinla joogay.
english: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadda waxaan u tegayaa kii i soo diray, midkiinna i weyddiin maayo, Xaggee baad tegaysaa?
english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas aan idinkula hadlay aawadood, qalbigiinna murug baa ka buuxsantay.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

kikuyu: Laakiin runta ayaan idiin sheegayaa, Waxaa idiin roon inaan tago. Haddaanan tegin, Gargaaruhu idiinma iman doono, laakiin haddaan tago waan idiin soo diri doonaa.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

kikuyu: Isagu markuu yimaado wuxuu dunida ku caddayn doonaa xagga dembiga iyo xaqa iyo xukunka;
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

kikuyu: xagga dembiga, waayo, way i rumaysan waayeen;
english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

kikuyu: xagga xaqa, waayo, Aabbahaan u tegayaa, imana arki doontaan mar dambe;
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

kikuyu: xagga xukunka, waayo, kan madaxda dunida ah waa la xukumay.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

kikuyu: Wax badan oo kalaan leeyahay inaan idiin sheego, laakiin imminka qaadi kari maysaan.
english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

kikuyu: Laakiin markuu kan Ruuxa runta ahu yimaado, wuxuu idinku wadi doonaa runta oo dhan, waayo, isagu iskama hadli doono, wuxuuse ku hadli doonaa wuxuu maqlo, wuxuuna idiin sheegi doonaa waxa imanaya.
english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

kikuyu: Wuu i ammaani doonaa, waayo, waxayguu qaadi doonaa, wuuna idiin sheegi doonaa.
english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

kikuyu: Wax kasta oo Aabbuhu leeyahay anigaa leh. Sidaa daraaddeed waxaan idhi, Waxayguu qaadaa, wuuna idiin sheegi doonaa.
english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

kikuyu: In yar dabadeed i arki maysaan, oo weliba in yar dabadeed waad i arki doontaan.
english: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed xertiisa qaarkood waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Waa maxay waxan uu inagu leeyahay, In yar dabadeed i arki maysaan, oo weliba in yar dabadeed waad i arki doontaan, iyo, Maxaa yeelay, Aabbahaan u tegayaa?
english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxay yidhaahdeen, Waa maxay waxan uu leeyahay, In yar dabadeed? Garan mayno wuxuu leeyahay.
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa garanayay inay doonayeen inay wax weyddiiyaan, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma waxaad isweyddiinaysaan xaalkan aan idhi, In yar dabadeed i arki maysaan, oo weliba in yar dabadeed waad i arki doontaan?
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Waad ooyi doontaan oo barooran doontaan, duniduse waa farxi doontaa. Waad murugoon doontaan, laakiin murugaddiinnu waxay u rogman doontaa farxad.
english: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

kikuyu: Naagtu goortay umulayso, way murugootaa, waayo, saacaddeedaa timid, laakiin markay ilmaha umusho, dhibtii dib uma xusuusato farxad aawadeed, waayo, nin baa dunida ku dhashay.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

kikuyu: Haddaba waad murugsan tihiin, laakiin mar dambe ayaan idin arki doonaa, qalbigiinnuna wuu farxi doonaa, farxaddiinnana ninna idinkama qaadi doono.
english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
