kikuyu: Oo maalintaasna waxba ima weyddiin doontaan. Runtii, runtii, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Haddii aad wax uun weyddiisataan Aabbaha, magacayga ayuu idinku siin doonaa.
english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

kikuyu: Tan iyo imminka waxba magacayga kuma weyddiisan. Weyddiista, waanad heli doontaan, inay farxaddiinnu buuxsanto.
english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas ayaan masaallo idinkula hadlay. Waxaa imanaysa goortii aanan mar dambe masaallo idinkula hadli doonin, laakiin aan bayaan idiinkaga warrami doono Aabbaha.
english: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

kikuyu: Maalintaas waxaad ku weyddiisan doontaan magacayga. Idinkuma lihi inaan Aabbaha baryayo daraaddiin.
english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

kikuyu: Waayo, Aabbaha qudhiisu wuu idin jecel yahay, maxaa yeelay, waad i jeclaateen, oo waadna rumaysateen inaan xagga Ilaah ka imid.
english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

kikuyu: Aabbaha ayaan ka imid oo dunida imid. Haddana waan ka tegayaa dunida oo Aabbahaan u tegayaa.
english: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

kikuyu: Xertiisii ayaa ku tidhi, Bal eeg, bayaan baad hadda u hadlaysaaye, oo masaal ku hadli maysid.
english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

kikuyu: Imminka waannu garanaynaa inaad wax walba taqaan, oo aadan u baahnayn qofna inuu wax ku weyddiiyo. Taas aawadeed waannu rumaysan nahay inaad Ilaah ka timid.
english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Hadda ma rumaysan tihiin?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

kikuyu: Ogaada, saacaddii baa imanaysa, waana timid, kolkaad u kala firdhi doontaan mid kasta xaggiisa, anna keligay baad iga tegi doontaan, oo weliba keligay ma ihi, waayo, waxaa ila jooga Aabbaha.
english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas waxaan idiinkula hadlay inaad nabad igu haysataan. Dunida ayaad dhib kala kulantaan, laakiinse kalsoonaada, anaa ka adkaaday dunidaye.
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas Ciise ayaa ku hadlay, markaasuu indhihiisii kor u qaaday xagga samada oo yidhi, Aabbow, saacaddii way timid. Ammaan Wiilkaaga inuu Wiilku ku ammaano,
english: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

kikuyu: sidaad amar ugu siisay dadka oo dhan inuu nolosha weligeed ah siiyo kuwaad isaga siisay oo dhan.
english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

kikuyu: Tanu waa nolosha weligeed ah inay ku gartaan, adoo ah Ilaaha runta ah oo keliya, iyo inay gartaan Ciise Masiix, kii aad soo dirtay.
english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Dhulka ayaan kugu ammaanay, anoo dhammeeyey shuqulkaad ii dhiibtay inaan sameeyo.
english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

kikuyu: Haddana, Aabbow, adiga qudhaadu igu ammaan ammaantaan kula lahaa intaan dunidu jirin.
english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

kikuyu: Magacaagaan u muujiyey dadkii aad dunida iga siisay. Kuwaagii bay ahaayeen, oo anaad i siisay, iyaguna ereygaagay xajiyeen.
english: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

kikuyu: Hadda waxay garanayaan wax kastoo aad i siisayba inay xaggaaga ka yimaadeen.
english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

kikuyu: Waayo, erayadaad i siisay ayaan siiyey iyaga, wayna aqbaleen, run ahaan bayna u garteen inaan kaa imid, wayna rumaysteen inaad i soo dirtay.
english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

kikuyu: Iyaga waan kuu baryayaa; kuu baryi maayo dunida, laakiin waxaan kuu baryayaa kuwaad i siisay, waayo, waa kuwaagii.
english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

kikuyu: Waxayga oo dhan adaa leh, waxaagana anaa leh, iyagana waan ku ammaanmay.
english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

kikuyu: Anigu dunida sii joogi maayo; kuwanuse duniday joogayaan, aniguna waan kuu imanayaa. Aabbe Quduusow, iyaga ku hay magacaagii aad i siisay, inay mid ahaadaan sideenna oo kale.
english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

kikuyu: Intaan iyaga la jiray, waxaan iyaga ku hayay magacaagii aad i siisay, waanan ilaaliyey, midkoodna ma lumin, wiilka halaagga maahee, in Qorniinku ahaado.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Haddana waan kuu imanayaa, oo waxyaalahan ayaan ku hadlayaa intaan dunida joogo inay haystaan farxaddayda oo ay ka buuxsanto iyaga.
english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

kikuyu: Ereygaagii ayaan siiyey, oo dunidu waa nebcaatay, waayo, iyagii kuwa dunida ma aha, sidaanan kan dunida u ahayn.
english: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

kikuyu: Kaa baryi maayo inaad iyaga dunida ka qaaddid, waxaanse kaa baryayaa inaad ka dhawrtid kan sharka leh.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

kikuyu: Iyagu kuwa dunida ma aha, sidaanan kan dunida u ahayn.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

kikuyu: Iyaga quduus kaga dhig runta, ereygaagu waa rune.
english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

kikuyu: Sidaad dunida iigu soo dirtay ayaan anna iyaga dunida ugu diray.
english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

kikuyu: Oo aawadood ayaan quduus iskaga dhigaa, in iyagana xagga runta quduus lagaga dhigo.
english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

kikuyu: Kuwan oo keliya kuu baryi maayo, waxaanse weliba kuu baryayaa kuwa igu rumaysanaya hadalkooda aawadiis,
english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

kikuyu: inay dhammaan mid ahaadaan, sidaad adigu, Aabbow, iigu jirtid, aniguna aan kuugu jiro, inay iyaguna inoogu jiraan, in dunidu rumaysato inaad i soo dirtay.
english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

kikuyu: Oo ammaantaad i siisay iyagaan siiyey, inay mid ahaadaan sidaynu mid u nahay.
english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

kikuyu: Iyagaan ku jiraa, adna anigaad igu jirtaa, inay mid ku dhan yihiin, in dunidu garato inaad i soo dirtay, iyo inaad iyaga u jeclaatay, sidaad ii jeclaatay.
english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

kikuyu: Aabbow, kuwaad i siisay waan doonayaa inay ila joogaan meeshaan joogo inay arkaan ammaantaydii aad i siisay, waayo, adaa i jeclaa intaan dunida la aasaasin.
english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

kikuyu: Aabbaha xaqa ahow, dunidu kuma ay garanaynin, laakiinse waan ku garanayay; kuwanna waxay garanayeen inaad i soo dirtay.
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

kikuyu: Magacaagaan iyagii garansiiyey, waanan garansiin doonaa, in jacaylkii aad i jeclayd uu ku jiro iyaga, anna aan iyaga ku jiro.
english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

kikuyu: Ciise markuu waxyaalahaas yidhi wuu la baxay xertiisii oo kala gudbay Tog Qidroon, meeshay ku tiil beer uu galay, isaga iyo xertiisiiba.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

kikuyu: Yuudasna, kii gacangeliyey, meeshaas wuu garanayay, waayo, Ciise marar badan ayuu meeshaas xertiisii la tegi jiray.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Haddaba Yuudas isagoo askar iyo saraakiil ka wada wadaaddadii sare iyo Farrisiintii ayuu meeshaas la yimid laambado iyo siraaddo iyo hub.
english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Ciise isagoo og waxa ku dhici doona oo dhan ayuu baxay oo ku yidhi iyaga, Kumaad doondoonaysaan?
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

kikuyu: Waxay ugu jawaabeen, Ciisihii reer Naasared. Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Isagii baan ahay. Waxaana iyaga la taagnaa Yuudas kii gacangeliyey.
english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Ciise markuu ku yidhi, Isagii baan ahay, dib bay u socdeen, oo dhulkay ku dhaceen.
english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

kikuyu: Mar kale haddaba ayuu weyddiiyey, oo ku yidhi, Kumaad doondoonaysaan? Oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Ciisihii reer Naasared.
english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Waan idiin sheegay inaan isagii ahay. Haddaba haddaad i doonaysaan, kuwan iska daaya, ha tageene.
english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

kikuyu: Wuxuu saas u yidhi inuu dhammaado hadalkii uu ku hadlay oo ahaa, Kuwii aad i siisay, midkoodna ma lumin.
english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

kikuyu: Simoon Butros haddaba, isagoo seef haysta, ayuu soo bixiyey, oo wuxuu ku dhuftay wadaadka sare addoonkiisii, oo ka gooyay dhegta midigta. Addoonkii magiciisu wuxuu ahaa Malkos.
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Ciise wuxuu Butros ku yidhi, Seefta galkeeda ku celi. Koobka Aabbuhu i siiyey miyaanan cabbayn?
english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

kikuyu: Haddaba askartii iyo ninkii u sarreeyey iyo saraakiishii Yuhuudda ayaa Ciise qabtay, markaasay xidhxidheen,
english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

kikuyu: oo markii hore waxay u geeyeen Annas, waayo, wuxuu ahaa soddoggii Kayafas oo ahaa wadaadkii sare sannaddaas.
english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

kikuyu: Kayafas wuxuu ahaa kii kula taliyey Yuhuudda inay u roon tahay in nin keliyahu dadka u dhinto.
english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

kikuyu: Waxaa Ciise daba socday Simoon Butros iyo mid kale oo xer ah. Ninkaas xerta ahaa wadaadka sare waa garanayay, wuuna la galay Ciise barxadda wadaadkii sare.
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

kikuyu: Butros se wuxuu taagnaa albaabka agtiisa oo dibadda ah. Sidaa daraaddeed kii kale oo xerta ahaa oo wadaadka sare garanayay ayaa dibadda u soo baxay oo la hadlay tii albaabka ilaalinaysay, oo Butros ayuu soo geliyey.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

kikuyu: Gabadhii albaabka ilaalinaysay waxay Butros ku tidhi, Adiguna ma waxaad tahay mid ka mid ah ninkan xertiisa? Wuxuu ku yidhi, Ma ihi.
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa taagnaayeen addoommadii iyo saraakiishii oo dab dhuxul ah sameeyey, maxaa yeelay, dhaxan bay ahayd, wayna kulaalayeen. Butrosna wuu la joogay, isagoo taagan oo dabka kulaalaya.
english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

kikuyu: Haddaba wadaadkii sare wuxuu Ciise wax ka weyddiiyey xertiisii iyo waxbariddiisii.
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Bayaan baan dunida ula hadlay, oo weligay wax baan ku bari jiray sunagogyada iyo macbudka, meesha ay Yuhuudda oo dhammi isugu timaado, oo waxba si qarsoon uma odhan jirin.
english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

kikuyu: Maxaad ii weyddiinaysaa? Weyddii kuwa maqlay waxaan kula hadlay. Bal eeg, kuwaasaa og waxaan idhi e.
english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

kikuyu: Markuu sidaas yidhi saraakiishii midkood oo ag taagnaa ayaa Ciise dharbaaxay isagoo leh, Ma saasaad ugu jawaabaysaa wadaadka sare?
english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Haddii aan si xun u hadlay, xumaanta ka marag fur, haddaan si wanaagsan u hadlayse, maxaad ii dharbaaxaysaa?
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

kikuyu: Annas haddaba wuxuu isagoo xidhxidhan u diray Kayafas oo ahaa wadaadka sare.
english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

kikuyu: Simoon Butros ayaa taagnaa oo dabka kulaalayay. Haddaba waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Adiguna ma waxaad tahay xertiisii midkood? Markaasuu inkiray oo yidhi, Ma ihi.
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

kikuyu: Addoommadii wadaadka sare midkood oo qaraabo ay ahaayeen kii Butros uu dhegta ka gooyay wuxuu yidhi, Miyaanan beerta kugula arkin isaga?
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

kikuyu: Haddaba Butros mar kale ayuu inkiray, oo markiiba diiqii baa ciyey.
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise ayay ka kaxeeyeen Kayafas ilaa guriga taliyaha. Waxay ahayd aroortii hore, oo iyagu ma ay gelin guriga taliyaha si aanay u nijaasoobin, laakiinse inay cashadii Iidda Kormaridda wax ka cunaan.
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

kikuyu: Bilaatos haddaba ayaa u soo baxay iyagii oo ku yidhi, Maxaad ku ashtakaynaysaan ninkan?
english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

kikuyu: Way u jawaabeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Ninkanu haddaanu ahayn xumaanfale, kuuma aannu soo gacangelinneen.
english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Bilaatos wuxuu ku yidhi, Idinku qaata, oo sharcigiinna ku xukuma. Yuhuuddu waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Xalaal nooma aha inaannu nin dillo,
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

kikuyu: inuu ahaado hadalkii Ciise ku hadlay kolkuu sheegay siduu u dhiman doono.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kikuyu: Bilaatos haddaba guriga taliyaha ayuu mar kale galay oo Ciise u yeedhay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Adigu ma waxaad tahay Boqorka Yuhuudda?
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Ma adaa iska odhanaya waxaas, mise kuwa kalaa iiga kaa sheegay?
english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

kikuyu: Bilaatos ayaa ugu jawaabay, Ma Yuhuudi baan ahay? Quruuntaadii iyo wadaaddadii sare ayaa ii soo kaa gacangeliyeye. Maxaad samaysay?
english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Boqortooyadaydu tan dunidan ma aha. Haddii boqortooyadaydu tan dunidan tahay, midiidinyadaydu waa ii diriri lahaayeen inaan Yuhuudda la ii gacangelin. Imminkase boqortooyadaydu tan halkan ma aha.
english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Bilaatos ayaa ku yidhi, Haddaba ma boqor baad tahay? Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Waad tidhaahdaa inaan boqor ahay. Taas ayaan u dhashay, oo taas ayaan dunida u imid, inaan marag u furo runta. Mid kasta oo kan runta ah wuu maqlaa codkayga.
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

kikuyu: Bilaatos ayaa ku yidhi, Waa maxay runtu? Oo markuu sidaa ku yidhi, mar kale ayuu Yuhuudda u baxay oo ku yidhi, Eedna isagii kuma aan helin.
english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaad leedihiin caado inaan mid idiin sii daayo Iidda Kormaridda. Haddaba ma doonaysaan inaan idiin sii daayo Boqorkii Yuhuudda?
english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay dhammaan mar kale qayliyeen iyagoo leh, Ninkan ma aha, laakiin Baraabbas. Baraabbas wuxuu ahaa waxdhace.
english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bilaatos haddaba Ciise watay oo karbaashay,
english: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

kikuyu: askartiina taaj ayay qodxan uga taxeen, oo madaxiisay saareen, oo waxay u geliyeen dhar guduudan.
english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

kikuyu: Markaasay u yimaadeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Nabad Boqorka Yuhuuddow, wayna dharbaaxeen.
english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

kikuyu: Bilaatos haddana dibadduu u baxay oo ku yidhi iyaga, Eega, isagaan idiin soo bixinayaa inaad ogaataan inaanan eed ku helin.
english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

kikuyu: Ciise haddaba ayaa dibadda u soo baxay isagoo sita taajkii qodxanta ahaa iyo dharkii guduudnaa, oo Bilaatos ayaa ku yidhi iyaga, Bal eega ninka.
english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed markii wadaaddadii sare iyo saraakiishii arkeen, ayay qayliyeen iyagoo leh, Iskutallaabta ku qodob, iskutallaabta ku qodob. Bilaatos ayaa ku yidhi, Idinku wata, oo iskutallaabta ku qodba, waayo, anigu eed kuma aan heline.
english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

kikuyu: Yuhuuddii ayaa ugu jawaabtay, Sharci baannu leennahay, sharcigaas xaggiisana waa inuu dhinto, waayo, wuxuu iska dhigay Wiilka Ilaah.
english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Bilaatos markuu hadalkaas maqlay, aad buu u sii baqay,
english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

kikuyu: oo haddana wuxuu galay guriga taliyaha oo ku yidhi Ciise, Xaggee baad ka timid? Laakiin Ciise jawaabna uma uu celinin.
english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Bilaatos ayaa ku yidhi, Miyaanad ila hadlayn? Miyaanad ogayn inaan leeyahay amar aan kugu sii daayo iyo amar aan iskutallaabta kugu qodbo?
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ugu jawaabay, Amarna iguma aad lahaateen haddaan xagga sare lagaa siin. Sidaa daraaddeed kii ii soo kaa gacangeliyey ayaa kaa dembi weyn.
english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

kikuyu: Taas dabadeed Bilaatos wuxuu doonayay inuu sii daayo, laakiin Yuhuuddii ayaa qaylisay iyagoo leh, Haddaad ninkan sii daysid, Kaysar saaxiibkiis ma ihid. Nin kasta oo boqor iska dhigaba, wuxuu ku caasiyaa Kaysar.
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

kikuyu: Haddaba Bilaatos markuu hadalladaas maqlay, ayuu Ciise dibadda u soo saaray, oo wuxuu ku fadhiistay kursiga xukumaadda, meesha la yidhaahdo Sallaxa Dhagaxa ah oo af Cibraanigana lagu yidhaahdo Gabbata.
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxay ahayd Maalintii Diyaargarayskii Kormaridda, abbaaraha saacaddii lixaad. Oo wuxuu Yuhuudda ku yidhi, Bal eega boqorkiinna.
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed waxay ku qayliyeen, Kaxee, kaxee, iskutallaabta ku qodob. Markaasaa Bilaatos wuxuu ku yidhi, Boqorkiinna miyaan iskutallaabta ku qodbaa? Wadaaddadii sare ayaa ugu jawaabay, Boqor ma lihin Kaysar maahee.
english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu haddaba u dhiibay in iskutallaabta lagu qodbo.
english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

kikuyu: Wayna kaxeeyeen Ciise. Markaas isagoo sita iskutallaabta ayuu u kacay meeshii Dhakada la yidhaahdo, oo af Cibraaniga lagu odhan jiray Golgota,
english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

kikuyu: meeshaasay iskutallaabaha ku qodbeen isaga iyo laba kale, midba gees, Ciisena dhexda.
english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

kikuyu: Bilaatosna wax buu qoray oo ku dhejiyey iskutallaabta dusheeda, waxaana ku qorraa, CIISIHII REER NAASARED, BOQORKA YUHUUDDA.
english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Yuhuudda badideed ayaa qorniinkaas akhriday, waayo, meeshii Ciise iskutallaabta lagaga qodbay waa u dhowayd magaalada, oo qorniinkii wuxuu ku qorraa af Cibraaniga iyo af Roomaaniga iyo af Gariigga.
english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed wadaaddadii sare oo Yuhuudda waxay Bilaatos ku yidhaahdeen, Ha qorin, Boqorka Yuhuudda, laakiin qor, Kanaa yidhi, Waxaan ahay Boqorka Yuhuudda.
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

kikuyu: Bilaatos ayaa ugu jawaabay, Waxaan qoray ayaan qoray.
english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

kikuyu: Haddaba askartii markay Ciise iskutallaabta ku qodbeen, dharkiisay qaateen oo ay afar meelood ka dhigeen, askari waliba meel buu qaatay, khamiiskiina way qaateen. Khamiiskii meella kama tollayn dusha iyo hoosta.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Yeynan kala jeexin, laakiin aan u saami ridanno kii heli doona, inuu noqdo Qorniinka oo leh, Iyagu waxay qaybsadeen dharkaygii. Khamiiskaygiina way u saami riteen. Haddaba waxyaalahaas askartii baa samaysay.
english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

kikuyu: Waxaa Ciise iskutallaabtiisa ag taagnaa hooyadiis, iyo habaryartiis, Maryan afadii Kaloobaas, iyo Maryan tii reer Magdala.
english: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Ciise markuu arkay hooyadiis iyo kii xerta ahaa oo uu jeclaa oo ag taagan, ayuu hooyadiis ku yidhi, Islaan yahay, waa kaa wiilkaagii.
english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu kii xerta ahaana ku yidhi, Waa taa hooyadaa. Oo saacaddaas dabadeed kii xerta ahaa ayaa gurigiisii u kaxeeyey.
english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

kikuyu: Markaas dabadeed Ciise isagoo garanaya wax kasta inay dhammaadeen, in Qorniinku ahaado, ayuu yidhi, Waan harraadsanahay.
english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa meeshaas yiil weel khal ka buuxo. Sidaa daraaddeed geed isbonji la yidhaahdo bay khalkii ka buuxiyeen, markaasay kor saareen geed husob la yidhaahdo oo afkiisa ku dhoweeyeen.
english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

kikuyu: Haddaba markii Ciise khalkii qaatay ayuu yidhi, Waa dhammaatay, markaasuu madaxa foororshay oo ruuxii bixiyey.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed Yuhuuddii, inaan meydadku sabtida iskutallaabaha sii saarnaan, waxay Bilaatos ka baryeen in lugaha laga jebiyo oo meydadka la qaado, waayo, waxay ahayd Maalintii Diyaargarayska, oo maalinta sabtidaas waxay ahayd maalin weyn.
english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

kikuyu: Haddaba askartii waa timid, oo ay lugaha ka jebiyeen kii hore iyo kii kale oo iskutallaabaha lagula qodbay isaga.
english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

kikuyu: Laakiin markay Ciise u yimaadeen oo ay arkeen inuu durba dhintay kama ay jebin lugihii.
english: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

kikuyu: Laakiin mid askartii ka mid ah ayaa dhinaca Ciise waran kaga wareemay, oo markiiba waxaa ka soo baxay dhiig iyo biyo.
english: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

kikuyu: Oo kii arkayna wuu marag furay, maraggiisuna waa run, wuuna garanayaa inuu run sheegayo, inaad idinkuna rumaysataan.
english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxyaalahaas waxay u dhaceen inuu ahaado Qorniinka leh, Lafihiisa midna la jebin maayo.
english: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

kikuyu: Oo Qorniin kale wuxuu leeyahay, Way arki doonaan kii ay wareemeen.
english: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas dabadeed, Yuusuf kii ahaa reer Arimataya, isagoo xer u ah Ciise laakiinse si qarsoon cabsidii uu ka cabsaday Yuhuudda aawadeed, wuxuu Bilaatos ka baryay inuu meydka Ciise qaado. Bilaatosna waa u fasaxay. Sidaa daraaddeed wuu yimid oo meydkiisii qaaday.
english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa kaloo yimid Nikodemos kii markii hore habeennimada u yimid, wuxuuna keenay malmal iyo cuud isku qasan oo qiyaastii boqol rodol ah.
english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxay qaadeen meydkii Ciise oo ku duudduubeen maryo iyo dhir udgoon siday caadada aasniinta Yuhuuddu ahayd.
english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

kikuyu: Meeshii isaga iskutallaabta lagu qodbay waxaa ku tiil beer, beerta dhexdeedana waxaa ku tiil xabaal cusub oo aan ninna weli la dhigin.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

kikuyu: Haddaba Maalintii Diyaargarayska oo Yuhuudda aawadeed ayay meeshaas Ciise u dhigeen, waayo, xabaashii waa dhowayd.
english: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.

kikuyu: Maalintii ugu horraysay ee toddobaadka Maryan tii reer Magdala ayaa aroortii hore xabaashii timid, intay weli gudcur ahayd, oo waxay aragtay dhagaxii oo xabaashii laga qaaday.
english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed way orodday oo u tagtay Simoon Butros iyo kii kale oo xerta ahaa oo Ciise jeclaa, waxayna ku tidhi, Sayidkii ayay xabaashii kala baxeen, oo garan mayno meeshay dhigeen.
english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

kikuyu: Saas aawadeed Butros iyo kii kale oo xerta ahaa ayaa baxay, oo waxay tageen xabaashii.
english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

kikuyu: Way wada ordeen labadoodiiba, oo kii kale oo xerta ahaa ayaa Butros ka dheereeyey, oo uga hor maray xabaashii.
english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

kikuyu: Markaasuu foororsaday, oo wuxuu arkay maryihii oo yaal, laakiinse ma uu gelin.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

kikuyu: Haddana Simoon Butros oo daba socday baa yimid, markaasuu xabaashii galay, oo wuxuu arkay maryihii oo yaal
english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

kikuyu: iyo maradii madaxiisa saarnayd oo aan la oollin maryihii, laakiin meel keligeed ku duudduubnayd.
english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

kikuyu: Markaas haddaba waxaa galay kii kale oo xerta ahaa oo hore u yimid xabaashii, wuuna arkay oo rumaystay.
english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

kikuyu: Waayo, weli Qorniinka ma ay garan inay tahay inuu kuwa dhintay ka soo sara kaco.
english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

kikuyu: Haddaba xertii ayaa mar kale guryahoodii ku noqotay.
english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

kikuyu: Laakiin Maryan ayaa xabaashii dibaddeeda taagnayd iyadoo ooyaysa. Haddaba intay ooyaysay bay xabaashii ku foororsatay.
english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

kikuyu: Waxayna aragtay laba malaa'igood oo dhar cadcad xidhan oo fadhiya meesha meydka Ciise oolli jiray, mid madaxa, midna cagaha.
english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Haweenay yahay, maxaad u ooyaysaa? Markaasay ku tidhi, Waxaan u ooyayaa, Sayidkaygii bay qaadeen, oo garanna maayo meeshay dhigeen.
english: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

kikuyu: Markay sidaa ku tidhi ayay dib u jeesatay oo ay aragtay Ciise oo taagan, mana ay garanaynin inuu Ciise yahay.
english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Haweenay yahay, Maxaad u ooyaysaa? Kumaad doondoonaysaa? Iyadoo u malaynaysa inuu yahay ninkii beerta ka shaqaynayay waxay ku tidhi, Adeerow, haddaad isagii halkan ka qaadday, ii sheeg meeshaad dhigtay, anna waan ka soo qaadan doonaaye.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Maryamay. Markaasay jeesatay oo afka Cibraaniga ku tidhi, Rabbooni, ee ah Macallimow.
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

kikuyu: Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Ha i taaban, waayo, weli kor uguma aan tegin Aabbaha, laakiin u tag walaalahay oo ku dheh, Wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan kor ugu tegayaa Aabbahay oo ah Aabbihiin, Ilaahay oo ah Ilaahiin.
english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

kikuyu: Maryan tii reer Magdala ayaa timid oo xertii ku tidhi, Waxaan arkay Sayidkii, oo waxay u sheegtay inuu waxyaalahaas iyada ku yidhi.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

kikuyu: Haddaba maalintaas markay makhribkii ahayd, ayaantii u horraysay ee toddobaadka, oo ay albaabbadu xidhnaayeen meeshay xertu joogtay cabsida ay Yuhuudda ka cabsadeen aawadeed, ayaa Ciise yimid oo isdhex taagay, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Nabadi ha idinla jirto.
english: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Oo markuu waxaas yidhi, wuxuu iyagii tusay gacmihiisii iyo dhinaciisii. Sidaa daraaddeed xertii waa ku farxeen markay Sayidkii arkeen.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ciise ayaa mar kale ku yidhi, Nabadi ha idinla jirto. Sida Aabbuhu ii soo diray ayaan anna idiin dirayaa.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

kikuyu: Oo markuu waxaas yidhi ayuu ku neefsaday oo ku yidhi, Aqbala Ruuxa Quduuskaa.
english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

kikuyu: Nin alla ninkaad dembiyadiisa cafidaan way cafiyan yihiin, nin alla ninkaad dembiyadiisa ku celisaan way ceshan yihiin.
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Toomas mid laba iyo tobanka ka mid ah oo Didumos la odhan jiray lama joogin markuu Ciise yimid.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

kikuyu: Haddaba xertii kale ayaa ku tidhi, Waxaannu aragnay Sayidkii. Laakiin wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaanan gacmihiisa ku arkin calaamadii musmaarrada, oo aanan fartayda gelin nabarkii musmaarrada, oo aanan gacantayda gelin dhinaciisa, rumaysanba maayo.
english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

kikuyu: Oo siddeed maalmood dabadeed xertiisii gudaha ayay mar labaad wada joogeen, oo Toomasna waa la joogay. Markaasaa Ciise yimid, albaabbadii oo xidhan, oo intuu isdhex taagay ayuu ku yidhi, Nabadi ha idinla jirto.
english: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu Toomas ku yidhi, Fartaada keen oo arag gacmahayga, oo gacantaadana keen oo geli dhinacayga, oo ha rumaysad la'aanin laakiin rumayso.
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

kikuyu: Toomas ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Rabbigay iyo Ilaahayow.
english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi, Waad i aragtay, taas aawadeed ayaad rumaysatay. Waxaa barakaysan kuwa aan i arag ee rumaystay.
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa Ciise ku sameeyey xertii hortooda calaamooyin kale oo badan oo aan ku qorrayn kitaabkan.
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

kikuyu: Laakiin waxyaalahan waxaa loo qoray inaad rumaysataan inuu Ciise yahay Masiixa, Wiilka Ilaah, iyo inaad nolosha ku lahaataan magiciisa idinkoo rumaysanaya.
english: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas dabadeed Ciise ayaa mar kale xertii isugu muujiyey Bad Tiberiyas agteeda. Oo sidatan ayuu isu tusay.
english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

kikuyu: Waxaa wada joogay Simoon Butros, iyo Toomas ka la yidhaahda Didumos, iyo Nataana'el oo ahaa kii Kaana tii Galili, iyo wiilashii Sebedi, iyo laba kale oo xertiisa ah.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

kikuyu: Simoon Butros wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Waa soo kalluumaysanayaa. Markaasay ku yidhaahdeen, Annana waa ku raacaynaa. Markaasay tageen oo doonnida fuuleen; laakiin habeenkaas waxba ma ay qaban.
english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

kikuyu: Laakiin markii waagu beryay Ciise wuxuu taagnaa xeebta, xertiisiise ma ay garanaynin inuu Ciise yahay.
english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise haddaba ku yidhi, Carruur yahay, wax la cuno ma haysaan? Waxay ugu jawaabeen, Maya.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Shabagga ku tuura dhinaca midigta ee doonnida, waadna heli doontaane. Haddaba way tuureen, oo ma ayna karin inay soo jiidaan, kalluunka faro badnaantiisa aawadeed.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

kikuyu: Kii xerta ahaa oo Ciise jeclaa ayaa ku yidhi Butros, Waa Sayidkii. Haddaba markuu Simoon Butros maqlay inuu Sayidka yahay, ayuu dharkiisa guntaday (waayo, wuu qaawanaa), oo wuxuu isku tuuray badda.
english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

kikuyu: Laakiin xertii kale waxay ku yimaadeen sixiimadda yar (waayo, kama ay fogayn dhulka, laakiin waxay u jireen qiyaastii laba boqol oo dhudhun), waxayna jiidayeen shabaggii kalluunka.
english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

kikuyu: Haddaba markay dhulkii u soo degeen waxay arkeen dab dhuxul ah iyo kalluun saaran iyo kibis.
english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise ku yidhi iyagii, Keena qaar kalluunkaad hadda soo qabateen.
english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Simoon Butros ayaa sixiimaddii fuulay, oo wuxuu xagga dhulka u jiiday shabaggii oo ka buuxa boqol iyo saddex iyo konton kalluun oo waaweyn, oo in kastoo ay faro badnaayeen shabaggii ma dillaacin.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ciise wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Kaalaya oo quraacda. Oo xertii midkoodna kuma uu dhicin inuu yidhaahdo, Kumaad tahay? waayo, waxay garanayeen inuu Sayidka yahay.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa Ciise yimid oo qaaday kibistii oo siiyey iyaga, kalluunkiina sidoo kale.
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

kikuyu: Taasu waa markii saddexaad oo Ciise xertii isu muujiyey markii uu kuwa dhintay ka soo sara kacay dabadeed.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

kikuyu: Haddaba markay quraacdeen dabadeed Ciise wuxuu Simoon Butros ku yidhi, Simoon ina Yoonisow, kuwan ma iga jeceshahay? Wuxuu ku yidhi, Haah, Sayidow, waad og tahay inaan ku jeclahay. Markaasuu ku yidhi, Baraarkayga daaji.
english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

kikuyu: Haddana wuxuu mar labaad ku yidhi isaga, Simoon ina Yoonisow, ma i jeceshahay? Wuxuu ku yidhi, Haah, Sayidow, waad og tahay inaan ku jeclahay. Markaasuu ku yidhi, Idahayga ilaali.
english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

kikuyu: Markii saddexaad ayuu ku yidhi, Simoon ina Yoonisow, Ma i jeceshahay? Butros ayaa ka calool xumaaday, waayo, wuxuu markii saddexaad ku yidhi, Ma i jeceshahay? Markaasuu ku yidhi, Sayidow, wax walba waad og tahay, waadna garanaysaa inaan ku jeclahay. Ciise ayaa ku yidhi, Idahayga daaji.
english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

kikuyu: Runtii, runtii, waxaan kugu leeyahay, Markaad yarayd adigu waad guntan jirtay, oo waxaad mari jirtay meeshaad doonaysay, laakiin markaad gabowdid, gacmahaad kala bixin doontaa, oo mid kalaa kuu guntin doona, oo wuxuu kuu qaadi doonaa meel aadan doonayn.
english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

kikuyu: Wuxuu waxaas u yidhi inuu tuso dhimashaduu Ilaah ku ammaani doono. Markuu waxaas yidhi dabadeed, wuxuu ku yidhi, I soo raac.
english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

kikuyu: Butros markuu jeestay wuxuu arkay kii xerta ahaa oo Ciise jeclaa oo daba socda; isagu wuxuu ahaa kii laabta Ciise ku tiirsanaa wakhtigii cashada oo ku yidhi, Sayidow, waa kuma kan ku gacangelin doonaa?
english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

kikuyu: Haddaba Butros markuu arkay, wuxuu Ciise ku yidhi, Sayidow, kanna ka warran?
english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

kikuyu: Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaan doonayo inuu joogo ilaa aan imanayo, maxaa kaa galay? Adigu i soo raac.
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa walaalaha ku dhex faafay hadalkaas oo leh, Kaas oo xerta ka mid ahaa ma dhiman doono. Laakiin Ciise kuma odhan, Ma dhiman doono, wuxuuse yidhi, Haddaan doonayo inuu joogo ilaa aan imanayo, maxaa kaa galay?
english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

kikuyu: Kan weeye kii xerta ahaa oo u marag furay waxyaalahan, oo qoray waxyaalahan, oo waxaannu garanayna maraggiisu inuu run yahay.
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

kikuyu: Waxaana jira waxyaalo badan oo kale oo Ciise sameeyey, oo haddii mid mid loo wada qoro, waxaan u malaynayaa inaan dunidu qaaddeen buugagga laga qoro.
english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.

kikuyu: Te'ofilosow, hadalkii hore waxaan ka qoray wax kasta oo Ciise bilaabay inuu sameeyo oo baro
english: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

kikuyu: ilaa maalintii sare loo qaaday isaga oo ka dambaysay wakhtiguu Ruuxa Quduuskaa ku amray rasuulladii uu doortay.
english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

kikuyu: Markuu xanuunsaday dabadeed, iyagii ayuu isagoo nool waxyaalo badan oo la hubo isugu muujiyey, oo muddo afartan maalmood ah ayuu iyagii u muuqday, oo kala hadlay waxyaalaha ku saabsan boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Oo intuu iyagii la shiray, ayuu wuxuu kula dardaarmay, oo ku yidhi, Yeruusaalem ha ka tegina, laakiinse suga ballankii Aabbaha oo aad iga maqasheen,
english: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

kikuyu: waayo, runtii Yooxanaa wuxuu dadka ku baabtiisay biyo, laakiinse waxaa laydinku baabtiisi doonaa Ruuxa Quduuska ah maalmo aan badnayn dabadood.
english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed markay isu yimaadeen, ayay weyddiiyeen isaga oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Rabbow, ma haddeer baad boqortooyada u soo celinaysaa Israa'iil?
english: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu iyaga ku yidhi, Dantiinna ma aha inaad ogaataan wakhtiyada iyo xilliyada uu Aabbuhu amarkiisa kaga dhigay.
english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaad heli doontaan xoog markii Ruuxa Quduuska ahi idinku soo dego; oo markhaatiyaal ayaad iiga noqon doontaan Yeruusaalem, iyo Yahuudiya oo dhan, iyo Samaariya, iyo meesha dunida ugu fog.
english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo kolkuu waxyaalahaas yidhi dabadeed, iyagoo eegaya, ayaa sare loo qaaday isagii, oo daruur baa indhahoodii ka qarisay.
english: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

kikuyu: Oo intuu sii socday, iyagoo samada aad u fiirinaya, ayaa waxaa isa soo ag taagay laba nin oo dhar cadcad qaba,
english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Nimankiinan reer Galiliyow, maxaad la taagan tihiin oo aad samada u eegaysaan? Ciisahan samada laydiinka sare qaaday, sidaad u aragteen isagoo samada u socda oo kale ayuu u iman doonaa.
english: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

kikuyu: Markaasay Yeruusaalem ku noqdeen iyagoo ka yimid buurtii Saytuun la odhan jiray, oo u dhowayd Yeruusaalem, oo u jirtay maalin sabtiyeed socodkeed.
english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

kikuyu: Oo markay magaaladii galeen, waxay aadeen qolladdii sare, meeshay joogi jireen Butros iyo Yooxanaa iyo Yacquub iyo Andaros, iyo Filibos iyo Toomas, iyo Bartolomayos, iyo Matayos, iyo Yacquub ina Alfayos, iyo Simoon Qiiroleh, iyo Yuudas ina Yacquub.
english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo dhammu, iyagoo isku wada qalbi ah, ayay ku sii adkaysteen tukasho, iyaga iyo dumarka, iyo Maryan oo ahayd Ciise hooyadiis, iyo walaalihiis.
english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

kikuyu: Oo wakhtigaas ayaa Butros walaalaha dhexdooda istaagay (oo waxaa wada jiray dad badan oo qiyaastoodu ahayd boqol iyo labaatan); markaasuu yidhi,
english: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waxaa waajib ahaa in Qorniinku noqdo, kaas oo Ruuxa Quduuska ahu waagii hore afka Daa'uud kaga hadlay waxa ku saabsan Yuudas oo ahaa kii waday kuwii qabtay Ciise.
english: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, isaga waa laynagu tirshay, oo shuqulkan ayuu qaybtiisii helay.
english: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

kikuyu: Haddaba ninkaasu meel ayuu ku iibsaday abaalgudka xaqdarradiis; oo intuu madax madax u dhacay ayuu dhexda ka kala dillaacay, oo mindhicirkiisii oo dhammuna waa ka soo daatay.
english: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa kuwii Yeruusaalem joogay oo dhammu ay wada ogaadeen; sidaas daraaddeed meeshaas waxaa afkooda loogu bixiyey Akeldama, taas oo micneheedu yahay, meeshii dhiigga.
english: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa kitaabkii Sabuurrada lagu qoray, Gurigiisu cidla' ha noqdo, Ninnana yuusan meeshaas degin; iyo Wakiilnimadiisa mid kale ha qabto.
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’

kikuyu: Haddaba nimankii inala socday wakhti kasta intuu Rabbi Ciise ina soo dhex galay, inagana dhex baxay,
english: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

kikuyu: oo ka bilaabmay baabtiiskii Yooxanaa ilaa maalintii sare laynooga qaaday isaga, iyagii midkood waa inuu markhaati ina gala ahaado sarakiciddiisa.
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

kikuyu: Markaasay laba iska soo saareen, kuwaas oo ahaa Yuusuf oo la odhan jiray Barsabaas ee naanaystiisu ahayd Yuustos, iyo Matiyas.
english: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay tukadeen oo yidhaahdeen, Rabbow, adigoo garanaya qalbiga dadka oo dhan, na tus labadan kaad dooratay,
english: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

kikuyu: inuu galo meeshii shuqulkan iyo rasuulnimadan oo Yuudas ka dhacay inuu meeshiisa tago.
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

kikuyu: Markaasay u saami riteen; saamigiina wuxuu ku dhacay Matiyas; oo isagana waxaa lagu daray koob-iyo-tobankii rasuul.
english: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

kikuyu: Oo kolkii maalintii Bentekoste la gaadhay, meel bay kulligood wada joogeen.
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa filanla'aan samada ka yimid sanqadh sida dabayl xoog leh oo aad u dhacaysa, oo waxay buuxisay gurigii ay fadhiyeen oo dhan.
english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

kikuyu: Markaasaa carrabbo u kala qaybsamaya sida dab oo kale iyaga u muuqday oo ku dul fadhiistay midkood kasta.
english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa waxaa kulligood ka wada buuxsamay Ruuxa Quduuska ah, oo waxay bilaabeen inay afaf kale ku hadlaan sidii Ruuxu iyaga u siiyey hadalka.
english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa Yeruusaalem joogay Yuhuud oo ahaayeen niman cibaado leh oo ka yimid quruun kasta oo samada hoosteeda joogta.
english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

kikuyu: Oo markii sanqadhaas la maqlay, dadkii badnaa ayaa isu yimid, wayna yaabeen, maxaa yeelay, nin kastaa wuxuu maqlay iyagoo afkiisa ku hadlaya.
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

kikuyu: Oo dhammaantood way wada nexeen oo yaabeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Bal eeg, kuwan hadlaya oo dhammu miyaanay reer Galili ahayn?
english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

kikuyu: Sidee baa midkeen waluba u maqlaa iyagoo ku hadlaya afkeenna aynu ku dhalannay?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

kikuyu: Innagoo ah reer Bartiya iyo Mediya iyo Ceelaam, iyo kuwa deggan Mesobotamiya, iyo Yahuudiya iyo Kabbadokiya, iyo Bontos iyo Aasiya,
english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

kikuyu: iyo Farugiya iyo Bamfuliya, iyo Masar iyo meelaha Liibiya oo Kuranaya ku wareegsan, iyo ajanabiyo Rooma ka yimid oo ah Yuhuud iyo kuwa raacsan labadaba,
english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

kikuyu: iyo reer Kereetee iyo Carabta, waxaynu maqlaynaa iyagoo ku hadlaya afafkeenna oo ka hadlaya Ilaah waxyaalihiisa waaweyn.
english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

kikuyu: Markaasay wada yaabeen oo shakiyeen, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Tani micneheedu waa maxay?
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waa ku qosleen oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Kuwan waxaa ka buuxa khamri cusub.
english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros intuu koob-iyo-tobankii isla taagay, ayuu sare u qaaday codkiisa oo ku yidhi iyaga, Niman yahow reer Yahuudiya iyo dhammaantiinan Yeruusaalem degganow, tan ogaada oo hadalladayda dhegaysta.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwanu ma sakhraansana sidaad u malaynaysaan inay sakhraansan yihiin; maxaa yeelay, tanu waa saacaddii saddexaad ee maalmeed.
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxanu waa wixii lagaga dhex hadlay nebi Yoo'eel,
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

kikuyu: Ilaah baa yidhi, Maalmaha ugu dambaysta waxyaalahanu waa noqon doonaan, Ruuxayga ayaan ku shubi doonaa dad oo dhan; Oo wiilashiinna iyo hablihiinnu wax bay sii sheegi doonaan, Raggiinna dhallinyarada ahuna wax bay arki doonaan, Odayaashiinnuna riyooyin bay ku riyoon doonaan;
english: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

kikuyu: Haah, oo maalmahaas addoommadayda, rag iyo dumarba, Ruuxaygaan ku shubi doonaa, iyaguna wax bay sii sheegi doonaan.
english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan samada sare ka muujin doonaa yaabab, Dhulka hoosena waxaan ka muujin doonaa calaamooyin, Kuwaas oo ah dhiig iyo dab iyo uumiskii qiiqa.
english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

kikuyu: Qorraxdu waxay u beddelmi doontaa gudcur, Dayaxuna wuxuu u beddelmi doonaa dhiig, Intaanay iman maalinta Rabbigu, Taas oo ah maalin weyn oo caan ah.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqon doontaa in ku alla kii magaca Rabbiga ku dhawaaqaa, uu badbaadi doono.
english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

kikuyu: Rag yahow reer binu Israa'iil, hadalladan maqla; Ciisihii reer Naasared oo ahaa nin Ilaah idiinku caddeeyey shuqullo xoog leh iyo yaabab iyo calaamooyin oo Ilaah ku sameeyey isaga gacantiisa idinka dhexdiinna, sidaad idinka qudhiinnuba u og tihiin,
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

kikuyu: markii isaga lagu gacangeliyey taladii Ilaah goostay oo uu hore u ogaa, gacanta sharcilaawayaasha ayaad ku qabateen, waadna ku qodobteen iskutallaabta oo disheen.
english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

kikuyu: Isaga Ilaah baa sara kiciyey, oo ka furfuray xanuunkii dhimashada, maxaa yeelay, dhimashadu ma xajin karin.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

kikuyu: Waayo, Daa'uud baa isaga ka hadlay, oo yidhi, Had iyo jeerba Rabbigaan hortayda ku arki jiray, Maxaa yeelay, midigtayduu joogaa si aan la ii dhaqaajin.
english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

kikuyu: Taas aawadeed qalbigaygu waa farxay, carrabkayguna waa reyreeyey; Weliba jidhkaygu rajuu ku nasan doonaa.
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, naftayda Haadees kuma dayn doontid, Kaaga Quduuska ahna uma dayn doontid inuu qudhun arko.
english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

kikuyu: Waxaad i tustay jidadka nolosha, Hortaadana farxad baad iga buuxin doontaa.
english: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waxaan si bayaan ah idiinku sheegi karaa in awowe Daa'uud dhintay, lana aasay, xabaashiisuna ilaa maanta waa inagu dhex taal.
english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

kikuyu: Haddaba isagoo nebi ahaa oo ogaa in Ilaah dhaar ugu dhaartay isaga inuu dhashiisa midkood carshigiisa ku fadhiisin doono,
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

kikuyu: wuxuu hore u arkay oo ka hadlay Masiixa sarakiciddiisa inaan isaga Haadees lagu dayn, jidhkiisuna qudhun arag.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

kikuyu: Ciisahan Ilaah baa sara kiciyey, annagoo dhammuna markhaatiyaal baan ka wada nahay.
english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

kikuyu: Haddaba isagoo Ilaah midigtiisa sare loogu qaaday, oo Aabbaha ka helay ballankii Ruuxa Quduuska ahaa, ayuu soo shubay waxan oo aad arkaysaan oo maqlaysaan.
english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, Daa'uud samooyinka kor uma aadin; laakiin isaga qudhiisaa leh, Rabbigu wuxuu Sayidkayga ku yidhi, Midigtayda fadhiiso
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

kikuyu: Ilaa aan cadaawayaashaada cagahaaga hoostooda geliyo.
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

kikuyu: Reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu aad ha u ogaadeen in Ilaah ka dhigay Rabbi iyo Masiixba Ciisahan aad iskutallaabta ku qodobteen.
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

kikuyu: Markay taas maqleen ayaa qalbiga laga wareemay, markaasay ku yidhaahdeen Butros iyo rasuulladii kale, Walaalayaalow, maxaannu falnaa?
english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros iyagii ku yidhi, Toobadkeena, oo midkiin kasta ha lagu baabtiiso magaca Ciise Masiix dembidhaafkiinna aawadiis, oo waxaad heli doontaan hadiyadda ah Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, ballanka waxaa leh idinka iyo carruurtiinna iyo kuwa fog oo dhan in alla intii Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ahu u yeedho.
english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

kikuyu: Hadallo kaloo badan ayuu markhaati ahaan ugu waaniyey isagoo leh, Naftiinna ka badbaadiya qarnigan qalloocan.
english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa kuwii hadalkiisii aqbalay la baabtiisay, oo waxaa maalintaas lagu daray iyaga abbaaraha saddex kun oo qof.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku sii adkaysteen rasuulladu waxay bari jireen iyo xidhiidhka ka dhexeeyey iyaga, iyo kibista jebinteeda iyo tukasho.
english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

kikuyu: Oo naf kasta cabsi baa gashay; oo rasuulladii waxay sameeyeen yaabab iyo calaamooyin badan.
english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii rumaystay oo dhammu waa wada jireen, wax walubana waa ka wada dhexeeyeen;
english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

kikuyu: oo intay iibiyeen waxyaalahoodii iyo alaabtoodiiba ayay dhammaan u wada qaybiyeen sidii nin kasta baahidiisu ahayd.
english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

kikuyu: Oo maalin walba iyagoo isku wada qalbi ah ayay macbudka ku jiri jireen, oo kibistana guryahooday ku jejebin jireen, cuntadoodana farxad iyo qalbi daacad ah ayay ku cuni jireen.
english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

kikuyu: Ilaah bay ammaani jireen, oo dadka oo dhammuna waa u bogay iyaga. Ilaahna maalin walba kuwa badbaadaya ayuu ku dari jiray.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

kikuyu: Haddaba saacaddii sagaalaad oo wakhtigii salaadda ah ayaa Butros iyo Yooxanaa macbudka tageen.
english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Waxaa la soo qaaday nin curyaannimo uurkii hooyadiis kala soo baxay oo maalin walba la ag dhigi jiray albaabka macbudka oo la odhan jiray Qurux Badane inuu kuwa macbudka gelayay dawarsado.
english: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

kikuyu: Isagu, markuu arkay Butros iyo Yooxanaa oo ku dhow inay macbudka galaan, ayuu dawarsaday iyaga.
english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros, oo Yooxanaa la socdo, intuu aad u fiiriyey isaga, ku yidhi, Na soo eeg.
english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu u fiirsaday iyaga, isagoo filanaya inuu iyaga wax ka helo.
english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros baa ku yidhi, Lacag iyo dahab midna ma haysto, laakiin waxaan haystaan ku siinayaa. Magaca Ciise Masiix, kii reer Naasared, ku soco.
english: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu intuu gacanta midigtaa ku dhegay ayuu sara kiciyey; oo markiiba cagihiisii iyo anqowyadiisiiba waa xoogaysteen.
english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

kikuyu: Intuu kor u booday ayuu istaagay oo socod bilaabay; markaasuu iyaga macbudkii la galay, isagoo socda oo boodboodaya oo Ilaah ammaanaya.
english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

kikuyu: Dadkii oo dhammuna waxay arkeen isagoo socda oo Ilaah ammaanaya;
english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

kikuyu: markaasay waxay garteen inuu isagu yahay kii Albaabkii Quruxda Badnaa agtiisa dawarsiga u fadhiisan jiray; markaasay yaab iyo amankaag ula dhinteen wixii ku dhacay isaga.
english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

kikuyu: Oo intuu Butros iyo Yooxanaa ku dhegganaa ayay dadkii oo dhammu ku soo wada ordeen balbaladii la odhan jiray Balbaladii Sulaymaan iyagoo aad u yaabsan.
english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

kikuyu: Markuu Butros dadkii arkay ayuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Niman yahow reer binu Israa'iil, Maxaad waxan ula yaabsan tihiin, ama maxaad sidaas noogu fiirinaysaan sidii annagoo xooggayaga ama cibaadadayada ku socodsiinnay isaga?
english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

kikuyu: Ilaaha Ibraahim iyo Isxaaq iyo Yacquub, oo ahaa Ilaaha awowayaasheen, wuxuu ammaanay Midiidinkiisii Ciise, kii aad gacangeliseen oo aad Bilaatos hortiisa ku diideen markuu goostay inuu sii daayo.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

kikuyu: Laakiin idinku waxaad diideen Kan Quduuska iyo Xaqaba ah, oo waxaad weyddiisateen nin dhiig qaba in laydiin sii daayo,
english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

kikuyu: oo waxaad disheen Amiirkii nolosha, kan Ilaah ka sare kiciyey kuwii dhintay, annaguna markhaatiyaal baannu ka nahay.
english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

kikuyu: Magiciisa ayaa xoogsiiyey kan aad arkaysaan oo garanaysaan, rumaysadka uu magiciisa ku rumaystay aawadiis. Rumaysadka uu ku rumaystay isaga ayaa ninkan idinka oo dhan hortiinna ku siiyey caafimaadkan.
english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

kikuyu: Waxaanan ogahay, walaalayaalow, inaad tan aqoonla'aan u samayseen, sidii madaxdiinnuba yeeshay oo kale.
english: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah sidaasuu u dhammeeyey waxyaalihii uu hore uga sheegay afafkii nebiyada oo dhan oo ahaa in Masiixu silci doono.
english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

kikuyu: Haddaba toobadkeena oo soo noqda, si dembiyadiinna loo tirtiro, si ay wakhtiyo qabowjis lihii uga yimaadaan Rabbiga hortiisa,
english: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

kikuyu: oo uu soo diro Ciise Masiix, kii uu hore idiinku doortay,
english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

kikuyu: kan ay waajibka tahay inay samadu aqbasho tan iyo wakhtiyada la soo celinayo wax walba oo Ilaah kaga hadlay afkii nebiyadiisii quduuska ahaa tan iyo bilowgii.
english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

kikuyu: Muuse wuxuu yidhi, Rabbiga Ilaaha ahu wuxuu walaalihiinna dhexdooda idiinka kicin doonaa nebi anoo kale ah. Waa inaad isaga ka dhegaysataan wax kastuu idinku yidhaahdo.
english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

kikuyu: Waxay noqon doontaa in naf kastoo aan nebigaas dhegaysan dadka laga dhex saari doono oo la baabbi'in doono.
english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

kikuyu: Nebiyadii oo dhan tan iyo Samuu'eel iyo kuwii ka dambeeyey, in alla intii hadashay, waxay wada sheegeen maalmahan.
english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

kikuyu: Waxaad tihiin wiilashii nebiyada iyo wiilashii axdigii Ilaah la dhigtay awowayaashiin, markuu Ibraahim ku yidhi, Qabiilooyinka dunida oo dhammu farcankaagay ku barakoobi doonaan.
english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’

kikuyu: Ilaah markuu Midiidinkiisii kiciyey, idinkuu markii hore idiin soo diray inuu idin barakeeyo markuu midkiin kasta dembiyadiisa ka soo jeediyo.
english: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

kikuyu: Intay dadkii la hadlayeen ayaa wadaaddadii iyo sirkaalkii macbudka iyo Sadukiintii u yimaadeen,
english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

kikuyu: iyagoo ka xumaaday, maxaa yeelay, waxay dadkii bareen oo Ciise ku ogeysiiyeen sarakicidda kuwii dhintay.
english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

kikuyu: Markaasay qabqabteen oo xabbiseen ilaa maalintii ku xigtay, maxaa yeelay, durba fiidkii bay ahayd.
english: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

kikuyu: Laakiin qaar badan oo hadalkii maqlay waa rumaysteen; oo tiradii nimanku waxay noqotay abbaaraha shan kun.
english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa dhacday in maalintii dambe taliyayaashoodii iyo waayeelladoodii iyo culimmadoodii ay Yeruusaalem isugu soo wada urureen;
english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: waxaana joogay Annas oo ahaa wadaadkii sare, iyo Kayafas, iyo Yooxanaa, iyo Aleksanderos, iyo in alla intii wadaadka sare xigaalo la ahayd.
english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

kikuyu: Oo intay dhexda soo taageen bay weyddiiyeen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Xooggee ama magacee baad waxan ku samayseen?
english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros oo Ruuxa Quduuska ahi ka buuxo wuxuu iyaga ku yidhi, Kuwiinnan dadka u taliya iyo waayeelladow,
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

kikuyu: haddii maanta naloo imtixaamayo falimihii wanaagsanaa oo loo sameeyey nin xoogdaran iyo sidii ninkan loo bogsiiyey,
english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

kikuyu: dhammaantiin ogaada, idinka iyo dadka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu, in magaca Ciise Masiix, kii reer Naasared, oo aad iskutallaabta ku qodobteen, oo Ilaah ka sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay, daraaddiis ninkanu isagoo bogsaday halkan hortiinna ah ku taagan yahay.
english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

kikuyu: Isagu waa dhagixii idinkoo wax dhisa aad diiddeen, oo noqday madaxa rukunka.
english: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’

kikuyu: Mid kale badbaadada lagama helo, maxaa yeelay, ma jiro magac kale samada hoosteeda oo dadka dhexdooda loo bixiyey oo waajib inoo ah inaynu ku badbaadno.
english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

kikuyu: Markay arkeen Butros iyo Yooxanaa dhiirranaantoodii, oo ay garteen inay yihiin niman aan wax baran, jaahiliinna ah, ayay yaabeen; markaasay garteen inay Ciise la joogi jireen.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

kikuyu: Markay arkeen ninkii la bogsiiyey oo la taagan iyaga, waxba way ka odhan kari waayeen.
english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

kikuyu: Laakiin intay amreen inay shirka dibadda uga baxaan, ayay wada hadleen iyagoo leh,
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

kikuyu: Maxaynu nimankan ku samaynaa? Waayo, inay calaamo caan ah faleen waa u muuqataa kuwa Yeruusaalem jooga oo dhan; mana dafiri karno.
