english: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

kikuyu: Laakiin si ayan dadka ugu sii faafin, aynu cabsiinno si ayan hadda ka dib magacan ninna ugula hadlin.
english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

kikuyu: Markaasay u yeedheen oo ku amreen inayan aslanba Ciise magiciisa ku hadlin, waxna ku barin.
english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros iyo Yooxanaa ayaa u jawaabay iyagii oo ku yidhi, Idinku kala xukuma inay Ilaah hortiisa ku qumman tahay inaannu idinka idin maqallo intaannu Ilaah maqli lahayn, iyo in kale;
english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

kikuyu: waayo, waxyaalihii aannu aragnay oo maqallay iskama dayn karno inaannu ka hadalno.
english: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

kikuyu: Markaasay, intay sii cabsiiyeen, sii daayeen, waayo, waxay waayeen waxay ku taqsiiraan, dadka aawadiis; maxaa yeelay, dadkii oo dhammu waxay Ilaah ku ammaaneen wixii la sameeyey.
english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

kikuyu: Waayo, ninkii calaamadan lagu bogsiiyey waa ka weynaa afartan sannadood.
english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

kikuyu: Markii la sii daayay ayay intoodii kale u yimaadeen oo uga warrameen wixii wadaaddada sare iyo waayeelladu ku yidhaahdeen oo dhan.
english: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

kikuyu: Oo markay taas maqleen, iyagoo isku wada qalbi ah, ayay codkoodii sare ugu qaadeen Ilaah oo yidhaahdeen, Rabbiyow, adigu waxaad tahay kan sameeyey samada, iyo dhulka, iyo badda, iyo waxa ku jira oo dhan;
english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

kikuyu: kii Ruuxa Quduuska ah kaga hadlay afkii awowahayo Daa'uud oo ahaa midiidinkaagii oo yidhi, Quruumuhu maxay u cadhoodeen, Dadkuna maxay ugu fikireen wax aan waxba ahayn?
english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

kikuyu: Boqorrada dhulku col bay u taagnaayeen. Taliyayaashuna intay is-urursadeen Ayay waxay caasi ku noqdeen Rabbiga iyo Masiixiisa;
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’

kikuyu: waayo, waxaa run ah in magaaladan gudaheeda Herodos iyo Bontiyos Bilaatos oo ay la jiraan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn iyo dadka reer binu Israa'iil iyagoo ka gees ah Ciise Midiidinkaaga quduuska ah, oo aad subagtay, ay isu urursadeen,
english: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

kikuyu: inay sameeyaan wax alla wixii gacantaada iyo taladaadu hore u gooyeen inay noqdaan.
english: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

kikuyu: Laakiin Rabbiyow, eeg, way na cabsiinayaane; haddaba addoommadaada sii dhiirranaan oo dhan oo ay ereygaaga ku sheegaan,
english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

kikuyu: intii aad gacantaada u soo fidinaysid si aad ugu bogsiisid, si calaamooyin iyo yaabab ugu samaysmaan magaca Midiidinkaaga quduuska ah Ciise.
english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

kikuyu: Oo markay tukadeen dabadeed, meeshay ku urursanaayeen baa gariirtay; oo dhammaantood waxaa ka wada buuxsamay Ruuxa Quduuska ah, oo ereygii Ilaah bay dhiirranaan ugu hadleen.
english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

kikuyu: Oo intoodii badnayd oo rumaysatay isku qalbi iyo naf bay ahaayeen; midkoodna ma odhan, Waxaan leeyahay waa waxaygii, laakiin wax waluba waa ka dhexeeyeen.
english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

kikuyu: Oo rasuulladu xoog weyn bay sarakicidda Rabbi Ciise uga marag fureen; oo nimco badan baa dhammaantood ku soo dul degtay.
english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

kikuyu: Mid wax la'aana iyaga kuma jirin, waayo, in alla intii dhul ama guryo lahayd way iibiyeen, oo qiimihii wixii la iibiyey ayay keeneen,
english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

kikuyu: oo rasuullada soo hor dhigeen; oo waxaa wax loo qaybshay mid kasta siduu wax ugu baahnaa.
english: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf oo rasuulladu ugu yeedhi jireen Barnabas, kan lagu micneeyey Wiilkii dhiirigelinta, oo qoladiisu Laawi ahayd oo reer Qubrus u dhashay,
english: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

kikuyu: intuu beer uu lahaa iibshay ayuu lacagtii keenay oo soo hor dhigay rasuullada.
english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

kikuyu: Laakiin nin Ananiyas la odhan jiray, isagoo haweenaydiisii Safira la jirto, ayuu xoolihiisii qaar iibshay,
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

kikuyu: markaasuu qiimihii, haweenaydiisii oo la og, intuu qaar la hadhay, qaar keenay oo rasuulladii soo hor dhigay.
english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros baa ku yidhi, Ananiyasow, maxaa Shayddaanku qalbigaaga u geliyey inaad Ruuxa Quduuska ah been u sheegtid oo aad qiimihii dhulka qaar la hadhid?
english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

kikuyu: Markaad haysatay, miyaanay waxaagii ahayn? Oo markii la iibshay dabadeedna, miyaanad adigu u talin? Maxaad waxan qalbigaaga u gelisay? Dad been uma aad sheegin, waxaadse u sheegtay Ilaah.
english: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

kikuyu: Markii Ananiyas hadalladaas maqlay ayaa, intuu dhulka ku dhacay, naftii ka dhacday; oo kuwii taas maqlay oo dhan cabsi weyn baa gashay.
english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

kikuyu: Markaasaa nimankii dhallinyarada ahaa, intay kaceen, isagay duudduubeen, markaasay qaadeen oo soo aaseen.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

kikuyu: Abbaaraha saddex saacadood dabadeed ayaa haweenaydiisii soo gashay iyadoo aan ogayn wixii dhacay.
english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Inaad dhulkii intaas ku iibiseen iyo in kale, ii kala sheeg. Markaasay tidhi, Haah, intaasaannu ku iibinnay.
english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros baa ku yidhi, Sidee baad ugu heshiiseen inaad Ruuxa Rabbiga jirrabtaan? Bal eeg, kuwii ninkaaga soo aasay cagahoodii albaabka agtiisay ka soo sanqadhayaane. Adigana way ku qaadi doonaan.
english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

kikuyu: Markiiba intay ku hor dhacday isaga, ayaa naftii ka dhacday; markaasaa nimankii dhallinyarada ahaa soo galeen, oo waxay arkeen iyadoo meyd ah, markaasay intay qaadeen ku aaseen ninkeedii agtiisa.
english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

kikuyu: Markaasaa cabsi weyni gashay kiniisaddii iyo kuwii waxyaalahaas maqlay oo dhan.
english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

kikuyu: Rasuulladii waxay gacmahooda dadka dhexdiisa ku sameeyeen calaamooyin iyo yaabab badan; iyagoo isku wada qalbi ah ayay waxay wada joogeen Balbaladii Sulaymaan.
english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

kikuyu: Laakiin kuwii kale midkoodna kuma dhicin inuu iyaga ku darmado, hase ahaatee dadkii waa sharfeen iyaga;
english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

kikuyu: oo waxaa ku soo kordhay iyaga kuwa badan oo Rabbiga rumaystay, oo rag iyo dumarba leh;
english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

kikuyu: xataa waxay noqotay inay kuwii bukay jidadka u soo saareen oo ku jiifiyeen sariiro iyo dermooyin si hooskiisu u dul maro qaarkood, markii Butros uu soo maro.
english: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa kaloo ku soo ururay dad badan oo ka yimid magaalooyinkii Yeruusaalem ku wareegsanaa, iyagoo wada dad buka iyo kuwo jinniyo wasakh lahu derdereen; oo kulligood waa la wada bogsiiyey.
english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa kacay wadaadkii sare iyo kuwii la socday oo dhan, kuwaas oo ka mid ahaa dariiqada Sadukiinta; markaasay iyagoo aad u xanaaqsan,
english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

kikuyu: intay rasuulladii qabqabteen, xabsi ku rideen.
english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

kikuyu: Laakiin malaa'igtii Rabbiga ayaa habeennimo albaabbadii xabsiga ka furtay, oo intay dibadda u soo saartay, ku tidhi,
english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

kikuyu: Taga oo macbudka isdhex taaga, oo waxaad dadka kula hadashaan erayada oo dhan ee Noloshan.
english: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

kikuyu: Markay taas maqleen ayay, intay aroortii macbudkii galeen, dadkii wax bareen. Laakiin wadaadkii sare iyo kuwii la jiray ayaa yimid, oo waxay isugu yeedheen shirkii iyo duqowdii reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan, markaasay cid u direen xabsigii in kuwii xidhnaa laga keeno.
english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

kikuyu: Laakiin saraakiishu markay xabsiga yimaadeen waa ka waayeen iyagii; markaasay shirkii ku noqdeen oo u warrameen,
english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Waxaannu aragnay xabsigii oo aad u xidhan, oo nimankii ilaalinayayna albaabbada ka taagan yihiin; laakiin markaannu furnay, ninna waa ka waynay.
english: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

kikuyu: Haddaba markii sirkaalkii macbudka iyo wadaaddadii sare hadalladaas maqleen, waxay la fajaceen waxyaalahaasu waxay noqon doonaan.
english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

kikuyu: Mid baa intuu u yimid ku yidhi, Ogaada, nimankii aad xabsiga ku riddeen, macbudkay dhex taagan yihiin, oo dadkay wax ku barayaane.
english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa sirkaalkii, isagoo saraakiil kale la socoto, intuu tegey, rabshadla'aan u soo kaxeeyey; waayo, waxay ka baqeen dadku inuu dhagxiyo.
english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

kikuyu: Markaasay, intay soo kaxeeyeen, shirka soo hor taageen. Kolkaasaa wadaadkii sare weyddiiyey,
english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

kikuyu: oo yidhi, Waxaannu aad idiinku amarnay inaydnaan magacan wax ku barin; laakiin bal eega, waxaad Yeruusaalem ka buuxiseen waxbariddiinnii, oo weliba waxaad damacsan tihiin inaad ninkan dhiiggiisii dusha naga saartaan.
english: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros iyo rasuulladii ayaa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waa inaannu Ilaah addeecno intaannu dad addeeci lahayn.
english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

kikuyu: Ilaahii awowayaashayo ayaa soo sara kiciyey Ciisihii aad geedka ku deldesheen oo disheen.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa isaga gacantiisa midigeed sare ugu qaaday inuu ahaado Amiir iyo Badbaadiye si uu Israa'iil toobad iyo dembidhaaf u siiyo.
english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas annagaa ka marag ah, waxaa kaloona ka marag ah Ruuxa Quduuska ah oo Ilaah siiyey kuwa addeeca isaga.
english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

kikuyu: Laakiin markay taas maqleen, way ka xanaaqeen, oo waxay ku tashadeen inay laayaan.
english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa shirkii iska dhex taagay mid Farrisiinta ka mid ahaa oo la odhan jiray Gamalii'eel, kaas oo ahaa macallinkii sharciga, dadkuna aad u maamuusi jireen, oo wuxuu amray in nimanka dibadda cabbaar loo saaro.
english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

kikuyu: Markaasuu iyagii ku yidhi, Niman yahow reer binu Israa'iil, iska jira waxaad la damacsan tihiin inaad nimankaas ku samaysaan.
english: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, hadda ka hor waxaa kacay Tudas, isagoo nin weyn iska dhigaya, kaasoo niman badan oo qiyaas afar boqol gaadhaa raaceen. Isagii waa la dilay, oo intii addeecday oo dhammuna way kala firdheen, oo waxay noqdeen wax aan waxba ahayn.
english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

kikuyu: Ninkaas dabadiis, waagii dadka la qori jiray, waxaa kacay Yuudas kii reer Galili, oo dad buu duufsaday; isaguna waa dhintay, oo intii addeecday oo dhammuna way kala firdheen.
english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nimankan faraha ka qaada oo iska daaya; waayo, taladan ama shuqulkanu hadday dad ka yimaadeen, waa baabbi'i doonaan;
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

kikuyu: laakiin hadday Ilaah ka yimaadeen, ma baabbi'in kari doontaan; haddii kale malaha waxaa la ogaan doonaa inaad Ilaah la diriraysaan.
english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

kikuyu: Markaasay ku raaceen isaga; oo intay rasuulladii u yeedheen, ayay garaaceen, oo waxay ku amreen inayan magaca Ciise ku hadlin, markaasay sii daayeen.
english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

kikuyu: Markaasay shirkii hortiisii ka tageen, iyagoo ku faraxsan in lagu tiriyey inay istaahilaan in Magaca aawadiis loo maamuus jebiyo.
english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

kikuyu: Maalin walba macbudka dhexdiisa iyo guryahaba kama ay joojin inay dadka baraan oo ku wacdiyaan wax ku saabsan Ciise Masiix.
english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

kikuyu: Waagaas waxaa dhacay, intii xertu badnaysay, in Yuhuuddii Gariigta ahayd ay ka gunuunaceen Cibraaniyadii, maxaa yeelay, carmalladoodii laga dhintay wixii maalin walba la siin jiray looguma hagarbixin.
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

kikuyu: Markaasaa laba-iyo-tobankii, intay isugu yeedheen kuwa badan oo xerta ka mid ahaa, waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Ma wanaagsana inaannu ereyga Ilaah iska dayno oo aannu miisas ka adeegno.
english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

kikuyu: Haddaba, walaalayaalow, waxaad dhexdiinna ka xushaan toddoba nin oo sharaf leh, oo ay ka buuxaan Ruuxa iyo xigmaddu, oo aynu u dooranno shuqulkan.
english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

kikuyu: Annaguse waxaannu ku sii adkaysan doonnaa tukasho iyo shuqulka ereyga.
english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

kikuyu: Hadalkiina waa ka wada farxiyey dadkii badnaa oo dhan; oo waxay doorteen Istefanos oo ahaa nin ay ka buuxaan rumaysad iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ahu, iyo Filibos, iyo Barokhoros, iyo Nikanoor, iyo Timoon, iyo Barmenaas, iyo Nikolas kii reer Antiyokh oo diinta soo galay.
english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

kikuyu: Kuwaasay rasuulladii hor keeneen; oo markay tukadeen dabadeed, ayay gacmahoodii saareen.
english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa ereygii Ilaah faafay, tiradii xertiina Yeruusaalem aad ugu badatay, oo tiro badan oo wadaaddo ahina iimaankay yeeleen.
english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Istefanos oo ay nimco iyo xoog ka buuxaan ayaa dadka dhexdiisa ku sameeyey yaabab iyo calaamooyin waaweyn.
english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa kacay oo Istefanos la murmay kuwii sunagogga la odhan jiray sunagogga Libertiinta, iyo kan reer Kuranaya, iyo reer Iskanderiya, iyo kuwa Kilikiya iyo Aasiya.
english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

kikuyu: Iyaguna waa is-hor taagi kari waayeen xigmaddii iyo Ruuxii uu ku hadlay.
english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

kikuyu: Markaasay niman laaluusheen, oo nimankii baa waxay yidhaahdeen, Waxaannu maqalnay isagoo Muuse iyo Ilaahba caayaya.
english: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

kikuyu: Markaasay kiciyeen dadkii iyo waayeelladii iyo culimmadii, oo intay isagii ku soo kediyeen oo qabteen, ayay shirkii geeyeen.
english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay soo taageen markhaatiyaal been ah oo leh, Ninkanu iskama daayo inuu meeshan quduuska ah iyo sharciga erayo xunxun ka sheego,
english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

kikuyu: waayo, waxaannu maqalnay isagoo leh, Ciisahan reer Naasared meeshan buu dumin doonaa, wuxuuna beddeli doonaa caadooyinkii Muuse inooga tegey.
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

kikuyu: Oo kuwii shirka wada fadhiyey oo dhan, iyagoo aad u fiirinaya, waxay arkeen wejigiisii oo ah sidii weji malaa'igeed oo kale.
english: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii sare wuxuu yidhi, Waxanu ma saasaa?
english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Walaalo iyo aabbayaalow, dhegaysta, Ilaaha Ammaantu wuxuu u muuqday awoweheen Ibraahim markuu Mesobotamiya joogay intuusan Haaraan degin,
english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Ka soo kac waddankaaga iyo dadkaaga, oo kaalay dalka aan ku tusi doono.
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

kikuyu: Markaasuu ka soo kacay dalkii reer Kaldayiin oo wuxuu soo degay Haaraan; oo markuu aabbihiis dhintay ayaa Ilaah meeshaas isaga ka soo wareejiyey oo keenay dalkan aad haatan deggan tihiin,
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

kikuyu: oo dhaxalna kama uu siin, xataa meel uu cagtiisa dhigo; laakiin wuxuu isaga ka ballanqaaday inuu dalka mulki u siiyo isaga iyo farcankiisa ka dambeeyaba, in kastoo uusan dhal lahayn.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

kikuyu: Ilaah sidan buu u hadlay, in farcankiisu degi doono dal shisheeye, oo iyaga la addoonsan doono, oo afar boqol oo sannadood la dhibi doono.
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu yidhi, Quruunta iyagu ay u addoonsamaan ayaan xukumi doonaa; markaas dabadeed ayay ka soo bixi doonaan oo meeshan iigu adeegi doonaan.
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu isaga siiyey axdiga gudniinta; haddaba Ibraahim wuxuu dhalay Isxaaq, oo maalintii siddeedaad ayuu guday isaga; Isxaaqna wuxuu dhalay Yacquub; Yacquubna wuxuu dhalay laba-iyo-tobankii aynu ka soo farcannay.
english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

kikuyu: Kuwii aan ka soo farcannayna intay Yuusuf ka masayreen ayay waxay ka iibiyeen Masar;
english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

kikuyu: laakiin Ilaah baa isaga la jiray oo dhibaatadiisii oo dhan ka samatabbixiyey, oo axsaan iyo xigmad ka siiyey Fircoon, oo ahaa boqorkii Masar; markaasuu isaguna wuxuu isagii taliye uga dhigay Masar iyo reerkiisii oo dhan.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa Masar iyo Kancaan oo dhan ka wada dhacay abaar iyo dhibaato weyn; awowayaasheenna dhuuni bay ka waayeen.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

kikuyu: Laakiin markii Yacquub maqlay in Masar sarreen jiro, ayuu markii ugu horraysay awowayaasheen diray.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

kikuyu: Oo markii labaad waxaa walaalihiis la aqoonsiiyey Yuusuf; markaasaa Fircoon wuxuu gartay Yuusuf qoladiisii.
english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yuusuf cid u diray oo u yeedhay aabbihiis Yacquub iyo dadkiisii oo dhan oo ahaa shan iyo toddobaatan qof.
english: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Yacquub Masar tegey. Isaga qudhiisii waa dhintay iyo awowayaasheenba;
english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

kikuyu: waxaana la geeyey Shekem oo la dhigay xabaashii Ibraahim qiimaha lacagta ah kaga iibsaday wiilashii Xamoor oo Shekem joogay.
english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

kikuyu: Laakiin markuu soo dhowaaday wakhtigii ballankii Ilaah kula ballamay Ibraahim, ayay dadkii ku soo kordheen oo ku bateen Masar,
english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

kikuyu: tan iyo intii boqor kale oo aan Yuusuf oqooni Masar ka kacay.
english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

kikuyu: Isaguna waa khiyaaneeyey dadkeenna, awowayaasheenna wuu xumeeyey, oo wuxuuna ku qasbay inay ilmahoodii yaryaraa iska tuuraan si ayan u sii noolaan.
english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

kikuyu: Muusena wakhtigaasuu dhashay, oo wuxuu ahaa wax qurux badan; oo saddex bilood ayaa gurigii aabbihiis lagu hayay;
english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

kikuyu: markii la tuurayna, Fircoon gabadhiisii ayaa qaadatay oo sidii wiilkeedii oo kale u korsatay.
english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

kikuyu: Muusena waxaa la baray xigmaddii Masriyiinta oo dhan; hadalladiisa iyo falimihiisana xoog buu ku lahaa.
english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

kikuyu: Laakiin markuu gaadhay afartan sannadood oo buuxa ayaa waxaa qalbigiisa gashay inuu walaalihiis oo reer binu Israa'iil ahaa soo booqdo.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Oo markuu arkay midkood oo lagu gardarroonayo, ayuu ka celiyey, oo intuu kii la dulmayay uu aarguday, ayuu Masrigii dilay;
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu u malaynayay in walaalihiis garteen sida Ilaah gacantiisa iyaga ugu samatabbixinayo, laakiin ma ay garan.
english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

kikuyu: Oo maalintii ku xigtay ayuu iyagoo diriraya u yimi, oo wuxuu damcay inuu heshiisiiyo, markaasuu yidhi, Niman yahow, walaalaad tihiine; maxaad isu dulmaysaan?
english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

kikuyu: Laakiin kii deriskiisii dulmayay, ayaa isaga iska riixay oo ku yidhi, Yaa nooga kaa dhigay taliye iyo xaakin?
english: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

kikuyu: Ma waxaad doonaysaa inaad ii dishid sidaad Masrigii shaalay u dishay?
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

kikuyu: Markaasaa Muuse hadalkaas aawadiis cararay, oo sidii ajanabi buu dalka Midyaan u degganaa, meeshaasna laba wiil buu ku dhalay.
english: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

kikuyu: Markii afartan sannadood dhammaatay dabadeed ayaa waxaa isagii Buur Siinay cidladeedii uga muuqatay malaa'ig ku dhex jirta geed dab ka ololayo.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

kikuyu: Oo markii Muuse arkay ayuu wuxuu arkay la yaabay, oo intuu u soo dhowaanayay inuu arko, ayaa waxaa u yimid codkii Rabbiga oo leh,
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan ahay Ilaaha awowayaashaa, Ilaaha Ibraahim iyo Ilaaha Isxaaq iyo Ilaaha Yacquub. Markaasaa Muuse gariiray oo ku dhici waayay inuu eego.
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu isaga ku yidhi, Kabaha cagahaaga ka furfur; maxaa yeelay, meesha aad ku taagan tahay waa dhul quduus ah.
english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

kikuyu: Dadkayga Masar jooga rafaadkooda waan arkay, taahoodana waan maqlay, oo waxaan u imid inaan samatabbixiyo; haddaba kaalay, Masar baan kuu diri doonaaye.
english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

kikuyu: Muusahakan ay diideen oo ku yidhaahdeen, Yaa kaa dhigay taliye iyo xaakin? Isagaa Ilaah ugu soo diray gacanta malaa'igtii geedka uga soo muuqatay inuu ahaado taliye iyo samatabbixiye.
english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

kikuyu: Kanaa iyaga Masar ka soo saaray, oo yaabab iyo calaamooyin ku sameeyey Masar, iyo Badda Cas, iyo cidlada afartan sannadood.
english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

kikuyu: Kanu waa Muusihii ku yidhi reer binu Israa'iil, Ilaah wuxuu walaalihiin idiinka dhex kicin doonaa nebi sidayda oo kale.
english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

kikuyu: Kanu waa kii ku dhex jiray kiniisaddii cidlada oo la jiray malaa'igtii isaga kala hadashay Buur Siinay iyo awowayaasheen, kii la siiyey hadallada nool inuu ina siiyo.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

kikuyu: Isaga awowayaasheen ma ay doonaynin inay addeecaan, laakiin intay iska riixeen ayay qalbigooda geliyeen inay Masar dib ugu jeestaan,
english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

kikuyu: oo waxay Haaruun ku yidhaahdeen, Inoo samee ilaahyo ina hor socda; maxaa yeelay, Muusihii inaga soo kaxeeyey dhulka Masar garan mayno waxa ku dhacay.
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay wakhtigaas sameeyeen weyl, oo sanamkii waxay u keeneen allabari, oo waxay ku farxeen shuqulkii gacmahoodu sameeyeen.
english: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah baa ka jeestay, oo wuxuu faraha uga qaaday inay u adeegaan guutada samada; sida ay ugu qoran tahay kitaabka nebiyada, Bal reer binu Israa'iilow, afartankii sannadood oo aad cidlada joogteen, Ma anigaad i siiseen xoolo qalan iyo allabaryo?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

kikuyu: Weliba waxaad qaadateen taambuuggii Molokh Iyo xiddigtii ilaaha Remfan, Oo ah waxyaalihii aad u samaysateen inaad caabuddaan. Haddaba waxaan idiin kaxayn doonaa Baabuloon shishadeeda.
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

kikuyu: Awowayaasheen waxay cidlada ku hayeen taambuuggii maragga, sidii kii Muuse la hadlay ugu amray isaga inuu u sameeyo sidii qaabkii uu arkay.
english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

kikuyu: Kaas ayaa awowayaasheen markoodii la soo qaadeen Yashuuca markay galeen oo qaateen dhulkii quruumihii Ilaah awowayaasheen hortooda ku eryay, ilaa waagii Daa'uud.
english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

kikuyu: Daa'uudna Ilaah hortiis ayuu wanaag ka helay, oo wuxuu weyddiistay inuu Ilaahii Yacquub u helo meel uu dego.
english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Sulaymaan baa guri u dhisay.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

kikuyu: Hase ahaatee Kan ugu sarreeya ma dego guryo gacmo lagu sameeyo; sida nebigu leeyahay,
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

kikuyu: Samadu waa carshigayga, Dhulkuna waa meeshaan cagaha saarto, Rabbigu wuxuu leeyahay, Guri caynmaad ii dhisi doontaan? Ama maxay tahay meeshaan ku nastaa?
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

kikuyu: Miyaan gacantaydu samayn waxyaalahan oo dhan?
english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’

kikuyu: Idinkan madaxa adag oo aan qalbiga iyo dhegaha laga gudinow, weligiinba Ruuxa Quduuska ah waad hor joogsataan. Sidii awowayaashiin yeeli jireen oo kale ayaad idinna yeeshaan.
english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

kikuyu: Bal nebiyada kee baan awowayaashiin silcin? Xataa iyagu waxay dileen kuwii hore u sheegay imaatinka Kan xaqa ah; kan idinku aad haatan gacangeliseen oo disheen.
english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

kikuyu: Waxaad sharciga u hesheen sidii wax malaa'igahu hagaajiyeen, laakiinse ma aydnaan xajin.
english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

kikuyu: Haddaba markay waxyaalahaas maqleen way ka xanaaqeen oo u ilka jirriqsadeen isaga.
english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

kikuyu: Laakiin isagoo Ruuxa Quduuska ahu ka buuxo ayuu samada aad u fiiriyey, oo wuxuu arkay ammaanta Ilaah iyo Ciise oo midigta Ilaah taagan,
english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu yidhi, Bal eega, waxaan arkayaa samooyinkii oo la furay iyo Wiilkii Aadanaha oo midigta Ilaah taagan.
english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

kikuyu: Laakiin markaasay cod weyn ku qayliyeen oo dhegaha furaysteen, oo iyagoo isku wada qalbi ah ku yaaceen isagii.
english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

kikuyu: Markaasay intay magaalada ka soo saareen dhagxiyeen; kuwii maragga ahaana dharkoodii waxay ag dhigteen nin dhallinyaro ah oo la odhan jiray Sawlos.
english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

kikuyu: Markaasay dhagxiyeen Istefanos oo Rabbiga baryaya oo ku leh, Rabbi Ciisow, ruuxayga qaado.
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu jilba joogsaday oo cod weyn ku qayliyey oo ku yidhi, Rabbiyow, dembigan dushooda ha ka dhigin. Oo markuu sidaas yidhi, ayuu dhintay.
english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

kikuyu: Sawlosna raalli buu ka ahaa diliddiisa. Oo maalintaas kiniisaddii Yeruusaalem ku tiil aad baa loo silciyey; oo dhammaantoodna rasuulladii mooyaane waxay ku kala firdheen dalalka Yahuudiya iyo Samaariya.
english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

kikuyu: Markaasaa niman cibaado leh Istefanos aaseen oo aad ugu baroorteen.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

kikuyu: Laakiin Sawlos aad buu kiniisadda u rafaadiyey, oo intuu guri walba galay, ayuu rag iyo dumarba ka soo jiiday, oo xabsi ku riday.
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwii kala firidhsanaa, meel walba oo ay mareenba ereygii bay ku wacdiyeen.
english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Filibos wuxuu tegey magaalada Samaariya, oo wuxuu dadka ku wacdiyey Masiixa.
english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

kikuyu: Oo dadkii badnaa, iyagoo isku wada qalbi ah, ayay dhegaysteen wuxuu Filibos ku hadlay markay waxyaalahaas maqleen oo ay arkeen calaamooyinkuu sameeyey.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwo badan oo jinniyo wasakh leh qabay, jinniyadii oo cod weyn ku qaylinaya ayaa ka soo baxay, oo kuwo badan oo curyaan ahaa iyo laangadhayaashiiba waa la bogsiiyey.
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

kikuyu: Magaaladaasna aad baa looga farxay.
english: There was great joy in that city.

kikuyu: Waxaa jiray nin Simoon la odhan jiray oo markii hore magaalada wax ku sixri jiray oo dadka reer Samaariya ka yaabin jiray, isagoo isugu sheegaya inuu yahay nin weyn.
english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

kikuyu: Isagay dhammaantood, yar iyo weynba, wada dhegaysan jireen oo odhan jireen, Ninkanu waa xooggii Ilaah oo la odhan jiray Weyne.
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

kikuyu: Sababtii ay u dhegaysteenna waxay ahayd inuu wakhti dheer iyaga sixirkiisa kaga yaabiyey.
english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

kikuyu: Laakiin markay rumaysteen injiilka boqortooyada Ilaah iyo magaca Ciise Masiix oo Filibos ku wacdiyey ayaa iyaga rag iyo dumarba la baabtiisay.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

kikuyu: Simoon qudhiisuna waa rumaystay, oo markii la baabtiisay dabadeed, had iyo goorba wuxuu la socon jiray Filibos, wuuna la yaabay markuu arkay calaamooyinkii iyo yaababkii waaweynaa oo uu sameeyey.
english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

kikuyu: Haddaba markii rasuulladii Yeruusaalem joogay maqleen in Samaariya ereygii Ilaah aqbashay, ayay waxay u soo direen Butros iyo Yooxanaa,
english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

kikuyu: kuwaasoo markay yimaadeen, u duceeyey iyaga inay Ruuxa Quduuska ah helaan;
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, midkoodna weli kuma uu soo degin; laakiinse magaca Rabbi Ciise oo keliya ayaa lagu baabtiisay.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Markaasay gacmahooda saareen, oo waxay heleen Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Haddaba Simoon markuu arkay in markii rasuulladu gacmahooda saareen, waxaa la siiyey Ruuxa Quduuska ah, ayuu lacag u taagay,
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Anigana i siiya xooggan in nin kastoo aan gacmahayga saaroba, uu helo Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros baa wuxuu ku yidhi, Lacagtaadu ha kula baabba'do, maxaa yeelay, waxaad u malaysay in hadiyadda Ilaah lacag lagu helo.
english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

kikuyu: Xaalkan kuma lihid ama qayb ama badh; maxaa yeelay, qalbigaagu Ilaah hortiisa kuma qummana.
english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed xumaantaadan ka toobadkeen, Rabbigana ka bari in fikirka qalbigaaga lagaa cafiyo.
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan arkaa adigoo ku jira xammeetida qadhaadhnimada, kuna xidhan xaqdarrada.
english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Simoon u jawaabay oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Rabbiga ii barya inaan waxyaalahaas aad ku hadasheen midkoodna igu dhicin.
english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

kikuyu: Haddaba iyagu markay marag fureen oo Rabbiga ereygiisa ku hadleen, waxay ku noqdeen Yeruusaalem, waxayna tuulooyin badan oo reer Samaariya ah ku wacdiyeen injiilka.
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

kikuyu: Laakiin Rabbiga malaa'igtiisa ayaa waxay la hadashay Filibos, iyadoo ku leh, Kac oo aad xagga koonfureed, oo waxaad raacdaa jidka Yeruusaalem ka taga ilaa Gaasa taasoo cidla ah.
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

kikuyu: Wuuna u kacay oo aaday; oo waxaana ku soo baxay nin bohon oo Xabashi ah oo amar weyn ka hoos hayay Kandake boqoraddii Xabashida, wuuna u talin jiray maalkeeda oo dhan, wuxuuna Yeruusaalem u yimid inuu Ilaah caabudo.
english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

kikuyu: Kolkuu ka soo noqonayay, ayuu ku fadhiyey gaadhifaraskiisa, oo wuxuu akhriyeyey kitaabka nebi Isayos.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

kikuyu: Ruuxuna wuxuu Filibos ku yidhi, Ku dhowow, oo gaadhigan raac.
english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

kikuyu: Oo Filibos markuu ku orday, wuxuu maqlay isagoo akhriyaya kitaabka nebi Isayos, wuxuuna ku yidhi, Ma garanaysaa waxaad akhriyaysid?
english: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasuu yidhi, Sidee baan ku garan karaa in lay toosiyo mooyaane? Markaasuu Filibos ka baryay inuu soo fuulo oo la fadhiisto.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

kikuyu: Haddaba meeshuu Qorniinka ka akhriyeyey waa tan, Isaga sidii wan la qalayo baa loo kaxeeyey; Oo sidii lax ku aamusan ninka dhogorta ka xiira hortiisa, Isagu afkiisa ma uu furo;
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: Intuu is-hoosaysiiyey baa gartiisii laga qaaday; Farcankiisii yaa sheegi doona? Maxaa yeelay, noloshiisa dhulkaa laga qaaday.
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

kikuyu: Bohonku wuxuu Filibos u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Waxaan kaa baryayaa, Nebigu yuu ka hadlayaa? Ma isaga qudhiisaa mise waa mid kale?
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

kikuyu: Filibos baa afkiisa furay, oo intuu Qorniinkan ka bilaabay ayuu isaga ku wacdiyey Ciise.
english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

kikuyu: Kolkay waddada marayeen waxay yimaadeen meel biyah, bohonkuna wuxuu yidhi, Bal eeg, waa biyo. Maxaa iga celinaya in lay baabtiiso?
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu amray in gaadhigu joogsado; labadooduna biyahay galeen, Filibos iyo bohonkuba, oo wuu baabtiisay isaga.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

kikuyu: Oo markay biyihii ka soo baxeen, ayuu Ruuxii Rabbigu dhuftay Filibos, bohonkuna mar dambe ma uu arkin isagii, maxaa yeelay, jidkiisii ayuu iska qaaday isagoo faraxsan.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

kikuyu: Laakiin Filibos waxaa laga helay Asootos, oo magaalooyinkuu dhex marayay oo dhan wuxuu ku wacdiyey injiilka ilaa intuu gaadhay Kaysariya.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

kikuyu: Laakiin Sawlos oo weli dhaaranaya inuu cabsiiyo oo dilo xerta Rabbiga, ayuu wuxuu u tegey wadaadkii sare,
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

kikuyu: oo weyddiistay warqado uu la tago Dimishaq ilaa sunagogyada, si hadduu helo dadkii Jidka, ha ahaadeen rag ama dumarba, uu iyagoo xidhxidhan Yeruusaalem u keeno.
english: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo kolkuu sodcaalay, waxaa dhacday inuu Dimishaq u soo dhowaaday; oo dhaqsiba waxaa hareerihiisa ka iftiimay iftiin samada ka yimid.
english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

kikuyu: Markaasuu dhulka ku dhacay, oo wuxuu maqlay cod isaga ku leh, Sawlosow, Sawlosow, maxaad ii silcinaysaa?
english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Yaad tahay, Sayidow? Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waxaan ahay Ciisaha aad silcinaysid;
english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

kikuyu: laakiin kac oo magaalada gal, oo waxaa laguu sheegi doonaa wixii kugu waajib ah inaad samaysid.
english: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

kikuyu: Nimankii la sodcaalayayna hadalla'aan bay istaageen, iyagoo codkii maqlaya laakiin aan ninna arkaynin.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Sawlos dhulkii ka kacay; markii indhihiisii furmeenna, waxba ma uu arkin; markaasay gacanta ku hageen oo Dimishaq keeneen.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

kikuyu: Saddex maalmood ayuu aragla'aan joogay, waxbana ma cunin, waxbana ma cabbin.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa Dimishaq joogay nin xer ah oo la odhan jiray Ananiyas; oo Rabbigu wuxuu kula hadlay riyo, isagoo ku leh, Ananiyasow. Isna wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa i kan, Rabbiyow.
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Rabbigu wuxuu ku yidhi, Kac oo aad jidka la yidhaahdo Toosane, oo waxaad guriga Yuudas ka doontaa nin la yidhaahdo Sawlos oo reer Tarsos ah; oo bal eeg, waa tukanayaaye;
english: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu arkay nin la yidhaahdo Ananiyas isagoo u soo gelaya oo gacmihiisa dul saaraya inuu araggiisii helo.
english: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ananiyas baa u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, Rabbiyow, waxaan dad badan ka maqlay ninkanu intuu shar badan u gaystay quduusiintaada Yeruusaalem jooga;
english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: halkanna wuxuu wadaaddada sare ka haystaa amar inuu xidhxidho kuwa magacaaga kuugu yeedha oo dhan.
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Rabbigu wuxuu ku yidhi, Soco, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu ii yahay weel aan doortay inuu magacayga hor geeyo dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn iyo boqorrada iyo reer binu Israa'iil;
english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, waxaan tusi doonaa waxyaalaha waajib ku ah inuu u silco magacaygii dartiis.
english: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Ananiyas tegey oo gurigii galay, oo intuu gacmihiisa dul saaray, ayuu wuxuu ku yidhi, Walaal Sawlosow, Rabbi Ciise oo kuugu muuqday jidkaad ku timid baa ii soo diray inaad araggaaga heshid iyo in Ruuxa Quduuska ahu kaa buuxsamo.
english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Oo markiiba waxaa indhihiisa ka soo dhacay wax xuubab u eg, wuuna helay araggiisii; markaasuu kacay oo waa la baabtiisay;
english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

kikuyu: cunto buuna cunay, waana xoogaystay. Haddaba dhawr maalmood ayuu la joogay xertii Dimishaq joogtay.
english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

kikuyu: Oo markiiba sunagogyada dhexdooda ayuu dadka kaga dhex wacdiyey Ciise inuu yahay Wiilka Ilaah.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

kikuyu: Dadkii maqlay oo dhammuna waa yaabeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Kanu sow ma aha kii Yeruusaalem ku layn jiray kuwa magacaas ugu yeedhi jiray? Oo sababtaas ayuu halkan u yimid inuu iyagoo xidhxidhan hor keeno wadaaddada sare.
english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

kikuyu: Laakiin Sawlos xooggiisii baa u sii kordhay, wuuna wareeriyey Yuhuuddii Dimishaq joogtay isagoo caddaynaya inuu kanu yahay Masiixa.
english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

kikuyu: Oo markii maalmo badan dhaafeen, ayay Yuhuuddu ku tashadeen inay dilaan;
english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

kikuyu: laakiin Sawlos waa ogaaday tashigoodii. Haddaba habeen iyo maalinba irdaha magaalada bay ka fiirin jireen inay dilaan;
english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

kikuyu: laakiin xertiisii baa habeen qaadday oo derbiga ka sii daysay iyagoo dambiil ku dejinaya.
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

kikuyu: Oo kolkuu Yeruusaalem yimid, wuxuu isku dayay inuu xertii ku darsamo; dhammaantoodse waa ka cabsadeen, maxaa yeelay, ma ay rumaysnayn inuu xer yahay.
english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

kikuyu: Laakiin Barnabas baa kaxeeyey, oo wuxuu u geeyey rasuulladii oo u sheegay siduu Rabbiga ugu arkay jidka, iyo inuu la hadlay, iyo siduu Dimishaq geesinimo ugu wacdiyey magaca Ciise.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

kikuyu: Markaasuu iyagii la joogay, isagoo la gelaya, kalana baxaya Yeruusaalem, geesinimona dadka ugu wacdiyaya magaca Rabbiga;
english: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

kikuyu: wuxuuna la hadlay oo la dooday Yuhuuddii Gariigta ahayd; iyaguse waxay doondooneen inay dilaan.
english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

kikuyu: Kolkii walaalihii garteen, waxay keeneen Kaysariya, oo waxay u sii direen Tarsos.
english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

kikuyu: Sidaas darteed kiniisaddii ku tiil Yahuudiya iyo Galili iyo Samaariya oo dhan nabad bay lahayd, waana dhisantay oo badatay iyadoo ku socota cabsida Rabbiga iyo gargaarka Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacay intuu Butros marayay dhinacyada oo dhan inuu u yimid quduusiintii Ludda degganayd.
english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

kikuyu: Halkaasna wuxuu ka helay nin la odhan jiray Ayne'as, kaas oo siddeed sannadood sariirtiisa jiifay, maxaa yeelay, curyaan buu ahaa.
english: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros wuxuu ku yidhi, Ayne'asow, Ciise Masiix baa ku bogsiinaya; kac oo sariirtaada gogol. Oo markiiba wuu kacay.
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

kikuyu: Kuwii Ludda iyo Sharoon degganaana waa arkeen, oo Rabbigay u soo jeesteen.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa Yaafaa joogi jirtay naag xer ah oo la odhan jiray Tabita taasoo micneheedu yahay Dorkas. Naagtaas waa camal wanaagsanayd, sadaqooyinna waa bixin jirtay.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas waxaa dhacday inay bukootay, wayna dhimatay, kolkay maydheenna waxay dhigeen qollad sare.
english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

kikuyu: Dhowaantii ay Ludda u dhowayd Yaafaa aawadeed, xertii markay maqleen in Butros halkaas joogo, waxay u direen laba nin iyagoo ka baryaya oo leh, Ha ka raagin inaad noo timaadid.
english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros kacay oo raacay iyagii. Oo kolkuu yimidna, waxay geeyeen qolladdii sare; carmalladii oo dhammina waa ag taagnaayeen iyagoo ooyaya oo tusaya garbageliyaashii iyo dharkii Dorkas samaysay intay la joogi jirtay iyaga.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros baa dhammaantood dibadda u saaray, markaasuu jilba joogsaday oo duceeyey, oo intuu meydka xaggiisa u jeestay ayuu ku yidhi, Tabitay, kac. Markaasay indhihii kala qaadday; oo markay Butros aragtayna way fadhiisatay.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

kikuyu: Markaasuu gacan siiyey oo kiciyey; oo markuu u yeedhay quduusiintii iyo carmalladiiba, iyadoo nool ayuu hor taagay.
english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

kikuyu: Taasna waa laga wada ogaaday Yaafaa oo dhan; kuwa badanna waa rumaysteen Rabbiga.
english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

kikuyu: Waxaana dhacday inuu maalmo badan Yaafaa la joogay nin la yidhaahdo Simoon oo megdeeye ah.
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa Kaysariya joogay nin la odhan jiray Korneeliyos, oo taliye u ahaa boqol askari oo la odhan jiray Ciidankii Talyaaniga.
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

kikuyu: Ninkaasu nin cibaadaysan buu ahaa, oo Ilaah buuna ka cabsan jiray, isaga iyo gurigiisuba, dadkana sadaqooyin badan buu siin jiray, oo had iyo goorna Ilaah buu baryi jiray.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

kikuyu: Abbaaraha sagaalka saacadood oo maalmeed wuxuu riyo bayaan ugu arkay malaa'igtii Ilaah oo u soo gelaysa oo ku leh isaga, Korneeliyosow.
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu aad u fiiriyey isagoo cabsanaya oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Waa maxay, Rabbiyow? Markaasay ku tidhi, Baryooyinkaaga iyo sadaqooyinkaaga waxay Ilaah hortiisa u baxeen xusuus.
english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaad niman u dirtaa Yaafaa inay u soo yeedhaan Simoon kan la yidhaahdo Butros.
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

kikuyu: Wuxuu marti u yahay nin Simoon la yidhaahdo oo megdeeye ah oo gurigiisu ku yaal badda dhinaceeda.
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

kikuyu: Oo kolkii malaa'igtii isaga la hadashay ka tagtay, wuxuu u yeedhay laba midiidin iyo askari cibaadaysan oo ka mid ah kuwa had iyo goorba u adeegi jiray;
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

kikuyu: oo markuu wax walba u sheegay, ayuu wuxuu u diray Yaafaa.
english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

kikuyu: Haddaba maalintii dambe intay safrayeen oo magaalada ku soo dhowaanayeen, ayaa Butros wuxuu tegey gurigii dushiisa inuu ku tukado abbaaraha saacaddii lixaad,
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

kikuyu: waana gaajooday oo wuxuu doonayay inuu wax cuno; laakiin intay wax u diyaarinayeen ayuu riyooday,
english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

kikuyu: wuxuuna arkay samada oo furantay, oo waxaa soo degayay weel sida shiraaq weyn oo kale oo afartiisa geesood loogu soo dejinayo dhulka;
english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

kikuyu: oo waxaana ku jiray jinsi kasta oo xayawaan afar lugood leh iyo waxa dhulka gurguurta iyo haadda cirka.
english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa isaga u yimid cod leh, Kac, Butrosow; gowrac oo cun.
english: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros wuxuu yidhi, Saas yaanay noqon, Rabbiyow, maxaa yeelay, weligay ma aan cunin wax xaaraan ah oo aan nadiif ahayn.
english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

kikuyu: Mar labaad codkii baa u yimid isagoo leh, Wixii Ilaah nadiifiyey, xaaraan ha ka dhigin.
english: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

kikuyu: Taasuna waxay dhacday saddex goor; markiibana weelkii waa loo qaaday samada.
english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

kikuyu: Haddaba Butros intuu si aad ah ugu wareersaday riyadii uu arkay waxay micneheedu ahayd, bal eega, nimankii Korneeliyos soo diray, iyagoo mar weyddiistay gurigii Simoon, ayay waxay istaageen albaabka hortiisa,
english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

kikuyu: waxayna u yeedheen oo weyddiisteen in Simoon, kan la yidhaahdo Butros, uu meeshaas marti ku yahay iyo in kale.
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

kikuyu: Oo Butros intuu riyadii ka fikirayay ayaa Ruuxu wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eeg, saddex nin baa ku raadinaysa.
english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

kikuyu: Haddaba kac oo hoosta tag oo raac, adoo aan shaki lahayn, maxaa yeelay, anaa soo diray.
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros nimankii hoos ugu tegey, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Bal eega, anigu waxaan ahay kaad raadinaysaan. Waa maxay sababta aad u timaadeen?
english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Korneeliyos oo boqol askari u taliya oo nin xaqa ah, Ilaahna ka cabsada, oo quruunta Yuhuudda oo dhammuna wanaaggiisa u markhaati furto, waxaa u digay isaga malaa'ig quduus ah inuu gurigiisa kuugu yeedho, hadallona kaa maqlo.
english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed ayuu gudaha ugu yeedhay oo marti geliyey. Maalintii dambe ayuu kacay oo iyagii la baxay, walaalihii Yaafaa joogana qaarkood ayaa raacay isagii.
english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

kikuyu: Maalintii dambe waxay soo galeen Kaysariya. Korneeliyosna iyaguu sugayay isagoo isugu yeedhay xigtadiisii iyo saaxiibbadiisii u dhowaa.
english: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

kikuyu: Markuu Butros soo galay, ayaa Korneeliyos ka hor yimid, lugihiisana ku dhacay, waana caabuday.
english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros baa kiciyey oo ku yidhi, Istaag; aniga qudhayduba nin baan ahay.
english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

kikuyu: Oo intuu isagii la hadlayay, ayuu soo galay, oo wuxuuna arkay kuwo badan oo isu yimid;
english: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

kikuyu: markaasuu ku yidhi iyagii, Idinka qudhiinnu waa og tihiin inay xaaraan u tahay nin Yahuudi ah inuu ku darmado ama u dhowaado nin quruun kale ah; hase ahaatee Ilaah baa i tusay inaanan ninna ku sheegin nin xaaraan ah ama aan nadiif ahayn;
english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

kikuyu: sidaas aawadeed, markii la ii yeedhay, waxaan imid diididla'aan. Saas darteed waxaan idin weyddiinayaa sababtii aad iigu soo yeedheen.
english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Korneeliyos wuxuu ku yidhi, Afar maalmood oo hore, saacaddan oo kale, ayaan joogay anoo gurigayga saacaddii sagaalaad ku tukanaya; oo bal eeg waxaa i hor istaagay nin qaba dhar dhalaalaya,
english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

kikuyu: oo wuxuu yidhi, Korneeliyosow, baryadaadii waa la maqlay, sadaqooyinkaagiina Ilaah hortiisa waa laga xusuustay.
english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Sidaas darteed Yaafaa cid u dir oo u yeedho Simoon, kan Butros la yidhaahdo. Wuxuu marti ku yahay guriga Simoon megdeeye oo badda dhinaceeda yaal.
english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

kikuyu: Sidaas darteed markiiba cid baan kuu soo diray; oo si wanaagsan baadna u samaysay inaad timid. Haddaba sidaa darteed dhammaantayo halkan waa wada joognaa Ilaah hortiisa, inaannu maqalno waxyaalihii Rabbigu kugu amray oo dhan.
english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros afkiisa kala qaaday oo wuxuu yidhi, Runtii waxaan garanayaa Ilaah inuusan dadka u kala eexan:
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

kikuyu: laakiin kii kastoo Ilaah ka cabsada, xaqnimadana sameeya, quruun kastaba ha ku jiree, Ilaah waa aqbalaa.
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

kikuyu: Ereygii ayuu u soo diray reer binu Israa'iil isagoo ku wacdiyaya nabad xagga Ciise Masiix. Isagu waa wax walba Rabbigood.
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

kikuyu: Idinka qudhiinnu waad taqaaniin ereygaas lagu faafiyey Yahuudiya oo dhan oo laga soo bilaabay Galili, baabtiiskii Yooxanaa ku wacdiyey dabadeed,
english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

kikuyu: iyo siduu Ilaah Ciisaha reer Naasared ku subkay Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo xoogga. Isagu waa wareegi jiray, wanaagna wuu fali jiray, oo wuxuu bogsiin jiray kuwii Ibliisku caddibay oo dhan; maxaa yeelay, Ilaah baa la jiray isagii.
english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

kikuyu: Annagu markhaatiyaal baannu ka nahay waxyaalihii oo dhan oo uu ku sameeyey waddanka Yuhuudda iyo Yeruusaalem labadaba. Isaguna waa kii ay dileen markay geedkii ka soo deldeleen.
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

kikuyu: Isaga Ilaah baa maalintii saddexaad sara kiciyey, oo bayaan u muujiyey,
english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

kikuyu: uma muujin dadka oo dhan, laakiin wuxuu u muujiyey markhaatiyaashii Ilaah hore u doortay, xataa annaga oo isaga wax la cunnay oo la cabnay markuu kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kacay dabadeed.
english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

kikuyu: Wuxuu nagu amray inaannu dadka wacdinno, aannuna markhaati u furno inuu kanu yahay kii Ilaah ka dhigay xaakinka kuwa nool iyo kuwa dhintayba.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

kikuyu: Isaga nebiyada oo dhan ayaa u markhaati fura in mid kastoo isaga rumaystaa uu magiciisa ku helo dembidhaafka.
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

kikuyu: Intii Butros weli ku hadlayay hadalladaas ayaa Ruuxa Quduuska ah ku soo degay kuwa ereyga maqlay oo dhan.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

kikuyu: Oo kuwii ka mid ahaa kuwii gudnaa oo rumaystay, iyagoo ahaa intii Butros la timid, way wada yaabeen, maxaa yeelay, xataa dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ayaa lagu soo shubay hadiyadda Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay maqleen iyagoo afaf ku hadlaya oo Ilaah weynaynaya.
english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

kikuyu: Markaasaa Butros u jawaabay, oo ku yidhi, Ma nin baa biyaha diidi kara, si aan loogu baabtiisin kuwaas oo ah kuwa Ruuxa Quduuska ah helay sidaannu annaguna u helnay?
english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku amray in lagu baabtiiso magaca Ciise Masiix. Kolkaasay ka baryeen inuu dhawr maalmood la joogo.
english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

kikuyu: Haddaba rasuulladii iyo walaalihii Yahuudiya joogay ayay waxay maqleen in dadka aan Yuhuudda ahaynna ay ereygii Ilaah aqbaleen.
english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

kikuyu: Oo markii Butros Yeruusaalem yimid, kuwii ka mid ahaa kuwii gudnaa ayaa la murmay isagii,
english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Waxaad u tagtay niman aan la gudin, waadna la cuntay.
english: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros wuxuu bilaabay inuu sheekadii ugu sheego siday isugu xigtay, oo wuxuu yidhi.
english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan joogay magaalada Yaafaa la yidhaahdo oo waan tukanayay, markaas waxaan khilaawo ku arkay riyo oo ahayd weel soo degaya sida shiraaq weyn oo kale oo afartiisa geesood samada lagaga soo dejinayo; wuuna ii soo dhowaaday,
english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

kikuyu: oo markaan aad u fiiriyey, ayaan ka fikiray oo waxaan arkay xayawaankii afarta lugood lahaa oo dhulka, iyo dugaagta, iyo waxa gurguurta, iyo haadda cirka.
english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan maqlay cod igu leh, Kac, Butrosow, gowrac oo cun.
english: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idhi, Saas yaanay noqon, Rabbiyow, maxaa yeelay, wax xaaraan ah oo aan nadiif ahayn, weligay afkayga ma gelin.
english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

kikuyu: Laakiin markii labaad cod baa samada ka soo jawaabay oo yidhi, Wixii Ilaah nadiifiyey, xaaraan ha ka dhigin.
english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

kikuyu: Taasna waxay dhacday saddex goor; markaasaa dhammaantood mar labaad samada kor loogu bixiyey.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

kikuyu: Oo bal eega, markiiba saddex nin baa istaagtay gurigaannu joognay hortiisa, kuwaasoo la iiga soo diray Kaysariya.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

kikuyu: Ruuxuna wuxuu ii sheegay inaan raaco iyaga, anoo aan shaki lahayn. Oo lixdatan walaalaha ihina way i raaceen; waxaannan galnay ninkii gurigiisii;
english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

kikuyu: markaasuu wuxuu noo sheegay siduu gurigiisa ugu arkay malaa'igta taagan oo ku leh, Yaafaa cid u dir oo uga soo yeedh Simoon kan la yidhaahdo Butros;
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

kikuyu: kaasoo kugula hadli doona hadallo aad ku badbaadi doontid, adiga iyo dadka gurigaaga oo dhammiba.
english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

kikuyu: Oo kolkaan bilaabay inaan hadlo ayaa Ruuxa Quduuska ah ku soo degay iyaga siduu bilowgii inoogu soo degay innagana.
english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

kikuyu: Markaasaan xusuustay ereygii Rabbiga, siduu u yidhi, Runtii Yooxanaa wuxuu dadka ku baabtiisay biyo; laakiin idinka waxaa laydinku baabtiisi doonaa Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii Ilaah iyaga siiyey isku hadiyaddii, siduu inoo siiyey markii aynu Rabbi Ciise Masiix rumaysannay, anigu kumaan ahaa kaygan Ilaah diidi karaa?
english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

kikuyu: Oo markay waxyaalahaas maqleen, ayay dooddii ka aamuseen, Ilaah bayna ammaaneen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Haddaba xataa dadka aan Yuhuudda ahaynna Ilaah baa siiyey toobadkeen inay nolol helaan.
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwii u kala firidhsanaa, dhibaatadii kacday Istefanos aawadiis, waxay u sodcaaleen tan iyo Foynike iyo Qubrus iyo Antiyokh, iyagoo aan ereyga kula hadlin ninna, Yuhuudda oo keliya mooyaane.
english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa jiray qaar iyaga ka mid ah oo ahaa niman reer Qubrus iyo reer Kuranaya ahaa, kuwaasoo, kolkay Antiyokh yimaadeen, xataa Gariiggiina la hadlay, iyagoo ku wacdiyaya Rabbi Ciise.
english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Gacanta Rabbiguna waa la jirtay iyaga; oo kuwa tiro badan oo rumaystay baa Rabbiga u soo jeestay.
english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

kikuyu: Oo warkii iyaga ku saabsanaa baa wuxuu soo gaadhay kiniisaddii Yeruusaalem ku tiil; markaasay Barnabas tan iyo Antiyokh u direen;
english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

kikuyu: kaasoo farxay markuu yimid oo arkay nimcada Ilaah; wuxuuna kulligood ku waaniyey inay Rabbiga ku xajistaan niyad qalbiga ka timid,
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, nin wanaagsan buu ahaa oo waxaa ka buuxsamay Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo rumaysad; dad badan baana Rabbiga u kordhay.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

kikuyu: Markaasuu Tarsos tegey inuu Sawlos ka doono;
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

kikuyu: markuu soo helayna, ayuu Antiyokh keenay. Waxaana dhacday inay sannad dhan kiniisadda la urureen oo ay dad badan wax bareen, oo meeshii ugu horraysay ee xertii loogu yeedhay Masiixiyiin waxay ahayd Antiyokh.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

kikuyu: Wakhtigaas waxaa Yeruusaalem ka yimid nebiyo inay Antiyokh tagaan.
english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

kikuyu: Markaasaa mid iyaga ka mid ah oo Agabos la odhan jiray ayaa istaagay, oo wuxuu Ruuxa ku sheegay in abaar weyni dunida ku dhici doonto, taas oo dhacday wakhtigii Kalawdiyos.
english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

kikuyu: Markaasaa mid kasta oo xertii ka mid ihiba, sidii tabartiisu ahayd, wuxuu goostay inuu caawimaad u diro walaalihii Yahuudiya jooga,
