english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

kikuyu: oo sidaasay yeeleen, oo waxay waayeelladii ugu sii dhiibeen gacanta Barnabas iyo Sawlos.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

kikuyu: Haddaba wakhtigaas boqorkii Herodos ahaa ayuu wuxuu gacmihiisa u fidiyey inuu dhibo qaar ka mid ah kuwa kiniisadda.
english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

kikuyu: Wuxuuna seef ku dilay Yacquub oo ahaa Yooxanaa walaalkiis.
english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

kikuyu: Oo markuu arkay inay ka farxisay Yuhuuddii, ayuu weliba ku daray inuu soo qabto Butros. Maalmahaasna waxay ahaayeen maalmihii Iidda Kibista-aan-khamiirka-lahayn.
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

kikuyu: Oo kolkuu qabtayna, wuxuu ku riday xabsi, oo u dhiibay afar kooxood oo afar askari ah inay ilaaliyaan, isagoo doonaya inuu Iidda Kormaridda dabadeed dadka u soo saaro.
english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

kikuyu: Sidaas darteed Butros xabsigaa lagu hayay; laakiin kiniisadda baa Ilaah aad iyo aad ugu bariday isaga.
english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

kikuyu: Oo markii Herodos damcay inuu soo saaro, isla habeenkaas Butros wuxuu kala dhex hurday laba askari isagoo ku xidhan laba silsiladood; waardiyayaalna albaabka hortiisa ayay xabsiga ka ilaalinayeen.
english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

kikuyu: Oo bal eega, malaa'igtii Rabbiga baa is-ag taagtay, oo iftiin baana xabsiga iftiimiyey. Markaasay Butros dhinaca ku dhufatay oo toosisay, oo waxay ku tidhi, Dhaqso u kac. Kolkaasaa silsiladihiina gacmihiisii ka dhaceen.
english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaa'igtii waxay ku tidhi, Gunto oo kabahaaga xidho. Taas buuna yeelay. Markaasay waxay ku tidhi isagii, Dharkaagii huwo oo i soo raac.
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu soo baxay oo raacay; ma uuna garanaynin in waxay malaa'igtu samaysay ay run tahay, laakiin wuxuu u maleeyey inuu riyo arkay.
english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

kikuyu: Oo markay dhaafeen waardiyihii kowaad iyo kii labaad ayay waxay yimaadeen iriddii birta ahayd oo magaalada loo mari jiray; taas oo iyagii isaga furantay; markaasay ka baxeen oo waxay sii dhex mareen jid yar; markiiba malaa'igtii waa ka tagtay isagii.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

kikuyu: Oo markii Butros isgartay ayuu wuxuu yidhi, Imminka run ahaantii waan garanayaa in Rabbigu malaa'igtiisii soo diray oo iga bixiyey gacanta Herodos iyo wixii dadka Yuhuuddu filanayeen oo dhan.
english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

kikuyu: Kolkuu waxaas ka fikiray, wuxuu yimid gurigii Maryan, oo ahayd hooyadii Yooxanaa oo Markos la odhan jiray; meeshaasoo dad badan ku urursanaayeen oo ku tukanayeen.
english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

kikuyu: Markuu albaabka iridda garaacayna, waxaa timid gabadh midiidin ah oo Roda la odhan jiray inay maqasho.
english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

kikuyu: Kolkay codkii Butros garatay, farxad darteed bay albaabka u furi weyday, laakiin gudaha bay ku orodday, wayna sheegtay in Butros iridda hor taagan yahay.
english: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay ku yidhaahdeen iyadii, Waad waalan tahay. Laakiin way ku sii adkaysatay inay sidaa tahay. Iyaguse waxay yidhaahdeen, Waa malaa'igtiisii.
english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Butros waa sii garaacay, oo kolkay albaabka fureenna, way arkeen isagii, wayna yaabeen.
english: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

kikuyu: Laakiin isagoo u gacan haadinaya inay aamusaan ayuu wuxuu u sheegay sida Rabbigu xabsiga uga soo saaray. Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waxyaalahan u sheega Yacquub iyo walaalahaba. Markaasuu ka tegey oo meel kale aaday.
english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

kikuyu: Markii waagu beryay, qasmid aan yarayn ayaa askartii ka dhex kacday waxa Butros ku dhacay aawadeed.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

kikuyu: Oo Herodos markuu raadiyey isagii oo heli waayay, ayuu wuxuu imtixaamay askartii, oo wuxuu ku amray in iyaga la laayo. Markaasuu Yahuudiya ka tegey oo Kaysariya aaday, oo meeshaasuu joogay.
english: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

kikuyu: Dadka Turos iyo Siidoon ayuu aad uga xumaaday; markaasay u yimaadeen isagii iyagoo isku wada qalbi ah, oo waxay la saaxiibeen Balaastos kii gurigii boqorka u talin jiray, oo nabad bay ka baryeen, maxaa yeelay, waddankooda waxaa cuntada siin jiray waddankii boqorka.
english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

kikuyu: Maalintii la ballamay ayaa Herodos wuxuu gashaday dharkii boqornimada oo carshiga ku fadhiistay, markaasuu iyaga qudbad u jeediyey.
english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

kikuyu: Dadkiina waa qayliyeen, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Kanu waa ilaah codkiis ee ma aha bini-aadan codkiis.
english: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

kikuyu: Markiiba ayaa malaa'igtii Rabbigu ku dhufatay, maxaa yeelay, Ilaah ma uu ammaanin; markaasaa waxaa cunay dixiryo, oo naftiina ka dhacday.
english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

kikuyu: Laakiin Rabbiga ereygiisu waa kordhay oo batay.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

kikuyu: Barnabas iyo Sawlos ayaa ka soo noqday Yeruusaalem markay shuqulkoodii soo dhammaysteen, oo waxay wateen Yooxanaa oo la odhan jiray Markos.
english: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

kikuyu: Haddaba kiniisaddii Antiyokh ku tiil waxaa joogay nebiyo iyo macallimiin, kuwaas oo ahaa Barnabas, iyo Simecoon oo la odhan jiray Niger, iyo Lukiyos oo reer Kuranaya ah, iyo Mana'een oo la koray taliye Herodos, iyo Sawlos.
english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

kikuyu: Oo markay Rabbiga caabudayeen oo soomanaayeen ayaa Ruuxa Quduuska ahu wuxuu ku yidhi, Barnabas iyo Sawlos iigu sooca shuqulkii aan ugu yeedhay.
english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

kikuyu: Markay soomeen oo duceeyeen oo gacmahoodii saareen dabadeed ayay direen iyagii.
english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

kikuyu: Haddaba iyagoo Ruuxa Quduuska ahu soo diray waxay tageen Selukiya; meeshaasna waxay uga dhoofeen Qubrus.
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

kikuyu: Oo kolkay Salamis joogeen, ereygii Ilaah bay ku wacdiyeen sunagogyada Yuhuudda; oo Yooxanaa ayay kaaliye u haysteen.
english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

kikuyu: Oo kolkay gasiiraddii oo dhan dhex mareen ayay waxay yimaadeen Bafos, taas oo ay kala kulmeen nin saaxir ah oo ahaa nebi been ah oo Yuhuudi ah oo magiciisa la odhan jiray Barciise;
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

kikuyu: kaas oo la jiray taliye Sergiyos Bawlos oo ahaa nin garasha leh. Kaasu markuu u yeedhay Barnabas iyo Sawlos, wuxuu doonayay inuu ereyga Ilaah maqlo.
english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa iyagii ka hor istaagay saaxirka Elumas (oo sidaas magiciisa loo fasiri jiray), oo wuxuu isku dayayay inuu taliyihii ka leexiyo iimaanka.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

kikuyu: Laakiin Sawlos, oo ahaa Bawlos, kaasoo Ruuxa Quduuska ahu ka buuxsamay, ayaa aad u fiiriyey,
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

kikuyu: oo ku yidhi, Kaaga khiyaanada iyo xumaanta oo dhammu ka buuxsantay oo ah wiilka Ibliiska iyo cadowga xaqnimada oo dhan, miyaanad ka joogsanayn qalloocinta aad ku qalloocinaysid jidadka toosan oo Rabbiga?
english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

kikuyu: Haddaba, bal eeg, gacanta Rabbigu waa ku saaran tahay, oo waad indha beeli doontaa, adigoo aan qorraxda arkayn intii wakhti ah. Kolkaasaa markiiba waxaa ku soo dhacday isagii ceeryaamo iyo gudcur; wuuna warwareegay oo doondoonay nin gacanta ku haga.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaa taliyihii, kolkuu arkay wixii dhacay, rumaystay, isagoo ka yaabsan Rabbiga waxbariddiisa.
english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

kikuyu: Haddaba Bawlos iyo kuwii la socday ayaa ka dhoofay Bafos, oo waxay yimaadeen Berga oo Bamfuliya ku jirta; markaasaa Yooxanaa ka tegey iyagii oo Yeruusaalem ku noqday.
english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Laakiin iyagu kolkii ay ka tageen Berga waxay yimaadeen Antiyokh oo Bisidiya ku jirta; oo maalintii sabtidana sunagogga ayay galeen oo fadhiisteen.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

kikuyu: Markii sharcigii iyo nebiyadii la akhriyey dabadeed kuwii sunagogga u sarreeyey ayaa cid u soo diray iyagoo leh, Walaalayaalow, haddaad dadka u haysaan hadal waana ah, dhaha.
english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bawlos istaagay isagoo gacan haadinaya, oo wuxuu yidhi. Nimanka reer binu Israa'iilow iyo kuwiinna Ilaah ka cabsadow, dhegaysta.
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

kikuyu: Ilaaha dadkan reer binu Israa'iil wuxuu doortay awowayaasheen, dadkana buu sarraysiiyey markay dhulka Masar degganaayeen, oo gacan taagan buuna kaga soo saaray iyagii.
english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

kikuyu: Oo wakhti abbaaraha afartan sannadood ah ayuu dabiicaddoodii ugu dulqaatay cidlada.
english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Oo markuu toddoba quruumood ka baabbi'iyey dhulka Kancaan dabadeed ayuu dhulkoodii dhaxal u siiyey iyagii abbaaraha afar boqol iyo konton sannadood;
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

kikuyu: waxyaalahaas dabadeedna wuxuu siiyey xaakinno ilaa nebi Samuu'eel.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

kikuyu: Dabadeed waxay weyddiisteen boqor, markaasaa Ilaah wuxuu iyagii siiyey Saa'uul ina Qiish oo ahaa nin reer Benyaamiin intii afartan sannadood ah.
english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

kikuyu: Kolkuu isagii boqortooyadii ka wareejiyeyna, wuxuu u kiciyey iyagii Daa'uud inuu boqorkooda noqdo; kaasoo uu u markhaati furay isagoo leh, Waxaan ogaaday Daa'uud oo ina Yesay ah inuu yahay nin ah sida qalbigaygu doonayo oo samayn doona waxaan doonayo oo dhan.
english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

kikuyu: Ninkan farcankiisii Ilaah siduu ballanqaaday ayuu Israa'iil ugaga keenay Badbaadiye kaasoo ah Ciise;
english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

kikuyu: oo intuusan imanba, Yooxanaa wuxuu dadka Israa'iil oo dhan hore ugu wacdiyey baabtiiska toobadda.
english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

kikuyu: Oo intii Yooxanaa shuqulkiisa dhammaynayay, wuxuu yidhi, Yaad u malaynaysaan inaan ahay? Anigu isagii ma ihi. Laakiin, bal eega, waxaa iga daba imanaya mid aanan istaahilin inaan kabaha cagihiisa ka furo.
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, idinkoo ah farcankii Ibraahim iyo kuwa idinku dhex jira oo Ilaah ka cabsadow, innaga ayaa laynoo soo diray ereyga badbaadintan.
english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwii Yeruusaalem joogay iyo taliyayaashoodii waa garan waayeen isaga iyo codadkii nebiyada oo sabti walba la akhriyi jiray, sidaas daraaddeed ayay waxyaalihii dhammeeyeen markay xukumeen isagii.
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

kikuyu: Oo in kastoo ayan ka helin sabab lagu dilo, ayay waxay Bilaatos weyddiisteen in la dilo.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

kikuyu: Oo markay dhammeeyeen waxyaalihii laga qoray oo dhan, ayay geedkii ka soo dejiyeen oo xabaal geliyeen.
english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah baa ka sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay,
english: But God raised him from the dead,

kikuyu: oo maalmo badan waxaa isagii arkay kuwii kala yimid Galili ilaa Yeruusaalem kuwaasoo hadda ah markhaati furayaashiisii xagga dadka.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

kikuyu: Oo waxaannu idin keenaynaa war wanaagsan oo ku saabsan ballankii awowayaasheen loo ballanqaaday,
english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

kikuyu: oo ah sidii Ilaah ballankaas ugu oofiyey carruurteenna markuu Ciise sara kiciyey, sida ay Sabuurka labaadna ugu qoran tahay. Waxaad tahay Wiilkayga, maantaan ku dhalay.
english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

kikuyu: Isagii buu ka sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay inuusan mar dambe qudhun ku noqon, sidaas daraaddeed ayuu sidan ku hadlay, isagoo leh, Waxaan idin siin doonaa barakooyinka runta ah oo Daa'uud loo ballanqaaday.
english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

kikuyu: Saas aawadeed wuxuu Sabuur kale ku yidhi, Kaaga quduuska ah uma oggolaan doontid inuu qudhmo.
english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, Daa'uud markuu qarnigiisa ugu shaqeeyey talada Ilaah dabadeed ayuu dhintay, waana lala xabaalay awowayaashiis, wuuna qudhmay;
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

kikuyu: laakiin kii Ilaah sara kiciyey, ma uu qudhmin.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

kikuyu: Sidaas darteed, walaalayaalow, garta in ninkan xaggiisa dembidhaafka laydinkaga wacdiyey;
english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

kikuyu: nin kasta oo isaga rumaystana xaq baa lagaga dhigay wax walba oo sharciga Muuse uusan xaq idinkaga dhigi karin.
english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

kikuyu: Sidaas darteed iska jira inaanay idinku dhicin wixii nebiyadu sheegeen iyagoo leh,
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

kikuyu: Bal eega, kuwiinnan wax quudhsadow, yaaba oo luma; Waayo, maalmihiinnii waxaan samaynayaa shuqul, Oo ah shuqul aydnaan rumaysan doonin, haddii laydiin sheego.
english: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”

kikuyu: Kolkay baxayeen, dadkii waxay ka baryeen inay hadalladaas sabtida dambe kula hadlaan.
english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

kikuyu: Haddaba markii sunagogga laga tegey, kuwa badan oo Yuhuud ah iyo kuwa cibaadaysan oo Yuhuudda raacsan ayaa waxay raaceen Bawlos iyo Barnabas, kuwaas oo la hadlayay iyaga oo ku adkeeyey inay nimcada Ilaah ku sii wadaan.
english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

kikuyu: Sabtida dambe ayaa magaaladii oo dhan in yar mooyaane isugu timid inay maqasho ereyga Ilaah.
english: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

kikuyu: Laakiin Yuhuuddu markay arkeen dadkii faraha badnaa, waxaa iyaga ka buuxsamay masayr, wayna beeneeyeen waxyaalihii Bawlos ku' hadlay, waana caayeen.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

kikuyu: Haddaba Bawlos iyo Barnabas ayaa geesinimo ku hadlay iyagoo leh, Waxay ahayd lagama maarmaan in ereyga Ilaah markii hore idinka laydinkula hadlo. Laakiin idinku waad diiddeen, oo waxaad isku xukunteen sidii kuwo aan istaahilin nolosha weligeed ah, oo bal eega, sidaas aawadeed waxaannu u jeesanaynaa dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn.
english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, sidaasaa Rabbigu nagu amray isagoo leh, Waxaan kaa dhigi doonaa iftiinka quruumaha, Inaad badbaadinta u noqotid ilaa meeshii dunida ugu fog.
english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

kikuyu: Haddaba markii dadkii aan Yuhuudda ahayn taas maqleen, ayay ku farxeen oo ereygii Ilaah ammaaneen; oo waxaana rumaystay kuwii nolosha weligeed ah loo dhigay.
english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

kikuyu: Ereygii Rabbigana waxaa lagu faafiyey waddankii oo dhan.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

kikuyu: Laakiin Yuhuuddu waxay soo kiciyeen dumarkii cibaadada iyo sharafta lahaa iyo raggii madaxda magaalada ahaa, silec bayna Bawlos iyo Barnabas ku kiciyeen, oo soohdintoodii bay ka eryeen iyagii.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

kikuyu: Laakiin markay siigadii cagahooda ka dhabaandhabeen, dabadeed ayay waxay yimaadeen Ikoniyon.
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

kikuyu: Xertiina waxaa ka buuxsamay farxad iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Waxaa Ikoniyon ka dhacday inay wada galeen sunagogga Yuhuudda, oo siday u hadleen aawadeed dad badan oo Yuhuud iyo Gariigba ah ayaa rumaystay.
english: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

kikuyu: Laakiin Yuhuuddii caasiyiinta ahayd ayaa waxay dadkii aan Yuhuudda ahayn ku kiciyeen oo si xun ugu direen walaalihii.
english: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

kikuyu: Haddaba wakhti dheer ayay halkaas joogeen iyagoo geesinimo ugu hadlaya Rabbiga, kaasoo markhaati u furay ereyga nimcadiisa, wuxuuna siiyey inay calaamooyin iyo yaabab gacmahooda ku sameeyaan.
english: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii badnaa oo magaaladu kala qaybsameen, oo qaar waxay raaceen Yuhuudda, qaarna rasuulladii.
english: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

kikuyu: Markii dadkii aan Yuhuudda ahayn iyo Yuhuuddaba, iyaga iyo taliyayaashoodii, ay ku yaaceen inay caayaan oo dhagxiyaan,
english: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

kikuyu: ayay garteen, oo waxay u carareen magaalooyinkii la odhan jiray Luka'oniya iyo Lustara iyo Derbe iyo dhulka ku wareegsan;
english: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

kikuyu: meeshaasna ayay injiilka ku wacdiyeen dadka.
english: There they preached the Good News.

kikuyu: Lustara waxaa fadhiyey nin aan cagaha xoog ku lahayn, oo tan iyo markuu uurka hooyadii ka dhashay curyaan ahaa, kaasoo aan weligiis socon.
english: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu maqlay Bawlos oo hadlaya, kaasoo indhaha aad ugu fiiriyey, gartayna inuu rumaysad uu ku bogsan karo leeyahay,
english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

kikuyu: wuxuuna cod dheer ku yidhi, Cagahaaga sare isugu taag. Markaasuu booday oo socday.
english: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

kikuyu: Markii dadkii badnaa arkeen wixii Bawlos sameeyey, ayay codkoodii sare u qaadeen, iyagoo afkii Luka'oniya ku leh, Ilaahyadu waxay inoogu yimaadeen iyagoo sidii niman u eg.
english: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

kikuyu: Barnabasna waxay u bixiyeen Yubiter; Bawlosna waxay u bixiyeen Merkuriyos, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu ahaa kii hadalka waday.
english: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

kikuyu: Markaasaa wadaadkii Yubiter oo macbudkiisu ku yiil magaalada horteeda, wuxuu irdaha keenay dibiyo, iyo ubaxyo isku taxan, wuxuuna doonayay inuu dadkii badnaa la sadqeeyo.
english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

kikuyu: Laakiin rasuulladii Barnabas iyo Bawlos markay maqleen, ayay dharkoodii jeexjeexeen, oo dadkii badnaa ku soo dhex boodeen, iyagoo ku dhawaaqaya
english: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

kikuyu: oo leh, Niman yahow, maxaad waxyaalahan u samaynaysaan? Annagu waxaannu nahay niman idinla dabiicad ah, oo waxaannu idiin keenaynaa war wanaagsan inaad ka soo jeesataan waxyaalahan aan micnaha lahayn oo u jeesataan Ilaaha nool, kaasoo sameeyey samada iyo dhulka iyo badda iyo waxyaalaha ku jira oo dhan,
english: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

kikuyu: kaasoo qarniyada tegey quruumaha oo dhan u oggolaaday inay jidadkooda ku socdaan.
english: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

kikuyu: Hase ahaatee isu maragfurla'aan iskama sii dayn, laakiin wanaag buu sameeyey, oo wuxuu samada idinka siiyey roob iyo xilliyo barwaaqo ah, isagoo qalbiyadiinna ka dherginaya cunto iyo farxad.
english: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

kikuyu: Markay waxyaalahaas yidhaahdeen, ayay dadkii badnaa dhib kaga joojiyeen inay u sadqeeyaan iyaga.
english: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa Antiyokh iyo Ikoniyon ka yimid Yuhuud, oo markay dadkii badnaa yeelsiiyeen, ayay Bawlos dhagxiyeen, oo magaaladii ka jiideen, iyagoo u malaynaya inuu dhintay.
english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

kikuyu: Laakiin intii xertii hareerihiisii taagnaayeen, ayuu kacay, markaasuu magaaladii galay; maalintii dambena wuu ka baxay oo Barnabas u raacay Derbe.
english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

kikuyu: Oo markay magaaladaas injiilkii ku wacdiyeen oo kuwo badan xer ka dhigeen, ayay ku noqdeen Lustara iyo Ikoniyon iyo Antiyokh,
english: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

kikuyu: iyagoo nafihii xerta ku xoogaynaya, kuna waaninaya inay iimaanka ku sii wadaan, iyagoo ku leh, Waa inaynu dhibaatooyin badan ku galnaa boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Oo markay iyagii kiniisad walba waayeello uga dooreen oo ay soon ku tukadeen, waxay iyagii ku ammaana geliyeen Rabbiga ay rumaysteen.
english: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

kikuyu: Markaasay sii dhex mareen Bisidiya oo yimaadeen Bamfuliya.
english: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

kikuyu: Oo kolkay ereyga kaga hadleen Berga ayay waxay tageen Ataliya;
english: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

kikuyu: meeshaasna waxay uga dhoofeen Antiyokh, taasoo ahayd meeshii iyaga lagaga ammaana geliyey nimcadii Ilaah shuqulkii ay sameeyeen aawadiis.
english: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

kikuyu: Oo markay yimaadeen oo kiniisaddii isu ururiyeen waxay uga warrameen waxyaalihii Ilaah iyaga la sameeyey oo dhan iyo siduu albaabka iimaanka ugu furay dadkii aan Yuhuudda ahayn.
english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

kikuyu: Markaasay wakhti aan yarayn xertii la joogeen.
english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

kikuyu: Niman Yahuudiya ka yimid ayaa walaalihii wax baray iyagoo leh, Haddaan caadada Muuse laydinku gudin, badbaadi kari maysaan.
english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

kikuyu: Oo markii Bawlos iyo Barnabas wax aan yarayn kula murmeen oo ku su'aaleen iyaga, ayaa walaalihii waxay doorteen Bawlos iyo Barnabas iyo kuwo kale oo iyaga ka mid ah inay Yeruusaalem aadaan oo ay u tagaan rasuulladii iyo waayeelladii inay su'aashan kala hadlaan.
english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed iyagoo kiniisaddu soo sagootiday, waxay sii dhex mareen Foynike iyo Samaariya, iyagoo ka warramaya sidii dadkii aan Yuhuudda ahayn u soo jeesteen; waxayna aad uga farxiyeen walaalihii oo dhan.
english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

kikuyu: Oo markay Yeruusaalem yimaadeen, ayaa kiniisaddii iyo rasuulladii iyo waayeelladiiba soo dhoweeyeen, markaasay waxay uga warrameen waxyaalihii Ilaah iyaga la sameeyey oo dhan.
english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa kacay kuwo dariiqadii Farrisiinta ahaa oo rumaysnaa, kuwaasoo leh, Waa in la gudo iyaga, oo lagu amro inay sharciga Muuse xajiyaan.
english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

kikuyu: Haddaba rasuulladii iyo waayeelladii baa ururay inay xaajadan ka tashadaan.
english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

kikuyu: Oo kolkay wax badan su'aaleenna, Butros baa istaagay oo ku yidhi iyagii, Walaalayaalow, waad og tihiin in maalmo hore Ilaah dhexdiinna ka doortay in dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ay afkayga ereygii injiilka ka maqlaan oo ay rumaystaan.
english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaaha qalbiga garta ayaa u markhaati furay iyaga, wuxuuna iyaga siiyey Ruuxa Quduuska ah siduu innagana inoo siiyey;
english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

kikuyu: oo inama kala soocin innaga iyo iyaga, laakiin qalbiyadooda rumaysad buu ku nadiifiyey.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

kikuyu: Haddaba maxaad Ilaah u jirrabaysaan inaad harqood qoorta xerta saartaan, kaasoo innaga iyo awowayaasheen aynaan qaadi karin?
english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan rumaysan nahay inaynu ku badbaadi doonno nimcadii Rabbi Ciise siday ugu badbaadi doonaan.
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

kikuyu: Dadkii badnaa oo dhammu way wada aamuseen; wayna dhegaysteen Barnabas iyo Bawlos markay uga warramayeen intay ahaayeen calaamooyinkii iyo yaababkii Ilaah gacantooda ku sameeyey dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn dhexdooda.
english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

kikuyu: Kolkay aamuseen dabadeed ayaa Yacquub u jawaabay, isagoo leh,
english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, i dhegaysta, Simecoon waa ka warramay sidii Ilaah markii ugu horraysay u soo booqday dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn inuu dad uga soo bixiyo iyaga magiciisa aawadiis.
english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

kikuyu: Taasuna waxay raacsan tahay hadalladii nebiyada; siday ugu qoran tahay,
english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas dabadeed waan soo noqon doonaa, Oo mar labaad ayaan dhisi doonaa taambuuggii Daa'uud oo dhacay; Oo mar labaad ayaan dhisi doonaa jajabkiisa, Waanan taagi doonaa;
english: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

kikuyu: Si nimankii hadhay ay Rabbiga u doondoonaan, Iyo quruumaha oo dhan oo magacayga loogu yeedho,
english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’

kikuyu: Taas waxaa yidhi Rabbiga waxyaalahaas muujiyey tan iyo bilowgii dunida.
english: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed taladaydu waxay tahay inaynaan dhibin kuwa ka mid ah dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn oo Ilaah u jeestay;
english: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

kikuyu: laakiin inaynu u qorno iyagii inay ka fogaadaan wasakhnimada sanamyada, iyo sinada, iyo waxa la ceejiyo, iyo dhiigga.
english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, tan iyo qarniyadii hore waxaa Muuse magaalo walba ku leeyahay kuwa dadka ku wacdiya waxa isaga ku saabsan, oo sabti walba sunagogyadaa laga akhriyaa.
english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay la wanaagsanaatay rasuulladii iyo waayeelladii iyo kiniisaddii oo dhan inay iska dhex doortaan niman ay Antiyokh ula diraan Bawlos iyo Barnabas, kuwaas oo ahaa Yuudas oo la odhan jiray Barsabaas iyo Silas oo ahaa niman madax ah walaalaha dhexdooda.
english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

kikuyu: Markaasay qoreen oo iyagii la direen warqad leh, Annagoo ah rasuullada iyo walaalaha waayeellada ah waxaannu soo salaamaynaa walaalaha ka mid ah dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn oo jooga Antiyokh iyo Suuriya iyo Kilikiya.
english: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

kikuyu: Waxaannu maqallay in kuwo annaga naga tegey hadallo idinku dhibeen, nafihiinnana rogayeen, kuwaasoo aannan u amrin;
english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

kikuyu: sidaas daraaddeed waxaa nala wanaagsanaatay, annagoo isku qalbi noqonnay, inaannu soo dooranno niman aannu idiinla soo dirno gacaliyayaashayadii Barnabas iyo Bawlos,
english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

kikuyu: kuwaasoo ah niman naftooda u biimeeyey magicii Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix aawadiis.
english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Sidaas aawadeed waxaannu soo dirnay Yuudas iyo Silas kuwaasoo iyaguna afka idiinka sheegi doona waxyaalahaas oo kale.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

kikuyu: Waxaa la wanaagsanaatay Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo annagaba inaannan idin saarin culaab ka weyn waxyaalahan waajibka ah.
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

kikuyu: Waa inaad ka fogaataan waxa sanamyada loo sadqeeyo, iyo dhiig, iyo waxa la ceejiyo, iyo sinada. Kuwaas haddaad iska dhawrtaan si wanaagsan baad yeeli doontaan. Nabadgelyo.
english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, kolkii la diray ayay waxay yimaadeen Antiyokh; oo markay dadkii badnaa isu ururiyeen dabadeed waxay u dhiibeen warqaddii.
english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

kikuyu: Markay akhriyeenna ayay waanadii ku farxeen.
english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

kikuyu: Yuudas iyo Silas, iyagoo qudhooduna nebiyo ahaa, ayay hadallo badan walaalihii ku waaniyeen oo ku xoogeeyeen.
english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

kikuyu: Oo markay muddo joogeen dabadeed ayaa walaalihii nabad ugu direen kuwii iyagii u soo diray.
english: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

kikuyu: Laakiin Bawlos iyo Barnabas ayaa Antiyokh sii joogay, oo waxay kuwo badan oo kale la barayeen oo kula wacdiyeyeen ereyga Rabbiga.
english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

kikuyu: Maalmo dabadeed Bawlos ayaa wuxuu Barnabas ku yidhi, Hadda aynu ku noqonno oo booqanno walaalaha jooga magaalo kasta oo aynu ereyga Rabbiga ku wacdinnay inaan soo aragno siday yihiin.
english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

kikuyu: Barnabas wuxuu doonayay inay kaxaystaan Yooxanaa oo la odhan jiray Markos.
english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

kikuyu: Laakiin Bawlos waxaa la wanaagsanaatay inayan kaxaysan isaga kaasoo iyaga kaga tegey Bamfuliya oo aan shuqulkii iyaga u raacin.
english: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

kikuyu: Waxaa dhacay khilaaf weyn; sidaas daraaddeed way kala tageen, markaasaa Barnabas kaxaystay Markos, oo wuxuu u dhoofay Qubrus;
english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

kikuyu: laakiin Bawlos wuxuu doortay Silas, markaasuu baxay isagoo ay walaalihii ku ammaana gelinayaan nimcadii Ilaah.
english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu dhex maray Suuriya iyo Kilikiya isagoo kiniisadihii xoogaynaya.
english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu kaloo yimid Derbe iyo Lustara; oo bal eega, halkaas waxaa joogay nin xer ah oo la odhan jiray Timoteyos, oo ahaa Yahuudiyad rumaysan wiilkeed, aabbihiise wuxuu ahaa Gariig.
english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

kikuyu: Isagana walaalihii Lustara iyo Ikoniyon joogay baa u marag furay.
english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

kikuyu: Bawlos wuxuu doonayay inuu isagu raaco; markaasuu waday oo guday, Yuhuudda meelahaas joogtay darteed; maxaa yeelay, kulligood way wada ogaayeen in aabbihiis uu Gariig ahaa.
english: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

kikuyu: Oo intay magaalooyinka dhex marayeen, waxay u dhiibeen amarradii rasuulladii iyo waayeelladii Yeruusaalem joogay soo amreen, inay dhawraan.
english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Haddaba kiniisadihii iimaankay ku xoogoobeen, oo maalin kastaba tiradoodu waa kordhaysay.
english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay dhex mareen dhulka Farugiya iyo Galatiya iyagoo Ruuxa Quduuska ahu u diiday inay ereyga kaga dhex hadlaan Aasiya,
english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

kikuyu: oo markay Musiya u dhowaadeen waxay isku dayeen inay Bituniya galaan; laakiin Ruuxa Ciise uma oggolaan;
english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

kikuyu: markaasay soo dhaafeen Musiya oo waxay yimaadeen Taroo'as.
english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

kikuyu: Oo habeennimo ayaa Bawlos wax riyo ku arkay. Waxaa taagnaa nin reer Makedoniya ah isagoo ka baryaya oo leh, Makedoniya kaalay oo na caawi.
english: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

kikuyu: Oo markuu riyadii arkay dabadeed markiiba waxaannu doonnay inaannu Makedoniya tagno, taasoo nala noqotay in Ilaah noogu yeedhay inaannu iyaga injiilka ku wacdinno.
english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

kikuyu: Haddaba ayaannu Taroo'as ka dhoofnay, oo waxaannu toos u aadnay Samotraki, maalintii xigtayna waxaannu nimid Ne'abolis;
english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

kikuyu: markaasaannu meeshaas ka tagnay, oo waxaannu aadnay Filiboy, taas oo ah magaalomadaxda reer Makedoniya, oo ay reer Rooma u taliyaan, magaaladaas waxaannu joognay dhawr maalmood.
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

kikuyu: Maalintii sabtida ahayd ayaannu iridda ka baxnay, oo waxaannu tagnay webi dhinaciis, meeshaas oo aannu u malaynay meel lagu tukado; markaasaannu fadhiisannay, oo waxaannu la hadallay dumarkii urursanaa.
english: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

kikuyu: Oo naag Ludiya la odhan jiray, oo dhar guduudan iibin jirtay, oo magaalada Tu'ateyra ka iman jirtay, oo Ilaah caabudi jirtay baa na maqashay; taasoo Rabbigu qalbigeeda furay inay dhegaysato waxyaalihii Bawlos ku hadlay.
english: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

kikuyu: Oo markii la baabtiisay iyada iyo dadkii gurigeeda, ayay naga bariday iyadoo leh. Haddaad qiyaasaysaan inaan Rabbiga aamin u ahay, gurigayga kaalaya oo jooga. Waana na yeelsiisay.
english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa dhacday, markii aannu u sii soconnay meeshii lagu tukan jiray, in ay naga hor timid gabadh jinni wax sheega qabtaa, taasoo waxsheegiddeeda faa'iido badan ugu keeni jirtay sayidyadeeda.
english: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

kikuyu: Taasaa Bawlos iyo annaga na soo raacday, wayna qaylisay iyadoo leh, Nimankanu waa addoommadii Ilaaha ugu sarreeya, kuwaasoo idinku wacdiyaya jidka badbaadada.
english: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

kikuyu: Sidaasna maalmo badan ayay yeelaysay. Laakiin Bawlos oo ka xumaaday ayaa u jeestay oo jinnigii ku yidhi, Magaca Ciise Masiix ayaan kugu amrayaa inaad iyada ka soo baxdid. Markaasuu saacaddiiba ka soo baxay.
english: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.

kikuyu: Laakiin sayidyadeedii, markay arkeen in rajadii faa'iidadoodu dhammaatay, ayay Bawlos iyo Silas qabteen, oo waxay u jiideen suuqa, taliyayaasha hortooda,
english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

kikuyu: oo markay xaakinnadana u keeneen, waxay yidhaahdeen, Nimankanu iyagoo Yuhuud ah ayay si weyn magaaladayada u dhibayaan,
english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

kikuyu: oo waxay na barayaan caadooyin aan noo xalaal ahayn inaannu aqbalno oo yeelno annagoo reer Rooma ah.
english: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa dadkii badnaa ku wada kaceen; oo xaakinnadiina dharkoodii bay ka jeexeen, waxayna ku amreen in la uleeyo.
english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

kikuyu: Oo markay ulo badan ku dhufteen, ayay xabsiga ku rideen iyagoo ku amraya xabsihayihii inuu aad u ilaaliyo;
english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

kikuyu: isaguna markuu amar caynkaas ah helay, wuxuu iyagii ku riday xabsigii ugu hooseeyey, cagahoodana qori buu aad ugu xidhay.
english: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

kikuyu: Laakiin abbaaraha habeenbadhka Bawlos iyo Silas ayaa tukanayay oo Ilaah gabay ku ammaanayay, maxaabiistuna way dhegaysanayeen;
english: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

kikuyu: oo filanla'aan waxaa dhacay dhulgariir weyn, sidaas darteed aasaaskii xabsigu waa ruxmay; oo markiiba albaabbadii oo dhammu waa wada furmeen; mid walbana silsiladihiisii waa ka furmeen.
english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

kikuyu: Xabsihayihiina markuu hurdada ka toosay oo arkay albaabbadii xabsiga oo wada furmay, ayuu seeftiisii la baxay oo ku dhowaaday inuu isdilo, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu u malaynayay maxaabiistii inay baxsatay.
english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

kikuyu: Laakiin Bawlos baa cod weyn ku qayliyey isagoo leh, Waxba ha isyeelin; maxaa yeelay, kulligayo halkaannu wada joognaa.
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu cid u diray siraaddo, oo gudaha ku booday isagoo baqdin la gargariiraya, oo wuxuu ku hor dhacay Bawlos iyo Silas,
english: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

kikuyu: markaasuu dibadda u soo saaray, oo ku yidhi, Sayidyadow, maxaa igu waajib ah inaan yeelo inaan ku badbaado?
english: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

kikuyu: Kolkaasay ku yidhaahdeen, Rumayso Rabbi Ciise, waadna badbaadi doontaa, adiga iyo dadka gurigaaguba.
english: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

kikuyu: Oo ereyga Rabbiga ayay kula hadleen isaga iyo kuwii gurigiisa joogay oo dhan.
english: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wakhtiga habeenka qudhiisa iyagii kaxeeyey oo nabrahoodii ka maydhay; oo markiiba waa la baabtiisay isagii iyo dadkiisii oo dhanba.
english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

kikuyu: Haddaba gurigiisuu iyagii keenay oo cunto hor dhigay. Isagoo Ilaah rumaysanna ayuu aad ula farxay kuwii gurigiisa joogay oo dhan.
english: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.

kikuyu: Laakiin kolkii ay maalin noqotay ayaa xaakinnadii waxay direen saraakiishii oo leh, Nimankaas sii daa.
english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa xabsihayihii hadalladaas u sheegay Bawlos, oo wuxuu ku yidhi, Xaakinnadii baa amar soo diray in laydin sii daayo; haddaba soo baxa oo nabad ku taga.
english: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Bawlos baa wuxuu iyagii ku yidhi, Caddaan bay noogu garaaceen annagoo aan nala xukumin oo ah niman reer Rooma, oo waxayna nagu rideen xabsi; imminkana ma qarsoodii bay nooga saarayaan? Sidaas ma aha; laakiin iyaga qudhoodu ha yimaadeen oo dibadda ha noo saareen.
english: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

kikuyu: Haddaba saraakiishii baa hadalladaas u sheegay xaakinnadii; oo kolkay maqleen inay reer Rooma yihiin ayay baqeen.
english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

kikuyu: Markaasay yimaadeen oo cafi ka baryeen; oo kolkay dibadda u soo saareenna, waxay weyddiisteen inay magaalada ka tagaan.
english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

kikuyu: Oo markay xabsigii ka soo baxeen waxay galeen gurigii Ludiya, oo kolkay walaalihii arkeenna ayay dhiirigeliyeen oo ka tageen.
english: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

kikuyu: Haddaba markay sii dhex mareen Amfibolis iyo Abollooniya ayay waxay yimaadeen Tesaloniika meeshaas oo sunagogga Yuhuuddu ahaa;
english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

kikuyu: oo Bawlos sidii caadadiisu ahayd, ayuu iyagii u galay, oo saddex sabtiyoodna ayuu Qorniinka kala hadlay,
english: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

kikuyu: isagoo caddaynaya oo muujinaya inay waajib ahayd in Masiixu silco oo ka soo sara kaco kuwii dhintay, wuxuuna yidhi, Ciisahan aan idinku wacdiyey waa Masiixa.
english: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

kikuyu: Oo waxaa la rumaysiiyey oo Bawlos iyo Silas isku daray qaar iyaga ka mid ah oo ahaa Gariig fara badan oo cibaadaysan iyo dumarka madaxda ah oo aan fara yarayn.
english: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

kikuyu: Laakiin Yuhuuddii oo ka masayrsan ayaa nimanka suuqa ka soo kaxaysatay kuwo shar leh, urur bayna isu keeneen, oo magaaladii bay buuq ka dhigeen; oo markay gurigii Yasoon weerareen ayay waxay dooneen inay iyagii dadka u soo saaraan.
english: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

kikuyu: Oo markay waayeen, ayay Yasoon iyo kuwo walaalo ah ku hor jiideen taliyayaashii magaalada iyagoo ku qaylinaya oo leh, Kuwii dunida rogay ayaa halkanna yimid,
english: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

kikuyu: iyagoo uu Yasoon martiggeliyey; kuwaas oo dhanna waxay falaan wax ka gees ah amarrada Kaysar, iyagoo leh, Waxaa jira boqor kale oo Ciise ah.
english: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

kikuyu: Markaasay dhib geliyeen dadkii badnaa iyo taliyayaashii magaalada oo waxyaalahaas maqlay.
english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

kikuyu: Oo kolkay Yasoon iyo kuwii kale dammiin ka qaadeen, ayay sii daayeen.
english: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

kikuyu: Oo markiiba walaalihii waxay habeennimo Bawlos iyo Silas u direen Beroya, kuwaas oo kolkay meeshaas yimaadeen galay sunagogga Yuhuudda.
english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuwaasu waa ka sharaf badnaayeen kuwii Tesaloniika joogay, maxaa yeelay, ereygay aqbaleen iyagoo xiiso weyn u qaba oo maalin kasta baadhaya Qorniinka inay hubsadaan waxyaalahaasi inay sidaas yihiin iyo in kale.
english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

kikuyu: Sidaas darteed kuwa badan oo iyaga ka mid ah baa rumaystay iyo dumar Gariig ah oo sharaf leh iyo niman aan fara yarayn.
english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

kikuyu: Laakiin kolkii Yuhuuddii Tesaloniika joogtay ogaatay in Bawlos ereyga Ilaah Beroya ku wacdiyey, ayay meeshaasna yimaadeen oo qas iyo dhib geliyeen dadkii badnaa.
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

kikuyu: Markaasaa walaalihii kolkiiba Bawlos u direen inuu tago ilaa badda; Silas iyo Timoteyosna halkaasay weli joogeen.
english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

kikuyu: Laakiin kuwii Bawlos ambabbixiyey waxay isagii keeneen ilaa Ateenay; markaasay ka tageen iyagoo Silas iyo Timoteyos amar u qaadaya inay degdeg u yimaadaan.
english: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

kikuyu: Haddaba Bawlos intuu Ateenay ku sugayay iyagii, ruuxiisu waa kacay markuu arkay magaalada oo sanamyo ka buuxaan.
english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

kikuyu: Saas daraaddeed ayuu Yuhuuddii iyo nimankii cibaadaysnaa kula xaajooday sunagogga, suuqa dhexdiisana ayuu maalin walba kula xaajooday kuwii kula kulmayba.
english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

kikuyu: Waxaana la kulmay isagii kuwo ka mid ah faylosuufiinta Ebikuriyiin iyo Istoo'ikiin ah. Qaar baa waxay yidhaahdeen, Ninkan dawdarka ihi muxuu odhan doonaa? Qaar kalena waxay yidhaahdeen, Wuxuu u eg yahay nin ilaahyo qalaad wax ka sheega; maxaa yeelay, wuxuu dadkii ku wacdiyey Ciise iyo sarakicidda.
english: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

kikuyu: Markaasay isagii qabteen, oo waxay u kaxeeyeen Are'obagos iyagoo ku leh, Ma ogaan karnaa waxay tahay waxbariddan cusub oo aad ku hadlaysid?
english: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad dhegahayaga maqashiisaa waxyaalo qalaad. Sidaa darteed waxaannu doonaynaa inaannu ogaanno waxyaalahanu waxay yihiin.
english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

kikuyu: (Haddaba reer Ateenay oo dhammi iyo dadkii qalaad oo halkaas degganaa, wakhtigooda wax kale kuma ay dhaafin inay sheegaan ama maqlaan wax cusub mooyaane.)
english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bawlos oo Are'obagos dhex taagan wuxuu yidhi, Nimankiinan reer Ateenay ahow, wax kasta waxaan idinku garanayaa inaad tihiin kuwo ilaahyada ka cabsada.
english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

kikuyu: Waayo, markaan soo socday oo aan arkay waxyaalaha aad caabuddaan waxaan soo arkay oo kale meel allabari oo lagu qoray, Waxaa leh ilaah aan la oqoon. Haddaba waxaad oqoonla'aanta ku caabuddaan ayaan wax idiinka sheegayaa.
english: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

kikuyu: Ilaaha sameeyey dunida iyo waxyaalaha ku jira oo dhanba, oo ah Rabbiga samada iyo dhulka, ma deggana macbudyo gacmo lagu sameeyey,
english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

kikuyu: gacmo dadna looguma adeego sidii isagoo wax u baahan, maxaa yeelay, dhammaan isagaa siiya nolosha iyo neefta iyo wax walbaba;
english: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

kikuyu: oo quruun kasta oo bini-aadmi ah ayuu isaga mid dhigay inay dunida dusheeda oo dhan degganaadaan isagoo gooyay xilliyaduu hore u diyaarshay iyo xadadka degmooyinkooda;
english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

kikuyu: inay Ilaah doondoonaan, in hadday suurtowdo ay haabhaabtaan oo ay helaan isaga, in kastoo uusan ka fogayn midkeen kasta;
english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, isagaynu ku nool nahay, kuna soconnaa, kuna jirnaa; sidaasoo kuwo ka mid ah gabayayaashiinnu ay yidhaahdeen, Weliba innaguna waxaynu nahay farcankiisa.
english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

kikuyu: Haddaba innagoo ah Ilaah farcankiis waa inaynaan ka fikirin in Ilaahnimadu ay la mid tahay dahab ama lacag ama dhagax oo lagu xardhay sancada iyo farsamada dadka.
english: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

kikuyu: Haddaba wakhtiyadii oqoonla'aanta Ilaah baa dhaafay, laakiin hadda wuxuu dadka ku amrayaa in dhammaantood meel kastaba ha joogeene ay soo toobadkeenaan;
english: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, wuxuu dhigay maalin uu dunida si xaq ah ugu xukumi doono ninkuu doortay, taasoo uu dhammaan ugu caddeeyey sarakicidda uu isagii ka soo sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay.
english: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

kikuyu: Haddaba kolkay maqleen wax ku saabsan ka soo sarakicidda kuwii dhintay, qaar waa ku qosleen, laakiin qaar kale waxay yidhaahdeen, Mar kale ayaannu waxan kaa maqli doonnaa.
english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Bawlos waa ka dhex tegey iyagii.
english: Thus Paul went out from among them.

kikuyu: Laakiin niman baa raacay isagii oo rumaystay; kuwaasoo ay ka mid ahaayeen Diyonusiyos ki Are'obagos, iyo haweenay la odhan jiray Damaris, iyo kuwo kale oo la socdayba.
english: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas dabadeed Ateenay ayuu ka tegey, oo wuxuu yimid Korintos.
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

kikuyu: Meeshaasna wuxuu ka helay Yuhuudi Akula la odhan jiray, oo reer Bontos ah, oo mar dhow haweenaydiisa Bariskilla kala yimid Itaaliya, maxaa yeelay, Kalawdiyos baa ku amray Yuhuudda oo dhan inay Rooma ka tagaan; wuuna u yimid iyagii.
english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

kikuyu: Isaguna la shuqul buu ahaa, sidaas darteed ayuu ula joogay iyagii, wayna shaqeeyeen; waayo, xagga shuqulkooda waxay ahaayeen taambuug-sameeyayaal.
english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu sabti walba sunagogga kula doodi jiray oo soo jeedin jiray Yuhuud iyo Gariigba.
english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

kikuyu: Laakiin markii Silas iyo Timoteyos Makedoniya ka yimaadeen, hadalka ayaa haystay Bawlos isagoo Yuhuudda hortooda ka sheegaya in Ciise yahay Masiixa.
english: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

kikuyu: Oo markay is hor taageen oo caytameen, isagu dharkiisuu hurgufay oo ku yidhi iyagii, Dhiiggiinnu madaxiinna ha dul ahaado; anigu nadiif baan ahay, hadda ka dib waxaan u tegi doonaa dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn.
english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

kikuyu: Markaasuu meeshaas ka tegey, oo wuxuu galay gurigii ninka Tiitos Yuustos la odhan jiray, kaasoo Ilaah caabudi jiray, oo gurigiisu ku xigay sunagogga.
english: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Kirisbos oo sunagogga u sarreeyey baa Rabbiga rumaystay, isaga iyo kuwii gurigiisa oo dhanba; kuwo badan oo reer Korintos ahna ayaa markay maqleen rumaystay, oo waa la baabtiisay.
english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbiga ayaa wuxuu Bawlos habeennimo riyo ku yidhi, Ha cabsanin, laakiin hadal, hana aamusin;
english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, anaa kula jooga, ninnana kuma dhici doono inuu wax ku yeelo, waayo, dad badan baan magaaladan ku leeyahay.
english: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

kikuyu: Meeshaasna sannad iyo lix bilood ayuu joogay, oo wuxuu dhexdooda barayay ereyga Ilaah.
english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

kikuyu: Laakiin kolkii Galliyo ahaa taliyaha Akhaya, Yuhuuddii oo isku qalbi ah baa ku kacday Bawlos, oo waxay hor keeneen kursigii xukumaadda iyagoo leh,
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

kikuyu: Ninkanu wuxuu dadka yeelsiiyaa inay Ilaah u caabudaan si sharciga ka gees ah.
english: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

kikuyu: Laakiin kolkii Bawlos u dhowaa inuu afkiisa kala qaado ayaa Galliyo Yuhuuddii ku yidhi, Kuwiinnan Yuhuudda ahow, xaajadii hadday tahay xaqdarro ama xumaan shar ah, sababtaas waan idiinku dulqaadan lahaa;
english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

kikuyu: laakiin hadday yihiin su'aalo ku saabsan hadallo iyo magacyo iyo sharcigiinna, idinka qudhiinnu fiiriya, maxaa yeelay, anigu dooni maayo inaan waxyaalahaas xaakin u ahaado.
english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu iyagii ka eryay kursigii xukumaadda.
english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

kikuyu: Kolkaasay kulligood waxay qabteen Sostenees oo sunagogga u sarreeyey, wayna ku garaaceen isagii kursigii xukumaadda hortiisa. Galliyona dan kama gelin waxyaalahaas.
english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

kikuyu: Markaasaa Bawlos maalmo badan sii joogay, dabadeed ayuu walaalihii ka tegey, oo wuxuu u dhoofay Suuriya, isagoo ay la socdaan Bariskilla iyo Akula, wuxuuna Kenekhreya hore ugu xiirtay madaxa, maxaa yeelay, nidar buu galay.
english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay yimaadeen Efesos, oo halkaasuu iyagii kaga tegey; laakiin isagu wuxuu galay sunagogga oo la dooday Yuhuuddii.
english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

kikuyu: Oo markay weyddiisteen inuu wakhti ka sii dheer joogo, ma uu oggolaan;
english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

kikuyu: laakiin markuu ka tegey ayuu ku yidhi, Mar kalaan idiin soo noqon doonaa haddii Ilaah doonayo, markaasuu Efesos ka dhoofay.
english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

kikuyu: Oo markuu Kaysariya ku soo degay, ayuu wuxuu u aaday oo salaamay kiniisadda, markaasuu Antiyokh aaday.
english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

kikuyu: Markuu intii mudda ah meeshaas joogayna, wuu ka tegey, markaasuu meel meel u sii dhex maray dalalka Galatiya iyo Farugiya isagoo xertii adkaynaya.
english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa Efesos yimid Yuhuudi Abolloos la odhan jiray oo reer Iskanderiya ahaa, oo wuxuu ahaa nin hadalyaqaan ah, oo Qorniinka garasho xoog leh u leh.
english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

kikuyu: Ninkaas jidka Rabbiga hore baa loo baray; oo isagoo ruuxa ku kulul ayuu ku hadlay oo hagaag u baray waxyaalihii Ciise ku saabsanaa, isagoo garanaya baabtiiskii Yooxanaa oo keliya;
english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu bilaabay inuu geesinimo kaga dhex hadlo sunagogga. Laakiin Bariskilla iyo Akula, markay maqleen isagii, ayay kaxaysteen, kolkaasay aad ugu sii caddeeyeen jidka Ilaah.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

kikuyu: Oo markuu damcay inuu u sii dhaafo Akhaya, ayaa walaalihii dhiiro geliyeen, oo waxay xerta u qoreen inay soo dhoweeyaan isagii; markuu yimidna aad buu u caawiyey iyagii, kuwaasoo nimco ku rumaystay,
english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, si xoog leh ayuu Yuhuuddii u garansiiyey oo caddaan ugu tusay Qorniinka in Ciise yahay Masiixa.
english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa dhacay, markii Abolloos Korintos joogay, in Bawlos oo soo dhex maray waddanka sare yimid Efesos, oo halkaas wuxuu kula kulmay kuwo xer ah.
english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi iyagii, Ruuxa Quduuska ah ma hesheen markaad rumaysateen? Kolkaasay ku yidhaahdeen, Maya, maba aannu maqlin in Ruuxa Quduuska ahi jiro iyo in kale.
english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu ku yidhi, Haddaba maxaa laydinku baabtiisay? Oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Baabtiiskii Yooxanaa.
english: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

kikuyu: Bawlosna wuxuu ku yidhi, Yooxanaa wuxuu dadka ku baabtiisay baabtiiska toobadda, isagoo dadkii ku leh, Waa inaad rumaysataan kan iga daba iman doona, isagoo ula jeeda Ciise.
english: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”

kikuyu: Oo markay waxaas maqleen, waxaa iyagii lagu baabtiisay Rabbi Ciise magiciisa.
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Markii Bawlos gacmaha dul saarayna ayaa Ruuxa Quduuska ahu ku soo degay iyagii; markaasay afaf kale ku hadleen oo ay wax sii sheegeen;
english: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

kikuyu: nimankii oo dhanna waxay ahaayeen abbaaraha laba iyo toban.
english: They were about twelve men in all.

kikuyu: Haddaba sunagogga ayuu galay, oo meeshaas ayuu saddex bilood geesinimo kaga dhex hadlay, isagoo dadka la doodaya oo u soo jeedinaya waxyaalo ku saabsan boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Laakiin qaarkood markay madax adkaadeen oo caasiyoobeen, iyagoo xumaan kaga hadlaya Jidka dadkii badnaa hortooda, ayuu iyagii ka tegey oo xertii ka soo soocay, oo maalin walba ayuu dad kula doodi jiray iskoolka Turannos.
english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

kikuyu: Taasuna laba sannadood ay socotay, si dadkii Aasiya degganaa, oo Yuhuud iyo Gariigba lahaa, ay u wada maqleen ereyga Rabbiga.
english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu gacmaha Bawlos ku sameeyey cajaa'ibyo khaas ah,
english: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

kikuyu: sidaas aawadeedna waxaa jidhkiisa kuwii bukay looga keenay marooyin yaryar ama macawiso, markaasaa cudurradii iyagii daayeen, jinniyadiina waa ka baxeen.
english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

kikuyu: Laakiin kuwo Yuhuudda wareegi jirtay ka mid ah oo jinniyosaarayaal ah baa waxay ku talo jireen inay kuwii jinniyada qabay ka dul yidhaahdaan magaca Rabbi Ciise, iyagoo leh, Waxaan idinku dhaarinayaa Ciisaha Bawlos dadka ku wacdiyo.
english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

kikuyu: Waxaa jiray oo sidaas sameeyey toddoba wiil oo Iskeba dhalay, kaasoo ahaa wadaad sare oo Yuhuudi ah.
english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

kikuyu: Markaasaa jinnigii u jawaabay oo ku yidhi iyagii, Ciise ayaan garanayaa, Bawlosna waan aqaan, idinkuse yaad tihiin?
english: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”

kikuyu: Haddaba ninkii jinniga qabay baa ku booday iyagii, wuuna ka xoog badiyey kulligood, oo ka adkaaday, sidaas darteed ayay gurigaas ka carareen, iyagoo qaawan oo dhaawacan.
english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa taas wada ogaaday Yuhuuddii iyo Gariigtii oo dhan oo Efesos joogtay; baqdinna waa wada gashay dhammaantood, magaca Rabbi Ciisena waa la weyneeyey.
english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

kikuyu: Markaasaa qaar badan oo rumaystay yimaadeen iyagoo qiranaya oo caddaysanaya falimahooda.
english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

kikuyu: Kuwii sixir fali jirayna qaarkood intay kitaabbadoodii ururiyeen ayay dadka hortooda ku wada gubeen; wayna tiriyeen qiimadooda, oo waxay arkeen inay ahayd konton kun oo gogo' oo lacag ah.
english: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

kikuyu: Sidaasaa ereygii Rabbigu xoog ugu batay oo u adkaaday.
english: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

kikuyu: Haddaba markii waxyaalahaasu dhammaadeen ayaa Bawlos ruuxiisa kula talo jiray inuu Yeruusaalem tago markuu Makedoniya iyo Akhaya sii dhex maray dabadeed, isagoo leh, Markaan meeshaas tago dabadeed, waa inaan Roomana arko.
english: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu Makedoniya u diray laba ka mid ah kuwii isaga u adeegi jiray oo ahaa Timoteyos iyo Erastos, isaga qudhiisuse wuxuu ku hadhay Aasiya intii muddo ah.
english: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa wakhtigaas kacday rabshad aan yarayn oo ku saabsan Jidka.
english: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, ninkoo Deemeetriyos la odhan jiray oo lacagtume ahaa, oo macbudyo yaryar oo Di'ana lacag ka samayn jiray, wuxuu sancaawiyadii u keeni jiray faa'iido aan yarayn;
english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

kikuyu: kuwaasoo uu isla soo ururiyey raggii la shuqul ahaa isagoo ku leh, Niman yahow, waad og tihiin inaynu shuqulkan ka helno hodantinimadeenna.
english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

kikuyu: Waxaad arkaysaan oo aad maqlaysaan in Bawloskanu sasabay oo jeediyey dad badan, oo aan kuwii Efesos oo keliya ahayn, laakiin kuwii joogay Aasiya badidood, isagoo leh, Ilaahyo gacmo lagu sameeyo, ilaahyo ma aha.
english: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.

kikuyu: Khatar uma aha shuqulkeenna oo keliya in la quudhsado, laakiin waxay khatar u tahay oo kale in macbudka ilaahadda weyn oo Di'ana la fududaysto, weynaanteedana laga baabbi'iyo, taasoo Aasiya oo dhan iyo duniduba ay wada caabudaan.
english: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”

kikuyu: Oo markay taas maqleen, aad bay u cadhoodeen, wayna dhawaaqeen iyagoo leh, Waxaa weyn Di'anada reer Efesos.
english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

kikuyu: Magaaladii oo dhammuna waa wada qasnayd; waxayna qabsadeen Gayos iyo Aristarkhos oo ahaa niman reer Makedoniya oo la socdaali jiray Bawlos, markaasay iyagoo isku wada qalbi ah te'atradii ku yaaceen.
english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

kikuyu: Kolkii Bawlos damcay inuu dadkii dhex galo, xertii uma ay oggolaan isagii.
english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

kikuyu: Haddaba qaar ka mid ah madaxda Aasiya oo saaxiibbo u ahaa isagii ayaa u soo cid diray, oo waxay ka baryeen inuusan isku biimayn te'atradii.
english: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

kikuyu: Haddaba qaar wax bay ku qayliyeen, qaar kalena wax kalay ku qayliyeen, maxaa yeelay, ururkii waa qasnaa, badidooduna ma ay garanayn waxay isugu yimaadeen.
english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

kikuyu: Markaasay Aleksanderos ka soo saareen dadkii badnaa isagoo ay Yuhuuddii hore u soo tuurayaan. Markaasaa Aleksanderos gacan taagay, oo wuxuu damci lahaa inuu af isku daafaco dadka hortiisa.
