kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan idinka baryayaa inaad cunto qaadataan, waayo, taasu waa caafimaadkiinna aawadiis; maxaa yeelay, midkiinna tin keliyahu ka go'i maayo madaxiisa.
english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

kikuyu: Oo markii uu saas yidhi, ayuu wuxuu soo qaatay kibis, oo dadkii oo dhan hortooda ayuu Ilaah ugu mahadnaqay, oo intuu kala jebiyey ayuu bilaabay inuu wax cuno.
english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

kikuyu: Markaasay wada dhiirranaadeen dhammaantood, oo iyagiina wax bay cuneen.
english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

kikuyu: Oo intayadii doonnidii ku jirtay oo dhammu waxaannu ahayn laba boqol iyo lix iyo toddobaatan qof.
english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

kikuyu: Oo markii ay cuntada ka dhergeen, ayay doonnidii fududeeyeen, oo sarreenkiina waxay ku tuureen badda.
english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

kikuyu: Oo markii waagii beryay, ayay dhulkii garan waayeen; laakiin waxay arkeen marso xeeb leh, oo waxay doonayeen inay doonnidii halkaas ku kaxeeyaan hadday karaan.
english: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

kikuyu: Markaasay barroosinnadii badda ku xooreen oo badda ku sii daayeen, oo isla markaasba waxay fureen xadhkihii shukaanaha ku xidhnaa, oo intay shiraaqii dabaysha u sii daayeen, ayay xeebta ku hagaageen.
english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxay ku dhaceen meel laba badood isaga darmadaan, markaasaa doonnidii dhulka ku dhufatay; oo dhankeedii hore ayaa meel ku liimbaaday oo waxay noqotay wax aan la dhaqdhaqaajin karin, laakiin dhankii dambe wuxuu bilaabay inuu ku burburo mawjadihii xooggooda.
english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

kikuyu: Markaasaa askartii waxay ku taliyeen inay maxaabiista laayaan, si aan midkoodna intuu dabaasho uga baxsan.
english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

kikuyu: Laakiin boqol-u-taliyihii oo doonayay inuu badbaadiyo Bawlos, ayaa qasdigoodii ka joojiyey; oo wuxuu amray in kuwa dabaalan karaa ay doonnida iska tuuraan, oo ay marka hore dhulka tagaan;
english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

kikuyu: oo inta kalena qaar ha ku dabaasho looxaan, qaarna waxyaalo kale oo ay doonnida ka sii qaataan. Oo sidaas daraaddeed waxay noqotay inay dhammaantood dhulkii u baxsadeen iyagoo nabdoon.
english: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

kikuyu: Oo kolkii aannu wada baxsannay ayaan ogaannay in gasiiraddaas la yidhaahdo Melita.
english: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

kikuyu: Oo barbariyiintii waxay na tuseen raxmad khaas ah; waayo, iyagu waxay shideen dab, oo dhammaantayona way na soo dhoweeyeen, sababtuna waa roobkii wakhtigaas jiray daraaddiis iyo dhaxantii daraaddeed.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

kikuyu: Laakiin Bawlos ayaa soo ururshay xaabo badan, oo wuxuu saaray dabka, kolkaasaa kulaylka daraaddiis waxaa soo baxay jilbis oo gacantiisuu ku dhegay.
english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

kikuyu: Oo barbariyiintiina markay arkeen bahalkii gacantiisa ka laalaaday ayaa midkoodba wuxuu mid kale ku yidhi, Shakila'aan ninkanu waa nin dhiig qaba, waayo, in kastoo uu baddii nabdoonaan kaga baxsaday, haddana xaqnimadu uma oggolaan inuu sii noolaado.
english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee bahalkii ayuu dabka iskaga tuuray, oo innaba waxyeello ma gaadhin isagii.
english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

kikuyu: Laakiin iyagii waxay filanayeen inuu haddiiba bararo ama uu markiiba dhaco isagoo meyd ah; laakiin kolkii ay wakhti dheer dhawrayeen oo ay arkeen inaan waxyeello ku dhicin isagii, ayay fikirradoodii beddeleen, oo waxay isku yidhaahdeen, Isagu waa ilaah.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

kikuyu: Haddaba meeshaas waxaa u dhowaa dhulal uu leeyahay ninkii gasiiradda madaxda u ahaa oo magiciisa la odhan jiray Bobliyos. Kaasuna waa na soo dhoweeyey, oo intii saddex maalmood ah ayuu si sharaf ah noo marti qaaday.
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in Bobliyos aabbihiis jiifsaday isagoo qandho iyo dabadhiig qaba. Markaasaa Bawlos isagii u galay oo intuu u duceeyey ayuu gacmihiisii saaray oo wuu bogsiiyey isagii.
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

kikuyu: Oo markii waxaas la sameeyey dabadeed ayaa intii kale oo cudurro qabtay oo gasiiraddii joogtay oo dhammu wada yimaadeen, oo iyana waa la bogsiiyey;
english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

kikuyu: oo kuwaasuna waxay nagu sharfeen sharaf badan; oo markii aannu dhoofaynay ayay doonnida noo saareen wax alla wixii aannu u baahnayn.
english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

kikuyu: Saddex bilood dabadeed waxaannu ku dhoofnay doonni Iskanderiya ka timid oo wakhtigii qabowga gasiiraddii joogtay taasoo sumaddeedii ahayd Walaalihii Mataanaha ahaa.
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

kikuyu: Markaasaannu nimid Surakus, oo saddex maalmood ayaan halkaas sii joognay.
english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

kikuyu: Oo halkaasaannu ka wareegnay oo waxaannu gaadhnay Regiyon; oo maalin dabadeed waxaa kacday dabayl koonfureed, oo maalintii labaadna waxaannu nimid Botiyolos.
english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

kikuyu: Oo halkaas waxaan ka helnay walaalo, oo waxay naga baryeen inaan toddoba maalmood iyaga la sii joogno, oo sidaas ayaan Rooma ku nimid.
english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

kikuyu: Oo halkaasna walaalihii markii ay maqleen warkayagii, ayay u soo baxeen inay naga hor yimaadaan, oo waxay soo gaadheen tan iyo Suuqa Abbiyus iyo Saddexdii Makhaayadood. Oo Bawlosna markuu arkay iyagii ayuu Ilaah ku mahadnaqay oo sii dhiirranaaday.
english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

kikuyu: Oo markii aannu Rooma galnay ayaa Bawlos waxaa loo oggolaaday inuu keli ahaantiis u joogo isaga iyo askarigii dhawrayay.
english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqotay in saddex maalmood dabadeed uu isugu wada yeedhay kuwii Yuhuudda ugu waaweynaa; oo kolkii ay u yimaadeen, ayuu ku yidhi iyagii, Walaalayaalow, anigu in kastoo aanan wax xumaan ah ku samayn dadkii ama caadooyinkii awowayaasheen toona, haddana anoo maxbuus ah ayaa waxaa layga soo waday Yeruusaalem oo waxaa la ii gacangeliyey reer Rooma.
english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

kikuyu: Iyaguna, markii ay i imtixaameen, waxay damceen inay iska kay daayaan, maxaa yeelay, sabab dhimasho istaahisha aanay igu jirin.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

kikuyu: Laakiin Yuhuuddu markay taas qilaafeen ayaa waxaa dirqi igu noqotay inaan Kaysar u ashtakoodo; taasuna ma ahaan inaan haystay wax aan quruuntayda ku dacwaynayo.
english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

kikuyu: Sababtaas daraaddeed ayaan idiin yeedhay inaan idin arko oo aan idinla hadlo; maxaa yeelay, rajadii reer binu Israa'iil sugayaan daraaddeed ayaan silsiladdan ugu xidhnahay.
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay isagii ku yidhaahdeen, Annagu wax warqadaa oo adiga kugu saabsan Yahuudiya kama aannu helin, oo walaalihii midkoodna xaggaas kama iman, noomana soo sheegin ama kaama soo warramin xumaato.
english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaannu jeclaan lahayn inaannu kaa maqalno waxaad u malaynaysid; maxaa yeelay, xagga dariiqadan waxaannu ka og nahay in meel walba ka gees ahaan lagaga hadlo.
english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

kikuyu: Oo intay maalin ka ballanqaadeen, ayay hoygiisii ugu yimaadeen iyagoo tiro badan, oo isna xaalkii aad buu ugu sii caddeeyey oo u marag furay boqortooyada Ilaah, oo wuxuu iyagii ku waaninayay wax Ciise ku saabsan oo ku yaalla sharciga Muuse iyo nebiyadiiba tan iyo aroortii ilaa fiidkii.
english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

kikuyu: Oo qaar baa rumaystay waxyaalihii lagu hadlay, qaar kalena way rumaysan waayeen.
english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

kikuyu: Oo intay dhexdooda ka heshiin waayeen, ayay kala tageen, Bawlos se wax keliya ayuu ku hadlay, isagoo leh, Ruuxa Quduuska ah si hagaagsan ayuu uga dhex hadlay nebi Isayos markuu awowayaashiin la hadlay,
english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

kikuyu: oo ku yidhi, Adigu dadka u tag, oo waxaad ku tidhaahdaa, Maqal baad ku maqli doontaan, mana garan doontaan; Idinkoo arkaya, wax baad arki doontaan, idiinmana dhaadhici doonto;
english: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

kikuyu: Waayo, dadkan qalbigoodu waa qallafsanaaday, Oo dhib bay dhegahooda wax ugu maqlaan, Indhahoodana way isku qabteen; Si aanay indhaha wax ugu arkin, Oo dhegaha wax ugu maqlin, Oo qalbiga wax ugu garan, Si aanay u soo noqon, Oo aanan u bogsiin.
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’

kikuyu: Haddaba idinku waxaad ogaataan in badbaadadan Ilaah loo soo diray dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn; oo iyaguna way maqli doonaan.
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

kikuyu: Oo markuu waxyaalahaas ku yidhi ayaa Yuhuuddii iska tageen, iyagoo isla murmaya.
english: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.

kikuyu: Oo laba sannadood oo dhan ayuu iska degganaa hoy uu isagu kiraystay, oo kulli intii u soo gashay oo dhanna wuu soo wada dhoweeyey.
english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

kikuyu: Oo isagoo aad u dhiirran ayuu wuxuu ku wacdiyi jiray boqortooyada Ilaah, wuxuuna bari jiray waxyaalaha ku saabsan Rabbi Ciise Masiix, cidnana uma diidin.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

kikuyu: Waxaa warqaddan qoraya Bawlos oo ah addoonkii Ciise Masiix, oo loogu yeedhay inuu rasuul ahaado, oo gooni looga dhigay injiilka Ilaah.
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

kikuyu: Injiilkaas ayuu Ilaah markii hore nebiyadii ku ballanqaaday xagga Qorniinka quduuska ah,
english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ku saabsan yahay Wiilkiisa, kii ka dhashay farcankii Daa'uud xagga jidhka,
english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

kikuyu: oo sarakiciddii uu ka sara kacay kuwii dhintay ay ku caddaysay inuu xagga ruuxa quduusnimada yahay Wiilka Ilaah oo xoog leh oo ah Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix,
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

kikuyu: kan aannu ku helnay nimco iyo rasuulnimo, inaannu addeecidda rumaysadka magiciisa daraaddiis ugu geeyno quruumaha oo dhan.
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

kikuyu: Idinkuna kuwaas dhexdooda aad ku jirtaan oo ah kuwii loo yeedhay oo Ciise Masiix.
english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

kikuyu: Waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa kuwa Rooma jooga oo dhan oo uu Ilaah jeclaaday, oo loogu yeedhay quduusiin. Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbeheen ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Marka hore waxaan Ilaahay xagga Ciise Masiix ugu mahadnaqayaa kulligiin, maxaa yeelay, rumaysadkiinna waxaa lagaga warramaa dunida oo dhan.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah, kan aan ruuxayga ugu adeego xagga injiilka Wiilkiisa, ayaa markhaati iiga ah sidaan maalin walbaba joogsila'aan baryadayda idiinku xusuusto,
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

kikuyu: anigoo weyddiisanaya inaan imminka ugu dambaysta si kastaba ku lib helo inaan Ilaah idankiisa idiinku imaado.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

kikuyu: Waayo, aad baan u doonayaa inaan idin arko oo idin siiyo hadiyad Ruuxa ka timaada inaad ku xoogaysataan;
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

kikuyu: taasuna waa inaan idinkula dhiirranaado rumaysadka, kiinna iyo kaygaba.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, dooni maayo inaad garan weydaan inaan marar badan damcay inaan idiin imaado inaan idinkana midho idinku dhex lahaado sida aan quruumaha kale ugu dhex leeyahay, laakiin waa layga hor joogsaday ilaa haatan.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Waxaa waajib la iigu leeyahay inaan wacdiyo Gariigga iyo Barbariyiinta, kuwa caqliga leh iyo kuwa garaadka la'ba.
english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed anigu diyaar baan u ahay inaan injiilka ku wacdiyo kuwiinna Rooma joogana.
english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu injiilka ka xishoon maayo, maxaa yeelay, waa u xoogga Ilaah xagga badbaadinta ku alla kii rumaysta, marka hore Yuhuudda dabadeedna Gariigga.
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhexdiisa waxaa laga muujiyaa xaqnimada Ilaah oo rumaysad ka timaada, rumaysadna u socota, sida qoran. Kii xaq ahu rumaysad buu ku noolaan doonaa.
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

kikuyu: Cadhadii Ilaah ayaa samada laga muujiyey iyadoo ka gees ah cibaadodarrada iyo xaqdarrada dadka oo dhan, kuwaasoo runta ku joojiya xaqdarro;
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, wixii Ilaah laga garan karo waa ka dhex muuqataa iyaga, waayo, Ilaah waa u muujiyey iyaga.
english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

kikuyu: Tan iyo abuurniinta dunida waxyaalihiisii aan la arki karin ayaa bayaan loo arkaa, iyagoo laga garto waxyaalihii la sameeyey, xataa xooggiisa daa'imiska ah iyo ilaahnimadiisa, si ayan marmarsiinyo u lahaan.
english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, iyagoo Ilaah garanaya ayayan isaga Ilaah ahaan u ammaanin, umana ay mahadnaqin, laakiin fikirradoodii waa xumaadeen, qalbigoodii garaadka la'aana waa madoobaaday.
english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

kikuyu: Iyagoo kuwo caqli leh isku sheegaya ayay nacasoobeen.
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

kikuyu: Ammaantii Ilaaha aan dhimanin ayay ku beddeleen sanam u eg nin dhimanaya iyo haad iyo xayawaan iyo waxa bogga ku gurguurta.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

kikuyu: Taas aawadeed iyagoo qalbigooda wax xun ka damacsan, Ilaah wuxuu u daayay wasakhnimo in dhexdooda jidhkoodu ku maamuus jabo;
english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, runtii Ilaah bay been ku beddeleen, oo waxay caabudeen oo u adeegeen ummadda intay caabudi lahaayeen kan uumay oo weligiis ammaanta leh. Aamiin.
english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Saas daraaddeed Ilaah wuxuu u daayay damacyo ceeb ah; waayo, dumarkoodu isticmaalkii loo abuuray waxay ku beddeleen mid ka gees ah kii loo abuuray.
english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena raggii intay iska daayeen isticmaalkii dumarka ayay iyagoo damacoodu gubayo isu kacsadeen; rag waxay rag kale ku sameeyeen ceeb, oo waxay dhexdooda ka heleen abaalgudkii qaladkooda waajibka ku ahaa.
english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

kikuyu: Intay oggolaan waayeen inay Ilaah ku sii haystaan aqoontooda, Ilaah wuxuu u daayay maan dulli ah inay sameeyaan waxyaalo aan qummanayn,
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

kikuyu: iyagoo ay ka buuxaan xaqdarrada, iyo sharnimada, iyo damacnimada, iyo xumaanta oo dhammu; waxaa kaloo ay ka buuxaan hinaasada, iyo dilidda, iyo ilaaqda, iyo khiyaanada, iyo camalxumaanta, oo waxay yihiin kuwa wax xun ku faqa,
english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

kikuyu: iyo kuwa wax xanta, iyo kuwa Ilaah neceb, iyo kuwa wax caaya, iyo kuwa kibirka badan, iyo kuwa faanka badan, iyo kuwa wax shar ah hindisa, iyo kuwa waalidkood caasiga ku ah,
english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

kikuyu: iyo kuwa garaadka la', iyo kuwa axdiga jebiya, iyo kuwa aan kalgacaylka lahayn, iyo kuwa aan naxariista lahayn.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

kikuyu: Iyagoo garanaya qaynuunka Ilaah in kuwa waxyaalahaas sameeyaa ay dhimasho istaahilaan, ayaanay samayn waxyaalahaas oo keliya ee weliba waxay u bogaan kuwa sameeya.
english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, nin yahow, marmarsiinyo ma lihid ku kastoo aad tahayba kaaga wax xukuma; maxaa yeelay, meeshii aad ku kale ku xukuntid, waad isku xukumaysaa, waayo, kaaga wax xukumaa, waxaad samaysaa isla wixii.
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

kikuyu: Oo waxaannu og nahay in xukunka Ilaah uu ka gees yahay kuwa waxyaalaha caynkaas ah sameeya, sida runta ah.
english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

kikuyu: Nin yahow, ma waxay kula tahay, kolkaad xukuntid kuwa waxyaalaha caynkaas ah sameeya oo aad isla wixiina sameeysid, inaad xukunka Ilaah ka baxsan doonto?
english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

kikuyu: Ma waxaad quudhsanaysaa hodantinimada wanaaggisa iyo samirkiisa iyo dulqaadashadiisa? Miyaadan garanayn in wanaagga Ilaah kuu kaxeeyo xagga toobadda?
english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

kikuyu: Laakiin engegnaantaada iyo toobadla'aanta qalbigaaga aawadood waxaad cadho u urursanaysaa maalinta cadhada iyo muuqashada xukunka xaqa ah oo Ilaah,
english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

kikuyu: kan nin kasta u siin doona sida shuqulkiisu ahaa,
english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

kikuyu: kuwa dulqaadashada shuqulka wanaagsan ku doondoonaa ammaan iyo ciso iyo dhimashola'aan, wuxuu siin doonaa nolosha weligeed ah;
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

kikuyu: laakiin kuwa iskala qaybqaybiya, oo aan runta addeecin, laakiinse xaqdarrada addeeca, waxaa u ahaan doona cadho iyo ciil,
english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

kikuyu: iyo dhibaato iyo cidhiidhiba, oo waxay u ahaan doonaan naf kasta oo dadka sharka sameeya, marka hore Yuhuudda, dabadeedna Gariigga.
english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

kikuyu: Laakiin ammaan iyo ciso iyo nabad baa u ahaan doona ku kasta oo wanaag sameeya, marka hore Yuhuudda, dabadeedna Gariigga;
english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, Ilaah dadka uma kala eexdo.
english: For there is no partiality with God.

kikuyu: In alla intii sharcila'aan dembaabtay, sharcila'aan bay halligmi doonaan, oo in alla intii sharciga hoostiisa ku dembaabtayna, sharcigaa lagu xukumi doonaa;
english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

kikuyu: waayo, kuwa sharciga maqlaa ma aha kuwa xaqa Ilaah hortiis, laakiinse kuwa sharciga yeela xaq baa laga dhigi doonaa.
english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

kikuyu: Markii dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn oo aan sharciga lahaynu, ay dabiicadda ka sameeyaan waxyaalaha sharciga, kuwan aan sharciga lahaynu waa isu sharci.
english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

kikuyu: Waxay muujiyaan shuqulka sharciga oo qalbiyadooda ku qoran, iyagoo garashadoodu u markhaati furayso, oo fikirradoodu midba midka kale ashtakaynayo ama marmarsiinyo samaysanayo,
english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

kikuyu: maalinta Ilaah waxyaalaha qarsoon ee dadka ku xukumi doono Ciise Masiix sida injiilkaygu leeyahay.
english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiin adigu haddaad isku sheegtid Yuhuudi, oo sharciga isku hallaysid, oo Ilaah ku faantid,
english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

kikuyu: oo doonistiisa taqaanid, oo aad u bogtid waxyaalaha aad u fiican, adigoo sharciga wax lagugu baray,
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

kikuyu: oo aad aaminsan tahay inaad tahay kan haga kuwa indhaha la', iyo kan nuurka u ah kuwa gudcurka ku jira,
english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

kikuyu: iyo kan doqonnada qumaatiya, iyo macallinka carruurta, adigoo sharciga ku haysta muuqashadii aqoonta iyo runta;
english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

kikuyu: haddaba kaaga kan kale wax baraa, sow wax isbari maysid? Kaaga dadka ku wacdiya, Waxba ha xadina; adigu miyaad wax xaddaa?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

kikuyu: Kaaga yidhaahda, Yaan la sinaysan, miyaad adigu sinaysataa? Kaaga sanamyada nebcaada, miyaad macbudyo dhacdaa?
english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

kikuyu: Kaaga sharciga ku faana, miyaad Ilaah ku cisa jebisaa sharciga aad gudubtay aawadiis?
english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

kikuyu: Waayo, magaca Ilaaha waa lagaga caytamaa quruumaha dhexdooda idinka daraaddiin, sida qoran.
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.

kikuyu: Waayo, hubaal gudniintu wax bay tartaa, haddaad sharciga yeeshid, laakiin haddaad sharciga gudubtid, gudniintaadii waxay noqotay buuryoqabnimo.
english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii mid buuryoqab ahu xajiyo qaynuunnada sharciga, buuryoqabnimadiisii miyaan loo tirin doonin sida gudniin?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

kikuyu: Oo kan jinsigiisu buuryoqab yahay, hadduu sharciga dhammeeyo, miyuusan ku xukumi doonin kaaga sharciga gudba, in kastoo aad haysatid qorniinka iyo gudniinta?
english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

kikuyu: Waayo, kii dadka sida Yuhuudi ugu muuqdaa, Yuhuudi ma aha; gudniinta jidhka ka muuqataana, gudniin ma aha;
english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

kikuyu: laakiin waxaa Yuhuudi ah kii hoosta Yuhuudi ka ah; gudniintuna waa tan qalbiga, ee ku jirta ruuxa, oo aan ku jirin qorniinka; kaas ammaantiisu kama timaado dadka, waxayse ka timaadaa Ilaah.
english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

kikuyu: Haddaba maxay Yuhuuddu dadka kale dhaantaa? Ama gudniinta waxtarkeedu waa maxay?
english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

kikuyu: Si walba wuu u badan yahay; marka hore waxaa Yuhuudda lagu ammaaneeyey hadallada Ilaah.
english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

kikuyu: Haddaba, maxaa jira, haddii qaar aanay rumaysad lahayn? Rumaysaddarradoodu miyey Ilaah aaminnimadiisa burin doontaa?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

kikuyu: Ma suurtowdo! Ilaah runlow ha ahaado in kastoo nin waluba beenlow yahay, sida qoran, In xaq lagaaga dhigo hadalladaada, Oo aad libaantid markii lagu xukumo.
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii xaqnimola'aanteennu muujiso xaqnimada Ilaah, maxaynu odhan doonnaa? Ma xaq daranyahay Ilaaha cadhada soo dejiyaa? (Sida dad baan u hadlayaa.)
english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

kikuyu: Ma suurtowdo! Hadduu xaq daranyahay, sidee baa Ilaah dunida u xukumi doonaa?
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

kikuyu: Runta Ilaah hadday beentayda ugu badatay ammaantiisa, de maxaa aniga haddana weli la iigu xukumaa sida mid dembi leh?
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

kikuyu: Maxaannu u odhan weynaa, Shar aan samayno in wanaag yimaado? sida lanoo hafro oo ay qaar naga sheegaan sidii annagoo nidhaahna. Xukunka ay kuwaasu helaan waa xaq.
english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

kikuyu: Waa maxay haddaba? Miyaynu dhaannaa iyaga? Maya, sinaba. Waayo, horaannu u dacweynay Yuhuudda iyo Gariigtaba inay kulligood dembi ku hoos jiraan.
english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

kikuyu: Sida qoran, Mid xaq ahu ma jiro, midnaba;
english: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

kikuyu: Mid wax garanayaa ma jiro; Mid Ilaah doondoonaa ma jiro;
english: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

kikuyu: Dhammaantood gees bay u wada leexdeen, waxay wada noqdeen wax aan wax tar lahayn; Mid wanaag falaa ma jiro, midnaba;
english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”

kikuyu: Hungurigoodu waa xabaal furan; Carrabbadooda wax bay ku khiyaaneeyeen; Bushimahooda waxaa ku hoos jira sun jilbis;
english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

kikuyu: Afkooda waxaa ka buuxa habaar iyo qadhaadh;
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

kikuyu: Cagahoodu waxay u dheereeyaan inay dhiig daadiyaan;
english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

kikuyu: Jidadkooda waxaa yaal hoog iyo ba';
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

kikuyu: Jidka nabaddana ma yaqaaniin;
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

kikuyu: Cabsida Ilaahna indhahooda ma hor taal.
english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

kikuyu: Waannu og nahay in wax alla wixii sharcigu yidhaahdo, uu ku leeyahay kuwa sharciga ku hoos jira, in af kasta la xidho, oo dunida oo dhammu ay Ilaah ku hor gar darnaato.
english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, shuqullada sharciga ninna xaq ku noqon maayo Ilaah hortiis, waayo, sharciga ayaa lagu gartaa dembiga.
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

kikuyu: Laakiin haatan sharciga la'aantiis ayaa xaqnimadii Ilaah la muujiyey, waxaana u marag furay sharciga iyo nebiyadii,
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

kikuyu: waxaana weeyaan xaqnimada Ilaah ee lagu helo rumaysadka xagga Ciise Masiix oo u ah in alla inta rumaysata oo dhan, waayo, kala duwanaan ma leh.
english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, dhammaan way wada dembaabeen oo gaadhi waayeen ammaanta Ilaah;
english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

kikuyu: iyagoo hadiyad ahaan xaq lagaga dhigay nimcadiisa xagga madaxfurashada Ciise Masiix ku furtay,
english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: kan Ilaah u soo bixiyey inuu dhiiggiisa kafaaraggud ku noqdo xagga rumaysadka la rumaystay dhiiggiisa aawadiis, inuu xaqnimadiisa ku muujiyo dembidhaafka uu dembiyadii hore loo sameeyey ku dhaafay samirkii Ilaah;
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

kikuyu: waxaa weeye muujinta xaqnimadiisa ee haatan joogta inuu isaga qudhiisu xaq ahaado iyo kan xaq ka dhiga kan Ciise rumaysan.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

kikuyu: Haddaba faankii meeh? Waa reebban yahay. Sharci caynkee ah buu ku hadhay? Ma xagga shuqulladaa? Maya; laakiinse wuxuu ku hadhay sharciga rumaysadka.
english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaannu ku tirinnaa in nin xaq ku noqdo rumaysadka ee uusan xaq ku noqon shuqullada sharciga.
english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

kikuyu: Ama Ilaah ma Ilaaha Yuhuudda oo keliya baa? Miyuusan ahayn kan quruumaha kalena? Haah, waa yahay kan quruumaha kalena,
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

kikuyu: hadday tahay in Ilaah mid keliya yahay oo uu kuwa gudan xaq kaga dhigi doono rumaysadka, kuwa buuryoqabka ahna rumaysadka.
english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

kikuyu: De miyaannu haddaba sharciga ku burinnaa rumaysadka? Yaanay noqon! Laakiin sharciga waannu taagnaa.
english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

kikuyu: Haddaba maxaynu nidhaahnaa inuu helay Ibraahim oo awowgeennii hore ahaa xagga jidhka?
english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii Ibraahim shuqullo xaq ku noqday, wax uu ku faano buu leeyahay ee Ilaah hortiisa ma aha.
english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

kikuyu: Maxaa Qorniinku leeyahay? Ibraahimna Ilaah buu rumaystay, oo waxaa isaga loogu tiriyey xaqnimo.
english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Haddee kii shaqeeya abaalgudkiisa looguma tiriyo sida nimco laakiinse sida qaan oo kale.
english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

kikuyu: Laakiin kii aan shaqayn illowse rumaysta kan xaq ka dhiga kuwa aan cibaadada lahayn, rumaysadkiisa waxaa lagu tiriyaa xaqnimo.
english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

kikuyu: Sida Daa'uudna uga sheegayo barakadii ninkii Ilaah xaq u tiriyo shuqullola'aantood, isagoo leh,
english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan kuwa xadgudubyadooda la cafiyey, Oo dembiyadooda la daboolay.
english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninkii Rabbigu uusan dembi u tirinayn.
english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

kikuyu: Haddaba barakadan miyaa lagaga hadlay kuwa gudan oo keliya, mise kuwa buuryoqabka ahna waa lagaga hadlay? Waayo, waxaannu nidhaahnaa, Ibraahim rumaysadkiisii waxaa loogu tiriyey xaqnimo.
english: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

kikuyu: Sidee baa haddaba loogu tiriyey? Ma markuu gudnaa, mise markuu buuryoqabka ahaa? Ma aha markuu gudnaa, laakiinse waa markuu buuryoqabka ahaa;
english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

kikuyu: oo wuxuu helay calaamada gudniinta, tan ahayd shaabaddii xaqnimada oo rumaysadkii uu haystay intuu buuryoqabka ahaa; inuu noqdo aabbihii inta rumaysata oo dhan in kastoo ay buuryoqab yihiin, in xaqnimo loo tiriyo iyaga,
english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

kikuyu: iyo inuu aabbaha gudniinta u noqdo kuwa aan ahayn kuwa gudan oo keliya laakiinse kuwa ku socda tallaabooyinka rumaysadka ee Aabbeheen Ibraahim haystay intuu buuryoqabka ahaa.
english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

kikuyu: Waayo, ballankii lagula ballamay Ibraahim ama farcankiisii inuu ku noqdo kii dunida dhaxli lahaa, uguma iman sharciga, laakiinse wuxuu ugu yimid xaqnimada rumaysadka.
english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii kuwa sharciga leh ay noqdaan kuwa dhaxalka leh, de markaas rumaysadkii waxaa laga dhigay wax aan waxtar lahayn, ballankiina waa la buriyey,
english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, sharcigu wuxuu keenaa cadho, laakiinse meeshii aan sharci jirin xadgudubna ma jiro.
english: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed waa xagga rumaysadka inay noqoto xagga nimcada, in ballanku hubaal u ahaado farcanka oo dhan; ee uusan u ahayn kan sharciga leh oo keliya, laakiinse inuu u ahaado kan leh rumaysadkii Ibraahim, kan aabbaha inoo ah kulligeen,
english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

kikuyu: (sida qoran, Quruumo badan baan aabbe kaaga dhigay) Ilaaha uu rumaystay hortiisa, kan nooleeya kuwii dhintay oo u yeedha waxyaalaha aan jirin sida iyagoo jira.
english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

kikuyu: Ibraahim rajuu wax ku rumaystay iyadoo aan rajo jirin inuu aabbe u noqdo quruumo badan, sida waxyaalihii lagula hadlay leeyihiin, Farcankaagu sidaasuu noqon doonaa.
english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

kikuyu: Isagoo aan rumaysadkii ku tabaryaraan wuxuu ka fikiray jidhkiisii sida meyd oo kale ahaa (isagoo boqol jir ku dhow) iyo meydnimadii maxalkii Saarah.
english: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

kikuyu: Ballankii Ilaah rumaysaddarro kagama uu shakiyin, laakiinse rumaysad buu ku xoogaystay, isagoo Ilaah ammaanaya
english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

kikuyu: oo aad u huba in wixii uu u ballanqaaday uu samayn karo.
english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeedna waxaa loogu tiriyey xaqnimo.
english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Wixii loo tiriyey looma qorin isaga aawadiis oo keliya,
english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

kikuyu: laakiin waxaa loo qoray innaga aawadeenna. Waa loo tirin doonaa kuweenna rumaysan kii kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey Rabbigeenna Ciise,
english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

kikuyu: kii loo bixiyey xadgudubkeenna aawadiis oo loo sara kiciyey inuu xaq inaga dhigo.
english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed innagoo xaq laynagaga dhigay rumaysad, nabad baynu xagga Ilaah ku haysannaa Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix;
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

kikuyu: kan xaggiisa aynu rumaysad ku galnay nimcadan aynu dhex taagan nahay, oo waxaynu ku faraxnaa rajada ammaanta Ilaah.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

kikuyu: Oo taas oo keliya ma aha, laakiinse waxaynu ku faraxnaa dhibaatooyinkeenna, innagoo og in dhibaatadu dulqaadasho keento;
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

kikuyu: dulqaadashaduna aqoon dheer, aqoonta dheeruna rajo;
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

kikuyu: rajaduna inama ceebayso, maxaa yeelay, jacaylka Ilaah baa qalbiyadeenna ku dhex shubmay, oo waxaa ku shubay Ruuxa Quduuska ah oo layna siiyey.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

kikuyu: Waayo, innagoo weli itaaldaran ayuu Masiixu wakhti qumman u dhintay kuwa aan cibaadada lahayn.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

kikuyu: Mar dhif ah mid waa u dhintaa nin xaq ah, mindhaase qof waa ku dhici lahaa inuu nin wanaagsan u dhinto.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Masiixu waa inoo dhintay intaynu weli dembilayaal ahayn, oo sidaasuu Ilaah jacaylkiisii inoogu muujiyey.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaynu haatan dhiiggiisa xaq ku noqonnay, de si ka badanna isagaynu kaga badbaadi doonnaa cadhada Ilaah.
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii, intaynu col la ahayn, Ilaah inagula heshiiyey dhimashadii Wiilkiisa, de si ka badanna, innagoo la heshiis ah, ayaynu ku badbaadi doonnaa noloshiisa,
english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

kikuyu: oo taas oo keliyana ma ahaane, weliba waxaynu ku faraxnaa Ilaah xagga Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, kan aynu haatan heshiiska ku helnay.
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

kikuyu: Haddaba sida dembigu nin keliya dunida ugu soo galay, dhimashaduna dembiga ugu timid, sidaasaa dhimashadiina u gaadhay dadka oo dhan, waayo, waa la wada dembaabay;
english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

kikuyu: waayo, dembigu duniduu ku jiray intaan sharcigu iman, laakiin dembi lama tiriyo markii aan sharci jirin.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

kikuyu: Habase ahaatee waagii Aadan ilaa Muuse dhimashadu waxay u talisay xataa kuwii aan u dembaabin sidii xadgudubkii Aadan kan ah masaalka kan iman lahaa.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

kikuyu: Hadiyaddu ma aha sida dembiga, waayo, haddii nin keliya dembigiis kuwa badanu u dhinteen, de in ka sii badan waxaa kuwa badan u badatay nimcada Ilaah iyo hadiyadda nin nimcadiis ku timid, kan ah Ciise Masiix.
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

kikuyu: Hadiyaddu ma aha sida mid qof dembaabay ku timid, waayo, mid xukunkiis wuxuu keenay ciqaab, laakiin hadiyaddu waxay dembiyo badan ugu timid inay xaq ka dhigto kuwo badan.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

kikuyu: Haddii mid dembigiisa aawadiis ay dhimasho ku talisay midkaas aawadiis, de si ka badanna kuwa hela badnaanta nimcada iyo hadiyadda xaqnimada, noloshay ku dhex talin doonaan kii kale aawadiis kaas oo ah Ciise Masiix.
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Haddaba dembiga nin keliya aawadiis waxaa dadka oo dhan ugu yimid xukun, sidaas oo kalena nin keliya xaqnimaduu sameeyey aawadeed waxaa dadka oo dhan ugu timid hadiyad in xaq laga dhigo oo ay noolaadaan.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida nin keliya caasinimadiisii kuwa badan dembilayaal looga dhigay, sidaas oo kalena nin keliya addeeciddiis ayaa kuwa badan xaq looga dhigi doonaa.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

kikuyu: Sharciguna wuxuu u yimid inuu dembigu bato, laakiinse meeshii dembigu ku batay, nimcaduna way ka sii badatay aad iyo aad;
english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

kikuyu: in, sida dembigu dhimashada ugu taliyey, sidaas oo kalena ay nimcadu ugu taliso xaqnimo ilaa nolosha weligeed ah ee xagga Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

kikuyu: Haddaba maxaynu nidhaahnaa? Miyaynu ku sii soconnaa dembiga inay nimcadu badato?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

kikuyu: Yaanay noqon! Innagoo dembiga kala dhimannay, sidee baynu mar dambe ugu dhex noolaannaa?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

kikuyu: Mise ma waydaan ogayn in kulli inteenna lagu baabtiisay Ciise Masiix dhexdiisa, lagu dhex baabtiisay dhimashadiisa?
english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaynu isaga kula aasannay baabtiiska dhimashada dhexdeeda, in, sidii Masiixa kuwii dhintay loogaga sara kiciyey ammaanta Aabbaha, aan innaguna sidaas oo kale cusaybka nolosha ku dhex soconno.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

kikuyu: Haddaynu isaga kula midownay dhimasho tiisa u eg, de sidaas oo kalena sarakicid tiisa u eg waynu kula midoobi doonnaa.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

kikuyu: Waynu og nahay in dabiicaddeennii hore iskutallaabta lagula qodbay isaga, in jidhka dembigu baabba'o, si aynaan mar dambe addoommo ugu ahaan dembiga.
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii dhintay dembi wuu ka xoroobay oo xaq baa laga dhigay.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddaynu Masiixa la dhimannay, waxaynu rumaysan nahay inaynu haddana isaga la noolaan doonno.
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

kikuyu: Waynu og nahay in Masiixa oo kuwii dhintay ka sara kacay uusan mar dambe dhimanayn; dhimashadu mar dambe u talin mayso.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

kikuyu: Waayo, dhimashaduu dhintay mar keliya ayuu xagga dembiga ka dhintay, laakiin noloshuu ku nool yahay, Ilaah buu u nool yahay.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena idinku isku tiriya inaad dembiga u tihiin kuwo dhintay, oo aad Ilaah u tihiin kuwo nool xagga Ciise Masiix.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed dembigu yuusan jidhkiinna dhimanaya u talin inaad damacyadiisa xunxun addeecdaan.
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

kikuyu: Xubnihiinnana dembiga ha u siinina sida qalabka xaqdarrada, laakiin Ilaah isa siiya sida idinkoo ah kuwo ka soo noolaaday kuwii dhintay, xubnihiinnana Ilaah u siiya sida qalabka xaqnimada.
english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

kikuyu: Waayo, dembigu idiinma talin doono, maxaa yeelay, sharciga kuma hoos jirtaan, laakiinse waxaad ku hoos jirtaan nimcada.
english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

kikuyu: Waa sidee haddaba? Sharciga kuma hoos jirno, oo waxaynu ku hoos jirnaa nimcada, sidaas daraaddeed miyaan dembaabnaa? Yaanay noqon!
english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

kikuyu: Ma waydaan ogayn inaad addoommo u tihiin kii aad isu siisaan sida addoommo addeeca, oo aad addoommadiisa tihiin kii aad addeecdaan, ama ha noqoto dembiga idiin kaxeeya xagga dhimashada ama addeecidda idiin kaxaysa xagga xaqnimada?
english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

kikuyu: Laakiinse mahad Ilaah baa leh, waayo, waxaad ahaan jirteen addoommadii dembiga, haatanse qalbigiinaad ka addeecdeen caynaddii waxbariddii laydin siiyey;
english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

kikuyu: oo idinkoo dembiga laydinka xoreeyey, xaqnimada ayaad addoommo u noqoteen.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

kikuyu: Sida dadkaan u hadlayaa jidhkiinna itaaldarradiisa aawadeed. Waayo, sidii aad xubnihiinna uga dhigi jirteen addoommadii wasakhnimada iyo dembiga inaad dembi fashaan, sidaas oo kalena haatan xubnihiinna ka dhiga addoommadii xaqnimada quduusnaanta aawadeed.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

kikuyu: Waayo, markaad addoommadii dembiga ahaan jirteen, xagga xaqnimada waxaad ahaydeen xor.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

kikuyu: Haddaba wakhtigaas maxaad midho ku haysateen waxyaalaha aad haatan ka xishoonaysaan? Waayo, waxyaalahaas ugu dambaystoodu waa dhimashada.
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

kikuyu: Laakiin haatan idinkoo dembi laydinka xoreeyey oo aad addoommadii Ilaah noqoteen, waxaad midho ku haysataan quduusnaanta, oo ugu dambaysteeduna waa nolosha weligeed ah.
english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

kikuyu: Waayo, mushahaarada dembigu waa dhimashada, laakiinse hadiyadda Ilaah waa nolosha weligeed ah ee laga helo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Mise ma waydaan ogayn, walaalayaalow, in sharcigu nin u taliyo intuu nool yahay oo keliya? (Waxaan la hadlayaa dadka sharciga yaqaan.)
english: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

kikuyu: Naagtii nin luhu sharcigay ugu xidhan tahay ninkeeda intuu nool yahay, laakiinse mar haddii ninku dhinto, way ka furan tahay sharcigii ninka.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed inta ninkeedu nool yahay, hadday nin kale naag u noqoto, waxaa loogu yeedhi doonaa dhillo, laakiinse ninkeedu hadduu dhinto, sharciga way ka furan tahay, oo sidaas daraaddeed dhillo ma aha in kastoo ay nin kale naag u noqoto.
english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, walaalahayow, jidhkii Masiixa baa meyd idinka dhigay xagga sharciga, in mid kale idin lahaado, oo ah kii kuwii dhintay laga sara kiciyey inaynu Ilaah midho u soo bixinno.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

kikuyu: Waayo, markii aynu jidhka ku dhex jirnay, damacyadii dembiyada ee sharciga ka yimid waxay ka dhex shaqaynayeen xubnaheenna inay midho u soo bixiyaan dhimasho.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan sharcigii waa laynaga furay, innagoo ka dhimannay wixii aynu ku hoos xidhnayn, si aynu ugu adeegno cusaybka ruuxa ee aynaan ugu adeegin gabowga qorniinka.
english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

kikuyu: Haddaba maxaynu nidhaahnaa? Sharcigu ma dembi baa? Ma suurtowdo! Hase ahaatee, dembi ma aanan garteen, sharcigaan ku gartay mooyaane, damaca xun ma aanan garteen haddaan sharcigu i odhan, Waa inaadan wax damcin.
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”

kikuyu: Dembigu, isagoo wakhti helay, ayuu amarka dhexdayda kaga falay damac xun oo kasta; waayo, sharciga la'aantiis dembigu waa meyd.
english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

kikuyu: Waa baan noolaa sharciga la'aantiis, laakiin markii amarku yimid, dembigu waa soo noolaaday, aniguna waan dhintay.
english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

kikuyu: Amarkii nolosha ii geeyn lahaa, waxaan gartay inuu dhimasho ii geeynayo.
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

kikuyu: Waayo, dembigu, isagoo wakhti helay, ayuu amarka igu khiyaaneeyey, wuuna igu dilay.
english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

kikuyu: Haddabase sharcigu waa quduus, amarkuna waa quduus, waana xaq, wuuna wanaagsan yahay.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

kikuyu: Haddaba wixii wanaagsanaa miyey dhimasho ii noqdeen? Ma suurtowdo! Laakiin dembigu, inuu muuqdo inuu dembi yahay, ayuu wax wanaagsan igaga dhex shaqeeyey oo dhimasho ii keenay, in dembigu amarka ku noqdo dembi miidhan.
english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaynu og nahay in sharcigu ku saabsan yahay ruuxa, laakiinse anigu waxaan ahay mid jidhka raaca oo lagu iibiyey dembiga hoostiisa.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan samaynayo garan maayo, maxaa yeelay, ma sameeyo wixii aan doonayo, laakiin waxaan sameeyaa wixii aan necbahay.
english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaan sameeyo waxa aanan doonayn, de markaas waxaan gartay in sharcigu wanaagsan yahay.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

kikuyu: Haddabase haatan ma aha aniga kan waxaas sameeyaa, laakiinse waa dembiga igu dhex jira.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

kikuyu: Waayo, waan ogahay inaan wax wanaagsanu igu dhex jirin, taas waxaan ula jeedaa, jidhkayga wax wanaagsanu kuma jiraan, waayo, waan ku talo jiraa inaan waxa wanaagsan sameeyo, laakiin ma sameeyo.
english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxa wanaagsan oo aan doonayo inaan falo, ma sameeyo, laakiinse waxa sharka ah oo aanan doonayn inaan falo, ayaan sameeyaa.
english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaan sameeyo wixii aanan doonayn inaan falo, de haatan ma aha aniga kan sameeyaa, laakiinse waa dembiga igu dhex jira.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

kikuyu: Haddee waxaan arkaa qaynuunka in shar ila jiro in kastoo aan doonayo inaan waxa wanaagsan sameeyo.
english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

kikuyu: Waayo, sharciga Ilaah ayaan kaga farxaa ninka gudaha ah.
english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan xubnahayga ka arkaa qaynuun kale, isagoo la dagaallamaya qaynuunka maankayga oo maxbuus iiga dhigaya qaynuunka dembiga oo xubnahayga ku jira.
english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

kikuyu: Nin belaysan baan ahay. Yaa iga furan doona jidhkan dhimashada leh?
english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

kikuyu: Waxaan Ilaah ugu mahadnaqayaa inuu Rabbigeen Ciise Masiix igu furan doono. Sidaas daraaddeed aniga qudhaydu waxaan maankayga ugu adeegaa sharciga Ilaah; laakiinse waxaan jidhka ugu adeegaa qaynuunka dembiga.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, kuwa Ciise Masiix ku dhex jiraa, haatan xukun ma laha.
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

kikuyu: Waayo, qaynuunka Ruuxa nolosha ee ku dhex jira Ciise Masiix ayaa iga xoreeyey qaynuunka dembiga iyo dhimashada.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

kikuyu: Waayo, wax aan sharcigu samayn karayn, maxaa yeelay, wuu itaaldarnaa jidhka aawadiis, ayaa Ilaah sameeyey isagoo Wiilkiisa ku soo diraya u-ekaantii jidhka dembiga leh oo u soo diraya dembiga aawadiis, wuxuuna xukumay dembigii jidhka ku jiray,
english: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

kikuyu: in qaynuunka sharcigu inagu buuxsamo kuweenna aan sida jidhka u socon, laakiinse u socda sida Ruuxa.
english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwa sida jidhka u socdaa, waxay ka fikiraan waxyaalaha jidhka, laakiinse kuwa sida Ruuxa u socdaa, waxay ka fikiraan waxyaalaha Ruuxa.
english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

kikuyu: Jidhka kafikiriddiisu waa dhimashada, laakiinse Ruuxa kafikiriddiisu waa nolosha iyo nabadda,
english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, jidhka kafikiriddiisu waa la col Ilaah, waayo, ma hoos gasho sharciga Ilaah, mana hoos geli karto.
english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

kikuyu: Kuwa jidhka ku dhex jiraana kama farxin karaan Ilaah.
english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

kikuyu: Laakiin idinku kuma aad dhex jirtaan jidhka, illowse waxaad ku dhex jirtaan Ruuxa, haddii Ruuxa Ilaah idinku dhex jiro. Laakiin nin hadduusan Ruuxa Masiixa lahayn, de kaasu kiisii ma aha.
english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

kikuyu: Oo haddii Masiixu idinku dhex jiro, jidhku waa meyd dembiga aawadiis; laakiinse ruuxu waa nolosha xaqnimada aawadeed.
english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii Ruuxii kii Ciise kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey idinku dhex jiro, kii Ciise Masiix kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey, jidhkiinna dhimanayana wuxuu ku noolayn doonaa Ruuxiisa idinku dhex jira.
english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, walaalayaalow, wax baa inagu waajib ah, laakiin waajib inooguma aha jidhka, inaynu u noolaanno sida jidhka,
english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

kikuyu: waayo, haddaad sida jidhka u noolaataan, hubaal waad dhiman doontaan, laakiin haddaad falimaha jidhka Ruuxa ku dishaan, waad noolaan doontaan.
english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

kikuyu: In alla intii Ruuxa Ilaah hoggaamiyo, waa carruurta Ilaah.
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, ma aydnaan helin ruuxa addoonnimada inaad mar kale cabsataan, laakiinse waxaad hesheen Ruuxa carruur idinka dhigay, kan aynu ku qaylinno Aabbow.
english: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

kikuyu: Ruuxa qudhiisu wuu markhaati furaa oo wuxuu ruuxeenna u sheegaa inaynu innagu nahay carruurta Ilaah.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

kikuyu: Oo haddaynu carruur nahay, de haddaba waxaynu nahay kuwo wax dhaxla, kuwo Ilaah dhaxla oo Masiix wax la dhaxla, haddii aynu isaga la xanuunsanno, in laynala ammaano isaga.
english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku tirinayaa in waxyaalaha wakhtigan la joogo lagu xanuunsadaa ayan istaahilin in lala simo ammaanta iman doonta oo laynoo muujin doono.
english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

kikuyu: Uunku wuxuu filasho aad u weyn ku sugaa muujinta carruurta Ilaah.
english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

kikuyu: Uunkii waxaa la hoos geliyey wax aan waxtar lahayn, ikhtiyaarkiisna uma uu hoos gelin, laakiin waa kii hoos geliyey aawadiis,
english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

kikuyu: taasoo la rajaynayo in uunka qudhiisana laga xorayn doono addoonnimada qudhunka ah oo la gelin doono xorriyadda ammaanta carruurta Ilaah.
english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaynu og nahay in uunka oo dhammu wada taahayo oo wada foolanayo ilaa haatan.
english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

kikuyu: Iyagoo keliya ma aha, laakiin innagana waa sidaas oo kale, kuweenna haysta midhihii ugu horreeyey ee Ruuxa, xataa innaga qudheennu dhexdeenna ayaynu ka taahnaa, innagoo sugayna carruurnoqoshadeenna, taasu waxaa weeyaan samatabbixinta jidhkeenna.
english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaynu ku badbaadnay rajo, laakiin rajadii la arko rajo ma aha, maxaa yeelay, waa ayo kan rajeeyaa wuxuu arko?
english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaynu rajayno wax aynaan arkin, de haddaba dulqaadasho ayaynu ku sugnaa.
english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

kikuyu: Sidaasoo kalena Ruuxu wuxuu inaga caawimaa itaaldarradeenna, waayo, garan mayno wax inoo eg oo aynu ku tukanno, laakiin Ruuxa qudhiisu waa inoo duceeyaa isagoo ku taahaya taah aan sanqadhayn.
english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

kikuyu: Oo kii qalbiyada baadhaa waa yaqaan fikirka Ruuxa, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu quduusiinta ugu duceeyaa sida Ilaah doonayo.
english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

kikuyu: Oo waxaynu og nahay in wax waliba wanaag ugu wada shaqeeyaan kuwa Ilaah jecel, xataa kuwa qasdigiisa loogu yeedhay.
english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwuu hore u yiqiin wuxuu haddana hore ugu doortay inay u ekaadaan suuradda Wiilkiisa, inuu isagu curad ku noqdo walaalo badan dhexdood.
english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

kikuyu: Oo kuwuu hore u doortayna, haddana wuu u yeedhay, kuwuu u yeedhayna, haddana xaq buu ka dhigay, kuwuu xaq ka dhigayna, haddana wuu ammaanay.
english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

kikuyu: Haddaba maxaan waxyaalahan ka nidhaahnaa? Haddii Ilaah inala gees yahay, yaa inaga gees ah?
english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

kikuyu: Kii aan xataa Wiilkiisa lexejeclaysan, laakiinse innaga dhammaanteen u bixiyey, sidee buusan wax walbana inoola siin doonin isaga?
english: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

kikuyu: Yaa ashtakayn doona kuwa Ilaah doortay? Waa Ilaah kan wax xaq ka dhigaa.
english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

kikuyu: Waa ayo kan wax xukumi doonaa? Waa Ciise Masiix kii dhintay, oo haddana kuwii dhintay ka sara kacay, oo Ilaah midigtiisa jooga, oo haddana inoo duceeya innaga.
english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

kikuyu: Yaa jacaylka Masiixa inaga sooci doona? Ma dhibaato, mise cidhiidhi, mise silic, mise baahi, mise arrad, mise khatar, mise seef?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

kikuyu: Sida qoran, Adiga daraaddaa ayaa lanoo laayaa maalinta oo dhan, Waxaa lanoo tiriyey sida ido la qalayo.
english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

kikuyu: Maya, waxyaalahan oo dhan dhexdooda aad baynu ugu guulaysannaa kii ina jeclaa xaggiisa.
english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan hubaa inaan dhimashada, ama nolosha, ama malaa'igaha, ama kuwa madaxda ah, ama waxyaalaha haatan jooga, ama waxyaalaha iman doona, ama kuwa xoogga leh,
english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

kikuyu: ama kor, ama hoos, ama uun kaleeto inaga sooci karin jacaylka Ilaah oo ku jira Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Runtaan ku sheegayaa Masiixa, oo been sheegi maayo, qalbigayguna marag buu iigu furayaa Ruuxa Quduuskaa
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

kikuyu: in caloolxumo weyn iyo xanuun aan joogsanaynin ay ku jiraan qalbigayga.
english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan aniga qudhaydu ka inkaarnaado Masiixa walaalahay aawadood oo ah xigaalkayga aannu isku jidhka nahay,
english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

kikuyu: kuwa ah reer binu Israa'iil, oo leh carruur-ka-dhigidda, iyo ammaanta, iyo axdiyada, iyo sharciga siintiisa, iyo u-adeegidda Ilaah, iyo ballamada,
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

kikuyu: kuwa awowayaasha leh, oo xagga jidhka Masiixu ka yimid iyaga, kan wax walba ka sarreeya oo ah Ilaah ammaanta leh weligiis. Aamiin.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Laakiin mana aha sidii iyadoo ereygii Ilaah dhacay. Waayo, kuwa Israa'iil ka dhashay kulligood reer binu Israa'iil ma wada aha.
english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

kikuyu: Farcankii Ibraahim oo ay yihiin aawadeed kulligood carruur kuma wada aha, laakiin waxaa la yidhi, Kuwa Isxaaq ka farcama ayaa farcankaaga loogu yeedhi doonaa.
english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

kikuyu: Taas waxaa weeyaan, inaan carruurta jidhku ahayn carruurta Ilaah, laakiin carruurtii loo ballanqaaday ayaa farcan lagu tiriyaa.
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

kikuyu: Waayo, kanu waa hadal ballan ah, Wakhtigan oo kale ayaan kuu iman doonaa, oo Saarah waxay dhali doontaa wiil.
english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

kikuyu: Oo taas oo keliyana ma ahee, laakiin Rebeqahna mid bay u uuraysatay, kaas oo ahaa aabbeheen Isxaaq.
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

kikuyu: Waayo, carruurta oo aan weli dhalan oo aan weli samayn wanaag iyo xumaan midna, in qasdiga Ilaah doorashada ku istaago, oo uusan ahaan xagga shuqullada, laakiin xagga kii dadka u yeedha,
english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

kikuyu: waxaa iyada lagu yidhi, Kan weynu wuxuu u adeegi doonaa kan ka yar.
english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

kikuyu: Sida qoran, Yacquub waan jeclaaday, Ceesawse waan necbaaday.
english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

kikuyu: Maxaan nidhaahnaa haddaba? Ma xaqdarro baa Ilaah la jirta? Ma suurtowdo!
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu Muuse ku yidhi, Waan u naxariisan doonaa kii aan u naxariisto, waanan u nixi doonaa, kii aan u naxo.
english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed xagga kan doonaya ma aha, xagga kan ordana ma aha, laakiinse waa xagga Ilaaha naxariista leh.
english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

kikuyu: Waayo, Qorniinku wuxuu Fircoon ku leeyahay, Tan daraaddeed baan kuu sara kiciyey inaan xooggayga adiga kaa dhex muujiyo iyo in magacayga dhulka oo dhan lagu faafiyo.
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

kikuyu: Haddaba kuu doonayo wuu u naxariistaa, kuu doonayona qalbigiisuu engejiyaa.
english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

kikuyu: Waxaad igu odhan doontaa, Muxuu weli ii eedaynayaa? Waayo, yaa doonistiisa ka gees noqda?
english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

kikuyu: Laakiinse, nin yahow, kumaad tahay kaaga Ilaah u jawaabayow? Wixii la sameeyey miyey kii sameeyey ku odhan doonaan, Maaxad sidan noogu samaysay?
english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

kikuyu: Dheriyasameeyuhu miyuusan lahayn amar uu ugu taliyo dhoobada inuu fud keliya in ka sameeyo weel cisa leh, inta kalena mid aan cisa lahayn?
english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

kikuyu: Bal maxay la tahay Ilaah haddii, isagoo doonaya inuu cadhadiisa muujiyo oo xooggiisa dadka ogeysiiyo, uu samir badan ugu dulqaatay weelasha cadhada oo loo diyaariyey baabbi'idda,
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

kikuyu: iyo inuu hodantinimadii ammaantiisa ogeysiiyo weelasha naxariista oo uu hore ugu diyaariyey ammaanta,
english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

kikuyu: xataa kuweenna uu u yeedhay oo uusan uga yeedhin Yuhuudda oo keliya laakiinse uu uga yeedhay quruumaha kalena?
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

kikuyu: Siduu Hooseeca ka dhex yidhi, Kuwo aan dadkaygii ahayn ayaan u bixin doonaa, Dadkayga, Tu aan ahayn gacalisadaydiina waxaan u bixin doonaa, Gacaliso.
english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

kikuyu: Oo waxay noqon doontaa, meeshii laga yidhi iyaga, Dadkayga ma ihidin, Meeshaas waxaa looga bixin doonaa, Carruurtii Ilaaha nool.
english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

kikuyu: Oo Isayos wuxuu ku qayliyey wax Israa'iil ku saabsan isagoo leh, In kastoo tirada reer binu Israa'iil noqoto sida cammuudda badda, intii hadhay waa badbaadi doontaa,
english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

kikuyu: waayo, Rabbigu hadalkiisa dhulkuu ku samayn doonaa, isagoo dhammaystiraya oo soo gaabinaya,
english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

kikuyu: oo sidii Isayos hore u yidhi, Haddaan Rabbigii Saba'ood farcan inoo reebin, Sidii Sodom baan noqon lahayn, oo sidii Gomora baa laynaga dhigi lahaa.
english: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

kikuyu: Maxaan nidhaahnaa haddaba? Dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn oo aan xaqnimada raacin, waxay heleen xaqnimada, oo ah xaqnimada rumaysad lagu helo;
english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
