kikuyu: laakiin reer binu Israa'iil iyagoo raaca sharciga xaqnimada, sharcigaas ma ay gaadhin.
english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

kikuyu: Tan sababteedu waa maxay? Maxaa yeelay, rumaysad kuma ay doondoonin, shuqullada samayntooda mooyaane. Waxay ku turunturoodeen dhagaxii turunturada;
english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

kikuyu: sida qoran, Bal eega, waxaan Siyoon dhex dhigayaa dhagax lagu turunturoodo oo ah sallax lagu xumaado; Oo kii rumaysta isaga ma ceeboobi doono.
english: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waxaan qalbigayga ka doonayaa oo Ilaah ka baryaa inay iyagu badbaadaan.
english: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan markhaati u furayaa inay iyagu Ilaah qiiro weyn u qabaan, laakiinse xagga aqoonta ma aha.
english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagoo aan ogayn xaqnimada Ilaah oo doonaya inay taagaan tooda, ayayan hoos gelin Ilaah xaqnimadiisa.
english: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, Masiixu wuxuu mid kasta oo rumaysta u yahay sharciga dhammaadkiisii xagga xaqnimada.
english: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

kikuyu: Waayo, Muuse wuxuu qoray in ninkii yeelaa xaqnimada sharciga uu ku noolaan doono iyada.
english: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

kikuyu: Laakiin xaqnimada rumaysadku sidanay tidhaahdaa, Qalbigaaga ha iska odhan, Yaa samada kori doona (inuu Masiix soo dejiyo)?
english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);

kikuyu: Ama, Yaa yamayska hoos u geli doona (inuu Masiix kuwa dhintay ka soo sara kiciyo)?
english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

kikuyu: Laakiin maxay leedahay? Eraygii waa kuu dhow yahay, waana ku jiraa afkaaga iyo qalbigaaga, waxaa weeyaan erayga rumaysadka oo aannu kugu wacdinno.
english: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, haddaad afka ka qiratid in Ciise yahay Rabbiga, oo aad qalbiga ka rumaysatid in Ilaah isaga ka sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay, waad badbaadi doontaa,
english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

kikuyu: waayo, qalbiga wax baa laga rumaystaa xagga xaqnimada, afkana wax baa laga qirtaa xagga badbaadinta.
english: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

kikuyu: Waayo, Qorniinku wuxuu leeyahay, Ku alla kii rumaysta isaga, ceeboobi maayo.
english: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Yuhuudda iyo Gariigtu waxba kuma kala duwana, waayo, isku Rabbi baa Rabbi u wada ah, waana u taajir in alla intii barida isaga.
english: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

kikuyu: Waayo, ku alla kii magaca Rabbiga ku baryaa, waa badbaadi doonaa.
english: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidee bay ugu baryi doonaan kan aanay rumaysnayn? Oo sidee bay u rumaysan doonaan kan aanay maqlin? Oo sidee bay u maqli doonaan haddii aan la wacdiyin?
english: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

kikuyu: Oo sidee bay u wacdiyi doonaan haddaan la dirin? sida qoran, Qurux badanaa cagaha kuwa wax ku wacdiya waxyaalaha wanaagsan.
english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”

kikuyu: Laakiin kulligood ma ay wada dhegaysan injiilka. Waayo, Isayos wuxuu leeyahay, Rabbow, yaa rumaystay warkayagii?
english: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”

kikuyu: Haddaba rumaysadku wuxuu ka yimaadaa maqlidda, maqlidduna waxay ku timaadaa ereyga Masiixa.
english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan leeyahay, Miyaanay maqlin? Haah, runtii. Codkoodii wuxuu gaadhay dhulka oo dhan, Hadalkoodiina wuxuu gaadhay dunida meesha ugu shishaysa.
english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan leeyahay, Miyaan reer binu Israa'iil ogayn? Ugu horraystii Muuse wuxuu yidhi, Waxaan idinkaga hinaasin doonaa kuwo aan quruun ahayn; Quruun aan wax garanayn waan idinkaga cadhaysiin doonaa.
english: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”

kikuyu: Isayosna waa dhiirranaa oo wuxuu yidhi, Waxaa i helay kuwo aan i doonayn, Waxaan u muuqday kuwo aan wax i weyddiinayn.
english: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”

kikuyu: Laakiin reer binu Israa'iil wuxuu ku yidhi, Maalintii oo dhan waxaan gacmahayga u kala bixinayay dad caasi ah oo muran miidhan ah.
english: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”

kikuyu: De waxaan leeyahay, Ilaah miyuu xooray dadkiisii? Ma suurtowdo. Waayo, anba waxaan ahay mid reer binu Israa'iil ah, oo farcankii Ibraahim ah, oo qabiilkii Benyaamiin ah.
english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Ilaah dadkiisii uu hore u yiqiin ma xoorin. Mise ma waydaan aqoon waxa Qorniinku ka sheegayo Eliyaas? siduu Ilaah ugu cawday isagoo reer binu Israa'iil ka cabanaya oo leh,
english: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

kikuyu: Rabbow, nebiyadaadii way dileen, meelahaagii allabarigana way dumiyeen, oo keligay baa hadhay, oo naftayday doondoonayaan.
english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”

kikuyu: Laakiinse jawaabtii Ilaah oo u timid isaga maxay leedahay? Waxaan nafahaantayda ula hadhay toddoba kun oo nin oo aan Bacal u jilba joogsan.
english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale wakhtigan la joogona waxaa jira kuwo hadhay oo nimco lagu doortay.
english: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii nimco lagu doortay, de haddaba ma aha mar dambe xagga shuqullada, haddii kalese nimcadu mar dambe nimco ma aha.
english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

kikuyu: Waa maxay haddaba? Wixii reer binu Israa'iil doondoonayeen ma ay helin, laakiinse kuwii la doortay waa heleen, intii kalena waa la engejiyey,
english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

kikuyu: sida qoran, Ilaah wuxuu iyaga siiyey maskax hurudda, iyo indho aanay waxba ku arkin, iyo dhego aanay waxba ku maqlin, ilaa maalintatan.
english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

kikuyu: Daa'uudna wuxuu yidhi, Miiskoodu ha u noqdo dabin iyo wax qabsada iyaga, Iyo wax ay ku turunturoodaan, iyo wax ka aarguta iyaga;
english: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

kikuyu: Indhahoodu ha madoobaadeen si aanay waxba u arkin, Dhabarkoodana foorari weligiis.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan leeyahay, Miyey turunturoodeen inay dhacaan? Maya, ma suurtowdo! Laakiin dhicitinkoodii aawadiis ayaa badbaadinu ugu timid quruumaha kale inay ka hinaasaan.
english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii dhicitinkoodii yahay taajirnimadii dunida, liidnaantoodiina tahay taajirnimadii quruumaha kale, de buuxnaantooduna intee bay sii badin doontaa taajirnimadii?
english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan la hadlayaa kuwiinnan oo ka mid ah dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn. Haddaba anigoo ah rasuulkii dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn, hawshayda waan derejeeyaa,
english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

kikuyu: si aan uga hinaasiyo kuwa aan isku jidhka nahay oo aan qaarkood badbaadiyo.
english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii xooriddoodu tahay maslaxadda dunida, aqbaliddoodii maxay noqon doontaa, soo noolaadka kuwii dhintay mooyaane?
english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

kikuyu: Inta ugu horraysa oo cajiinku hadday quduus tahay, de cajiinkuna wuu yahay, haddii xididku quduus yahayna, de laamahuna way yihiin.
english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii laamihii qaarkood laga jebiyey, oo adigoo saytuundibadeed ah lagugu tallaalo meeshoodii, oo aad ka qayb gasho wanaagga xididka geedka saytuunka ah,
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

kikuyu: ha ka faanin laamaha, laakiinse haddii aad faantid, bal ogow inaadan ahayn kan xididka sida, laakiinse xididkaa adiga ku sida.
english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaad odhan doontaa, Laamihii waxaa loo jebiyey in aniga laygu tallaalo meeshoodii.
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

kikuyu: Waa tahay. Rumaysaddarradoodii baa loo jebiyey, adna waxaad ku taagan tahay rumaysadkaaga. Ha iskibrin, laakiinse cabso;
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

kikuyu: waayo, haddaan Ilaah u tudhin laamihii asliga ahaa, de adna kuu tudhi maayo.
english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

kikuyu: Bal hadda fiiri roonaanta iyo adkaanta Ilaah; kuwii dhacay xaggooda adkaantiisaa la jirta, laakiinse xaggaaga waxaa la jirta roonaanta Ilaah, haddaad roonaantiisa ku sii socotid, haddii kaleeto adna waa lagu gooyn doonaa.
english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

kikuyu: Iyagana haddayan rumaysaddarradoodii ku sii socon, waa lagu tallaali doonaa meeshoodii, waayo, Ilaah waa awoodaa inuu iyaga mar kale ku tallaalo meeshoodii.
english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii adiga lagaa soo gooyay saytuun dibadeed oo si aburiddiisa ka gees ah laguugu tallaalay geed saytuun wanaagsan ah, intee baa in ka sii badan kuwan oo ah laamihii asliga ahaa loogu tallaali doonaa geedkoodii saytuunka ahaa?
english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, anigu dooni maayo, inaad jaahil ka ahaataan qarsoodigan, waabase intaas ood iskibrisaan. Adkaan aan dhammayn baa ku dhacday reer binu Israa'iil ilaa tirada buuxda oo quruumuhu soo gasho;
english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

kikuyu: oo sidaasay reer binu Israa'iil oo dhammu u wada badbaadi doonaan, sida qoran, Waxaa Siyoon ka soo bixi doona Bixiyaha. Wuxuu Yacquub ka sii jeedin doonaa cibaadola'aanta.
english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

kikuyu: Oo kanu waa axdigayga aan la dhigan doono iyaga, Markaan dembigooda ka qaadi doono.
english: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”

kikuyu: Xagga injiilka iyagu waa cadaawayaal aawadiin, laakiinse xagga doorashada waa kuwo la jecel yahay awowayaasha aawadood.
english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

kikuyu: Waayo, hadiyadaha iyo yeedhidda Ilaah ka soo noqosho ma leh.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

kikuyu: Waayo, idinkuba mar baad Ilaah caasi ku ahaydeen, laakiinse haatan waxaa laydiinku naxariistay kuwaas caasinimadooda,
english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

kikuyu: sidaas oo kalay iyaguna haatan caasi u noqdeen, in naxariistii laydin tusay, iyagana haatan loogu naxariisto.
english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah kulli wuxuu ku wada xidhay caasinimo inuu u wada naxariisto kulli.
english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

kikuyu: Mool dheeraa hodantinimada iyo xigmadda iyo aqoonta Ilaah! Xukummadiisa lama baadhi karo, jidadkiisana lama raadin karo!
english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

kikuyu: Waayo, bal yaa soo ogaaday maanka Rabbiga? Bal yaase lataliyihiisii noqday?
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

kikuyu: Yaase awil wax siiyey oo loo abaalgudi doonaa?
english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

kikuyu: Waayo, wax waluba isagay ka yimaadeen oo ku yimaadeen oo u yimaadeen aawadiis. Ammaanta isagaa leh weligiis. Aamiin.
english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

kikuyu: Haddaba, walaalayaalow, waxaan idinku baryayaa Ilaah naxariistiisa inaad jidhkiinna Ilaah u siisaan sida allabari nool oo quduus ah oo Ilaah ku farxo, waana cibaadaysigiinna caqliga leh.
english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

kikuyu: Ha u ekaanina dadka ifkan, laakiinse ku beddelma cusboonaanta maankiinna inaad hubsataan waxa ay tahay doonista Ilaah oo wanaagsan oo isagu ku farxo oo kaamilka ah.
english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, nimcadii lay siiyey ayaan ku hadlayaa, waxaan ku leeyahay, Mid kasta oo idinka mid ah, yuusan isderejayn intuu isderejayn lahaa in ka badan, laakiinse miyirqab ha ku fikiro, sida Ilaah mid kasta u siiyey qayb rumaysad ah.
english: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida aynu xubno badan ugu leennahay jidhkeenna, oo aan xubnaha oo dhammuna isku shuqul u ahayn,
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

kikuyu: sidaas oo kalaan, innagoo badan, Masiixa isku jidh ku nahay, oo midba midka kale waa xubnihiisii.
english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

kikuyu: Innagoo haysanna hadiyado ku kala duwan nimcadii layna siiyey, hadday tahay wax sii sheegid, aan wax ku sii sheegno sida qaybta rumaysadkeenna.
english: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

kikuyu: Ama hadday tahay adeegid, aan aad u adeegno; kii wax baraana, si fiican wax ha u baro;
english: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

kikuyu: kii wax waaniyaana, si fiican wax ha u waaniyo; kii wax bixiyaana, deeqsinimo wax ha u bixiyo; kii wax u taliyaana, dadaal wax ha ugu taliyo; kii wax u naxariistaana, farxad wax ha ugu naxariisto.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

kikuyu: Jacaylku ha noqdo mid aan labaweji lahayn, sharka karha, wanaagga xagsada.
english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

kikuyu: Kalgacayl walaalnimo isku wada jeclaada, midkiinba midka kale ha hor derejeeyo.
english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

kikuyu: Dadaalka ha ka caajisina, ruuxa ku kululaada, oo Rabbiga u adeega.
english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

kikuyu: Rajada ku farxa, dhibta u dulqaata, tukashada wadiddeeda ku sii adkaysta,
english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

kikuyu: oo ku caawiya waxa quduusiintu u baahan yihiin, oo shisheeyaha martiggeliya.
english: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

kikuyu: U duceeya kuwa idin silciya, u duceeya, oo ha habaarina.
english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

kikuyu: La farxa kuwa farxaya, la ooya kuwa ooyaya.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

kikuyu: Midba midka kale ha la fikir ahaado, ha kibrina, laakiin kuwa hoose la socda. Kuwo isla caqli badan ha noqonina.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

kikuyu: Ninna shar shar ha uga celinina. Ka fikira inaad samaysaan waxa wanaagsan dadka oo dhan hortiisa.
english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

kikuyu: Hadday suurtowdo, intaad kartaan, nabad kula jooga dadka oo dhan.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, ha aarsanina, laakiin meel u banneeya cadhada Ilaah, waayo, waxaa qoran, Aarsasho anigaa leh; anaa u abaalmarin, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii cadowgaagu gaajaysan yahay, cunto sii; hadduu harraadsan yahayna, waraabi, waayo, haddaad saas samayso waxaad madaxiisa ku kor ururin doontaa duxulo dab ah.
english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

kikuyu: Sharku yuusan kaa adkaan, laakiinse sharka wanaag kaga adkow.
english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

kikuyu: Naf waluba ha ka dambayso kuwa amarka sare leh, waayo, amar ma jiro kan Ilaah ka yimaada mooyaane. Kuwa jirana Ilaah baa ka dhigay kuwa amar leh.
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kii diida kan amarka leh wuxuu hor joogsadaa amarka Ilaah, kuwa hor joogsadaana waxay nafahaantooda u heli doonaan xukun.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

kikuyu: Madaxdu cabsi ma geliyaan kuwa shuqul wanaagsan sameeya, kuwa xumaan sameeya mooyaane. Ma waxaad doonaysaa inaadan ka cabsan kan amarka leh? Wax wanaagsan samee, oo ammaan baad ka helaysaa isla isaga.
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu xaggaaga ku yahay midiidinka Ilaah inuu wanaag kuu sameeyo. Laakiinse haddaad xumaan samaysid, cabso, waayo, isagu seefta uma sito sababla'aan. Maxaa yeelay, isagu waa midiidinka Ilaah, oo waa mid cadho kaga aarsada kii xumaan sameeya.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waa in laga dambeeyo kan amarka leh, mana aha cadhada aawadeed oo keliya, laakiinse waa niyadda aawadeedna.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

kikuyu: Waayo, sababtaas aawadeed waxaad u bixisaan cashuur, maxaa yeelay, iyagu waa midiidinnadii Ilaah oo had iyo goor ka shaqeeya isla waxaas.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

kikuyu: Mid waluba wuxuu idinku leeyahay siiya, kii baad idinku leh, baad siiya, kii cashuur idinku leh, cashuur siiya, kii laga cabsadana, ka cabsada, kii ciso lehna, ciseeya.
english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

kikuyu: Ninna yuusan wax idinku lahaan in midkiinba midka kale jeclaado mooyaane. Waayo, kii deriskiisa jeclaadaa sharciguu oofiyey.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

kikuyu: Waayo, amarradan la yidhi, Waa inaanad sinaysan, Waa inaanad qudh gooyn, Waa inaanad waxba xadin, Waa inaanad wax damcin, oo haddii amar kale jirana, waxaa lagu soo koobay hadalkan, Waa inaad deriskaaga u jeclaataa sida naftaada.
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Jacaylku xumaan kuma sameeyo deriskiisa; jacaylku haddaba waa oofinta sharciga.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waad garanaysaan wakhtiga inay haatan tahay saacaddii aad hurdada ka toosi lahaydeen, waayo, haatan ay badbaadintu inooga dhow dahay markii horoo aan rumaysannay.
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

kikuyu: Habeenkii hore buu u batay, maalintiina waa soo dhowaatay, sidaas daraaddeed aan iska dhigno shuqullada gudcurka oo aan qaadanno hubka iftiinka.
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

kikuyu: Sida iyadoo maalin ah aynu si qumman u soconno, yeynan ku socon rabshad iyo sakhraannimo, yeynan ku socon galmo iyo dhillanimo, yeynan ku socon ilaaq iyo hinaaso.
english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

kikuyu: Laakiin Rabbi Ciise Masiix huwada, oo jidhka ha ka fikirina inaad damacyadiisa samaysaan.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

kikuyu: Kii rumaysadka ku itaal yar soo dhoweeya, mana aha inaad ra'ayiyadiisa la murantaan.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

kikuyu: Mid baa rumaysan inuu wax walba cuno, kii itaal yarse wuxuu cunaa khodaarta.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

kikuyu: Kii cunaa yuusan quudhsanin kii aan cunin, kii aan cuninna yuusan xukumin kii cuna, waayo, Ilaah baa aqbalay isaga.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

kikuyu: Yaad tahay kaaga xukuma midiidinka mid kaleto? Waayo, sayidkiisuu u taagan yahay ama u dhacaa. Waana la taagi doonaa, waayo, Rabbigu waa awoodaa inuu taago.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

kikuyu: Nin bay la tahay in maalinu maalinta kale ka fiican tahay, mid kalena waxay la tahay in maalmaha oo dhammu isku mid yihiin. Mid kastaaba maankiisa aad ha ugu hubsado.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

kikuyu: Kii maalinta ka fikiraa, Rabbiguu uga fikiraa, kii wax cunaa, Rabbiguu u cunaa, waayo, Ilaah buu ku mahadnaqaa; kii aan wax cuninuna, Rabbiga ayuusan u cunin, oo Ilaah buu ku mahadnaqaa.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

kikuyu: Midkeenna naftiisa uma noola, midkeenna naftiisa uma dhinto.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii aynu nool nahay, Rabbigaynu u nool nahay; oo haddii aynu dhimannona, Rabbigaynu u dhimannaa, sidaas daraaddeed haddii aynu nool nahay iyo haddii aynu dhimannoba, Rabbigaa ina leh.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

kikuyu: Waayo, sababtaasaa Masiixu u dhintay, una soo noolaaday inuu Rabbi u noqdo kuwii dhintay iyo kuwa noolba.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

kikuyu: Adigu maxaad walaalkaa u xukuntaa? amase adigu maxaad walaalkaa u quudhsataa? Waayo, kulligeen waxaynu hor istaagi doonnaa kursiga xukumaadda Ilaah.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa qoran, Anigu waa noolahay, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay, oo jilib waluba anuu ii sujuudi doonaa, Carrab walubana Ilaah buu qiri doonaa.
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

kikuyu: Sidaasaa midkeen kastaba Ilaah ula xisaabtami doonaa.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed mar dambe yeynan isxukumin, laakiinse tan ka fikira inaan ninna walaalkiis u dhigin dhagax uu ku turunturoodo ama wax kaleeto oo hor joogsada.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

kikuyu: Waan ogahay, waanan ku hubaa Rabbi Ciise, inaan waxba nafahaantiisa iska xaaraan ahayn, laakiinse kii ku tiriya inay xaaraan tahay, kaas waa ka xaaraan.
english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii walaalkaa cuntadaada ka calool xumaado, jacaylka kuma sii socotid. Cuntadaada ha ku baabbi'in kii Masiixu u dhintay.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

kikuyu: Haddaba wanaaggiinna yaan la caayin.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

kikuyu: Waayo, boqortooyada Ilaah ma aha cunid iyo cabbid, laakiinse waa xaqnimada iyo nabadda iyo farxadda ku jira Ruuxa Quduuskaa.
english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Kii waxaas Masiixa ugu adeega, Ilaah buu ka farxiyaa, xagga dadkana waa mid loo bogay.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed haddaba aynu raacno waxyaalaha nabadda iyo waxyaalaha midkeenba midka kale xoog ugu yeelo.
english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

kikuyu: Shuqulka Ilaah ha u dumin cunto aawadeed. Hubaal wax waluba waa nadiif, laakiin waa u xun tahay kii cuna isagoo mid kale xumaynayo.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

kikuyu: Waa wanaagsan tahay inaadan hilib cunin ama khamri cabbin ama samayn wax kaleto oo walaalkaa ku turunturoodo.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

kikuyu: Rumaysadka aad leedahay, Ilaah hortiis u hayso. Waxaa faraxsan kii aan isku xukumin wixii la qumman isaga.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kii shakiya, hadduu cuno, waa xukuman yahay, maxaa yeelay, rumaysad wax kuma cuno, oo wax kastoo aan rumaysadka ka imaninu waa dembi.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

kikuyu: Kuweenna xoogga leh waxaa inagu waajib ah inaynu qaadno itaaldarrada kuwa xoogga yar, oo aynaan nafteenna ka farxin.
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

kikuyu: Midkeen kastaaba deriskiisa ha ka farxiyo inuu ku wanaagsanaado oo ku dhismo.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

kikuyu: Waayo, Masiixiiba naftiisii kama uu farxin, laakiinse sida qoran, Caydii kuwii adiga ku caayay ayaa igu kor dhacday.
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

kikuyu: Waayo, wax alla wixii hore loo qorayba waxaa loo qoray waxbarashadeenna, inaynu dulqaadashada iyo gargaarka Qorniinka rajo ku lahaanno.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

kikuyu: Ilaaha dulqaadashada iyo gargaariddu ha ka dhigo in midkiinba midka kale la fikir ahaado sida Ciise Masiix,
english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: inaad isku qalbi iyo isku af ku ammaantaan Ilaaha ah Aabbaha Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed isdhoweeya sida Masiixuna idiin dhoweeyey in Ilaah la ammaano.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Masiixu wuxuu noqday kuwa gudan midiidinkooda, runta Ilaah aawadeed, inuu u xaqiijiyo ballamadii awowayaashii hore la siiyey,
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

kikuyu: iyo in quruumuhu Ilaah u ammaanaan naxariistiisa, sida qoran, Sidaas daraaddeed waxaan kugu ammaani doonaa quruumaha dhexdooda, Oo magacaaga waan u gabyi doonaa.
english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana wuxuu leeyahay, Quruumahow, la reyreeya dadkiisa.
english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana, Rabbiga ammaana, quruumahoo dhammow, Dadkoo dhammuna ha ammaano isaga.
english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana Isayos wuxuu leeyahay, Waxaa jiri doona xididkii Yesay, Iyo kan u kacaya inuu u taliyo quruumaha, Isagayna quruumuhu wax ku rajayn doonaan.
english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

kikuyu: Ilaaha rajadu ha idinka buuxiyo farxad iyo nabad oo dhan, idinkoo rumaysan, si rajadiinnu ugu badato xoogga Ruuxa Quduuskaa.
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Oo aniga qudhayduna waxaan idiin hubaa, walaalahayow, inuu wanaag idinka buuxo, oo laydinka buuxiyey aqoon oo dhan, oo aad kartaan inaad iswaanisaan.
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

kikuyu: Laakiinse siyaalaha qaarkood dhiirranaan badan baan idiinku soo qoray inaan idin xusuusiyo, nimcadii xagga Ilaah layga siiyey aawadeed,
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

kikuyu: inaan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn u noqdo midiidinkii Ciise Masiix, anigoo shuqulka wadaadnimada u qabanaya injiilka Ilaah, in sadaqada dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn la aqbalo, iyadoo quduus lagaga dhigay Ruuxa Quduuskaa.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Haddaba xagga Ciise Masiix waxaan leeyahay wax aan ku faano, waana wax ku saabsan Ilaah.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuma dhici doono inaan waxba ka hadlo wixii Masiixii iga dhex shaqeeyey mooyaane, dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn addeeciddooda aawadeed, oo uu igaga dhex shaqeeyey hadal iyo camal,
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

kikuyu: oo uu ku sameeyey xoogga calaamooyinka iyo yaababka, iyo xoogga Ruuxa Quduuskaa, oo sidaasaan injiilka Masiixa ugu wada wacdiyey Yeruusaalem iyo hareeraheeda iyo ilaa Illurikon.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

kikuyu: Sidaasaan u hawaystay inaan injiilka ku wacdiyo meel aan Masiixa awil lagu magacaabin, si aanan ugu dul dhisin aasaaska nin kale dhigay.
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

kikuyu: Laakiinse, sida qoran, Waxaa arki doona kuwo aan warkiisu u iman, Kuwii aan maqlinuna waa garan doonaan.
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed marar badan baa layga hor joogsaday imaatinkii aan idiin iman lahaa;
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

kikuyu: laakiinse haatan anigoo aan meelahakan meel dambe ku lahayn, oo idin boholyoobayay sannado badan inaan idiin imaado,
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

kikuyu: markaan Isbaanya tago waxaan rajaynayaa inaan sodcaalkayga idinku arko oo idinna aad halkaas iga ambabbixisaan, markaan cabbaar idinku raaxaysto dabadeed,
english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

kikuyu: laakiinse haatan waxaan aadayaa Yeruusaalem inaan u adeego quduusiinta.
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

kikuyu: Waayo, dadka Makedoniya iyo Akhaya waxay aad u jeclaysteen inay wax u ururiyaan masaakiinta ka midka ah quduusiinta Yeruusaalem joogta.
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Way jeclaysteen, waana ku waajib inay sameeyaan. Waayo, dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn hadday noqdeen kuwo ka qayb galay waxyaalahooda ruuxa, de markaas waxaa ku waajib ah iyaga inay ugu adeegaan waxyaalaha jidhka.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed markaan tan dhammeeyo oo aan iyaga midhahan ku hubsado, idinkaan idin soo mari doonaa, anoo Isbaanya u socda.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan ogahay markaan idiin imaado inaan ku iman doono buuxnaanta barakada Masiixa.
english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waxaan idinku baryayaa Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix iyo jacaylka Ruuxa, inaad igula dadaashaan tukashooyinkiinna markaad Ilaah ii baridaan,
english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

kikuyu: in layga samatabbixiyo kuwa caasiyiinta ah oo Yahuudiya jooga, iyo in hawshayda aan Yeruusaalem u qabanayo ay noqoto mid ay quduusiintu aqbalaan;
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

kikuyu: inaan farxad idiinku imaado haddii Ilaah doonayo, oo aan idinla nasto.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

kikuyu: Ilaaha nabaddu ha idinla jiro kulligiin. Aamiin.
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Waxaan idin barayaa walaasheen Foybi oo ah mid u adeegta kiniisadda ku taal Kenekhreya,
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

kikuyu: inaad iyada ku dhowaysaan Rabbiga, sida quduusiinta u eg, oo aad ku caawintaan wax kasta oo ay idiinka baahan tahay, waayo, iyaduba kuwa badan bay caawintay iyo xataa aniga qudhayda.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

kikuyu: Igu salaama Bariska iyo Akula kuwa iila shaqeeya Ciise Masiix,
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: oo noloshayda aawadeed qoortooda u dhibay. Keligay uma mahadnaqayo, laakiinse kiniisadaha dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn oo dhammuna ay ku mahadnaqayaan.
english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Iguna salaama kiniisadda gurigooda ku jirta. Igu salaama gacaliyahay Ebaynetos, kan ah midhaha ugu horreeya ee Aasiya xagga Masiixa.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

kikuyu: Maryanna igu salaama, tan aad idiinku dadaashay.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

kikuyu: Igu salaama Andaronikos iyo Yuniyas oo xigaalkayga ah oo layla xidhay, kuwa caanka ku ah rasuullada dhexdooda, kuwa hortayna Masiixa ku jiray.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

kikuyu: Ambaliyas, gacaliyahayga xagga Rabbigana igu salaama.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

kikuyu: Urbanos kan Masiixa noola shaqeeya iyo gacaliyahay Istakhusna igu salaama.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

kikuyu: Abellees kan Masiixu u bogayna igu salaama. Kuwa reer Aristobulosna igu salaama.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

kikuyu: Xigaalkay Herodiyosna igu salaama. Iguna salaama kuwa reer Narkisos oo Rabbiga ku jira.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

kikuyu: Tarufayna iyo Tarufoosa oo Rabbiga u shaqeeyana igu salaama. Gacaliso Bersis oo Rabbiga aad ugu shaqaysayna igu salaama.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

kikuyu: Igu salaama Rufus kan Rabbigu doortay iyo hooyadiis oo hooyaday oo kale ah.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

kikuyu: Igu salaama Asunkiritos, iyo Filegoon, iyo Hermees, iyo Batrobas, iyo Hermaas, iyo walaalaha iyaga la jooga.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

kikuyu: Igu salaama Filologos, iyo Yulya, iyo Neere'us, iyo walaashiis, iyo Olumbas, iyo quduusiinta iyaga la jooga oo dhan.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

kikuyu: Midkiinba midka kale ha ku salaamo dhunkasho quduus ah. Kiniisadihii Masiixa oo dhammu waa idin soo salaamayaan.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

kikuyu: Haddaba walaalayaalow, waxaan idinka baryayaa inaad fiiro u lahaataan kuwa kicinaya iskala qaybinta iyo xumaatooyinka oo ka geesta ah cilmiga aad barateen, kana leexda iyaga.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

kikuyu: Kuwa caynkaas ahu Rabbigeenna Masiix uma adeegaan, laakiinse waxay u adeegaan calooshooda; hadalkooda macaan oo wanaagsan bay ku khiyaaneeyaan qalbiyada jaahiliinta.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

kikuyu: Warkii addeeciddiinnu wuxuu gaadhay dadka oo dhan. Sidaas daraaddeed aad baan idiinku faraxsanahay, laakiin waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad garaad u lahaataan waxa wanaagsan, oo aad ka eedla'aataan waxa sharka ah.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

kikuyu: Oo Ilaaha nabaddu Shayddaan buu haddiiba cagihiinna hoostooda ku burburin doonaa. Nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

kikuyu: Waxaa idin soo salaamaya Timoteyos oo ila shaqeeya, iyo Lukiyos, iyo Yasoon, iyo Soosibater, iyagoo ah xigaalkayga.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

kikuyu: Anigoo Tertiyos ah oo warqaddan qoray, Rabbigaan idinku salaamayaa.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

kikuyu: Gayos, oo aniga iyo kiniisadda oo dhammuba aannu marti u nahay, wuu idin soo salaamayaa. Erastos oo ah qasnajiga magaalada, iyo walaalkeen Kowartos way idin soo salaamayaan.
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

kikuyu: Nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto kulligiin. Aamiin.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

kikuyu: Bawlos oo loogu yeedhay inuu doonistii Ilaah ku ahaado rasuulkii Ciise Masiix, iyo walaalkeen Soostenees,
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

kikuyu: waxaannu warqaddan u qoraynaa kiniisadda Ilaah ee Korintos ku taal, kuwa quduus lagaga dhigay Ciise Masiix ee loogu yeedhay quduusiin, iyo kuwa meel kasta jooga oo ku barya magaca Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix oo ah Rabbigooda iyo keennaba.
english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

kikuyu: Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbeheen ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Mar kasta Ilaahay ayaan idiinku mahadnaqaa, nimcadii Ilaah ee Ciise Masiix laydinku siiyey aawadeed.
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, wax walba hodan buu idinkaga dhigay, ha ahaato hadal walba iyo aqoon walbaba,
english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

kikuyu: sida laydiinku adkeeyey maraggii Masiixa loo furay;
english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

kikuyu: si aan hadiyadiinna idiinka dhinmin intaad sugaysaan muujinta Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix;
english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: kan haddana idinku adkayn doona ilaa dhammaadka, inaad eedla'aataan maalinta Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ilaah waa aamin, kan xaggiisa laydiinku yeedhay xidhiidhka Wiilkiisa Ciise Masiix ee Rabbigeenna ah.
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waxaan magaca Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix idinkaga baryayaa inaad dhammaantiin isku wax ku wada hadashaan, iyo inaydnaan kala qaybsamin, laakiin inaad ku dhammaataan isku maan iyo isku talo.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

kikuyu: Walaalahayow, dadkii Khalo'ee ayaa iiga kiin warramay in ilaaqi idin dhex taal.
english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

kikuyu: Tan waxaan ula jeedaa midkiin inuu leeyahay, Waxaan ka mid ahay kuwa Bawlos; mid kalena, Kuwa Abolloos; mid kalena, Kuwa Keeyfas; mid kalena, Kuwa Masiix.
english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

kikuyu: Masiixu miyuu qaybsamaa? Bawlos miyaa iskutallaabta laydiinku qodbay? Ama ma waxaa laydinku baabtiisay magaca Bawlos?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

kikuyu: Waxaan Ilaah ugu mahadnaqayaa inaanan midkiinna baabtiisin, Kirisbos iyo Gayus maahee
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

kikuyu: inaanu ninna odhan, Waxaa laydinku baabtiisay Bawlos magiciisa.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

kikuyu: Waxaan kaloo baabtiisay kuwii guriga Istefanas joogay. Weliba garan maayo inaan qaar kale baabtiisay iyo in kale.
english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

kikuyu: Waayo, Masiixu iima uu soo dirin inaan dad baabtiiso, laakiin wuxuu ii soo diray inaan dadka injiilka ku wacdiyo, ee ma aha inaan ku hadlo xigmadda hadalka, waaba intaasoo iskutallaabta Masiixa la caaqibo tiraaye.
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

kikuyu: Waayo, hadalka ku saabsan iskutallaabtu waa u nacasnimo kuwa lumaya, laakiin waa u xoogga Ilaah kuweenna badbaadaya.
english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, waxaa qoran, Xigmadda kuwa xigmadda leh waan baabbi'in doonaa, Oo garashada kuwa garashada leh ayaan diidi doonaa.
english: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

kikuyu: Meeh kan xigmadda lihi? Meeh kan culimmada ka mid ahi? Meeh kan wakhtigan muranka badani? Ilaah miyaanu nacasnimo ka dhigin xigmadda dunida?
english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

kikuyu: Dunidu Ilaah kuma ay garanaynin xigmaddeeda, laakiin Ilaah xigmaddiisa aawadeed ayuu ku farxay inuu kuwa rumaysta ku badbaadiyo nacasnimadii wacdiga.
english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

kikuyu: In kastoo ay Yuhuuddu calaamooyin doonaan oo Gariigtuna ay xigmad doonaan,
english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

kikuyu: annaguse waxaannu dadka ku wacdinnaa Masiix oo iskutallaabta lagu qodbay, oo u ah xagga Yuhuudda wax lagu turunturoodo, xagga Gariigtana u ah nacasnimo.
english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

kikuyu: Xagga kuwa loo yeedhayse, ha ahaadeen Yuhuudda ama Gariigta, Masiix baa u ah xoogga Ilaah iyo xigmadda Ilaah.
english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

kikuyu: Waayo, nacasnimada Ilaah waa ka xigmad badan tahay xigmadda dadka, oo itaaldarrada Ilaahna waa ka itaal badan tahay itaalka dadka.
english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

kikuyu: U fiirsada waxa laydiinku yeedhay, walaalayaalow, sidaan loogu yeedhin qaar badan oo xigmad leh xagga jidhka, ama qaar badan oo xoog leh, ama qaar badan oo gob ah,
english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

kikuyu: laakiinse Ilaah wuxuu doortay waxyaalaha nacasnimada ah ee dunida inuu ceebeeyo kuwa xigmadda leh, oo Ilaah baa doortay waxyaalaha itaalka daran inuu ceebeeyo waxyaalaha itaalka leh.
english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

kikuyu: Waxyaalaha hoose iyo waxyaalaha la fududaystana Ilaah baa doortay, xataa waxyaalaha aan jirin, inuu waxyaalaha jira wax aan wax tarin ka dhigo,
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

kikuyu: si aan qofna ugu faanin Ilaah hortiisa.
english: that no flesh should boast before God.

kikuyu: Laakiin xaggiisa waxaad ku jirtaan Ciise Masiix kan inoo noqday xigmadda xagga Ilaah, iyo xaqnimada, iyo quduusnaanta, iyo madaxfurashada,
english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

kikuyu: in sida qoran, Kii faanaa, Rabbiga ha ku faano.
english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, anna markaan idiin imid, lama iman hadal wanaaggiis ama xigmad, anoo idinku wacdiyaya maraggii laga furay Ilaah,
english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

kikuyu: waayo, waxaan goostay inaanan waxba dhexdiinna ka ogaan Ciise Masiix oo ah kan iskutallaabta lagu qodbay maahee.
english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan idinkula joogay itaaldarro, iyo cabsi, iyo gariir badan.
english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadalkayga iyo wacdigayga kuma aan hadlin hadallo sasabasho iyo xigmad ah, laakiin waxaan ku hadlay tusidda Ruuxa iyo xoogga,
english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

kikuyu: inaan rumaysadkiinnu ku tiirsanaan xigmadda dadka, laakiin inuu xoogga Ilaah ku tiirsanaado.
english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

kikuyu: Waxaannu xigmadda kula hadallaa kuwa garashadu ku dhan tahay, taasoo aan ahayn xigmadda wakhtigan, oo aan ahayn xigmadda madaxda wakhtigan oo ah kuwa la baabbi'in doono;
english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

kikuyu: laakiin qarsoonaan ayaannu ugu hadallaa xigmadda Ilaah oo la qariyey, oo Ilaah dunida horteed ka dhigay ammaanteenna aawadeed,
english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

kikuyu: tan madaxda wakhtigan midkoodna aanu garanaynin, waayo, hadday garan lahaayeen, iskutallaabta kuma ay qodbeen Rabbiga ammaanta,
english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

kikuyu: laakiin sida qoran, Waxyaalo aanay ishu arkin, oo aanay dhegtu maqlin, Oo aan qalbiga dadka gelin, Wax kastoo ay yihiinba, Ilaah baa u diyaariyey kuwa isaga jecel.
english: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

kikuyu: Innagase Ilaah baa inoogu muujiyey Ruuxa, waayo, Ruuxu wuxuu baadhaa wax kasta, xataa waxyaalaha hoos u dhaadheer oo Ilaah.
english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, dadka dhexdood yaa garanaya nin waxyaalihiisa, ruuxa ninka ku jira mooyaane? Sidaas oo kalena ninna garan maayo waxyaalaha Ilaah, Ruuxa Ilaah mooyaane.
english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

kikuyu: Laakiin innagu ma aynu helin ruuxa dunida laakiinse Ruuxa Ilaah ka yimid, inaynu garanno waxyaalaha uu Ilaah nimco ahaan inoo siiyey.
english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaasna ayaannu ku hadalnaa, kumase hadalno hadallo la baro ee ah xigmadda dadka, laakiin waxa Ruuxu baro, annaga oo waxyaalaha ruuxa ah ku simayna waxyaalaha ruuxa ah.
english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

kikuyu: Ninka nafta raacaa ma aqbalo waxyaalaha Ruuxa Ilaah, waayo, nacasnimo bay u yihiin, mana garan karo, maxaa yeelay, ruuxa ayaa lagu imtixaamaa.
english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

kikuyu: Kii ruuxa raacaa wax walbuu imtixaamaa, laakiinse isaga qudhiisa ninna ma imtixaamo.
english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

kikuyu: Waayo, yaa gartay maanka Rabbiga inuu wax baro isaga? Laakiin annagu waxaannu leennahay maanka Ciise.
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

kikuyu: Anna, walaalayaalow, idiinlama aan hadli karin sida idinkoo ruuxa raaca, laakiin idinkoo jidhka raaca sida kuwo ilmo yaryar ah oo ku jira Masiix.
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

kikuyu: Waxaan idin siiyey caano ee idinma aan siin cunto, waayo, weli ma aydaan cuni karin, haatanna weli ma aad kartaan.
english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, weli jidhkaad raacdaan, waayo, intii xaasidnimo iyo ilaaq dhexdiinna ku jiraan, miyaanaydin jidhka raacsanayn oo sida dadka miyaanaydin u soconayn?
english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

kikuyu: Waayo, markii mid yidhaahdo, Anigu waxaan ka mid ahay kuwa Bawlos, mid kalena, Anna Abolloos, miyaanaydin dad ahayn?
english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

kikuyu: Haddaba muxuu yahay Abolloos? Bawlosna muxuu yahay? Waxay yihiin midiidinyadii aad xaggooda ku rumaysateen, oo mid kasta sida Rabbigu u siiyey isaga.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

kikuyu: Anigu waan beeray, Abolloosna wuu waraabiyey, laakiin Ilaah baa koriyey.
english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

kikuyu: Taa aawadeed waxba ma aha kan beeraa, ama kan waraabiyaa, laakiin waa Ilaah kan koriyaa.
english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

kikuyu: Kan beeraa iyo kan waraabiyaa waa isku mid, laakiin mid kastaa wuxuu heli doonaa abaalkiis siday hawshiisu ahayd.
english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

kikuyu: Waxaannu nahay kuwa Ilaah la shaqeeya, idinkuna waxaad tihiin beerta Ilaah iyo Ilaah dhismihiisa.
english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

kikuyu: Sida dhise xigmad leh waxaan aasaaskii ku dhigay nimcadii Ilaah i siiyey, oo mid kalena wuu ka dul dhisayaa. Laakiin mid kastaa ha ka fiirsado siduu uga dul dhisayo.
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

kikuyu: Waayo, ninna ma dhigi karo aasaas kale kan la dhigay mooyaane oo ah Ciise Masiix.
english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiin nin hadduu aasaaska ku dul dhiso dahab, ama lacag, ama dhagaxyo qaali ah, ama qoryo, ama caws, ama bal,
english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

kikuyu: nin kasta shuqulkiisa ayaa la muujin doonaa. Waayo, maalintu way caddayn doontaa, maxaa yeelay, dab baa lagu muujiyaa, waayo, nin kasta shuqulkiisa caynkuu yahay dabka ayaa tijaabin doona.
english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

kikuyu: Nin uun haddii shuqulkiisuu ku dul dhisay hadho, abaal buu heli doonaa.
english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

kikuyu: Nin uun haddii shuqulkiisu gubto, wuu khasaari doonaa, isaga qudhiisuse wuu badbaadi doonaa, laakiin sidii wax dab laga soo baxshay oo kaluu u badbaadi doonaa.
english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

kikuyu: Miyaanaydin garanaynin inaad tihiin macbudkii Ilaah oo uu Ruuxa Ilaah idinku jiro?
english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

kikuyu: Nin uuni hadduu macbudka Ilaah kharribo, isaga Ilaah baa kharribi doona, waayo, macbudkii Ilaah waa quduus, kaad idinku tihiin.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

kikuyu: Ninna yuusan iskhiyaanayn. Haddii nin dhexdiinna joogaa uu u malaynayo inuu wakhtigan xigmad leeyahay, doqon ha noqdo si uu xigmad u yeesho.
english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

kikuyu: Waayo, xigmadda dunidan doqonnimay la tahay Ilaah. Waayo, waxaa qoran, Isagu kuwa xigmadda leh ayuu khiyaanadooda ku qabtaa,
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

kikuyu: oo haddana, Rabbigu waa garanayaa tashiyada kuwa xigmadda leh inayan waxba tarin.
english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

kikuyu: Taa aawadeed ninna yaanu dadka ku faanin. Waayo, wax walba idinkaa leh,
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

kikuyu: ha ahaadeen ama Bawlos, ama Abolloos, ama Keeyfas, ama dunida, ama nolosha, ama dhimashada, ama waxyaalaha haatan jooga, ama waxyaalaha iman doona, dhammaan idinkaa leh.
english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

kikuyu: Idinkuna kuwa Masiix baad tihiin, Masiixuna waa kan Ilaah.
english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

kikuyu: Ha lanagu tiriyo inaannu nahay midiidinyada Masiixa iyo wakiillada waxyaalaha qarsoon ee Ilaah.
english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa laga doonayaa wakiillada in aamin laga helo.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

kikuyu: Laakiin waa ila yar tahay inaad idinku i xukuntaan ama in dad kale i xukumo; xataa aniga qudhaydu isma xukumo.
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxba iskuma ogi, laakiinse ma aha taas aawadeed in xaq layga dhigay, waayo, waa Rabbiga kan i xukumaa.
english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

kikuyu: Taa aawadeed wakhtiga hortiisa waxba ha xukumina ilaa Rabbigu imanayo, kan waxyaalaha qarsoon ee gudcurka iftiimin doona oo muujin doona tashiyada qalbiga, oo markaas nin kastaaba wuxuu ammaantiisa ka heli doonaa Ilaah.
english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

kikuyu: Haddaba, walaalayaalow, waxyaalahan ayaan aawadiin u soo qaaday qudhayda iyo Abolloosba, inaad xaggayaga ka barataan inaydnaan ka gudbin waxyaalaha qoran oo aan midkiinna midka kale u faanin.
english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

kikuyu: Waayo, yaa kaa soocay? Maxaad haysataa oo, aanad helin? Laakiin haddaad heshay, bal maxaad u faanaysaa sidii adigoo aan helin?
english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

kikuyu: Horaad u dheregteen, horaad hodan u noqoteen, la'aantayo sida boqorro ayaad wax u xukunteen. Waan jeclaan lahaa inaad wax xukuntaan, inaannu annaguna wax idinla xukunno.
english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan u malaynayaa in Ilaah na soo saaray, annagoo ah rasuulladii ugu dambeeyey, sida kuwa dhimashada lagu xukumay oo kale, maxaa yeelay, wax la daawado ayaa lanooga dhigay dunida, iyo malaa'igaha, iyo dadkaba.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

kikuyu: Annagu waxaannu nahay Masiixa aawadiis doqonno, idinkuse caqli baad ku leedihiin xagga Masiixa. Annagu waa xoog darannahay, idinkuse waad xoog badan tihiin, idinku ammaan baad leedihiin, annaguse waa maamuus la' nahay.
english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

kikuyu: Tan iyo saacaddan waan gaajaysan nahay, waanan harraadsan nahay, waanan arradan nahay, waa nala garaacay, oo meel aan ku hoyannona ma lihin.
english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

kikuyu: Waana hawshoonnaa annagoo gacmahayaga ku shaqayna; markii lana caayona waan ducaynaa; markii lana silciyona waan dulqaadannaa.
english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

kikuyu: Markii lana xantona, si qabow ayaannu u hadallaa, waxaannu noqonnay uskagga dunida iyo waxa ugu wasakhsan wax kasta tan iyo haatan.
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

kikuyu: Anigu waxyaalahaas u qori maayo inaan idin ceebeeyo laakiin inaan idin waaniyo sida carruurtayda aan jeclahay oo kale.
english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

kikuyu: In kastoo aad leedihiin toban kun oo Masiix idinku rabbeeyey, aabbayaal badan ma lihidin, waayo, Ciise Masiix ayaan idinku dhalay xagga injiilka.
english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan idinka baryayaa inaad igu dayataan.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

kikuyu: Taas aawadeed waxaan idiin soo diray Timoteyos oo xagga Rabbiga ah wiilkayga aan jeclahay oo aaminka ah. Wuu idin xusuusin doonaa socodkayga ee ah xagga Masiixa, sidaan meel kasta wax ugu baro kiniisad kasta.
english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

kikuyu: Qaar baa kibray sidii anigoo aan idiin imanaynin.
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

kikuyu: Laakiin dhowaan baan idiin iman doonaa, haddii Rabbigu yidhaahdo, oo markaasaan garan doonaa kuwa kibray xooggooda, ee ma aha hadalkooda.
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

kikuyu: Waayo, boqortooyada Ilaah hadal ma aha, ee waa xoog.
english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

kikuyu: Maxaad doonaysaan? Ma inaan ul idiinla imaado, mise jacayl iyo ruux qabow?
english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

kikuyu: Meel walba waxaa laga maqlay in dhexdiinna ay sino ku jirto, sinada caynkaas ahna xataa dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ma qabaan, taasoo ah inuu midkiin naagtii aabbihii haysto.
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

kikuyu: Weliba waad kibirsan tihiin, kamana aydnaan caloolxumaan, si kii waxaas sameeyey dhexdiinna looga saaro.
english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

kikuyu: Waayo, runtii, in kastoo jidhkaygu idinka maqan yahay, ruuxaygu waa idinla joogaa, oo sidii aniga oo jooga ayaan kii waxaas sameeyey ku xukumay
english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

kikuyu: magaca Rabbigeenna Ciise. Markaad idinka iyo ruuxayguba isugu timaadaan xoogga Rabbigeenna Ciise,
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: waa inaad kaasoo kale Shayddaanka u dhiibtaan in jidhku baabba'o, ruuxuse badbaado maalinta Rabbiga.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Faankiinnu ma wanaagsana. Miyeydnaan garanaynin in in yar oo khamiir ah ay cajiinka oo dhan khamiiriso?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

kikuyu: Khamiirkii hore iska safeeya inaad noqotaan cajiin cusub sidii idinkoo aan khamiirsanayn. Waayo, Masiixa ah Kormariddeenna waa la sadqeeyey.
english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

kikuyu: Haddaba yeynan ku iidin khamiirkii hore ama khamiirka xumaanta iyo sharka, laakiin aan ku iidno kibista khamiirka la' ee daacadda iyo runta ah.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

kikuyu: Waxaan warqaddaydii idiinku soo qoray inaydnaan kuwa sinaysta raacin.
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

kikuyu: Ulama jeedo kuwa sinaysta ee dunidan, iyo kuwa damaca badan iyo kuwa wax dulma, iyo kuwa sanamka caabuda, waayo, hadday sidaas tahay waxay noqon lahayd inaad dunida ka baxdaan.
english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadda waxaan idiin soo qoray, Ha raacina qof walaal la yidhaahdo hadduu sinaysto, ama wax badan damco, ama sanam caabudo, ama wax caayo, ama sakhraamo, ama wax dulmo. Waa inaydnaan kaasoo kale xataa wax la cunin.
english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

kikuyu: Waayo, maxaa iigu jira inaan xukumo kuwa dibadda ah? Idinku miyeydnaan xukumin kuwa gudaha ku jira?
english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

kikuyu: Kuwa dibadda ah Ilaah baa xukuma. Idinkuse kan sharka leh dhexdiinna ka saara.
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”

kikuyu: Midkiin haddii uu xaal ku haysto kan kale, miyuu ku dhacaa inuu ku dacweeyo kuwa aan xaqa ahayn hortooda, oo aanu ku dacwayn quduusiinta hortooda?
english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

kikuyu: Mise waydnaan garanaynin in quduusiintu ay dunida xukumi doonaan? Oo haddaad dunida xukuntaan, ma waxaad tihiin kuwa aan istaahilin inay waxyaalaha yaryar xukumaan?
english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

kikuyu: Miyeydnaan ogayn inaynu malaa'igaha xukumi doonno? Intee ka badan baa waxyaalaha noloshan ku saabsan aynu xukumaynaa?
english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii aad leedihiin axwaal ku saabsan waxyaalaha noloshan, kuwa aan waxba ka ahayn kiniisadda miyaad ka dhigaysaan inay xukumaan?
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

kikuyu: Waxaan taas u leeyahay inaan idin ceebeeyo. Ma sidaas baa inaan dhexdiinna laga helaynin mid xigmad leh oo karaya inuu u gar qaybiyo walaalihiis,
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

kikuyu: laakiin in walaal walaalkii dacweeyo oo uu weliba ku dacweeyo kuwa aan rumaysnayn hortooda?
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

kikuyu: Haddaba waa idiin wada daran tahay in midkiinba midka kale dacweeyo. Maad iska daysaan, ha laydin xumeeyee? Maad iska daysaan, ha laydin dulmee?
english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

kikuyu: Laakiin idinka qudhiinnu wax baad xumaysaan oo dulantaan, oo xataa walaalihiin.
english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

kikuyu: Ama miyeydnaan ogayn in kuwa xaqa darani ayan dhaxlayn boqortooyadii Ilaah? Yaan laydin khiyaanayn. Ama dhillayaasha, ama kuwa sanamka caabuda, ama kuwa sinaysta, ama khaanisiinta,
english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

kikuyu: ama tuugagga, ama kuwa wax badan damca, ama kuwa sakhraama, ama kuwa wax caaya, ama kuwa wax dulma, ma dhaxli doonaan boqortooyadii Ilaah.
english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Qaarkiin sidaas oo kale baad ahaan jirteen, laakiin waa laydinka maydhay, quduus baa laydinka dhigay, xaq baa laydinkaga dhigay magaca Rabbi Ciise Masiix iyo Ruuxa Ilaaheenna.
english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

kikuyu: Wax waliba waa ii xalaal, laakiin wax waliba iima roona. Wax waliba waa ii xalaal, laakiin waxba ima addoonsan doonaan.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

kikuyu: Cuntada waxaa loo sameeyey caloosha, calooshana cuntada, laakiin Ilaah baa baabbi'in doona tan iyo taaba. Jidhka looma samayn sinada ee waxaa loo sameeyey Rabbiga, Rabbiguna jidhkuu xannaaneeyaa.
english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

kikuyu: Ilaah waa sara kiciyey Rabbiga, innagana xooggiisa ayuu inagu sara kicin doonaa.
english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

kikuyu: Miyaanaydin garanaynin jidhadhkiinnu inay yihiin xubnaha Masiixa? Haddaba miyaan qaadaa xubnaha Masiixa oo dhillo xubnaheed ka dhigaa? Yaanay noqon.
english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

kikuyu: Miyaanaydin ogayn inuu kii dhillo raacaa la jidh yahay? Waayo, Ilaah wuxuu leeyahay, Labadu waxay noqon doonaan isku jidh.
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

kikuyu: Laakiin kii Rabbiga raacaa waa la ruux.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

kikuyu: Ka carara sinada. Dembi kaloo kasta oo nin falo, jidhka waa ka dibadda, laakiin kii dhillanimada falaa jidhkiisuu ku dembaabaa.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

kikuyu: Ama miyaanaydin ogayn jidhkiinnu inuu yahay macbudka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ee idinku jira ee aad Ilaah ka hesheen? Oo idinku isma lihidin,
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

kikuyu: waayo, qiimo weyn baa laydinku soo iibsaday. Sidaa aawadeed Ilaah jidhkiinna ku ammaana.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaad ii soo qorteen xaggooda, Waxaa nin u wanaagsan inuusan qof dumar ah taaban.
english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

kikuyu: Laakiin si aan loo sinaysan, nin kastaa afadiisa oo qudha ha haysto, naag kastaana ninkeeda oo qudha ha haysato.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

kikuyu: Ninku afada waxa ku qumman ha siiyo, sidaas oo kale afaduna ninka waxa ku qumman ha siiso.
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

kikuyu: Afadu jidhkeeda uma taliso, laakiin ninkaa u taliya, sidaas oo kale ninku jidhkiisa uma taliyo, laakiin afadaa u talisa.
english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

kikuyu: Ha isdiidina, wakhti aad ku heshiisaan inaad soon iyo tukasho u goosataan mooyaane, oo aad haddana isu timaadaan, si aan Shayddaanku idiin duufin iscelinla'aantiinna aawadeed.
english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

kikuyu: Laakiin taas fasax ahaan ayaan u leeyahay ee amrise maayo.
english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

kikuyu: De waxaan jeclaan lahaa in nimanka oo dhammu ay sidayda oo kale yihiin. Laakiin nin kastaaba hadiyad gooni ah ayuu Ilaah ka helaa, midkan sidan, kaasna sidaas.
english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

kikuyu: Laakiin anigu waxaan kuwa aan guursan iyo carmallada laga dhintay ku leeyahay, Waa u roon tahay iyaga inay sidayda oo kale sii ahaadaan,
english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

kikuyu: laakiin hadday iscelin kari waayaan, ha guursadeen; waayo, waxaa dhaanta inay guursadaan intay guban lahaayeen.
english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

kikuyu: Laakiin kuwa guursaday waxaan ku amrayaa, kan amrayaa aniga ma aha laakiin waa Rabbiga, Afadu yaanay ninkeeda ka tegin.
english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

kikuyu: Laakiin hadday ka tagto, ha iska guur la'aato ama ninkeedii ha la heshiiso; oo ninkuna yaanu afadiisa ka tegin.
english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

kikuyu: Kuwa kale anigu waxaan ku leeyahay ee ma aha Rabbiga, Hadduu mid walaal ah qabo afo aan rumaysanayn, oo ayna raalli ka tahay inay la joogto, yaanu ka tegin.
