english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

kikuyu: Oo afadii nin aan rumaysanayni qabo oo isna raalli ka yahay inuu la joogo, yaanay ninkeeda ka tegin.
english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

kikuyu: Waayo, ninka aan rumaysanayni wuxuu quduus ku noqdaa xagga naagta, oo naagta aan rumaysanaynina waxay quduus ku noqotaa xagga ninka rumaysan, haddii kale carruurtiinna wasakh bay ahaan lahaayeen, laakiin haatan waa quduus.
english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii kan aan rumaysanayni tago, ha iska tago. Waxaas oo kale walaalka ama walaashu uma xidhxidhna. Ilaah wuxuu inoogu yeedhay nabad.
english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

kikuyu: Waayo, sidee baad ku garanaysaa, naag yahay, inaad ninkaaga badbaadin doonto iyo in kale? Ama sidee baad ku garanaysaa, nin yahow, inaad naagtaada badbaadin doonto iyo in kale?
english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

kikuyu: Hase ahaatee, mid kastaa ha u socdo sidii Rabbigu ugu qaybshay iyo sidii Ilaah mid kasta ugu yeedhay. Oo sidaasaan kiniisadaha oo dhan ku amraa.
english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Nin gudan ma loo yeedhay? Gudniinla'aan yaanu noqon. Nin aan gudnayn ma loo yeedhay? Yaan la gudin.
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

kikuyu: Gudniintu waxba ma aha; gudniinla'aantuna waxba ma aha, laakiin waxaa waajib ah in la xajiyo qaynuunnada Ilaah.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

kikuyu: Nin kastaa sidii loogu yeedhay, ha sii ahaado.
english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

kikuyu: Ma laguu yeedhay adigoo addoon ah? Dan ha u gelin. Laakiin haddaad karayso inaad xorowdid, waa inaad aqbashid.
english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii xagga Rabbiga loogu yeedhay isagoo addoon ah, wuxuu yahay ninka xorta ah ee Rabbiga, sidaas oo kalena kii isagoo xor ah loo yeedhay, wuxuu yahay addoonka Masiix.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

kikuyu: Qiimo weyn baa laydinku soo iibsaday; addoommada dadka ha noqonina.
english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, nin kastaa sidii loogu yeedhay ha sii ahaado, isagoo Ilaah la jira.
english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

kikuyu: Amar bikradaha ku saabsan kama haysto xagga Rabbiga, laakiin waxaan kula talinayaa sida mid Rabbiga naxariis ka helay inuu aamin ahaado.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed waxay ila tahay dhibta haatan joogta aawadeed inay u roon tahay nin inuu sii ahaado siduu yahay.
english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

kikuyu: Miyaad naag ku xidhan tahay? Ha doonin inaad ka furnaato. Miyaad naag ka furan tahay? Ha doonin naag.
english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaad guursatid ma aad dembaabin, bikraduna hadday guursato ma ay dembaabin, laakiin kuwaas oo kale xagga jidhka dhib bay ka heli doonaan, laakiin dhibtaasaan idinka celin lahaa.
english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan leeyahay, walaalayaalow, wakhtiga waa la soo gaabiyey, hadda kaddib kuwa naagaha qabaa ha ahaadeen sidii iyagoo aan qabin;
english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

kikuyu: oo kuwa ooyaana sidii iyagoo aan ooyin, kuwa farxaana sidii iyagoo aan farxin, kuwa wax iibsadaana sidii iyagoo aan waxba lahayn;
english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

kikuyu: kuwa dunidan ku isticmaalaana, sidii iyagoo aan aad ugu isticmaalin, waayo, xaalka dunidan waa idlaanayaa.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad welwel la'aataan. Kii aan guursanin wuxuu u welwelaa waxyaalaha Rabbiga, siduu Rabbiga uga farxin lahaa.
english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

kikuyu: Laakiin kii guursaday wuxuu u welwelaa waxyaalaha dunida siduu afadiisa uga farxin lahaa.
english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

kikuyu: Afada iyo bikraddu waa kala duwan yihiin. Tii aan la qabinu waxay u welweshaa waxyaalaha Rabbiga si ay quduus uga ahaato xagga jidhka iyo xagga ruuxa. Tii guursatay waxay u welweshaa waxyaalaha dunida si ay ninkeeda uga farxiso.
english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

kikuyu: Tan waxaan idinku leeyahay waxtarkiinna aawadii ee ma aha inaan qool idin geliyo, laakiin in waxa roon la arko iyo inaad Rabbiga u adeegtaan kalajeedsadla'aan.
english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

kikuyu: Nin uun hadduu u maleeyo inuu wax aan toosnayn ku falayo xagga bikraddiisa, hadday wakhtigii dhallinyaronimadeedii dhaafto oo sidaas loo baahnaado, ha sameeyo wuxuu dooni lahaa. Dembaabi maayo ee ha guursadeen.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

kikuyu: Kii qalbigiisa ka adkaysta, isagoo aan la qasbin, laakiin nafsaddiisa u taliya, uuna qalbigiisa ka goostay inuu bikraddiisa iska sii hayo, si wanaagsan buu falaa.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

kikuyu: Sidaasna kii bikraddiisa u guuriyaa si wanaagsan ayuu falaa, iyo kii bikraddiisa aan u guurinin si ka wanaagsan ayuu falaa.
english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

kikuyu: Naag waxay ku xidhan tahay ninkeeda intuu nool yahay, laakiin haddii ninku dhinto, waa xor inay guursato kay doonto laakiin xagga Rabbiga oo keliya.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

kikuyu: Laakiin way ka sii faraxsanaan lahayd hadday iska joogto, siday aniga ila tahay, oo anigu waxaan u malaynayaa inaan Ruuxa Ilaah leeyahay.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

kikuyu: Xagga waxyaalaha sanamyada loo sadqeeyo, waxaynu garanaynaa inaynu dhammaan aqoon u wada leennahay. Aqoontu way kibrisaa, jacaylkuse wax buu dhisaa.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

kikuyu: Qof uuni hadduu u malaynayo inuu wax garanayo, weli garan maayo siduu u garan lahaa.
english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

kikuyu: Laakiin qof uuni hadduu Ilaah jecel yahay, Ilaah baa garanaya isaga.
english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

kikuyu: Haddaba xagga cunidda waxyaalaha sanamyada loo sadqeeyo, waxaynu garanaynaa inuusan sanam waxba dunida ka ahayn oo aan Ilaah jirin mid mooyaane.
english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

kikuyu: Waayo, in kastoo ay samada iyo dhulkaba jiraan wax ilaahyo lagu sheego, sidii iyadoo ilaahyo badan iyo sayidyo badni jiraan,
english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

kikuyu: laakiin innagu waxaynu leennahay Ilaah keliya oo Aabbaha ah, kan wax waluba ka yimaadaan oo innagana isagaa ina leh, iyo Sayid keliya oo Ciise Masiix ah, kan wax waluba ku ahaadeen oo innaguna isagaynu ku ahaannay.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

kikuyu: Laakiin dad oo dhammu aqoontaas ma wada laha, laakiin qaar sanamka tan iyo hadda u bartay, waxay u qabaan waxay cunaan sidii wax sanam loo sadqeeyo, qalbigooda itaalka daranina wuu nijaasoobay.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

kikuyu: Cuntadu ina hor joojin mayso Ilaah. Haddaynan cunin waxba inagama dhacaan, haddaynu cunnona waxba inooma kordhaan.
english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

kikuyu: Laakiin iska dhawra si aan ikhtiyaarkiinnu wax lagu turunturoodo ugu noqon kuwa itaalka daran.
english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

kikuyu: Haddii qof ku arko adigoo aqoonta leh oo cunto ugu fadhiya meeshii sanamyada, hadduu qalbiga ka itaal daranyahay, qalbigiisu miyaanu ku adkaanaynin inuu cuno waxa sanamyada loo sadqeeyo?
english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa aqoontaada aawadeed lumaya ka itaalka daran oo ah walaalkaagii uu Masiixu aawadiis u dhintay.
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

kikuyu: Markaad walaalaha sidaas ugu dembaabtaan oo aad qalbigooda itaalka daran u xumaysaan, waxaad ku dembaabtaan Masiix.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

kikuyu: Taa aawadeed haddii cunto walaalkay xumayso, hilib weligay ma cuni doono si aanan walaalkay u xumayn.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

kikuyu: Miyaanan xor ahayn? Miyaanan rasuul ahayn? Miyaanan arkin Rabbigeenna Ciise? Miyeydnaan ahayn shuqulkayga xagga Rabbiga?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

kikuyu: Xataa haddaanan kuwa kale rasuul u ahayn, idinka waa idiin ahay, waayo, waxaad tihiin shaabadda rasuulnimadayda xagga Rabbiga.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

kikuyu: Daafacaaddayda aan kuwa i imtixaama iskaga daafaco waa tan.
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

kikuyu: Miyaannan annagu jid u lahayn inaannu wax cunno oo wax cabno?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

kikuyu: Miyaannan jid u lahayn inaannu haweenay walaal ah kaxaysanno sida rasuullada kale iyo walaalaha Rabbiga iyo Keeyfas ay sameeyaan?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

kikuyu: Mise aniga iyo Barnabas oo keliyaan jid u lahayn inaannan shaqayn?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

kikuyu: Askarigee baa qarashkiisa weligiis iska bixiya? Yaa beer canab ah beera oo aan midhaheeda cunin? Ama yaa adhi daajiya oo aan caanaha adhiga dhamin?
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas ma sida dad baan u leeyahay? Oo sharcigu miyuusan waxyaalahaas oo kale lahayn?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa ku qoran sharciga Muuse, Waa inaadan dibiga af xidhin markuu sarreenka burburinayo. Ma Ilaah baa dibiyada oo keliya dhawra,
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

kikuyu: mise innagoo dhan buu inoola jeeda? Hubaal, aawadeen baa loo qoray, waayo, kan beerta qodaa waa inuu rajo ku qodo, kan tumaana waa inuu tumo isagoo rajaynaya inuu wax qayb u helo.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

kikuyu: Haddaannu idinku beernay waxyaalaha ruuxa, ma wax weyn baa haddaannu waxyaalaha jidhka idinka urursaano?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

kikuyu: Qaar kale hadday waxaas jid idiinku leeyihiin, miyaannan annagu si ka badan idiinku lahayn? Hase ahaatee, waxan noo jidka ah kuma aannu isticmaalin, laakiin wax walba waannu u dulqaadannaa inaannan sina u joojin injiilka Masiix.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: Miyeydnaan ogayn kuwa waxyaalaha quduuska ah ka shaqeeyaa inay macbudka wax ka cunaan, kuwa meesha allabariga ka adeegaana inay meesha allabariga qayb ku leeyihiin?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale Rabbigu wuxuu amray in kuwa dadka injiilka ku wacdiyaa ay injiilka ku noolaadaan.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxyaalahaas midkoodna kuma aan isticmaalin. Haddana waxyaalahan u qori maayo in sidaas la ii yeelo, waayo, waxaa ii roon inaan dhinto intii nin uun faankayga ka dhigi lahaa wax aan wax ka jirin.
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaan dadka injiilka ku wacdiyo, wax aan ku faano ma aha, waayo, wax baa i qasbaya, maxaa yeelay, waa ii hoog haddaanan dadka injiilka ku wacdiyin.
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaan waxaas ku sameeyo doonistayda aawadeed, abaalgud baan helayaa, laakiin haddaanan doonistayda ku samayn, weli wakiilnimo baa laygu aaminay.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

kikuyu: Haddaba abaalgudkaygu waa maxay? Waa in markaan injiilka dadka ku wacdiyo aan injiilka ka dhigo iibla'aan, si aanan ugu wada isticmaalin waxa ii jidka ah xagga injiilka.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

kikuyu: Waayo, in kastoo aan xor ka ahaa dad oo dhan, dhammaan ayaan addoon isaga dhigay, si aan qaar kaloo badan u soo kordhiyo.
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

kikuyu: Yuhuudda waxaan u noqday sida Yuhuudi oo kale, si aan Yuhuud kale u soo kordhiyo. Kuwa sharciga ka hooseeyana, sida mid sharciga ka hooseeya ayaan u noqday, aniga oo aan sharciga ka hoosayn, si aan kuwa sharciga ka hooseeya u soo kordhiyo.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

kikuyu: Xagga kuwa aan sharciga lahayn, sida mid aan sharci lahayn ayaan u noqday anigoo aan ahayn mid sharci la' xagga Ilaah, laakiin sharci leh xagga Masiix, si aan u soo kordhiyo kuwa aan sharciga lahayn.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

kikuyu: Xagga kuwa itaalka daran waxaan u noqday mid itaaldaran, si aan kuwa itaalka daran u soo kordhiyo. Dadka oo dhan ayaan wax kasta u noqday inaan si kastaba qaar ku badbaadiyo.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

kikuyu: Wax kasta waxaan u sameeyaa injiilka aawadiis, si aan u noqdo mid injiilka la qaybsada iyaga.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

kikuyu: Miyaanad ogayn in kuwa tartan ku ordaa ay wada ordaan, laakiin mid uun baa dheefta hela? Sidaas u orda inaad heshaan.
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

kikuyu: Kii cayaarta aad ugu dadaalaa, wax walba ayuu iska dhawraa. Kuwaasu haddaba waxay sidaas u yeelaan inay taaj dhammaanaya helaan, innaguse waxaynu helaynaa mid aan dhammaanaynin.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

kikuyu: Haddaba anigu uma ordo qasdila'aan, uma feedhtamo sida mid dabaysha ku dhufanaya.
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

kikuyu: Laakiin jidhkaygaan dhibaa oo addoon ka dhigaa si markaan qaar kale injiilka ku wacdiyo aan qudhayda lay diidin.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, anigu dooni maayo inaad garan weydaan siday awowayaasheen oo dhammu daruurta uga wada hooseeyeen, oo ay dhammaantood badda u wada dhex mareen,
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

kikuyu: iyo sidii dhammaantood xaggii Muuse loogu baabtiisay daruurta iyo baddaba,
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

kikuyu: iyo siday dhammaantood u wada cuneen isku cunto ruuxa ah,
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

kikuyu: oo dhammaantoodna ay u wada cabbeen isku cabbid ruuxa ah, waayo, waxay ka cabbeen dhagaxa ruuxa ah oo ka daba imanayay iyaga, dhagaxuna wuxuu ahaa Masiixa.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah kuma farxin badidood, oo waxaa iyaga lagu rogay cidlada.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaasi waxay inoo noqdeen masaallo si aynaan waxyaalaha sharka ah u damcin siday iyagu u damceen.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa sanamka caabuda ha ahaanina siday qaarkood u ahaayeen. Sida qoran, Dadku waxay u fadhiisteen inay wax cunaan oo wax cabbaan, oo waxay u kaceen inay cayaaraan.
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

kikuyu: Oo yeynan sinaysanin siday qaarkood u sinaysteen oo saddex iyo labaatan kun ay maalin keliya u dhinteen.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

kikuyu: Oo yeynan jirrabin Rabbiga siday qaarkood u jirrabeen oo ay masasku u baabbi'iyeen.
english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

kikuyu: Oo ha gunuunacina siday qaarkood u gunuunaceen oo uu baabbi'iyuhu u baabbi'iyey.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaasi waxay iyaga ugu dhaceen masaal ahaan, oo waxaa loo qoray in laynagu waaniyo innagoo wakhtiyada dhammaatinkoodii ina soo gaadhay.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed kii u malaynaya inuu taagan yahay, ha iska eego inuusan dhicin.
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

kikuyu: Jirrabaadna idinma qabsan tan dadka wada qabsata mooyaane, laakiin Ilaah waa aamin, mana oggolaan doono in laydin jirrabo intaad karaysaan in ka badan, laakiin markii laydin jirrabo wuxuu samayn doonaa jid aad kaga baxsataan si aad ugu adkaysan kartaan.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed, gacaliyayaalow, sanamcaabudidda ka carara.
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

kikuyu: Waxaan idiinla hadlayaa sida dad caqli leh loola hadlo oo kale. Idinku qiyaasa waxaan leeyahay.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

kikuyu: Koobka barakada leh ee aynu u ducayno miyaanu ahayn islawadaagidda dhiigga Masiix? Kibistaynu jebinnaa, miyaanay ahayn islawadaagidda jidhka Masiix?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

kikuyu: Innagu in kastoo aynu badan nahay, waxaynu nahay jidh qudha, maxaa yeelay, waxaa jira kibis qudha, waayo, dhammaanteen waxaynu wada qaybsannaa kibista qudha.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

kikuyu: Eega reer binu Israa'iil xagga jidhka; kuwa allabaryada cunaa miyaanay la wadaagin meesha allabariga?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

kikuyu: Haddaba maxaan leeyahay? Wax sanam loo sadqeeyo waa wax? Ama, sanam baa wax ah?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

kikuyu: Laakiin waxyaalaha ay dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn sadqeeyaan, waxay u sadqeeyaan jinniyo, ee Ilaah uma sadqeeyaan. Dooni maayo inaad jinniyada wax la wadaagtaan.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

kikuyu: Iskuma wada cabbi kartaan koobka Rabbiga iyo koobka jinniyada. Kama wada qayb geli kartaan miiska Rabbiga iyo miiska jinniyada.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

kikuyu: Miyaynu Rabbiga ka hinaasinnaa? Miyaynu isaga ka xoog badan nahay?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

kikuyu: Wax waliba waa xalaal, laakiin wax waliba ma roona. Wax waliba waa xalaal, laakiin wax waliba wax ma dhisaan.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

kikuyu: Ninna yuusan doonin waxa isaga qudhiisa u roon, laakiin mid kasta ha doono waxa kan kale u roon.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

kikuyu: Wax kasta oo suuqa lagu iibiyo cuna, idinkoo aan waxba weyddiinaynin niyada aawadeed.
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigaa leh dhulka iyo waxa ku jira oo dhanba.
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

kikuyu: Mid ka mid ah kuwa aan rumaysnayn hadduu diyaafad idiinku yeedho oo aad doonaysaan inaad tagtaan, wax kasto oo laydin hor dhigoba cuna, idinkoo aan waxba weyddiinaynin niyada aawadeed.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii laydinku yidhaahdo, Tanu waa wax sanam loo sadqeeyey, ha cunina, kan idiin sheegay aawadiis iyo niyada aawadeed.
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

kikuyu: Waxaan leeyahay, niyada kan kale, ee ma aha taada. Waayo, xoriyaddayda maxaa loogu xukumaa mid kale niyadiis?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

kikuyu: Haddaan mahad kaga qayb galo, maxaa la iigu caayaa wixii aan ku mahadnaqo?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaad wax cuntaan, ama wax cabtaan, ama wax kastaad samaysaan, dhammaan u wada sameeya Ilaah ammaantiisa.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Wax lagu turunturoodo ha u noqonina Yuhuudda ama Gariigta ama kiniisadda Ilaah,
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

kikuyu: sidaan aniguba dadka oo dhan uga farxiyo wax kastaba, anigoo aan doonaynin waxa ii roon, laakiin waxa kuwa badan u roon, si ay u badbaadaan.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

kikuyu: Igu dayda sidaan aniguba Masiix ugu daydo.
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinku ammaanayaa inaad wax walba igu xusuusataan oo aad u xagsataan cilmiga sidaan idiinku sheegay.
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad ogaataan inuu Masiixu yahay madaxa nin kasta, ninkuna inuu yahay madaxa naagta, Ilaahna inuu yahay madaxa Masiixa.
english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

kikuyu: Nin kasta oo tukada ama wax sii sheega isagoo madaxa wax u saaran yihiin, madaxiisuu ceebeeyaa.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

kikuyu: Oo naag kasta oo tukata ama wax sii sheegta iyadoo aan gambaysnayn, madaxeeday ceebaysaa. Waayo, waxay la mid tahay sidii iyadoo madax xiiran.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

kikuyu: Naag haddaanay gambaysnayn, timaha ha loo jaro, laakiin hadday ceeb ku tahay naag in loo jaro ama in loo xiiro, ha gambaysato.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

kikuyu: Nin waa inuusan madaxa dedan, waayo, ninku wuxuu yahay u-ekaanta iyo ammaanta Ilaah; naagtuna waxay tahay ammaanta ninka.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

kikuyu: Waayo, ninku xagga naagta kama uu iman, laakiin naagtuse xagga ninka ayay ka timid.
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, ninka looma abuurin naagta aawadeed, laakiin naagtase ninka aawadiis ayaa loo abuuray.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

kikuyu: Taas aawadeed naagtu waxay leedahay inay madaxeeda ku lahaato astaanta amarka, malaa'igaha aawadood.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

kikuyu: Hase ahaatee, xagga Rabbiga naagtu waxba ma aha ninka la'aantiis, ninkuna waxba ma aha naagta la'aanteed.
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida naagtu ninka uga timid ayaa ninkuna naagta uga dhashay, wax kastana xagga Ilaah bay ka yimaadeen.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

kikuyu: Idinkuba ka fiirsada. Ma u eg tahay naagta inay Ilaah barido iyadoo aan gambaysnayn?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

kikuyu: Dabiicadda qudheedu miyaanay idin barin in ninku hadduu timo dheer leeyahay ay maamuusdarro u yihiin isaga,
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

kikuyu: laakiin naagtu hadday timo dheer leedahay, waa u sharaf iyada. Waayo, timaha waxaa iyada loo siiyey hagoog.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii nin u eg yahay mid ilaaq jecel, caadadaas oo kale annagu ma lihin, kiniisadaha Ilaahna ma laha.
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

kikuyu: Anigoo tan idin faraya, idin ammaani maayo, waayo, isuguma timaadaan waxa roon, ee waxaad isugu timaadaan waxa daran.
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

kikuyu: Horta haddaba waxaan maqlay inaad iskala qaybisaan markaad kiniisadda isugu timaadaan, badhna waan rumaysanahay.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhexdiinna waa inay jiraan waxyaalo idinkala sooco in kuwa loo bogay ay idinka dhex muuqdaan.
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed markaad isu timaadaan, isuguma timaadaan inaad cashada Rabbiga cuntaan.
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

kikuyu: Waayo, mid kasta cashadiisuu kan kale ka hor cunaa, mid waa gaajaysan yahay, midna waa sakhraansan yahay.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

kikuyu: Sow ma lihidin guryo aad wax ku cuntaan oo wax ku cabtaan? Mise kiniisadda Ilaah baad fududaysanaysaan, oo aad kuwa aan waxba haysan ceebaynaysaan? Maxaan idinku idhaahdaa? Ma waxanaan idinku ammaanaa? Idinku ammaani maayo!
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbigaan ka helay wixii aan idiin dhiibay, taasoo ah, in Rabbi Ciise habeenkii la gacangeliyey uu kibis qaaday,
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

kikuyu: oo markuu ku mahadnaqay ayuu jejebiyey oo yidhi, Tanu waa jidhkaygii laydiin jejebiyey, tan u sameeya inaad igu xusuusataan.
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena cashada dabadeed ayuu qaaday koobkii, isagoo leh, Koobkanu waa axdiga cusub ee dhiiggayga. Tan u sameeya inaad igu xusuusataan mar alla markaad cabtaan.
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Waayo, mar alla markaad kibistan cuntaan oo aad koobkan cabtaan, waxaad muujinaysaan dhimashada Rabbiga ilaa uu yimaado.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

kikuyu: Taas aawadeed ku alla kii kibista u cuna ama koobka Rabbiga u cabba si aan istaahilin, jidhka iyo dhiigga Rabbigu dushiisay noqon doonaan.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

kikuyu: Nin kastaa ha is-imtixaamo, oo sidaas kibista wax ha uga cuno, oo koobka ha uga cabbo.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii cuna oo cabba, xukun ayuu naftiisa u cunaa oo u cabbaa isagoo aan jidhka garanaynin.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

kikuyu: Sababtaas aawadeed ayay badidiinnu u itaal daranyihiin, oo u bukaan, oo qaar aan yaraynu u dhinteen.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaynu innagu dhexdeenna iska xukumi lahayn, laynama xukumeen.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

kikuyu: Markii layna xukumo, Rabbiga ayaa ina edbiya, inaan laynala xukumin dunida.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

kikuyu: Taa aawadeed, walaalahayow, markaad isugu timaadaan inaad wax cuntaan, isa suga.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

kikuyu: Nin uun hadduu gaajoodo, gurigiisa wax ha ka soo cuno, inaydnaan xukun isugu iman. Intii kale waxaan hagaajin doonaa markaan imaado.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, dooni maayo inaad jaahil ka ahaataan waxa ku saabsan hadiyadaha Ruuxa ka yimaada.
english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

kikuyu: Waad og tihiin in, markaad dad aan Ilaah aaminin ahaan jirteen, laydin geeyn jiray sanamyada aan hadli karin, si laydinku geeyn jirayba.
english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed waxaan idin ogeysiinayaa inaan nin Ruuxa Ilaah ku hadlaa odhanaynin, Ciise waa inkaaran yahay, oo aan ninna odhan karin, Ciise waa Rabbi, inuu Ruuxa Quduuska ah ku hadlo mooyaane.
english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Waxaa jira hadiyado kala cayn ah, laakiin waa isku Ruux.
english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

kikuyu: Waxaana jira adeegid kala cayn ah, waana isku Rabbi.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

kikuyu: Waxaana jira shuqullo kala cayn ah, laakiin waa isku Ilaah, kan dhammaan wax walba kaga dhex shaqeeya.
english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

kikuyu: Laakiin mid kasta waxaa muujinta Ruuxa loo siiyaa waxtar.
english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

kikuyu: Mid waxaa laga siiyaa xagga Ruuxa hadal xigmad ah, mid kalena hadal aqoon ah siduu isku Ruuxu doonayo.
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

kikuyu: Mid kale Ruuxu rumaysad buu siiyaa, mid kalena hadiyado wax lagu bogsiiyo ayuu isku Ruuxu siiya.
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

kikuyu: Mid kalena shuqullo cajaa'ib leh, mid kalena wax sii sheegidda, mid kalena kalasoocidda ruuxyada, mid kalena afaf kala cayn ah, mid kalena afafka fasiriddooda.
english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

kikuyu: Isku Ruuxa oo keliya ayaa ka shaqeeya waxyaalahaas oo dhan, isagoo siduu doonayo mid mid wax ugu qaybinaya.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

kikuyu: Haddaba sida jidhku mid keliya u yahay, oo uu xubno badan u leeyahay, oo xubnaha oo dhan ee jidhka ay jidh keliya u yihiin, in kastoo ay badan yihiin, Masiixuna waa sidaas oo kale.
english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ruux qudha ayaa dhammaanteen jidh qudha inagu baabtiisay, haddaynu nahay Yuhuud ama Gariig, ama addoommo ama kuwa xor ah, oo waxaa laynaga waraabiyey Ruux qudha.
english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

kikuyu: Waayo, jidhku xubin qudha ma aha ee waa xubno badan.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

kikuyu: Hadday cagtu tidhaahdo, Anigu gacan ma ihi, taas aawadeed jidhka ka mid ma ihi, taasu sabab u noqon mayso inaanay jidhka ka mid ahayn.
english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

kikuyu: Hadday dhegtu tidhaahdo, Anigu isha ma ihi, taas aawadeed jidhka ka mid ma ihi, taasu sabab u noqon mayso inaanay jidhka ka mid ahayn.
english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

kikuyu: Haddii jidhka oo dhammu il wada ahaan lahaa, meeye dhegihii wax lagu maqli lahaana? Hadduu dhammaan dhego wada ahaan lahaa, meeh sankii wax lagu urin lahaana?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

kikuyu: Haatanse Ilaah baa siduu doonayay xubnaha middood kastaba jidhka ugu hagaajiyey.
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

kikuyu: Hadday dhammaan ahaan lahaayeen xubin qudha, meeh jidhkii?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

kikuyu: Haatanse waa xubno badan laakiin waa jidh qudha.
english: But now they are many members, but one body.

kikuyu: Ishu gacanta kuma odhan karto, Kuuma baahni; madaxuna cagaha kuma odhan karo, Idiinma baahni.
english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

kikuyu: Xataa xubnaha jidhka oo loo maleeyo inay u itaal yar yihiin, iyaga qudhooda waa loo baahan yahay,
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

kikuyu: oo kuwa jidhka oo aynu u malayno inay u maamuus yar yihiin, kuwaas ayaynu ka sii maamuusnaa kuwa kale, oo xubnaheenna cawrada ah baa ka xurmo badan kuwa kale.
english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

kikuyu: Xubnaheenna aan cawrada ahaynse waxba uma baahna. Laakiin Ilaah baa jidhka isku hagaajiyey isagoo tan ugu daran maamuus badan siinaya,
english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

kikuyu: inaan jidhku qaybsanaan, laakiin in xubiniba xubinta kale u welwesho.
english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

kikuyu: Haddii xubin qudha xanuunsato, xubnaha oo dhammu way la xanuunsadaan. Haddii xubin la maamuuso, xubnaha oo dhammu way la farxaan.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad tihiin jidhka Masiix iyo xubno ka mid ah.
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

kikuyu: Ilaah markii hore kiniisadda qaar wuxuu uga dhigay rasuullo, markii labaadna qaar kale nebiyo, markii saddexaadna qaar kale macallimiin, dabadeedna qaar cajaa'ibyo sameeya, qaarna kuwo leh hadiyado wax lagu bogsiiyo, qaarna kaalmeeyayaal, qaarna taliyayaal, iyo qaar afaf kala cayn ah ku hadla.
english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

kikuyu: Dhammaan ma wada rasuullo baa? Dhammaan ma wada nebiyo baa? Dhammaan ma wada macallimiin baa? Dhammaan ma wada cajaa'ibyo sameeyayaal baa?
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

kikuyu: Dhammaan ma wada leeyihiin hadiyado wax lagu bogsiiyo? Dhammaan ma ku hadlaan afaf kala cayn ah? Dhammaan wax ma fasiraan?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

kikuyu: Laakiin aad u doona hadiyadaha u waaweyn. Oo weliba waxaan idin tusayaa jid kan ka sii wanaagsan.
english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

kikuyu: Haddaan ku hadlo afafka dadka iyo malaa'igaha, laakiinse aanan jacayl lahayn, waxaan noqday naxaas dhawaaqaysa ama saxan bir ah oo sanqadhaya oo kale.
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

kikuyu: Oo haddaan leeyahay hadiyadda wax sii sheegidda, oo aan garanayo waxyaalaha qarsoon oo dhan iyo aqoonta oo dhan, iyo haddaan leeyahay rumaysadka oo dhan oo aan buuraha ku dhaqaajiyo, laakiinse aanan jacayl lahayn, waxba ma ihi.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

kikuyu: Oo wax kastaan leeyahay haddaan bixiyo oo masaakiinta ku quudiyo, iyo haddaan jidhkayga bixiyo in la gubo, laakiinse aanan jacayl lahayn, waxba ii tari maayo.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

kikuyu: Jacaylku waa samir badan yahay, waana raxiim, jacaylku ninna ma xasdo, jacaylku ma faano, mana kibro,
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

kikuyu: wax aan u ekayn ma falo, nafsaddiisana wax uma doondoono, mana xanaaqo, sharna kuma fikiro,
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

kikuyu: xaqdarrada kuma farxo, laakiin wuxuu ku farxaa runta.
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

kikuyu: Wax walba wuu u dulqaataa, wax walba wuu rumaystaa, wax walba wuu rajeeyaa, wax walba wuu u adkaystaa.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

kikuyu: Jacaylku weligii ma idlaado. Hadday wax sii sheegiddii jirto, way baabbi'i doontaa, hadday afaf jiraan way dhammaan doonaan, hadday aqooni jirto way baabbi'i doontaa.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaynu naqaan waa qabyo, oo si qabyo ahaan ah ayaynu wax u sii sheegnaa.
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

kikuyu: Laakiin markii waxa dhammi ay yimaadaan, waxa qabyada ahi way idlaan doonaan.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

kikuyu: Markaan ilmo yar ahaan jiray, sidii ilmo oo kale ayaan u hadli jiray, sidii ilmo oo kale ayaan wax u garan jiray, sidii ilmo oo kale ayaan u fikiri jiray, laakiinse haatan waxaan noqday nin weyn, oo waxyaalihii carruurnimada waan iska fogeeyey.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

kikuyu: Haatan si aan caddaan ahayn ayaynu muraayad wax ugu aragnaa, laakiin markaas ka fool ka fool ayaynu wax u arki doonnaa. Hadda si qabyo ahaan ah ayaan wax u garanayaa, laakiin markaas waxaan u garan doonaa sidii la ii gartay.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

kikuyu: Haddabase waxa waaraa waa saddexdan, rumaysad iyo rajo iyo jacayl; laakiin kuwan waxaa ugu wada weyn jacayl.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

kikuyu: Jacaylka raaca, oo weliba hadiyadaha Ruuxa ka yimaada aad u doona, oo siiba doona inaad wax sii sheegtaan.
english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii af uusan aqoon ku hadlaa, lama hadlo dadka, wuxuuse la hadlaa Ilaah, waayo, ninna ma garto; laakiin Ruuxa ayaa waxyaalaha qarsoon kaga dhex hadliya.
english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

kikuyu: Laakiin kii wax sii sheegaa wuxuu dadka kula hadlaa hadallo wax dhisa oo gargaar iyo qalbiqaboojis leh.
english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

kikuyu: Kii af uusan aqoon ku hadlaa wuu isdhisaa, laakiin kii wax sii sheegaa wuxuu dhisaa kiniisadda.
english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad dhammaantiin afaf ku wada hadashaan, laakiin waxaan ka sii jeclaan lahaa inaad wax sii sheegtaan. Kii afaf ku hadlaa hadduusan fasirin, waxaa ka sii weyn kii wax sii sheega, si ay kiniisaddu u hesho wax ay ku dhisanto.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadda, walaalayaalow, haddaan idiin imaado, anigoo afaf ku hadlaya, maxaan idiin tari doonaa, haddaanan idinkula hadlin muujin ama aqoon ama wax sii sheegid ama waxbarid?
english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

kikuyu: Xataa waxyaalo aan naf lahayni markay dhawaaqaan, ha ahaadeen ama biibiile ama kataarad, haddaanay dhawaaqa kala soocin, sidee baa loo kala garanayaa waxa la yeedhiyo ama waxa kataaradda laga dhawaajiyo?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

kikuyu: Hadduu buunku ku dhawaaqo cod aan la kala garan, yaa dagaal isu diyaargarayn doona?
english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

kikuyu: Sidaasoo kalena idinku markaad af ku hadashaan haddaydnan ku hadlin hadal la garto, sidee baa loo garanayaa waxa lagu hadlayo? Waayo, dabayshaad la hadlaysaan.
english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

kikuyu: Mindhaa waxaa dunida jira codad badan oo kala cayn ah, oo mid aan micne lahayni ma jiro.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaanan garanaynin micnaha codka, waxaan kii hadlaya u ahaan doonaa nin qalaad, kan hadlayaana nin qalaad ayuu ii ahaan doonaa.
english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

kikuyu: Sidaasoo kale idinkuna, idinkoo ku kulul hadiyadaha ruuxa, aad u dadaala inaad hadiyado badan u lahaataan kiniisadda dhisniinteeda.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed kii af ku hadlaa, Ilaah ha ka baryo si uu u fasiro.
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaan Ilaah af aanan oqoon ku baryo, ruuxayga ayaa barya, laakiin garashadaydu faa'iido ma leh.
english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

kikuyu: Maxaa jira haddaba? Ruuxa ayaan Ilaah ku baryi doonaa, laakiin waxaan kaloo isaga ku baryi doonaa garashada. Ruuxa ayaan ku heesi doonaa, oo garashadana waan ku heesi doonaa.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

kikuyu: Haddii kale haddaad ruuxa ku ducaysid, kii meesha jooga oo aan garanaynin, sidee buu u odhan doonaa, Aamiin, markaad mahadnaqaysid, hadduusan garanaynin waxaad leedahay?
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

kikuyu: Si wanaagsan baad u mahadnaqdaa, laakiin kan kale ma dhisna.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

kikuyu: Waxaan Ilaah ugu mahadnaqayaa inaan afaf ku hadlo intaad dhammaantiin ku hadashaan in ka badan,
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

kikuyu: laakiin kiniisadda dhexdeeda, meeshii aan toban kun oo eray af kaga hadli lahaa, waxaan ka jeclaan lahaa inaan shan eray garashadayda ku hadlo inaan kuwa kalena wax baro.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, carruur ha ka noqonina xagga maanka, xagga xumaantase dhallaan ka ahaada, laakiin xagga maanka dad waaweyn ka ahaada.
english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

kikuyu: Waxaa sharciga ku qoran, Waxaan dadkan kula hadli doonaa afaf qalaad iyo bushimo dad kale, oo xataa sidaa daraaddeed ima maqli doonaan, ayuu Rabbigu leeyahay.
english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

kikuyu: Haddaba afafku calaamo uma aha kuwa rumaysta ee waxay calaamo u yihiin kuwa aan rumaysan, wax sii sheegidduse calaamo uma aha kuwa aan rumaysan, laakiin waxay calaamo u tahay kuwa rumaysta.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii kiniisadda oo dhammu isu timaado, oo ay ku wada hadlaan afaf, oo haddii dad aan garanaynin ama aan rumaysanayni soo galaan, miyaanay odhanaynin, Waad waalan tihiin?
english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

kikuyu: Laakiin hadday dhammaantood wax sii sheegaan oo uu u yimaado mid aan rumaysanayn ama aan garanaynini, isaga waa la wada canaantaa, oo la wada xukumaa.
english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

kikuyu: Waxyaalaha qarsoon ee qalbigiisa waa la muujiyaa, oo taa aawadeed wejigiisuu u dhici doonaa oo Ilaah ayuu caabudi doonaa isagoo odhanaya, Runtii Ilaah waa idin dhex joogaa.
english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

kikuyu: Maxaa jira haddaba, walaalayaalow? Markaad isu timaadaan, mid kasta hees sabuur ah buu leeyahay, midna waxbarid buu leeyahay, midna muujin buu leeyahay, midna af buu leeyahay, midna fasiraad buu leeyahay. Wax walba ha loo sameeyo dhisniin.
english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

kikuyu: Haddii nin uun af ku hadlo, ha ahaadeen laba, ama hadday u bataan, saddex, oo midba markiisa ha hadlo, midna ha fasiro,
english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

kikuyu: laakiin haddaan mid fasiraa jirin, kiniisadda ha ka aamusnaado, oo isagu ha la hadlo qudhiisa iyo Ilaah.
english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

kikuyu: Nebiyadana laba ama saddex ha hadleen, kuwa kalena ha kala xukumeen waxay leeyihiin.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii wax loo muujiyo mid ag fadhiya, kii hore ha aamuso.
english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhammaantiin mid mid baad wax u sii wada sheegi kartaan, si ay dhammaan wax u bartaan oo dhammaan loogu wada gargaaro.
english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

kikuyu: Oo ruuxyada nebiyadu waa ka dambeeyaan nebiyada.
english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah ma aha Ilaaha iskuqasnaanta, laakiin waa kan nabadda. Kiniisadaha quduusiinta oo dhan dhexdoodana waa sidaas oo kale.
english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

kikuyu: Dumarku markay kiniisadaha joogaan ha aamuseen, waayo, looma fasixin inay hadlaan; laakiin ha dambeeyeen, sida uu sharcigu leeyahay.
english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

kikuyu: Hadday doonayaan inay wax bartaan, nimankooda ha ku weyddiiyeen guriga, maxaa yeelay, waa ku ceeb naag inay kiniisadda dhexdeeda ku hadasho.
english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

kikuyu: Maxaa jira! Ma idinkay ahaayeen kuwii uu ereyga Ilaah ka soo baxay, mise keligiin buu idiin yimid?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

kikuyu: Nin uun hadduu isu maleeyo inuu nebi yahay, ama mid Ruuxa raaca, ha garto waxyaalahaan idiin soo qorayo inay yihiin qaynuunka Rabbiga.
english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

kikuyu: Nin uuni hadduusan ogayn tan, isagana lama yaqaan.
english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

kikuyu: Taa aawadeed, walaalahayow, ku dadaala inaad wax sii sheegtaan, hana diidina in afaf lagu hadlo,
english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

kikuyu: laakiin wax walba ha loo sameeyo si habboon oo hagaagsan.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waxaan idin ogeysiinayaa injiilka aan idinku wacdiyey, oo aad idinkuna aqbasheen, oo aad ku taagan tihiin,
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

kikuyu: oo aadna ku badbaaddeen, haddaad xajisaan hadalkii aan idinku wacdiyey, haddaydnan micnela'aan u rumaysan.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

kikuyu: Waayo, markii ugu horraysay waxaan idiin dhiibay waxaan aniguba helay, oo waxa weeye, Masiixu wuxuu u dhintay dembiyadeenna sida Qorniinku leeyahay,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: waa la aasay isaga, oo maalintii saddexaad ayaa la sara kiciyey, sida Qorniinku leeyahay.
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: Markaasuu Keeyfas u muuqday, markii dambena laba iyo tobankii.
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

kikuyu: Markaasuu wuxuu mar keliya u muuqday kuwo ka badan shan boqol oo walaalo ah, kuwo weli intoodii badnayd ay hadda joogto, laakiin qaar baa dhintay.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

kikuyu: Gortaasuu Yacquub u muuqday, markaas rasuullada oo dhan.
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

kikuyu: Markii ugu dambaysayna aniga oo dhicis oo kale ah, ayuu ii muuqday.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

kikuyu: Waayo, anigu waxaan ahay kan rasuullada u liita oo aan istaahilin in loogu yeedho rasuul, waayo, kiniisadda Ilaah baan silcin jiray.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah nimcadiisa ayaan ku ahay waxaan ahayba, oo nimcadiisii lay siiyeyna wax aan waxtar lahayn ma ay noqon, laakiin anigu waxaan u hawshooday si ka badan dhammaantood, anigase ma aha laakiin waa nimcada Ilaah ee ila jirtay.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

kikuyu: Haddaba ha ahaato aniga ama iyaga, sidaasaannu u wacdinnaa oo idinna u rumaysateen.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

kikuyu: Haddii dadka lagu wacdiyey in Masiixa kuwii dhintay laga sara kiciyey, sidee baa qaarkiin u yidhaahdaa, Sarakicidda kuwii dhintay ma jirto?
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

kikuyu: Haddaanay jirin sarakicidda kuwii dhintay, Masiixana lama sara kicin.
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

kikuyu: Oo haddaan Masiixa la sara kicin, markaas wacdigayagu waa khasaare, rumaysadkiinnuna waa khasaare.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

kikuyu: Waxaa la arkayaa inaannu markhaatiyaal been ah ka nahay xagga Ilaah, waayo, waxaannu u marag furnay inuu Masiixa sara kiciyey, kan aanu sara kicin haddii aan kuwii dhintay la sara kicin.
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

kikuyu: Haddii aan kuwii dhintay la sara kicin, Masiixana lama sara kicin.
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

kikuyu: Oo haddii aan Masiixa la sara kicin, rumaysadkiinnu waa khasaare, oo weli dembiyadiinna ayaad ku jirtaan.
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

kikuyu: Oo weliba kuwii Masiixa rumaysnaa oo dhintayna, way halligmeen.
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

kikuyu: Haddaynu noloshan oo keliya Masiix ku rajayn lahayn, waxaynu ahaan lahayn kuwa u liita dadka loo naxo oo dhan.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan Masiixa ayaa kuwii dhintay laga sara kiciyey, isagoo ah midhaha ugu horreeya ee kuwa dhintay.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

kikuyu: Dhimashadu nin bay ku timid, saas aawadeed sarakicidda kuwii dhintayna nin bay ku timid.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

kikuyu: Siday dhammaan Aadan ugu wada dhintaan, sidaas oo kalaa dhammaan Masiixa loogu wada noolayn doonaa,
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

kikuyu: laakiin mid kasta markiisa, Masiixa midhaha ugu horreeya, markaas kuwa Masiixana wakhtiga imaatinkiisa.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

kikuyu: Markaasaa dhammaadku iman doonaa, markuu isagu boqortooyada u dhiibi doono Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, markuu baabbi'iyo madax walba iyo amar walba iyo xoog walba dabadeed.
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

kikuyu: Waayo, waa inuu wax xukumo ilaa uu cadaawayaashiisa oo dhan cagihiisa hoostooda geliyo.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

kikuyu: Oo cadaawaha ugu dambeeya ee la baabbi'in doonaa waa dhimasho.
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

kikuyu: Waayo, Wax walba cagihiisa hoostooduu geliyey. Laakiin markuu yidhaahdo, Wax walba waa la hoos geliyey, way cad dahay in laga reebay kan wax walba hoostiisa geliyey.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

kikuyu: Markii wax walba la hoos geliyo isaga, markaas ayaa Wiilka qudhiisana la hoos gelin doonaa kan wax walba hoos geliyey isaga, inuu Ilaah wax walba u ahaado dhammaan.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

kikuyu: Haddii kale maxay samayn doonaan kuwa loo baabtiisay kuwii dhintay? Haddii aan kuwii dhintay la sara kicinba, maxaa haddana loogu baabtiisaa iyaga?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

kikuyu: Maxaynu saacad walba haalis ugu jirnaa?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

kikuyu: Faanka aan idiin qabo xagga Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ayaan ku caddaynayaa, walaalayaalow, inaan maalin walba dhinto.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

kikuyu: Haddii aan sida dadka dugaag ugu la dagaallamay Efesos, maxay ii taraysaa? Haddii aan kuwii dhintay la sara kicin, aynu wax cunno oo cabno, waayo, berrito waynu dhiman doonnaaye.
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

kikuyu: Yaan laydin khiyaanayn, kuwa xun lasocodkoodu waa halleeya asluubta wanaagsan.
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

kikuyu: Si qumman u toosa oo hana dembaabina, waayo, qaar baan Ilaahba aqoonin. Waxaan taas u leeyahay inaan idinka xishoodsiiyo.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

kikuyu: Laakiin mid baa odhan doona, Sidee baa kuwii dhintay loo sara kiciyaa? Oo jidh caynkee ah bay ku yimaadaan?
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

kikuyu: Doqon yahow, waxaad adigu beertid ma noolaado haddaanu dhiman.
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad beertidba ma beertid jidhka noqonaya, laakiin iniintoo qudha, ha ahaato iniin sarreen ah, ama iniin cayn kale ah.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah wuxuu iyada siiyaa jidh siduu u doonayay, iniin kastana jidhkeeda.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

kikuyu: Hilib oo dhammu isku hilib ma aha, laakiin waxaa jira hilibka dadka iyo hilibka kaloo dugaagga, iyo hilibka kaloo shimbirraha, iyo hilibka kaloo kalluunka.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa jira jidhadhka samada iyo jidhadhka dhulka, laakiin ammaanta kuwa samadu waa mid, oo tan kuwa dhulkuna waa mid kale.
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

kikuyu: Waxaa jirta ammaanta qorraxda iyo ammaanta kaloo dayaxa iyo ammaanta kaloo xiddigaha, waayo, xiddiguba xiddigta kale way ka ammaan duwan tahay.
english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

kikuyu: Sarakicidda kuwii dhintayna waa sidaas oo kale. Waxaa lagu beeraa qudhun, waxaana lagu sara kiciyaa qudhunla'aan.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

kikuyu: Waxaa lagu beeraa maamuusla'aan, waxaana lagu sara kiciyaa ammaan, waxaa lagu beeraa itaaldarro, waxaa lagu sara kiciyaana xoog.
english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

kikuyu: Waxaa la beeraa jidh naf leh, waxaana la sara kiciyaa jidh ruux leh. Hadduu jiro jidh naf leh, jidh ruux lihina waa jiraa.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa qoran, Aadan oo ahaa ninkii ugu horreeyey wuxuu noqday naf nool, Aadankii ugu dambeeyeyse wuxuu noqday ruux wax nooleeya.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

kikuyu: Hase ahaatee, kan ruuxa lihi ma aha kii ugu horreeyey laakiin kan nafta leh, markaasna kan ruuxa leh.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

kikuyu: Ninkii ugu horreeyey waa kan dhulka oo cammuud ah, ninkii labaadna waa kan jannada.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

kikuyu: Sida kan cammuudda ah kuwa cammuud ahina waa sidaas oo kale, oo sida kan jannada, kuwa jannaduna waa sidaas oo kale.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

kikuyu: Oo sidaynu ugu eg nahay kan cammuudda ah, sidaas oo kale ayaynu ugu ekaan doonnaa kan jannada.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

kikuyu: Waxaan leeyahay, walaalayaalow, Jidhka iyo dhiiggu ma dhaxli karaan boqortooyada Ilaah. Qudhunkuna ma dhaxli karo qudhunla'aanta.
english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

kikuyu: Eega, waxaan idiin sheegayaa wax qarsoon. Dhammaanteen ma wada dhiman doonno, laakiin dhammaanteen waa layna beddeli doonaa,
english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

kikuyu: dhaqsiba, intaan il laysku qaban, markii buunka ugu dambeeya la yeedhiyo; waayo, buunku waa dhawaaqi doonaa oo kuwii dhintayna qudhunla'aan baa la sara kicin doonaa, waana layna beddeli doonaa.
english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

kikuyu: Waayo, kan qudhmayaa waa inuu gashado qudhunla'aanta, oo kan dhimanayaana waa inuu gashado dhimashola'aanta.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

kikuyu: Markii kan qudhmayaa uu gashado qudhunla'aanta, oo kan dhimanayaana uu gashado dhimashola'aanta, markaas hadalka qorani wuu noqon doonaa ee ah, Dhimashadii waxaa liqday libtii.
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

kikuyu: Dhimashoy, meeday libtaadii? Dhimashoy, meeday micidaadii?
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

kikuyu: Micida dhimashadu waa dembiga, oo xoogga dembiguna waa sharciga.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah baa mahad leh kan libta inagu siiya Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed, walaalahaygii aan jeclahayow, noqda kuwa adag, oo aan dhaqaaqayn, oo had iyo goorba shuqulka Rabbiga si aad ah u sameeya, idinkoo og hawshiinnu inayan khasaare ahayn xagga Rabbiga.
english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaan u amray kiniisadihii Galatiya, inay wax u ururshaan quduusiinta, idinkuna sidaas oo kale yeela.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

kikuyu: Maalinta ugu horraysa ee toddobaadka midkiin kastaa meel wax ha dhigo oo ha hayo wixii lagu barwaaqeeyey, si markaan imaado aan waxba loo ururin.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

kikuyu: Oo markaan imaado, kuwaad u bogteen ayaan warqado u dhiibi doonaa, oo waxaan u diri doonaa inay hadiyaddiinna Yeruusaalem geeyaan.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oo hadday ila noqoto inaan aniguna tago, way i raaci doonaan.
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

kikuyu: Markaan Makedoniya soo maro dabadeed ayaan idiin iman doonaa, waayo, Makedoniya waan soo marayaa.
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

kikuyu: Mindhaa cabbaar baan idinla joogi doonaa, xataa xilliga qabowga oo dhan, si aad iigu ambabbixisaan meel alla meeshaan tegi doono.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

kikuyu: Waayo, dooni maayo inaan hadda idin arko markaan sii socdo, maxaa yeelay, waxaan rajaynayaa inaan cabbaar idinla joogo, haddii Rabbigu idmo.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan sii joogayaa Efesos ilaa maalinta Bentekoste.
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa la ii furay albaab weyn oo shuqul ah, cadaawayaal badanina way jiraan.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

kikuyu: Timoteyos hadduu yimaado, dhawra, oo cabsila'aan ha idinkula joogo, waayo, wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa shuqulka Rabbiga sidayda oo kale.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

kikuyu: Haddaba ninna yuusan fududaysan isaga. Laakiin nabad ku soo ambabbixiya, ha ii yimaadee, waayo, waxaan filanayaa inuu walaalaha soo raaco.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

kikuyu: Xagga walaalka Abolloos aad baan u baryay isaga inuu walaalaha sii raaco oo idiin yimaado, laakiin raalli kama uu ahayn inuu haatan yimaado, laakiin wuu iman doonaa markuu nefis helo.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

kikuyu: Soo jeeda, iimaanka ku adkaada, rag ahaada, xoogooba.
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

kikuyu: Wax kastoo aad samaysaanba, jacayl ku sameeya.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waad garanaysaan kuwa guriga Istefanas jooga inay yihiin midhaha ugu horreeyey ee Akhaya iyo inay isu bixiyeen inay quduusiinta u adeegaan. Waxaan idinka baryayaa
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

kikuyu: inaad ka dambaysaan kuwaas oo kale iyo mid kasta oo la shaqeeya oo hawshooda.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku faraxsanahay imaatinka Istefanas iyo Fortunatos iyo Akhaykos, maxaa yeelay, wixii xaggiinna ka dhinnaa iyagaa dhammaystiray.
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

kikuyu: Waayo, ruuxayga iyo kiinnaba iyagaa nasiyey. Taa aawadeed aqoonsada kuwaas oo kale.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

kikuyu: Kiniisadaha Aasiya way idin soo salaamayaan. Akula iyo Bariskillana aad bay idiin soo salaamayaan xagga Rabbiga, iyaga iyo kiniisadda gurigooda ku taalba.
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

kikuyu: Walaalaha oo dhammu way idin soo salaamayaan. Isku salaama dhunkasho quduus ah.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah ayaan salaantan gacantayda ku qorayaa.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

kikuyu: Qof uun hadduusan Rabbiga jeclayn, ha inkaarnaado. Rabbigeennu waa imanayaa.
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

kikuyu: Nimcada Rabbi Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

kikuyu: Dhammaantiin jacaylkaygu ha idinla jiro xagga Ciise Masiix. Aamiin.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

kikuyu: Bawlos oo rasuulkii Ciise Masiix ku ah doonista Ilaah, iyo walaalkeen Timoteyos waxaannu warqaddan u qoraynaa kiniisadda Ilaah oo Korintos ku taal iyo kulli quduusiinta Akhaya oo dhan jooga.
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

kikuyu: Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waxaa barako leh Ilaaha ah Aabbaha Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, oo ah Aabbaha naxariista leh iyo Ilaaha gargaarka oo dhan,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

kikuyu: kan naga gargaara dhibtayada oo dhan inaannu kuwa dhib kasta ku jira ugu gargaari karno gargaarka Ilaah nagu gargaaray.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

kikuyu: Waayo, sida xanuunsigii Masiixu uu noogu badan yahay, sidaas oo kalena gargaarkayagu xagga Masiix wuu noogu badan yahay.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

kikuyu: Haddii lana dhibo waa gargaarkiinna iyo badbaadintiinna aawadood; haddii lana gargaarona waa gargaarkiinna aawadiis kaasoo yeesha dulqaadashada aannu ku dulqaadanno isku xanuunsiga aannu annaguna ku xanuunsanno.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

kikuyu: Oo rajadayada aannu idiin qabnaa waa hubaal, annagoo garanayna inaad tihiin kuwo xanuunsiga qayb ku leh, sidaas oo kalena waxaad tihiin kuwo gargaarka qayb ku leh.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, dooni mayno inaad ka garaad la'aataan waxa ku saabsan dhibtayada ee xagga Aasiya nagaga dhacday, in hoos aad lanoogu celiyey si xooggayaga dhaafsiisan, sidaas aawadeed ayaannu xataa nolosha uga quusannay.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

kikuyu: Laakiin annaga qudhayadu waxaannu naftayada ku haysannay xukunka dhimashada, inaannan naftayada isku hallayn, laakiin inaannu Ilaah isku hallayno kan sara kiciya kuwii dhintay.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

kikuyu: Isagaa naga samatabbixiyey dhimasho saas u weyn, wuuna na samatabbixin doonaa, kan aannu rajaynayno inuu weliba na samatabbixin doono;
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

kikuyu: idinkoo nagu wada kaalmaynaya baryadaad noo baridaan, in barakada lana siiyey kuwa badan daraaddood, dad badan ay ku mahadnaqaan aawadayo.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

kikuyu: Waxaannu ku faanaynaa, qalbigayaguna marag furayaa, inaannu dunida ugu soconnay quduusnimo iyo daacadnimo xagga Ilaah, ee uguma aan socon xigmadda jidhka laakiinse nimcada Ilaah, oo khusuusan xaggiinna.
english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

kikuyu: Wax kale idiin soo qori mayno waxaad akhridaan oo aad garanaysaan mooyaane, oo waanan rajaynayaa inaad sii garan doontaan ilaa dhammaadka.
english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

kikuyu: Sidaad si ahaan noogu garateen inaannu faankiinna nahay, sidaas oo kale idinkuna kayagaad tihiin maalinta Rabbigeenna Ciise.
english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Hubaalkaas daraaddiis ayaan doonayay inaan horta idiin imaado inaad barako labaad haysataan;
english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

kikuyu: iyo inaan idin sii maro ilaa Makedoniya, oo haddana aan Makedoniya ka imaado oo aan idinku soo noqdo, idinkuna inaad xagga Yahuudiya ii ambabbixisaan.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
