kikuyu: Haddaba markaan waxaas doonayay miyaan rogrogay? Ama waxaan goosto miyaan u goostaa sida uu ninka jidhka raacaa u goosto, inay xaggayga noqoto, Haah, haah, iyo Maya, maya?
english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

kikuyu: Laakiin sida uu Ilaah aamin u yahay, hadalkayagu xaggiinna ma aha, Haah, iyo Maya.
english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

kikuyu: Waayo, Wiilka Ilaah oo ah Ciise Masiix, ee aannu aniga iyo Silwanos iyo Timoteyos dhexdiinna kaga wacdinnay, ma ahayn Haah iyo Maya, laakiin xaggiisa waa Haah.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

kikuyu: Waayo, in kastoo ay badan yihiin ballamadii Ilaah, waxaa isaga xaggiisa ku jira, Haahda, oo weliba xaggiisa waxaa ku jira, Aamiinta, in xaggeenna Ilaah laga ammaano.
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

kikuyu: Laakiin kan ina wada xoogeeya xagga Masiixa oo ina subkay waa Ilaah,
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

kikuyu: kan haddana ina shaabadeeyey oo carbuunta Ruuxa inagu siiyey qalbigeenna.
english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah baan markhaati ugu yeedhayaa xagga naftayda, waxaan Korintos u iman waayay inaan idiin tudho.
english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

kikuyu: Ma aha inaannu sayid u ahaanno rumaysadkiinna, laakiin waxaannu nahay kuwa idinla wada shaqeeya farxaddiinna aawadeed, waayo, rumaysad ayaad ku taagan tihiin.
english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan aniga qudhaydu goostay inaanan haddana caloolxumo idiinla imanin.
english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaan idin calool xumeeyo, waa kee kan iga farxinayaa kii aan calool xumeeyey maahee?
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

kikuyu: Waxakan ayaan u qoray inaanan markaan imaado ka calool xumaan kuwa aan ku farxi lahaa, anigoo idinku aaminsan dhammaantiin inay farxaddaydu tahay farxadda kulligiin.
english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhib badan iyo silica qalbiga ayaan idinku soo qoray anigoo aad u ilmaynaya, oo ma aha inaad calool xumaataan, laakiin inaad garataan jacaylka aad u sii badan ee aan idiin qabo.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

kikuyu: Laakiin mid uuni hadduu qof calool xumeeyey, aniga ima uu calool xumayn, laakiin dhammaantiin buu si ahaan idiin calool xumeeyey; dooni maayo inaan idin culaysiyo.
english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

kikuyu: Taqsiirtan kuwa badani ay saareen way ku filan tahay kaasoo kale.
english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

kikuyu: Laakiinse waa inaad isaga cafidaan oo u gargaartaan inaanay sina caloolxumo aad u badani liqin kaasoo kale.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed waxaan idinka baryayaa inaad jacaylkiinna u caddaysaan isaga.
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

kikuyu: Waayo, taa aawadeed ayaan u qoray inaan idin imtixaamo inaad wax walba ku dhega nugushihiin iyo in kale.
english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

kikuyu: Kii aad wax ka cafidaan, aniguna waan ka cafiyaa: waxaan anigu ka cafiyeyna, haddaan wax ka cafiyey, waxaan uga cafiyey aawadiin Masiix hortiisa,
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

kikuyu: inaan Shayddaan inaga faa'iidaysan, waayo, innagu ma nihin kuwo jaahil ka ah xeeladdiisa.
english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

kikuyu: Markaan Taroo'as imid inaan injiilka Masiix kaga wacdiyo, ee uu Rabbigu irid iga furay,
english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

kikuyu: ruuxaygu ma nasan, waayo, ma aan helin walaalkay Tiitos, laakiin iyagaan nabadgelyeeyey oo Makedoniyaan u kacay.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa mahad leh kan had iyo goorba libta inagu siiya Masiix, oo meel walba udgoonka aqoontiisa gaadhsiiya, ee innaga inaga gaadhsiiya.
english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaynu Ilaah u nahay udgoonka Masiix xagga kuwa badbaadaya iyo kuwa lumayaba;
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

kikuyu: kuwa dambe udgoonka xagga dhimasho ilaa dhimasho, kuwa kalena udgoonka xagga nolol ilaa nolol. Oo yaa ku filan waxyaalahan?
english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

kikuyu: Waayo, innagu la mid ma nihin kuwa badan ee ereyga Ilaah ka baayacmushtara, laakiin sida kuwa daacadda ah iyo kuwa Ilaah ayaynu Masiix ugu hadallaa Ilaah hortiisa.
english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

kikuyu: Miyaannu bilaabaynaa inaannu haddana is-ammaanno? Ama miyaannu u baahan nahay warqado ammaan ah in laydiin diro ama in laydiinka soo diro sida qaar kale?
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad tihiin warqaddayada ee qalbigayaga ku qoran, tan ay dadka oo dhammu garanayaan oo akhriyaan,
english: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

kikuyu: idinkoo muuqanaya inaad tihiin warqadda Masiixa ee ah taannu ka adeegnay, ee aan khad lagu qorin, laakiinse lagu qoray Ruuxa Ilaaha nool, oo aan lagu qorin looxyo dhagax ah dushood laakiin lagu qoray looxyo qalbiyo jiidh ah dushood.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

kikuyu: Hubaalkan oo kale ayaannu Masiix ku leennahay xaggii Ilaah;
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

kikuyu: ma aha inaannu isku filan nahay inaannu wax ka tashanno xagga qudhayada, laakiin iskufillaantayadu waa xagga Ilaah,
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

kikuyu: kan haddana naga dhigay kuwa ku filan inaannu ka adeegno axdiga cusub, ma aha xagga qorniinka, laakiin xagga ruuxa, waayo, qorniinku wax buu dilaa, laakiin ruuxu wax buu nooleeyaa.
english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

kikuyu: Laakiin adeegidda dhimashada keentaa ee qorniin lagu xardhay dhagaxyo, hadday ammaan la ahaatay, si aan reer binu Israa'iil u karin inay Muuse wejigiisa aad u eegaan ammaanta wejigiisa aawadeed ee ah tan idlaanaysa,
english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

kikuyu: sidaanay u ahayn adeegidda ruuxa inay la ahaan doonto ammaan?
english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

kikuyu: Waayo, hadday adeegidda xukunka keentaa ammaan ahayd, adeegidda xaqnimada keentaa aad bay uga ammaan badan tahay.
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

kikuyu: Waayo, wixii ammaan lahaan jiray, ammaan kama lahayn wixii kan ku saabsan, ammaanta ka sarraysa aawadeed.
english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii waxa idlaanayaa ammaan lahaan jiray, intee ka badan baa waxa hadhaa ammaan leeyahay.
english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

kikuyu: Haddaba rajo caynkaas ah oo aannu leennahay aawadeed bayaan ayaannu u hadalnaa.
english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

kikuyu: Ma nihin sida Muuse, kan indho shareertay inaan reer binu Israa'iil aad u eegin dhammaadka tan idlaanaysay.
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

kikuyu: Laakiin fikirradoodii way adkaadeen. Waayo, tan iyo maalintaas markii axdiga hore la akhriyo, indho shareerkaas ayaa hadha isagoo aan laga saarin, kan xagga Masiix ka idlaaday.
english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

kikuyu: Laakiin tan iyo maalintaas mar alla markii Muuse wax laga akhriyo dabool ayaa qalbigooda saaran.
english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

kikuyu: Laakiin mar alla markii loo soo leexdo Rabbiga daboolka waa laga qaadaa.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa Ruuxa, oo meeshii Ruuxa Rabbigu joogana, waxaa jira xorriyad.
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

kikuyu: Laakiin dhammaanteen innagoo aan indho shareernayn, ammaanta Rabbiga ayaynu arkaynaa sidii oo muraayad lagu arko, oo isu-ekaanta ayaa laynoo roogayaa, ammaan ilaa ammaan, sida tan xagga Rabbiga Ruuxa ah ka timaada.
english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed sida lanoogu naxariistay, annagoo haysanna adeegiddan, qalbi jabi mayno;
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

kikuyu: laakiin waxaannu diidnay waxyaalihii qarsoonaa oo ceebta ahaa, annagoo aan sirta ku soconaynin ama aan ereyga Ilaah qalloocinaynin, laakiin muujinta runta ayaannu niyada dadka oo dhan isugu bognaa Ilaah hortiisa.
english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Laakiin injiilkayagu hadduu daboolan yahay, wuxuu ka daboolan yahay kuwa lumaya.
english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

kikuyu: Ilaaha wakhtigani wuu ka indho tiray maanka kuwa aan rumaysanaynin, inaan iftiinka injiilka ee ammaanta Masiix, kan ah u-ekaanta Ilaah, uu ifin iyaga.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

kikuyu: Waayo, annaga qudhayadu idinkuma wacdinno wax nagu saabsan, laakiin waxaannu idinku wacdinnaa wax ku saabsan Ciise Masiix oo Rabbiga ah, iyo annagoo ah addoommadiinna Ciise aawadiis.
english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

kikuyu: Waayo, waa Ilaah kan yidhi, Iftiin ha ka ifo gudcur, kan qalbiyadeenna uga ifay inuu iftiinka aqoonta ammaanta Ilaah inaga siiyo Ciise Masiix wejigiisa.
english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiin khasnaddan ayaannu ku haysannaa weelal dhoobo ah in xoogga weynaantiisa ay ka ahaato xaggii Ilaah ee aanay xaggayaga ka ahaan.
english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

kikuyu: Wax walba waa lanagu dhibay, laakiin lanama cidhiidhiyin, waannu qalbi walaacnay, laakiin ma aannu quusan,
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

kikuyu: waa lana silciyey, laakiin lanama dayrin, hoos baa lanoo tuuray, laakiin lanama baabbi'in.
english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

kikuyu: Mar walba jidhkaannu ku sidnaa dhimashada Ciise in haddana nolosha Ciise ay jidhkayaga ka muuqato.
english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

kikuyu: Waayo, annagoo nool waxaa weligayo lanoo bixiyaa dhimasho Ciise aawadiis, in haddana nolosha Ciise ka muuqato jidhkayaga dhimanaya.
english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed annaga dhimashadu way naga dhex shaqaysaa, laakiin noloshu idinkay idinka dhex shaqaysaa.
english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

kikuyu: Waxaannu leennahay isku ruuxa ee rumaysadka, sida qoran, waan rumaystay, taas aawadeed ayaan u hadlay; annaguna waan rumaysannaa, taas aawadeedna waannu u hadallaa.
english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

kikuyu: Waannu garanaynaa in kan sara kiciyey Rabbi Ciise uu inala sara kicin doono Ciise, oo hortiisuu ina wada keeni doonaa idinka iyo annagaba.
english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

kikuyu: Waayo, wax waliba waa aawadiin, in nimcada kuwa badan ku badanu ay mahad u badiso xagga ammaanta Ilaah.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed qalbi jabi mayno, laakiin in kastoo ninkayaga dibadda ahu uu kharribmayo, weliba kayaga gudaha ahu maalin kastuu cusboonaanayaa.
english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhibtayada fudud ee wakhtiga yar ah ayaa aad iyo aad noogu sii yeesha culayska ammaanta ee weligiis ah.
english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

kikuyu: Ma fiirsanno waxyaalaha la arko, laakiin waxyaalaha aan la arkin, waayo, waxyaalaha la arko in dhawr ah ayay sii joogaan, laakiin waxyaalaha aan la arkini weligood bay sii joogaan.
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaynu og nahay, haddii gurigeenna dhulka ee taambuug ahu uu dumo, inaynu Ilaah xaggiisa ku leennahay dhismo, mana aha guri gacmo lagu sameeyey, waase mid jannooyinka weligii ku jira.
english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

kikuyu: Kan baynu ku dhex taahnaa innagoo u xiisoonayna inaynu huwanno rugteenna xagga jannada ah.
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

kikuyu: Haddii aynu huwan nahay laynama heli doono innagoo qaawan.
english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

kikuyu: Haddaba kuweenna taambuuggan ku jiraa waynu taahnaa, innagoo layna culaysiyey, ma aha inaynu doonayno in layna qaawiyo, laakiin in layna huwiyo, si ay noloshu u liqdo waxa dhimanaya.
english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, kan waxakan inoo sameeyey waa Ilaah, kan carbuunta Ruuxa ina siiyey.
english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

kikuyu: Haddaba mar walba waynu kalsoon nahay innagoo og in intaynu jidhka ku jirno aynu Rabbiga ka maqan nahay,
english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

kikuyu: waayo, waxaynu ku soconnaa rumaysadka ee ma aha aragga.
english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

kikuyu: Waynu kalsoon nahay, oo waxaynu ka jecel nahay inaynu jidhka ka maqnaanno oo aynu Rabbiga la joogno.
english: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed haddaynu joogno iyo haddaynu maqnaannoba aad baynu u doonaynaa inaynu isaga ka farxinno.
english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhammaanteen waa in layna wada muujiyo kursiga xukumaadda ee Masiix hortiisa, in qof kastaa helo siday ahaayeen waxyaalihii uu jidhka ku falay, ha ahaadeen wanaag ama share.
english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed annagoo garanayna cabsida Rabbiga, ayaannu dadka aaminsiinnaa; laakiin Ilaah waannu u muuqannaa, waana rajaynaynaa inaannu qalbiyadiinnana u muuqanno.
english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

kikuyu: Annagu haddana isu kiin ammaani mayno, laakiin waxaannu idin siinaynaa waxaad aawadayo ku faantaan, inaad lahaataan waxaad ugu jawaabtaan kuwa wejiga ku faana ee aan qalbiga ku faanin.
english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, haddii aannu waalan nahay waa Ilaah aawadiis, haddii aannu miyir qabnona waa aawadiin.
english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

kikuyu: Waayo, jacaylka Masiix ayaa na qasba, annagoo tan xisaabna inuu mid dhammaan u dhintay, sidaa daraaddeed ayay dhammaan dhinteen.
english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu u dhintay dhammaan in kuwa nooli aanay u sii noolaan nafsaddooda laakiin ay u sii noolaadaan kan aawadood u dhintay oo u sara kacay.
english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

kikuyu: Taa aawadeed tan iyo haddeer ninna jidhka ku garan mayno, in kastoo aannu Masiix jidhka ku garan jirnay, haddase isaga sidaas u sii garan mayno.
english: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed haddii qof Masiix ku jiro waa abuur cusub, oo waxyaalihii hore way idlaadeen, bal eega, wax waliba way cusboonaadeene.
english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

kikuyu: Laakiin wax waliba waa xagga Ilaah kan inagula heshiiyey Masiix, oo na siiyey adeegidda heshiisnimada,
english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

kikuyu: taas waxa weeye, Ilaah duniduu Masiix kula heshiiyey, isagoo aan dembiyadooda ku xisaabaynin, oo noo dhiibay hadalka heshiisnimada.
english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ergo ayaannu u nahay Masiix aawadiis, sidii Ilaah oo idinka baryaya xaggayaga, Masiix aawadiis waxaannu idinku baraynaa, Ilaah la heshiiya.
english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

kikuyu: Wuxuu isaga oo aan dembi aqoonin ka dhigay inuu dembi noqdo aawadeen, inaynu noqonno xaqnimada Ilaah ee ku jirta isaga.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Annagoo la shaqaynayna Ilaah waxaannu idinka baryaynaa inaydnaan micnela'aan u qaadan nimcadii Ilaah,
english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

kikuyu: waayo, wuxuu leeyahay, Wakhti la aqbalay ayaan ku dhegaystay, Oo maalintii badbaadintana ayaan ku caawiyey. Bal eeg, hadda waa wakhtigii la aqbalay; bal eeg, hadda waa maalintii badbaadinta.
english: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

kikuyu: Annagu ninna wax uu ku turunturoodo uma dhigno, si aan adeegiddayada waxba looga sheegin.
english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

kikuyu: Laakiin sida midiidinyada Ilaah ayaannu wax walba isugu caddaynaynaa dulqaadasho badan, annagoo ku dhex jirna dhibaatooyin, iyo baahi, iyo cidhiidhiyo,
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

kikuyu: iyo karbaashyo, iyo xabsiyo, iyo rabshooyin, iyo hawlo, iyo soo jeedid, iyo soomid,
english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

kikuyu: annagoo isku caddaynayna daahirnimo, iyo aqoon, iyo samir, iyo roonaan, iyo Ruuxa Quduuskaa, iyo jacayl aan labaweji lahayn,
english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

kikuyu: iyo hadalka runtaa, iyo xoogga Ilaah, iyo hubka xaqnimada ee midigta iyo bidixdaba,
english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

kikuyu: haddii lana maamuuso iyo haddii lana maamuus jebiyoba, haddii war xun lanaga sheego, iyo haddii war wanaagsan lanaga sheegoba, sida annagoo ah khaa'inno laakiin kuwa runta ah;
english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

kikuyu: sida kuwo aan la garanaynin laakiin la yaqaan, sida kuwo dhimanaya, laakiin bal eeg, waannu nool nahaye, sida kuwo la edbiyo, laakiin aan dhimasho la gaadhsiin,
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

kikuyu: sida kuwo la calool xumeeyey, laakiin weli had iyo goorba farxa, sida masaakiin, laakiin dad badan hodansiiya, sida kuwo aan waxba haysanin laakiin wax walba leh.
english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

kikuyu: Afkayagu waa idiin furan yahay, idinka dadka Korintosow, qalbigayaguna si weyn buu idiinku furan yahay.
english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

kikuyu: Annagu idinma aannan cidhiidhiyin, laakiin waxaa idin cidhiidhiyey jacaylkiinna oo qudha.
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

kikuyu: Haddaba idinkuna sidaas oo kale abaalgud ahaan u qalbi furnaada. Waxaan idiinla hadlayaa sida carruutayda oo kale.
english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

kikuyu: Ha noqonina kuwo ku xidhan kuwa aan rumaysanaynin, waayo, sidee bay xaqnimada iyo dembigu isu weheliyaan, ama sidee bay iftiinka iyo gudcurku isu dhex galaan?
english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

kikuyu: Oo sidee bay Masiix iyo ina belaayo isku mid u yihiin? Ama maxaa ka dhexeeya mid rumaysta iyo mid aan rumaysanaynin?
english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

kikuyu: Macbudka Ilaah sidee buu ula mid yahay sanamyada? Waayo, innagu waxaynu nahay macbudka Ilaaha nool, siduu Ilaah yidhi, Iyaga waan dhex joogi doonaa, waanan dhex socon doonaa, Ilaahoodaan ahaan doonaa, oo iyaguna dadkaygay ahaan doonaan.
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed, Ka soo baxa dhexdooda oo ka soocma, ayuu Rabbigu leeyahay, Oo ha taabanina wax aan daahir ahayn, Waanan idin aqbali doonaa.
english: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

kikuyu: Waxaan idiin ahaan doonaa Aabbe, Oo idinkuna waxaad ii ahaan doontaan wiilal iyo gabdho, ayuu Rabbiga Qaadirka ahu leeyahay.
english: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

kikuyu: Haddaba, gacaliyayaalow, innagoo ballamadan haysanna, aan iska safayno nijaas kasta oo jidhka iyo ruuxa ku jirta, innagoo quduusnimada kaamilayna oo Ilaah ka cabsanayna.
english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

kikuyu: Qalbiyadiinna noo fura. Ninna ma aannu xumayn, ninna ma aannu hallayn, ninna wixiisa ma aannu damcin.
english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

kikuyu: U odhan maayo inaan idin xukumo, waayo, markii hore ayaan idhi, Qalbiyadayada ayaad ku jirtaan inaynu wada dhimanno oo aynu wada noolaanno.
english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

kikuyu: Iimaan weyn ayaan idinku qabaa, oo aad baan idiinku faanaa. Dhiirranaan baa iga buuxda, oo mar kastoo aan dhibaataysan nahayna farxad ayaa aad iiga badata.
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

kikuyu: Waayo, markaannu Makedoniya nimid jidhkayagu ma nasan, laakiin wax kasta waannu ku dhibtoonnay. Xagga dibadda waxaa jiray dagaallo, xagga gudahana waxaa jirtay cabsi.
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaaha dhiirigeliya kuwa is-hoosaysiiya ayaa nagu dhiirrigeliyey imaatinka Tiitos;
english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

kikuyu: mana aha imaatinkiisa oo keliya, laakiin wuxuu nagu dhiirrigeliyey dhiirrigeliskii aad isaga dhiirrigeliseen. Wuxuu noo sii sheegay xiisaha iyo caloolxumaanta iyo dadaalka aad ii qabtaan, si aan weliba aad ugu sii farxay.
english: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

kikuyu: Waayo, in kastoo aan warqaddaydii idinku calool xumeeyey, kama qoomameeyo, in kastoo aan markii hore ka qoomameeyey, waayo, waxaan gartay warqaddaas inay idin calool xumaysay, saacadna ha ahaatee.
english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

kikuyu: Haddana waan ku farxayaa, mana aha inaad si kale u calool xumaateen, laakiin inaad u calool xumaateen toobadkeenidda, waayo, waad u calool xumaateen sida Ilaah doonayay, inaanad waxba xaggayaga ku khasaarin.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, caloolxumaanta ah sida Ilaah doonayo waxay keentaa toobadda xagga badbaadada ee aan laga qoomamayn, laakiin caloolxumaanta dunidu waxay keentaa dhimasho.
english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

kikuyu: Bal ogaada, waxakan aad ka calool xumaateen sida Ilaah doonayay wuxuu dhexdiinna ka soo saaray dadaal, iyo iscaddayn, iyo cadho, iyo cabsi, iyo xiiso, iyo qiiro, iyo ciqaabid waaweyn. Wax walba waad isku caddayseen inaad xaalka ku eedla'dihiin.
english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

kikuyu: Haddaba in kastoo aan idiin soo qoray, uma aan qorin kan wax xumeeyey aawadiis, ama kan la xumeeyey aawadiis, laakiin in dadaalka aad noo qabtaan laydinka muujiyo Ilaah hortiis.
english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed waa lana dhiirrigeliyey. Dhiirrigeliskii aad na dhiirrigeliseenna farxad ka sii badan ayaannu ku faraxnay, farxadda Tiitos aawadeed, waayo, dhammaantiin ruuxiisaad nasiseen.
english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii aan xaggiisa wax uun idinku faaniyey, ma aan ceeboobin, laakiin wax walba run ahaan ayaannu idinkula hadalnay, sidaas oo kale ayaa faankayagii aan Tiitos u sheegay run u noqday.
english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

kikuyu: Jacaylkiisuna wuu ku sii badan yahay xaggiinna, maxaa yeelay, wuxuu xusuustaa dhammaantiin addeeciddiinna iyo sidaad idinkoo cabsanaya oo gariiraya u dhowayseen.
english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

kikuyu: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan wax walba kalsooni weyn idiinku qabo.
english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

kikuyu: Haddaba, walaalayaalow, waxaannu idin ogeysiinaynaa nimcada Ilaah oo la siiyey kiniisadaha Makedoniya,
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

kikuyu: si, markii dhib lagu tijaabiyey, farxaddooda badan iyo miskiinnimadooda weyni ay ugu badnaadeen hodantinimada deeqsinimadooda.
english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan u marag furayaa inay tabartooda ku siiyeen, oo weliba si dhaafsiisan tabartooda, siday u doonayeen,
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

kikuyu: iyagoo aad nooga baryaya inaannu ka guddoonno hadiyadda qaybta ku leh adeegidda xagga quduusiinta,
english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

kikuyu: oo mana aha sidaan rajaynay, laakiin hortii way isa siiyeen Rabbiga iyo annagaba sidii Ilaah doonayay.
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Tiitos waannu ka barinnay, in siduu hortii u bilaabay, sidaas oo kale uu idiinku dhammeeyo nimcadatan.
english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

kikuyu: Laakiin sidaad wax kasta badnaan uga haysaan xagga rumaysadka, iyo hadalka, iyo aqoonta, iyo dadaalka oo dhan, iyo jacaylka aad noo qabtaan, waa inaad nimcadanna badnaan uga haysaan.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

kikuyu: U hadli maayo amar ahaan, laakiin inaan dadaalka kuwa kale ku caddeeyo lillaahinimada jacaylkiinna.
english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

kikuyu: Waad garanaysaan nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix in isagoo hodan ah uu aawadiin miskiin u noqday, inaad miskiinnimadiisa hodan ku noqotaan.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

kikuyu: Oo sidan ayaan idinkula talinayaa, waayo, tanu way idiin dhaantaa idinkoo ah kuwii sannaddii hore ugu hor bilaabay inay sameeyaan, mana aha inaad samaysaan oo keliya, laakiin waanad doonaysaan.
english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

kikuyu: Laakiin hadda shaqaddii dhammeeya, in sidaad diyaar u ahaydeen, aad haddana ugu dhammaysaan waxaad awooddaan.
english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii diyaar la yahay, sida loo haysto ayaa loo aqbalaa ee ma aha sidaan loo haysan.
english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

kikuyu: Waayo, tan u odhan maayo in kuwa kale la daayo oo idinka laydin dhibo,
english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

kikuyu: laakiin sida ay sinnaantu tahay, wax ka siiya waxa badan ee aad wakhtigan la joogo haysataan, waayo, way baahan yihiin, inay waxooda badan wax idinka siiyaan markaad baahataan, si ay sinnaani u dhacdo,
english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

kikuyu: sida qoran, Kii wax badan soo gurtay, waxba uma hadhin, kii wax yar soo gurtayna, waxba kama dhinmin.
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaah baa mahad leh kan qalbiga Tiitos geliyey dadaalka aan idiin qabno oo kale.
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

kikuyu: Waayo, wuu aqbalay baryadayadii, laakiin isaga qudhiisu aad buu u doonayaa inuu idiin yimaado, maxaa yeelay, wuu idiin xiisoonayaa.
english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

kikuyu: Waxaannu isaga la dirnay walaalka ammaantiisa xagga injiilku kiniisadaha oo dhan wada gaadhay.
english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo keliyana ma aha, laakiin isagu waa kii ay kiniisaduhu ka dhigeen inuu nala socdaalo hadiyaddan aawadeed tan aannu uga adeegno Rabbiga ammaantiisa aawadeed iyo in la arko diyaarnimadayada.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

kikuyu: Waxaannu iska jiraynaa inaan qofna nagu masabidin deeqsinimadan aannu ka adeegno,
english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

kikuyu: waayo, waxaannu ka tashannaa waxyaalaha wanaagsan, mana aha Rabbiga hortiisa oo keliya, laakiin dadka hortiisana.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

kikuyu: Waxaannu iyaga la dirnay walaalkeen kan aannu marar badan caddaynay inuu waxyaalo badan ku dadaalo, haddeerna weliba wuu ka sii dadaal badan yahay hubaasha weyn ee uu xaggiinna ku qabo aawadeed.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

kikuyu: Tiitos waxaa weeyaan wehelkayga iyo ila-shaqeeyahayga xaggiinna; walaaleheenna waa kuwa kiniisaduhu idiin soo direen, waana yihiin ammaanta Masiix.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

kikuyu: Sidaa daraaddeed kiniisadaha hortooda iyaga caddaan ugu tusa jacaylkiinna iyo faanka aannu idiin qabno.
english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

kikuyu: Looma baahna inaan idiin soo qoro wax ku saabsan caawimaadda xagga quduusiinta,
english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

kikuyu: waayo, waan garanayaa diyaarnimadiinna aan kuwa Makedoniya idinku faaniyey, in dadka Akhaya sannaddii hore ay diyaar ahaayeen, oo jacaylkiinna kulaylkiisuna badidood buu sii kiciyey.
english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan u dirayaa walaalaha si aan faanka aannu idinku faaninnay micnela'aan loogaga dhigin xaalkan, inaad diyaar u ahaataan sidaan idhi,
english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

kikuyu: waaba intaasoo aannu faankan ku ceebownaaye, annagoo keliyana ma aha, laakiin idinkuna waad ku ceeboobaysaan, haddii kuwo reer Makedoniya ahi ay i soo raacaan oo ay idin arkaan idinkoo aan diyaar ahayn.
english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

kikuyu: Taas aawadeed waxaan u maleeyey inay dhaanto inaan walaalaha ka baryo inay hortay idiin yimaadaan, inay hore diyaar uga sii dhigaan deeqda aad ballanqaaddeen, inay taasi diyaar u ahaato deeq ahaan, mana aha qasab ahaan.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

kikuyu: Laakiin tan ogaada, Kii wax yar beeraa, wax yar buu goostaa, kii wax badan beeraana, wax badan buu goostaa.
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

kikuyu: Qof kastaa wax ha u bixiyo siduu qalbiga ka goostay, oo yaanu ku bixin caloolxumo ama qasab, waayo, Ilaah wuxuu jecel yahay kan farxad wax ku bixiya.
english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu karaa inuu nimco oo dhan idiin badiyo inaad mar walba wax kasta oo idinku filan haysataan inaad shuqul kasta oo wanaagsan ku badisaan;
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

kikuyu: sida qoran, Isagu wuu kala firdhiyey, masaakiintana wax buu siiyey, Xaqnimadiisuna way sii jirtaa weligeedba.
english: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

kikuyu: Kii beerreyga siiya abuur uu abuuro iyo kibis uu cuno, wuu siin doonaa wuuna badin doonaa abuurkiinna aad abuuraysaan, wuuna kordhin doonaa midhaha xaqnimadiinna.
english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

kikuyu: Wax kasta idinka waa laydinku hodansiin doonaa xagga deeqsinimada inaga dhex shaqaysa oo dhan ee aawadeed Ilaah loogu mahadnaqo.
english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

kikuyu: Waayo, samaynta shuqulkani ma dhammaystirto waxa dhiman ee ay quduusiintu u baahan yihiin oo qudha, laakiin waxaa kale oo ay kordhisaa in Ilaah aad loogu mahadnaqo.
english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

kikuyu: Caddaynta adeegiddan aawadeed, waxaa Ilaah loo ammaanaa addeeciddiinna markaad qirataan injiilka Masiix, iyo deeqsinimada markaad la wadaagtaan iyaga iyo dadka kale oo dhan.
english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

kikuyu: Way idiin duceeyaan, wayna idiin xiisoodaan nimcada aad u badan ee Ilaah ee idinku jirta aawadeed.
english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa mahad leh hadiyaddiisa aan la sheegi karin aawadeed.
english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

kikuyu: Aniga qudhayda oo Bawlos ah waxaan idinku baryayaa qabownimada iyo raxmadda Masiixa, anigoo is-hoosaysiiya markaan dhexdiinna joogo, laakiin xaggiinna geesi ku ah markaan idinka maqnahay.
english: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan idinka baryayaa inaanan anigu markaan joogo geesi ku ahaan hubaashaas aan u malaynayo inaan geesi ku ahaado xagga kuwa nagu tirinaya inaannu sida jidhka ku soconno.
english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, in kastoo aannu jidhka ku soconno, sida jidhka uma dagaallanno,
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

kikuyu: waayo, hubka dagaalkayagu ma aha xagga jidhka, laakiin xoog bay leeyihiin Ilaah hortiisa in qalcado lagu dumiyo.
english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

kikuyu: Waxaannu baabbi'innaa murannada, iyo wax kasta oo sarreeya oo aqoonta Ilaah iska sarraysiiya, oo fikir kasta maxbuus baannu ka dhignaa, si uu Masiix u addeeco,
english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

kikuyu: annagoo u diyaar ah inaannu ka aarsanno caasinimo oo dhan markii ay addeeciddiinnu kaamil noqoto.
english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

kikuyu: Waxaad eegaysaan waxa idin hor yaal. Haddii qof uun isku hubo inuu ka mid yahay kuwa Masiix, midkaasi mar kale isaga qudhiisu ha ka fiirsado in, siduu isagu uga mid yahay kuwa Masiix, aannu annaguna uga mid nahay.
english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

kikuyu: Waayo, in kastoo aan si badan ugu faanayo amarkayaga uu Rabbigu noo siiyey inaannu idinku dhisno ee aanu noo siin inaannu idinku duminno, weliba layma ceebayn doono.
english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

kikuyu: Tan waxaan u idhi inaanan u ekaan sidii anigoo warqadahayga idinku cabsiinaya.
english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxay yidhaahdaan, Warqadihiisu culays iyo xoog bay leeyihiin, laakiin joogidda jidhkiisu way tabardaran tahay, oo hadalkiisana waa la fududaystaa.
english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

kikuyu: Kaasoo kale ha ogaado in sidaannu xagga hadalka warqadaha ku nahay markaannu maqan nahay, aannu xagga falimaha ku nahay markaannu joogno.
english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuma dhacno inaannu isku tirinno ama isu ekaysiinno kuwa is-ammaana. Laakiin iyaga qudhooda oo isku qiyaasaya qudhooda oo isu ekaysiinaya qudhooda waa garaadlaawayaal.
english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

kikuyu: Isu faanin mayno si qiyaastayada dhaafsiisan, laakiin sida ay tahay qiyaasta Ilaah noo qaybiyey inay qiyaas ahaato, si aannu idiin soo gaadhno.
english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

kikuyu: Waayo, annaga qudhayadu si dhaafsiisan isugu kala bixin mayno sidii annagoo aan idin soo gaadhin; waayo, xataa idinka ayaannu idiinla nimid injiilka Masiix,
english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

kikuyu: annagoo aan si dhaafsiisan uga faanayn hawlihii dadka kale, laakiin rajo u leh intuu rumaysadkiinnu korayo inaannu aad iyo aad ugu weynaan doonno dhexdiinna sida soohdintayada ah,
english: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

kikuyu: si aannu injiilka ugu wacdinno meelaha idinka shisheeya oo aanan ku faanin waxa laga diyaariyey qof kale soohdintiisa.
english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

kikuyu: Kii faanaa, Rabbiga ha ku faano.
english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

kikuyu: Ma aha ka qudhiisa ammaana ka loo bogaa, laakiin waa ka uu Rabbigu ammaano.
english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad iigu dulqaadataan doqonnimadayda yar. Laakiin waad ii dulqaadataan.
english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

kikuyu: Waxaan idiinku masayrsanahay masayr xagga Ilaah ah, waayo, waxaan idiin guuriyey nin keliya, inaan idiin dhiibo Masiix idinkoo ah bikrad daahir ah.
english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan ka baqayaa in maankiinna laga halleeyo lillaahinimada iyo daahirnimada xagga Masiix, sidii abeesadii xeeladdeedii Xaawa ugu khiyaanaysay oo kale.
english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii mid yimaado oo idinku wacdiyo Ciise kale oo ah ku aanan ku wacdiyin, ama haddii aad heshaan ruux ka duwan kii aad hesheen, ama injiil ka duwan kii aad aqbasheen, si wanaagsan ayaad ugu dulqaadataan.
english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

kikuyu: Waxaan u malaynayaa inaanan sina uga liidan rasuulladaas ugu waaweyn.
english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

kikuyu: Laakiin in kastoo aanan hadalka ku fiicnayn, aqoonta waan ku fiicanahay, oo taasaannu si kasta idiinku muujinnay dadka oo dhan hortiisa.
english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

kikuyu: Dembi miyaan falay markaan is-hoosaysiiyey in idinka laydin sarraysiiyo, maxaa yeelay, injiilka Ilaah ayaan idinku wacdiyey hadiyad ahaan?
english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

kikuyu: Kiniisado kale ayaan dhacay, anigoo mushahaaro ka qaadaya, si aan idiinku adeego.
english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

kikuyu: Markaan idinla joogay oo aan wax u baahnaa, ninna culays kuma aan hayn, waayo, walaalihii markay Makedoniya ka yimaadeen waxay ii dhammaystireen waxaan u baahnaa, oo si kastana waan isu celiyey si aanan idiin culaysin, waanan isa sii celin doonaa.
english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

kikuyu: Sida Masiixa runtiisu ay iigu jirto, faankan laygama joojin doono xagga dalalka Akhaya.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

kikuyu: Waayo? Ma waxay tahay inaanan idin jeclayn? Ilaah baa garan.
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan samaynayo, waan sii samayn doonaa, inaan ka gooyo waxay kuwa doonaya inay wax ku faanaan ku faani lahaayeen, in waxay ku faanaan loo garto inay sidayada oo kale yihiin.
english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo kale waa rasuullo been ah iyo shaqeeyayaal khaa'inno ah iyagoo isu ekaysiinaya rasuullada Masiix.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

kikuyu: Oo layaabna ma leh, waayo, Shayddaanka qudhiisu wuxuu isu ekaysiiyaa malaa'igta iftiinka.
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

kikuyu: Haddaba wax weyn ma aha haddii ay midiidinyadiisuna isu ekaysiiyaan midiidinyada xaqnimada, iyagoo dhammaanshahoodu u ahaan doono sida shuqulladooda.
english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

kikuyu: Haddana waxaan leeyahay, Qofna yaanu doqon ii malayn, laakiin haddaad ii malaysaan, weliba sida doqon ii qaata inaan aniguna in yar faano.
english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku hadlayo ugu hadli maayo sida Rabbigu doonayo, laakiin si doqonnimo ah iyo si geesinimadan faanka ah ayaan ugu hadlayaa.
english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

kikuyu: Siday kuwa badanu jidhka ugu faanaan, ayaan anna ugu faani doonaa.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

kikuyu: Waayo, idinku si farxadleh ayaad doqonnada ugu dulqaadataan idinkoo caqli leh.
english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

kikuyu: Idinku waad u dulqaadataan nin hadduu idin addoonsado, hadduu wixiinna cuno, hadduu wax idinka qaato, hadduu isa sarraysiiyo, hadduu wejiga idinka dharbaaxo.
english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

kikuyu: Waan ka xishoonayaa inaan idhaahdo, Waannu tabardaran nahay. Laakiin weliba wax kasta oo uu qof geesi ku yahay, aniguna geesi baan ku ahay (sida doqon ayaan u hadlayaa).
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

kikuyu: Iyagu ma Cibraaniyo baa? Anna waan ahay. Ma reer binu Israa'iil baa? Anna waan ahay. Ma dhashii Ibraahim baa? Anna waan ahay.
english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

kikuyu: Iyagu ma Masiix bay u adeegaan? Si ka sii badan ayaan ugu adeegaa. Sidii qof waalan ayaan u hadlayaa. Waan ka hawlo badnaa, waanan ka xabsi badnaa, karbaashyo tirola'aan ahna waa laygu dhuftay, marar badanna dhimashaan ku dhowaaday.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

kikuyu: Shan goor Yuhuuddu waxay i karbaasheen afartan mid la'.
english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

kikuyu: Saddex goorna ulaa laygu dhuftay, marna waa lay dhagxiyey, saddex goor doonni baa ila jabtay, habeen iyo maalinna waxaan ku jiray badda.
english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

kikuyu: Marar badan baan safray, xagga webiyadana khatar baan galay, xagga tuugaggana khatar baan galay, xagga dadkaygana khatar baan galay, xagga dadka aan Yuhuuddu ahaynna khatar baan galay, xagga magaaladana khatar baan galay, xagga cidladana khatar baan galay, xagga baddana khatar baan galay, walaalo been ah dhexdoodana khatar baan ku galay.
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

kikuyu: Waxaanna ku jiray dhib iyo daal, marar badanna hurdola'aan iyo gaajo iyo harraad, marar badanna cuntola'aan iyo qabow iyo arrad.
english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas dibadda ahna waxaa ii dheeraad ah waxaa maalin walba i dhiba ee ah kawelwelidda kiniisadaha oo dhan.
english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Kumaa itaaldaran oo anna aanan itaal darnayn? Kumaa la xumeeyey oo aanan ka guban?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

kikuyu: Hadday tahay inaan faano waxaan ku faanayaa waxyaalaha ku saabsan itaaldarradayda.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

kikuyu: Ilaaha ah Aabbaha Rabbi Ciise, kan barakada leh weligiis, wuxuu yaqaan inaanan been sheegaynin.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

kikuyu: Xagga Dimishaq taliyihii ka hooseeyey boqorkii Aretas ahaa ayaa gaadh ka qabtay magaalada reer Dimishaq si uu ii qabto.
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

kikuyu: Markaas anigoo dambiil ku jira ayaa daaqad xagga derbiga hoos laygaga dejiyey oo aan gacmihiisii ka baxsaday.
english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

kikuyu: Waa inaan faano in kastoo aanay waxtar lahayn, laakiin waxaan gaadhi doonaa riyooyin iyo waxa Rabbigu muujiyo.
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

kikuyu: Waxaan garanayaa nin Masiix ku jira oo afar iyo toban sannadood ka hor kor loo qaaday ilaa samada saddexaad. Inuu jidhka ku jiray iyo inaanu jidhka ku jirin garan maayo, Ilaah baase garan.
english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan garanayaa ninkaas, laakiin inuu jidhka ku jiray iyo inaanu jidhka ku jirin garan maayo, Ilaah baase garan.
english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

kikuyu: Isaga kor baa loogu qaaday Firdooska, oo wuxuu maqlay erayo aan lagu hadlin oo aan nin loo idmin inuu ku hadlo.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

kikuyu: Kaasoo kale xaggiisa waan ku faani doonaa, laakiin xaggayga kuma faani doono, itaaldarradayda mooyaane.
english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaan dooni lahaa inaan faano, doqon ma ahaan doono, waayo, runtaan ku hadli doonaa; laakiin waan iska celiyaa inaanu qofna ii malayn mid ka weyn wuxuu igu arko ama iga maqlo.
english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

kikuyu: Inaanan isu sarraysiin waxyaalaha lay muujiyey weynaantooda dheer aawadeed, waxaa lay siiyey wax jidhkayga muda oo ah mid Shayddaan uu soo diray inuu i kadeedo, si aanan isu sarraysiin.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

kikuyu: Waxaas aawadiis saddex goor ayaan Rabbiga ka baryay in waxaasi iga fogaado.
english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

kikuyu: Oo isagu wuxuu igu yidhi, Nimcadaydu way kugu filan tahay; maxaa yeelay, xooggaygu wuu ku dhan yahay itaaldarrada. Sidaa aawadeed anigoo faraxsan ayaan ku faanayaa itaaldarrooyinkayga in xoogga Masiixu igu soo dego.
english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

kikuyu: Sidaa aawadeed waxaan ku farxaa itaaldarrooyin iyo hadallo cay ah iyo baahiyo iyo silecyo iyo dhibaatooyin Masiix aawadiis, waayo, markaan itaal daranahay, ayaan xoog badnahay.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

kikuyu: Doqon baan noqday; idinkaase igu qasbay. Waxay ahayd inaad i ammaantaan, waayo, sinaba ugama aan liidan rasuulladii ugu wada waaweynaa, in kastoo aanan waxba ahayn.
english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

kikuyu: Hubaal rasuul calaamooyinkiis ayaa si dulqaad leh laydiinka dhex sameeyey xagga calaamooyin iyo yaabab iyo shuqullo xoog leh.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

kikuyu: Maxaa idinka dhiman oo aad uga liidataan kiniisadaha kale, anigoo aan idin culaysin mooyaane? Xumaantan aawadeed iga raalli ahaada.
english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

kikuyu: Markan waa markii saddexaad oo aan diyaar u ahay inaan idiin imaado; oo idinma culaysin doono, maxaa yeelay, idinkaan idin doonayaa ee ma doonayo wixiinna; waayo, ma aha inay carruurtu waalidkood wax u kaydiso, laakiin waa inuu waalidku carruurta wax u kaydiyo.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

kikuyu: Anna si farxad leh ayaan isu bixin, naftiinnaanan isu bixin. Haddii aan aad idiin jeclahay, ma si ka yar baa lay jecel yahay?
english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

kikuyu: Hase ahaatee, anigu idinma aan culaysin, laakiin khaa'in baan noqday oo sir baan idinku qabtay.
english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

kikuyu: Miyaan faa'iido ahaan wax idiinkaga qaatay kuwii aan idiin soo diray midkoodna?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

kikuyu: Tiitos waan waaniyey, walaalkeenna waan la diray isagii. Tiitos miyuu faa'iido ahaan wax idiinkaga qaatay? Miyaannan isku ruux ku socon? Miyaannan isku tallaabooyin ku socon?
english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

kikuyu: Haatan waxaad u malaynaysaan inaannu iska kiin daafacayno. Ilaah hortiisa waxaannu u hadlaynaa sida kuwo Masiix, oo gacaliyayaalow, wax kastaba waxaannu u samaynaa si aad u dhisantaan.
english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan ka cabsanayaa in, kolkaan imaado, aan idinka waayo sidaan doonayo inaad ahaataan, idinna aad iga weydaan sidaad doonaysaan inaan ahaado, waaba intaasoo ay jiraan dirir, iyo masayr, iyo xanaaq, iyo iskala qaybqaybin, iyo cay, iyo xan, iyo qabweynaan, iyo rabshooyin;
english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

kikuyu: waaba intaasoo kolkaan mar kale imaado uu Ilaahay hortiinna igu hoosaysiiyaa, oo aan u baroortaa kuwo badan oo hadda ka hor dembaabay, oo aan ka toobadkeenin wasakhnimadii iyo sinadii iyo nejisnimadii ay faleen.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

kikuyu: Socodkan aan idiin imanayo waa kaygii saddexaad. Laba ama saddex markhaati afkooda ayaa eray walba lagu xaqiiqayn doonaa.
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

kikuyu: Markii horaan idhi, haddana waan leeyahay; sidaan idinku idhi markii labaad oo aan idinla joogay, ayaan haatanna anoo idinka maqan ku leeyahay kuwii hadda ka hor dembaabay iyo inta kale oo dhanba in haddaan mar kale imaado, aanan u tudhayn iyaga,
english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

kikuyu: waayo, waxaad doondoonaysaan wax caddeeya in Masiixu iga dhex hadlayo, kan aan xaggiinna ku itaalka yarayn, laakiinse dhexdiinna ku xoogga badan.
english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagoo itaaldaran ayaa iskutallaabta lagu qodbay, laakiin wuxuu ku nool yahay xoogga Ilaah. Annaguba isaga waannu la itaal yar nahay, laakiin isagaannu xaggiinna kula noolaan doonnaa xoogga Ilaah.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

kikuyu: Isjirraba inaad iimaanka ku jirtaan iyo in kale, oo bal istijaabiya. Oo miyeydnaan is-ogayn in Ciise Masiix idinku jiro haddaydnan ahayn kuwo aan loo bogin?
english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan rajaynayaa inaad ogaan doontaan inaannan ahayn kuwo aan loo bogin.
english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

kikuyu: Hadda waxaannu Ilaah ka baryaynaa inaydnaan wax shar ah samayn, mana aha inaannu annagu u muuqanno sidii kuwo loo bogay, laakiinse waa inaad idinku samaysaan waxa wanaagsan, in kastoo aannu nahay sidii kuwo aan loo bogin.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

kikuyu: Waayo, annagu ma samayn karno wax runta ka gees ah, laakiinse waxaannu samayn karnaa wax runta la jira.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

kikuyu: Waayo, waannu ku faraxnaa markaannu itaal yar nahay, idinkuna aad itaal weyn tihiin. Wax kalena Ilaah baannu ka baryayna oo waa kaamilnimadiinna.
english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

kikuyu: Sababtan aawadeed ayaan waxyaalahan u qoray intaan maqnaa, si aanan markaan joogo si adag idiinkula macaamiloon sida amarkii Rabbigu ii siiyey inaan idinku dhiso oo aanan idinku dumin.
english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

kikuyu: Ugu dambaysta, walaalayaalow, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Nabadgelyo. Qummanaada, dhiirranaada, isku fikir ahaada, nabad ku jooga, oo Ilaaha jacaylka iyo nabaddu wuu idinla joogi doonaa.
english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

kikuyu: Dhunkasho quduus ah midkiinba midka kale ha ku salaamo.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Quduusiinta oo dhammi way idin soo salaamayaan.
english: All the saints greet you.

kikuyu: Nimcada Rabbi Ciise Masiix iyo jacaylka Ilaah iyo wehelnimada Ruuxa Quduuska ahu kulligiin ha idinla jireen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Waxaa warqaddan qoraya Bawlos oo ah rasuul aan xagga dadka ka iman, oo aan dadna ku iman, laakiinse ku yimid Ciise Masiix iyo Ilaaha Aabbaha ah oo isaga ka sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay.
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

kikuyu: Aniga iyo walaalaha ila jooga oo dhammi waxaannu tan u qoraynaa kiniisadaha Galatiya.
english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

kikuyu: Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix,
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: kan naftiisii u bixiyey dembiyadeenna aawadood, si uu inooga bixiyo dunidatan la joogo oo sharka leh sida ay tahay doonista kan Ilaah iyo Aabbe inoo ah.
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

kikuyu: Isagaa ammaanta leh weligiis iyo weligiis. Aamiin.
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Waxaan la yaabsanahay dhaqsiiyaha aad uga dhaqaaqaysaan kii nimcada Masiixa idiinku yeedhay, oo aad u leexanaysaan injiil kale,
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

kikuyu: oo aan ahayn mid kale, laakiin waxaa jira kuwo idin dhibaya, oo doonaya inay injiilka Masiixa qalloociyaan.
english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiinse annaga ha noqoto ama malaa'ig samada ka timid ha noqotee, kii idinku wacdiya injiil aan ahayn kaannu idinku wacdinnay, ha inkaarnaado.
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

kikuyu: Sidii aannu markii hore nidhi, waxaan haatanna leeyahay, Haddii nin idinku wacdiyo injiil kale oo aan ahayn kii aad aqbasheen, ha inkaarnaado.
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

kikuyu: Ma waxaan haatan is-oggolaysiinayaa dadka mise Ilaah? Mise waxaan doondoonayaa inaan dadka ka farxiyo? Haddaan weli dadka ka sii farxinayo, ma aanan ahaadeen addoonkii Masiixa.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waxaan idin ogaysiinayaa in injiilka aan idinku wacdiyey uusan ka iman xagga dadka.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

kikuyu: Waayo, kama aan helin xagga dadka, laymana barin, laakiin waxaa ii muujiyey Ciise Masiix.
english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waad maqasheen dabiicaddaydii hore xagga diintii Yuhuudda, sidii aan kiniisaddii Ilaah aad iyo aad ugu silcin jiray oo u kharribi jiray.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa badan oo asaaggay ah oo aan isku waddan nahay ayaan kaga hor maray diinta Yuhuudda, anigoo aad iyo aad ugu adag xeerarkii awowayaashay.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ilaaha uurkii hooyaday iga doortay, oo nimcadiisa iigu yeedhay, markuu ku farxay
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

kikuyu: inuu Wiilkiisa iga dhex muujiyo inaan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ku wacdiyo isaga warkiisa, isla markaasba lama aan tashan bini aadan.
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

kikuyu: Yeruusaalemna uma aan aadin kuwii hortay rasuullada ahaa, laakiinse waxaan aaday dalka Carabta, dabadeedna waxaan ku soo noqday Dimishaq.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

kikuyu: Kolkaasaan saddex sannadood dabadeed Yeruusaalem aaday inaan Keeyfas soo barto, oo shan iyo toban maalmood ayaan la joogay isagii.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

kikuyu: Laakiin rasuulladii kale midna kama arag, Yacquub oo ah Sayidka walaalkiis mooyaane.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

kikuyu: Waxan aan idiin soo qorayo, Ilaah hortiis, been ka sheegi maayo.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

kikuyu: Markaas dabadeed waxaan imid xagga dalalka Suuriya iyo Kilikiya,
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

kikuyu: oo weliba laygama weji garanayn kiniisadaha Masiixa oo Yahuudiya ku yiil.
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

kikuyu: Laakiin waxay maqleen oo keliya in la yidhi, Kii mar ina silcin jiray, hadda wuxuu wax ku wacdiyayaa iimaankii uu mar kharribi jiray.
english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah bay u ammaaneen daraadday.
english: So they glorified God in me.

kikuyu: Afar iyo toban sannadood dabadeed ayaan mar kale Yeruusaalem aaday, Barnabasna wuu ila jiray, oo Tiitosna waan kaxaystay.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

kikuyu: Sidii la iigu muujiyey ayaan u tegey, oo waxaan iyaga hor dhigay injiilka aan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ku wacdiyo, laakiinse waxaan gooni ahaan u tusay kuwii sharafta lahaa, si aanan u ahaan mid waxtarla'aan iska ordaya ama hore u orday.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

kikuyu: Laakiin xataa Tiitos oo ila socday, isagoo Gariig ah, laguma qasbin in la gudo
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

kikuyu: walaalaha beenta ah oo qarsoodiga lanoogu soo geliyey daraaddood, kuwa noogu soo galay inay basaasaan xorriyaddeenna aynu Ciise Masiix ku haysanno, inay na addoonsadaan.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

kikuyu: In runta injiilku idinla sii jirto, taas daraaddeed ayaannan saacad qudha u hoos gelin iyaga.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwii loo maleeyey inay sharaf leeyihiin (wax kastoo ay ahaayeen, waxba igama gelin; waayo, Ilaah dadka wejigiisa uma kala eexdo) waxaan leeyahay, Kuwii sharafta lahaa waxba iguma ay darin.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

kikuyu: Laakiinse kolkay arkeen in laygu ammaaneeyey injiilka kuwa buuryoqabka ah, xataa sidii Butros loogu ammaaneeyey injiilka kuwa gudan,
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

kikuyu: waayo, kii Butros kaga dhex shaqeeyey sii uu rasuul ugu ahaado kuwa gudan ayaa anna igaga dhex shaqeeyey sii aan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn rasuul ugu ahaado,
english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

kikuyu: oo kolkay ogaadeen nimcada lay siiyey, Yacquub iyo Keeyfas iyo Yooxanaa, iyagoo loo sharfay sida tiirar, waxay aniga iyo Barnabas na siiyeen gacanta midigta oo wehelnimada, inaannu annagu u tagno dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn, iyaguna ay u tagaan kuwa gudan.
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

kikuyu: Waxay keliyahoo doonayeen inaannu masaakiinta xusuusanno, taas oo aan ku dadaalayay inaan sameeyo.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Keeyfas kolkuu Antiyokh yimid, waan hor joogsaday, maxaa yeelay, wuu eedaysnaa.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, intaan qaar Yacquub ka iman, Keeyfas wuxuu wax la cuni jiray dad aan Yuhuud ahayn, laakiinse markay yimaadeen, wuu ka soo noqday oo ka soocmay, isagoo kuwa gudan ka cabsanaya.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

kikuyu: Yuhuudda inteedii kalena sidaas oo kalay labawejiilayaal la ahaayeen isaga, sidaas daraaddeed labawejiilenimadoodii waxay la tagtay xataa Barnabas.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Kolkaan arkay inayan si hagaagsan ugu soconayn runta injiilka, ayaan kulli hortooda Keeyfas ku idhi, Adigoo Yuhuudi ah haddaad u dhaqanto sida dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn, oo aadan ahaan sida Yuhuudda, sidee baad ugu qasbaysaa dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn inay u dhaqmaan sida Yuhuudda?
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

kikuyu: Innagoo jinsigeennu Yuhuud yahay, oo aan ahayn dembilayaal aan Yuhuud ahayn,
english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

kikuyu: ayaynu weliba garanaynaa inaan nin xaq ku noqon shuqullada sharciga, rumaysadka uu Ciise Masiix ku rumaystay mooyaane, xataa innagu waan rumaysannay Ciise Masiix inaynu xaq ku noqonno rumaysadka Masiix ee ayan ahayn shuqullada sharciga, maxaa yeelay, shuqullada sharciga ninna xaq kuma noqon doono.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

kikuyu: Laakiinse markaynu doonaynay inaynu Masiix xaq ku noqonno, haddii la helo inaynu qudheennu dembilayaal nahay, Masiix miyuu yahay midiidinka dembiga? Ma suurtowdo!
english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaan mar kale dhiso waxyaalihii aan dumiyey, waxaan isku caddaynayaa inaan ahay mid xad gudbay.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

kikuyu: Anigu sharcigaan ugu dhintay xagga sharciga inaan Ilaah u noolaado.
english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

kikuyu: Waxaa iskutallaabta laygula qodbay Masiixa, laakiin weli waan noolahay. Aniga ma aha kan nooli, laakiin Masiix ayaa igu dhex nool, oo nolosha aan haatan jidhka ku dhex noolahay waxaan ku noolahay rumaysadka xagga Wiilka Ilaah, kan i jeclaaday oo naftiisa u bixiyey daraadday.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

kikuyu: Nimcada Ilaah burin maayo, waayo, haddii xaqnimo sharciga laga helo, Masiix micnela'aan buu u dhintay.
english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

kikuyu: Garaadlaawayaasha reer Galatiyow, yaa idin sasabtay, kuwiinna indhahooda la hor dhigay Ciise Masiix oo iskutallaabta lagu qodbay?
english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

kikuyu: Waxaan keliyahoo idinka doonayaa inaan idinka barto, Ruuxa ma waxaad ku hesheen shuqullada sharciga mise maqlidda rumaysadka?
english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

kikuyu: Ma sidaasaad u garaadla'dihiin? Idinkoo Ruuxa ku bilaabay miyaad haatan jidhka ku dhammaynaysaan?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

kikuyu: Ma waxtarla'aan baad wax badan ugu xanuunsateen? hadday waxtarla'aan ahayd.
