english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

kikuyu: Haddaba kan Ruuxa idin siiya oo shuqullada xoogga leh idinku dhex sameeyaa, ma wuxuu ku sameeyaa shuqullada sharciga mise maqlidda rumaysadka?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalaa Ibraahim Ilaah u rumaystay, oo waxaa isaga loogu tiriyey xaqnimo.
english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Haddaba ogaada in kuwa rumaysadka lahu yihiin wiilashii Ibraahim.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

kikuyu: Qorniinka oo hore u arkay in Ilaah quruumaha xaq kaga dhigi doono rumaysad, ayaa injiilka hore ugu sii sheegay Ibraahim isagoo leh, Quruumaha oo dhammi adigay kugu barakoobi doonaan.
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kuwa rumaysadka lahu waxay la barakaysan yihiin Ibraahimkii rumaystay.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

kikuyu: In alla intii shuqullada sharciga isku hallaysaa, inkaar bay ku hoos jiraan; waayo, waxaa qoran, Waa inkaaran yahay ku kasta oo aan ku sii soconin inuu sameeyo wax kasta oo ku qoran kitaabka sharciga.
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

kikuyu: Inuusan ninna sharciga xaq ku noqon Ilaah hortiisa waa bayaan, waayo, Kii xaq ahu rumaysad buu ku noolaan doonaa.
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

kikuyu: Sharciguna kama iman rumaysadka, laakiin, Kii sameeya waxyaalaha sharciga iyaguu ku noolaan doonaa.
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

kikuyu: Masiix wuxuu inaga furtay inkaartii sharciga, isagoo inkaar inoo noqday, waayo, waxaa qoran, Mid kasta oo geed ka soo deldelanu wuu inkaaran yahay,
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

kikuyu: inay barakadii Ibraahim quruumaha ugu timaado Ciise Masiix; inaynu ballankii Ruuxa ku helno rumaysad.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, sida dadkaan u hadlayaa, In kastoo ay tahay xataa axdiga dadka, mar haddii la hubiyo, lama buriyo, waxbana laguma daro.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

kikuyu: Ballamada waxaa loo qaaday Ibraahim iyo kii ka soo farcamay. Lama odhan, Kuwa ka soo farcamay sida kuwa badan, laakiinse sidii mid keliya, oo ah kan ka soo farcamay, kaas oo ah Masiixa.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

kikuyu: Waxaan leeyahay, Ilaah baa axdi hore u dhigay, oo sharcigii afar boqol iyo soddon sannadood dabadeed yimid ma buriyo axdigaas oo ballanka ma baabbi'iyo.
english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii dhaxalka laga helo sharciga, ballanka lagama sii heleen; laakiinse Ilaah baa Ibraahim ballan ku siiyey.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

kikuyu: Haddaba sharcigu waa maxay? Waxaa loogu daray xadgudubyo aawadood, ilaa farcankii loo ballanqaaday yimaado, oo waxaa xagga malaa'igaha lagaga amray dhexdhexaadiye gacantiis.
english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

kikuyu: Dhexdhexaadiye mid keliyahu ma leh, laakiinse Ilaah waa mid keliya.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

kikuyu: Haddaba sharcigu miyuu ka gees yahay ballamadii Ilaah? Ma suurtowdo, waayo, haddii sharci wax noolayn kara laysa siiyey, sida runta ah, xaqnimada waxaa laga heli lahaa sharciga.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

kikuyu: Laakiin Qorniinku wax walba dembiguu ku hoos xidhay in ballanka rumaysadka ee Ciise Masiix la siiyo kuwa rumaystay.
english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

kikuyu: Laakiinse intaan rumaysadku iman waxaa laynagu hoos hayay sharciga, innagoo xidhan, ilaa rumaysadka la muujiyo.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed sharcigu wuxuu ahaa edbiyeheenna inuu Masiixa inoo geeyo, inaynu xaq ku noqonno rumaysadka.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

kikuyu: Laakiinse rumaysadkii waa yimid, oo taas daraaddeed mar dambe edbiye kama hoosayno.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

kikuyu: Waayo, kulligiin waxaad wiilashii Ilaah ku tihiin rumaysad idinkoo ku jira Ciise Masiix.
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: In alla intiinna lagu baabtiisay Masiix, waxaad huwateen Masiix.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

kikuyu: Ma jiro Yuhuud ama Gariig, ma jiro addoon ama xor, ma jiro lab ama dhaddig, waayo, kulligiin mid baad ku wada tihiin Ciise Masiix.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Haddaad tihiin Masiixa kuwiisa, waxaad tihiin Ibraahim farcankiisa oo ah kuwa dhaxalka leh sida ballanku leeyahay.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan leeyahay, Inta midka dhaxalka lahu ilmo yar yahay, waxba kama duwana addoon in kastuu yahay sayidka wax walba,
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

kikuyu: laakiinse wuxuu ka hooseeyaa kuwa ilaaliya iyo wakiillo ilaa maalintii aabbihiis ka ballamay.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale innagu markaynu carruur ahayn, waxaa ina addoonsan jiray waxyaalaha aasaaska ah ee dunida;
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

kikuyu: laakiinse markii wakhtigii buuxsamay, Ilaah wuxuu soo diray Wiilkiisii, isagoo naag ka dhashay oo sharciga ku hoos dhashay,
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

kikuyu: inuu furto kuwii sharciga ku hoos jiray inuu carruurtiis inaga dhigo.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

kikuyu: Oo wiilashiisa aad tihiin daraaddeed ayaa Ilaah u soo diray Ruuxa Wiilkiisa qalbiyadeenna dhexdooda, isagoo dhawaaqaya oo leh, Aabbow.
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

kikuyu: Saasaadan mar dambe addoon u ahayn, laakiinse waxaad tahay wiilkiisa, oo haddaad wiilkiisa tahay, waxaadna tahay mid dhaxal leh xagga Ilaah.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiinse markii aydnaan Ilaah garanayn, waxaad addoommo u ahaydeen kuwo aan ilaahyo ahayn xagga dabiicadda.
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

kikuyu: Laakiin haatan idinkoo Ilaah gartay ama Ilaah idin gartay, sidee baad mar kale ugu noqotaan waxyaalaha aasaaska oo miskiinnimada ah, tabartana daran, kuwa aad jeceshihiin inaad mar kale addoommo u noqotaan?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

kikuyu: Waxaad dhawrtaan maalmo, iyo bilo, iyo xilliyo, iyo sannado.
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

kikuyu: Waxaan ka baqayaa inaan waxtarla'aan idinkugu hawshooday.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

kikuyu: Waxaan idinka baryayaa, walaalayaalow, inaad noqotaan sida aan ahay, waayo, anba waxaan ahay sida aad tihiin. Waxba iguma aydnaan xumayn.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

kikuyu: Laakiin waad og tihiin in itaaldarrada jidhka aawadeed aan markii ugu horraysay injiilka idinku wacdiyey.
english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

kikuyu: Waxa ku saabsan jidhkayga oo idin jirrabay ma aydnaan quudhsan, mana aydnaan nicin, laakiin waxaad ii aqbasheen sidii malaa'ig Ilaah, xataa sidii Ciise Masiix.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Haddaba meeday farxaddiinnii? Waayo, waxaan idiinku markhaati furayaa inaad ii bixin lahaydeen indhihiinna oo aad i siin lahaydeen, hadday suurtowbi lahayd.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

kikuyu: Haddaba cadowgiinnii miyaan noqday runta aan idiin sheego aawadeed?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

kikuyu: Aad bay idinku doondoonayaan si aan wanaagsanayn, laakiin waxay doonaan inay idinka kaayo xidhaan, si aad idinku iyaga u doondoontaan.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

kikuyu: Waa wanaagsan tahay in aad loo doondoono wixii wanaagsan had iyo goorba, oo ayan ahayn markaan idinla joogo oo keliya.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

kikuyu: Carruurtaydiiyey, mar kalaan idin foolanayaa ilaa Masiix idinku dhex abuurmo.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan haatan idinla joogo oo aan codkayga beddelo, waayo, waan idinka shakiyayaa.
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

kikuyu: Kuwiinna doonaya inay sharciga ka hooseeyaanow, ii sheega. Sharciga miyeydnaan maqlin?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa qoran in Ibraahim laba wiil lahaa, kii uu addoonta ka dhalay iyo kii uu naagta xorta ah ka dhalay.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

kikuyu: Laakiin kii addoontu xagga jidhkuu ka dhashay, naagta xorta ah keediise ballan buu ku dhashay.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahanu waa masaal, waayo, dumarkanu waxay ka dhigan yihiin laba axdi, mid Buur Siinay buu ka yimid isagoo u dhalaya addoonnimo, taasu waa Haagaar.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

kikuyu: Haagaartanu waa Buur Siinay oo Carabiya ku taal, oo waxay ka dhigan tahay Yeruusaalemta haatan joogta; waayo, waa la addoonsaday iyada iyo carruurteedaba.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Yeruusaalemta sare waa xor, waana hooyadeen.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa qoran, Faraxsanow, madhalaysta aan dhalinay; Kala bax oo mashxarad, taada aan foolanay; Waayo, tan cidlowday carruurteedu waa ka badan yihiin tan ninka leh kuweeda.
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

kikuyu: Innaguna, walaalayaalow, waxaynu nahay carruurtii ballanka sida Isxaaq oo kale.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

kikuyu: Laakiin markaas kii jidhka ka dhashay wuxuu silciyey kii Ruuxa ka dhashay, haatanna waa sidaas oo kale.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

kikuyu: Laakiin maxaa Qorniinku leeyahay? Addoonta iyo wiilkeedaba eri, waayo, wiilka addoontu dhaxal la wadaagi maayo wiilka naagta xorta ah.
english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, walaalayaalow, innagu ma nihin addoon carruurteed, laakiinse waxaynu nahay naagta xorta ah carruurteed.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

kikuyu: Xorriyad ayuu Masiixu inagu xoreeyey. Haddaba adkaada, oo mar dambe yaan laydinku qaban harqoodka addoonnimada.
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

kikuyu: Bal ogaada, aniga oo Bawlos ah waxaan idinku leeyahay, Haddii laydin gudo, Masiixu waxba idiin tari maayo.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

kikuyu: Waxaan haddana ugu markhaati furayaa, nin kasta oo la gudo, waxaa ku waajib ah inuu sharciga oo dhan sameeyo.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

kikuyu: Waad ka soocan tihiin Masiixa, kuwiinna sharciga xaq ku noqon lahaayow; nimcadiina waad ka dhacdeen.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

kikuyu: Waayo, innagu xagga Ruuxa waxaynu rumaysad ku sugnaa rajada xaqnimada.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, xagga Ciise Masiix gudniinta iyo buuryoqabnimada midna wax ma tarto, laakiinse waxaa wax tara rumaysadka ku shaqeeya jacayl.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

kikuyu: Si wanaagsan baad u ordayseen, ee yaa idinka hor joogsaday inaydnaan runta addeecin?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

kikuyu: Taladanu kama iman kan idiin yeedhaya.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

kikuyu: In yar oo khamiir ah cajiinka oo dhan bay khamiirisaa.
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

kikuyu: Xagga Rabbiga waan idin hubaa inaydnaan wax kale ka fikirayn, laakiin kii idin dhibaa, xukunkiisuu qaadan doonaa mid kastuu yahayba.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

kikuyu: Laakiin, walaalayaalow, haddii aan anigu weli gudniinta wax ku wacdiyo, maxaa weli la ii silciyaa? Haddaba xumaan-u-qaadashada iskutallaabtu waa dhammaatay.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa in kuwa idin wareeriyaa ay isgooyaan.
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

kikuyu: Waayo, walaalayaalow, waxaa laydiinku yeedhay xorriyad, laakiin xorriyaddiinna jidhka marmarsiinyo ha uga dhigina, laakiin midkiinba midka kale kalgacayl ha ugu adeego.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

kikuyu: Waayo, sharciga oo dhammu hadal keliya buu ku dhammaaday, waana kan, Waa inaad deriskaaga u jeclaataa sidaad naftaada u jeceshahay.
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaad isqaniintaan oo iscuntaan, iska dhawra yeydnan isbaabbi'in.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan leeyahay, Ruuxa ku socda, kolkaas aydnaan damaca jidhka yeelayne.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

kikuyu: Waayo, damaca jidhku waa ka gees Ruuxa, Ruuxuna waa ka gees jidhka, maxaa yeelay, kuwanu waa kala gees, si aydnaan u samayn waxyaalahaad doonaysaan.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddii Ruuxu idin hoggaamiyo, sharciga kuma hoos jirtaan.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

kikuyu: Shuqullada jidhku waa muuqdaan, waana kuwan, sino, wasakhnimo, dhillanimo,
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

kikuyu: sanamcaabudid, sixirnimo, cadownimo, dirir, masayr, xanaaq, is-ilaaq, iskala qaybqaybin, bidcinimo,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

kikuyu: xaasidnimo, sakhraannimo, rabshooyin iyo waxyaalo la mid ah. Kuwaas waan idiinka digayaa, sidaan markii horeba idiinku sheegay, in kuwa waxyaalaha caynkaas ah sameeyaa ayan dhaxli doonin boqortooyada Ilaah.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Laakiin midhaha Ruuxu waa jacayl, farxad, nabad, dulqaadasho, roonaan, wanaag, aaminnimo,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

kikuyu: qabownimo, iscelin; waxa caynkaas ah sharci ka gees ahu ma jiro.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

kikuyu: Kuwa Ciise Masiix waxay iskutallaabta ku qodbeen jidhka iyo kacsigiisa xaaraanta ah iyo damacyadiisa sharka ah.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

kikuyu: Haddii aynu Ruuxa ku nool nahay, aynu Ruuxana ku soconno.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

kikuyu: Yeynan iskibrin, oo iska xanaajin, oo isxaasidin.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, nin haddii xadgudub lagu qabto, kuwiinna Ruuxa raaca midka caynkaas ah ku soo celiya qabow, adigoo isdhawraya si aan adna laguu jirrabin.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

kikuyu: Midba midka kale culaabta ha u qaado, oo sidaas ku oofiya sharciga Masiixa.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

kikuyu: Haddii nin isu maleeyo inuu weyn yahay isagoo aan waxba ku fillayn, wuu iskhiyaaneeyaa.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

kikuyu: Laakiin nin kastaa shuqulkiisa ha tijaabiyo, dabadeedna faan ayuu iska heli doonaa oo ku kale kama heli doono.
english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

kikuyu: Waayo, nin kastaaba waa inuu culaabtiisa qaato.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

kikuyu: Kan hadalka la baraa wax walba oo wanaagsan qayb ha ka siiyo kan wax bara.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

kikuyu: Yaan laydin khiyaanayn; Ilaah laguma majaajiloodo, waayo, nin kastaa wax alla wuxuu beerto ayuu goosan doonaa.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii jidhkiisa wax ku beertaa wuxuu jidhka ka goosan doonaa qudhun, laakiin kii Ruuxa wax ku beertaa, wuxuu Ruuxa ka goosan doonaa nolol weligeed ah.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

kikuyu: Oo wanaagfalidda yeynan ka daalin, waayo, wakhtigeeda ayaynu wax ka goosan doonnaa haddaynan ka qalbi jabin.
english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed markaynu wakhtiga haysanno, kulli aan wanaag u samayno, khusuusan dadka rumaysadka leh.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

kikuyu: Bal eega xuruufta waaweyn oo aan gacantayda idiinku soo qoray.
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

kikuyu: Kuwa doonaya inay dadka istusaan inay wanaagsan yihiin xagga jidhka waxay keliyahoo idinku qasbaan in laydin gudo, inaan iskutallaabta Masiixa aawadeed loo silcin iyaga.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

kikuyu: Xataa kuwa gudanu sharciga ma xajiyaan, laakiin waxay u doonayaan in laydin gudo inay jidhkiinna ku faanaan.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

kikuyu: Laakiinse yaanay noqon inaan wax kale ku faano iskutallaabta Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix mooyaane, tan dunidu iigu musmaarantay, anna aan dunida ugu musmaarmay.
english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

kikuyu: Waayo, gudniinta iyo buuryoqabnimada midna waxba ma tarto, laakiinse waxaa wax tara abuurid cusub.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

kikuyu: In alla intii qaynuunkan ku socota, iyo Israa'iilka Ilaahba, nabad iyo naxariisuba dushooda ha ahaadeen.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

kikuyu: Hadda dabadeed ninna yuu i dhibin, waayo, waxaa jidhkayga ku yaal sumadihii Ciise.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ruuxiinna ha la jirto. Aamiin.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah, oo rasuul u ah Ciise Masiix xagga doonista Ilaah, waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa quduusiinta Efesos joogta iyo kuwa aaminka ah oo Ciise Masiix ku jira.
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

kikuyu: Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ammaanu ha u ahaato Ilaaha ah Aabbaha Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix. Wuxuu Masiix inagu siiyey barako kasta oo Ruuxa ka timid ee ku jirta meelaha jannada,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

kikuyu: xataa siduu inoogu doortay isaga dhexdiisa intaan dunida la aasaasin ka hor inaynu quduus ahaanno oo iin la'aanno isaga hortiisa, isagoo ina jecel,
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

kikuyu: oo hore inoogu doortay inuu inaga dhigto carruurtiisii xagga Ciise Masiix siduu doonayay oo ku farxay,
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

kikuyu: in la ammaano cisada nimcadiisa ee uu inagu siiyey kan uu jecel yahay.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

kikuyu: Isaga, sida ay hodantinimada nimcadiisu tahay, waxaynu dhiiggiisa ku leennahay madaxfurasho ah dembidhaafkeenna.
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

kikuyu: Nimcadaas wuxuu inoogu badiyey xagga xigmadda iyo miyirka oo dhan,
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ina ogeysiiyey qarsoodiga doonistiisa siduu ugu farxay oo Masiixa ugu fikiray
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

kikuyu: oo ugu talaggalay dhammaadka wakhtiga inuu Masiixa ku ururiyo wax kasta, waxa samooyinka ku jira iyo waxa dhulka joogaba.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

kikuyu: Isagaynu dhaxal ku helnay innagoo laynagu doortay qasdiga kan wax kasta kaga shaqeeya sida ay tahay talada doonistiisu,
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

kikuyu: in kuweenna markii hore Masiixa wax ku rajeeyey aynu ahaanno kuwo aawadood lagu ammaano Ilaah cisadiisa.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

kikuyu: Oo weliba idinku isagaad ku maqasheen ereyga runta ah, kaas oo ah injiilka badbaadadiinna, oo weliba idinku markii aad rumaysateen ayaa laydinku shaabadeeyey Ruuxa Quduuska ah oo uu ballanqaaday,
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: oo ah carbuuntii dhaxalkeenna xagga furashada hantida Ilaah in la ammaano cisadiisa.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan maqlay rumaysadkiinna xagga Rabbi Ciise, iyo jacaylka aad quduusiinta oo dhan u qabtaan, oo sidaas daraaddeed
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

kikuyu: ma joojiyo inaan Ilaah idiinku mahadnaqo. Baryadayda ayaan idinku soo xusuusanayaa,
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

kikuyu: in Ilaaha Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix oo ah Aabbaha ammaanta uu ruuxa xigmadda iyo muujinta idinku siiyo aqoonta aad isaga taqaaniin.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

kikuyu: Oo waxaan Ilaah baryayaa in indhaha qalbigiinna la nuuriyo, si aad u ogaataan waxa ay tahay rajada yeedhistiisu, iyo waxa ay tahay hodantinimada ammaanta dhaxalkiisa ee ku jirta quduusiinta,
english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

kikuyu: iyo waxa ay tahay weynaanta xooggiisa aan la koobi karin oo uu u hayo kuweenna rumaysan, sida uu u shaqeeyo xoogga itaalkiisa
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

kikuyu: ee uu kaga shaqeeyey Masiixii, goortuu kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey, oo uu fadhiisiyey meelaha jannada xagga midigtiisa.
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu isaga ka sarreeysiiyey madax kasta, iyo amar kasta, iyo xoog kasta, iyo sayidnimo kasta, iyo magac kasta oo la magacaabay, mana aha wakhtigan oo keliya, laakiinse xataa kan imanaya.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

kikuyu: Wax kastana wuxuu ka hoosaysiiyey cagihiisa, oo wuxuu isaga madax wax kasta ka sarreeyaa uga dhigay kiniisadda,
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

kikuyu: taas oo ah jidhkiisa oo ah buuxidda kan wax kasta meel walba ku buuxiya.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad ku dhimateen xadgudubyadiinna iyo dembiyadiinna,
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

kikuyu: kuwaas oo aad markii hore ugu socon jirteen sida socodka wakhtigan iyo sida madaxda xoogga hawada oo ah ruuxa haatan ka dhex shaqaynaya carruurta caasinimada.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Iyaga dhexdooda mar baynu dhammaanteen ku dhaqmi jirnay damacyada jidhkeenna, innagoo samaynayna waxyaalaha jidhka iyo maanku ay doonayaan, oo innaguna xagga dabiicadda waxaynu ka ahayn carruurtii cadhada sida dadka kale.
english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Ilaaha naxariista hodanka ka ahu wuxuu inagu jeclaaday jacaylkiisa weyn,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

kikuyu: oo sidaas daraaddeed markii aynu xadgudubyadeenna ku dhimannay wuxuu inala soo noolaysiiyey Masiix. Idinku nimco baad ku badbaaddeen.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

kikuyu: Oo innagana isagii buu inala soo sara kiciyey, oo wuxuu isagii inala fadhiisiyey meelaha jannada xagga Ciise Masiix,
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: si uu wakhtiyada imanaya hodantinimada weyn oo nimcadiisa ugu muujiyo roonaanta uu inoogu qabo xagga Ciise Masiix.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

kikuyu: Waayo, idinku waxaad ku badbaaddeen nimco xagga rumaysadka, mana aha wax xaggiinna ka yimid,
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

kikuyu: laakiinse waa hadiyadda Ilaah, mana aha xagga shuqullada, si aan ninna ugu faanin.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

kikuyu: Waayo, innagu waxaynu nahay wixii uu sameeyey, oo waxaa laynoogu uumay Ciise Masiix shuqullada wanaagsan aawadood oo Ilaah hore ugu diyaariyey inaynu ku soconno.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed idinku xusuusta inaad waa hore xagga jidhka ka ahaan jirteen dad aan Yuhuud ahayn, oo kuwa gudan la yidhaahdo oo xagga jidhka gacmo lagu guday ay idiinku yeedhi jireen buuryoqab.
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

kikuyu: Waagaas Masiix baad ka soocnaydeen, oo shisheeyaad ka ahaydeen dawladda reer binu Israa'iil, oo ajanabi baad ka ahaydeen axdiyada ballanka, idinkoo aan rajo lahayn, oo aan dunida Ilaah ku lahayn.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwiinna mar hore fogaa, haatan waxaad ku jirtaan Ciise Masiix, oo waxaa laydinku soo dhoweeyey dhiigga Masiixa.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu waa nabaddeenna, oo waa kan labada mid ka dhigay, oo dumiyey qoqobkii derbiga dhexe,
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

kikuyu: isagoo jidhkiisii ku buriyey cadownimadii taas oo ah sharciga amarrada ku jira qaynuunnada, inuu isaga qudhiisu labadii isugu abuuro nin cusub, isagoo saas nabad ku samaynaya,
english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

kikuyu: iyo inuu labadooda oo isku jidh ah Ilaah kula heshiisiiyo xagga iskutallaabta, isagoo halkaas ku dilay cadownimada.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

kikuyu: Oo markuu yimid ayuu nabad ku wacdiyey kuwiinnii fogaa, oo kuwii dhowaana nabad buu ku wacdiyey,
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

kikuyu: waayo, labadeennaba isagaynu Ruux keliya ugu galnaa Aabbaha.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed idinku mar dambe ma ihidin ajanabiyo iyo shisheeyayaal, laakiinse quduusiintaad isku waddan tihiin, oo waxaad ka mid tihiin reerka Ilaah,
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

kikuyu: oo waxaa laydinka dul dhisay aasaaskii rasuullada iyo nebiyada, oo waxaa dhagaxii geeska ee ugu weynaa idiin ah Ciise Masiix qudhiisa.
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

kikuyu: Oo dhismaha oo dhammu isaguu si wanaagsan isugu haystaa oo weynaadaa, oo wuxuu Rabbiga u noqdaa macbud quduus ah.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

kikuyu: Idinkana isagaa laydinku wada dhisay inaad ahaataan rugtii Ilaah xagga Ruuxa.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

kikuyu: Sababtaas daraaddeed anigoo Bawlos ah waxaan Ciise Masiix maxbuus ugu ahay idinka oo ah dad aan Yuhuud ahayn aawadiin.
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

kikuyu: Hubaal waxaad maqasheen wakiilnimada nimcada Ilaah oo la iigu kiin dhiibay,
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

kikuyu: iyo sida qarsoodigii laygu ogeysiiyey wixii la ii muujiyey, sidii aan mar hore dhawr eray idiinku soo qoray.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

kikuyu: Markaad akhridaan waxaad ogaan karaysaan garashadayda xagga qarsoodiga Masiixa,
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

kikuyu: kaas oo aan qarniyadii kale loogu ogeysiin bini aadmiga sida haatan Ruuxu ugu muujiyey rasuulladiisa iyo nebiyadiisa quduuska ah.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

kikuyu: Taas waxaa weeyaan in haatan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ay yihiin kuwo wax inala dhaxla, oo aan isku jidh nahay, oo ay inagula qayb qaataan ballankii Ciise Masiix xagga injiilka,
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

kikuyu: kaas oo aniga layga dhigay midiidin sida ay tahay hadiyadda nimcada Ilaah oo lay siiyey sida ay tahay shaqaynta xooggiisu.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

kikuyu: Aniga oo quduusiinta oo dhan ugu liita waxaa nimcadan la ii siiyey inaan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ku wacdiyo hodantinimada Masiixa oo aan la baadhi karin,
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

kikuyu: iyo inaan dadka oo dhan garansiiyo waxay tahay talogelidda qarsoodigii weligiis ku qarsoonaa Ilaaha ah kan wax walba abuuray.
english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Sababtuna waxaa weeyaan in haatan madaxda iyo kuwa amarka leh oo ku jira meelaha jannada, kiniisadda lagu ogeysiiyo xigmadda Ilaah oo badan oo kala cayncaynka ah,
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

kikuyu: sida uu yahay qasdiga weligiis ah oo isagu ku qasdiyey Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix,
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: kaas oo aynu ku leennahay dhiirranaan, oo aynu iskuhallayn ugu geli karno xagga rumaysadka aynu isaga rumaysan nahay.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaan idinka baryayaa inaydnaan ku qalbi jabin dhibaatooyinkayga aan daraaddiin u maray, waayo, taasu waa idiin ammaan.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

kikuyu: Sababtaas daraaddeed waxaan ugu jilba joogsadaa Aabbaha hortiisa,
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: kaas oo magiciisa lagu magacaabay reerka oo dhan inta jannada ku jirta iyo inta dhulka joogtaba,
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

kikuyu: in sida hodantinimada ammaantiisu ay tahay uu idin siiyo itaal aad Ruuxiisa kaga xoogaysataan xagga gudihiinna,
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

kikuyu: iyo in Masiixu qalbiyadiinna degganaado xagga rumaysadka,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

kikuyu: inaad jacayl xidid iyo aasaas ku yeelataan, iyo inaad u xoogaysataan si aad quduusiinta oo dhan ula garataan waxa ay yihiin ballaadhka iyo dhererka iyo korudheerida iyo hoosudheerida,
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

kikuyu: iyo inaad ogaataan jacaylka Masiixa oo aqoonta dhaafa, si ay idiinka buuxsanto Ilaah buuxnaantiisa oo dhammu.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

kikuyu: Haddaba kan awooda inuu inoo sameeyo wax aad iyo aad uga sii badan waxa aynu weyddiisanno ama ku fikirno oo dhan sida u yahay xoogga inaga dhex shaqeeya,
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

kikuyu: isaga ammaanu ha ugu ahaato kiniisadda iyo Ciise Masiixba tan iyo qarniyada oo dhan iyo weligiis iyo weligiisba. Aamiin.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed anigoo maxbuus ku ah Rabbiga, waxaan idinka baryayaa inaad yeedhistii laydiinku yeedhay ugu socotaan si istaahil ah,
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

kikuyu: idinkoo leh is-hoosaysiin iyo qalbiqaboobaan oo dhan iyo samir, oo midkiinba midka kale jacayl ugu dulqaadanayo.
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

kikuyu: Ku dadaala inaad midownimada xagga Ruuxa ku xajisaan xidhiidhka nabadda.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa jira jidh keliya iyo Ruux keliya, xataa sida idinka laydiinkugu yeedhay rajo keliya xagga yeedhistiinnii.
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

kikuyu: Oo waxaa jira Rabbi keliya iyo iimaan keliya iyo baabtiis keliya,
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

kikuyu: iyo Ilaah keliya oo kulli Aabbe u ah, oo wax walba ka sarreeya, oo wax walba ka dhex shaqeeya, oo wax walba ku jira.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

kikuyu: Laakiinse midkeen kastaba nimcada waxaa laynoo siiyey sida ay tahay qiyaasta hadiyadda Masiixa.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed wuxuu yidhi, Markuu kor u baxay ayuu wuxuu qabtay oo kaxeeyey kuwii maxaabiista ahaan jiray, Wuxuuna dadka siiyey hadiyado.
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

kikuyu: Haddaba, kor buu u baxay, micneheedu waa maxay haddayan ahayn inuu isagu hoos ugu degtay meelaha dhulka ugu hooseeya?
english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

kikuyu: Waa isla kii hoos u degtay kan haddana kor u baxay oo samooyinka oo dhan ka sara maray si uu isaga buuxiyo wax kastaba.
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

kikuyu: Oo qaar wuxuu ka dhigay inay ahaadaan rasuullo, qaarna nebiyo, qaarna wacdiyayaal, qaarna kuwo kiniisadda dhaqaaleeya, iyo macallimiin.
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

kikuyu: Sababtuna waa kaamilidda quduusiinta xagga shuqulka adeegidda, iyo xagga dhisidda jidhka Masiixa,
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

kikuyu: ilaa aynu wada gaadhno midnimada rumaysadka iyo aqoonta Wiilka Ilaah oo aynu noqonno dad waaweyn xagga qiyaasta koridda ee buuxnaanta Masiixa.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

kikuyu: Waa inaynaan mar dambe ahaan carruur rogrogmanaysa oo lagu kaxaysto dabayl kasta oo cilmi ah xagga dulanka dadka iyo khiyaanada iyo sirta qaladka.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

kikuyu: Laakiinse innagoo si jacayl ah runta ugu hadlayna aynu wax walba ku korno xaggiisa, kan madaxa ah oo ah Masiixa,
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

kikuyu: kaas oo jidhka oo dhammu si wanaagsan isugu haysto oo isugu wada xidhan yahay caawimaadda xubin kastaaba keento sida xubin kastaaba u shaqayso qiyaasteeda oo ugu kordhiso jidhka inuu jacayl ku dhismo.
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Rabbiga waan idiinkugu markhaati furayaa, oo waxaan idinku leeyahay, Mar dambe ha ugu soconina sida dad aan Ilaah aaminin ugu socdaan xumaanta maankooda.
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

kikuyu: Waxgarashadoodii way madoobaatay, oo jaahilnimada iyaga ku jirta aawadeed iyo qalbi engegnaantooda aawadeed ayay ajanabi uga noqdeen nolosha Ilaah.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

kikuyu: Iyagoo xishood beelay waxay isu daayeen nijaas inay wasakh kasta hunguriweynaan ku sameeyaan.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku Masiixa sidaas kuma aydnaan baran,
english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

kikuyu: hadday run tahay inaad isaga maqasheen oo isaga laydinku baray sida runtu Ciise ugu jirto.
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

kikuyu: Waa inaad iska xoortaan dabiicaddii hore, oo ku saabsanayd socodkiinnii aad ku socon jirteen, taas oo kharribanta xagga damacyada khiyaanada;
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

kikuyu: oo waa inaad ku cusboonaataan ruuxa maankiinna,
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

kikuyu: oo aad huwataan dabiicadda cusub oo loo abuuray inay Ilaah ugu ekaato xaqnimada iyo quduusnimada runta.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed beenta iska fogeeya, oo midkiin waluba deriskiisa run ha kula hadlo, waayo, innaga midkeenba midka kale wuxuu u yahay xubnihiisa.
english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

kikuyu: Haddaad cadhootaan, ha dembaabina. Qorraxdu yay idinka dhicin idinkoo cadhaysan.
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

kikuyu: Ibliiskana meel ha siinina.
english: and don’t give place to the devil.

kikuyu: Kii wax xadi jiray yuusan mar dambe wax xadin, laakiinse ha hawshoodo isagoo gacmihiisa ku shaqaynaya oo wax wanaagsan samaynaya si uu u haysto wax uu siiyo ka wax u baahan.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

kikuyu: Hadal qudhun ahu yuusan afkiinna ka soo bixin, laakiinse ku hadla waxa u wanaagsan dhisidda loo baahan yahay inay nimceeyaan kuwa maqla.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

kikuyu: Ha calool xumaynina Ruuxa Quduuska ah oo Ilaah oo laydiinku shaabadeeyey maalinta madaxfurashada.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

kikuyu: Haddaba qadhaadh iyo dhirif iyo cadho iyo qaylo iyo cay oo dhammi ha idinka fogaadeen iyo xumaan kastaaba;
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

kikuyu: oo idinka midkiinba midka kale ha u roonaado, oo ha u qalbi jilicsanaado, idinkoo iscafiyaya sidii Ilaahba Masiixa idiinku cafiyey.
english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

kikuyu: Haddaba ahaada kuwo ku dayda Ilaah idinkoo ah sida carruur la jecel yahay.
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

kikuyu: Jacayl ku socda siduu Masiixuba idiin jeclaa, oo uu nafsaddiisii inoogu bixiyey inuu Ilaah u ahaado qurbaan iyo allabari oo uu ahaado caraf udgoon.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

kikuyu: Laakiinse sida ay quduusiinta ugu eg tahay, marnaba yaan dhexdiinna laga sheegin sino, iyo wasakh oo dhan, iyo damacnimo,
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

kikuyu: iyo ceeb, iyo hadal nacasnimo ah, iyo kaftan bilaash ah, oo aan idinku habboonayn, laakiinse waxaa idinku wacan mahadnaqid.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

kikuyu: Waayo, taas waad taqaaniin in dhillay, ama qof wasakh ah, ama nin damac xun oo sanam caabudaa, uusan innaba dhaxal ku lahayn boqortooyada Masiix iyo Ilaah.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

kikuyu: Ninnaba yuusan idinku khiyaanayn hadal aan micne lahayn; waayo, waxyaalahaas daraaddood ayaa cadhada Ilaah ugu soo degtaa carruurta caasinimada.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ha ahaanina kuwa iyaga waxyaalahaas la qaybsada; waayo, mar baad ahaydeen gudcur,
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

kikuyu: haatanse waxaad Rabbiga ku tihiin nuur; haddaba u socda sida carruurta nuurka,
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

kikuyu: waayo, midhaha nuurku waxay ku wada jiraan wanaag iyo xaqnimo iyo run oo dhan.
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

kikuyu: Tijaabiya waxa Rabbigu aad ugu farxo,
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

kikuyu: oo innaba xidhiidh ha la yeelanina shuqullada aan midhaha lahayn oo gudcurka, laakiinse kashifa;
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

kikuyu: waayo, waxay qarsoodiga ku sameeyaan waa ceeb xataa in laga hadlo.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

kikuyu: Laakiinse wax kastaba markii la kashifo ayaa lagu muujiyaa nuurka; waayo, wax alla wixii la muujiyaaba waa nuur.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed isagu wuxuu yidhi, Kaaga hurdow toos, oo kuwii dhintay ka kac, oo Masiixuna waa ku iftiimin doonaa.
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

kikuyu: Haddaba ka digtoonaada sidaad u socotaan, oo ha u soconina sida kuwo aan caqli lahayn, laakiinse u socda sida kuwo caqli leh.
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

kikuyu: Wakhtiga ka faa'iidaysta, maxaa yeelay, maalmuhu shar bay leeyihiin.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed nacasyo ha ahaanina, laakiinse garta waxa ay doonista Rabbigu tahay.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

kikuyu: Ha ku sakhraamina khamriga rabshadu ku jirto, laakiinse Ruuxu ha idinka buuxsamo.
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

kikuyu: Iskula hadla sabuurro iyo heeso ammaan ah iyo gabayo xagga ruuxa, idinkoo gabyaya oo Rabbiga qalbigiinna ka ammaanaya.
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

kikuyu: Mar kasta Ilaaha Aabbaha ah wax walba mahad ugu naqa magaca Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

kikuyu: Midkiinba midka kale ha iska hoosaysiiyo idinkoo Masiixa ka cabsanaya.
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

kikuyu: Dumar yahow, nimankiinna ka dambeeya sidaad Rabbiga uga dambaysaan.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

kikuyu: Waayo, ninku waa madaxa afada sida Masiixuba u yahay madaxa kiniisadda isagoo ah badbaadiyaha jidhka.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

kikuyu: Laakiinse sida kiniisaddu uga dambayso Masiixa, afooyinkuna ha uga dambeeyeen nimankooda xagga wax kastaba.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

kikuyu: Nimankow, idinkuna afooyinkiinna u jeclaada siduu Masiixuba u jeclaaday kiniisadda oo uu nafsaddiisii u bixiyey iyada aawadeed,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

kikuyu: inuu quduus ka dhigo oo ku nadiifiyo maydhidda biyaha xagga erayga,
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

kikuyu: si uu kiniisadda isugu keeno iyadoo qurux badan, oo aan lahayn ama bar ama duudduub ama wax la mid ah, laakiinse inay ahaato mid quduus ah oo aan iin lahayn.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas oo kale nimanka waxaa ku waajib ah inay afooyinkooda u jeclaadaan sida jidhkooda oo kale. Waayo, kii afadiisa jeclaadaa wuxuu jeclaadaa nafsaddiisa;
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, ninna weligiis ma nebcaan jidhkiisa, laakiinse wuu quudiyaa, wuuna xannaaneeyaa, sida Masiixuba u xannaaneeyo kiniisadda;
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

kikuyu: waayo, innagu waxaynu nahay xubnihii jidhkiisa.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

kikuyu: Oo sababtaas aawadeed nin wuxuu ka tegayaa aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis, wuxuuna la joogayaa naagtiisa, oo labaduba waxay noqonayaan isku jidh.
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

kikuyu: Qarsoodiganu waa weyn yahay, laakiinse waxaan ka hadlayaa Masiixa iyo kiniisadda.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee idinka midkiin waluba afadiisa ha u jeclaado sida naftiisa oo kale, oo afaduna ninkeeda ha maamuusto.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

kikuyu: Carruurtay, waalidkiinna ku addeeca xagga Rabbiga, waayo, taasu waa qumman tahay.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

kikuyu: Qaynuunkii kowaad oo ballan la jiraa waa kan, Aabbahaa iyo hooyadaa maamuus
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

kikuyu: inaad nabdoonaatid oo cimrigaagu ku dheeraado dhulka.
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

kikuyu: Aabbayaashow, carruurtiinna ha ka cadhaysiinina, laakiinse waxaad ku korisaan edbinta iyo waanada Rabbiga.
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

kikuyu: Addoommadow, kuwa xagga jidhka sayidyadiinna ah ku addeeca cabsi iyo gariir iyo qalbi daacad ah sidaad Masiixa uga cabsataan oo kale.
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

kikuyu: Ha ahaanina kuwo markii loo jeedo oo keliya shaqeeya sida kuwa dadka ka farxiya, laakiinse ahaada sida addoommada Masiixa, idinkoo doonista Ilaah xagga qalbiga ka samaynaya.
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

kikuyu: Niyo wanaagsan ku adeega sida idinkoo Rabbiga u adeegaya oo aan dad u adeegin,
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

kikuyu: idinkoo garanaya wax kasta oo wanaagsan oo mid kasta sameeyo inuu Rabbiga isla waxaas ka helayo hadduu yahay addoon iyo hadduu yahay xorba.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

kikuyu: Sayidyadow, idinkuna isla waxaas iyaga u sameeya, oo cabsiinta iska daaya, waayo, waad og tihiin inuu kan ah Sayidkooda iyo kiinnaba jannada ku jiro, oo uusan dadka u kala eexan.
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

kikuyu: Ugu dambaysta waxaan idinku leeyahay, Ku xoogaysta Rabbiga iyo xoogga itaalkiisa.
english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

kikuyu: Oo hubka Ilaah oo dhan qaata, si aad u awooddaan inaad sirta Ibliiska hor istaagtaan.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

kikuyu: Waayo, innagu lama legdanno bini-aadan, laakiinse waxaynu la legdannaa kuwa madaxda ah iyo kuwa amarka leh iyo taliyayaasha dunida gudcurka ah iyo ruuxyada sharka ah oo samooyinka ku jira.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed hubka Ilaah qaata si aad u awooddaan inaad maalinta sharka iyaga is-hor taagtaan, oo markaad saas oo dhan yeeshaan aad awooddaan inaad istaagtaan.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

kikuyu: Haddaba istaaga idinkoo runta dhexda ku xidhan, oo laabtana laabdhawrka xaqnimada ku xidhan,
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

kikuyu: oo cagahana gashan isu-diyaarinta injiilka nabadda,
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

kikuyu: oo weliba waxaa kaloo aad qaadataan gaashaanka rumaysadka, kaas oo aad ku awoodaysaan inaad ku wada demisaan kan sharka leh fallaadhihiisa ololaya oo dhan.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad qaadataan koofiyada badbaadada iyo seefta Ruuxa oo ah erayga Ilaah.
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

kikuyu: Mar kasta Ilaah wax kaga barya Ruuxa baryo iyo duco kastaba, oo taas ku dhawra adkaysasho oo dhan iyo u-ducaynta quduusiinta oo dhan.
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

kikuyu: Oo anigana iigu soo duceeya in lay siiyo hadal aan afka ku furo inaan cabsila'aan u muujiyo qarsoodiga injiilka,
english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

kikuyu: kaas oo aan u ahay mid ergo ah oo silsilad ku xidhan, inaan cabsila'aan ugu hadlo sida igu waajibka ah.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

kikuyu: Laakiinse inaad ogaataan axwaashayda iyo sidaan ahayba, waxaa idiin wada sheegi doona Tukhikos oo xagga Rabbiga ku ah walaalkay gacaliye iyo midiidin aamin ah.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

kikuyu: Waxaan isaga idiinku soo diray isla sababtan inaad xaaladdayada ogaataan iyo inuu qalbigiinna dhiirrigeliyo.
english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

kikuyu: Walaalaha ha u ahaadeen nabad iyo jacayl rumaysad la jiro oo xagga Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix ka yimid.
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kulligood kuwa Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix jacaylka aan dhammaanayn ku jecel, nimco ha u ahaato.
english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

kikuyu: Annagoo ah Bawlos iyo Timoteyos, oo ah addoommadii Ciise Masiix, waxaannu warqaddan u qoraynaa kulli quduusiinta Ciise Masiix oo magaalada Filiboy la jooga hoggaamiyayaasha kiniisadda iyo caawiyayaasha.
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

kikuyu: Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Mar kastoo aan idin xusuustaba Ilaahay baan u mahadnaqaa,
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

kikuyu: oo kol kasta markaan kulligiin idiin duceeyo, waxaan idiin soo duceeyaa anigoo faraxsan
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

kikuyu: wehelnimadiinna xagga ka-wadashaqaynta injiilka aawadeed maalintii ugu horraysay ilaa haatan.
english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan aaminsanahay in kan shuqul wanaagsan idinku dhex bilaabay uu dhammayn doono ilamaa maalinta Ciise Masiix.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed waa igu qumman tahay inaan sidaas kulligiin idiinka fikiro, waayo, qalbigaan idinku hayaa, maxaa yeelay, kulligiin waxaad tihiin kuwo nimcada igala qayb qaata xagga xidhnaantayda iyo xagga daaficidda iyo xaqiiqaynta injiilkaba.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

kikuyu: Aniga Ilaah baa iiga markhaati ah sidaan kulligiin idinkugu xiisoonayo xagga jacaylka Ciise Masiix.
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Waxaan Ilaah ka baryayaa in jacaylkiinnu aad iyo aad ugu sii bato xagga aqoonta iyo waxgarashada oo dhan,
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

kikuyu: inaad waxyaalaha wanaagsan tijaabisaan, oo aad daacad iyo ceeb ka saliin ahaataan ilamaa maalinta Masiixa,
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

kikuyu: idinkoo ay midhaha xaqnimadu idinka buuxaan, kuwaas oo Ciise Masiix ku yimaada, oo Ilaah u ah ammaan iyo mahad.
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

kikuyu: Haddaba, walaalayaalow, waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad ogaataan in waxyaalihii igu dhacay ay injiilka horumar u noqdeen,
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

kikuyu: sidaas daraaddeed waxaa askartii boqorka iyo kuwa kale oo dhanba u wada muuqday inaan Ciise Masiix aawadiis u xidhnahay.
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

kikuyu: Oo weliba walaalaha xagga Rabbiga badidood, iyagoo xidhnaantayda ku kalsoon, ayay aad iyo aad ugu dhiirran yihiin inay ereyga Ilaah cabsila'aan ku hadlaan.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

kikuyu: Runtii waxaa jira qaar Masiixa ku naadiya xaasidnimo iyo dirir, qaarna waxay ku naadiyaan niyo wanaagsan.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

kikuyu: Qaarko waxay ku naadiyaan jacayl, iyagoo og in la ii doortay injiilka daaficiddiisa,
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

kikuyu: laakiinse kuwa kale waxay Masiixa u naadiyaan si ay dadka u kala qaybqaybiyaan, iyagoo aan daacad ahayn oo ku fikiraya inay dhib igu kiciyaan anigoo xidhan.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

kikuyu: Haddaba waa sidee? Hadday iska yeelyeel tahay iyo hadday dhab tahayba, Masiixa si kastaba waa loo naadiyaa, oo anigu taas waan ku farxay oo weliba waan ku farxi doonaa.
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaan ogahay in taasu badbaado ay iigu noqonayso xagga ducadiinna iyo caawimaadda Ruuxa Ciise Masiix,
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: sida aan aad iyo aad u filanayo oo u rajaynayo, inaanan waxba ku ceeboobin, laakiinse siday weligeed ahaan jirtay in haddeerna dhiirranaan oo dhan Masiixa lagu ammaano jidhkayga, hadday tahay nolol iyo hadday tahay dhimashoba.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

kikuyu: Waayo, aniga waxaa nolosha ii ah Masiixa, oo dhimashaduna waa ii faa'iido.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

kikuyu: Laakiinse inaan jidhka ku sii noolaado, hadday taasu tahay midhaha hawshayda, waxaan doorto garan maayo.
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu labada dhexdoodaan ku dhibtoonayaa, oo waxaan jeclahay inaan tago oo Masiixa la joogo, waayo, taasu aad bay iigu roon tahay,
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

kikuyu: laakiinse inaan jidhka ku sii jiro aad baa loogu sii baahan yahay idinka aawadiin.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

kikuyu: Waan aaminsanahay oo waan ogahay inaan sii joogi doono, oo aan kulligiin idinla sii joogi doono horumarkiinna iyo farxadda rumaysadkiinna aawadood,
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

kikuyu: in faankiinnu Ciise Masiix ku bato xaggayga, joogistayda aan mar kale idinla joogo aawadeed.
english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

kikuyu: Laakiinse dabiicaddiinnu ha ahaato mid istaahisha injiilka Masiixa, in haddii aan imaado oo aan idin arko, ama haddii aan maqnaadoba, aan wax xaaladdiinna ku saabsan maqlo inaad isku ruux keliya ku taagan tihiin idinkoo isku naf ku dadaalaya iimaanka injiilka,
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

kikuyu: oo idinku innaba ha ka cabsanina cadaawayaashiinna, taas oo iyaga u ah calaamada halaagga, laakiinse waxay idiin tahay calaamada badbaadadiinna, taasuna waxay ka timaadaa xagga Ilaah.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, waxaa laydinku siiyey Masiixa aawadiis, mana aha inaad isaga rumaysataan oo keliya, laakiinse inaad isaga daraaddiisna u xanuunsataan,
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

kikuyu: idinkoo ku dadaalaya isku dadaalkii aad igu aragteen oo haatanna aad igu maqashaan.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii ay Masiixa ku jiraan dhiirrigelin iyo qalbiqabowjis jacayl ah iyo haddii ay ku jirto walaalnimo xagga Ruuxa iyo haddii ay ku jiraan jixinjix iyo naxariis,
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

kikuyu: farxaddayda buuxiya, inaad isku maan ahaataan oo aad isku jacayl lahaataan, idinkoo isku niyo ah oo isku maan ah.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

kikuyu: Idinku waxba ha ku samaynina iskala-qaybqaybin iyo faan bilaash ah, laakiinse wax walba ku sameeya is-hoosaysiin, idinkoo midkiinba midka kale ku tirinayo inuu ka kale isaga ka wanaagsan yahay.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

kikuyu: Midkiin waluba yuusan fiiro u lahaan waxyaalihiisa, laakiinse midkiin waluba fiiro ha u lahaado waxyaalaha kuwa kale.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

kikuyu: Fikirkaas oo Ciise Masiix ku jiray, idinkana ha idinku jiro.
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu lahaa suuradda Ilaah, oo inuu Ilaah la mid ahaado kuma uu tirin in taasu tahay boobis,
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

kikuyu: laakiinse wuu ismadhiyey, oo wuxuu qaatay addoon suuraddiis, oo wuxuu noqday mid dad u eg,
english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

kikuyu: oo markuu nin u ekaaday, ayuu is-hoosaysiiyey oo addeecay inuu dhinto, xataa inuu iskutallaabta ku dhinto.
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed Ilaah isaga aad buu u sarraysiiyey, oo wuxuu isaga siiyey magaca magac kasta ka sarreeya;
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

kikuyu: in jilib kastoo ah waxyaalaha samada ku jira iyo waxyaalaha dhulka jooga iyo waxyaalaha dhulka ka hooseeyaaba, ay magaca Ciise u wada sujuudaan,
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

kikuyu: iyo in carrab kastaaba qirto in Ciise Masiix yahay Rabbiga in Ilaaha Aabbaha ah lagu ammaano.
english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

kikuyu: Haddaba, gacaliyayaalow, xataa sidii aad weligiin u addeeci jirteen, iyadoo aan ahayn intii aan idinla joogay oo keliya, laakiinse haatan intaan idinka maqnahay si sidii hore aad uga sii badan badbaadadiinna ku shaqaysta cabsi iyo gariir,
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

kikuyu: waayo, waa Ilaah kan idinkaga dhex shaqeeya xagga doonista iyo xagga shuqulkaba farxaddiisa wanaagsan aawadeed.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

kikuyu: Haddaba wax walba ku sameeya gunuunac iyo muran la'aantood,
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

kikuyu: inaad ceeb iyo eed la'aataan, idinkoo ah carruurtii Ilaah oo aan iin lahayn, oo ku dhex jira qarni qalloocan oo qallafsan, kuwaas oo aad uga dhex muuqataan sida nuurar dunida ku dhex jira,
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

kikuyu: idinkoo hore u soo fidinaya ereyga nolosha, si aan anigu u helo wax aan ku faano maalinta Masiixa, taas oo ah inaanan micnela'aan u ordin oo aanan micnela'aan u hawshoon.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

kikuyu: Oo weliba haddii laygu dul sadqeeyo allabariga iyo hawsha rumaysadkiinna, waan farxayaa, oo kulligiin waan idinla farxayaa,
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

kikuyu: oo weliba sidaas oo kale idinkuna waad farxaysaan oo waad ila rayraysaan.
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaan Rabbi Ciise ka rajaynayaa inaan dhowaan idiin soo diro Timoteyos si aan aniguna ugu farxo markii aan xaaladdiinna ogaado.
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

kikuyu: Waayo, ma aan hayo nin isaga la mid ah oo xaaladdiinna si dhab ah uga welwelaya.
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu waxay kulligood doonayaan waxyaalahooda, mana aha waxyaalaha Ciise Masiix.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku waad taqaaniin xaqiiqadiisa in sida ilmo aabbihiis ugu adeego uu isagu iigula adeegay xagga injiilka.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaan rajaynayaa inaan haddiiba isaga idiin soo diro markii aan arko sida ay xaaladdaydu u socoto.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbigaan ku kalsoonahay inaan aniga qudhayduna dhowaan idiin iman doono.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaan lagamamaarmaan ku tiriyey inaan idiin soo diro Ebafroditos oo ah walaalkay iyo mid ila shaqeeya oo aan isku askar nahay, oo ah kii aad soo dirteen iyo midiidinkiinna xagga baahidayda,
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, isagu wuu idiin xiisooday kulligiin, oo aad buu u tiiraanyooday, waayo, idinku waad maqasheen inuu bukay,
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

kikuyu: oo xaqiiqa isagu wuu bukay oo dhimashuu ku dhowaaday, laakiinse Ilaah baa u naxariistay isaga, mana aha isaga oo keliya, laakiinse anigana wuu ii naxariistay, inaanan lahaan caloolxumo caloolxumo dul saaran.
english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed anigoo aad u dadaalaya ayaan isagii soo diray, inaad faraxdaan markii aad mar kale aragtaan, oo ay anigana caloolxumadu iga yaraato.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed idinkoo aad u faraxsan isaga Rabbiga ku qaabbila, oo kuwa isaga la mid ahna maamuusa,
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, shuqulka Masiixa aawadiis ayuu dhimasho ugu dhowaaday, markuu nafsaddiisa khatar u geliyey inuu dhammaystiro wixii ka dhinnaa hawshii aad ii qabateen.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

kikuyu: Walaalahayow, ugu dambaysta, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Rabbiga ku farxa. Sida xaqiiqadaa anigu inaan isla wixii idiin soo qoro dhib iguma aha, laakiinse idinka way idiin roon tahay.
english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

kikuyu: Eeyaha iska jira, oo iska jira kuwa sharka sameeya, oo iska jira gudniinta beenta ah,
english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

kikuyu: waayo, innagu waxaynu nahay kuwa gudan oo Ruuxa Ilaah ku caabuda, oo Ciise Masiix ku faana, oo aan jidhkana ku kalsoonayn,
english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

kikuyu: in kastoo aan aniga qudhayduba jidhka ku kalsoonahay, haddii nin u malaynayo inuu jidhka ku kalsoon yahay anigu waan ka sii daranahay.
english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

kikuyu: Aniga waxaa lay guday maalintii siddeedaad, oo waxaan ahay jinsiga reer binu Israa'iil, oo waxaan ka ahay qabiilka Benyaamiin, oo waxaan ahay Cibraani ka mid ah Cibraaniyada; oo xagga sharcigana waxaan ahay Farrisi;
english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

kikuyu: xagga qiiradana waxaan ahaa mid silcin jiray kiniisadda, xagga xaqnimada sharciga ku jirtana waxaan ahaa eedlaawe.
english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee waxyaalihii faa'iidada ii ahaa kuwaas Masiixa aawadiis ayaan khasaare ku tiriyey.
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

kikuyu: Runtii anigu wax kasta ayaan khasaare ku tirinayaa wanaagga aqoonta aan aqaan Rabbigayga Ciise Masiix aawadiis, kaas oo aan aawadiis wax kasta ugu khasaaray, oo haatan waxaan ku tirinayaa inay yihiin qushaash inaan Masiix faa'iido ahaan u helo
english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

kikuyu: oo isaga dhexdiisa layga helo, anigoo aan lahayn xaqnimo tayda ah, taas oo sharciga laga helo, laakiinse anigoo leh tan laga helo rumaysadka Masiixa, taas oo ah xaqnimada xagga Ilaah rumaysadka lagaga helo,
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

kikuyu: inaan ogaado isaga iyo xoogga sarakiciddiisa iyo wadawadaagidda xanuunsigiisa, anigoo isaga xagga dhimashadiisa ugu ekaanaya,
english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

kikuyu: si kasta ha ahaatee haddii aan gaadhi karo sarakicidda kuwii dhintay.
english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

kikuyu: Mana aha inaan hore u helay amase hore la ii kaamilay, laakiinse waan ku sii dadaalayaa inaan qabsado wixii Ciise Masiix ii qabtay.
english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Walaalahayow, anigu ku tirin maayo inaan aniga qudhaydu weli qabsaday, laakiinse wax keliya ayaan samaynayaa, waxyaalihii iga dambeeyey intaan illoobo ayaan waxaan laacayaa waxyaalaha iga horreeya.
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

kikuyu: Anigu waxaan dadaal ugu roorayaa xagga goolka iyo ilaa abaalgudka yeedhista sare oo Ilaah oo ah xagga Ciise Masiix.
