english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed in alla inteennii kaamil ahu aan sidaas ku fikirno, oo haddii aad si kala duwan wax kaga fikirtaan, xataa waxaas Ilaah baa idiin muujin doona.
english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

kikuyu: Laakiin wixii aynu hore u gaadhnay, isla waxaas aynu ku soconno.
english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, idinku kulligiin igu wada dayda, oo u fiirsada kuwa sidaas u socda xataa sidaad annaga masaal noogu haysataan.
english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa jira kuwa badan oo socda oo aan marar badan wax idiinka sheegay, oo aan haddana anigoo ooyaya idiin sheegayo inay yihiin cadaawayaasha iskutallaabta Masiixa,
english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

kikuyu: oo kuwaas dhammaadkoodu waa halligaad, ilaahooduna waa caloosha, ammaantooduna waxay ku jirtaa ceebtooda, oo waxay ka fikiraan waxyaalaha dunida.
english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

kikuyu: Laakiinse innaga waddaninimadeennu waxay ku jirtaa jannada halkaasoo aynu weliba ka sugayno Badbaadiye kaas oo ah Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Isagu wuxuu beddeli doonaa jidhkeenna liita inuu u ekaado jidhkiisa ammaanta leh, oo wuxuu ku beddelayaa xoogga uu isagu ku awoodo inuu wax kastaba isaga hoosaysiiyo.
english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed walaalahayga aan jeclahay oo aan u xiisoonayow, idinku waxaad tihiin farxaddayda iyo taajkayga. Gacaliyayaalow, xagga Rabbiga saas ugu xoogaysta.
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

kikuyu: Waxaan waaninayaa Yu'odiya, oo waxaan waaninayaa Suntukhee inay labadoodu xagga Rabbiga isku maan ahaadaan.
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

kikuyu: Ka ila shaqeeya oo runta ahow, waxaan kaa baryayaa inaad dumarkaas caawiso, waayo, iyaga iyo Kaleemeentos iyo kuwa kaloo ila shaqeeyaba oo magacyadoodu ku qoran yihiin kitaabka nolosha, waxay iila dhibtoodeen injiilka aawadiis.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

kikuyu: Mar kasta Rabbiga ku faraxsanaada, oo weliba waxaan idin leeyahay, Farxa.
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

kikuyu: Qabownimadiinna dadka oo dhammu ha ogaado, waayo, Rabbigu waa soo dhow yahay.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

kikuyu: Waxba ha ka welwelina, laakiinse wax kastaba baryadiinna Ilaah ku ogeysiiya tukasho iyo duco mahadnaqid la jirto.
english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

kikuyu: Oo nabadda Ilaah oo waxgarasho kasta ka sarraysa ayaa waxay qalbiyadiinna iyo fikirradiinna ku dhawri doontaa Ciise Masiix.
english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ugu dambaysta, walaalayaalow, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Wax kasta oo run ah, iyo wax kasta oo sharaf leh, iyo wax kasta oo xaq ah, iyo wax kasta oo daahir ah, iyo wax kasta oo door ah, iyo wax kasta oo wanaag laga sheego, haddii wanaag ku jiro iyo haddii ammaanu ku jirto, waxyaalahan ka fiirsada.
english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

kikuyu: Idinku sameeya waxyaalihii aad barateen, oo aad hesheen, oo aad maqasheen, oo aad aniga igu aragteen; oo Ilaaha nabadduna wuu idinla jiri doonaa.
english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

kikuyu: Laakiin Rabbiga aad baan ugu faraxsanahay inaad haatan ugu dambaysta mar kale iga fikirteen; taas oo aad ka fikiri jirteen laakiin aad fursad u weydeen.
english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

kikuyu: Ka hadli maayo baahi, waayo, waxaan bartay inaan raalli ku ahaado hadba xaaladdii aan ku jiro.
english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

kikuyu: Waxaan aqaan saboolnimada, oo weliba waxaan aqaanna barwaaqada. Meel kasta iyo wax walba waxaan ku bartay dhergidda iyo gaajadaba, barwaaqada iyo baahidaba.
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

kikuyu: Wax walba waan ku samayn karaa gargaarkiisa kan i xoogeeya.
english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee si wanaagsan baad yeesheen markaad dhibaatadayda ila qaybsateen.
english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

kikuyu: Idinka qudhiinnuba waad taqaaniin, reer Filiboyow, in injiilka bilowgiisii markii aan Makedoniya ka soo kacay aan kiniisaduna ila qaybsan waxa ku saabsan bixinta iyo helidda, idinkoo keliya mooyaane.
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

kikuyu: Waayo, xataa markii aan Tesaloniika joogay, idinku mar iyo labaad ii soo dirteen wixii aan u baahnaa.
english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

kikuyu: Ma aha inaan hadiyad doonayo, laakiin waxaan doonayaa midhaha xaggiinna ku kordhaya.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

kikuyu: Laakiinse anigu wax kastaba waan haystaa, oo waan barwaaqaysanahay. Waan dheregsanahay, waayo, waxaan Ebafroditos ka helay wixii aad ii soo dirteen, kuwaas oo ah allabari Ilaah aqbali karo oo uu aad ugu farxo oo caraf udgoon leh.
english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

kikuyu: Ilaahaygu wuu idin siin doonaa wixii aad u baahan tihiin oo dhan, sida ay tahay hodantinimadiisa xagga ammaanta Ciise Masiix ku jirta.
english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Haddaba ammaanu ha u ahaato Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah weligiis iyo weligiis. Aamiin.
english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

kikuyu: Igu salaama mid kasta oo ka mid ah quduusiinta Ciise Masiix. Walaalaha ila joogaa way idin soo salaamayaan.
english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

kikuyu: Quduusiinta oo dhammu way idin soo salaamayaan, khusuusan kuwa guriga Kaysar jooga.
english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

kikuyu: Nimcada Rabbi Ciise Masiix ha la jirto ruuxiinna.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Anigoo ah Bawlos, oo ah rasuulkii Ciise Masiix xagga doonista Ilaah, iyo walaalkeen Timoteyos,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

kikuyu: waxaannu warqaddan u qoraynaa quduusiinta iyo walaalaha aaminka ah ee Masiixa ku jira oo Kolosay jooga. Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah.
english: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waxaannu ku mahadnaqnaa Ilaaha ah Aabbaha Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, annagoo had iyo goorba idiin soo ducaynayna.
english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

kikuyu: Waxaannu maqalnay rumaysadkiinna xagga Ciise Masiix iyo jacaylka aad quduusiinta oo dhan u qabtaan,
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

kikuyu: rajada jannada laydiin dhigay aawadeed, taas oo aad hore ugu maqasheen hadalka runta ah oo injiilka.
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

kikuyu: Kaasu waa idiin yimid, xataa siduu ugu yimid dunida oo dhan isagoo midho dhalaya oo kordhaya, sida uu idinkana midho idiinku dhalayo oo idiinku kordhayo, tan iyo maalintii aad maqasheen oo aad ogaateen nimcada Ilaah oo runta ku jirta.
english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

kikuyu: Sidaasaad ka barateen gacaliyeheenna Ebafras oo addoon nala ah, oo Masiixa u ah midiidin aamin ah aawadeen,
english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

kikuyu: kaas oo weliba noo caddeeyey jacaylkiinna Ruuxa ku jira.
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

kikuyu: Sababtaas daraaddeed tan iyo maalintii aannu taas maqalnay ma aannu joojin inaannu idiin soo ducayno. Waxaannu Ilaah idiin baryaynaa inay idinka buuxsanto aqoonta doonistiisa xagga xigmadda iyo waxgarashada Ruuxa oo dhan,
english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

kikuyu: inaad u socotaan si Rabbiga istaahisha oo aad wax kasta isaga kaga farxisaan, idinkoo midho ku soo saaraya shuqul kasta oo wanaagsan oo ku sii kordhaya aqoonta Ilaah.
english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

kikuyu: Weliba waxaannu Ilaah baryaynaa inaad ku xoogaysataan xoog oo dhan sida uu yahay itaalka ammaantiisu xagga adkaysashada iyo dulqaadashada farxaddu la jirto oo dhan.
english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

kikuyu: Mahad baannu u naqaynaa Aabbaha inaga dhigay kuwa istaahila inay ka qayb qaataan dhaxalka quduusiinta nuurka ku jirta.
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

kikuyu: Isagu waa inaga samatabbixiyey xoogga gudcurka, oo wuxuu inoo beddelay boqortooyadii Wiilka jacaylkiisa,
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

kikuyu: kaas oo aynu ku leennahay madaxfurasho ah dembidhaafka.
english: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

kikuyu: Isagu waa suuraddii Ilaaha aan la arki karin, oo ah curadka uunka oo dhan;
english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

kikuyu: waayo, wax kastaba isagaa uumay, waxyaalaha samooyinka ku jira, iyo waxyaalaha dhulka joogaba, waxyaalaha la arki karo iyo waxyaalaha aan la arki karinba, hadday yihiin carshiyo ama sayidnimo ama madax ama amarro; wax walba isagaa uumay oo loo uumay.
english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

kikuyu: Isagu wax kastaba wuu ka horreeyaa, oo wax kastaaba isagay isku haystaan.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

kikuyu: Oo isagu waa madaxa jidhka, kaas oo ah kiniisadda, oo isagu waa bilowgii iyo curadka kuwii dhintay ka kacay, si uu uga horreeyo wax kastaba.
english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa Aabbaha ka farxisay in buuxnaanta oo dhammu ay isaga ku jirto,
english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

kikuyu: iyo inuu isaga wax kastaba xaggiisa kula heshiiyo, isagoo kula nabday dhiiga iskutallaabtiisa; hadday yihiin waxyaalaha dhulka jooga ama hadday yihiin waxyaalaha samooyinka ku jiraba.
english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

kikuyu: Idinku waa hore waxaad ahaydeen kuwo ajanabi laga dhigay, oo maankiinnana cadow baad ka ahaydeen xagga shuqulladiinna sharka ah,
english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

kikuyu: laakiinse haatan isagu wuxuu idinkula heshiiyey jidhkiisii aadmiga oo dhintay, inuu isagu hortiisa idin keeno idinkoo quduus ah oo aan iin iyo eed midna lahayn,
english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

kikuyu: haddii aad ku sii jirtaan iimaanka, oo aad gun iyo xidid adag ku leedihiin, oo aydnaan ka fogaan rajadii injiilkii aad maqasheen, kaas oo lagu wacdiyey uunka samada ka hooseeya oo dhan, oo anigoo Bawlos ah layga dhigay midiidin.
english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

kikuyu: Haatan waxaan ku farxaa xanuunsigayga aan idiin xanuunsado, oo waxaan dhammaystiraa dhibaatooyinka Masiixa oo jidhkayga ku dhiman jidhkiisa aawadiis kaasoo ah kiniisadda.
english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

kikuyu: Taas waxaa la iiga dhigay midiidin xagga wakiilnimada Ilaah oo aniga aawadiin la ii siiyey inaan dhammaan erayga Ilaah ku wada wacdiyo.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

kikuyu: Wuxuu ahaa wax aan la garanayn oo qarsoonaa tan iyo weligiis iyo qarni kasta, laakiinse haatan waxaa loo muujiyey quduusiintiisa.
english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

kikuyu: Kuwaas Ilaah baa ku farxay inuu iyaga ogeysiiyo waxa ay tahay hodantinimada ammaanta qarsoodigan ee ku dhex jira quruumaha, kaas oo ah Masiixa idinku jira oo ah rajada ammaanta.
english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

kikuyu: Isaga waannu naadinnaa, annagoo nin kasta waaninayna oo nin kasta wax ku barayna xigmad oo dhan, inaannu nin walba hor keenno isagoo Masiixa kaamil ku ah.
english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

kikuyu: Taas ayaan u hawshoodaa anigoo aad u dadaalaya sida uu yahay shuqulkiisa si xoog leh igaga dhex shaqeeyaa.
english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad ogaataan sida weyn oo aan idiinku dadaalayo idinka iyo kuwa La'odikiya jooga iyo in alla intii aan arag wejigayga anoo nool;
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

kikuyu: inay qalbiyadoodu dhiirranaadaan, iyagoo jacayl isugu xidhan, iyo inay wada helaan hodantinimada hubaasha waxgarashada, inay ogaadaan qarsoodiga Ilaah, kaas oo ah Masiixa.
english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

kikuyu: Isaga waxaa ku wada qarsoon waxyaalaha qaaliga ah oo dhan oo ah xigmadda iyo aqoonta.
english: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

kikuyu: Taas waxaan u leeyahay inaan ninna idinku khiyaanayn hadal sasabasho ah.
english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

kikuyu: In kastoo aan idinka maqnahay xagga jidhka, weliba waan idinla joogaa xagga ruuxa, anigoo faraxsan oo fiirinaya nidaamkiinna iyo adkaanta rumaysadkiinna, xagga Masiixa.
english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaad u aqbasheen Rabbi Ciise Masiix, ku socda,
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

kikuyu: idinkoo isaga xidid ku yeeshay oo ku dhismay, oo rumaysadkiinna ku adkaaday, taas oo ah sidii laydiin baray, oo aad u mahadnaqa.
english: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Iska jira yaan ninna idinku dhicin faylosofiyadiisa iyo khiyaanadiisa bilaashka ah xagga caadooyinka dadka iyo waxyaalaha dunida ugu horreeya oo aan ka iman xagga Masiixa,
english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

kikuyu: waayo, buuxnaanta Ilaahnimada oo dhammu waa ku jirtaa isagoo jidh leh,
english: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

kikuyu: oo waa laydin buuxiyey idinkoo ku jira isagoo ah madaxa taaliye kasta iyo amar kasta.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

kikuyu: Oo isaga xaggiisaa laydinkaga guday gudniin aan gacmo lagu samayn markii aad gudniinta Masiixa ku xoorteen jidhka aadmiga.
english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

kikuyu: Idinka waxaa isaga laydinkula aasay baabtiiska, kaas oo isaga laydinkula soo kiciyey xagga rumaysadka aad u qabtaan xoogga Ilaah oo shaqeeya oo isaga kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey.
english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

kikuyu: Idinkoo ku dhintay xadgudubyadiinnii iyo buuryoqabnimadii jidhkiinna ayuu weliba isaga idinla soo noolaysiiyey, isagoo inaga cafiyey xadgudubyadeennii oo dhan.
english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

kikuyu: Wuxuu baabbi'iyey dacwadii inoogu qornayd qaynuunnada oo inaga geesta ahayd, oo weliba intuu fogeeyey ayuu ku qodbay iskutallaabta.
english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

kikuyu: Isagu hubkuu ka qaaday taliyayaasha iyo kuwa amarka leh, oo bayaan ayuu u ceebeeyey, isagoo iyaga kaga guulaysanaya.
english: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

kikuyu: Haddaba ninna yuusan idinku xukumin wax ku saabsan cunto ama cabbid ama maalin iid ah ama bil dhalatay ama maalmaha sabtida,
english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

kikuyu: kuwaas oo ah hooska waxyaalaha iman doona, laakiinse jidhka waxaa iska leh Masiixa.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

kikuyu: Ninna yuusan abaalgudkiinna idinka dulmin isagoo idin oggolaysiinaya is-hoosaysiinta iyo malaa'ig caabudidda, oo dhex gelaya waxyaalaha uusan arkin, oo micnela'aan ugu kibraya maankiisa aadmiga,
english: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

kikuyu: oo aan xajisanayn Madaxa jidhka oo dhammu wax ka helo, oo xubnaha iyo seedaha isku haysta, oo kordhinta Ilaah ku kordha.
english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

kikuyu: Haddii aad Masiixa kala dhimateen waxyaalaha dunida ugu horreeya, maxaad sidii idinkoo dunida ku nool isaga hoosaysiisaan qaynuunnada,
english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

kikuyu: kuwaas oo leh, Ha qaban, Ha dhadhamin, Ha taaban?
english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas oo dhan ayaa isticmaal ku wada baabba'aya. Qaynuunnadu waxay ka yimaadeen amarrada iyo cilmiga dadka.
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaasu sida haqiiqada ah waxay leeyihiin muuqasho xigmad ah xagga caabudidda qof naftiisa ku qasbo iyo is-hoosaysiinta iyo saxariirinta jidhka, laakiinse iyagu faa'iido ma leh ay ku hor joogsadaan dherjinta jidhka.
english: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii laydinla soo sara kiciyey Masiix, doondoona waxyaalaha korka yaal, meesha uu Masiixu joogo, isagoo fadhiya midigta Ilaah.
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

kikuyu: Ka fikira waxyaalaha korka yaal, hana ka fikirina waxyaalaha dhulka yaal.
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

kikuyu: Waayo, idinku waad dhimateen, oo noloshiinnuna Masiixay kula qarsoon tahay Ilaah.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

kikuyu: Masiixa oo ah nolosheenna, markuu soo muuqdo, kolkaasaad idinkuna ammaan kula soo muuqan doontaan.
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

kikuyu: Haddaba dila xubnihiinna dhulka yaal, kuwaas oo ah sino, iyo wasakhnimo, iyo kacsi xaaraan ah, iyo damac shar ah, iyo hunguri xumaan, taas oo ah sanam caabudid,
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

kikuyu: waxyaalahaas oo daraaddood ay cadhada Ilaah ugu soo degto carruurta caasinimada.
english: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Kuwaas ayaad waagii hore ku socon jirteen markii aad waxyaalahaas ku noolaan jirteen.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan iska fogeeya waxyaalahan oo dhan, kuwaas oo ah xanaaq, iyo cadho, iyo xumaan, iyo cay, iyo hadalka ceebta ah oo afkiinna ka baxa.
english: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

kikuyu: Been ha isu sheegina, waayo, idinku waad iska xoorteen dabiicaddii hore iyo falimaheediiba,
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

kikuyu: oo waxaad huwateen dabiicadii cusbayd taas oo loo cusboonaysiinayo aqoon sida ay tahay u-ekaanta kan iyada abuuray.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

kikuyu: Halkaas ma jiri karaan Gariig ama Yuhuudi, mid gudan ama mid buuryoqab ah, reer Barbari, ama reer Iskutees, addoon ama xor; laakiinse Masiixu waa wax walba, oo wax walba wuu ku jiraa.
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed idinku sida kuwa Ilaah doortay oo quduuska ah oo la jecel yahay, huwada qalbi leh naxariis iyo roonaan iyo is-hoosaysiin iyo qaboobaan iyo dulqaadasho.
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

kikuyu: Midkiinba midka kale ha u dulqaato oo ha cafiyo, haddii mid ka cabanayo mid kale; xataa sida Rabbiguba idiin cafiyey, idinkuna sidaas oo kale yeela:
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

kikuyu: oo waxyaalahaas oo dhan waxaad ka dul huwataan jacayl, kaas oo ah xidhiidhka kaamilnimada.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

kikuyu: Oo nabadda Masiixuna ha ku taliso qalbiyadiinna, taas oo laysugu kiin yeedhay isku jidh keliya; oo mahadnaqayaal ahaada.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

kikuyu: Oo erayga Masiixu ha idiinku jiro si badan xagga xigmadda oo dhan, idinkoo wax isbaraya oo isku waaninaya sabuurro iyo heeso ammaan ah iyo gabayo xagga ruuxa, idinkoo Ilaah ugu gabyaya nimcada qalbiyadiinna ku jirta.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

kikuyu: Oo wax alla wixii aad ku samaysaan hadal ama shuqulba, magaca Rabbi Ciise ku wada sameeya oo Ilaaha Aabbaha ah ugu mahadnaqa isaga.
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

kikuyu: Dumar yahow, nimankiinna ka dambeeya sida ay ugu habboon tahay xagga Rabbiga.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

kikuyu: Nimankow, idinkuna afooyinkiinna jeclaada oo ha ku qadhaadhoobina.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

kikuyu: Carruurtoy, waalidkiinna wax kastaba ku addeeca, waayo, taasu waa ka farxisaa Rabbiga.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

kikuyu: Aabbayaashow, carruurtiinna ha ka cadhaysiinina, yeeyan qalbi jabine.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

kikuyu: Addoommadow, wax kastaba ku addeeca kuwa xagga jidhka sayidyadiinna ah; hana ahaanina kuwo markii loo jeedo oo keliya shaqeeya sida kuwa dadka ka farxiya, laakiinse ku adeega qalbi daacad ah, idinkoo Rabbiga ka cabsanaya.
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

kikuyu: Wax alla wixii aad samaysaanba, xagga qalbiga ka sameeya, sidii idinkoo Rabbiga u samaynaya oo aan dad aawadiis u samaynayn,
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

kikuyu: idinkoo garanaya inaad xagga Rabbiga ka heli doontaan abaalgudkii dhaxalka. Waxaad u adeegtaan Rabbiga Masiixa ah.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii xumaan falaa wuxuu dib u heli doonaa xumaantuu falay, waayo, dadka looma kala eexdo.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

kikuyu: Sayidyadow, addoommadiinna siiya waxa xaqa ah oo u qalma, idinkoo garanaya inaad jannada Sayid ku leedihiin.
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

kikuyu: Haddaba baryada ku sii adkaada, idinkoo ku soo jeeda oo mahadnaqaya.
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

kikuyu: Oo weliba annagana noo soo duceeya in Ilaah noo furo albaabka hadalka, si aannu uga hadalno qarsoodiga Masiixa, kaas oo aan u xidhnahay;
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

kikuyu: inaan u muujiyo, sida igu waajibka ah inaan uga hadlo.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

kikuyu: Kuwa dibadda jooga xaggooda xigmad ku socda, oo wakhtiga ku faa'iidaysta.
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

kikuyu: Mar kasta hadalkiinnu nimco ha lahaado isagoo cusbo lagu daray, inaad ogaataan sida idinku waajibka ah inaad mid kasta ugu jawaabtaan.
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

kikuyu: Axwaalkayga oo dhan waxaa idiin sheegi doona walaalkeen Tukhikos oo ah gacaliye iyo midiidin aamin ah oo addoon ila ah xagga Rabbiga.
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

kikuyu: Isagaan idiinku soo diray sababtan daraaddeed, inaad ogaataan axwaalkayaga iyo inuu qalbiyadiinna dhiirrigeliyo,
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

kikuyu: oo weliba waxaan isaga la soo diray walaalkeen Oneesimos, kaas oo ah mid aamin ah iyo gacaliye, oo idinka mid ah. Iyagu waxay idiinka warrami doonaan waxa meeshan ka dhacay oo dhan.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

kikuyu: Waxaa idin soo salaamaya Aristarkhos oo ila xidhan, iyo Markos oo Barnabas abti u yahay, kaas oo wax isaga ku saabsan laydinku amray; hadduu idiin yimaado aqbala.
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

kikuyu: Weliba waxaa idin soo salaamaya Ciise oo la yidhaahdo Yuustos. Kuwaas oo ka mid ah kuwa gudan ayaa ah kuwa keliya oo iila shaqeeya boqortooyada Ilaah, iyagoo ii noqday kuwo i dhiirrigeliyey.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

kikuyu: Waxaa kaloo idin soo salaamaya Ebafras, oo idinka mid ah, oo ah addoonkii Ciise Masiix. Kol kastaba baryadiisa ayuu idiinku dadaalaa inaad istaagtaan, idinkoo kaamil ah oo aad u huba doonista Ilaah oo dhan.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

kikuyu: Waxaan ugu markhaati furayaa inuu u hawshoodo idinka aawadiin iyo kuwa La'odikiya jooga iyo kuwa Hi'erabolis jooga aawadood.
english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

kikuyu: Waxaa idin soo salaamaya Luukos oo ah gacaliyaha dakhtarkaa iyo Deemaas.
english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

kikuyu: Walaalaha La'odikiya jooga iyo Numfas, iyo kiniisadda gurigiisa ku jirta nagu salaama.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

kikuyu: Warqaddan markii laydinka dhex akhriyo, haddana ha laga dhex akhriyo kiniisadda reer La'odikiya, oo idinkuna akhrista warqadda aad La'odikiya ka heli doontaan.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

kikuyu: Oo Arkhibbos waxaad ku tidhaahdaan, Adeegiddii xagga Rabbiga oo aad heshay, ku dadaal inaad dhammaysid.
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah ayaa salaantan gacantayda ku qoraya. Xusuusta xidhnaantayda. Nimco ha idinla jirto.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Annagoo ah Bawlos iyo Silwanos iyo Timoteyos waxaannu warqaddan u qoraynaa dadka Tesaloniika kiniisaddooda oo ku jirta Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix. Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabadu.
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Had iyo goorba Ilaah baannu idiinku mahadnaqnaa kulligiin, annagoo baryadayada idinku xusuusanayna.
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

kikuyu: Waxaannu joogsila'aan Ilaaheenna oo ah Aabbeheenna hortiis ku xusuusannaa shuqulka rumaysadkiinna iyo hawsha jacaylkiinna iyo dulqaadashada rajadiinna ee ku jira Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

kikuyu: Annagu waannu og nahay, walaalaha Ilaah jecel yahayow, in Ilaah idin doortay,
english: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

kikuyu: waayo, injiilkayagu idiinkuma iman hadal oo keliya, laakiinse wuxuu kaloo idiinku yimid xoog iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo hubaal badan. Waad garanaysaan caynkaannu dhexdiinna ku ahayn idinka aawadiin.
english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

kikuyu: Oo waxaad noqoteen kuwo ku dayda annaga iyo Rabbigaba, idinkoo ereyga ku helay dhib badan iyo farxadda Ruuxa Quduuska ah.
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed masaal baad u noqoteen kuwa rumaystay oo Makedoniya iyo Akhaya jooga oo dhan.
english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

kikuyu: Waayo, ereygii Rabbigaa idinka dhawaaqay, mana aha Makedoniya iyo Akhaya dhexdooda oo keliya, laakiinse rumaysadkiinna xagga Ilaah wuxuu gaadhay meel kasta; oo sidaas daraaddeed uma aannu baahnin inaannu wax nidhaahno.
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyaguba waxay ka warramaan wax nagu saabsan oo ah sidaannu idiinku soo galnay, iyo sidaad sanamyadii uga jeesateen oo Ilaah ugu soo jeesateen, inaad u adeegtaan Ilaaha nool oo runta ah,
english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

kikuyu: oo aad samada ka sugtaan Wiilkiisa uu kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kiciyey oo ah Ciisaha inaga samatabbixinaya cadhada imanaysa.
english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

kikuyu: Waayo, walaalayaalow, waxaad og tihiin imaatinkayagii aannu idiin nimid inuusan noqon mid aan waxtar lahayn.
english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

kikuyu: Laakiinse annagoo awil aad ugu xanuunsannay oo lanagu ceebeeyey Filiboy, sidaad og tihiin, waxaannu ku dhiirranaannay Ilaaheenna inaannu injiilka Ilaah idiin sheegno annagoo dhib badan ku jirna.
english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

kikuyu: Waayo, waanadayadu kama iman qalad ama wasakh ama khiyaano,
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

kikuyu: laakiinse siduu Ilaah noogu bogay inuu nagu ammaaneeyo injiilka, sidaasaannu u hadalnaa, mana aha inaannu dadka ka farxinno, laakiinse inaannu ka farxinno Ilaaha qalbigayaga imtixaama.
english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

kikuyu: Sidaad og tihiin, marnaba kuma aannu isticmaalin hadal sasabasho ah ama damacnimo qarsoon, oo taas Ilaah baa marag ka ah.
english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

kikuyu: Dadka xaggiisana ammaan kama aannu doondoonin, ama xaggiinna ha noqoto, ama xagga dad kale, in kastoo aan culaab idinku noqon kari lahayn, annagoo ah rasuulladii Masiixa.
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

kikuyu: Laakiin dhexdiinna waxaannu idiinku roonayn sida mid carruurteeda nuujisa ay iyaga u dhaqaalayso.
english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, annagoo aad idiin jecel, ayaannu ku faraxnay inaannu wax idin siinno, mana aha injiilka Ilaah oo keliya, laakiinse xataa naftayada, maxaa yeelay, waxaad noo noqoteen kuwo aan jecel nahay.
english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

kikuyu: Waayo, waad xusuusan tihiin, walaalayaalow, sidaannu dhib iyo daal ugu shaqaynay habeen iyo maalinba, inaannan midkiinna culaysin, oo waxaannu idinku wacdinnay injiilka Ilaah.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

kikuyu: Idinkuna markhaati baad ka tihiin, Ilaahna wuu ka yahay, sidaannu daahir iyo xaq iyo ceebla'aan kula macaamiloonnay kuwiinna rumaysan.
english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

kikuyu: Sidaad og tihiin waxaannu midkiin kastaba kula macaamiloonnay sida aabbe carruurtiisa ula macaamiloodo, annagoo idin waaninayna oo idin dhiirigelinayna oo idiin markhaati furayna,
english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

kikuyu: inaad u socotaan si istaahisha Ilaaha idiinku yeedhay boqortooyadiisa iyo ammaantiisa.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

kikuyu: Oo sababtaas daraaddeed ayaannu joogsila'aan Ilaah ugu mahadnaqnaa in, markii aad naga hesheen ereygii Ilaah oo aad naga maqasheen, aydnaan u aqbalin sidii dad hadalkiis laakiin siduu run u yahay ereygii Ilaah oo haddana idinka dhex shaqeeya kuwiinna rumaysan.
english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

kikuyu: Waayo, walaalayaalow, waxaad noqoteen kuwo ku dayday dadka kiniisadaha Ilaah oo Yahuudiya jooga, kuwaas oo ah kuwa Ciise Masiix, maxaa yeelay, idinkuna waxaad dadkiinna ka hesheen dhibtaas oo kale, siday iyaguba uga heleen Yuhuudda,
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

kikuyu: oo ah kuwii dilay Rabbi Ciise iyo nebiyadiiba, oo annagana dibadda noo eryay, oo aan Ilaah ka farxin, dadka oo dhanna ka geesta ah.
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

kikuyu: Oo waxay noo diidaan inaannu dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn la hadalno inay badbaadaan. Sidaasay mar walba dembiyadooda u dhammaystiraan, laakiin ugu dambaysta cadhada waa ku dul degtay.
english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

kikuyu: Laakiin, walaalayaalow, annagoo wakhti yar lanaga kiin qaaday, xagga isla-joogidda ee ayan ahayn xagga qalbiga, aad iyo aad baannu ugu dadaalnay inaannu wejigiinna aragno, annagoo xiiso weyn u qabna;
english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

kikuyu: waayo, waannu jeclaan lahayn inaannu idiin nimaadno, anigoo Bawlos ah mar iyo lababa waan jeclaa, laakiinse Shayddaan baa naga hor joogsaday.
english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, waa ayo rajadayada iyo farxaddayada iyo taajka faanidda oo ahaan doona Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix hortiisa goortuu yimaado? Sow idinka ma aha?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

kikuyu: Waa idinka faankayaga iyo farxaddayaduba.
english: For you are our glory and our joy.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed markii aannu is-hayn kari waynay, way nala wanaagsanayd inaannu keliyahaantayo Ateenay ku hadhno;
english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

kikuyu: oo waxaannu idiin soo dirnay walaalkayo Timoteyos, oo ah midiidinka Ilaah xagga injiilka Masiixa, inuu idin xoogeeyo oo idin dhiirrigeliyo xagga rumaysadkiinna,
english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

kikuyu: inaan dhibaatooyinkani ninna dhaqdhaqaajin, waayo, idinka qudhiinnuba waad ogsoon tihiin in tan lanoo doortay.
english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

kikuyu: Waayo, markii aannu idinla joognay, horaannu idiinku sii sheegnay inaannu dhibtoonayno; waana sida ay noqotay, idinkuna waad og tihiin.
english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

kikuyu: Sababtaas daraaddeed markii aan is-hayn kari waayay, waxaan idiinku soo cid diray inaan rumaysadkiinna ogaado, waaba intaasoo kii wax jirrabi jiray idin jirrabay oo hawshayadii wax aan waxtar lahayn noqotaye.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haatan markii Timoteyos nooga kiin yimid, wuxuu noo keenay warka wanaagsan oo ku saabsan rumaysadkiinna iyo jacaylkiinna, iyo inaad kol kasta si wanaagsan noo xusuusataan idinkoo xiiso u qaba inaad na aragtaan sida aannu annaguba xiiso ugu qabno inaannu idin aragno;
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

kikuyu: sababtaas daraaddeed, walaalayaalow, dhibkayagii iyo qaxarkayagii oo dhan waxaannu kaga qalbi qabownay xaggiinna, rumaysadkiinna aawadiis;
english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, haatan annagu waa nool nahay haddaad xagga Rabbiga ku xoogaysataan.
english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

kikuyu: Waayo, mahad intee le'eg baannu Ilaah ugu naqi karnaa idinka aawadiin iyo farxaddii oo dhan oo aannu ku faraxnay Ilaahayaga hortiisa idinka aawadiin?
english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

kikuyu: Habeen iyo maalinba aad iyo aad baannu Ilaah u baryaynaa inaannu wejigiinna aragno oo aannu dhammaystirno waxa ka dhiman rumaysadkiinna.
english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

kikuyu: Haddaba Ilaaha ah Aabbeheenna iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise qudhiisu jidkayaga xaggiinna ha ku soo toosiyeen.
english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

kikuyu: Rabbigu ha idiin kordhiyo oo ha idiin badiyo jacaylka midkiinba midka kale u qabo iyo dadka kale oo dhanba, sida aan annaguba idiin jecel nahay,
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

kikuyu: inuu xoogeeyo qalbiyadiinna iyagoo aan ceeb lahayn oo quduusnimo ku jira Ilaaheenna oo ah Aabbeheenna hortiisa, goortii Rabbigeenna Ciise la yimaado quduusiintiisa oo dhan.
english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

kikuyu: Ugu dambaysta, walaalayaalow, waxaannu idinku baryaynaa oo idinku waaninaynaa Rabbi Ciise, sidaad nooga hesheen sidii waajibka idinku ahayd inaad u socotaan oo Ilaah uga farxisaan, in sidaad ku socotaan, aad si ka badan u socotaan.
english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

kikuyu: Waayo, amarradii aan Rabbi Ciise idinku siinnay waad og tihiin.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, doonista Ilaah waxaa weeyaan inaad quduus ahaataan oo aad sino ka fogaataan,
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

kikuyu: in midkiin kastaaba garto siduu weelkiisa ugu hayn lahaa quduusnaan iyo maamuus,
english: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

kikuyu: mana aha inuu hammadda damaca xaaraanta ah ku socdo sida dadka aan Ilaah aqoonin;
english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

kikuyu: inaan ninna xadgudbin oo walaalkiis xaalkan ku xumayn, maxaa yeelay, Rabbigu waa mid ka aarguda waxyaalahan oo dhan sidaannu mar hore idiinku dignay oo idiinku sii sheegnay.
english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah wasakhnimo inooguma yeedhin, laakiinse wuxuu inoogu yeedhay quduusnaan.
english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kii diidaa, dad ma diido, wuxuuse diidaa Ilaaha idin siiya Ruuxiisa Quduuska ah.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

kikuyu: Laakiinse xagga jacaylka walaalaha loo qabo uma aad baahnidin in wax laydiin soo qoro, maxaa yeelay, idinka qudhiinnaba Ilaah baa idin baray in midkiinba midka kale jeclaado.
english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

kikuyu: Waayo, sidaasaad jeceshihiin kulli walaalaha jooga Makedoniya oo dhan. Laakiin waxaannu idinku waaninaynaa, walaalayaalow, inaad intaas aad uga sii badisaan,
english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

kikuyu: oo aad u dadaashaan inaad nabdoonaataan, oo aad dantiinna ku joogtaan oo aad gacmihiinna ku shaqaysaan, sidaannu idinkugu amarnay;
english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

kikuyu: inaad sida idiin eg ugu socotaan xagga kuwa dibadda jooga, oo aydnaan waxba u baahnaan.
english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

kikuyu: Laakiin walaalayaalow, dooni mayno inaad jaahil ka ahaataan waxa ku saabsan kuwii dhintay ee waxaannu doonaynaa inaydnaan calool xumaan sida kuwa kale oo aan rajo lahayn.
english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddaynu rumaysan nahay in Ciise dhintay oo haddana soo sara kacay, de sidaas oo kalaa kuwii Ciise rumaysnaa oo dhintay Ilaah la keeni doonaa isaga.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

kikuyu: Waayo, tan waxaannu idiinku leennahay ereyga Rabbiga in kuweenna nool oo hadha ilaa imaatinka Rabbiga, sinaba ugama hor mari doonno kuwii dhintay.
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, Rabbiga qudhiisu samaduu kala soo degi doonaa qaylo iyo codka malaa'igta sare iyo buunka Ilaah, kolkaasay kuwii Masiixa rumaysnaa oo dhintay horta soo kici doonaan,
english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

kikuyu: dabadeedna kuweenna nool oo hadha ayaa iyaga kor loola qaadi doonaa daruuraha dhexdooda inaynu Rabbiga hawada kula kulanno, oo sidaasaynu Rabbiga weligeen ula joogi doonnaa.
english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed hadalladan midkiinba midka kale ha ugu qalbi qabowjiyo.
english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, uma baahnidin in laydiin soo qoro wax ku saabsan wakhtiyada iyo xilliyada.
english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

kikuyu: Waayo, idinka qudhiinnuba qummaati baad u garanaysaan inay maalinta Rabbigu u imanayso sida tuug habeen u yimaado.
english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

kikuyu: Markay leeyihiin, Waa nabad iyo salaamad, kolkaasaa filashola'aan halaaggu u qaban doonaa sida fooshu naag uur leh u qabato; iyaguna sinaba ugama baxsan doonaan.
english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku, walaalayaalow, gudcur kuma jirtaan in maalintaasu sida tuug idiin qabato.
english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

kikuyu: Waayo, kulligiin waxaad tihiin carruurta nuurka iyo carruurta maalinnimada, innagu ma nihin kuwa habeennimada iyo gudcurka;
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

kikuyu: sidaas daraaddeed yeynan seexan sida kuwa kale yeelaan, laakiinse aan soo jeedno oo aan feeyignaanno.
english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwa seexdaa habeenkay seexdaan, kuwa sakhraamaana habeenkay sakhraamaan.
english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

kikuyu: Laakiin innagoo kuwa maalinta ah aan feeyignaanno, oo gashanno hubka laabta oo rumaysadka iyo jacaylka ah iyo koofiyadda rajada badbaadada ah.
english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah inooma uu dooran cadhada, laakiinse wuxuu inoo doortay inaynu ku badbaadno Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix,
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: kan inoo dhintay, inaynu la wada noolaanno isaga, haddaynu nool nahay iyo haddaynu dhimannoba.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed midkiinba midka kale ha dhiirrigeliyo oo ha dhiso sidaad yeelaysaan oo kale.
english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaannu idinka baryaynaa, walaalayaalow, inaad maamuustaan kuwa idinku dhex hawshooda, oo xagga Rabbiga idinkaga sarreeya oo idinla taliya;
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

kikuyu: oo aad iyaga aad iyo aad jacayl ugu derejaysaan shuqulkooda aawadiis. Nabad ku wada jooga.
english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

kikuyu: Oo waannu idin waaninaynaa, walaalayaalow, Kuwa si aan hagaagsanayn u socda la taliya, oo kuwa qalbi jabay dhiirigeliya, oo kuwa itaalka yar garab siiya, oo dadka oo dhanna u dulqaata.
english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

kikuyu: Iska jira inaan midkiinna midka kale shar shar uga celin; laakiinse kol kasta wax wanaagsan ha ugu dadaalo, oo dadka oo dhanna ha ugu dadaalo.
english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

kikuyu: Had iyo goorba farxa.
english: Always rejoice.

kikuyu: Joogsila'aanna tukada.
english: Pray without ceasing.

kikuyu: Wax walbana mahad ka naqa, waayo, taasu waxay idiin tahay doonista Ilaah xagga Ciise Masiix.
english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

kikuyu: Ruuxa ha deminina.
english: Don’t quench the Spirit.

kikuyu: Wax sii sheegiddana ha quudhsanina.
english: Don’t despise prophecies.

kikuyu: Wax walba tijaabiya, waxa fiicanna xajiya.
english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

kikuyu: Wax kasta oo shar u egna ka fogaada.
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

kikuyu: Ilaaha nabadda qudhiisu quduus ha idinka wada dhigo, oo ruuxiinna iyo naftiinna iyo jidhkiinna dhammaan ha la wada ilaaliyo, iyagoo ceeb la' markii Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix yimaado.
english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kan idiin yeedhaa waa aamin, wuuna samayn doonaa.
english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, noo soo duceeya.
english: Brothers, pray for us.

kikuyu: Walaalaha oo dhanna dhunkasho quduus ah ku salaama.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Rabbigaan idinku dhaarinayaaye, Warqaddan ha loo akhriyo walaalaha oo dhan.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

kikuyu: Nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Annagoo ah Bawlos iyo Silwanos iyo Timoteyos waxaannu warqaddan u qoraynaa dadka Tesaloniika kiniisaddooda oo ku jirta Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waxaa nagu waajib ah, walaalayaalow, inaannu mar walba aawadiin Ilaah ugu mahadnaqno, sida noo eg, maxaa yeelay, rumaysadkiinnu aad buu u kordhayaa, jacaylka aad kulligiin isu qabtaanna waa badnaanayaa.
english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaannu idinku faannaa kiniisadaha Ilaah dhexdooda, waana dulqaadashadiinna iyo rumaysadkiinna aad ku dhex leedihiin silecyada iyo dhibaatooyinka aad u adkaysataan oo dhan.
english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

kikuyu: Taasu waxay muujisaa xukunka xaqa ah ee Ilaah, in laydinku tiriyo kuwo istaahila boqortooyada Ilaah, tan aad daraaddeed u xanuunsataan.
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

kikuyu: Waayo, xagga Ilaah waa xaq inuu dhib ugu abaalgudo kuwa idin dhiba,
english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

kikuyu: iyo inuu kuwiinna la dhibay nala kiin nasiyo markii Rabbi Ciise samada ka muuqdo, isagoo wata malaa'igaha xooggiisa
english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

kikuyu: oo dab ololaya ku jira, oo ka aargudanaya kuwa aan Ilaah aqoon iyo kuwa aan addeecin injiilka Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

kikuyu: Waxaa lagu ciqaabi doonaa halaag weligiis ah, oo waxaa laga gooyn doonaa Rabbiga hortiisa iyo ammaanta xooggiisa,
english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

kikuyu: markuu yimaado maalintaas in isaga lagu ammaano quduusiintiisa oo lagula yaabo kuwii rumaystay oo dhan, maxaa yeelay, markhaatifurkayagii aan idiin sheegnay waa la rumaystay.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

kikuyu: Sababtaas daraaddeed mar walba waannu idiin ducaynaa in Ilaaheen idinka dhigo kuwa istaahila yeedhistiisa oo uu xoog ku dhammeeyo doonis kasta oo wanaag ah iyo shuqulka rumaysadka,
english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

kikuyu: in magaca Rabbi Ciise dhexdiinna lagu ammaano, idinkana in laydinku dhex ammaano isaga, sida nimcada Ilaaheenna iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix ay tahay.
english: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Xagga Rabbi Ciise Masiix imaatinkiisa iyo ururkeenna aynu la kulmi doonno isaga, waxaannu idinka baryaynaa, walaalayaalow,
english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

kikuyu: inaan caqligiinnu dhaqso u qasmin ama aydnaan ku argaggixin ruux, ama hadal, ama warqad sida mid annagu aannu soo dirnay, sidii iyadoo maalintii Rabbigu hadda joogto.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

kikuyu: Sinaba yaan laydiin khiyaanayn, waayo, maalintaasu ma iman doonto ilamaa horta Ilaah laga fallaagoobo, oo la muujiyo ninka dembiga oo ah wiilka halaagga,
english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

kikuyu: kan ka geesta ah oo iska sarraysiiya wax alla waxa Ilaah la yidhaahdo oo dhan iyo waxa la caabudo oo dhan, oo sidaasuu u dhex fadhiistaa macbudka Ilaah isagoo qudhiisu Ilaah iska dhigaya.
english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

kikuyu: Miyeydnaan xusuusnayn inaan waxyaalahan idiin sheegay markii aan weli idinla joogay?
english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

kikuyu: Haatan waad garanaysaan waxa joojinaya in isaga wakhtigiisa la muujiyo.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

kikuyu: Waayo, qarsoodiga dembigu haatan waa shaqaynayaa, laakiin kan haddeer joojinayaa wuxuu joojinayaa ilaa jidka laga qaado isaga.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

kikuyu: Markaas waxaa la muujin doonaa sharcilaawaha, kan Rabbi Ciise ku halligi doono neefta afkiisa, oo imaatinka muuqashadiisa uu ku baabbi'in doono.
english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

kikuyu: Kaas imaatinkiisu waa sida shuqul Shayddaan oo leh xoog iyo calaamooyin iyo cajaa'ibyo been ah oo dhan,
english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

kikuyu: iyo khiyaanada xaqdarrada oo dhan. Waxaana leh kuwa lumaya, maxaa yeelay, waxay diideen inay runta jeclaadaan oo ay sidaas u badbaadaan.
english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

kikuyu: Oo sababtaas daraaddeed ayaa Ilaah ugu soo diraa wax qalad kaga dhex shaqeeya si ay been u rumaystaan,
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

kikuyu: in kuwa aan runta rumaysan, laakiinse xaqdarrada ku farxay, kulligood la wada xukumo.
english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa nagu waajib ah inaannu mar walba aawadiin Ilaah ugu mahadnaqno, walaalayaasha Rabbigu jecel yahayow, waayo, waxaa Ilaah bilowgii idiin doortay badbaado ka timaada Ruuxa quduus idinka dhigaya, iyo rumaysadka runta,
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

kikuyu: tan uu idiinku yeedhay injiilkayaga inaad heshaan ammaanta Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, walaalayaalow, xoogaysta, oo cilmigii laydin baray xajista, ha noqoto wixii hadal laydinku baray ama wixii warqaddayada laydinku baraye.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

kikuyu: Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix qudhiisa iyo Ilaaha Aabbeheen ah, kan ina jeclaaday oo nimcadiisa inagu siiyey dhiirranaanta weligeed ah iyo rajada wanaagsan,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

kikuyu: qalbiyadiinna ha dhiirrigeliyo oo ha ku xoogeeyo shuqul iyo hadal walba oo wanaagsan.
english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

kikuyu: Ugu dambaysta, walaalayaalow, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Noo soo duceeya in ereyga Rabbigu dhaqso u faafo oo loo ammaano sida dhexdiinna loogu ammaano,
english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

kikuyu: oo lanaga badbaadiyo dadka qalloocan oo sharka ah, waayo, rumaysad lama wada laha.
english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbigu waa aamin; wuuna idin xoogayn doonaa, sharkana wuu idinka ilaalin doonaa.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

kikuyu: Xaggiinnana Rabbiga waannu aaminsan nahay inaad samaysaan oo aad samayn doontaan wixii aannu idinku amarno.
english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

kikuyu: Rabbigu qalbiyadiinna ha ku toosiyo jacaylka Ilaah iyo dulqaadashada Masiixa.
english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

kikuyu: Hadda walaalayaalow, waxaannu magaca Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix idinku amraynaa inaad ka fogaataan walaal kasta oo si aan hagaagsanayn u socda oo aan ku soconayn cilmigii ay naga heleen.
english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

kikuyu: Waayo, idinka qudhiinnuba waad garanaysaan sida idinku waajibka ah inaad nagu dayataan; waayo, si aan hagaagsanayn uma aannu socon markaannu idin dhex joognay.
english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

kikuyu: Ninnana kama aannu cunin kibis aannan wax ka bixin, laakiin dhib iyo daal ayaannu ku shaqaysannay habeen iyo maalinba inaannan midkiinna culaysin;
english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

kikuyu: mana aha inaannan amar u lahayn, laakiinse waa inaannu masaal idiin noqonno oo aad nagu dayataan.
english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

kikuyu: Waayo, xataa markaannu idinla joognay, waxaannu idinku amarnay, Mid hadduusan doonayn inuu shaqeeyo yuusan waxba cunin.
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaannu maqalnay inay idin dhex joogaan kuwo si aan hagaagsanayn u socda oo aan innaba shaqayn, laakiin axwaalka dadka kale faraggeliya.
english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

kikuyu: Kuwa caynkaas ah waxaannu Rabbi Ciise Masiix ku amraynaa oo ku waaninaynaa inay xasilloonaan ku shaqaystaan oo kibistooda cunaan.
english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

kikuyu: Idinkuse, walaalayaalow, wanaagfallidda ha ka qalbi jabina.
english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

kikuyu: Haddii nin addeeci waayo waxaannu warqaddan ku qornay, ninkaas iska jira oo ha raacina si uu isugu yaxyaxo.
english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

kikuyu: Weliba sida cadow ha ula macaamiloonina, laakiin sida walaalkiin u waaniya.
english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

kikuyu: Haddaba Rabbiga nabadda qudhiisu mar walba si kasta nabad ha idiin siiyo. Rabbigu kulligiin ha idinla jiro.
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah ayaan salaantan gacantayda ku qorayaa; waana u calaamo warqad kasta oo tayda ah. Sidaasaan u qoraa.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

kikuyu: Nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto kulligiin.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah oo rasuulkii Ciise Masiix ku ah amarka Ilaaha Badbaadiyeheenna ah iyo Ciise Masiix oo rajadeenna ah,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

kikuyu: waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa Timoteyos oo xagga iimaanka ku ah wiilkayga runta ah. Nimco iyo naxariis iyo nabadu ha kaaga yimaadeen Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Sidaan kugu waaniyey markaan Makedoniya tegayay ayaan haatanna kugu waaninayaa inaad Efesos sii joogtid oo aad kuwo ku amartid inayan cilmi kale dadka barin,
english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

kikuyu: ama ayan dhegaysanin sheekooyin iyo abtirsiinyada aan dhammaadka lahayn oo keena su'aalo intay hor marin lahaayeen talada Ilaah oo rumaysadka ku jirta.
english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

kikuyu: Laakiin amarka dhammaadkiisu waa jacayl ka soo baxa qalbi daahir ah iyo niyo wanaagsan iyo rumaysad aan labaweji lahayn.
english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan qaar baa seegay, oo waxay ku leexdeen hadal aan micne lahayn,
english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

kikuyu: oo waxay doonayaan inay noqdaan macallimiinta sharciga in kastoo ayan garanayn waxay yidhaahdaan ama waxay ku xaqiiqeeyaan.
english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

kikuyu: Waxaynu og nahay in sharcigu wanaagsan yahay haddii loo isticmaalo si sharciga ku qumman.
english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

kikuyu: Sidaynu u og nahay, sharciga looma samayn nin xaq ah, laakiin waxaa loo sameeyey sharcilaawayaasha, iyo caasiyiinta, iyo cibaadalaawayaasha, iyo dembilayaasha, iyo kuwa aan quduuska ahayn, iyo kuwa nijaasta ah, iyo kuwa aabbahood dila, iyo kuwa hooyadood dila, iyo gacankudhiiglayaasha,
english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

kikuyu: iyo kuwa sinaysta, iyo khaniisiinta, iyo kuwa dadka xada, iyo beenlowyada, iyo kuwa beenta ku dhaarta, iyo hadday jiraan wax kaleeto oo ka gees ah cilmiga runta ah,
english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

kikuyu: oo ah sida injiilka ammaanta Ilaaha barakada leh oo laygu ammaaneeyey.
english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku mahadnaqayaa kan xoogga i siiyey oo ah Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, waayo, wuxuu igu tiriyey mid aamin ah intuu hawshiisa ii doortay,
english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

kikuyu: in kastoo aan hore u ahaan jiray mid dadka caaya oo silciya, oo dhiba, laakiin waa la ii naxariistay, waayo, aqoonla'aan baan ku sameeyey, anigoo aan rumaysanayn.
english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

kikuyu: Nimcada Rabbigeenna waxay aad iyo aad ula badatay rumaysadka iyo jacaylka ku jira Ciise Masiix.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Hadalkanu waa run, waana mid istaahila in la wada aqbalo, in Ciise Masiix dunida u yimid inuu badbaadiyo dembilayaasha anoo ah kan ugu daran.
english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

kikuyu: Laakiin sababtaas daraaddeed waa la ii naxariistay in, anigoo ah kan ugu daran, Ciise Masiix iga muujiyo dulqaadashadiisa oo dhan, inaan masaal u noqdo kuwa hadda dabadeed isaga rumaysan doona inay nolol weligeed ah helaan.
english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

kikuyu: Boqorka daa'imiska ah, oo aan dhiman karin, oo aan la arki karin, oo ah Ilaaha keligiis ah, maamuus iyo ammaanu ha u ahaadeen weligiis iyo weligiis. Aamiin.
english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Wiilkaygii Timoteyosow, waxaan kugu ammaanaynayaa amarkan oo ah sidii waxyaalihii hore laguugu sheegay, inaad iyaga dagaal wanaagsan ku dagaallantid,
english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

kikuyu: adigoo haysta iimaan iyo qalbi wanaagsan. Waxyaalahaas dadka qaarkood way iska tuureen, oo waxay iimaankooda ka dhigeen sida doonni burburtay.
english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

kikuyu: Waxaana ka mid ah Humenayos iyo Aleksanderos, oo aan Shayddaan u dhiibay si ay u bartaan inayan wax caayin.
english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ugu horraysta waxaan kugu waaninayaa inaad Ilaah u baridid, oo aad u tukatid, oo aad u ducaysid, oo aad u mahadnaqdid dadka oo dhan,
english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

kikuyu: khusuusan boqorrada iyo kuwa amarka lehba, inaynu nolol xasilloon oo nabdaysan ku noolaanno, innagoo si walba cibaado iyo maamuus u leh.
english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

kikuyu: Taasu way wanaagsan tahay, waana mid Ilaaha Badbaadiyeheenna ahu aqbali karo.
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

kikuyu: Wuxuu doonayaa in dadka oo dhammu badbaado oo ay runta gartaan.
english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa jira Ilaah keliya iyo dhexdhexaadiye keliya oo u dhexeeya Ilaah iyo dadka, waana ninka Ciise Masiix ah,
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: oo naftiisii dadka oo dhan furashadooda u bixiyey, oo wakhtigiisii qummanaa loo markhaati furay.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed baa layga dhigay inaan noqdo mid wax wacdiya oo rasuul ah oo macallin dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ugu ah iimaan iyo run. Taasu waa runtay, oo been sheegi maayo.
english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed waxaan doonayaa in raggu meel walba ku tukado iyagoo gacmo quduus ah kor u qaadaya oo aan cadho iyo muran lahayn.
english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena naaguhu waa inay, iyagoo xishoonaya oo digtoon, isku sharraxaan dhar qof xishood leh ku habboon, oo ayan isku sharraxin timo tidcan, iyo dahab ama luul ama dhar qaali ah.
english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

kikuyu: Laakiinse ha isku sharraxeen shuqullo wanaagsan oo u eg dumarka cibaadada qira.
english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

kikuyu: Naagtu aamusnaan wax ha ku barato iyadoo isdambaysiinaysa.
english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

kikuyu: Laakiin naagna u fasixi maayo inay nin wax barto ama ay ka xukun sarrayso, inay aamusnaato mooyaane.
english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

kikuyu: Waayo, markii hore Aadan baa la sameeyey, dabadeedna Xaawa.
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

kikuyu: Aadanna lama khiyaanayn, laakiin naagtii baa inta la khiyaaneeyey waxay noqotay mid xadgudubtay.
english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxay ku badbaadi doontaa carruurdhalidda, hadday ku sii socdaan rumaysad iyo jacayl iyo quduusnaan iyagoo digtoon.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

kikuyu: Hadalku waa run, Haddii nin doonayo shuqulka hoggaamiyaha kiniisadda, shuqul wanaagsan buu doonayaa.
english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed hoggaamiyaha kiniisaddu waa inuu ahaado mid aan ceeb lahayn, oo naag keliya qaba, oo feeyigan, oo digtoon, oo sharaf leh, oo martida soo dhoweeya, oo ku wanaagsan waxbaridda;
english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

kikuyu: oo uusan sakhraan noqon, oo uusan gacan fududaan, laakiin waa inuu noqdo mid tudhid badan, oo uusan ilaaq lahayn, oo uusan lacag jeclayn.
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

kikuyu: Waa inuu ahaado mid gurgiisa si wanaagsan ugu taliya, oo carruurtiisu ka dambeeyaan oo maamuusaan.
english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

kikuyu: Laakiin nin hadduusan garanayn si uu gurigiisa ugu taliyo, sidee buu kiniisadda Ilaah u xanaanayn doonaa?
english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

kikuyu: Waa inuusan ahaan mid dhowaan rumaystay, waaba intaasoo intuu kibro uu Ibliiska xukunkiisa ku dhacaaye.
english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

kikuyu: Weliba waa inuu markhaati wanaagsan ka helo kuwa dibadda ah, waaba intaasoo uu ku dhacaa cay iyo dabinka Ibliiska.
english: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena caawiyayaasha kiniisaddu waa inay ahaadaan dad la maamuuso oo ayan noqon laba-hadallayaal, oo ayan khamri badan cabbin, oo ayan faa'iidada ceebta ah jeclaan.
english: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

kikuyu: Waa inay qarsoodiga iimaanka qalbi daahir ah ku haystaan.
english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

kikuyu: Kuwaas marka hore ha la tijaabiyo, dabadeedna sida iyagoo ah caawiyayaasha kiniisadda ha u adeegeen hadday eed la' yihiin.
english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale dumarkuna waa inay digtoonaadaan oo ayan ahaan kuwa wax xanta. Waa inay feeyignaadaan, oo ay wax walba aamin ku ahaadaan.
english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

kikuyu: Caawiyayaasha kiniisaddu mid kastaaba naag keliya ha guursado, hana noqdeen kuwo si wanaagsan ugu talinaya carruurtooda iyo guryahooda.
english: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwa sida iyagoo ah caawiyayaasha kiniisadda si wanaagsan ugu adeega, waxay nafsaddooda u helaan derejo wanaagsan iyo dhiirranaan badan oo ay iimaanka Ciise Masiix ku dhiirran yihiin.
english: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Waxaan rajaynayaa inaan dhowaan kuu imaado, laakiin waxaan waxyaalahan kuugu soo qorayaa,
english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

kikuyu: in, haddii aan wax badan raago, aad ogaato sida waajibka ah oo loogu camal fali lahaa guriga Ilaah dhexdiisa, oo ah kiniisadda Ilaaha nool iyo tiirka iyo aasaaska runtaa.
