english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

kikuyu: Oo muranla'aan qarsoodiga cibaadadu waa weyn yahay. Isaga jidh baa lagu muujiyey, oo ruux baa xaq laga caddeeyey, malaa'iguhuna way arkeen, quruumahana waa laga dhex wacdiyey, dunidana waa laga rumaystay, ammaanna kor baa loogu qaaday.
english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

kikuyu: Laakiin Ruuxu bayaan buu u sheegayaa in wakhtiga ugu dambaysta qaar ka fogaan doono iimaanka, iyagoo dhegaysanaya ruuxaxa khiyaaneeya iyo cilmiyada jinniyada,
english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

kikuyu: oo waxay kaga fogaan doonaan labawejiilenimada dadka beenta ku hadla oo qalbigooda la gubay sida isagoo bir kulul lagu dhejiyey.
english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

kikuyu: Waxay diidaan in la guursado, oo amraan in laga fogaado cuntooyinka Ilaah u abuuray in kuwa rumaysta oo runta yaqaanu mahadnaqid ku aqbalaan.
english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

kikuyu: Waayo, wax kasta oo Ilaah abuuray wuu wanaagsan yahay, waana inaan waxba la diidin haddii mahadnaqid lagu aqbalo,
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

kikuyu: waayo, waxaa quduus lagaga dhigaa ereyga Ilaah iyo ducada.
english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

kikuyu: Haddaad walaalaha waxyaalahan xusuusisid waxaad ahaan doontaa Ciise Masiix midiidinkiisa wanaagsan, adigoo hadallada iimaanka iyo cilmiga wanaagsan oo aad raacday ku xoogaysanaya.
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

kikuyu: Laakiin ka fogow sheekooyinka habraha oo nijaasta ah, oo nafsaddaada bar cibaadaysiga,
english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

kikuyu: waayo, jidhka waxbariddiisu wax yar bay tartaa, laakiinse cibaadaysigu si walba waxtar buu u leeyahay isagoo ballan u leh nolosha haatan joogta iyo tan imanaysaba.
english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

kikuyu: Hadalku waa run, waana mid istaahila in la wada aqbalo.
english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

kikuyu: Sababtan daraaddeed waannu u hawshoonnaa oo u dadaalnaa, maxaa yeelay, waxaannu rajo ku leennahay Ilaaha nool oo Badbaadiyaha u ah dadka oo dhan, khusuusan kuwa rumaysan.
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan dadka ku amar oo bar.
english: Command and teach these things.

kikuyu: Ninna yuusan quudhsan dhallinyaronimadaada, laakiinse kuwa rumaystay masaal ugu noqo xagga hadalka, iyo xagga dabiicadda, iyo xagga jacaylka, iyo xagga rumaysadka, iyo xagga daahirsanaantaba.
english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

kikuyu: Ilaa aan imaado, akhriska iyo waaninta iyo waxbaridda u digtoonow.
english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

kikuyu: Ha dayicin hibada aad haysatid oo lagugu siiyey waxyaalihii laguu sii sheegay markii waayeelladu gacmahooda ku saareen.
english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan ku dadaal, oo nafsaddaada oo dhan u go' in horumarkaagu dadka oo dhan u muuqdo.
english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

kikuyu: Nafsaddaada iyo cilmigaagaba u digtoonow. Oo waxyaalahan ku sii soco, waayo, haddaad yeeshid, nafsaddaada iyo kuwa ku dhegaystaba waad badbaadin doontaa.
english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

kikuyu: Nin waayeel ah ha canaanan, laakiin u waani sida aabbe oo kale; dhallinyaradana u waani sida walaalo oo kale;
english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

kikuyu: habrahana sida hooyooyin oo kale u waani, naagaha dhallintayarna sida walaalo oo kale, adigoo daahir ah.
english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

kikuyu: Maamuus carmallada runta ah oo nimankoodii ka dhinteen,
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

kikuyu: laakiin haddii naag carmal ahu carruur leedahay ama carruurteedu ay carruur leedahay, iyagu marka hore ha barteen inay dadkooda si cibaado leh kula macaamiloodaan, waalidkoodna u cawilceliyaan, waayo taasu way wanaagsan tahay, waana mid Ilaah aqbali karo.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, tii carmal run ah oo cidlootay, waxay rajo ku leedahay Ilaah, habeen iyo maalinna baryada iyo tukashada way sii waddaa.
english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

kikuyu: Laakiin tii raaxaysi u noolaataa waa meyd intay nooshahay.
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan ku amar inay ceeb la'aadaan.
english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

kikuyu: Laakiin qof hadduusan dadkiisa dhaqaalayn, khusuusan kuwa gurigiisa jooga, kaasu iimaankuu ka hor yimid, wuuna ka sii liitaa mid aan rumaysanayn.
english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

kikuyu: Ha la qoro carmal aan lixdan sannadood ka yarayn oo nin keliya naag u ahaan jirtay,
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

kikuyu: oo loogu marag furay inay shuqullo wanaagsan samaysay, hadday carruur korisay, hadday shisheeyaha marti soori jirtay, hadday quduusiinta cagaha u maydhay, hadday kuwii dhibaataysnaa u gargaartay, hadday shuqul kasta oo wanaagsan aad ugu dadaashay.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

kikuyu: Laakiinse carmallada dhallintayar diid, waayo, markay qooqaan ayay ka jeestaan Masiixa, oo waxay doonayaan inay guursadaan.
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

kikuyu: Iimaankoodii hore way naceen, oo sidaas daraaddeed waa la xukumay.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

kikuyu: Waxay kaloo weliba bartaan inay caajisiin noqdaan, iyagoo iska wareegaya oo guriba guri uga baxaya; caajisiin oo keliyana ma ahaye, weliba way warsheeko badan yihiin, oo axwaalka dadka kalena way faraggeliyaan, iyagoo ku hadlaya waxyaalo aan waajib ku ahayn.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaan doonayaa inay carmallada dhallintayaru guursadaan, oo carruur dhalaan, oo gurigooda u taliyaan, oo ayan cadowga isu jebin inuu caayo.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

kikuyu: Waayo, hadda ka hor qaar baa xagga Shayddaanka u leexday.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

kikuyu: Haddii naag rumaysanu ay leedahay carmallo ha u gargaarto iyaga, oo kiniisadda yaan la culaysin, si ay u gargaarto kuwa carmallada runta ah.
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

kikuyu: Waayeellada si wanaagsan wax ugu taliya ha lagu tiriyo kuwo istaahila in labanlaab loo maamuuso, khusuusan kuwa ku hawshooda waxwacdinta iyo waxbaridda.
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

kikuyu: Waayo, Qorniinku wuxuu leeyahay, Waa inaadan dibiga af xidhin markuu sarreenka burburinayo. Wuxuu kaloo leeyahay, Shaqaalahu waa istaahilaa abaalgudkiisa.
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

kikuyu: Nin waayeel ah ashtako ha ku qaadin, laba ama saddex qof oo ku markhaati fura mooyaane.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

kikuyu: Kuwa dembaaba inta kale oo dhan hortooda ku canaano in kuwa kalena ay cabsadaan.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

kikuyu: Waxaan Ilaah iyo Ciise Masiix iyo malaa'igaha la doortay hortooda kugu waaninayaa inaad waxyaalahan ku dhawrtid eexashola'aan, oo aadan waxba samayn adoo dadka kala jeclaanaya.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

kikuyu: Ninna gacmaha degdeg ha u saarin, dad kale dembiyadoodana ha ka qayb gelin. Nafsaddaada daahirsanaan ku dhawr.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hadda ka dib biyo oo keliya ha cabbin, illowse waxoogaa yar oo khamri ah u cab calooshaada iyo cudurradaada mararka badan kugu soo noqnoqda daraaddood.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

kikuyu: Dadka qarkood dembiyadoodu waa bayaan, oo waxay u hor marayaan xukunka, dadka qaarkoodna kuwoodu way daba socdaan.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena waxaa jira shuqullo wanaagsan oo bayaan ah, kuwa aan caynkaas ahaynna lama qarin karo.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

kikuyu: In alla intii addoommo ah oo ka hoosaysa harqoodka addoonnimada, sayidyadooda ha ku tiriyeen kuwo maamuus oo dhan istaahila, si aan magaca Ilaah iyo cilmiga loo caayin.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

kikuyu: Kuwii sayidyo rumaysan lahu yaanay quudhsan, maxaa yeelay, waa walaalo; laakiin ha u adeegeen intay quudhsan lahaayeen, maxaa yeelay, kuwa shuqulkooda wanaagsan ka faa'iidaa waa kuwa rumaysan oo la jecel yahay. Dadka waxyaalahan bar oo ku waani.
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

kikuyu: Haddii nin dadka cilmi kale baro oo uusan u oggolaan hadalka runta ah oo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix iyo cilmiga raacsan cibaadada,
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: kaasu waa kibirsan yahay, oo waxba garan maayo. Wuxuuna u jeellan yahay su'aalo iyo hadal-iskuqabasho, waxaana ka yimaada hinaaso iyo dirir iyo cay iyo tuhun xun,
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

kikuyu: iyo murannada dadka maankoodu kharribmay oo runta waayey, iyagoo u malaynaya in cibaadadu tahay wax faa'iido laga helo.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

kikuyu: Laakiin cibaadadu waa faa'iido weyn markii waxa la haysto raalli lagu yahay;
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

kikuyu: waayo, dunida waxba ma aynu keenin, waxbana ka qaadan kari mayno.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

kikuyu: Laakiinse haddaynu haysanno dhar iyo dhuuni, way inagu filnaan doonaan.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

kikuyu: Laakiin kuwa doonaya inay taajir noqdaan, waxay ku dhacaan duufsasho iyo dabin iyo damacyo badan oo nacasnimo ah waxyeellona leh, oo dadka ku hafiya baabbi'in iyo halaag.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

kikuyu: Waayo, jacaylka lacagtu waa xididka xumaatooyinka oo dhan, oo qaar intay higsanayeen ayay iimaankii ka ambadeen, oo waxaa muday tiiraanyo badan.
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu, nin yahow Ilaah, waxyaalahan ka carar; oo raac xaqnimada, iyo cibaadada, iyo iimaanka, iyo jacaylka, iyo dulqaadashada, iyo qabownimada.
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

kikuyu: Dagaalka wanaagsan oo iimaanka dagaallan, oo qabso nolosha weligeed ah, oo laguugu yeedhay, oo aad qirashada wanaagsan ku hor qiratay markhaatiyaal badan.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

kikuyu: Ilaah hortiis kan wax kasta nooleeya, iyo Ciise Masiix hortiis, kan Bontiyos Bilaatos hortiisa qirashada wanaagsan ku qirtay, waxaan kugu amrayaa
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

kikuyu: inaad amarka ku xajisid iinla'aan iyo ceebla'aan ilaa Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix muuqdo,
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: muuqashadaas uu wakhtigiisa muujin doono, kan ammaanta leh oo keligiis xoogga leh, oo ah Boqorka boqorrada iyo Sayidka sayidyada,
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

kikuyu: kan keligiis aan dhimanayn, oo ku dhex jira nuurka aan loo dhowaan karin, oo aan ninna arkin, lana arki karin; isagu ha lahaado ciso iyo itaal weligiis. Aamiin.
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

kikuyu: Kuwa dunidatan haatan la joogo hodanka ku ah waani inayan iskibrin oo ayan maalka aan la hubin isku hallayn, laakiinse ay isku halleeyaan Ilaaha wax kasta si deeqsinimo ah inoo siiya si aynu ugu raaxaysanno.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

kikuyu: Oo waani inay wax san sameeyaan, oo ay shuqullo wanaagsan hodan ku ahaadaan, oo ay deeqsi ahaadaan, oo ay dadka kale wax siiyaan,
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

kikuyu: iyagoo wakhtiga imanaya u dhiganaya aasaas wanaagsan, inay nolosha runta ah qabsadaan.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

kikuyu: Timoteyosow, wixii laguu dhiibay ilaali, oo ka leexo hadalka aan micnaha lahayn oo nijaasta ah iyo muranka aqoonta beenta ah,
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

kikuyu: oo qaar qirashadeeda aawadeed iimaanka ku gafeen. Nimco ha idinla jirto.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah oo rasuulkii Ciise Masiix ku ah doonista Ilaah, sida uu leeyahay ballanka nolosha Ciise Masiix ku jirta,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa Timoteyos oo ah wiilkayga aan jeclahay. Nimco iyo naxariis iyo nabadu ha kaaga yimaadeen Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku mahadnaqayaa Ilaaha aan qalbi daahir ah ugu adeego siday awowayaashay ugu adeegi jireen, anigoo habeen iyo maalinba joogsila'aan baryadayda kugu xusuusanaya.
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

kikuyu: Markaan ilmadaadii xusuusto waxaan aad u doonayaa inaan ku arko, inaan aad u farxo.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

kikuyu: Waxaan xusuustay rumaysadka aan labada weji lahayn oo kugu jira, oo markii horena ku jiri jiray ayeeyadaa Lowis iyo hooyadaa Yunikee, adigana waan kugu aaminsanahay inuu kugu jiro.
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed waxaan ku xusuusinayaa inaad kicisid hadiyadda Ilaah ee kugu jirta oo kuugu timid gacmosaariddaydii.
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah inama uu siin ruuxa cabsida, laakiinse wuxuu ina siiyey ruuxa xoogga iyo jacaylka iyo miyirka.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ha ka xishoon u markhaatifuridda Rabbigeenna ama aniga oo isaga maxbuus u ah, laakiinse dhibaatada injiilka kaga qayb qaado xoogga Ilaah.
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

kikuyu: Ilaah waa kan ina badbaadiyey oo yeedhid quduus ah inoogu yeedhay, mana aha xagga shuqulladeenna, laakiinse waa xagga qasdigiisa iyo nimcadiisa, oo uu waayadii hore hortood inagu siiyey Ciise Masiix,
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

kikuyu: laakiinse haatan lagu muujiyey muuqashada Badbaadiyeheenna Ciise Masiix, kaas oo dhimashada baabbi'iyey, oo nolosha iyo dhimashola'aanta iftiinka ugu soo saaray xagga injiilka,
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

kikuyu: kaas oo laygu doortay inaan noqdo mid wax wacdiya iyo rasuul iyo macallinba.
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Sababtaas aawadeed ayaan waxyaalahan ugu xanuunsanayaa; laakiinse ka xishoon maayo, waayo, waan garanayaa kan aan rumaystay, oo waxaan aaminsanahay inuu awoodo inuu dhawro wixii aan ku ammaanaystay ilaa maalintaas.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

kikuyu: Masaalkii erayada runta ahaa ee aad iga maqasheen ku xaji rumaysadka iyo jacaylka Ciise Masiix ku jira.
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ammaanadii wanaagsanayd ee laguu dhiibay ku dhawr Ruuxa Quduuska ah oo inagu dhex jira.
english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

kikuyu: Waad og tahay in kuwii Aasiya joogay oo dhammu ay iga leexdeen, waxaana ka mid ah Fugelos iyo Hermogenees.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

kikuyu: Rabbiga ha u naxariisto reerkii Oneesiforos; waayo, marar badan ayuu i nasiyey, kamana xishoon silsiladdayda.
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

kikuyu: Laakiinse markuu Rooma joogay wuxuu ku dadaalay inuu i daydayo, wuuna i helay.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

kikuyu: Rabbigu maalintaas ha u naxariisto. Oo adigu aad baad u taqaan intuu waxyaalo ka adeegay Efesos.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

kikuyu: Haddaba, wiilkaygiiyow, ku xoogayso nimcada Ciise Masiix ku jirta.
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Oo waxyaalihii aad markhaatiyaal badan dhexdood igaga maqashay ku ammaanee niman aamin ah oo awooda inay kuwa kaleeto baraan.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

kikuyu: Dhibaato ka qayb qaado sida askari wanaagsan oo Ciise Masiix.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Nin askari ahi, si uu uga farxiyo kii isaga askari ahaanta u qortay, iskuma murgiyo axwaasha noloshan,
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

kikuyu: weliba haddii nin galo cayaaraha loo loollamo, taaj looma saaro hadduusan sida qaynuunka ah u loollamin.
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

kikuyu: Ninka beerta leh ee hawshoodaa waa inuu ahaadaa kan ugu horreeya oo midhaha ka qayb qaata.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

kikuyu: Waxaan leeyahay ka fiirso, waayo, Rabbigu wuxuu ku siin doonaa wax walba garashadooda.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

kikuyu: Bal xusuuso Ciise Masiix, kan kuwii dhintay ka soo sara kacay, oo Daa'uud ka soo farcamay, sida uu leeyahay injiilka aan idinku wacdiyo,
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

kikuyu: kan aan u dhibtoodo oo aan u xidhnahay sidii mid wax xun falay; laakiinse erayga Ilaah ma xidhna.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

kikuyu: Haddaba wax walba waxaan ugu adkaystaa kuwa la doortay aawadood inay iyana helaan badbaadada ammaanta weligeeda leh oo ku jirta Ciise Masiix.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

kikuyu: Hadalkanu waa dhab, Haddii aynu isaga la dhimannay, dee haddana waynu la noolaan doonnaa,
english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

kikuyu: haddii aynu adkaysanno, dee haddana wax baynu la xukumi doonnaa; haddii aynu isaga inkirnona, dee isna wuu ina diidi doonaa;
english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

kikuyu: haddii aynu nahay aaminlaawayaal, isagu weli waa aamin; waayo, isagu isma burin karo.
english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan iyaga xusuusi oo Rabbiga hortiisa ku amar inayan hadal ku murmin, waayo, kaasu faa'iido ma leh, laakiinse kuwa maqla ayuu sii kharribaa.
english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

kikuyu: Ku dadaal inaad nafsaddaada loo bogay Ilaah siisid, adigoo ah shaqeeye aan dadka ka xishoonin, oo hadalka runta ah si hagaagsan u wada.
english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ka fogow hadalka aan micnaha lahayn, oo nijaasta ah, waayo, kuwaas waxay hore u sii wadi doonaan cibaadola'aanta,
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

kikuyu: oo hadalkoodu sida waraabowgu u faafo ayuu u sii faafi doonaa; iyaga waxaa ka mid ah Humenayos iyo Fileetos,
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

kikuyu: oo ah kuwa xagga runta ka gefay iyagoo leh, Sarakicidda waa horaa la soo dhaafay, oo qaar bay iimaanka ka halleeyaan.
english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee aasaaskii adkaa oo Ilaah dhigay wuu taagan yahay, isagoo leh sumaddan, Rabbigu wuu yaqaan kuwiisa; oo mid kasta oo magaca Rabbiga soo qaada xaqnimola'aanta ha ka tago.
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

kikuyu: Haddaba kuma jiraan guri weyn weelal dahab iyo lacag keliya ahi, laakiinse waxaa kaloo yaal kuwo qoryo iyo dhoobo ah; oo qaarkoodna wax sharaf leh ayay taraan, qaarna wax aan sharaf lahayn.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed haddii nin iska daahirsho kuwan, kaasu wuxuu ahaan doonaa weel sharaf leh, oo quduus laga dhigay, oo sayidka wax u tara, oo shuqul kasta oo wanaagsan loo diyaariyey.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

kikuyu: Haddaba ka fogow damacyada xunxun ee dhallinyaronimada, laakiinse xaqnimo, iyo rumaysad, iyo jacayl, iyo nabad la raac kuwa Rabbiga uga yeedha qalbi daahir ah.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

kikuyu: Iska diid su'aalaha nacasnimada iyo jaahilnimada ah, adigoo og inay dagaallo dhalaan.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

kikuyu: Addoonka Rabbigu waa inuusan ilaaqtamin, laakiin waa inuu ahaado mid dadka u wada roon, oo waxbaridda ku wanaagsan, oo dulqaadasho badan,
english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

kikuyu: oo si qabow u edbiya kuwa isaga diida; mindhaa Ilaah waa siin doonaa toobadkeenid inay runtay gartaan,
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

kikuyu: oo ay dabinka Ibliiska ka baxsadaan, iyagoo lagu qabtay si ay muraadkiisa u yeelaan.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

kikuyu: Bal tan ogow, maalmaha ugu dambeeya waxaa iman doona wakhtiyo dhib badan.
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, dadku waxay ahaan doonaan kuwo naftooda jecel, iyo kuwo lacag jecel, iyo kuwo faan badan, iyo kuwo kibir badan, iyo kuwo caytan badan, iyo kuwo waalidkood caasi ku ah, iyo kuwo aan mahadnaqin, iyo kuwo aan quduus ahayn,
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

kikuyu: iyo kuwo aan kalgacayl lahayn, iyo kuwo aan heshiis doonaynin, iyo kuwo wax xanta, iyo kuwo aan iscelin karin, iyo kuwo ba'an, iyo kuwo aan wanaagga jeclayn,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

kikuyu: iyo kuwo gacangeliyayaal ah, iyo kuwo haad ah, iyo kuwo isla weyn, iyo kuwa raaxaysi jecel intii ay Ilaah jeclaan lahaayeen.
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

kikuyu: Iyagu waxay haystaan u-ekaanta cibaadaysiga, laakiinse xooggiisay diidaan; kuwaas ka leexo.
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwaas waxaa ka mid ah kuwa guryaha gala, oo ambiya naagaha caqliga la' oo dembiyadu ku raran yihiin, oo damacyada kala duduwanu ay la tageen,
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

kikuyu: oo weligood wax baranaya, laakiinse aan marnaba awoodin inay runta gartaan.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

kikuyu: Siday Yannees iyo Yambarees isu hor taageen Muuse, saas oo kalay kuwanuna runta isu hor taagaan; waana niman maankoodu kharribmay oo xagga iimaankana laga nacay.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

kikuyu: Laakiinse hore uma socon doonaan, waayo, nacasnimadoodu bayaan bay dadka oo dhan u noqon doontaa sidii ay kuwaas toodiiba u noqotay.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu waxaad raacday waxbariddayda, iyo socodkayga, iyo qasdigayga, iyo rumaysadkayga, iyo dulqaadashadayda, iyo jacaylkayga, iyo samirkayga,
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

kikuyu: iyo silecyadayda, iyo xanuunsigayga. Waxyaalihii xunxumaa ee igu dhacay markaan Antiyokh iyo Ikoniyon iyo Lustara joogay! Silecyadii badnaa ee aan u adkaystay! Oo kulligood Rabbigaa iga samatabbixiyey.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

kikuyu: Runtii, kulli inta doonaysa inay si cibaado leh Ciise Masiix ugu noolaadaan waa la silcin doonaa.
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

kikuyu: Laakiinse dadka sharka leh iyo khaa'innadu aad iyo aad bay u sii xumaan doonaan, iyagoo wax khiyaaneeya, lana khiyaaneeyo.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu ku sii soco waxyaalihii aad baratay oo aad hubsatay, adigoo garanaya kuwii aad ka baratay;
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

kikuyu: tan iyo yaraantaadii waxaad garanaysay qorniinka quduuska ah oo badbaadada kugu garansiin kara rumaysadka Ciise Masiix lagu rumaysto.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Qorniin kastaa wuxuu ku ahaaday Ruuxa Ilaah oo waxtar buu u leeyahay waxbaridda, iyo canaanashada, iyo hagaajinta, iyo edbinta xagga xaqnimada;
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

kikuyu: in ninka Ilaah u ahaado mid dhan oo aad loogu diyaariyey shuqul kasta oo wanaagsan.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

kikuyu: Waxaan kugu amrayaa Ilaah hortiis iyo Ciise Masiix oo xukumi doona kuwa nool iyo kuwii dhintayba hortiisa, oo waxaan kaloo kugu amrayaa muuqashadiisa iyo boqortooyadiisa,
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

kikuyu: inaad hadalka dadka ku wacdido. Wakhti wanaagsan iyo wakhti xunba ku dadaal, oo canaano, oo hagaaji, oo waani, adigoo dulqaadanaya oo wax baraya.
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa iman doona wakhti aan dadku u adkaysan doonin cilmiga runta ah, laakiinse iyagoo dheguhu cuncunayaan ayay waxay u urursan doonaan macallimiin siday damcaan;
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

kikuyu: oo dhegahooday runta ka leexin doonaan, oo waxay u jeedin doonaan sheekooyin.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu mar kasta digtoonow, oo dhibta u adkayso, oo shuqulka wacdiyaha qabo, oo adeegiddaada dhammee.
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

kikuyu: Waayo, haatan allabari ahaan baa lay bixinayaa, oo wakhtigii aan tegi lahaa waa yimid.
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

kikuyu: Dagaalkii wanaagsanaa waan dagaallamay, oo tartankii waan dhammeeyey, iimaankiina waan dhawray.
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa la ii dhigay taajkii xaqnimada oo Rabbiga ah xaakinka xaqa ahu i siin doono maalintaas; oo keligayna ima siin doono, laakiin kuwa muuqashadiisa jecel oo dhanna wuu siin doonaa.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

kikuyu: Ku dadaal inaad dhaqso iigu timaadid;
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

kikuyu: waayo, Deemaas intuu dunidan haatan la joogo jeclaaday ayuu iga tegey, oo wuxuu aaday Tesaloniika; Kereeskeesna wuxuu aaday Galatiya; Tiitosna wuxuu aaday Dalmatiya.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

kikuyu: Haatan Luukos oo keliya ayaa ila jooga. Markos soo kaxee oo ha ku soo raaco; waayo, waxtar buu igu leeyahay xagga adeegidda.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Tukhikos waxaan u diray Efesos.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

kikuyu: Markaad soo kacdid ii soo qaad shuluggayga aan kaga tegey Karbos oo Taroo'as jooga, buwaagtiina ii soo qaad khusuusan idiinta wax lagu qoro.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

kikuyu: Aleksanderos, kii naxaasta tumi jiray, wax xun oo badan buu ii yeelay; Rabbigu wuxuu ugu abaalgudi doonaa sidii camalladiisu ahaayeen.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

kikuyu: Adiguna iska jir isaga, waayo, aad buu hadalkayaga u hor joogsaday.
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

kikuyu: Isdaafacaaddaydii hore ninna isma kay garab taagin, laakiinse kulli waa layga wada tegey. Taas yaan dushooda laga dhigin.
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

kikuyu: Laakiinse Rabbiga ayaa iskay garab taagay, oo xoog i siiyey, inaan farriinta dadka oo dhan wada gaadhsiiyo oo ay dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn wada maqlaan; oo waxaa layga samatabbixiyey afkii libaaxa.
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

kikuyu: Oo Rabbiguna wuu iga samatabbixin doonaa shuqul kasta oo shar ah, oo wuxuu igu nabad gelin doonaa boqortooyadiisa jannada ah. Isaga ammaanu ha u ahaato weligiis iyo weligiis. Aamiin.
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Igu salaan Bariska iyo Akula iyo reerkii Oneesiforos.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

kikuyu: Erastos wuxuu ku hadhay Korintos; laakiinse Torofimos oo buka ayaan Mileetos uga soo kacay.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

kikuyu: Ku dadaal inaad wakhtiga qabowga hortiis ii timaadid. Waxaa ku soo salaamaya Yubulos iyo Budees iyo Liinos iyo Kalawdiya iyo walaalaha oo dhan.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

kikuyu: Rabbigu ruuxaaga ha la jiro. Nimcona ha kula jirto. Aamiin.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah oo Ilaah addoon u ah, Ciise Masiixna rasuul u ah, siday yihiin iimaanka kuwa Ilaah doortay iyo aqoonta runta oo ah xagga cibaadada,
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: iyagoo rajaynaya nolosha weligeed ah oo Ilaaha aan beenta sheeginu u ballanqaaday waayadii hore hortood,
english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

kikuyu: laakiinse wakhtiyadiisii goonida ahaa uu hadalkiisii ku muujiyey wacdigii laygu ammaaneeyey sida Ilaaha Badbaadiyeheenna ahu u amray,
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

kikuyu: waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa Tiitos oo ah wiilkayga runta ah xagga iimaanka inaga dhexeeya. Nimco iyo nabadu ha kaaga yimaadeen Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Badbaadiyeheenna Ciise Masiix.
english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

kikuyu: Sababtaas daraaddeed ayaan Kereetee kaaga dhex tegey inaad hagaajisid waxyaalaha hadhay iyo inaad waayeello magaalo walba ka dooratid sidaan kuugu amray,
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

kikuyu: hadduu mid waliba yahay nin aan ceeb lahayn, oo naag keliya qaba, oo leh carruur rumaysan, oo aan rabshad iyo caasinimo lagu dacwaynin.
english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

kikuyu: Waayo, hoggaamiyaha kiniisaddu waa inuu ceeb la'aado sida wakiilka Ilaah; oo uusan madax adkaan, oo uusan camal fududaan, oo uusan sakhraan noqon, oo uusan gacan fududaan, oo uusan faa'iidada ceebta ah jeclaan,
english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

kikuyu: laakiinse waa inuu ahaado mid martida soo dhoweeya, oo wanaag jecel, oo feeyigaan, oo xaq ah, oo quduus ah, oo iscelin kara;
english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

kikuyu: isagoo xajinaya hadalka aaminka ah oo ah sidii loo baray, inuu awoodo inuu cilmiga runta ah ku waaniyo oo ku canaanto kuwa muranka miidhan ah.
english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa jira caasiyiin badan, iyo kuwa hadal xun ku hadla, iyo khaa'inno, oo khusuusan waa kuwa gudan.
english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

kikuyu: Kuwaas afkooda waa in la xidho, maxaa yeelay, waa kuwa reero dhan gembiya iyagoo faa'iidada ceebta ah aawadeed u baraya waxyaalo aan waajib ahayn inay baraan.
english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

kikuyu: Mid iyaga ka mid ahaa oo nebigoodii ahaa ayaa wuxuu yidhi, Reer Kereetee weligood waa beenaalayaal, iyo dugaag xun, iyo kuwo cir weyn oo caajisiin ah.
english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

kikuyu: Markhaatigaasu waa run. Sababtaas aawadeed aad u canaano iyaga inay iimaanka si run ah ugu socdaan
english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

kikuyu: iyagoo aan dhegaysanayn sheekooyinka Yuhuudda iyo amarrada dadka runta ka leexanaya.
english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

kikuyu: Kuwa daahirka ah wax waluba waa u daahir, laakiin kuwa nijaasaysan oo aan rumaysadka lahayn waxba daahir uma aha, laakiinse kaskooda iyo niyadooduba waa nijaasoobeen.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

kikuyu: Waxay afka ka qirtaan inay Ilaah yaqaaniin, laakiin camalladooday isaga kaga hor yimaadaan, iyagoo karaahiyo iyo caasiyiin ah, oo xagga shuqul wanaagsan oo dhan laga nacay.
english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

kikuyu: Laakiinse adigu ku hadal waxyaalaha ku habboon cilmiga runta ah.
english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

kikuyu: Odayaashu waa inay feejignaadaan oo dhug yeeshaan oo digtoonaadaan oo ay si run ah ugu socdaan iimaanka iyo jacaylka iyo dulqaadashada.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena habruhu waa inay asluub quduus ah lahaadaan, oo ayan noqon kuwa wax xanta, oo ayan khamri badan addoommo u noqon, laakiinse ay noqdaan kuwo wax wanaagsan dadka bara.
english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

kikuyu: Oo waa inay naagaha dhallintayar baraan inay jeclaadaan nimankooda iyo carruurtooda,
english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

kikuyu: oo ay digtoonaadaan, oo ay daahir noqdaan, oo ay gurigooda ka shaqeeyaan, oo ay wanaagsanaadaan, iyagoo nimankooda ka dambeeya, si aan ereyga Ilaah loo caayin.
english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

kikuyu: Ragga dhallinyarada ahna sidaas oo kale ku waani inay digtoonaadaan.
english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

kikuyu: Wax walba nafsaddaada masaal ahaan u tus xagga shuqullada wanaagsan; oo cilmigaagana ku tus qummanaan, iyo dhuglahaan,
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

kikuyu: iyo hadal run ah oo aan ceeb lahayn, si midka geesta kaa ahu u ceeboobo, oo uusan u helin wax xun oo uu inaga sheego.
english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

kikuyu: Addoommaduna waa inay sayidyadooda ka dambeeyaan, oo ay wax kasta kaga farxiyaan, oo ayan la murmin,
english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

kikuyu: oo ayan wax ka xadin, laakiin waa inay aaminnimo wanaagsan oo dhan muujiyaan, inay si kasta cilmiga Ilaaha Badbaadiyeheenna ah ammaan ugu soo jiidaan.
english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

kikuyu: Waayo, nimcadii Ilaah way muuqatay, iyadoo badbaado u keenaysa dadka oo dhan,
english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

kikuyu: oo ina baraysa inaynu cibaadola'aanta iyo damacyada dunida diidno, oo aynu wakhtigan haatan la joogo digtoonaan iyo xaqnimo iyo cibaado ku noolaanno,
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

kikuyu: innagoo sugayna rajada barakaysan iyo muuqashada ammaanta Ilaaheenna weyn oo ah Badbaadiyeheenna Ciise Masiix.
english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Isagu nafsaddiisuu u bixiyey aawadeen, inuu dembi oo dhan inaga furto oo uu inaga dhigto dad daahirsan oo uu isagu leeyahay oo ku dadaalaya shuqullo wanaagsan.
english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan dadka kula hadal, oo ku waani, oo ku canaano, adigoo amar oo dhan leh. Oo ninna yuusan ku quudhsan.
english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

kikuyu: Xusuusi iyaga inay taliyayaasha iyo kuwa amarka leh ka dambeeyaan, oo ay dhego nuglaadaan, oo ay shuqul kasta oo wanaagsan diyaar u ahaadaan,
english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

kikuyu: oo ayan ninna caayin oo noqon kuwa ilaaq badan, laakiinse dadka oo dhan roonaan iyo qaboobaan ha tuseen.
english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

kikuyu: Waayo, innaguba waa baynu ahayn nacasyo, iyo caasiyiin, iyo kuwa la khiyaaneeyey, iyo addoommada damacyada xaaraanta ah iyo raaxooyinka kala duduwan, oo waxaynu ku socon jirnay xumaan iyo xaasidnimo, oo waxaynu ahaan jirnay kuwo la nebcaaday oo iyana midba midka kale neceb yahay.
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

kikuyu: Laakiinse markii raxmaddii Ilaaha Badbaadiyeheenna ah iyo jacaylkii uu dadka u qabay muuqdeen,
english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

kikuyu: ayuu ina badbaadiyey. Inaguma uu badbaadin shuqullada xaqnimada oo aynu samaynay, laakiinse naxariistiisa aawadeed wuxuu inagu badbaadiyey nadiifinta dhalashadii labaad iyo cusboonaysiinta Ruuxa Quduuska ah,
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: oo uu aad inoogu shubay oo uu inoogu soo dhiibay Badbaadiyeheenna ah Ciise Masiix;
english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

kikuyu: inaynu, innagoo quduus laynagaga dhigay nimcadiisa, rajada ku noqonno kuwo nolol weligeed ah dhaxla.
english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

kikuyu: Hadalkanu waa run, oo xagga waxyaalahan waxaan doonayaa inaad ku adkaysatid in kuwa Ilaah rumaysanu ay digtoonaadaan inay shuqullo wanaagsan ku dadaalaan. Waxyaalahanu way wanaagsan yihiin, dadkana wax bay u taraan.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

kikuyu: Laakiin ka fogow su'aalaha nacasnimada ah, iyo abtirsiinyada, iyo murannada, iyo ilaaqda sharciga ku saabsan, waayo, waxtar iyo micne toona ma leh.
english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

kikuyu: Haddaad nin bidci ah mar iyo laba waanisid dabadeed ka leexo,
english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

kikuyu: adigoo garanaya in ninka caynkaas ahu qalloocan yahay oo dembaabo isagoo isxukumay.
english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

kikuyu: Markaan kuu soo diro Artemaas ama Tukhikos aad ugu dadaal inaad iigu timaado Nikobolis, waayo, waxaan goostay inaan xilliga qabow meeshaas joogi doono.
english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

kikuyu: Ku dadaal inaad Seenaas kan sharciga yaqaan iyo Abolloos soo ambabbixisid si ayan waxba ugu baahan.
english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

kikuyu: Dadkeennuna ha barto inay shuqullo wanaagsan ugu dadaalaan caawimaadda loo baahan yahay, inayan kuwo aan midho lahayn noqonin.
english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

kikuyu: Kuwa ila jooga oo dhammu way ku soo salaamayaan. Igu salaan kuwa iimaanka nagu jecel. Nimco ha idinla wada jirto.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah oo Ciise Masiix maxbuus u ah, iyo walaalkeen Timoteyos, waxaannu warqaddan u qoraynaa Filemon oo ah gacaliyahayaga nala shaqeeya,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

kikuyu: iyo walaashayo Afiya, iyo Arkhibbos oo askar nala ah, iyo kiniisadda gurigaaga ku taal.
english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

kikuyu: Nimco ha idinla jirto iyo nabad ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbeheenna ah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Had iyo goorba Ilaahay baan kuugu mahadnaqaa, anigoo baryadayda kugu xusuusanaya,
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

kikuyu: waayo, waxaan maqlay jacaylka aad quduusiinta oo dhan u qabto iyo rumaysadka aad Rabbi Ciise ku rumaysato.
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

kikuyu: Oo waxaan baryayaa in wadaagidda iimaankaagu uu socodsiiyo aqoonta wax kasta oo wanaagsan oo inoogu jira Masiixa.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Waayo, jacaylkaaga waxaan ku haystay farxad iyo dhiirranaan badan, maxaa yeelay, qalbiga quduusiinta adaa qabowjiyey, walaalkayow.
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, in kastoo aan Masiixa ku leeyahay dhiirranaan badan inaan kugu amro waxa kuu eg,
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

kikuyu: haddana waxaan ka jeclaan lahaa inaan ku baryo jacaylka aawadiis, anigoo ah duqii Bawlos, maxbuusna Ciise Masiix u ah.
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waxaan kuu baryayaa wiilkayga Oneesimos oo aan dhalay anigoo xabbisan,
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

kikuyu: kii waagii hore aan waxtarka kuu lahaan jirin, haatanse adiga iyo anigaba wax ina tara.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

kikuyu: Waan kuu soo celinayaa, isagoo qalbigayga ah.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

kikuyu: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan sii hayo inuu aawadaa iigu adeego inta aan injiilka u xabbisanahay.
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ma aanan doonayn inaan sameeyo wax aadan ila ogayn, inaan wanaaggaagu noqon dirqi laakiinse uu noqdo ikhtiyaar.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

kikuyu: Mindhaa wuxuu cabbaar kaaga maqnaa inaad weligaa haysatid;
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

kikuyu: laakiinse aadan mar dambe u haysan addoon sidiis, illowse si mid addoon ka wanaagsan oo ah walaal aan khusuusan anigu jeclahay, laakiinse adigu aad iga sii jeceshahay, xagga jidhka iyo xagga Rabbigaba.
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaad igu tirinaysid inaan ahay saaxiibkaaga wax kula wadaaga, isaga u aqbal sidaad ii aqbali lahayd.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

kikuyu: Oo hadduu ku xumeeyey ama wax kaa qabo, aniga igu xisaab.
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

kikuyu: Anigoo Bawlos ah waxaan gacantayda ku qorayaa, Anigaa bixin doona. Kugu odhan maayo, Wax baan kugu leeyahay xataa naftaadaba ha noqotee.
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

kikuyu: Haah, walaalkayow, xagga Rabbiga farxad aan kaa helo, qalbigaygana xagga Masiixa ku qabowji.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

kikuyu: Waxaan aaminsanahay addeeciddaada, oo sidaas daraaddeed ayaan warqaddan kuugu soo qorayaa, anigoo garanaya inaad samaynaysid wax ka sii badan waxaan leeyahay.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

kikuyu: Isla markaasna ii diyaari meel aan ku hoydo; waayo, waxaan rajaynayaa in baryadiinna laygu kiin siiyo.
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

kikuyu: Waxaa ku soo salaamaya Ebafras oo xagga Ciise Masiix maxbuus ila ah,
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

kikuyu: iyo Markos, iyo Aristarkhos, iyo Deemaas, iyo Luukos, kuwaas oo ila shaqeeya.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

kikuyu: Nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ruuxiinna ha la jirto. Aamiin.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

kikuyu: Ilaah wuxuu waagii hore siyaalo badan oo kala duduwan awowayaasheen kula hadlay nebiyadii,
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

kikuyu: laakiin maalmahan ugu dambaystooda wuxuu inagula hadlay Wiilkiisa uu ka dhigay kan wax walba dhaxla, kan uu duniyooyinkana ku sameeyey.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

kikuyu: Oo isagu waa dhalaalka ammaantiisa iyo u-ekaanta ahaantiisa, oo wax walba wuxuu ku hayaa erayga xooggiisa, oo goortuu daahirinta dadka dembiyadooda sameeyey dabadeed ayuu wuxuu fadhiistay Weynaha xagga sare midigtiisa,
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

kikuyu: isagoo aad uga wanaagsan malaa'igaha siduu u dhaxlay magac ka sii wanaagsan kooda.
english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

kikuyu: Malaa'igihii tee buu marnaba ku yidhi, Adigu waxaad tahay Wiilkayga, Maantaan ku dhalay? Oo weliba, Waxaan isaga u noqon doonaa Aabbe, Oo isaguna wuxuu ii noqon doonaa Wiil?
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”

kikuyu: Oo weliba, markuu curadka dunida dhex keenayay, wuxuu yidhi, Malaa'igaha Ilaah oo dhammu isaga ha caabudeen.
english: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

kikuyu: Oo xagga malaa'igahana wuxuu ka yidhi, Wuxuu malaa'igihiisa ka dhigaa dabaylo, Kuwa u adeegana dab ololkiis.
english: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”

kikuyu: Laakiin Wiilka wuxuu ka yidhi, Carshigaagu, Ilaahow, waa weligiis iyo weligiis; Oo usha qummanaantuna waa usha boqortooyadaada.
english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

kikuyu: Adigu xaqnimada waad jeclayd, dembigana waad necbayd, Sidaas daraaddeed Ilaaha Ilaahaaga ahi wuxuu kuugu subkay Saliidda farxadda, oo kuwa ku weheliyana wuu kaa sarraysiiyey.
english: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”

kikuyu: Oo, Adigu Rabbiyow, bilowgii dhulkaad aasaastay, Samooyinkuna waa shuqullada gacmahaaga,
english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

kikuyu: Iyagu way baabbi'i doonaan, adiguse waad sii jiraysaa; Oo kulligood sida dhar bay u duugoobi doonaan,
english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

kikuyu: Oo sida go' baad u laallaabi doontaa, Sida dhar bayna u beddelmi doonaan; Adiguse sidaadii uun baad tahay Sannadahaaguna ma dhammaan doonaan.
english: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”

kikuyu: Malaa'igihii tee buu marnaba ku yidhi, Midigtayda fadhiiso Ilaa aan cadaawayaashaada cagahaaga hoostooda geliyo?
english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”

kikuyu: Miyaanay kulligood ahayn ruuxyo kaalmeeya oo loo soo diray inay shuqul u qabtaan kuwa badbaadada dhaxli doona?
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

kikuyu: Taa aawadeed waa inaynu aad u dhegaysanno waxaynu maqalnay waaba intaasoo ay inaga fakadaan.
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii hadalkii malaa'iguhu ku hadleen xaqiiq ahaa, oo kii kasta oo xadgudub iyo caasinimo sameeyey uu helay abaalgud xaq ah,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

kikuyu: sidee baynu u baxsan doonnaa haddaynu dayacno badbaadintan weyn oo Rabbigu kolkii hore ku hadlay oo kuwii maqlayna inoo xaqiiqeeyeen?
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

kikuyu: Ilaahna wuxuu ugu marag furay calaamooyin iyo yaababba, iyo xoogag kala duduwan, iyo hadiyado Ruuxa Quduuska ahu u qaybiyey siduu doonayay.
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

kikuyu: Waayo, dunida iman doonta oo aynu ka hadalno malaa'igaha kama uu hoosaysiin.
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

kikuyu: Laakiin mid baa meel ka marag furay isagoo leh, Bal waa maxay dadku oo aad u xusuusataa isaga? Ama wiilka aadanaha, oo aad u soo booqataa?
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

kikuyu: Waxaad isaga wax yar ka hoosaysiisay malaa'igaha. Waxaanad taaj uga dhigtay ammaan iyo murwad, Oo waxaad ka sarraysiisay shuqullada gacmahaaga,
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

kikuyu: Wax walbana cagihiisaad ka hoosaysiisay. Isagoo wax walba isaga ka hoosaysiiyey, wax uu dhaafay oo aanu isaga ka hoosaysiinini ma jiraan, laakiin imminka weli ma aragno wax walba oo isaga laga hoosaysiiyey.
english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaynu aragnaa Ciise, kan wax yar malaa'igaha laga hoosaysiiyey, isagoo xanuunka dhimashada aawadiis ammaan iyo murwad taaj loogu geliyey inuu nimcada Ilaah dhimashada ugu dhadhamiyo qof walba.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

kikuyu: Waayo, waa u ekayd kan wax walba u yihiin, oo wax walba ka yimaadeen, markuu carruur badan ammaan u keeno, inuu bilaabaha badbaadadooda xanuun ku kaamilo.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

kikuyu: Waayo, kan quduus ka dhiga iyo kuwa quduus laga dhigaaba kulli mid keliya ayay ka yimaadaan; taas aawadeed isagu kalama xishoodo inuu iyaga ugu yeedho walaalo,
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Magacaaga waxaan u sheegi doonaa walaalahay, Oo ururka dhexdiisa ayaan kugu ammaani doonaa.
english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana, Isagaan aamini doonaa, oo haddana, Bal eega, aniga iyo carruurta Ilaah i siiyey.
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”

kikuyu: Carruurtu waxay qayb ka heleen jidh iyo dhiig, taas aawadeed isaguna sidaas oo kale ayuu uga qayb qaatay, inuu dhimasho ku baabbi'iyo kii xoogga dhimashada lahaa, oo ah Ibliiska,
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

kikuyu: iyo inuu furo kulli kuwii cimrigoodii oo dhan addoonnimo ugu hoos jiray cabsida dhimashada.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

kikuyu: Waayo, runtii, ma uu qaadan suuradda malaa'igaha, wuxuuse qaatay tan dhashii Ibraahim.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa isaga u ekayd inuu wax walba ugu ekaado walaalihiis, inuu wadaad sare oo naxariis iyo aamin badan leh u noqdo xagga waxyaalaha Ilaah, si uu cadhotir ugu noqdo dembiyada dadka.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

kikuyu: Waayo, isaga qudhiisu wuu xanuunsaday isagoo la jirrabay, taas aawadeed wuu karaa inuu caawiyo kuwa la jirrabo.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

kikuyu: Haddaba walaalaha quduuska ah oo ka qayb gala yeedhniinta jannadow, u fiirsada Ciise oo ah Rasuulka iyo Wadaadka sare ee iimaanka aynu qiranno.
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

kikuyu: Aamin buu u ahaa kan doortay, sidii Muuseba gurigiisii oo dhan aaminka ugu ahaa.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa isaga lagu tiriyey inuu istaahilo ammaan ka badan tii Muuse, sida kan guriga dhisa uga murwad badan yahay guriga.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

kikuyu: Waayo, guri walba mid baa dhisay, laakiin kan wax walba dhisay waa Ilaah.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

kikuyu: Oo runtii Muuse gurigiisa oo dhan aamin buu ugu ahaa sida midiidin, inuu markhaati u ahaado waxyaalaha mar dambe lagu hadli doono.
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

kikuyu: Laakiin Masiix aamin buu u ahaa sida wiil gurigiisa ka sarreeya; oo gurigiisu waa innaga haddaynu ilaa ugu dambaysta dhiirranaanteenna iyo faanka rajadeenna aad u xajinno.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

kikuyu: Haddaba waa sidan waxa Ruuxa Quduuska ahi leeyahay, Maanta haddaad codkiisa maqashaan,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

kikuyu: Qalbiyadiinna ha adkaynina sidii wakhtigii dhirifka, Sidii maalintii jirrabaadda ee cidlada dhexdeeda,
english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

kikuyu: Meeshii ay awowayaashiin igu jirrabeen, oo ay igu tijaabiyeen, Oo ay afartanka sannadood shuqulladaydii ku arkeen.
english: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed qarnigan waan u cadhaysnaa, Oo waxaan idhi, Had iyo goorba qalbigooday ka qaldamaan, Oo iyagu ma ay aqoon jidadkaygii.
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed anigoo cadhaysan ayaan waxaan ku dhaartay, Iyagu nasashadayda ma geli doonaan.
english: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

kikuyu: Iska jira, walaalayaalow. Yaanu qalbi shar leh oo aan rumaysad lahayni midkiinna ku jirin, idinkoo Ilaaha nool ka dheeraanaya.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

kikuyu: Laakiin maalin kasta iswaaniya, intii la odhanayo, Maanta, inuusan midkiinna ku engegin khiyaanada dembiga.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaynu noqonnay kuwa Masiix ka qayb qaatay, haddaynu aad u xajinno bilowgii kalsoonaanteenna ilaa ugu dambaysta,
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

kikuyu: inta la leeyahay, Maanta haddaad codkiisa maqashaan, Qalbiyadiinna ha adkaynina sidii wakhtigii dhirifka.
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

kikuyu: Waayo, yaa, markay maqleen, Ilaah ka dhirfiyey? Miyaanay ahayn kulligood kuwii Muuse ka keenay Masar?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

kikuyu: Oo yuu afartan sannadood u cadhaysnaa? Miyaanay ahayn kuwii dembaabay oo meydadkoodu cidlada ku dhacdhaceen?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

kikuyu: Oo yuu ku dhaartay inaanay nasashadiisa gelin, kuwii isaga addeeci waayay mooyaane?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

kikuyu: Oo waxaynu aragnaa inaanay geli karin rumaysaddarro aawadeed.
english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed aynu cabsanno, inta ballan nasashadiisa lagu gelayaa jiro, inaan midkiinna u ekaan mid gaadhi waayay.
english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

kikuyu: Waayo, innagana war wanaagsan baa laynagu wacdiyey sidooda oo kale, laakiin hadalkay maqleen waxba uma uu tarin iyaga, maxaa yeelay, kuwii maqlay rumaysad kuma ay darin.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuweenna rumaystay, nasashadaas waynu galnaa, siduu u yidhi, Sidaas daraaddeed anigoo cadhaysan ayaan waxaan ku dhaartay, Iyagu nasashadayda ma geli doonaan, in kastoo ay shuqulladii ka dhammaadeen aasaaska dunida.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu meel buu maalintii toddobaad sidan ka yidhi, Maalintii toddobaad Ilaah baa shuqulladiisii oo dhan ka nastay.
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

kikuyu: Meeshatanna mar kale wuxuu yidhi, Iyagu nasashadayda ma geli doonaan.
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaa hadhay qaar gelaya, oo kuwii kolkii hore warkii wanaagsanaa lagu wacdiyey way geli waayeen caasinimo aawadeed.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed haddana mar kale maalintoo buu gooni u dhigay, isagoo wakhti dheer dabadeed qorniinka Daa'uud ku leh, Maanta, sidii kolkii hore la yidhi, Maanta haddaad codkiisa maqashaan, Qalbiyadiinna ha adkaynina.
english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii Yashuuca iyagii nasiyey, Ilaah markaas dabadeed kama uu hadleen maalin kale.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaa dadka Ilaah u hadha nasasho.
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii nasashadiisa galay, isaga qudhiisuna waa ka nastay shuqulladiisii sidii Ilaah kuwiisii uga nastay.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

kikuyu: Haddaba aynu u dadaalno inaynu nasashadaas galno inaan ninna caasinimadaas oo kale ku dhicin.
english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

kikuyu: Waayo, hadalka Ilaah wuu nool yahay, waana shaqeeyaa, oo waa ka af badan yahay seef kasta oo laba af leh, isagoo ka dhex dusaya ilaa kala soocniinta nafta iyo ruuxa, iyo xubnaha iyo dhuuxaba, waana kala gartaa fikirrada iyo waxyaalaha qalbiga ku jira.
english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

kikuyu: Oo uun aan hortiisa ka muuqani ma jiro, laakiin wax waliba way qaawan yihiin oo bannaan yihiin indhihiisa hortooda, kan aynu ku tirsan nahay.
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

kikuyu: Haddaba innagoo leh wadaad sare oo weyn, kan samooyinka sii dhex maray, kaas oo ah Ciisoo Wiilka Ilaah ah, aynu qirashadeenna xajinno.
english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

kikuyu: Waayo, ma aynu lihin wadaad sare oo aan itaaldarradeenna ka nixi karin, laakiin waxaynu leennahay mid si walba loo jirrabay sideenna oo kale, oo aan weliba dembi lahayn.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

kikuyu: Haddaba aynu carshiga nimcada dhiirranaan ugu soo dhowaanno si aynu naxariis u qaadanno oo aynu u helno nimco ina caawisa wakhtiga baahida.
english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

kikuyu: Wadaad sare oo kasta, oo dadka laga dhex bixiyo, waxaa dadka loogu doortaa waxyaalaha Ilaah ku saabsan, inuu hadiyado iyo allabaryoba u bixiyo dembiyada aawadood.
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

kikuyu: Isagu waa u naxariisan karaa kuwaan aqoonta lahayn iyo kuwa qaldan, maxaa yeelay, isaga qudhiisuba wuu itaal daranyahay.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

kikuyu: Oo sidaas daraaddeed waa inuu qudhiisa wax ugu bixiyo dembiyada aawadood, siduu dadka wax ugu bixiyo oo kale.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

kikuyu: Ninna murwadda iskama qaato, laakiin waa kii Ilaah ugu yeedho siduu Haaruun ugu yeedhay.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale Masiixu isma ammaanin inuu noqdo wadaad sare, laakiin waxaa doortay kan ku yidhi, Adigu waxaad tahay Wiilkayga, Maantaan ku dhalay.
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

kikuyu: Meel kalena wuxuu ka yidhi. Adigu weligaaba wadaad baad tahay Sidii derejadii Malkisadaq.
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Masiixu maalmihii jidhkiisa wuxuu tukasho iyo baryooyin qaylo dheer iyo ilmo ugu bixiyey kan kara inuu isaga dhimasho ka badbaadiyo, waana loo maqlay cibaadadiisa.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

kikuyu: In kastuu wiil ahaa, weliba wuxuu addeecid ku bartay waxyaalihii uu ku xanuunsaday;
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

kikuyu: oo goortuu kaamil noqday wuxuu kuwa isaga addeeca oo dhan u noqday sababta badbaadada weligeed ah.
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

kikuyu: Oo Ilaah baa isaga wuxuu ku magacaabay wadaad sare sidii derejadii Malkisadaq.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

kikuyu: Waxaannu haysanna waxyaalo badan oo aannu kan kaga hadalno, laakiin waa fasir adag yahay dhegaculayskiinna aawadiis.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

kikuyu: Wakhtigii aad macallimiin noqon lahaydeen ayaad haddana u baahan tihiin in laydin baro waxyaalaha ugu horreeya ee Ereyada Ilaah, oo waxaad noqoteen sidii kuwa caano u baahan ee aan cunto adag u baahnayn.
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

kikuyu: Waayo, mid kasta oo ay cuntadiisu caano tahay aqoon uma laha hadalka xaqnimada, waayo, waa ilmo yar.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

kikuyu: Laakiin cuntada adag waxaa leh dadka waaweyn oo ah kuwa ku isticmaalidda kaskooda ku kala garta wanaagga iyo xumaanta.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed aynu iska dayno ka hadlidda waxyaalihii ugu horreeyey ee Masiix, oo hore aynu ugu soconno kaamilnimada, oo yeynan mar kale dhigin aasaaska ka-toobadkeenidda shuqulladii dhintay, iyo iimaanka xagga Ilaah,
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

kikuyu: iyo waxbaridda baabtiisyada, iyo gacmo-dul-saaridda, iyo sarakicidda kuwii dhintay, iyo xukunka weligiis ah.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

kikuyu: Oo tan waynu samayn doonnaa haddii Ilaah idmo.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

kikuyu: Kuwii mar loo iftiimiyey, oo hadiyaddii jannada dhadhamiyey, oo laga dhigay kuwa ka qayb galay Ruuxa Quduuskaa,
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: oo dhadhamiyey eraygii wanaagsanaa ee Ilaah iyo xoogagga wakhtiga iman doona,
english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

kikuyu: oo dabadeedna dhacay, ma suurtowdo in loo cusboonaysiiyo toobadkeenidda, iyagoo mar kale Wiilka Ilaah iskutallaabta isugu qodbaya oo bayaan u ceebaynaya.
english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhulka cabbay roobka marar badan ku dul da'a, oo u soo saara geedo u wanaagsan kuwii beeray, wuxuu Ilaah ka helaa barako,
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

kikuyu: laakiin hadduu dhalo qodxan iyo yamaarug, waxtar ma leh, oo habaar buu ku dhow yahay, ugudambaystiisana waa in la gubaa.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

kikuyu: Laakiin gacaliyayaalow, wax ka wanaagsan oo idinku saabsan ayaa lana aaminsiiyey iyo waxyaalaha badbaadada, in kastoo aannu sidan u hadalnay.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah ma xaqdarra, mana illoobo shuqulkiinna iyo jacaylka aad magiciisa u qabtaan, maxaa yeelay, quduusiinta ayaad u adeegteen oo weli waad u adeegtaan.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

kikuyu: Oo annagu waxaannu jecel nahay in midkiin kastaa muujiyo dadaalkaas oo kale tan iyo hubaasha rajada ilaa ugu dambaysta,
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

kikuyu: inaydnaan caajisiin noqon laakiin aad noqotaan kuwo ku dayda kuwa rumaysadka iyo dulqaadashada ku dhaxla ballamada.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

kikuyu: Markii Ilaah ballan u qaaday Ibraahim, isagoo mid ka weyn oo uu ku dhaarto aan haysan, ayuu isku dhaartay,
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Hubaal waan ku barakayn doonaa, oo waan ku kordhin doonaa.
