english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

kikuyu: Oo sidaas isagoo u dulqaadanaya ayuu helay wixii loo ballanqaaday.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

kikuyu: Waayo, dadku waxay ku dhaartaan kan iyaga ka weyn, oo waxaa muran kasta oo kooda ah ugu dambaysa dhaar si loo xaqiiqaysto,
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

kikuyu: sidaas daraaddeed, Ilaah, isagoo aad u doonaya inuu kuwa ballanka dhaxla tuso taladiisa aan beddelmi karin, ayuu dhaar ku galay;
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

kikuyu: in laba waxyaalood, oo aan beddelmi karin, oo aan suurtoobin inuu Ilaah been ka sheego, aynu ku helno dhiirranaan xoog leh innagoo magangal u soo cararnay si aynu u qabsanno rajada ina hor taal,
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

kikuyu: tan aynu sida barroosinka nafta u haysanno, mid adkaan iyo hubaalba ah oo gelaysa waxa daaha ka shisheeya,
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

kikuyu: meeshii Ciise sida horseed inoo galay isagoo noqday wadaad sare oo weligiis ah sidii derejadii Malkisadaq.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

kikuyu: Malkisadaqan, oo Saalem boqorka u ahaa, wadaadkii Ilaaha ugu sarreeyana ahaa, wuxuu la kulmay Ibraahim oo ka soo noqday layntii boqorrada, wuuna barakeeyey.
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

kikuyu: Oo Ibraahim wuxuu isagii wax kasta ka siiyey toban meelood oo meel. Malkisadaq hortii waxaa magiciisii lagu fasiray, Boqorka Xaqnimada, dabadeedna, Boqorka Saalem, oo ah Boqorka Nabadda.
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

kikuyu: Aabbe ma lahayn, hooyona ma lahayn, abtirsiinyona ma lahayn, oo isagoo aan lahayn bilowga maalmaha ama dhammaadka nolosha laakiin loo ekaysiiyey Wiilka Ilaah, ayuu weligiis wadaad sii ahaanayaa.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

kikuyu: Haddaba ka fiirsada ninkanu siduu u weynaa, kan Ibraahim oo madaxda awowayaashii ahi meeltobnaad ka siiyey boolidii.
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

kikuyu: Oo runtii kuwii qoladii Laawi oo helay shuqulka wadaadnimada waxay haystaan amar ay dadka kaga qaataan meeltobnaadka sida sharcigu leeyahay, kuwaas waxaa weeye walaalahood in kastoo ay kuwanu ka yimaadeen xanjaadka Ibraahim.
english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

kikuyu: Laakiin kii aan iyaga ku abtirsanin ayaa wuxuu Ibraahim ka qaatay meeltobnaadyo, oo barakeeyey kii ballamada loo qaaday.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

kikuyu: Laakiin muranla'aan kan yar waxaa barakeeya kan ka wanaagsan.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

kikuyu: Oo halkan waxaa meeltobnaadyada qaata dadka dhinta, laakiin halkaas mid loo markhaati furay inuu nool yahay.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

kikuyu: Waxaa la odhan kara, Laawiga meeltobnaadyada qaataana, Ibraahim meeltobnaadyo ayuu ku bixiyey.
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu weli xanjaadkii aabbihiis buu ku jiray kolkii Malkisadaq la kulmay.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii kaamilnimo ku jirtay wadaadnimadii Laawi, waayo, iyada ayuu dadku sharciga ka hoos helaye, maxaa weli loogu baahnaa in wadaad kale ka kaco derejadii Malkisadaq oo aan lagu magacaabin derejadii Haaruun?
english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

kikuyu: Waayo, wadaadnimada markii la beddelo waa lagamamaarmaan in sharcigana la beddelo.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii waxyaalahan laga sheegay waa qolo kale oo aan nin meeshii allabariga ka shaqeeyey ka iman.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

kikuyu: Waa cad dahay in Sayidkeennu ka soo baxay Yahuudah, oo ah qolo aan Muuse kaga hadlin wax wadaaddo ku saabsan.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

kikuyu: Oo weliba aad bay u sii cad dahay, haddii wadaad kale oo Malkisadaq u egi kaco,
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

kikuyu: kii aan wadaad lagaga dhigin sharciga abtirsiinyada xagga jidhka, laakiin xagga xoogga nolosha aan dhammaadka lahayn.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

kikuyu: Waayo, isaga waxaa loogu markhaati furay, Adigu weligaaba wadaad baad tahay Sidii derejadii Malkisadaq.
english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Waayo, amarkii hore waxaa loo buriyey itaaldarradiisii iyo faa'iidola'aantiisii,
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, sharcigu waxba ma uu kaamilin. Oo waxaa la keenay rajo ka wanaagsan oo aynu Ilaah ugu dhowaanno.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

kikuyu: Oo isagu dhaarla'aan wadaad kuma uu noqon.
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

kikuyu: Iyagu dhaarla'aan bay wadaaddo ku noqdeen, laakiin isagu wuxuu ku noqday dhaarta kan ku yidhi, Rabbigu waa dhaartay, kana soo noqon maayo, Adigu weligaaba wadaad baad tahay.
english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

kikuyu: Oo sidaasuu Ciise ku noqday dammiinka axdiga ka wanaagsan.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

kikuyu: Iyaguna waxay noqdeen wadaaddo tiro badan, maxaa yeelay, dhimashada ayaa ka joojisay inay sii jiraan:
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

kikuyu: Isaguse wuxuu haystaa wadaadnimadiisa aan beddelmi karin, waayo, weligiis buu sii jirayaa.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed dhammaan buu u badbaadin karaa kuwa Ilaah ugu dhowaada isaga, maxaa yeelay, isagu weligiis waa nool yahay si uu ugu duceeyo iyaga.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

kikuyu: Waayo, wadaad sare oo caynkan ahu waa inagu habboonaa, mid quduus ah oo aan khiyaano iyo wasakh toona lahayn, oo dembilayaasha ka soocan, oo samooyinka laga sarraysiiyey,
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

kikuyu: kan aan u baahnayn inuu maalin walba allabari u bixiyo sida wadaaddadii sare, kolka hore dembiyadiisa aawadood, dabadeedna kuwa dadka aawadood; tan mar keliya ayuu sameeyey markuu isbixiyey.
english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

kikuyu: Waayo, sharcigu niman itaaldaran ayuu wadaaddo sare ka dhigaa, laakiin hadalka dhaarta oo sharciga ka dambeeyey wuxuu ka dhigaa Wiil weligiis kaamil ah.
english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

kikuyu: Waxyaalihii la yidhi wixii ugu muhimsanaa waa kan, Waxaynu leennahay wadaad sare oo caynkaas ah, kan fadhiistay midigta carshiga Weynaha jannooyinka ku jira,
english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

kikuyu: kan u adeega waxyaalaha quduuska ah iyo taambuugga runta ah ee Rabbigu dhisay oo aan dad dhisin.
english: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

kikuyu: Waayo, wadaad kasta oo sare waxaa loo doortay inuu hadiyado iyo allabaryo bixiyo, sidaas daraaddeed waa lagamamaarmaan in wadaadkan sarena haysto wax uu bixiyo.
english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

kikuyu: Haddaba hadduu dhulka joogi lahaa, wadaad ma uu ahaadeen, maxaa yeelay, waxaa jira kuwa hadiyado u bixiya sida sharcigu leeyahay;
english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

kikuyu: kuwa u adeega waxa ah u-ekaanta iyo hooska waxyaalaha jannada, sidii Muuse loogu digay kolkuu ku dhowaa inuu taambuugga sameeyo. Waayo, wuxuu yidhi, Aad ugu fiirso inaad wax walba u samayso siduu ahaa u-ekaanshihii buurta lagugu tusay.
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”

kikuyu: Laakiin haatan wuxuu helay shuqul aad uga wanaagsan siduu u yahay dhexdhexaadiyaha axdiga ka wanaagsan ee lagu dhisay ballamo ka wanaagsan.
english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii axdigii hore uusan eed lahayn, mid labaad meella looma dooneen.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

kikuyu: Wuxuu yidhi, isagoo iyaga eedaynaya, Bal eega, maalmihii waa imanayaan, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay, Oo anigu axdi cusub baan la dhigan doonaa reer Israa'iil iyo reer Yahuudah;
english: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

kikuyu: Oo aan ahayn axdigii aan awowayaashood la dhigtay oo kale Maalintii aan iyaga gacanta qabtay inaan ka kaxeeyo dalka Masar, Waayo, iyagu kuma ay sii socon axdigaygii, Aniguna farahaan ka qaaday, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

kikuyu: Waayo, kanu waa axdiga aan la dhigan doono reer Israa'iil Maalmahaas dabadood, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay; Qaynuunnadayda waxaan gelin doonaa maankooda, Qalbigoodana waan ku qori doonaa, Oo Ilaah baan u ahaan doonaa, Iyaguna dad bay ii ahaan doonaan;
english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

kikuyu: Oo iyagu ma bari doonaan mid walba deriskiisa Iyo mid walba walaalkiis, iyagoo leh, Rabbiga garo, Waayo, kulli way i garan doonaan, Kan ugu yar ilaa kan ugu weyn.
english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagoo xaqdaran baan u naxariisan doonaa, Dembiyadoodana kol dambe ma xusuusan doono.
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”

kikuyu: Kolkuu yidhi, Axdi cusub, ayuu kii hore duug ka dhigay. Laakiin kan duugoobayaa oo gaboobayaa wuxuu u dhow yahay inuu libdho.
english: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

kikuyu: Xataa axdigii hore wuxuu lahaa qaynuunno ku saabsan caabudid, iyo meel quduus ah ee dunidatan.
english: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa la dhisay taambuug; intii hore waxaa ku jiray laambadaha isku yiil, iyo miiska, iyo kibista tusniinta, oo waxaa la odhan jiray Meeshii Quduuska ahayd.
english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

kikuyu: Daaha labaad shishediisa waxaa ku jiray taambuuggii la odhan jiray, Quduuskii Quduusyada,
english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

kikuyu: isagoo leh girgire dahab ah oo foox lagu shido, iyo sanduuqii axdiga oo kulligiis dahab lagu dahaadhay, dhexdiisana waxaa ku jiray weel dahab ah oo maannadii ku jirto, iyo ushii Haaruun oo magooshay, iyo looxyadii axdiga;
english: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

kikuyu: dushiisana Keruubiimtii ammaanta oo hadhaynaya daboolka kafaaraggudka, waxyaalahaas oo aannan hadda gooni gooni uga hadli karin.
english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxyaalahan oo sidaas loo diyaariyey, wadaaddadu waxay had iyo goor galaan taambuugga kowaad iyagoo shuqulka dhammaynaya.
english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

kikuyu: Laakiin kan labaad waxaa sannaddiiba mar gala wadaadka sare oo keliya, isagoo aan dhiigla'aan gelaynin. Oo dhiiggaas wuxuu u bixiyaa naftiisa iyo dembiyada dadku aqoonla'aanta ku sameeyo.
english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

kikuyu: Ruuxa Quduuska ahu wuxuu tilmaamaa inaan jidkii Quduuskii Quduusyada weli la muujin, inta taambuugga hore weli taagan yahay.
english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

kikuyu: Tani wakhtiga la joogo waa masaal, sida loo bixiyo hadiyado iyo allabaryo, kuwaas oo aan kaamil ka dhigi karin caabudaha niyadiisa,
english: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

kikuyu: iyagoo ku saabsan cuntooyin iyo cabbitin iyo maydhmaydhid kala duwan oo ah amarrada jidhka oo keliya oo la dejiyey ilaa wakhtiga hagaajinta.
english: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

kikuyu: Masiixu wuxuu yimid, isagoo ah wadaadka sare ee waxyaalaha wanaagsan oo iman doona. Taambuuggii wadaadnimadiisu wuxuu ahaa ku ka weyn oo ka kaamilsan, oo aan gacmo lagu samayn, kaasu waxaa weeyaan mid aan abuuristan ka iman.
english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

kikuyu: Mar buu wada galay meeshii quduuska ahayd, isagoo aan orgiyo iyo weylal dhiiggoodii wadin, laakiin wuxuu waday dhiiggiisa, sidaasuu furasho weligeed ah inoogu helay.
english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii orgiyo iyo dibiyo dhiiggooda, iyo qaalin dambaskeeda lagu rusheeyo kuwa nijaasoobay, ay quduus ka dhigaan in jidhka la nadiifiyo,
english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

kikuyu: intee ka badan ayuu dhiigga Masiix, kan Ruuxa weligiis ah isugu bixiyey Ilaah isagoo aan eed lahayn, niyadiinna ka nadiifin kara shuqullada dhintay si aad ugu adeegtaan Ilaaha nool?
english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

kikuyu: Oo sidaas daraaddeed isagu waa dhexdhexaadiyaha axdiga cusub in kuwii loo yeedhay ay helaan dhaxalka weligiis ah oo la ballanqaaday, waayo, dhimashadu waxay u noqotay ka madaxfurashada xadgudubyada lagu sameeyey axdigii hore.
english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

kikuyu: Waayo, meeshii dardaaran jiro waa lagamamaarmaan inuu kii dardaarmay dhinto.
english: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

kikuyu: Waayo, dardaaranka waa la fuliyaa meeshii dhimasho jirto, maxaa yeelay, waxba ma taro intii kii dardaarmay nool yahay.
english: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

kikuyu: Haddaba xataa axdigii hore laguma gelin dhiigla'aan.
english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

kikuyu: Waayo, markii Muuse amar kasta kula hadlay dadka oo dhan sida sharcigu leeyahay, wuxuu qaaday dhiiggii weylalka iyo orgiyada, iyo biyo, iyo dhogor guduudan, iyo geed husob la yidhaahdo, oo wuxuu ku rusheeyey kitaabka qudhiisa iyo dadka oo dhanba,
english: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

kikuyu: isagoo leh, Kanu waa dhiiggii axdiga oo Ilaah idinku amray.
english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena taambuugga iyo weelasha lagu adeego oo dhan ayuu ku rusheeyey dhiiggii.
english: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

kikuyu: Inta badan wax walba waxaa lagu nadiifiyaa dhiig sida sharcigu leeyahay, oo dhiigdaadinla'aan dembidhaaf ma jiro.
english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

kikuyu: Haddaba lagamamaarmaan bay ahayd in u-ekaanta waxyaalaha jannooyinka ku jira kuwan lagu nadiifiyo; laakiin waxyaalaha jannada qudhooda waa in lagu nadiifiyo allabaryo kuwan ka wanaagsan.
english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

kikuyu: Masiixu ma uu gelin meel quduus ah oo gacmo lagu sameeyey, oo u eg tan runta ah, laakiin wuxuu galay jannada qudheeda inuu hadda Ilaah hortiisa inooga muuqdo.
english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

kikuyu: Weliba uma uu gelin inuu marar badan isbixiyo, sida wadaadka sare meesha quduuska ah sannad walba ula galo dhiig uusan lahayn.
english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

kikuyu: Haddii kale lagamamaarmaan bay ahayd inuu marar badan xanuunsado tan iyo aasaaskii dunida; laakiin haatan oo dhammaadkii wakhtiga ah isaga mar keliya ayaa la muujiyey inuu dembiga ku baabbi'iyo allabarigiisa.
english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

kikuyu: Waxaa dadka looga dhigay inay mar dhintaan, taas dabadeedna la xukumo,
english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

kikuyu: sidaas oo kalena Masiix, isagoo mar loo bixiyey inuu qaado dembiyada kuwa badan, ayuu dembila'aan mar labaad badbaadin ugu muuqan doonaa kuwa isaga sugaya.
english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

kikuyu: Waayo, sharcigu wuxuu leeyahay hooska waxyaalaha wanaagsan oo iman doona, laakiin ma leh suuradda waxyaalahaas qudheeda. Oo caabudayaasha marnaba kaamil kagama uu dhigi karo allabaryo sannad walba had iyo goor la bixiyo.
english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

kikuyu: Haddii kale miyaan la joojiyeen in allabaryo la bixiyo? Maxaa yeelay, caabudayaashu, iyagoo mar la nadiifiyey, mar dambe dembiyo iskama ay garteen.
english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

kikuyu: Laakiin allabaryadaas waxaa sannad walba lagu xusuustaa dembiyo.
english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

kikuyu: Waayo, ma suurtowdo in dibiyo iyo orgiyo dhiiggoodu dembiyo qaado.
english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

kikuyu: Saas daraaddeed kolkuu Masiixu dunida soo galay wuxuu lahaa, Allabaryo iyo qurbaan ma aad doonaynin, Laakiin jidh baad ii diyaarisay.
english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

kikuyu: Waxyaalo la bixiyo oo la gubo oo dhan iyo dembi allabaryadiis kuma aad faraxsanayn.
english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

kikuyu: Markaasaan idhi, Bal eeg, waxaan u imid Inaan sameeyo doonistaada, Ilaahow. Kitaabka duudduuban wax igu saabsan baa ku qoran.
english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”

kikuyu: Siduu horay u yidhi, Allabaryo iyo qurbaan iyo waxyaalo la bixiyo oo la gubo iyo dembi allabaryadiis ma aad doonayn, kumana aad faraxsanayn, kuwaas oo loo bixiyo sida sharcigu leeyahay.
english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

kikuyu: Markaasuu yidhi, Bal eeg, waxaan u imid inaan sameeyo doonistaada. Wuxuu rujiyey kii kowaad si uu ka labaad u taago.
english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

kikuyu: Sida doonistaasu tahay, waxaa quduus laynagaga dhigay bixinta jidhka Ciise Masiix oo mar keliya la bixiyey.
english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

kikuyu: Wadaad waluba maalin kastuu istaagaa isagoo adeegaya oo marar badan bixinaya allabaryo isku mid ah, kuwa aan marnaba dembiyo qaadi karin,
english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

kikuyu: laakiin isagu kolkuu allabari keliya mar keliya dembiyo u bixiyey ayuu fadhiistay midigta Ilaah;
english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

kikuyu: isagoo markaas dabadeed sugaya ilaa cadaawayaashiisa cagihiisa hoostooda la geliyo.
english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, bixin keliya ayuu kaamil kaga dhigay weligood kuwa quduus laga dhigay.
english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

kikuyu: Oo taas Ruuxa Quduuska ahuna markhaati ahaan buu noogu sheegaa, waayo, kolkuu yidhi,
english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

kikuyu: Kanu waa axdiga aan la dhigan doono iyaga Maalmahaas dabadood, ayaa Rabbigu leeyahay; Qaynuunnadayda waxaan gelin doonaa qalbigooda, Maankoodana waan ku qori doonaa; markaasuu wuxuu ku daray;
english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

kikuyu: Oo dembiyadooda iyo xadgudubyadoodana mar dambe ma xusuusan doono.
english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

kikuyu: Markii waxyaalahan la cafiyo, wax dambe oo dembi loo bixiyaa ma jiro.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed, walaalayaalow, waxaynu haysannaa dhiirranaan inaynu meesha quduuska ah ku galno dhiigga Ciise,
english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

kikuyu: oo ah waddo cusub oo nool oo uu inooga banneeyey daaha, kaas oo ah jidhkiisa.
english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

kikuyu: Oo waxaynu haysannaa wadaad weyn oo ka sarreeya guriga Ilaah.
english: and having a great priest over God’s house,

kikuyu: Taas daraaddeed aynu ugu soo dhowaanno qalbi run ah iyo hubaal rumaysad, iyadoo qalbiyadeenna laga nadiifiyey niyo shar leh, jidhkeennana lagu maydhay biyo daahir ah.
english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

kikuyu: Aynu aad u xajinno qirashada rajadeenna liicliicashola'aan, maxaa yeelay, kan inoo ballanqaaday waa aamin.
english: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

kikuyu: Oo midkeenba midka kale ha ka fikiro si aynu isugu guubaabinno kalgacayl iyo shuqullo wanaagsan.
english: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

kikuyu: Yeynan iska daynin isku ururkeenna sida ay tahay caadada dadka qaarkood, laakiin aan isdhiirrigelinno, khusuusan markaad aragtaan inay Maalintu soo dhowaanayso.
english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

kikuyu: Haddaynu badheedh u dembaabno kolkaynu aqoonta runta helnay dabadeed, allabari dambe oo dembiyo loo bixiyaa ma hadho.
english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa u hadha filasho cabsi leh oo xukun, iyo dab kulul oo baabbi'in doona kuwa Ilaah ka geesta ah.
english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

kikuyu: Ninkii diida sharciga Muuse kolkii laba ama saddex nin ku markhaati furaan ayuu naxariisla'aan dhintaa.
english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

kikuyu: Taqsiir intee le'eg oo ka sii xun baad u malaynaysaan inuu istaahili doono kii Wiilka Ilaah ku joogjoogsaday, oo dhiigga axdiga oo isaga quduuska lagaga dhigay ku tiriyey wax aan quduus ahayn, oo caayay Ruuxa nimcada?
english: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

kikuyu: Waayo, innagu waynu naqaan kan yidhi, Aarsasho anigaa leh; oo waan abaalmarin doonaa. Mar kalena waxaa la yidhi, Rabbigu dadkiisa wuu xukumi doonaa.
english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

kikuyu: Waa wax aad cabsi u leh in lagu dhaco gacmaha Ilaaha nool.
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

kikuyu: Laakiin xusuusta maalmihii hore, kolkii laydin iftiimiyey dabadeed, oo aad u adkaysateen dagaal weyn oo xanuunno badan leh.
english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

kikuyu: Mar waxaa laydinku bandhigay cay iyo dhibaatooyin, marna waxaad wax la wadaagteen kuwa sidaas oo kale loo galay.
english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

kikuyu: Waayo, waad u naxariisateen kuwii xidhnaa, farxad baadna ku aqbasheen dhicitinka maalkiinna la dhacay, idinkoo og inaad idinka qudhiinnu maal ka wanaagsan oo raagaya haysataan.
english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed ha iska tuurina dhiirranaantiinna abaalgudka weyn leh.
english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad dulqaadasho ugu baahan tihiin si aad u qaadataan wixii laydiin ballanqaaday markaad doonista Ilaah samaysaan dabadeed.
english: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

kikuyu: Wakhti yar dabadeed Kii iman lahaa wuu iman doonaa, mana raagi doono.
english: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

kikuyu: Laakiin kayga xaqa ahu rumaysad buu ku noolaan doonaa; Oo hadduu dib u noqdo, naftaydu kuma farxi doonto isaga.
english: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

kikuyu: Innagu ma ihin kuwa halaagga dib ugu noqda, laakiin waxaynu nahay kuwa rumaysad leh si naftu u badbaaddo.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

kikuyu: Rumaysadku waa hubaasha waxyaalaha la rajeeyo, iyo xaqiiqaynta waxyaalaha aan la arkin.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

kikuyu: Waayo, saasaa loogu markhaati furay waayeelladii.
english: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

kikuyu: Rumaysad ayaynu ku garanaynaa in duniyooyinka lagu abuuray erayga Ilaah, sidaas daraaddeed waxa la arko lagama samayn waxa muuqda.
english: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

kikuyu: Haabiil rumaysad ayuu Ilaah ugu bixiyey allabari aad uga wanaagsan kii Qaabiil, sidaas daraaddeed waxaa loogu markhaati furay inuu xaq yahay, Ilaahna waa ka markhaati furay hadiyadihiisii. Saas daraaddeed isagoo dhintay ayuu weli hadlaa.
english: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

kikuyu: Enoog rumaysad baa kor loogu qaaday si uusan dhimasho u arag, lamana helin, maxaa yeelay, Ilaah baa isagii qaaday, waayo, intaan kor loo qaadin ka hor ayaa markhaati loo furay inuu Ilaah ka farxiyey.
english: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

kikuyu: Oo rumaysadla'aantiis ma suurtowdo in isaga laga farxiyo, taas aawadeed kan Ilaah u yimaadaa waa inuu rumaysto inuu jiro oo uu yahay kan u abaalguda kuwa isaga doondoona.
english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

kikuyu: Nuux oo Ilaah uga digay waxyaalo aan weli la arkin ayaa cabsaday, oo rumaysad buu ku diyaariyey doonni in reerkiisu ku badbaado, sidaasuu dunida u xukumay oo ku noqday mid dhaxla xaqnimada rumaysadka ku timaada.
english: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

kikuyu: Ibraahim kolkii loo yeedhay, rumaysad buu ku addeecay inuu tago meeshuu ku heli lahaa dhaxalka, wuuna tegey isagoo aan garanaynin meeshuu ku socdo.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

kikuyu: Rumaysad buu ku degganaa dhulkii loo ballanqaaday sidii dhul qalaad, wuxuuna taambuugyo la degganaa Isxaaq iyo Yacquub oo ahaa kuwii la dhaxlay isku ballan.
english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

kikuyu: Waayo, wuxuu filanayay magaalo aasaas leh oo kan dhisay oo sameeyey uu Ilaah yahay.
english: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

kikuyu: Saarah qudheedu rumaysad bay ku heshay xoog ay ku uuraysato, oo iyadoo dhaaftay wakhtigii dhalmada ayay dhashay, waayo, waxay ku tirisay ku aamin ah kii u ballanqaaday.
english: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeedna waxaa mid sidii nin dhintay oo kale ah ka dhashay dad u badan sida xiddigaha cirka iyo sida cammuudda badda xeebteeda taal oo aan la tirin karin.
english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

kikuyu: Kuwaasu kulligood rumaysad bay ku wada dhinteen, iyagoo aan helin waxyaalihii loo ballanqaaday, laakiin meel fog bay ka arkeen oo way aqbaleen, oo waxay qirteen inay dhulka ku ahaayeen shisheeyayaal iyo dad sodcaal ah.
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

kikuyu: Waayo, kuwa waxyaalahan oo kale yidhaahdaa waxay muujiyaan inay doondoonayaan waddan kooda ah.
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

kikuyu: Oo hadday xusuusnaayeen waddankii ay ka baxeen way heli lahaayeen wakhti ay ku noqdaan.
english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

kikuyu: Laakiin imminka waxay aad u doonayaan waddan ka wanaagsan oo ah jannada, sidaas daraaddeed Ilaah ka xishoon maayo in loogu yeedho Ilaahood, waayo, wuxuu iyaga u diyaariyey magaalo.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

kikuyu: Ibraahim kolkii la jirrabay, rumaysad buu Isxaaq allabari ahaan ugu bixiyey. Kii ballamada aqbalay ayaa wuxuu bixinayay wiilkiisii keliyaha,
english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

kikuyu: in kastoo lagu yidhi, Kuwa Isxaaq ka farcama ayaa farcankaaga loogu yeedhi doonaa.
english: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

kikuyu: Wuxuu ku tirinayay in Ilaah ka kicin karo xataa kuwii dhintay; oo sida masaal oo kale ayuu isagii uga helay kuwii dhintay.
english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

kikuyu: Isxaaq rumaysad buu ugu duceeyey Yacquub iyo Ceesaw xagga waxyaalaha iman doona.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

kikuyu: Yacquubna markuu dhimanayay rumaysad buu ugu duceeyey mid kasta oo wiilashii Yuusuf ka mid ah, oo Ilaahna wuu caabuday isagoo cuskanaya ushiisa guudkeeda.
english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

kikuyu: Yuusufna markii dhimashadiisii dhowayd rumaysad buu kaga hadlay bixitinka reer binu Israa'iil, wuxuuna ka dardaarmay lafihiisa.
english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

kikuyu: Muusena markuu dhashay, waalidkiis rumaysad bay ku qariyeen saddex bilood, maxaa yeelay, waxay arkeen inuu ilmo wanaagsan yahay, kamana ay cabsan amarkii boqorka.
english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

kikuyu: Muuse markuu weynaaday rumaysad buu ku diiday in loogu yeedho wiilkii gabadha Fircoon.
english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ka doortay in lala silciyo dadkii Ilaah intuu wakhti yar dembi ku farxi lahaa;
english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

kikuyu: isagoo ku tirinaya cayda lagu caayo Masiixa aawadiis inay ka qiimo weyn tahay maalka Masar, waayo, wuxuu filanayay abaalgudka.
english: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

kikuyu: Rumaysad buu kaga tegey Masar isagoo aan ka cabsanayn boqorka cadhadiisii, waayo, wuxuu u adkaystay sidii mid fiirinaya kan aan la arkin.
english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

kikuyu: Rumaysad buu ku sameeyey Kormaridda iyo dhiigga rushayntiisii inuusan Baabbi'iyihii curadyadu iyaga taaban.
english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

kikuyu: Rumaysad bay ku dhex mareen Badda Cas sidii dhul engegan, laakiin markay Masriyiintu saas isku dayeen, way liqday.
english: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

kikuyu: Derbiyadii Yerixoo rumaysad bay ku dumeen kolkii toddoba maalmood lagu warwareegay dabadeed.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

kikuyu: Dhilladii Raxab rumaysadkeedii aawadiis lama ay halligmin kuwii caasiyiinta ahaa, maxaa yeelay, basaasyadii bay nabad ku dhowaysay.
english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

kikuyu: Oo maxaan kale oo idhaahdaa? Waayo, wakhtigu waa igu gaabnaan doonaa haddaan wax ka sheegi lahaa Gidcoon, iyo Baaraaq, iyo Samsoon, iyo Yeftaah, iyo Daa'uud, iyo Samuu'eel iyo nebiyadii.
english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

kikuyu: Rumaysad bay kaga adkaadeen boqortooyooyin, oo xaqnimo ku sameeyeen, oo ballamo ku heleen, oo afafka libaaxyada ku xidheen,
english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

kikuyu: oo xooggii dabka ku demiyeen, oo seefta afkeedii kaga baxsadeen, oo itaaldarradii kaga xoogaysteen, oo dagaal ku itaal weynaadeen, oo colalkii shisheeyaha ku eryeen.
english: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

kikuyu: Dumar baa waxay heleen kuwii ka dhintay iyagoo la sara kiciyey, qaar kalena waa la xanuujiyey ilaa ay ka dhinteen iyagoo aan aqbalin in la samatabbixiyo si ay ku gaadhaan sarakicid ka wanaagsan.
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

kikuyu: Qaar kalena waxay jirrabaad ahaan ula kulmeen majaajilo iyo karbaashid iyo weliba silsilado iyo xabbis.
english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

kikuyu: Waana la dhagxiyey, miinshaarna waa lagu kala jeexay, waana la jirrabay, seefna waa lagu gowracay, wayna warwareegeen iyagoo qaba hargo idaad iyo hargo riyood, iyagoo caydh ah oo la dhibay oo la silciyey.
english: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

kikuyu: Dunidu ma ay istaahilin iyagii. Waxayna warwareegi jireen lamadegaanka iyo buuraha iyo boholaha iyo godadka dhulka.
english: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

kikuyu: Kuwaas oo dhammu, iyagoo loo markhaati furay rumaysadkoodii daraaddiis, ayaanay helin wixii loo ballanqaaday;
english: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

kikuyu: waayo, Ilaah wuxuu hore u arkay wax ka wanaagsan oo inagu saabsan, inaan la'aanteen iyaga kaamil laga dhigin.
english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, innagoo haysanna markhaatiyaal badan oo sida daruur u weyn oo inagu wareegsan, aynu iska dhigno culays kasta iyo dembiga dhibyaraanta inoogu dhegaya, oo aynu adkaysasho ku orodno tartanka ina hor yaal,
english: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

kikuyu: innagoo fiirinayna Ciise oo ah Bilaabaha iyo Dhammeeyaha rumaysadkeenna, kii farxaddii hor tiil daraaddeed u adkaystay iskutallaabta, isagoo fududaysanaya ceebta, oo fadhiistay midigta carshiga Ilaah.
english: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

kikuyu: Haddaba ka fiirsada kii u adkaystay hadalkii ka geesta ahaa oo dembilayaasha inaydnaan daalin oo aanay nafihiinnu itaal beelin.
english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

kikuyu: Idinkoo dembi la dagaallamaya weli iskama aydnaan celin ilaa dhiig idinka daato.
english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

kikuyu: Waxaad illowdeen waanada idiinla hadasha sida wiilal oo kale. Wiilkaygiiyow, ha fududaysan Rabbiga edbintiisa, Hana itaal beelin kolkuu ku canaanto.
english: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

kikuyu: Waayo, ka uu Rabbigu jecel yahay ayuu edbiyaa, Wuuna karbaashaa wiil kasta oo uu aqbalo.
english: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

kikuyu: U adkaysta edbinta. Ilaah wuxuu idiinla macaamiloodaa sida wiilal oo kale; waayo, waa wiilkee kan aanu aabbihii edbin?
english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaan laydinku edbin edbinta laga wada qayb galo, haddaba waxaad tihiin garacyo, oo wiilashiisii ma ihidin.
english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

kikuyu: Oo weliba waxaynu lahayn aabbayaal xagga jidhka ah, oo ina edbiyey, oo waynu maamuusnay. Miyaynan intaas in ka badan ka dambaynayn Aabbaha ruuxyada oo aynaan noolaannayn?
english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu dhawr maalmood ayay inoo edbiyeen sidii la wanaagsanayd, laakiin isagu wuxuu inoo edbiya si inoo faa'iido ah si aynu uga qayb galno quduusnimadiisa.
english: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

kikuyu: Edbinina wakhtiga la joogo uma eka mid lagu farxo, laakiin waxay u eg tahay mid caloolxumo leh, laakiin dabadeedto waxay kuwii lagu edbiyey u dhashaa midho nabad iyo xaqnimo ah.
english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed xoogeeya gacmaha taagta daran iyo jilbaha tabarta yar.
english: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

kikuyu: Cagihiinnana waddooyin toosan u sameeya si aan curyaanku u murkacan laakiin u bogsado.
english: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

kikuyu: Nabad kula dadaala dadka oo dhan, iyo quduusnaanta aan la'aanteed ninna Rabbiga arki doonin.
english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

kikuyu: Fiiro u yeesha si aan ninna u gaadhi waayin nimcada Ilaah, waaba intaasoo xidid qadhaadhi soo baxaa oo idin dhibaa, oo qaar badanu ku nijaasoobaane,
english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

kikuyu: si aan dhillay u jirin ama qof cibaado la' sidii Ceesaw oo ahaa kii curadnimadiisii kala baxay waxoogaa cunto ah.
english: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

kikuyu: Waayo, waad og tihiin, xataa kolkuu dabadeedto jeclaaday inuu dhaxlo barakada, in loo diiday, in kastoo uu doondoonay, isagoo ilmo daadinaya, waayo, ma uu helin meel uu ka soo noqdo.
english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

kikuyu: Waayo, ma aydnaan iman buurtii la taaban karay, oo ololaysay, iyo madowgii, iyo gudcurkii, iyo duufaankii,
english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

kikuyu: iyo dhawaaqii buunka, iyo codkii erayada, oo ahaa codkii ay kuwii maqlay Muuse ka baryeen inaan eray dambe lagula hadlin.
english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

kikuyu: Waayo, uma ay adkaysan karin wixii lagu amray, markii lagu yidhi, Xataa haddii neef buurta taabto, waa la dhagxin doonaa.
english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.

kikuyu: Muuqashadiina cabsi intay ka qabtay Muuse wuxuu yidhi, Aad iyo aad baan u cabsanayaa oo waan gariirayaa.
english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

kikuyu: Laakiin idinku waxaad timaadeen Buur Siyoon iyo magaaladii Ilaaha nool oo ah Yeruusaalemtii jannada, oo waxaad u timaadeen guutooyin malaa'igo ah oo isu soo ururay,
english: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

kikuyu: iyo kiniisadda curadyada oo ku qoran jannada, iyo Ilaaha ah Xaakinka wax kasta, iyo ruuxyada kuwa qumman oo la kaamilay,
english: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

kikuyu: iyo Ciise oo ah dhexdhexaadiyaha axdiga cusub, iyo dhiigga rushaynta oo u hadla si ka wanaagsan kii Haabiil.
english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

kikuyu: Digtoonaada si aydnaan u diidin kan hadlaya; waayo, haddayan baxsan kuwii diiday kii dhulka ku waaniyey, si ka badan innaguna ma baxsan doonno haddaynu ka jeesanno kan jannada ka hadlaya,
english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

kikuyu: kan codkiisii wakhtigaas gariiriyey dhulka; laakiin hadda wuu ballanqaaday isagoo leh, Weliba mar kale ayaan gariirin doonaa dhulka, dhulka oo keliyana ma aha ee xataa samadana waan gariirin doonaa.
english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

kikuyu: Erayadii ahaa, Weliba mar kale, micnehoodu waxaa weeye in la qaadi doono waxyaalihii la gariiriyey sidii waxyaalo la sameeyey, si waxyaalihii aan la gariirinu u hadhaan.
english: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed innagoo helayna boqortooyo aan la gariirin karin, aynu mahadnaqno si aynu Ilaah uga farxinno innagoo cibaado iyo cabsi ugu adeegayna;
english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

kikuyu: waayo, Ilaaheennu waa dab wax baabbi'iya.
english: for our God is a consuming fire.

kikuyu: Jacaylka walaalnimadu ha sii jiro.
english: Let brotherly love continue.

kikuyu: Ha illoobina inaad shisheeyaha marti qaaddaan, waayo, sidaas qaar baa malaa'igo u marti qaaday iyagoo aan ogayn.
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

kikuyu: U xusuusta kuwa xidhan sidii idinkoo iyaga la xidhan, iyo kuwa la silciyey sidii idinkoo isku jidh ah.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

kikuyu: Guurka hala wada maamuuso, oo sariirtuna yeynan nijaasoobin, maxaa yeelay, khaniisiinta iyo dhillayadaba Ilaah waa xukumi doonaa.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

kikuyu: Dabiicaddiinnu ha ahaato mid aan lacag jeclayn, oo waxaad haysataan raalli ku ahaada, waayo, isaga qudhiisu wuxuu yidhi, Sinaba kuu dayn maayo, oo sinaba kuu dayrin maayo.
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed innagoo ku kalsoon waxaynu nidhaahnaa, Rabbigu waa kaalmeeyahayga, oo anigu cabsan maayo; Bal maxaa dad igu samayn doonaa?
english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

kikuyu: Xusuusta hoggaamiyayaashiinna idiin sheegay ereyga Ilaah. Oo ka fiirsada waxa ka yimaada asluubtoodii, oo iimaankoodii ku dayda.
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

kikuyu: Ciise Masiix waa isku mid shalay iyo maanta iyo weligiiba.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

kikuyu: Waxbaridda kala duwan oo qalaadu yay idinla tegin, waayo, waa wanaagsan tahay in qalbigu nimco ku taagnaado ee uusan ku taagnaan cunto, tan kuwa ku macaamilooday aanay ku faa'iidin.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

kikuyu: Waxaynu leennahay meel allabari, oo kuwa taambuugga ka adeega aanay amar u lahayn inay wax ka cunaan.
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

kikuyu: Waayo, neefafka dhiiggooda wadaadka sare keeno meesha quduuska ah dembiga aawadiis jidhadhkooda waxaa lagu gubaa xerada dibaddeeda.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed Ciisena si uu dadka quduus ugaga dhigo dhiiggiisa wuxuu ku xanuunsaday iridda dibaddeeda.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

kikuyu: Haddaba aynu isaga ugu tagno xerada dibaddeeda, innagoo qaadayna caydii la caayay isaga.
english: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

kikuyu: Waayo, innagu halkan kuma lihin magaalo sii raagaysa, laakiin waxaynu doondoonaynaa tan iman doonta.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

kikuyu: Haddaba xaggiisa aynu had iyo goor Ilaah ugu bixinno allabariga ammaanta, kaas waxaa weeye dibnaha magiciisa qirta midhahooda.
english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

kikuyu: Laakiinse inaad wax wanaagsan fashaan oo wax wada wadaagtaan ha illoobina; waayo, allabaryada caynkaas ah Ilaah aad buu ugu farxaa.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

kikuyu: Hoggaamiyayaashiinna addeeca oo ka dambeeya, waayo, iyagu waxay ilaaliyaan naftiinna sidii iyagoo jawaab ka bixin doona. Taas farxad ha ku sameeyeen, oo yaanay qulubsanaan, waayo, taasu waxba idiin tari mayso.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

kikuyu: Noo soo duceeya; waayo, waxaannu hubnaa inaannu leennahay niyo wanaagsan annagoo doonayna inaannu wax kasta si qumman ugu soconno.
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

kikuyu: Oo aad baan idiinka baryayaa inaad tan samaysaan, in dhaqso laygu soo kiin celiyo.
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ilaaha nabadda oo ka soo celiyey kuwii dhintay Rabbigeenna Ciise oo ah Adhijirka weyn ee idaha, oo ku soo celiyey dhiigga axdiga weligiis ah,
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

kikuyu: kaamil ha idinkaga dhigo wax kasta oo wanaagsan si aad u samaysaan doonistiisa, oo waxa isaga ka farxiya ha inooga dhex shaqeeyo Ciise Masiix, kan ammaanta leh weligiis iyo weligiis. Aamiin.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, waxaan idinka baryayaa inaad u dulqaadataan hadalka waanada ah, waayo, waxaan idiin soo qoray dhawr eray.
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

kikuyu: Ogaada in walaalkeen Timoteyos la sii daayay, kan hadduu dhaqso u yimaado, aannu idin soo wada arki doonno.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

kikuyu: Igu salaama kuwa idin hoggaamiya oo dhan, iyo quduusiinta oo dhan. Kuwa Itaaliya ka yimaadaa way idin soo salaamayaan.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

kikuyu: Nimco ha idinla jirto kulligiin. Aamiin.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Yacquub, oo ah addoonkii Ilaah iyo Rabbi Ciise Masiix, wuxuu salaan gaadhsiinayaa laba iyo tobanka qolo oo kala firidhsan.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

kikuyu: Walaalahayow, kolkaad jirrabaaddo kala cayncayn ah kala kulantaan, kulli farxad u tirsada,
english: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

kikuyu: idinkoo og tijaabinta rumaysadkiinnu inay dulqaadasho keento.
english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

kikuyu: Oo dulqaadashadu ha dhammayso shuqulkeeda si aad kaamil u ahaataan oo aad u dhanaataan, oo aydnaan waxba ugu baahnaan.
english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii midkiin xigmad u baahan yahay, ha ka baryo Ilaah, kan kulli si deeqsinimo ah u siiya isagoo aan canaanan, oo waa la siin doonaaye.
english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

kikuyu: Laakiin rumaysad ha ku baryo, isagoo aan shakiyayn, waayo, kii shakiyaa wuxuu la mid yahay hirka badda oo dabayshu kaxayso oo rogrogto.
english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

kikuyu: Ninkaasu yuusan u malayn inuu Rabbiga wax ka heli doono.
english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

kikuyu: Labaqalbiiluhu wuu ka rogrogmadaa socodkiisa oo dhan.
english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

kikuyu: Walaalkii hooseeyaa ha ku faano sarraysiintiisa,
english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

kikuyu: kii taajir ahuna ha ku faano hoosaysiintiisa, waayo, wuxuu u idlaan doonaa sida ubaxa cawska.
english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

kikuyu: Qorraxdu waxay la soo baxdaa kulaylka, wayna engejisaa cawska, oo ubaxiisuna wuu daataa, quruxda midabkiisuna way ka luntaa; sidaas oo kale ayaa taajirku ugu lumi doonaa socodkiisa.
english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ninka jirrabaadda u sii adkaysta, waayo, goortii loo bogo, wuxuu heli doonaa taajka nolosha kan Ilaah u ballanqaaday kuwa isaga jecel.
english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

kikuyu: Midna yuu odhanin kolkii la jirrabo, Xagga Ilaah baa layga jirrabay. Waayo, Ilaah laguma jirrabo shar, isaguna midna ma jirrabo.
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

kikuyu: Mid kasta waxaa jirraba damaciisa sharka ah isagoo la jiidanayo oo la sasabayo.
english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

kikuyu: Dabadeed damacu kolkuu uuraysto wuxuu dhalaa dembi, dembiguna kolkuu weynaado wuxuu keenaa dhimasho.
english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

kikuyu: Yaan laydin khiyaanayn, walaalahayga aan jeclahayow.
english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

kikuyu: Hadiyad kasta oo wanaagsan iyo hibo kasta oo kaamil ah kor bay ka timaadaa iyadoo ka soo degaysa xagga Aabbaha nuurarka isagoo aan lahayn rogrogmad ama hoos laallaabasho.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

kikuyu: Isagoo doonaya ayuu hadalka runta ah inagu dhalay si aynu u noqonno midhaha ugu horreeya oo uunkiisa.
english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

kikuyu: Waad garanaysaan tan, walaalahayga aan jeclahayow. Laakiin nin walba ha u dhaqsado maqlinta, oo ha u gaabiyo hadalka, cadhadana ha u gaabiyo;
english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

kikuyu: waayo, dad cadhadiisu ma keento xaqnimada Ilaah.
english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed iska fogeeya wasakhnimada oo dhan iyo badnaanta xumaanta; oo qabownimo ku qaata hadalka laydinku tallaalay, kan naftiinna badbaadin kara.
english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

kikuyu: Noqda kuwa hadalka yeela, oo ha ahaanina kuwa maqla oo keliya oo nafsaddooda khiyaaneeya.
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii mid yahay kan hadalka maqla oo keliya, oo uusan ahayn kan yeela, wuxuu la mid yahay nin wejiga abuuristiisa muraayad ku fiirinaya.
english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

kikuyu: Waayo, wuu isfiiriyaa, oo iska tagaa, oo markiiba is-illoobaa siduu ahaa.
english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

kikuyu: Laakiin kii fiiriya sharciga kaamilka iyo xorriyadda ah oo ku sii socda, isagoo aan ahayn kan maqla oo illooba laakiin kan shuqulka yeela, kaasu waa ku barakaysnaan doonaa yeeliddiisa.
english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

kikuyu: Haddii mid isu maleeyo inuu cibaado badan yahay, oo uusan afkiisa xakamayn, laakiin uu qalbigiisa khiyaaneeyo, kaas cibaadadiisu waa wax aan waxtar lahayn.
english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

kikuyu: Cibaado daahir ah oo aan nijaas lahayn Ilaaha Aabbaha ah hortiisa waxay tahay in la xannaaneeyo agoonta iyo carmallada markay dhib ku jiraan, iyo in layska dhawro wasakhda dunida.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

kikuyu: Walaalahayow, iimaanka Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix kan ammaanta leh eexasho ha ku haysanina.
english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

kikuyu: Haddii nin kaatun dahab ah iyo dhar quruxsan qabaa shirkiinna soo galo, oo haddana haddii nin kale oo miskiin ah oo dhar uskag leh qabaa soo galo,
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

kikuyu: oo aad fiirisaan ka dharka quruxdasan qaba oo aad ku tidhaahdaan, Adigu kaalay oo halkan wanaagsan fadhiiso, oo aad ku tidhaahdaan ka miskiinka ah, Adigu xaggaas istaag ama halkan cagahayga ag fadhiiso,
english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

kikuyu: miyeydnaan kala qaybsamin oo miyeydnaan noqonin kuwa fikirrada sharka leh wax ku xukuma?
english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

kikuyu: I dhegaysta, walaalahayga aan jeclahayow. Miyaan Ilaah u dooran kuwa ah masaakiinta xagga dunida inay ahaadaan kuwa hodan ku ah rumaysadka oo dhaxla boqortooyaduu u ballanqaaday kuwa isaga jecel?
english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

kikuyu: Laakiin idinku waad maamuus jebiseen miskiinkii. Taajiriintu miyaanay idin dulmin oo miyaanay idiin jiidin maxkamadda?
english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

kikuyu: Miyaanay caayin magaca wanaagsan oo laydiinku yeedhay?
english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaad oofisaan sharciga boqornimada siduu Qorniinku leeyahay, Waa inaad deriskaaga u jeclaataa sida naftaada, si wanaagsan baad yeeshaan.
english: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaad dadka u kala eexataan waad dembaabtaan, oo sharcigu wuu idinku caddeeyey inaad tihiin kuwa xadgudbay.
english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii sharciga oo dhan xajiya oo qaynuun keliya ku gafa, kulli wuu ku eedaysan yahay.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii yidhi, Ha sinaysan; wuxuu kaloo yidhi, Cidna ha dilin. Haddaanad sinaysanin laakiin aad dad disho, waxaad noqotay ku sharciga ku xadgudbay.
english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

kikuyu: Sidii kuwo sharciga xorriyadda lagu xukumi doono, u hadla oo u yeela.
english: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

kikuyu: Xukunku naxariis uma leh kii aan dadka u naxariisan; naxariistu way ka faantaa xukunka.
english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

kikuyu: Maxay tartaa, walaalahayow, haddii nin yidhaahdo, Rumaysad baan leeyahay, laakiin aanu shuqullo lahayn? Rumaysadku ma badbaadin karaa isaga?
english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

kikuyu: Walaal wiil ah ama walaal gabadh ah hadday arradan yihiin oo cuntadii maalinta u baahan yihiin,
english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

kikuyu: oo midkiin ku yidhaahdo iyaga, Nabad gala, diirsada oo dherga, oo weliba aydnaan siin waxa jidhku u baahan yahay, maxay tartaa?
english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas oo kale rumaysadku haddaanu shuqullo lahayn keli ahaantiisu waa meyd.
english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaa la odhan doonaa, Adigu waxaad leedahay rumaysad, anna waxaan leeyahay shuqullo. I tus rumaysadkaaga aan shuqullada lahayn, anna rumaysadkayga shuqulladaydaan kugu tusi doonaa.
english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

kikuyu: Waad rumaysan tahay in Ilaah yahay mid keliya. Taas waad ku wanaagsan tahay. Xataa jinniyaduna sidaas way rumaysan yihiin, wayna gariiraan.
english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

kikuyu: Doqonow, ma doonaysaa inaad garatid in rumaysadka aan shuqullada lahaynu aanu waxba tarin?
english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

kikuyu: Miyaan awowgeen Ibraahim shuqullo lagu caddaynin inuu xaq yahay goortuu wiilkiisii Isxaaq meeshii allabariga ku bixiyey?
english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

kikuyu: Waad garanaysaa in rumaysadku shuqulladiisii la shaqeeyey, oo rumaysadku kaamil ku noqday shuqullada.
english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

kikuyu: Waxaa rumoobay Qorniinka leh, Ibraahimna Ilaah buu rumaystay, oo waxaa isaga loogu tiriyey xaqnimo, oo waxaa loogu yeedhay saaxiibkii Ilaah.
english: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.

kikuyu: Waxaad garanaysaan in nin shuqullo lagu caddeeyo inuu xaq yahay oo aan lagu caddayn rumaysadka oo keliya.
english: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kale miyaan dhilladii Raxab ahayd shuqullo lagu caddayn inay xaq tahay kolkay soo dhowaysay basaasyadii oo ay jid kale u dirtay?
english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

kikuyu: Sida jidhkii aan ruux lahaynu meyd u yahay, sidaas oo kaluu rumaysadkii aan shuqullo lahaynuna meyd u yahay.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

kikuyu: Macallimiin badan ha noqonina, walaalahayow, idinkoo garanaya inaynu heli doonno xukun ka sii weyn.
english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

kikuyu: Waayo, dhammaanteen wax badan baynu ku gafnaa. Haddii nin ku gafi waayo hadalka, kaasu waa nin kaamil ah, wuuna xakamayn karaa jidhka oo dhan.
english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

kikuyu: Haddaba haddaynu fardaha afkooda xakame gelinno inay ina addeecaan, jidhkooda oo dhanna waynu jeedinnaa.
english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

kikuyu: Ogaada, xataa doonniyaha, in kastoo ay waaweyn yihiin, oo dabaylo waaweynu kaxeeyaan, weliba waxaa loogu jeediyaa shukaan aad u yar meeshii ninka wada qushigiisu doonayo.
english: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena carrabku waa qayb yar, waxyaalo waaweyn buuna ku faanaa. Bal eega dab yaru intuu qoryo shido.
english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

kikuyu: Carrabkuna waa dab, waana dunida xaqdarrada. Carrabku wuxuu ku dhex jiraa xubnaheenna, waana kan wasakheeya jidhka oo dhan oo ololiya orodka abuurista, oo jahannamadu isagay ololisaa.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

kikuyu: Cayn walba oo ah dugaag, iyo haad, iyo waxa bogga ku gurguurta, iyo waxa badda ku jiraba waa la rabbeeyaa, oo waxaa lagu rabbeeyey dabiicadda dadka.
english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

kikuyu: Laakiin ninna ma rabbayn karo carrabka; waa shar rogrogmada, oo waxaa ka buuxda sunta wax disha.
english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

kikuyu: Isla isagaynu ku ammaannaa Rabbiga iyo Aabbaha, oo isla isagaynu ku habaarnaa dadka Ilaah ekaantiisa laga abuuray.
english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

kikuyu: Isku af baa waxaa ka soo baxa ammaan iyo habaar. Walaalahayow, waxyaalahanu waa inaanay sidaas noqon.
english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

kikuyu: Ishu miyey isku meel ka soo wada daysaa biyo macaan iyo kuwa qadhaadh?
english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

kikuyu: Walaalahayow, geed berde ahu miyuu dhali karaa saytuun, ama geed canab ahu miyuu dhali karaa midho berde ah? Sidaas oo kalena biyo dhanaanu macaan ma ay noqon karaan.
english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

kikuyu: Kumaa idinku dhex jira oo xigmad iyo waxgarasho leh? Shuqulladiisa ha ku muujiyo dabiicaddiisa wanaagsan, isagoo leh qabowga xigmadda.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

kikuyu: Haddaad xaasidnimo qadhaadh iyo iskala qaybqaybin ku haysataan qalbigiinna, ha faanina, runtana been ha ka sheegina.
english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

kikuyu: Xigmaddaasu ma aha tan kor ka soo degta, laakiin waa tan dhulka iyo nafta iyo jinniyada.
english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

kikuyu: Waayo, meeshii xaasidnimo iyo iskala qaybqaybinu ku jiraan, meeshaas waxaa ku jira iskuqasnaan iyo falniin kasta oo shar leh.
english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

kikuyu: Laakiin xigmaddii kor ka timaadaa horta waa daahir, dabadeedna waa nabad iyo qabow iyo mid si dhib yar loola heshiiyo, oo waxaa ka buuxa naxariis iyo midho wanaagsan, mana leh u-kala-eexasho ama labaweji.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Midhaha xaqnimada nabad waa loogu beeraa kuwa nabadda ka shaqeeya.
english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

kikuyu: Dagaallada iyo dirirta idinku dhex jira xaggee bay ka yimaadaan? Miyaanay ka imanin damacyadiinna ku dhex dagaallamaya xubnihiinna?
english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

kikuyu: Waad damacdaan, mana lihidin; waad dishaan, waadna xaasiddaan, mana heli kartaan; waad dirirtaan, waadna dagaallantaan, mana lihidin, waayo, ma aad weyddiisataan.
english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

kikuyu: Waad weyddiisataan, mana heshaan, waayo, si xun baad u weyddiisataan inaad ku bixisaan damacyadiinna aawadood.
english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

kikuyu: Dhillayo iyo dhillooyin yahow, miyeydnaan garanayn inay saaxiibnimada dunidu Ilaah la col tahay? Sidaas daraaddeed kii kasta oo doonaya inuu saaxiib la ahaado dunida, Ilaah buu la col noqdaa.
english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

kikuyu: Mise waxaad u malaynaysaan in Qorniinku micnela'aan ku hadlo, Ruuxa uu ka dhigay inuu ina dhex joogo ayaa aad iyo aad inoo jecel isagoo inoo masayra?
english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

kikuyu: Laakiin isagu wuxuu bixiyaa nimco badan oo badan. Haddaba Qorniinku wuxuu leeyahay, Ilaah waa hor joogsadaa kuwa kibra, laakiin kuwa is-hoosaysiiya ayuu nimco siiyaa.
english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

kikuyu: Haddaba Ilaah ka dambeeya, laakiin Ibliiska hor joogsada, wuu idinka carari doonaaye.
english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

kikuyu: U soo dhowaada Ilaah, isaguna wuu idiin soo dhowaan doonaa. Dembilayaashow, gacmihiinna nadiifiya. Labaqalbiilayaashow, qalbiyadiinna daahiriya.
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

kikuyu: Dhibtooda oo baroorta oo ooya. Qosolkiinnu baroor ha u rogmado, farxaddiinnuna caloolxumo.
english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

kikuyu: Is-hoosaysiiya Rabbiga hortiisa, isna wuu idin sarraysiin doonaa.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

kikuyu: Xumaan ha iskaga hadlina, walaalayaalow. Kii xumaan walaalkiis kaga hadlaa ama walaalkiis xukumaa, sharciga ayuu xumaan kaga hadlaa, sharcigana wuu xukumaa. Haddaad sharciga xukuntid, adigu ma ihid mid sharciga yeela, laakiin waxaad tahay mid isaga xukuma.
english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

kikuyu: Waa mid keliya kan sharciga bixiyaa oo wax xukumaa, oo waa kan kara inuu wax badbaadiyo oo uu wax dumiyo. Laakiin adigu yaad tahay, kan deriskiisa xukumow?
english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

kikuyu: Bal kaalaya hadda, kuwiinnan yidhaahda, Maanta ama berri waxaannu tegi doonaa magaalo, oo halkaasaannu sannad joogi doonnaa, waannu baayacmushtari doonnaa oo faa'iidaysan doonnaa,
english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

kikuyu: kuwiinnan aan garanaynin waxa berri dhici doona. Noloshiinnu waa maxay? Waayo, idinku waxaad tihiin ceeryaamo, tan wakhti yar muuqata dabadeedna libidha.
english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

kikuyu: Waa inaad tidhaahdaan, Haddii Rabbigu doonayo, waannu noolaan doonnaa oo waxaannu samayn doonnaa tan ama taas.
english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

kikuyu: Laakiin idinku haatan waxaad ku faanaysaan isla weynaantiinna. Faanka caynkaas ah oo dhammu waa shar.
english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

kikuyu: Haddaba kii garanaya inuu wax wanaagsan sameeyo laakiin aan samayn, dembi bay u tahay isaga.
english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

kikuyu: Bal kaalaya hadda, kuwiinnan taajiriinta ahow, ooya oo ka baroorta dhibaatooyinka idinku soo degaya.
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

kikuyu: Duunyadiinnii way qudhuntay, dharkiinniina aboor baa cunay.
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

kikuyu: Dahabkiinnii iyo lacagtiinniiba way mirdheen, miridhkooduna markhaati buu idinku noqon doonaa, wuxuuna jidhkiinna u cuni doonaa sida dabka oo kale. Maal baad u urursateen maalmaha ugu dambeeya.
english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

kikuyu: Shaqaalayaashii beerihiinnii idiin gooyay mushahaaradoodii aad dulmiga uga reebateen way dhawaaqaysaa, qaylooyinkii kuwii beerihii gooyayna waxay galeen dhegaha Rabbiga Saba'ood.
english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

kikuyu: Dhulkaad ku barwaaqaysateen, waadna ku raaxaysateen, oo qalbiyadiinnii waxaad u naaxiseen maalinta gowracidda.
