english: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

kikuyu: Waad xukunteen, waadna disheen kan xaqa ah. Isaguna isma kiin hor taago.
english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

kikuyu: Haddaba, walaalayaalow, dulqaata ilaa imaatinka Rabbiga. Bal ogaada, ninka beerrey ahu wuxuu sugaa midhaha qiimaha leh ee dhulka, isagoo u dulqaata ilaa uu helo roobka hore iyo kan dambe.
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

kikuyu: Idinkuna dulqaata, qalbiyadiinnana xoogeeya, waayo, imaatinka Rabbigu wuu dhow yahay.
english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

kikuyu: Ha iska cabanina, walaalayaalow, yaan laydin xukumine. Bal ogaada, xaakinku albaabbada hortooduu taagan yahaye.
english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, u qaata tilmaan dhibaato iyo dulqaadasho ah nebiyadii ku hadlay magaca Rabbiga.
english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

kikuyu: Bal ogaada! Waxaynu ugu yeedhnaa kuwo barakaysan kuwii adkaystay. Waad maqasheen adkaysashadii Ayuub, waadna aragteen dhammaadkii qasdiga Rabbiga, waayo, Rabbigu waa raxmad badan yahay, naxariisna wuu leeyahay.
english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

kikuyu: Laakiin wax walba hortood, walaalahayow, ha dhaaranina; ha ku dhaaranina jannada, ama dhulka, ama dhaar kale; haahdiinnu haah ha ahaato, mayadiinnuna maya ha ahaato, yeydnan ku dhicin xukun hoostiis.
english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Mid dhibaataysanu ma idinku dhex jiraa? Ha ducaysto. Mid faraxsanu ma jiraa? Ha gabyo.
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

kikuyu: Mid bukaa ma idinku dhex jiraa? Ha u yeedho waayeellada kiniisadda, oo iyagu ha u duceeyeen, oo saliid ha ku mariyeen magaca Rabbiga.
english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

kikuyu: Ducadii rumaysad lahu way bogsiin doontaa kii buka, oo Rabbigu waa sara kicin doonaa, oo hadduu dembaabay waa loo dembidhaafi doonaa.
english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Midkiinba midka kale dembiyadiisa ha u qirto oo ha u duceeyo si aad u bogsataan. Nin xaq ah baryadiisa shaqaysa wax badan bay kartaa.
english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

kikuyu: Eliyaas wuxuu ahaa nin dabiicaddeenna oo kale leh. Aad buu Ilaah u baryay inaan roob di'in, roobna saddex sannadood iyo lix bilood dhulka kuma uu di'in.
english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

kikuyu: Oo kol kale ayuu Ilaah baryay, oo cirku roob buu soo daayay, dhulkuna midhihiisii buu soo saaray.
english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

kikuyu: Walaalahayow, haddii midkiin ka leexdo runta, oo mid soo celiyo isaga,
english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

kikuyu: ogaada in kii dembilaha qaladka jidkiisa ka soo celiyaa uu dembilihii naftiisa dhimasho ka badbaadin doono oo uu dembiyo badan qarin doono.
english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

kikuyu: Anigoo ah Butros oo ah rasuulkii Ciise Masiix waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa qariibbada ku kala firidhsan Bontos, iyo Galatiya, iyo Kabbadokiya, iyo Aasiya, iyo Bituniya,
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

kikuyu: oo lagu doortay aqoontii Ilaaha Aabbaha ahu hore u sii ogaa, oo quduus lagaga dhigay Ruuxa, xagga addeecidda iyo rushaynta dhiiggii Ciise Masiix. Nimco iyo nabadu ha idiin bateen.
english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

kikuyu: Ammaanu ha u ahaato Ilaaha ah Aabbaha Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix. Naxariistiisa badan aawadeed ayuu mar kale ina dhalay inaynu rajo nool ku helno sarakiciddii Ciise Masiix ka soo sara kacay kuwii dhintay,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

kikuyu: oo aynu helno dhaxal aan dhammaanayn, oo aan nijaasoobayn, oo aan baabba'ayn, oo jannada laydiinku kaydiyey.
english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

kikuyu: Idinku waxaad tihiin kuwo xoogga Ilaah iyo rumaysadka lagu dhawro ilaa badbaadada diyaarka u ah in wakhtiga ugu dambaysta la muujiyo.
english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

kikuyu: Taas waad ku faraxsan tihiin in kastoo, haddii ay waajib tahay, aad haatan wakhti yar ku murugootaan jirrabaaddo badan oo kala cayncayn ah.
english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

kikuyu: Si loo tijaabiyo rumaysadkiinna, oo aad uga sii qaalisan dahabka oo ah wax baabba'a in kastoo dab lagu tijaabiyo. Markaasaa laga helayaa mahad iyo ammaan iyo ciso markii Ciise Masiix la muujiyo.
english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

kikuyu: Isaga ma aydin arkin, waadse jeceshihiin, hadda in kastoo aydnaan arkin, waadse rumaysan tihiin, oo waxaad ku faraxdaan farxad aan la sheegi karin oo ammaan leh.
english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

kikuyu: Waxaadna helaysaan waxa rumaysadkiinnu ku dhammaado oo ah badbaadada naftiinna.
english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

kikuyu: Nebiyadii sii sheegay nimcada idiin imanaysa waxay doondooneen oo aad u raadiyeen wax ku saabsan badbaadadaas.
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

kikuyu: Waxayna raadiyeen wixii iyo wakhtigii Ruuxii Masiixa oo iyaga ku jiray uu u tilmaamay markuu horay uga sii markhaati furay waxyaalaha Masiixu ku xanuunsan doono iyo waxyaalaha ammaanta ah oo iyaga ka daba iman doona.
english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa iyagii loo muujiyey inaanay iyagu isugu adeegin waxyaalahaas, laakiinse idinkay idiinku adeegeen, oo waxyaalahaas waxaa idin ogaysiiyey kuwii injiilka idinkaga wacdiyey Ruuxa Quduuska ah ee jannada laga soo diray; waxyaalahaas oo ay malaa'iguhuna jecel yihiin inay fiiriyaan.
english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

kikuyu: Haddaba isku giijiya guntiga maankiinna, dhug yeesha, oo aad u rajeeya nimcada laydiin keeni doono markii Ciise Masiix la muujiyo.
english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

kikuyu: Idinkoo ah carruur addeec leh ha raacina damacyadiinnii hore oo aad ku samayseen jaahilnimadiinnii;
english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

kikuyu: laakiinse siduu kan idiin yeedhay quduuska u yahay, idinkuna sidaas oo kale dabiicaddiinna oo dhan quduus ku ahaada,
english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, waxaa qoran, Idinku waa inaad quduus ahaataan, waayo, aniguba quduus baan ahay.
english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

kikuyu: Haddaad Aabbow ugu yeedhaan kan nin walbaba u xukuma eexashola'aan iyo sida shuqulkiisu yahay, cabsi Ilaah isku dhaafiya wakhtiga aad qariibka tihiin.
english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

kikuyu: Waxaad og tihiin inaan dabiicaddiinnii bilaashka ahayd oo aad awowayaashiin ka dhaxasheen laydinkaga soo furan waxyaalaha baabba'aya oo ah sida lacagta iyo dahabka,
english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

kikuyu: laakiinse waxaa laydinku soo furtay dhiiggii qaaliga ahaa oo Masiix oo ah sidii wan yar oo aan wax ceeb ah iyo iin toona lahayn.
english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

kikuyu: Isaga horaa loo yiqiin intaan dunida la aasaasin, laakiinse wakhtiyadii dhammaadkoodii ayaa loo muujiyey idinka aawadiin,
english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

kikuyu: idinkoo isaga aawadiis ku ah kuwa rumaysan Ilaaha isaga ka soo sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay oo ammaanay isaga, in rumaysadkiinna iyo rajadiinnu ay Ilaah ku xidhnaadaan aawadeed.
english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

kikuyu: Sidaad naftiinna u daahiriseen markaad addeecdeen runta xagga jacaylka walaalnimada oo aan iska yeelyeel ahayn, aad iyo aad qalbiga isaga jeclaada.
english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

kikuyu: Idinka mar kale laydinkuma dhalin abuur baabba'aya, laakiinse waxaa laydinku dhalay abuur aan baabba'ayn oo ah erayga Ilaah oo nool oo waara.
english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

kikuyu: Waayo, Wax kasta oo jiidh lahu waa sida caws oo kale, Oo quruxdiisa oo dhammuna waa sida ubaxa duurka oo kale, Haddaba cawsku wuu engegaa, ubaxuna wuu dhacaa;
english: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

kikuyu: Laakiinse erayga Rabbigu weligiisba wuu waaraa. Haddaba kaasu waa eraygii warka wanaagsanaa oo laydinku wacdiyey.
english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed iska wada fogeeya xumaan oo dhan, iyo khiyaano oo dhan, iyo labawejiilenimo, iyo hinaaso, iyo cay oo dhan,
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

kikuyu: oo sida carruur dhallaan ah u jeclaada caanaha ruuxa ee saafiga ah, si aad ugu kortaan xagga badbaadada,
english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

kikuyu: haddii aad dhadhamiseen in Rabbigu raxmad leeyahay,
english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

kikuyu: kaas oo aad u imanaysaan, oo ah dhagax nool, oo dadku diiday, laakiin xagga Ilaah laga doortay oo qaali ah.
english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

kikuyu: Idinkuna sida dhagaxyo noolnool ayaa waxaa laydinka dhisayaa guri ruux ah inaad ahaataan wadaaddo quduus ah si aad xagga ruuxa uga bixisaan allabariyo uu Ilaah ku aqbalo Ciise Masiix.
english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, waxaa Qorniinku leeyahay, Bal eega, waxaan Siyoon dhex dhigayaa dhagax geeseed oo weyn, oo la doortay, oo qaali ah, Oo kii isaga rumaystaa ma ceeboobi doono.
english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed qaalinimada waxaa leh idinkoo ah kuwa rumaysan, laakiinse xagga kuwa aan rumaysnayn, Dhagaxii kuwa wax dhisa ay diideen, Wuxuu noqday madaxa rukunka;
english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

kikuyu: iyo Dhagax lagu turunturoodo oo ah dhadhaab lagu xumaado; waayo, waxay ku turunturoodaan ereyga, maxaa yeelay, ma addeecsana; taas oo ah wixii loo xugmay.
english: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku waxaad tihiin jinsi la doortay, iyo wadaaddada boqorka, iyo quruun quduus ah, iyo dad Ilaah iska leeyahay, inaad ogeysiisaan wanaagga kan gudcurka idiinka yeedhay oo idiinku yeedhay xagga nuurkiisa yaabka leh.
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

kikuyu: Idinku waagii hore dad ma aydin ahayn, laakiinse haatan waxaad tihiin dadka Ilaah, idinku markii hore naxariis ma aydin helin, laakiinse haatan naxariis baad hesheen.
english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, waxaan idiin baryayaa, idinkoo ah sidii qariib iyo dad sodcaal ah, inaad ka fogaataan damacyada jidhka oo nafta la dagaallama.
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

kikuyu: Quruumaha dhexdooda dabiicad wanaagsan ku dhaqma, in meeshii ay wax xun idinkaga sheegi lahaayeen sidii idinkoo ah kuwo xumaan fala, ay shuqulladiinna wanaagsan oo ay arkaan Ilaah ku ammaanaan maalinta booqashada.
english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

kikuyu: Rabbiga daraaddiis u addeeca amar kasta oo dadka, ama ha ahaado boqorka ka sarreeya dadka oo dhan,
english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

kikuyu: amase taliyayaasha uu isagu u soo diray inay ka aargutaan kuwa xumaanta sameeya oo ay ammaanaan kuwa samaanta fala.
english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

kikuyu: Waayo, Ilaah doonistiisu waxa weeye inaad samafalid ku aamusiisaan jaahilnimada nacasyada,
english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

kikuyu: idinkoo xor ah oo aan xorriyaddiinna ugu isticmaalayn sidii jubbad aad xumaanta ku qarisaan, laakiinse sidii idinkoo ah addoommo Ilaah.
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

kikuyu: Dadka oo dhan maamuusa, walaalahana jeclaada, Ilaahna ka cabsada, oo boqorka ciseeya.
english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

kikuyu: Midiidinyadow, ka cabsada oo ka dambeeya sayidyadiinna, mana aha kuwa wanaagsan oo idiin roon oo keliya, laakiinse xataa kuwa qalloocan.
english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

kikuyu: Waayo, tanu waa wax loo bogo haddii nin niyada xagga Ilaah uga adkaysto dhibaatooyinka, isagoo xaqdarro ku xanuunsanaya.
english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

kikuyu: Markii aad dembaabtaan, oo laydin garaaco, haddii aad u dulqaadataan, maxay ammaan leedahay? Laakiinse markaad wanaag fashaan oo aad xanuunsataan, haddii aad u dulqaadataan, taasu waa wax Ilaah u bogo.
english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

kikuyu: Waayo, taasu waa wixii laydiinku yeedhay, maxaa yeelay, Masiix baa idiin xanuunsaday, oo wuxuu idinkaga tegey masaal inaad tallaabooyinkiisa raacdaan.
english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

kikuyu: Isagu ma uu dembaabin, khiyaanona afkiisa lagama helin.
english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

kikuyu: Oo isagu markii la caayay, dadkii caayay cay uma uu celin. Markuu xanuunsadayna ninna ma uu cabsiin, laakiinse wuxuu isu dhiibay kan xaqnimada wax ku xukuma.
english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

kikuyu: Oo isagu dembiyadeennii wuxuu ku qaaday jidhkiisii geedka saarnaa, si innagoo dembi kala dhimannay aynu xaqnimo ugu noolaanno. Waxaad ku bogsateen xariijimihii karbaashiddiisii.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaad u ambanayseen sida ido oo kale, laakiinse haatan waxaad u soo noqoteen Adhijirka iyo Hoggaamiyaha naftiinna.
english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

kikuyu: Sidaas oo kalena, dumar yahow, nimankiinna ka dambeeya in xataa haddii qaar uusan erayga addeecin ay erayga la'aantiis ku soo hanuunsamaan dabiicadda afooyinkooda,
english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

kikuyu: markay arkaan dabiicaddiinna daahirsan ee cabsida leh.
english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

kikuyu: Isqurxintiinnu yaanay ahaan tan dibadda ah, oo ah timo tidcan, iyo dahab layska lulo, amase dhar la xidho,
english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

kikuyu: laakiinse ha ahaato inta qalbiga ee qarsoon, taasoo leh wax aan baabba'ayn ee ah ruuxa qabow oo aamusan, kaasoo Ilaah hortiisa qiimo badan ku leh.
english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

kikuyu: Waayo, sidaasoo kalaa waagii hore dumarkii quduuska ahaa oo Ilaah wax ka rajayn jiray ay isu qurxin jireen, iyagoo nimankoodii ka dambeeya.
english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

kikuyu: Saarahba sidaasoo kalay Ibraahim u addeeci jirtay, oo ay ugu yeedhi jirtay, Sayidow; oo idinna haddii aad wanaag fashaan oo aydnaan ka cabsan wixii argaggax leh waxaad tihiin carruurteeda.
english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

kikuyu: Nimankow, idinkuna sidaas oo kale afooyinkiinna aqoon kula dhaqma sidii iyagoo ah weel tabardaran, oo iyaga maamuusa sida kuwa idinla dhaxla nimcada nolosha, si aan baryadiinna loo hor joogsan.
english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

kikuyu: Ugu dambaysta, waxaan idinku leeyahay, Kulligiin isku maan ahaada, oo isu jixinjixa, oo sida walaalo isu jeclaada, oo isu naxariista, oo is-hoosaysiiya.
english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

kikuyu: Shar shar ha ka celinina, cayna cay ha ka celinina, laakiinse duco ka celiya, maxaa yeelay, saas aawadeed waxaa laydiinku yeedhay inaad barako dhaxashaan, waayo,
english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

kikuyu: Kii doonaya inuu nolol jeclaado, Oo arko maalmo wanaagsan, Carrabkiisa shar ha ka joojiyo, Bushimihiisana yaanay khiyaano ku hadlin.
english: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

kikuyu: Oo ha ka leexdo shar, oo wanaag ha sameeyo; Nabad ha doondoono oo ha raacdaysto;
english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

kikuyu: Waayo, Rabbiga indhihiisu waxay fiiriyaan kuwa xaqa ah, Dhegihiisuna waxay u furan yihiin baryadooda; Laakiin wejiga Rabbigu waa ka gees kuwa sharka sameeya.
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

kikuyu: Haddii aad waxa wanaagsan ku dadaashaan, bal yaa wax idin yeeli doona?
english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

kikuyu: Laakiinse xaqnimada daraaddeed haddii aad u xanuunsataan, waad barakaysan tihiin. Haddaba ha ka cabsanina cabsigelintooda, hana welwelina.
english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

kikuyu: Rabbiga Masiixa ah qalbiyadiinna quduus kaga dhiga, oo mar kasta diyaar u ahaada inaad u jawaabtaan nin alla ninkii wax idinka weyddiiya sabab ku saabsan rajada aad leedihiin, laakiinse qabow iyo cabsi ugu jawaaba,
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

kikuyu: idinkoo qalbi wanaagsan leh, in markii wax xun laydinka sheego, ay ceeboobaan kuwa caaya dabiicaddiinna wanaagsan ee xagga Masiixa ah.
english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

kikuyu: Waayo, haddii ay doonista Ilaah tahay, waxaa ka wanaagsan inaad samafalidda u xanuunsataan intii aad u xanuunsan lahaydeen sharfalidda.
english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, Masiixba mar buu u xanuunsaday dembiyada. Isagoo xaq ah ayuu u xanuunsaday kuwa aan xaqa ahayn aawadood inuu inoo keeno Ilaah. Xagga jidhka waa laga dilay, laakiinse xagga ruuxa waa laga nooleeyey.
english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

kikuyu: Ruuxii ayuu ku tegey oo wuxuu wacdiyey ruuxyadii xabsigii ku jiray,
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

kikuyu: kuwaas oo waagii hore ahaa caasiyiin markii dulqaadashada Ilaah ay sugaysay intii maalmihii Nuux oo la diyaarinayay doonnidii, taasoo ay biyihii kaga badbaadeen dhawr qof oo ah siddeed nafood oo keliya.
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

kikuyu: Biyahaasuna waxay ka dhigan yihiin baabtiiska hadda idinku badbaadiya sarakicidda Ciise Masiix, oo aan ahayn ka fogaynta wasakhda jidhka, laakiinse waxaa weeye baryo ka timaada qalbi wanaagsan oo xagga Ilaah.
english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ciise Masiix jannaduu galay oo wuxuu joogaa gacanta midigta oo Ilaah, oo malaa'igaha iyo kuwa amarka leh iyo kuwa xoogga leh oo dhanba waa laga hoosaysiiyey isaga.
english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

kikuyu: Mar haddii Masiixu jidhka ku xanuunsaday, idinkuna sidaas oo kale isu diyaariya, idinkoo isku maan ah; maxaa yeelay, kii jidhka ku xanuunsaday waa ka joogsaday dembiga,
english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

kikuyu: si wakhtiga idiin hadhay oo aad jidhka ku nooshihiin aydnaan damacyada dadka mar dambe ugu noolaan, laakiinse aad ugu noolaataan doonista Ilaah.
english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa idinku filan wakhtigii hore oo aad doonistii dadka aan Ilaah aaminin samayn jirteen, markii aad ku socon jirteen nejisnimo, iyo damacyadii jidhka, iyo sakhraannimo, iyo rabshad, iyo khamricabbid, iyo sanamcaabudid xaaraan ah.
english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

kikuyu: Oo markii aydnaan iyaga u raacin nejisnimadaas badan, way idinla yaabaan oo way idin caayaan.
english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

kikuyu: Iyagu waxay faleen waxay kala xisaabtami doonaan kan diyaarka u ah inuu xukumo kuwa nool iyo kuwa dhintayba.
english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

kikuyu: Waayo, taas aawadeed injiilka waxaa lagu wacdiyey xataa kuwii dhintay in iyaga jidhka lagu xukumo sida dadka, laakiinse ay ruuxa ku noolaadaan sida Ilaah.
english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

kikuyu: Haddaba wax walba dhammaadkoodu wuu dhow yahay, sidaas daraaddeed digtoonaada, oo tukashada u feeyignaada.
english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

kikuyu: Wax walba hortood idinku aad isu jeclaada, maxaa yeelay, jacaylku wuxuu qariyaa dembiyo faro badan.
english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

kikuyu: Ismartiqaada gunuunacla'aan.
english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

kikuyu: Sida mid waluba u helay hadiyad, idinku isu adeega, sida wakiillo wanaagsan oo helay nimcada Ilaah ee badan ee kala cayncaynka ah.
english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

kikuyu: Haddii nin hadlo, ha u hadlo sidii isagoo ku hadlaya ereyga Ilaah; haddii nin adeegona, ha u adeego siduu Ilaah xoogga u siiyo, in wax walbaba Ilaah ku ammaanmo Ciise Masiix, kaasoo weligiis iyo weligiisba leh ammaanta iyo dowladnimadaba. Aamiin.
english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, ha la yaabina jirrabaadda dabka ah oo idinku dhex dhacday in laydiin tijaabiyo sida iyadoo ay idinku dhaceen wax la yaab lihi.
english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

kikuyu: Laakiinse sidaad u tihiin kuwo ka qayb qaatay waxyaalaha Masiixu ku xanuunsaday, farxa, inaad farxad aad u weyn ku faraxdaan marka ammaantiisa la muujiyo.
english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

kikuyu: Haddii magaca Masiix aawadiis laydin caayo, waad barakaysan tihiin, maxaa yeelay, waxaa idin dul jooga Ruuxa ammaanta oo ah Ruuxa Ilaah.
english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

kikuyu: Haddaba midkiinna yuusan u xanuunsan sida isagoo ah gacankudhiigle, ama tuug, ama sharfale, ama mid faraggeliya axwaasha dadka kale.
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddii nin u xanuunsado sida isagoo Masiixi ah, yaanu ceebsan, laakiinse Ilaah ha ku ammaano magacan.
english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa la gaadhay wakhtigii dadka Ilaah xukunka laga bilaabi lahaa, oo haddii innaga marka hore laynaga bilaabo, kuwa aan injiilka Ilaah addeecin muxuu aakhirkoodu ahaan doonaa?
english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

kikuyu: Haddaba haddii kan xaqa ahu si dhib leh ku badbaado, xaggee bay ka muuqan doonaan cibaadalaawaha iyo dembiluhu?
english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed kuwa doonista Ilaah u xanuunsada, iyagoo samafalaya, naftooda ammaano ha ugu dhiibeen Abuuraha aaminka ah.
english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

kikuyu: Anigoo anba oday la ah oo marag ka ah waxyaalihii Masiixu ku xanuunsaday oo weliba ka qayb qaadanaya ammaanta la muujin doono, waxaan ku waaninayaa odayaasha idinku dhex jira:
english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

kikuyu: Ilaaliya idaha Ilaah oo idin dhex jooga, idinkoo aan qasab ahaan u dhawrayn, laakiinse raalli ka ah sida Ilaah doonayo.
english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

kikuyu: Oo weliba ha u dhawrina faa'iido ceeb ah daraaddeed, laakiinse ku dhawra maan diyaar ah, hana u xukumina sida idinkoo sayidyo u ah kuwaad u talisaan, laakiinse idaha masaallo u noqda.
english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

kikuyu: Oo marka Adhijirka sare la muujiyo, idinku waxaad heli doontaan taajka ammaanta oo aan baabba'ayn.
english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

kikuyu: Sidaasoo kalena dhallinyaraday, odayaasha ka dambeeya, oo kulligiinba is-hoosaysiiya, in midkiinba midka kale u adeego, maxaa yeelay, Ilaah waa hor joogsadaa kuwa kibra, laakiinse kuwa is-hoosaysiiya ayuu nimco siiyaa.
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed gacanta xoogga leh oo Ilaah iska hoosaysiiya, si uu wakhtigiisa idiin sarraysiiyo.
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

kikuyu: Welwelkiinna oo dhan isaga saara, maxaa yeelay, isagu dan buu idinka leeyahay.
english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

kikuyu: Feeyignaada oo soo jeeda, waayo, cadowgiinna Ibliiska ahu sida libaax ciyaya ayuu u wareegaa oo u doondoonaa cid uu liqo.
english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

kikuyu: Isaga hor joogsada, idinkoo iimaankiinna ku adag, oo garanaya in isla dhibaatooyinkaasu ay ku dhacaan walaalahiinna dunida ku jira.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

kikuyu: Haddaba Ilaaha leh nimcada oo dhan oo idiinku yeedhay ammaantiisa daa'imkaa oo Masiixa ku jirta, markii aad in yar xanuunsataan ka dib isagu wuu idin kaamili doonaa, oo idin adkayn doonaa, oo idin xoogayn doonaa.
english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

kikuyu: Weligiis iyo weligiisba xoogga isagaa leh. Aamiin.
english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Waxaan warqad yar idiinku soo qoray gacanta walaalkeen Silwanos oo aan ku tirinayo inuu aamin yahay. Oo waxaan idinku waaninayaa oo marag ahaan idiinku sheegayaa in tanu tahay nimcada Ilaah oo run ah. Taas ku adkaada
english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

kikuyu: Waxaa idin soo salaamaya tan Baabuloon joogta oo laydinla doortay, iyo wiilkayga Markos.
english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

kikuyu: Isku salaama dhunkasho jacayl ah. Oo intiinna Masiixa kuwiisa ah oo dhan nabaddu ha u ahaato.
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

kikuyu: Anigoo ah Simoon Butros, oo addoon iyo rasuulba u ah Ciise Masiix, waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa kuwa helay iimaan qaali ah oo keenna la mid ah, oo ku helay xaqnimada Ilaaheenna iyo Badbaadiyeheenna Ciise Masiix.
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: Nimco iyo nabadu ha idinku bateen xagga aqoonta Ilaah iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise.
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, Ilaah xooggiisu wuxuu ina siiyey wax kasta oo ku saabsan nolosha iyo cibaadadaba, oo wuxuu inagu siiyey aqoonta kan inoogu yeedhay ammaantiisa iyo wanaaggiisa.
english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

kikuyu: Wuxuu kuwaas inagu siiyey ballamadiisa qaaliga ah oo aad iyo aad u waaweyn, inaad kuwaas ku noqotaan kuwo ka qayb qaata dabiicadda Ilaah, idinkoo ka baxsaday kharribaadda dunida ku jirta ee ku timid damaca jidhka.
english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

kikuyu: Sababtaas daraaddeed idinkuna aad u dadaala, oo rumaysadkiinna waxaad ku dartaan wanaag, wanaaggiinnana aqoon,
english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

kikuyu: aqoontiinnana iscelin, iscelintiinnana dulqaadasho, dulqaadashadiinnana cibaado,
english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

kikuyu: cibaadadiinnana kalgacayl walaalnimo, kalgacaylkiinna walaalnimona jacayl.
english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

kikuyu: Haddii aad waxyaalahaas leedihiin oo ay idinku badan yihiin, iyagu waxay idinka dhigayaan kuwo aan cajisiin ama midhalaawayaal ahayn xagga aqoonta Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix.
english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waayo, kii waxyaalahaasu ka maqan yihiin wuu indha la' yahay oo arag gaaban yahay, oo wuxuu illoobay in dembiyadiisii hore laga safeeyey.
english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, walaalayaalow, aad ugu dadaala inaad xaqiijisaan in laydiin yeedhay oo laydin doortay, waayo, haddii aad waxyaalahaas samaysaan, weligiin ma turunturoon doontaan.
english: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

kikuyu: Saas daraaddeed aad baa laydiin siin doonaa gelidda boqortooyada daa'imiska ah oo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix oo Badbaadiyeheenna ah.
english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed anigu had iyo goorba diyaar baan u ahaan doonaa inaan waxyaalahan idin xusuusiyo, in kastoo weliba aad taqaaniin oo laydinku adkeeyey runta aad haysataan.
english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

kikuyu: Waxaa ila qumman in in alla intii aan jidhkan ku jiro aan xusuusin idinku guubaabiyo.
english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

kikuyu: Waayo, waan ogahay inay dhaqso u imanayso goortii aan jidhkan ka tegi lahaa siduu Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix i ogeysiiyey.
english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

kikuyu: Waxaan ku dadaali doonaa inaad tegiddayda dabadeed mar kastaba awooddaan inaad waxyaalahan xusuusataan.
english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

kikuyu: Annagu ma aannu raacin sheekooyin khiyaano lagu hindisay, markii aannu idin ogeysiinnay xoogga iyo imaatinka Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, laakiinse waxaannu ahayn markhaatiyaal indhaha ku arkay weynaantiisa.
english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

kikuyu: Waayo, isagu wuxuu xagga Ilaaha Aabbaha ah ka helay maamuus iyo ammaan markii cod sidaas ahu isaga uga yimid xagga ammaanta aad u weyn ee yidhi, Kanu waa Wiilkayga aan jeclahay oo aan ku faraxsanahay.
english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Oo codkaas aannu maqalnay wuxuu ka yimid samada markii aannu buurta quduuska ah isaga la joognay.
english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

kikuyu: Oo waxaynu haysannaa hadalka nebiyadii sii sheegeen, oo aad loo sii xaqiijiyey, oo waad ku wanaagsan tihiin inaad u fiirsataan hadalkaas sida laambad meel gudcur ah ka ifaysa, ilaa waagu beryayo oo xiddigta waaberi qalbigiinna ka soo baxdo,
english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

kikuyu: idinkoo taas horta garanaya in wixii nebiyadii sii sheegeen oo la qoray ayan lahayn micnayn gooni ah.
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

kikuyu: Waayo, wixii nebiyadii sii sheegeen weligood kuma ay iman dadka doonistiisa, laakiinse dad Ruuxa Quduuska ahu waday ayaa xagga Ilaah kaga hadlay.
english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaa dadkii ka dhex kacay nebiyo been ah, oo idinkana sidaas oo kale waxaa idinku dhex jiri doona macallimiin been ah, oo qarsoodi idinku keeni doona bidcinimo wax halligaysa, iyagoo diidaya xataa Sayidkii soo iibsaday, oo dushooda ku soo dejinaya halligaad dhaqso ah.
english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

kikuyu: Kuwa badan baa raaci doona ficiladooda nijaasta ah, oo sababtooda ayaa loo caayi doonaa jidka runta ah.
english: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

kikuyu: Damac xumaan bay hadallo iskayeelyeel ah idinkaga baayacmushtari doonaan, kuwaas oo xukunkoodii waa hore lagu xukumay uusan haatan raagayn, halligaaddoodiina ayan gam'ayn.
english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, Ilaah uma tudhin malaa'igihii dembaabay, laakiinse wuxuu iyagii ku tuuray cadaabta, oo wuxuu ku riday godad gudcur ah iyagoo xukun aawadiis loo hayo.
english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

kikuyu: Oo dunidii horena uma u tudhin, laakiinse wuxuu badbaadshay Nuux, oo ahaa mid xaqnimada wax ku wacdiya, iyo toddoba qof oo kale, markuu daadkii ku soo daayay dunidii cibaadalaawayaasha.
english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

kikuyu: Oo magaalooyinkii ahaa Sodom iyo Gomorana wuxuu ka dhigay dambas, oo intuu afgembi ku xukumay, ayuu masaal uga dhigay kuwii cibaadalaawayaal noqon lahaa,
english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

kikuyu: oo wuxuu ka samatabbixiyey Luud kii xaqa ahaa oo aad loogu saxariiriyey sharcilaawayaashii dabiicaddoodii nijaasta ahayd.
english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

kikuyu: Waayo, ninkaas xaqa ahaa iyaguu dhex degganaa, oo waxaa naftiisii xaqa ahayd maalin ka maalin silciyey camaladoodii sharciga ka geesta ahaa markuu arkay oo maqlay.
english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

kikuyu: Rabbigu waa yaqaan sida kuwa cibaadada leh jirrabaadda looga samatabbixiyo iyo sida kuwa aan xaqa ahayn loo hayo iyagoo ciqaaban ilaa maalinta xisaabta,
english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

kikuyu: khusuusan kuwa jidhka raaca, iyagoo damaca nijaasta ah ku socda, oo sayidnimada quudhsada. Iyagu waa indha adag yihiin oo waa macangag, kamana cabsadaan inay kuwa derejada leh caayaan.
english: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

kikuyu: Malaa'iguhuna in kastoo ay iyaga itaal iyo xoogba ka badan yihiin, iyaga dacwo cay ah Rabbiga hortiisa kagama dacweeyaan.
english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

kikuyu: Laakiinse kuwanu waa sida xayawaan aan caqli lahayn oo u dhashay in la qabsado oo la dilo, oo waxay caayaan wax aanay garanayn. Hubaal iyagu halligaaddooda ayay ku halligmi doonaan.
english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

kikuyu: Xaqdarradooda waxaa loogu abaalgudaa xaqdarro, oo waxaa iyaga la wanaagsan inay maalinnimada raaxaystaan. Iyagu waa waskhaamiin iyo ceebaalowyo, oo markay idinla feeysteeyaan waxay ku raaxaystaan khiyaanadooda.
english: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

kikuyu: Waxay leeyihiin indho sino miidhan ah oo aan dembi ka joogsan karin. Kuwa aan adkayn ayay sasabtaan, waxayna leeyihiin qalbi damacxumaan ku noqnoqda, oo waa dad nacladeed.
english: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

kikuyu: Jidkii qummanaa ayay ka leexdeen oo way ambadeen, waxayna raaceen jidkii Balcaam ina Becoor oo jeclaaday abaalgudka xaqdarrada.
english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

kikuyu: Laakiinse isaga waxaa loo canaantay xadgudubkiisii aawadiis. Dameer carrab la' ayaa ku hadlay dad codkiis, oo wuxuu joojiyey waallidii nebiga.
english: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa ilo aan biyo lahayn, iyo ceeryaamo uu duufaan kaxeeyo, oo waxaa iyaga daraaddood loo sii dhigay madowga gudcurka.
english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu waxay ku hadlaan hadal faan ah oo aan micne lahayn, oo kuwa in yar kaga baxsanaya kuwa qaladka ku socda ayay ku sasabtaan damacyada jidhka xagga nijaasta;
english: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

kikuyu: oo waxay iyaga ugu ballanqaadaan xorriyad, laakiinse iyaga qudhooduba waa addoommadii kharribaadda. Waayo, wixii ka adkaada nin ayaa isaga addoonsada.
english: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

kikuyu: Waayo, markii ay nijaasta dunida kaga baxsadeen aqoontii Rabbiga ah Badbaadiyeheenna Ciise Masiix, haddii ay haddana ku dhex murgaan oo laga adkaado, xaalkooda dambe waa ka sii xumaadaa kii hore.
english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

kikuyu: Intii ay jidka xaqnimada aqoon lahaayeen oo ay dib uga noqon lahaayeen amarka quduuska ah oo iyaga la siiyey, waxaa uga wanaagsanaan lahayd inayan aqoon jidkaas.
english: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

kikuyu: Wixii maahmaahda runta ah lagu yidhi ayaa iyaga ku dhacay. Eeygu wuxuu ku noqdaa mantaggiisa. Doofaarraddii maydhatayna waxay dib ugu noqotaa gelgelinta dhoobada.
english: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, tanu waa warqaddii labaad oo aan idiin soo qoray, oo labadoodaba waxaan maankiinna daacadda ah ku guubaabinayaa xusuusin,
english: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

kikuyu: inaad xusuusataan erayadii ay nebiyadii quduuska ahaa hore ugu hadleen, iyo amarkii Rabbiga Badbaadiyaha ah oo ay rasuulladiinnu ku hadleen.
english: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

kikuyu: Marka hore waxaad og tihiin in maalmaha ugu dambeeya kuwa majaajiloodaa ay la iman doonaan majaajilo iyagoo damacyadooda daba socda,
english: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

kikuyu: oo waxay odhan doonaan, Ballankii imaatinkiisii meeh? Waayo, haatan iyo maalintii awowayaashii ay dhinteen wax waluba waxay u socdaan sidii ay ahaayeen tan iyo bilowgii abuurniinta.
english: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

kikuyu: Waayo, iyagu kaas bay u illoobaan in waagii hore samooyin jireen iyo dhul erayga Ilaah biyo lagaga dhex abuuray,
english: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

kikuyu: kuwaas oo dunidii waagaas jirtay ay ku baabba'day iyadoo daad qaaday.
english: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

kikuyu: Laakiinse samooyinka haatan jira iyo dhulkaba isku eray baa dab loogu kaydiyey, oo waxaa loo hayaa maalinta xisaabta iyo halligaadda dadka cibaadalaawayaasha ah.
english: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

kikuyu: Laakiinse, gacaliyayaalow, waxan keliya ha illoobina in maalin keliyahu Rabbiga la tahay sida kun sannadood, kun sannadoodna la yihiin sida maalin keliya.
english: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

kikuyu: Rabbigu kama raago inuu ballankiisa oofiyo sida dadka qaarkiis ku tiriyo inay tahay raagid, laakiinse idinkuu idiin dulqaadanayaa, oo dooni maayo in qofnaba halligmo, laakiinse wuxuu doonayaa in kulli la wada toobadkeeno.
english: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

kikuyu: Laakiinse maalinta Rabbigu waxay u iman doontaa sida tuug oo kale; maalintaas oo ay samooyinku baabbi'i doonaan iyagoo sanqadh weynu ka yeedhayso, oo waxyaalaha abuuranna iyagoo gubanaya ayay baabbi'i doonaan. Dhulka iyo shuqullada ku jirana waa la gubi doonaa.
english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

kikuyu: Haddii waxyaalahan oo dhammu ay sidaas u baabbi'i doonaan, haddaba dad caynkee ah baa idinku waajib ah inaad noqotaan si aad ugu dhaqantaan dabiicad quduus ah iyo cibaado,
english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

kikuyu: idinkoo sugaya oo aad ugu dadaalaya imaatinka maalinta Ilaah, taasoo samooyinku iyagoo ololaya ay baabbi'i doonaan, waxyaalaha abuuranna iyagoo gubanaya ayay dhalaali doonaan.
english: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

kikuyu: Laakiinse sidii uu inoo ballanqaaday, waxaynu sugaynaa samooyin cusub iyo dhul cusub oo xaqnimo dhex deggan tahay.
english: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, gacaliyayaalow, idinkoo waxyaalahaas sugaya, ku dadaala in laydin helo idinkoo nabdoon oo aan wasakh iyo eed lahayn Ilaah hortiisa.
english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

kikuyu: Sidii walaalkeen gacaliye Bawlos idiinku soo qoray xigmaddii la siiyey, ku tiriya in dulqaadashada Rabbigeennu tahay badbaado;
english: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

kikuyu: siduu warqadihiisii oo dhan waxyaalahan ugaga hadlay. Kuwaas waxaa ku jira wax in la gartaa ay dhib tahay, oo jaahiliinta iyo kuwaan adkayn ayaa qalloociya, siday Qorniinka kaleba u qalloociyaan oo ay u halligmaan.
english: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, gacaliyayaalow, idinkoo waxyaalahan hore u garanayay, isjira, yaan laydinku kaxaysan qaladka kuwa sharka ah oo aydnaan ka dhicin adkaantiinna.
english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

kikuyu: Laakiinse ku kora nimcada iyo aqoonta Rabbigeenna ah Badbaadiyeheenna Ciise Masiix. Isaga ammaanu ha u ahaato haatan iyo weligeedba. Aamiin.
english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Waxaannu idiin soo qoraynaa wax ku saabsan wixii tan iyo bilowgii jiray, oo aannu maqalnay, oo aannu indhahayaga ku aragnay, oo aannu eegnay, oo ay gacmahayagu taabteen oo Ereyga nolosha ah.
english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

kikuyu: Nolosha waa la muujiyey, oo waannu aragnay, waanan u marag furaynaa, oo waxaannu idiinka warramaynaa nolosha weligeed ah, ta Aabbaha la jirtay oo lanoo muujiyey.
english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

kikuyu: Wixii aannu aragnay oo aannu maqalnay ayaannu idiinka warramaynaa, si aad idinkuna noo soo wehelisaan; oo wehelnimadeennu waa mid la jirta Aabbaha iyo Wiilkiisa Ciise Masiix ah.
english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Oo waxaannu waxyaalahan idiinku soo qoraynaa si ay farxaddiinnu u buuxsanto.
english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Warkii aannu ka maqalnay oo aan idiinka warramayno wuxuu yahay, in Ilaah nuur yahay, oo isaga aan gudcur ku jirin innaba.
english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

kikuyu: Haddaynu nidhaahno, Wehelnimo ayaynu la wadaagnaa isaga, oo aynu gudcurka ku soconno, been baynu sheegnaa, oo runta ma falno.
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

kikuyu: Laakiin haddaynu nuurka ku soconno siduu isaguba nuurka ugu jiro, wehelnimo ayaynu isla wada wadaagnaa, oo dhiigga Ciise, oo Wiilkiisa ah, wuxuu inaga nadiifiyaa dembi oo dhan.
english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

kikuyu: Haddaynu nidhaahno, Dembi ma lihin, nafsaddeenna ayaynu khiyaanaynaa, oo runtuna inaguma jirto.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

kikuyu: Haddaynu dembiyadeenna qiranno, isagu waa aamin iyo caaddil inuu dembiyadeenna inaga cafiyo, oo uu inaga nadiifiyo xaqdarrada oo dhan.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Haddaynu nidhaahno, Ma aynu dembaabin, waxaynu Ilaah ka dhignaa beenaaleh, oo ereygiisa inaguma jiro.
english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

kikuyu: Carruurtaydiiyey, waxaan waxyaalahan idiinku soo qorayaa si aydnaan u dembaabin; oo qof uun hadduu dembaabo, waxaynu xagga Aabbaha ku leennahay Dhexdhexaadiye, waana Ciise Masiix kan xaqa ah.
english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

kikuyu: Oo isaguna wuxuu dembiyadeenna u yahay kafaaraggudka; oo kuweenna oo keliya uma aha ee weliba wuxuu u yahay dembiyada dunida oo dhan.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

kikuyu: Oo taas ayaynu ku garanaynaa inaynu naqaan isaga, haddaynu qaynuunnadiisa adkayno.
english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

kikuyu: Kan yidhaahda, Waan aqaan isaga, oo aan qaynuunnadiisa adkayn, waa beenaaleh, oo runtu kuma jirto isaga.
english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

kikuyu: Laakiin kan ereygiisa adkeeya, runtii, Ilaah jacaylkiisu wuu ku dhan yahay isaga. Taas aynu ku garanaynaa inaynu isaga ku jirno.
english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

kikuyu: Kan yidhaahda, Isagaan ku jiraa, waa inuu u socdaa siduu isagu u socday.
english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, qaynuun cusub idiin soo qori maayo, laakiin waxaan idiin soo qorayaa qaynuun hore oo aad tan iyo bilowgii haysateen. Qaynuunkii hore waa hadalkii aad bilowgii maqasheen.
english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

kikuyu: Oo weliba qaynuun cusub ayaan idiin soo qorayaa, kaas oo isaga iyo idinkaba run idinku dhex ah, maxaa yeelay, gudcurku waa dhammaanayaa, oo nuurka runta ahuna imminkuu iftiimayaa.
english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

kikuyu: Kan yidhaahda, Nuurkaan ku jiraa, oo walaalkiis neceb, wuxuu ku jiraa gudcurka ilaa imminkada.
english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

kikuyu: Kan walaalkii jecel, nuurkuu ku jiraa, oo wax lagu xumaado kuma jiro isaga.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

kikuyu: Laakiin kan walaalkii neceb, gudcurkuu ku jiraa, oo gudcurkuu ku socdaa, oo garan maayo meeshuu marayo, waayo, gudcurkaa indhihiisa tiray.
english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

kikuyu: Wax baan idiin soo qorayaa, carruurtiiyey, maxaa yeelay, dembiyadiinnii waa laydinka cafiyey magiciisa aawadiis.
english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

kikuyu: Aabbayaashow, wax baan idiin soo qorayaa, maxaa yeelay, waad garanaysaan kan tan iyo bilowgii jira. Ragga dhallinyarada ahow, wax baan idiin soo qorayaa, maxaa yeelay, idinku kan sharka ah ayaad ka adkaateen. Carruurtaydiiyey, wax baan idiin soo qoray, maxaa yeelay, Aabbaha waad garanaysaan.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

kikuyu: Aabbayaashow, wax baan idiin soo qoray, maxaa yeelay, waad garanaysaan kan tan iyo bilowgii jira. Ragga dhallinyarada ahow, wax baan idiin soo qoray, maxaa yeelay, waad xoog weyn tihiin, oo ereyga Ilaah baa idinku jira, oo kan sharka ah ayaad ka adkaateen.
english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

kikuyu: Dunida iyo waxyaalaha dunida ku jira toona ha jeclaanina. Qof uun hadduu dunida jeclaado, jacaylka Aabbuhu kuma jiro isaga.
english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

kikuyu: Maxaa yeelay, waxaa dunida ku jira oo dhan oo ah damaca jidhka, iyo damaca indhaha, iyo faanka nolosha, xagga Aabbaha kama yimaadaan ee waxay ka yimaadaan xagga dunida.
english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

kikuyu: Oo duniduna way idlaanaysaa, iyo damaceeduba; laakiin kan doonista Ilaah yeelaa wuu jirayaa weligiis.
english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

kikuyu: Carruurtiiyey, waa saacaddii u dambaysay, oo sidaad maqasheen inuu kan Masiixa ka geesta ahi imanayo, weliba imminka kuwa badan oo Masiixa ka gees ah ayaa kacay, taa aawadeed ayaynu ku garanaynaa inay saacaddii u dambaysay tahay.
english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

kikuyu: Way inaga baxeen, laakiin kuweennii ma ay ahayn; hadday kuweennii ahaayeen, way inala joogi lahaayeen; laakiin way inaga baxeen oo taasaa caddaynaysa inaanay kulligood inaga mid ahayn.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

kikuyu: Laakiin idinku waxaad leedihiin subkid ka timid Kan Quduuska ah, oo wax walba waad taqaaniin.
english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

kikuyu: Wixii aan idiin soo qoray uma aan soo qorin aqoonla'aantiinna xagga runta aawadeed, laakiin waxaan u soo qoray aqoonta aad runta taqaaniin iyo inaanay beenina runta ka iman aawadood.
english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

kikuyu: Waa kuma beenaaluhu, kan dafira inuu Ciise yahay Masiixa mooyaane? Isagu waa kan Masiixa ka geesta ah, waana kan dafira Aabbaha iyo Wiilkaba.
english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii Wiilka inkiraa, ma leh Aabbaha; laakiin kan Wiilka qirtaa Aabbuhuu leeyahay.
english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

kikuyu: Haddaba idinku waxaad tan iyo bilowgii maqlayseen ha idinku sii jiro. Haddii wixii aad tan iyo bilowgii maqlayseen idinku sii jiro, idinkuna waxaad ku sii jiri doontaan Wiilka iyo Aabbaha.
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

kikuyu: Oo kanu waa ballankii uu inoogu ballanqaaday oo ah nolosha weligeed ah.
english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

kikuyu: Waxaan idiin soo qoray waxyaalahan ku saabsan kuwa idin khiyaanaynaya.
english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

kikuyu: Subkidda aad ka hesheen isaga way idinku sii jirtaa; oo uma baahnidin in cidina wax idin barto; laakiin sida subkiddiisu wax walba idiin barto, oo ay run u tahay, beenna aanay u ahayn, waa inaad siday wax idiin bartay ugu sii jirtaan.
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

kikuyu: Oo imminka, carruurtiiyey, ku sii jira isaga; in kolkuu muuqdo aynu kalsoonaan doonno oo aynaan wakhtiga imaatinkiisa ka xishoonin inaynu hor tagno.
english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

kikuyu: Haddaad og tihiin inuu xaq yahay, waxaad weliba ogaataan in mid walba oo xaqnimo falaa uu isaga ka dhashay.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

kikuyu: Bal ogaada siduu yahay jacaylka Aabbuhu ina siiyey, taasoo ah in laynoogu yeedho carruurta Ilaah, oo saasaynu nahay. Sidaa aawadeed dunidu ina garan mayso, maxaa yeelay, isagaba ma ay garanaynin.
english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, imminka waxaynu nahay carruurta Ilaah; oo weli waxaynu noqon doonno lama muujin, laakiin waxaynu og nahay in goortuu muuqdo aynu noqon doonno sidiisa oo kale, waayo, waynu arki doonnaa isaga siduu yahay.
english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

kikuyu: Oo mid kasta oo waxyaalahaas ka rajeeyaa isaga, naftiisuu daahiriyaa siduu isaguba daahir u yahay.
english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

kikuyu: Kii kasta oo dembi falaa wuxuu falaa caasinimo; oo dembigu wuxuu yahay caasinimo.
english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

kikuyu: Oo idinku waad og tihiin in isagu u muuqday inuu dembiyadeenna inaga qaado, oo isagu dembi ma leh.
english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii isaga ku sii jiraa, ma dembaabo; ku alla kii dembaabaa ma uu arkin isaga, oo weliba ma yaqaan isaga.
english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

kikuyu: Carruurtiiyey, yaan cidi idin khiyaanayn; kii xaqnimo falaa waa xaq siduu isaguba xaq u yahay.
english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

kikuyu: Kii dembi falaa wuxuu yahay kan Ibliiska; oo Ibliisku tan iyo bilowgii ayuu dembaabayay. Taas aawadeed ayuu Wiilka Ilaah u muuqday inuu baabbi'iyo shuqullada Ibliiska.
english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii Ilaah ka dhashay dembi ma falo; maxaa yeelay, Ilaah dabiicaddiisu way ku sii jirtaa isaga; oo ma dembaabi karo, waayo, wuxuu ka dhashay Ilaah.
english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

kikuyu: Tan ayay carruurta Ilaah iyo carruurta Ibliisku ku kala muuqdaan; ku alla kii aan xaqnimo falin ma aha kan Ilaah, oo waxaa la mid ah kan aan walaalkii jeclayn.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

kikuyu: Oo kanu waa warkii aad tan iyo bilowgii maqlayseen, kaasoo ah inaynu isjeclaanno,
english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

kikuyu: oo aynaan ahaanin sida Qaabiil oo ahaa kan sharka leh oo walaalkii dilay. Oo muxuu u dilay? Waayo, shuqulladiisu waxay ahaayeen shar, oo kuwii walaalkiisna xaq bay ahaayeen.
english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

kikuyu: Walaalayaalow, ha la yaabina haddii ay dunidu idin neceb tahay.
english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

kikuyu: Waxaynu og nahay inaynu dhimashada ka soo gudubnay oo aynu u soo gudubnay nolosha, maxaa yeelay, walaalaha ayaynu jecel nahay. Oo ka aan walaalkii jeclayn, dhimashaduu ku sii hadhaa.
english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii walaalkii neceb waa dhiigqabe, oo idinkuna waad og tihiin inaanu dhiigqabena lahayn nolosha weligeed ah oo ku sii jiraysa.
english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

kikuyu: Taasaynu jacaylka ku garanaynaa, waayo, isagu naftiisuu u bixiyey aawadeen; oo innaguna waa inaynu nafteenna u bixinno walaalaheen.
english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

kikuyu: Laakiin kan leh xoolaha dunidan, oo arka walaalkiis oo baahan, oo qalbigiisa ka xidha, sidee baa jacaylka Ilaah ugu jiraa isaga?
english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

kikuyu: Carruurtaydiiyey, yeynan ku jeclaanin hadalka iyo afka toona, laakiin camalka iyo runta aan ku jeclaanno.
english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

kikuyu: Oo taasaynu ku garan doonnaa inaynu kuwa runta nahay, oo aynu isaga hortiisa qalbigeenna kaga dhiiro gelin doonnaa
english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

kikuyu: xagga wax alla wixii qalbigeennu inagu eedeeyo, maxaa yeelay, Ilaah waa ka weyn yahay qalbigeenna, oo wax walbaba wuu og yahay.
english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, haddii aan qalbigeennu ina eedayn, kalsoonaan ayaynu ku leennahay xagga Ilaah.
english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

kikuyu: Oo wax kastoo aynu ka barinno waynu ka helnaa, maxaa yeelay, qaynuunnadiisa ayaynu xajinnaa, oo waxaynu falnaa waxa isaga ka farxiya.
english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

kikuyu: Oo kanu waa qaynuunkiisa, kaasoo ah inaynu rumaysanno magaca Wiilkiisa Ciise Masiix ah, oo aynu isjeclaanno, siduu qaynuunka inoo siiyey.
english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

kikuyu: Oo kii xajiya qaynuunnadiisa, wuu ku sii jiraa isaga, isaguna wuu ku sii jiraa. Oo saasaynu ku garanaynaa inuu isagu inagu sii jiro xagga Ruuxa uu ina siiyey.
english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, ha rumaysanina ruux walba, laakiin ruuxyada tijaabiya si aad u hubsataan inay kuwa Ilaah yihiin; waayo, nebiyo badan oo been ah ayaa u soo baxay dunida.
english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

kikuyu: Taasaad ku garanaysaan Ruuxa Ilaah; ruux walba oo qirta in Ciise Masiix jidh ku yimid, waa ku Ilaah.
english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

kikuyu: Oo ruux walba oo aan qiran Ciise Masiix ku Ilaah ma aha; oo kanuna waa ruuxa kan Masiixa ka geesta ah oo aad maqasheen inuu imanayo, imminkana duniduu ku jiraa.
english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

kikuyu: Carruurtiiyey, kuwa Ilaah baad tihiin, oo iyagaad ka adkaateen; maxaa yeelay, Ka idinku jira ayaa ka weyn ka dunida ku jira.
english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

kikuyu: Iyagu waa kuwa dunida; oo taas aawadeed waxay ka hadlaan waxa dunida, oo duniduna way maqashaa.
english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

kikuyu: Innaguna kuwa Ilaah baynu nahay; ka Ilaah yaqaan waa ina maqlaa; oo ka aan kan Ilaah ahaynna inama maqlo. Taasaynu ku garanaynaa ruuxa runta ah iyo ruuxa qaladka ah.
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, aynu isjeclaanno; waayo, Ilaah baa leh jacaylka; oo mid walba oo jecel, wuxuu ka dhashay Ilaah, Ilaah buuna yaqaan.
english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

kikuyu: Oo ka aan jeclaynina Ilaah ma yaqaan; waayo, Ilaah waa jacayl.
english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

kikuyu: Ilaah baa Wiilkiisa keliya oo dhashay dunida u soo diray si aynu ugu noolaanno isaga, oo taasaa jacaylka Ilaah laynoogu muujiyey.
english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

kikuyu: Oo taas jacayl baa ku jira, mana aha inaynu Ilaah jeclayn, laakiinse isagaa ina jeclaaday, oo wuxuu Wiilkiisa u soo diray si uu kafaaraggudka dembiyadeenna u noqdo.
english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, haddii Ilaah sidaa inoo jeclaaday, waa inaynu isjeclaanno.
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

kikuyu: Cidina Ilaah ma arkin marnaba. Haddii aynu isjeclaanno, Ilaah wuu inagu jiraa, oo jacaylkiisu wuu inagu dhan yahay.
english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

kikuyu: Ruuxiisuu ina siiyey oo taasaynu ku garanaynaa inaynu ku sii jirno isaga, isaguna inagu sii jiro.
english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

kikuyu: Innagu waynu aragnay oo waxaynu markhaati u furaynaa in Aabbuhu Wiilka soo diray si uu Badbaadiyaha dunida u noqdo.
english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii qirta inuu Ciise yahay Wiilka Ilaah, Ilaah baa ku sii jira isaga, isaguna wuu ku sii jiraa Ilaah.
english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

kikuyu: Oo innaguna waan garanaynaa oo waan rumaysan nahay jacaylka Ilaah inoo qabo. Ilaah waa jacayl; oo kii ku sii jiraa jacaylka, Ilaah buu ku sii jiraa, Ilaahna isaguu ku sii jiraa.
english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

kikuyu: Taasaa jacaylku kaamil inoogu noqday si aynu kalsoonaan u lahaanno maalinta xisaabta; maxaa yeelay, siduu isagu yahay ayaynu innaguna dunidan ku nahay.
english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

kikuyu: Jacaylku baqdin ma leh, laakiin jacaylka kaamilka ahi baqdinta dibadduu u saaraa, waayo, baqdintu ciqaab bay leedahay. Oo kii baqaana kaamil kuma noqdo jacaylka.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

kikuyu: Waynu jecel nahay isaga, waayo, isagaa hore inoo jeclaaday.
english: We love him, because he first loved us.

kikuyu: Haddii qof yidhaahdo, Ilaah waan jeclahay, oo uu walaalkiis neceb yahay, waa beenaaleh, maxaa yeelay, kan aan jeclayn walaalkii uu arko sidee buu u jeclaan karaa Ilaaha uusan arag?
english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

kikuyu: Oo waxaynu isaga ka haysannaa qaynuunkan, kaas oo ah, Kii Ilaah jecel, walaalkiina ha jeclaado.
english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii rumaysta inuu Ciise yahay Masiixa, Ilaah buu ka dhashay; oo ku alla kii jecel kan dhalay, kan isaga ka dhashayna wuu jecel yahay.
english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

kikuyu: Taasaynu ku garanaynaa inaynu carruurta Ilaah jecel nahay, goortaynu Ilaah jeclaanno oo qaynuunnadiisa xajinno.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

kikuyu: Waa kan jacaylka Ilaah, kaasoo ah inaynu qaynuunnadiisa xajinno; oo qaynuunnadiisuna ma cusla.
english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

kikuyu: Ku alla kii ka dhashay Ilaah, wuxuu ka adkaadaa dunida, oo waxaa libta ka adkaata dunida ah rumaysadkeenna.
english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

kikuyu: Waa ayo kan dunida ka adkaadaa, kan rumaystaa inuu Ciise yahay Wiilka Ilaah mooyaane?
english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

kikuyu: Kanu waa kii biyo iyo dhiig ku yimid, oo ah Ciise Masiix; biyo keliya kuma iman, laakiin wuxuu ku yimid biyo iyo dhiig.
english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

kikuyu: Oo waa Ruuxa kan maragga furaa, waayo, Ruuxa waa runta.
english: For there are three who testify:

kikuyu: Waxaa jira saddex marag fura; waana Ruuxa iyo biyaha iyo dhiigga, oo saddexdaasuna waa isku mid.
english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

kikuyu: Haddii aynu maragfurka dadka aqbali lahayn, maragfurka Ilaah baa ka weyn, waayo, maragfurka Ilaah waa kan oo ah inuu Wiilkiisa ka marag furay.
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

kikuyu: Ka Wiilka Ilaah rumaystaa maragguu ku haystaa nafsaddiisa, kii aan Ilaah rumaysanna, wuxuu isaga ka dhigay beenaaleh; maxaa yeelay, wuxuusan rumaysan maraggii uu Ilaah ka marag furay Wiilkiisa.
english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

kikuyu: Maragguna waa kan, kaas oo ah in Ilaah ina siiyey nolosha weligeed ah, oo ay noloshanu Wiilkiisa ku jirto.
english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

kikuyu: Kan Wiilka haystaa, noloshuu leeyahay. Kii aan Wiilka Ilaah haysanna nolosha ma leh.
english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

kikuyu: Waxyaalahan waxaan idiinku soo qoray, idinka oo rumaystay magaca Wiilka Ilaah, si aad u ogaataan inaad nolosha weligeed ah leedihiin.
english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

kikuyu: Oo tanu waa kalsoonaanta aynu isaga u qabno, taasoo ah haddaynu wax uun doonistiisa ku barinno, isagu wuu ina maqlaa,
english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

kikuyu: oo haddaynu og nahay inuu inaga maqlo wax alla wixii aynu ka barinno, waxaynu og nahay inaynu leennahay waxyaalihii aynu isaga ka barinnay.
