english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

kikuyu: Haddii qof uun arko walaalkii oo samaynaya dembi aan xagga dhimashada ahayn, waa inuu Ilaah baryo; isaguna noloshuu siin doonaa kuwa samaynaya dembi aan xagga dhimashada ahayn. Waxaa jira dembi xagga dhimashada ah. Oo anigu odhan maayo, Kaas ha ka tukado.
english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

kikuyu: Xaqdarrada oo dhammu waa dembi; oo waxaa jira dembi aan xagga dhimashada ahayn.
english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

kikuyu: Waan og nahay in ku alla kii Ilaah ka dhashay aanu dembaabin. Maxaa yeelay, kii ka dhashay Ilaah naftiisuu ilaaliyaa, oo ka sharka lihina ma taabto.
english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

kikuyu: Waxaynu og nahay inaynu kuwa Ilaah nahay, oo ay dunida oo dhammuna ku jirto gacanta ka sharka leh.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

kikuyu: Waxaynu og nahay in Wiilka Ilaah yimid, oo wuxuu ina siiyey garasho si aynu ugu garanno kan runta ah; innaguna waa ku jirnaa kan runta ah, oo ah Wiilkiisa ee Ciise Masiix ah. Kanu waa Ilaaha runta ah iyo nolosha weligeed ah.
english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

kikuyu: Carruurtiiyey, sanamyada iska ilaaliya.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

kikuyu: Anigoo odayga ah waxaan salaamayaa marwada la doortay iyo carruurteeda aan runta ku jeclahay, keligayna ma ahaye, laakiin xataa waxaa jecel kuwa runta yaqaan oo dhan,
english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

kikuyu: runta inagu dhex jirta, weligeedna inagu dhex jiri doonta aawadeed.
english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

kikuyu: Nimco iyo naxariis iyo nabad ka yimaada Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Ciise Masiix oo ah Wiilka Aabbaha ayaa inala jiri doona xagga runta iyo jacaylka.
english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

kikuyu: Aad baan ugu farxay markaan arkay carruurtaadii qaarkood oo runta ku socda, waana sidaynu Aabbaha amar uga helnay.
english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

kikuyu: Oo haatan waxaan kaa baryayaa, murwoy, sidii anigoo aan kuu soo qorayn amar cusub laakiinse kii aynu tan iyo bilowgii haysannay, kaasoo ah inaynu isjeclaanno.
english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

kikuyu: Tanu waa jacayl inaynu amarradiisa ku soconno. Amarkiina waa kan, waana sidaad tan iyo bilowgii u maqli jirteen inaad ku socotaan.
english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

kikuyu: Waayo, khaa'inno badan baa dunida u soo baxay, waana kuwa aan qiran in Ciise Masiix jidh ku yimid. Kaasu waa khaa'inka iyo ku Masiixa ka gees ah.
english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

kikuyu: Iska jira si aydnaan u khasaarayn wixii aynu falnay, laakiinse si aad abaalgud dhan u heshaan.
english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

kikuyu: Mid kasta oo dhaafa oo aan cilmiga Masiixa ku sii socon, kaasu Ilaah ma leh; laakiin kii cilmiga ku sii socdaa, Aabbaha iyo Wiilka labadaba wuu leeyahay.
english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

kikuyu: Haddii nin idiin yimaado oo uusan cilmigan idiin keenin, gurigiinna ha soo gelinina, hana salaamina,
english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

kikuyu: waayo, kii salaamaa, wuxuu ka qayb galaa shuqulladiisa sharka ah.
english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

kikuyu: In kastoo aan hayo wax badan oo aan idiin soo qoro, ma aan jeclayn inaan warqad iyo khad idiinku soo qoro; laakiinse waxaan rajaynayaa inaan idiin imaado oo aan afkayga idinkula hadlo, si ay farxaddiinnu u buuxsanto.
english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

kikuyu: Carruurtii walaashaada la doortay way ku soo salaamayaan.
english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

kikuyu: Anigoo odayga ah waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa gacaliye Gayos oo aan runta ku jeclahay.
english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

kikuyu: Gacaliyow, waxaan kuugu duceeyaa inaad wax kasta ku liibaantid oo aad caafimaad qabtid siday naftaadu u liibaansan tahay.
english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

kikuyu: Waayo, aad baan ugu farxay markii walaalo yimaadeen oo ka markhaati fureen runtaada iyo sidaad runta ugu socotid.
english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

kikuyu: Ma lihi farxad tan iiga weyn inaan maqlo in carruurtaydu ay runta ku socdaan.
english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

kikuyu: Gacaliyow, aaminnimaad ku samaysaa shuqul kasta oo aad u samaysid walaalaha iyo shisheeyahaba.
english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

kikuyu: Iyagu jacaylkaagay kiniisadda horteeda kaga markhaati fureen. Wanaag baad samayn lahayd haddii aad iyaga u ambabbixisid sida Ilaah istaahilo;
english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

kikuyu: maxaa yeelay, magiciisa aawadiis ayay u ambabbexeen iyagoo aan waxba ka qaadan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn.
english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaa inagu waajib ah inaynu kuwaas oo kale soo dhowayno, si aynu u noqonno kuwa runta kala wada shaqeeya iyaga.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

kikuyu: Wax baan kiniisadda u soo qoray, laakiinse Diyotrefees oo jecel inuu iyaga ka sarreeyo, na aqbali maayo.
english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed, haddaan imaado, waxaan xusuusin doonaa shuqulladiisa uu sameeyo isagoo hadallo xunxun nagu shubaya. Taasu kuma filla isaga, mana aqbalo walaalaha, kuwii aqbali lahaana wuu u diidaa, kiniisaddana wuu ka eryaa.
english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

kikuyu: Gacaliyow, ha ku dayan waxa sharka ah, laakiinse ku dayo waxa wanaagsan. Ka samafalaa waa ku Ilaah, ka shar falaase Ilaah ma uu arkin.
english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

kikuyu: Dadka oo dhammu way u markhaati furaan Deemeetriyos, runta qudheedu way u markhaati furtaa, annaguna waannu u markhaati furnaa, waanad og tahay in markhaatifurkayagu run yahay.
english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

kikuyu: Waxaan hayay waxyaalo badan oo aan kuu soo qoro, laakiinse dooni maayo inaan qalin iyo khad kuugu soo qoro.
english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

kikuyu: Laakiin waxaan rajaynayaa inaan dhowaan ku arko, oo aynu afkeenna iskula hadli doonno.
english: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

kikuyu: Anigoo Yuudas ah oo ah addoonkii Ciise Masiix, Yacquubna walaalkiis ah, waxaan warqaddan u qorayaa kuwa loo yeedhay oo Ilaaha Aabbaha ahu jecel yahay, Ciise Masiixna loo dhawray.
english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: Naxariis iyo nabad iyo jacayl ha idiin bateen.
english: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

kikuyu: Gacaliyayaalow, intaan aad u dadaalayay inaan idiin soo qoro wax ku saabsan badbaadada inaga dhexaysa, waxaa dirqi igu noqday inaan idiin soo qoro oo aan idinku waaniyo inaad aad ugu dadaashaan iimaankii mar la wada siiyey quduusiinta oo dhan.
english: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

kikuyu: Waayo, waxaa jira niman qarsoodi idiinku soo galay, waana kuwii waa hore xukunkan loo qoray, oo ah kuwa aan cibaadada lahayn, oo nimcada Ilaaheenna ku beddela nijaas, oo inkira Ciise Masiix oo ah Sayidkeenna iyo Rabbigeenna keliya.
english: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Hadda, in kastoo aad hore u tiqiineen wax kasta, waxaan jeclahay inaan idin xusuusiyo sidii Rabbigu dad uga badbaadiyey dalka Masar, dabadeedna u baabbi'iyey kuwii aan rumaysan isaga;
english: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.

kikuyu: oo malaa'igihii aan dhawrin madaxtinimadoodii, laakiinse rugtoodii ka tegey, wuxuu ilaa xukunka maalinta weyn ku hayaa silsilado weligood ah iyagoo gudcur ku hoos jira.
english: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

kikuyu: Si la mid ah Sodom iyo Gomora iyo magaalooyinkii kale ee ku wareegsanaa oo sinaystay oo jidh kale uga daba orday, ayaa masaal laga dhigay, iyagoo ciqaabta dabka weligiis ah ku silcaya.
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

kikuyu: Weliba kuwan riyooda sidaas oo kalay jidhkooda u nijaaseeyaan, sayidnimadana u nacaan, oo kuwa derejada leh u caayaan.
english: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

kikuyu: Laakiin Mikaa'iil oo ah malagga sare markuu Ibliiska kula murmayay meydkii Muuse aawadiis, kuma uu dhicin inuu xukun cay ah ku xukumo, laakiinse wuxuu ku yidhi, Rabbigu ha ku canaanto.
english: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”

kikuyu: Laakiin kuwanu wax kastoo ayan garanaynba way caayaan, oo waxay ku baabba'aan waxay abuuristooda ku garanayaan sida xayawaanka aan caqliga lahayn.
english: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.

kikuyu: Waa u hoog iyaga, waayo, waxay raaceen jidkii Qaabiil, oo faa'iido aawadeed ayay Balcaam qaladkiisii ugu yaaceen, oo waxay ku halligmeen fallaagadii Qorax.
english: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa dhagaxyo qarsoon oo ku dhex jira cashooyinkiinna jacaylka markay idinla faysteeyaan iyagoo aan cabsanaynin; waxayna yihiin adhijirro naftooda jira, iyo daruuro aan biyo lahayn oo dabaylo kaxeeyaan, iyo geedo jiilaal oo aan midho lahayn, oo laba goor dhintay, oo la rujiyey;
english: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

kikuyu: iyo hirar kacsan oo badda, oo ceebtoodu xumbaynayso, iyo xiddigo ambaday, oo madowga gudcurka weligood loo hayaa.
english: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

kikuyu: Enoog oo ahaa farcankii toddobaad oo Aadan isna kuwanuu wax ka sii sheegay isagoo leh, Bal eega, Rabbigu wuxuu yimid isagoo wata quduusiintiisii aan tirada lahayn,
english: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

kikuyu: inuu xukun ku soo dejiyo kulli, iyo inuu kuwa aan cibaadada lahayn oo dhan ku caddeeyo shuqulladoodii cibaadola'aanta ahaa oo ay cibaadola'aanta ku sameeyeen, iyo waxyaalihii adkaa oo dhan oo ay dembilayaasha aan cibaadada lahaynu isaga ka sheegeen.
english: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa kuwa gunuunaca, oo cawda, oo damacyadooda xaaraanta ah ka daba orda, afkooduna wuxuu ku hadlaa hadallo isweyneyn ah, dadkana way u kala eexdaan inay faa'iido helaan aawadeed.
english: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

kikuyu: Laakiinse idinku, gacaliyayaalow, xusuusta hadalladii rasuulladii Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ay hore idinkula hadleen.
english: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waxay idinku yidhaahdeen, Ugu dambaysta waxaa jiri doona kuwa wax ku majaajilooda, oo daba socda damacyadooda aan cibaadada lahayn.
english: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”

kikuyu: Kuwanu waa kuwa dadka kala erya, oo nafta dunida u nool iyagoo aan Ruuxa lahayn.
english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

kikuyu: Laakiinse, gacaliyayaalow, nafsaddiinna ku dul dhisa rumaysadkiinna aad quduuska u ah, oo Ruuxa Quduuska ah ku tukada,
english: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: nafsaddiinna ku haya jacaylka Ilaah, idinkoo sugaya naxariista Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix oo idin geeynaysa nolosha weligeed ah.
english: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

kikuyu: Kuwa shakisan u naxariista;
english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

kikuyu: qaarna dabka ka dhufta oo badbaadiya, qaarna u naxariista idinkoo cabsanaya oo nacaya xataa dharka jiidhka ku wasakhoobay.
english: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

kikuyu: Oo kan kara inuu turunturada idinka ilaaliyo oo uu ammaantiisa idin hor taago, idinkoo aan iin lahayn oo aad u faraxsan,
english: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

kikuyu: isagoo ah Ilaaha keligiis ah oo Badbaadiyeheenna ah, ammaan iyo weynaan iyo xoog iyo amar ha u ahaadeen xagga Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, wakhtiga oo dhan ka hor iyo haatan iyo weligeedba. Aamiin.
english: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Tanu waa muujintii Ciise Masiix oo Ilaah isaga siiyey inuu tuso addoommadiisa waxyaalaha waajibka ah inay dhowaan dhacaan. Oo isagu wuxuu taas tusay addoonkiisii Yooxanaa isagoo malaa'igtiisa u soo diraya isaga,
english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

kikuyu: kaasoo ka markhaati furay erayga Ilaah iyo markhaatifuridda Ciise Masiix, iyo wixii uu isagu arkay oo dhan.
english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

kikuyu: Waxaa barakaysan ka akhriya iyo kuwa maqla erayadii wax sii sheegidda, oo xajiya waxyaalaha ku qoran, waayo, wakhtigii wuu dhow yahay.
english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

kikuyu: Anigoo Yooxanaa ah waxaan waxyaalahan u soo qorayaa toddobada kiniisadood oo Aasiya ku yaal. Nimco iyo nabadu ha idiinka yimaadeen kan jira oo jiray oo iman doona, iyo xagga toddobada ruux oo carshigiisa hor jooga,
english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

kikuyu: iyo xagga Ciise Masiix oo ah markhaatiga aaminka ah, iyo curadka kuwii dhintay, iyo amiirka boqorrada dhulka. Kan ina jecel oo dembiyadeenna dhiiggiisa inagaga furay,
english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

kikuyu: oo boqortooyo inaga dhigay inaynu wadaaddo u ahaanno Ilaaha ah Aabbihiis, isaga ammaanu ha u ahaato iyo dowladnimo weligiis iyo weligiisba. Aamiin.
english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Bal eega, wuxuu la imanayaa daruuraha, oo waxaa isaga arki doona il kasta iyo kuwii isaga wareemay; oo qabiilooyinka dhulka oo dhammuna isagay u barooran doonaan. Haah, saas ha ahaato. Aamiin.
english: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

kikuyu: Rabbiga Ilaaha ahu wuxuu leeyahay, Anigu waxaan ahay Alfa iyo Oomeega, oo ah kan jira oo jiray oo iman doona, iyo Qaadirka.
english: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

kikuyu: Anigoo Yooxanaa ah oo walaalkiin ah iyo mid idinkala qayb galay dhibaatada iyo boqortooyada iyo dulqaadashada ku jira Ciise, waxaan gasiiradda Batmos la yidhaahdo u joogay erayga Ilaah iyo u markhaatifuridda Ciise aawadood.
english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Maalintii Rabbiga waxaan ku jiray Ruuxa, oo waxaan meel iga dambaysa ka maqlay cod weyn oo ah sidii buun oo leh,
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

kikuyu: Wixii aad aragtid buug ku qor, oo waxaad u sii dirtaa toddobada kiniisadood; kuwaas oo ah tan Efesos, iyo tan Simurna, iyo tan Bergamos, iyo tan Tu'ateyra, iyo tan Sardis, iyo tan Filadelfiya, iyo tan La'odikiya.
english: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

kikuyu: Oo anna dib baan u jeestay inaan arko codkii ila hadlay, oo markii aan dib u jeestay waxaan arkay toddoba laambadood oo dahab ah.
english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

kikuyu: Oo laambadaha badhtankooda waxaan ku arkay mid u eg bini-aadan oo qaba khamiis dheer, oo laabtana waxaa ugu xidhnaa suun dahab ah.
english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

kikuyu: Oo madaxiisa iyo timihiisuna waxay u caddaayeen sida suuf cad iyo sida baraf oo kale; oo indhihiisuna waxay ahaayeen sida dab ololkiis,
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

kikuyu: oo cagihiisuna waxay u ekaayeen naxaas dhalaalaysa sidii iyadoo foorno lagu safeeyey, codkiisuna wuxuu u ekaa codka biyo badan.
english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

kikuyu: Oo gacantiisa midigtaana wuxuu ku haystay toddoba xiddigood, oo afkiisana waxaa ka soo baxay seef soofaysan oo laba af leh, jaahiisuna wuxuu u ekaa qorraxda oo xoog u dhalaalaysa.
english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

kikuyu: Oo markii aan arkay ayaan ku hor dhacay sidii mid dhintay. Oo markaasuu gacantiisii midigta ahayd i saaray, oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Ha cabsan. Anigu waxaan ahay kan ugu horreeyey iyo kan ugu dambeeya,
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

kikuyu: iyo kan nool. Anigu waan dhintay, oo bal eeg, waan noolahay tan iyo weligayba, oo waxaan haystaa furayaasha dhimashada iyo Haadees.
english: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

kikuyu: Haddaba waxaad qortaa waxyaalahaad aragtay iyo waxyaalaha hadda jira iyo waxyaalaha hadda ka dib dhici doona.
english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

kikuyu: Toddobada xiddigood oo aad ku aragtay gacantayda midigtaa iyo toddobada laambadood oo dahabka ah qarsoodigooda micnihiisu waxaa weeye sidan, toddobada xiddigood waxaa weeyaan malaa'igaha toddobada kiniisadood, toddobada laambadoodna waxaa weeyaan toddobada kiniisadood.
english: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.

kikuyu: Kiniisadda Efesos ku taal malaa'igteeda waxaad u qortaa: Kan toddobada xiddigood gacantiisa midigtaa ku haystaa oo toddobada laambadood oo dahabka badhtankooda ku socdaa wuxuu kugu leeyahay waxyaalahan,
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:

kikuyu: Waan ogahay shuqulladaada, iyo hawshaada, iyo dulqaadashadaada, iyo inaadan u adkaysan karin kuwa sharka ah, iyo inaad tijaabisay kuwa rasuullada isku sheega iyagoo aan ahayn, oo waxaad ogaatay inay been yihiin.
english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

kikuyu: Waad dulqaadataa, oo dhib baad ugu adkaysatay magacayga aawadiis, kamana aad daalin.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.

kikuyu: Laakiin wax baan kuu haystaa, waayo, jacaylkaagii hore waad ka tagtay.
english: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

kikuyu: Haddaba xusuuso meeshii aad ka dhacday, oo toobadkeen, oo shuqulladaadii hore samee; haddii kalese anigu waan kuu iman doonaa oo laambaddaada waan ka qaadi doonaa meesheeda haddii aadan toobadkeenin.
english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.

kikuyu: Laakiinse tan aad leedahay, waxaad neceb tahay dadka Nikolas raaca shuqulladooda oo aan aniguna necbahay.
english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

kikuyu: Kii dheg lahu ha maqlo waxa Ruuxu ku leeyahay kiniisadaha. Kii guulaysta ayaa waxaan siin doonaa amar uu wax kaga cuno geedka nolosha oo ku dhex yaal Firdooska Ilaah.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

kikuyu: Kiniisadda Simurna ku taalna malaa'igteeda waxaad u qortaa; Kan ugu horreeyey oo ugu dambeeya, oo dhintay, oo soo noolaaday, wuxuu kugu leeyahay waxyaalahan,
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

kikuyu: Waan ogahay dhibaatadaada iyo faqiirnimadaada (laakiin taajir baad tahay), iyo cayda ay kugu caayaan kuwa Yuhuudda isku sheegaa oo aan ahayn, laakiinse ah kuwa sunagogga Shayddaanka.
english: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

kikuyu: Ha ka cabsan waxyaalaha aad dhowaan ku xanuunsan doontid. Bal eega, in laydin tijaabiyo aawadeed, Ibliisku qaarkiin buu dhowaan xabsi ku ridi doonaa, oo idinku intii toban maalmood ah waxaad heli doontaan dhibaato. Ilaa dhimashada aamin ahow, anna waxaan ku siin doonaa taajka nolosha.
english: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

kikuyu: Kii dheg lahu ha maqlo waxa Ruuxu ku leeyahay kiniisadaha. Kii guulaysta dhimashada labaad waxba yeeli mayso.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

kikuyu: Kiniisadda Bergamos ku taalna malaa'igteeda waxaad u qortaa; Kan haysta seefta soofaysan oo labada af leh wuxuu kugu leeyahay waxyaalahan,
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

kikuyu: Waan ogahay meeshaad deggan tahay inay tahay meesha carshiga Shayddaanku yaal; oo magacayga waad xajisaa, mana aad inkirin iimaankayga xataa waagii Antibas joogay, isagoo ahaa markhaatigaygii iyo kaygii aaminka ahaa oo dhexdiinna lagu dilay meesha Shayddaanku deggan yahay.
english: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

kikuyu: Laakiinse dhawr waxyaalood baan kuu haystaa, maxaa yeelay, halkaas waxaad ku haysataa kuwo xajiya waxbariddii Balcaam, kaas oo baray Baalaaq inuu reer binu Israa'iil hortooda ku tuuro dhagax lagu turunturoodo, inay cunaan waxyaalo sanamyo loo bixiyey iyo inay sinaystaan.
english: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

kikuyu: Weliba waxaad kaloo haysataa kuwo sidaas oo kale u xajiya waxbariddii dadka Nikolas raaca.
english: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed toobadkeena, haddii kalese dhaqsaan idiinku iman, oo waxaan iyaga kula diriri doonaa seefta afkayga.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

kikuyu: Kii dheg lahu ha maqlo waxa Ruuxu ku leeyahay kiniisadaha. Kii guulaysta waxaan wax ka siin doonaa maannada qarsoon, oo waxaan siin doonaa dhagax cad, dhagaxa dushiisana waxaa ku qoran magac cusub oo aan ninna aqoon, kan hela mooyaane.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

kikuyu: Kiniisadda Tu'ateyra ku taalna malaa'igteeda waxaad u qortaa; Wiilka Ilaah oo indhihiisu u eg yihiin dab ololkiis, cagihiisuna u eg yihiin naxaas dhalaalaysaa wuxuu kugu leeyahay waxyaalahan;
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

kikuyu: Waan ogahay shuqulladaada, iyo jacaylkaaga, iyo rumaysadkaaga, iyo adeegiddaada, iyo samirkaaga, iyo inay shuqulladaadii dambe ka sii badan yihiin kuwaagii hore.
english: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

kikuyu: Laakiinse wax baan kuu haystaa, waayo, waxaad oggoshahay naagta Yesebeel la yidhaahdo oo nebiyad isku sheegta; oo waxay addoommadayda bartaa oo ku sasabtaa inay sinaystaan oo ay cunaan waxyaalo sanamyo loo bixiyey.
english: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan iyada siiyey wakhti ay ku toobadkeento, iyaduse dooni mayso inay ka toobadkeento sinadeeda.
english: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, haddaba iyada sariir baan ku dul tuurayaa, oo kuwii iyada la sinaystana waxaan ku dhex tuurayaa dhibaato weyn, haddii ayan ka toobadkeenin shuqulladeeda.
english: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan carruurteeda ku dili doonaa dhimasho, kiniisadaha oo dhammuna waxay ogaan doonaan inaan ahay kan baadhbaadha kelyaha iyo qalbiyada, oo anna midkiin walbaba waxaan wax u siin doonaa sida shuqulladiinnu yihiin.
english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

kikuyu: Laakiinse intiinna kale oo Tu'ateyra joogta, in alla intiinna aan waxbariddan haysan, oo sida ay iyagu yidhaahdaan, aan aqoon waxyaalaha moolka dheer oo Shayddaanka, idinka waxaan idinku leeyahay, Dushiinna culaab kale saari maayo.
english: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

kikuyu: Habase yeeshee waxa aad haysataan xajiya ilaa aan imaado.
english: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

kikuyu: Kii guulaysta oo shuqulladayda sii xajiya tan iyo ugu dambaysta, waxaan siin doonaa amar uu ku xukumo quruumaha.
english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

kikuyu: Oo wuxuu ku xukumi doonaa ul bir ah, sida weelasha dheriyasameeyuhu ay u burburaan; sida aan aniguba Aabbahay uga helay:
english: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;

kikuyu: oo weliba waxaan siin doonaa xiddigta waaberi.
english: and I will give him the morning star.

kikuyu: Kii dheg lahu ha maqlo waxa Ruuxu ku leeyahay kiniisadaha.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

kikuyu: Kiniisadda Sardis ku taalna malaa'igteeda waxaad u qortaa; Kan haysta toddobada Ruux oo Ilaah iyo toddobada xiddigood, wuxuu kugu leeyahay waxyaalahan: Waan ogahay shuqulladaada, oo magac baad leedahay sida wax nool, laakiinse meyd baad tahay.
english: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

kikuyu: Haddaba soo jeed, oo adkee waxyaalaha kuu hadhay oo dhimashada ku dhow; waayo, shuqulladaadii ma aan helin iyagoo kaamil ku ah Ilaahayga hortiisa.
english: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

kikuyu: Haddaba sidaas daraaddeed xusuuso sidii aad u heshay oo aad u maqashay, oo xaji, oo toobadkeen. Laakiinse haddii aadan soo jeedin, waxaan u iman doonaa sida tuug oo kale, mana aad ogaan doontid saacadda aan kuu iman doono.
english: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

kikuyu: Laakiinse waxaad Sardis ku leedahay dhawr qof oo aan dharkooda nijaasayn; oo anigay ila socon doonaan iyagoo dhar cad qaba; maxaa yeelay, way istaahilaan.
english: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

kikuyu: Kii guulaystaa sidaasuu u xidhan doonaa dhar cad; oo anna sinaba magiciisa ugama tirtiri doono kitaabka nolosha, oo waxaan magiciisa ka qiran doonaa Aabbahay hortiisa iyo malaa'igihiisa hortooda.
english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

kikuyu: Kii dheg lahu ha maqlo waxa Ruuxu ku leeyahay kiniisadaha.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

kikuyu: Kiniisadda Filadelfiya ku taalna malaa'igteeda waxaad u qortaa; Kan quduuska ah, oo runta ah, oo furihii Daa'uud haysta, oo wuxuu furo aanu ninna xidhi karin, wuxuu xidhana aanu ninna furi karin, wuxuu kugu leeyahay waxyaalahan;
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

kikuyu: Waan ogahay shuqulladaada (oo bal eeg, waxaan hortaada dhigay albaab furan oo aanu ninna xidhi karin), waayo, waxaad leedahay waxoogaa xoog ah, oo eraygaygiina waad dhawrtay, oo magacaygiina ma aad inkirin.
english: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, kuwa isku sheega Yuhuud oo aan ahayn ee beenta sheegaya waxaan ka keeni doonaa sunagogga Shayddaanka, oo bal eeg, iyaga waxaan ka dhigi doonaa inay yimaadaan oo ay cagahaaga hortooda ku sujuudaan oo ay ogaadaan inaan anigu ku jeclahay.
english: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

kikuyu: Adigu waxaad dhawrtay ereygayga oo aad dulqaadatay, oo sidaas daraaddeed waxaan kaa dhawri doonaa saacadda jirrabaadda oo dhowaan u imanaysa dunida oo dhan inay jirrabto kuwa dhulka deggan.
english: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

kikuyu: Anigu dhaqsaan u imanayaa. Haddaba xaji waxaad haysatid si aan ninna taajkaaga kaaga qaadin.
english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

kikuyu: Kii guulaysta waxaan ka dhigi doonaa tiir ku jira macbudka Ilaahayga, halkaasna mar dambe kama bixi doono, oo waxaan dushiisa ku qori doonaa magaca Ilaahayga, iyo magaca magaalada Ilaahayga, taas oo ah Yeruusaalemta cusub, oo samada iyo xagga Ilaahayga ka soo degaysa, iyo xataa magacayga cusub.
english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

kikuyu: Kii dheg lahu ha maqlo waxa Ruuxu ku leeyahay kiniisadaha.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

kikuyu: Kiniisadda La'odikiya ku taalna malaa'igteeda waxaad u qortaa; Aamiin, oo ah markhaatiga aaminka ah oo runta ah, oo ah madaxa uunka Ilaah, wuxuu kugu leeyahay waxyaalahan;
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:

kikuyu: Waan ogahay shuqulladaada iyo inaadan qabow iyo kulayl midna ahayn. Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaad tahay qabow iyo kulayl midkood.
english: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

kikuyu: Haddaba waad diirran tahay, oo qabow iyo kulayl midna ma ihid, sidaas daraaddeed afkaygaan kaa tufi doonaa.
english: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

kikuyu: Waxaad tidhaahdaa, Taajir baan ahay, oo maal baan helay, oo waxba uma baahni, oo ma ogid inaad tahay tan belaysan, oo loo naxo, oo miskiinka ah, oo indhaha la', oo qaawan.
english: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxaan kugula talinayaa inaad iga iibsatid dahab dab lagu safeeyey, si aad taajir u noqotid, iyo dhar cad si aad u xidhatid oo aanay ceebta qaawanaantaadu u muuqan, iyo indhakuul aad indhaha marsatid si aad wax u aragtid.
english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

kikuyu: In alla inta aan jeclahay waan canaantaa oo edbiyaa, sidaas daraaddeed qiiro yeelo oo toobadkeen.
english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

kikuyu: Bal eeg, albaabkaan taaganahay oo garaacayaa; haddaba haddii nin codkayga maqlo oo albaabka iga furo, waan u soo gelayaa, oo waan la cashayn, isna wuu ila cashayn.
english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

kikuyu: Kii guulaysta, waxaan siin doonaa amar uu carshigayga igula fadhiisto, sida aan aniguba u guulaystay, oo aan Aabbahay ugula fadhiistay carshigiisa.
english: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

kikuyu: Kii dheg lahu ha maqlo waxa Ruuxu ku leeyahay kiniisadaha.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

kikuyu: Waxyaalahaas dabadeed kor baan eegay oo waxaan arkay albaab samada ka furmay, oo codkii ugu horreeyey oo aan maqlay sidii buun ila hadlaya oo kale, wuxuu igu yidhi, Halkan soo fuul oo waxaan ku tusi doonaa waxyaalaha waajibka ah inay hadda ka dib dhacaan.
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

kikuyu: Haddiiba waxaan ku jiray Ruuxa, oo bal eeg, waxaa jiray carshi samada qotoma, oo mid baa carshigii ku fadhiyey,
english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

kikuyu: oo kii fadhiyey midabkiisu wuxuu u ekaa dhagax yasbid iyo dhagax sardiyos, oo carshigana waxaa ku wareegsanaa qaansoroobaad midabkeedu u eg yahay dhagax sumurud.
english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

kikuyu: Oo carshigii hareerihiisana waxaa yiil afar iyo labaatan carshi oo kale; oo carshiyadii dushoodana waxaan ku arkay afar iyo labaatan oday oo ku fadhiya, oo dhar cad qaba; madaxana waxaa u saarnaa taajaj dahab ah.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

kikuyu: Oo carshigiina waxaa ka soo baxay hillaac iyo codad iyo onkod. Oo waxaa jiray toddoba laambadood oo dab ah oo carshiga hortiisa ka ololaya, kuwaas oo ah toddobada Ruux oo Ilaah.
english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

kikuyu: Oo carshigii hortiisana waxaa yiil wax la mid ah bad muraayad ah oo u eg madarad, oo carshiga badhtankiisa iyo carshiga hareerihiisa waxaa joogay afar xayawaan oo hor iyo dibba indho miidhan ah.
english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

kikuyu: Xayawaankii kowaad wuxuu u ekaa libaax, xayawaankii labaadna wuxuu u ekaa weyl, xayawaankii saddexaadna wuxuu lahaa weji u eg weji nin, xayawaankii afraadna wuxuu u ekaa gorgor duulaya.
english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

kikuyu: Oo afarta xayawaan mid waluba wuxuu lahaa lix baal, oo hareerahooda iyo gudahooduba waa indho miidhan; oo habeen iyo maalin midna ma nastaan, oo waxay yidhaahdaan, Quduus, quduus, quduus waxaa ah Rabbiga ah Ilaaha Qaadirka ah, oo jiray oo jira oo iman doona.
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

kikuyu: Oo marka xayawaanku ay ammaanaan oo ciseeyaan oo mahad u naqaan kan carshiga ku fadhiya oo ah kan nool weligiis iyo weligiis,
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

kikuyu: ayaa afar iyo labaatanka oday waxay ku hor dhici doonaan kan carshiga ku fadhiya, oo waxay caabudi doonaan kan nool weligiis iyo weligiis, oo taajajkoodana waxay ku tuuri doonaan carshiga hortiisa, iyagoo leh,
english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

kikuyu: Rabbigayagow, Ilaahayagow, adigu waad istaahishaa inaad heshid ammaanta iyo cisada iyo xoogga, waayo, wax kasta adaa abuuray, maxaa yeelay, doonistaada aawadeed ayay u ahaadeen oo u abuurmeen.
english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

kikuyu: Oo anna kii carshiga ku fadhiyey gacantiisa midigta waxaan ku arkay kitaab wax kaga qoran yihiin dul iyo hoosba, oo waxaa ku shaabadaysnaa toddoba shaabadood.
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan arkay malaa'ig xoog weyn oo ku naadinaysa cod weyn, oo leh, Bal yaa istaahila inuu kitaabka kala bixiyo oo uu furo shaabadihiisa?
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

kikuyu: Oo samada, iyo dhulka dushiisa, iyo dhulka hoostiisa laguma arag mid awooda inuu kitaabka kala bixiyo ama eego.
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

kikuyu: Oo markaasaan aad u ooyay, maxaa yeelay, lama helin mid istaahila inuu kitaabka kala bixiyo ama eego.
english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

kikuyu: Markaasaa odayaashii midkood wuxuu igu yidhi, Ha ooyin, bal eeg, Libaaxa qabiilka reer Yahuudah ka mid ah oo ah xididkii ka yimid Daa'uud ayaa wuxuu ku guulaystay inuu furo kitaabka iyo toddobadiisa shaabadoodba.
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

kikuyu: Oo carshiga badhtankiisii iyo afarta xayawaan iyo odayaasha badhtankoodii waxaan ku arkay Wan taagan oo ah sida mid la gowracay oo leh toddoba gees iyo toddoba indhood oo ah toddobada Ruux oo Ilaah, oo loo soo diray dunida oo dhan.
english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

kikuyu: Oo isna intuu yimid ayuu kitaabkii ka qaatay kii carshigii ku fadhiyey gacantiisii midigtaa.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

kikuyu: Oo markuu kitaabkii qaatay ayaa afartii xayawaan iyo afar iyo labaatankii odayba waxay ku dhaceen Wankii hortiisa iyagoo midkood waluba wato kataarad iyo fijaanno dahab ah oo foox ka buuxo oo ah baryadii quduusiinta.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

kikuyu: Oo waxay ku gabyeen gabay cusub iyagoo leh, Adigu waxaad istaahishaa inaad kitaabka qaadato oo aad shaabadihiisa furto; waayo, waa lagu gowracay, oo waxaad Ilaah dhiiggaaga ugu soo iibisay dad ah qabiil kasta iyo af kasta iyo dad kasta iyo quruun kasta,
english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

kikuyu: oo waxaad iyagii ka dhigtay inay Ilaaheenna u ahaadaan boqortooyo iyo wadaaddo; oo iyana dhulka ayay wax ku xukumi doonaan.
english: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

kikuyu: Oo anna carshigii iyo xayawaanadii iyo odayaasha hareerahoodii waxaan ku arkay oo ka maqlay malaa'igo badan codkood, oo tiradooduna waxay ahayd toban kun oo meelood oo min toban kun ah, iyo kumaan kun;
english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

kikuyu: oo waxay cod weyn ku lahaayeen, Istaahil waxaa ah Wankii la gowracay inuu helo xoog, iyo maal, iyo xigmad, iyo itaal, iyo ciso, iyo ammaan, iyo mahad.
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

kikuyu: Oo wax kasta oo la abuuray oo ku jira samada, iyo dhulka dushiisa, iyo dhulka hoostiisa, iyo badda gudaheeda, iyo waxyaalaha iyaga ku jira oo dhan, ayaa waxaan maqlay iyagoo leh, Kan carshiga ku fadhiya iyo Wanka ha u ahaadeen mahad, iyo ciso, iyo ammaan, iyo xoog, weligood iyo weligood.
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa afartii xayawaan waxay yidhaahdeen, Aamiin. Odayaashiina way dhaceen oo sujuudeen.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

kikuyu: Oo waan arkayay markii Wankii furay toddobadii shaabadood middood, oo waxaan maqlay afartii xayawaan midkood oo codkiisa la moodo onkod leh, Kaalay oo arag.
english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaan arkay faras cad oo kii fuushanaana wuxuu haystay qaanso, oo waxaa isaga la siiyey taaj; oo wuxuu soo baxay isagoo guulaysanaya, wuxuuna u soo baxay inuu guulaysto.
english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

kikuyu: Oo haddana markii uu furay shaabaddii labaad ayaa waxaan maqlay xayawaankii labaad oo leh, Kaalay oo arag.
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa soo baxay faras kale oo xamar ah; oo kii fuushanaana waxaa la siiyey amar inuu dunida nabadda ka qaado iyo in dadka midba midka kale dilo; oo waxaa la siiyey seef weyn.
english: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

kikuyu: Oo haddana markuu shaabadda saddexaad furay ayaa waxaan maqlay xayawaankii saddexaad oo leh, Kaalay oo arag. Oo bal eeg, waxaan arkay faras madow; oo kii fuushanaana wuxuu gacanta ku haystay miisaan.
english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan afartii xayawaan badhtankooda ka maqlay wax cod la moodo oo leh, Koombo sarreen ah qiimaheedu waa dinaar, saddex koombo oo shaciir ahna qiimahoodu waa dinaar, saliidda iyo khamrigana wax ha yeelin.
english: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

kikuyu: Oo haddana markuu furay shaabaddii afraad ayaa waxaan maqlay xayawaankii afraad codkiisii oo leh, Kaalay oo arag.
english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxaan arkay faras cirro leh; oo kii fuushanaana magiciisu wuxuu ahaa Dhimasho; oo waxaa la socday Haadees. Oo waxaa iyaga la siiyey amar ay ku xukumaan dunida waaxdeed oo ay ku laayaan seef, iyo abaar, iyo dhimasho, iyo dugaagga dhulka.
english: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

kikuyu: Oo haddana markuu furay shaabaddii shanaad waxaan meeshii allabariga hoosteeda ku arkay nafihii kuwii loo dilay eraygii Ilaah aawadiis, iyo markhaatigii ay fureen aawadiis,
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

kikuyu: oo iyana waxay ku dhawaaqeen cod weyn iyagoo leh, Sayidkayaga quduuskaa oo runtahow, ilaa goormaadan xukumayn oo aadan dhiigayaga nooga aarayn kuwa dhulka jooga?
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

kikuyu: Oo midkood kastaba waxaa la siiyey khamiis cad; oo waxaa loo sheegay inay wakhti yar sii nastaan ilamaa kuwa iyaga addoommada la ah iyo walaalahooda dhowaan sidoodii oo kale loo dili doono ay soo dhammaadaan.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaan arkay markii uu furay shaabaddii lixaad, markaasaa waxaa dhacay dhulgariir weyn; oo qorraxduna waxay u madoobaatay sidii joonyad dhogor ah, oo dayaxii oo dhammuna wuxuu noqday sidii dhiig oo kale;
english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

kikuyu: oo xiddigihii samaduna waxay ku soo daateen dhulka sida geed berde ahi u tuuro midhihiisa aan bislaan markii dabayl weyni ruxdo.
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

kikuyu: Oo samadiina waxaa loo qaaday sidii kitaab la duubay oo kale, oo buur walba iyo gasiirad walbaba meeshoodii waa laga dhaqaajiyey.
english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

kikuyu: Oo boqorradii dunida, iyo amiirrada, iyo saraakiisha sare, iyo taajiriinta, iyo kuwa xoogga weyn ah, iyo addoon kasta iyo mid kasta oo xor ahuba, waxay ku dhuunteen godadka iyo dhagaxyada buuraha;
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

kikuyu: oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen buurihii iyo dhagaxyadii, Nagu soo dhaca oo naga qariya kan carshiga ku fadhiya wejigiisa iyo cadhada Wanka,
english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

kikuyu: waayo, waxaa timid maalintii weynayd oo cadhadooda; bal yaa awooda inuu istaago?
english: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

kikuyu: Taas dabadeed waxaan arkay afar malaa'igood oo taagan afarta gees oo dhulka, oo xajinaya afarta dabaylood, si aan dabaylu ugu dhicin dhulka ama badda ama dhirta.
english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

kikuyu: Oo waxaan arkay malaa'ig kale oo ka soo baxaysa qorrax ka soo baxa oo haysata shaabadda Ilaaha nool; oo cod weyn bay ugu dhawaaqday afartii malaa'igood oo amarka lagu siiyey inay wax yeelaan dhulka iyo badda, oo waxay ku tidhi,
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

kikuyu: Waxba ha yeelina dhulka iyo badda iyo dhirta toona, jeer aannu addoommada Ilaahayaga wejiga ka shaabadayno.
english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

kikuyu: Oo waxaan maqlay intoodii la shaabadeeyey tiradoodii, waxayna ahaayeen boqol iyo afar iyo afartan kun oo intaasaa laga shaabadeeyey qabiilooyinka reer binu Israa'iil oo dhan.
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Yahuudah waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun; Qabiilka reer Ruubeenna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun; Qabiilka reer Gaadna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun;
english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Aasheerna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun; Qabiilka reer Naftaalina waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun; Qabiilka reer Manasehna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun;
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Simecoonna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun; Qabiilka reer Laawina waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun; Qabiilka reer Isaakaarna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun;
english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

kikuyu: Qabiilka reer Sebulunna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun; Qabiilka reer Yuusufna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun; Qabiilka reer Benyaamiinna waxaa laga shaabadeeyey laba iyo toban kun.
english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

kikuyu: Oo bal eeg, waxyaalahaas ka dib waxaan arkay dad faro badan, oo aan ninna tirin karin, oo lagala soo baxay quruun kasta, iyo qabiil kasta, iyo dad kasta, iyo af kasta, oo taagan carshiga hortiisa iyo Wanka hortiisa, iyagoo qaba khamiisyo cadcad, gacmahana ku haysta caleemo timireed.
english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay ku dhawaaqeen cod weyn, iyagoo leh, Badbaado waxaa leh Ilaahayaga carshiga ku fadhiya iyo Wanka.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

kikuyu: Oo malaa'igihii oo dhammuna waxay taagnaayeen carshiga hareerihiisa iyo odayaashii iyo afartii xayawaan hareerahooda; oo carshiga hortiisii ayay ku dhaceen oo intay wejigooda dhulka saareen ayay Ilaah caabudeen,
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

kikuyu: iyagoo leh, Aamiin; Ilaahayagu weligiis iyo weligiis ha lahaado barako, iyo ammaan, iyo xigmad, iyo mahad, iyo ciso, iyo xoog, iyo itaal. Aamiin.
english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

kikuyu: Oo odayaashii midkood baa jawaabay oo wuxuu igu yidhi, Kuwan khamiisyada cadcad qabaa yay yihiin, xaggee bayse ka yimaadeen?
english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

kikuyu: Oo waxaan ku idhi, Sayidkaygiiyow, waad taqaan. Markaasuu wuxuu igu yidhi, Kuwanu waa kuwii ka soo baxay dhibaatadii weynayd, oo waxay khamiisyadoodii ku maydheen oo ku caddeeyeen dhiiggii Wanka.
english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

kikuyu: Sidaas daraaddeed waxay joogaan carshiga Ilaah hortiisa; oo waxay isaga ugu adeegaan macbudkiisa habeen iyo maalinba; oo kan carshiga ku fadhiyaana wuxuu dushooda ka dhisan doonaa taambuuggiisa.
english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

kikuyu: Oo iyana mar dambe ma ay gaajoon doonaan, mana ay harraadi doonaan mar dambe, qorraxda iyo kulaylkuna kuma ay dhici doonaan;
english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

kikuyu: waayo, Wanka carshiga badhtankiisa jooga ayaa wuxuu ahaan doonaa adhijirkooda, oo wuxuu iyaga u hoggaamin doonaa ilaha biyaha nolosha; oo Ilaahna indhahooda ilmo kastuu ka tirtiri doonaa.
english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

kikuyu: Oo haddana markuu furay shaabaddii toddobaad, intii nus saac ah waxaa samada ka dhacday aamusnaan.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

kikuyu: Markaasaan waxaan arkay toddobadii malaa'igood oo Ilaah hortiisa taagan, oo waxaa la siiyey toddoba buun.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaa timid malaa'ig kale, oo waxay is-ag taagtay meeshii allabariga, iyadoo haysata idan dahab ah, oo waxaa la siiyey foox badan si ay ugu darto baryadii quduusiinta oo dhan oo ay ugu shiddo meeshii allabariga oo dahabka ahayd oo carshiga hortiisa tiil.
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

kikuyu: Oo qiiqii fooxa oo ay baryadii quduusiintu la socoto ayaa wuxuu ka baxay gacantii malaa'igta oo wuxuu kor u aaday Ilaah hortiis.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaa'igtii waxay qaadatay idankii, oo waxay ka buuxisay dabkii meesha allabariga, kolkaasay waxay ku tuurtay dhulka; markaasaa waxaa dhacay onkod, iyo codad, iyo hillaac, iyo dhulgariir.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

kikuyu: Markaasaa toddobadii malaa'igood oo toddobada buun haystay waxay isu diyaariyeen inay ka dhawaajiyaan.
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

kikuyu: Malaa'igtii kowaad ayaa ka dhawaajisay, markaasaa waxaa soo dhacay roob dhagaxyaale iyo dab dhiig ku dhex qasan yahay, oo waxaa lagu tuuray dhulka; markaasaa dunida saddex meelood oo meeli gubatay, oo dhirtana saddex meelood oo meel baa gubatay, oo cawskii qoyanaa oo dhammuna waa gubtay.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaa ka dhawaajisay malaa'igtii labaad, markaasaa waxaa badda lagu tuuray wax le'eg buur weyn oo dab ka ololayo; markaasaa baddii saddex meelood oo meel baa dhiig noqotay;
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

kikuyu: oo waxaa halkaas ku dhintay uunkii badda ku jiray oo nafta lahaa saddex meelood oo meel, oo doonniyihiina saddex meelood oo meel baa la baabbi'iyey.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaa ka dhawaajisay malaa'igtii saddexaad, markaasaa waxaa samada ka soo dhacday xiddig weyn oo sidii laambadeed u ololaysa, oo waxay ku dul dhacday webiyaasha saddex meelood oo meel, iyo ilihii biyaha ahaa;
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

kikuyu: oo xiddigta magaceedana waxaa la yidhaahdaa Qadhaadh; oo biyihiina saddex meelood oo meel baa qadhaadh noqotay; dad badanuna wuxuu ku dhintay biyihii, maxaa yeelay, qadhaadh baa laga dhigay.
english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaa ka dhawaajisay malaa'igtii afraad, markaasaa waxaa wax lagu dhuftay qorraxda saddex meelood oo meel, iyo dayaxa saddex meelood oo meel, iyo xiddigaha saddex meelood oo meel, in saddex meelood oo meeli ay gudcur noqoto, iyo in maalinta saddex meelood oo meeli aanay iftiimin, habeenkuna uu noqdo sidaas oo kale.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

kikuyu: Haddana waxaan arkay oon maqlay gorgor dhex duulaya samada isagoo cod weyn ku leh, Waxaa hoogay oo hoogay oo hoogay kuwa dhulka deggan, sababtuna waa buunanka dhawaaqooda hadhay oo saddexda malaa'igood ay dhowaan ka dhawaajin doonaan.
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaa ka dhawaajisay malaa'igtii shanaad, markaasaan arkay xiddig samada ka timid oo dhulka ku soo dhacday; oo waxaa iyadii la siiyey furihii ceelka yamayska.
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

kikuyu: Markaasay waxay furtay ceelkii yamayska, oo ceelkii waxaa kor uga soo baxay qiiq u eg qiiq foorno weyn; oo qiiqii ceelka aawadiis ayaa qorraxdii iyo hawadiiba gudcur la noqdeen.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

kikuyu: Markaasaa qiiqii waxaa ka soo baxay oo dhulka ku soo degay ayax; oo waxaa iyagii la siiyey xoog sida hangarallayaasha dhulku ay xoog u leeyihiin.
english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa lagu yidhi, Waxba ha yeelina cawska dhulka iyo wax cagaar ah iyo geednaba, dadka aan shaabadda Ilaah wejiga ku lahayn mooyaane.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaa lagu amray inaanay dadka dilin, laakiinse inay intii shan bilood ah xanuujiyaan, oo xanuunkooduna wuxuu ahaa sida xanuunka hangarallahu markuu nin qaniino.
english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

kikuyu: Oo ayaamahaasna dadku waxay doondooni doonaan dhimasho, oo sinaba uma ay heli doonaan, oo waxay jeclaan doonaan inay dhintaan, laakiinse dhimashadu way ka carari doontaa iyaga.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

kikuyu: Oo ayaxa qaabkiisuna wuxuu u ekaa fardo dagaal loo diyaariyey; oo madaxana waxaa u saarnaa taajaj dahab u eg, oo wejiyadooduna waxay u ekaayeen wejiyo dad.
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

kikuyu: Oo waxay lahaayeen timo u eg timo dumar; ilkahooduna waxay u ekaayeen ilko libaax.
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

kikuyu: Oo waxay lahaayeen laabdhawr u eg laabdhawr bir ah; oo sanqadha baallahooduna waxay u ekayd sanqadh fardo badan oo dagaal ku yaacaya gaadhifardoodkood.
english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

kikuyu: Oo waxay lahaayeen dabo u eg hangarallayaasha dabadooda iyo miciyo; oo dabadoodana waxay ku lahaayeen xoog ay dadka wax ku yeelaan intii shan bilood ah.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

kikuyu: Oo waxaa iyaga boqor u ah malagga yamayska; oo magiciisana afka Cibraaniga waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa Abaddoon; afka Gariiggana magiciisa waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa Abolyoon.
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

kikuyu: Hooggii kowaad wuu dhammaaday; oo bal eeg, weli waxaa dhiman oo hadda ka dib imanaya laba hoog oo kale.
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaa ka dhawaajisay malaa'igtii lixaad, markaasaan maqlay cod ka yeedhaya geesihii girgirihii allabariga oo dahabka ahaa oo Ilaah hor yaal,
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

kikuyu: oo ku lahaa malaa'igtii lixaad oo buunka haysatay, Fur afarta malaa'igood oo ku ag xidhan webiga weyn oo Yufraad.
english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa la furay afartii malaa'igood oo loo diyaariyey saacadda iyo maalinta iyo bisha iyo sannadda inay laayaan dadka saddex meelood oo meel.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

kikuyu: Oo tiradii ciidankii fardooleyda ahaa waxay ahayd labaatan kun oo meelood oo min toban kun ah; oo anigu waan maqlay tiradoodii.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

kikuyu: Oo sidaasaa waxaan tusintii ku arkay fardihii iyo kuwii fuushanaa oo qaba laabdhawr u eg dab iyo dhagax yakintos iyo baaruud; oo fardaha madaxyadooduna waxay u ekaayeen madaxyo libaax; oo afafkoodana waxaa ka soo baxayay dab iyo qiiq iyo baaruud.
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

kikuyu: Oo dadkii saddex meelood oo meel waxaa lagu dilay saddexdan belaayo oo ah dabka iyo qiiqa iyo baaruudda afkoodii ka soo baxay.
english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

kikuyu: Waayo, fardaha xooggoodu wuxuu ku jiray afkooda iyo dabadooda, waayo, dabadoodu waxay u ekayd abeesooyin, oo waxay lahaayeen madaxyo, oo kuwaasay dadka wax ku yeeli jireen.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

kikuyu: Oo dadkii hadhay oo aan lagu dilin saddexdaas belaayo, kama ay toobadkeenin shuqulladii gacmahooda, si ayan u caabudin jinniyo, iyo sanamyo dahab ah, iyo kuwo lacag ah, iyo kuwo naxaas ah, iyo kuwo dhagax ah, iyo kuwo qoryo ah, oo aan wax arki karin, waxna maqli karin, soconna karin;
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

kikuyu: kamana ay toobadkeenin diliddoodii iyo saaxirnimadoodii iyo sinadoodii iyo tuugnimadoodii.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaan arkay malaa'ig kale oo xoog weyn oo samada ka soo degaysa, iyadoo daruur huwan, madaxeedana waxaa saarnaa qaansoroobaad, wejigeeduna wuxuu u ekaa qorraxda oo kale, cagaheeduna waxay u ekaayeen tiirar dab ah,
english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

kikuyu: oo gacanteedana waxay ku haysatay buug yar oo furan. Oo cagteedii midig waxay saartay badda, teedii bidixdana waxay saartay dhulka,
english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

kikuyu: oo markaasay ku dhawaaqday cod weyn oo u eg libaax ciyaya, oo markay qaylisay ayaa toddobadii onkodba onkodeen.
english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

kikuyu: Oo markii toddobadii onkod onkodeen, waxaan ku dhowaa inaan wax qoro; markaasaan maqlay cod samada ka leh, Shaabad ku xidh waxyaalaha toddobada onkod ay ku onkodeen, oo ha qorin.
english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa malaa'igtii aan arkay oo ku taagnayd badda iyo dhulka ayaa gacanteedii midig samada kor ugu taagtay,
english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

kikuyu: oo inaan wakhti mar dambe jirayn ayay ugu dhaaratay kan weligiis iyo weligiisba nool, oo abuuray samada iyo waxyaalaha ku dhex jira, iyo dhulka iyo waxyaalaha ku dhex jira, iyo badda iyo waxyaalaha ku dhex jiraba.
english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

kikuyu: Laakiinse wakhtiga codka malaa'igta toddobaad markay ku dhow dahay inay ka dhawaajiso ayaa waxaa dhammaan doona qarsoodiga Ilaah siduu ugu bishaareeyey nebiyadii addoommadiisa ahaa.
english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

kikuyu: Oo haddana waxaan mar kale maqlay codkii aan samada ka maqlay oo igu leh, Tag oo qaado buugga furan oo ku jira gacanta malaa'igta ku taagan badda iyo dhulka.
english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

kikuyu: Markaasaan malaa'igtii u tegey, oo waxaan ku idhi, Buugga yar i sii. Markaasay igu tidhi, Qaado oo cun; oo wuxuu calooshaada ka dhigi doonaa qadhaadh, laakiin intuu afkaaga ku jiro wuxuu u macaanaan doonaa sida malab oo kale.
english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

kikuyu: Markaasaan buuggii yaraa ka qaatay malaa'igta gacanteedii, waanan cunay, oo intuu afkayga ku jiray wuxuu u macaanaa sida malab oo kale; oo markii aan cunay ayaa calooshaydii qadhaadh noqotay.
english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

kikuyu: Oo iyana waxay igu tidhi. Waa inaad mar kale wax ka sii sheegtid dad badan iyo quruumo badan iyo afaf badan iyo boqorro badan.
english: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa lay siiyey cawsduur ul u eg, oo waxaa laygu yidhi, Sara joogso, oo qiyaas macbudka Ilaah, iyo meesha allabariga, iyo kuwa Ilaah ku caabuda meeshaas.
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

kikuyu: Oo barxadda macbudka dibaddiisa ku taal iska daa, oo ha qiyaasin; waayo, iyada waxaa la siiyey quruumaha; oo magaalada quduuska ahna waxay ku tuman doonaan intii laba iyo afartan bilood ah.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

kikuyu: Oo labadayda markhaati waxaan siin doonaa xoog ay wax ku sii sheegaan kun iyo laba boqol iyo lixdan maalmood, iyagoo jawaanno qaba.
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

kikuyu: Oo kuwanu waa labada geed oo saytuunka ah iyo labada laambadood oo hor taagan Rabbiga dhulka.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

kikuyu: Oo haddii nin damco inuu wax yeelo, dab baa afkooda ka soo bixi doona oo gubi doona cadaawayaashooda; oo haddii nin damco inuu wax yeelo, waa in saas loo dilo.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

kikuyu: Kuwanu waxay leeyihiin amar ay samada ku xidhaan, si aan roob u di'in inta ay wax sii sheegayaan, oo waxay kaloo leeyihiin amar ay biyaha dhiig kaga dhigaan oo ay dhulkana ugu soo dejiyaan belaayo kasta mar alla markii ay doonayaan.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

kikuyu: Oo markii ay dhammeeyaan markhaatifuridda waxaa la diriri doonaa bahalka yamayska ka soo bixi doona, oo wuu ka adkaan doonaa, wuuna dili doonaa iyaga.
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

kikuyu: Oo meydadkoodu waxay oolli doonaan jidka magaalada weyn oo xagga ruuxa laga yidhaahdo Sodom iyo Masar, halkaasoo Rabbigooda iskutallaabta lagu qodbay.
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

kikuyu: Oo saddex maalmood iyo badh ayaa waxaa meydadkooda daawan doona dad ka yimid dadadka iyo qabiilooyinka iyo afafka iyo quruumaha; oo umana ay oggolaan doonaan in meydadkooda qabri la geliyo.
english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

kikuyu: Oo kuwa dhulka degganuna way ku farxi doonaan oo rayrayn doonaan, oo midkoodba midka kale wuxuu u diri doonaa hadiyado; maxaa yeelay, labadan nebi waxay saxariiriyeen kuwa dhulka deggan.
english: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

kikuyu: Oo saddex maalmood iyo badh dabadeed waxaa iyaga soo gashay neeftii nolosha oo xagga Ilaah ka timid, markaasay cagahoodii ku istaageen; oo kuwii iyaga daawadayna waxaa ku soo degtay cabsi weyn.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

kikuyu: Oo waxay samada ka maqleen cod weyn oo ku leh, Halkan soo fuula. Markaasay samada tegeen iyagoo daruur ku dhex jira, oo cadaawayaashoodiina way arkeen.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

kikuyu: Oo saacaddaasna waxaa dhacay dhulgariir weyn, oo magaaladii toban meelood oo meel ayaa duntay; oo dhulgariirkii wuxuu dilay toddoba kun oo qof, oo intoodii kalena way cabsadeen, oo waxay ammaaneen Ilaaha samada.
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

kikuyu: Oo hooggii labaadna wuu dhammaaday; oo bal eeg, hooggii saddexaadna dhaqsuu u imanayaa.
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

kikuyu: Markaasaa waxaa ka dhawaajisay malaa'igtii toddobaad, oo waxaa samada ka yeedhay codad waaweyn, oo waxay yidhaahdeen, Boqortooyadii dunidu waxay noqotay boqortooyadii Rabbigeenna iyo Masiixiisa, oo isna boqor buu ahaan doonaa weligiis iyo weligiis.
english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

kikuyu: Oo afar iyo labaatankii oday oo carshiyadooda ku fadhiyey Ilaah hortiisa way dhaceen, oo intay wejigooda dhulka saareen, ayay Ilaah caabudeen, iyagoo leh,
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

kikuyu: Rabbiyow Ilaaha Qaadirkaa oo jira oo jirayow, mahad baannu kuu naqaynaa; maxaa yeelay, waxaad qaadatay xooggaagii weynaa, oo wax baad xukuntay.
